A 40-day feeding trial was then conducted with 20-day-old goat kids. Compared to conventional feed, FF increased feed digestibility, body weight and carcass weight. Mechanistically, FF enhanced the interactions among rumen microbes and increased the gene abundance related to carbohydrate and AA metabolism. The FF then upregulated expression of mitochondrial respiratory chain-related genes in the rumen epithelium, thereby improving epithelial energy metabolism. Overall, this study shows that fermented feed optimized by microbial consortium improves goat kid growth and carcass quality through the fermented feed-rumen microbiota axis, offering a sustainable approach for ruminant production.
articles.abstractZh: 通过发酵对饲料进行预处理以提高其营养价值对于幼龄反刍动物来说是有效的。本研究利用酿酒酵母、地衣芽孢杆菌和粪肠球菌组成的微生物群落优化发酵饲料，并探讨其对山羊幼崽生长性能和瘤胃功能的影响机制。地衣芽孢杆菌是FF营养价值最关键的决定因素。优化的 FF 具有更高水平的粗蛋白、钙、磷和限制性氨基酸 (AA)。 FF 包含多样性较低但均匀度较高的活微生物群。通过提高乳酸明串珠菌和乳酸乳球菌的丰度，丰富了微生物群的 AA 和碳水化合物代谢。然后对 20 天大的小山羊进行了为期 40 天的喂养试验。与传统饲料相比，FF 提高了饲料消化率、体重和胴体重量。从机制上讲，FF 增强了瘤胃微生物之间的相互作用，并增加了与碳水化合物和 AA 代谢相关的基因丰度。然后FF上调瘤胃上皮中线粒体呼吸链相关基因的表达，从而改善上皮能量代谢

articles.title: Modulation of grape must vitamin content by oenological treatments affects Saccharomyces cerevisiae fermentation performance and wine volatile composition.
articles.titleZh: 通过酿酒处理调节葡萄汁维生素含量会影响酿酒酵母的发酵性能和葡萄酒的挥发性成分。
articles.authors: Garces F, Picart J, Bosaro M, Riviere E, Morge C, Alexandre H, Roullier-Gall C.
articles.abstract: This study explores the impact of oenological treatments with fining agents or yeast-based nutrients on the vitamin content of grape musts, and thus on the fermentative performance of Saccharomyces cerevisiae yeasts and the volatile composition of wine. Products such as bentonites and oenological carbons were shown to deplete several B-group vitamins from the must, while yeast derivatives were able to release significant amounts. Bentonite was used to modulate the vitamin B1 (thiamine) content of a real must and different yeast inoculation procedures were evaluated: active dry yeast and cells precultivated in order to modulate their physiological state and intracellular B1 pool. A significant impact of initial thiamine on fermentative activity was observed, while the effect of inoculation seemed to be linked to the adaptation of yeasts to liquid medium rather than intracellular B1. Thiamine availability was linked to an overall increase in volatile compound production. B1 addition to a bentonite treated must restored the volatile profile of the untreated control, suggesting that thiamine depletion is a major factor underlying the effects of bentonite treatment on wine volatile composition. These results allowed to identify the mechanisms by which fining agents can modify wine characteristics while confirming thiamine's importance in vinification processes.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了使用澄清剂或酵母营养物质进行酿酒处理对葡萄汁维生素含量的影响，从而对酿酒酵母的发酵性能和葡萄酒的挥发性成分产生影响。膨润土和酿酒碳等产品被证明会消耗葡萄汁中的多种 B 族维生素，而酵母衍生物能够释放大量维生素。使用膨润土来调节真实葡萄汁中的维生素 B1（硫胺素）含量，并评估不同的酵母接种程序：活性干酵母和预培养的细胞，以调节其生理状态和细胞内 B1 库。观察到初始硫胺素对发酵活性的显​​着影响，而接种的效果似乎与酵母对液体培养基的适应有关，而不是与细胞内 B1 的适应有关。硫胺素的可用性与挥发性化合物产量的总体增加有关。在膨润土中添加 B1 必须恢复未处理对照的挥发性特征，这表明硫胺素消耗是膨润土处理对葡萄酒挥发性成分影响的一个主要因素

articles.title: Adaptive Spo11 RNA editing gate optimizes meiosis I pace and mitotic proliferation while preserving ascospore formation.
articles.titleZh: 自适应 Spo11 RNA 编辑门可优化减数分裂 I 速度和有丝分裂增殖，同时保留子囊孢子形成。
articles.authors: Wu M, Liu J, Han J, Huang J, Feng C, Jiang C, Xu JR, Wang Q, Liu H.
articles.abstract: Spo11-mediated DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs) are essential for meiotic recombination, yet how Spo11 activity is temporally regulated during mitosis and fungal development remains unclear. In the fungal plant pathogen Fusarium graminearum, we found that FgSpo11 has a DSB-independent role delaying meiosis I and a DSB-dependent role critical for postmeiotic mitoses during ascosporogenesis. Loss of FgSpo11 accelerates meiosis I and causes excessive postmeiotic divisions, ultimately causing aborted ascospores. A premature stop codon (TAG) is corrected to tryptophan (TGG) by adenosine-to-inosine RNA editing exclusively during sexual reproduction, enabling full-length protein synthesis. A genomically "corrected" allele bypassing this editing preserves ascospore formation but causes meiotic and vegetative mitotic defects. Beyond its on-switch function, this editing acts as a tunable rheostat fine-tuning FgSpo11 dosage during meiosis. Evolutionary analyses reveal recurrent gain and loss of this editing, highlighting adaptive modulation of Spo11 deployment. This study uncovers a single-site RNA editing gate controlling a key meiotic regulator and illustrates transcriptome plasticity in reconciling life cycle demands in eukaryotic pathogens.
articles.abstractZh: Spo11 介导的 DNA 双链断裂 (DSB) 对于减数分裂重组至关重要，但 Spo11 活性在有丝分裂和真菌发育过程中如何暂时调节仍不清楚。在真菌植物病原体禾谷镰刀菌中，我们发现 FgSpo11 具有延迟减数分裂 I 的 DSB 独立作用，以及对子囊孢子发生过程中减数分裂后有丝分裂至关重要的 DSB 依赖性作用。 FgSpo11 的缺失会加速减数分裂 I 并导致减数分裂后过度分裂，最终导致子囊孢子流产。仅在有性生殖过程中，通过腺苷至肌苷 RNA 编辑将过早终止密码子 (TAG) 纠正为色氨酸 (TGG)，从而实现全长蛋白质合成。绕过这种编辑的基因组“校正”等位基因保留了子囊孢子的形成，但导致减数分裂和营养有丝分裂缺陷。除了其开关功能外，这种编辑还充当可调变阻器，在减数分裂期间微调 FgSpo11 剂量。进化分析揭示了这种编辑的反复增益和损失，强调了 Spo11 部署的自适应调制。这项研究揭示了控制关键减数分裂调节因子的单位点 RNA 编辑门，并说明了转录组可塑性

articles.title: Discovery of a [4Fe-4S] cluster in the PRRSV Nsp1α leader protease reveals host-virus interplay in its downstream functions.
articles.titleZh: PRRSV Nsp1α 前导蛋白酶中 [4Fe-4S] 簇的发现揭示了宿主-病毒在其下游功能中的相互作用。
articles.authors: Quist T, Buzuk A, Nguyen HT, Takeoka K, Bak DW, Weerapana E, Perlstein DL, Pandelia ME.
articles.abstract: Porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome virus (PRRSV; Betaarterivirus suid) is a major global threat to swine production, yet effective antiviral therapies are lacking. The leader protease Nsp1α is essential for viral replication and innate immune suppression, and its N-terminal zinc-finger (ZF) domain is critical for function, although its molecular role remains unclear. Here, we show that the ZF domain plays only a minor role in protease activity and that Nsp1α is largely inactive following release from the polyprotein. Using Mössbauer and UV/visible spectroscopy combined with chemoproteomics, we demonstrate that the ZF site binds not only Zn but also a [4Fe-4S] cluster. Notably, the Fe-S cluster, but not Zn, allosterically modulates residual protease activity. Nsp1α directly engages the cytosolic iron-sulfur cluster assembly machinery via CIAO1 and competes with the Fe-S carrier CIAO3, establishing the [4Fe-4S] cluster as a bona fide cofactor. These findings redefine Nsp1α as an Fe-S-dependent viral protein and reveal previously unidentified opportunities for metal-targeted antiviral strategies.
articles.abstractZh: 猪繁殖与呼吸综合征病毒（PRRSV；猪β动脉病毒）是全球养猪生产的主要威胁，但缺乏有效的抗病毒疗法。前导蛋白酶 Nsp1α 对于病毒复制和先天免疫抑制至关重要，其 N 末端锌指 (ZF) 结构域对于功能至关重要，尽管其分子作用仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明 ZF 结构域在蛋白酶活性中仅发挥次要作用，并且 Nsp1α 在从多蛋白释放后基本上没有活性。使用穆斯堡尔和紫外/可见光谱与化学蛋白质组学相结合，我们证明 ZF 位点不仅结合 Zn，还结合 [4Fe-4S] 簇。值得注意的是，Fe-S 簇（而非 Zn）以变构方式调节残余蛋白酶活性。 Nsp1α 通过 CIAO1 直接参与细胞质铁硫簇组装机制，并与 Fe-S 载体 CIAO3 竞争，将 [4Fe-4S] 簇建立为真正的辅助因子。这些发现将 Nsp1α 重新定义为一种 Fe-S 依赖性病毒蛋白，并揭示了以前未发现的金属靶向抗病毒策略的机会。

articles.title: Mitochondria directly interact with the nuclear pore complex.
articles.titleZh: 线粒体直接与核孔复合体相互作用。
articles.authors: Menendez-Montes I, Marin-Vicente C, Mukherjee S, Ahmed MS, Gomez MJ, Anene-Nzelu CG, Lee CJM, Koslowski S, Solmonson A, Tassin T, Ali SR, Pessoa P, Elnwasany A, Lam NT, Thet S, Calvo E, Cardoso AC, Pereira AHM, Xiao F, Wang P, Mohamed A, El-Feky H, Elghamry A, Gancedo-Alonso G, Nguyen NUN, Hsu CC, Westfall AK, DeBerardinis R, Foo RS, Kinter M, Pressé S, Xing C, Szweda L, Aroumougame A, Sanchez-Cabo F, Enriquez JA, Torres M, Vazquez J, Sadek HA.
articles.abstract: Mitochondria regulate cellular processes through direct and indirect interactions with other organelles. A well-studied example has been contact with the endoplasmic reticulum at mitochondrial-associated endoplasmic reticulum membranes1, which control pathways including redox and calcium homeostasis2,3. Recent studies have also reported direct mitochondria-nuclear membrane contacts in cancer cells and yeast that promote pro-survival signalling4,5. Here we identify direct interactions between mitochondria and nuclear pores. Using two unbiased proteomic screens, GST pulldown and BioID, we found that VDAC1 was the top mitochondrial candidate that interacts with the filamentous nuclear pore protein RANBP2. In vitro RANBP2 CRISPR knockout, RANBP2 truncation or site-directed mutagenesis of RANBP2-VDAC1 interacting amino acids resulted in reduced mitochondria-nucleus proximity and decreased nuclear ATP and phosphocreatine levels. This was accompanied by a decline in the levels of the nuclear phosphoproteome and downregulation of pathways involved in histone modification, cellular differentiation and transcriptional regulation in vitro. Moreover, deletion of the RANBP2 C-terminal domain in vivo in mice resulted in embryonic lethality due to cardiac and neural crest differentiation defects. Collectively, these results describe a mechanism by which mitochondria directly interact with the nuclear pore complex, a phenomenon critical for regulation of nuclear energetics and cellular differentiation. Undoubtedly, additional roles of this interaction remain to be revealed.
articles.abstractZh: 线粒体通过与其他细胞器的直接和间接相互作用来调节细胞过程。一个经过充分研究的例子是线粒体相关内质网膜与内质网的接触1，它控制包括氧化还原和钙稳态在内的途径2,3。最近的研究还报道了癌细胞和酵母中线粒体与核膜的直接接触，促进了促生存信号传导 4,5。在这里，我们确定了线粒体和核孔之间的直接相互作用。使用两种无偏蛋白质组筛选（GST pulldown 和 BioID），我们发现 VDAC1 是与丝状核孔蛋白 RANBP2 相互作用的顶级线粒体候选者。体外 RANBP2 CRISPR 敲除、RANBP2 截短或 RANBP2-VDAC1 相互作用氨基酸的定点诱变导致线粒体-细胞核接近度降低以及核 ATP 和磷酸肌酸水平降低。伴随着核磷酸蛋白质组水平的下降以及参与组蛋白修饰、细胞分化和体外转录调节的途径的下调。此外，RANBP2 C 端结构域的缺失

articles.title: Navigating adoption barriers for microbial proteins in future food.
articles.titleZh: 克服未来食品中微生物蛋白的采用障碍。
articles.authors: Gnaim R, Kassim H, Neidhardt L, Gassler T, Ledesma-Amaro R.
articles.abstract: Microbial biomass fermentation, in which microbes are cultivated to produce nutrient-dense biomass, offers a scalable route to sustainable protein production with low land, water, and greenhouse gas footprints. However, its shift from a speciality to a mainstream food continues to be difficult. Here, we move beyond technological overviews and propose a three-phase adoption framework: novelty barrier, early trust-building, and mainstream normalisation. This framework organises techno-economic, regulatory, and infrastructural barriers into a single trajectory. We trace single-cell proteins' rise, decline and resurgence, map engineering and policy enablers by phase, and outline levers to move microbial proteins into resilient food systems.
articles.abstractZh: 微生物生物质发酵通过培养微生物来生产营养丰富的生物质，为可持续蛋白质生产提供了一条可扩展的途径，同时减少了土地、水和温室气体足迹。然而，它从特色食品向主流食品的转变仍然很困难。在这里，我们超越了技术概述，提出了一个三阶段的采用框架：新颖性障碍、早期建立信任和主流正常化。该框架将技术经济、监管和基础设施障碍组织成单一轨迹。我们追踪单细胞蛋白质的兴起、衰落和复兴，按阶段绘制工程和政策推动因素，并概述将微生物蛋白质转移到有弹性的食品系统中的杠杆。

articles.title: Semirandom DNA adducts regulate a filamentous defense-associated reverse transcriptase.
articles.titleZh: 半随机 DNA 加合物调节丝状防御相关逆转录酶。
articles.authors: Neville N, Johnson NV, Escobar EE, Chiang CH, Nreca A, Johnson SR, Dai N, Hanneman A, Corrêa IR, McLellan JS, Trachman RJ.
articles.abstract: Retrons and several defense-associated reverse transcriptases (DRTs) synthesize non-genomic DNA for bacteriophage immunity. In some instances, this non-genomic DNA is of undefined, semirandom sequence. How undefined DNA sequences impart antiphage defense is not known. Herewe report the cryo-EM structure and functional characterization of the DRT1 antiphage defense system. We show that DRT1 performs template-free, protein-primed DNA synthesis to generate semirandom DNA adducts. DNA synthesis activates the nitrilase domain of DRT1, while DNA adducts drive the assembly of quiescent DRT1 filaments. Filamentous DRT1 is composed of domain-swapped C termini that are entwined, forming pseudoknots between tetrameric stacks. This configuration occludes conserved active-site residues, resulting in a dormant state. Bacteriophage escape mutants identify a T4 single-stranded DNA helicase required for DRT1 activity. Functionally, DRT1 resembles a minimal retron where a single gene produces a reverse transcriptase, effector and non-genomic antitoxin DNA.
articles.abstractZh: 逆转录子和几种防御相关逆转录酶 (DRT) 合成非基因组 DNA 以实现噬菌体免疫。在一些情况下，这种非基因组DNA具有未定义的、半随机的序列。未定义的 DNA 序列如何赋予抗噬菌体防御尚不清楚。在此，我们报告了 DRT1 抗噬菌体防御系统的冷冻电镜结构和功能表征。我们证明 DRT1 执行无模板、蛋白质引发的 DNA 合成，以生成半随机 DNA 加合物。 DNA 合成激活 DRT1 的腈水解酶结构域，而 DNA 加合物驱动静止 DRT1 丝的组装。丝状 DRT1 由结构域交换的 C 末端缠绕而成，在四聚体堆叠之间形成假结。这种结构封闭了保守的活性位点残基，导致休眠状态。噬菌体逃逸突变体鉴定出 DRT1 活性所需的 T4 单链 DNA 解旋酶。从功能上讲，DRT1 类似于一个最小的逆转录子，其中单个基因产生逆转录酶、效应子和非基因组抗毒素 DNA。

articles.title: CLPX acquires an iron-sulfur cluster to sustain mitochondrial proteostasis in cancer cells.
articles.titleZh: CLPX 获得铁硫簇来维持癌细胞中的线粒体蛋白质稳态。
articles.authors: Huang C, Zhang Y, Gao H, Song Y, Hu S, Sun C, Duan S, Ma D, Jiang X, Liu G.
articles.abstract: Mitochondrial proteostasis-maintaining mechanisms are crucial for protecting cells from the toxicity of misfolded protein accumulation. Although excessive stress is known to inactivate these mechanisms and thereby induce mitophagy in cancer cells, the detailed molecular mechanisms coordinating these mitochondrial quality control processes remain unclear. Herein, we identify CLPX, a mitochondrial protease subunit, as an iron-sulfur protein, which requires a [4Fe-4S] cluster to bind with CLPP to exert proteolysis function. Iron chelation impairs the assembly of the [4Fe-4S] cluster onto CLPX, thereby disrupting mitochondrial proteostasis maintenance and inducing mitophagy. Furthermore, cysteine deprivation caused by excessive reactive oxygen species accumulation hinders iron-sulfur cluster biosynthesis, thereby undermining CLPX function and inducing mitophagy. Our research elucidates an iron-sulfur cluster-dependent mechanism sustaining mitochondrial proteostasis.
articles.abstractZh: 线粒体蛋白质稳态维持机制对于保护细胞免受错误折叠蛋白质积累的毒性至关重要。尽管已知过度压力会使这些机制失活，从而诱导癌细胞发生线粒体自噬，但协调这些线粒体质量控制过程的详细分子机制仍不清楚。在此，我们将线粒体蛋白酶亚基 CLPX 鉴定为铁硫蛋白，其需要 [4Fe-4S] 簇与 CLPP 结合才能发挥蛋白水解功能。铁螯合会损害 [4Fe-4S] 簇在 CLPX 上的组装，从而破坏线粒体蛋白质稳态的维持并诱导线粒体自噬。此外，过多的活性氧积累导致的半胱氨酸剥夺阻碍了铁硫簇的生物合成，从而破坏了 CLPX 功能并诱导线粒体自噬。我们的研究阐明了维持线粒体蛋白质稳态的铁硫簇依赖性机制。

articles.title: Prion-based protein self-assembly tunes mutagenesis to enable rapid adaptation.
articles.titleZh: 基于朊病毒的蛋白质自组装可调节诱变以实现快速适应。
articles.authors: Van Elgort A, Jakobson CM, Chen YR, Byers JS, Futia RA, Lozanoski TM, Harvey ZH, Xie JL, Garcia DM, Jarosz DF.
articles.abstract: Mutations supply the raw material for evolution, yet because most are neutral or deleterious, elevated mutation rates are typically transient. Nonetheless, modeling predicts that a mechanism for heritable but reversible "mutagenesis switches" would be advantageous in some selective contexts. Here, we report that frequent prion-based switching of DNA repair and recombination proteins alters mutagenesis in Saccharomyces cerevisiae populations from diverse ecological niches, including the laboratory and clinic, providing adaptive benefits in short-term evolution under strong selective pressure. Self-templating protein assembly alters the activities and interactions of multiple DNA-fidelity factors, reshaping adaptive outcomes while maintaining resilience to genotoxic stress. In the WHO priority pathogen Candida albicans, which diverged from S. cerevisiae ∼300 million years ago, a key regulator of prion inheritance accelerates the rapid emergence of fluconazole resistance. These findings suggest that protein self-assembly can generate epigenetic memory that tunes genome diversification over multiple generations, enabling rapid adaptation in challenging environments.
articles.abstractZh: 突变为进化提供了原材料，但由于大多数突变是中性或有害的，因此突变率升高通常是暂时的。尽管如此，模型预测可遗传但可逆的“诱变开关”机制在某些选择性环境中将是有利的。在这里，我们报告说，频繁的基于朊病毒的DNA修复和重组蛋白转换改变了来自不同生态位（包括实验室和诊所）的酿酒酵母种群的诱变，在强选择压力下为短期进化提供了适应性益处。自模板蛋白质组装改变了多种 DNA 保真度因子的活动和相互作用，重塑适应性结果，同时保持对基因毒性应激的恢复能力。世界卫生组织优先病原体白色念珠菌（Candida albicans）在约 3 亿年前从酿酒酵母（S. cerevisiae）分化而来，朊病毒遗传的关键调节因子加速了氟康唑耐药性的迅速出现。这些发现表明，蛋白质自组装可以产生表观遗传记忆，调节多代基因组的多样性，从而能够在充满挑战的环境中快速适应。

articles.title: Heterodera schachtii enolase does not elicit canonical immune responses in Arabidopsis thaliana.
articles.titleZh: Heterodera schachtii 烯醇酶不会在拟南芥中引起典型的免疫反应。
articles.authors: Euler MF, Sumaya NPDN, Aslam S, Lerch J, Mendy B, Grundler FMW.
articles.abstract: Enolase (2-phospho-D-glycerate hydrolase, EC 4.2.1.11) is a conserved glycolytic enzyme that catalyzes the reversible dehydration of 2-phosphoglycerate to phosphoenolpyruvate. In animal- and entomopathogenic nematodes, enolase has been shown to interact with host organisms and activate immune responses. In the plant-parasitic cyst nematode Heterodera schachtii, an established model species, enolase is hypothesized to be similarly exposed to host plant tissues during infection, based on its identification in the secretomes of related plant-parasitic nematodes. Unlike animals, plants lack an adaptive immune system and instead rely on innate immune responses to detect pathogen-derived molecules. Therefore, we investigated whether H. schachtii enolase can activate plant immune responses and influence growth and development in its host, Arabidopsis thaliana. Recombinant H. schachtii enolase was heterologously expressed in Escherichia coli and confirmed to be enzymatically active. Treatment of A. thaliana seedlings with purified enolase did not induce reactive oxygen species production, a hallmark of early plant immune activation. A concentration of 85 [Formula: see text]g/ml had no effect on plant growth; only at the highest applied concentrations (425-850 [Formula: see text]g/ml) was shoot growth reduced, while root growth remained unaffected. Consistently, quantitative PCR analysis of canonical defense marker genes (FRK1, NHL10, PAD3, CYP81F2, and JAZ10) showed no robust transcriptional activation of plant immune pathways. Together, these results indicate that H. schachtii enolase does not function as an elicitor of canonical plant immune responses.
articles.abstractZh: 烯醇化酶（2-磷酸-D-甘油酸水解酶，EC 4.2.1.11）是一种保守的糖酵解酶，可催化 2-磷酸甘油酸可逆脱水为磷酸烯醇丙酮酸。在动物和昆虫病原线虫中，烯醇酶已被证明可以与宿主生物体相互作用并激活免疫反应。在植物寄生胞囊线虫 Heterodera schachtii（一种已建立的模式物种）中，根据相关植物寄生线虫分泌体中的鉴定，假设烯醇酶在感染过程中类似地暴露于宿主植物组织。与动物不同，植物缺乏适应性免疫系统，而是依赖先天免疫反应来检测病原体衍生的分子。因此，我们研究了 H. schachtii 烯醇酶是否可以激活植物免疫反应并影响其宿主拟南芥的生长和发育。重组 H. schachtii 烯醇酶在大肠杆菌中异源表达，并被证实具有酶活性。用纯化的烯醇酶处理拟南芥幼苗不会诱导活性氧的产生，而活性氧是早期植物免疫激活的标志。浓度85[分子式：见正文]g/ml没有效果

articles.title: An integration of bacterial probiotic extract and green nanoparticles as a safe approach for conservation of historical manuscript against fungal deterioration: an applied study.
articles.titleZh: 细菌益生菌提取物和绿色纳米粒子的整合作为保护历史手稿防止真菌恶化的安全方法：一项应用研究。
articles.authors: Abdel-Nasser M, Fouda A, Abdel-Maksoud G.
articles.abstract: This study focuses on integrations of an eco-friendly, cost effectiveness, and safe approach for conservation of historical manuscripts to avoid the risks from utilizing traditional conservation methods and synthetic fungicides, which pose dangerous effects on environment, human health, and materials of historical museums. Therefore, the deterioration aspects of an 11th-century historical manuscript, including its paper and leather binding, were assessed in relation to the influence of the corresponding fungal communities. Photographic documentation, scanning electron microscopy (SEM), X-ray diffraction (XRD), attenuated total reflectance Fourier-transform infrared (ATR-FTIR), color changes, and pH values in comparison to a control sample were used to examine the deterioration aspects. Dust, dirt, corrosion, stains, weakness, missing parts, decreasing paper crystal, changing cellulosic band wavenumbers, color change, and acidity were identified as the most degrading elements. Thirteen fungal strains were isolated from the historical manuscript and identified morphologically and molecularly as Aspergillus flavus (five isolates), A. chinensis (one isolate), Penicillium chrysogenum (one isolate), Cladosporium velox (one isolate), Paecilomyces variotii (two isolates), Paecilomyces brunneolus (one isolate), Curvularia tamilnaduensis (one isolate), and Curvularia geniculate (one isolate). These strains showed high activity for producing different hydrolytic enzymes involved in biodeterioration, including cellulase, amylase, gelatinase, and pectinase. The conservation of the historical manuscript against fungal deterioration was achieved using innovative and pioneering environmentally friendly biomaterials: Lactobacillus plantarum extract (100 µg mL⁻¹) followed by green-synthesized TiO₂-NPs (100 µg mL⁻¹). Other conservation techniques, such as cleaning, consolidation, completion of missed parts, and other necessary methods for the studied manuscript, were also applied and revealed the aesthetic value of the manuscript.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究的重点是整合生态友好、成本效益和安全的历史手稿保护方法，以避免使用传统保护方法和合成杀菌剂对环境、人类健康和历史博物馆材料造成危险影响的风险。因此，我们根据相应真菌群落的影响对 11 世纪历史手稿（包括纸张和皮革装订）的恶化情况进行了评估。使用照片记录、扫描电子显微镜 (SEM)、X 射线衍射 (XRD)、衰减全反射傅里叶变换红外 (ATR-FTIR)、颜色变化以及与对照样品相比的 pH 值来检查劣化方面。灰尘、污垢、腐蚀、污渍、弱点、缺失部件、纸张晶体减少、纤维素带波数变化、颜色变化和酸度被确定为最具降解性的元素。从历史手稿中分离出 13 株真菌，并从形态学和分子学角度鉴定为黄曲霉（5 个分离株）、中华曲霉（1 个分离株）、产黄青霉（0 个分离株）。

articles.title: A chromosome-level genome assembly of Lycoris radiata unveils evolutionary origin of Amaryllidaceae alkaloids and elucidates the complete pathway of galanthamine biosynthesis.
articles.titleZh: 石蒜的染色体水平基因组组装揭示了石蒜科生物碱的进化起源，并阐明了加兰他敏生物合成的完整途径。
articles.authors: Zhao Y, Zeng P, Lei P, Liu X, Chang H, Hu Y, Li Q, Zhao D, Peng Y, Fang F, He J, Jiang H, Cai J.
articles.abstract: Amaryllidaceae alkaloids (AmAs) are a structurally diverse class of specialized metabolites with substantial pharmacological importance, produced exclusively within the Amaryllidoideae subfamily. However, the limited availability of high-quality genomes from Amaryllidoideae plants has constrained systematic investigations of genes underlying AmAs biosynthesis. Here, we report a high-quality genome assembly of Lycoris radiata, which enabled the discovery of key downstream enzymes in the galanthamine biosynthetic pathway and uncovered reversible reactions between two critical metabolite pairs, providing new mechanistic insight into pathway architecture, and enabling reconstruction of the galanthamine biosynthetic pathway in Yarrowia lipolytica. The core genes for AmAs biosynthesis originated in ancestral angiosperms, and the complete pathway was assembled in the Amaryllidoideae subfamily through gene duplication and neofunctionalization. Furthermore, the tissue-specific accumulation of AmAs and the expression patterns of biosynthetic genes indicate that root tissues could play a role in AmA metabolism in Lycoris.
articles.abstractZh: 石蒜科生物碱 (AmAs) 是一类结构多样的特殊代谢物，具有重要的药理学重要性，仅在石蒜科亚科中产生。然而，来自石蒜科植物的高质量基因组的可用性有限，限制了对 AmAs 生物合成基因的系统研究。在这里，我们报告了石蒜的高质量基因组组装，这使得能够发现加兰他敏生物合成途径中的关键下游酶，并发现两个关键代谢物对之间的可逆反应，为途径结构提供新的机制见解，并能够重建解脂耶氏酵母中的加兰他敏生物合成途径。 AmAs生物合成的核心基因起源于祖先被子植物，完整的途径通过基因复制和新功能化在石蒜亚科中组装而成。此外，AmAs 的组织特异性积累和生物合成基因的表达模式表明，根组织可能在石蒜的 AmA 代谢中发挥作用。

articles.title: A minimal transcription factor network is sufficient to drive paclitaxel biosynthesis.
articles.titleZh: 最小的转录因子网络足以驱动紫杉醇生物合成。
articles.authors: Pan Q, Ochoa-Villarreal M, Howat S, Amir R, Yan Z, French CE, Loake GJ, Cui B.
articles.abstract: The supply of the anticancer drug paclitaxel is limited by its low natural abundance and complex chemical structure. We previously reported the development of a cultured Taxus cambial meristematic cell (CMC) system, where methyl jasmonate enhances paclitaxel production. In this report, we describe a comprehensive analysis to identify potential master regulators of paclitaxel biosynthesis. We report that the combined expression of two myeloblastosis transcription factors can cooperatively activate a subset of paclitaxel biosynthetic genes in stable transgenic CMCs, resulting in a 121-fold increase in paclitaxel and a 364-fold increase in its valuable precursor baccatin III. Our findings provide a powerful approach to enhancing production of this vital compound and can also be applied to other valuable products.
articles.abstractZh: 抗癌药物紫杉醇的供应因其天然丰度低且化学结构复杂而受到限制。我们之前报道了培养的红豆杉形成层分生细胞（CMC）系统的开发，其中茉莉酸甲酯增强了紫杉醇的产生。在本报告中，我们描述了一项综合分析，以确定紫杉醇生物合成的潜在主调节剂。我们报告说，两种成髓细胞增多症转录因子的联合表达可以协同激活稳定转基因CMC中的紫杉醇生物合成基因的子集，导致紫杉醇增加121倍，其有价值的前体浆果赤霉素III增加364倍。我们的研究结果提供了一种强大的方法来提高这种重要化合物的产量，并且也可以应用于其他有价值的产品。

articles.title: A sustained living coating for infectious keratitis therapy via probiotic consumption and production effects.
articles.titleZh: 通过益生菌的消耗和生产作用来治疗感染性角膜炎的持续活性涂层。
articles.authors: Xu M, Liu S, Zhou L, Zhang W, Lin H, Shum HC.
articles.abstract: Excessive inflammation and infection are critical factors leading to biomaterial failure and delayed wound healing. Surface modification of biomaterials with drug-loaded coatings can effectively address these issues. Traditional drug-loaded coatings often suffer from diminishing drug concentrations and the development of bacterial resistance. To address these issues, we developed a living coating using Lactobacillus plantarum as a metabolic factory for sustained anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects for up to 10 weeks. This innovative approach leverages continuous consumption and production effects. The consumption effect mitigates reactive oxygen species during inflammation, preventing inflammation-induced cell apoptosis, while the production effect releases various organic acids that combat bacteria and prevent resistance. Furthermore, the living coating demonstrates excellent in vitro and in vivo biocompatibility, with minimal hemolysis rate and absence of systemic toxicity. This versatile living coating has been successfully integrated onto corneal bandage, accelerating the healing process of infected corneal wounds.
articles.abstractZh: 过度炎症和感染是导致生物材料失效和伤口愈合延迟的关键因素。利用载药涂层对生物材料进行表面修饰可以有效解决这些问题。传统的载药涂层经常会遇到药物浓度降低和细菌耐药性产生的问题。为了解决这些问题，我们开发了一种活性涂层，使用植物乳杆菌作为代谢工厂，可持续抗炎和抗菌作用长达 10 周。这种创新方法利用了持续的消费和生产效应。消耗效应可减轻炎症过程中的活性氧，防止炎症诱导的细胞凋亡，而生产效应则释放各种有机酸，对抗细菌并防止耐药性。此外，活性涂层表现出优异的体外和体内生物相容性，具有最小的溶血率并且不存在全身毒性。这种多功能活性涂层已成功集成到角膜绷带上，加速了感染角膜伤口的愈合过程。

articles.title: Foliar spraying of Bradyrhizobium and Anabaena improve stress tolerance under deficit irrigation of Cowpea.
articles.titleZh: 叶面喷洒慢生根瘤菌和鱼腥藻可提高豇豆在缺水灌溉下的胁迫耐受性。
articles.authors: Elsadany AY, El-Nahrawy S.
articles.abstract: Water deficit is considered one of the most significant factors limiting cowpea productivity, necessitating sustainable strategies to improve crop tolerance to drought stress. This study investigated the effects of foliar application of Bradyrhizobium and Anabaena on the growth, physiological performance, and productivity of cowpea under different irrigation intervals. Under the 15-day irrigation interval (water-stressed condition), the combined Bradyrhizobium and Anabaena treatment increased total seed yield by more than 30% compared with the stressed untreated control. This confirms the strong role of the consortium in improving drought tolerance and productivity under limited irrigation. Anabaena was identified as Anabaena cylindrica using rpoC1 gene sequence analysis. Phytohormone content of A. cylindrica was quantified by HPLC and bioactive compounds from Bradyrhizobium sp. and A. cylindrica were detected by GC- MS. The study evaluated nodule number, leaf N, K, Na contents, K/Na ratio, chlorophyll, carotenoids, total soluble sugars (TSS), relative water content (RWC), proline concentration, antioxidant enzymes (APX and CAT), and soil enzyme activities (dehydrogenase and urease) along with yield components and total seed yield. Results showed that the consortium treatment significantly improved chlorophyll, carotenoids, TSS, and RWC, while reducing proline accumulation compared with stressed control. It also increased root nodulation, enhanced N and K uptake, reduced Na accumulation, and improved K/Na ratio. It stimulated CAT and APX activities in leaves and enhanced soil enzyme activities, leading to improved yield components and overall productivity under drought stress. These findings highlight the potential of combining Bradyrhizobium and Anabaena cylindrica as an eco-friendly and sustainable biostimulant strategy to enhance cowpea productivity and drought resilience under water-limited conditions.
articles.abstractZh: 缺水被认为是限制豇豆生产力的最重要因素之一，因此需要采取可持续战略来提高作物对干旱胁迫的耐受性。本研究调查了不同灌溉间隔下叶面喷施慢生根瘤菌和鱼腥藻对豇豆生长、生理性能和生产力的影响。在15天的灌溉间隔（水分胁迫条件）下，与胁迫的未处理对照相比，慢生根瘤菌和鱼腥藻联合处理使种子总产量增加了30%以上。这证实了该联盟在有限灌溉条件下提高耐旱性和生产力方面的强大作用。通过rpoC1基因序列分析，鱼腥藻被鉴定为圆筒鱼腥藻。通过 HPLC 和慢生根瘤菌 (Bradyrhizobium sp.) 的生物活性化合物对 A. cylindrica 的植物激素含量进行定量。和 A. cylindrica 通过 GC-MS 进行检测。该研究评估了根瘤数、叶片N、K、Na含量、K/Na比、叶绿素、类胡萝卜素、总可溶性糖（TSS）、相对含水量（RWC）、脯氨酸浓度、抗氧化酶（APX和CAT）以及土壤酶活性（脱氢酶和脲酶）

articles.title: The impactful role of the HDACs in the regulation of gene expression and as targets for disease therapy.
articles.titleZh: HDAC 在基因表达调节和作为疾病治疗靶点方面的重要作用。
articles.authors: Van Bree BA, Eichner LJ.
articles.abstract: Histone deacetylases (HDACs) are potent regulators of gene expression, yet incomplete understanding of individual HDAC function coupled with the lack of selective inhibitors has impeded successful targeting of these proteins for the improvement of human health. Although all HDAC proteins contain a deacetylase domain, the 18 distinct human HDAC proteins have remarkably distinct mechanisms of action. In a misleading oversimplification, HDACs are often thought to uniformly deacetylate histones to affect global gene expression in a functionally redundant manner. Instead, findings continue to define the distinct roles of individual HDACs, highlighting the potential value of data-driven precision targeting of individual HDACs or specific subclasses of HDACs for disease therapy. Here, we will discuss this decade's advances about how the zinc-dependent HDACs, HDAC1 to HDAC11, regulate gene expression in health and disease.
articles.abstractZh: 组蛋白脱乙酰酶 (HDAC) 是基因表达的有效调节剂，但对个体 HDAC 功能的不完全了解，加上选择性抑制剂的缺乏，阻碍了成功靶向这些蛋白质以改善人类健康。尽管所有 HDAC 蛋白均含有脱乙酰酶结构域，但 18 种不同的人类 HDAC 蛋白具有截然不同的作用机制。在一种误导性的过度简化中，HDAC 通常被认为能够使组蛋白均匀去乙酰化，从而以功能冗余的方式影响全局基因表达。相反，研究结果继续定义了个体 HDAC 的独特作用，强调了数据驱动的精确靶向个体 HDAC 或 HDAC 特定亚类对于疾病治疗的潜在价值。在这里，我们将讨论近十年来锌依赖性 HDAC（HDAC1 至 HDAC11）如何调节健康和疾病中的基因表达的进展。

articles.title: Elucidation of sugar metabolic profiles and transcriptional regulatory networks during the developmental stages of sweet corn kernels.
articles.titleZh: 阐明甜玉米粒发育阶段的糖代谢谱和转录调控网络。
articles.authors: Feng H, Guo J, Xu C, Li Z, Hu Z, Zhu J, Chen W, Qiu F, Xu C.
articles.abstract: Sweet corn is highly valued by consumers due to its desirable taste, which is largely influenced by sugar metabolism within the kernels. Despite its importance, the genetic and transcriptional regulatory mechanisms underlying sugar metabolism in sweet corn remain inadequately characterized. In this study, targeted profiling of sugar metabolism was conducted at three critical developmental stages of sweet corn kernels-the blister, milky, and waxy stages-using gas chromatography-mass spectrometry. Simultaneously, the direct RNA sequencing was employed to explore the complexity of transcriptional regulation throughout kernel development at the transcriptomic level, facilitating the construction of a regulatory network for sugar metabolism-related genes. The results indicated that variations in polyadenylation tail length may modulate sugar metabolism during kernel development by influencing transcript abundance. This study elucidates potential transcriptional regulatory pathways governing sugar metabolites in sweet corn kernels and provides foundational data to support precision breeding strategies.
articles.abstractZh: 甜玉米因其理想的口味而受到消费者的高度重视，而这在很大程度上受到籽粒内糖代谢的影响。尽管其重要性，但甜玉米糖代谢的遗传和转录调控机制仍然没有得到充分的表征。在这项研究中，利用气相色谱-质谱法对甜玉米粒的三个关键发育阶段（起泡阶段、乳化阶段和蜡质阶段）进行了糖代谢的有针对性的分析。同时，利用直接RNA测序在转录组水平探讨整个籽粒发育过程中转录调控的复杂性，促进糖代谢相关基因调控网络的构建。结果表明，聚腺苷酸尾长度的变化可能通过影响转录丰度来调节籽粒发育过程中的糖代谢。这项研究阐明了控制甜玉米粒中糖代谢物的潜在转录调控途径，并为支持精准育种策略提供了基础数据。

articles.title: Isoflavonoids from Iris albicans as a carbon source to enhance the anti-aging potential of lactic acid bacteria-derived postbiotics.
articles.titleZh: 来自白色鸢尾的异黄酮作为碳源，可增强乳酸菌衍生后生元的抗衰老潜力。
articles.authors: Elbermawi A, Darwish MS, Abou-Zeid NA, Zaki AA, Elawady AA, Amen Y.
articles.abstract: Dietary strategies that limit protein glycation can help slow aging and prevent age‑related diseases by reducing the accumulation of advanced glycation end products (AGEs). This study evaluated the antioxidant, antiglycation, and prebiotic potential of postbiotics produced by lactic acid bacteria using Iris albicans extract and its major isoflavonoids as carbon sources. Antioxidant activity (DPPH, ABTS, FRAP), prebiotic potential (Apreb activity scores), and antiglycation effects were assessed via fructosamine formation, oxidative stress markers, protein aggregation, and AGE‑RAGE inhibition assays. Among all tested postbiotics, Limosilactobacillus reuteri MSD37 showed the highest antioxidant and antiglycation activities, especially when cultured with I. albicans extract or irilone. This postbiotic effectively preserved thiol groups, reduced protein oxidation, and inhibited AGE‑RAGE interactions. Moreover, L. reuteri MSD37 postbiotic enriched with I. albicans extract exhibited notably high prebiotic activity toward probiotic strains. Overall, I. albicans represents a promising carbon source for producing anti‑aging postbiotics, highlighting the potential of L. reuteri MSD37 as a gerobiotic candidate for promoting healthy aging.
articles.abstractZh: 限制蛋白质糖化的饮食策略可以通过减少晚期糖基化终产物（AGE）的积累来帮助延缓衰老并预防与年龄相关的疾病。本研究使用白色鸢尾提取物及其主要异黄酮类化合物作为碳源，评估了乳酸菌产生的后生元的抗氧化、抗糖化和益生元潜力。通过果糖胺形成、氧化应激标记物、蛋白质聚集和 AGE-RAGE 抑制测定来评估抗氧化活性（DPPH、ABTS、FRAP）、益生元潜力（Apreb 活性评分）和抗糖化作用。在所有测试的后生元中，罗伊氏柠檬酸杆菌 MSD37 显示出最高的抗氧化和抗糖化活性，尤其是与白色念珠菌提取物或 irilone 一起培养时。这种后生元有效地保留了硫醇基团、减少了蛋白质氧化并抑制了 AGE-RAGE 相互作用。此外，富含白色念珠菌提取物的罗伊氏乳杆菌 MSD37 后生元对益生菌菌株表现出显着高的益生元活性。总体而言，白色念珠菌是生产抗衰老后生元的有前景的碳源，凸显了罗伊氏乳杆菌 MSD37 作为蒙古包的潜力

articles.title: Unraveling the gut microbiota-brain axis: Mechanisms, pathophysiology, and therapeutic opportunities.
articles.titleZh: 揭示肠道微生物群-脑轴：机制、病理生理学和治疗机会。
articles.authors: Jiang C, Nageeb WM, Batool S, Hashish A, Alkhawagah SM, Abdelsattar Ibrahim HA, Zhu W, Che C, Li X, Jin M, Zhang X, Ghonaim AH, Ren M, Li S.
articles.abstract: The gut microbiota-brain axis constitutes a dynamic, bidirectional communication network that integrates neural, endocrine, immune, and metabolic pathways to regulate host physiology and behavior. Accumulating evidence indicates that disturbances within this axis have been consistently associated with metabolic, autoimmune, and neuropsychiatric disorders; however, much of the current evidence, particularly from human studies, remains largely correlative, and causal relationships are still under active investigation, highlighting its systemic relevance to health and disease. This review synthesizes current understanding of the structural and functional components of the gut microbiota-brain axis, including microbial community dynamics, neural signaling pathways, and key endocrine and immune mediators. We examine mechanistic insights into how microbial-derived metabolites influence brain function, cognition, mood regulation, stress responses, and disease pathogenesis. In addition, we discuss emerging therapeutic strategies targeting the gut microbiota-brain axis, including psychobiotics and fecal microbiota transplantation, while acknowledging dietary approaches, such as prebiotic supplementation, fiber-rich diets, and fermented food consumption, as complementary strategies that modulate microbiota composition that may indirectly support gut-brain axis function. By integrating mechanistic, clinical, and translational perspectives, this review aims to clarify current knowledge gaps and highlight future directions for leveraging the gut microbiota-brain axis in personalized approaches to neuropsychiatric disease management.
articles.abstractZh: 肠道菌群-大脑轴构成了一个动态的、双向的通讯网络，整合了神经、内分泌、免疫和代谢途径来调节宿主的生理和行为。越来越多的证据表明，该轴内的紊乱始终与代谢、自身免疫和神经精神疾病相关。然而，目前的许多证据，特别是来自人类研究的证据，在很大程度上仍然具有相关性，并且因果关系仍在积极调查中，突出了其与健康和疾病的系统相关性。这篇综述综合了目前对肠道微生物群-脑轴的结构和功能组成部分的理解，包括微生物群落动态、神经信号通路以及关键的内分泌和免疫介质。我们研究微生物代谢物如何影响大脑功能、认知、情绪调节、应激反应和疾病发病机制的机制。此外，我们讨论了针对肠道微生物群-大脑轴的新兴治疗策略，包括精神抗生素和粪便微生物群移植，同时承认饮食方法，例如益生元补充剂

articles.title: Image-based phenotypic sorting of synthetic cells.
articles.titleZh: 基于图像的合成细胞表型分选。
articles.authors: van den Brink M, Stam M, Claassens NJ, Danelon C.
articles.abstract: Understanding the relationships between genotype and phenotype is key to many areas of biological research and to the development of synthetic cells. We describe an image-based screening and sorting workflow that explores the phenotypes of gene-expressing vesicles within nonclonal populations and selects the desired variants. Using automated confocal microscopy and real-time, neural network-assisted image analysis, we demonstrate that liposomes can be selected for fluorescence intensity, protein localization, membrane morphology, and dynamic behaviors, and their phenotype can be linked to genetic content. This approach could substantially accelerate the evolution of cellular functions in a minimal synthetic context.
articles.abstractZh: 了解基因型和表型之间的关系是许多生物学研究领域和合成细胞开发的关键。我们描述了一种基于图像的筛选和分选工作流程，该工作流程探索非克隆群体中基因表达囊泡的表型并选择所需的变体。使用自动共焦显微镜和实时神经网络辅助图像分析，我们证明可以根据荧光强度、蛋白质定位、膜形态和动态行为来选择脂质体，并且它们的表型可以与遗传内容相关联。这种方法可以在最小的合成环境下大大加速细胞功能的进化。

articles.title: Natural variation in <i>PtoCPK3</i> governs drought tolerance by orchestrating xylem remodeling and lignin metabolism in <i>Populus</i>.
articles.titleZh: PtoCPK3 的自然变异通过协调杨属植物的木质部重塑和木质素代谢来控制耐旱性。
articles.authors: Wang D, Jiang Y, Quan M, Liao B, Chen Y, Gu M, Guan Y, Zhang D, Qin S, Fang Y, Qi W, Xiao L, Ren T, Zhao T, Du Q, Ingvarsson PK, El-Kassaby YA, Zhang D.
articles.abstract: Drought stress severely limits the growth of perennial trees. Xylem structure is central to water conduction; however, lignin monomer composition driving xylem remodeling for drought adaptation remains enigmatic. By integrating multi-omics analyses, genotype-environment association analysis, and metabolite-based genome-wide association studies, we identified PtoCPK3 as a key gene associated with precipitation-related traits and the aridity index in Populus tomentosa. This variation in association was linked to coniferyl alcohol and ferulic acid, two metabolites related to guaiacyl (G)-lignin monomer biosynthesis. Overexpressing PtoCPK3 enhanced drought tolerance in transgenic poplar by promoting xylem remodeling associated with a decreased lignin S/G ratio. Mechanistically, drought-induced Ca2+ signaling activates PtoCPK3 to phosphorylate PtoERF72 at Ser96, enhancing its activation of PtoWOX13b and direct repression of PtoUGT72AZ2. Synergistic repression of PtoUGT72AZ2 by PtoWOX13b reduces glycosylation of G-monomer precursors, favoring ferulic acid and coniferyl alcohol accumulation. Furthermore, natural variants in PtoCPK3 and PtoERF72 drive geographic divergence, with the PtoCPK3II_PtoERF72CC genotype conferring superior drought resilience via elevated phosphorylation efficiency. This module links drought signaling to xylem remodeling, providing genetic targets for breeding drought-resilient trees.
articles.abstractZh: 干旱胁迫严重限制了多年生树木的生长。木质部结构是水传导的核心；然而，木质素单体组成驱动木质部重塑以适应干旱仍然是个谜。通过整合多组学分析、基因型-环境关联分析和基于代谢物的全基因组关联研究，我们确定PtoCPK3是与毛白杨降水相关性状和干旱指数相关的关键基因。这种关联的变化与松柏醇和阿魏酸有关，这两种代谢物与愈创木基（G）-木质素单体生物合成有关。过表达 PtoCPK3 通过促进与木质素 S/G 比降低相关的木质部重塑来增强转基因杨的耐旱性。从机制上讲，干旱诱导的 Ca2+ 信号传导激活 PtoCPK3，使 PtoERF72 Ser96 磷酸化，增强其对 PtoWOX13b 的激活并直接抑制 PtoUGT72AZ2。 PtoWOX13b 对 PtoUGT72AZ2 的协同抑制减少了 G 单体前体的糖基化，有利于阿魏酸和松柏醇的积累。此外，PtoCPK3 和 PtoERF72 的自然变异导致地理差异，其中 PtoCPK

articles.title: The transcription factor AP-1 regulates the catalase family and oxidative stress adaptation in the dermatophyte Trichophyton rubrum.
articles.titleZh: 转录因子 AP-1 调节皮肤真菌红色毛癣菌的过氧化氢酶家族和氧化应激适应。
articles.authors: Petrucelli MF, Azevedo MIG, Oliveira VM, Sanches PR, Rossi A, Martinez-Rossi NM.
articles.abstract: Oxidative stress results from an imbalance between the production of reactive oxygen species and cellular antioxidant activity, thereby causing cellular damage. In Saccharomyces cerevisiae, the Basic Leucine Zipper (bZIP) transcription factor AP-1 plays a key regulatory role in antioxidant responses. In Trichophyton rubrum, oxidative stress is countered by antioxidant enzymes and three main regulators: the HOG pathway, AP-1, and SKN7. Here, we investigated the role of AP-1 using a Δap1 mutant of T. rubrum exposed to hydrogen peroxide or menadione. RT-qPCR revealed higher expression of HOG-pathway genes and lower expression of skn7 and catalase genes in the Δap1 mutant under oxidative stress conditions, together with reduced catalase activity. Lipid peroxidation assays indicated greater oxidative damage in the mutants, particularly after menadione exposure. In silico analysis identified an AP-1 consensus binding site in the catalase gene TERG_02005. Post-transcriptional analysis revealed alternative splicing events, specifically intron retention, both in TERG_02005 and in genes related to the spliceosome machinery, which also contained predicted AP-1 binding sites. These findings indicate that AP-1 plays a role in regulating oxidative stress-responsive genes in T. rubrum, particularly those that code for catalase. Additionally, AP-1 may influence spliceosome function, linking transcriptional and post-transcriptional responses to oxidative stress.
articles.abstractZh: 氧化应激是由于活性氧的产生与细胞抗氧化活性之间的不平衡造成的，从而导致细胞损伤。在酿酒酵母中，碱性亮氨酸拉链 (bZIP) 转录因子 AP-1 在抗氧化反应中发挥着关键的调节作用。在红色毛癣菌中，氧化应激通过抗氧化酶和三个主要调节因子来对抗：HOG 途径、AP-1 和 SKN7。在这里，我们使用暴露于过氧化氢或甲萘醌的 T. rubrum Δap1 突变体研究了 AP-1 的作用。 RT-qPCR 显示，在氧化应激条件下，Δap1 突变体中 HOG 通路基因的表达较高，skn7 和过氧化氢酶基因的表达较低，同时过氧化氢酶活性降低。脂质过氧化测定表明突变体存在更大的氧化损伤，特别是在甲萘醌暴露后。计算机分析确定了过氧化氢酶基因 TERG_02005 中的 AP-1 共有结合位点。转录后分析揭示了 TERG_02005 和与剪接体机制相关的基因中的选择性剪接事件，特别是内含子保留，其中也包含预测的 AP-1 结合位点。这些发现在

articles.title: Metabolically engineered probiotic OMVs as nanovaccine mediating sequential immunomodulation for chronic bone infection immunotherapy.
articles.titleZh: 代谢工程益生菌 OMV 作为纳米疫苗介导慢性骨感染免疫治疗的序贯免疫调节。
articles.authors: Lei J, Tong B, Zhang S, Ou Z, Zhu D, Zhou X, Liang H, Zhang Z, Tan L, Yang C, Feng X.
articles.abstract: Chronic, drug-resistant bone infection caused by methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) features an immunosuppressive niche enabling persistent infection and impaired bone healing. A specific treatment requires initial antibacterial immune activation against infection, followed by reshaping an anti-inflammatory microenvironment for later bone repair. Here, we screen Lactococcus lactis outer membrane vesicles (Lac-OMVs) with first-stage dendritic cell (DC) activation and later stage inflammatory macrophage repolarization potential. Mechanistically, enrichment of the nicotinamide metabolism pathway within Lac-OMVs is discovered, with nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) as a key anti-inflammatory mediator. NAD+-enriched Lac-OMVs (NAD+-Lac-OMVs) are thus metabolically engineered via targeted culture condition optimization, exerting biphasic immunomodulatory effects: (1) early-stage DC activation establishes robust humoral immunity, protecting against primary and recurrent MRSA challenge (99.35% and 98.07% bacterial clearance rates, respectively); and (2) later stage targeted NAD+ delivery reprograms inflammatory macrophages at the defect site, resolving inflammation and establishing a pro-osteogenic microenvironment (∼10 times higher bone-repair rate).
articles.abstractZh: 由耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌 (MRSA) 引起的慢性耐药性骨感染具有免疫抑制作用，可导致持续感染和骨愈合受损。特定的治疗需要首先激活抗菌免疫来抵抗感染，然后重塑抗炎微环境以进行后续的骨修复。在这里，我们筛选具有第一阶段树突状细胞（DC）激活和后期炎症巨噬细胞复极化潜力的乳酸乳球菌外膜囊泡（Lac-OMV）。从机制上讲，发现 Lac-OMV 内烟酰胺代谢途径的富集，其中烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸 (NAD+) 作为关键的抗炎介质。因此，富含 NAD+ 的 Lac-OMV（NAD+-Lac-OMV）通过靶向培养条件优化进行代谢工程改造，发挥双相免疫调节作用：（1）早期 DC 激活建立强大的体液免疫，防止原发性和复发性 MRSA 攻击（细菌清除率分别为 99.35% 和 98.07%）； (2) 后期靶向 NAD+ 递送可重新编程缺损部位的炎症巨噬细胞，从而解决炎症和

articles.title: Nucleophagy removes cytotoxic trapped PARP1.
articles.titleZh: 核吞噬可去除细胞毒性捕获的 PARP1。
articles.authors: Hoslett G, Tribble S, Lascaux P, Koukouravas S, Torrecilla I, Song W, Hou CX, Li J, González-Fernández M, De Gregoriis G, Dagg RA, O'Brien D, Pierangelini A, Martial T, Ng AWT, Raimundo N, Milosevic I, Freire R, Li Y, Rottenberg S, Krastev DB, Lord CJ, Tarsounas M, Ramadan K.
articles.abstract: Poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibitors (PARPi) induce cytotoxicity in homologous recombination repair (HR)-deficient (HRD) cancers by trapping PARP1 on chromatin, thereby causing irreparable replication-associated DNA damage. Although increased clearance of trapped PARP1 from chromatin reduces the sensitivity of cancer cells to PARPi, details surrounding this process remain unclear. PARPi exposure is known to cause increased autophagy flux, whereas autophagy inhibition can hypersensitize cells to PARPi. Our study reveals that trapped PARP1 is cleared via nucleophagy, with the selective autophagy receptor TEX264 and its partner segregase p97 (also known as VCP) orchestrating this process. TEX264 interacts directly with trapped PARP1, linking it to the autophagosomal protein LC3 for degradation. Disrupting this pathway, either chemically or genetically, increases PARP1 trapping, resulting in protein aggregates, DNA damage and cell lethality, ultimately re-sensitizing PARPi-resistant cells. We conclude that nucleophagy serves a cytoprotective role by targeting PARPi-induced trapped PARP1 for degradation.
articles.abstractZh: 聚（ADP-核糖）聚合酶（PARP）抑制剂（PARPi）通过将 PARP1 捕获在染色质上，在同源重组修复（HR）缺陷（HRD）癌症中诱导细胞毒性，从而导致不可修复的复制相关 DNA 损伤。尽管捕获的 PARP1 从染色质中清除的增加会降低癌细胞对 PARPi 的敏感性，但有关此过程的细节仍不清楚。已知 PARPi 暴露会导致自噬通量增加，而自噬抑制可以使细胞对 PARPi 过敏。我们的研究表明，被捕获的 PARP1 通过核自噬被清除，选择性自噬受体 TEX264 及其伙伴分离酶 p97（也称为 VCP）协调这一过程。 TEX264 直接与捕获的 PARP1 相互作用，将其与自噬体蛋白 LC3 连接起来进行降解。通过化学或基因方式破坏这一途径，会增加 PARP1 捕获，导致蛋白质聚集、DNA 损伤和细胞致死，最终使 PARPi 耐药细胞重新变得敏感。我们得出结论，核吞噬通过靶向 PARPi 诱导的捕获的 PARP1 降解来发挥细胞保护作用。

articles.title: Stress-induced ribosome degradation in Bacillus subtilis is mediated by the RNase Y-specificity complex.
articles.titleZh: 枯草芽孢杆菌中应激诱导的核糖体降解是由 RNase Y 特异性复合物介导的。
articles.authors: Cornejo FA, Driller K, Ahmed-Begrich R, Schmidt K, Jahn M, Shanmuganathan V, Hahnke K, Kondrot F, Wulff TF, Rämisch S, Alagesan K, Charpentier E, Turgay K.
articles.abstract: Limiting ribosome synthesis and activity is crucial for adaptation to stresses, such as heat or nutrient starvation. In Bacillus subtilis, this can be achieved through the coordinated action of the alarmones (p)ppGpp and the transcription factor Spx. Here, we performed a genetic screen to identify novel factors that contribute to the heat shock response in B. subtilis. We identified the Y-complex, which confers specificity to the endonuclease RNase Y, as a critical player under stress conditions, such as heat or transition into the stationary phase. This protein complex is required for the targeting and processing of diverse RNAs, notably the maturation of mRNAs encoding proteins involved in translation and metabolism. We further demonstrate that the Y-complex and RNase Y initiate the degradation of rRNAs of mature ribosomes, lowering their abundance. We propose that the Y-complex is a regulatory hub that modulates gene expression, adjusts protein synthesis and resource allocation.
articles.abstractZh: 限制核糖体合成和活性对于适应应激（例如热或营养饥饿）至关重要。在枯草芽孢杆菌中，这可以通过警报素 (p)ppGpp 和转录因子 Spx 的协调作用来实现。在这里，我们进行了遗传筛选，以确定有助于枯草芽孢杆菌热休克反应的新因素。我们确定了 Y 复合物，它赋予核酸内切酶 RNase Y 特异性，在应激条件下（例如热或进入稳定期）发挥关键作用。这种蛋白质复合物是多种 RNA 的靶向和加工所必需的，特别是编码参与翻译和代谢的蛋白质的 mRNA 的成熟。我们进一步证明 Y 复合物和 RNase Y 启动成熟核糖体 rRNA 的降解，降低其丰度。我们认为Y复合体是调节基因表达、调整蛋白质合成和资源分配的调节中心。

articles.title: Sexual identity of Akh neurons shapes Nucb1-dependent metabolic and reproductive plasticity.
articles.titleZh: Akh 神经元的性别特征决定了 Nucb1 依赖性代谢和生殖可塑性。
articles.authors: Pujari N, Chevrier K, Turriff N, Al-Tahir Y, Shahi D, Gorjan AS, Li ASO, Jois SV, Donà E, Ferrari M, Unniappan S, Leung AKW.
articles.abstract: Sex differences in metabolic physiology are widespread across species and are tightly linked to reproductive demands. Here, we identify nucleobindin 1 (Nucb1), a conserved calcium-binding protein, as a female-specific metabolic regulator in the adipokinetic hormone (Akh)-producing cells (APCs) of Drosophila melanogaster. APC-specific nucb1 knockdown increased energy storage and body mass in females but not in males. Cellular sex reversal experiments revealed these female-specific functions of Nucb1 to be dependent on the intrinsic sexual identity of the APCs, rather than the sex of the organism. Furthermore, under nutrient restriction, females lacking nucb1 in APCs failed to suppress oocyte maturation, indicating disrupted coupling between nutrient status and reproductive output. In contrast, we identified slowpoke-binding protein (Slob) in the APCs as a regulator of male-specific body fat storage. Together, these findings demonstrate that sex-specific metabolic and reproductive regulation arises from differential regulatory factors within the same neuroendocrine cell type.
articles.abstractZh: 代谢生理学的性别差异在物种之间普遍存在，并且与生殖需求密切相关。在这里，我们鉴定出核结合蛋白 1 (Nucb1)，一种保守的钙结合蛋白，作为果蝇脂肪运动激素 (Akh) 产生细胞 (APC) 中的雌性特异性代谢调节剂。 APC 特异性 nucb1 敲低增加了女性的能量储存和体重，但男性则没有。细胞性别逆转实验表明，Nucb1 的这些雌性特异性功能依赖于 APC 的内在性别特征，而不是生物体的性别。此外，在营养限制下，APC 中缺乏 nucb1 的雌性无法抑制卵母细胞的成熟，表明营养状态和生殖输出之间的耦合被破坏。相比之下，我们发现 APC 中的 Slowpoke 结合蛋白 (Slob) 是男性特有的身体脂肪储存的调节因子。总之，这些发现表明，性别特异性代谢和生殖调节源于同一神经内分泌细胞类型内的差异调节因素。

articles.title: Beyond petrochemicals: challenges and opportunities in industrial-scale biomanufacturing.
articles.titleZh: 超越石化产品：工业规模生物制造的挑战和机遇。
articles.authors: Kim JY, Yu HE, Kim MH, Lee SY.
articles.abstract: Biomanufacturing offers a sustainable alternative to petrochemical manufacturing by harnessing engineered microorganisms to convert renewable feedstocks into diverse value-added products. Systems metabolic engineering has driven its advancement, enabling rational design of microbial strains with enhanced performance and robustness. Despite these achievements, large-scale commercialisation remains limited, highlighting the persistent gap between laboratory success and industrial deployment. We examine the challenges and opportunities in advancing biomanufacturing towards industrial implementation through two cases, succinic acid and polyhydroxyalkanoates, that exemplify products nearing, yet not fully reaching, commercial maturity. Finally, we discuss how integrating artificial intelligence with systems metabolic engineering can accelerate sustainable biomanufacturing.
articles.abstractZh: 生物制造通过利用工程微生物将可再生原料转化为各种增值产品，为石化制造提供了可持续的替代方案。系统代谢工程推动了其进步，使得能够合理设计具有增强性能和稳健性的微生物菌株。尽管取得了这些成就，大规模商业化仍然有限，凸显了实验室成功与工业部署之间持续存在的差距。我们通过琥珀酸和聚羟基脂肪酸酯这两个案例研究了推进生物制造走向工业化的挑战和机遇，这两个案例说明了产品已接近但尚未完全达到商业成熟度。最后，我们讨论将人工智能与系统代谢工程相结合如何加速可持续生物制造。

articles.title: International multisite implementation of distributed cell-free protein biomanufacturing to advance health and research equity.
articles.titleZh: 国际多地点实施分布式无细胞蛋白质生物制造，以促进健康和研究公平。
articles.authors: da Silva SJR, Matthews Q, Cazaux S, Vigar JRJ, Santos BNR, Carvalho DCM, Cranmer LA, Duplat D, Singh S, Simchi M, Benítez-Bolivar P, de Lima Cavalcanti TYV, Wu K, Mendes RPG, Kale T, Divarzak ALL, Bozovicar K, Doucet J, Arce A, Léon C, Ferrando V, Nguyen J, Ho A, de Lima SC, Bayat P, Guo Y, Cicek S, Tinafar A, Krokovsky L, Machado LC, Rayhan A, Iwe IA, Klenov A, de Araujo TPG, Nascimento JPM, Magalhães JJF, Guevara-Suarez M, Garcia Canete P, Ayi K, Charania M, Stehelin TE, Chatfield-Reed K, Paiva MHS, Crandall I, Mazzulli T, da Luz Wallau G, Silva-Júnior A, Bernal A, Athale CA, Green AA, Weaver SC, González C, Federici F, Pena L, Pardee K.
articles.abstract: Limitations in global access to research and health care capacity undermine equity, sustainability, and resilience, particularly in resource-limited settings. Molecular diagnostics and biologic therapeutics are set to revolutionize medicine; however, our dependence on centralized biomanufacturing and cold chain logistics restricts access to these benefits. These constraints reflect a chronic and unmet global challenge. Here, with research teams in North and South America and Asia, we challenge the top-down paradigm by advancing community-driven solutions that empower underserved populations to participate in the bioeconomy, producing what they need, when, and where they need it. Our approach leverages low-burden biomanufacturing-built on cell-free protein synthesis and open-source hardware-to enable local, on-demand production of high-value bioproducts, including growth factors, vaccines, and diagnostic enzymes, demonstrating performance comparable to commercial gold standards. Implemented at 10 sites worldwide, this platform supported patient trials targeting globally relevant pathogens. Together, these efforts lay the foundation for a globally inclusive biomanufacturing ecosystem, where innovation goes beyond geographic boundaries.
articles.abstractZh: 全球获得研究和医疗保健能力的限制破坏了公平性、可持续性和复原力，特别是在资源有限的环境中。分子诊断和生物治疗将彻底改变医学；然而，我们对集中式生物制造和冷链物流的依赖限制了我们获得这些好处。这些制约因素反映了一个长期且未解决的全球挑战。在这里，我们与北美、南美和亚洲的研究团队一起，通过推进社区驱动的解决方案来挑战自上而下的范式，使服务不足的人群能够参与生物经济，在他们需要的时间和地点生产他们需要的东西。我们的方法利用基于无细胞蛋白质合成和开源硬件的低负担生物制造，实现高价值生物产品的本地按需生产，包括生长因子、疫苗和诊断酶，表现出可与商业黄金标准相媲美的性能。该平台在全球 10 个地点实施，支持针对全球相关病原体的患者试验。这些努力共同为全球包容性生物制造生态系统奠定了基础

articles.title: Mitochondria-lysosome coupling contributes to lysosome acidification and aging.
articles.titleZh: 线粒体-溶酶体偶联有助于溶酶体酸化和衰老。
articles.authors: Liu Q, Yoo S, Zhang ZA, Li L, Su H, Vannur L, Wooldredge AC, Hughes JB, Desprez PY, Hao N, Lithgow G, Andersen JK, Hansen M, Campisi J, Zhou C.
articles.abstract: Nearly all cellular processes are pH dependent. The acidic pH inside the lysosome (vacuole in yeast) is essential for cellular content degradation, signaling, and autophagy. Defects in lysosome/vacuole acidification are a conserved hallmark of aging and age-related diseases. Traditionally, the lysosome/vacuole is thought to import free protons (H⁺) from the surrounding neutral cytosol. Here, we uncovered a conserved lysosome/vacuole acidification mechanism from yeast to human involving lysosomal/vacuolar uptake of H+ pumped out by mitochondrial electron transport chain through mitochondria-lysosomes/vacuoles membrane contacts. Aging/senescence-associated disruption of mitochondria-lysosome/vacuole contacts causes lysosomal/vacuolar de-acidification, which can be reversed by either expressing an engineered linker to connect these two organelles or through an asymmetry-dependent rejuvenation process in daughter cells. Preserving lysosomal acidification in senescent human cells prevents the induction of major senescence-associated secretory phenotype factors and restores autophagic flux. These findings reshape our current understanding of the mechanisms underlying lysosomal/vacuolar (de-)acidification in both young and aged/senescent cells.
articles.abstractZh: 几乎所有的细胞过程都依赖于 pH 值。溶酶体（酵母中的液泡）内的酸性 pH 对于细胞内容物降解、信号传导和自噬至关重要。溶酶体/液泡酸化缺陷是衰老和年龄相关疾病的一个保守标志。传统上，溶酶体/液泡被认为从周围的中性细胞质中输入游离质子 (H⁺)。在这里，我们发现了从酵母到人类的保守溶酶体/液泡酸化机制，涉及溶酶体/液泡摄取由线粒体电子传递链通过线粒体-溶酶体/液泡膜接触泵出的H+。衰老/衰老相关的线粒体-溶酶体/液泡接触破坏导致溶酶体/液泡脱酸，这可以通过表达工程连接子来连接这两个细胞器或通过子细胞中不对称依赖性的复兴过程来逆转。保持衰老人类细胞中的溶酶体酸化可防止诱导主要的衰老相关分泌表型因子并恢复自噬流。这些发现重塑了我们目前对溶酶体/液泡潜在机制的理解（

articles.title: A high-throughput selection system for fast-acting covalent protein drugs.
articles.titleZh: 速效共价蛋白药物的高通量选择系统。
articles.authors: Fan Q, Mei J, Li T, Zang C, Li M, Tang J, Xu Y, Yu G, Liu D, Chen K, Yang B, Huang J, Zhou T, Dang B.
articles.abstract: Covalent protein drugs offer therapeutic potential but are limited by slow target engagement and the absence of high-throughput selection platforms. Rapid covalent binding requires coordinated optimization of affinity, stability, and warhead geometry, which is an intrinsically multidimensional challenge. We developed a yeast display platform coupled with chemoselective modification that enables selection of fast-acting covalent proteins without increasing intrinsic warhead reactivity. Using this system, we engineered a covalent programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) antagonistic nanobody with rapid cross-linking kinetics [observed rate constant (kobs) = 0.18 min-1, half-life (t1/2) = 3.8 min] and improved tumor suppression compared with envafolimab and atezolizumab. Similarly, we engineered a fast-acting covalent interleukin-18 (kobs = 0.54 min-1, t1/2 = 1.3 min) and a covalent miniprotein targeting the receptor binding domain of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), demonstrating applicability across protein modalities.
articles.abstractZh: 共价蛋白药物具有治疗潜力，但受到靶标结合缓慢和缺乏高通量选择平台的限制。快速共价结合需要亲和力、稳定性和弹头几何形状的协调优化，这本质上是一个多维的挑战。我们开发了一个酵母展示平台，结合化学选择性修饰，可以选择快速作用的共价蛋白，而不增加内在的弹头反应性。使用该系统，我们设计了一种共价程序性死亡配体 1 (PD-L1) 拮抗纳米抗体，具有快速交联动力学 [观察到的速率常数 (kobs) = 0.18 min-1，半衰期 (t1/2) = 3.8 分钟]，并且与 envafolimab 和 atezolizumab 相比，肿瘤抑制效果得到改善。同样，我们设计了一种快速作用的共价白细胞介素 18（kobs = 0.54 min-1，t1/2 = 1.3 分钟）和一种针对严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒 2 (SARS-CoV-2) 受体结合域的共价小蛋白，证明了跨蛋白质模式的适用性。

articles.title: Conserved RNA helicase Vasa regulates ribonucleoprotein condensate dynamics and mRNA localization.
articles.titleZh: 保守的 RNA 解旋酶 Vasa 调节核糖核蛋白凝聚动力学和 mRNA 定位。
articles.authors: Tian S, Kim H, Curnutte HA, Trcek T.
articles.abstract: Germ granules are germline ribonucleoprotein condensates that concentrate proteins and mRNAs essential for animal development. Although the DEAD-box RNA helicase Vasa is a conserved core germ granule component, its role within these condensates remains poorly understood. Using Drosophila and human cell systems, we showed that condensation of Oskar (Osk), the fly germ granule nucleator, occurred independently of Vasa. However, in late oocytes lacking Vasa, Osk-eGFP formed aggregates and exhibited markedly reduced exchange with the aggregate surroundings. Consistently, Vasa increased Osk-eGFP condensate recovery in cells. Additionally, mRNA localization to germ granules was not persistent in oocytes lacking Vasa, while in cells, co-expression of Vasa and Osk was necessary and sufficient for mRNA localization to condensates. Notably, localization of nanos messenger ribonucleoprotein (mRNP) to condensates reduced Vasa-dependent enhancement of Osk-eGFP exchange. Together, our study reveals the DEAD-box RNA helicase Vasa as a central regulator of condensate dynamics and mRNP localization in vivo and in cellulo.
articles.abstractZh: 胚芽颗粒是胚系核糖核蛋白浓缩物，浓缩了动物发育必需的蛋白质和 mRNA。尽管 DEAD-box RNA 解旋酶 Vasa 是一种保守的核心胚芽颗粒成分，但它在这些凝聚物中的作用仍然知之甚少。利用果蝇和人类细胞系统，我们发现果蝇胚芽颗粒成核剂奥斯卡 (Osk) 的凝结独立于 Vasa 发生。然而，在缺乏 Vasa 的晚期卵母细胞中，Osk-eGFP 形成聚集体，并表现出与聚集体周围环境的交换显着减少。 Vasa 一致提高了细胞中 Osk-eGFP 冷凝物的回收率。此外，在缺乏 Vasa 的卵母细胞中，mRNA 定位到胚芽颗粒的现象并不持久，而在细胞中，Vasa 和 Osk 的共表达对于 mRNA 定位到凝聚物来说是必要且充分的。值得注意的是，纳米信使核糖核蛋白（mRNP）在凝结物中的定位减少了 Osk-eGFP 交换的 Vasa 依赖性增强。总之，我们的研究揭示了 DEAD-box RNA 解旋酶 Vasa 作为体内和细胞内凝聚动力学和 mRNP 定位的中央调节器。

articles.title: DupyliCate: mining, classifying, and characterizing gene duplications.
articles.titleZh: DupyliCate：挖掘、分类和表征基因重复。
articles.authors: Natarajan S, Pucker B.
articles.abstract: Paralogs, copies of a gene, form an important basis for novelty during evolution. Analysis of such gene duplications is important to understand the emergence of novel traits during evolution. DupyliCate is a Python tool that has been developed for this purpose. With the ability to process multiple datasets concurrently, flexible features, and parameters to set species-specific thresholds, DupyliCate offers a high-throughput method for gene copy identification and analysis. The different available parameters and modes are explored in detail based on Arabidopsis thaliana datasets. Proof of concept for the tool is presented by characterizing well known duplications in different plants, and its broad applicability is demonstrated by running it on diverse datasets including complex plant genome sequences with high heterozygosity. Further, two case studies involving the evolution of FLAVONOL SYNTHASE (FLS) genes in Brassicales, and the evolution of flavonol synthesis regulating myeloblastosis (MYB) transcription factors-MYB12 and MYB111 across a large number of plant species, are presented as exemplar use cases. The tool's applicability beyond plants is demonstrated on Escherichia coli, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, and Caenorhabditis elegans datasets. DupyliCate is available at: https://github.com/ShakNat/DupyliCate .
articles.abstractZh: 旁系同源物（基因的副本）构成了进化过程中新颖性的重要基础。对此类基因重复的分析对于理解进化过程中新特征的出现非常重要。 DupyliCate 是为此目的开发的 Python 工具。 DupyliCate 能够同时处理多个数据集、灵活的功能和设置物种特定阈值的参数，为基因拷贝识别和分析提供了一种高通量方法。基于拟南芥数据集详细探索了不同的可用参数和模式。该工具的概念证明是通过表征不同植物中众所周知的重复来进行的，并且通过在不同的数据集（包括具有高杂合性的复杂植物基因组序列）上运行该工具来证明其广泛的适用性。此外，两个案例研究涉及芸苔目中黄酮醇合成酶 (FLS) 基因的进化，以及大量植物物种中调节成髓细胞增多症 (MYB) 转录因子 MYB12 和 MYB111 的黄酮醇合成的进化，作为示例用例。该工具的适用性超出了植物范围，并在大肠杆菌上得到了证明，

articles.title: Engineering high-quality cultured beef through curcumin-driven metabolic reprogramming in a high-protein scaffold.
articles.titleZh: 通过在高蛋白支架中姜黄素驱动的代谢重编程来设计高品质的培养牛肉。
articles.authors: Wang D, Li M, Ma J, Zhao Y, Du G, Zhou J, Chen J, Guan X.
articles.abstract: Cultured meat, produced by culturing animal cells in vitro, is emerging as a sustainable alternative to conventional meat. Despite significant progress in production scale-up, inefficient myogenic differentiation remains a key obstacle to achieving the quality required for consumer acceptance. Here, we elucidate the critical role of metabolic reprogramming and mitochondrial remodeling in myogenesis, revealing that day 1 of differentiation is a key transition window. We then identify curcumin as a potent natural compound that enhances mitochondrial remodeling and metabolic reprogramming, thereby promoting myotube formation and maturation. Concurrently, we develop an edible, high-protein scaffold based on yeast protein and integrate it with curcumin-mediated myogenic induction. Finally, we successfully produce cultured beef featuring abundant and orderly aligned myotubes, with nutritional and sensory qualities closely matching those of conventional beef. Our work offers new insights into the metabolic regulation of effective myogenesis and presents a viable strategy for high-quality cultured meat production.
articles.abstractZh: 通过体外培养动物细胞生产的培养肉正在成为传统肉类的可持续替代品。尽管在扩大生产规模方面取得了重大进展，但低效的生肌分化仍然是实现消费者接受所需的质量的主要障碍。在这里，我们阐明了代谢重编程和线粒体重塑在肌生成中的关键作用，揭示了分化的第一天是一个关键的过渡窗口。然后，我们确定姜黄素是一种有效的天然化合物，可以增强线粒体重塑和代谢重编程，从而促进肌管的形成和成熟。同时，我们开发了一种基于酵母蛋白的可食用高蛋白支架，并将其与姜黄素介导的生肌诱导相结合。最终，我们成功生产出了肌管丰富且排列整齐的培养牛肉，其营养和感官品质与传统牛肉非常接近。我们的工作为有效肌生成的代谢调节提供了新的见解，并提出了高质量培养肉生产的可行策略。

articles.title: Glycine: The missing link between carbohydrate and xenobiotic metabolism in the maturing human hepatocyte.
articles.titleZh: 甘氨酸：成熟人类肝细胞中碳水化合物和外源代谢之间缺失的联系。
articles.authors: Pozo Garcia V, Çobanoğlu TS, Riga K, Sharma S, Jennings P, Vos JC, Moco S.
articles.abstract: Modulation of cellular metabolism is crucial in pluripotent stem cell (PSC) development and differentiation. Glycine was shown to promote liver cell maturation, boosting Cytochrome P450 (CYP) isoform 3A4 activity, a key enzyme in phase I metabolism. This study examines the remodeling of central and xenobiotic metabolism during the glycine-supplemented differentiation of induced PSCs (iPSCs) into hepatocyte-like cells (HLCs) and HepG2 into a metabolically active form (mHepG2). In these cell systems, glycine promoted oxidative metabolism and mitochondrial function, collagen, glycogen, bile acid anabolism, one-carbon metabolism, and heme biosynthesis, typical of a hepatocyte phenotype. While the metabolic effects of glycine were divergent in mHepG2 and HLCs, in both cases, heme synthesis was boosted by glycine incorporation, a vital feature in supporting xenobiotic metabolism through the heme-containing enzymes CYPs. From this study, a link between glycine supplementation, carbohydrate metabolism, and enhancement of the xenobiotic machinery is established through metabolic plasticity in the maturing hepatocyte.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞代谢的调节对于多能干细胞（PSC）的发育和分化至关重要。甘氨酸被证明可以促进肝细胞成熟，增强细胞色素 P450 (CYP) 亚型 3A4 活性，这是 I 相代谢中的关键酶。本研究探讨了在补充甘氨酸的诱导 PSC (iPSC) 分化为肝细胞样细胞 (HLC) 以及 HepG2 分化为代谢活性形式 (mHepG2) 的过程中中枢代谢和外源代谢的重塑。在这些细胞系统中，甘氨酸促进氧化代谢和线粒体功能、胶原蛋白、糖原、胆汁酸合成代谢、一碳代谢和血红素生物合成，这是肝细胞表型的典型特征。虽然甘氨酸的代谢作用在 mHepG2 和 HLC 中有所不同，但在这两种情况下，甘氨酸的掺入都促进了血红素合成，这是通过含血红素的酶 CYP 支持外源代谢的重要特征。从这项研究中，通过成熟肝细胞的代谢可塑性建立了甘氨酸补充、碳水化合物代谢和外源性机制增强之间的联系。

articles.title: Multi-omics reveal phosphatidic acid phosphatases modify Niemann-Pick type C disease severity.
articles.titleZh: 多组学揭示磷脂酸磷酸酶可改变 Niemann-Pick C 型疾病的严重程度。
articles.authors: Munkacsi AB, Conway GE, Multerer K, Jackson MD, Csaki L, Rajakumar T, Sheridan JP, Niktab E, Hwu WL, Chien YH, Walterfang M, Del Rio Hernandez C, Chan RB, Zhou B, Nandakumar R, Zhang P, Di Paolo G, Maue RA, Reue K, Sturley SL.
articles.abstract: Niemann-Pick type C (NP-C) disease is a fatal, neurodegenerative disorder caused by lysosomal lipid accumulation with variable symptomatic penetrance at the primary disease locus encoded by the NPC1 gene. We identified genetic modifiers of disease progression by integrating genetic, genomic, and lipidomic analyses across yeast, mice, and human patients. A yeast screen identified 45 candidate modifiers of disease severity, including phosphatidic acid hydrolase (PAH1), a key enzyme in triacylglycerol (TAG) synthesis. Lipidomic profiling of liver, cerebral cortex, and cerebellum from Npc1 -/- mice at multiple ages demonstrated that dysregulation of TAG metabolism strongly correlates with disease progression. Deletion of the murine PAH1 orthologues Lpin1 or Lpin2 in Npc1 -/- mice reduced lifespan, accelerated Purkinje cell loss, and increased hepatic lipid accumulation. In NP-C patients, two LPIN3 variants were associated with early childhood onset. These findings identify lipins as modifiers of NP-C disease and expand our understanding of lipid metabolism in neurodegeneration.
articles.abstractZh: Niemann-Pick C 型 (NP-C) 病是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，由溶酶体脂质积累引起，在 NPC1 基因编码的原发疾病位点具有不同的症状外显率。我们通过整合酵母、小鼠和人类患者的遗传、基因组和脂质组学分析，确定了疾病进展的遗传修饰因素。酵母筛选确定了 45 种疾病严重程度的候选修饰因子，包括磷脂酸水解酶 (PAH1)，这是三酰甘油 (TAG) 合成中的关键酶。对多个年龄的 Npc1 -/- 小鼠的肝脏、大脑皮层和小脑的脂质组学分析表明，TAG 代谢失调与疾病进展密切相关。 Npc1 -/- 小鼠中小鼠 PAH1 直系同源物 Lpin1 或 Lpin2 的缺失会缩短寿命，加速浦肯野细胞损失，并增加肝脏脂质积累。在 NP-C 患者中，两种 LPIN3 变异与儿童早期发病相关。这些发现将脂质确定为 NP-C 疾病的调节剂，并扩大了我们对神经退行性变中脂质代谢的理解。

articles.title: Recent advancements of wastewater treatment by photocatalysis: A comprehensive review.
articles.titleZh: 光催化废水处理的最新进展：综合综述。
articles.authors: Swamy KR, Shyamala G, Gurugubelli TR, Ravindran G, Bathula B.
articles.abstract: The global need for clean water has led to the study of novel treatment methods, and nanotechnology is one of them as it has a high reactivity and a large surface area. Nanomaterials including titanium dioxide (TiO2), zinc oxide (ZnO), and carbon nanotubes have shown great efficiency in the removal of heavy metals, dyes, and organic pollutants via photocatalytic reactions as a sustainable water treatment process. This review critically analyzes these nanomaterials, with emphasis on metal oxide-based photocatalysts to degrade recalcitrant contaminants in wastewater. It also discusses synthesis methods, such as top-down and bottom-up methods, their working mechanisms, and applications. Ongoing challenges include large-scale production, cost effectiveness, and optimization of synthesis, which have to be addressed further. The review provides a general overview between the material design, photocatalytic activity, and environmental impact and considers the scalability, industrial viability, and long-term sustainability, thus presenting a balanced evaluation of the studies performed on a large scale.
articles.abstractZh: 全球对清洁水的需求引发了对新型处理方法的研究，纳米技术就是其中之一，因为它具有高反应活性和大表面积。作为一种可持续的水处理工艺，包括二氧化钛 (TiO2)、氧化锌 (ZnO) 和碳纳米管在内的纳米材料在通过光催化反应去除重金属、染料和有机污染物方面表现出了巨大的效率。这篇综述批判性地分析了这些纳米材料，重点是基于金属氧化物的光催化剂来降解废水中的顽固污染物。它还讨论了合成方法，例如自上而下和自下而上的方法、它们的工作机制和应用。持续存在的挑战包括大规模生产、成本效益和合成优化，这些都必须进一步解决。该综述提供了材料设计、光催化活性和环境影响之间的总体概述，并考虑了可扩展性、工业可行性和长期可持续性，从而对大规模进行的研究进行了平衡的评估。

articles.title: Stepwise multi-gate control of the HOG MAPK pathway under hyperosmotic stress.
articles.titleZh: 高渗应激下 HOG MAPK 通路的逐步多门控制。
articles.authors: Tatebayashi K, Saito H.
articles.abstract: In the budding yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae, adaptation to hyperosmotic stress is mediated by the Hog1 mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) via the high-osmolarity glycerol (HOG) pathway, which comprises a MAPK cascade and two upstream branches, SHO1 and SLN1. In the SHO1 branch, hyperosmotic stress is detected by transmembrane proteins such as Sho1, Opy2, Hkr1, and Msb2; however, the signaling steps directly controlled by the stress have remained unclear. Here, we show that hyperosmotic stress regulates three distinct steps within the SHO1 branch. It promotes the phosphorylation of the MAP2K Pbs2 by the MAP3K Ste11 through Sho1-dependent protein interactions and requires Hkr1, and it also regulates an upstream step required for Ste11 activation that depends on Hkr1 and Opy2. Together with a previously described step in Pbs2-mediated Hog1 phosphorylation, these findings show that osmotic stress regulates the pathway at three levels, defining stepwise multi-gate control of HOG pathway activation.
articles.abstractZh: 在芽殖酵母酿酒酵母中，对高渗应激的适应是由 Hog1 丝裂原激活蛋白激酶 (MAPK) 通过高渗透甘油 (HOG) 途径介导的，该途径包括 MAPK 级联和两个上游分支 SHO1 和 SLN1。在 SHO1 分支中，高渗应激由 Sho1、Opy2、Hkr1 和 Msb2 等跨膜蛋白检测；然而，由压力直接控制的信号传导步骤仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明高渗应激调节 SHO1 分支内的三个不同步骤。它通过 Sho1 依赖性蛋白质相互作用促进 MAP3K Ste11 对 MAP2K Pbs2 的磷酸化，并且需要 Hkr1，并且它还调节取决于 Hkr1 和 Opy2 的 Ste11 激活所需的上游步骤。与之前描述的 Pbs2 介导的 Hog1 磷酸化步骤一起，这些发现表明渗透压在三个水平上调节该通路，定义了 HOG 通路激活的逐步多门控。

articles.title: Structure of ergosteryl-aspartate synthase reveals how an entrapped tRNA is used like a prosthetic swinging arm in the synthesis of aminoacylated sterols.
articles.titleZh: 麦角甾醇-天冬氨酸合酶的结构揭示了如何在氨酰化甾醇的合成中像假体摇臂一样使用捕获的 tRNA。
articles.authors: Murayama H, Yakobov N, Mahmoudi N, Legrosdidier S, Fournier N, Zuttion S, Matsumoto K, Nishimura M, Ji J, Senger B, Huck L, Gamper HB, Kise Y, Kleiner RE, Frechin M, Hou YM, Becker HD, Itoh Y, Fischer F, Nureki O.
articles.abstract: Ergosteryl-3β-O-L-aspartate synthase (ErdS) catalyzes tRNA-dependent aspartylation of ergosterol, a lipid essential for fungal cell membrane integrity. However, the functional significance of ergosteryl-aspartate and the molecular mechanisms underlying its synthesis remain unclear. Here, we show that ErdS localization is highly dynamic and that Erg-Asp is required for proper hyphal growth, sporulation, and spore germination, and likely influences stress tolerance. The cryo-electron microscopy structure of ErdS revealed an unprecedented sterol-binding pocket. In addition, the structures in complex with a non-hydrolyzable Asp-N-tRNAAsp show a tRNA-guided intramolecular aminoacyl transfer mechanism between two functional domains of the enzyme. The CCA end of tRNAAsp undergoes a large displacement to reach the aa-tRNA transfer active site, while the tRNA elbow is clamped by a long extension an N-terminal α-helix. The present structural and mutational analyses demonstrate that domain fusion, dynamic repositioning, and tRNA-mediated substrate handover underlie the multifunctional catalytic efficiency of ErdS and participates in Erg-Asp synthesis independently from protein synthesis. These findings elucidate the regulatory mechanism of tRNA-dependent sterol modification and provide insights into fungal membrane dynamics, highlighting potential targets for antifungal therapies.
articles.abstractZh: 麦角甾醇-3β-O-L-天冬氨酸合酶 (ErdS) 催化麦角甾醇的 tRNA 依赖性天冬氨酸化，麦角甾醇是真菌细胞膜完整性所必需的脂质。然而，麦角甾醇天冬氨酸的功能意义及其合成的分子机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明 ErdS 定位是高度动态的，并且 Erg-Asp 是菌丝正常生长、孢子形成和孢子萌发所必需的，并且可能影响胁迫耐受性。 ErdS 的冷冻电子显微镜结构揭示了前所未有的甾醇结合袋。此外，与不可水解的 Asp-N-tRNAAsp 复合的结构显示了酶的两个功能域之间的 tRNA 引导的分子内氨酰基转移机制。 tRNAAsp 的 CCA 末端经历较大的位移以到达 aa-tRNA 转移活性位点，而 tRNA 肘部则被 N 端 α 螺旋的长延伸夹紧。目前的结构和突变分析表明，结构域融合、动态重新定位和 tRNA 介导的底物切换是 ErdS 多功能催化效率的基础，并独立于蛋白质合成参与 Erg-Asp 合成。论文

articles.title: A protein interactome for the last eukaryotic common ancestor illuminates the biochemical basis of modern genetic diseases.
articles.titleZh: 最后一个真核生物共同祖先的蛋白质相互作用组阐明了现代遗传疾病的生化基础。
articles.authors: Cox RM, Papoulas O, Shril S, Lee C, Gardner TP, Ansari ZT, Battenhouse AM, Lee M, Drew K, McWhite CD, Yang D, Leggere JC, Durand D, Hildebrandt F, Wallingford JB, Marcotte EM.
articles.abstract: All eukaryotes share a single-celled ancestor from ∼1.5 to 1.8 billion years ago, the so-called last eukaryotic common ancestor (LECA). Roughly half of gene families found in modern eukaryotes were already present in LECA, forming molecular systems that continue to influence genetic diseases and traits today. To investigate these systems, we compared genes across 156 organisms to define a core set of protein-coding gene families likely present in LECA, with a quarter remaining uncharacterized. Integrating >26,000 mass spectrometry proteomics analyses from 31 species, we inferred higher-order complexes among these ancient proteins. This reconstructed interactome reveals both established and novel assemblies, offering a biochemical snapshot of LECA's organization. Finally, by exploring these ancient protein interactions, we found new human gene-disease associations for bone density and congenital birth defects, illustrating the value of ancestral protein networks for modern functional genetics.
articles.abstractZh: 所有真核生物都有一个大约 1.5 至 18 亿年前的单细胞祖先，即所谓的最后真核共同祖先 (LECA)。现代真核生物中发现的大约一半基因家族已经存在于 LECA 中，形成了至今仍影响遗传疾病和性状的分子系统。为了研究这些系统，我们比较了 156 个生物体的基因，以确定 LECA 中可能存在的一组核心蛋白质编码基因家族，其中四分之一尚未表征。整合来自 31 个物种的超过 26,000 份质谱蛋白质组学分析，我们推断出这些古老蛋白质之间的高阶复合物。这个重建的相互作用组揭示了已建立的和新颖的组装，提供了 LECA 组织的生化快照。最后，通过探索这些古老的蛋白质相互作用，我们发现了骨密度和先天性出生缺陷的新人类基因-疾病关联，说明了祖先蛋白质网络对于现代功能遗传学的价值。

articles.title: Distinct repair outcomes from single and convergent replication fork collapse.
articles.titleZh: 单一和聚合复制叉崩溃的不同修复结果。
articles.authors: Conwell SC, Patel KVN, Weeks-Pollenz SJ, Dahmen SN, Cranford MT, Dunphy WG, Long DT, Cortez D, Dewar JM.
articles.abstract: Replication fork collapse at single-strand DNA breaks threatens genome stability but how such forks are repaired and resolved has remained unclear. Here we replicate site-specific nicks with single or converging replication forks in Xenopus laevis egg extracts. Collapse of a single fork generates a single-ended double-strand break (DSB) that undergoes homologous recombination to yield stable D-loops and end-to-end fusions, yet does not restart DNA synthesis. Single collapsed forks can also undergo extensive nucleolytic degradation, appearing to disassemble the sister fork through 'secondary collapse' events that resolve single-ended DSBs without engaging DSB repair. In contrast, semisynchronous convergent collapse generates a double-ended DSB that is primarily repaired through annealing-dependent DSB repair, completing DNA synthesis but generating precise deletions and templated insertions. These error-prone products are not detected following single-fork collapse. Our findings demonstrate that single and semisynchronous convergent collapsed forks elicit distinct repair outcomes.
articles.abstractZh: 单链 DNA 断裂时的复制叉崩溃威胁着基因组的稳定性，但如何修复和解决此类复制叉仍不清楚。在这里，我们用非洲爪蟾卵提取物中的单个或会聚复制叉复制位点特异性切口。单个叉的塌陷会产生单端双链断裂 (DSB)，该断裂经过同源重组产生稳定的 D 环和端到端融合，但不会重新启动 DNA 合成。单个塌陷叉也可能经历广泛的溶核降解，似乎通过“二次塌陷”事件分解姐妹叉，从而在不进行 DSB 修复的情况下解决单端 DSB。相比之下，半同步收敛塌陷产生双端 DSB，主要通过退火依赖性 DSB 修复进行修复，完成 DNA 合成，但产生精确的删除和模板化插入。这些容易出错的产品在单叉崩溃后不会被检测到。我们的研究结果表明，单一和半同步收敛塌陷叉会产生不同的修复结果。

articles.title: Expanding the versatility of the protein master Pichia pastoris towards efficient biosynthesis of diterpenoid sclareol.
articles.titleZh: 扩展蛋白质大师毕赤酵母的多功能性，以实现二萜香紫苏醇的有效生物合成。
articles.authors: Zhang M, Bai F, Shen Y, Cai P, Zhou YJ.
articles.abstract: Non-conventional yeasts offer unique advantages as tailored cell factories. Pichia pastoris is a master of protein expression and secretion. However, engineering P. pastoris for the overproduction of secondary metabolites is challenging due to its tightly regulated metabolism. How can we overcome this metabolic rigidity for efficient biosynthesis of energy-demanding molecules such as sclareol, a valuable diterpenoid? In this research article, we developed a host-specific framework integrating systematic pathway-level rewiring of the sclareol biosynthetic pathway and central metabolism to alleviate precursor acetyl-coenzyme A and cofactor NADPH limitations. Regulatory-level remodeling identified metabolic factors that enhance cellular robustness and protein homeostasis, reprogrammed global transcriptional regulators for carbon and nitrogen flux balance, and tailored process-level fermentation to eliminate byproducts. These efforts enabled a sclareol titer of 27.8 g l-1 in minimal medium, representing the highest diterpenoid production reported. This work redefines P. pastoris as a powerful chassis for natural product biosynthesis, providing a generalizable roadmap for engineering non-conventional hosts.
articles.abstractZh: 非传统酵母作为定制细胞工厂具有独特的优势。毕赤酵母是蛋白质表达和分泌的大师。然而，由于其代谢受到严格调控，对巴斯德毕赤酵母进行改造以过量生产次级代谢产物具有挑战性。我们如何克服这种代谢刚性，以有效地生物合成香紫苏醇（一种有价值的二萜类化合物）等需要能量的分子？在这篇研究文章中，我们开发了一个宿主特异性框架，整合香紫苏醇生物合成途径和中央代谢的系统途径水平重新布线，以减轻前体乙酰辅酶 A 和辅因子 NADPH 的限制。监管水平重塑确定了增强细胞稳健性和蛋白质稳态的代谢因子，重新编程了碳氮通量平衡的全局转录调节因子，并定制了工艺水平发酵以消除副产物。这些努力使基本培养基中的香紫苏醇滴度达到 27.8 g l-1，代表了所报告的最高二萜类化合物产量。这项工作将巴斯德毕赤酵母重新定义为天然产物生物合成的强大基础，为工程设计提供了通用的路线图。

articles.title: PlasmidGPT: A generative framework for plasmid analysis and generation.
articles.titleZh: PlasmidGPT：质粒分析和生成的生成框架。
articles.authors: Shao B, Han Z, Liang Z, Huo YX.
articles.abstract: We introduce PlasmidGPT, a generative language model pretrained on 153,208 engineered plasmid sequences from Addgene. PlasmidGPT learns informative sequence embeddings that enable visualization of research topics across laboratories and analysis of plasmid diversity across vector types. Leveraging these embeddings, PlasmidGPT accurately predicts features of engineered plasmids and achieves state-of-the-art performance in lab-of-origin prediction. The learned representations also generalize to natural plasmids, enabling host taxonomy prediction at both the phylum and genus level. Moreover, PlasmidGPT enables controlled generation of functional plasmid sequences by using either a predefined input sequence or specified design constraints, producing outputs that recapitulate the part co-occurrence and synteny of real plasmids.
articles.abstractZh: 我们引入 PlasmidGPT，这是一种在 Addgene 的 153,208 个工程质粒序列上进行预训练的生成语言模型。 PlasmidGPT 学习信息丰富的序列嵌入，从而实现跨实验室研究主题的可视化以及跨载体类型的质粒多样性分析。利用这些嵌入，PlasmidGPT 可以准确预测工程质粒的特征，并在起源实验室预测中实现最先进的性能。学习到的表示也可以推广到天然质粒，从而能够在门和属水平上进行宿主分类学预测。此外，PlasmidGPT 可以通过使用预定义的输入序列或指定的设计约束来控制功能性质粒序列的生成，产生重现真实质粒的部分共现和同线性的输出。

articles.title: The MsZFP1-MsWRKY40-MsWRKY41 module efficiently regulates LHCII biogenesis via ABA-dependent manner in alfalfa.
articles.titleZh: MsZFP1-MsWRKY40-MsWRKY41 模块通过 ABA 依赖性方式有效调节苜蓿中的 LHCII 生物发生。
articles.authors: Wen W, Gao L, Su L, Lv A, Fan N, You X, Zhang Y, Zhou P, Wang Z, Shi F, An Y.
articles.abstract: The light-harvesting complex (LHC) is the antenna system of photosystem that affects the photosynthetic efficiency of plants. In this study, MsWRKY41 was demonstrated to directly activate the expression of MsAlb3 and MsDVR1, which involved in LHC protein insertion into thylakoid membrane and chlorophyll biosynthesis, respectively. Knockdown of MsWRKY41 in alfalfa led to yellow-green leaves and abnormal thylakoid structure. MsWRKY41 was the downstream target gene of MsWRKY40, which also directly and positively regulated the expression of four LHC protein genes MsLHCB1/4.3/5/7. Overexpression of MsWRKY40 increased the accumulation of PSII-LHCII supercomplexes. MsWRKY40 physically interacted with zinc finger protein MsZFP1, which partly inhibited the expression of MsWRKY40-targeted genes. This interaction was weakened by physiologically high levels of ABA, leading to up-regulated expression of MsWRKY40-targeted genes. These results revealed a regulatory module centered on MsWRKY40-MsWRKY41, which integrates the biosynthetic processes of LHCB subunits and chlorophyll into a gene regulatory network, efficiently regulating LHCII biogenesis.
