articles.abstractZh: 光捕获复合体（LHC）是影响植物光合作用效率的光系统天线系统。在这项研究中，MsWRKY41被证明可以直接激活MsAlb3和MsDVR1的表达，它们分别参与LHC蛋白插入类囊体膜和叶绿素生物合成。苜蓿中 MsWRKY41 的敲低会导致叶子黄绿色和类囊体结构异常。 MsWRKY41是MsWRKY40的下游靶基因，也直接正向调控4个LHC蛋白基因MsLHCB1/4.3/5/7的表达。 MsWRKY40 的过度表达增加了 PSII-LHCII 超复合物的积累。 MsWRKY40 与锌指蛋白 MsZFP1 发生物理相互作用，从而部分抑制 MsWRKY40 靶向基因的表达。生理上高水平的 ABA 削弱了这种相互作用，导致 MsWRKY40 靶向基因的表达上调。这些结果揭示了一个以MsWRKY40-MsWRKY41为中心的调控模块，它将LHCB亚基和叶绿素的生物合成过程整合到基因调控网络中，有效调控LHCII生物合成。

articles.title: Dietary sulfur amino acids enhance anti-tumor immunity in colon cancer via an NKT cell-XCL1-cDC1 circuit.
articles.titleZh: 膳食含硫氨基酸通过 NKT 细胞-XCL1-cDC1 回路增强结肠癌的抗肿瘤免疫力。
articles.authors: Lobel L, Fonseca-Pereira D, Nakatsu G, Michaud M, Cao YG, Bae S, Krabak C, Oren Y, Clay SL, El Tekle G, Chun E, Kon S, Chan AT, Clardy J, Glickman JN, Ajami NJ, Day A, Damania A, Baruch EN, White MG, Diggs LP, Wargo J, Riffelmacher T, Balancio A, Kronenberg M, Huttenhower C, Garrett WS.
articles.abstract: The efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in colon cancer (CC) is limited by the tolerogenic immune landscape of both the tumor and the intestine. Here, we investigated the impact of microbial metabolic pathways associated with ICI responsiveness on anti-tumor immunity in CC. Sulfur amino acid (Saa) metabolic pathways were enriched in ICI responders and in individuals without CC. In murine models, high-Saa diets restricted CC progression, increased colonic mucus thickness, and promoted the expansion of mucus-dwelling Mucispirillum schaedleri (M. schaedleri). Dietary Saa supplementation increased the frequency of activated intratumoral cytotoxic CD8+ T cells. The protective effect of high-Saa diets required type 1 conventional dendritic cells (cDC1s) in tumor-draining lymph nodes, where M. schaedleri was sufficient to drive cDC1 expansion and activation. Mechanistically, M. schaedleri stimulated natural killer T (NKT) cell expansion and secretion of the chemokine XCL1, which was essential for cDC1 recruitment and anti-tumor immunity. Dietary modulation of this NKT-XCL1-cDC1 axis in combination with ICIs may open avenues for improved treatments of CC.
articles.abstractZh: 免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）在结肠癌（CC）中的疗效受到肿瘤和肠道的耐受性免疫环境的限制。在这里，我们研究了与 ICI 反应相关的微生物代谢途径对 CC 抗肿瘤免疫的影响。硫氨基酸 (Saa) 代谢途径在 ICI 应答者和无 CC 的个体中丰富。在小鼠模型中，高 Saa 饮食限制了 CC 的进展，增加了结肠粘液厚度，并促进了粘液中的谢氏粘螺菌 (M. schaedleri) 的扩张。膳食 Saa 补充剂增加了肿瘤内细胞毒性 CD8+ T 细胞活化的频率。高 Saa 饮食的保护作用需要肿瘤引流淋巴结中的 1 型常规树突状细胞 (cDC1)，其中 M. schaedleri 足以驱动 cDC1 扩增和激活。从机制上讲，M. schaedleri 刺激自然杀伤 T (NKT) 细胞扩增和趋化因子 XCL1 的分泌，这对于 cDC1 招募和抗肿瘤免疫至关重要。 NKT-XCL1-cDC1 轴的饮食调节与 ICI 相结合可能为改善 CC 治疗开辟途径。

articles.title: Rapid transcriptional response to a dynamic morphogen by time integration.
articles.titleZh: 通过时间整合对动态形态发生素进行快速转录反应。
articles.authors: Brantley SE, Janssen J, Chao A, Vergassola M, Blythe SA, Di Talia S.
articles.abstract: During development, cells must interpret extracellular signals with speed and accuracy. While morphogen gradients pattern tissues, how cells respond to dynamic morphogens remains unclear. Here, we investigate how dorsal patterning in the Drosophila embryo is specified by a rapidly evolving BMP gradient. Using a live reporter of BMP pathway activity and nascent transcription reporters, we find that gene expression is best predicted by time integration of BMP signaling, rather than instantaneous levels. We show that the transcription factor Zen lowers the signaling threshold required for activation, enabling integration to drive rapid transcriptional responses even at low BMP levels. We tested our integration model using mutants that alter BMP signaling dynamics. Within the normal expression domain, integration was still predictive of gene expression. However, higher levels of integrated signaling were needed in more lateral regions of the embryo, suggesting additional spatial patterning regulation. Together, these results suggest that cells interpret dynamic morphogen signals through the combined action of temporal integration and spatial competence, providing a framework for robust pattern formation on fast developmental timescales.
articles.abstractZh: 在发育过程中，细胞必须快速、准确地解释细胞外信号。虽然形态发生素梯度影响组织，但细胞如何响应动态形态发生素仍不清楚。在这里，我们研究了果蝇胚胎的背侧模式是如何通过快速演变的 BMP 梯度来指定的。使用 BMP 通路活性的实时报告器和新生转录报告器，我们发现通过 BMP 信号传导的时间整合而不是瞬时水平来最好地预测基因表达。我们发现转录因子 Zen 降低了激活所需的信号阈值，即使在低 BMP 水平下也能实现整合以驱动快速转录反应。我们使用改变 BMP 信号动力学的突变体测试了我们的整合模型。在正常表达域内，整合仍然可以预测基因表达。然而，胚胎的更多侧向区域需要更高水平的整合信号传导，这表明额外的空间模式调节。总之，这些结果表明细胞通过时间整合和空间能力的联合作用来解释动态形态发生素信号，为稳健的形态发生素信号提供了一个框架。

articles.title: Myco-synthesized copper oxide nanoparticles as a sustainable bionanofungicide for managing Fusarium falciforme and enhancing potato productivity.
articles.titleZh: 真菌合成的氧化铜纳米粒子作为可持续的生物纳米杀菌剂，用于管理镰状镰刀菌和提高马铃薯生产力。
articles.authors: Ahmed RU, Abou-Zeid AM, Ahmed AIS, Saad-Alla KM.
articles.abstract: Developing sustainable alternatives to chemical fungicides is imperative for sustainable agriculture. This study establishes a green nanotechnology approach by harnessing the biocatalytic potential of indigenous rhizosphere fungi to synthesize copper oxide nanoparticles (CuONPs). A consortium of soil-borne fungi, including Mucor circinelloides, was isolated from agricultural soils in Tanta, Egypt, and employed in the myco-synthesis of CuONPs. Comprehensive characterization confirmed the formation of crystalline, spherical nanoparticles (average size: 10.7 nm). The nanoparticles exhibited notable, dose-dependent antifungal activity in vitro, suppressing mycelial growth of the potato pathogen Fusarium falciforme by 33.95%, significantly outperforming bulk copper sulfate. Based on preliminary dose-response trials, 200 mg L- 1 was selected as the optimal concentration balancing antifungal efficacy and absence of phytotoxicity. In a greenhouse trial, foliar application of myco-synthesized CuONPs (200 mg L- 1) to F. falciforme-infected potato plants mitigated disease-induced growth inhibition, restored photosynthetic pigment levels, and rebalanced antioxidant enzyme systems, primarily enhancing catalase activity. Significantly, CuONPs supported protein homeostasis under stress and, most importantly, boosted tuber yield by up to 40% in healthy plants and appeared to restore productivity in infected ones. In contrast, the commercial fungicide showed phytotoxic effects on tuber initiation. This work establishes myco-synthesized CuONPs as a novel, dual-action agent for plant protection and growth promotion, offering a sustainable and effective strategy for integrated disease management.
articles.abstractZh: 开发化学杀菌剂的可持续替代品对于可持续农业至关重要。本研究通过利用本地根际真菌的生物催化潜力来合成氧化铜纳米颗粒（CuONP），建立了一种绿色纳米技术方法。从埃及坦塔的农业土壤中分离出包括卷枝毛霉在内的土传真菌群，并将其用于 CuONP 的真菌合成。综合表征证实了结晶球形纳米颗粒的形成（平均尺寸：10.7 nm）。该纳米颗粒在体外表现出显着的剂量依赖性抗真菌活性，可将马铃薯病原体镰状镰刀菌的菌丝生长抑制33.95%，明显优于散装硫酸铜。根据初步剂量反应试验，选择 200 mg L-1 作为平衡抗真菌功效和无植物毒性的最佳浓度。在一项温室试验中，叶面喷施真菌合成的 CuONP（200 mg L-1）至镰状镰刀菌感染的马铃薯植株，可减轻疾病引起的生长抑制，恢复光合色素水平，并重新平衡抗氧化酶系统，主要是

articles.title: Changes in gut microbiota composition following water kefir consumption in healthy adults.
articles.titleZh: 健康成年人饮用开菲尔水后肠道微生物群组成的变化。
articles.authors: de Mel R, Al Khafaji AH, Muthusamy S, Xu J, Håkansson Å.
articles.abstract: Fermented foods have gained increasing scientific interest for their potential to modulate gut microbiota and provide probiotic microorganisms with possible health benefits. This intervention trial examined the impact of daily consumption of water kefir, a sustainable plant-based fermented beverage, on gut microbiota composition in 40 healthy adults. Participants consumed 200 mL of homemade water kefir daily for 14 days, with fecal samples collected before and after the intervention. Some participants reported mild, transient gastrointestinal effects such as flatulence (32%) and bloating (24%), which are common when introducing live microorganisms, while others experienced reduced abdominal pain (28%), and most (66%) reported no noticeable change in symptoms. 16S rRNA sequencing revealed significant shifts in microbial composition, including a 6.5% decrease in Firmicutes and increases in Bacteroidetes (+ 21.6%) and Actinobacteria (+ 14.8%). At the species level, beneficial taxa such as Blautia spp. and Roseburia faecis increased, along with commensals including Bacteroides fragilis, Bacteroides uniformis, Gemmiger formicilis, Prevotella copri, and Parabacteroides distasonis (p < 0.01). Although α-diversity remained unchanged, β-diversity differed significantly between pre- and post-intervention samples (p = 0.025). By comparing the relative abundance of dominant genera in participants' gut microbiota and in water kefir, overlapping genera such as Lactobacillus, Bifidobacterium, Prevotella, Coprococcus, and Faecalibacterium were identified. Among these, Bifidobacterium and Prevotella increased, Coprococcus decreased, and Lactobacillus and Faecalibacterium remained stable. Genera exclusive to the gut microbiota also exhibited differential changes. These findings suggest that water kefir consumption is associated with modulation of the gut microbiota, including increases in saccharolytic and short-chain fatty acid (SCFA)-producing taxa, potentially influenced by its exopolysaccharides and microbial community. Some genera from water kefir may transiently affect the gut microbiome, and the concurrent increase in Bifidobacterium and Prevotella may suggest a potential probiotic-like effect. However, causality cannot be established, and further studies are needed to assess the persistence of these changes and their long-term clinical relevance.
articles.abstractZh: 发酵食品因其调节肠道微生物群和为益生菌微生物提供可能的健康益处的潜力而受到越来越多的科学关注。这项干预试验研究了每天饮用开菲尔水（一种可持续的植物性发酵饮料）对 40 名健康成年人肠道微生物群组成的影响。参与者连续 14 天每天饮用 200 毫升自制开菲尔水，并在干预前后收集粪便样本。一些参与者报告出现轻微、短暂的胃肠道反应，例如肠胃气胀 (32%) 和腹胀 (24%)，这在引入活微生物时很常见，而其他参与者则出现腹痛减轻 (28%) 的情况，大多数 (66%) 报告症状没有明显变化。 16S rRNA 测序显示微生物组成发生显着变化，包括厚壁菌门减少 6.5%，拟杆菌门 (+ 21.6%) 和放线菌门 (+ 14.8%) 增加。在物种层面，有益的类群如布劳特亚属（Blautia spp）。和 Roseburia faecis 增加，同时共生菌包括脆弱拟杆菌、均匀拟杆菌、蚁形杆菌、普雷沃氏菌和 distasonis 副拟杆菌 (p < 0.

articles.title: Dual-channel optogenetics in yeast for multiplexed light-based control of cellular processes and pathways.
articles.titleZh: 酵母中的双通道光遗传学用于细胞过程和途径的多重光控制。
articles.authors: Tan LYH, Lin Z, Yeoh JW, Zhang J, Poh CL.
articles.abstract: Optogenetics which involves the use of light to control cell functions on a genetic level has found utility in studying cell physiology, biomaterials and metabolic engineering. S. cerevisiae is an industrially relevant model organism that is used in many applications, but due to the large number of genes required and issues relating to cross-activation between different colours, optogenetics for different wavelengths of light have not been multiplexed in S. cerevisiae. In this paper, we develop a compact red light responsive optogenetic system for S. cerevisiae that requires only a single gene and no exogenous cofactors. Through engineering modular protein domains, we reduce the cross-activation of our system by blue light. We integrate our red light optogenetic system with EL222 blue light optogenetics to establish dual channel optogenetics in S. cerevisiae and demonstrate its utility for engineering biology through the light-based control of flavonoid luteolin synthesis and flocculation for ease of product extraction. We also demonstrate our system's potential for the development of living materials by producing dual-coloured optogenetic patterns using S. cerevisiae. This work expands optogenetic applications in S. cerevisiae from single-light to multi-light systems, introducing the potential to multiplex different colours of light for dynamic, orthogonal control of separate cell processes.
articles.abstractZh: 光遗传学涉及利用光在基因水平上控制细胞功能，它在研究细胞生理学、生物材料和代谢工程中具有实用性。酿酒酵母是一种工业相关的模式生物，用于许多应用，但由于需要大量基因以及与不同颜色之间交叉激活相关的问题，不同波长光的光遗传学尚未在酿酒酵母中多重化。在本文中，我们为酿酒酵母开发了一种紧凑的红光响应光遗传学系统，该系统仅需要单个基因且不需要外源辅因子。通过设计模块化蛋白质结构域，我们减少了蓝光对系统的交叉激活。我们将红光光遗传学系统与 EL222 蓝光光遗传学相结合，在酿酒酵母中建立双通道光遗传学，并通过基于光的黄酮类木犀草素合成和絮凝控制以方便产品提取，展示其在工程生物学中的实用性。我们还通过使用酿酒酵母产生双色光遗传学图案来展示我们的系统开发生物材料的潜力。这项工作前

articles.title: Fungal metabolite-based immunotherapy overcomes tumor-associated macrophage immunosuppression.
articles.titleZh: 基于真菌代谢物的免疫疗法克服了肿瘤相关巨噬细胞的免疫抑制。
articles.authors: Hu J, Ju X, Deng B, Tang K, Yuan D, Sun X, Kong L, Xu Y, Fu Z, Koda S, Shao S, Chen Y, Sun G, Zheng S, Zhao H, Liu Y, Chen H, Zong Z, Ma Y, Yu H, Qin Y, Li X, Hua H, Zhao Y, Tang R, Zheng K, Tong C, Ling Teng MW, Dong X, Deng X, Li Y, Yang YL, Chen Y, Yan J.
articles.abstract: Tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) are key drivers of immunosuppression in the tumor microenvironment, yet effective strategies to reprogram them remain limited. Here, we develop an exogenous precursor-assisted fungal metabolite (ePAFM) strategy, which generates bioactive fungal metabolites, and identify IM502, a meroterpenoid-like compound, as a potent TAM modulator. Mechanistically, IM502 primarily inhibits PI3Kγ and redirects STAT signaling from STAT3/6 to STAT1/2 dominance, thereby reversing TAM-mediated immunosuppression, substantially enhancing the abundance and functional quality of natural killer (NK) and T cells. Notably, IM502 reprograms human colorectal cancer TAMs, restoring CD8+ T cell proliferation. It suppresses established tumors and metastases across multiple cancer types, demonstrating superior efficacy to other macrophage-targeted agents, effects comparable to clinical drugs, and an ability to overcome PD-1 blockade resistance. This work establishes the ePAFM platform for metabolite generation and highlights the promise of IM502 for cancer immunotherapy.
articles.abstractZh: 肿瘤相关巨噬细胞（TAM）是肿瘤微环境中免疫抑制的关键驱动因素，但对其进行重新编程的有效策略仍然有限。在这里，我们开发了一种外源前体辅助真菌代谢物 (ePAFM) 策略，该策略可产生具有生物活性的真菌代谢物，并鉴定出 IM502（一种类萜类化合物）作为有效的 TAM 调节剂。从机制上讲，IM502 主要抑制 PI3Kγ，并将 STAT 信号从 STAT3/6 重定向到 STAT1/2 主导，从而逆转 TAM 介导的免疫抑制，显着增强自然杀伤 (NK) 和 T 细胞的丰度和功能质量。值得注意的是，IM502 重新编程人类结直肠癌 TAM，恢复 CD8+ T 细胞增殖。它可抑制多种癌症类型的已形成肿瘤和转移，表现出优于其他巨噬细胞靶向药物的功效、与临床药物相当的效果，以及克服 PD-1 阻断耐药性的能力。这项工作建立了用于代谢物生成的 ePAFM 平台，并强调了 IM502 在癌症免疫治疗中的前景。

articles.title: Scalable and cost-efficient custom gene library assembly from oligopools.
articles.titleZh: 从寡池组装可扩展且经济高效的定制基因库。
articles.authors: Freschlin CR, Yang KK, Romero PA.
articles.abstract: Advances in metagenomics, deep learning, and generative protein design have enabled broad in silico exploration of sequence space, but experimental characterization is still constrained by the cost and scalability of DNA synthesis. Here, we present OMEGA (Oligo-based Multiplexed Efficient Gene Assembly), a low-cost, accessible method for assembling hundreds to thousands of full-length genes in parallel using standard laboratory techniques. OMEGA computationally fragments target genes into short, high-fidelity Golden Gate-compatible oligonucleotides that can be ordered as a pooled library and assembled across multiplexed subpools. We systematically optimized the number of fragments per gene and orthogonal ligation sites per reaction and determine that OMEGA can assemble up to 2.6-kilobase constructs using as many as 70 Golden Gate sites. To validate the approach, we assembled and functionally screened a library of 810 natural and synthetic green fluorescent protein variants, recovering 94 to 97% of target sequences with high uniformity. OMEGA enables precision library construction at scale, with per-gene costs as low as $1.50, and offers a broadly applicable solution for bridging computational protein design with high-throughput experimental validation. We have developed OMEGA as an open-source software package and an easy-to-use Colab notebook to facilitate community adaptation.
articles.abstractZh: 宏基因组学、深度学习和生成蛋白质设计的进步使得对序列空间进行广泛的计算机探索成为可能，但实验表征仍然受到 DNA 合成的成本和可扩展性的限制。在这里，我们提出了 OMEGA（基于寡核苷酸的多重高效基因组装），这是一种低成本、易于使用的方法，可使用标准实验室技术并行组装数百至数千个全长基因。 OMEGA 通过计算将目标基因片段化为短的、高保真金门兼容的寡核苷酸，这些寡核苷酸可以作为混合文库订购，并在多重子池中组装。我们系统地优化了每个基因的片段数量和每个反应的正交连接位点，并确定 OMEGA 可以使用多达 70 个 Golden Gate 位点组装多达 2.6 KB 的构建体。为了验证该方法，我们组装并功能筛选了 810 个天然和合成绿色荧光蛋白变体的文库，以高度均匀性回收了 94% 至 97% 的目标序列。 OMEGA 能够大规模精确构建文库，每个基因的成本低至 1.50 美元，并为桥接基因库提供广泛适用的解决方案。

articles.title: Shifting IRES versus Cap-initiated translation during homeostatic stem cell differentiation and stress.
articles.titleZh: 在稳态干细胞分化和应激过程中，IRES 的变化与 Cap 启动的翻译相对应。
articles.authors: Mazzola MC, Zhao T, Kiem A, Kristiansen TA, Gustafsson K, Wong LP, Scott-Solomon E, Fahlberg MD, Mayerhofer C, Mayerhofer E, Forward S, Assita ER, Schiroli G, Handley M, Kfoury Y, Fukushima T, Li D, Keyes S, Sharda A, Milosevic J, Kato H, Ivanov P, Sykes DB, Kwok SJJ, Sadreyev RI, Sankaran VG, Hsu YC, Scadden DT.
articles.abstract: Cell stress can increase the use of methylated guanosine (m7G) cap-independent, internal ribosome entry site (IRES)-mediated translation initiation relative to cap-dependent translation (IRES/Cap). Reporters that quantify IRES/Cap have demonstrated differential activity across cultured cell types and stress conditions. By generating an IRES/Cap reporter mouse, we were able to systematically evaluate IRES/Cap across distinct tissues and cell types during physiological stresses and lineage commitment. Caloric stress invoked the expected boost in IRES/Cap translation regardless of differentiation state, but unexpectedly, IRES/Cap progressively increased during hematopoietic and epithelial (hair follicle) differentiation under normal, homeostatic conditions. This was independent of total protein output or cell cycle. Even within cells of a given differentiation state, cells with lower relative IRES utilization had markedly higher multipotent capability in vivo. The RNA processing protein PTBP1 is a mediator of this translation initiation preference. Therefore, low IRES/Cap is a signature of high stemness and suggests that modulation of translation initiation participates in cell differentiation state.
articles.abstractZh: 相对于帽子依赖性翻译（IRES/Cap），细胞应激可以增加甲基化鸟苷（m7G）的使用，帽子独立的、内部核糖体进入位点（IRES）介导的翻译起始。量化 IRES/Cap 的记者已证明不同培养细胞类型和应激条件下的活性存在差异。通过生成 IRES/Cap 报告小鼠，我们能够在生理应激和谱系定型期间系统地评估不同组织和细胞类型的 IRES/Cap。无论分化状态如何，热量应激都会引起 IRES/Cap 翻译的预期增强，但出乎意料的是，在正常稳态条件下，IRES/Cap 在造血和上皮（毛囊）分化过程中逐渐增加。这与总蛋白输出或细胞周期无关。即使在给定分化状态的细胞内，相对IRES利用率较低的细胞在体内也具有明显较高的多能能力。 RNA 加工蛋白 PTBP1 是这种翻译起始偏好的介导者。因此，低 IRES/Cap 是高干性的标志，表明翻译起始的调节参与细胞差异

articles.title: Stepwise construction of the path to doubled haploid breeding in sorghum.
articles.titleZh: 高粱双单倍体育种路径的逐步构建.
articles.authors: Sui Y, Sun Y, Cheng Z, Li Y, Li K, Zhang X, Yin T, Yang S, Li G, Liu M, Tang S, Wu C.
articles.abstract: Doubled haploid (DH) breeding greatly accelerates crop improvement, but efficient in vivo haploid induction has remained limited primarily to maize because readily available haploid inducers are lacking in other species. Here, we establish a complete DH breeding pipeline for sorghum by overcoming this key limitation. Using genome editing, we developed maternal haploid inducers that achieved haploid induction rates up to 16.04% in the P898012 background, with an average of 12.18% across 92 diverse crosses (15,156 seeds; various genetic backgrounds and environments). A dual-marker system combining fluorescence and pigmentation enabled reliable haploid identification. By optimizing a scalable emasculation protocol and using sorghum's naturally high rate of chromosome doubling, we established an efficient in planta DH production process. This framework provides a practical, transferable approach to implementing DH technology in sorghum and other crops.
articles.abstractZh: 双单倍体 (DH) 育种极大地加速了作物改良，但有效的体内单倍体诱导仍然主要限于玉米，因为其他物种缺乏现成的单倍体诱导剂。在这里，我们克服了这一关键限制，建立了完整的高粱DH育种管道。通过基因组编辑，我们开发了母本单倍体诱导剂，在 P898012 背景下单倍体诱导率高达 16.04%，在 92 个不同的杂交（15,156 粒种子；各种遗传背景和环境）中平均单倍体诱导率为 12.18%。结合荧光和色素沉着的双标记系统实现了可靠的单倍体鉴定。通过优化可扩展的去雄方案并利用高粱天然的高染色体加倍率，我们建立了高效的植物 DH 生产工艺。该框架提供了一种实用的、可转移的方法来在高粱和其他作物上实施区域供暖技术。

articles.title: Cystine C-S bond cleavage fuels cysteine production under disulfide reductase deficiency.
articles.titleZh: 在二硫键还原酶缺乏的情况下，胱氨酸 C-S 键断裂会促进半胱氨酸的产生。
articles.authors: Schmidt EE, Jurányi EP, Miller CG, Austad SA, Ditrói T, Seaford ZM, Yoon SJ, Noyd RC, Kang YP, Prigge JR, Csikós V, Serrano Alvarez M, Erdélyi K, Kővári D, DeNicola GM, Nagy P.
articles.abstract: All organisms have thioredoxin reductase (TR) or glutathione reductase (GR), the only enzymes that use reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate to reduce cytosolic disulfides into thiols, thereby powering deoxyribonucleotide biosynthesis, elimination of oxidants, oxidative damage repair and reduction of the disulfide nutrient cystine into the thiol amino acid cysteine. Hence, TR/GR-null bacteria or yeast are inviable; yet, remarkably, mice with TR/GR-null livers thrive, in part by synthesizing life-sustaining cysteine through alternative pathways that evolved in metazoans. Although TR/GR-null livers generate some of their cysteine through the serine transsulfuration pathway, we here show that most cysteine in TR/GR-null livers comes from a pathway in which pyridoxal-phosphate-dependent cleavage of a carbon-sulfur bond in cystine generates cysteine persulfide, which decomposes nonenzymatically into cysteine. This potent yet previously unrecognized pathway is regulated by cellular levels of sulfur metabolites and represents a potent cytoprotective response that might be induced in most mammalian cells under conditions that chronically elevate cytosolic cystine levels.
articles.abstractZh: 所有生物体都含有硫氧还蛋白还原酶 (TR) 或谷胱甘肽还原酶 (GR)，这是唯一使用还原烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸磷酸将胞质二硫化物还原为硫醇的酶，从而为脱氧核糖核苷酸生物合成、消除氧化剂、氧化损伤修复以及将二硫键营养素胱氨酸还原为硫醇氨基酸半胱氨酸提供动力。因此，TR/GR 无效的细菌或酵母菌是无法生存的；然而，值得注意的是，肝脏 TR/GR 缺失的小鼠却能茁壮成长，部分原因是通过后生动物进化的替代途径合成维持生命的半胱氨酸。虽然TR/GR无效的肝脏通过丝氨酸转硫途径产生一些半胱氨酸，但我们在这里表明TR/GR无效的肝脏中的大多数半胱氨酸来自这样的途径，其中胱氨酸中碳硫键的吡哆醛-磷酸依赖性裂解产生半胱氨酸过硫化物，其非酶促分解为半胱氨酸。这种有效但以前未被识别的途径受硫代谢物的细胞水平调节，并且代表了一种有效的细胞保护反应，可能在长期升高胞质胱氨酸水平的条件下在大多数哺乳动物细胞中诱导。

articles.title: Experimental evolution reveals genomic signatures of variety-specific selection of Cercospora beticola in Germany.
articles.titleZh: 实验进化揭示了德国 Cercospora beticola 品种特异性选择的基因组特征。
articles.authors: Yang Y, Wyatt NA, Martinez AL, Bolton MD, Lennefors BL, Keunecke H, Reineke H, Köhler M, Varrelmann M, Liebe S.
articles.abstract: Cercospora leaf spot, caused by Cercospora beticola, is the most destructive foliar disease of sugar beet. Management has relied heavily on fungicides, but widespread fungicide resistance emphasized the need for resistant varieties. To assess how varietal resistance shapes C. beticola populations, we conducted a 3-year field experiment at four locations in Germany using sugar beet varieties ranging from susceptible to highly resistant. Infected leaves were collected separately per variety and location to serve as inoculum for the following year, maintaining variety- and location-specific pathogen populations under controlled selective conditions. A total of 900 isolates were subjected to whole-genome sequencing and population genetic analyses. Isolates collected in 2022 showed extensive admixture among locations. Equal mating-type ratios were observed in some populations but skewed in others, suggesting that sexual reproduction may occur locally. Location-specific re-inoculation preserved population continuity but did not produce detectable local adaptation. By contrast, the population was affected to some extent by variety-specific re-inoculation. Populations from one highly resistant variety formed two divergent lineages with reduced diversity and altered allele frequency spectra, consistent with host-driven selection. Genome scans identified 26 candidate genes, including two putative effectors, associated with adaptation to the highly resistant variety. These findings demonstrate rapid C. beticola adaptation to resistant varieties, highlighting the role of host-driven selection in resistance management.
articles.abstractZh: 甜菜尾孢叶斑病是由甜菜尾孢菌引起的，是甜菜最具破坏性的叶部病害。管理在很大程度上依赖于杀菌剂，但广泛的杀菌剂抗性强调了对抗性品种的需求。为了评估品种抗性如何影响 C. beticola 种群，我们在德国的四个地点使用从易感到高抗性的甜菜品种进行了为期 3 年的田间实验。每个品种和地点分别收集受感染的叶子，作为来年的接种物，在受控的选择条件下维持品种和地点特定的病原体种群。总共对 900 个分离株进行了全基因组测序和群体遗传分析。 2022 年收集的分离株显示不同地点存在广泛混合。在一些种群中观察到相同的交配类型比例，但在其他种群中观察到了倾斜，这表明有性繁殖可能发生在当地。特定地点的重新接种保留了种群的连续性，但没有产生可检测到的局部适应。相比之下，种群在一定程度上受到了特定品种再接种的影响。来自一种高度抵抗力的人群

articles.title: Ribo-Tweezer: Rapid removal of ribosomal proteins reveals additional layers of post-transcriptional gene regulation.
articles.titleZh: Ribo-Tweezer：快速去除核糖体蛋白揭示了转录后基因调控的额外层。
articles.authors: Chen Y, Cheng CP, Cates K, Marinov GK, Lantz TC, Yang H, Liu I, Genuth NR, Andronescu C, Hung V, Bermudez A, Rothschild D, Georgeson J, Barocio SB, Kundaje A, Pitteri S, Ruggero D, Barna M.
articles.abstract: The ribosome is a ribozyme, but it also acts as a dynamic regulator of gene expression. Although ribosomal protein (RP) composition varies, dissecting the functional contributions of individual RPs beyond their housekeeping roles is challenging because of the lack of tools for manipulation in situ. Here, we developed Ribo-Tweezer, a degron-based system directly tethered to mature ribosomes that enables rapid, reversible, and selective depletion of specific RPs. Using Ribo-Tweezer in mouse embryonic stem cells (mESC), we find a previously uncharacterized role for RACK1 in stem cell fate control via translational regulation of zinc-finger transcriptional networks and long interspersed nuclear element-1 (LINE1) expression. This translation-transcription coupling provides a mechanism by which translation control is further amplified in gene regulation. Distinct translational programs induced by RPLP0 and RPLP1 depletion further demonstrate RP-specific regulatory functions in translation. Together, these findings establish Ribo-Tweezer as a powerful platform that has illuminated selective functions for RPs in gene regulation, which gives biological meaning to ribosome heterogeneity.
articles.abstractZh: 核糖体是一种核酶，但它也充当基因表达的动态调节剂。尽管核糖体蛋白 (RP) 的组成各不相同，但由于缺乏原位操作工具，剖析单个 RP 在其管家角色之外的功能贡献具有挑战性。在这里，我们开发了Ribo-Tweezer，一种基于降解决定子的系统，直接连接到成熟核糖体，能够快速、可逆和选择性地消耗特定的RP。在小鼠胚胎干细胞 (mESC) 中使用 Ribo-Tweezer，我们发现 RACK1 通过锌指转录网络的翻译调节和长散布核元件 1 (LINE1) 表达在干细胞命运控制中发挥着先前未表征的作用。这种翻译-转录耦合提供了一种在基因调控中进一步放大翻译控制的机制。 RPLP0 和 RPLP1 缺失诱导的不同翻译程序进一步证明了 RP 特异性的翻译调节功能。总之，这些发现使 Ribo-Tweezer 成为一个强大的平台，阐明了 RP 在基因调控中的选择性功能，这赋予了核糖体异质性生物学意义。

articles.title: Antibacterial and anticancer properties of Streptomyces microflavus BA2 isolated from brackish waters.
articles.titleZh: 从咸水中分离出的微黄链霉菌 BA2 的抗菌和抗癌特性。
articles.authors: Atallah BM, El-Domany R, Agwa HE, El-Mohsnawy E.
articles.abstract: The increasing incidence of cancer and the rapid emergence of antibiotic-resistant pathogens represent two of the greatest global health threats and necessitate safe, multifunctional agents. In the present study, the brackish water actinomycete Streptomyces microflavus BA2 was isolated from sediments of Lake Burullus (Egypt). Morphological and molecular analyses, including 16 S rRNA sequencing, confirmed its membership in the family Streptomycetaceae with 100% agreement to S. microflavus NRRL B-2156. The culture filtrate showed potent antibacterial activity against Staphylococcus aureus, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Proteus mirabilis, Salmonella typhi and Escherichia coli, with the aqueous diethyl ether fraction exhibiting the highest inhibition. GC-MS analyses identified seven bioactive compounds, including five fatty acids with antibacterial and anticancer properties, as well as phenolic derivatives. The diethyl ether extract showed moderate antitumor activity against HepG-2 liver cancer cells (IC₅₀ = 189.66 µg/ml), moderate antioxidant potential (IC₅₀ = 74.15 ± 3.27 mg/ml), and safe to moderate toxicity to normal WI-38 lung fibroblasts. These results underscore the high biomedical potential of S. microflavus BA2 as a promising source of natural agents for combating cancer and antibiotic resistance.
articles.abstractZh: 癌症发病率的增加和抗生素耐药病原体的迅速出现是全球最大的两个健康威胁，因此需要安全、多功能的药物。在本研究中，从布鲁勒斯湖（埃及）的沉积物中分离出了咸水放线菌 Streptomyces microflavus BA2。形态学和分子分析（包括 16 S rRNA 测序）证实其属于链霉菌科，与 S. microflavus NRRL B-2156 100% 一致。培养滤液对金黄色葡萄球菌、肺炎克雷伯菌、奇异变形杆菌、伤寒沙门氏菌和大肠杆菌表现出有效的抗菌活性，其中乙醚水溶液部分表现出最高的抑制作用。 GC-MS 分析鉴定出七种生物活性化合物，包括五种具有抗菌和抗癌特性的脂肪酸，以及酚类衍生物。二乙醚提取物对 HepG-2 肝癌细胞显示出中等的抗肿瘤活性 (IC₅₀ = 189.66 µg/ml)，具有中等的抗氧化潜力 (IC₅₀ = 74.15 ± 3.27 mg/ml)，对正常 WI-38 肺成纤维细胞具有安全至中度的毒性。这些结果凸显了生物医学的高水平

articles.title: Characterisation of Kothea flammea gen. nov., sp. nov., a planctomycete of the family Pirellulaceae isolated from Fjord Schlei in the Baltic Sea.
articles.titleZh: Kothea flammea 属的特征。十一月，SP。 11 月，从波罗的海的 Fjord Schlei 分离出的 Pirellulaceae 科浮霉菌。
articles.authors: Kumar G, Kallscheuer N, Appiah D, Hammer J, Haufschild T, Jogler C.
articles.abstract: The flame-like reddish to orange-pigmented planctomycetal strain SH139T was isolated from brackish water obtained from Fjord Schlei in Northern Germany as part of an isolation effort led by Heinz Schlesner at Kiel University between the 1980s and early 2000s. Single gene- and whole genome-based analyses employing five established phylogenetic markers indicate that the novel isolate constitutes a novel genus and species within the family Pirellulaceae in the phylum Planctomycetota. The strain is aerobic, heterotrophic, mesophilic, and exhibits neutrophilic to slight alkaliphilic properties. Its genome size and DNA G + C content of 7.8 Mb and 55.8%, respectively, are comparable to the current closest relatives. The results of the phenotypic and phylogenetic analyses are supported by comprehensive comparative genomic data, including pangenome reconstruction and profiling of carbohydrate-active enzymes and biosynthetic gene clusters. We thus introduce Kothea flammea gen. nov., sp. nov., that is constituted by the here characterized isolate SH139T (= KCTC 102020T = DSM 116129T) as type strain. The novel genus is named after Prof. Erika Kothe (Friedrich Schiller University Jena, Germany) in recognition of her pioneering work on microbial communication.
articles.abstractZh: 火焰状的淡红色至橙色的浮游菌菌株 SH139T 是从德国北部 Fjord Schlei 的微咸水中分离出来的，这是基尔大学 Heinz Schlesner 在 20 世纪 80 年代至 2000 年代初领导的分离工作的一部分。采用五个已建立的系统发育标记进行的基于单基因和全基因组的分析表明，该新分离株构成浮霉菌门皮雷菌科中的新属和种。该菌株是需氧、异养、嗜温的，并表现出嗜中性至轻度嗜碱的特性。其基因组大小和 DNA G + C 含量分别为 7.8 Mb 和 55.8%，与目前最接近的亲属相当。表型和系统发育分析的结果得到了全面的比较基因组数据的支持，包括全基因组重建以及碳水化合物活性酶和生物合成基因簇的分析。因此，我们介绍了 Kothea flammea gen。十一月，SP。 11月11日，其由此处表征的分离株SH139T（= KCTC 102020T = DSM 116129T）作为模式菌株组成。该新属以 Erika Kothe 教授（德国耶拿弗里德里希席勒大学）命名

articles.title: COST1 stimulates RHD3 GTPase activity to maintain ER morphology and plant growth in <i>Arabidopsis</i>.
articles.titleZh: COST1 刺激 RHD3 GTPase 活性以维持拟南芥中的 ER 形态和植物生长。
articles.authors: Wang J, Jiang J, Ren J, Zhao Y, Zhang Y, Feng D, Li Y, Zhang Q, Niu Y, Zhang X, Xu K, Sun J, Wang P, Zheng H, Bassham DC, Wang C, Hu J, Bao Y.
articles.abstract: The endoplasmic reticulum (ER) is essential for cellular homeostasis, yet plant-specific mechanisms regulating its structure remain poorly understood. Here, we uncover a functional partnership between the Arabidopsis dynamin-like GTPase RHD3 and the plant-specific DUF641 protein COST1 in maintaining ER morphology and plant growth. COST1 was previously isolated as a negative regulator of autophagy in the drought response. In this study, by using IP-MS, we identified COST1 as an ER-associated protein that interacts directly with RHD3, a key regulator of ER membrane fusion. COST1, despite lacking transmembrane domains, tightly associates with the ER membrane via RHD3, which recruits COST1 to ER three-way junctions. In addition, recruiting of COST1 to the ER can improve the dimerization of RHD3 and its protein stability. Biochemical assays revealed that COST1 promotes the GTP hydrolysis activity of RHD3 by ~20% and significantly stimulates its membrane fusion capacity. Structural modeling predicts a heterotetrameric complex entangled with each protein's multiple helix bundles, where COST1's carboxyl-terminal domain aligns with RHD3's GTPase region, suggesting a mechanism for GTP hydrolysis regulation. Genetic analyses demonstrated that cost1 rhd3 double mutants exhibit exacerbated ER fragmentation and stunted growth compared with single mutants, underscoring their synergistic roles. Transcriptomic profiling linked these phenotypes to disordered stress responding and growth pathways. Our findings reveal a plant-specific regulatory module in which COST1 partners with RHD3 to govern ER architecture, bridging membrane dynamics with growth and stress adaptation, providing insights into ER maintenance mechanisms with plant innovations and the potential applications in improving crop resilience.
articles.abstractZh: 内质网（ER）对于细胞稳态至关重要，但调节其结构的植物特异性机制仍知之甚少。在这里，我们发现了拟南芥动力蛋白样 GTPase RHD3 和植物特异性 DUF641 蛋白 COST1 在维持 ER 形态和植物生长方面的功能伙伴关系。 COST1 之前被分离为干旱反应中自噬的负调节因子。在这项研究中，通过使用 IP-MS，我们将 COST1 鉴定为一种 ER 相关蛋白，它与 RHD3（ER 膜融合的关键调节因子）直接相互作用。尽管 COST1 缺乏跨膜结构域，但它通过 RHD3 与 ER 膜紧密结合，RHD3 将 COST1 招募到 ER 三路连接处。此外，将COST1招募到ER可以改善RHD3的二聚化及其蛋白质稳定性。生化检测显示，COST1 可将 RHD3 的 GTP 水解活性提高约 20%，并显着刺激其膜融合能力。结构模型预测异四聚体复合物与每种蛋白质的多个螺旋束纠缠在一起，其中 COST1 的羧基末端结构域与 RHD3 的 GTPase 区域对齐，这表明 GTP 水解的机制

articles.title: Deciphering the ancestral mechanisms of neural regeneration through single-cell analyses of jellyfish rhopalium repair.
articles.titleZh: 通过水母修复的单细胞分析破译神经再生的祖先机制。
articles.authors: Li Y, Wang F, Sun T, Ma X, Yu Z, Xu Z, Wang W, Xing Y, Peng S, Wang L, Zhao J, Dong Z.
articles.abstract: The rhopalium, an early specialized centralized nervous structure in medusozoans, exhibits a remarkable regenerative capacity after removal, offering a unique model for investigating the ancestral regulatory logic of neural regeneration. However, the cellular and molecular mechanisms underlying the process remain unknown. Here, we defined distinct stages of rhopalium regeneration in the jellyfish Aurelia coerulea and constructed a stage-specific cell landscape and gene regulatory networks. Notably, we identified a population of wound-induced cells that emerges rapidly postinjury and activates Wnt signaling to initiate blastema formation; cross-species comparisons revealed that this regulatory mechanism is conserved across metazoans. We further identified that retinoic acid signaling is essential for photoreceptor regeneration and ocelli reconstruction. The findings presented herein uncover the ancestral regulatory mechanisms governing neural regeneration in the early centralized nervous system, providing insights into the common evolutionary origins of neural repair across organisms.
articles.abstractZh: rhopalium是水生动物中一种早期特化的中枢神经结构，在去除后表现出显着的再生能力，为研究神经再生的祖先调节逻辑提供了独特的模型。然而，该过程背后的细胞和分子机制仍然未知。在这里，我们定义了水母 Aurelia coerulea 中 rhopalium 再生的不同阶段，并构建了特定阶段的细胞景观和基因调控网络。值得注意的是，我们发现了一组伤口诱导的细胞，这些细胞在受伤后迅速出现，并激活 Wnt 信号传导以启动胚基形成；跨物种比较表明，这种调节机制在后生动物中是保守的。我们进一步确定视黄酸信号对于光感受器再生和单眼重建至关重要。本文提出的研究结果揭示了早期中枢神经系统中控制神经再生的祖先调节机制，为跨生物体神经修复的共同进化起源提供了见解。

articles.title: In situ cryo-ET defines the ultrastructure of ER exit sites in human cells.
articles.titleZh: 原位冷冻电子断层扫描定义了人体细胞内质网出口位点的超微结构。
articles.authors: Downes KW, Flood JR, Nans A, Van der Verren SE, Audhya A, Zanetti G.
articles.abstract: Trafficking of secretory proteins from the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) to the Golgi apparatus comprises the first, essential steps towards the appropriate localization of 30% of eukaryotic proteins. Coat protein complexes COPII and COPI are involved in the forward and retrograde transport of cargo and cargo receptors between the ER and the Golgi, respectively. Although COPII forms coated vesicles in vitro, the biogenesis, morphology and organization of transport carriers in mammalian cells is subject to debate. Here we use in situ cryo-electron tomography and super-resolution fluorescence microscopy to reveal the molecular architecture of ER exit sites in human cells that were not perturbed with drugs, temperature blocks or overexpression systems. We visualize ribosome-exclusion zones enriched with COPII- and COPI-coated vesicles and thus resolve the debate regarding the existence of COPII-coated vesicles. COPII vesicles derive from ER membranes, whereas COPI vesicles originate from vesicular-tubular clusters that constitute the ER-Golgi intermediate compartment (ERGIC). We quantify coated vesicle morphology and positioning with respect to other ER exit site components, providing a molecular description of the organization of the mammalian early secretory pathway.
articles.abstractZh: 将分泌蛋白从内质网 (ER) 运输到高尔基体是实现 30% 真核蛋白适当定位的首要且重要的步骤。外壳蛋白复合物 COPII 和 COPI 分别参与内质网和高尔基体之间货物和货物受体的正向和逆行运输。尽管 COPII 在体外形成包被囊泡，但哺乳动物细胞中转运载体的生物发生、形态和组织仍存在争议。在这里，我们使用原位冷冻电子断层扫描和超分辨率荧光显微镜来揭示人类细胞中内质网出口位点的分子结构，这些位点不受药物、温度阻断或过度表达系统的干扰。我们对富含 COPII 和 COPI 包被囊泡的核糖体排斥区进行可视化，从而解决了有关 COPII 包被囊泡是否存在的争论。 COPII 囊泡源自 ER 膜，而 COPI 囊泡源自构成 ER-高尔基体中间室 (ERGIC) 的囊泡管状簇。我们量化包被囊泡的形态和相对于其他 ER 出口部位成分的定位，提供了

articles.title: Intestinal obstruction impairs feeding and promotes sleep in <i>Drosophila melanogaster</i>.
articles.titleZh: 肠梗阻会损害黑腹果蝇的进食并促进睡眠。
articles.authors: Reinger C, Blackie L, Medeiros AM, Gillet H, Kring C, Gaspar P, Hadjieconomou D, Sickmann M, Affolter M, Miguel-Aliaga I, Müller M, Kempf A.
articles.abstract: At the onset of life, feeding must be initiated while developmental waste products-the meconium-need to be eliminated. Although these two fundamental physiological processes are interconnected, their mechanistic coupling remains poorly understood. Using Drosophila as a model system, we investigated the coordination of these processes. We show that meconium excretion starts shortly after eclosion and that feeding initiation begins only after partial meconium elimination. We identified a cis-regulatory element associated with the apterous gene that is required for proper hindgut development. Its disruption prevents meconium excretion and leads to intestinal obstruction. As a result, flies with a defective element avoid food and exhibit increased proboscis extension sleep. Experimental inhibition of excretion in freshly eclosed flies recapitulates these phenotypes, indicating that intestinal blockage is sufficient to impair feeding and alter sleep/wake states. The progression of phenotypes parallels hallmarks of mechanical gut obstruction in humans, suggesting that the observed effects may arise from broader physiological consequences of intestinal blockage. Our findings uncover a link between intestinal clearance, feeding, sleep, and survival, with potential implications for understanding similar processes across species.
articles.abstractZh: 在生命开始时，必须开始喂养，同时需要消除发育废物——胎便。尽管这两个基本的生理过程是相互关联的，但它们的机制耦合仍然知之甚少。使用果蝇作为模型系统，我们研究了这些过程的协调。我们发现胎便排泄在羽化后不久就开始，并且仅在部分胎便排出后才开始进食。我们鉴定了与适当后肠发育所需的apterous基因相关的顺式调控元件。它的破坏会阻止胎便排泄并导致肠梗阻。因此，具有缺陷元件的果蝇会避免进食并表现出延长长鼻的睡眠。对刚封闭的果蝇排泄的实验抑制概括了这些表型，表明肠道阻塞足以损害进食并改变睡眠/觉醒状态。表型的进展与人类机械性肠道梗阻的特征相似，表明观察到的影响可能来自肠道梗阻更广泛的生理后果。我们的发现揭示了一个林

articles.title: Rap1-mediated steric hindrance protects telomeres from MRX sensing.
articles.titleZh: Rap1 介导的空间位阻可保护端粒免受 MRX 感应。
articles.authors: Mattarocci S, Reginato G, Cannavo E, Roisné-Hamelin F, Gnügge R, Deshayes A, Pobiega S, Alibert O, Morin V, Ropars V, Mehringer J, Geli V, Cuniasse P, Charbonnier JB, Symington LS, Cejka P, Marcand S.
articles.abstract: Telomere capping largely depends on telomere length. Abnormally short telomeres are prone to activate DNA damage checkpoint, undergo unscheduled chromosomal fusions through nonhomologous end-joining (NHEJ) and be resected. All these processes are mediated by the Mre11-Rad50-Xrs2NBS1 (MRXMRN) complex. The response to telomere length is thought to correlate with the number of DNA-bound telomeric proteins but the mechanisms translating this number into functional protection remain unclear. Here, combining genetic and reconstitution biochemistry approaches, we explain why NHEJ inhibition and DNA resection suppression are proportional to the length of Rap1-bound arrays adjacent to DNA ends in Saccharomyces cerevisiae. Our findings reveal that MRX has a capacity to distinguish short from long protein blocks at DNA breaks, which translates into the ability of Rap1 protein-DNA arrays to suppress MRX on the basis of their length. Unlike the previously described direct inhibition of MRXMRN by Rif2 and TRF2 iDDR, the process described here does not rely on direct protein-protein interactions. Instead, Rap1 inhibits MRX by steric hindrance, determined both by the length of DNA it shields and by the coverage density. These results explain how cells detect short telomeres, a crucial process for telomere length homeostasis and telomere-driven senescence.
articles.abstractZh: 端粒加帽很大程度上取决于端粒长度。异常短的端粒很容易激活DNA损伤检查点，通过非同源末端连接（NHEJ）进行非计划的染色体融合并被切除。所有这些过程均由 Mre11-Rad50-Xrs2NBS1 (MRXMRN) 复合物介导。人们认为对端粒长度的反应与 DNA 结合端粒蛋白的数量相关，但将这个数量转化为功能性保护的机制仍不清楚。在这里，结合遗传和重建生物化学方法，我们解释了为什么 NHEJ 抑制和 DNA 切除抑制与酿酒酵母中与 DNA 末端相邻的 Rap1 结合阵列的长度成正比。我们的研究结果表明，MRX 能够区分 DNA 断裂处的短蛋白质块和长蛋白质块，这转化为 Rap1 蛋白质-DNA 阵列根据长度抑制 MRX 的能力。与之前描述的 Rif2 和 TRF2 iDDR 对 MRXMRN 的直接抑制不同，此处描述的过程不依赖于直接的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用。相反，Rap1 通过空间位阻抑制 MRX，空间位阻由其屏蔽的 DNA 长度和 b 决定。

articles.title: Schizophrenia risk gene ZNF804A controls ribosome localization and synaptogenesis in developing human neurons.
articles.titleZh: 精神分裂症风险基因 ZNF804A 控制人类神经元发育中的核糖体定位和突触发生。
articles.authors: Sichlinger L, Hausherr M, Guerrisi S, Dutan-Polit L, Chennell G, Nagy R, Matuleviciute R, Nasser F, Farkas S, Bamford RA, Leung SK, Duarte RRR, Powell TR, Mill J, Marcus K, Vernon AC, Srivastava DP.
articles.abstract: ZNF804A was among the first genes robustly associated with schizophrenia based on findings from large-scale genomic studies. Previous research has implicated ZNF804A in the regulation of gene expression and synaptic function, but the role of this gene in neurodevelopment and in schizophrenia pathogenesis remains unclear. To study its function during neurodevelopment, we generated isogenic human induced pluripotent stem cells with reduced ZNF804A expression, differentiated them into developing cortical glutamatergic neurons, and studied their transcriptomic, synaptic, and protein signatures. Mutant neurons showed modest evidence for changes in gene expression. However, high-content confocal imaging revealed increased excitatory synapse density in mutant neurons. Cell compartment-specific proteomic analysis further revealed that mutant neurons had higher levels of ribosomal and translational proteins within neurites, and high-content imaging confirmed increased local protein synthesis efficiency. Overall, these results demonstrate that in human developing cortical glutamatergic neurons, ZNF804A regulates excitatory synapse formation potential via increased local protein translation.
articles.abstractZh: 根据大规模基因组研究的结果，ZNF804A 是首批与精神分裂症密切相关的基因之一。先前的研究表明 ZNF804A 参与基因表达和突触功能的调节，但该基因在神经发育和精神分裂症发病机制中的作用仍不清楚。为了研究其在神经发育过程中的功能，我们生成了 ZNF804A 表达减少的同基因人类诱导多能干细胞，将它们分化为发育中的皮质谷氨酸神经元，并研究了它们的转录组、突触和蛋白质特征。突变神经元显示出基因表达变化的适度证据。然而，高内涵共聚焦成像显示突变神经元的兴奋性突触密度增加。细胞区室特异性蛋白质组分析进一步表明，突变神经元在神经突内具有更高水平的核糖体和翻译蛋白，高内涵成像证实局部蛋白质合成效率增加。总体而言，这些结果表明，在人类发育中的皮质谷氨酸能神经元中，ZNF804A 通过增加局部蛋白质翻译来调节兴奋性突触形成潜力。

articles.title: Bio-generated CoO-NPs from Salvia officinalis: a promising tool against ESBL-producing bacteria.
articles.titleZh: 从丹参中生物生成的 CoO-NP：一种对抗产 ESBL 细菌的有前途的工具。
articles.authors: Kalaba MH, Elrefaey AA, Saber ME, Sharaf MH, Moghannem SA, Youssef ASE.
articles.abstract: Extended-spectrum β-lactamase (ESBL)-producing bacteria pose significant therapeutic challenges, necessitating the development of alternative antimicrobial agents such as metal nanoparticles. Among 58 bacterial isolates from clinical samples at the National Cancer Institute (Cairo, Egypt), eight ESBL-producing strains were identified (six E. coli and two K. pneumoniae) using phenotypic screening and VITEK 2 system, representing preliminary laboratory findings. GC-MS analysis of Salvia officinalis aqueous extract revealed 16 compounds, with rosmarinic acid (20.41%) as the major constituent. The successful green synthesis of cobalt oxide nanoparticles (CoO-NPs) using S. officinalis was confirmed through UV-visible spectroscopy showing a characteristic peak at 520 nm, HRTEM revealing particle sizes of 10-50 nm, and XRD patterns matching the CoO phase. FTIR spectroscopy confirmed the presence of metal-oxygen bonds and surface functionalization. CoO-NPs demonstrated significant antibacterial activity against ESBL-producing isolates with inhibition zones ranging from 24 to 26 mm and MIC values of 0.312-0.625 mg/ml while enhancing the efficacy of several antibiotics, particularly rifampicin, meropenem, and gentamicin. Antioxidant assays revealed free radical scavenging activity with IC50 values of 513.7 µg/mL and 208 µg/mL for DPPH (2,2-diphenyl-1-picrylhydrazyl) and ABTS (2,2'-azino-di-[3-ethylbenzthiazoline sulfonate (6)]), respectively. Cytotoxicity studies against normal cell lines showed dose-dependent effects with IC50 values of 303.526 µg/mL for VERO cells and 253.19 µg/mL for OEC cells, with significant morphological changes observed at 500 µg/mL. These preliminary laboratory findings suggest that S. officinalis-mediated CoO-NPs represent a promising therapeutic agent against ESBL-producing bacteria, offering a balance between antimicrobial efficacy and biological safety.
articles.abstractZh: 产生超广谱 β-内酰胺酶 (ESBL) 的细菌带来了重大的治疗挑战，需要开发金属纳米颗粒等替代抗菌剂。在国家癌症研究所（埃及开罗）从临床样本中分离出的 58 个细菌中，使用表型筛选和 VITEK 2 系统鉴定出了 8 个产 ESBL 菌株（6 个大肠杆菌和 2 个肺炎克雷伯菌），这代表了初步的实验室发现。对丹参水提取物进行 GC-MS 分析，发现 16 种化合物，其中迷迭香酸 (20.41%) 为主要成分。通过紫外-可见光谱显示 520 nm 处的特征峰、HRTEM 显示粒径为 10-50 nm 以及与 CoO 相匹配的 XRD 图案，证实了使用 S. officinalis 成功绿色合成氧化钴纳米颗粒 (CoO-NP)。 FTIR 光谱证实了金属-氧键和表面功能化的存在。 CoO-NPs 对产 ESBL 分离株表现出显着的抗菌活性，抑制范围为 24 至 26 mm，MIC 值为 0.312-0.625 mg/ml，同时增强了多种抗生素（尤其是利福平）的功效

articles.title: Effect of biological and agricultural foaming agents on concrete waste for the preparation of porous ceramic materials.
articles.titleZh: 生物和农用发泡剂对制备多孔陶瓷材料的混凝土废料的影响。
articles.authors: Khattab RM, Abo-Almaged HH, Ali MM, Sadek HEH, Marzouk MA.
articles.abstract: This study offers a novel method for recycling leftover concrete to create porous ceramic materials. Various pouring agents, such as starch mixed with flour, yeast, baking powder, wheat straw, or sawdust, have created porous waste concrete ceramic materials. The starch is a binder for ceramic particles and a growth substrate for forming gas bubbles. Utilizing starch consolidation procedures, the green bodies are produced by firing them at temperatures of 1200 °C, 1250 °C, and 1300 °C. Various techniques characterize the fired sample, including Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy, Thermogravimetric analysis, Differential Scanning Calorimetry, Apparent porosity, Bulk density, Compressive strength, Phase composition, and Microstructure. The acquired results showed that apparent porosity decreased except for samples containing baking powders, while the bulk density and compressive strength increased as the firing temperature increased. With apparent porosity of 56% and 39%, bulk density of 1.27 g/cm3 and 1.64 g/cm3, and mechanical characteristics of 0.55 MPa and 1.47 MPa at 1250 °C and 1300 °C, respectively, samples containing flour have a highly porous structure. At 1250 °C, the thermal transmittance of this sample reaches 0.327 W/m2K. The sawdust-containing sample exhibited the highest strength, reaching 1.54 MPa at 1250 °C and 5.23 MPa at 1300 °C. At those respective temperatures, its apparent porosity measured approximately 55% and 38%. Additionally, sawdust samples had a thermal transmittance of up to 0.336 W/m2K. Therefore, the current study created porous structure ceramics by substituting all or some of the more expensive polymer additives with recycled concrete debris. The resulting ceramics are potentially used in gas burners, membranes, filters, and refractory thermal conductivity.
articles.abstractZh: 这项研究提供了一种回收剩余混凝土来制造多孔陶瓷材料的新方法。各种浇注剂，例如与面粉、酵母、发酵粉、麦秆或锯末混合的淀粉，已形成多孔废混凝土陶瓷材料。淀粉是陶瓷颗粒的粘合剂和形成气泡的生长基质。利用淀粉固结程序，在 1200 °C、1250 °C 和 1300 °C 的温度下烧制生坯。各种技术表征烧制样品，包括傅里叶变换红外光谱、热重分析、差示扫描量热法、表观孔隙率、体积密度、抗压强度、相组成和微观结构。结果表明，除了含有发酵粉的样品外，表观孔隙率均下降，而堆积密度和抗压强度随着烧成温度的升高而增加。含有面粉的样品具有高度多孔结构，表观孔隙率为56%和39%，堆积密度为1.27 g/cm3和1.64 g/cm3，1250℃和1300℃下的机械特性分别为0.55 MPa和1.47 MPa。在 1250 °C 时，t

articles.title: Effect of lactic acid bacteria inoculation and urea on fermentation quality and aerobic stability of sugarcane top silage.
articles.titleZh: 接种乳酸菌和尿素对甘蔗顶青贮发酵品质及有氧稳定性的影响
articles.authors: Bureenok S, Pitiwittayakul N, Saenmahayak B, Sun L, Lukkananukool A, Schonewille JT.
articles.abstract: The aim of this study was to investigate the effect of Lactiplantibacillus paraplantarum ST1 and Limosilactobacillus fermentum G3 and their combination with urea on the aerobic stability of sugarcane tops silages. The fermentation profile was not affected by the interaction between urea and lactic acid bacteria (LAB), except for the lactic acid content (P = 0.012). Lactic acid content was higher in LAB silage (P = 0.008). The use of urea resulted in higher levels of pH value, butyric acid, and ammonia-nitrogen compared to LAB. The addition of urea increased the crude protein, and fiber content in silage and decreased the in vitro dry matter digestibility of silage by 7.1% (P < 0.001). In the urea-treated silages, the pH values remained stable, and the yeast counts remained low during five days of air exposure. In contrast, yeast counts increased in the silages without urea treatment, irrespective of the use of LAB. Clostridium sensu stricto 12 was found exclusively in urea-treated silages. The use of LAB additives without urea appears to be advantageous for the fermentation process of sugarcane tops silage. Despite improving the aerobic stability, the addition of urea is not warranted because it results in a poor-quality silage.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究的目的是研究副植物乳杆菌 ST1 和发酵硅酸乳杆菌 G3 及其与尿素的组合对甘蔗顶部青贮饲料有氧稳定性的影响。除乳酸含量外，发酵曲线不受尿素和乳酸菌 (LAB) 之间相互作用的影响 (P = 0.012)。 LAB 青贮饲料中的乳酸含量较高（P = 0.008）。与 LAB 相比，使用尿素会导致 pH 值、丁酸和氨氮水平更高。添加尿素提高了青贮饲料中粗蛋白、纤维含量，使青贮饲料体外干物质消化率降低7.1%（P < 0.001）。在经尿素处理的青贮饲料中，在暴露于空气的五天内，pH 值保持稳定，酵母菌数量保持较低水平。相比之下，无论是否使用乳酸菌，未经尿素处理的青贮饲料中酵母菌数量都会增加。 Clostridium sensu stricto 12 仅在尿素处理的青贮饲料中发现。使用不含尿素的 LAB 添加剂似乎有利于甘蔗顶部青贮饲料的发酵过程。尽管提高了有氧稳定性，但添加尿素并不值得。

articles.title: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase signaling is driven by the Golgi protein GOLPH3 and its interaction with MYO18A.
articles.titleZh: 致癌受体酪氨酸激酶信号传导由高尔基体蛋白 GOLPH3 及其与 MYO18A 的相互作用驱动。
articles.authors: Starost KA, Bommi JR, Peterman MC, McCullough MX, Buschman MD, Yun B, Field SJ.
articles.abstract: Receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) signaling drives cancer and is a validated therapeutic target. Modulators of RTK signaling can reveal mechanisms of oncogenesis and offer new therapeutic targets. Golgi phosphoprotein 3 (GOLPH3) is a Golgi-localized oncoprotein that promotes signaling downstream of mTOR. Here, examination of RTK signaling indicated that GOLPH3 acted at the level of the RTK and increased all downstream signaling. We found that GOLPH3 enhanced the delivery of RTKs to the plasma membrane. This role was shared with its binding partner myosin 18A (MYO18A) and depended on the interaction of GOLPH3 with MYO18A. The GOLPH3-MYO18A complex at the Golgi apparatus was required and rate-limiting for RTK signaling across the cell types and receptors assessed. Our findings provide insight into the relationship between the function of GOLPH3 at the Golgi and its role as a cancer driver, highlighting its potential as a therapeutic target in cancer.
articles.abstractZh: 受体酪氨酸激酶 (RTK) 信号传导驱动癌症，是经过验证的治疗靶点。 RTK 信号调节剂可以揭示肿瘤发生机制并提供新的治疗靶点。高尔基体磷蛋白 3 (GOLPH3) 是一种高尔基体定位的癌蛋白，可促进 mTOR 下游信号传导。在这里，对 RTK 信号传导的检查表明 GOLPH3 在 RTK 水平上起作用并增加所有下游信号传导。我们发现 GOLPH3 增强了 RTK 向质膜的递送。这一作用与其结合伙伴肌球蛋白 18A (MYO18A) 共同承担，并且取决于 GOLPH3 与 MYO18A 的相互作用。高尔基体上的 GOLPH3-MYO18A 复合物是跨细胞类型和受体评估的 RTK 信号传导所必需的和限速的。我们的研究结果深入了解了高尔基体中 GOLPH3 的功能与其作为癌症驱动因素的作用之间的关系，强调了其作为癌症治疗靶点的潜力。

articles.title: Valorization of fruit pomaces for glycosidic enzymes production via solid state fermentation.
articles.titleZh: 通过固态发酵生产糖苷酶的果渣的价值。
articles.authors: Hafez ZH, Mahmoud AE, Mahmoud HA, Mohammed AT, Ibrahim MK.
articles.abstract: Agro-industrial fruit pomaces represent complex, nutrient-rich substrates that can support microbial enzymes production within circular bioeconomy frameworks. This study systematically compared grape, mango, orange, and pomegranate pomaces as solid substrates for glycosidic enzymes production (amylase, xylanase, pectinase) using 14 microbial strains under solid-state fermentation conditions with the aim of identifying an efficient microorganism-substrate system that produces the highest glycosidic enzyme activity. For the 14 strains studied, Candida guilliermondii NRRL Y-2075 yielded the highest reported amylase activity (4344.67 U/gds) when cultivated on pomegranate pomace with no detectable activity in the unfermented pomace. Response surface methodology (RSM) based on a central composite design was subsequently applied to identify the optimal operational region for amylase production by evaluating pH, inoculum size, incubation temperature and time. Maximum amylase activity (4839.05 U/gds) was obtained at pH 5.6, 12.2% inoculum size, 30.7 °C incubation temperature, and 24 h of incubation. Experimental validation closely matched model predictions. Additional one-factor-at-a-time experiments demonstrated that supplementation with external carbon, nitrogen, amino acids, or metal ions did not enhance enzyme production, indicating that pomegranate pomace alone provides sufficient nutrients for efficient amylase synthesis. Collectively, the results suggest that pomegranate pomace can function as a nutritionally sufficient SSF substrate, reducing process complexity and supplementation requirements for sustainable amylase production.
articles.abstractZh: 农工业果渣是复杂、营养丰富的底物，可以支持循环生物经济框架内微生物酶的生产。本研究系统地比较了葡萄、芒果、橙子和石榴果渣作为固体底物在固态发酵条件下使用 14 种微生物菌株生产糖苷酶（淀粉酶、木聚糖酶、果胶酶）的情况，目的是确定一种能产生最高糖苷酶活性的高效微生物-底物系统。对于所研究的 14 种菌株，吉里蒙假丝酵母 NRRL Y-2075 在石榴果渣上培养时产生最高报道的淀粉酶活性 (4344.67 U/gds)，而在未发酵的果渣中未检测到活性。随后应用基于中心复合设计的响应面方法 (RSM) 通过评估 pH、接种量、孵育温度和时间来确定淀粉酶生产的最佳操作区域。在 pH 5.6、接种量 12.2%、孵育温度 30.7 °C 和孵育 24 小时时获得最大淀粉酶活性 (4839.05 U/gds)。实验验证与模型预测紧密匹配。额外的一次一因素 e

articles.title: Diverse mechanisms of translation arrest by a Clostridia ribosome stalling peptide CliM.
articles.titleZh: 梭菌核糖体停滞肽 CliM 的多种翻译停滞机制。
articles.authors: Yoshida M, Gersteuer F, Berendes O, Fujiwara K, Safdari HA, Paternoga H, Takada H, Obana N, Grubmüller H, Bock LV, Wilson DN, Chiba S.
articles.abstract: Ribosome arrest peptides undergo programmed translational stalling in response to changes in the cellular environment to feedback-regulate gene expression. CliM, an arrest peptide in Clostridia, is encoded upstream of the YidC membrane protein insertase gene, but its function and mechanism remain unclear. Here we show that CliM monitors YidC activity to maintain adequate cellular YidC capacity. Interestingly, Clostridium kluyveri CliM induces elongation arrest at multiple sense codons, whereas Clostridioides difficile CliM causes termination arrest. Cryo-EM-based structural and mutational analyses demonstrate that C. difficile CliM adopts multiple α-helices within the nascent polypeptide exit tunnel, where it forms extensive arrest-essential interactions with the ribosome. The residue immediately N-terminal to the stalling site contributes to arrest by sterically interfering with full accommodation of the release factor or aminoacyl-tRNA in the A-site. Molecular dynamics simulations suggest that membrane insertion of CliM induces sequential unwinding of these α-helical structures and relocation of the penultimate residue, thereby triggering arrest release. These findings provide a unified mechanistic framework that explains the distinct arrest behaviors of CliM homologs.
articles.abstractZh: 核糖体阻滞肽响应细胞环境的变化而经历程序性翻译停滞，从而反馈调节基因表达。 CliM 是梭菌中的一种阻滞肽，编码于 YidC 膜蛋白插入酶基因的上游，但其功能和机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们展示了 CliM 监控 YidC 活动以维持足够的细胞 YidC 容量。有趣的是，克鲁维梭菌 CliM 诱导多个有义密码子的延伸停滞，而艰难梭菌 CliM 导致终止停滞。基于冷冻电镜的结构和突变分析表明，艰难梭菌 CliM 在新生多肽出口隧道内采用多个 α 螺旋，在此处与核糖体形成广泛的阻滞必需相互作用。紧邻停滞位点 N 端的残基通过空间干扰 A 位点中释放因子或氨酰基-tRNA 的完全调节而有助于停滞。分子动力学模拟表明，CliM 的膜插入会诱导这些 α 螺旋结构的顺序解旋和倒数第二个残基的重新定位，从而触发逮捕释放。这些发现提供了

articles.title: Nicotine biosynthesis is completed by cryptic activating glucosylation.
articles.titleZh: 尼古丁生物合成是通过隐秘的激活糖基化完成的。
articles.authors: Schwabe BTW, Angstman IM, Vollheyde K, Ingold Z, Li J, Stankevich KS, Spicer CD, Fascione MA, Grogan G, Geu-Flores F, Lichman BR.
articles.abstract: Nicotine is a neuroactive alkaloid produced by tobacco (Nicotiana tabacum) as a defence against herbivory, and an addictive stimulant that has been used by humans for millennia. Despite its significance, the core steps of its biosynthesis have remained elusive. Here, we demonstrate the in vitro reconstruction of a four-enzyme stereoselective biocatalytic cascade that forms (S)-nicotine from nicotinic acid and N-methylpyrrolinium. This cascade includes two glucose-processing enzymes that participate in a cryptic activating glucosylation step. We also reconstruct this pathway in planta and present high resolution X-ray structures of the key carbon-carbon bond forming reductase-oxidase pair bound to their substrate and product, respectively. This work establishes the complete biosynthetic pathway to nicotine, providing new gene targets for controlling alkaloid production in Nicotiana and unlocking enzymatic routes to pyridine alkaloids.
articles.abstractZh: 尼古丁是一种由烟草（Nicotiana tabacum）产生的神经活性生物碱，用于防御食草动物，也是人类使用数千年的成瘾兴奋剂。尽管它具有重要意义，但其生物合成的核心步骤仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们展示了四酶立体选择性生物催化级联的体外重建，该级联由烟酸和 N-甲基吡咯啉形成 (S)-尼古丁。该级联包括两种参与神秘的激活糖基化步骤的葡萄糖加工酶。我们还在植物中重建了这条途径，并展示了分别与其底物和产物结合的形成还原酶-氧化酶对的关键碳-碳键的高分辨率X射线结构。这项工作建立了尼古丁的完整生物合成途径，为控制烟草中生物碱的产生提供了新的基因靶标，并解锁了吡啶生物碱的酶促途径。

articles.title: Synthetic rewriting of the IGH locus.
articles.titleZh: IGH 基因座的综合重写。
articles.authors: Fu ZH, Ma Y, Cheng S, Zhong Y, Wang N, Ba Z, Zhao GR, Wu Y.
articles.abstract: V(D)J recombination, which joins V, D, and J genes across immunoglobulin loci, is essential for antibody diversity. To unlock the inherent constraints of V(D)J recombination, we systematically designed, assembled, and shuffled a synthetic human immunoglobulin heavy chain locus (SynIgh). SynIgh was designed de novo, incorporating 60 VH, 31 D, and 13 JH from global populations, along with 63 synthetic rearrangement sites, endowing it with modularity, extensibility, and dynamicity. We then synthesized the repetitive SynIgh sequence with a stabilizer. Using this construct, we generated a SynIgh mouse model capable of undergoing V(D)J recombination. Moreover, we demonstrated that a dual-rearrangement strategy, combining synthetic rearrangement with natural V(D)J recombination, enables shuffling of the SynIgh locus in mice. This strategy expands the diversity of V(D)J recombination outcomes, thereby reconfiguring the process of antibody diversity generation. SynIgh establishes a generalizable framework for the design, building, testing, and learning of mammalian genome architecture and function.
articles.abstractZh: V(D)J 重组将 V、D 和 J 基因跨免疫球蛋白基因座连接起来，对于抗体多样性至关重要。为了解开 V(D)J 重组的固有限制，我们系统地设计、组装和改组了合成的人免疫球蛋白重链位点 (SynIgh)。 SynIgh 是从头设计的，整合了来自全球人群的 60 个 VH、31 个 D 和 13 个 JH，以及 63 个合成重排位点，赋予其模块化、可扩展性和动态性。然后我们用稳定剂合成了重复的 SynIgh 序列。使用该构建体，我们生成了能够进行 V(D)J 重组的 SynIgh 小鼠模型。此外，我们证明了将合成重排与天然 V(D)J 重组相结合的双重重排策略能够对小鼠中的 SynIgh 基因座进行改组。该策略扩大了 V(D)J 重组结果的多样性，从而重新配置了抗体多样性生成的过程。 SynIgh 为哺乳动物基因组结构和功能的设计、构建、测试和学习建立了一个通用框架。

articles.title: Architecture of clathrin-independent AP3:ARF1-coated carriers.
articles.titleZh: 不依赖网格蛋白的 AP3:ARF1 包被载体的结构。
articles.authors: Kaufman JGG, Tagiltsev G, Stalder DS, Taylor RJ, Sava I, Guo H, Ciazynska KA, Zaccai NR, Gray SR, Vallis Y, Höning S, Kelly BT, Gershlick DC, Briggs JAG, Owen DJ.
articles.abstract: The AP3 complex mediates cargo sorting and carrier assembly for the trafficking of transmembrane proteins from endosomes to lysosomes. AP3 is generally believed to localize to clathrin-free, ARF1-positive, elongated carriers in cells, but the architecture of AP3-based coats was unknown. Using in vitro reconstitution and cryo-electron tomography, we demonstrate that AP3:ARF1 spontaneously remodels membranes containing cargo and the phosphoinositide PI(3,5)P2 into tubular structures coated in spiraling rows of AP3 arches and ARF1 dimers. Targeted point mutations disrupting critical AP3:ARF1 and AP3:AP3 lattice interfaces disrupt AP3 recruitment, carrier formation, and lysosomal cargo trafficking in cells. We propose that AP3 generates tubular carriers on endosomes by organizing ARF1 dimers into elongated membrane-deforming arrays while simultaneously selecting cargo. By demonstrating that AP3:ARF1 can generate carriers without using a clathrin lattice, we explain the clathrin independence of AP3-mediated trafficking.
articles.abstractZh: AP3 复合物介导跨膜蛋白从内体运输到溶酶体的货物分选和载体组装。人们普遍认为 AP3 定位于细胞中无网格蛋白、ARF1 阳性、细长的载体，但基于 AP3 的外壳的结构尚不清楚。使用体外重建和冷冻电子断层扫描，我们证明AP3:ARF1自发地将含有货物和磷酸肌醇PI(3,5)P2的膜重塑为涂有螺旋行AP3拱和ARF1二聚体的管状结构。破坏关键 AP3:ARF1 和 AP3:AP3 晶格界面的靶向点突变会破坏细胞内 AP3 的招募、载体形成和溶酶体货物运输。我们建议 AP3 通过将 ARF1 二聚体组织成细长的膜变形阵列，同时选择货物，从而在内体上生成管状载体。通过证明 AP3:ARF1 可以在不使用网格蛋白晶格的情况下生成载体，我们解释了 AP3 介导的运输的网格蛋白独立性。

articles.title: Rewiring STAT signaling from the cell surface with Trikine immunotherapeutics.
articles.titleZh: 使用 Trikine 免疫疗法重新连接细胞表面的 STAT 信号传导。
articles.authors: Rodriguez GE, Zhao Y, Nishiga Y, Peprah F, Shen J, Abhiraman GC, Ogishi M, Zhang C, Saco J, Waghray D, Serasanambati M, Torres L, Simone BW, Su L, Wilson SC, Yang A, Sun Q, Picton L, Saxton RA, Bhandarkar V, Lee MJ, Andrews E, Jiang H, Obenaus M, Yen M, Atajanova T, Blish CA, Spranger S, Wherry EJ, Kirane A, Ribas A, Raulet DH, Kalbasi A, Dougan SK, Dougan M, Sage J, Garcia KC.
articles.abstract: Cytokines dimerize two receptor chains to activate Janus kinases and signal transducer and activator of transcription (STAT) transcription factors that regulate immune cells, but they have therapeutic liabilities. We engineered "Trikines" to compel cis formation of three-chain cytokine receptor complexes at the cell surface that induce bespoke STAT transcriptional signaling programs. Trikines coactivated phosphorylation of STAT5 (pSTAT5) and pSTAT3 signatures distinct from natural cytokines by assembling trimeric combinations of interleukin-2 (IL-2), IL-10, and IL-21 receptors. In preclinical models, an IL-2-based Trikine restrained terminal differentiation of T cells, promoted stemness, and enhanced durability of tumor control without observable toxicity. An IL-10-based Trikine induced immune infiltration into poorly immunogenic tumors, showing efficacy in preclinical models of small cell lung cancer and pancreatic cancer. Trikines obviate the need for cell engineering to customize STAT signatures and may hold potential for immunotherapy.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞因子使两条受体链二聚化，以激活 Janus 激酶以及调节免疫细胞的信号转导器和转录激活剂 (STAT) 转录因子，但它们具有治疗作用。我们设计了“Trikines”来迫使细胞表面顺式形成三链细胞因子受体复合物，从而诱导定制的 STAT 转录信号转导程序。三因子通过组装白细胞介素 2 (IL-2)、IL-10 和 IL-21 受体的三聚体组合，共激活 STAT5 (pSTAT5) 和 pSTAT3 特征的磷酸化，这与天然细胞因子不同。在临床前模型中，基于 IL-2 的 Trikine 抑制 T 细胞的终末分化，促进干性，并增强肿瘤控制的持久性，且没有可观察到的毒性。基于 IL-10 的 Trikine 诱导免疫浸润到免疫原性较差的肿瘤中，在小细胞肺癌和胰腺癌的临床前模型中显示出疗效。 Trikines 消除了细胞工程定制 STAT 特征的需要，并且可能具有免疫治疗的潜力。

articles.title: Structurally diverse secondary metabolites from the dung-inhabiting fungus Botryotrichum murorum.
articles.titleZh: 来自粪便真菌 Botryotrichum murorum 的结构多样的次生代谢物。
articles.authors: Charria-Girón E, Liu YY, Surup F, Marin-Felix Y.
articles.abstract: A combination of confidence-aware MS/MS-based metabolomics and conventional chemical screening approaches was employed to investigate the metabolome of Botryotrichum murorum DSM 113281, isolated from tortoise dung. The metabolomic survey revealed a high degree of chemical diversity; however, low production rates necessitated large-scale solid-state cultivation to purify the major constituents. This approach led to the discovery of tortoisellide A (1), which features a rare polyketide γ-lactol scaffold, an unprecedented thio-substituted analogue 2 of the 14-membered bis-macrolactone antibiotic grahamimycin A, alongside the known sesquiterpenoid eremophilane cryptosphaerolide (3) and isocochliodinol (4). All planar structures were elucidated by HR-MS and NMR analysis. Tortoisellide A (1) displayed pronounced tautomerism at its hemiacetal carbon C-23, manifesting in the duplication of most NMR signals. Mosher ester analysis supported the assignment of the 2'S configuration of compound 2, while the configurations at C-2 and C-8 were tentatively assigned by analogy to the natural (-)-grahamimycin A1. The previously unassigned side-chain configuration of 3 was determined as 17S, 19S, 21S by NMR chemical shift and J-based configurational analyses (Murata's method) supported by computational modeling. Compounds showed varying degrees of cytotoxicity against mammalian cell lines, with isocochliodinol being most active displaying potency in the nanomolar range. The metabolite diversity of B. murorum broadens the chemical repertoire of coprophilous fungi and knowledge on the diversification of secondary metabolism in the Sordariales.
articles.abstractZh: 采用基于置信度的 MS/MS 代谢组学和传统化学筛选方法相结合来研究从龟粪中分离出的 Botryotrichum murorum DSM 113281 的代谢组。代谢组学调查揭示了高度的化学多样性；然而，低生产率需要大规模固态培养来纯化主要成分。这种方法导致了龟甲内酯 A (1) 的发现，它具有罕见的聚酮化合物 γ-乳醇支架、14 元双大环内酯抗生素格雷霉素 A 的前所未有的硫代取代类似物 2，以及已知的倍半萜类 eremophilane cryptosphaerolide (3) 和 isocochliodinol (4)。所有平面结构均通过 HR-MS 和 NMR 分析阐明。龟甲内酯 A (1) 在其半缩醛碳 C-23 处表现出明显的互变异构现象，表现为大多数 NMR 信号的重复。 Mosher酯分析支持了化合物2的2'S构型的归属，而C-2和C-8的构型通过与天然(-)-grahamimycin A1的类比而初步归属。之前未分配的侧链配置3被确定为17S、19S、21S

articles.title: Sustainable biosynthesis of silver nanoparticles from vinegar bacteria fermentation waste: characterization, bioactivity and food packaging potential.
articles.titleZh: 从醋细菌发酵废物中可持续生物合成银纳米颗粒：表征、生物活性和食品包装潜力。
articles.authors: Akbaş P, Adıgüzel AO, Kaya E, Adıgüzel SK, Uğurtay E.
articles.abstract: Silver nanoparticles (AgNPs) have emerged as promising agents with significant potential for biotechnological applications, particularly in active packaging systems and wound-healing dressings, owing to their broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity and ability to enhance product safety, shelf life, and infection control. In this context, AgNPs were successfully synthesized via a green synthesis method, offering an environmentally friendly, sustainable, and low-cost approach, using Acetobacter sp. (strains 1A, 1B, 2B, 2D, 3A) and Komagataeibacter sp. (strain X1) isolated from homemade vinegars in the province of Samsun. The synthesis of nanoparticles was verified by the presence of surface plasmon resonance (SPR) peaks formed at 414-432 nm in the reaction mixture. The scanning electron microscopy (SEM) analysis showed that AgNPs were spherical in shape and varied in size between 20 and 100 nm depending on the bacterial isolate used in the synthesis. DLS analysis revealed that all synthesized AgNPs exhibited hydrodynamic diameters ranging from 85.05 to 179.1 nm with PDI values between 0.274 and 0.402, indicating moderately monodisperse to heterogeneous distributions depending on the bacterial isolate. Zeta potential measurements demonstrated that AgNPs had negatively charged surfaces with moderate to high colloidal electrostatic stability (- 12.3 to - 31.8 mV). The antimicrobial activity of the obtained AgNPs was tested against Gram-negative and Gram-positive bacteria, with a low inhibition concentration (16 µg/mL) particularly observed in the ESBL-positive E. coli strain. Antioxidant tests revealed that AgNPs synthesized using Komagataeibacter sp. X1 (KX1-AgNP) exhibited the highest activity and effectively neutralized DPPH radicals by 56.01%. Cytotoxicity studies showed that AgNPs preserved fibroblast cell viability at low concentrations but exhibited toxic effects at high doses. Packaging analyses showed that X1-film effectively preserved food by significantly reducing total viable, psychrotrophic, and yeast-mold counts during storage. These results indicate that biosynthesized AgNPs possess strong antimicrobial and antioxidant properties, with vinegar bacteria serving as an efficient, eco-friendly, and cost-effective source. This strategy offers promising potential for sustainable applications in food packaging and nanotechnology.
articles.abstractZh: 银纳米颗粒（AgNP）已成为一种有前途的制剂，在生物技术应用中具有巨大潜力，特别是在活性包装系统和伤口愈合敷料中，因为它们具有广谱抗菌活性，并且能够提高产品安全性、保质期和感染控制。在此背景下，利用醋杆菌属，通过绿色合成方法成功合成了纳米银颗粒，提供了一种环境友好、可持续且低成本的方法。 （菌株 1A、1B、2B、2D、3A）和 Komagataeibacter sp。 （菌株 X1）从萨姆松省的自制醋中分离出来。通过反应混合物中 414-432 nm 处形成的表面等离子共振 (SPR) 峰的存在来验证纳米颗粒的合成。扫描电子显微镜 (SEM) 分析表明，AgNP 呈球形，尺寸在 20 至 100 nm 之间变化，具体取决于合成中使用的细菌分离株。 DLS 分析表明，所有合成的 AgNP 的流体动力学直径范围为 85.05 至 179.1 nm，PDI 值在 0.274 至 0.402 之间，表明根据条件的不同，具有中等单分散到异质分布。

articles.title: A fungal pathobiont promotes Streptococcus vaginal persistence and pathogenesis through physical and metabolic interactions.
articles.titleZh: 真菌病原体通过物理和代谢相互作用促进链球菌阴道持久存在和发病机制。
articles.authors: Cohen S, Crossen AJ, Jensen O, Neely MN, Le Doare K, Nobbs AH, Ost KS, Doran KS.
articles.abstract: Group B Streptococcus (GBS) frequently colonizes the vagina asymptomatically, where the bacterium interacts with a complex microbial community. During pregnancy, colonization can trigger adverse outcomes and neonatal invasive infection. Using an adapted murine model of vaginal colonization, we show that the human pathobiont Candida albicans supports GBS fitness in the vaginal tract and ascension to the uterus. C. albicans positively associates with GBS across several human studies, and C. albicans and GBS physically interact in a mouse co-colonization model. This co-colonization contributes to GBS persistence in the vagina, cervix, and uterus and facilitates antibiotic evasion. Across clinical isolates, the hyphal form of C. albicans promotes GBS aggregation and adhesion to host epithelial cells. Contact with GBS induces arginine biosynthesis in C. albicans, which drives bacterial virulence gene expression and primes GBS adhesion. These findings show that interkingdom nutrient exchange can increase GBS pathogenic potential and highlight targets for preventive therapies.
articles.abstractZh: B 族链球菌 (GBS) 经常在无症状的情况下定植于阴道，细菌在阴道中与复杂的微生物群落相互作用。在怀孕期间，定植可能引发不良后果和新生儿侵袭性感染。使用适应的阴道定植小鼠模型，我们发现人类致病生物白色念珠菌支持 GBS 在阴道中的适应和上升到子宫。在多项人类研究中，白色念珠菌与 GBS 呈正相关，并且在小鼠共定殖模型中，白色念珠菌和 GBS 存在物理相互作用。这种共定植有助于 GBS 在阴道、子宫颈和子宫中持续存在，并有助于逃避抗生素。在临床分离株中，白色念珠菌的菌丝形式促进 GBS 聚集并粘附到宿主上皮细胞。与 GBS 接触会诱导白色念珠菌中的精氨酸生物合成，从而驱动细菌毒力基因表达并引发 GBS 粘附。这些发现表明，王国间的营养物质交换可以增加 GBS 的致病潜力，并突出预防性治疗的目标。

articles.title: A Wnt-induced conformational phospho-switch in DVL3 controls association with Frizzled receptors and Wnt/β-catenin signaling.
articles.titleZh: DVL3 中 Wnt 诱导的构象磷酸开关控制着卷曲受体和 Wnt/β-连环蛋白信号传导的关联。
articles.authors: Micka M, Kumar J, Paclíková P, Hayek Z, Hanáková K, Bechara C, Plešingerová H, Šedo O, Bologna S, Del Nero E, Gömöryová K, Bystrý V, Gybeľ T, Číhalová T, Kravec M, Potěšil D, Zdráhal Z, Tripsianes K, Bryja V.
articles.abstract: It is well known that Dishevelled (DVL) phosphorylation by casein kinase 1 (CK1) relays Wnt signals from Frizzled (FZD) receptors to downstream effectors, yet any mechanistic aspects of DVL function related to phosphorylation remain unresolved. Here, we uncovered a Wnt-induced DVL phospho-switch that is mutually exclusive with FZD association. CK1 multiphosphorylation changes dramatically the bulk electrostatics to promote DVL intramolecular interaction between the DEP domain and the adjacent disordered region. A panel of DVL3 mutants demonstrated a switch-like behavior at the molecular level when a charge threshold was reached. Charge accumulation proximal to DEP proved to be a key functional event required, but not sufficient, for Wnt/β-catenin signaling. Proximity interactomics revealed FZD receptors as the prominent effectors of the DVL phospho-switch function consistent with the molecular competition at the DEP interface. By integrating findings at different levels, we propose a universal mechanism, in which Wnt-induced DVL conformational phospho-switch attenuates coresidence with FZDs as a means for downstream signaling events.
articles.abstractZh: 众所周知，酪蛋白激酶 1 (CK1) 引起的 Disheveled (DVL) 磷酸化将 Wnt 信号从 Frizzled (FZD) 受体传递到下游效应器，但与磷酸化相关的 DVL 功能的任何机制方面仍未解决。在这里，我们发现了 Wnt 诱导的 DVL 磷酸开关，它与 FZD 关联相互排斥。 CK1 多磷酸化极大地改变了整体静电，从而促进 DEP 结构域和相邻无序区域之间的 DVL 分子内相互作用。当达到电荷阈值时，一组 DVL3 突变体在分子水平上表现出类似开关的行为。事实证明，DEP 附近的电荷积累是 Wnt/β-连环蛋白信号传导所需的关键功能事件，但还不够。邻近相互作用组学揭示 FZD 受体是 DVL 磷酸开关功能的主要效应器，与 DEP 界面的分子竞争一致。通过整合不同水平的发现，我们提出了一种通用机制，其中 Wnt 诱导的 DVL 构象磷酸开关减弱了与 FZD 的共存，作为下游信号事件的手段。

articles.title: An X-to-autosome-to-Y chromosome amplified retrogene family functions in spermatids.
articles.titleZh: X 染色体到常染色体到 Y 染色体扩增了精子细胞中的逆基因家族功能。
articles.authors: Mier IF, Arlt MF, Lawson AM, Dulka EA, Wooldridge TB, Hoekstra HE, Mueller JL.
articles.abstract: Mammalian Y chromosomes acquire lineage-specific gene families1,2,3,4,5 with spermatogenic functions in male fertility,1,2,6,7,8 a mechanism that counters Y chromosome decay. However, in most mammals, the mechanisms by which Y chromosomes acquire new gene families and the benefits they confer to males remain poorly understood. Here, we discover that deer mice (Peromyscus) acquired a lineage-specific, massively amplified Y-linked gene family, Phf8y. Phf8y arose via the transposition of autosomal Phf8l, which previously arose via retrotransposition from an X-linked gene, PHD-finger protein 8 (Phf8). Phf8y, Phf8l, and Phf8 are expressed in haploid spermatids, where their encoded proteins each bind FAM178B in Mus musculus and Peromyscus maniculatus, while PHF8 binds ZFP711 in both species, suggesting that PHF8L/PHF8Y have similar functions. By contrast, Mus musculus PHF8L and P. maniculatus PHF8 and PHF8Y bind ZFP318, distinct from PHF8 interactors. We deleted Phf8l in M. musculus and found that neither the loss of Phf8l alone nor the loss of Phf8l and Phf8 together resulted in overt spermatogenesis defects or male infertility. However, Phf8l preferentially represses X-linked genes, and Phf8l and Phf8 cooperatively repress long interspersed element 1 (LINE1) retrotransposons and 5S rRNA. The specific regulation of X-linked genes by Phf8l suggests that while Phf8l does not influence X-bearing versus Y-bearing sperm fitness in M. musculus, acquisition of Phf8y on the Peromyscus Y chromosome may influence sperm fitness. Peromyscus Phf8y resembles the Y-linked Ssty gene family in M. musculus, which is in an evolutionary arms race, suggesting acquired Y-amplified, spermatid-specific gene families are genetic signatures of sex chromosome evolutionary arms races.
articles.abstractZh: 哺乳动物 Y 染色体获得谱系特异性基因家族1,2,3,4,5，在男性生育能力中具有生精功能，1,2,6,7,8 一种对抗 Y 染色体衰退的机制。然而，在大多数哺乳动物中，Y 染色体获得新基因家族的机制以及它们给雄性带来的好处仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们发现鹿鼠（Peromyscus）获得了谱系特异性、大规模扩增的 Y 连锁基因家族 Phf8y。 Phf8y 通过常染色体 Phf8l 的转座产生，而 Phf8l 之前是通过 X 连锁基因 PHD 指蛋白 8 (Phf8) 的逆转录转座产生的。 Phf8y、Phf8l 和 Phf8 在单倍体精细胞中表达，它们编码的蛋白各自与小家鼠和指足鼠中的 FAM178B 结合，而 PHF8 在这两个物种中与 ZFP711 结合，表明 PHF8L/PHF8Y 具有相似的功能。相比之下，小家鼠 PHF8L 和 P. maniculatus PHF8 和 PHF8Y 结合 ZFP318，与 PHF8 相互作用蛋白不同。我们在小家鼠中删除了 Phf8l，发现 Phf8l 单独缺失或 Phf8l 和 Phf8 一起缺失都不会导致明显的精子发生缺陷或男性不育。然而，Phf8l 优先抑制 X 连锁基因，

articles.title: Cell cycle oscillations in a polarity network facilitate state switching by morphogenetic cues.
articles.titleZh: 极性网络中的细胞周期振荡通过形态发生线索促进状态切换。
articles.authors: Ng K, Sebaa H, Hirani N, Chizh A, Messi Z, Bland T, Sugioka K, Goehring NW.
articles.abstract: The establishment of cell form, fate, and function during morphogenesis requires coordination between cell polarity and developmental cues. To achieve this, cells must establish polarity domains that are stable yet sensitive to guiding cues. Here, we show that Caenorhabditis elegans germline blastomeres use a time-varying polarization landscape to resolve this trade-off. Specifically, coupling the PAR polarity network to the oscillatory activity of cell cycle kinase CDK-1 ensures that newborn cells operate in a low feedback regime that lowers barriers to state switching, allowing spatial cues to induce and orient PAR protein asymmetries. As CDK-1 activity rises during mitosis, molecular feedback increases, reinforcing cue-induced asymmetries to yield robust and stable patterning of PAR polarity domains. Consistent with this model, we show that low CDK/feedback regimes destabilize PAR domains but are required for de novo polarization and polarity reorientation by cues. We propose that oscillatory networks represent a general mechanism for dynamically optimizing cellular decision-making landscapes, ensuring robust, signal-induced state switching during development.
articles.abstractZh: 形态发生过程中细胞形态、命运和功能的建立需要细胞极性和发育线索之间的协调。为了实现这一目标，细胞必须建立稳定但对引导信号敏感的极性域。在这里，我们展示了秀丽隐杆线虫种系卵裂球使用随时间变化的极化景观来解决这种权衡。具体来说，将 PAR 极性网络与细胞周期激酶 CDK-1 的振荡活性耦合，可确保新生细胞在低反馈状态下运行，从而降低状态转换的障碍，从而允许空间线索诱导和定向 PAR 蛋白不对称性。随着 CDK-1 活性在有丝分裂期间升高，分子反馈增加，增强线索诱导的不对称性，从而产生稳健且稳定的 PAR 极性域模式。与该模型一致，我们表明低 CDK/反馈机制会不稳定 PAR 域，但对于通过线索进行从头极化和极性重新定向是必需的。我们认为振荡网络代表了一种动态优化细胞决策环境的通用机制，确保发育过程中稳健的、信号诱导的状态切换。

articles.title: Devising a Zfu2p targeted antifungal strategy that may preserve commensalism while suppressing Candida albicans virulence during vulvovaginal candidiasis.
articles.titleZh: 设计 Zfu2p 靶向抗真菌策略，可在外阴阴道念珠菌病期间保留共生性，同时抑制白色念珠菌的毒力。
articles.authors: Kabir AR, Chaudhary AA, Chakraborty J, Podder S.
articles.abstract: Candida albicans is the leading cause of vulvovaginal candidiasis (VVC), a multifactorial disease of the lower female reproductive tract. Despite numerous studies, the molecular-pathophysiology during VVC and its commensal state within the host remains elusive. To address this, we performed a comprehensive computational analysis by integrating RNA-Seq datasets from both host and pathogen. Differentially expressed genes were identified and used to construct three network models: within the pathogen, host, and host-pathogen interaction. Subsequent inter-network nodes mapping enabled us to attain two distinct condition-specific fungal targeted networks in the host, during VVC (466 nodes and 496 edges) and commensal state (162 nodes and 176 edges), which were validated by condition-specific immune response by gene ontology analysis. Intending to target pathogenesis while preserving its commensal integrity, we identified an exclusive fungal protein Zfu2p that acts as a master regulator in the gene regulatory network of the pathogen. It promotes pathogenic attributes through its target gene RNR22 and interacts with the host protein UBC. Subsequently, the drug repurposing strategy coupled with molecular dynamics analysis identified Ergotamine as a promising candidate, which may disrupt biofilm formation while preserving commensal balance. This study offers insights into VVC pathophysiology and suggests a targeted therapy, though experimental validation of Ergotamine's efficacy remains essential.
articles.abstractZh: 白色念珠菌是外阴阴道念珠菌病 (VVC) 的主要原因，这是一种女性下生殖道的多因素疾病。尽管进行了大量研究，VVC 期间的分子病理生理学及其在宿主体内的共生状态仍然难以捉摸。为了解决这个问题，我们通过整合宿主和病原体的 RNA-Seq 数据集进行了全面的计算分析。鉴定出差异表达基因并用于构建三个网络模型：病原体内、宿主内以及宿主-病原体相互作用。随后的网络间节点映射使我们能够在 VVC（466 个节点和 496 个边）和共生状态（162 个节点和 176 个边）期间在宿主中获得两个不同的条件特异性真菌靶向网络，这些网络通过基因本体分析的条件特异性免疫反应进行了验证。为了在保持其共生完整性的同时锁定发病机制，我们鉴定了一种独特的真菌蛋白 Zfu2p，它充当病原体基因调控网络中的主调控因子。它通过其靶基因 RNR22 促进致病属性并与宿主蛋白 UBC 相互作用。随后，药物再利用策略结合

articles.title: Hierarchical small molecule inhibition of MYST acetyltransferases.
articles.titleZh: MYST 乙酰转移酶的分级小分子抑制。
articles.authors: Chen X, Castroverde A, Perez M, Holewinski R, Suazo KF, Karki R, Andresson T, Garcia BA, Meier JL.
articles.abstract: MYST lysine acetyltransferases (KATs) are a class of epigenetic enzymes critical for cellular function that constitute an emerging therapeutic target in cancer. Recently, several drug-like MYST inhibitors have been reported that show promise in preclinical models as well as in clinical trials of breast cancer. Understanding the specificity of these molecules is critical for their effective use as chemical probes. Here we apply an integrated profiling strategy to systematically define the potency and selectivity of drug-like MYST KAT inhibitors. First, we use optimized chemoproteomic profiling and histone acetylation biormarkers to study the industry-developed KAT inhibitor PF-9363. This reveals dose-dependent engagement of native KAT complexes, with hierarchical inhibition following the order KAT6A/B > KAT7 » KAT8 > KAT5. This pattern of target engagement is shared by the clinical candidate PF-8144.
