Next, we demonstrate how PF-9363's ability to disrupt capture of MYST complex members in chemoproteomic experiments can be leveraged to identify uncharacterized candidate members of these complexes, including the transcription factor FOXK2. Applying insights from these studies to WM-8014, WM-1119 and WM-3835, which have been extensively applied in the literature as MYST probes, highlights unexpected cross-inhibition and suggests a framework for how these small molecules and biomarkers may be applied to differentiate KAT6A/B and KAT7-dependent phenotypes. Finally, we benchmark the activity of PF-9363 in the NCI-60 cell line screen, providing evidence that its ability to engage KAT8 at elevated concentrations can drive acute growth inhibition. Collectively, our studies indicate the potential for MYST KAT inhibitors, including clinical candidates, to exhibit dose-dependent target engagement reminiscent of kinase inhibitors. The assays and biomarkers described here should find broad utility in assessing selective target engagement by this inhibitor class.
articles.abstractZh: MYST 赖氨酸乙酰转移酶 (KAT) 是一类对细胞功能至关重要的表观遗传酶，构成了癌症的新兴治疗靶点。最近，据报道，几种类似药物的 MYST 抑制剂在乳腺癌的临床前模型和临床试验中显示出良好的前景。了解这些分子的特异性对于它们作为化学探针的有效使用至关重要。在这里，我们应用综合分析策略来系统地定义类药物 MYST KAT 抑制剂的效力和选择性。首先，我们使用优化的化学蛋白质组学分析和组蛋白乙酰化生物标志物来研究行业开发的 KAT 抑制剂 PF-9363。这揭示了天然 KAT 复合物的剂量依赖性参与，并按照 KAT6A/B > KAT7 » KAT8 > KAT5 的顺序进行分层抑制。临床候选药物 PF-8144 也采用这种目标参与模式。接下来，我们展示了如何利用 PF-9363 在化学蛋白质组学实验中破坏 MYST 复合体成员捕获的能力来识别这些复合体的未表征的候选成员，包括转录因子 FOXK2。将这些研究的见解应用于 WM-801

articles.title: Magnetic medical microrobots with memory-capable genetic circuits.
articles.titleZh: 具有记忆功能的遗传电路的磁性医疗微型机器人。
articles.authors: Chen H, Chen Y, Wang Y, Ning P, Li Y, Sun Y, Wei X, Gao R, Fan X, Tao F, Guo Z, Gu W, Li Z, Fan X, Yin Z, Cheng Y.
articles.abstract: Autonomous microrobots can reach hard-to-access regions in the human body for minimally invasive therapy. However, their microscale size limits the integration of on-board memory, making their operation dependent on external controls. Here, we develop a magnetic probiotic microrobot integrated with memory-capable genetic circuit to execute autonomous antitumor treatment. Through a one-time magnetic hyperthermia trigger, the biological thermal sensor in the microrobot perceives temperature change and activates the memory module Bxb1-ssrA-attB-P7-attP, transferring the microrobots into a therapeutic state to continuously degrade fibrin and soften the tumor microenvironment. The genetic memory remains active for at least 12 days. A synergy toward deep tumor penetration is subsequently established between the memory-encoded softening and the physical penetration through magnetically controlled wave-like locomotion of microrobots. Compared with memory-absent microrobots, the proposed microrobots achieve a 6.70-fold tumor matrix stiffness reduction and boost in vivo anticancer efficacy from 21.86 to 87.52%. Beyond oncology, the proposed system establishes a generalizable framework of memory-encoded medical microrobots.
articles.abstractZh: 自主微型机器人可以到达人体难以到达的区域进行微创治疗。然而，它们的微型尺寸限制了板载存储器的集成，使得它们的操作依赖于外部控制。在这里，我们开发了一种磁性益生菌微型机器人，集成了具有记忆功能的遗传电路，以执行自主抗肿瘤治疗。通过一次性磁热疗触发，微型机器人中的生物热传感器感知温度变化并激活存储模块Bxb1-ssrA-attB-P7-attP，使微型机器人进入治疗状态，持续降解纤维蛋白，软化肿瘤微环境。遗传记忆至少保持活跃 12 天。随后，通过微型机器人的磁控波状运动，在记忆编码软化和物理穿透之间建立了对深层肿瘤穿透的协同作用。与无记忆微型机器人相比，所提出的微型机器人的肿瘤基质硬度降低了 6.70 倍，体内抗癌功效从 21.86% 提高到 87.52%。除了肿瘤学之外，所提出的系统还建立了一个可推广的 mem 框架

articles.title: Polyketide synthase-like functionality acquired by plant fatty acid elongase.
articles.titleZh: 由植物脂肪酸延伸酶获得的聚酮合酶样功能。
articles.authors: Kim H, Park K, Jia H, Huang F, Tang X, Zhong T, Yu W, Riethoven JM, Cahoon RE, Zhang C, Cahoon EB.
articles.abstract: Fatty acid elongation typically proceeds through a four-step cycle of condensation, reduction, dehydration, and reduction for each two-carbon extension. Here, we describe a variation of this pathway in Orychophragmus limprichtianus, whose seed oil contains previously unknown C24-C28 keto-hydroxy fatty acids that account for ~25% of total fatty acids. These compounds are produced through an endoplasmic reticulum-localized discontinuous elongation process in which a 3-keto-hydroxy intermediate bypasses full reduction and is extended through a polyketide synthase-like mechanism. Transcriptomic and functional assays identified two divergent enzymes, a variant fatty acid elongase 1 (FAE1) and a low-activity 3-ketoacyl-CoA reductase (KCR1), as central to this process. Protein modeling and mutant analysis suggest that specific amino acid substitutions underlie altered KCR1 activity, enabling accumulation of keto intermediates. Our findings reveal unexpected flexibility in plant fatty acid elongation and provide innovative tools for engineering plants and microbes to produce renewable oils with tailored industrial functions.
articles.abstractZh: 脂肪酸延伸通常通过缩合、还原、脱水和每个两个碳延伸的还原的四步循环进行。在这里，我们描述了 Orychophragmus limprichtianus 中这一途径的变异，其种子油含有以前未知的 C24-C28 酮羟基脂肪酸，约占总脂肪酸的 25%。这些化合物是通过内质网局部不连续延伸过程产生的，其中 3-酮羟基中间体绕过完全还原并通过聚酮合酶样机制延伸。转录组学和功能分析鉴定出两种不同的酶，一种变体脂肪酸延长酶 1 (FAE1) 和一种低活性 3-酮脂酰辅酶 A 还原酶 (KCR1)，作为该过程的核心。蛋白质模型和突变体分析表明，特定的氨基酸取代改变了 KCR1 活性，从而实现了酮中间体的积累。我们的研究结果揭示了植物脂肪酸伸长的意想不到的灵活性，并为工程植物和微生物提供了创新工具，以生产具有定制工业功能的可再生油。

articles.title: SNOR promotes translation restart after dormancy.
articles.titleZh: SNOR 促进休眠后翻译重新启动。
articles.authors: Gluc M, Rosa H, Bozko M, Turner LA, Prince CR, Peskova Y, Feaga HA, Gould KL, Mattei S, Jomaa A.
articles.abstract: Cellular dormancy enables survival during prolonged nutrient limitation by reversibly suppressing protein synthesis1-4. How inactive eukaryotic ribosomes are reactivated when nutrients return remains unclear. Here, using high-resolution in situ cryo-electron tomography in Schizosaccharomyces pombe, we identify SNOR, an SBDS domain-containing ribosome-associated factor that binds at the peptidyl transferase centre and contacts the hypusinated loop of eIF5A during glucose depletion-induced dormancy. Rather than acting as a canonical hibernation factor, SNOR licenses dormant ribosomes for rapid translational restart. Upon glucose repletion, SNOR and eIF5A act together to promote efficient recovery of polysomes and exit from dormancy. These findings define a stress-responsive ribosome restart module that couples carbon-source limitation to surveillance of the ribosomal active site and reactivation of protein synthesis.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞休眠通过可逆地抑制蛋白质合成来实现长期营养限制下的生存1-4。当营养物质返回时，失活的真核核糖体如何重新激活仍不清楚。在这里，我们利用粟酒裂殖酵母的高​​分辨率原位冷冻电子断层扫描技术，鉴定出 SNOR，一种含有 SBDS 结构域的核糖体相关因子，在葡萄糖耗尽诱导的休眠过程中与肽基转移酶中心结合并接触 eIF5A 的 hypuslated 环。 SNOR 不是充当典型的冬眠因子，而是许可休眠核糖体进行快速翻译重启。葡萄糖补充后，SNOR 和 eIF5A 共同作用，促进多核糖体的有效恢复并退出休眠。这些发现定义了一种应激响应性核糖体重启模块，该模块将碳源限制与核糖体活性位点的监测和蛋白质合成的重新激活结合起来。

articles.title: Acarbose redirects gut microbiome utilization of dietary carbohydrates to suppress anaphylaxis in mice.
articles.titleZh: 阿卡波糖改变肠道微生物组对膳食碳水化合物的利用，以抑制小鼠的过敏反应。
articles.authors: Yakabe K, Inoue Y, Yanagisawa Y, Imai S, Suwa S, Ando M, Wu Y, Kurokawa R, Srirat T, Haneda T, Miki T, Ito M, Hirayama A, Kurashima Y, Fukuda S, Hase K, Suda W, Takeyama H, Hori S, Kim YG.
articles.abstract: Microbiota-accessible carbohydrates modulate host immunity by shaping gut microbial composition and metabolism. However, their role in modulating the microbiota to influence allergic responses is unclear. Here we show that a widely used antidiabetic agent, the α-glucosidase inhibitor acarbose, redirects dietary carbohydrate utilization by gut bacteria to suppress mast-cell-dependent anaphylaxis in mice, independently of adaptive immune responses. Enhanced carbohydrate availability promoted the proliferation of Parabacteroides distasonis in the mouse gut, leading to increased succinate abundance and intracellular NAD+ levels, and reduced reliance on b-type cytochrome-dependent anaerobic respiration. Direct administration of succinate suppressed systemic anaphylaxis and mast cell degranulation in vitro, implicating succinate as a key effector. A human cohort analysis revealed that patients treated with α-glucosidase inhibitors showed a lower incidence of anaphylaxis than untreated individuals. These findings uncover a previously unrecognized gut-microbiota-mediated pathway linking dietary carbohydrate metabolism to systemic immune regulation.
articles.abstractZh: 微生物可接触的碳水化合物通过塑造肠道微生物组成和代谢来调节宿主免疫力。然而，它们在调节微生物群以影响过敏反应方面的作用尚不清楚。在这里，我们展示了一种广泛使用的抗糖尿病药物，α-葡萄糖苷酶抑制剂阿卡波糖，可以改变肠道细菌对膳食碳水化合物的利用，从而抑制小鼠肥大细胞依赖性过敏反应，而与适应性免疫反应无关。碳水化合物可用性的增强促进了小鼠肠道中 Parabacteroides distasonis 的增殖，导致琥珀酸丰度和细胞内 NAD+ 水平增加，并减少了对 b 型细胞色素依赖性无氧呼吸的依赖。直接施用琥珀酸可抑制体外全身过敏反应和肥大细胞脱粒，表明琥珀酸是关键效应物。一项人类队列分析显示，接受 α-葡萄糖苷酶抑制剂治疗的患者的过敏反应发生率低于未接受治疗的患者。这些发现揭示了一条以前未被认识的肠道微生物介导的途径，将膳食碳水化合物代谢与系统免疫调节联系起来。

articles.title: High-throughput screening approach identifies substrate-selective Hsp104 variants that counter amyloid seeding with diminished off-target effects.
articles.titleZh: 高通量筛选方法可识别底物选择性 Hsp104 变体，这些变体可对抗淀粉样蛋白播种并减少脱靶效应。
articles.authors: Ryan JJ, Miller KR, Puri A, Sprunger ML, Bochantine MM, Lopez A, Chen S, Bao A, Ling C, Xu A, Bell B, Sohn BS, Li L, Chang C, Mohammed K, Staller MV, Jackrel ME.
articles.abstract: Hsp104, a yeast protein-remodeling factor, can disaggregate misfolded proteins implicated in neurodegeneration. Although many potentiated Hsp104 variants have been generated, suboptimal properties have limited their application in mammalian systems. Here, we present the development of a high-throughput screening approach for identifying enhanced Hsp104 variants. To screen a large library of variants in parallel and with a quantitative output, we coupled a live-or-die yeast-based selection with next-generation sequencing. The identified Hsp104 variants solubilize preformed α-synuclein and TDP-43 aggregates, inhibit seeding of preformed α-synuclein fibrils in mammalian biosensor cells, restore TDP-43 splicing of native targets, and have diminished off-target toxicity in mammalian cells. Certain variants show distinct changes in ATP hydrolysis, which we suggest is the key driver of these improved properties. We anticipate that our approach is broadly applicable to a range of protein engineering targets to allow coupling of a phenotypic readout to high-throughput quantitative analysis of variants in parallel.
articles.abstractZh: Hsp104 是一种酵母蛋白质重塑因子，可以分解与神经退行性疾病有关的错误折叠蛋白质。尽管已经产生了许多增强的 Hsp104 变体，但次优特性限制了它们在哺乳动物系统中的应用。在这里，我们介绍了一种用于鉴定增强型 Hsp104 变体的高通量筛选方法的开发。为了并行筛选大型变体文库并提供定量输出，我们将基于活或死酵母的选择与下一代测序结合起来。鉴定出的 Hsp104 变体可溶解预先形成的 α-突触核蛋白和 TDP-43 聚集体，抑制预先形成的 α-突触核蛋白原纤维在哺乳动物生物传感器细胞中的播种，恢复天然靶标的 TDP-43 剪接，并减少哺乳动物细胞中的脱靶毒性。某些变体在 ATP 水解方面表现出明显的变化，我们认为这是这些改进特性的关键驱动因素。我们预计我们的方法广泛适用于一系列蛋白质工程目标，以允许将表型读数与变体的高通量定量分析并行耦合。

articles.title: Image-based, pooled phenotyping reveals multidimensional, disease-specific variant effects.
articles.titleZh: 基于图像的汇总表型分析揭示了多维、疾病特异性变异效应。
articles.authors: Pendyala S, Partington K, Bradley N, McEwen AE, Straub G, Kim HJ, Fayer S, Holmes DL, Sitko KA, Garge RK, Wang ZR, Wheelock MK, Vandi AJ, Powell RL, Friedman CE, McDermot E, Kishore N, Roth FP, Rubin AF, Yang KC, Starita LM, Noble WS, Fowler DM.
articles.abstract: Genetic variants produce complex phenotypic effects that confound current assays and predictive models. We developed variant in situ sequencing (VIS-seq), a pooled, image-based method measuring variant effects on molecular and cellular phenotypes in diverse cell types. Applying VIS-seq to ∼3,000 LMNA and PTEN variants yielded high-dimensional morphological profiles capturing changes in protein abundance, localization, activity, and cell architecture. VIS-seq identified a subset of linker-subdomain LMNA variants that increase nuclear circularity, in contrast to aggregating or low-abundance rod-subdomain variants that decrease circularity. VIS-seq also identified autism-associated PTEN variants that mislocalize and accurately distinguished autism-linked from tumor syndrome-linked and gnomAD control variants. Most variants impacted a multidimensional phenotypic continuum not recapitulated by any single functional readout. By linking variants to cell images at scale, VIS-seq illuminates how variant effects cascade from molecules to subcellular structures to cells, providing a framework for resolving the complexity of variant function.
articles.abstractZh: 遗传变异产生复杂的表型效应，使当前的检测和预测模型变得混乱。我们开发了变异原位测序 (VIS-seq)，这是一种基于图像的汇总方法，用于测量变异对不同细胞类型中分子和细胞表型的影响。将 VIS-seq 应用于约 3,000 个 LMNA 和 PTEN 变体，产生了高维形态学特征，捕获了蛋白质丰度、定位、活性和细胞结构的变化。 VIS-seq 鉴定了一个增加核圆形度的接头子结构域 LMNA 变体的子集，与降低圆形度的聚集或低丰度杆子结构域变体相反。 VIS-seq 还发现了与自闭症相关的 PTEN 变异，这些变异会错误定位并准确地区分与自闭症相关的变异、与肿瘤综合征相关的变异以及 gnomAD 对照变异。大多数变异影响多维表型连续体，无法通过任何单一功能读数来概括。通过大规模地将变异与细胞图像联系起来，VIS-seq 阐明了变异效应如何从分子级联到亚细胞结构再到细胞，为解决变异功能的复杂性提供了一个框架。

articles.title: Tomato B cell receptor-associated protein 31 homologs enhance thermotolerance by promoting chloroplast PSBW accumulation and stabilizing the PSII-LHCII complex.
articles.titleZh: 番茄 B 细胞受体相关蛋白 31 同源物通过促进叶绿体 PSBW 积累和稳定 PSII-LHCII 复合物来增强耐热性。
articles.authors: Chen C, Xiong F, Hu Y, Qi Z, Wang Y, Ma X, Lv W, Ma N, Meng Q, Lu C, Zhuang K.
articles.abstract: B-cell receptor-associated protein 31 (BAP31) is an endoplasmic reticulum (ER) transmembrane protein in humans that regulates protein trafficking, apoptosis, and inflammatory responses to maintain cellular homeostasis. However, its role in plants remains largely unknown. Here, we identified two tomato (Solanum lycopersicum) homologs, SlBAP31 and SlBAP31-LIKE, which are strongly induced by heat stress and function redundantly to stabilize photosystem II-light-harvesting complex II (PSII-LHCII) supercomplexes. Although localization to the ER or Golgi apparatus has been detected, both proteins are also present in chloroplasts, where they interact with SlTOC75, a core component of the chloroplast TOC-TIC translocon complex. Loss of either protein reduces the abundance of PSBW under heat stress. Among the two tomato PSBW isoforms, SlPSBW2 plays a predominant role in PSII-LHCII stability, and its accumulation depends in part on glycine 121 at the C terminus and interaction with SlBAP31/SlBAP31-LIKE. Collectively, our results reveal that ER/Golgi- and chloroplast periphery-localized SlBAP31 and SlBAP31-LIKE positively regulate tomato thermotolerance by mediating SlPSBW2 accumulation and stabilizing the PSII-LHCII supercomplex.
articles.abstractZh: B 细胞受体相关蛋白 31 (BAP31) 是人类的一种内质网 (ER) 跨膜蛋白，可调节蛋白质运输、细胞凋亡和炎症反应以维持细胞稳态。然而，它在植物中的作用仍然很大程度上未知。在这里，我们鉴定了两种番茄（Solanum lycopersicum）同源物，SlBAP31和SlBAP31-LIKE，它们受到热应激的强烈诱导，并且冗余地发挥稳定光系统II-光捕获复合物II（PSII-LHCII）超复合物的作用。尽管已检测到定位于 ER 或高尔基体，但这两种蛋白也存在于叶绿体中，并与叶绿体 TOC-TIC 易位子复合物的核心成分 SlTOC75 相互作用。任何一种蛋白质的损失都会降低热应激下 PSBW 的丰度。在两种番茄 PSBW 亚型中，SlPSBW2 在 PSII-LHCII 稳定性中起主导作用，其积累部分取决于 C 末端的甘氨酸 121 以及与 SlBAP31/SlBAP31-LIKE 的相互作用。总的来说，我们的结果表明，ER/高尔基体和叶绿体外围定位的 SlBAP31 和 SlBAP31-LIKE 通过介导 SlPSBW2 积累和 slPSBW2 积极调节番茄耐热性。

articles.title: Multi-faceted characterization of the gut microbiome and metabolome in patients with primary Sjögren syndrome.
articles.titleZh: 原发性干燥综合征患者肠道微生物组和代谢组的多方面特征。
articles.authors: Chen C, Xing Y, Xing G, Zeng F, Zheng N, Sha S, Zhao L, Zhang Y, Ling Y, Yao X, Liu C, Zhang Y, Mei T, Guo R, Kang J, Cheng L, Fan S, Sun W, Li S, Yan Q, Yao X, Kong X, Ma W.
articles.abstract: The gut microbiome and its metabolomic potential in primary Sjögren syndrome (pSS) remain largely unexplored. Here, we perform whole-metagenome shotgun sequencing of fecal samples from 206 pSS patients and 355 non-pSS controls, integrating compositional and functional profiling with serum and fecal metabolomes. pSS is associated with extensive multi-kingdom alterations, including 49 bacterial (e.g., Streptococcus parasanguinis, Ligilactobacillus salivarius, and Veillonella parvula), 19 fungal (notably Candida albicans), and 1,323 viral species. These signatures form robust inter-kingdom correlations and achieve high diagnostic accuracy in an independent validation cohort. Functional and metabolomic analyses reveal enrichment of toxin-related and aromatic pathways and depletion of protective metabolites in patients. pSS-enriched bacteria harbor abundant immunogenic epitopes, virulence factors, and antimicrobial resistance genes, and induce proinflammatory responses ex vivo. Together, these findings outline a multi-faceted microbial framework for pSS and suggest mechanistic links between gut dysbiosis and immune dysregulation.
articles.abstractZh: 肠道微生物组及其在原发性干燥综合征 (pSS) 中的代谢组学潜力在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们对 206 名 pSS 患者和 355 名非 pSS 对照者的粪便样本进行全宏基因组鸟枪测序，将成分和功能分析与血清和粪便代谢组相结合。 pSS 与广泛的多界改变相关，包括 49 种细菌（例如副血链球菌、唾液乳杆菌和小韦荣球菌）、19 种真菌（尤其是白色念珠菌）和 1,323 种病毒。这些特征形成了强大的王国间相关性，并在独立验证队列中实现了高诊断准确性。功能和代谢组学分析揭示了患者毒素相关和芳香途径的富集以及保护性代谢物的消耗。富含 pSS 的细菌具有丰富的免疫原性表位、毒力因子和抗菌素耐药基因，并在体外诱导促炎症反应。总之，这些发现概述了 pSS 的多方面微生物框架，并表明肠道菌群失调和免疫失调之间的机制联系。

articles.title: Pooled CRISPRi screening reveals fungal-specific drug target candidates.
articles.titleZh: 汇集 CRISPRi 筛选揭示了真菌特异性候选药物靶点。
articles.authors: Wensing LF, Després PC, Francis D, Fogal M, Hendriks A, Gervais NC, Fikry C, Adamu Bukari AR, Gerstein AC, Cuomo CA, Shapiro RS.
articles.abstract: The rising rate of drug-resistant fungal infections and the emergence of intrinsically resistant pathogens pose growing clinical challenges. Because fungi are closely related to mammals, developing antifungals without toxic off-target effects is difficult. Targeted gene repression can model drug-mediated inhibition and reveal gene dosage sensitivity, but traditional approaches in the fungal pathogen Candida albicans are labour intensive and low throughput. Here we adapt pooled CRISPR interference (CRISPRi) screening in C. albicans to enable large-scale functional genomic analysis. We assess repression sensitivity of 130 essential genes conserved in fungi without close homologues in humans and identify highly dosage-sensitive genes across multiple pathways. Screening across ten environmental conditions reveals environment-dependent effects on gene sensitivity. Extending these experiments to two drug-resistant clinical isolates shows that many fitness defects are conserved across genetic backgrounds. Thus, CRISPRi pooled screening enables rapid, large-scale functional genomics across diverse genetic backgrounds in C. albicans.
articles.abstractZh: 耐药真菌感染率的上升和固有耐药病原体的出现给临床带来了越来越大的挑战。由于真菌与哺乳动物密切相关，因此开发没有毒性脱靶效应的抗真菌药物非常困难。靶向基因抑制可以模拟药物介导的抑制并揭示基因剂量敏感性，但真菌病原体白色念珠菌的传统方法是劳动密集型且通量低。在这里，我们在白色念珠菌中采用了混合 CRISPR 干扰 (CRISPRi) 筛选，以实现大规模功能基因组分析。我们评估了真菌中保守的 130 个必需基因在人类中没有密切同源物的抑制敏感性，并跨多个途径鉴定了高度剂量敏感的基因。对十种环境条件的筛选揭示了环境依赖性对基因敏感性的影响。将这些实验扩展到两种耐药临床分离株表明，许多健康缺陷在不同遗传背景下都是保守的。因此，CRISPRi 混合筛选能够在白色念珠菌的不同遗传背景中进行快速、大规模的功能基因组学。

articles.title: Proteolysis activity mapping and substrate discovery platform for identifying tumor-activated biosensors.
articles.titleZh: 用于识别肿瘤激活生物传感器的蛋白水解活性图谱和底物发现平台。
articles.authors: Algov I, Van Heest A, Hopton M, Liang F, Holmes A, Hao L, Zhou X.
articles.abstract: Dysregulated extracellular proteolytic activity is a prominent hallmark of cancer and can thus be exploited for tumor detection and therapeutic development. However, the discovery of tumor-responsive probes has been hindered by the lack of methods to directly screen proteolytic events in specific tissue samples. Here we report PSurf, a platform that enables the identification of tissue-specific protease sensors with tissue specimens. Through differential selection of tumor-specific sequences over healthy tissue, PSurf identifies context-specific tumor-activated probes that precisely distinguish metastatic lesions in lung tissue slices. Using these substrates, we engineered nanobody-targeted biosensors that release urinary reporters upon tumor-specific cleavage in vivo, enabling precise non-invasive tumor detection in a mouse lung metastasis model. PSurf provides a foundation for developing conditionally activated agents through tissue-specific activity mapping and probe discovery.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞外蛋白水解活性失调是癌症的一个突出标志，因此可用于肿瘤检测和治疗开发。然而，由于缺乏直接筛选特定组织样本中蛋白水解事件的方法，肿瘤响应探针的发现受到阻碍。在这里，我们报告 PSurf，一个能够利用组织样本识别组织特异性蛋白酶传感器的平台。通过对健康组织中肿瘤特异性序列的差异选择，PSurf 识别出特定环境的肿瘤激活探针，可以精确地区分肺组织切片中的转移性病变。使用这些底物，我们设计了纳米抗体靶向生物传感器，可在体内肿瘤特异性裂解时释放尿报告基因，从而在小鼠肺转移模型中实现精确的非侵入性肿瘤检测。 PSurf 为通过组织特异性活动映射和探针发现开发条件激活剂奠定了基础。

articles.title: RAB5c orchestrates LC3-associated phagocytosis to promote microbicidal function of macrophages.
articles.titleZh: RAB5c 协调 LC3 相关的吞噬作用以促进巨噬细胞的杀菌功能。
articles.authors: Freitas-Filho EG, Zaidan I, Alzamora-Terrel DL, Bifano C, Fortes-Rocha M, de Castro PA, Eugênio Araujo Piraine R, Pinzan CF, de Rezende CP, Boada-Romero E, Wileman T, Almeida F, Goldman GH, Florey O, Cunha LD.
articles.abstract: Noncanonical conjugation of ATG8 proteins, including LC3, to single membranes implicates the autophagy machinery in cell functions unrelated to metabolic stress. One such pathway is LC3-associated phagocytosis (LAP), which aids in phagosome maturation and subsequent signaling upon cargo uptake mediated by certain innate immunity-associated receptors. Here, we show that a specific isoform of RAB5 GTPases, the molecular switches controlling early endosome traffic, is necessary for LAP. We demonstrate that RAB5c regulates phagosome recruitment and function of complexes required for phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate [PI(3)P] and reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation by macrophages. RAB5c facilitates phagosome translocation of the V-ATPase transmembrane core, which is needed for ATG16L1 binding and consequent LC3 conjugation. RAB5c depletion impaired macrophage elimination of the fungal pathogen Aspergillus fumigatus and disruption of the V-ATPase-ATG16L1 axis increased susceptibility in vivo. Thus, early endosome-to-phagosome trafficking can be selectively engaged to promote pathogen elimination by directing phagosomal maturation toward LAP.
articles.abstractZh: ATG8 蛋白（包括 LC3）与单膜的非规范结合表明细胞功能中的自噬机制与代谢应激无关。其中一种途径是 LC3 相关吞噬作用 (LAP)，它有助于吞噬体成熟以及随后由某些先天免疫相关受体介导的货物摄取信号传导。在这里，我们证明了 RAB5 GTPases 的特定亚型（控制早期内体运输的分子开关）对于 LAP 是必需的。我们证明 RAB5c 调节吞噬体的募集和复合物的功能，这些复合物是磷脂酰肌醇 3-磷酸 [PI(3)P] 和巨噬细胞产生活性氧 (ROS) 所需的。 RAB5c 促进 V-ATPase 跨膜核心的吞噬体易位，这是 ATG16L1 结合和随后的 LC3 缀合所必需的。 RAB5c 的缺失会损害巨噬细胞对真菌病原体烟曲霉的消除，并且 V-ATPase-ATG16L1 轴的破坏会增加体内的敏感性。因此，早期内体到吞噬体的运输可以选择性地参与，通过引导吞噬体向 LAP 成熟来促进病原体消除。

articles.title: The genetic landscape of antibiotic sensitivity in <i>Staphylococcus aureus</i>.
articles.titleZh: 金黄色葡萄球菌抗生素敏感性的遗传景观。
articles.authors: Li W, Liu M, Oikonomou P, Blattman S, Berisa M, Paul F, Hettleman J, Gonzalez J, Hu Q, Chen H, Tavazoie S, Jiang W.
articles.abstract: A comprehensive genetic landscape of antibiotic sensitivity in Staphylococcus aureus is lacking. Using genome-scale CRISPR-interference libraries, we systematically quantified global gene fitness across 10 antibiotics and uncovered hundreds of significant antibiotic-gene interactions. Essential genes dominated these interactions, a finding not revealed by transposon-based studies. CRISPR interference repression of transcriptional and translational processes desensitized bacteria to multiple antibiotics. In contrast, repression of cell wall synthesis/cell division (CC), DNA replication/DNA recombination (DD), coenzyme A biosynthesis, and riboflavin metabolism strongly sensitized bacteria to antibiotics. Network and genetic analyses further revealed synergistic genetic interactions (GIs) within these bioprocesses, including an extensive CC-DD subnetwork. Only a subset of CC-DD synergies was dependent on the cell division inhibitor SosA. Informed by these GIs, we identified multiple drug-drug combinations with potent synergistic activity against multidrug-resistant S. aureus. Our detailed profiling of drug-gene, gene-gene, and drug-drug interactions reveals important functional relationships among essential genes and defines a vulnerability landscape to guide drug target discovery and effective combination therapies.
articles.abstractZh: 金黄色葡萄球菌抗生素敏感性的全面遗传图谱缺乏。使用基因组规模的 CRISPR 干扰文库，我们系统地量化了 10 种抗生素的全局基因适应性，并发现了数百种重要的抗生素基因相互作用。必需基因主导了这些相互作用，这一发现并未被基于转座子的研究揭示。 CRISPR 干扰抑制转录和翻译过程使细菌对多种抗生素失去敏感性。相比之下，细胞壁合成/细胞分裂（CC）、DNA复制/DNA重组（DD）、辅酶A生物合成和核黄素代谢的抑制使细菌对抗生素强烈敏感。网络和遗传分析进一步揭示了这些生物过程中的协同遗传相互作用 (GI)，包括广泛的 CC-DD 子网络。只有一部分 CC-DD 协同作用依赖于细胞分裂抑制剂 SosA。根据这些地理标志，我们确定了多种药物组合，对多重耐药金黄色葡萄球菌具有有效的协同活性。我们对药物-基因、基因-基因和药物-药物相互作用的详细分析揭示了重要的功能关系

articles.title: Cysteine availability tunes ubiquitin signaling via inverse stability of LRRC58 E3 ligase and its substrate CDO1.
articles.titleZh: 半胱氨酸的可用性通过 LRRC58 E3 连接酶及其底物 CDO1 的逆稳定性调节泛素信号传导。
articles.authors: Andree GA, Stier LJ, Schmiederer K, Thielen AS, Schmid L, Maiwald SA, Gottemukkala KV, Du J, von Gronau S, Strasser C, Müller J, Henneberg LT, Guyot C, Kleiger G, Mann M, Murray PJ, Schulman BA.
articles.abstract: Cellular responses to amino acid fluctuations often hinge on ubiquitin-mediated control of metabolic enzymes, yet the underlying E3 ligase pathways remain poorly defined. Using quantitative proteomics and active cullin-RING ligase (CRL) profiling, we identify LRRC58 as a cysteine-responsive substrate receptor whose stability increases sharply under cysteine starvation. Proteomics reveals an inverse relationship between LRRC58 and the metabolic enzyme cysteine dioxygenase 1 (CDO1), suggesting a cysteine-linked regulatory axis. Biochemical reconstitution and cryo-EM structures show that LRRC58 forms an active CUL2- or CUL5-based CRL that selectively positions CDO1 for ubiquitylation at Lys8. Disease mutant versions of CDO1 mapping to the LRRC58 interface and impaired for the endogenous ubiquitylation pathway were degraded through orthogonal targeting by a VHL-based degrader. Together, our proteomics-guided discovery pipeline, cellular stability studies, and structural analyses uncover a metabolically-tuned LRRC58-CDO1 pathway that links cysteine availability to selective proteasomal turnover, reveals principles of metabolite-regulated CRL activity, and showcases mechanisms distinguishing endogenous and targeted protein degradation.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞对氨基酸波动的反应通常取决于泛素介导的代谢酶控制，但潜在的 E3 连接酶途径仍不清楚。使用定量蛋白质组学和活性 cullin-RING 连接酶 (CRL) 分析，我们将 LRRC58 鉴定为半胱氨酸响应底物受体，其稳定性在半胱氨酸饥饿下急剧增加。蛋白质组学揭示了 LRRC58 与代谢酶半胱氨酸双加氧酶 1 (CDO1) 之间的负相关关系，表明半胱氨酸相关的调节轴。生化重建和冷冻电镜结构显示 LRRC58 形成基于 CUL2 或 CUL5 的活性 CRL，选择性地将 CDO1 定位在 Lys8 处进行泛素化。映射到 LRRC58 界面且内源泛素化途径受损的 CDO1 疾病突变版本通过基于 VHL 的降解器的正交靶向进行降解。我们的蛋白质组学引导的发现流程、细胞稳定性研究和结构分析共同揭示了代谢调节的 LRRC58-CDO1 途径，该途径将半胱氨酸可用性与选择性蛋白酶体周转联系起来，揭示了代谢物调节的 CRL 活性的原理，并展示了区分机制

articles.title: Dietary grape pomace mitigates high-NSP-induced inflammation and production loss via microbiome-SCFA-immune mediated pathways.
articles.titleZh: 膳食葡萄渣通过微生物组-SCFA-免疫介导途径减轻高 NSP 诱导的炎症和产量损失。
articles.authors: Sharma MK, Agarwal N, Stadulis SE, Dugan EM, Giovannoni CB, Glesener H, Abdollahzadeh D, Tanveer H, Gracey PR, Huang M, Gibney PA, Voth-Gaeddert LE, Tako E.
articles.abstract: The United States poultry industry is transitioning away from antibiotic growth promoters (AGP) to antibiotic-free programs, which may increase the risk of chronic intestinal inflammation due to exposure to multiple factors. Grape pomace (GP), a polyphenol-rich by-product, might be a promising candidate for mitigating such inflammation. This study investigated the fermented and non-fermented GP as potential substitutes for antibiotic growth promoters in broilers. A total of 126 broilers were divided into six treatment groups: (i) standard diet (STD), (ii) high non-starch polysaccharide diet (NSP), (iii) NSP + zinc bacitracin (AGP), (iv) NSP + 0.5% GP (GP), (v) NSP + 0.5% Lactobacillus casei fermented GP (LAB FGP), and (vi) NSP + 0.5% Saccharomyces cerevisiae fermented GP (YST FGP). NSP-fed birds exhibited reduced growth and increased TNF-α and IL-1β expression, indicating chronic inflammation. GP and FGP suppressed cytokine expression, modulated microbial homeostasis, and increased butyrate production, suggesting functional modulation of the cecal microbiome. Exploratory correlation identified the Lactobacillaceae-butyrate-IL-1β pathway, positively associated with growth, microbiome, and SCFA production, and negatively associated with inflammation. Overall, incorporating 0.5% of GP or FGP into the diet may serve as an effective alternative to AGPs in broiler production, with the added benefits of antioxidants and prebiotics.
articles.abstractZh: 美国家禽业正在从抗生素生长促进剂（AGP）过渡到无抗生素计划，这可能会增加由于接触多种因素而导致慢性肠道炎症的风险。葡萄渣（GP）是一种富含多酚的副产品，可能是减轻此类炎症的有希望的候选者。本研究调查了发酵和非发酵 GP 作为肉鸡抗生素生长促进剂的潜在替代品。总共 126 只肉鸡分为 6 个处理组：(i) 标准日粮 (STD)、(ii) 高非淀粉多糖日粮 (NSP)、(iii) NSP + 杆菌肽锌 (AGP)、(iv) NSP + 0.5% GP (GP)、(v) NSP + 0.5% 干酪乳杆菌发酵 GP (LAB FGP) 和 (vi) NSP + 0.5%酿酒酵母发酵 GP (YST FGP)。饲喂 NSP 的鸡表现出生长减缓和 TNF-α 和 IL-1β 表达增加，表明存在慢性炎症。 GP 和 FGP 抑制细胞因子表达、调节微生物稳态并增加丁酸盐产量，表明盲肠微生物组的功能调节。探索性相关性确定了乳杆菌科-丁酸-IL-1β途径，与生长、微生物群呈正相关

articles.title: Glucose-dependent acidification strategy by nectar-dwelling bacteria mediates pollen tube burst.
articles.titleZh: 花蜜栖息细菌的葡萄糖依赖性酸化策略介导花粉管破裂。
articles.authors: Kato Y, Miura H, Takayama S, Fujii S.
articles.abstract: Floral nectary gland serves as an ecological hub, including a habitat for microorganisms introduced by pollinators. Although nectar supplies abundant carbon sources, it is limited in nitrogen sources. To address this unbalanced nutritional condition, it is considered that some nectar-dwelling bacteria including those belong to genus Acinetobacter obtain nutrients from pollen protoplasm by inducing pollen tube burst. Here, using gas chromatography-mass spectrometry, we identify gluconic acid in A. nectaris and A. pollinis as the substance responsible for triggering pollen tube burst via acidification of the surrounding environments. Through whole-genome sequencing and functional analysis, we identify a membrane-bound pyrroloquinoline quinone (PQQ)-dependent glucose dehydrogenase which produces gluconic acid. Notably, nectar-dwelling Acinetobacter species consistently retain PQQ biosynthetic genes, and expression of the PQQ precursor peptide gene are upregulated in the presence of glucose, suggesting that these bacteria can synthesize PQQ and gluconic acid immediately upon entering the nectary gland. Taken together with previous findings, this glucose-dependent acidification is beneficial for both efficient carbon source utilization and nutrient landscape modification, a bacterial adaptive strategy well-suited to the competitive nectar environment.
articles.abstractZh: 花蜜腺是一个生态中心，包括传粉媒介引入的微生物的栖息地。虽然花蜜提供丰富的碳源，但氮源有限。为了解决这种不平衡的营养状况，人们认为一些花蜜栖息的细菌，包括属于不动杆菌属的细菌，通过诱导花粉管破裂从花粉原生质中获取营养。在这里，我们使用气相色谱-质谱法，确定了蜜腺蜜和花粉蜜中的葡萄糖酸是通过周围环境酸化触发花粉管破裂的物质。通过全基因组测序和功能分析，我们鉴定了一种膜结合吡咯喹啉醌（PQQ）依赖性葡萄糖脱氢酶，可产生葡萄糖酸。值得注意的是，花蜜中的不动杆菌始终保留 PQQ 生物合成基因，并且 PQQ 前体肽基因的表达在葡萄糖存在下上调，表明这些细菌在进入蜜腺后可以立即合成 PQQ 和葡萄糖酸。与之前的发现结合起来，这种葡萄糖依赖性酸化是有益的

articles.title: Mitochondria serve as a holdout compartment for aggregation-prone proteins hindering efficient degradation.
articles.titleZh: 线粒体充当易于聚集的蛋白质的阻挡室，阻碍了有效降解。
articles.authors: Gierisch ME, Barchi E, Marogna M, Wallnöfer MH, Ankarcrona M, Naia L, Salomons FA, Dantuma NP.
articles.abstract: The accumulation of protein aggregates has been causatively linked to the pathogenesis of neurodegenerative diseases. Here, we conduct a genome-wide CRISPR-Cas9 screen to identify cellular factors that regulate the degradation of an aggregation-prone reporter. Genes encoding proteins involved in mitochondrial homeostasis, including the translation factor eIF5A, are enriched among suppressors of the degradation of the reporter. Genetic or chemical inhibition of eIF5A leads to dissociation of the aggregation-prone substrate from mitochondria, which is accompanied by enhanced ubiquitin-dependent proteasomal degradation. The presence of an aggregation-prone, amphipathic helix that localizes the reporter to mitochondria is crucial for the stimulatory effect of eIF5A inhibition on proteasomal degradation. Additionally, inhibition of eIF5A also enhances degradation of mutant huntingtin and α-synuclein, two disease-associated proteins that contain amphipathic helices and mislocalize to mitochondria. We propose that mitochondria serve as a holdout compartment for aggregation-prone proteins. Therefore, preventing mitochondrial localization of aggregation-prone proteins may offer a viable therapeutic strategy for reducing disease-associated proteins in neurodegenerative disorders.
articles.abstractZh: 蛋白质聚集体的积累与神经退行性疾病的发病机制存在因果关系。在这里，我们进行了全基因组 CRISPR-Cas9 筛选，以确定调节易于聚集的报告基因降解的细胞因子。编码参与线粒体稳态的蛋白质（包括翻译因子 eIF5A）的基因在报告基因降解的抑制因子中丰富。 eIF5A 的遗传或化学抑制导致易于聚集的底物从线粒体解离，同时增强泛素依赖性蛋白酶体降解。将报告基因定位于线粒体的易于聚集的两亲性螺旋的存在对于 eIF5A 抑制对蛋白酶体降解的刺激作用至关重要。此外，抑制 eIF5A 还会增强突变亨廷顿蛋白和 α-突触核蛋白的降解，这两种疾病相关蛋白含有两亲性螺旋并错误定位到线粒体。我们建议线粒体作为易于聚集的蛋白质的阻挡室。因此，防止易聚集蛋白的线粒体定位可能提供一种可行的方法

articles.title: Short RNA chaperones promote aggregation-resistant TDP-43 conformers to mitigate neurodegeneration.
articles.titleZh: 短 RNA 伴侣可促进抗聚集 TDP-43 构象异构体，从而减轻神经退行性变。
articles.authors: Copley KE, Mauna JC, Danielson HL, Chen Q, Ozguney B, Ngo M, Xie L, Smirnov A, Davis M, Mayne L, Linsenmeier M, Rubien JD, Bergmann CA, Portz B, Lee BL, Odeh HM, Lai L, Chang YW, Hallegger M, Ule J, Pasinelli P, Poon Y, Mittal J, Fawzi NL, Black BE, Donnelly CJ, Jensen BK, Shorter J.
articles.abstract: Aberrant aggregation of the prion-like RNA binding protein TDP-43 drives several fatal neurodegenerative proteinopathies, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). In this work, we define how short, specific RNAs solubilize TDP-43. These short RNAs engage and stabilize the TDP-43 RNA recognition motifs, which allosterically destabilizes a conserved helical region in the prion-like domain, thereby promoting aggregation-resistant conformers. Sequence-space mining identified short RNA chaperones with enhanced activity against TDP-43 and disease-linked variants. Enhanced short RNA chaperones mitigated aberrant TDP-43 phenotypes in optogenetic models and in ALS patient-derived and control motor neurons. In mice with cytoplasmic TDP-43 aggregation and motor neuron loss, an enhanced short RNA chaperone reduced pathological aggregation, restored TDP-43 function, and conferred neuroprotection. These results define a mechanistic and therapeutic framework for RNA-based strategies to counter TDP-43 proteinopathies.
articles.abstractZh: 朊病毒样 RNA 结合蛋白 TDP-43 的异常聚集会导致多种致命的神经退行性蛋白病，包括肌萎缩侧索硬化症 (ALS)。在这项工作中，我们定义了短的特异性 RNA 溶解 TDP-43 的方式。这些短 RNA 接合并稳定 TDP-43 RNA 识别基序，从而以变构方式破坏朊病毒样结构域中保守螺旋区域的稳定性，从而促进抗聚集构象异构体。序列空间挖掘发现了针对 TDP-43 和疾病相关变体具有增强活性的短 RNA 伴侣。增强的短 RNA 伴侣可减轻光遗传学模型以及 ALS 患者来源和控制运动神经元中的异常 TDP-43 表型。在细胞质 TDP-43 聚集和运动神经元丢失的小鼠中，增强的短 RNA 伴侣减少了病理性聚集，恢复了 TDP-43 功能，并赋予神经保护作用。这些结果为基于 RNA 的对抗 TDP-43 蛋白病的策略定义了机制和治疗框架。

articles.title: A chromatin-associated pool of Aurora A controls kinetochore-microtubule attachments to ensure chromosome biorientation.
articles.titleZh: Aurora A 染色质相关池控制着丝粒-微管附着，以确保染色体生物取向。
articles.authors: Meaders JL, Rodriguez AA, Variyar S, Park S, Cirulli AE, Oegema K, Corbett KD, Desai A.
articles.abstract: Accurate chromosome segregation requires dynamic kinetochore-microtubule attachments that, under the regulation of Aurora family kinases, biorient and align replicated chromosomes. In Caenorhabditis elegans, Aurora A acts with the TPX2-related activator TPXL-1 to regulate these attachments and control spindle length. We show that, in addition to prominent spindle pole localization, TPXL-1-AurA has a chromatin-associated pool positioned between the sister kinetochores. Structural modeling and biochemical analysis support TPXL-1 directly recognizing the nucleosome acidic patch via an arginine anchor. Disrupting this interaction selectively removed chromatin-bound TPXL-1-AurA and caused chromosome missegregation, whereas elevation of the chromatin pool disrupted chromosome alignment. These opposing perturbations inversely affected kinetochore recruitment of the microtubule-binding Ska complex. These results support spatially distinct TPXL-1-AurA populations acting sequentially, with the spindle pole pool controlling spindle length by switching kinetochores out of a depolymerization-coupled state, and the chromatin pool controlling attachment stabilization to ensure biorientation prior to anaphase.
articles.abstractZh: 准确的染色体分离需要动态的动粒-微管附着，在极光家族激酶的调节下，对复制的染色体进行生物定向和对齐。在秀丽隐杆线虫中，Aurora A 与 TPX2 相关激活剂 TPXL-1 一起作用，调节这些附着物并控制纺锤体长度。我们发现，除了显着的纺锤体极定位之外，TPXL-1-AurA 还具有位于姐妹着丝粒之间的染色质相关池。结构建模和生化分析支持 TPXL-1 通过精氨酸锚直接识别核小体酸性斑块。破坏这种相互作用会选择性地去除染色质结合的 TPXL-1-AurA 并导致染色体错误分离，而染色质库的升高会破坏染色体排列。这些相反的扰动反向影响微管结合 Ska 复合体的动粒募集。这些结果支持空间上不同的 TPXL-1-AurA 群体按顺序作用，纺锤体极池通过将动粒切换出解聚耦合状态来控制纺锤体长度，染色质池控制附着稳定性以确保先于生物取向。

articles.title: A redox-sensitive phosphatase regulates glycolysis as a metabolic switch in the bacterial inner membrane.
articles.titleZh: 氧化还原敏感的磷酸酶将糖酵解调节为细菌内膜中的代谢开关。
articles.authors: Zheng L, Niu W, Xie X, Vu T, Du G.
articles.abstract: Microorganisms rapidly adjust their metabolism to survive fluctuating environmental conditions, but how they coordinate glycolytic control with redox signals remains unclear. We found that the membrane phosphatase PgpA acts as a redox-sensitive switch to regulate glycolytic flux in Escherichia coli. PgpA dephosphorylates key glycolytic intermediates, glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate and glycerol-3-phosphate, to modulate central metabolism. This activity is controlled by a reversible disulfide bond that forms an inactive dimer under oxidative stress and restores activity when reduced. This redox-dependent regulation enables E. coli to fine-tune metabolism in response to changes in nutrients and oxygen availability. PgpA inactivation increases glucose uptake and promotes metabolism, while constitutive activation impairs growth under anaerobic conditions. We also found that PgpA influences redox homeostasis by regulating glutathione biosynthesis. These findings reveal a negative feedback mechanism in which PgpA integrates glycolysis with redox balance, serving as a central regulator of bacterial metabolic homeostasis in response to environmental changes.
articles.abstractZh: 微生物快速调整其新陈代谢以在波动的环境条件下生存，但它们如何协调糖酵解控制与氧化还原信号仍不清楚。我们发现膜磷酸酶 PgpA 作为氧化还原敏感开关来调节大肠杆菌中的糖酵解通量。 PgpA 使关键的糖酵解中间体、3-磷酸甘油醛和 3-磷酸甘油去磷酸化，以调节中枢代谢。这种活性由可逆的二硫键控制，二硫键在氧化应激下形成无活性的二聚体，并在还原时恢复活性。这种氧化还原依赖性调节使大肠杆菌能够微调新陈代谢，以响应营养物质和氧气可用性的变化。 PgpA 失活会增加葡萄糖摄取并促进新陈代谢，而组成型激活会损害厌氧条件下的生长。我们还发现 PgpA 通过调节谷胱甘肽生物合成来影响氧化还原稳态。这些发现揭示了一种负反馈机制，其中 PgpA 将糖酵解与氧化还原平衡结合起来，作为细菌代谢稳态的中心调节因子来响应环境变化。

articles.title: RNA-triggered cell killing with CRISPR-Cas12a2.
articles.titleZh: 使用 CRISPR-Cas12a2 RNA 触发细胞杀伤。
articles.authors: Scholz P, Thompson J, Crosby KT, Fauth T, Krah NM, Schlauderaff G, Back R, Berkheimer ZA, Jolley A, Sombroek D, Medert R, Zurek C, Dmytrenko O, Wilson E, Schut FT, Rutter J, Zhang X, Krohn M, Jackson RN, Beisel CL, Liu Y.
articles.abstract: Selectively eradicating target cells on the basis of their genetic or transcriptional identity remains important in basic research, medicine, biotechnology and agriculture1-3. For applications involving bacteria, CRISPR nucleases offer promising options due to their ability to enact RNA-guided counterselection4-7; however, using these same nucleases for counterselection in eukaryotes has proven much more restrictive8-14. Here we show that Cas12a2, a recently discovered type V CRISPR nuclease, exhibits RNA-triggered DNA shredding15,16, and enables programmable and sequence-specific elimination of yeast and human cells expressing a target transcript. Triggering Cas12a2 elicits rampant double-stranded DNA breaks in trans, leading to cell death. Cell killing can be activated by a wide range of target transcripts, with no observed off-target activation. Leveraging this approach, we selectively eliminate cells that harbour human papillomavirus, cells that failed to undergo gene editing, or cells that encode a prevalent oncogenic point mutation in KRAS. These findings expand the CRISPR toolbox to allow the selective elimination of eukaryotic cells on the basis of their transcriptional profile.
articles.abstractZh: 根据靶细胞的遗传或转录特性选择性根除靶细胞在基础研究、医学、生物技术和农业中仍然很重要1-3。对于涉及细菌的应用，CRISPR 核酸酶提供了有前景的选择，因为它们能够进行 RNA 引导的反选择4-7；然而，事实证明，在真核生物中使用这些相同的核酸酶进行反选择具有更大的限制性8-14。在这里，我们展示了 Cas12a2，一种最近发现的 V 型 CRISPR 核酸酶，表现出 RNA 触发的 DNA 粉碎15,16，并能够以可编程和序列特异性消除表达目标转录物的酵母和人类细胞。触发 Cas12a2 会引起双链 DNA 反式断裂，导致细胞死亡。细胞杀伤可以由多种靶转录物激活，没有观察到脱靶激活。利用这种方法，我们选择性地消除携带人乳头瘤病毒的细胞、未能进行基因编辑的细胞或编码 KRAS 中常见致癌点突变的细胞。这些发现扩展了 CRISPR 工具箱，允许根据真核细胞的转录原选择性消除它们

articles.title: SnRK2.6 phosphorylates sucrose transporter ZmSUT1 to enhance yield by modulating leaf senescence in maize.
articles.titleZh: SnRK2.6 磷酸化蔗糖转运蛋白 ZmSUT1，通过调节玉米叶片衰老来提高产量。
articles.authors: Yang T, Huang Y, Wu Z, Long Z, Zhu H, Wang S, Tang L, Li R, Liang Z, Zhang H, Huang Y, Li X, Lu X, Wu Y.
articles.abstract: The extended stay-green trait is beneficial to increase photosynthetic efficiency, thereby enhancing crop yield. However, factors and mechanisms affecting this process remain largely unknown. Here, we cloned a leaf precocious senescence gene (lps1-1) and created additional null alleles. All lps1 mutants exhibited accelerated leaf senescence with reduced chlorophyll contents and photosynthetic efficiency. The 100-kernel weight and storage reserve content were decreased in lps1 kernels, while the opposite was observed in overexpression lines. Lps1 encoded a protein kinase SnRK2.6 that phosphorylated the sucrose transporter ZmSUT1 in the BETL region, thereby enhancing protein stability, homodimer formation ability, and sucrose transport activity. Overexpression of ZmSUT1 delayed leaf senescence and enhanced photosynthetic capacity and kernel weight, while mutation of ZmSUT1 did the opposite. This mechanism appears to be conserved in grasses. Our findings provide insights for yield and quality improvement in crops through delaying leaf senescence.
articles.abstractZh: 延长的保绿性状有利于提高光合效率，从而提高作物产量。然而，影响这一过程的因素和机制仍然很大程度上未知。在这里，我们克隆了叶片早衰基因 (lps1-1) 并创建了额外的无效等位基因。所有lps1突变体均表现出叶片加速衰老，叶绿素含量和光合效率降低。 lps1 籽粒的百粒重和贮藏储备含量降低，而过表达品系中观察到相反的情况。 Lps1编码蛋白激酶SnRK2.6，磷酸化BETL区域的蔗糖转运蛋白ZmSUT1，从而增强蛋白质稳定性、同源二聚体形成能力和蔗糖转运活性。 ZmSUT1 的过表达延迟了叶片衰老并增强了光合能力和籽粒重量，而 ZmSUT1 的突变则起到相反的作用。这种机制似乎在草类中是保守的。我们的研究结果为通过延缓叶片衰老来提高作物产量和质量提供了见解。

articles.title: A <i>Caenorhabditis elegans</i> spatiotemporal proximity atlas reveals the MAPK p38 as a generator of phenotypic plasticity in vivo.
articles.titleZh: 秀丽隐杆线虫时空邻近图谱揭示了 MAPK p38 作为体内表型可塑性的发生器。
articles.authors: Yuan W, Nunamaker LA, Weaver YM, Weaver BP.
articles.abstract: Phenotypic plasticity, the ability to change diverse traits without altering genomic information, is fundamental for organismal adaptations to changing environments. The mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) pathway plays a key role in cellular adaptations to changing environments. To analyze the contributions of the MAPK p38 and its interaction partners to phenotypic plasticity in an animal, we established an in vivo proximity labeling proteomics method called ContinuumID. With this method, we built an atlas of PMK-1 physical interactors during development, in specific tissues, and during exposure to osmotic, ultraviolet, or oxidative stressors. We identified multiple stable and dynamic developmental stage-, tissue-, and stress-specific PMK-1 interactors. Phenotypic analyses of animals in which specific interactors were knocked down revealed considerable variability of diverse PMK-1-dependent outputs. These included target gene expression, survival under stress, lysosomal homeostasis during development, and neuronal integrity during aging. PMK-1 interactors exerted positive, negative, and neutral contributions to these outputs within and across functional pathways. Comparing developmental and stress-induced activation of PMK-1 and the regulatory functions of its interactors revealed that PMK-1 integrates the regulation of highly conserved protein synthesis and RNA processing pathways with that of rapidly changing signaling and metabolic adaptations to confer distinct survival advantages or disadvantages during stress.
articles.abstractZh: 表型可塑性是在不改变基因组信息的情况下改变不同性状的能力，是生物体适应不断变化的环境的基础。丝裂原激活蛋白激酶 (MAPK) 通路在细胞适应不断变化的环境中发挥着关键作用。为了分析 MAPK p38 及其相互作用伙伴对动物表型可塑性的贡献，我们建立了一种称为 ContinuumID 的体内邻近标记蛋白质组学方法。通过这种方法，我们构建了发育过程中、特定组织中以及暴露于渗透、紫外线或氧化应激源期间的 PMK-1 物理相互作用物图谱。我们确定了多个稳定和动态的发育阶段、组织和应激特异性 PMK-1 相互作用因子。对特定相互作用因子被敲除的动物的表型分析揭示了不同 PMK-1 依赖性输出的相当大的变异性。这些包括靶基因表达、应激下的生存、发育过程中的溶酶体稳态以及衰老过程中的神经元完整性。 PMK-1 相互作用因子对功能途径内和跨功能途径的这些输出产生积极、消极和中性的贡献。比较开发

articles.title: A bacterial-derived quorum-sensing platform enables dynamic metabolic control in yeast.
articles.titleZh: 细菌衍生的群体感应平台能够实现酵母的动态代谢控制。
articles.authors: Zhai H, Liu X, Guo P, Guo Y, Yang X, Qi Q, Nielsen J, Liu Z, Chen Y, Hou J.
articles.abstract: Dynamic regulation of metabolic pathways is critical for optimizing microbial production, yet robust quorum-sensing (QS) systems remain largely unavailable in eukaryotic microorganisms. Here, we establish a bacterial-derived QS platform in Saccharomyces cerevisiae by repurposing the noncanonical RpaI/RpaR system (a LuxI/R-type QS system), which produces p-coumaroyl-homoserine lactone as a signal molecule, bypassing a fundamental metabolic barrier that has prevented functional bacterial QS in eukaryotes. The engineered circuit features low leakage, high sensitivity, and broad dynamic range. By coupling QS with signal amplification and clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR) interference modules, we create a bifunctional cascade system enabling autonomous transcriptional activation and repression. This QS platform enables growth-production decoupling and improves the production of cordycepin, geraniol, and 3-hydroxypropionic acid in both baseline and high-producing strains. Our work establishes a functional bacterial QS system in yeast and expands the synthetic biology toolkit for eukaryotic hosts.
articles.abstractZh: 代谢途径的动态调节对于优化微生物生产至关重要，但真核微生物中仍然基本上不具备强大的群体感应（QS）系统。在这里，我们通过重新利用非经典的 RpaI/RpaR 系统（LuxI/R 型 QS 系统），在酿酒酵母中建立了一个细菌衍生的 QS 平台，该系统产生对香豆酰高丝氨酸内酯作为信号分子，绕过了阻碍真核生物中功能性细菌 QS 的基本代谢屏障。该设计电路具有低泄漏、高灵敏度和宽动态范围的特点。通过将 QS 与信号放大和成簇规则间隔短回文重复 (CRISPR) 干扰模块耦合，我们创建了一个双功能级联系统，可实现自主转录激活和抑制。该 QS 平台能够实现生长与生产脱钩，并提高基线菌株和高产菌株中虫草素、香叶醇和 3-羟基丙酸的产量。我们的工作在酵母中建立了功能性细菌 QS 系统，并扩展了真核宿主的合成生物学工具包。

articles.title: Global mitochondrial connectivity map reveals the landscape of yeast functional assemblies and conserved protein communities.
articles.titleZh: 全球线粒体连接图揭示了酵母功能组装和保守蛋白质群落的概况。
articles.authors: Jessulat M, Phanse S, Aoki H, Broderick K, Zhang Q, Castro IG, Novales NA, Hossain SA, Saccon T, Moutaoufik MT, Joseph TP, Amin S, Hoell L, Minic Z, Bykov Y, Preminger N, Crespo SG, Snider J, Golshani A, Stagljar I, Rodriguez-Medina JR, Clarke CF, Schuldiner M, Babu M.
articles.abstract: Mitochondria are essential organelles whose functions depend on coordinated multiprotein complexes, yet their composition and organization remain incomplete. Here, we present a large-scale map of mitochondrial protein complexes by integrating affinity purification of 740 endogenously GFP-tagged mitochondrial proteins with biochemical co-fractionation of mitochondrial extracts from yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae) grown under respiratory conditions. Mass spectrometry identifies 13,716 high-confidence protein associations and defines 556 heteromeric complexes, many previously unknown. These assemblies reveal factors involved in coenzyme Q6 biosynthesis, membrane contact sites, phospholipid transport, and coordination with the MICOS complex during respiration. We further link 538 assemblies to 294 candidate human disease genes and construct a conservation map of 852,146 predicted mitochondrial interactions across 271 genomes, and validate key predictions in human cell lines and mouse brain tissue. Together, this work provides a comprehensive mitochondrial interactome, assigning functions to poorly characterized proteins, and offering insights into mitochondrial biology and disease-associated assemblies.
articles.abstractZh: 线粒体是重要的细胞器，其功能依赖于协调的多蛋白复合物，但它们的组成和组织仍然不完整。在这里，我们通过将 740 种内源 GFP 标记的线粒体蛋白的亲和纯化与呼吸条件下生长的酵母（酿酒酵母）线粒体提取物的生化共分级相结合，展示了线粒体蛋白复合物的大规模图谱。质谱法鉴定了 13,716 个高置信度蛋白质关联，并定义了 556 个异聚复合物，其中许多是以前未知的。这些组装揭示了参与辅酶 Q6 生物合成、膜接触位点、磷脂转运以及呼吸过程中与 MICOS 复合体协调的因素。我们进一步将 538 个组件与 294 个候选人类疾病基因联系起来，并构建了 271 个基因组中 852,146 个预测线粒体相互作用的保守图谱，并验证了人类细胞系和小鼠脑组织中的关键预测。总之，这项工作提供了一个全面的线粒体相互作用组，为特征不明的蛋白质分配功能，并提供对线粒体生物学和疾病的见解

articles.title: Resilience of recombinant antibiotic resistance gene-containing plasmids against common cell culture disposal methods.
articles.titleZh: 含有重组抗生素抗性基因的质粒对常见细胞培养处理方法的抵抗力。
articles.authors: Gluth A, Zmasek C, Chiu S, Moon TS.
articles.abstract: Antibiotics have saved an untold number of people and animals since penicillin's miraculous discovery in 1928. In the following half-century, progressive discoveries involving antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs), the microorganisms responsible, and their transferrable genetic material have yielded the tools necessary for genetic engineering, birthing the biotechnologies that continue to revolutionize healthcare. After half a century of antibiotic use in the biological sciences, we are, however, faced with an inconvenient question: what happens to residual antibiotics and ARG-containing recombinant DNA after experiments? According to sequencing, we demonstrate that neither severe bleach treatments nor autoclaving completely destroys plasmid-encoded ARGs in bacterial cultures. Furthermore, we show that various bacteria can be transformed using the isolated DNA, confirming that intact plasmids survived these common cell culture disposal methods. This work will catalyze future policy discussions, the development of antibiotic-free selection systems, and continued support for research into the underexplored anthropogenic sources of engineered DNA.
articles.abstractZh: 自 1928 年奇迹般地发现青霉素以来，抗生素拯救了无数人和动物。在接下来的半个世纪中，抗生素抗性基因 (ARG)、相关微生物及其可转移遗传物质的不断发现，为基因工程提供了必要的工具，催生了持续革新医疗保健的生物技术。然而，在生物科学中使用抗生素半个世纪之后，我们面临着一个棘手的问题：实验后残留的抗生素和含有 ARG 的重组 DNA 会怎样？根据测序，我们证明严格的漂白处理或高压灭菌都不能完全破坏细菌培养物中质粒编码的 ARG。此外，我们表明可以使用分离的 DNA 转化各种细菌，证实完整的质粒在这些常见的细胞培养处理方法中存活下来。这项工作将促进未来的政策讨论、无抗生素选择系统的开发，并继续支持对未充分开发的工程 DNA 人为来源的研究。

articles.title: Emergence of specific binding and catalysis from a designed generalist binding protein.
articles.titleZh: 设计的多面性结合蛋白出现特异性结合和催化作用。
articles.authors: Chen Y, Bhattacharya S, Bergmann L, Correy GJ, Tan SK, Hou K, Biel JT, Lu L, Bakanas I, Gestwicki JE, Volkov AN, Korendovych IV, Polizzi NF, Fraser JS, DeGrado WF.
articles.abstract: Binding and catalysis play central roles in living systems. While natural proteins have finely tuned affinities for their primary ligands, they also bind weakly and promiscuously to other molecules, which serve as starting points for the incremental evolution of different specificities. Thus, modern proteins have emerged from the joint exploration of sequence and structural space. Interactions between natural proteins and small molecules can be systematically profiled by crystallographic fragment screening in defined geometries, yet this approach has not been applied to highly designable de novo proteins. Here we apply this method to explore the binding specificity of a de novo small-molecule-binding protein, apixaban-binding helical bundle. As in nature, we found that it formed weak complexes, which were excellent starting points for the design of entirely distinct functions, including a turn-on fluorophore binder and a highly efficient Kemp eliminase with a catalytic efficiency of 3,200,000 M-1 s-1, approaching the diffusion limit. This work illustrates how simultaneous consideration of sequence and chemical structure diversity can guide the emergence of different functions in designed proteins.
articles.abstractZh: 结合和催化在生命系统中发挥着核心作用。虽然天然蛋白质对其主要配体具有微调的亲和力，但它们也与其他分子微弱且混杂地结合，这些分子作为不同特异性渐进进化的起点。因此，现代蛋白质是从序列和结构空间的共同探索中出现的。天然蛋白质和小分子之间的相互作用可以通过在定义的几何形状中进行晶体片段筛选来系统地分析，但这种方法尚未应用于高度可设计的从头蛋白质。在这里，我们应用这种方法来探索从头开始的小分子结合蛋白阿哌沙班结合螺旋束的结合特异性。正如在自然界中一样，我们发现它形成了弱复合物，这是设计完全不同功能的绝佳起点，包括开启荧光团结合剂和催化效率为 3,200,000 M-1 s-1 的高效 Kemp 消除酶，接近扩散极限。这项工作说明了同时考虑序列和化学结构多样性如何指导不同功能的出现

articles.title: Development of a bioassay-guided genome mining approach for antifungal natural product discovery from pseudomonads.
articles.titleZh: 开发生物测定引导的基因组挖掘方法，用于从假单胞菌中发现抗真菌天然产物。
articles.authors: Lund G, Mosquito S, Withall DM, Caulfield J, Hughes D, Clark IM, Rudd J, Mauchline TH.
articles.abstract: Zymoseptoria tritici causes Septoria Leaf Blotch disease of wheat and has evolved to overcome most chemical and genetic control methods. As such, new tools are required for future disease control. We identified Pseudomonas isolates that antagonise Z. tritici through the production of secreted secondary metabolites, using a novel in vitro antagonism assay. Quantitative assessment identified variation in sensitivity of Z. tritici isolates to antagonism by Pseudomonas isolates. Genome assemblies of 3 strongly antagonistic Pseudomonas isolates contain a predicted Biosynthetic Gene Cluster (BGC) with high similarity to a reference BGC encoding the biosynthesis of known antifungal compound 2,4-diacetylphloroglucinol (2,4-DAPG). Mutagenesis of the core biosynthetic gene phlD resulted in loss of 2,4-DAPG production in Pseudomonas isolate Roth82, and loss of Z. tritici inhibition in vitro. These results demonstrate that our in vitro antagonism assay can be used to identify, quantify, and mechanistically characterise bacterial antagonism of Z. tritici through the production of secondary metabolites. This is the first study to putatively identify that resistance to bacterial antagonism exists as a quantitative trait within natural Z. tritici populations. Our approach of in vitro phenotype-guided genome mining can also prioritise candidate BGCs for discovery of antifungal natural products effective against Z. tritici.
articles.abstractZh: 小麦发酵腐霉引起小麦叶斑病，并且已经进化到克服了大多数化学和遗传控制方法。因此，未来的疾病控制需要新的工具。我们使用一种新颖的体外拮抗测定，鉴定了通过产生分泌的次生代谢产物来拮抗小麦小麦的假单胞菌分离株。定量评估确定了小麦小麦分离株对假单胞菌分离株拮抗作用的敏感性变化。 3 个强拮抗性假单胞菌分离株的基因组组件包含预测的生物合成基因簇 (BGC)，与编码已知抗真菌化合物 2,4-二乙酰间苯三酚 (2,4-DAPG) 生物合成的参考 BGC 高度相似。核心生物合成基因 phlD 的诱变导致假单胞菌 Roth82 中 2,4-DAPG 产量的丧失，以及对小麦小麦的体外抑制作用的丧失。这些结果表明，我们的体外拮抗测定可用于通过次级代谢产物的产生来识别、量化和机械表征小麦 Z. tritici 的细菌拮抗作用。这是第一项推定确定细菌拮抗作用存在的研究

articles.title: Bridging continuous and discrete evolution through a controllable, hypermutagenic phage-bacteria system.
articles.titleZh: 通过可控的高诱变噬菌体细菌系统桥接连续和离散进化。
articles.authors: Ong S, Ghode P, Narenderan A, Lao S, Willenborg F, Eden TV, Marsh CO, Yew WS, Fredens J.
articles.abstract: Directed evolution methods face trade-offs between the control of discrete approaches and the throughput of modern continuous systems. Here, we engineered a method called lytic selection and evolution (LySE) for near-continuous evolution of bacterial gene clusters while maintaining discrete checkpoints. We developed a hypermutagenic T7 DNA polymerase variant fused to a dual adenine-cytosine deaminase to install all possible transition mutations at similar frequencies. By relieving pressure from maintaining genome fidelity, we obtained mutation rates of 3.82 × 10-5 substitutions per base. For biocontainment, the T7 DNA polymerase was encoded on an accessory plasmid, while the target gene cluster was encoded on a T7 DNA polymerase-lacking T7 phagemid. Alternating cycles of lysis and transduction enable selective replication and mutagenesis of target genes, while off-target genomic mutations are discarded. LySE evolved a 25-fold increase in tetA-encoded tigecycline resistance in 5 cycles, and a 50.9% increase in endpoint biomass of a bacterial strain that uses the polyethylene terephthalate monomer, ethylene glycol, as its sole carbon source. Our method balances speed and control for directed bacterial evolution.
articles.abstractZh: 定向进化方法面临着离散方法的控制和现代连续系统的吞吐量之间的权衡。在这里，我们设计了一种称为裂解选择和进化（LySE）的方法，用于细菌基因簇的近乎连续进化，同时保持离散的检查点。我们开发了一种与双腺嘌呤-胞嘧啶脱氨酶融合的超诱变 T7 DNA 聚合酶变体，以相似的频率安装所有可能的过渡突变。通过减轻维持基因组保真度的压力，我们获得了每个碱基 3.82 × 10-5 替换的突变率。为了实现生物防护，T7 DNA 聚合酶在辅助质粒上编码，而靶基因簇在缺乏 T7 DNA 聚合酶的 T7 噬菌粒上编码。裂解和转导的交替循环能够实现靶基因的选择性复制和诱变，同时丢弃脱靶基因组突变。 LySE 在 5 个循环中使 tetA 编码的替加环素耐药性增加了 25 倍，并且使用聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯单体乙二醇作为其唯一碳源的细菌菌株的终点生物量增加了 50.9%。我们的方法平衡了速度和控制

articles.title: Genetic variation reveals a homeotic long noncoding RNA that modulates human hematopoietic stem cells.
articles.titleZh: 遗传变异揭示了调节人类造血干细胞的同源长非编码RNA。
articles.authors: Lyu P, Agarwal G, Guo CJ, Sychla A, Bourgeois W, Ye T, Weng C, Antoszewski M, Joubran S, Caulier A, Poeschla M, Armstrong SA, Rouskin S, Sankaran VG.
articles.abstract: The HOXA gene locus coordinates body patterning, hematopoiesis, and differentiation. While studying blood phenotype-associated variation within the HOXA locus, we identified a genetic variant, rs17437411, associated with globally reduced blood counts, protection from blood cancers, and variation in anthropometric phenotypes. We found that this variant disrupts the activity of a previously unstudied antisense long non-coding RNA (lncRNA) located between HOXA7 and HOXA9, which we named HOXA opposite-strand transcript, stem-cell regulator, antisense mid-cluster between loci (HOTSCRAMBL). The HOTSCRAMBL variant disrupts lncRNA function and reduces human hematopoietic stem cell (HSC) self-renewal. Mechanistically, HOTSCRAMBL enables appropriate expression and splicing of HOXA genes in HSCs, most notably HOXA9, in an SRSF2-dependent manner. Given the critical role of HOXA gene expression in some blood cancers, we also demonstrate that HOTSCRAMBL variation or deletion compromises HOXA-dependent acute myeloid leukemias. Collectively, we show how insights from human genetic variation can uncover critical regulatory processes required for effective developmental gene expression.
articles.abstractZh: HOXA 基因位点协调身体模式、造血和分化。在研究 HOXA 基因座内与血液表型相关的变异时，我们发现了一种遗传变异 rs17437411，它与整体血细胞计数减少、预防血癌和人体测量表型变异相关。我们发现这种变异破坏了之前未研究过的位于 HOXA7 和 HOXA9 之间的反义长非编码 RNA (lncRNA) 的活性，我们将其命名为 HOXA 相反链转录本、干细胞调节因子、基因座间反义中间簇 (HOTSCRAMBL)。 HOTSCRAMBL 变异会破坏 lncRNA 功能并减少人类造血干细胞 (HSC) 的自我更新。从机制上讲，HOTSCRAMBL 能够以 SRSF2 依赖性方式在 HSC 中适当表达和剪接 HOXA 基因，尤其是 HOXA9。鉴于 HOXA 基因表达在某些血癌中的关键作用，我们还证明 HOTSCRAMBL 变异或缺失会损害 HOXA 依赖性急性髓系白血病。总的来说，我们展示了人类遗传变异的见解如何揭示有效发育基因表达所需的关键调控过程。

articles.title: LIPT1 loss confers replication stress and PARP inhibitor sensitivity through PrimPol-mediated ssDNA gaps.
articles.titleZh: LIPT1 缺失通过 PrimPol 介导的 ssDNA 间隙赋予复制应激和 PARP 抑制剂敏感性。
articles.authors: Shang Z, Chiang JC, Hsu CC, Newman C, Davis AJ, Zhang Y.
articles.abstract: Replication stress (RS) and altered metabolism are two hallmarks of cancer, yet how metabolic perturbations contribute to RS remains poorly understood. Lipotransferase 1 (LIPT1) catalyzes the covalent attachment of lipoic acid to mitochondrial 2-ketoacid dehydrogenases, sustaining flux through the tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle. Loss of LIPT1 causes accumulation of 2-hydroxyglutarate (2-HG), which is known to inhibit α-ketoglutarate (α-KG)-dependent histone demethylases and promotes heterochromatin formation. Here, we show that 2-HG-driven heterochromatin impedes replication fork progression, causing fork stalling and RS in LIPT1-deficient cancer cells. To bypass stalled forks, PrimPol-mediated repriming resumes DNA synthesis but leaves behind single-stranded DNA (ssDNA), which requires poly(adenosine 5'-diphosphate-ribose) polymerase 1 (PARP1) for repair. Furthermore, nascent DNA at reprimed forks undergoes MRE11-dependent degradation, further destabilizing replication fork integrity. Consequently, LIPT1 deficiency promotes replication and genome instability, and therapeutic vulnerability to PARP inhibitor. Together, these findings reveal a mechanistic link between mitochondrial lipoylation and replication fork stability, uncovering a metabolic basis for genome instability in cancer.
articles.abstractZh: 复制应激 (RS) 和代谢改变是癌症的两个标志，但代谢扰动如何导致 RS 仍知之甚少。脂转移酶 1 (LIPT1) 催化硫辛酸与线粒体 2-酮酸脱氢酶共价连接，维持三羧酸 (TCA) 循环的通量。 LIPT1 的缺失会导致 2-羟基戊二酸 (2-HG) 的积累，已知它会抑制 α-酮戊二酸 (α-KG) 依赖性组蛋白去甲基酶并促进异染色质形成。在这里，我们发现 2-HG 驱动的异染色质阻碍复制叉进展，导致 LIPT1 缺陷的癌细胞中复制叉停滞和 RS。为了绕过停滞的分叉，PrimPol 介导的重新引发恢复 DNA 合成，但留下单链 DNA (ssDNA)，需要聚（腺苷 5'-二磷酸核糖）聚合酶 1 (PARP1) 进行修复。此外，重新引发的叉处的新生 DNA 会经历 MRE11 依赖性降解，进一步破坏复制叉完整性的稳定性。因此，LIPT1 缺陷会促进复制和基因组不稳定，以及 PARP 抑制剂的治疗脆弱性。总之，这些发现揭示了线粒体 l 之间的机制联系。

articles.title: An anaerobic pathogen rewires host metabolism to fuel oxidative growth in the inflamed gut.
articles.titleZh: 厌氧病原体会重新连接宿主的新陈代谢，以促进发炎肠道的氧化生长。
articles.authors: Spiga L, Fansler RT, Wu Y, Grote A, Langford-Butler M, Miller AK, Neal M, Hale OF, Singla D, Calcutt MW, Rose AE, Bresson MM, Schrimpe-Rutledge AC, Berdy B, Codreanu SG, Washington MK, Bratton BP, Sherrod SD, McLean JA, Zengler K, Sears CL, Behringer MG, Gnirke A, Tao L, Livny J, Olivares-Villagómez D, Earl AM, Zhu W.
articles.abstract: To colonize their host and cause disease, enteric pathogens must deploy their virulence factors to establish distinct nutrient niches. How anaerobic pathogens construct nutrient niches in the densely populated large intestine remains poorly understood. Enterotoxigenic Bacteroides fragilis (ETBF) is a classically anaerobic bacterium implicated in inflammation-associated diseases, including colitis and colorectal cancer. Here, we show that ETBF uses its virulence factor, Bacteroides fragilis toxin (BFT), to generate and adapt to a localized oxidative niche that supports gut colonization. BFT manipulates colonic epithelial signaling and the bile acid recycling pathway, inducing a metabolic shift in the epithelium from oxidative phosphorylation to glycolysis. This shift increases local concentrations of lactate and oxygen, nutrients that support oxidative metabolism in ETBF. These findings reveal an unexpected strategy by which a classically anaerobic pathogen leverages host metabolic remodeling to generate and exploit an oxidative niche in the inflamed gut.
articles.abstractZh: 为了定植宿主并引起疾病，肠道病原体必须利用其毒力因子来建立独特的营养生态位。厌氧病原体如何在人口密集的大肠中构建营养生态位仍然知之甚少。产肠毒素脆弱拟杆菌 (ETBF) 是一种典型的厌氧细菌，与炎症相关疾病有关，包括结肠炎和结直肠癌。在这里，我们证明 ETBF 使用其毒力因子脆弱拟杆菌毒素 (BFT) 来生成并适应支持肠道定植的局部氧化生态位。 BFT 操纵结肠上皮信号传导和胆汁酸回收途径，诱导上皮细胞从氧化磷酸化到糖酵解的代谢转变。这种转变增加了乳酸和氧气的局部浓度，这些营养物质支持 ETBF 中的氧化代谢。这些发现揭示了一种意想不到的策略，经典厌氧病原体利用宿主代谢重塑来产生和利用发炎肠道中的氧化生态位。

articles.title: Live-cell imaging of endogenous Egr1 mRNA using an MPBS knock-in mouse model.
articles.titleZh: 使用 MPBS 敲入小鼠模型对内源 Egr1 mRNA 进行活细胞成像。
articles.authors: Ahn H, Jeong H, Kim DW, Shim JY, Park HY.
articles.abstract: Real-time imaging of endogenous mRNA is essential for understanding the dynamics of gene regulation, yet appropriate animal models have been limited. We developed an Egr1-MPBS knock-in mouse line in which all endogenous Egr1 transcripts are tagged with 12 tandem MS2 and PP7 binding site (MPBS) pairs, enabling direct visualization of single mRNA molecules under physiological conditions. To establish proof of principle, we derived mouse embryonic fibroblast (MEF) lines from this model and performed live-cell imaging of fluorescently labeled Egr1 transcripts. We found that the insertion of the MPBS cassette did not alter endogenous mRNA stability or expression dynamics. This system allowed us to observe Egr1 transcriptional bursting and quantitatively track individual mRNA molecules as they diffused within the nucleus and cytoplasm. By integrating technological innovation with mechanistic insight, the Egr1-MPBS mouse establishes a broadly applicable platform for quantitative studies of gene expression and RNA trafficking at single-molecule resolution in living systems.
articles.abstractZh: 内源 mRNA 的实时成像对于了解基因调控的动态至关重要，但合适的动物模型却很有限。我们开发了 Egr1-MPBS 敲入小鼠系，其中所有内源性 Egr1 转录本都标有 12 个串联 MS2 和 PP7 结合位点 (MPBS) 对，从而能够在生理条件下直接可视化单个 mRNA 分子。为了建立原理证明，我们从该模型中衍生出小鼠胚胎成纤维细胞 (MEF) 系，并对荧光标记的 Egr1 转录本进行活细胞成像。我们发现 MPBS 盒的插入不会改变内源 mRNA 稳定性或表达动态。该系统使我们能够观察 Egr1 转录爆发并定量跟踪单个 mRNA 分子在细胞核和细胞质中的扩散。通过将技术创新与机制洞察相结合，Egr1-MPBS 小鼠建立了一个广泛适用的平台，用于在生命系统中以单分子分辨率定量研究基因表达和 RNA 运输。

articles.title: Streptomyces produce a diphtheria toxin-like exotoxin that targets insects.
articles.titleZh: 链霉菌产生一种针对昆虫的类似白喉毒素的外毒素。
articles.authors: Xu Y, Stubbendieck RM, Viswanatha R, Krč A, Baik LS, Suh WS, Hu Y, Wang H, Yin L, Mameli E, van der Meij A, Carlson JR, Doxey AC, Stenmark P, Perrimon N, Currie CR, Dong M.
articles.abstract: Streptomyces and insects engage in complex interactions shaped by millions of years of evolution. While many beneficial relationships are well recognized, it remains unknown whether Streptomyces produce virulence factors targeting insects specifically. Here, through bioinformatic analysis, we identified diphtheria toxin (DT) homologues, which we named Streptomyces antiquus insecticidal proteins (SAIP), within a monophyletic lineage of Streptomyces that emerged more than 100 million years ago. SAIP is cytotoxic to insect cells and lethal to Drosophila melanogaster, suppressing neuronal activity and immune responses in vivo. Structural and functional studies validated that SAIP is homologous to DT and acts by ADP ribosylation of eukaryotic elongation factor 2. CRISPR-Cas9 screening identified the insect protein Flower as the SAIP receptor across a range of insects. Toxigenic Streptomyces can consume dead insects and produce bioactive secondary metabolites while growing on insect carcasses. These findings establish an insecticidal toxin in Streptomyces and demonstrate that Streptomyces have evolved highly specific virulence factors against insects.
articles.abstractZh: 链霉菌和昆虫在数百万年的进化过程中发生着复杂的相互作用。虽然许多有益关系已得到广泛认可，但链霉菌是否产生专门针对昆虫的毒力因子仍不清楚。在这里，通过生物信息学分析，我们在一亿多年前出现的链霉菌单系谱系中鉴定出了白喉毒素 (DT) 同源物，我们将其命名为古链霉菌杀虫蛋白 (SAIP)。 SAIP 对昆虫细胞具有细胞毒性，对黑腹果蝇具有致命性，可抑制体内神经元活动和免疫反应。结构和功能研究证实 SAIP 与 DT 同源，并通过真核延伸因子 2 的 ADP 核糖基化发挥作用。CRISPR-Cas9 筛选鉴定出昆虫蛋白 Flower 是一系列昆虫的 SAIP 受体。产毒链霉菌可以消耗死去的昆虫并在昆虫尸体上生长时产生生物活性次生代谢产物。这些发现在链霉菌中建立了杀虫毒素，并证明链霉菌已进化出针对昆虫的高度特异性毒力因子。

articles.title: PARP4 ADP-ribosylates PIDD1 to complete a phospho/SUMO/PAR-ylation cascade that orchestrates PIDDosome assembly.
articles.titleZh: PARP4 ADP 核糖基化 PIDD1 以完成磷酸/SUMO/PAR 化级联，从而协调 PIDDosome 组装。
articles.authors: Shah RB, Li Y, Person A, Frigon L, Ðukić N, Kini E, Chen R, Pascal JM, Cohen MS, Ahel I, Haley JD, Sidi S.
articles.abstract: Adenosine diphosphate (ADP) ribosylation (ADPr) regulates multiple stress responses, yet substrates in the apoptotic machinery remain elusive. We show that a single, DNA damage-induced ADPr event controls proapoptotic PIDDosome (PIDD1/RAIDD/caspase-2) formation in response to unresolved interstrand DNA cross-links (ICL). ADPr targets conserved E783 in the PIDD1 death domain (DD); is catalyzed by poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase 4 (PARP4), a phylogenetically orphan PARP of previously unknown function; is reversed by the ribosylhydrolase activity of PARP14; and is triggered by Ataxia Telangiectasia and RAD3-related (ATR) phosphorylation-induced, PIAS1-mediated SUMOylation of the PIDD1 DD, which enables PARP4 docking. PIDD1 ADPr is dispensable for the recruitments of RAIDD and caspase-2 but essential for the dimerization of the caspase. Hence, denying E783 ADPr spares the onset of PIDDosome assembly but blocks its completion, thus eliminating caspase-2 activation and ensuing apoptosis. Conversely, removal of PARP14 forces apoptosis, even in cells with tolerable damage. The data identify PARP4 as an ICL response effector and illuminate a three-step modification sequence of the PIDD1 DD that conducts PIDDosome assembly from initiation to completion.
articles.abstractZh: 二磷酸腺苷 (ADP) 核糖基化 (ADPr) 调节多种应激反应，但细胞凋亡机制中的底物仍然难以捉摸。我们发现，单个 DNA 损伤诱导的 ADPr 事件可控制促凋亡 PIDDosome (PIDD1/RAIDD/caspase-2) 的形成，以响应未解决的链间 DNA 交联 (ICL)。 ADPr 靶向 PIDD1 死亡结构域 (DD) 中保守的 E783；由聚（ADP-核糖）聚合酶 4 (PARP4) 催化，这是一种以前未知功能的系统发育孤儿 PARP； PARP14 的核糖基水解酶活性可逆转；它是由共济失调毛细血管扩张和 RAD3 相关 (ATR) 磷酸化诱导的 PIAS1 介导的 PIDD1 DD SUMO 化触发，从而实现 PARP4 对接。 PIDD1 ADPr 对于 RAIDD 和 caspase-2 的募集是可有可无的，但对于 caspase 的二聚化至关重要。因此，拒绝 E783 ADPr 可以避免 PIDDosome 组装的开始，但阻止其完成，从而消除 caspase-2 激活并随后发生细胞凋亡。相反，去除 PARP14 会迫使细胞凋亡，即使是在损伤可耐受的细胞中也是如此。该数据将 PARP4 识别为 ICL 响应效应器，并阐明了 PIDD1 DD 的三步修改序列，

articles.title: Plant-associated fungi co-opt ancient antimicrobials for host manipulation.
articles.titleZh: 植物相关真菌利用古老的抗菌剂来操纵宿主。
articles.authors: Mesny F, Wolf V, López-Moral A, Kraege A, Punt W, Liu S, Zhu J, Park J, Sato Y, Thomma BPHJ.
articles.abstract: Evolutionary histories of effector proteins secreted by fungal pathogens to mediate plant colonization remain largely elusive. While most functionally characterized effectors modulate plant immunity, recent discoveries have revealed previously unknown functions in targeting host-associated microbiota. We now developed an antimicrobial activity predictor for effector candidates (AMAPEC) and identified a wealth of antimicrobial effectors, including many highly conserved ones-suggesting ancient evolutionary origins. Unexpectedly, several plant immunomodulatory effectors display antimicrobial activity. We propose that these evolved from ancestral antimicrobials while perhaps retaining their original functions. In addition to roles in suppressing host immunity, they may manipulate plant microbiota to promote colonization. We show that the Verticillium dahliae effector Vd424Y affects host microbiota during infection and, more recently, evolved to target plant cell nuclei to manipulate host immunity. Thus, we argue that microbial antagonism is a fundamental fungal effector function and suggest that fungi repurposed ancient antimicrobials to serve diverse roles during host-pathogen coevolution.
articles.abstractZh: 真菌病原体分泌的效应蛋白介导植物定植的进化历史在很大程度上仍然难以捉摸。虽然大多数功能特征效应器调节植物免疫力，但最近的发现揭示了以前未知的针对宿主相关微生物群的功能。我们现在开发了候选效应器的抗菌活性预测器（AMAPEC），并鉴定了大量的抗菌效应器，包括许多高度保守的效应器，这表明了古老的进化起源。出乎意料的是，几种植物免疫调节效应物表现出抗菌活性。我们认为它们是从祖先的抗菌药物进化而来的，同时可能保留其原始功能。除了抑制宿主免疫力之外，它们还可以操纵植物微生物群以促进定植。我们发现，大丽黄萎病效应子 Vd424Y 在感染过程中影响宿主微生物群，并且最近进化为靶向植物细胞核以操纵宿主免疫。因此，我们认为微生物拮抗作用是真菌的一种基本效应功能，并表明真菌重新利用了古老的抗菌药物，在宿主-病原体共进化过程中发挥不同的作用。

articles.title: PSGRN: Gene regulatory network inference from single-cell perturbational data through self-training with synthetic gold standards.
articles.titleZh: PSGRN：通过使用合成金标准进行自我训练，从单细胞扰动数据中推断基因调控网络。
articles.authors: Song X, Deng K, Chen M, Guan Y.
articles.abstract: Gene regulatory networks (GRNs) are essential for understanding how genes coordinate cellular processes. Large-scale single-cell perturbation studies now offer powerful opportunities for GRN inference, yet many state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods fail to fully use interventional information. We present PSGRN, a top-performing method in the CausalBench Challenge, which integrates interventional and observational single-cell RNA sequencing data using a self-training framework with synthetic gold standards. Across eight datasets and six evaluation metrics, PSGRN consistently outperformed existing approaches. With interventional data, it achieved up to 43% higher Wasserstein distances and the lowest false omission rate in K562 compared with recent SOTA methods. Using experimentally validated regulatory interactions, PSGRN showed up to 30% gains in precision and over 100% gains in recall. These results highlight PSGRN's versatility and scalability, establishing it as a robust tool for GRN inference and biological discovery from single-cell data.
articles.abstractZh: 基因调控网络 (GRN) 对于理解基因如何协调细胞过程至关重要。大规模单细胞扰动研究现在为 GRN 推断提供了强大的机会，但许多最先进的 (SOTA) 方法无法充分利用干预信息。我们展示了 PSGRN，这是 CausalBench 挑战赛中表现最好的方法，它使用具有合成金标准的自我训练框架集成了介入性和观察性单细胞 RNA 测序数据。在八个数据集和六个评估指标中，PSGRN 始终优于现有方法。通过介入数据，与最近的 SOTA 方法相比，它在 K562 中实现了高达 43% 的 Wasserstein 距离提高和最低的错误遗漏率。使用经过实验验证的监管相互作用，PSGRN 的精确度提高了 30%，召回率提高了 100% 以上。这些结果凸显了 PSGRN 的多功能性和可扩展性，使其成为 GRN 推理和单细胞数据生物发现的强大工具。

articles.title: The nuclear cap-binding complex safeguards stress-resistant protein synthesis and proliferation of stem cells.
articles.titleZh: 核帽结合复合物可保护干细胞的抗应激蛋白质合成和增殖。
articles.authors: Oh S, Chang J, Jo H, Yoon J, Jang SK, Kim YK, Jang J.
articles.abstract: The integrated stress response (ISR) suppresses global translation while allowing selective synthesis of key regulatory proteins. However, how translation persists during ISR remains unclear. In eukaryotes, the 5'-cap of mRNAs is bound by either the cap-binding complex (CBC) or eIF4E. We show that under stress, CBC-bound mRNAs recruit eIF2A, an alternative initiation factor, to sustain translation when eIF4E-dependent translation is inhibited. Human embryonic stem cells (hESCs), which inherently exhibit ISR, continue proliferating due to a compensatory increase in eIF2A. This increase ensures CBC-dependent translation (CT) of essential cell cycle regulators. Notably, yes-associated protein (YAP), a key proliferation factor, is a major CT target driving stress-resistant stem cell proliferation. Our findings reveal CT as a critical pathway that preserves protein synthesis and proliferation under stress.
articles.abstractZh: 整合应激反应（ISR）抑制全局翻译，同时允许关键调节蛋白的选择性合成。然而，翻译在情监侦期间如何持续仍不清楚。在真核生物中，mRNA 的 5'-帽通过帽结合复合物 (CBC) 或 eIF4E 结合。我们发现，在压力下，当 eIF4E 依赖性翻译受到抑制时，CBC 结合的 mRNA 会招募另一种起始因子 eIF2A 来维持翻译。人类胚胎干细胞 (hESC) 本质上表现出 ISR，由于 eIF2A 的代偿性增加而持续增殖。这种增加确保了重要细胞周期调节因子的 CBC 依赖性翻译 (CT)。值得注意的是，yes 相关蛋白 (YAP) 是一种关键的增殖因子，是驱动抗应激干细胞增殖的主要 CT 靶点。我们的研究结果表明 CT 是在压力下保持蛋白质合成和增殖的关键途径。

articles.title: Block-building with yeast to elucidate an artificial pathway for de novo biosynthesis of glabridin.
articles.titleZh: 用酵母构建模块以阐明光甘草定从头生物合成的人工途径。
articles.authors: Deng H, Cao L, Li S, Zhang C, Zeng W, Zhao X, Zhou J.
articles.abstract: Prenylated phytochemicals like glabridin are valuable therapeutics and cosmetics, yet their plant scarcity and arduous synthesis hinder industrial supply. Rebuilding pathways in microbes is hampered by complex topology and carbon-cofactor competition. In this work, we design an artificial biosynthetic route using a "block-building" workflow, constructing independently optimizable upstream precursor-supply and downstream tailoring/prenylation blocks. Structure-informed retrosynthesis eliminates methylation to lock flux toward the isoflavone core, while a tunable yeast-embedded dimethylallyl pyrophosphate platform enables crucial prenylation. Screening alternative pterocarpan reductase sources resolves the rate-limiting pentacyclic ring-opening step, achieving glabridin synthesis. Hybridization serves as the block glue, enabling the diploid Saccharomyces cerevisiae strain to produce 0.24 mg/L of glabridin from glucose, with bioreactor validation reaching 1.20 mg/L. Extending this to a yeast × Escherichia coli consortium delivers 32.8 mg/L equol, confirming framework generality. In this work, the strategy converts intricate phytochemical pathways into plug-and-play genetic modules, enabling rapid fermentation-based manufacturing without extensive genome rewriting.
articles.abstractZh: 像光甘草定这样的异戊二烯化植物化学物质是有价值的治疗剂和化妆品，但它们的植物稀缺性和艰巨的合成阻碍了工业供应。复杂的拓扑结构和碳辅因子竞争阻碍了微生物通路的重建。在这项工作中，我们使用“区块构建”工作流程设计了一条人工生物合成路线，构建了可独立优化的上游前体供应和下游剪裁/异戊二烯化区块。基于结构的逆合成消除了甲基化，以锁定异黄酮核心的通量，而可调节的酵母嵌入二甲基烯丙基焦磷酸平台可实现关键的异戊二烯化。筛选替代紫檀还原酶来源解决了限速五环开环步骤，实现了光甘草定的合成。杂交作为块胶，使二倍体酿酒酵母菌株能够从葡萄糖生产 0.24 mg/L 的光甘草定，生物反应器验证达到 1.20 mg/L。将其扩展到酵母 × 大肠杆菌联盟可提供 32.8 mg/L 的雌马酚，证实了框架的通用性。在这项工作中，该策略将复杂的植物化学途径转化为即插即用的遗传模块，en

articles.title: Integrated multi-dimensional modeling of non-model bacteria identifies engineering targets for acarbose biosynthesis optimization.
articles.titleZh: 非模型细菌的综合多维建模确定了阿卡波糖生物合成优化的工程目标。
articles.authors: Cai F, Zhang S, Dai Y, Zhao Z, Fu X, Kang Q, Shi Y, Wang Z, Bai L.
articles.abstract: Metabolic engineering for high-value compounds such as acarbose, a diabetes drug, requires systematic understanding of metabolic regulation. Here, we applied a multi-dimensional systems biology approach in Actinoplanes sp. SE50/110, a non-model acarbose-producing bacterium. We reconstructed an improved genome-scale metabolic model (iASE1267) with expanded metabolic coverage and a MEMOTE score of 80%, enabling more accurate phenotype predictions. Using a dual-objective OptRAM strain design strategy, we identified two sets of static engineering targets, including AcbR overexpression with adenylosuccinate lyase repression, and overexpression of dTDP-glucose 4,6-dehydratase with repression of 4-(cytidine 5'-diphospho)-2-methyl-D-erythritol kinase. Time-course metabolic modeling further revealed dynamic metabolic valves-ASPO1, PC, and PYK-governing flux redistribution. Integrating these targets, we reconstructed a core transcription-metabolism network and identified two pleiotropic negative transcription factors (TFs). Experimental validation of these TFs and metabolic genes increased acarbose titers by 18%-23%. This work establishes a framework integrating static/dynamic metabolic modeling with transcriptional networks for engineering non-model microbes.
articles.abstractZh: 高价值化合物（例如糖尿病药物阿卡波糖）的代谢工程需要对代谢调节的系统了解。在这里，我们在 Actinoplanes sp 中应用了多维系统生物学方法。 SE50/110，一种非模型阿卡波糖产生细菌。我们重建了改进的基因组规模代谢模型 (iASE1267)，该模型具有扩大的代谢覆盖范围和 80% 的 MEMOTE 评分，能够实现更准确的表型预测。使用双目标 OptRAM 菌株设计策略，我们确定了两组静态工程目标，包括 AcbR 过表达和腺苷琥珀酸裂合酶抑制，以及 dTDP-葡萄糖 4,6-脱水酶过表达和 4-(胞苷 5'-二磷酸)-2-甲基-D-赤藓糖醇激酶抑制。时程代谢模型进一步揭示了动态代谢阀 - ASPO1、PC 和 PYK - 控制流量重新分布。整合这些目标，我们重建了核心转录代谢网络并鉴定了两个多效性负转录因子（TF）。这些 TF 和代谢基因的实验验证使阿卡波糖滴度提高了 18%-23%。这项工作建立了一个整合静态/动态代谢模式的框架

articles.title: Phytochemical-mediated green synthesis of selenium nanoparticles using Catharanthus roseus and their physicochemical characterization, biological evaluation, and molecular docking analysis.
articles.titleZh: 利用长春花植物化学介导的硒纳米颗粒的绿色合成及其理化表征、生物学评价和分子对接分析。
articles.authors: Desouky AF, Fahim AM, Kelany AK, Kamel MA, Mohamed AF, Abo Elsoud MM, Abdelhamid SA.
articles.abstract: This study reports the green biosynthesis of bioactive selenium nanoparticles using Catharanthus roseus extract as a reducing and stabilizing agent. Liquid chromatography-electrospray ionization tandem mass spectrometry profiling identified key phytoconstituents, including riboflavin 5'-phosphate and chlorogenic acid, involved in the process. Characterization confirmed successful synthesis: ultraviolet-visible spectroscopy showed an absorption peak at 266 nm, high-resolution transmission electron microscopy revealed spherical particles ranging from 8.6 to 65.6 nm, zeta potential was - 3.55 mV, and X-ray diffraction confirmed crystallinity. Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy indicated the involvement of phenolic and carboxyl groups. The biosynthesized selenium nanoparticles exhibited broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity, antiviral action against adenovirus (half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC50) = 22.99 µg/mL), and potent cytotoxicity against HepG2 hepatocellular carcinoma cells (IC50= 1.5 µg/mL). Molecular docking and dynamics simulations suggested stable interactions between seleniumphytochemical complexes and biological targets. Overall, this work demonstrates that C. roseus provides a sustainable route to novel, multifunctional selenium nanoparticles with promising preliminary bioactivity, establishing a foundation for future therapeutic development and in vivo studies.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究报告了使用长春花提取物作为还原剂和稳定剂的生物活性硒纳米粒子的绿色生物合成。液相色谱-电喷雾电离串联质谱分析鉴定了参与该过程的关键植物成分，包括核黄素 5'-磷酸和绿原酸。表征证实合成成功：紫外-可见光谱显示在 266 nm 处有吸收峰，高分辨率透射电子显微镜显示球形颗粒范围为 8.6 至 65.6 nm，zeta 电位为 - 3.55 mV，X 射线衍射证实了结晶度。傅里叶变换红外光谱表明酚基和羧基的参与。生物合成的硒纳米颗粒表现出广谱抗菌活性、对腺病毒的抗病毒作用（半数抑制浓度（IC50）= 22.99 µg/mL）以及对HepG2肝细胞癌细胞的有效细胞毒性（IC50= 1.5 µg/mL）。分子对接和动力学模拟表明硒植物化学复合物与生物靶标之间存在稳定的相互作用。总的来说，这项工作表明 C.

articles.title: Dual-calibration RT-qPCR reveals distinct dnaK1/2/3 and groEL1/2 expression dynamics under heat and acid stress in the sinefungin producer Streptomyces incarnatus.
articles.titleZh: 双校准 RT-qPCR 揭示了 Sinefungin 生产者 Streptomyces incarnatus 在热和酸胁迫下不同的 dnaK1/2/3 和 groEL1/2 表达动态。
articles.authors: Xiao-Hui Z, Kubo M, Yamagata H, Nakashima Y, Hasunuma T, Kanao T, Tamura T.
articles.abstract: Streptomyces incarnatus NRRL8089 produces sinefungin, a nucleoside antibiotic whose yield is enhanced under defined environmental stresses. Here, dual-calibration RT-qPCR was used to resolve paralogue-specific expression dynamics of the dnaK and groE chaperone systems under heat and acid stress conditions that increase sinefungin titres. The canonical dnaK1–dnaJ1 and groES–groEL1 operons exhibited moderate induction, whereas monocistronic paralogues (dnaK2, dnaK3 and groEL2) showed markedly higher inducibility, with up to ~ 125-fold increases relative to baseline expression. Promoter analyses revealed conserved inverted repeats and differences in predicted secondary-structure stability, suggesting that promoter architecture contributes to paralogue-specific responsiveness.
