Here we identify p21⁺Trem2⁺ senescent macrophages as a major source of inflammaging, using primary mouse and human macrophage models of DNA damage and cholesterol-induced senescence characterized by multi-omic profiling. We found that senescent macrophages exhibit a distinctive p21-TREM2 expression profile and senescence-associated secretory phenotype, driven in part by type I interferon signaling via cytosolic mitochondrial DNA. We also found that senescent macrophage accumulation occurs in aging, metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease mouse livers, and is enriched in human cirrhotic liver tissue. Finally, senolytic treatment targeting senescent macrophages reduced liver inflammation and steatosis in both aged mice and mice with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease. These findings establish macrophage senescence as a central driver of chronic inflammation in aging and metabolic liver disease, and a tractable therapeutic target.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞衰老通过衰老相关的分泌表型驱动衰老过程中的慢性无菌炎症，但负责的衰老细胞类型尚不清楚。巨噬细胞具有多种衰老特征，包括炎症分泌，但巨噬细胞是否可以进入衰老状态仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用以多组学分析为特征的 DNA 损伤和胆固醇诱导衰老的原代小鼠和人类巨噬细胞模型，将 p21⁺Trem2⁺ 衰老巨噬细胞确定为炎症的主要来源。我们发现衰老的巨噬细胞表现出独特的 p21-TREM2 表达谱和衰老相关的分泌表型，部分是由通过胞质线粒体 DNA 的 I 型干扰素信号传导驱动的。我们还发现，衰老的巨噬细胞积聚发生在衰老、代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪肝病小鼠肝脏中，并且在人类肝硬化肝组织中富集。最后，针对衰老巨噬细胞的 senolytic 治疗减少了老年小鼠和患有代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝病的小鼠的肝脏炎症和脂肪变性。这些发现将巨噬细胞衰老确定为

articles.title: PcabHLH58/PcabHLH151 regulates adventitious root development and nitrogen uptake in poplar.
articles.titleZh: PcabHLH58/PcabHLH151 调节杨树不定根发育和氮吸收。
articles.authors: Wei H, Zhou X, Xiang X, Du J, Bai Y, Zhang M, Song X, Qu G, Zhang L, Hu J.
articles.abstract: As a crucial ecological shelterbelt and timber species in China, Populus relies on adventitious root (AR) formation and root architecture for its ecological adaptability and clonal propagation efficiency. Two key root trait-related genes, PcabHLH58 and PcabHLH151, were identified through genome-wide association studies (GWAS) in Populus cathayana. Single or double mutations of PcabHLH58 and PcabHLH151 significantly inhibited AR development and nitrogen uptake in poplar. Furthermore, both genes can form homodimers or heterodimers to modulate the expression of PcaSCL33 and PcaPLT1 during AR development. The higher expression level and stronger regulatory capacity of PcabHLH58 imply its more critical role in the AR development. Additionally, PcaWOX5 was found to be modulated through both the PcabHLH58/PcabHLH151-PcaSCL33/PcaSHR and PcabHLH58/PcabHLH151-PcaPLT1 pathway. PcaPAR1 was identified as a feedback regulatory node in modulating the regulatory activities of both PcabHLH58 and PcabHLH151. Collectively, this study elucidates a novel regulatory network involving root development in poplar and provides foundational insights for future genetic breeding efforts.
articles.abstractZh: 作为中国重要的生态防护林和用材树种，杨树的生态适应性和无性繁殖效率依赖于不定根（AR）的形成和根系结构。通过青杨全基因组关联研究 (GWAS) 鉴定出两个关键的根性状相关基因 PcabHLH58 和 PcabHLH151。 PcabHLH58 和 PcabHLH151 的单突变或双突变显着抑制杨树 AR 发育和氮吸收。此外，这两个基因都可以形成同二聚体或异二聚体，以在 AR 发育过程中调节 PcaSCL33 和 PcaPLT1 的表达。 PcabHLH58较高的表达水平和较强的调控能力意味着其在AR发展中的作用更为关键。此外，发现 PcaWOX5 通过 PcabHLH58/PcabHLH151-PcaSCL33/PcaSHR 和 PcabHLH58/PcabHLH151-PcaPLT1 途径进行调节。 PcaPAR1 被确定为调节 PcabHLH58 和 PcabHLH151 调节活动的反馈调节节点。总的来说，这项研究阐明了涉及杨树根系发育的新型调控网络，并为未来的遗传育种工作提供了基础见解。

articles.title: Acclimation of Photosynthesis to the Environment 1 acts as a copper-binding superoxide detoxification enzyme.
articles.titleZh: 光合作用对环境的适应 1 充当铜结合超氧化物解毒酶。
articles.authors: Malesinski S, Vidal-Meireles A, Giovannetti E, Chazaux M, Krieger-Liszkay A, Boderiou C, Latil J, Viola S, Tabares LC, Arnoux P, Chauvat F, Dindaeng P, Maurin C, Siponen M, Caffarri S, Cassier-Chauvat C, Alric J, Johnson X.
articles.abstract: Plant acclimation is a growing scientific concept, at molecular, cellular and global scales. All photosynthetic organisms that created an oxic atmosphere on earth possess a gene of unknown function "Acclimation of Photosynthesis to the Environment 1". Here we show that APE1 encodes a thylakoid-bound protein with a unique motif that binds copper and detoxifies the superoxide anion radical, O2•-. Maturation of the recombinant APE1 protein from Chlamydomonas reinhardtii requires formation of cysteine disulfide bonds after copper binding or via a high affinity interaction with a copper chaperone (Plastid Copper Chaperone 1) that boosts its scavenging capacity for O2•-. APE1 co-occurs in evolution with Photosystem II oxygen evolving proteins and it is the archaic O2•- detoxifying enzyme for acclimating photosynthesis to an oxygenic environment.
articles.abstractZh: 植物驯化是一个在分子、细胞和全球尺度上不断发展的科学概念。地球上所有产生含氧大气的光合生物都拥有一个功能未知的基因“光合作用适应环境1”。在这里，我们证明 APE1 编码一种类囊体结合蛋白，该蛋白具有独特的基序，可结合铜并解毒超氧阴离子自由基 O2•-。来自莱茵衣藻的重组 APE1 蛋白的成熟需要在铜结合后形成半胱氨酸二硫键，或者通过与铜伴侣（质体铜伴侣 1）的高亲和力相互作用来增强其对 O2•- 的清除能力。 APE1 在进化过程中与光系统 II 氧气演化蛋白共同发生，它是古老的 O2•- 解毒酶，用于使光合作用适应含氧环境。

articles.title: Bioactive pigment production by marine bacteria from Colombian estuarine and deep-sea environments.
articles.titleZh: 来自哥伦比亚河口和深海环境的海洋细菌生产生物活性色素。
articles.authors: Ríos-López LG, Zuluaga-Valencia SD, Zuleta-Correa A, Gómez-León J, Quintero M.
articles.abstract: The marine environment is a reservoir of microbial diversity with high biotechnological potential. Natural pigments, such as some secondary metabolites, are of particular interest due to their ease of microbial cultivation and recovery, as well as their diverse biological activities. This study aimed to explore pigment production by bacteria isolated from estuarine and deep-sea environments in Colombia and evaluate their antimicrobial potential. Six from twenty-six isolates were tested for pigment production, and were taxonomically assigned to the genera Streptomyces (four), Pseudomonas (one), and Serratia (one). The pigment extracts demonstrated strong antimicrobial activity, with inhibition exceeding 90% against Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) and Candida albicans. Streptomyces sp. INV ACT17, isolated from marine sediments at 1,400 m depth was the most promising strain. Further characterization identified ISP-2 medium with a 1.5 mg/mL inoculum as optimal for pigment production. FTIR and molecular network dereplication analysis using UHPLC-MS/MS suggested actinomycin D as the major pigmented compound, a finding subsequently confirmed by NMR spectroscopy. Kinetic studies revealed a non-growth-associated profile with maximum production (762 ± 59 mg/L) after 196 h, and achieved a IC50 0.12 µg/mL against MRSA. These findings highlight deep–sea actinobacteria as valuable sources of bioactive pigments and establish Streptomyces sp. INV ACT17 is a promising candidate for natural antimicrobial discovery and development.
articles.abstractZh: 海洋环境是微生物多样性的宝库，具有很高的生物技术潜力。天然色素，例如一些次生代谢物，由于其易于微生物培养和回收以及其多样化的生物活性而受到特别关注。本研究旨在探索从哥伦比亚河口和深海环境中分离出的细菌产生色素的情况，并评估其抗菌潜力。对 26 个分离株中的 6 个进行了色素生产测试，并在分类学上分为链霉菌属（4 个）、假单胞菌属（1 个）和沙雷氏菌属（1 个）。色素提取物表现出强大的抗菌活性，对耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌 (MRSA) 和白色念珠菌的抑制率超过 90%。链霉菌属。从 1,400 米深的海洋沉积物中分离出来的 INV ACT17 是最有前途的菌株。进一步的表征确定含有 1.5 mg/mL 接种量的 ISP-2 培养基最适合颜料生产。使用 UHPLC-MS/MS 进行的 FTIR 和分子网络去重复分析表明放线菌素 D 是主要的色素化合物，这一发现随后被 NMR 光谱证实。动力学

articles.title: Comparative metabolomic assessment of bioconverted traditional and black wheat via the in vitro piglet digestion model.
articles.titleZh: 通过体外仔猪消化模型对生物转化的传统小麦和黑小麦进行比较代谢组学评估。
articles.authors: Mockus E, Starkute V, Klupsaite D, Badaras S, Liatukas Z, Ruzgas V, Ruzauskas M, Bartkiene E.
articles.abstract: Colored wheat is gaining significant attention in the food and feed industry due to its components’ potential health benefits. As weaning piglets experience major discomfort in their early life, the quality and bioavailability of the feed nutrients become crucial for their survival. Fermentation of the feed aims to be a cheap and efficient stage of the feed production, as it is able to overcome major shortcomings of the cereals. The aim of this study was to investigate the differences in metabolites between traditional (variety “Herkus”) and black (variety “DS8558-1”) (DS) wheat cereals (both non-pre-treated and fermented with Lactiplantibacillus plantarum strain) using an in vitro swine digestion model with weaning piglets’ faecal microbiota. The following in vitro digestion and fermentation parameters were evaluated: free and total amino acids concentration in the digesta; total amino acids in the undigested residue and bioconverted/control wheat wholemeal substrate; short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), volatile organic compounds (VOCs), free amino acids (FAAs), biogenic amines (BAs) and other small non-volatile metabolites in the in vitro fermentation samples. The in vitro digestibility and fermentability were significantly altered by bioconversion, while the substrate factor was significant only for the in vitro fermentability. The in vitro digestion of some of the non-essential and essential (valine, phenylalanine, leucine/isoleucine, histidine) AAs was significantly affected by both factors. Lysine digestibility was affected only by bioconversion. The bioconversion significantly affected the content of SCFAs, such as 2-methylpropanoic, butanoic, 3-methylbutanoic and pentanoic acids in in vitro fermentation (IVF) samples. The substrate was significant for all the analysed SCFAs, except propanoic and hexanoic acids. Benzenacetic, dihydrocinnamic and 4-hydroxyhydrocinnamic acids were significantly upregulated in DS IVF samples. P-cresol was upregulated in the bioconverted IVF samples. Both of the factors were significant for p-cresol concentrations in the IVF samples. The γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) production in the IVF samples was significantly affected by both factors. Lactate concentrations in the IVF samples were affected only by the substrate factor. These results highlight the significance of bioconversion for the overall digestibility of wheat wholemeal substrates as well as changes in the production of biologically relevant metabolites for piglets.
articles.abstractZh: 彩色小麦因其成分具有潜在的健康益处而在食品和饲料行业中受到广泛关注。由于断奶仔猪在其生命早期会经历严重的不适，因此饲料营养素的质量和生物利用度对其生存至关重要。饲料发酵旨在成为饲料生产的廉价且高效的阶段，因为它能够克服谷物的主要缺点。本研究的目的是利用断奶仔猪粪便微生物群的体外猪消化模型，研究传统（品种“Herkus”）和黑色（品种“DS8558-1”）(DS) 小麦谷物（未经预处理并用植物乳杆菌菌株发酵）之间代谢物的差异。评估了以下体外消化和发酵参数：消化物中的游离氨基酸和总氨基酸浓度；未消化残渣和生物转化/对照小麦全麦底物中的总氨基酸；体外发酵样品中的短链脂肪酸（SCFA）、挥发性有机化合物（VOC）、游离氨基酸（FAA）、生物胺（BA）和其他小非挥发性代谢物。体外消化率

articles.title: GID/CTLH E3 ligase complex control cell fate programs for sexual development of Plasmodium falciparum.
articles.titleZh: GID/CTLH E3 连接酶复合物控制恶性疟原虫性发育的细胞命运程序。
articles.authors: Marapana DS, Lopaticki S, Balan B, Reaksudsan K, Cobbold SA, Geoghegan ND, Khurana S, Scally SW, Hickey P, Jayakrishnan N, Vaibhav V, Spall S, Yousef JM, Dagley LF, Goodman CD, Cozijnsen A, McFadden GI, Rogers KL, Jex A, Komander D, McCarthy JS, Tonkin CJ, Dixon MWA, Cowman AF.
articles.abstract: Transmission of the malaria parasite Plasmodium falciparum requires the formation of specialised sexual cells called gametocytes. A hallmark of P. falciparum gametocyte development is its long duration, during which the parasite undergoes dramatic cellular remodelling including morphological, physiological and metabolic changes which result in the formation of a transmission ready, stage V gametocyte. Here we show that the PfGID E3 ubiquitin ligase complex regulates critical gametocyte cell fate programmes through the targeted ubiquitination of key proteins. Deletion of PfGID complex components leads to an arrest in gametocyte development and a loss of transmission to mosquitoes. PfGID governs gametocyte development by fine-tuning the protein levels of two substrates: the ZFP36 family RNAbinding protein GD1, and PfDPL, a cryptochrome-like protein. Our findings reveal that PfDPL regulates the expression of male-specific proteins early in gametocyte development that are essential for gametogenesis. In parallel to the PfDPL controlled cell fate program the RNA binding protein GD1 regulates transcripts crucial for gametocyte development by holding them in a state of translational repression. These findings illuminate the intricate molecular choreography underlying Plasmodium sexual development and provide insights into how single-celled eukaryotes execute cell-fate programmes to navigate complex life cycles and adapt to diverse host environments.
articles.abstractZh: 疟原虫恶性疟原虫的传播需要形成称为配子体的特殊性细胞。恶性疟原虫配子体发育的一个特点是其持续时间长，在此期间寄生虫经历剧烈的细胞重塑，包括形态、生理和代谢变化，从而形成准备好传播的第五阶段配子体。在这里，我们证明 PfGID E3 泛素连接酶复合物通过关键蛋白的靶向泛素化来调节关键的配子体细胞命运程序。 PfGID 复合体成分的缺失会导致配子体发育停滞以及向蚊子传播的能力丧失。 PfGID 通过微调两种底物的蛋白质水平来控制配子体发育：ZFP36 家族 RNA 结合蛋白 GD1 和 PfDPL（一种隐花色素样蛋白）。我们的研究结果表明，PfDPL 在配子细胞发育早期调节雄性特异性蛋白的表达，这对于配子发生至关重要。与 PfDPL 控制的细胞命运程序并行，RNA 结合蛋白 GD1 通过将转录物保持在翻译复制状态来调节对配子体发育至关重要的转录物。

articles.title: Mammalian-like steroidogenesis in plants gives rise to endocrine-mimetic cardenolides.
articles.titleZh: 植物中类似哺乳动物的类固醇生成产生模拟内分泌的强心烯内酯。
articles.authors: Xu M, Kastner DW, Luo W, Li FS, Müller P, Sun Y, Huang W, Glinkerman CM, Guempel M, Kulik HJ, Weng JK.
articles.abstract: Steroid hormones are central regulators of eukaryotic physiology, yet their signaling pathways are also exploited as key targets in cross-kingdom endocrine interference. Among them, cardenolides are steroid hormones in mammals that target sodium-potassium adenosine triphosphatase (Na+/K+-ATPase) to modulate ionic homeostasis. Notably, at least 17 plant orders are known to produce cardenolides as potent antiherbivore defenses by mimicking this signaling axis. A prominent example is digoxin, an FDA-approved cardiac drug sourced from foxglove. Despite decades of study, the biochemical basis by which plants evolved this endocrine mimicry remains unclear. Here, we identify S14βH, a noncanonical 2-oxoglutarate/Fe(II)-dependent dioxygenase (2OGD) that catalyzes stereoinverted steroid C14β-hydroxylation through an unprecedented mechanism involving hydrogen atom transfer, substrate reorientation, and opposite-face hydroxyl rebound. An intricate metabolic network comprising enzymatic redox transformations and malonylation, together with spontaneous lactonization, then channels 14β-hydroxylated pregnenolone toward the core cardenolide digitoxigenin. Comparative biochemical and evolutionary analyses further reveal that mammalian-like steroidogenesis is conserved in seed plants and has been independently co-opted for cardenolide biosynthesis across diverse lineages. Our findings expand the mechanistic scope of radical enzymology, illustrate how the malleability of plant metabolism enables repeated endocrine mimicry, and ultimately motivate future investigation into potential hormonal functions of steroids produced via mammalian-like steroidogenesis in plants.
articles.abstractZh: 类固醇激素是真核生理学的核心调节因子，但它们的信号通路也被用作跨界内分泌干扰的关键靶标。其中，心内酯是哺乳动物体内的类固醇激素，以钠钾腺苷三磷酸酶（Na+/K+-ATP酶）为靶点来调节离子稳态。值得注意的是，已知至少有 17 种植物能够通过模仿这一信号轴产生强效的抗草食动物防御物质卡烯内酯。一个突出的例子是地高辛，这是一种经 FDA 批准的心脏药物，源自毛地黄。尽管经过数十年的研究，植物进化出这种内分泌拟态的生化基础仍不清楚。在这里，我们鉴定了 S14βH，一种非经典的 2-酮戊二酸/Fe(II) 依赖性双加氧酶 (2OGD)，它通过涉及氢原子转移、底物重新定向和相反面羟基反弹的前所未有的机制催化立体反转类固醇 C14β-羟基化。一个复杂的代谢网络包括酶促氧化还原转化和丙二酰化，以及自发内酯化，然后将 14β-羟基化孕烯醇酮引导至核心卡烯内酯洋地黄毒甙元。比较生化和进化

articles.title: Matrix plasticity and the molecular basis of extracellular filament assembly in <i>Bacillus cereus</i>.
articles.titleZh: 蜡样芽孢杆菌的基质可塑性和胞外丝组装的分子基础。
articles.authors: Álvarez-Mena A, Abdul Shukkoor MB, Caro-Astorga J, Berbon M, Antequera-Gómez ML, Grifé-Ruiz M, Grélard A, Kauffmann B, Morvan E, Kuipers OP, de Vicente A, Habenstein B, Loquet A, Romero D.
articles.abstract: The controlled assembly of extracellular filaments is essential for bacterial multicellularity and surface colonization. While Gram-positive bacteria rely on a variety of mechanisms to construct surface-associated fibers, many noncanonical pathways remain largely unexplored. Here, we identify a regulated, sortase-independent system in Bacillus cereus that governs the polymerization of filaments within the extracellular matrix (ECM). This tripartite system comprises CapP, a chaperone-like protein, and the structural subunits TasA and CalY. CapP modulates filament formation in a concentration- and domain-dependent manner, promoting ordered heteropolymer assembly while preventing uncontrolled aggregation. Disrupting this pathway leads to distinct compensatory changes in matrix composition-including exopolysaccharide expression, extracellular DNA release, and flagellar regulation-revealing an unexpected level of matrix plasticity. Our findings uncover a unique mechanism of ECM biogenesis in Gram-positive bacteria and suggest that plasticity in matrix organization may be a widespread adaptive strategy across bacterial lineages.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞外丝的受控组装对于细菌的多细胞性和表面定殖至关重要。虽然革兰氏阳性细菌依靠多种机制来构建表面相关纤维，但许多非经典途径在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这里，我们在蜡样芽孢杆菌中发现了一个受调节的、不依赖于分选酶的系统，该系统控制着细胞外基质（ECM）内细丝的聚合。该三联系统包含 CapP（一种伴侣蛋白）以及结构亚基 TasA 和 CalY。 CapP 以浓度和域依赖性方式调节细丝形成，促进有序异聚物组装，同时防止不受控制的聚集。破坏这一途径会导致基质组成发生明显的代偿性变化，包括胞外多糖表达、细胞外 DNA 释放和鞭毛调节，从而揭示出意想不到的基质可塑性水平。我们的研究结果揭示了革兰氏阳性细菌中 ECM 生物发生的独特机制，并表明基质组织的可塑性可能是跨细菌谱系的广泛适应性策略。

articles.title: Oncogenic and tumor-suppressive forces converge on a progenitor niche at the benign-to-malignant transition.
articles.titleZh: 致癌力和肿瘤抑制力在良性向恶性转变的祖细胞生态位上汇聚。
articles.authors: Reyes J, Del Priore I, Chaikovsky AC, Pasnuri N, Elhossiny AM, Park J, Weiler P, Krause T, Moorman A, Snopkowski C, Takizawa M, Burdziak C, Ratnayeke N, Masilionis I, Ho YJ, Chaligné R, Romesser PB, Filliol A, Nawy T, Morris JP, Zhao Z, Pasca Di Magliano M, Alonso-Curbelo D, Pe'er D, Lowe SW.
articles.abstract: The benign-to-malignant transition is a defining step in cancer progression. To investigate when and how malignancy initiation occurs and tissue reorganization proceeds, we combine single-cell and spatial transcriptomic profiling in mouse models of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) that capture spontaneous p53 loss. Among Kras-mutant cells, we find that oncogenic and tumor-suppressive programs, including those controlled by p53, CDKN2A, and SMAD4, are co-activated in a discrete progenitor-like population, engaging senescence-like responses. Using a framework we developed for spatial analysis, we show that a niche centered on these cells undergoes stepwise remodeling during tumor progression, mirroring invasive PDAC. Transient KRAS inhibition depletes progenitor-like cells and dismantles their niche, delaying malignancy initiation. Conversely, p53 suppression enables progenitor cell expansion, epithelial-mesenchymal reprogramming, and immune-privileged niche formation. These findings position the progenitor-like state at the convergence of cancer-driving mutations, plasticity, and tissue remodeling, revealing a critical window for intercepting malignancy.
articles.abstractZh: 良性到恶性的转变是癌症进展的决定性步骤。为了研究恶性肿瘤发生的时间和方式以及组织重组的进行，我们在胰腺导管腺癌 (PDAC) 小鼠模型中结合了单细胞和空间转录组分析，捕获自发的 p53 丢失。在 Kras 突变细胞中，我们发现致癌和肿瘤抑制程序，包括由 p53、CDKN2A 和 SMAD4 控制的程序，在离散的类祖细胞群中共同激活，参与衰老样反应。使用我们开发的空间分析框架，我们发现以这些细胞为中心的生态位在肿瘤进展过程中经历逐步重塑，反映了侵入性 PDAC。短暂的 KRAS 抑制会耗尽类祖细胞并破坏它们的生态位，从而延缓恶性肿瘤的发生。相反，p53 抑制能够促进祖细胞扩增、上皮间质重编程和免疫特权生态位形成。这些发现将类祖细胞状态定位在癌症驱动突变、可塑性和组织重塑的融合点，揭示了拦截恶性肿瘤的关键窗口。

articles.title: PsAvh109 suppresses SA-triggered immunity by mimicking TPL function to disrupt mediator complex assembly.
articles.titleZh: PsAvh109 通过模仿 TPL 功能破坏介质复合物组装来抑制 SA 触发的免疫。
articles.authors: Tan X, Sun Y, Qi Z, Miao Y, Liu Z, Wan Y, Hou X, Li H, Li W, Chen Y, Xu Q, Wang Q.
articles.abstract: Pathogens disrupt transcriptional hubs to subvert host immunity, yet the spatiotemporal mechanisms remain enigmatic. Here, we report a pathogen effector interferes with the core eukaryotic transcriptional machinery by acting as a functional mimic of host repressors, deploying this suppression in synchrony with the plant immune rhythm. We discover the Phytophthora sojae nuclear effector directly targets the host Mediator complex. Crucially, PsAvh109 emulates the host repressor TOPLESS (TPL), competitively occupying the Mediator subunit MED21 and locks the MED21-MED6 interaction interface, repressing salicylic acid (SA)-responsive defense genes. Strikingly, PsAvh109 expression is induced by host-derived SA, the very signal displaces TPL from MED21 to activate immunity. This enables the pathogen to release the essential effector PsAvh109 precisely when the host initiates defense, perpetuating transcriptional repression during a critical vulnerability window. Our findings reveal a previously unrecognized strategy where pathogens exploit host signaling dynamics to release effectors that enforce sustained repression of defense programs.
articles.abstractZh: 病原体破坏转录中枢以破坏宿主免疫，但时空机制仍然是个谜。在这里，我们报告了一种病原体效应子通过充当宿主阻遏物的功能模拟物来干扰核心真核转录机制，与植物免疫节律同步部署这种抑制。我们发现大豆疫霉核效应子直接靶向宿主介体复合体。至关重要的是，PsAvh109 模拟宿主阻遏蛋白 TOPLESS (TPL)，竞争性占据介导亚基 MED21 并锁定 MED21-MED6 相互作用界面，抑制水杨酸 (SA) 反应性防御基因。引人注目的是，PsAvh109 表达是由宿主来源的 SA 诱导的，该信号取代了 MED21 中的 TPL 以激活免疫。这使得病原体能够在宿主启动防御时精确地释放必要的效应子 PsAvh109，从而在关键的脆弱窗口期间持续进行转录抑制。我们的研究结果揭示了一种以前未被认识的策略，即病原体利用宿主信号动力学来释放效应器，从而强制持续抑制防御程序。

articles.title: Water kefir as a paradigm for multi-omics and genome-scale metabolic modelling in fermented food.
articles.titleZh: 水开菲尔作为发酵食品中多组学和基因组规模代谢模型的范例。
articles.authors: Khan A, Breselge S, O'Mahony AK, O'Sullivan O, Cotter PD, McCarthy SN, Mahony J, Kenny JG.
articles.abstract: Water Kefir is a plant-based fermented beverage, traditionally produced on a small scale by fermenting a sucrose solution with fresh or dried fruits, using water kefir grains as inoculum. The grains are relatively simple communities that consist of both eukaryotes and prokaryotes, rendering them a paradigm for studying microbial ecology and interspecies interactions. Recently, water kefir has attracted growing research and industrial interest due to its potential and perceived health benefits. Owing to its increasing popularity, there is a growing demand for controlled and standardised production on an industrial scale. However, industrial-scale production remains a challenge due to the limited knowledge of the biological interactions of the microbial consortia and the lack of defined starter cultures. This review examines the current understanding of microbial and metabolic complexity of water kefir obtained from various omics studies. It further investigates the potential of an integrated multi-omics approach to elucidate mechanisms of microbial interactions and provides a roadmap for conducting multi-omics studies on fermented foods using water kefir as an example. This review also explores the potential application of genome-scale metabolic modelling in the development of functional and defined microbial communities for food fermentation. It identifies key challenges associated with such modelling and provides perspectives to address them. Finally, this review briefly discusses the regulatory challenges associated with the use of defined communities in food systems.
articles.abstractZh: 水开菲尔是一种植物性发酵饮料，传统上通过使用水开菲尔粒作为接种物，用新鲜或干果发酵蔗糖溶液来小规模生产。谷物是由真核生物和原核生物组成的相对简单的群落，使它们成为研究微生物生态学和种间相互作用的范例。最近，水开菲尔因其潜在的和公认的健康益处而吸引了越来越多的研究和工业兴趣。由于其日益普及，对工业规模的受控和标准化生产的需求不断增长。然而，由于对微生物群落的生物相互作用的了解有限且缺乏明确的发酵剂，工业规模生产仍然是一个挑战。这篇综述探讨了目前从各种组学研究中获得的对水开菲尔微生物和代谢复杂性的理解。它进一步研究了综合多组学方法阐明微生物相互作用机制的潜力，并提供了以水开菲尔为例对发酵食品进行多组学研究的路线图。这篇评论

articles.title: A molecular framework of the Rht-A1-TaLA1-D module controlling tiller angle in wheat.
articles.titleZh: 控制小麦分蘖角度的 Rht-A1-TaLA1-D 模块的分子框架。
articles.authors: Chen Y, Xie Z, Dong C, Li D, Cheng H, Lv B, Xia C, Sun J, Liu X, Kong X, Zhang L.
articles.abstract: Tiller angle is a critical determinant of wheat plant architecture, which profoundly impacts yield potential. However, the regulatory mechanisms of tiller angle in wheat remain largely unexplored. To explore the underlying mechanisms, we identify two EMS-mutagenized wheat mutants tiller angle 1 (ta1) and ta2 with enlarged tiller angles. Molecular characterization reveals that TA1 and TA2 encode the DELLA protein Rht-A1 and TaLA1-D, respectively. Biochemical analyses demonstrate that the Rht-A1ta1 variant acquires enhanced protein stability, whereas TaLA1-Dta2 exhibits destabilization. We establish a mechanistic framework that Rht-A1 physically associates with TaPROG1 to synergistically repress TaLA1-D transcription. Moreover, we show that TaGSK3 directly interacts with and phosphorylates TaLA1-D to enhance its stability in reducing wheat tiller angles. Population genomic analyses uncover a significant selection for the elite TaLA1-DHap1 allele during modern wheat breeding, correlating with compact plant architecture and elevated thousand-grain weight. This study provides new insights into plant architecture regulation and target genes for improving yield potential in wheat.
articles.abstractZh: 分蘖角度是小麦株型的关键决定因素，它深刻影响产量潜力。然而，小麦分蘖角的调控机制在很大程度上仍未被探索。为了探索其潜在机制，我们鉴定了两个 EMS 诱变的小麦突变体分蘖角 1 (ta1) 和分蘖角增大的 ta2。分子表征表明，TA1 和 TA2 分别编码 DELLA 蛋白 Rht-A1 和 TaLA1-D。生化分析表明，Rht-A1ta1 变体获得了增强的蛋白质稳定性，而 TaLA1-Dta2 表现出不稳定。我们建立了一个机制框架，Rht-A1 与 TaPROG1 物理结合，协同抑制 TaLA1-D 转录。此外，我们发现 TaGSK3 直接与 TaLA1-D 相互作用并磷酸化 TaLA1-D，以增强其减少小麦分蘖角度的稳定性。群体基因组分析揭示了现代小麦育种过程中精英 TaLA1-DHap1 等位基因的显着选择，与紧凑的植株结构和千粒重的增加相关。这项研究为提高小麦产量潜力的植物结构调控和靶基因提供了新的见解。

articles.title: Insects manipulate host nuclear trafficking and epigenetic regulation to facilitate herbivory.
articles.titleZh: 昆虫操纵宿主核运输和表观遗传调控以促进食草。
articles.authors: Zhang ZL, Hu TB, Xu XY, Lu HB, Lu JB, Zhuo JC, Wang YZ, Sun ZT, Chen JP, Li JM, Zhang CX, Huang HJ.
articles.abstract: Effectors secreted by pathogens or insects manipulate host plant cellular processes depending on their target destination. However, our current knowledge regarding nucleus-localized effectors from herbivorous insects remains limited. Here, we demonstrate that Nilaparvata lugens evolve a nuclear localization signal (NLS)-containing salivary effector NlAMSP that is specialized for targeting host plants. NlAMSP resides in the cytoplasm of insect salivary glands, but, upon secretion, migrates into the nucleus of rice cells. This nuclear translocation is enabled by the cleavage of its signal peptide, allowing the NLS-dependent import via the host importin-α/β pathway. SUMOylation at sites within the NLS is essential for the NlAMSP function, enhancing its nuclear localization and protein stability by preventing autophagy-associated degradation. In plants, NlAMSP interacts with the histone deacetylase OsHDA706 and redirects it from the cytoplasm to the nucleus, thereby disrupting its interaction with the JA biosynthesis regulator OsLOX14 in the cytoplasm. This interference reduces OsLOX14 accumulation and suppresses the JA-associated defense responses. Furthermore, nucleus-localized OsHDA706 diminishes histone H4K5ac and H4K8ac, thereby suppressing the expression of NLR and WRKY genes essential for rice resistance to N. lugens. Our findings uncover a mechanism by which an insect effector manipulates host nuclear trafficking and epigenetic regulation to facilitate herbivory.
articles.abstractZh: 病原体或昆虫分泌的效应器根据其目标目的地操纵宿主植物细胞过程。然而，我们目前对食草昆虫核定位效应器的了解仍然有限。在这里，我们证明褐飞虱进化出一种含有核定位信号（NLS）的唾液效应器 NlAMSP，专门针对宿主植物。 NlAMSP 存在于昆虫唾液腺的细胞质中，但分泌后会迁移到水稻细胞的细胞核中。这种核易位是通过其信号肽的裂解实现的，从而允许通过宿主输入蛋白-α/β途径进行 NLS 依赖性输入。 NLS 内位点的 SUMO 化对于 NlAMSP 功能至关重要，可通过防止自噬相关的降解来增强其核定位和蛋白质稳定性。在植物中，NlAMSP 与组蛋白脱乙酰酶 OsHDA706 相互作用，并将其从细胞质重定向到细胞核，从而破坏其与细胞质中 JA 生物合成调节因子 OsLOX14 的相互作用。这种干扰减少了 OsLOX14 的积累并抑制了 JA 相关的防御反应。此外，核定位的 OsHDA

articles.title: Peroxidase-mimicking chitosan/dextran-coated cobalt ferrite-graphene oxide nanozyme enhances hydrogen peroxide-mediated killing of cariogenic pathogens in dental biofilm models.
articles.titleZh: 模拟过氧化物酶的壳聚糖/葡聚糖包被的钴铁氧体-氧化石墨烯纳米酶增强了过氧化氢介导的牙科生物膜模型中致龋病原体的杀灭作用。
articles.authors: Ghaffari M, Nilsson M, Tolker-Nielsen T, Taheri-Kafrani A.
articles.abstract: Dental caries is a chronic, multifactorial and biofilm-mediated disease driven by complex microbial interactions within the oral cavity. The causative biofilm is particularly challenging to eliminate due to the protective extracellular matrix that shelters the embedded microorganisms and promotes retention of acidic metabolites, leading to enamel demineralization. Conventional antimicrobial agents are often ineffective in disrupting this matrix and fail to eradicate microbes within biofilms. In this study, we report the synthesis of a novel dextran and chitosan- decorated cobalt ferrite-grafted graphene oxide (CoFe₂O₄/GO@Dex-CS) nanozyme with high peroxidase-like activity as an innovative strategy to control dental biofilms. The nanozyme was synthesized via a facile sono-chemical co-precipitation and coating method. Comprehensive characterization via XRD, FTIR, DLS, TEM, SEM and EDX confirms the nanozyme’s structural integrity and successful functionalization with biocompatible dextran and chitosan, enhancing targeted biofilm penetration and stability. This nanozyme catalyzes hydrogen peroxide to generate reactive oxygen species in situ, resulting in significant reduction in the number of viable bacteria in oral model biofilms. In a monospecies Streptococcus mutans biofilm, the CoFe₂O₄/GO@Dex-CS nanozyme in combination with H₂O₂ exhibited a strong antibiofilm effect, resulting in a reduction of viable S. mutans cells by more than 3-log compared to the untreated control. In a supragingival plaque model biofilm comprising six species a > 2-log reduction in viable S. mutans was observed. Notably, in the same model, the treatment also resulted in a > 3-log reduction of the number of viable Fusebacterium nucleatum and Veillonella dispar as well as in a reduction in the number of viable Actinomyces naeslundii. The biocompatibility of the nanozyme components and its potent catalytic activity highlight its potential for incorporation into mouthwashes or toothpastes to effectively manage dental plaque and prevent caries development. Our findings demonstrate that nanozyme-based catalytic therapeutics offer a promising alternative strategy for the treatment and prevention of biofilm-associated oral diseases.
articles.abstractZh: 龋齿是一种慢性、多因素和生物膜介导的疾病，由口腔内复杂的微生物相互作用驱动。由于保护性细胞外基质可以庇护嵌入的微生物并促进酸性代谢物的保留，从而导致牙釉质脱矿，因此消除致病生物膜特别具有挑战性。传统的抗菌剂通常无法有效破坏这种基质，并且无法根除生物膜内的微生物。在这项研究中，我们报道了一种新型葡聚糖和壳聚糖修饰的钴铁氧体接枝氧化石墨烯（CoFe2O4/GO@Dex-CS）纳米酶的合成，该纳米酶具有高过氧化物酶样活性，作为控制牙齿生物膜的创新策略。纳米酶是通过简便的声化学共沉淀和涂层方法合成的。通过 XRD、FTIR、DLS、TEM、SEM 和 EDX 进行的综合表征证实了纳米酶的结构完整性以及与生物相容性葡聚糖和壳聚糖的成功功能化，从而增强了目标生物膜的渗透性和稳定性。这种纳米酶催化过氧化氢原位产生活性氧，从而显着减少核反应。

articles.title: Phage-assisted evolution of allosteric protein switches.
articles.titleZh: 变构蛋白开关的噬菌体辅助进化。
articles.authors: Southern NT, von Bachmann A, Hovsepyan A, Griebl M, Wolf B, Lemmen N, Kroell AS, Westermann S, Mathony J, Niopek D.
articles.abstract: Allostery, the transmission of locally induced conformational changes to distant functional sites, is a key mechanism for protein regulation. Artificial allosteric effectors enable remote manipulation of cell function; their engineering, however, is hampered by our limited understanding of allosteric residue networks. Here, we introduce a phage-assisted evolution platform for in vivo optimization of allosteric proteins. It applies opposing selection pressures to enhance activity and switchability of phage-encoded effectors and leverages retron-based recombineering to broadly explore fitness landscapes, introducing point mutations, insertions, and deletions. Applying this framework to the transcription factor AraC yielded near-binary optogenetic switches, with light-controlled activity spanning ~1000-fold dynamic range. Long-read sequencing across selection cycles enabled high-resolution tracking of evolving variant pools, revealing adaptive trajectories and context-dependent residue interactions. Mechanistically, we find that linker mutations promoting α-helix extension at the sensor-effector junction enhance conformational coupling between LOV2 and AraC. These variants emerge consistently across independently evolved pools, underscoring their functional relevance. Together, we develop a framework for the directed evolution of programmable allosteric switches in vivo. By coupling dynamic selection with deep mutational scanning and temporal sequencing, it enables both functional optimization and mechanistic insight into allosteric networks.
articles.abstractZh: 变构，即局部诱导的构象变化向远处功能位点的传递，是蛋白质调节的关键机制。人工变构效应器能够远程操控细胞功能；然而，我们对变构残基网络的了解有限，阻碍了它们的工程。在这里，我们介绍了用于变构蛋白体内优化的噬菌体辅助进化平台。它应用相反的选择压力来增强噬菌体编码效应器的活性和可切换性，并利用基于逆转录子的重组工程来广泛探索适应性景观，引入点突变、插入和删除。将此框架应用于转录因子 AraC 产生了近二元光遗传学开关，光控活性跨越约 1000 倍的动态范围。跨选择周期的长读长测序能够对不断变化的变异池进行高分辨率跟踪，揭示适应性轨迹和上下文相关的残基相互作用。从机制上讲，我们发现促进传感器-效应器连接处的α螺旋延伸的接头突变增强了LOV2和AraC之间的构象耦合。这些变体出现了缺点

articles.title: TargetGAN: A generative AI framework for the design of plant core promoters with targeted activity.
articles.titleZh: TargetGAN：一种生成式人工智能框架，用于设计具有目标活性的植物核心启动子。
articles.authors: Xiang X, Yao Q, Deng K, Ge Y, Xiong Q, Lu Y, Hu X.
articles.abstract: Plant core promoters (PCPs) are key genetic elements that control gene expression and have significant value for crop breeding and plant synthetic biology. Natural promoters (NPs) are constrained by their limited diversity and narrow activity range, and it remains unclear whether synthetic promoters (SPs) can transcend these natural constraints. Here, we present TargetGAN, a deep-learning framework trained on 76,851 NPs that integrates a generative adversarial network (GAN) with a pre-trained activity predictor to enable the de novo design of PCPs with user-defined activity. We used TargetGAN to generate 55,296 SPs and selected 5,250 for high-throughput functional validation using STARR-seq. Of these, 2,909 were successfully characterized, with a moderate correlation (Pearson correlation coefficient = 0.6435) between predicted and experimental activity. Surprisingly, 29 SPs exhibited ultra-high activity, exceeding the maximum activity of the tested NPs. Further orthogonal validation using luciferase reporter assays showed a strong positive correlation with STARR-seq measurements across a broad dynamic range. Notably, the most active synthetic candidate, SP1482, significantly outperformed the strongest tested NP, the UBI core promoter, achieving a 128-fold increase in expression relative to the 35S minimal promoter. Interpretable motif analysis suggested that ultra-high-activity promoter design can be achieved through the precise arrangement of strong activating motifs. These results demonstrate that TargetGAN is a robust and generalizable framework for the targeted generation of PCPs tailored to user-defined activity levels and will be a powerful tool both for precise gene regulation in plant systems and for overexpression analysis in genetic engineering and synthetic biology.
articles.abstractZh: 植物核心启动子（PCP）是控制基因表达的关键遗传元件，对于作物育种和植物合成生物学具有重要价值。天然启动子（NP）受到其有限的多样性和狭窄的活性范围的限制，并且尚不清楚合成启动子（SP）是否可以超越这些天然限制。在这里，我们提出了 TargetGAN，这是一个在 76,851 个 NP 上进行训练的深度学习框架，它将生成对抗网络 (GAN) 与预先训练的活动预测器集成在一起，以实现具有用户定义活动的 PCP 的从头设计。我们使用 TargetGAN 生成 55,296 个 SP，并使用 STARR-seq 选择 5,250 个进行高通量功能验证。其中，2,909 个被成功表征，预测活动与实验活动之间具有中等相关性（皮尔逊相关系数 = 0.6435）。令人惊讶的是，29 个 SP 表现出超高活性，超过了测试的 NP 的最大活性。使用荧光素酶报告基因检测的进一步正交验证显示，在广泛的动态范围内与 STARR-seq 测量值呈强正相关。值得注意的是，最活跃的合成候选物 SP1482 明显优于

articles.title: Chemical anchoring of immunotherapeutic drugs within senescent tumor cells overcomes senescence-driven immunotherapy resistance.
articles.titleZh: 免疫治疗药物在衰老肿瘤细胞内的化学锚定克服了衰老驱动的免疫治疗耐药性。
articles.authors: Huang W, Chen J, Ali N, Tian J, Zhang W.
articles.abstract: Multidrug resistance (MDR) compromises cancer treatment efficacy and leads to therapeutic failure. Therapy-induced senescence further complicates MDR through senescence-enhanced drug efflux and senescence-associated secretory phenotypes (SASPs), remaining a huge challenge. Here, we develop a self-generative senescence-associated β-galactosidase (SA-β-gal)-initiated chemical anchoring of lysosomal protein approach to counteract drug efflux and reprogram SASPs. A senescence-tumor-targeted immunotherapeutic drug (DN-Ghcy) is fabricated by a SA-β-gal-activatable bio-orthogonal receptor (Ghcy) and an engineered immunostimulatory prodrug (DN, an indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase (IDO) inhibitor conjugated to a PD-L1 binding peptide). DN-Ghcy is selectively immobilized in senescent tumor cells via SA-β-gal-catalyzed bio-orthogonal nano-receptor, enabling drug retention and bypassing transporter-mediated efflux. Under near-infrared irradiation, DN-Ghcy concurrently mediates degradation of PD-L1, release of IDO inhibitor, and disruption of lysosomal integrity. This strategy reverses immunotherapy resistance in female mice with senescent tumors, establishing a promising modality to overcome senescence-driven immunotherapy resistance.
articles.abstractZh: 多药耐药性（MDR）会损害癌症治疗效果并导致治疗失败。治疗诱导的衰老通过衰老增强的药物流出和衰老相关的分泌表型（SASP）使 MDR 进一步复杂化，这仍然是一个巨大的挑战。在这里，我们开发了一种自我生成衰老相关β-半乳糖苷酶（SA-β-gal）引发的溶酶体蛋白化学锚定方法，以抵消药物外流和重新编程SASP。衰老肿瘤靶向免疫治疗药物 (DN-Ghcy) 由 SA-β-gal 可激活生物正交受体 (Ghcy) 和工程化免疫刺激前药（DN，一种与 PD-L1 结合肽缀合的吲哚胺 2,3-双加氧酶 (IDO) 抑制剂）制成。 DN-Ghcy 通过 SA-β-gal 催化的生物正交纳米受体选择性固定在衰老肿瘤细胞中，从而实现药物保留并绕过转运蛋白介导的外流。在近红外照射下，DN-Ghcy 同时介导 PD-L1 降解、IDO 抑制剂释放和溶酶体完整性破坏。这种策略逆转了患有衰老肿瘤的雌性小鼠的免疫治疗耐药性，建立了一种有前途的克服衰老肿瘤的方法

articles.title: Comparative characterization of Cas12f orthologs reveals mechanistic features underlying enhanced genome editing efficiency.
articles.titleZh: Cas12f 直系同源物的比较表征揭示了增强基因组编辑效率的机制特征。
articles.authors: Guan K, Ocampo RF, Matheus Carnevali PB, Castelle CJ, Gonzalez-Osorio L, Castanzo DT, Thomas NC, Brothers M, Dangerfield TL, Hooper MM, West MS, Appleby NM, Krudop I, Lamothe RC, Aliaga Goltsman DS, Alexander LM, Butterfield CN, Johnson KA, Brown CT, Taylor DW.
articles.abstract: Miniature CRISPR-Cas12f nucleases are attractive candidates for therapeutic genome editing because of their compact size and compatibility with adeno-associated virus (AAV) delivery. However, editing efficiencies in mammalian cells are lower than those of larger systems. The extensive phylogenetic diversity of Cas12f suggests unexplored mechanistic variation with the potential for optimization. Here we identify and characterize a naturally occurring Cas12f ortholog discovered through metagenomics, Alistipes sp. Cas12f (Al3Cas12f), which supports robust genome editing in human cells. Through structural, biochemical and kinetic analyses, we compare Al3Cas12f to two recently described orthologs, Oscillibacter sp. Cas12f and Ruminiclostridium herbifermentans Cas12f. These orthologs present divergent architectures and regulatory features governing protospacer-adjacent motif recognition, guide RNA (gRNA) binding, dimerization and DNA cleavage. Notably, Al3Cas12f achieves efficient R-loop formation through a stable dimer interface and a naturally optimized gRNA. Leveraging these structural insights, we generate an engineered Al3Cas12f variant (RKK) that increases editing and improves activity across several tested genomic loci. By overcoming locus-dependent variability and an apparent potency threshold, this engineered compact editor seems to expand the feasibility of low-dose, AAV-compatible therapeutic genome editing. Our results elucidate mechanistic determinants of Cas12f activity and offer a framework for engineering compact genome editors that may bear therapeutic potential.
articles.abstractZh: 微型 CRISPR-Cas12f 核酸酶因其紧凑的尺寸和与腺相关病毒 (AAV) 传递的兼容性而成为治疗性基因组编辑的有吸引力的候选者。然而，哺乳动物细胞的编辑效率低于较大系统的编辑效率。 Cas12f 广泛的系统发育多样性表明其存在尚未探索的机制变异，具有优化的潜力。在这里，我们鉴定并表征了通过宏基因组学发现的天然存在的 Cas12f 直系同源物 Alitipes sp。 Cas12f (Al3Cas12f)，支持人类细胞中强大的基因组编辑。通过结构、生化和动力学分析，我们将 Al3Cas12f 与最近描述的两种直向同源物 Oscillibacter sp. 进行比较。 Cas12f 和瘤胃梭状芽胞杆菌 Cas12f。这些直系同源物呈现出不同的结构和调控特征，控制着原型间隔子相邻基序识别、引导RNA (gRNA) 结合、二聚化和DNA 切割。值得注意的是，Al3Cas12f 通过稳定的二聚体界面和自然优化的 gRNA 实现了高效的 R 环形成。利用这些结构见解，我们生成了一种工程化的 Al3Cas12f 变体 (RKK)，它可以增加编辑并改善活性

articles.title: Design of the biosensor-dependent coupling system stabilizes the high-synthesis phenotype of cell factory.
articles.titleZh: 生物传感器依赖性偶联系统的设计稳定了细胞工厂的高合成表型。
articles.authors: Qin L, Yang B, Huang R, Zhang H, Li Q, Li X, Tan Y, Sun W, Jia H, Hu B, Lv B, Li C.
articles.abstract: Microbial cell factories offer a sustainable route to plant-derived natural products, but yield drift and strain degeneration persist. Growth-coupled biosynthesis can continuously enrich high producers, yet specific product-responsive biosensors remain scarce and their population-level effects are unclear. Here, we describe a rapid transcriptome-mining workflow that, as proof-of-concept, delivers yeast biosensors for glycyrrhetinic acid and medicarpin. By fine-tuning PDR5 promoter, we expand the dynamic range of the glycyrrhetinic acid sensor and wire it to an essential gene, establishing a growth-addiction circuit that increases titer by 46.8 % after subculture. Single-cell transcriptome reveals that the evolved strain population exhibits a completely different division of labor compared to the initial strain. Coupling does not eliminate phenotypic heterogeneity; instead, it amplifies a dedicated sub-population marked by discrete transcriptional signatures. Deletion of genes highly expressed in non-producing cells or enrichment of high-producing cell clusters can further boost population-level production. This study provides both a generalizable biosensor-discovery platform and single-cell-guided strategies for stabilizing and optimizing natural-product cell factories.
articles.abstractZh: 微生物细胞工厂为生产植物源性天然产品提供了一条可持续的途径，但产量漂移和菌株退化仍然存在。生长耦合生物合成可以不断丰富高生产者，但特定产品响应的生物传感器仍然稀缺，其群体水平的影响尚不清楚。在这里，我们描述了一种快速转录组挖掘工作流程，作为概念验证，它提供了甘草次酸和麦卡平的酵母生物传感器。通过微调 PDR5 启动子，我们扩大了甘草次酸传感器的动态范围，并将其连接到必需基因，建立了生长成瘾回路，继代培养后滴度增加了 46.8%。单细胞转录组揭示，与初始菌株相比，进化后的菌株群体表现出完全不同的分工。偶联并不能消除表型异质性；相反，它放大了由离散转录特征标记的专用亚群。删除非生产细胞中高表达的基因或富集高生产细胞簇可以进一步提高群体水平的生产。这项研究提供了一个通用的生物传感器发现平台和系统

articles.title: Essential oil and extract of clevenger's waste of hymenocrater calycinus (boiss.) benth. as a non-toxicity option for cutaneous burns according to traditional use.
articles.titleZh: hymenocrater calycinus (boiss.) Benth 的精油和提取物。根据传统用途，作为皮肤烧伤的无毒选择。
articles.authors: Ghavam M.
articles.abstract: Essential oils and their by-products extracted using distillation methods are a rich and diverse source of natural products with various therapeutic applications. Hymenocrater calycinus (Boiss.) Benth. is used in traditional Iranian medicine as an analgesic, antiallergic, and a remedy for treating cutaneous burns. The present study was conducted for the first time to compare the antimicrobial activity and cytotoxicity of the essential oil and the residual water extract after distillation of H. calycinus from the habitats of Kashan, Iran. The essential oil of this plant was extracted by hydro-distillation using a Clevenger apparatus, and the residual water extract in the Clevenger apparatus flask after separation from the plant waste was concentrated and converted into a dry extract. Chemical profiling of the essential oil was performed using GC-MS. Total phenolic content (TPC), total flavonoid content (TFC), and antioxidant capacity were quantified using the Folin-Ciocalteu, quercetin equivalence, and DPPH assays, respectively. The antimicrobial activity of the essential oil and extract was determined by the agar diffusion method, and the lowest inhibitory and bactericidal concentrations were determined against eleven microorganisms (three Gram-positive bacteria, six Gram-negative bacteria, and one yeast strain). The MTT method was used to evaluate the cytotoxicity of the essential oil and extract on Human Dermal Fibroblast (HDF) cell lines. The results showed that the yield of H. calycinus essential oil was about 0.68% w/w, and heptacosane (48.06%), citronellol oleate (7.81%), and caryophyllene oxide (5.67%) were the dominant components of this essential oil. The IC50 value of the extract was 85.55 ± 5.31 µg/mL, and the total phenolic and flavonoid contents was 321.42 ± 8.04 and 30.6 ± 2.11 µg/mg, respectively. The results of antimicrobial activity showed that the lowest MIC value of the essential oil was against the Gram-negative Pseudomonas aeruginosa, with a value of 62.5 µg/mL. The results of cytotoxicity confirmed the non-toxicity of the extract at all concentrations and the non-toxicity of the essential oil at a concentration of 25 µg/mL. Therefore, the essential oil, and in particular the extract from Clevenger's residual water (a waste and by-product), in vitro is a natural, inexpensive, and environmentally friendly option for combating skin infections and hospital-acquired burn complications caused by P. aeruginosa, which is in line with the use of this plant in traditional medicine for wound healing and burn care. Further clinical and in vivo trials are needed.
articles.abstractZh: 使用蒸馏方法提取的精油及其副产品是具有各种治疗应用的丰富多样的天然产物来源。 Hymenocrater calycinus (Boiss.) Benth.在伊朗传统医学中用作镇痛剂、抗过敏剂和治疗皮肤烧伤的药物。本研究首次比较了来自伊朗卡尚栖息地的萼萼香精油和蒸馏后残留水提取物的抗菌活性和细胞毒性。使用Clevenger装置通过水蒸馏提取该植物的精油，并将与植物废物分离后的Clevenger装置烧瓶中残留的水提取物浓缩并转化为干提取物。使用 GC-MS 对精油进行化学分析。分别使用 Folin-Ciocalteu、槲皮素当量和 DPPH 测定法对总酚含量 (TPC)、总黄酮含量 (TFC) 和抗氧化能力进行定量。采用琼脂扩散法测定精油及提取物的抑菌活性，并求得最低抑菌浓度和杀菌浓度。

articles.title: Green mycosynthesis of a CuO/ZnO heterojunction nanocomposite using Aspergillus terreus and its antibacterial and anti-virulence activity against multidrug-resistant Escherichia coli.
articles.titleZh: 利用土曲霉绿色真菌合成 CuO/ZnO 异质结纳米复合材料及其对多重耐药大肠杆菌的抗菌和抗毒力活性。
articles.authors: Obaid AN, Abdelghany TM, Soliman AM, Mahmoud NN, Mekky AE.
articles.abstract: The rapid spread of multidrug-resistant (MDR) Escherichia coli poses a severe global health risk and demands the development of new antibacterial strategies. Biologically manufactured metal oxide nanocomposites have gained popularity due to their superior antibacterial activity and environmentally sustainable synthesis. This study uniquely integrates fungal metabolite profiling, green synthesis of a CuO/ZnO heterojunction nanocomposite, and molecular evaluation of anti-virulence activity against clinically isolated MDR Escherichia coli. The CuO/ZnO system was selected due to its synergistic heterostructure, which enhances reactive oxygen species generation and improves antibacterial performance compared to single metal oxides. In this investigation, an MDR E. coli strain was isolated from wound infections and identified using 16 S rRNA sequencing. A soil-derived fungus capable of forming CuO/ZnO nanocomposites was isolated and identified as Aspergillus terreus using 18 S rRNA sequencing. The bioactive constituents in the fungal filtrate were identified using High performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) and Gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS). UV-Vis spectroscopy, transmission electron microscope (TEM), Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy(FTIR), and X-ray diffraction (XRD) were used to characterize the biosynthesized CuO/ZnO nanocomposite. The antibacterial effect against MDR E. coli was examined using disc diffusion and minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) assays, and the influence on virulence and quorum-sensing genes was measured using quantitative reverse transcription PCR (qRT-PCR). The MDR E. coli isolate was resistant to all antibiotics tested. A variety of phenolic acids, flavonoids, and aromatic compounds were detected in the fungal filtrate; however, the filtrate alone did not exhibit antibacterial activity. The CuO/ZnO nanocomposite showed strong antibacterial activity, with an inhibition zone diameter of 2.3 ± 0.4 mm and MIC of 62.5 ± 0.2 µg/mL. Gene expression analysis indicated considerable downregulation of critical virulence genes, including fimH, luxS, toxA, and papC, suggesting impairment of adhesion, toxin synthesis, and quorum sensing. The biosynthesized CuO/ZnO nanocomposite shows strong antibacterial and anti-virulence activity against MDR E. coli, indicating its potential as an alternative antibacterial agent.
articles.abstractZh: 多重耐药（MDR）大肠杆菌的快速传播构成了严重的全球健康风险，需要开发新的抗菌策略。生物制造的金属氧化物纳米复合材料因其卓越的抗菌活性和环境可持续的合成而受到欢迎。这项研究独特地整合了真菌代谢物分析、CuO/ZnO异质结纳米复合材料的绿色合成以及针对临床分离的MDR大肠杆菌的抗毒力活性的分子评估。选择CuO/ZnO系统是因为其具有协同异质结构，与单一金属氧化物相比，它可以增强活性氧的产生并提高抗菌性能。在这项研究中，从伤口感染中分离出一种 MDR 大肠杆菌菌株，并使用 16 S rRNA 测序进行鉴定。分离出一种能够形成 CuO/ZnO 纳米复合材料的土壤来源真菌，并使用 18 S rRNA 测序将其鉴定为土曲霉 (Aspergillus terreus)。使用高效液相色谱（HPLC）和气相色谱-质谱（GC-MS）鉴定真菌滤液中的生物活性成分。紫外-可见光谱、透射

articles.title: Lipid-trap mass spectrometry identifies lipid-protein interactions in cells.
articles.titleZh: 脂质捕获质谱法可识别细胞中的脂质-蛋白质相互作用。
articles.authors: Paquola A, Benson CE, Desale SE, Ozbalci C, Storck EM, Terry SJ, Rao BD, Nwite KN, Ferrentino F, Eggert US.
articles.abstract: Cells actively maintain complex lipidomes that encompass thousands of lipids; however, many of the roles of these lipids remain unexplored. Specific interactions between lipids and membrane proteins are a likely reason for lipidome complexity. Here we report the development of a technique, named lipid-trap mass spectrometry (LTMS), to systematically study lipid-protein interactions directly captured from mammalian cells. LTMS uses immunoprecipitation of GFP-tagged proteins expressed in HeLa cells, followed by lipidomic analysis of lipids bound to the GFP-tagged protein. We applied LTMS to cell division to illustrate the technique. We chose this process because membranes regulate their lipid composition as they undergo major changes during cytokinesis, and many cytokinetic proteins, including RACGAP1 and ESCRT-III components CHMP4B and CHMP2A, are membrane-associated. Using LTMS, we found that RACGAP1 and CHMP4B associate with specific lipid species in dividing compared with non-dividing cells. We expand our understanding of lipid diversity during cell division and present a general approach to explore lipid-protein interactions to further our knowledge of the roles of lipids in mammalian cells.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞积极维持包含数千种脂质的复杂脂质组；然而，这些脂质的许多作用仍有待探索。脂质和膜蛋白之间的特定相互作用可能是脂质组复杂性的原因。在这里，我们报告了一种名为脂质捕获质谱（LTMS）的技术的发展，该技术可系统地研究直接从哺乳动物细胞中捕获的脂质-蛋白质相互作用。 LTMS 对 HeLa 细胞中表达的 GFP 标记蛋白进行免疫沉淀，然后对与 GFP 标记蛋白结合的脂质进行脂质组学分析。我们将 LTMS 应用于细胞分裂来说明该技术。我们选择这个过程是因为膜在胞质分裂过程中经历重大变化时调节其脂质组成，并且许多细胞分裂蛋白（包括 RACGAP1 和 ESCRT-III 成分 CHMP4B 和 CHMP2A）与膜相关。使用 LTMS，我们发现与非分裂细胞相比，RACGAP1 和 CHMP4B 与分裂细胞中的特定脂质种类相关。我们扩展了对细胞分裂过程中脂质多样性的理解，并提出了探索脂质-蛋白质相互作用的通用方法，以进一步了解脂质在哺乳动物细胞中的作用。

articles.title: Nerol as an anti-quorum sensing and therapeutic agent against <i>Acinetobacter baumannii</i> pneumonia.
articles.titleZh: 橙花醇作为抗群体感应和治疗鲍曼不动杆菌肺炎的药物。
articles.authors: Lu Q, Wei S, Sun Y, Liang Z, Li Y, Zeng H.
articles.abstract: Acinetobacter baumannii is a major nosocomial pathogen causing pneumonia; its virulence, biofilm formation, and antibiotic resistance are all regulated by quorum sensing (QS). Nerol, a monoterpene derived from orange peel, exhibits antibacterial activity. This study demonstrates that Nerol exhibits a minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC90) of 0.5 mg/mL against A. baumannii. At subinhibitory concentrations, it inhibits N-acyl-homoserine lactones, biofilm formation, motility, and extracellular polymeric substance (EPS) production. Proteomics revealed synchronous downregulation of virulence proteins, including BfmS, YiaD_1, MacB, MurF, and MtgA. ITC confirmed its 2:1 stoichiometric, exothermic binding to the BfmS sensor domain (KD 1.3 × 10-4 M), disrupting the BfmRS two-component system and blocking downstream QS pathways. Experiments demonstrated that Nerol significantly reduced the gene expression and protein secretion levels of proinflammatory cytokines (TNF-α, IL-6, and IL-1β) by inhibiting the activation of the NF-κB/MAPK signaling cascade. Nerol's ability to counteract QS and alleviate inflammatory responses highlights its potential as a therapeutic agent for treating A. baumannii infections.
articles.abstractZh: 鲍曼不动杆菌是引起肺炎的主要医院病原体；其毒力、生物膜形成和抗生素耐药性均受群体感应（QS）调节。橙花醇是一种从橙皮中提取的单萜，具有抗菌活性。本研究表明橙花醇对鲍曼不动杆菌的最低抑制浓度 (MIC90) 为 0.5 mg/mL。在亚抑制浓度下，它会抑制 N-酰基高丝氨酸内酯、生物膜形成、运动和细胞外聚合物 (EPS) 的产生。蛋白质组学揭示了毒力蛋白的同步下调，包括 BfmS、YiaD_1、MacB、MurF 和 MtgA。 ITC 证实其以 2:1 化学计量、放热的方式与 BfmS 传感器结构域 (KD 1.3 × 10-4 M) 结合，破坏 BfmRS 双组分系统并阻断下游 QS 途径。实验表明，橙花醇通过抑制 NF-κB/MAPK 信号级联的激活，显着降低促炎细胞因子（TNF-α、IL-6 和 IL-1β）的基因表达和蛋白质分泌水平。橙花醇对抗 QS 和减轻炎症反应的能力凸显了其作为治疗鲍曼不动杆菌的治疗剂的潜力

articles.title: Synthesis of some novel coumarin-based heterocycles, elucidation of their antifungal behavior, molecular docking and computational studies.
articles.titleZh: 一些新型香豆素基杂环化合物的合成，阐明其抗真菌行为，分子对接和计算研究。
articles.authors: Ismail MF, Salem MAI, Marzouk MI, Mahmoud NFH, Abdullah NH, Gouda MAS.
articles.abstract: A novel series of coumarin-cyanoacetohydrazide hybrids was synthesized via efficient strategies that exploit the nucleophilic and electrophilic functionalities of the cyanoacetohydrazide scaffold. The designed framework incorporated a C-4 amino-substituted coumarin nucleus, enabling the construction of diverse fused and heteroannulated coumarin derivatives under mild conditions, affording moderate to excellent yields. The structures of all new compounds were confirmed by spectroscopic analyses (IR, MS, 1H, and 13C NMR). Selected derivatives were evaluated for antifungal activity against phytopathogenic fungi. Results revealed that compounds 2, 3, 6, 7, and 8 exhibited notable inhibition, while compound 8 showed the broadest antifungal spectrum and the highest inhibition potency (inhibition zones up to 4.00 ± 0.50 mm). IC50 determination highlighted compounds 2 (0.35 mg/mL) and 3 (< 0.63 mg/mL) as the most potent. At the same time, molecular docking against five key fungal enzymes indicated strong, multi-target binding affinities for compounds 6-8, particularly 8, which showed ΔG values below -8.982 kcal/mol. Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations established correlations between frontier orbital energies, energy gaps, softness, dipole moments, and antifungal performance, suggesting that reduced ΔE and enhanced softness favor the biological activity. These findings identify compound 8 as a promising broad-spectrum antifungal lead and provide valuable structure-activity insights for the rational design of coumarin-based antifungal agents.
articles.abstractZh: 通过利用氰基乙酰肼支架的亲核和亲电子功能的有效策略合成了一系列新型香豆素-氰基乙酰肼杂化物。设计的框架包含一个 C-4 氨基取代的香豆素核，能够在温和条件下构建多种融合和杂环香豆素衍生物，提供中等至优异的产率。所有新化合物的结构均通过光谱分析（IR、MS、1H 和 13C NMR）确认。评估了所选衍生物对植物病原真菌的抗真菌活性。结果显示，化合物2、3、6、7和8表现出显着的抑制作用，而化合物8表现出最广的抗真菌谱和最高的抑制效力（抑制区域达4.00±0.50 mm）。 IC50 测定结果表明化合物 2 (0.35 mg/mL) 和 3 (< 0.63 mg/mL) 的效力最强。同时，针对五种关键真菌酶的分子对接表明化合物 6-8，特别是 8 具有很强的多靶点结合亲和力，其 ΔG 值低于 -8.982 kcal/mol。密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算建立了两者之间的相关性

articles.title: tRNA-deacylase-directed discovery of biosynthetic pathways.
articles.titleZh: tRNA 脱酰酶指导的生物合成途径的发现。
articles.authors: Millar DC, Zhou Y, Marchand JA, Roberts-Mataric H, Chen T, Hu CX, Fang J, Millar S, Stone EA, Pelton JG, Sosa MB, Chang MCY.
articles.abstract: Amino acids are one of nature's most privileged building blocks for generating molecular diversity on length scales ranging from small molecules to proteins. While amino acid products arising from certain class-defined biosynthetic pathways can be found with established bioinformatic strategies, those that fall outside of these types remain difficult to identify. Here, to address this challenge, we have developed an approach to find biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) that utilize and modify amino acid monomers while remaining agnostic to biosynthetic class. We demonstrate that tRNA deacylases specific for host-synthesized non-canonical amino acids (ncAAs) serve as a common genomic marker of ncAA metabolism. Using this approach, we show that thousands of cryptic BGCs can be identified and demonstrate the discovery of BGCs for several distinct ncAAs as well as a hydrazide-containing tripeptide. We anticipate this approach will have broad applications for discovering natural products with ncAAs and beyond.
articles.abstractZh: 氨基酸是自然界中最重要的组成部分之一，用于产生从小分子到蛋白质的长度尺度上的分子多样性。虽然可以通过既定的生物信息学策略找到由某些类别定义的生物合成途径产生的氨基酸产物，但那些不属于这些类型的氨基酸产物仍然难以识别。为了应对这一挑战，我们开发了一种方法来寻找生物合成基因簇（BGC），该基因簇利用和修饰氨基酸单体，同时保持对生物合成类别的不可知性。我们证明，宿主合成的非规范氨基酸 (ncAA) 特异的 tRNA 脱酰酶可作为 ncAA 代谢的常见基因组标记。使用这种方法，我们表明可以识别数千个神秘的 BGC，并证明发现了几种不同的 ncAA 以及含酰肼三肽的 BGC。我们预计这种方法将在发现 ncAA 及其他天然产物方面具有广泛的应用。

articles.title: Branched-chain amino acid catabolism is potentially deficient in pancreatic cancer with high-neural invasion.
articles.titleZh: 支链氨基酸分解代谢在具有高神经侵袭性的胰腺癌中可能存在缺陷。
articles.authors: Michida H, Hagiwara A, Saito Y, Kawasaki N, Kanda M, Kawasaki M, Karakawa S, Suzuki H, Ikeda M, Makinoshima H, Mitsunaga S.
articles.abstract: Elevated plasma branched-chain amino acid (BCAA) levels are observed in some metabolic disorders, such as obesity and diabetes, due to impaired hepatic BCAA catabolism. In pancreatic cancer, elevated plasma BCAA levels are observed years before diagnosis, possibly due to increased protein degradation. However, the status of BCAA catabolism in pancreatic cancer remains unclear. Here, we hypothesized that defective hepatic BCAA utilization contributes to this elevation in pancreatic cancer, similar to observations in obesity and diabetes. Consistent with our hypothesis, increased phosphorylation of the hepatic BCAA catabolic enzyme, branched-chain α-keto acid dehydrogenase (BCKDH), was observed in a murine nerve invasion model with human pancreatic cancer cells, indicative of an inactive state. Notably, this was associated with reduced whole-body BCAA flux, increased skeletal muscle degradation, and elevated plasma BCAA levels. Patients with stage III pancreatic cancer with severe neural invasion exhibited high plasma BCAA and reduced muscle mass. In addition, patients with stage IV pancreatic cancer showed hepatic BCKDH phosphorylation, which correlated with poor prognosis. Overall, these results suggest the potential existence of impaired BCAA catabolism via hepatic BCKDH downregulation in pancreatic cancer.
articles.abstractZh: 由于肝脏 BCAA 分解代谢受损，在一些代谢性疾病（例如肥胖和糖尿病）中观察到血浆支链氨基酸 (BCAA) 水平升高。在胰腺癌中，在诊断前数年就观察到血浆支链氨基酸水平升高，这可能是由于蛋白质降解增加所致。然而，支链氨基酸在胰腺癌中的分解代谢状况仍不清楚。在这里，我们假设肝脏 BCAA 利用率缺陷导致胰腺癌发病率升高，类似于肥胖和糖尿病中的观察结果。与我们的假设一致，在人胰腺癌细胞的小鼠神经侵袭模型中观察到肝脏 BCAA 分解代谢酶、支链 α-酮酸脱氢酶 (BCKDH) 的磷酸化增加，表明处于非活性状态。值得注意的是，这与全身支链氨基酸通量减少、骨骼肌降解增加和血浆支链氨基酸水平升高有关。具有严重神经侵犯的 III 期胰腺癌患者表现出高血浆 BCAA 和减少的肌肉质量。此外，IV期胰腺癌患者表现出肝脏BCKDH磷酸化，这与不良预后相关。全面的，

articles.title: High throughput screen reveals four compounds with novel antifungal activity, including a metal-responsive candidate with in vivo efficacy against Candida albicans.
articles.titleZh: 高通量筛选揭示了四种具有新型抗真菌活性的化合物，其中包括一种具有体内抗白色念珠菌功效的金属响应候选化合物。
articles.authors: Nysten J, Van Campenhout L, Vanhoffelen E, Vande Velde G, Van Dijck P.
articles.abstract: Fungal infections represent a growing global health concern, aggravated by the paucity of effective antifungal therapies and the rapid rise of drug resistance. The development of new treatments is challenging due to the shared eukaryotic biology of fungi and human hosts, which restricts selective molecular targets and contributes to issues such as host toxicity and fungistatic activity. These challenges underscore the pressing need for new agents with distinct modes of action. In this study, we identified four promising compounds with novel antifungal activity from a high-throughput screen of 20,000 compounds against the opportunistic fungal pathogen, Candida albicans, namely Z1199266541, Z1024453766, Z56842335, and Z126932704. Subsequently, the compounds were characterized in vitro to assess their spectrum of activity, efficacy against a fluconazole-resistant isolate (CaCi-17), and effectiveness in combination treatments, followed by in vivo evaluation in a Galleria mellonella infection model. Among the candidates, Z56842335 emerged as a lead compound, effectively clearing infection caused by the Candida albicans in this invertebrate model. Mechanistic analyses revealed that the antifungal activity of Z56842335 is mitigated by supplementation with iron, copper, and zinc, indicating a metal-dependent mode of action. Notably, despite its apparent metal-binding capacity, Z56842335 displays a narrow spectrum of activity, targeting only C. albicans and, to a lesser extent C. dubliniensis. This selectivity suggests that, in addition to metal availability, species-specific factors such as differences in metal acquisition, intracellular metal buffering, or compound uptake or accumulation may contribute to susceptibility, highlighting a promising yet mechanistically intriguing avenue for further investigation.
articles.abstractZh: 真菌感染是一个日益严重的全球健康问题，有效抗真菌疗法的缺乏和耐药性的迅速上升加剧了这一问题。由于真菌和人类宿主具有共同的真核生物学特性，这限制了选择性分子靶标并导致宿主毒性和抑菌活性等问题，因此新疗法的开发具有挑战性。这些挑战凸显了对具有不同作用模式的新药物的迫切需求。在这项研究中，我们从针对机会性真菌病原体白色念珠菌的 20,000 种化合物的高通量筛选中鉴定出了四种具有新型抗真菌活性的有前途的化合物，即 Z1199266541、Z1024453766、Z56842335 和 Z126932704。随后，对这些化合物进行了体外表征，以评估其活性谱、对氟康唑耐药分离株 (CaCi-17) 的功效以及联合治疗的有效性，然后在大蜡螟感染模型中进行体内评估。在候选药物中，Z56842335 作为先导化合物出现，有效清除该无脊椎动物模型中白色念珠菌引起的感染。机理分析表明，

articles.title: Comparative analysis towards the identification of genome wide characteristics of a beneficial fungal endophyte.
articles.titleZh: 比较分析鉴定有益真菌内生菌的全基因组特征。
articles.authors: Tsiouri O, Argyri A, Skiada V, Avramidou M, Dadami E, Vasileiadis S, Papadopoulou KK.
articles.abstract: Fusarium solani strain K (FsK) is an endophytic fungus with a wide host range that protects its host plants against pathogens and environmental stresses. In this study, we performed de novo genome sequencing and annotation, while a phylogenomic analysis confirmed the placement of FsK within the Fusarium solani species complex (FSSC). A comprehensive comparative genomics analysis was conducted with the closely-related pathogenic Fusarium vanettenii 77-13-4 species as well as two beneficial fungal species, the basidiomycete Serendipita indica and the arbuscular mycorrhizal fungus Rhizophagus irregularis, both model symbiotic organisms in their respective fungal division. All fungal strains can colonize tomato as a common host. To identify mechanisms of early-stage FsK-plant interaction and fungal adaptation, comparative analysis of secreted effectors, carbohydrate-active enzymes and secondary metabolite clusters, was performed. FsK specific genes implicated in DNA repair and iron acquisition via ferrirhodin synthesis were identified, highlighting adaptation to stress conditions and possible mutualistic functions with plant hosts. These findings provide insights into the genomic determinants of lifestyles of root colonizing fungi and establish a foundation for future functional studies on fungal-plant interactions in agricultural contexts.
articles.abstractZh: 茄病镰刀菌 K 株 (FsK) 是一种内生真菌，具有广泛的宿主范围，可保护宿主植物免受病原体和环境胁迫的侵害。在这项研究中，我们进行了从头基因组测序和注释，同时系统发育分析证实了 FsK 在茄病镰刀菌物种复合体 (FSSC) 中的位置。对密切相关的致病性 Fusarium v​​anettenii 77-13-4 物种以及两种有益真菌物种（担子菌 Serendipita indica 和丛枝菌根真菌 Rhizophagus irrepargeis）进行了全面的比较基因组学分析，这两种真菌都是各自真菌部门的共生模型。所有真菌菌株都可以作为共同宿主定殖在番茄上。为了确定早期 FsK-植物相互作用和真菌适应的机制，对分泌效应子、碳水化合物活性酶和次级代谢物簇进行了比较分析。鉴定了与 DNA 修复和通过铁红蛋白合成获取铁有关的 FsK 特异性基因，强调了对胁迫条件的适应以及与植物宿主可能的互利功能。这些发现提供了对基因组阻止的见解

articles.title: Impact of black garlic and its encapsulated form on the physicochemical properties, antioxidant potential, and aroma-active profile of wheat bread.
articles.titleZh: 黑蒜及其胶囊形式对小麦面包的理化特性、抗氧化潜力和香气活性特征的影响。
articles.authors: Kelebek H, Sasmaz HK, Yazici GN, Sevindik O, Guclu G, Uzlasir T, Aksay Ö, Ozer MS, Selli S.
articles.abstract: This study investigated the impact of black garlic (BG) and encapsulated black garlic (EBG) additions (2–8%) on the physicochemical properties, antioxidant potential, aroma profile, and sensory characteristics of bread. Antioxidant capacity, measured by DPPH and ABTS assays, was highest in bread with 8% BG, while total phenolic content increased from 48.27 mg/100 g in the control to 86.56 mg/100 g. LC-ESI-MS/MS revealed significant increases in citric, malic, succinic, and pyroglutamic acids with BG addition. Texture profile analysis revealed that hardness significantly increased with BG addition, reaching 1214.67 g in 8% BG bread compared to 237.39 g in the control, while chewiness also followed an upward trend. In contrast, resilience decreased from 0.57 to 0.29 with 8% BG enrichment. HS-SPME-GC-MS and GC-O identified sulfur-containing compounds, especially diallyl disulfide and allyl methyl trisulfide, as key contributors to the distinctive aroma of BG- and EBG-enriched breads. Sensory evaluation showed overall acceptability scores between 3.78 and 4.10, with 8% BG bread rated highest for flavor and aroma. These findings indicate that BG and EBG can enhance both the functional and sensory qualities of bread, supporting their potential as innovative ingredients in commercial bakery products.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究调查了黑蒜 (BG) 和胶囊黑蒜 (EBG) 添加量 (2-8%) 对面包理化特性、抗氧化潜力、香气特征和感官特性的影响。通过 DPPH 和 ABTS 测定法测量，BG 为 8% 的面包的抗氧化能力最高，而总酚含量从对照的 48.27 mg/100 g 增加到 86.56 mg/100 g。 LC-ESI-MS/MS 显示添加 BG 后柠檬酸、苹果酸、琥珀酸和焦谷氨酸显着增加。质构分析显示，添加 BG 后硬度显着增加，8% BG 面包的硬度达到 1214.67 克，而对照面包为 237.39 克，而咀嚼度也呈上升趋势。相比之下，当 BG 富集 8% 时，弹性从 0.57 下降到 0.29。 HS-SPME-GC-MS 和 GC-O 鉴定出含硫化合物，尤其是二烯丙基二硫化物和烯丙基甲基三硫化物，是富含 BG 和 EBG 的面包独特香气的关键因素。感官评价显示总体可接受性得分在 3.78 至 4.10 之间，其中 8% BG 面包的风味和香气评价最高。这些发现表明 BG 和 EBG 可以增强功能性

articles.title: Inhibition of Candida albicans yeast-to-hypha transition and virulence by cyclic dipeptides derived from probiotic Aeromonas veronii V03.
articles.titleZh: 源自益生菌维罗尼气单胞菌 V03 的环状二肽对白色念珠菌从酵母到菌丝的转变和毒力的抑制。
articles.authors: Sekar J, Parasuraman G, Shanmugam A, Dharumadurai D, Dileep Kumar BS, Natesan S.
articles.abstract: Candida albicans, a common opportunistic fungal pathogen, poses serious clinical challenges due to multidrug resistance and limited therapeutic options. In this study, four cyclic dipeptides (diketopiperazines, DKPs), cyclo(L-Pro-L-Leu), cyclo(L-Pro-L-Val), cyclo(D-Pro-L-Phe), and cyclo(L-Pro-D-Tyr) were isolated from the probiotic bacterium Aeromonas veronii strainV03 and evaluated for antimicrobial and antivirulence activities. All DKPs exhibited broad-spectrum antibacterial and antifungal effects, with cyclo(D-Pro-L-Phe) exhibiting particularly potent activity against C. albicans, with minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) values lower than the standard antifungal amphotericin B under the tested conditions. The DKPs also significantly inhibited key virulence traits of C. albicans, including yeast-to-hypha transition, secreted hydrolase activities (aspartic proteases and phospholipases), and biofilm formation, in a dose-dependent manner. Molecular docking revealed strong binding affinities of the DKPs to virulence-associated proteins, including ERG1, ERG11, HGC1, HWP1, SAP2, SAP5, and ALS1, consistent with their observed antivirulence effects. These findings highlight DKPs from A. veronii V03 as promising antivirulence agents and potential leads for alternative antifungal therapeutics.
articles.abstractZh: 白色念珠菌是一种常见的机会性真菌病原体，由于多重耐药性和有限的治疗选择，带来了严重的临床挑战。在本研究中，从益生菌维氏气单胞菌菌株 V03 中分离出四种环状二肽（二酮哌嗪，DKP）、环（L-Pro-L-Leu）、环（L-Pro-L-Val）、环（D-Pro-L-Phe）和环（L-Pro-D-Tyr），并评估其抗菌和抗毒活性。所有DKP均表现出广谱抗菌和抗真菌作用，其中环(D-Pro-L-Phe)对白色念珠菌表现出特别有效的活性，在测试条件下其最低抑菌浓度(MIC)值低于标准抗真菌两性霉素B。 DKP 还以剂量依赖性方式显着抑制白色念珠菌的关键毒力特征，包括酵母到菌丝的转变、分泌的水解酶活性（天冬氨酸蛋白酶和磷脂酶）和生物膜形成。分子对接显示 DKP 与毒力相关蛋白（包括 ERG1、ERG11、HGC1、HWP1、SAP2、SAP5 和 ALS1）具有很强的结合亲和力，这与观察到的抗毒作用一致。这些发现凸显了 DKP

articles.title: New predicted dual CDK-2/CDK-1 inhibitors from Aspergillus unguis isolate SP51-EGY with relative selectivity for colorectal cancer cells: a computational and experimental approach.
articles.titleZh: 新预测的来自曲霉分离物 SP51-EGY 的双重 CDK-2/CDK-1 抑制剂对结直肠癌细胞具有相对选择性：一种计算和实验方法。
articles.authors: El-Rashedy AA, Ibrahim AM, Abdel-Aziz MS, Fayad W, El-Hady FKA.
articles.abstract: Colorectal cancer is one of the deadliest cancers in the world. The main problem with cancer treatments is that they need to protect healthy cells. Cyclin-dependent kinases (CDKs), especially CDK-2 and CDK-1, are essential for regulating the cell cycle, cell growth, and tumor genesis. Their dysregulation is frequently detected in colorectal cancer, resulting in uncontrolled cell division and resistance to apoptosis, making them attractive targets for anticancer therapy. The fungal "Aspergillus unguis isolate SP51-EGY" "Sh cell" (shake mycelia) extract had the most significant cytotoxic action against HCT116 cancer cells (IC50 = 3.49 µg/mL) and a selectivity index (SI = 23.33), indicating relative cytotoxicity against cancer cells. Computational modeling and cellular phenotypic data suggest a potential mechanism of dual CDK2/1 inhibition, forming a testable hypothesis that requires direct enzymatic validation. Compounds corresponding to peaks [7] and [14] have been tentatively assigned as promising CDK inhibitors based on molecular docking studies; due to their: (1) strong binding affinities (-13.23 to -46.05 kcal/mol) confirmed by stable molecular dynamics (RMSD < 2.0 Å); (2) cell cycle arrest mediated by dual CDK2/1 inhibition; and (3) favorable drug-like properties, such as molecular weight < 500 Da, good intestinal absorption, and minimal toxicity. Critical interactions with CDK2 (Tyr16, Phe81) and CDK1 (Met88) active site residues were identified by structural analysis. These interactions competed with ATP to disrupt the CDK2 cyclin A and CDK1/cyclin A/B complexes, which resulted in both G1/S and G2/M cell cycle arrests. These integrated computational and cellular findings suggest that the fungal-derived compounds are promising candidates for novel dual CDK2/CDK1 inhibitors, warranting further experimental validation through biochemical kinase assays.
articles.abstractZh: 结直肠癌是世界上最致命的癌症之一。癌症治疗的主要问题是它们需要保护健康细胞。细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶 (CDK)，尤其是 CDK-2 和 CDK-1，对于调节细胞周期、细胞生长和肿瘤发生至关重要。它们的失调在结直肠癌中经常被发现，导致不受控制的细胞分裂和细胞凋亡抵抗，使它们成为抗癌治疗的有吸引力的目标。真菌“曲霉分离株 SP51-EGY”“Sh 细胞”（摇动菌丝体）提取物对 HCT116 癌细胞具有最显着的细胞毒性作用 (IC50 = 3.49 µg/mL) 和选择性指数 (SI = 23.33)，表明对癌细胞的相对细胞毒性。计算模型和细胞表型数据表明了双重 CDK2/1 抑制的潜在机制，形成了需要直接酶验证的可检验假设。根据分子对接研究，对应于峰 [7] 和 [14] 的化合物已被初步指定为有前途的 CDK 抑制剂；由于它们：（1）稳定的分子动力学（RMSD < 2.0 Å）证实了强结合亲和力（-13.23 至 -46.05 kcal/mol）； (2) 细胞

articles.title: Optimization of polyhydroxyalkanoate biopolymer production from lignocellulosic wood waste using statistical experimental designs.
articles.titleZh: 使用统计实验设计优化木质纤维素木材废料的聚羟基链烷酸酯生物聚合物生产。
articles.authors: Kumar M, Jassim AY, Sachan RSK, Kumar D, Selvaraj M, Kumar G, Sarangi MK, Mohan A, Karnwal A, Nesterova N.
articles.abstract: Plastic pollution, resulting from the persistence of conventional polymers, remains a critical environmental challenge that necessitates the development of biodegradable alternatives. Polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHAs) represent an attractive solution, being naturally synthesized by microorganisms under nutrient-limited conditions. This study investigates the production of PHAs using lignocellulosic wood waste, specifically sal and teak residues, as an economical carbon source. Fermentable sugars were obtained via dilute sulfuric acid hydrolysis (10% w/v biomass with 4% v/v H2SO4), incubated at 120 °C for 1 h, and filtered to yield a hydrolysate containing approximately ~ 36 mg/mL total reducing sugars (DNS assay). The hydrolysate served as the carbon source in bioprocess optimization (optimal carbon concentration: 2.50%, equivalent to 25 g/L). Potential PHA-producing isolates were screened using Nile Blue and Sudan Black staining. The most efficient producer, Klebsiella pneumoniae strain DSM 30,104 (MK2023), confirmed through 16 S rRNA sequencing, demonstrated notable PHA accumulation. Process parameters-including carbon and nitrogen concentrations and Temperature-were optimized through Plackett-Burman Design (PBD) followed by Response Surface Methodology (RSM) using a face-centered central composite design. Optimal production was achieved at 2.50% carbon, 0.105% nitrogen, and 34 °C, yielding 5.7 mg/mL PHA after 72 h with 10% (v/v) inoculum. UV-Vis and FTIR analyses confirmed the polymer's identity as polyhydroxybutyrate (PHB). The study highlights wood waste as a viable, low-cost substrate for PHA synthesis, promoting sustainable biopolymer production while advancing circular bioeconomy practices.
articles.abstractZh: 由于传统聚合物的持久存在而造成的塑料污染仍然是一个严峻的环境挑战，因此需要开发可生物降解的替代品。聚羟基脂肪酸酯 (PHA) 是一种有吸引力的解决方案，由微生物在营养有限的条件下自然合成。本研究调查了使用木质纤维素木材废料（特别是盐和柚木残留物）作为经济碳源生产 PHA 的方法。通过稀硫酸水解（10% w/v 生物质和 4% v/v H2SO4）获得可发酵糖，在 120°C 下孵育 1 小时，过滤得到含有约 36 mg/mL 总还原糖的水解产物（DNS 测定）。水解产物作为生物过程优化中的碳源（最佳碳浓度：2.50%，相当于25 g/L）。使用尼罗蓝和苏丹黑染色筛选潜在的 PHA 生产菌株。通过 16 S rRNA 测序证实，最高效的生产者肺炎克雷伯菌菌株 DSM 30,104 (MK2023) 表现出显着的 PHA 积累。工艺参数（包括碳和氮浓度以及温度）经过优化

articles.title: PYEAST - A Computational Toolkit for Saccharomyces cerevisiae Genetic Engineering.
articles.titleZh: PYEAST - 酿酒酵母基因工程计算工具包。
articles.authors: Madika A, Suri A, Purohit A, Van Raad D, Norman M, Hartley CJ, Loan TD.
articles.abstract: Saccharomyces cerevisiae is a widely used biotechnological workhorse in both academic and industrial settings. One reason for its continued popularity is the extensive legacy of genetic tools, developed over its long history of use, that enable precise manipulation of the S. cerevisiae genome. These tools have enabled extensive genetic characterization and dramatic re-programming efforts for applications ranging from fundamental research to industrial chemical production. However, existing software is often designed for automated pipelines and can be cumbersome to integrate into existing laboratories. Here we present a digital toolkit called PYEAST (Python Enabled Automated Strain Transformation) that encodes some of the most widely used methods for working with S. cerevisiae, modernizes them to leverage advances in DNA synthesis, and facilitates digital sequence management.
articles.abstractZh: 酿酒酵母是学术和工业领域广泛使用的生物技术主力。其持续受欢迎的原因之一是遗传工具的广泛遗产，这些工具是在其长期使用历史中开发出来的，能够精确操作酿酒酵母基因组。这些工具为从基础研究到工业化学品生产的应用提供了广泛的遗传表征和戏剧性的重新编程工作。然而，现有的软件通常是为自动化管道设计的，集成到现有实验室中可能很麻烦。在这里，我们展示了一个名为 PYEAST（Python 支持的自动菌株转换）的数字工具包，它编码了一些最广泛使用的酿酒酵母方法，使它们现代化以利用 DNA 合成的进步，并促进数字序列管理。

articles.title: Computational identification of conserved dengue virus envelope protein epitopes for vaccine design and immunodiagnostic platform.
articles.titleZh: 用于疫苗设计和免疫诊断平台的保守登革热病毒包膜蛋白表位的计算鉴定。
articles.authors: da Silva MK, Fulco UL, Alqahtani T, Sindi ER, Oliveira JIN, Zerihun YA, Zaki MEA, Akter S.
articles.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) remains a major global health challenge, with its incidence increasing sharply over the past two decades. More than 390 million infections occur annually, affecting nearly half of the world’s population. Despite progress in vaccine research, the coexistence of four antigenically distinct dengue virus serotypes (DENV1-4) complicates vaccine and diagnostic development, emphasizing the urgent need for improved preventive and diagnostic strategies. Immunoinformatics and computational vaccinology are powerful tools to elucidate host–pathogen interactions and accelerate vaccine and diagnostic discovery. As vaccination remains the most effective strategy to reduce the dengue burden and accurate diagnostics are essential for surveillance, this study identified conserved and serotype-specific dengue epitopes to support vaccine and diagnostic development. We conducted a comprehensive in silico analysis of the DENV envelope (E) protein across all four serotypes to identify conserved and serotype-specific T-cell and B-cell epitopes. Molecular docking was performed to evaluate HLA-binding affinity between predicted epitopes and their corresponding alleles, and intrinsically disordered regions of the dengue envelope protein were analyzed to identify flexible segments potentially involved in immune recognition. Finally, normal mode analysis was carried out to assess the structural flexibility and stability of the resulting epitope–HLA complexes. Our analysis revealed highly conserved CD8+ (CD4 +) epitopes, such as E57, E135, E175, E313 and E417 (E133, E134, and E234) that remain antigenic despite sequence variation, suggesting their potential use in a universal dengue vaccine. We also identified distinct serotype-specific epitopes, which could serve as molecular signatures for precise immunodiagnostic assays (DENV-2: E236, E267, and E424; DENV-3: E204, E229, E274, E350, and E410; and DENV-4: E402, E403, E65, and E446). Population coverage analysis predicted a global reach of 66.87%, with high representation in East Asia, Europe, and the Americas. Molecular docking and normal mode analyses confirmed stable peptide–HLA interactions with favorable binding energies, particularly for LTDYGALTL–HLA-A01:01 and DTAWDFGSI–HLA-A26:01 complexes. Collectively, this integrative in silico framework identifies epitope candidates that can inform next-generation multivalent dengue vaccines and enhance serotype-specific diagnostic platforms.
articles.abstractZh: 登革热病毒（DENV）仍然是全球主要的健康挑战，其发病率在过去二十年急剧增加。每年发生超过 3.9 亿例感染，影响世界近一半人口。尽管疫苗研究取得了进展，但四种抗原性不同的登革热病毒血清型 (DENV1-4) 的共存使疫苗和诊断开发变得复杂，强调迫切需要改进预防和诊断策略。免疫信息学和计算疫苗学是阐明宿主与病原体相互作用并加速疫苗和诊断发现的强大工具。由于疫苗接种仍然是减少登革热负担的最有效策略，并且准确的诊断对于监测至关重要，因此本研究确定了保守的血清型特异性登革热表位以支持疫苗和诊断的开发。我们对所有四种血清型的 DENV 包膜 (E) 蛋白进行了全面的计算机分析，以确定保守的和血清型特异性的 T 细胞和 B 细胞表位。进行分子对接以评估预测表位与其相应等位基因之间的 HLA 结合亲和力，并且本质上

articles.title: Genomic and phenotypic comparisons reveal lineage-specific traits of the probiotic <i>Saccharomyces boulardii</i>.
articles.titleZh: 基因组和表型比较揭示了益生菌布拉氏酵母菌的谱系特异性特征。
articles.authors: Duffey HE, Hedin KA, Gelli HP, Vaaben TH, Sommer MOA.
articles.abstract: Saccharomyces boulardii is a widely used probiotic yeast, yet its functional distinction from closely related Saccharomyces cerevisiae strains and the consistency of traits across commercial isolates remain unclear. Here, we performed integrated genomic, physiological, metabolic, and host-cell analyses of five S. boulardii isolates and three distinct S. cerevisiae strains. Despite high genomic similarity, S. boulardii exhibited conserved lineage-specific features, including a chromosomal inversion, reduced CAZyme copy numbers, and consistent sequence variation in metabolic pathways. Functionally, S. boulardii isolates showed enhanced acid tolerance, elevated acetate and succinate production, and reproducible immunomodulatory activity, including NF-κB suppression and reduced IL-8 and TNF-α secretion. All isolates consistently activated the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR), unlike other S. cerevisiae strains, which instead displayed faster growth and greater bile tolerance. Overall, probiotic-relevant phenotypes were conserved across S. boulardii, defining it as a functionally coherent probiotic lineage.
articles.abstractZh: 布拉酵母菌是一种广泛使用的益生菌酵母，但其与密切相关的酿酒酵母菌株的功能区别以及商业分离株之间性状的一致性仍不清楚。在这里，我们对五种布拉氏酵母菌分离株和三种不同的酿酒酵母菌株进行了综合基因组、生理学、代谢和宿主细胞分析。尽管基因组相似性很高，布拉氏酵母菌仍表现出保守的谱系特异性特征，包括染色体倒位、CAZyme 拷贝数减少以及代谢途径中一致的序列变异。在功能上，布拉氏酵母菌分离株表现出增强的耐酸性、增加的乙酸盐和琥珀酸盐产量以及可重复的免疫调节活性，包括 NF-κB 抑制和减少 IL-8 和 TNF-α 分泌。与其他酿酒酵母菌株不同，所有分离株均一致激活芳基碳氢化合物受体（AhR），后者表现出更快的生长和更强的胆汁耐受性。总体而言，布拉氏链球菌的益生菌相关表型是保守的，将其定义为功能一致的益生菌谱系。

articles.title: Green synthesis, characterization, evaluation of anticancer and antioxidant potentials of gold and copper oxide nanoparticles using jujube fruit extract.
articles.titleZh: 使用枣果提取物绿色合成、表征、评价金和氧化铜纳米粒子的抗癌和抗氧化潜力。
articles.authors: Demir Becerekli H, Akbaş F.
articles.abstract: Metallic nanoparticles synthesized via plant extracts under green chemistry principles exhibit unique physicochemical and biological properties. In this study, for the first time, gold nanoparticles (AuNPs) and copper oxide nanoparticles (CuO NPs) were synthesized using Ziziphus jujuba Mill. fruit extract as a natural reducing and stabilizing agent. The biosynthesized nanoparticles were comprehensively characterized by UV-Vis, SEM-EDX, TEM, FTIR, XRD, and DLS analyses, confirming their nanoscale size, crystalline structure, and surface functionalization by plant-derived biomolecules. The antioxidant potential of the nanoparticles was evaluated using DPPH and ABTS radical scavenging assays, revealing effective free radical scavenging activity, with AuNPs exhibiting comparatively higher antioxidant performance. Cytotoxicity studies performed on A549, MDA-MB-231, and SH-SY5Y cancer cell lines demonstrated a significant, concentration-dependent reduction in cell viability, while relatively lower toxicity was observed in healthy L929 fibroblast cells. Notably, CuO NPs showed stronger cytotoxic effects compared to AuNPs, highlighting differences in their biological behavior.
