Using real-time single-molecule fluorescence measurements, biochemical assays, and cryo-EM analysis, we show that human mitochondrial translation initiation occurs through two parallel pathways. In one pathway, leaderless mRNA first loads onto the 28S small subunit, followed by recruitment of the 39S large subunit to form the 55S initiation complex. In the second pathway, a preassembled 55S monosome directly loads onto leaderless mRNA. Both pathways require recruitment of mtIF2 and fMet-tRNAMet before mRNA binding. However, the monosome-loading pathway tolerates non-formylated Met-tRNAMet and is suppressed by mtIF3. Together, these findings define the heterogeneous pathways of human mitochondrial translation initiation on leaderless mRNAs.
articles.abstractZh: 线粒体翻译对于细胞功能至关重要，其失调与线粒体疾病和癌症有关。然而，人类线粒体核糖体启动翻译的机制仍然知之甚少，特别是因为线粒体 mRNA 通常缺乏指导细菌和细胞质系统中翻译启动的 5' 非翻译区。使用实时单分子荧光测量、生化测定和冷冻电镜分析，我们表明人类线粒体翻译起始是通过两条平行途径发生的。在一种途径中，无前导序列的 mRNA 首先加载到 28S 小亚基上，然后招募 39S 大亚基形成 55S 起始复合物。在第二条途径中，预组装的 55S 单体直接加载到无前导序列 mRNA 上。两种途径都需要在 mRNA 结合之前募集 mtIF2 和 fMet-tRNAMet。然而，单体加载途径可耐受非甲酰化 Met-tRNAMet，并被 mtIF3 抑制。总之，这些发现定义了无前导 mRNA 上人类线粒体翻译起始的异质途径。

articles.title: Preparation of starch/PVA/Cu-NPs bio-nanocomposites in packing as preservation of UF soft cheese.
articles.titleZh: 淀粉/PVA/Cu-NPs生物纳米复合材料的制备用于包装超滤软奶酪的保鲜。
articles.authors: El-Refai HA, Gomaa SK, Zaki RA, El-Sayed SM, El-Sayed HS, Hassan YR, Elrefaey A, Abd El-Aziz ME.
articles.abstract: This study represents the biosynthesis of copper oxide nanoparticles (CuO-NPs) via bacteria and their utilization in the synthesis of a bio-nanocomposite based on starch (St) and polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) to be applied in preserving ultrafiltration (UF) soft cheese. The bio-nanocomposites were synthesized by blending St/PVA with a ratio of 4:1 wt, wt and loaded with various concentrations of CuO-NPs (0, 20, 40, and 80 mg) to obtain bio-nanocomposite coatings S1, S2, S3, and S4, respectively. The coatings' mechanical strength, water and oxygen barrier quality, morphology, and crystallinity were all studied. The chemical composition, microbial load, total solids, and pH changes for uncoated and coated cheese samples that were stored at 5 ± 2 °C for 60 days were evaluated. Results showed that films loaded with CuO-NPs significantly improved the mechanical and barrier properties of the prepared films, in addition to reducing the moisture loss and microbial growth and extending the shelf life of the coated cheese. In addition, the bio-nanocomposite coating loaded with higher CuO-NP concentrations (S3 and S4) showed superior antimicrobial effects, indicating their potential as active edible coatings for cheese preservation.
articles.abstractZh: 这项研究展示了通过细菌生物合成氧化铜纳米颗粒（CuO-NP），以及它们在合成基于淀粉（St）和聚乙烯醇（PVA）的生物纳米复合材料中的应用，该复合材料可用于保存超滤（UF）软奶酪。将St/PVA以4:1 wt: wt的比例混合并负载不同浓度的CuO-NPs（0、20、40和80 mg）合成生物纳米复合材料，分别获得生物纳米复合材料涂层S1、S2、S3和S4。研究了涂层的机械强度、水和氧阻隔质量、形态和结晶度。对在 5 ± 2 °C 下储存 60 天的未涂层和涂层奶酪样品的化学成分、微生物负荷、总固体量和 pH 值变化进行了评估。结果表明，负载 CuO-NP 的薄膜除了减少水分损失和微生物生长并延长涂层奶酪的保质期外，还显着提高了所制备薄膜的机械和阻隔性能。此外，负载较高 CuO-NP 浓度（S3 和 S4）的生物纳米复合涂层表现出优异的抗菌效果，表明它们作为活性食用菌的潜力。

articles.title: Targeting IP<sub>6</sub> signaling to destabilize homologous recombination proteins to overcome PARP inhibitor resistance.
articles.titleZh: 靶向 IP<sub>6</sub> 信号传导以破坏同源重组蛋白的稳定性，从而克服 PARP 抑制剂耐药性。
articles.authors: Lee SG, Seo Y, Jeong S, Chung Y, Kong S, Kim M, Rhlee JH, Um S, Mathew BP, Maiti S, Kuram MR, Abozeid MA, Park A, Yoo JN, Khim KW, Son K, Amarsanaa E, Kim K, Hong S, Choi J, Park IB, Lee EA, Jeon JH, Park JH, Han JS, Park CY, Kim S, Choi JH, Hong SY, Seo MD, Lee H, Lee JY, Myung K.
articles.abstract: Homologous recombination (HR) is crucial for maintaining genomic integrity and is tightly regulated, yet the role of ubiquitin-dependent degradation in HR proteins remains poorly understood. Through high-throughput screening for compounds that modulate the DNA replication stress response, we identify ML367 and its derivative, UNI418. Kinase profiling and detail molecular analyses reveal that UNI418 inhibits PIKfyve and PIP5K1C, reducing inositol hexaphosphate (IP6) levels and triggering Cul4A-dependent degradation of RAD51, CtIP, and CHK1. Further analysis identifies WDR5 as a DCAF protein that facilitates Cul4A-mediated proteolysis of RAD51 and CHK1. Functionally, UNI418 suppresses HR, enhances tumor sensitivity to PARP inhibitors (PARPis), and re-sensitizes PARPi-resistant tumor cells in both in vitro and in vivo xenograft models. These findings reveal a Cul4A-WDR5-dependent proteolysis pathway regulating HR protein stability via phosphatidyl inositol signaling. This mechanism offers a promising therapeutic strategy for overcoming PARPi resistance and improving combinatorial cancer treatment strategies.
articles.abstractZh: 同源重组 (HR) 对于维持基因组完整性至关重要，并且受到严格调控，但 HR 蛋白中泛素依赖性降解的作用仍知之甚少。通过高通量筛选调节 DNA 复制应激反应的化合物，我们鉴定出 ML367 及其衍生物 UNI418。激酶分析和详细分子分析表明，UNI418 抑制 PIKfyve 和 PIP5K1C，降低肌醇六磷酸 (IP6) 水平并触发 Cul4A 依赖性 RAD51、CtIP 和 CHK1 降解。进一步分析确定 WDR5 是一种 DCAF 蛋白，可促进 Cul4A 介导的 RAD51 和 CHK1 蛋白水解。从功能上讲，UNI418 可抑制 HR，增强肿瘤对 PARP 抑制剂 (PARPis) 的敏感性，并在体外和体内异种移植模型中使 PARPi 耐药肿瘤细胞重新敏感。这些发现揭示了 Cul4A-WDR5 依赖性蛋白水解途径通过磷脂酰肌醇信号传导调节 HR 蛋白稳定性。该机制为克服 PARPi 耐药性和改进组合癌症治疗策略提供了一种有前景的治疗策略。

articles.title: UPLC profiling of matcha extract capping biosynthesized copper oxide nanoparticles and their antimicrobial and cytotoxic potentials.
articles.titleZh: UPLC 分析抹茶提取物覆盖生物合成的氧化铜纳米颗粒及其抗菌和细胞毒性潜力。
articles.authors: Batouti ME, Al-Harby NF, Abdelwahab MS, Metwally RA.
articles.abstract: This research demonstrates a green synthesis and subsequent functionalization process of copper oxide nanoparticles (CuO NPs) utilizing matcha green tea extract as a sustainable reducing and functionalizing agent. UPLC-MS analysis revealed the presence of significant bioactive phytochemicals, notably epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG), which is implicated in the reduction process. Thorough characterisation (XRD, FT-IR, SEM) verified the synthesis of pure, crystalline, monoclinic CuO NPs with an average size of 16-24 nm. The nanoparticles had considerable antibacterial activity, exhibiting robust efficacy against Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus aureus, with a minimum inhibitory concentration of 250 µg/ml. CuO NPs-matcha exhibited significant, dose-dependent cytotoxicity against MCF-7 and Caco-2 carcinoma cells, with IC₅₀ values of 122.1 and 161.9 µg/ml, respectively. Crucially, they demonstrated markedly reduced toxicity towards non-cancerous Vero cells (IC₅₀ = 333.2 µg/ml), yielding selectivity indices of 2.73 and 2.06, which confirms a favorable selective profile. Although the positive control doxorubicin showed greater potency (lower IC₅₀), the CuO NPs-Matcha demonstrated significantly higher selectivity for cancer cells, suggesting a potentially improved safety profile despite its lower efficacy. These findings underscore the matcha-synthesized CuO NPs as a highly promising and biocompatible nanomaterial for specific medicinal applications, particularly in antibacterial and anticancer therapies.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究展示了利用抹茶绿茶提取物作为可持续还原剂和功能化剂的氧化铜纳米粒子（CuO NPs）的绿色合成和后续功能化过程。 UPLC-MS 分析表明存在重要的生物活性植物化学物质，特别是表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯 (EGCG)，它参与了还原过程。彻底的表征（XRD、FT-IR、SEM）验证了平均尺寸为 16-24 nm 的纯结晶单斜 CuO 纳米粒子的合成。该纳米粒子具有相当大的抗菌活性，对大肠杆菌和金黄色葡萄球菌表现出强大的功效，最低抑菌浓度为250 µg/ml。 CuO NPs-抹茶对 MCF-7 和 Caco-2 癌细胞表现出显着的剂量依赖性细胞毒性，IC₅₀ 值分别为 122.1 和 161.9 µg/ml。至关重要的是，他们证明对非癌性 Vero 细胞的毒性显着降低（IC50 = 333.2 µg/ml），产生的选择性指数为 2.73 和 2.06，这证实了良好的选择性特征。尽管阳性对照阿霉素显示出更大的效力（较低的 IC₅₀），但 CuO NPs-Matcha 表现出显着的效果。

articles.title: Zebrafish gon4la mutants recapitulate human GON4L-related growth disorders and reveal novel metabolic organs abnormalities.
articles.titleZh: 斑马鱼 gon4la 突变体重现了人类 GON4L 相关的生长障碍，并揭示了新的代谢器官异常。
articles.authors: Tsai SM, Hsu CH, Chiang IC, Liao WN, Chen JK, Jiang YJ.
articles.abstract: Biallelic mutations in human GON4L have been linked to short stature, craniofacial abnormalities, and microcephaly, yet the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. GON4L is a nuclear protein composed of a YY1AP1-like region, two PAH domains, and one SANT domain, all implicated in transcriptional or chromatin regulation. Here, we define the function of Gon4la (a zebrafish ortholog of human GON4L) in post-embryonic growth and tissue homeostasis. We generated three gon4la mutant lines using CRISPR-Cas9, each predicted to express truncated proteins lacking the C-terminal PAH/SANT domains and differing in N-terminal YY1AP1-like region retention. All gon4la mutants displayed proportionate dwarfism with intestinal and pancreatic abnormalities, accompanied by expanded progenitor proliferation and impaired epithelial differentiation. Only mutants completely lacking the N-terminal YY1AP1-like region exhibited reduced igf1a expression, elevated growth hormone pathway activity, and increased mortality, consistent with endocrine dysregulation. Our findings demonstrate that distinct domains of Gon4la contribute differentially to systemic growth and metabolic organ homeostasis. Zebrafish gon4la mutants provide a tractable vertebrate model for dissecting mechanisms of GON4L-related developmental disorder, Li-Takada-Miyake syndrome (LTMS), and for functional testing of rare GON4L variants.
articles.abstractZh: 人类 GON4L 的双等位基因突变与身材矮小、颅面异常和小头畸形有关，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。 GON4L 是一种核蛋白，由一个 YY1AP1 样区域、两个 PAH 结构域和一个 SANT 结构域组成，所有这些都与转录或染色质调节有关。在这里，我们定义了 Gon4la（人类 GON4L 的斑马鱼直系同源物）在胚胎后生长和组织稳态中的功能。我们使用 CRISPR-Cas9 生成了三个 gon4la 突变体系，每个突变体系都预测表达缺乏 C 端 PAH/SANT 结构域且 N 端 YY1AP1 样区域保留不同的截短蛋白。所有 gon4la 突变体均表现出相应的侏儒症，伴有肠道和胰腺异常，并伴有祖细胞增殖扩大和上皮分化受损。只有完全缺乏 N 端 YY1AP1 样区域的突变体才会表现出 igf1a 表达减少、生长激素途径活性升高和死亡率增加，这与内分泌失调一致。我们的研究结果表明，Gon4la 的不同结构域对系统生长和代谢器官稳态的贡献不同。斑马鱼 gon4la mut

articles.title: A GPS2-like protein interacts with HOS15 and HDA6 to form a repressor complex that regulates ABA signaling and drought adaptation in Arabidopsis.
articles.titleZh: GPS2 样蛋白与 HOS15 和 HDA6 相互作用，形成阻遏复合物，调节拟南芥中的 ABA 信号传导和干旱适应。
articles.authors: Ali A, Zareen S, Bader ZE, Park J, Khan IU, Park K, Albakri N, Bae MJ, Bressan RA, Pardo JM, Yun DJ, Xu ZY.
articles.abstract: Plants rely on chromatin-mediated transcriptional control to fine-tune stress responses; however, the evolutionary conservation and functional diversification of repressor complexes remain incompletely understood. Here, we identify GPS2-like protein (GPL) as the missing component of the plant counterpart of the animal nuclear receptor-corepressor complex. GPL interacts with HOS15, PWR, and HDA6/HDA9 to form a chromatin repressor module that suppresses abscisic acid (ABA)-responsive genes. Loss-of-function gpl mutants exhibit ABA hypersensitivity and enhanced drought tolerance, whereas GPL overexpression confers ABA insensitivity. Mechanistically, GPL promotes histone H3K9 deacetylation and dimethylation at stress-responsive loci and stabilizes HOS15 to ensure its nuclear retention. Global RNA sequencing reveals widespread derepression of ABA-responsive transcriptional networks in gpl mutants. Under stress conditions, ABA destabilizes the GPL-HOS15 complex, relieving repression and activating defense-related genes. These findings establish GPL as the plant homolog of GPS2 and reveal that the GPL-HOS15 repressor complex functions as a chromatin-mediated rheostat to dynamically balance growth and drought adaptation. Our work provides mechanistic insight into stress-responsive chromatin remodeling and identifies GPL as a potential target for engineering climate-resilient crops.
articles.abstractZh: 植物依靠染色质介导的转录控制来微调应激反应；然而，抑制复合物的进化保守性和功能多样化仍未完全被了解。在这里，我们确定 GPS2 样蛋白 (GPL) 是动物核受体-辅阻遏物复合物的植物对应物中缺失的成分。 GPL 与 HOS15、PWR 和 HDA6/HDA9 相互作用，形成染色质阻遏模块，抑制脱落酸 (ABA) 响应基因。功能缺失的 gpl 突变体表现出 ABA 超敏性和增强的耐旱性，而 GPL 过表达则导致 ABA 不敏感。从机制上讲，GPL 促进应激反应位点处的组蛋白 H3K9 脱乙酰化和二甲基化，并稳定 HOS15 以确保其核保留。全局 RNA 测序揭示了 gpl 突变体中 ABA 响应转录网络的广泛去抑制。在应激条件下，ABA 会破坏 GPL-HOS15 复合物的稳定性，从而解除抑制并激活防御相关基因。这些发现将 GPL 确定为 GPS2 的植物同源物，并揭示 GPL-HOS15 阻遏复合物作为染色质介导的变阻器发挥作用，以动态平衡

articles.title: A single viral enzyme drives tRNA-dependent hypermodification of DNA at adenine.
articles.titleZh: 单一病毒酶驱动 tRNA 依赖性 DNA 腺嘌呤超修饰。
articles.authors: Silva RMB, Slyvka A, Lee YJ, Guan C, Lund SR, Raleigh EA, Skowronek K, Kuska MS, Bochtler M, Weigele PR.
articles.abstract: Nucleic acid modifying enzymes drive diverse defense and counter-defense measures in the evolutionary arms race between viruses and their cellular hosts. Abundant and widespread bacterial viruses (bacteriophage or phage) encode for biosynthetic pathways that install elaborate DNA hypermodifications which protect their genomic DNA from host endonucleases. Here, we establish the molecular basis for the multistep biosynthesis of 6-aminocarboxymethyl-2'-deoxyadenosine (6-NcmdA), a nucleobase hypermodification found in the virion DNA of bacteriophage Mu that leads to restriction evasion in the context of phage-host conflicts. In the first step, we show that Mu-encoded Mom enzyme catalyzes the formation of 6-NcmdA by transferring glycine from charged tRNAGly to the N6 position of adenine within double-stranded DNA. We uncover a second step where the glycyl-dA intermediate undergoes an on-base rearrangement to form 6-NcmdA. Examination of the proposed reaction pathways by quantum chemical calculations confirms the instability of acyl exocyclic groups at N6-adenine and reveals an energetically favorable orientation of 6-NcmdA that restores canonical base pairing. An X-ray structure confirms Mom is a member of the GNAT superfamily and suggests binding sites for both tRNA and DNA. Guided by the Mom structure and patterns of sequence conservation across metagenomic space, we show residues R111 and S124 are essential for catalysis. This work demonstrates that the Mom enzyme defines a new category of acetyltransferases utilizing charged tRNA to modify DNA.
articles.abstractZh: 在病毒与其细胞宿主之间的进化军备竞赛中，核酸修饰酶驱动着多种防御和反防御措施。大量且广泛分布的细菌病毒（噬菌体或噬菌体）编码生物合成途径，这些途径安装复杂的 DNA 超修饰，保护其基因组 DNA 免受宿主核酸内切酶的影响。在这里，我们建立了 6-氨基羧甲基-2'-脱氧腺苷 (6-NcmdA) 多步生物合成的分子基础，6-NcmdA 是噬菌体 Mu 病毒体 DNA 中发现的一种核碱基超修饰，可在噬菌体-宿主冲突的情况下导致限制性逃避。第一步，我们证明 Mu 编码的 Mom 酶通过将甘氨酸从带电荷的 tRNAGly 转移到双链 DNA 内腺嘌呤的 N6 位来催化 6-NcmdA 的形成。我们发现了第二步，甘氨酰-dA 中间体经历碱基重排形成 6-NcmdA。通过量子化学计算对所提出的反应途径进行检查，证实了 N6-腺嘌呤处酰基外环基团的不稳定性，并揭示了 6-NcmdA 的能量有利方向，可恢复经典碱基配对。 X射线结构确认

articles.title: In silico design of a multiepitope vaccine against antibiotic drug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii.
articles.titleZh: 针对抗生素耐药鲍曼不动杆菌的多表位疫苗的计算机设计。
articles.authors: Khadka S, Khan MA, Iqbal S, Ullah A, Ahmad A, Khan NZ, Khattak A.
articles.abstract: Acinetobacter baumannii, a member of the ESKAPE pathogens, causes approximately 722,000 infections annually and is notorious for rapidly developing resistance to multiple antibiotics, resulting in poor clinical outcomes. Due to the rapid emergence of drug-resistant strains and limited effective treatments, the World Health Organization has listed A. baumannii as a top-priority pathogen for vaccine development, highlighting the urgent need for novel therapeutic strategies. In this study, we employed an in silico approach to design a multiepitope vaccine (MEV) targeting multidrug-resistant strains by analyzing RNA-seq data from meropenem-resistant isolates. The vaccine non-toxicity, probably antigenic, and non-allergenic nature was predicated via ToxinPred, VaxiJen v2.0, and AllerTOP v2.0 tools. CTL and HTL epitope prediction was carried out using NetMHCpan and NetMHCIIpan respectively. PEP-FOLD3.5 server predicted T-cell epitopes 3D structure. Molecular docking of the modeled epitopes into the MHC binding grooves was performed using the HADDOCK 2.4 web server for strong binding interactions. MD simulations were carried out using GROMACS version 2021.4 for the MEV stability and PCA was performed to identify dominant conformational states during the simulation. C-ImmSim server was used for the simulation of immune response. RNA-seq analysis from meropenem resistant A. baumannii strains, we identified 1,240 significantly upregulated genes linked to resistance mechanisms. From 156 non-homologous proteins, 12 highly conserved, non-allergenic antigenic proteins were selected to predict 12 CTL and 7 HTL epitopes with strong HLA-binding affinity and immunogenic potential. Molecular docking and dynamics simulations confirmed stable epitope-MHC interactions and structural stability of the 335-amino-acid MEV construct, while immune simulations indicated robust activation of innate and adaptive responses. This in silico study lays a promising foundation for vaccine development against A. baumannii and provides a critical step toward future in vitro and in vivo validation.
articles.abstractZh: 鲍曼不动杆菌是 ESKAPE 病原体的一员，每年引起约 722,000 例感染，并且因快速发展对多种抗生素的耐药性而臭名昭著，导致临床结果不佳。由于耐药菌株的迅速出现和有效治疗方法的有限，世界卫生组织已将鲍曼不动杆菌列为疫苗开发的首要病原体，凸显了对新治疗策略的迫切需要。在这项研究中，我们采用计算机模拟方法，通过分析美罗培南耐药菌株的 RNA-seq 数据，设计了针对多重耐药菌株的多表位疫苗 (MEV)。通过 ToxinPred、VaxiJen v2.0 和 AllerTOP v2.0 工具预测疫苗的无毒性、可能的抗原性和非过敏性。分别使用NetMHCpan和NetMHCIIpan进行CTL和HTL表位预测。 PEP-FOLD3.5服务器预测T细胞表位3D结构。使用 HADDOCK 2.4 网络服务器将建模表位分子对接至 MHC 结合槽中，以实现强结合相互作用。使用 GROMACS 版本 2021.4 进行 MD 模拟，以了解 MEV 稳定性和 PCA w

articles.title: Multi-omics profiling finds synbio milk differs nutritionally from bovine milk and contains 93 uncharacterized fungal metabolites and 236 fungal proteins.
articles.titleZh: 多组学分析发现 Synbio 奶在营养上与牛奶不同，含有 93 种未表征的真菌代谢物和 236 种真菌蛋白。
articles.authors: Velamuri R, Yertha T, Fagan J.
articles.abstract: Synbio milk, containing recombinant bovine β-lactoglobulin (β-LG), produced in the fungus Trichoderma reesei, was deficient nutritionally compared to bovine milk. It also contained both fungal proteins and fungal metabolites never verified safe for human consumption. By three independent methods synbio milk was found to contain predominantly fungal protein, not the 90–99% β-LG, claimed by the product developer. By (1) shotgun proteomics, (2) ELISA and classical protein analysis, and (3) simulated mixing experiments, measuring percent deviation of the amino acid composition of synbio milk from that of bovine milk, fungal protein content was found to be 75.1%, 86.5% and 90–95%, respectively. Additionally, high sensitivity untargeted mass spectrometry revealed substantial levels of 69 nutrients in bovine milk, of which only 7 were present in small amounts in synbio milk. This analysis also revealed 93 compounds in synbio milk, byproducts/waste products of fungal fermentation, whose chemical identities could not be established searching large mass spectral databases, suggesting they are novel compounds. Neither these nor the fungal proteins found in the synbio milk have been tested for safety or allergenicity at exposure levels relevant for synbio milk consumption. Therefore, comprehensive toxicity and allergenicity testing are needed to assess the safety of synbio milk for human consumption.
articles.abstractZh: Synbio 牛奶含有由里氏木霉真菌产生的重组牛 β-乳球蛋白 (β-LG)，与牛奶相比营养不足。它还含有从未被证实对人类食用安全的真菌蛋白和真菌代谢物。通过三种独立的方法，发现 Synbio 牛奶主要含有真菌蛋白，而不是产品开发商声称的 90-99% β-LG。通过（1）鸟枪蛋白质组学，（2）ELISA和经典蛋白质分析，以及（3）模拟混合实验，测量合生元奶与牛奶氨基酸组成的偏差百分比，发现真菌蛋白质含量分别为75.1%、86.5%和90-95%。此外，高灵敏度非靶向质谱分析显示牛奶中含有大量 69 种营养物质，其中只有 7 种少量存在于 synbio 牛奶中。该分析还揭示了合成生物奶（真菌发酵的副产品/废物）中的 93 种化合物，通过搜索大型质谱数据库无法确定其化学特性，表明它们是新化合物。这些以及 Synbio 牛奶中发现的真菌蛋白均未经过测试

articles.title: Nuclear translocation of β-catenin in Wg/Wnt signaling via the IFT-A microtubule-associated complex requires Pasovec/Gid8 proteins.
articles.titleZh: Wg/Wnt 信号传导中通过 IFT-A 微管相关复合物进行的 β-连环蛋白核易位需要 Pasovec/Gid8 蛋白。
articles.authors: Vuong LT, Mlodzik M.
articles.abstract: Wg/Wnt signaling is critical throughout development and homeostasis and associated with many diseases, including cancer. Wg/Wnt signaling is mediated by β-catenin (Armadillo/Arm in Drosophila) with the IFT-A/Kinesin2 complex promoting nuclear translocation of β-catenin/Arm. Existing information suggests that additional proteins are involved. Here, we demonstrate that a conserved protein, Pasovec (Psv; Gid8 in mammals), with loss-of-function mutants resembling wg and arm/β-catenin mutant phenotypes, is required for nuclear β-catenin/Arm localization. Psv interacts with the IFT-A/Kinesin2 complex, physically binding IFT140, a core component of IFT-A. The Psv/Gid8-IFT140 association is independent of Wg/Wnt-signaling activation. Psv/Gid8 contains a CRA domain, identified as interacting with RanBPM, which mediates its nuclear localization. Mutations in CRA affect Psv/Gid8's own nuclear localization and that of β-catenin/Arm upon Wg/Wnt-signaling activation. Psv with a mutated CRA can act as an inhibitor of Wg/Wnt signaling. Together, this study describes a previously unidentified factor, required for Wg/Wnt signaling, that functions during the nuclear translocation process of β-catenin/Arm.
articles.abstractZh: Wg/Wnt 信号传导在整个发育和稳态中至关重要，并与包括癌症在内的许多疾病相关。 Wg/Wnt 信号传导由 β-连环蛋白（果蝇中的犰狳/Arm）介导，IFT-A/Kinesin2 复合物促进 β-连环蛋白/Arm 的核转位。现有信息表明还涉及其他蛋白质。在这里，我们证明了一种保守蛋白 Pasovec（Psv；哺乳动物中的 Gid8）具有类似于 wg 和 arm/β-catenin 突变体表型的功能丧失突变体，是核 β-catenin/Arm 定位所必需的。 Psv 与 IFT-A/Kinesin2 复合物相互作用，物理结合 IFT140（IFT-A 的核心成分）。 Psv/Gid8-IFT140 关联独立于 Wg/Wnt 信号传导激活。 Psv/Gid8 包含一个 CRA 结构域，被确定为与 RanBPM 相互作用，介导其核定位。 CRA 突变影响 Psv/Gid8 自身的核定位以及 Wg/Wnt 信号激活后 β-catenin/Arm 的核定位。具有突变 CRA 的 Psv 可以充当 Wg/Wnt 信号传导的抑制剂。总之，这项研究描述了 Wg/Wnt 信号传导所需的一个先前未识别的因子，该因子在 β-连环蛋白的核易位过程中发挥作用

articles.title: Off-label and repurposed use of disulfiram beyond alcohol dependence: A systematic review of clinical and preclinical evidence.
articles.titleZh: 除酒精依赖外双硫仑的标签外和重新用途：临床和临床前证据的系统评价。
articles.authors: Benkő BM, De Brito Parreirinha NS, Sebe I, Zelkó R.
articles.abstract: This systematic review assesses off-label and repurposed uses of disulfiram (DIS) beyond alcohol dependence, synthesizing clinical trials, case reports, and preclinical studies (2015-2025) per PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Database and registry searches yielded 229 studies: 44 clinical trials (mainly cancer, infectious diseases) and 185 articles. Cancer-led indications, followed by infectious, inflammatory, cognitive, and metabolic diseases. Off-label use is under-documented; trials often failed due to recruitment issues, poor responses, adverse events, or funding. They yielded data on high-dose regimens and safety, stressing risk-benefit assessments. Preclinical promise faces clinical hurdles such as poor bioavailability, formulation limits, and high-dose toxicity. Key barriers: (1) low oral bioavailability and rapid hepatic metabolism, (2) unscaled delivery systems, (3) adverse events needing evaluation. DIS holds life cycle potential via multifaceted mechanisms; success demands optimized delivery, rigorous trials, and scalable formulations.
articles.abstractZh: 本系统评价根据 PRISMA 2020 指南综合了临床试验、病例报告和临床前研究（2015-2025），评估了酒精依赖之外双硫仑 (DIS) 的标签外和重新用途。数据库和注册检索产生了 229 项研究：44 项临床试验（主要是癌症、传染病）和 185 篇文章。以癌症为主导的适应症，其次是感染性疾病、炎症性疾病、认知性疾病和代谢性疾病。标签外使用的记录不足；试验常常因招募问题、反应不佳、不良事件或资金而失败。他们提供了有关高剂量治疗方案和安全性的数据，强调风险效益评估。临床前前景面临着生物利用度差、配方限制和高剂量毒性等临床障碍。主要障碍：(1) 口服生物利用度低和肝脏代谢快，(2) 输送系统未规模化，(3) 需要评估的不良事件。 DIS 通过多方面机制保持生命周期潜力；成功需要优化的交付、严格的试验和可扩展的配方。

articles.title: Sustainable production of insecticidal and acaricidal metabolites by endophytic fungi using solid-state fermentation.
articles.titleZh: 利用固态发酵内生真菌可持续生产杀虫和杀螨代谢物。
articles.authors: El-Gendy MMAA, Sadek HE, Barghout ME, Ibrahim SS, Elbehery HH, El-Bondkly AM.
articles.abstract: The purpose of this study was to isolate and assess endophytic fungi from wheat plants as potential biocontrol agents against major wheat pests. A total of 38 fungal isolates, obtained from the Delta, Middle, and Upper regions of Egypt, were examined for their ability to produce bioactive metabolites exhibiting insecticidal and acaricidal activities. Among them, isolate MORSY-27 exhibited remarkable biosynthetic potential, yielding notably high levels of cuticle-degrading enzymes. It also synthesized substantial amounts of phytochemicals, including alkaloids, phenolics, terpenoids, flavonoids, and fatty acids. According to morphological, biochemical, and molecular analyses, the isolate was identified as Geomyces sp. MORSY-27. Different agro-industrial residues were evaluated as cost-effective substrates for solid-state fermentation to reduce production expenses; among these, sunflower cake supported the highest metabolite production. Extracts derived from Geomyces sp. MORSY-27 exhibited strong insecticidal activity against Agrotis ipsilon, significantly impairing larval and pupal development. Additionally, the extracts exhibited potent, concentration- and time-dependent acaricidal effects, achieving nearly 100% adult mortality of Tetranychus urticae and complete inhibition of egg hatching. Gas chromatography-mass spectrometry analysis revealed the presence of 39 bioactive compounds. These findings indicate that Geomyces sp. MORSY-27 demonstrates significant potential as a sustainable and cost-effective source of natural biopesticides, offering valuable potential for integrated pest management.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究的目的是分离和评估小麦植株中的内生真菌作为针对主要小麦害虫的潜在生物防治剂。对从埃及三角洲、中部和上部地区获得的总共 38 种真菌分离株进行了检测，以确定它们产生具有杀虫和杀螨活性的生物活性代谢物的能力。其中，分离株MORSY-27表现出显着的生物合成潜力，产生显着高水平的角质层降解酶。它还合成了大量的植物化学物质，包括生物碱、酚类、萜类化合物、黄酮类化合物和脂肪酸。根据形态学、生化和分子分析，该分离物被鉴定为地霉菌属(Geomyces sp.)。莫尔西-27。评估不同的农业工业残留物作为固态发酵的成本效益底物，以降低生产费用；其中，葵花籽饼支持的代谢物产量最高。源自地霉菌属的提取物。 MORSY-27 对小地老虎表现出很强的杀虫活性，显着损害幼虫和蛹的发育。此外，提取物表现出有效的、浓度和时间依赖性的杀螨作用

articles.title: A SWI/SNF-specific Ig-like domain, SWIFT, is a transcription factor binding platform.
articles.titleZh: SWI/SNF 特异性 Ig 样结构域 SWIFT 是一个转录因子结合平台。
articles.authors: Jain SU, Williamson KE, Ying AW, Turner AM, Jiang RJ, Raval S, So K, Allison MJ, Sankar A, Sáme Guerra DD, Lin Y, Jiang Z, Mashtalir N, Rohrs HW, Lichti CF, Muir TW, Papanastasiou M, Paulo JA, Gygi SP, Gross ML, Kadoch C.
articles.abstract: Mammalian switch/sucrose nonfermenting (mSWI/SNF) chromatin remodeling complexes modulate DNA accessibility and gene expression; however, their genomic targeting mechanisms remain incompletely understood. Here, we identify SWIFT [SWI/SNF immunoglobulin fold (Ig-fold) for transcription factor interactions], a conserved transcription factor (TF) binding domain on the SMARCD subunits. SWIFT is necessary and sufficient for direct engagement with the transactivation domain of the PU.1 TF. A single amino acid mutation disrupts PU.1-mSWI/SNF binding, impairs complex targeting, and attenuates oncogenic transcription and proliferation in PU.1-dependent human cancer cells. Dominant expression of the SWIFT domain in isolation sequesters TFs from mSWI/SNF and poisons TF-"addicted" cancer cells. Finally, TFs across diverse families interact with SMARCD paralog-specific SWIFT domains. These results define a major mechanism of cell type- and disease-specific mSWI/SNF chromatin targeting and inform approaches toward therapeutic modulation.
articles.abstractZh: 哺乳动物开关/蔗糖非发酵 (mSWI/SNF) 染色质重塑复合物调节 DNA 可及性和基因表达；然而，它们的基因组靶向机制仍不完全清楚。在这里，我们鉴定了 SWIFT [用于转录因子相互作用的 SWI/SNF 免疫球蛋白折叠（Ig 折叠）]，它是 SMARCD 亚基上的保守转录因子 (TF) 结合域。 SWIFT 对于直接参与 PU.1 TF 的反式激活域来说是必要且充分的。单个氨基酸突变会破坏 PU.1-mSWI/SNF 结合，损害复杂的靶向性，并减弱 PU.1 依赖性人类癌细胞中的致癌转录和增殖。 SWIFT 结构域的显性表达会隔离 mSWI/SNF 中的 TF，并毒害对 TF“上瘾”的癌细胞。最后，不同家族的 TF 与 SMARCD 旁系同源特定的 SWIFT 域进行交互。这些结果定义了细胞类型和疾病特异性 mSWI/SNF 染色质靶向的主要机制，并为治疗调节方法提供了信息。

articles.title: AI-aided engineering and production optimization of chimeric hetero-viral capping enzymes for mRNA vaccines.
articles.titleZh: 用于 mRNA 疫苗的嵌合异病毒加帽酶的人工智能辅助工程和生产优化。
articles.authors: Shahatibieke D, Tang X, Zheng X, Abulaizi A, Abula A.
articles.abstract: The 5’ cap structure exerts profound impacts on mRNA vaccine stability, translational efficiency, and evasion of innate immunity, encompassing key enzymatic components: triphosphatase (TPase), guanylyl transferase (GTase), and bifunctional methyltransfer-ases (N7G-MTase/2’-O-MTase). However, conventional multi-enzyme capping systems for mRNA vaccines are plagued by inherent inefficiencies. Herein, we report an AI-driven novel hetero-viral chimeric capping enzyme for mRNA vaccines, developed through bioinformatics mining of the DeepSeek and UniProt databases. This single-molecule biocatalyst integrates all capping functions by fusing a rabbit fibroma virus (RFV)-derived TPase/GTase domain with bifunctional methyltransferase domains from flavivirus (FV), respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and rotavirus (RV). Following systematic tag-host optimization, a soluble and functional RFV-FV chimera was achieved via N-terminal maltose-binding protein (MBP) fusion in E. coli BL21(DE3) pLysS, whereas RFV-RSV and RFV-RV chimeras formed insoluble aggregates or were trapped in chaperone complexes. Complementary assays confirmed that the RFV-FV capping enzyme exhibited catalytic activities comparable to the commercial vaccinia virus-derived capping enzyme: TPase (96.76%±1.63%), GTase (100.69%±2.95%), and MTase (77.87%±3.85%). Our work presents a versatile cross-viral RFV-FV capping enzyme that enables large-scale prokaryotic production and ensures mRNA vaccine quality via its multifunctional catalytic activity, thereby streamlining mRNA vaccine manufacturing and establishing an AI-driven paradigm for designer enzyme engineering.
articles.abstractZh: 5’帽结构对 mRNA 疫苗的稳定性、翻译效率和先天免疫的逃避产生深远的影响，包括关键的酶成分：三磷酸酶 (TPase)、鸟苷基转移酶 (GTase) 和双功能甲基转移酶 (N7G-MTase/2’-O-MTase)。然而，用于 mRNA 疫苗的传统多酶加帽系统存在固有的低效率问题。在此，我们报告了一种用于 mRNA 疫苗的人工智能驱动的新型异病毒嵌合加帽酶，该酶是通过 DeepSeek 和 UniProt 数据库的生物信息学挖掘而开发的。这种单分子生物催化剂通过将兔纤维瘤病毒 (RFV) 衍生的 TPase/GTase 结构域与来自黄病毒 (FV)、呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 和轮状病毒 (RV) 的双功能甲基转移酶结构域融合，整合了所有加帽功能。经过系统的标签宿主优化后，通过大肠杆菌 BL21(DE3) pLysS 中的 N 端麦芽糖结合蛋白 (MBP) 融合实现了可溶性功能性 RFV-FV 嵌合体，而 RFV-RSV 和 RFV-RV 嵌合体形成不溶性聚集体或被捕获在分子伴侣复合物中。补充测定证实 RFV-FV 封端酶与比较物相比表现出催化活性

articles.title: Bacterial collagenase harnesses collagen geometry for processive cleavage.
articles.titleZh: 细菌胶原酶利用胶原几何形状进行持续裂解。
articles.authors: Oki H, Takebe K, Bonsu A, Fujii K, Masuda R, Henderson N, Mima T, Koide T, Moradi M, Matsushita O, Sakon J, Kawahara K.
articles.abstract: Collagen, the major structural protein in the animal extracellular matrix, forms a triple helix that resists proteolysis and requires specialised enzymes for degradation. Flesh-eating bacteria secrete collagenases that unwind the collagen triple helix and processively trim Gly-X-Y triplet repeats, yet the molecular basis of this process has remained obscure. Here, cryo-electron microscopy reveals how Hathewaya histolytica collagenase ColH engages its substrate and exploits the helix's architecture for catalysis. ColH encircles a single collagen triple helix in a closed-ring conformation and, through dynamic domain motions, dehydrates and destabilises it. The enzyme undergoes substrate-assisted twisting to adopt a rigid ratcheted conformation, in which one chain is bent into a tripeptide-long 'bight' and threaded into the active site for cleavage, while two uncut strands are partitioned to non-catalytic sites. Release of the bight appears to reset the enzyme, with the uncut strands serving as guiding tracks. Repeated cycling between dynamic and rigid states likely enables triplet-by-triplet translocation, allowing ColH to harness collagen's geometry for processive degradation. These findings reveal a bacterial strategy for collagen unwinding and cleavage distinct from that of mammalian collagenases, highlighting divergent evolutionary solutions for degrading one of nature's most intractable substrates.
articles.abstractZh: 胶原蛋白是动物细胞外基质中的主要结构蛋白，形成三螺旋，可抵抗蛋白水解并需要专门的酶进行降解。食肉细菌分泌胶原酶，解开胶原蛋白三螺旋并逐步修剪 Gly-X-Y 三联体重复序列，但这一过程的分子基础仍然不清楚。在这里，冷冻电子显微镜揭示了 Hathewaya histolytica 胶原酶 ColH 如何与其底物结合并利用螺旋结构进行催化。 ColH 以闭环构象包围单个胶原蛋白三螺旋，并通过动态域运动使其脱水和不稳定。该酶经过底物辅助扭转，形成刚性棘轮构象，其中一条链弯曲成三肽长的“弯曲”，并穿入活性位点进行切割，而两条未切割的链则被分配到非催化位点。释放弯曲似乎可以重置酶，未切割的链充当引导轨道。动态和刚性状态之间的重复循环可能会实现三重态易位，从而使 ColH 能够利用胶原蛋白的几何形状进行持续降解。这些

articles.title: Bioethanol production using sugar beet (Beta vulgaris) juice as substrate by stress-tolerant yeast strains isolated from Areke.
articles.titleZh: 使用从 Areke 分离的耐胁迫酵母菌株，使用甜菜（Beta vulgaris）汁作为底物生产生物乙醇。
articles.authors: Fentahun M.
articles.abstract: Traditionally fermented beverages are potential sources of industrially relevant microorganisms. Among alternative energy sources, biofuels have gained increasing attention as replacements for fossil fuels. This study aimed to investigate the potential stress-tolerant yeast strains isolated from Areke for bioethanol production using sugar beet (Beta vulgaris) juice as substrate. In the current study, four wild yeast strains capable of withstanding multiple stresses were isolated from Areke. Fresh sugar beets were gathered from a local supplier in Debre Markos town, and the physicochemical characterization of the sugar beet juice was determined using standard methods. Ethanol production was optimized using four selected Saccharomyces cerevisiae strains, namely MUA1F (OR209275.1), MUA3F (OR209274.1), MUA11F (OR209277.1), and MUA15F (OR209276.1), using sugar beet juice as the substrate. Most Saccharomyces cerevisiae strains showed better fermentation performance under high osmotic pressure, ethanol concentration, and temperature stress than the Methera standard yeast in ethanol production. Fermentation optimization showed that these native Saccharomyces cerevisiae strains efficiently converted sugar beet juice to ethanol without requiring many pretreatments, indicating their potential for industrial applications. These findings suggest that the Saccharomyces cerevisiae isolates MUA3F and MUA15F should be further assessed, improved, and optimized for industrial bioethanol production because of their fermentation potential.
articles.abstractZh: 传统发酵饮料是工业相关微生物的潜在来源。在替代能源中，生物燃料作为化石燃料的替代品越来越受到关注。本研究旨在研究从 Areke 中分离出的潜在耐胁迫酵母菌株，用于以甜菜（Beta vulgaris）汁为底物生产生物乙醇。在当前的研究中，从 Areke 中分离出了四种能够承受多种胁迫的野生酵母菌株。从德布雷马科斯镇的当地供应商处采集新鲜甜菜，并使用标准方法测定甜菜汁的理化特性。使用四种选定的酿酒酵母菌株，即 MUA1F (OR209275.1)、MUA3F (OR209274.1)、MUA11F (OR209277.1) 和 MUA15F (OR209276.1)，以甜菜汁为底物，对乙醇生产进行优化。在乙醇生产中，大多数酿酒酵母菌株在高渗透压、乙醇浓度和温度胁迫下表现出比 Methera 标准酵母更好的发酵性能。发酵优化表明这些天然酿酒酵母菌株能够有效地

articles.title: Can nanozymes make the leap to the clinic? Advances, hurdles, and prospects.
articles.titleZh: 纳米酶能否跨入临床？进展、障碍和前景。
articles.authors: Pandey NK, Tran HH, Steager EB, Cormode DP, Koo H.
articles.abstract: Nanozymes (enzyme-like catalytic nanomaterials) represent a new generation of artificial enzymes designed to overcome key limitations of their natural counterparts, including high production costs, low stability, and challenging storage requirements. Their versatility spans biosensing, bioimaging, therapeutics, and environmental remediation, attracting widespread interest across disciplines. Recent advances have moved nanozymes beyond benchtop proof of concept, with multiple in vivo studies and early clinical investigations demonstrating their translational potential. However, progress toward the clinic remains constrained by limited mechanistic understanding under physiologically relevant conditions; concerns over safety, biodegradability, and long-term efficacy; and uncertainties in scalable manufacturing, market feasibility, and regulatory approval. This review highlights recent breakthroughs in biomedical nanozymes and identifies key knowledge gaps that must be addressed to accelerate successful clinical translation and commercialization.
articles.abstractZh: 纳米酶（类酶催化纳米材料）代表了新一代人工酶，旨在克服天然酶的关键局限性，包括高生产成本、低稳定性和挑战性的储存要求。它们的多功能性涵盖生物传感、生物成像、治疗和环境修复，吸引了跨学科的广泛兴趣。最近的进展使纳米酶超越了台式概念验证，多项体内研究和早期临床研究证明了其转化潜力。然而，临床进展仍然受到生理相关条件下有限的机制理解的限制。对安全性、生物降解性和长期功效的担忧；以及可扩展制造、市场可行性和监管审批方面的不确定性。这篇综述重点介绍了生物医学纳米酶的最新突破，并确定了必须解决的关键知识差距，以加速成功的临床转化和商业化。

articles.title: Multigram-scale stereoselective synthesis of neurosteroid isomers by gut microbial isolates using plant biomass-derived medium.
articles.titleZh: 使用植物生物质衍生培养基，通过肠道微生物分离物进行多克规模的神经类固醇异构体立体选择性合成。
articles.authors: Gicana RG, Wang PH, Wu TY, Huang YH, Huang MH, Lai YL, Brandon-Mong GJ, Wei Y, Yeo WWZ, Ng IS, Chiang YR.
articles.abstract: We present a sustainable microbial platform utilizing gut bacteria and a plant-based medium for stereoselective neurosteroid biosynthesis. Through bioinformatics- and structural biology-guided screening of over 3000 bacterial isolates, we identified three gut strains exhibiting distinct stereospecificities: Holdemania filiformis produces isopregnanolone, Clostridium innocuum generates epipregnanolone, and Hungatella effluvii synthesizes pregnanolone. Following heterologous expression in Escherichia coli, we characterized two H. filiformis proteins: steroid 5α-reductase (Hp5αR) and 3β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase/reductase (Hf4205). We developed molasses-okara medium (MOM), a plant-derived composite medium combining sugarcane molasses with enzymatically hydrolyzed okara devoid of animal-derived components. In multigram batch whole-cell biotransformation trials using MOM, we achieved over 95% progesterone conversion into target neurosteroid isomers. The inherent stereoselectivity of these whole-cell biotransformations bypasses downstream chiral chromatographic separation, enabling pharmaceutical-grade product recovery through a simple open-column purification. Compared with peptone-yeast extract-glucose media, MOM reduced production costs by 90% and carbon footprint by 95% in whole-cell biotransformation, demonstrating sustainable bioeconomy principles in pharmaceutical biotechnology.
articles.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个利用肠道细菌和基于植物的培养基进行立体选择性神经类固醇生物合成的可持续微生物平台。通过生物信息学和结构生物学指导下筛选 3000 多种细菌分离株，我们鉴定出三种表现出不同立体特异性的肠道菌株：Holdemania filiformis 产生异孕醇酮，Clostridium innocuum 产生表孕醇酮，Hungatella effluvii 合成孕醇酮。在大肠杆菌中异源表达后，我们鉴定了两种丝状幽门螺杆菌蛋白：类固醇 5α-还原酶 (Hp5αR) 和 3β-羟基类固醇脱氢酶/还原酶 (Hf4205)。我们开发了糖蜜-豆渣培养基 (MOM)，这是一种植物源性复合培养基，将甘蔗糖蜜与酶水解豆渣相结合，不含动物源性成分。在使用 MOM 的多克批量全细胞生物转化试验中，我们实现了超过 95% 的孕酮转化为目标神经类固醇异构体。这些全细胞生物转化固有的立体选择性绕过了下游手性色谱分离，从而通过简单的开柱纯化即可回收医药级产品。与蛋白胨-y相比

articles.title: ß-adrenergic-like signalling engages CrebB in Drosophila gut to promote female longevity.
articles.titleZh: β-肾上腺素能样信号传导与果蝇肠道中的 CrebB 结合，以促进雌性长寿。
articles.authors: Sumit AF, Whitehead B, Özyeşil I, Shen D, Anver S, Foukas LC, Alic N.
articles.abstract: Adrenergic signalling is heavily implicated in human age-related disease and yet the potential for this neuroendocrine signalling pathway to modulate ageing has received little attention. Here, we use Drosophila melanogaster to test if adrenergic-like signalling can promote longevity by manipulating tyramine (TA) or octopamine (OA), the invertebrate equivalents of adrenergic hormones. Increased neuronal synthesis of TA boosts health and longevity in both sexes, whereas OA is marginally beneficial in males. Orally administered TA or OA extend female or male lifespan, respectively. Increased activation of the ß-adrenergic-like signalling in the gut, by manipulating a ß-adrenergic-like receptor, PKA or CrebB, is sufficient to delay female ageing. Transcriptional profiling reveals that CrebB links the ß-adrenergic pathway to longevity-promoting processes in the gut where its function is required for the beneficial effects of TA feeding in females. Here we show that localised activation of ß-adrenergic signalling has the potential to counter animal ageing.
articles.abstractZh: 肾上腺素信号传导与人类年龄相关疾病密切相关，但这种神经内分泌信号传导途径调节衰老的潜力却很少受到关注。在这里，我们使用黑腹果蝇来测试类肾上腺素信号传导是否可以通过操纵酪胺（TA）或章鱼胺（OA）（肾上腺素激素的无脊椎动物等效物）来促进寿命。增加 TA 的神经元合成可促进两性的健康和寿命，而 OA 对男性则略有益处。口服TA或OA可分别延长女性或男性的寿命。通过操纵β-肾上腺素能样受体PKA或CrebB，增加肠道中β-肾上腺素能样信号传导的激活，足以延缓女性衰老。转录分析表明，CrebB 将 ß-肾上腺素能途径与肠道中的长寿过程联系起来，而其功能是 TA 喂养对雌性产生有益影响所必需的。在这里，我们证明β-肾上腺素信号传导的局部激活具有对抗动物衰老的潜力。

articles.title: Transcriptomic analysis of Rnq1 loss and prionization reveals alterations in translation pathways and energy metabolism.
articles.titleZh: Rnq1 丢失和朊病毒化的转录组分析揭示了翻译途径和能量代谢的改变。
articles.authors: Du Z, Alasady MJ, Mendillo ML, Li L.
articles.abstract: Prion proteins can undergo self-perpetuating conformational changes that alter their functions. One such protein, Rnq1, whose prion form acts as a master regulator of several other prions’ formation and transmission, is unknown for its physiological functions. Here, we investigated how Rnq1 loss and prionization affect the yeast transcriptomic profile. We found that both the Rnq1 loss and prionization exert similar global effects on the transcriptome, with more transcripts upregulated than downregulated. Notably, the upregulated differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were predominantly enriched for translation-related gene ontology (GO) terms, largely due to the overrepresentation of snoRNAs and tRNAs. In contrast, the downregulated DEGs were primarily associated with energy production, especially in mitochondria. Interestingly, the Rnq1 prion mainly exhibited amplified loss-of-function effects. Further analyses suggest that, as a low-complexity protein, Rnq1 has evolved to interact with multiple cellular partners to maintain physiological balance, particularly between protein synthesis and energy production. The loss and prionization of Rnq1 may disrupt these natural interactions, thereby triggering feedback regulations and/or perturbing RNA processing through crosstalk among transcription factors, RNA polymerases, and other cellular machinery. Together, our results provide new insights into Rnq1 functions and prion-mediated cellular behaviors with broader implications of prion-based phenomena across biological systems.
articles.abstractZh: 朊病毒蛋白可以经历自我延续的构象变化，从而改变其功能。其中一种蛋白质 Rnq1 的朊病毒形式是其他几种朊病毒形成和传播的主要调节因子，但其生理功能尚不清楚。在这里，我们研究了 Rnq1 丢失和朊病毒化如何影响酵母转录组谱。我们发现 Rnq1 丢失和朊病毒化对转录组产生相似的全局影响，上调的转录本多于下调的转录本。值得注意的是，上调的差异表达基因（DEG）主要富集于翻译相关基因本体（GO）术语，这主要是由于 snoRNA 和 tRNA 的过度表达。相比之下，下调的 DEG 主要与能量产生相关，尤其是在线粒体中。有趣的是，Rnq1朊病毒主要表现出放大的功能丧失效应。进一步的分析表明，作为一种低复杂性蛋白质，Rnq1 已进化为与多个细胞伙伴相互作用以维持生理平衡，特别是蛋白质合成和能量产生之间的平衡。 Rnq1 的丢失和朊化可能会破坏这些自然相互作用，

articles.title: 2'-O-Methylation maintains ribosome structural and translation integrity.
articles.titleZh: 2'-O-甲基化可维持核糖体结构和翻译的完整性。
articles.authors: Zhao Y, Rai J, Cohen LN, Shu Y, Xu C, Goswami H, Chen X, Jin H, Marchand V, Motorin Y, Ghalei H, Li H.
articles.abstract: In eukaryotic ribosomes, ∼2% of RNA nucleotides undergo 2'-O-methylation, a conserved cellular mechanism thought to be critical for maintaining and regulating translation. Here, we use ribosome profiling, translation assays, proteomics, and high-resolution structural analyses to show that loss of native 2'-O-methylation in yeast ribosomes disproportionally affects the translation of ribosomal protein transcripts, driven by changes in codon usage and recognition of structured RNA. Translation reprogramming by the hypomethylated ribosomes is supported by reduced thermostability and high-resolution evidence of altered ribosomal structures and conformations. Consistent with the roles of the affected proteins in sustaining cellular fitness, hypomethylated ribosomes under stress exhibit a selective loss of downregulated proteins and misassembly associated with methylation loss. Our data provide structural and mechanistic insights into how 2'-O-methylation supports ribosome integrity and mediates cellular stress responses.
articles.abstractZh: 在真核核糖体中，约 2% 的 RNA 核苷酸会发生 2'-O-甲基化，这是一种保守的细胞机制，被认为对于维持和调节翻译至关重要。在这里，我们使用核糖体分析、翻译测定、蛋白质组学和高分辨率结构分析来表明，酵母核糖体中天然 2'-O-甲基化的丧失不成比例地影响核糖体蛋白质转录本的翻译，这是由密码子使用和结构 RNA 识别的变化驱动的。低甲基化核糖体的翻译重编程得到了热稳定性降低和核糖体结构和构象改变的高分辨率证据的支持。与受影响的蛋白质在维持细胞健康中的作用一致，低甲基化核糖体在应激下表现出下调蛋白质的选择性丢失以及与甲基化丢失相关的错误组装。我们的数据提供了关于 2'-O-甲基化如何支持核糖体完整性和介导细胞应激反应的结构和机制见解。

articles.title: A double-staining automated flow cytometry method for real-time monitoring of bacteria in continuous bioreactors.
articles.titleZh: 一种双染色自动流式细胞术方法，用于实时监测连续生物反应器中的细菌。
articles.authors: López-Gálvez J, Schönfelder E, Mayer H, Schiessl K, Silva MOD, Harms H, Müller S.
articles.abstract: In biotechnological processes, cell density and physiology are critical parameters for controlling the feed rate, harvest time, and process performance. We developed an automated flow cytometry approach that enables continuous, real-time (fully automated, hourly) monitoring of bacterial populations in continuous bioreactors. The method employed a double-staining protocol that combined DAPI to assess total DNA content and Alexa Fluor 488-EdU via Click-iT technology to identify the proportions of cells undergoing active DNA replication through EdU incorporation. The integrated workflow included fixation, permeabilization, staining, and measurement steps and was applied to three Gram-negative strains: Bradyrhizobium sp., Escherichia coli, and Stenotrophomonas rhizophila. Automated analysis captured growth dynamics and cell cycle progression, providing insights into population behavior under different dilution rates. In this study, automated on-line sampling enabled hourly flow cytometry measurements of cell concentration and physiological indicators during continuous cultivation, supporting real-time monitoring and control in industrial biotechnology.
articles.abstractZh: 在生物技术过程中，细胞密度和生理学是控制进料速率、收获时间和过程性能的关键参数。我们开发了一种自动化流式细胞术方法，可以连续、实时（全自动、每小时）监测连续生物反应器中的细菌种群。该方法采用双重染色方案，结合 DAPI 来评估总 DNA 含量，并通过 Click-iT 技术结合 Alexa Fluor 488-EdU 来确定通过 EdU 掺入进行活跃 DNA 复制的细胞比例。集成的工作流程包括固定、透化、染色和测量步骤，并应用于三种革兰氏阴性菌株：慢生根瘤菌、大肠杆菌和根际寡养单胞菌。自动化分析捕获了生长动态和细胞周期进展，提供了对不同稀释率下群体行为的见解。在这项研究中，自动化在线采样能够在连续培养过程中每小时进行细胞浓度和生理指标的流式细胞术测量，支持工业生物技术中的实时监测和控制。

articles.title: A splicing factor's unexpected detour to the mitochondrial surface.
articles.titleZh: 剪接因子意外绕道至线粒体表面。
articles.authors: Raicu AM, Churchman LS.
articles.abstract: In this issue of Molecular Cell, Garcia et al.1 reveal an unexpected role for the splicing factor U2AF in repressing translation and influencing the localization of nuclear-encoded mitochondrial mRNAs to the outer mitochondrial membrane.
articles.abstractZh: 在本期《分子细胞》中，Garcia 等人1 揭示了剪接因子 U2AF 在抑制翻译和影响核编码线粒体 mRNA 定位到线粒体外膜方面的意外作用。

articles.title: Architecture and regulation of nanoscale chromatin domains.
articles.titleZh: 纳米级染色质结构域的结构和调控。
articles.authors: Vinayak V, Lakadamyali M, Shenoy VB.
articles.abstract: Nanoscale chromatin domains have emerged as fundamental units of mammalian genome organization during interphase and mitosis. Single-molecule localization microscopy now enables their direct visualization, revealing conserved features including characteristic packing, enrichment of linker histones, and radial stratification of histone marks. These domains act as dynamic regulators of gene activity, remodel in response to developmental and environmental cues, and become disrupted in disease. Experimental findings and biophysical modelling point to internucleosomal interactions and epigenetic reactions as key drivers of their organization. By situating them alongside lamin- and nucleolus-associated domains, we propose a unified biophysical framework for genome organization across scales. Their recurrent disruption in aging and disease makes them compelling targets for diagnosis and intervention.
articles.abstractZh: 纳米级染色质结构域已成为哺乳动物间期和有丝分裂期间基因组组织的基本单位。单分子定位显微镜现在可以直接可视化，揭示保守的特征，包括特征包装、连接组蛋白的富集和组蛋白标记的径向分层。这些结构域充当基因活性的动态调节因子，根据发育和环境线索进行重塑，并在疾病中被破坏。实验结果和生物物理模型表明核小体间相互作用和表观遗传反应是其组织的关键驱动因素。通过将它们与核纤层蛋白和核仁相关域放在一起，我们提出了一个统一的生物物理框架，用于跨尺度的基因组组织。它们对衰老和疾病的反复破坏使它们成为诊断和干预的引人注目的目标。

articles.title: Complete biosynthesis of psychedelic tryptamines from three kingdoms in plants.
articles.titleZh: 来自植物三个王国的迷幻色胺的完整生物合成。
articles.authors: Berman P, Höfer J, Mehlman H, Almekias-Siegl E, Khersonsky O, Dong Y, Heinig U, Sulimani L, Hao LK, Cohen S, Peleg Y, Meir S, Rogachev I, Meiri D, Fleishman SJ, Aharoni A.
articles.abstract: Psychedelic indolethylamines with therapeutic potential are naturally produced in plants, fungi, and animals. Here, we elucidated the complete N,N-dimethyltryptamine (DMT) biosynthetic pathway in hallucinogenic plant species traditionally used in shamanic rituals for spiritual healing. Leveraging the similarities in their chemical structures, we reconstructed in one plant assay the full biosynthetic pathways of five renowned natural psychedelics; psilocin and psilocybin found in mushrooms, DMT from plants, and bufotenin and 5-methoxy-DMT secreted by the Sonoran Desert toad. We further engineered halogenated analogs of these molecules, which do not naturally occur in plants and exhibit prospective therapeutic potential for psychiatric conditions. Blending catalytic functions across the tree of life, coupled with metabolic engineering guided by rational protein design of mutant enzymes, enabled substantially more efficient in planta production of the indolethylamine components. This work establishes a versatile platform for concurrent biosynthesis and diversification of psychoactive indolethylamines, paving the way for their production in plants.
articles.abstractZh: 具有治疗潜力的迷幻吲哚乙胺自然产生于植物、真菌和动物中。在这里，我们阐明了传统上用于萨满仪式精神治疗的致幻植物物种中完整的 N,N-二甲基色胺 (DMT) 生物合成途径。利用它们化学结构的相似性，我们在一种植物分析中重建了五种著名的天然迷幻药的完整生物合成途径；蘑菇中发现的赛洛辛和赛洛西宾、植物中的 DMT 以及索诺兰沙漠蟾蜍分泌的蟾蜍毒素和 5-甲氧基-DMT。我们进一步设计了这些分子的卤化类似物，它们不是天然存在于植物中的，并且对精神疾病表现出潜在的治疗潜力。将整个生命树的催化功能与以突变酶的合理蛋白质设计为指导的代谢工程相结合，使得植物生产吲哚乙胺成分的效率大大提高。这项工作为精神活性吲哚乙胺的同时生物合成和多样化建立了一个多功能平台，为它们在植物中的生产铺平了道路。

articles.title: Computationally guided discovery of Ly6e/LY6E-dependent AAV capsid variants.
articles.titleZh: Ly6e/LY6E 依赖性 AAV 衣壳变体的计算引导发现。
articles.authors: Ono H, Fujino S, Sunagawa GA.
articles.abstract: Systemic adeno-associated virus (AAV) delivery to the central nervous system (CNS) would broaden neuroscience studies and therapeutic development, but capsids evolved in mice often underperform across species. We used structure-guided computational prioritization of short peptide inserts predicted to engage the BBB-associated Ly6-family receptor Ly6e/LY6E, grafting candidates into a surface loop of an AAV9 capsid. Selected variants increased blood-brain barrier transduction and enabled widespread CNS gene delivery in Syrian hamsters after intravenous dosing, with lead capsids showing Ly6e-dependent binding and transduction in cell assays. Using the same strategy for the human ortholog, we identified multiple AAV9 variants with LY6E-dependent enhancement of in vitro transduction. These capsids support species-matched CNS delivery and demonstrate how receptor-informed computation can focus experimental screening when in vivo library selection is impractical.
articles.abstractZh: 全身性腺相关病毒（AAV）输送到中枢神经系统（CNS）将扩大神经科学研究和治疗开发，但小鼠体内进化的衣壳在不同物种中的表现往往不佳。我们使用结构引导的计算优先顺序对短肽插入物进行预测，预测与 BBB 相关的 Ly6 家族受体 Ly6e/LY6E 结合，将候选物移植到 AAV9 衣壳的表面环中。选定的变体增加了血脑屏障转导，并使叙利亚仓鼠在静脉给药后能够广泛传递 CNS 基因，铅衣壳在细胞测定中显示出 Ly6e 依赖性结合和转导。对人类直系同源物使用相同的策略，我们鉴定了多个具有 LY6E 依赖性体外转导增强作用的 AAV9 变体。这些衣壳支持物种匹配的中枢神经系统递送，并证明当体内文库选择不切实际时，受体信息计算如何能够集中实验筛选。

articles.title: Interplay of SLC33A1-dependent and -independent Golgi sialic acid O-acetylation in CASD1 catalysis.
articles.titleZh: CASD1 催化中 SLC33A1 依赖性和非依赖性高尔基体唾液酸 O-乙酰化的相互作用。
articles.authors: Albers M, Bosse L, Schröter L, Junemann AT, Rossdam C, Hartmann M, Grove M, Litfin T, Egger AS, Kwiatkowski M, Thedieck K, Zocher G, Buettner FFR, Malde AK, von Itzstein M, Mühlenhoff M.
articles.abstract: Sialic acid O-acetylation is implicated in the modulation of sialoglycan recognition and ganglioside biology. The sugar modification is catalyzed by CASD1, a Golgi membrane protein that encompasses a luminal catalytic domain and a multipass transmembrane domain. The mechanism of how acetyl-CoA is provided to the Golgi remains poorly understood. Here, we show that the acetyl-CoA transporter SLC33A1 provides acetyl-CoA to the luminal domain of CASD1 and that patient-derived SLC33A1 variants linked to inherited neurodevelopmental and neurodegenerative disorders impair ganglioside 9-O-acetylation. Under conditions that enable the formation of 7,9-di-O-acetylated sialoglycans, genetic inactivation of SLC33A1 impaired di-O-acetylation, but unexpectedly, still enabled mono-O-acetylation. Structure prediction and site-directed mutagenesis revealed a second active site in CASD1 that shares striking similarities with the catalytic acetyl-CoA binding transmembrane tunnel of the lysosomal acetyltransferase HGSNAT. Together, our data provide strong evidence that CASD1 has dual functionalities and catalyzes 7,9-di-O-acetylation through SLC33A1-dependent luminal acetylation and SLC33A1-independent transmembrane acetylation.
articles.abstractZh: 唾液酸 O-乙酰化参与唾液酸聚糖识别和神经节苷脂生物学的调节。糖修饰由 CASD1 催化，CASD1 是一种高尔基体膜蛋白，包含一个腔催化结构域和一个多通道跨膜结构域。乙酰辅酶A如何提供给高尔基体的机制仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们证明乙酰辅酶A转运蛋白SLC33A1向CASD1的管腔结构域提供乙酰辅酶A，并且与遗传性神经发育和神经退行性疾病相关的患者来源的SLC33A1变体会损害神经节苷脂9-O-乙酰化。在能够形成 7,9-二-O-乙酰化唾液聚糖的条件下，SLC33A1 的基因失活会损害二-O-乙酰化，但出乎意料的是，仍然能够形成单-O-乙酰化。结构预测和定点突变揭示了 CASD1 中的第二个活性位点，该位点与溶酶体乙酰转移酶 HGSNAT 的催化乙酰辅酶 A 结合跨膜通道具有惊人的相似性。总之，我们的数据提供了强有力的证据，证明 CASD1 具有双重功能，并通过 SLC33A1 依赖的管腔乙酰化和 SLC33A1 独立的管腔乙酰化催化 7,9-二-O-乙酰化。

articles.title: NDUFA5 deficiency promotes renal inflammation in diabetic nephropathy via mitochondrial ROS signaling.
articles.titleZh: NDUFA5 缺乏通过线粒体 ROS 信号传导促进糖尿病肾病的肾脏炎症。
articles.authors: Gong G, Meng L, Wang M, Si X, Ren Y.
articles.abstract: Diabetic nephropathy (DN) involves mitochondrial dysfunction, but the role of complex I subunit NDUFA5 is unclear. This study investigated its protective mechanisms. Using tubule-specific Ndufa5 knockout mice, streptozotocin-induced diabetic mice, and high glucose-treated human kidney-2 (HK-2) cells, we assessed the effects of NDUFA5 manipulation. Renal NDUFA5 expression was reduced in diabetes. Its knockout exacerbated mitochondrial damage, ROS overproduction, and renal injury, while AAV9-mediated overexpression ameliorated these defects. NDUFA5 overexpression also suppressed pro-inflammatory cytokines (interleukin-1β (IL-1β), tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α), and monocyte chemoattractant protein-1 (MCP-1)) and nuclear factor-κB (NF-κB) signaling in vivo and in vitro. Mechanistically, NDUFA5 attenuated inflammation by inhibiting mitochondrial reactive oxygen species (mtROS) generation. Thus, NDUFA5 protects against DN, at least in part, by preserving mitochondrial integrity and reducing oxidative stress and inflammation, highlighting its potential as a therapeutic target.
articles.abstractZh: 糖尿病肾病 (DN) 涉及线粒体功能障碍，但复合物 I 亚基 NDUFA5 的作用尚不清楚。本研究调查了其保护机制。使用肾小管特异性 Ndufa5 敲除小鼠、链脲佐菌素诱导的糖尿病小鼠和高葡萄糖处理的人肾 2 (HK-2) 细胞，我们评估了 NDUFA5 操作的效果。糖尿病患者肾脏 NDUFA5 表达降低。它的敲除加剧了线粒体损伤、ROS 过量产生和肾损伤，而 AAV9 介导的过度表达则改善了这些缺陷。 NDUFA5 过表达还在体内和体外抑制促炎细胞因子（白介素-1β (IL-1β)、肿瘤坏死因子-α (TNF-α) 和单核细胞趋化蛋白-1 (MCP-1)）和核因子-κB (NF-κB) 信号传导。从机制上讲，NDUFA5 通过抑制线粒体活性氧 (mtROS) 的产生来减轻炎症。因此，NDUFA5 至少部分通过保护线粒体完整性、减少氧化应激和炎症来预防 DN，凸显了其作为治疗靶点的潜力。

articles.title: Structure and mechanism of the heterotetrameric ADP-glucose pyrophosphorylase essential for starch synthesis in plants.
articles.titleZh: 植物淀粉合成所必需的异四聚体 ADP-葡萄糖焦磷酸化酶的结构和机制。
articles.authors: Wu Y, Lin H, Li W, Wang X, Shen X, Lin X, Zhu L, Wang R, Yang T, Yi S, Ye R, Yang H, Zhang Y, Zhang J, Fan M.
articles.abstract: ADP-glucose pyrophosphorylase (AGPase) catalyzes the conversion of glucose-1-phosphate and adenosine 5'-triphosphate (ATP) to ADP-glucose (ADPG), the dedicated precursor of starch in plants. It is a rate-limiting enzyme of the starch biosynthesis pathway, and its activity is closely linked to crop productivity. Plant AGPase is a heterotetramer composed of two types of subunits, and its activity is subject to allosteric regulation by photosynthetic metabolites, with 3-phosphoglycerate (3-PGA) acting as an activator and phosphate as an inhibitor. Here, we report the cryo-electron microscopy structures of Arabidopsis heterotetrameric AGPase in apo, 3-PGA-bound, phosphate-bound, ATP/3-PGA-bound, and ADPG/3-PGA-bound states. AGPase consists of two small subunits (APS1) and two large subunits (APL1), organized as a dimer of APS1-APL1 heterodimers. Both the small and large subunits comprise an N-terminal catalytic domain and a C-terminal left-handed β-helix domain. By combining structural analysis with functional characterization, we identified the binding sites of the allosteric modulators and substrate/product in the AGPase and elucidated the mechanism of allosteric regulation, which involves 3-PGA binding-induced conformational changes at the active site. These findings provide critical insights into ADPG synthesis by plant heterotetrameric AGPase and offer clues to engineer the AGPase to enhance starch production and increase crop yields.
articles.abstractZh: ADP-葡萄糖焦磷酸化酶 (AGPase) 催化 1-磷酸葡萄糖和 5'-三磷酸腺苷 (ATP) 转化为 ADP-葡萄糖 (ADPG)，这是植物中淀粉的专用前体。它是淀粉生物合成途径的限速酶，其活性与作物生产力密切相关。植物AGPase是由两种亚基组成的异四聚体，其活性受到光合代谢物的变构调节，其中3-磷酸甘油酸（3-PGA）作为激活剂，磷酸盐作为抑制剂。在这里，我们报道了拟南芥异四聚体 AGP 酶在 apo、3-PGA 结合、磷酸盐结合、ATP/3-PGA 结合和 ADPG/3-PGA 结合状态下的冷冻电镜结构。 AGPase 由两个小亚基 (APS1) 和两个大亚基 (APL1) 组成，组织为 APS1-APL1 异二聚体的二聚体。小亚基和大亚基均包含 N 端催化结构域和 C 端左手 β 螺旋结构域。通过将结构分析与功能表征相结合，我们确定了 AGPase 中变构调节剂和底物/产物的结合位点，并阐明了变构调节机制，这在

articles.title: The E3 ubiquitin ligase RHB1A and the transcription factor GRF1 form a regulatory module that orchestrates the trade-off between photosynthetic growth and salt tolerance in poplar.
articles.titleZh: E3 泛素连接酶 RHB1A 和转录因子 GRF1 形成一个调节模块，协调杨树光合生长和耐盐性之间的权衡。
articles.authors: Chen K, Hao X, Zhao L, Chen N, Xu L, Huang H, Luo T, Shi W, Zhao J, Li S, Wang Y, Luo Y, Li Y, Liang S, Ren Y, Liu J, Ma T, Jiang Y.
articles.abstract: Salt stress imposes a major constraint on plant growth and prompts plants to suppress growth-related processes, including photosynthesis, to prioritize stress defense and survival. However, the dynamic transcriptional regulation underlying this transition from growth to stress responses remains poorly understood. Here, we identify the bifunctional transcription factor GROWTH REGULATORY FACTOR 1 (GRF1) and its interacting partner, the RING-H2 E3 ubiquitin ligase RHB1A, in poplar. We define the GRF1 regulatory network by demonstrating that RHB1A mediates the ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation of GRF1 using transgenic poplar lines and an integrated multi-omics approach. Under favorable conditions, GRF1 acts as a transcriptional activator of photosynthesis-related genes and a repressor of stress-responsive genes, thereby promoting photosynthetic growth. However, salt stress induces RHB1A, which promotes GRF1 degradation, thereby attenuating growth-promoting pathways and derepressing stress-response genes, ultimately conferring salt tolerance. These findings uncover a GRF1-RHB1A regulatory module that dynamically coordinates the trade-off between photosynthetic growth and salt response in poplar, providing key mechanistic insights into the transcriptional control of environmental responses in woody plants.
articles.abstractZh: 盐胁迫对植物生长造成主要限制，并促使植物抑制与生长相关的过程，包括光合作用，以优先考虑胁迫防御和生存。然而，从生长到应激反应的转变背后的动态转录调控仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们在杨树中鉴定出了双功能转录因子生长调节因子 1 (GRF1) 及其相互作用伙伴 RING-H2 E3 泛素连接酶 RHB1A。我们通过使用转基因杨树系和综合多组学方法证明 RHB1A 介导 GRF1 的泛素化和蛋白酶体降解来定义 GRF1 调控网络。在有利的条件下，GRF1充当光合作用相关基因的转录激活子和胁迫响应基因的抑制子，从而促进光合作用生长。然而，盐胁迫会诱导 RHB1A，从而促进 GRF1 降解，从而减弱促生长途径并抑制胁迫反应基因，最终赋予耐盐性。这些发现揭示了一个 GRF1-RHB1A 调节模块，该模块动态协调光合生长和盐分之间的权衡

articles.title: The genetic architecture of an allosteric hormone receptor.
articles.titleZh: 变构激素受体的遗传结构。
articles.authors: Stammnitz MR, Lehner B.
articles.abstract: Many proteins function as switches, transducing the concentrations of environmental chemicals into cellular responses. It is not well understood how signal processing by switches is genetically encoded. Here, using a massively parallel approach, GluePCA, we present >40,000 measurements and a complete map of how mutations alter the quantitative activation function of a receptor switch, the plant hormone sensor PYL1. Close to 90% of missense variants tune the dose-response of the receptor, often causing correlated changes in sensitivity, basal activity, maximum response and induction steepness. Based on theory we predict and then validate the underlying latent mechanism as a change in protein stability. Beyond this, signalling parameters can be independently tuned, with large effects in interface-distal positions and a modular genetic architecture across the receptor's structure. Rare single amino acid substitutions confer phenotypic innovation, including inverted and band-stop activation functions. Our data demonstrate the feasibility of dose-response profile quantification at massive scale and reveal the remarkable evolutionary malleability of a protein switch.
articles.abstractZh: 许多蛋白质起着开关的作用，将环境化学物质的浓度转换为细胞反应。目前尚不清楚开关的信号处理是如何进行基因编码的。在这里，我们使用大规模并行方法 GluePCA，展示了超过 40,000 个测量值以及突变如何改变受体开关（植物激素传感器 PYL1）的定量激活功能的完整图谱。接近 90% 的错义变异会调节受体的剂量反应，通常会导致敏感性、基础活性、最大反应和感应陡度的相关变化。根据理论，我们预测并验证了蛋白质稳定性变化的潜在潜在机制。除此之外，信号参数可以独立调整，对界面远端位置和整个受体结构的模块化遗传结构有很大影响。罕见的单一氨基酸取代赋予表型创新，包括倒置和带阻激活功能。我们的数据证明了大规模剂量反应曲线定量的可行性，并揭示了蛋白质开关显着的进化可塑性。

articles.title: U2AF regulates the translation and localization of nuclear-encoded mitochondrial mRNAs.
articles.titleZh: U2AF 调节核编码线粒体 mRNA 的翻译和定位。
articles.authors: Garcia GR, Palangat M, Moraly J, Donovan BT, Wang B, Phadke I, Sturgill D, Chen J, Zhang G, Holewinski RJ, Short B, Rivero GA, Swoboda DM, Taylor N, McGraw K, Larson DR.
articles.abstract: The mechanisms underlying molecular targeting to mitochondria remain enigmatic, yet this process is crucial for normal cellular function. The RNA-binding proteins U2AF1 and U2AF2 form a heterodimer (U2AF) that shuttles between the nucleus and cytoplasm, regulating splicing in the nucleus and translation in the cytoplasm. Our study in human bronchial epithelial cells (HBECs) identifies an unexpected role for U2AF in mitochondrial function. We demonstrate that U2AF interacts with nuclear-encoded mitochondrial (NE-mt) mRNAs and proteins, inhibits translation, localizes to the mitochondria, and regulates mRNA localization to mitochondria. Moreover, an oncogenic point mutation in U2AF1(S34F) disrupts this regulation, leading to altered mitochondrial structure, increased translation, large changes in the mitochondria proteome, and oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS)-dependent metabolic rewiring, recapitulating changes observed in bone marrow progenitors from patients with myelodysplastic syndromes. These findings reveal a non-canonical role for U2AF, where it modulates multiple aspects of mitochondrial function by regulating the translation and mitochondrial localization of nuclear-encoded mRNAs.
articles.abstractZh: 线粒体分子靶向的机制仍然是个谜，但这一过程对于正常细胞功能至关重要。 RNA结合蛋白U2AF1和U2AF2形成异二聚体(U2AF)，在细胞核和细胞质之间穿梭，调节细胞核中的剪接和细胞质中的翻译。我们对人支气管上皮细胞 (HBEC) 的研究发现 U2AF 在线粒体功能中发挥着意想不到的作用。我们证明 U2AF 与核编码线粒体 (NE-mt) mRNA 和蛋白质相互作用，抑制翻译，定位到线粒体，并调节 mRNA 定位到线粒体。此外，U2AF1（S34F）的致癌点突变破坏了这种调节，导致线粒体结构改变、翻译增加、线粒体蛋白质组发生巨大变化以及氧化磷酸化（OXPHOS）依赖性代谢重连，概括了在骨髓增生异常综合征患者的骨髓祖细胞中观察到的变化。这些发现揭示了 U2AF 的非典型作用，它通过调节核编码的翻译和线粒体定位来调节线粒体功能的多个方面

articles.title: Wound-healing, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities of β-glucan from red sea-mangroves-associated Candida tropicalis.
articles.titleZh: 来自红海红树林相关热带念珠菌的 β-葡聚糖具有伤口愈合、抗炎和抗氧化活性。
articles.authors: ElGazzare AT, Alkersh BM, Sabry SA, Ghozlan HA.
articles.abstract: Marine yeasts are underexplored resource for bioactive polysaccharides with potential pharmaceutical activities. In this study, five marine yeast isolates from mangrove shrubs were screened for β-glucan production. Isolate Y4 exhibited the highest β-glucan yield, reaching 17.11% of cell fresh weight- approximately 1.57-fold higher than Saccharomyces cerevisiae. Molecular identification revealed Y4 to be Candida tropicalis AUMC 15,533 through ITS rRNA sequencing and phylogenetic analysis. Structural characterization using ¹H NMR and FT-IR confirmed the presence of β-1,3 and β-1,6 glucan linkages. Optimization of β-glucan production via Plackett–Burman design identified glucose, yeast extract, shaking speed, and incubation time as critical factors, achieving a maximum yield of 0.42 g/100 mL. The extracted β-glucan demonstrated significant biological activities, including antioxidant capacity (IC₅₀= 18.31 µg/mL), wound healing efficacy (80.19% closure in 24 h), and anti-inflammatory effects, as evidenced by reduced expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines TNF-α (74.5% reduction) and IL-6 (80.8% reduction). Carboxymethylated β-glucan showed lower but still substantial activity across all assays. These findings highlight the superior biosynthetic capacity of marine C. tropicalis for β-glucan production and its potential therapeutic properties. This study underscores the importance of exploring marine microbial diversity for potential bioactive molecules with biomedical applications.
articles.abstractZh: 海洋酵母是具有潜在药物活性的生物活性多糖的尚未开发的资源。在这项研究中，筛选了来自红树林灌木的五种海洋酵母分离物，用于生产 β-葡聚糖。分离株 Y4 表现出最高的 β-葡聚糖产量，达到细胞鲜重的 17.11%，大约是酿酒酵母的 1.57 倍。通过ITS rRNA测序和系统发育分析，分子鉴定显示Y4为热带假丝酵母AUMC 15,533。使用 1H NMR 和 FT-IR 进行的结构表征证实了 β-1,3 和 β-1,6 葡聚糖键的存在。通过 Plackett-Burman 设计优化 β-葡聚糖生产，将葡萄糖、酵母提取物、振荡速度和孵育时间作为关键因素，实现了 0.42 g/100 mL 的最大产量。提取的β-葡聚糖表现出显着的生物活性，包括抗氧化能力（IC₅₀= 18.31 µg/mL）、伤口愈合功效（24小时内闭合80.19%）和抗炎作用，促炎细胞因子TNF-α（减少74.5%）和IL-6（减少80.8%）的表达减少证明了这一点。羧甲基化 β-葡聚糖在整个过程中表现出较低但仍具有显着的活性

articles.title: Effect of different levels of Fenugreek sprouts on rumen microbiota and milk yield in Hassani goats.
articles.titleZh: 不同水平的胡芦巴芽对哈桑山羊瘤胃微生物群和产奶量的影响。
articles.authors: Rabee AE, Nassar MS, El-Gendy MH, Badawy HS, Raef O.
articles.abstract: Germinated Fenugreek is a rich source of nutrients and bioactive compounds; therefore, it has garnered interest in improving animal productivity and health. This study evaluated the effect of two levels of dried Fenugreek sprouts (DF) (Trigonella foenum-graecum L.) on milk yield and composition, digestibility, rumen fermentation, and rumen bacteria in Hassani goats. Thirty lactating Hassani goats were assigned to three groups (n = 10) to receive three diets: control non-supplemented diets composed of 60% concentrate mixture and 40% Egyptian Clover (Trifolium alexandrinum); control diet supplemented with DF at15 g/head/d (F15); and control diet supplemented with DF at 30 g/head/d (F30). The results indicated that DF is rich in several nutrients and phytochemicals such as phenols, tannins, and flavonoids. The supplementation improved the digestibility of nutrients (p < 0.05). Additionally, group F30 revealed higher ammonia, total volatile fatty acids (VFA), acetic, propionic, iso butyric, butyric, iso valeric, and valeric (p < 0.05). Supplemented groups (F15 and F30) showed lower predicted methane (p < 0.05). Higher milk yield was observed in group F30 (p < 0.05). The supplementation affected the bacterial community, which was dominated by phyla Bacteroidota and Firmicutes. Additionally, the supplementation enhanced fiber-degrading bacteria such as Prevotella, Butyrivibrio, Christensenellaceae R-7 group, and Ruminococcus (p < 0.05). Dried Fenugreek sprouts affected rumen microbiota and improved animal performance. Therefore, it could be supplemented to lactating goats at 30 g/head.
articles.abstractZh: 发芽胡芦巴是营养物质和生物活性化合物的丰富来源；因此，它引起了人们对提高动物生产力和健康的兴趣。本研究评估了两种水平的干胡芦巴芽 (DF)（Trigonella foenum-graecum L.）对哈萨尼山羊产奶量和成分、消化率、瘤胃发酵和瘤胃细菌的影响。将 30 只哈桑尼泌乳山羊分为三组 (n = 10)，接受三种日粮： 对照非补充日粮，由 60% 浓缩物混合物和 40% 埃及三叶草 (Trifolium alexandrinum) 组成；添加 DF 的对照饮食为 15 克/头/天 (F15)；以及添加 DF 30 g/头/天的对照饮食 (F30)。结果表明，DF富含酚类、单宁酸和类黄酮等多种营养物质和植物化学物质。补充剂提高了营养素的消化率（p < 0.05）。此外，F30 组的氨、总挥发性脂肪酸 (VFA)、乙酸、丙酸、异丁酸、丁酸、异戊酸和戊酸含量较高 (p < 0.05)。补充组（F15 和 F30）显示出较低的预测甲烷值（p < 0.05）。 F30 组观察到较高的产奶量 (p < 0.05)。补充

articles.title: Endophytic Trichoderma and Bacillus isolates suppress Lasiodiplodia theobromae-associated dieback in blueberry under arid coastal conditions.
articles.titleZh: 在干旱沿海条件下，内生木霉和芽孢杆菌分离株可抑制蓝莓中与可可毛二孢相关的顶枯病。
articles.authors: Villanueva-Olivera W, Valladolid-Suyón E, Palomino M, Paredes J JC, Rivas J, Solórzano R, Jaramillo-Carrión M.
articles.abstract: Blueberry (Vaccinium corymbosum L.) production represents one of the main pillars of Peruvian agro-exports; however, its sustainability is increasingly threatened by wood-infecting fungal diseases such as dieback. This study was conducted in the Nuevo Proyecto-Olmos area (Lambayeque, Peru), covering a total cultivated area of 176 ha. The objectives were to molecularly identify the fungal pathogens associated with blueberry dieback to perform a preliminary evaluation of the antagonistic potential of endophytic microorganisms. Pathogens were isolated and characterized using morphological and molecular approaches, followed by pathogenicity tests and in vitro efficacy assays of beneficial microorganisms. Disease incidence was dominated by Lasiodiplodia spp., followed by Neopestalotiopsis, Fusarium, and Diaporthe. Lasiodiplodia theobromae was the most prevalent and aggressive species, confirming its association with the observed disease symptoms. For the genus Lasiodiplodia, temperatures between 25 and 30 °C favored mycelial growth, whereas 20 °C and 35 °C limited development. Endophytic isolates of Trichoderma spp. and Bacillus spp. inhibited pathogen mycelial growth by more than 60% under in vitro conditions. These findings highlight the potential of beneficial microorganisms as preliminary candidates for the biological control of wood-infecting fungi in blueberry production systems.
articles.abstractZh: 蓝莓（Vaccinium corymbosum L.）生产是秘鲁农产品出口的主要支柱之一；然而，其可持续性日益受到枯萎病等木材感染真菌病害的威胁。这项研究在 Nuevo Proyecto-Olmos 地区（秘鲁兰巴耶克）进行，总耕地面积为 176 公顷。目的是从分子角度鉴定与蓝莓枯萎病相关的真菌病原体，以对内生微生物的拮抗潜力进行初步评估。使用形态学和分子方法分离和表征病原体，然后进行致病性测试和有益微生物的体外功效测定。发病率以毛毛二孢属为主，其次为新拟盘霉属、镰刀菌属和毛霉属。 Lasiodiplodia theobromae 是最常见和最具攻击性的物种，证实了它与观察到的疾病症状的相关性。对于毛二倍体属，25 至 30 °C 之间的温度有利于菌丝生长，而 20 °C 和 35 °C 限制发育。木霉属的内生分离株。和芽孢杆菌属。抑制病原体菌丝生长60%以上

articles.title: Investigating uncharacterised genes in Saccharomyces cerevisiae using robot scientists.
articles.titleZh: 使用机器人科学家研究酿酒酵母中未表征的基因。
articles.authors: Bjurström EY, Gower AH, Lasin P, Savolainen OI, Tiukova IA, King RD.
articles.abstract: Despite extensive research on Saccharomyces cerevisiae functional genomics, approximately 880 out of ~6,000 open reading frames (ORFs) remain uncharacterised. In this study we propose a method for characterising genes with limited prior functional knowledge using an automated laboratory platform, in conjunction with several hypothesis instantiation methods. We demonstrate this method by investigating YGR067C, an uncharacterised ORF hypothesised to regulate respiration during the diauxic shift. Predictions of the first-order effects of deletion were obtained by curating a list of pathways relevant to the hypothesis. Higher-order effects were predicted using simulation models based on the GEM Yeast9. The predictions were tested using empirical data from biological experiments performed in the Robot Scientist Eve, which generated OD560, transcriptomics, and metabolomics data. We observed that YGR067C deletion led to downregulation of transcripts in some ethanol consuming respiratory pathways during the glucose phase During the ethanol phase we observed that NAD+, NADP+ and NADH accumulated, and several amino acid biosynthesis pathways were enriched for the ygr067c∆ strain, suggesting longer term consequences of YGR067C mediated regulation. Based on these observations we propose that the role of YGR067C during the diauxic shift is to regulate genes related to ethanol consumption and respiration in the glucose phase.
articles.abstractZh: 尽管对酿酒酵母功能基因组学进行了广泛的研究，但约 6,000 个开放阅读框 (ORF) 中的约 880 个仍未得到表征。在本研究中，我们提出了一种使用自动化实验室平台结合几种假设实例化方法来表征具有有限先验功能知识的基因的方法。我们通过研究 YGR067C 来证明这种方法，YGR067C 是一种未表征的 ORF，假设在双峰转变期间调节呼吸。通过整理与假设相关的路径列表，获得了对删除的一阶效应的预测。使用基于 GEM Yeast9 的模拟模型预测了高阶效应。使用机器人科学家夏娃中进行的生物实验的经验数据对预测进行了测试，该实验生成了 OD560、转录组学和代谢组学数据。我们观察到，YGR067C 缺失导致葡萄糖阶段期间一些乙醇消耗呼吸途径中的转录本下调。在乙醇阶段，我们观察到 NAD+、NADP+ 和 NADH 积累，并且 ygr067cΔ 菌株的几种氨基酸生物合成途径富集，这表明

articles.title: Structural and functional dissection of a higher-order oligomerization interface in yeast ceramide synthase.
articles.titleZh: 酵母神经酰胺合酶中高阶寡聚化界面的结构和功能解剖。
articles.authors: Fang Q, Yang C, Yao N, Xie T, Gong X.
articles.abstract: Ceramide synthases (CerSs) are crucial enzymes in sphingolipid metabolism and have shown therapeutic potential for treating various metabolic disorders. However, their regulatory mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this study, we report the cryo-electron microscopy structure of a yeast CerS (yCerS), composed of a catalytic Lac1 subunit and a regulatory Lip1 subunit, organized into a higher-order 4:4 assembly. This assembly is formed by dimerization of two 2:2 Lac1-Lip1 subcomplexes via an interface primarily involving the Lac1 subunit. Notably, within this interface, the C-terminal transmembrane helix (TM8) of Lac1 adopts a dramatically twisted conformation and engages in extensive interactions with TMs 6/7/8 of the adjacent Lac1 subunit. This structural rearrangement sterically occludes the catalytic chamber and blocks acyl-CoA substrate entry. Functional assays further demonstrate that, although structurally reminiscent of an autoinhibitory conformation, this interface is required for the regulation of ceramide output and cellular adaption during perturbation of complex sphingolipid biosynthesis. Together, our findings uncover a complex oligomerization-mediated regulatory mechanism in yCerS, advancing the mechanistic understanding of ceramide synthesis control and highlighting the nuanced role of oligomerization in modulating CerS activity.
articles.abstractZh: 神经酰胺合酶 (CerS) 是鞘脂代谢中的关键酶，并已显示出治疗各种代谢疾病的潜力。然而，人们对它们的调控机制仍知之甚少。在这项研究中，我们报道了酵母 CerS (yCerS) 的冷冻电子显微镜结构，该结构由催化 Lac1 亚基和调节性 Lip1 亚基组成，组织成高阶 4:4 组装。该组装体由两个 2:2 Lac1-Lip1 子复合物通过主要涉及 Lac1 亚基的界面二聚化而形成。值得注意的是，在该界面内，Lac1 的 C 端跨膜螺旋 (TM8) 采用显着扭曲的构象，并与相邻 Lac1 亚基的 TM 6/7/8 进行广泛的相互作用。这种结构重排在空间上封闭了催化室并阻止酰基辅酶A底物进入。功能测定进一步表明，尽管在结构上让人想起自抑制构象，但在复杂鞘脂生物合成的扰动过程中，该界面是调节神经酰胺输出和细胞适应所必需的。总之，我们的发现揭示了一个复杂的寡聚介导的调节机制

articles.title: The ribosome-associated N-terminal acetyltransferase B coordinates global proteostasis and autophagy in plants by creating Ac/N-degrons.
articles.titleZh: 核糖体相关的 N 末端乙酰转移酶 B 通过产生 Ac/N-降解决定子来协调植物中的整体蛋白质稳态和自噬。
articles.authors: Gong X, Pożoga M, Boyer JB, Xue Y, Meinnel T, Bange T, Giglione C, Hell R, Wirtz M.
articles.abstract: The N-terminal acetyltransferase B (NatB) acetylates ~20% of the eukaryotic proteome. However, the role of NatB-mediated N-terminal acetylation (NTA) for the regulation of the proteome fate remains unclear in eukaryotes. In this study, we demonstrate that CRISPR-Cas9-mediated deletion of NatB activity in plants results in significantly lowered global protein turnover due to decreased ubiquitin-proteasome system (UPS) activity and protein translation. Quantitative proteomics uncovers that NatB substrates are significantly enriched in the fraction of stabilized proteins in natb mutants. We provide direct evidence that the absent NTA of KIN11, a subunit of the autophagy-controlling energy sensor SnRK1, protects it from UPS-mediated destruction. The resulting accumulation of KIN11 is responsible for the increased resistance of natb mutants to energy limitation induced by prolonged darkness. Our findings establish NatB as a central regulator of UPS-autophagy interplay and highlight its role in maintaining proteome stability and enabling dynamic stress responses in plants.
articles.abstractZh: N 末端乙酰转移酶 B (NatB) 乙酰化约 20% 的真核蛋白质组。然而，NatB 介导的 N 末端乙酰化 (NTA) 在真核生物中调节蛋白质组命运的作用仍不清楚。在这项研究中，我们证明了 CRISPR-Cas9 介导的植物中 NatB 活性的缺失，由于泛素蛋白酶体系统 (UPS) 活性和蛋白质翻译的降低，导致整体蛋白质周转率显着降低。定量蛋白质组学发现，natB 底物在 natb 突变体中的稳定蛋白部分显着富集。我们提供的直接证据表明，KIN11（自噬控制能量传感器 SnRK1 的一个亚基）缺失 NTA 可保护其免受 UPS 介导的破坏。 KIN11 的积累导致 natb 突变体对长时间黑暗引起的能量限制的抵抗力增强。我们的研究结果确立了 NatB 作为 UPS-自噬相互作用的中央调节器，并强调了其在维持蛋白质组稳定性和实现植物动态应激反应中的作用。

articles.title: Conserved pathway for homarine catabolism in environmental bacteria.
articles.titleZh: 环境细菌中高胺分解代谢的保守途径。
articles.authors: Ferrer-González FX, Heal KR, Sacks JS, Romero-Maysonet Y, Finch AH, Carlson LT, Coe LSY, Bartolek Z, Luthy CB, Gaffney MP, Angier SK, Flynn SE, Bachmann Gómez CI, Dunn JML, Bay KJ, Yamamoto LA, Tien MZ, Armbrust EV, Durham BP, Sosa OA, Ingalls AE.
articles.abstract: Homarine (N-methylpicolinic acid) is a ubiquitous marine metabolite produced by phytoplankton and noted for its infochemical properties among marine animals, yet its microbial degradation pathways are uncharacterized. Here we identify a conserved operon (homABCDER) that mediates homarine catabolism in bacteria using comparative transcriptomics, mutagenesis and targeted knockouts. Phylogenetic and genomic analyses show that this operon is distributed across abundant bacterial clades, including coastal copiotrophs (for example, Rhodobacterales) and open-ocean oligotrophs (for example, SAR11, SAR116), and in genomes from non-marine environments. High-resolution mass spectrometry revealed N-methylglutamic acid and glutamic acid as key metabolic products of homarine in both model and natural systems, with N-methyl-glutamate dehydrogenase catalysing their conversion. Metatranscriptomics showed responsive and in situ expression of hom genes aligned with homarine availability. These findings uncover the genetic and metabolic basis of homarine degradation, establish its ecological relevance and highlight homarine as a versatile growth substrate that feeds into central metabolism via glutamic acid in diverse marine bacteria.
articles.abstractZh: Homarine（N-甲基吡啶甲酸）是浮游植物产生的一种普遍存在的海洋代谢物，因其在海洋动物中的信息化学特性而闻名，但其微生物降解途径尚不清楚。在这里，我们通过比较转录组学、诱变和靶向敲除，鉴定了一个保守操纵子（homABCDER），它介导细菌中的高胺分解代谢。系统发育和基因组分析表明，该操纵子分布在丰富的细菌进化枝中，包括沿海富营养菌（例如红细菌目）和公海寡营养菌（例如 SAR11、SAR116）以及来自非海洋环境的基因组。高分辨率质谱分析表明，N-甲基谷氨酸和谷氨酸是模型和自然系统中白马碱的关键代谢产物，N-甲基谷氨酸脱氢酶催化它们的转化。宏转录组学显示 hom 基因的响应性和原位表达与 Homarine 的可用性相关。这些发现揭示了苋碱降解的遗传和代谢基础，建立了其生态相关性，并强调了苋碱作为一种多功能生长底物，通过谷氨酰胺进入中央代谢

articles.title: Deep homology and design of proteasome chaperone proteins in Candidozyma auris.
articles.titleZh: 耳念珠菌蛋白酶体伴侣蛋白的深度同源性和设计。
articles.authors: Rapala JR, Siddiq M, Wittkopp PJ, O'Meara MJ, O'Meara TR.
articles.abstract: A central tenet of biology is that protein structure mediates the sequence-function relationship. Recently, there has been excitement about the promise of advances in protein structure modeling to generate hypotheses about sequence-structure-function relationships. Here, we leverage structural similarity to identify rapidly evolving proteasome assembly chaperones and characterize their function in Candidozyma (Candida) auris. Despite extensive sequence divergence, we demonstrate conservation of function, corroborating that specific folds, and not sequences, are required for function. This theoretical premise suggests that protein structures with certain properties should be functionally interchangeable, even if they were not products of a common evolutionary history. To reduce this theory to practice, we performed structure-informed protein design, exploring sequence space that is not accessible via stepwise evolution, and mutated more than 40 residues in the Poc4 proteasome assembly chaperone to demonstrate that artificial proteins can rescue complex biological processes in the context of the whole cell. This sequence-structure-function relationship expands our ability to use structure to identify deep evolutionary relationships between proteins and generate hypotheses about gene function in non-model organisms. Overall, this helps to define and understand functional constraints on protein evolution, with important implications for both future protein design and retrospective function prediction.
articles.abstractZh: 生物学的一个中心原则是蛋白质结构介导序列与功能的关系。最近，人们对蛋白质结构建模的进展前景感到兴奋，以产生有关序列-结构-功能关系的假设。在这里，我们利用结构相似性来识别快速进化的蛋白酶体组装伴侣，并表征它们在耳念珠菌（念珠菌）中的功能。尽管存在广泛的序列分歧，但我们证明了功能的保守性，证实了功能需要特定的折叠而不是序列。这一理论前提表明，具有某些特性的蛋白质结构在功能上应该是可以互换的，即使它们不是共同进化历史的产物。为了将这一理论付诸实践，我们进行了基于结构的蛋白质设计，探索了通过逐步进化无法进入的序列空间，并对 Poc4 蛋白酶体组装伴侣中的 40 多个残基进行了突变，以证明人工蛋白质可以在整个细胞的背景下拯救复杂的生物过程。这种序列-结构-功能关系扩展了我们使用结构的能力

articles.title: HR3/RORα-mediated cholesterol sensing regulates TOR signaling.
articles.titleZh: HR3/RORα 介导的胆固醇传感调节 TOR 信号传导。
articles.authors: Lassen M, Pardee K, Bradic I, Pedersen LH, Kubrak O, Ahrentløv N, Clancy S, Koyama T, Necakov A, Liu S, Kuksis A, Lajoie G, Edwards A, Teleman AA, Larsen MR, Krause HM, Texada MJ, Rewitz K.
articles.abstract: Cells and organisms adjust their growth based on the availability of cholesterol, which is essential for cellular functions. However, the mechanisms by which cells sense cholesterol levels and translate these into growth signals are not fully understood. We report that cholesterol rapidly activates the master growth-regulatory TOR pathway in Drosophila tissues. We identify the nuclear receptor HR3, an ortholog of mammalian RORα, as an essential factor in cholesterol-induced TOR activation.
