Here we provide evidence that cross-kingdom RNA interference also occurs in a beneficial plant symbiosis called arbuscular mycorrhiza. The arbuscular mycorrhizal fungus Rhizophagus irregularis transfers small RNAs into plant cells, promoting the colonization of host roots. This finding establishes inter-organismal RNA communication as a new regulatory mechanism of this ancient and widespread symbiosis.
articles.abstractZh: 跨界RNA干扰是植物-病原体相互作用中的一个新兴概念。在这里，我们提供的证据表明，跨界 RNA 干扰也发生在一种称为丛枝菌根的有益植物共生中。丛枝菌根真菌不规则根噬菌将小 RNA 转移到植物细胞中，促进宿主根部的定殖。这一发现将生物体间的 RNA 通讯确立为这种古老而广泛的共生关系的新调节机制。

articles.title: De novo design of Ras isoform selective binders.
articles.titleZh: Ras 亚型选择性结合物的从头设计。
articles.authors: Zhang JZ, Li X, Batingana AR, Liu C, Jiang H, Shannon K, Huang BJ, Wu K, Baker D.
articles.abstract: The four major isoforms encoded by RAS proto-oncogenes are differentially associated with cancer, but there are few isoform-specific binding reagents becasue the sequence differences are confined to their disordered C termini. To overcome this limitation, we use deep learning-based methods to design Ras isoform-specific binders (RIBs) for all major Ras isoforms de novo by targeting the Ras C terminus. The RIBs bind to their target Ras isoforms both in vitro and in cells with remarkable specificity, disrupting their membrane localization and inhibiting Ras activity. The RIBs enable dissection of the distinct roles of Ras isoforms during RasG12C inhibitor resistance, demonstrating their utility in understanding Ras biology and disease and suggesting potential therapeutic applications.
articles.abstractZh: RAS原癌基因编码的四种主要异构体与癌症存在差异性相关，但由于序列差异仅限于其无序的C末端，因此很少有异构体特异性结合试剂。为了克服这一限制，我们使用基于深度学习的方法，通过针对 Ras C 末端，从头设计针对所有主要 Ras 同工型的 Ras 同工型特异性结合物 (RIB)。 RIB 在体外和细胞内均以显着的特异性与其靶 Ras 亚型结合，破坏其膜定位并抑制 Ras 活性。 RIB 能够剖析 Ras 亚型在 RasG12C 抑制剂耐药性过程中的独特作用，证明它们在理解 Ras 生物学和疾病方面的实用性，并提出潜在的治疗应用。

articles.title: Enhancing plant antiviral responses and productivity through the elimination of m<sup>5</sup>C methyltransferase.
articles.titleZh: 通过消除 m<sup>5</sup>C 甲基转移酶增强植物抗病毒反应和生产力。
articles.authors: Jiang Y, Liu P, Zhang M, Yong B, Yin J, Chen L, Shi C, Li P, Guo Y, Hu H, Feng L, Chen L, Zhang T, Liu J, Zhong K, Zhou X, Chen F, Chen J, Yang J.
articles.abstract: RNA 5-methylcytosine (m5C) plays an undefined role in plant antiviral defense. Here, we reveal that the wheat methyltransferase NOP2/Sun RNA methyltransferase 2 (TaNSUN2) is an RNA m5C methyltransferase recruited by eukaryotic elongation factor 1-alpha (TaeEF1A) into Chinese wheat mosaic virus (CWMV) replication complexes (VRCs). TaNSUN2 promotes the m5C modification of CWMV RNAs to stabilize them and enhance their translational efficiency. Moreover, m5C modification in RNA 3' untranslated region strengthens both TaeEF1A binding, promoting viral replication, and viral coat protein interaction, facilitating viral assembly. A major allele of TaNSUN2 prevents its interaction with TaeEF1A and hinders its entry into the VRCs to suppress m5C modification of viral RNAs. TaNSUN2 knockout enhances wheat resistance to CWMV and increases the weight and size of wheat grains. Our findings provide mechanistic insights into the function of RNA modifications in plant virus infection and a valuable genetic resource for future wheat breeding projects.
articles.abstractZh: RNA 5-甲基胞嘧啶 (m5C) 在植物抗病毒防御中发挥着不确定的作用。在这里，我们揭示了小麦甲基转移酶 NOP2/Sun RNA 甲基转移酶 2 (TaNSUN2) 是一种 RNA m5C 甲基转移酶，由真核延伸因子 1-α (TaeEF1A) 招募到中国小麦花叶病毒 (CWMV) 复制复合物 (VRC) 中。 TaNSUN2 促进 CWMV RNA 的 m5C 修饰，以稳定它们并提高其翻译效率。此外，RNA 3'非翻译区的 m5C 修饰增强了 TaeEF1A 结合（促进病毒复制）和病毒外壳蛋白相互作用（促进病毒组装）。 TaNSUN2 的一个主要等位基因阻止其与 TaeEF1A 相互作用，并阻碍其进入 VRC，从而抑制病毒 RNA 的 m5C 修饰。 TaNSUN2 敲除增强了小麦对 CWMV 的抗性，并增加了小麦籽粒的重量和大小。我们的研究结果为植物病毒感染中 RNA 修饰的功能提供了机制见解，并为未来小麦育种项目提供了宝贵的遗传资源。

articles.title: Integrative analysis of mRNA stability regulation uncovers a metastasis-suppressive program in breast cancer.
articles.titleZh: mRNA 稳定性调节的综合分析揭示了乳腺癌的转移抑制程序。
articles.authors: Karner H, Mittmann TC, Chen VW, Borah AA, Langen A, Yousefi H, Fish L, Zaro BW, Navickas A, Goodarzi H.
articles.abstract: Heterogeneity in cancer gene expression is typically linked to genetic and epigenetic alterations, yet the extent of contribution from posttranscriptional regulation remains unclear. Here, we systematically measured messenger RNA (mRNA) dynamics across diverse breast cancer models, revealing that mRNA stability substantially shapes gene expression variability. To decipher these dynamics, we developed GreyHound, an interpretable multimodal deep-learning framework integrating RNA sequence features and RNA binding protein (RBP) expression. GreyHound identified an extensive network of RBPs and their regulons underlying variations in mRNA stability, including a regulatory axis centered on RBP RBMS3 and redox regulator TXNIP. RBMS3 depletion resulted in targeted transcript destabilization-associated with poor clinical outcomes and enhanced metastatic potential in xenograft models. In vivo epistasis studies confirmed that RBMS3-mediated regulation of TXNIP mRNA stability drives this metastasis-suppressive program. These findings identify a key posttranscriptional mechanism in breast cancer and illustrate how interpretable models of RNA dynamics can uncover regulatory programs in disease.
articles.abstractZh: 癌症基因表达的异质性通常与遗传和表观遗传改变有关，但转录后调控的贡献程度仍不清楚。在这里，我们系统地测量了不同乳腺癌模型中信使 RNA (mRNA) 的动态，揭示了 mRNA 稳定性在很大程度上影响了基因表达变异性。为了解读这些动态，我们开发了 GreyHound，这是一种可解释的多模式深度学习框架，集成了 RNA 序列特征和 RNA 结合蛋白 (RBP) 表达。 GreyHound 发现了一个广泛的 RBP 网络及其调节子，这些网络是 mRNA 稳定性变化的基础，包括以 RBP RBMS3 和氧化还原调节器 TXNIP 为中心的调节轴。 RBMS3 缺失导致靶向转录本不稳定，与异种移植模型中不良的临床结果和增强的转移潜力相关。体内上位性研究证实，RBMS3 介导的 TXNIP mRNA 稳定性调节驱动了这种转移抑制程序。这些发现确定了乳腺癌的一个关键转录后机制，并说明了可解释的 RNA 动力学模型如何揭示疾病的调控程序。

articles.title: Interactive effects of biochar and microbial biofertilizers on sandy soil fertility and cowpea yield in Egyptian agroecosystems.
articles.titleZh: 生物炭和微生物生物肥料对埃及农业生态系统沙质土壤肥力和豇豆产量的相互作用。
articles.authors: Khalifa DM, Hewait HM, Stanciu AS, Eladly RM, Shalaby ME, Głowacka A.
articles.abstract: Cowpea (Vigna unguiculata ssp. unguiculata) is a promising legume crop for arid and semi-arid regions due to its short growth duration, nutritional value, and drought tolerance. However, sandy soils in Egypt suffer from low fertility, weak aggregation, and poor water-holding capacity, which limit crop productivity. This study evaluated the combined effects of biochar and microbial inoculants (Bacillus amyloliquefaciens and Saccharomyces cerevisiae) on sandy soil fertility and cowpea productivity in Egypt. A two-season (2020–2021) field experiment was conducted in the Ismailia Governorate, Egypt, using cowpea cv. Dokki 126 in a randomized complete block design with 12 treatments (biochar, microbial inoculants, nitrogen fertilizer, and their combinations) and three replicates. The integrated application of biochar and microbial inoculants significantly increased total microbial counts by up to 65% and dehydrogenase activity by 42% compared to the control. Soil bulk density decreased by 18%, total porosity increased by 22%, and available soil N, P, and K contents increased by 45%, 52%, and 39%, respectively, leading to higher chlorophyll content (+ 28%), plant length (+ 21%), and seed yield (+ 33%) relative to the control. These findings indicate that integrating biochar with microbial inoculants significantly enhances sandy soil fertility and cowpea productivity, offering a sustainable pathway for soil restoration in arid ecosystems.
articles.abstractZh: 豇豆（Vigna unguiculata ssp. unguiculata）因其生长期短、营养价值高、耐旱性强，是干旱和半干旱地区很有前景的豆科作物。然而，埃及的沙质土壤肥力低、团聚性弱、持水能力差，限制了作物生产力。本研究评估了生物炭和微生物接种剂（解淀粉芽孢杆菌和酿酒酵母）对埃及沙质土壤肥力和豇豆生产力的综合影响。使用豇豆品种在埃及伊斯梅利亚省进行了两个季节（2020-2021）的田间试验。 Dokki 126 采用随机完整区组设计，包含 12 种处理（生物炭、微生物接种剂、氮肥及其组合）和 3 个重复。与对照相比，生物炭和微生物接种剂的综合应用使微生物总数显着增加了 65%，脱氢酶活性增加了 42%。土壤容重下降 18%，总孔隙度增加 22%，有效土壤 N、P 和 K 含量分别增加 45%、52% 和 39%，导致叶绿素含量 (+ 28%)、植物长度 (+ 21%) 和种子增加

articles.title: RejuAgro A as an antimicrobial for fire blight control of pome fruits and beyond.
articles.titleZh: RejuAgro A 作为抗菌剂，用于控制仁果类水果及其他水果的火疫病。
articles.authors: Huang J, Huyen TNBV, Liu X, Mitra S, Yu M, Zeng Q, Sundin GW, Cox KD, Förster H, Adaskaveg JE, Kuo CH, Yuan X, Cuhel RL, Yang CH.
articles.abstract: Fire blight, caused by Erwinia amylovora, severely impacts global apple and pear production. Current control measures rely heavily on conventional antibiotics like streptomycin, oxytetracycline, and kasugamycin, which raise concerns regarding resistance development and environmental impacts. This research introduces RejuAgro A (RAA), an antimicrobial produced by Pseudomonas soli 0617-T307, showing potent activity against E. amylovora, including streptomycin-resistant strains. RAA demonstrates efficacy comparable to streptomycin in field trials, effectively reducing fire blight incidence. Studies on the antimicrobial mechanism reveal that RAA inhibits RNA, DNA, and protein synthesis, distinguishing from that of conventional antibiotics. Furthermore, RAA displays broad-spectrum activity against diverse plant bacterial and fungal pathogens. The RAA biosynthesis gene cluster in P. soli is identified, revealing key genes essential for its production. RAA presents an alternative to traditional antibiotics, potentially enhancing sustainable apple and pear production and addressing antibiotic resistance concerns.
articles.abstractZh: 由火疫病菌引起的火疫病严重影响了全球苹果和梨的生产。目前的控制措施严重依赖链霉素、土霉素和春雷霉素等传统抗生素，这引起了人们对耐药性发展和环境影响的担忧。本研究介绍了 RejuAgro A (RAA)，这是一种由土壤假单胞菌 0617-T307 产生的抗菌剂，对梨火霉 (E. amylovora)（包括链霉素耐药菌株）表现出有效的活性。 RAA 在田间试验中显示出与链霉素相当的功效，可有效降低火疫病的发生率。抗菌机制研究表明，RAA 抑制 RNA、DNA 和蛋白质合成，与传统抗生素不同。此外，RAA 对多种植物细菌和真菌病原体表现出广谱活性。鉴定了 P. soli 中的 RAA 生物合成基因簇，揭示了其生产所必需的关键基因。 RAA 提供了传统抗生素的替代品，有可能提高苹果和梨的可持续生产并解决抗生素耐药性问题。

articles.title: Targeting the lethal weakness of SFTSV: Latest advances in antiviral strategies and immune prevention.
articles.titleZh: 针对SFTSV的致命弱点：抗病毒策略和免疫预防的最新进展。
articles.authors: Weng R, Wu H, Xu Y, Wang Z, Gu S, Chen K.
articles.abstract: In recent years, severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS), caused by the SFTS virus (SFTSV), has a fatality rate ranging from 12% to 50%, but there are currently no approved therapies to effectively treat the infection. Host cell receptors CCR2 and LRP1 have been identified as key entry points for viral invasion, and viral non-structural proteins evade the host innate immune response through multiple mechanisms. Several clinical studies have demonstrated that inflammatory markers (such as, IL-6, TNF-α, etc.), lipid metabolites, and ferritin are reliable prognostic indicators, aiding in early risk stratification. Favipiravir was associated with approximately a 10% reduction in mortality in clinical trials, while JAK inhibitors have shown efficacy in managing cytokine storms in critically ill patients. Recent drug repurposing studies have identified several FDA-approved compounds that show promise in combating SFTSV, potentially accelerating the development of therapeutic options. The comprehensive management of critically ill patients integrates multiple approaches, including antiviral therapy, immunomodulation, and organ function support, significantly improving clinical outcomes. Vaccine development has progressed across several platforms, including live attenuated and mRNA-based technologies. Several candidates have shown protective effects in animal studies, with improved formulations for high-risk elderly individuals. However, challenges remain in establishing protective immunity, ensuring long-term safety, and scaling up production for clinical use. This review summarizes recent progress in the transmission, pathogenesis, clinical features, immune response, prognosis, treatment, and vaccine development for SFTSV. It also identifies knowledge gaps and research limitations, proposing key areas for future focus to improve the management of this emerging infectious disease.
articles.abstractZh: 近年来，由SFTS病毒（SFTSV）引起的严重发热伴血小板减少综合征（SFTS）的病死率在12%至50%之间，但目前尚无批准的疗法可以有效治疗这种感染。宿主细胞受体CCR2和LRP1已被确定为病毒入侵的关键切入点，病毒非结构蛋白通过多种机制逃避宿主先天免疫反应。多项临床研究表明，炎症标志物（如IL-6、TNF-α等）、脂质代谢物和铁蛋白是可靠的预后指标，有助于早期风险分层。临床试验中法维匹拉韦可使死亡率降低约 10%，而 JAK 抑制剂在控制危重患者的细胞因子风暴方面已显示出功效。最近的药物再利用研究已经确定了几种 FDA 批准的化合物，这些化合物在对抗 SFTSV 方面显示出前景，可能会加速治疗方案的开发。危重症患者综合管理，综合抗病毒治疗、免疫调节、器官功能支持等多种手段，显着提高临床救治水平

articles.title: Taxonomic descriptions of Nocardia anocheti sp. nov. and Streptomyces odontomachicola sp. nov. isolated from ants.
articles.titleZh: 诺卡氏菌的分类学描述。十一月和链霉菌 odontomachicola sp。十一月与蚂蚁隔离。
articles.authors: Somphong A, Tunvongvinis T, Suriyachadkun C, Jaitrong W, Harunari E, Tanasupawat S, Phongsopitanun W.
articles.abstract: Two novel actinomycete strains, AG03ᵀ and ODS28ᵀ, were isolated from worker ants Anochetus graeffei and Odontomachus simillimus, respectively, collected in Thailand. Strain AG03ᵀ exhibited the highest 16S rRNA gene sequence similarity (98.28%) to Nocardia grenadensis NBRC 108939ᵀ, whereas strain ODS28ᵀ showed the highest similarity (97.73%) to Actinacidiphila bryophytorum NEAU-HZ10ᵀ. Chemotaxonomic analysis of AG03ᵀ revealed the presence of meso-diaminopimelic acid in the cell wall, glucose and mannose as whole-cell sugars, and MK-8(H₄ω-cycl) as the predominant menaquinone. In contrast, ODS28ᵀ contained LL-diaminopimelic acid, glucose, ribose, and xylose as whole-cell sugars, with MK-9(H₈) and MK-9(H₆) as the predominant menaquinones. Whole genome sequence-based relatedness values, including average nucleotide identity (ANI) and digital DNA-DNA hybridization (dDDH), supported the classification of both strains as representing novel species. Based on polyphasic taxonomic evidence, strains AG03ᵀ and ODS28ᵀ are proposed as the type strains of Nocardia anocheti sp. nov. (AG03ᵀ = TBRC 16206ᵀ = NBRC 115864ᵀ) and Streptomyces odontomachicola sp. nov. (ODS28ᵀ = TBRC 18345ᵀ = NBRC 116641ᵀ), respectively. The genomes of both strains contained biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) potentially responsible for the production of bioactive secondary metabolites. These findings suggest that social insects, such as ants, represent a promising source of novel actinomycetes.
articles.abstractZh: 两种新的放线菌菌株 AG03ᵀ 和 ODS28ᵀ 分别从泰国收集的工蚁 Anochetus graeffei 和 Odontomachus simillimus 中分离出来。菌株 AG03ᵀ 与诺卡氏菌 NBRC 108939ᵀ 表现出最高的 16S rRNA 基因序列相似性 (98.28%)，而菌株 ODS28ᵀ 与 Actinacidiphila bryophytorum NEAU-HZ10ᵀ 表现出最高的相似性 (97.73%)。 AG03ᵀ 的化学分类学分析揭示了细胞壁中存在内消旋二氨基庚二酸、作为全细胞糖的葡萄糖和甘露糖以及作为主要甲基萘醌的 MK-8（H₄ω-环）。相比之下，ODS28ᵀ 含有 LL-二氨基庚二酸、葡萄糖、核糖和木糖作为全细胞糖，其中 MK-9(H₈) 和 MK-9(H₆) 是主要的甲基萘醌。基于全基因组序列的相关性值，包括平均核苷酸同一性 (ANI) 和数字 DNA-DNA 杂交 (dDDH)，支持将两种菌株分类为代表新物种。基于多相分类学证据，菌株 AG03ᵀ 和 ODS28ᵀ 被提议作为 Nocardia anocheti sp 的模式菌株。十一月（AG03ᵀ = TBRC 16206ᵀ = NBRC 115864ᵀ）和 Streptomyces odontomachicola sp。十一月（ODS28ᵀ = TBRC 18345ᵀ = NBRC 116641ᵀ），

articles.title: A robust method for on-chip production and manipulation of lipid vesicles by inverted emulsion.
articles.titleZh: 一种通过反相乳液在芯片上生产和操纵脂质囊泡的可靠方法。
articles.authors: Yandrapalli N, Gonzales DT, Leng W, Alsayyah C, Abdukarimov N, Ernst R, Tang TD.
articles.abstract: Lipid vesicles are important as minimal model systems for cellular compartmentalization. They drive major advances in deciphering biological mechanisms by molecular reconstitution; provide rational solutions for primitive compartmentalization in origin-of-life studies; form the basis of synthetic cells and drug delivery vehicles. The emulsion method is a well-established route for producing bilayer lipid vesicles. However, the application of this method in microfluidics requires complex and specialized machinery. The bulk method suffers from the need to physically manipulate the vesicles through oil layers for characterization that can damage the vesicles. Given this, we present a facile and robust method for on-chip production and manipulation of lipid vesicles by the emulsion method. We prepared a simple device that allows preparation, imaging, and collection of activated lipid vesicles. This technique combines minimal processing steps with maximum flexibility in lipid vesicle production and manipulation with direct imaging, thus fast-tracking production lines across disciplines.
articles.abstractZh: 脂质囊泡作为细胞区室化的最小模型系统非常重要。他们推动了通过分子重建破译生物机制的重大进展；为生命起源研究中的原始划分提供合理的解决方案；形成合成细胞和药物输送载体的基础。乳液法是生产双层脂质囊泡的成熟途径。然而，这种方法在微流体中的应用需要复杂且专门的机械。本体方法需要通过油层对囊泡进行物理操作以进行表征，这可能会损坏囊泡。鉴于此，我们提出了一种通过乳液法在芯片上生产和操作脂质囊泡的简便而可靠的方法。我们准备了一个简单的装置，可以制备、成像和收集活化的脂质囊泡。该技术将最少的处理步骤与脂质囊泡生产和操作的最大灵活性与直接成像相结合，从而快速跟踪跨学科的生产线。

articles.title: Acinetobacter baumannii's lifestyle includes soil-dwelling colonization of decaying plant material and airborne spread.
articles.titleZh: 鲍曼不动杆菌的生活方式包括腐烂植物材料在土壤中的定植和空气传播。
articles.authors: Wilharm G, Skiebe E, Michalska A, Higgins PG, Weber K, Schaudinn C, Neugebauer C, Görlitz K, Meimers G, Rizova Y, Blaschke U, Heider C, Cuny C, Drewes S, Heuser E, Jeske K, Jacob J, Ulrich RG, Bocheński M, Kasprzak M, Burda E, Ciepliński M, Kaługa I, Jankowiak Ł, Aguirre JI, López-García A, Höfle U, Jagiello Z, Tobółka M, Janic B, Zieliński P, Kamiński M, Frisch J, Siekiera J, Wendel AF, Brauner P, Jäckel U, Kaatz M, Müller S, Lübke-Becker A, Wieler LH, von Wachsmann J, Thrukonda L, Helal M, Epping L, Wolf SA, Semmler T, Jerzak L.
articles.abstract: Acinetobacter baumannii is a Gram-negative nosocomial pathogen that is notorious for its rapid development of antibiotic resistance. However, its ecology and evolution outside hospital settings remain poorly defined. Here, we demonstrate that the natural lifestyle of A. baumannii includes soil-dwelling and airborne dissemination, which helps explaining its adaptability and tolerance to desiccation, radiation and antibiotics, and thus its predisposition to establish within hospitals. Starting from white stork nestlings previously discovered as a reservoir, we studied food chains and associated environments and identified soil and decaying plants as habitats. We demonstrate that sterilized plant material is rapidly colonized by airborne A. baumannii. A set of 401 genomes were sequenced and compared to publicly available genomes, revealing numerous links between wildlife isolates and hospital strains, and disclosing intercontinental dispersal. Our pan-genome estimate of the species (~51,000 gene families) more than doubles that of previous studies. Our data further suggest massive radiation of the species early after its emergence, possibly fostered by human activity since the Neolithic. Now, it is possible to study the ecology and evolution of A. baumannii in nature at an unprecedented temporal and spatial resolution and to elucidate the adaptive evolution of environmental bacteria towards multidrug-resistant opportunistic pathogens.
articles.abstractZh: 鲍曼不动杆菌是一种革兰氏阴性医院病原体，因其快速发展的抗生素耐药性而臭名昭著。然而，其在医院环境之外的生态和进化仍然不明确。在这里，我们证明了鲍曼不动杆菌的自然生活方式包括土壤栖息和空气传播，这有助于解释其对干燥、辐射和抗生素的适应性和耐受性，从而解释其在医院内定居的倾向。从之前被发现作为水库的白鹳雏鸟开始，我们研究了食物链和相关环境，并确定了土壤和腐烂的植物作为栖息地。我们证明，空气中的鲍曼不动杆菌能够迅速定植于灭菌的植物材料中。对 401 个基因组进行了测序，并与公开的基因组进行了比较，揭示了野生动物分离株和医院菌株之间的众多联系，并揭示了洲际传播。我们对该物种的泛基因组估计（约 51,000 个基因家族）是之前研究的两倍多。我们的数据进一步表明，该物种在出现后不久就发生了大规模辐射，这可能是由于新石器时代以来的人类活动造成的

articles.title: CF2H: a cell-free two-hybrid platform for rapid protein binder screening.
articles.titleZh: CF2H：用于快速蛋白质结合剂筛选的无细胞双杂交平台。
articles.authors: Capin J, Mayonove P, DeVisch A, Becher A, Ngo G, Courbet A, Ragotte RJ, Cohen Gonsaud M, Espeut J, Bonnet J.
articles.abstract: Protein binders that detect, activate, inhibit, or otherwise modulate their targets are pivotal for biomedical applications. With the increasing accuracy and accessibility of de novo protein design, faster and cheaper experimental screening methods would democratize and accelerate the identification of high-affinity binders. Here we present Cell-Free Two-Hybrid (CF2H), a rapid and sensitive method for detecting high-affinity protein-protein interactions (PPI) that does not require cloning, protein purification nor high-end laboratory equipment. CF2H uses a dimerization-activated DNA binding domain (DBD) fused to prey and bait proteins to trigger transcription upon protein-protein interaction. We demonstrate that CF2H enables the detection of interactions between various types of target and binder proteins such as single-domain antibodies, DARPins, and de novo designed binders. We benchmark CF2H as a screening platform by validating previously reported binders for Mdm2 and discovering high-affinity binders targeting the checkpoint inhibitor PD-L1 in less than 24 hours. Finally, we show that CF2H can be used to characterize small-molecule modulators of PPI and detect protein biomarkers, opening the door for a new class of cell-free biosensors.
articles.abstractZh: 检测、激活、抑制或以其他方式调节其靶标的蛋白质结合剂对于生物医学应用至关重要。随着蛋白质从头设计的准确性和可及性不断提高，更快、更便宜的实验筛选方法将实现民主化并加速高亲和力结合物的鉴定。在这里，我们推出无细胞双杂交 (CF2H)，这是一种快速、灵敏的检测高亲和力蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用 (PPI) 的方法，不需要克隆、蛋白质纯化或高端实验室设备。 CF2H 使用与猎物和诱饵蛋白融合的二聚化激活 DNA 结合域 (DBD)，在蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用时触发转录。我们证明 CF2H 能够检测各种类型的靶标和结合蛋白（例如单域抗体、DARPins 和从头设计的结合蛋白）之间的相互作用。我们通过验证先前报道的 Mdm2 结合物并在不到 24 小时内发现针对检查点抑制剂 PD-L1 的高亲和力结合物，将 CF2H 作为筛选平台进行基准测试。最后，我们证明 CF2H 可用于表征 PPI 小分子调节剂并检测蛋白质生物标志物

articles.title: Chromosome-level genome assemblies of the pink snow mold pathogens Microdochium majus and Microdochium nivale.
articles.titleZh: 粉红色雪霉病原体 Microdochium majus 和 Microdochium nivale 的染色体水平基因组组装。
articles.authors: Yang M, Xu M, Chen W, Zhang H, Cheng X, Liu T.
articles.abstract: Wheat Snow Mold (WSM), caused by Microdochium species, poses a serious threat to global wheat production. Despite its importance, the genetic and molecular mechanisms of Microdochium remain poorly understood. In particular, genome-wide differences between M. majus and M. nivale, which were previously considered a single species, have not been fully elucidated. Here, we present the first high-quality telomere-to-telomere genome assemblies of M. majus (231095) and M. nivale (231047), based on Nanopore and Illumina sequencing, with genome sizes of 36.50 Mb and 37.27 Mb. Each assembly was anchored to 13 chromosomes and one circular mitochondrial genome. We identified 11,432 and 11,904 protein-coding genes, with BUSCO completeness scores of 98.5% and 99.3%; of these, 11,094 and 11,504 genes were functionally annotated. Comparative genomics revealed a high degree of collinearity between the two strains, along with segment relocations and gene presence/absence variations. This study enhances our understanding of the genetic foundations of M. majus and M. nivale, laying the groundwork for future research on genetic evolution and disease management.
articles.abstractZh: 小麦雪霉病（WSM）由微地霉菌引起，对全球小麦生产构成严重威胁。尽管它很重要，但人们对 Microdochium 的遗传和分子机制仍然知之甚少。特别是，M. majus 和 M. nivale 之间的全基因组差异（之前被认为是单一物种）尚未完全阐明。在这里，我们展示了基于 Nanopore 和 Illumina 测序的 M. majus (231095) 和 M. nivale (231047) 的首次高质量端粒到端粒基因组组装，基因组大小为 36.50 Mb 和 37.27 Mb。每个组装体都固定在 13 条染色体和一个环状线粒体基因组上。我们鉴定了 11,432 和 11,904 个蛋白质编码基因，BUSCO 完整性得分为 98.5% 和 99.3%；其中，11,094 和 11,504 个基因进行了功能注释。比较基因组学揭示了两种菌株之间的高度共线性，以及片段重定位和基因存在/缺失变异。这项研究增强了我们对 M. majus 和 M. nivale 遗传基础的理解，为未来的遗传进化和疾病管理研究奠定了基础。

articles.title: Covalent warhead assembly in fostriecin biosynthesis involves malonylation-lactonisation by a bifunctional thioesterase and enzymatic demalonylation.
articles.titleZh: 磷霉素生物合成中的共价弹头组装涉及双功能硫酯酶的丙二酰化-内酯化和酶促脱丙二酰化。
articles.authors: Nguyen LNKT, Schlotte L, Hoffmann J, Betz D, Schröder M, Hahn F.
articles.abstract: α,β-Unsaturated δ-lactones (AUDLs) are key pharmacophores of various polyketides exhibiting potent biological activity. Fostriecin has attracted interest as an anticancer agent, but its structural characteristics have limited its development and motivated investigations into biosynthesis-based production strategies. Here, we elucidate the enzymatic steps responsible for AUDL formation in fostriecin biosynthesis by in vitro reconstitution using complex synthetic substrate surrogates. We demonstrate that the terminal polyketide synthase (PKS) module FosMod8 produces a 3-O-malonyllactone by the unusual bifunctional thioesterase FosTE, which catalyses O-malonylation and subsequent lactonisation. Structural modelling and site-directed mutagenesis reveal two arginine residues in the active site of FosTE that mediate malonyl-CoA binding and transesterification, thereby enabling the domain to mimic PKS acyltransferase chemistry. Additionally, we show that AUDL formation is carried out by the demalonylating enzyme FosM, whose activity strongly depends on prior fostriecin backbone phosphorylation by the broad-specific kinase FosH. This arrangement optimises the biosynthesis of phosphorylated AUDL metabolites by minimising shunt intermediate formation and losses from spontaneous side reactions of sensitive intermediates. This unique enzymatic logic represents a blueprint for other AUDLs and understanding it paves the way for new synthetic strategies to AUDL polyketides using chemoenzymatic synthesis or engineered biosynthesis.
articles.abstractZh: α,β-不饱和δ-内酯 (AUDL) 是各种聚酮化合物的关键药效​​团，具有强大的生物活性。磷霉素作为抗癌剂引起了人们的兴趣，但其结构特征限制了其发展并激发了对基于生物合成的生产策略的研究。在这里，我们通过使用复杂的合成底物替代物进行体外重建，阐明了磷三菌素生物合成中负责 AUDL 形成的酶促步骤。我们证明末端聚酮合酶 (PKS) 模块 FosMod8 通过不寻常的双功能硫酯酶 FosTE 产生 3-O-丙二酰内酯，该酶催化 O-丙二酰化和随后的内酯​​化。结构建模和定点诱变揭示了 FosTE 活性位点中的两个精氨酸残基介导丙二酰辅酶 A 结合和酯交换反应，从而使该结构域能够模拟 PKS 酰基转移酶化学。此外，我们发现 AUDL 的形成是由去丙二酰化酶 FosM 进行的，其活性很大程度上取决于广泛特异性激酶 FosH 先前对福斯特菌素主链的磷酸化。这种排列优化了磷酸化的生物合成

articles.title: Hetero-oligomerization drives structural plasticity of eukaryotic peroxiredoxins.
articles.titleZh: 异源寡聚化驱动真核过氧化还原蛋白的结构可塑性。
articles.authors: Zimmermann J, Lang L, Malo Pueyo J, Riedel M, Wahni K, Stobbe D, Leiskau L, Aref E, Lux C, Janvier S, Vertommen D, Lenhard S, Hannemann F, Thangamuragan S, Castro H, Helms V, Tomas AM, Herrmann JM, Salvador A, Mühlhaus T, Riemer J, Messens J, Deponte M, Morgan B.
articles.abstract: Peroxiredoxins are thiol peroxidases, which detoxify peroxides, relay redox signals and act as chaperones. In eukaryotes, multiple peroxiredoxin-1 (Prx1)/AhpC-type isoforms frequently co-exist in the same subcellular compartment, yet have been assumed to assemble only as homo-oligomeric complexes. Here we show that hetero-oligomerization is a conserved and functionally relevant property of Prx1/AhpC-type peroxiredoxins. Using biochemical reconstitution, native mass photometry, electron microscopy and live-cell assays, we demonstrate formation of heterodimers and heterodecamers, with diverse subunit stoichiometries, in peroxiredoxin pairs from different eukaryotic kingdoms. In Saccharomyces cerevisiae, oxidative challenge induces Tsa1-Tsa2 heterodecamerization with substoichiometric Tsa2 incorporation sufficing to stabilize the decameric state. Functional hetero-oligomers are also observed forming among human, plant and Leishmania peroxiredoxins. Our findings provide new insights into peroxiredoxin structural plasticity with broad implications for redox biology, stress responses and cellular adaptation, and also challenge the long-held paradigm of peroxiredoxin homo-oligomerization.
articles.abstractZh: 过氧化还原蛋白是硫醇过氧化物酶，可解毒过氧化物、传递氧化还原信号并充当伴侣。在真核生物中，多种过氧化还原蛋白-1 (Prx1)/AhpC 型同种型经常共存于同一亚细胞区室中，但被认为仅以同源寡聚复合物的形式组装。在这里，我们证明异源寡聚是 Prx1/AhpC 型过氧化还原蛋白的保守且功能相关的特性。使用生化重建、天然质量光度测定、电子显微镜和活细胞测定，我们证明了来自不同真核王国的过氧化还原蛋白对中具有不同亚基化学计量的异二聚体和异十聚体的形成。在酿酒酵母中，氧化挑战诱导 Tsa1-Tsa2 异十聚化，亚化学计量的 Tsa2 掺入足以稳定十聚状态。还观察到在人类、植物和利什曼原虫过氧化还原蛋白中形成功能性异源低聚物。我们的研究结果为过氧化还原蛋白结构可塑性提供了新的见解，对氧化还原生物学、应激反应和细胞适应具有广泛的影响，同时也挑战了长期以来所持有的过氧化还原蛋白同源寡聚的范式。

articles.title: Porphyromonas gingivalis produces a functional HemH ferrochelatase important for its survival in a heme-limited environment.
articles.titleZh: 牙龈卟啉单胞菌产生功能性 HemH 亚铁螯合酶，这对于其在血红素有限的环境中生存至关重要。
articles.authors: Śmiga M, Roszkiewicz E, Wojtal N, Olczak T.
articles.abstract: Porphyromonas gingivalis, the keystone pathogen responsible for dysbiosis in the oral microbiome, the development of periodontal diseases, and the contribution to systemic comorbidities, is a heme auxotroph. It encodes only four enzymes in the heme biosynthesis pathway (HemD, HemN, HemG, and HemH). Comparative genomic analyses demonstrated that, while many Bacteroidota members have lost most of the canonical heme biosynthetic enzymes, Porphyromonas species uniquely retained a ferrochelatase (HemH) homolog. This study aimed to functionally characterize the P. gingivalis HemH protein to prove its hypothesized role in heme formation. HemH can bind heme and PPIX and insert iron or manganese ions into the PPIX ring. The deletion of the hemH gene triggers a heme-starvation response characterized by transcriptional activation of heme uptake systems and virulence-associated genes, coupled with repression of transport and surface proteins preferentially expressed in heme-rich conditions. Therefore, it is proposed that HemH may play a role in maintaining proper heme homeostasis. In a heme-limited environment, P. gingivalis may use intracellular iron and PPIX reserves to synthesize heme by HemH, thereby contributing to heme supply.
articles.abstractZh: 牙龈卟啉单胞菌是导致口腔微生物群失调、牙周病发生以及全身合并症的主要病原体，它是一种血红素营养缺陷型。它仅编码血红素生物合成途径中的四种酶（HemD、HemN、HemG 和 HemH）。比较基因组分析表明，虽然许多拟杆菌门成员已经失去了大部分典型的血红素生物合成酶，但卟啉单胞菌物种独特地保留了亚铁螯合酶 (HemH) 同源物。本研究旨在对牙龈卟啉单胞菌 HemH 蛋白进行功能表征，以证明其在血红素形成中的假设作用。 HemH可以结合血红素和PPIX并将铁或锰离子插入PPIX环中。 hemH 基因的缺失会引发血红素饥饿反应，其特征是血红素摄取系统和毒力相关基因的转录激活，同时抑制在富含血红素的条件下优先表达的转运蛋白和表面蛋白。因此，有人提出 HemH 可能在维持适当的血红素稳态中发挥作用。在血红素有限的环境中，牙龈卟啉单胞菌可能利用细胞内铁和 PPIX 储备通过 He 合成血红素

articles.title: Protection of telomeres 1b safeguards the Arabidopsis genome by regulating ROS homeostasis.
articles.titleZh: 保护端粒 1b 通过调节 ROS 稳态来保护拟南芥基因组。
articles.authors: Min JH, Castillo-González C, Barcenilla BB, Yeo IC, Xie X, Bose S, Ortiz-Morea FA, Liu D, Canal E, Curtis D, Yerram M, Shin J, Ulianich P, Phadke C, He P, Wierzbicki AT, Zhang J, Shakirov EV, Juenger TE, Shippen DE.
articles.abstract: Telomeres safeguard the genome, acting as sentinels of oxidative stress and preventing chromosome ends from eliciting a DNA damage response. PROTECTION OF TELOMERES 1 (POT1) is a highly conserved telomere protein, essential for chromosome integrity and telomeric DNA replication. Arabidopsis thaliana encodes two divergent POT1 paralogs: AtPOT1a stimulates telomerase activity, but AtPOT1b function is unknown. Here we show that AtPOT1b modulates reactive oxygen species (ROS) homeostasis. Oxidative stress induces AtPOT1b expression and telomeric accumulation, while AtPOT1b inactivation elevates ROS, increases telomeric and genome-wide oxidation, and causes stochastic telomere length changes. To address how AtPOT1b controls ROS, we report its localization in nuclei and peroxisomes, and association with catalases and peroxidases that enhance ROS scavenging. Impairing AtPOT1b-CAT2 interaction increases ROS accumulation and telomeric oxidation. Moss or human POT1 rescues ROS overaccumulation in Arabidopsis pot1b mutants, but not telomere deficiency in pot1a pot1b mutants, supporting a conserved role for POT1 in modulating ROS homeostasis and genome stability, distinct from canonical telomeric functions.
articles.abstractZh: 端粒保护基因组，充当氧化应激的哨兵并防止染色体末端引发 DNA 损伤反应。端粒保护 1 (POT1) 是一种高度保守的端粒蛋白，对于染色体完整性和端粒 DNA 复制至关重要。拟南芥编码两种不同的 POT1 旁系同源物：AtPOT1a 刺激端粒酶活性，但 AtPOT1b 功能尚不清楚。在这里，我们证明 AtPOT1b 调节活性氧 (ROS) 稳态。氧化应激会诱导 AtPOT1b 表达和端粒积累，而 AtPOT1b 失活会提高 ROS，增加端粒和全基因组氧化，并导致随机端粒长度变化。为了解决 AtPOT1b 如何控制 ROS，我们报告了其在细胞核和过氧化物酶体中的定位，以及与增强 ROS 清除的过氧化氢酶和过氧化物酶的关联。损害 AtPOT1b-CAT2 相互作用会增加 ROS 积累和端粒氧化。 Moss 或人类 POT1 可以挽救拟南芥 pot1b 突变体中的 ROS 过度积累，但不能挽救 pot1a pot1b 突变体中的端粒缺陷，这支持了 POT1 在调节 ROS 稳态和基因组稳定性方面的保守作用，这与经典端粒不同

articles.title: Regulatory networks of iron sulfur cluster biology in cancer mechanisms and therapeutic perspectives.
articles.titleZh: 铁硫簇生物学在癌症机制和治疗前景中的调控网络。
articles.authors: Yao S, Guan H, Chai J, Liu X.
articles.abstract: Iron-sulfur (Fe/S) clusters are essential cofactors required for mitochondrial metabolism, redox regulation, DNA synthesis, and cellular viability. Defects in their biogenesis or function compromise mitochondrial homeostasis, iron balance, and genome stability, alterations frequently observed in cancer. Growing evidence indicates that Fe/S proteins participate in tumor cell proliferation, metabolic adaptation, oxidative stress tolerance, and therapeutic resistance. This review summarizes current knowledge on the mechanisms of Fe/S cluster assembly in distinct cellular compartments, including the mitochondria, cytosol, and nucleus, and outlines their physiological roles in normal and malignant cells. It further discusses the molecular mechanisms by which dysregulation of Fe/S cluster homeostasis contributes to tumorigenesis. In addition, we highlight emerging therapeutic strategies that exploit Fe/S cluster dependencies, including small-molecule approaches, regulated cell death pathways, and nanomedicine-based interventions. Collectively, these insights underscore the relevance of Fe/S cluster biology to cancer pathogenesis and its potential for therapeutic exploitation.
articles.abstractZh: 铁硫 (Fe/S) 簇是线粒体代谢、氧化还原调节、DNA 合成和细胞活力所需的重要辅助因子。它们的生物发生或功能缺陷会损害线粒体稳态、铁平衡和基因组稳定性，这些改变在癌症中经常观察到。越来越多的证据表明，Fe/S 蛋白参与肿瘤细胞增殖、代谢适应、氧化应激耐受和治疗抵抗。这篇综述总结了目前关于不同细胞区室（包括线粒体、细胞质和细胞核）中 Fe/S 簇组装机制的知识，并概述了它们在正常和恶性细胞中的生理作用。它进一步讨论了 Fe/S 簇稳态失调导致肿瘤发生的分子机制。此外，我们还重点介绍了利用 Fe/S 簇依赖性的新兴治疗策略，包括小分子方法、调节细胞死亡途径和基于纳米医学的干预措施。总的来说，这些见解强调了 Fe/S 簇生物学与癌症发病机制的相关性及其治疗开发的潜力。

articles.title: The role and possible mechanism of intestinal fungi in the progression of chronic liver diseases.
articles.titleZh: 肠道真菌在慢性肝病进展中的作用及可能机制。
articles.authors: Hu Y, Yang Y, Wang S, Chu H.
articles.abstract: Chronic liver disease (CLD) causes 2 million annual deaths (4% of all global deaths). While gut bacteria are widely studied, intestinal fungi remain largely overlooked despite their critical roles in maintaining microecological homeostasis. This review summarizes fungal characteristics in alcohol-related liver disease, metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease, primary sclerosing cholangitis, and cirrhosis, analyzing roles of fungi and their metabolites. Targeting the gut fungal community may offer therapeutic strategies for CLD.
articles.abstractZh: 慢性肝病 (CLD) 每年导致 200 万人死亡（占全球死亡人数的 4%）。虽然肠道细菌得到了广泛的研究，但肠道真菌在维持微生态稳态方面发挥着关键作用，但在很大程度上仍然被忽视。本综述总结了酒精相关性肝病、代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪性肝病、原发性硬化性胆管炎和肝硬化中的真菌特征，分析了真菌及其代谢物的作用。针对肠道真菌群落可能为慢性肺病提供治疗策略。

articles.title: Translational regulation by oxidative desulfuration of tRNA modifications.
articles.titleZh: 通过 tRNA 修饰的氧化脱硫进行翻译调节。
articles.authors: Mo Y, Ishiguro K, Miyauchi K, Sakaguchi Y, Hanzawa Y, Akiyama N, Murayama A, Machida K, Imataka H, Yamashita A, Ohira T, Shirouzu M, Suzuki T.
articles.abstract: Modifications in the anticodon region of transfer RNA (tRNA) are essential for accurate and efficient protein synthesis. 5-Methyl-2-thiouridine derivatives (xm5s2U) are major modifications at the wobble position of tRNA anticodons decoding purine-ending two-codon sets. Although the thiocarbonyl group of xm5s2U enhances decoding efficiency, it is chemically susceptible to oxidative desulfuration, yielding 4-pyrimidinone derivatives (xm5h2U). Here, we identify xm5h2U derivatives in human cells and mouse tissues and confirm their cellular formation by spike-in experiments. Desulfurized tRNAs carrying 5-methoxycarbonylmethyl-4-pyrimidinone (mcm5h2U) show impaired codon recognition in a human reconstituted in vitro translation system. The mcm5h2U modification reduces aminoacylation of tRNAs for lysine, glutamate, and glutamine, but not arginine. Cryogenic electron microscopy reveals the structural basis of altered AAA/AAG decoding by mcm5h2U at the ribosomal A-site. These findings reveal a mechanism by which oxidative desulfuration of tRNA modifications dynamically regulates codon recognition and protein synthesis under oxidative stress conditions in human and mammalian cells.
articles.abstractZh: 转移 RNA (tRNA) 反密码子区域的修饰对于准确有效的蛋白质合成至关重要。 5-甲基-2-硫尿苷衍生物 (xm5s2U) 是解码嘌呤末端双密码子集的 tRNA 反密码子摆动位置的主要修饰。尽管xm5s2U的硫代羰基提高了解码效率，但它在化学上对氧化脱硫敏感，产生4-嘧啶酮衍生物(xm5h2U)。在这里，我们鉴定了人类细胞和小鼠组织中的 xm5h2U 衍生物，并通过掺入实验确认了它们的细胞形成。携带 5-甲氧基羰基甲基-4-嘧啶酮 (mcm5h2U) 的脱硫 tRNA 在人体重建的体外翻译系统中显示出密码子识别受损。 mcm5h2U 修饰减少了赖氨酸、谷氨酸和谷氨酰胺的 tRNA 氨酰化，但不减少精氨酸。低温电子显微镜揭示了 mcm5h2U 在核糖体 A 位点改变 AAA/AAG 解码的结构基础。这些发现揭示了人类和哺乳动物细胞氧化应激条件下 tRNA 修饰的氧化脱硫动态调节密码子识别和蛋白质合成的机制。

articles.title: An ultraconserved pseudo 5' splice site fine-tunes development by regulating alternative splicing within TOR-related pathways.
articles.titleZh: 超保守的伪 5' 剪接位点通过调节 TOR 相关途径内的选择性剪接来微调发育。
articles.authors: Ding Z, Fang ZY, Li H, Jiang XP, Xie YL, Bian WX, Wu YT, Lu XY, Song BL, Fan YJ, Xu YZ.
articles.abstract: Introns have expanded dramatically during evolution, and while their internal sequences have greatly diverged, the potential function of ultraconserved RNA motifs remains an important, unanswered question. Sharing the sequence with the utilized 5' splice sites (5'SSs), pseudo-5'SSs are widespread in introns but are never spliced. We searched homologous introns and identified eight ultraconserved pseudo-5'SSs (UCP-5'SSs). The most conserved one resides in the animal ENOX1/Enox genes that are involved in plasma membrane electron transport and cell enlargement. In vivo deletion of this 9-nt UCP-5'SS in Drosophila results in a significantly enlarged ovary and increased fecundity. We demonstrate that this UCP-5'SS is a silencer for alternative splicing (AS) regulation of an upstream ultraconserved essential exon through interaction with the U1 snRNP-core proteins. The AS changes are observed in all the tested Drosophila mutants from the dTOR and Insulin-like pathways. Remarkably, loss of this UCP-5'SS significantly mitigates the changes. Multiple-source human cells treated with the mTOR/Insulin pathway inhibitors also change the AS and specifically increase the translation of U1-70K, suggesting remarkable conservation of this mechanism. This study reveals an ultraconserved regulatory network in which a short intronic RNA element functions as a sensor of TOR-related pathways during ovarian development.
articles.abstractZh: 内含子在进化过程中急剧扩张，虽然它们的内部序列有很大差异，但超保守 RNA 基序的潜在功能仍然是一个重要的、尚未解答的问题。伪 5'SS 与所使用的 5' 剪接位点 (5'SS) 共享序列，在内含子中广泛存在，但从未被剪接。我们搜索了同源内含子并鉴定了八个超保守的伪 5'SS (UCP-5'SS)。最保守的基因存在于动物 ENOX1/Enox 基因中，它们参与质膜电子传递和细胞增大。在果蝇体内删除该 9-nt UCP-5'SS 会导致卵巢显着增大并增加繁殖力。我们证明，该 UCP-5'SS 是一种沉默子，通过与 U1 snRNP 核心蛋白相互作用，对上游超保守必需外显子进行选择性剪接 (AS) 调节。在所有测试的果蝇突变体中都观察到 dTOR 和胰岛素样途径的 AS 变化。值得注意的是，失去 UCP-5'SS 会显着减轻这些变化。用 mTOR/胰岛素途径抑制剂处理的多源人类细胞也会改变 AS，并特别增加 U1-70K 的翻译，su

articles.title: DCPS modulates TDP-43-linked neurodegeneration through P-body-mediated RNA decay.
articles.titleZh: DCPS 通过 P 体介导的 RNA 衰变调节 TDP-43 相关的神经变性。
articles.authors: Ye Y, Zhang Z, Xiao Y, Zhu C, Wright N, Asbury J, Huang Y, Wang W, Gomez-Isaza L, Troncoso JC, He C, Sun S.
articles.abstract: The proteinopathy of the RNA-binding protein TDP-43, characterized by nuclear clearance and cytoplasmic inclusion, is a hallmark of multiple neurodegenerative diseases, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), frontotemporal dementia (FTD), and Alzheimer's disease (AD). Through CRISPR interference (CRISPRi) screening in human neurons, we identified the decapping scavenger enzyme (DCPS) as a novel genetic modifier of TDP-43 loss-of-function (LOF)-mediated neurotoxicity. Our findings reveal that TDP-43 LOF leads to aberrant mRNA degradation via dysregulating the properties and activity of processing bodies (P-bodies). TDP-43 interacts with P-body component proteins, potentially influencing their dynamic equilibrium and assembly into ribonucleoprotein (RNP) granules. Loss of TDP-43 hyperactivates P-bodies, increasing mRNA association and RNA decay. Reducing DCPS restores P-body integrity and RNA turnover, ultimately improving neuronal survival. Overall, this study highlights a novel role of TDP-43 in RNA processing through P-body regulation and identifies DCPS as a potential therapeutic target for TDP-43 proteinopathy-related neurodegenerative diseases.
articles.abstractZh: RNA 结合蛋白 TDP-43 的蛋白病以核清除和细胞质内含物为特征，是多种神经退行性疾病的标志，包括肌萎缩侧索硬化症 (ALS)、额颞叶痴呆 (FTD) 和阿尔茨海默病 (AD)。通过对人类神经元进行 CRISPR 干扰 (CRISPRi) 筛选，我们发现脱帽清道夫酶 (DCPS) 是 TDP-43 功能丧失 (LOF) 介导的神经毒性的新型遗传修饰剂。我们的研究结果表明，TDP-43 LOF 通过调节加工体（P 体）的特性和活性导致异常 mRNA 降解。 TDP-43 与 P 体成分蛋白相互作用，可能影响其动态平衡和组装成核糖核蛋白 (RNP) 颗粒。 TDP-43 的缺失会使 P 体过度激活，增加 mRNA 关联和 RNA 衰减。减少 DCPS 可恢复 P 体完整性和 RNA 更新，最终提高神经元存活率。总体而言，这项研究强调了 TDP-43 通过 P 体调节在 RNA 加工中的新作用，并将 DCPS 确定为 TDP-43 蛋白病相关神经退行性疾病的潜在治疗靶点。

articles.title: High-Quality Genome Assemblies of Two Prototheca wickerhamii Strains.
articles.titleZh: 两种 Prototheca wickerhamii 菌株的高质量基因组组装。
articles.authors: Fang L, Guo J, Ning Q, Luo Y, Jian J, Ning J.
articles.abstract: Prototheca wickerhamii is a non-photosynthetic microalgal species that has been implicated in opportunistic human infections. Understanding its genomic features is crucial for both medical applications and symbiosis research. We generated high-quality genome assemblies for two strains of Prototheca wickerhamii, Pw26 and PwS1, using PacBio HiFi reads. The assemblies were evaluated for completeness and accuracy using BUSCO analysis. The assembled genomes for Pw26 and PwS1 were 17.8 MB and 17.4 MB, respectively, with contig N50 values of 1.6 MB. The number of assembled contigs is closely related to the number of chromosomes. The GC content was 63.5% for both genomes. Comparative analysis showed high similarity in genome size and alignment, with Pw26 having slightly more protein-coding genes (46,394) than PwS1 (44,702). Repeat sequences accounted for 6.03% and 4.18% of the genomes in Pw26 and PwS1, respectively. These high-quality genome assemblies provide a valuable resource for comparative genomics and functional exploration of Prototheca wickerhamii. The detailed genomic characterization supports further studies on pathogenic mechanisms.
articles.abstractZh: Prototheca wickerhamii 是一种非光合作用微藻物种，与人类机会性感染有关。了解其基因组特征对于医学应用和共生研究都至关重要。我们使用 PacBio HiFi 读取为 Prototheca wickerhamii 的两种菌株 Pw26 和 PwS1 生成了高质量的基因组组装。使用 BUSCO 分析评估组件的完整性和准确性。 Pw26 和 PwS1 的组装基因组分别为 17.8 MB 和 17.4 MB，重叠群 N50 值为 1.6 MB。组装的重叠群的数量与染色体的数量密切相关。两个基因组的 GC 含量均为 63.5%。比较分析显示基因组大小和比对高度相似，Pw26 的蛋白质编码基因 (46,394) 略多于 PwS1 (44,702)。重复序列分别占 Pw26 和 PwS1 基因组的 6.03% 和 4.18%。这些高质量的基因组组装为 Prototheca wickerhamii 的比较基因组学和功能探索提供了宝贵的资源。详细的基因组表征支持对致病机制的进一步研究。

articles.title: p38 MAPK orchestrates cross-tissue potassium homeostasis for survival.
articles.titleZh: p38 MAPK 协调跨组织钾稳态以维持生存。
articles.authors: Huang R, Hu F, Li Y, Gao Q, Huang J, Wang J, Lu W, Wang L, Fang Y, Blackwell TK, Wu Z.
articles.abstract: Potassium is vital for life, yet how potassium homeostasis is maintained at the tissue or organismal level under dietary scarcity remains poorly understood. Stress-activated signaling pathway p38 MAPK is implicated in immune response and aging, but its specific role in low potassium response is unclear. Here we show that a specific p38 MAPK-ATF-7 pathway orchestrates cross-tissue potassium homeostasis in Caenorhabditis elegans. It drives transcriptional upregulation of a crucial P-type ATPase pump CATP-3 specifically in the hypodermis, a process that integrates cell-autonomous mechanisms with non-autonomous ASI neuronal signals, thereby enhancing organismal survival during potassium deficiency. Notably, this regulation is distinct from canonical osmotic stress responses, revealing a specialized and conserved survival strategy. Analogous p38-mediated control of P-type ATPases occurs in yeast and mammalian cells, suggesting broad relevance. Our findings redefine potassium regulation as a cross-tissue process linked to lifespan, stress signaling, and innate immunity with potential implications for aging and age-related diseases.
articles.abstractZh: 钾对生命至关重要，但在饮食匮乏的情况下如何在组织或有机体水平上维持钾稳态仍知之甚少。应激激活信号通路 p38 MAPK 与免疫反应和衰老有关，但其在低钾反应中的具体作用尚不清楚。在这里，我们展示了特定的 p38 MAPK-ATF-7 通路在秀丽隐杆线虫中协调跨组织钾稳态。它驱动皮下组织中关键的 P 型 ATP 酶泵 CATP-3 的转录上调，这一过程将细胞自主机制与非自主 ASI 神经元信号整合在一起，从而增强缺钾期间的生物体生存。值得注意的是，这种调节与典型的渗透应激反应不同，揭示了一种专门且保守的生存策略。类似的 p38 介导的 P 型 ATP 酶控制发生在酵母和哺乳动物细胞中，表明具有广泛的相关性。我们的研究结果将钾调节重新定义为与寿命、压力信号和先天免疫相关的跨组织过程，对衰老和年龄相关疾病具有潜在影响。

articles.title: Phytochrome B integrates jasmonic acid and warm temperature signaling pathways to regulate cotyledon chloroplast development.
articles.titleZh: 光敏色素 B 整合茉莉酸和高温信号通路来调节子叶叶绿体发育。
articles.authors: Qi P, Huai J, Gao N, Yao Y, Lin R.
articles.abstract: Chloroplast biogenesis and development are coordinated by both endogenous factors and environmental cues. The interplay between jasmonic acid (JA) and temperature in regulating chloroplast development remains poorly understood. Here, we demonstrate that methyl jasmonate (MeJA) and warm temperature (28 °C) treatments additively impair chlorophyll accumulation and chloroplast development in Arabidopsis thaliana cotyledons. We found that the thermosensor phytochrome B (phyB) suppresses, whereas the JA receptor CORONATINE INSENSITIVE 1 (COI1) promotes, MeJA- and warm temperature-mediated chloroplast development. Moreover, phyB directly interacts with JASMONATE ZIM-DOMAIN 1 (JAZ1) and JAZ3, preventing their JA-induced degradation, and warm temperature attenuates this interaction. Strikingly, we reveal that transcription factors ELONGATED HYPOCOTYL 5 (HY5) and MYC2 oppositely regulate cotyledon chloroplast development in response to MeJA and warm temperature by directly and differentially modulating downstream transcriptional networks. Our study establishes a molecular framework in which phyB integrates JA and warm temperature signaling through the HY5-MYCs transcriptional regulatory network to fine-tune chloroplast development, highlighting a plant strategy for ecological adaptation.
articles.abstractZh: 叶绿体的生物发生和发育是由内源因素和环境因素协调的。茉莉酸（JA）和温度在调节叶绿体发育中的相互作用仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们证明茉莉酸甲酯（MeJA）和温暖的温度（28°C）处理会额外损害拟南芥子叶中的叶绿素积累和叶绿体发育。我们发现热传感器光敏色素 B (phyB) 抑制 MeJA 和温暖温度介导的叶绿体发育，而 JA 受体 CORONATINE INSENSITIVE 1 (COI1) 则促进。此外，phyB 直接与 JASMONATE ZIM-DOMAIN 1 (JAZ1) 和 JAZ3 相互作用，防止 JA 诱导的降解，而温暖的温度会减弱这种相互作用。引人注目的是，我们发现转录因子 ELONGATED HYPOCOTYL 5 (HY5) 和 MYC2 通过直接和差异性地调节下游转录网络，响应 MeJA 和温暖的温度，相反地调节子叶叶绿体发育。我们的研究建立了一个分子框架，其中 phyB 通过 HY5-MYCs 转录调控网络整合 JA 和温暖的温度信号

articles.title: Ribosomal modifications are associated with mesenchymal fate selection in the neural crest lineage.
articles.titleZh: 核糖体修饰与神经嵴谱系中的间充质命运选择相关。
articles.authors: Poverennaya I, Murtazina A, Li L, Maili L, Sourada L, Montano-Gutierrez LF, Galimullina R, Steinschaden T, Kaiser M, Zikmund T, Goralija A, Gao T, Attina A, Clara O, Bartenhagen C, Erickson A, Gershtein Y, Chen S, Polaskova K, Sterba J, Semasch B, Anderson ER, Prakash V, Vincent T, Arceo M, Kogner P, Schlisio S, Kharchenko PV, David A, Kaiser J, Fischer M, Skoda J, Trainor PA, Chagin AS, Adameyko I.
articles.abstract: Neural crest cells contribute to craniofacial formation by differentiating into skeletogenic mesenchyme and neuro-glial lineages. Using Smart-seq2 single-cell transcriptomics, we show that mesenchymal fate commitment correlates specifically with the expression of rRNA-modifying and ribosome assembly factors, rather than structural ribosomal proteins. Notably, EMG1 and NHP2 introduce key post-transcriptional modifications into 18S rRNA, including m¹acp³ψ at U1248, which requires TSR3 for final maturation. Disrupting NHP2 or TSR3 in vitro and in vivo perturbs cranial neural crest differentiation; post-migratory temporal knockout of Polr1a or Polr1c also causes craniofacial malformations. These findings align with cell type-specific m¹acp³ψ levels during neural crest differentiation. Given the neural crest contribution to neuroblastoma, we analyze patient data to find that elevated ribosomal control and rRNA-modifying proteins predict poorer outcomes. Complementary experiments in neuroblastoma cell lines reveal functional roles for TSR3 and WDR74 in mesenchymal-like tumor states. Together, our results link rRNA modifications and ribosome assembly to fate decisions, suggesting ribosomal heterogeneity shapes both normal development and tumor progression.
articles.abstractZh: 神经嵴细胞通过分化成成骨间充质和神经胶质细胞谱系来促进颅面形成。使用 Smart-seq2 单细胞转录组学，我们发现间充质命运承诺与 rRNA 修饰因子和核糖体组装因子的表达（而不是结构核糖体蛋白）特异性相关。值得注意的是，EMG1 和 NHP2 在 18S rRNA 中引入了关键的转录后修饰，包括 U1248 处的 m1acp3ψ，它需要 TSR3 才能最终成熟。体外和体内破坏 NHP2 或 TSR3 会扰乱颅神经嵴分化； Polr1a 或 Polr1c 迁移后颞部敲除也会导致颅面畸形。这些发现与神经嵴分化过程中细胞类型特异性的 m1acp3ψ 水平一致。鉴于神经嵴对神经母细胞瘤的影响，我们分析了患者数据，发现核糖体控制和 rRNA 修饰蛋白升高预示着较差的预后。神经母细胞瘤细胞系的补充实验揭示了 TSR3 和 WDR74 在间充质样肿瘤状态中的功能作用。总之，我们的结果将 rRNA 修饰和核糖体组装与命运决定联系起来，表明核糖体

articles.title: Targeting redundant gene families: A multiplexed, tissue-specific CRISPR toolbox for Arabidopsis genetic screens.
articles.titleZh: 针对冗余基因家族：用于拟南芥遗传筛选的多重、组织特异性 CRISPR 工具箱。
articles.authors: Anfang M, Yahya RH, Caldararu O, Ben Yaakov S, Landau U, Berman A, Hu Y, Belew ZM, Crocoll C, Xu D, Nour-Eldin HH, Mayrose I, Shani E.
articles.abstract: Genome-scale targeted CRISPR libraries for forward genetic screens in plants are powerful tools for functional analysis, but they suffer from limited spatial control, single sgRNA design, and poor handling of genetic redundancy. We develop multiplexed CRISPR libraries in which each construct contains two sgRNAs that simultaneously target multiple members of a gene family. The libraries can also function at the cell-type-specific and tissue levels. A double-barcoding strategy enables efficient tracking and identification of sgRNA combinations at the plant level without individually sequencing each line. Using this platform, we generate over 1,000 Arabidopsis lines that express sgRNAs targeting 707 transporter genes across 114 gene families involved in nutrient uptake. The multiplexed design increases gene coverage and editing efficiency, underscoring its improved targeting capability to reveal hidden phenotypes. This toolbox provides a scalable resource for multi-targeted genome editing and spatially precise forward genetic screens in plants.
articles.abstractZh: 用于植物正向遗传筛选的基因组规模靶向 CRISPR 文库是功能分析的强大工具，但它们存在空间控制有限、sgRNA 设计单一以及遗传冗余处理不佳的问题。我们开发了多重 CRISPR 文库，其中每个构建体都包含两个同时靶向基因家族多个成员的 sgRNA。该文库还可以在细胞类型特异性和组织水平上发挥作用。双条形码策略能够在植物水平上有效跟踪和识别 sgRNA 组合，而无需对每个品系进行单独测序。利用该平台，我们生成了 1,000 多个拟南芥品系，这些品系表达 sgRNA，这些 sgRNA 靶向涉及营养吸收的 114 个基因家族中的 707 个转运蛋白基因。多重设计增加了基因覆盖率和编辑效率，强调了其改进的靶向能力以揭示隐藏的表型。该工具箱为植物中的多目标基因组编辑和空间精确的正向遗传筛选提供了可扩展的资源。

articles.title: Transcriptional regulation of the pneumococcal capsule can dictate serotype-specific infection.
articles.titleZh: 肺炎球菌荚膜的转录调控可以决定血清型特异性感染。
articles.authors: Marra M, Gazioglu O, Glanville DG, Harper-Cummings VM, Santana-Krimskaya S, Kroken AR, D'Mello A, Ganaie FA, Nahm MH, Tettelin H, Orihuela CJ, Yesilkaya H, Ulijasz AT.
articles.abstract: Streptococcus pneumoniae (the pneumococcus) is a human bacterial pathogen and the major cause of bacterial pneumonia, which can further develop into sepsis. The pneumococcus has evolved over 107 antigenically-distinct serotypes that are defined by the chemical composition of its capsule; its major virulence factor and the main protective antigen within the vaccine. Owing to its capsule diversification, certain serotypes are known for being more effective at either colonization or invasiveness. It has historically been accepted that these differences are due to the chemical properties of the capsule itself, whose biosynthetic genes are encoded in a single capsular polysaccharide (cps) operon. Here we show that infection outcomes can also be the result of a serotype's subtle, natural variations within the regulatory region which results in unique transcriptional control of the cps locus. We propose that these data explain, in part, how this pathogen might rapidly evolve its capsule expression to accommodate evolutionary pressures introduced from pneumococcal vaccines, without having to rely on genetic recombination.
articles.abstractZh: 肺炎链球菌（肺炎球菌）是一种人类细菌病原体，是细菌性肺炎的主要原因，可进一步发展为败血症。肺炎球菌已进化出超过 107 种抗原性不同的血清型，这些血清型由其荚膜的化学成分定义。它的主要毒力因子和疫苗内的主要保护性抗原。由于其荚膜多样化，某些血清型已知在定植或侵袭方面更有效。历史上人们普遍认为，这些差异是由于荚膜本身的化学特性造成的，其生物合成基因是在单个荚膜多糖 (cps) 操纵子中编码的。在这里，我们表明，感染结果也可能是调节区域内血清型微妙的自然变异的结果，这导致了 cps 位点的独特转录控制。我们认为这些数据部分解释了这种病原体如何快速进化其荚膜表达以适应肺炎球菌疫苗引入的进化压力，而不必依赖基因重组。

articles.title: Accelerated discovery of highly active enzyme nanohybrids with parallelized Bayesian optimization in hybrid space.
articles.titleZh: 通过混合空间中的并行贝叶斯优化加速发现高活性酶纳米杂化物。
articles.authors: Liu Y, Hu H, Han Y, Deon Chon JS, Lo CL, Chen Z, Zhang Z, Yuan Z, Ge J.
articles.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has significantly advanced protein engineering, enabling rapid enzyme evolution for diverse applications. However, the fragile nature of biomacromolecules requires enzyme immobilization to preserve catalytic activity under harsh industrial conditions, which often restricts substrate diffusion and reduces enzymatic activity. This challenge demands extensive trial-and-error experiments to optimize immobilized carriers with high activity for different enzymes. Here we show a machine-learning-guided workflow along with an algorithm named parallelized hybrid-space Bayesian optimization (PHBO) to accelerate the discovery of nanocarriers for specific enzymes and reactions. Leveraging prior knowledge, machine learning and iterative feedback, within limited number of experiments, this workflow explores the reaction space of over 107 experiments and achieves activity recovery of 100%, 90%, and 79% for glucose oxidase, catalase, and Candida Antarctica lipase B, respectively. These results demonstrate that data-efficient optimization can substantially accelerate the discovery of enzyme nanohybrids with high catalytic activity across diverse enzymatic systems.
articles.abstractZh: 人工智能 (AI) 显着先进了蛋白质工程，使酶能够快速进化以适应不同的应用。然而，生物大分子的脆弱性质需要酶固定化以在恶劣的工业条件下保持催化活性，这通常限制底物扩散并降低酶活性。这一挑战需要进行大量的试错实验，以优化对不同酶具有高活性的固定化载体。在这里，我们展示了机器学习引导的工作流程以及名为并行混合空间贝叶斯优化（PHBO）的算法，以加速特定酶和反应的纳米载体的发现。利用先验知识、机器学习和迭代反馈，在有限数量的实验内，该工作流程探索了超过 107 个实验的反应空间，并分别实现了葡萄糖氧化酶、过氧化氢酶和南极假丝酵母脂肪酶 B 的 100%、90% 和 79% 的活性恢复。这些结果表明，数据有效的优化可以大大加速跨不同酶系统具有高催化活性的酶纳米杂化物的发现。

articles.title: Cyclophilin A stabilizes the capsid protein p72 to facilitate African swine fever virus replication.
articles.titleZh: 亲环蛋白 A 可稳定衣壳蛋白 p72，促进非洲猪瘟病毒复制。
articles.authors: Kong H, Yang L, Zhang Z, Zhang Y, Liu L, Wang W, Song L, Zhu Y, Sun E, Li F, Bu Z, Sheng X, Zhao D.
articles.abstract: African swine fever virus (ASFV) is a large DNA virus that poses a major threat to the global swine industry. Its virion is encapsulated by an icosahedral capsid predominantly composed of the structural protein p72, which constitutes approximately one-third of the total virion mass. Despite its abundance, the mechanisms regulating p72 stability remain poorly understood. Here, we demonstrate that host-mediated stabilization of p72 is essential for efficient ASFV replication. Mass spectrometry of p72 co-precipitates identified host cyclophilin A (CypA, also known as PPIA) as a key binding partner of p72. CypA interacts with p72 both in vitro and in vivo, specifically engaging exposed regions of p72 via its hydrophobic cavity. CypA interaction stabilizes p72 by reducing its ubiquitination and preventing proteasomal degradation, whereas cyclic CypA inhibitors destabilize p72 by disrupting this interaction and promoting its ubiquitination. Importantly, genetic or pharmacological inhibition of CypA markedly impairs ASFV replication. Mechanistically, CypA inhibition disrupts viral factory formation and virion assembly by decreasing p72 protein accumulation without affecting its transcription. Together, our findings uncover a host-dependent mechanism regulating capsid protein stability and highlight host CypA as a promising target for antiviral strategies against ASFV.
articles.abstractZh: 非洲猪瘟病毒（ASFV）是一种大型DNA病毒，对全球养猪业构成重大威胁。其病毒颗粒被主要由结构蛋白 p72 组成的二十面体衣壳包裹，约占病毒颗粒总质量的三分之一。尽管 p72 数量丰富，但调节 p72 稳定性的机制仍知之甚少。在这里，我们证明宿主介导的 p72 稳定对于 ASFV 的有效复制至关重要。 p72 共沉淀物的质谱分析确定宿主亲环蛋白 A（CypA，也称为 PPIA）是 p72 的关键结合伴侣。 CypA 在体外和体内均与 p72 相互作用，通过其疏水性空腔特异性地接合 p72 的暴露区域。 CypA 相互作用通过减少 p72 的泛素化并防止蛋白酶体降解来稳定 p72，而环状 CypA 抑制剂则通过破坏这种相互作用并促进其泛素化来不稳定 p72。重要的是，CypA 的遗传或药理学抑制显着损害 ASFV 复制。从机制上讲，CypA 抑制通过减少 p72 蛋白积累来破坏病毒工厂的形成和病毒粒子组装，而不影响其转录本

articles.title: CUL3<sup>LRB</sup> E3 ubiquitin ligases control thermosensory growth in <i>Arabidopsis</i> by differentially regulating HY5 and PIF4 protein stability.
articles.titleZh: CUL3<sup>LRB</sup> E3 泛素连接酶通过差异调节 HY5 和 PIF4 蛋白稳定性来控制拟南芥中的热感生长。
articles.authors: Singhal C, Upadhyaya G, Rajkumar MS, Modak A, Sethi V, Singh S, Das D, Jain M, Gangappa SN.
articles.abstract: Rising temperatures from global warming harm plant health, reducing crop yields and threatening food security. Understanding the impact of climate change on plant health is crucial for developing climate-resilient crops. Here, we report LIGHT-RESPONSE BRIC-A-BRACK/TRAMTRACK/BROAD (LRB) E3 ubiquitin ligases as essential components of thermosensory growth in Arabidopsis. Single lrb mutants show subtle to moderate warm temperature insensitivity, while lrb12 double and lrb123 triple mutants exhibit complete insensitivity. Whole-genome transcriptomic analysis revealed that LRBs are crucial for the warm temperature-induced expression of genes involved in growth and hormone signaling. Genetic and gene expression analyses confirm that the LRBs are essential for PHYTOCHROME INTERACTING FACTOR 4 (PIF4)-mediated thermomorphogenesis. LRBs physically associate with PIF4, likely preventing its degradation and maintaining optimal protein levels. Concurrently, LRBs ubiquitinate and degrade the key repressor ELONGATED HYPOCOTYL5 during the daytime, thereby enhancing PIF4 signaling. Together, this study uncovers a dual mechanism by which LRBs potentiate thermosensory growth in response to warm ambient temperatures.
articles.abstractZh: 全球变暖导致气温升高损害植物健康，降低作物产量并威胁粮食安全。了解气候变化对植物健康的影响对于开发气候适应型作物至关重要。在这里，我们报告光响应 BRIC-A-BRACK/TRAMTRACK/BROAD (LRB) E3 泛素连接酶是拟南芥热感生长的重要组成部分。单 lrb 突变体表现出轻微到中等的温暖温度不敏感性，而 lrb12 双突变体和 lrb123 三重突变体则表现出完全不敏感性。全基因组转录组分析表明，LRB 对于高温诱导的生长和激素信号传导基因的表达至关重要。遗传和基因表达分析证实，LRB 对于 PHYTOCHROME INTERACTING FACTOR 4 (PIF4) 介导的热形态发生至关重要。 LRB 与 PIF4 物理结合，可能防止其降解并维持最佳蛋白质水平。同时，LRB 在白天泛素化并降解关键阻遏物 ELONGATED HYPOCOTYL5，从而增强 PIF4 信号传导。总之，这项研究揭示了 LRB 增强热感应生长以响应温暖环境的双重机制

articles.title: Direct observation of Notch signaling-induced transcription hubs mediating gene-expression responses.
articles.titleZh: 直接观察 Notch 信号传导诱导的转录中枢介导基因表达反应。
articles.authors: Santa-Cruz Mateos C, Roussos C, de Haro Arbona FJ, Falo-Sanjuan J, Bray S.
articles.abstract: Developmental decisions rely on cells making accurate transcriptional responses to signals they receive, as with Notch pathway activity. Local condensates or transcription factor hubs are a proposed mechanism for facilitating gene activation by nuclear complexes. To investigate their importance in endogenous Notch signaling, we deployed multicolor live imaging to measure Notch transcription-complex enrichment at a target gene locus in combination with the transcription dynamics. The coactivator Mastermind (Mam) was present in signaling-dependent nuclear foci during Notch active developmental stages. Tracking these highly dynamic Mam hubs together with transcription in the same nucleus revealed that their appearance precedes and correlates with the profile of transcription and becomes stabilized if transcription is inhibited. Manipulations to signaling levels had concordant effects on hub intensities and transcription profiles, altering their probability and amplitude. Together, the results argue that signaling induces the formation of transcription hubs whose properties are instrumental in the quantitative gene-expression response to Notch activation.
articles.abstractZh: 发育决策依赖于细胞对其接收到的信号做出准确的转录反应，就像 Notch 通路活动一样。局部凝聚物或转录因子中心是一种促进核复合物基因激活的机制。为了研究它们在内源性 Notch 信号传导中的重要性，我们采用多色实时成像来结合转录动力学来测量目标基因位点上的 Notch 转录复合物富集度。在 Notch 活跃发育阶段，共激活因子 Mastermind (Mam) 存在于信号依赖性核灶中。跟踪这些高度动态的 Mam 中枢以及同一细胞核中的转录表明，它们的出现先于转录谱并与转录谱相关，如果转录受到抑制，它们就会变得稳定。对信号水平的操纵对中枢强度和转录谱产生一致的影响，改变它们的概率和幅度。总之，结果表明信号传导诱导转录中心的形成，其特性有助于对Notch激活的定量基因表达反应。

articles.title: Light-directed evolution of dynamic, multi-state, and computational protein functionalities.
articles.titleZh: 动态、多状态和计算蛋白质功能的光定向进化。
articles.authors: Gligorovski V, Labagnara M, Scutteri L, Blackholm M, Möglich A, Mansouri N, Rahi SJ.
articles.abstract: Evolving dynamic, multi-state, and computational protein functionalities is challenging because it requires selection pressure on all the states of a protein of interest (POI) and the transitions between them. To create a continuous directed evolution paradigm for such properties, we genetically engineered budding yeast for optogenetic input to switch a POI "on" and "off," which, in turn, controls a Cdk1 cyclin that is essential for one cell-cycle stage but detrimental for another. The method, "optovolution," generates dynamic selection pressure on POI cycling at the timescale of tens of minutes. We used it to evolve 19 new variants of the LOV transcription factor El222, including in vivo green-light-responsive variants allowing LOV color-multiplexing. Evolving the PhyB-Pif3 optogenetic system, we discovered that loss of YOR1 makes supplementing phycocyanobilin (PCB) unnecessary. Finally, we demonstrated the generality of the method by evolving a non-light-responsive AND gate (PEST-rtTA). Optovolution makes difficult-to-engineer protein functionalities continuously evolvable.
articles.abstractZh: 不断发展的动态、多状态和计算蛋白质功能具有挑战性，因为它需要对目标蛋白质 (POI) 的所有状态以及它们之间的转换施加选择压力。为了为这些特性创建一个连续定向进化范式，我们对芽殖酵母进行了基因改造，用于光遗传学输入，以“打开”和“关闭”POI，从而控制 Cdk1 细胞周期蛋白，该细胞周期蛋白对于一个细胞周期阶段至关重要，但对另一个细胞周期阶段有害。该方法“光进化”在数十分钟的时间尺度内对 POI 循环产生动态选择压力。我们用它进化出了 LOV 转录因子 El222 的 19 个新变体，包括允许 LOV 颜色复用的体内绿光响应变体。通过改进 PhyB-Pif3 光遗传学系统，我们发现 YOR1 的缺失使得无需补充藻蓝蛋白 (PCB)。最后，我们通过发展非光响应与门（PEST-rtTA）证明了该方法的通用性。光进化使难以设计的蛋白质功能能够不断进化。

articles.title: Mechanisms of gene regulation by SRCAP and H2A.Z.
articles.titleZh: SRCAP 和 H2A.Z 的基因调控机制。
articles.authors: Tollenaere A, Ugur E, Dalla Longa S, Deluz C, Assenheimer D, Gebhardt JCM, Leonhardt H, Suter DM.
articles.abstract: Discriminating regulatory functions of chromatin composition from those of chromatin-modifying complexes is a central problem in gene regulation. This question remains unexplored in the context of histone variants and their dedicated chromatin remodelers. Here we dissect the distinct and cell cycle-dependent functions of Snf2 Related CREBBP Activator Protein (SRCAP) and H2A.Z in gene regulation of pluripotent stem cells. Using acute degradation of endogenous SRCAP, we uncover dynamic changes of H2A.Z occupancy and continuous requirement of SRCAP over the cell cycle. We also engineered an SRCAP mutant, defective for H2A.Z deposition, allowing us to distinguish H2A.Z-dependent and independent functions of SRCAP. We discover that SRCAP exhibits essential H2A.Z-independent functions in inhibiting DNA binding of dozens of pioneer transcription factors at enhancers by steric hindrance. In contrast, H2A.Z acts mainly as a transcriptional repressor gatekeeping the expression of lineage-specific genes. Our study establishes the catalytic-independent role of a chromatin remodeler in broadly regulating transcription factor binding, and demonstrates how a chromatin remodeler-histone variant pair orchestrates transcription to maintain self-renewal and plasticity of pluripotent stem cells.
articles.abstractZh: 区分染色质组成的调节功能和染色质修饰复合物的调节功能是基因调节的中心问题。在组蛋白变体及其专用染色质重塑剂的背景下，这个问题仍未得到探索。在这里，我们剖析了 Snf2 相关 CREBBP 激活蛋白 (SRCAP) 和 H2A.Z 在多能干细胞基因调控中的独特且细胞周期依赖性功能。利用内源性 SRCAP 的急性降解，我们发现了 H2A.Z 占据的动态变化以及细胞周期中 SRCAP 的持续需求。我们还设计了一个 SRCAP 突变体，其 H2A.Z 沉积有缺陷，使我们能够区分 SRCAP 的 H2A.Z 依赖性和独立功能。我们发现 SRCAP 在通过空间位阻抑制增强子上数十种先驱转录因子的 DNA 结合方面表现出重要的 H2A.Z 独立功能。相比之下，H2A.Z 主要充当转录抑制子，控制谱系特异性基因的表达。我们的研究确立了染色质重塑剂在广泛调节转录因子结合中的催化独立作用，并证明了染色质重塑剂-组蛋白变体如何发挥作用

articles.title: Mechanisms of PfDNMT2 inhibition and PfATP6-mediated resistance to the antimalarial candidate SC83288 in Plasmodium falciparum.
articles.titleZh: 恶性疟原虫中 PfDNMT2 抑制和 PfATP6 介导的抗疟候选药物 SC83288 耐药机制。
articles.authors: Sanchez CP, Duffey M, Celada RV, Kucharski M, Hoarau M, Saeyang T, Kamchonwongpaisan S, Sohraby F, de Buhr S, Nunes Alves A, Lucky AB, Miao J, Regnault C, Dziekan JM, Bozdech Z, Barrett MP, Lanzer M.
articles.abstract: The emergence of multi-drug resistant Plasmodium falciparum underscores the urgent need for new antimalarial therapies. SC83288, a chemically distinct antimalarial compound, is highly effective against P. falciparum both in vivo and in vitro, including strains resistant to artemisinin and partner drugs. Here, we show that SC83288 disrupts blood-stage development by blocking DNA replication and arresting karyokinesis. We identify the parasite's DNA and tRNAAsp methyltransferase PfDNMT2 as a primary molecular target, linking drug action to impaired epigenetic regulation, altered S-adenosylmethionine fluxes, and compensatory transcriptional responses. Resistance to SC83288 arises through mutations in the parasite's SERCA-type Ca²⁺ ATPase PfATP6, which enable transport of the compound into the endoplasmic reticulum, away from its nuclear targets. This resistance mechanism carries a substantial fitness cost, limiting its potential for spread. Together, target validation, a unique resistance profile, and high fitness cost strengthen SC83288's potential as a promising clinical development candidate for malaria treatment.
articles.abstractZh: 多重耐药性恶性疟原虫的出现凸显了对新抗疟疗法的迫切需要。 SC83288 是一种化学性质独特的抗疟化合物，在体内和体外对恶性疟原虫非常有效，包括对青蒿素和伙伴药物耐药的菌株。在这里，我们证明 SC83288 通过阻断 DNA 复制和阻止核分裂来破坏血液阶段的发育。我们将寄生虫的 DNA 和 tRNAAsp 甲基转移酶 PfDNMT2 确定为主要分子靶标，将药物作用与受损的表观遗传调控、改变的 S-腺苷甲硫氨酸通量和补偿性转录反应联系起来。对 SC83288 的抗性是通过寄生虫的 SERCA 型 Ca²⁺ ATP 酶 PfATP6 的突变而产生的，这使得该化合物能够转运到内质网中，远离其核靶点。这种抵抗机制带来了巨大的适应成本，限制了其传播的潜力。靶点验证、独特的耐药性和高适应成本共同增强了 SC83288 作为疟疾治疗有前途的临床开发候选药物的潜力。

articles.title: Neurons with granulovacuolar degeneration bodies are resilient to tau-induced protein synthesis impairment.
articles.titleZh: 具有颗粒空泡变性体的神经元能够抵抗 tau 诱导的蛋白质合成损伤。
articles.authors: Smits JFM, Ligthart TW, Jorge-Oliva M, Middelhoff S, Schipper F, Pita-Illobre D, Li KW, Scheper W.
articles.abstract: In Alzheimer's disease, many surviving neurons with tau pathology contain granulovacuolar degeneration bodies (GVBs), neuron-specific lysosomal structures induced by pathological tau assemblies. This could indicate a neuroprotective role for GVBs; however, the mechanism of GVB formation and its functional implications are elusive. Here, we demonstrate that casein kinase 1δ (CK1δ) activity is required for GVB formation. CK1δ is sequestered in the GVB during this process in an autophagy-dependent manner. We show that neurons with GVBs (GVB+) are resilient to tau-induced impairment of global protein synthesis and are protected against tau-mediated neurodegeneration. GVB+ neurons do not exhibit differential activation of transient translational stress responses but have increased ribosomal content. Unlike neurons without GVBs, GVB+ neurons fully retain the capacity to induce long-term potentiation-induced protein synthesis in the presence of tau pathology. Our results have identified CK1δ as a key regulator of GVB formation that confers a protective neuron-specific stress response to tau pathology. These findings provide opportunities for targeting neuronal resilience in tauopathies.
articles.abstractZh: 在阿尔茨海默病中，许多具有 tau 病理学的存活神经元含有粒空泡变性体 (GVB)，这是由病理性 tau 组装诱导的神经元特异性溶酶体结构。这可能表明 GVB 具有神经保护作用；然而，GVB 的形成机制及其功能意义尚不清楚。在这里，我们证明酪蛋白激酶 1δ (CK1δ) 活性是 GVB 形成所必需的。在此过程中，CK1δ 以自噬依赖性方式隔离在 GVB 中。我们发现，具有 GVB (GVB+) 的神经元能够抵抗 tau 诱导的整体蛋白质合成损伤，并免受 tau 介导的神经变性的影响。 GVB+神经元不表现出短暂翻译应激反应的差异激活，但核糖体含量增加。与没有 GVB 的神经元不同，GVB+ 神经元完全保留了在 tau 病理存在的情况下诱导长期增强诱导的蛋白质合成的能力。我们的结果已确定 CK1δ 是 GVB 形成的关键调节因子，可对 tau 病理学赋予保护性神经元特异性应激反应。这些发现为针对 tau蛋白病的神经元弹性提供了机会。

articles.title: Polycomb repression works without Siesta, the <i>Drosophila</i> ortholog of mammalian PCGF3.
articles.titleZh: Polycomb 抑制无需 Siesta（哺乳动物 PCGF3 的果蝇直系同源物）即可发挥作用。
articles.authors: Kahn TG, Garrido A, Yushkova A, Kim M, Glotov A, Sreekumar S, Larsson J, Schwartz YB.
articles.abstract: Polycomb group proteins mediate epigenetic repression via multisubunit complexes, including canonical Polycomb Repressive Complex 1 (PRC1), which monoubiquitylates histone H2A and binds histone H3 trimethylated at lysine-27 (H3K27me3). The RING1 subunit of PRC1, critical for H2A ubiquitylation, forms other complexes. These variant RING1 complexes also ubiquitylate H2A but cannot bind H3K27me3, and their role in epigenetic repression is debated. Using Drosophila genetics, we found that canonical PRC1 and variant RING1 complexes ubiquitylate H2A at distinct genomic regions. We established that the Drosophila PCGF protein specific for variant RING1 complexes, which we named Siesta, is not required for epigenetic repression of developmental genes but controls larval locomotion independently of H2A ubiquitylation. Leveraging a massively parallel transgenic approach, we demonstrated that H2A ubiquitylation has minimal impact on transcriptional repression. Our findings imply that Siesta-RING1 complexes operate outside the Polycomb regulatory system and that the popular PRC1 classification will benefit from revision.
articles.abstractZh: Polycomb 族蛋白通过多亚基复合物介导表观遗传抑制，其中包括经典的 Polycomb 抑制复合物 1 (PRC1)，其单泛素化组蛋白 H2A 并结合赖氨酸 27 (H3K27me3) 三甲基化的组蛋白 H3。 PRC1 的 RING1 亚基对 H2A 泛素化至关重要，可形成其他复合物。这些变异的 RING1 复合物也泛素化 H2A，但不能结合 H3K27me3，并且它们在表观遗传抑制中的作用存在争议。利用果蝇遗传学，我们发现规范的 PRC1 和变体 RING1 复合物在不同的基因组区域泛素化 H2A。我们确定果蝇 PCGF 蛋白对 RING1 复合体变体具有特异性，我们将其命名为 Siesta，它不是发育基因的表观遗传抑制所必需的，但它独立于 H2A 泛素化控制幼虫运动。利用大规模并行转基因方法，我们证明 H2A 泛素化对转录抑制的影响最小。我们的研究结果表明，Siesta-RING1 复合体在 Polycomb 监管体系之外运作，流行的 PRC1 分类将受益于修订。

articles.title: Toll-like receptor signaling outcome is determined by the stoichiometry of the endogenous TRIFosome.
articles.titleZh: Toll 样受体信号转导结果由内源 TRIFosome 的化学计量决定。
articles.authors: Moncrieffe MC, Suresh P, Boyle J, Cui Y, Nawalpuri B, Verstak B, Zhang YP, Zhang Z, Taylor M, Egelman EH, Gay N, Klenerman D, Bryant C.
articles.abstract: Toll-like receptors (TLRs) drive innate immunity via assembly of macromolecular signal transduction platforms [supramolecular organizing centers (SMOCs)] coordinated by adaptor proteins such as Toll/interleukin-1 receptor (IL-1R) domain-containing adaptor-inducing interferon-β (TRIF), but whether oligomeric TRIFosomes form is unknown. Here, using cryo-electron microscopy and biophysical characterization of full-length TRIF in vitro, we show that it forms filamentous oligomers, which associate with the TRIF signaling partners receptor interacting protein 1 (RIP1) and RIP3 kinases, suggesting that oligomeric TRIFosomes could form. Endogenous TRIF, however, is predominantly monomeric in the absence of ligand, only forming TRIFosome oligomers in macrophages after stimulation of TLR4 or TLR3 when large, macromolecular signaling complexes form. TRIFosomes are fully formed 45 min after TLR3 or 60 min after TLR4 stimulation, commensurate with activation of nuclear factor κB in these cells. TLR3/4 activation triggers rapid interferon signaling prior to TRIFosome formation through monomeric TRIF, unexpectedly suggesting that a macromolecular platform of TRIF is not required to drive this signaling pathway. Collectively, these data show TRIFosome macromolecular platform formation and, unexpectedly, that TLR signaling can be SMOC-independent in addition to being SMOC-dependent.
articles.abstractZh: Toll 样受体 (TLR) 通过组装大分子信号转导平台 [超分子组织中心 (SMOC)] 来驱动先天免疫，这些平台由接头蛋白（例如 Toll/白细胞介素-1 受体 (IL-1R) 结构域，包含接头诱导干扰素-β (TRIF)）协调，但是否形成寡聚 TRIFosome 尚不清楚。在这里，利用冷冻电子显微镜和体外全长 TRIF 的生物物理表征，我们发现它形成丝状寡聚物，与 TRIF 信号传导伴侣受体相互作用蛋白 1 (RIP1) 和 RIP3 激酶结合，表明可以形成寡聚 TRIFosome。然而，内源 TRIF 在没有配体的情况下主要是单体，仅在刺激 TLR4 或 TLR3 形成大的大分子信号复合物时在巨噬细胞中形成 TRIFosome 寡聚物。 TRIFosomes 在 TLR3 刺激后 45 分钟或 TLR4 刺激后 60 分钟完全形成，与这些细胞中核因子 κB 的激活相称。 TLR3/4 激活在通过单体 TRIF 形成 TRIFosome 之前触发快速干扰素信号传导，出人意料地表明不需要 TRIF 大分子平台来驱动该信号

articles.title: Altering the carbohydrate-binding specificity of the legume lectin FRIL through structure-guided engineering.
articles.titleZh: 通过结构引导工程改变豆类凝集素 FRIL 的碳水化合物结合特异性。
articles.authors: Liu YM, Nguyen HTV, Chen X, Shahed-Al-Mahmud M, Chen TH, Liao KS, Lo JM, Kan TC, Ren CT, Ma C.
articles.abstract: FRIL is a legume lectin from the hyacinth bean that has broad-spectrum antiviral activity. A distinctive trait of FRIL among similar mannose/glucose-specific legume lectins is that FRIL shows specificity for complex type N-glycans. We postulate that an extended binding site on FRIL facilitates this ligand selectivity. Here, we show legume lectin carbohydrate recognition domain (CRD) loop B is the main determinant of complex versus high-mannose N-glycan specificity in FRIL and Concanavalin A (ConA), respectively. First, we find that the inactive precursors of recombinant FRIL (rFRIL) and proConA (rproConA) can be activated via deglycosylation. Secondly, the cryo-EM structures of inactive apo rFRIL, active FRIL in complex with Galβ1,4-(Fucα1,3-)GlcNAcβ1,2-Man tetrasaccharide, and active rFRIL in complex with Mannose9GlcNAc2 (Man9) N-glycan are determined, and residues H102 and Y101 on loop B are identified as crucial for complex glycan recognition. Finally, we swapped loop B residues 101 and 102 alongside loop C residue 145 on FRIL to their structural equivalent on ConA, resulting in a FRIL mutant that binds exclusively to high mannose N-glycans. Taken together, we have established a process of activating recombinant FRIL and related lectins through deglycosylation, and demonstrated the crucial role that loop B residues play in establishing oligosaccharide specificity.
articles.abstractZh: FRIL 是一种来自风信子豆的豆类凝集素，具有广谱抗病毒活性。在类似的甘露糖/葡萄糖特异性豆类凝集素中，FRIL 的一个显着特征是 FRIL 对复杂型 N-聚糖表现出特异性。我们假设 FRIL 上的扩展结合位点有利于这种配体选择性。在这里，我们表明豆类凝集素碳水化合物识别结构域 (CRD) 环 B 分别是 FRIL 和伴刀豆球蛋白 A (ConA) 中复合物与高甘露糖 N-聚糖特异性的主要决定因素。首先，我们发现重组 FRIL (rFRIL) 和 proConA (rproConA) 的无活性前体可以通过去糖基化被激活。其次，确定了非活性 apo rFRIL、与 Galβ1,4-(Fucα1,3-)G​​lcNAcβ1,2-Man 四糖复合物中的活性 FRIL 以及与 Mannose9GlcNAc2 (Man9) N-聚糖复合物中的活性 rFRIL 的冷冻电镜结构，并确定环 B 上的残基 H102 和 Y101 对于复杂聚糖识别至关重要。最后，我们将 FRIL 上的环 B 残基 101 和 102 以及环 C 残基 145 交换为 ConA 上的结构等效物，从而产生仅与高甘露糖 N-聚糖结合的 FRIL 突变体。综上所述，我们建立了一个

articles.title: An H3K14ub-H3K9me3 feedback circuit governs heterochromatin spreading and inheritance in fission yeast.
articles.titleZh: H3K14ub-H3K9me3 反馈电路控制裂殖酵母中的异染色质扩散和遗传。
articles.authors: Toda T, Zang J, Qi H, Fang Y, Jiang P, Shan CM, Wong J, Jia S.
articles.abstract: Heterochromatin is a bistable chromatin state essential for genome stability and gene regulation. Its spreading and inheritance have long been explained by a "read-write" cycle in which histone methyltransferases bind pre-existing tri-methylation of histone H3 lysine 9 (H3K9me3) and propagate this mark to neighboring nucleosomes. However, the weak affinity and limited catalytic stimulation provided by H3K9me3 alone challenge this model. The fission yeast H3K9 methyltransferase Clr4 functions within the CLRC complex, which also catalyzes histone H3 lysine 14 ubiquitination (H3K14ub). Here we show that H3K14ub and H3K9me3 form a feedback loop: H3K14ub strongly stimulates Clr4 activity on nucleosomes, while both H3K14ub and H3K9me3 stabilize CLRC binding to chromatin. Even subtle perturbations that disrupt this feedback, such as mutating one of the three H3 genes to prevent ubiquitination or methylation, or impairing Clr3-mediated H3K14 deacetylation, compromises heterochromatin spreading and inheritance. Conversely, counteracting activities, such as H3K14 acetylation by Mst2 and H3K9 demethylation by Epe1, synergistically constrains heterochromatin expansion. Thus, rather than relying solely on the weak H3K9me3 "read-write" cycle, heterochromatin is maintained through an integrated circuit of ubiquitination, deacetylation, and methylation, which governs spreading and inheritance.
articles.abstractZh: 异染色质是一种双稳态染色质状态，对于基因组稳定性和基因调控至关重要。长期以来，它的传播和遗传一直被解释为“读写”循环，其中组蛋白甲基转移酶结合组蛋白 H3 赖氨酸 9 (H3K9me3) 预先存在的三甲基化，并将该标记传播到邻近的核小体。然而，H3K9me3 单独提供的弱亲和力和有限的催化刺激对这一模型提出了挑战。裂殖酵母 H3K9 甲基转移酶 Clr4 在 CLRC 复合体中发挥作用，该复合体还催化组蛋白 H3 赖氨酸 14 泛素化 (H3K14ub)。在这里，我们证明 H3K14ub 和 H3K9me3 形成反馈环：H3K14ub 强烈刺激核小体上的 Clr4 活性，而 H3K14ub 和 H3K9me3 都稳定 CLRC 与染色质的结合。即使是破坏这种反馈的细微扰动，例如突变三个 H3 基因之一以防止泛素化或甲基化，或损害 Clr3 介导的 H3K14 脱乙酰化，也会损害异染色质扩散和遗传。相反，抵消活性，例如 Mst2 的 H3K14 乙酰化和 Epe1 的 H3K9 去甲基化，协同限制异染色质扩张。因此，与其依赖

articles.title: CFD protein deficiency induce slow transit constipation is correlated with gut microbial dysbiosis.
articles.titleZh: CFD 蛋白缺乏引起的慢传输型便秘与肠道微生物失调相关。
articles.authors: Hu S, Liu H, Song F, Huang D, Wei Q.
articles.abstract: Dysregulation of complement factor D (CFD) has been associated with various diseases, such as metabolic, cardiovascular, and renal disorders. However, its role in intestinal function has been less studied. Our research found that CFD-deficient (Cfd–/–) mice exhibited spontaneous slow transit constipation (STC) compared to wild-type (WT) mice. Moreover, the fecal weight and water content in Cfd–/– mice were significantly reduced, despite no specific changes in feeding behavior. Reduced C-kit protein expression, colon injury, complement dysfunction and dysbiosis of the fecal microbiota are also observed in Cfd–/– mice. After microbiota transplantation from WT mice into Cfd–/– mice, reduced stool output, water content, decreased C-kit protein expression and colon injury were significantly improved. These results indicate that CFD is critical for controlling microbial homeostasis in the colon and, in its absence, leads to colon injury and promotes slow transit constipation.
articles.abstractZh: 补体因子 D (CFD) 失调与多种疾病有关，例如代谢、心血管和肾脏疾病。然而，其在肠道功能中的作用研究较少。我们的研究发现，与野生型 (WT) 小鼠相比，CFD 缺陷 (Cfd–/–) 小鼠表现出自发性慢传输便秘 (STC)。此外，尽管进食行为没有具体变化，但 Cfd–/– 小鼠的粪便重量和水分含量显着减少。在 Cfd–/– 小鼠中还观察到 C-kit 蛋白表达减少、结肠损伤、补体功能障碍和粪便微生物群失调。将WT小鼠的微生物群移植到Cfd–/–小鼠后，粪便排出量、含水量减少、C-kit蛋白表达减少和结肠损伤均得到显着改善。这些结果表明，CFD 对于控制结肠微生物稳态至关重要，如果缺乏 CFD，则会导致结肠损伤并促进慢传输型便秘。

articles.title: Design-driven optimization of low-cost reagent formulations for reproducible and high-yielding cell-free gene expression.
articles.titleZh: 低成本试剂配方的设计驱动优化，实现可重复和高产的无细胞基因表达。
articles.authors: Olsen ML, Copeland CE, Sundberg CA, Aw R, Shaver ZM, Rao G, Swartz JR, Karim AS, Jewett MC.
articles.abstract: Access to recombinant proteins is vital in basic science and biotechnology research. Cell-free gene expression systems provide one approach to address this need, but widespread utilization remains limited by the cost, complexity, and inconsistency of current platforms. To address these limitations, we carry out a multi-dimensional definitive screening design to reduce the number of reagent components and remove costly secondary energy substrates. From 1,231 different reagent formulations, we discover a simple and reproducible system based on 12 components. The optimized reagent formulation can produce 2.4 ± 0.3 g/L of protein product at the 15-µL scale (~$60/gprotein) and 3.7 ± 0.2 g/L (~$39/gprotein) at the 4-mL scale with oxygen supplementation. This provides an average 95% reduction in cost over previous cell-free reagent formulations. We further show that the optimized reagent formulation can produce nucleoside triphosphates from nitrogenous bases and ribose and that it is robust to failure across batches of cell lysates, users/locations, and in the synthesis of more than 20 different proteins. For example, we demonstrate the production of fifteen therapeutically relevant products, including full-length aglycosylated monoclonal antibodies. We anticipate that our optimized reagent formulation will democratize the use of cell-free systems for protein manufacturing and synthetic biology applications.
articles.abstractZh: 获得重组蛋白对于基础科学和生物技术研究至关重要。无细胞基因表达系统提供了一种满足这一需求的方法，但广泛使用仍然受到当前平台的成本、复杂性和不一致性的限制。为了解决这些限制，我们进行了多维明确的筛选设计，以减少试剂成分的数量并去除昂贵的二次能源底物。从 1,231 种不同的试剂配方中，我们发现了一个基于 12 种成分的简单且可重复的系统。优化的试剂配方可在 15 µL 规模下产生 2.4 ± 0.3 g/L 的蛋白质产品（约 60 美元/克蛋白质），在 4 mL 规模下产生 3.7 ± 0.2 g/L（约 39 美元/克蛋白质），并补充氧气。与之前的无细胞试剂配方相比，成本平均降低了 95%。我们进一步表明，优化的试剂配方可以从含氮碱基和核糖生产三磷酸核苷，并且在细胞裂解物批次、用户/位置以及 20 多种不同蛋白质的合成中具有稳健的失败能力。例如，我们展示了十五种治疗相关产品的生产

articles.title: Lipochaperoning folding of water-soluble functional membrane protein in genetically and biosynthetically tuned Escherichia <i>coli</i>.
articles.titleZh: 遗传和生物合成调节的大肠杆菌中水溶性功能膜蛋白的脂伴侣折叠。
articles.authors: Bogdanova N, Ryabichko S, Zheng L, Bogdanov M.
articles.abstract: Hydrophobic membrane proteins are widely believed to require lipid bilayers for proper folding, collapsing or aggregating in aqueous environments.
