Using lactose permease (LacY) as a model membrane protein, we show instead that folding in vivo can be optimized for unusual specific molecular interactions with particular phospholipids during functional folding and final localization. Co-overproducing LacY with lysophosphatidic acid (LPA), a normally short-lived intermediate in phospholipid biosynthesis, unexpectedly yields a water-soluble, native LacY in the cytoplasm. This approach obviates SIMPLEx and QTY protein redesign strategies, enabling soluble production of unmodified membrane proteins in vivo. Although surplus LacY spills from the cytoplasmic leaflet together with LPA into cytoplasm, LPA-driven activation of only principal ClsA and buildup of cardiolipin (CL) ensure the SecYEG translocon capacity for proper membrane insertion of LacY. These findings challenge current models of membrane protein biogenesis and provide new opportunities to study membrane proteins in both membrane and aqueous contexts.
articles.abstractZh: 人们普遍认为疏水膜蛋白需要脂质双层才能在水环境中正确折叠、塌陷或聚集。使用乳糖通透酶（LacY）作为模型膜蛋白，我们证明体内折叠可以针对功能折叠和最终定位过程中与特定磷脂的不寻常的特定分子相互作用进行优化。与溶血磷脂酸 (LPA)（磷脂生物合成中通常寿命较短的中间体）共同过量生产 LacY，意外地在细胞质中产生了水溶性的天然 LacY。这种方法避免了 SIMPLEx 和 QTY 蛋白质重新设计策略，从而能够在体内可溶性生产未修饰的膜蛋白。尽管多余的 LacY 与 LPA 一起从细胞质小叶溢出进入细胞质，但 LPA 驱动的仅主要 ClsA 的激活和心磷脂 (CL) 的积累确保了 SecYEG 易位子能够正确插入 LacY 的膜。这些发现挑战了当前的膜蛋白生物合成模型，并为研究膜和水环境中的膜蛋白提供了新的机会。

articles.title: Optimisation of verapamil hydrochloride loaded polyhydroxyalkanoate nano and microparticles using response surface methodology.
articles.titleZh: 使用响应面法优化负载盐酸维拉帕米的聚羟基脂肪酸酯纳米颗粒和微粒。
articles.authors: Ramachandran S, Prakash P, Raman S, Dheyab MA, Sudesh K, Moses EJ, Parumasivam T.
articles.abstract: Polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHAs) are biodegradable polymers with significant potential for drug delivery. However, a challenge remains in their application for encapsulating highly water-soluble drugs. This study aims to develop and optimise PHA-based nanoparticles (NPs) and microparticles (MPs) for the delivery of verapamil hydrochloride (VRP·HCl) using a systematic statistical approach. A quaternary PHA copolymer, poly(3-hydroxybutyrate-co-4-hydroxybutyrate-co-5-hydroxyvalerate-co-3-hydroxyhexanoate) [P(3HB-co-4HB-co-5HV-co-3HHx)], was biosynthesised using genetically modified Cupriavidus necator. Polymer characterisation by Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (1H NMR), Gas Chromatography (GC), Gel Permeation Chromatography (GPC), and Limulus Amebocyte Lysate (LAL) assay confirmed a high-purity (97 ± 5 wt%) and endotoxin-free P(3HB-co-4HB-co-5HV-co-3HHx) copolymer with a monomer composition of 69 mol% 3HB, 14 mol% 4HB, 12 mol% 5HV, and 5 mol% 3HHx. VRP·HCl-loaded NPs and MPs were prepared via a double-emulsion solvent evaporation method and optimised using response surface methodology (RSM) based on a central composite design (CCD) to predict and evaluate the influence of polymer mass, drug mass, and stabiliser concentration on particle size, drug loading (DL), and encapsulation efficiency (EE). Particle size, polydispersity index (PDI), zeta potential (ZP), DL, and EE were evaluated experimentally. The optimised NP and MP formulations achieved mean particle sizes of 245.06 ± 0.01 nm and 2.23 ± 1.50 µm, with maximum EE of 38.95 ± 20.37% and 45.23 ± 2.85%, respectively. The corresponding DL values for NPs and MPs were 23.37 ± 12.22% and 18.09 ± 1.14%, respectively. Statistical analysis demonstrated good model predictability within the explored design space, enabling the identification of formulation regions governed primarily by polymer mass, drug distribution, and emulsion characteristics. In conclusion, this study demonstrates the feasibility of encapsulating a hydrophilic drug within a fully hydrophobic, biodegradable PHA matrix while establishing a systematic optimisation framework for the development of PHA-based NP and MP drug delivery systems.
articles.abstractZh: 聚羟基脂肪酸酯 (PHA) 是可生物降解的聚合物，具有巨大的药物输送潜力。然而，它们在封装高度水溶性药物的应用中仍然存在挑战。本研究旨在使用系统统计方法开发和优化基于 PHA 的纳米颗粒 (NP) 和微粒 (MP)，用于递送盐酸维拉帕米 (VRP·HCl)。使用转基因 Cupriavidus necator 生物合成四元 PHA 共聚物聚(3-羟基丁酸酯-co-4-羟基丁酸酯-co-5-羟基戊酸酯-co-3-羟基己酸酯) [P(3HB-co-4HB-co-5HV-co-3HHx)]。通过核磁共振 (1H NMR)、气相色谱 (GC)、凝胶渗透色谱 (GPC) 和鲎变形细胞裂解物 (LAL) 测定对聚合物进行表征，证实了高纯度 (97 ± 5 wt%) 且不含内毒素的 P(3HB-co-4HB-co-5HV-co-3HHx) 共聚物，单体组成为 69 mol% 3HB、14 mol% 4HB、12 mol% 5HV 和 5 mol% 3HHx。通过双乳液溶剂蒸发法制备 VRP·HCl 负载的 NP 和 MP，并使用基于中心复合设计 (CCD) 的响应面法 (RSM) 进行优化，以预测和评估聚合物质量、药物组成的影响。

articles.title: Significance of amino acid recycling from vacuoles for viability and sporulation of yeast cells under starvation conditions.
articles.titleZh: 液泡中的氨基酸回收对于饥饿条件下酵母细胞的活力和孢子形成的意义。
articles.authors: Nakajo H, Sekito T, Okamura R, Nakagawa S, Hamada N, Yamamoto Y, Yagi W, Ozaka N, Kimura T, Abe S, Sugimoto N, Akiyama K, Kawano-Kawada M.
articles.abstract: Amino acid recycling is one of the fundamental roles of autophagy. To fulfill this role, amino acid export from vacuoles must operate. Its machinery, however, has not been well elucidated so far, making it difficult to accurately evaluate its physiological significance. Avt6 is a transporter that exports acidic amino acids, such as aspartate and glutamate. We found that disrupting AVT6 in cells lacking other vacuolar amino acid exporters, including Avt3, Avt4, and Avt7, increased vacuolar neutral amino acid content. Conversely, Avt6 overexpression decreased these amino acid levels. These results suggest that Avt6 is also involved in the vacuolar export of neutral amino acids. Although avt3∆avt4∆avt6∆avt7∆ cells maintained viability under nitrogen starvation as wild-type cells, protein synthesis was reduced. By further deleting LEU2, a gene involved in leucine biosynthesis, viability was significantly reduced. Moreover, avt3∆avt4∆avt6∆avt7∆ diploid cells formed fewer spores in a sporulation medium. These phenotypes overlapped with those of cells defective in macroautophagy. This study reveals an extensive redundancy of transporters in vacuolar amino acid recycling and experimentally demonstrates that the vacuolar amino acids generated by macroautophagy are utilized to manage nutrient stress.
articles.abstractZh: 氨基酸回收是自噬的基本作用之一。为了发挥这一作用，必须从液泡输出氨基酸。然而，迄今为止其机制尚未得到很好的阐明，因此很难准确评估其生理意义。 Avt6 是一种输出酸性氨基酸（例如天冬氨酸和谷氨酸）的转运蛋白。我们发现，在缺乏其他液泡氨基酸输出蛋白（包括 Avt3、Avt4 和 Avt7）的细胞中破坏 AVT6，会增加液泡中性氨基酸含量。相反，Avt6 过度表达降低了这些氨基酸水平。这些结果表明 Avt6 还参与中性氨基酸的液泡输出。尽管 avt3Δavt4Δavt6Δavt7Δ 细胞在氮饥饿下与野生型细胞一样保持活力，但蛋白质合成减少。通过进一步删除参与亮氨酸生物合成的基因 LEU2，活力显着降低。此外，avt3Δavt4Δavt6Δavt7Δ二倍体细胞在孢子形成培养基中形成较少的孢子。这些表型与巨自噬缺陷细胞的表型重叠。这项研究揭示了液泡氨基酸回收和实验中转运蛋白的广泛冗余

articles.title: Swapped and non-swapped TRAAK states co-exist in membranes at a ratio influenced by temperature.
articles.titleZh: 交换和非交换的 TRAAK 状态以受温度影响的比例共存于膜中。
articles.authors: Ma Y, Ackermann K, Waheed Q, Postis V, Smith TK, Bode BE, Pliotas C.
articles.abstract: The potassium two-pore domain (K2P) ion channel TRAAK is expressed in the nervous system and regulates the fast action potential in membranes. Like all K2P channels, TRAAK possesses a distinct extracellular cap, which adopts a swapped and a non-swapped conformation1,2. However, the proportional representation of these two species within native membranes - and the trigger or stimulus associated with this conformational transition - are unknown. Here, we utilise Pulse Dipolar EPR Spectroscopy combined with heterologous single-subunit spin-labelling and monitor the complete conformational ensemble of TRAAK's cap domain in membranes. We demonstrate the coexistence of the swapped and non-swapped states, quantify their populations within the TRAAK ensemble, and show that the swapped conformation dominates, with the ratio being influenced by temperature. Native lipid analysis shows that TRAAK selectively associates with and is activated by signalling lipids to the exclusion of membrane-dominant phosphatidylcholine lipids from its vicinity, forming a distinct microdomain. Our approach can identify the immediate lipid environment, detect and quantify cap state populations in homo-/hetero-K2P channels and link domain swapping to specific triggers.
articles.abstractZh: 钾二孔结构域 (K2P) 离子通道 TRAAK 在神经系统中表达，调节膜中的快速动作电位。与所有 K2P 通道一样，TRAAK 具有独特的细胞外帽，采用交换和非交换构象 1,2。然而，这两种物质在天然膜内的比例代表以及与这种构象转变相关的触发或刺激因素尚不清楚。在这里，我们利用脉冲偶极 EPR 光谱与异源单亚基自旋标记相结合，监测膜中 TRAAK 帽结构域的完整构象整体。我们证明了交换态和非交换态的共存，量化了它们在 TRAAK 系综中的数量，并表明交换构象占主导地位，其比例受温度影响。天然脂质分析表明，TRAAK 选择性地与信号脂质结合并被信号脂质激活，以将膜主导的磷脂酰胆碱脂质排除在其附近，形成独特的微域。我们的方法可以识别直接脂质环境，检测和量化同源/异源 K2 中的上限状态群体

articles.title: An acetylation-dependent switch underlies host disease tolerance during streptococcal infection.
articles.titleZh: 乙酰化依赖性开关是链球菌感染期间宿主疾病耐受性的基础。
articles.authors: Paudel SK, Gannavaram S, Caparon MG, Xu W.
articles.abstract: Building on our finding that Streptococcus pyogenes pyruvate dehydrogenase (PDH) suppresses host disease tolerance (DT) via short-chain fatty acid (SCFA)-mediated modulation of host acetyl-CoA and IL-10 levels, we characterize the global transcriptomic and epigenetic mechanisms underlying this immunometabolic manipulation. Combining new histological and ultrastructural analyses with an in-depth re-analysis of single-cell and bulk RNA-seq datasets to more comprehensively characterize the DT response, we show that PDH deficiency is associated with broad immunologic rewiring, characterized by intracellular bacterial containment within phagocytes, expansion of pro-resolving myeloid cells, and altered cell-cell communication. Metabolic analysis of ΔPdh-infected tissues revealed a shift away from acetyl-CoA metabolism towards glycolysis and the coordinated activation of a multi-faceted DT program, encompassing hypoxia signaling, iron handling, and the NRF2-mediated antioxidant response. Crucially, a focused re-analysis of existing transcriptome datasets from Histone Deacetylase (HDAC)-inhibited macrophages suggested that Trichostatin A (TSA) abrogates the protective transcriptome in ΔPdh infection, indicating that acetylation-dependent repression functions as a key regulator of the host DT response. By integrating new experimental data with advanced computational analyses, our work reveals a bacterial strategy of metabolic-epigenetic crosstalk, suggesting acetylation as a critical control point for mitigating infection-associated tissue damage.
articles.abstractZh: 基于我们的发现，即化脓性链球菌丙酮酸脱氢酶 (PDH) 通过短链脂肪酸 (SCFA) 介导的宿主乙酰辅酶 A 和 IL-10 水平的调节来抑制宿主疾病耐受性 (DT)，我们描述了这种免疫代谢操作背后的全局转录组和表观遗传机制。将新的组织学和超微结构分析与对单细胞和批量 RNA-seq 数据集的深入重新分析相结合，以更全面地表征 DT 反应，我们发现 PDH 缺陷与广泛的免疫重新布线相关，其特征是吞噬细胞内的细胞内细菌遏制、促解析骨髓细胞的扩张以及细胞间通讯的改变。对 ΔPdh 感染组织的代谢分析揭示了从乙酰辅酶 A 代谢转向糖酵解的转变以及多方面 DT 程序的协调激活，包括缺氧信号传导、铁处理和 NRF2 介导的抗氧化反应。至关重要的是，对组蛋白脱乙酰酶 (HDAC) 抑制巨噬细胞的现有转录组数据集进行集中重新分析表明，曲古抑菌素 A (TSA) 废除了 ΔPdh 中的保护性转录组

articles.title: Enhancing chicken manure with bread waste and black soldier fly associated bacteria to increase larval biomass.
articles.titleZh: 用面包废料和黑水虻相关细菌增强鸡粪，以增加幼虫生物量。
articles.authors: Abdelmaksoud EM, El-Sayed W, Rashwan RS, Hegazy SA, Abou-Taleb KA, Abdelsalam SA.
articles.abstract: Black soldier fly larvae (BSFL) represent a promising and sustainable source of protein and essential nutrients for poultry feed. This study aimed to improve BSFL growth and organic waste bioconversion by utilizing chicken manure (CM), a widely available but environmentally problematic byproduct of poultry production due to its unpleasant odor, greenhouse gas emissions, and pathogen risks. In the first trial, CM was combined with bread waste (BW) at different ratios to overcome the poor larval growth observed when reared on CM alone. The 1:1 BW: CM mixture yielded the highest larval biomass, feed conversion efficiency, and nutritional value. In the second trial, beneficial bacteria were isolated from BSF egg surfaces and larval guts (3.5 × 10⁶ and 2.4 × 10⁶ CFU/ml, respectively). Thirteen isolates were screened for urease and protease activity, and five were selected and identified using phenotypic traits and 16 S rRNA sequencing: Microbacterium paraoxydans, Bacillus proteolyticus, Priestia megaterium, Bacillus subtilis, and Morganella morganii. Supplementation of CM-based diets with these strains significantly improved BSFL dry weight and feed conversion efficiency, with the most notable enhancements achieved using M. paraoxydans and M. morganii. Amino acid analysis of larvae fed a 3CM:1BW diet supplemented with M. paraoxydans revealed elevated levels of essential (Isoleucine, leucine, Phenylalanine, valine) and non-essential (alanine, Glycine) amino acids. Overall, this study demonstrates a cost-effective and eco-friendly strategy for optimizing BSFL production while recycling organic waste in sustainable livestock systems.
articles.abstractZh: 黑水虻幼虫 (BSFL) 是一种有前途且可持续的家禽饲料蛋白质和必需营养素来源。本研究旨在利用鸡粪 (CM) 来改善 BSFL 生长和有机废物生物转化。鸡粪是一种广泛使用的家禽生产副产品，但因其难闻的气味、温室气体排放和病原体风险而对环境造成问题。在第一项试验中，将 CM 与面包废料 (BW) 以不同的比例混合，以克服单独使用 CM 饲养时观察到的幼虫生长不良的问题。 1:1 BW: CM 混合物产生最高的幼虫生物量、饲料转化效率和营养价值。在第二项试验中，从 BSF 卵表面和幼虫肠道中分离出有益细菌（分别为 3.5 × 106 和 2.4 × 106 CFU/ml）。筛选了 13 个分离株的脲酶和蛋白酶活性，并使用表型性状和 16 S rRNA 测序选择并鉴定了 5 个分离株：副氧化微杆菌、解蛋白芽孢杆菌、巨大Priestia megaterium、枯草芽孢杆菌和摩根氏菌。在以 CM 为基础的日粮中添加这些菌株显着提高了 BSFL 干重和饲料转化效率，其中最大

articles.title: Genome modelling and design across all domains of life with Evo 2.
articles.titleZh: 使用 Evo 2 进行生命各个领域的基因组建模和设计。
articles.authors: Brixi G, Durrant MG, Ku J, Naghipourfar M, Poli M, Sun G, Brockman G, Chang D, Fanton A, Gonzalez GA, King SH, Li DB, Merchant AT, Nguyen E, Ricci-Tam C, Romero DW, Schmok JC, Taghibakhshi A, Vorontsov A, Yang B, Deng M, Gorton L, Nguyen N, Wang NK, Pearce MT, Simon E, Adams E, Amador ZJ, Ashley EA, Baccus SA, Dai H, Dillmann S, Ermon S, Guo D, Herschl MH, Ilango R, Janik K, Lu AX, Mehta R, Mofrad MRK, Ng MY, Pannu J, Ré C, St John J, Sullivan J, Tey J, Viggiano B, Zhu K, Zynda G, Balsam D, Collison P, Costa AB, Hernandez-Boussard T, Ho E, Liu MY, McGrath T, Powell K, Pinglay S, Burke DP, Goodarzi H, Hsu PD, Hie BL.
articles.abstract: All of life encodes information with DNA. Although tools for genome sequencing, synthesis and editing have transformed biological research, we still lack sufficient understanding of the immense complexity encoded by genomes to predict the effects of many classes of genomic changes or to intelligently compose new biological systems. Artificial intelligence models that learn information from genomic sequences across diverse organisms have increasingly advanced prediction and design capabilities1,2. Here we introduce Evo 2, a biological foundation model trained on 9 trillion DNA base pairs from a highly curated genomic atlas spanning all domains of life to have a 1 million token context window with single-nucleotide resolution. Evo 2 learns to accurately predict the functional impacts of genetic variation-from noncoding pathogenic mutations to clinically significant BRCA1 variants-without task-specific fine-tuning. Mechanistic interpretability analyses reveal that Evo 2 learns representations associated with biological features, including exon-intron boundaries, transcription factor binding sites, protein structural elements and prophage genomic regions. The generative abilities of Evo 2 produce mitochondrial, prokaryotic and eukaryotic sequences at genome scale with greater naturalness and coherence than previous methods. Evo 2 also generates experimentally validated chromatin accessibility patterns when guided by predictive models3,4 and inference-time search. We have made Evo 2 fully open, including model parameters, training code5, inference code and the OpenGenome2 dataset, to accelerate the exploration and design of biological complexity.
articles.abstractZh: 所有生命都用 DNA 编码信息。尽管基因组测序、合成和编辑工具已经改变了生物学研究，但我们仍然对基因组编码的巨大复杂性缺乏足够的了解，无法预测多种基因组变化的影响或智能地构建新的生物系统。从不同生物体的基因组序列中学习信息的人工智能模型具有越来越先进的预测和设计能力1,2。在这里，我们介绍 Evo 2，这是一种生物基础模型，使用来自精心策划的基因组图谱中的 9 万亿个 DNA 碱基对进行训练，该图谱涵盖生命的所有领域，具有单核苷酸分辨率的 100 万个标记上下文窗口。 Evo 2 学会准确预测遗传变异的功能影响 - 从非编码致病突变到临床上显着的 BRCA1 变异 - 无需针对特定任务进行微调。机制可解释性分析表明，Evo 2 学习与生物学特征相关的表征，包括外显子-内含子边界、转录因子结合位点、蛋白质结构元件和原噬菌体基因组区域。 Ev的生成能力

articles.title: Microbiota-mediated induction of beige adipocytes in response to dietary cues.
articles.titleZh: 微生物群介导的米色脂肪细胞响应饮食线索的诱导。
articles.authors: Tanoue T, Nagayama M, Roochana AJA, Zimmerman S, Ashenberg O, Jain T, Igarashi R, Sasajima S, Takeshita K, Hetherington N, Okahashi N, Ueda M, Konishi M, Nakayama Y, Minoda A, Skelly AN, Minokoshi Y, Pucci N, Mende DR, Arita M, Yamamoto H, Watanabe S, Miura K, Behie SW, Suda W, Sato T, Atarashi K, Matsushita M, Kajimura S, Plichta DR, Saito M, Xavier RJ, Honda K.
articles.abstract: Interactions between diet and the gut microbiota are fundamental to metabolic health, shaping energy balance and disease susceptibility1-5. However, the underlying mechanisms by which dietary and microbial factors converge to regulate host physiology remain unclear. Here we show that protein availability profoundly modulates the functional landscape of the gut microbiota and promotes remodelling of white adipose tissue (WAT). Specifically, low-protein diets (LPDs) robustly induce signature genes of browning in WAT to a similar extent to that seen in response to classical stimuli, such as cold exposure or β-adrenergic receptor activation6-8. LPD-mediated browning was markedly diminished in germ-free mice, and this defect was rescued by colonization with defined bacterial consortia made up of strains that were isolated and down-selected from the faeces of either LPD-fed mice or healthy human volunteers with 18F-fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography (FDG-PET)-confirmed brown- or beige-fat activity9-12. Microbiota-induced browning was mediated both by bile acids driving the activation of the farnesoid X receptor (FXR) in adipose progenitor cells, and by nrfA-encoding commensal-derived ammonia driving the expression of fibroblast growth factor 21 (FGF21) in hepatocytes. The bile acid-FXR and ammonia-FGF21 axes both have non-redundant, essential roles in promoting WAT browning. These findings highlight a mechanistic link between diet, gut microbial metabolism and adipose tissue remodelling, uncovering microbiota-dependent pathways by which the host responds to dietary cues.
articles.abstractZh: 饮食与肠道微生物群之间的相互作用对于代谢健康、塑造能量平衡和疾病易感性至关重要1-5。然而，饮食和微生物因素共同调节宿主生理的潜在机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明蛋白质的可用性深刻地调节肠道微生物群的功能景观并促进白色脂肪组织（WAT）的重塑。具体来说，低蛋白饮食 (LPD) 会强烈诱导 WAT 中的褐变特征基因，其程度与经典刺激（例如寒冷暴露或 β-肾上腺素受体激活）的反应程度相似6-8。 LPD 介导的褐变在无菌小鼠中显着减少，并且通过用确定的细菌菌群定植来挽救这种缺陷，该细菌菌群由从 LPD 喂养的小鼠或健康人类志愿者的粪便中分离和下调选择的菌株组成，通过 18F-氟脱氧葡萄糖正电子发射断层扫描 (FDG-PET) 证实棕色或米色脂肪活性 9-12。微生物群诱导的褐变是由驱动脂肪祖细胞中法尼醇 X 受体 (FXR) 激活的胆汁酸和编码 nrfA 的共生体介导的

articles.title: Structural remodeling of the mitochondrial protein biogenesis machinery under proteostatic stress.
articles.titleZh: 蛋白质应激下线粒体蛋白质生物合成机制的结构重塑。
articles.authors: Ehses K, López-Alonso JP, Antico O, Lang Y, Rudack T, Azem A, Muqit MMK, Ubarretxena-Belandia I, Fernández-Busnadiego R.
articles.abstract: Cells have evolved organelle-specific responses to maintain protein homeostasis (proteostasis). During proteostatic stress, mitochondria down-regulate translation and enhance protein folding, yet the underlying mechanisms remain poorly defined. Here, we used cryo-electron tomography to observe the structural consequences of mitochondrial proteostatic stress within human cells. We detected protein aggregates within the mitochondrial matrix, accompanied by a marked remodeling of cristae architecture. Concomitantly, the number of mitochondrial ribosome complexes was significantly reduced. Mitochondrial Hsp60 (mHsp60), a key protein folding machine, underwent major conformational changes to favor complexes with its co-chaperone mHsp10. We visualized the interactions of mHsp60 with native substrate proteins and determined in vitro mHsp60 cryo-electron microscopy structures enabling nucleotide state assignment of the in situ structures. These data converge on a model of the mHsp60 functional cycle and its essential role in mitochondrial proteostasis. More broadly, our findings reveal structural mechanisms governing mitochondrial protein biosynthesis and their remodeling under proteostatic stress.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞已经进化出细胞器特异性反应来维持蛋白质稳态（蛋白质稳态）。在蛋白质稳态应激期间，线粒体下调翻译并增强蛋白质折叠，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用冷冻电子断层扫描来观察人类细胞内线粒体蛋白稳态应激的结构后果。我们检测到线粒体基质内的蛋白质聚集体，伴随着嵴结构的明显重塑。与此同时，线粒体核糖体复合物的数量显着减少。线粒体 Hsp60 (mHsp60) 是一种关键的蛋白质折叠机，经历了重大构象变化，有利于与其共伴侣 mHsp10 形成复合物。我们可视化了 mHsp60 与天然底物蛋白的相互作用，并确定了体外 mHsp60 冷冻电子显微镜结构，从而实现了原位结构的核苷酸状态分配。这些数据集中在 mHsp60 功能循环模型及其在线粒体蛋白质稳态中的重要作用。更广泛地说，我们的研究结果揭示了控制线粒体蛋白质生物合成及其在蛋白质稳态下重塑的结构机制

articles.title: An interfacial-intramolecular electron highway for accelerated electrocatalytic CO<sub>2</sub> reduction by an O<sub>2</sub>-tolerant formate dehydrogenase.
articles.titleZh: 一种界面-分子内电子高速公路，用于通过耐 O<sub>2</sub> 的甲酸脱氢酶加速电催化 CO<sub>2</sub> 还原。
articles.authors: Liu W, Zhang P, Wang X, Zhang K, Yang W, Cui H, Liu J, Sun J, You C, Cui H, Zhu Z, Zhang L.
articles.abstract: Bioelectrocatalytic CO2 reduction offers a sustainable route for CO2 bioconversion, yet remains limited by interfacial-intramolecular electron transfer and oxygen sensitivity. Here, we mine a formate dehydrogenase from Shewanella oneidensis MR-1 (SoFdhAB) featuring completely oxygen tolerant and direct-electron-transfer (DET) electrocatalytic performances. Cryo-electron microscopy (Cryo-EM) analysis reveals an intramolecular electron highway comprising five [4Fe-4S] clusters, a regional face-face contact facilitating interfacial ET, and a unique oxygen resistance mechanism different from inactivation-activation. By acquiring a beneficial variant SoFdhAB-Y94S, a direct bioelectrocatalytic CO2 reduction system is constructed, accumulating 2.88 ± 0.03 mmol formate in 64 hours with a steady rate of 45.3 ± 0.5 μmol h-1 cm-2 and a Faradaic efficiency of 93.1 ± 5.2%. The merits of oxygen tolerance and efficient (electro)catalytic property endow SoFdhAB a robust enzyme adopted in potential application scenarios, and the inherent DET capability may inspire the interfacial engineering of other oxidoreductases.
articles.abstractZh: 生物电催化二氧化碳还原为二氧化碳生物转化提供了一条可持续的途径，但仍然受到界面分子内电子转移和氧敏感性的限制。在这里，我们从 Shewanella oneidensis MR-1 (SoFdhAB) 中挖掘出一种甲酸脱氢酶，具有完全耐氧和直接电子转移 (DET) 电催化性能。冷冻电子显微镜 (Cryo-EM) 分析揭示了由五个 [4Fe-4S] 簇组成的分子内电子高速公路、促进界面 ET 的区域面-面接触以及不同于失活-激活的独特氧抵抗机制。通过获得有益的变体SoFdhAB-Y94S，构建了直接生物电催化CO2还原系统，在64小时内积累2.88±0.03mmol甲酸，稳定速率为45.3±0.5μmol h-1 cm-2，法拉第效率为93.1±5.2%。耐氧性和高效（电）催化特性的优点赋予 SoFdhAB 一种在潜在应用场景中采用的强大酶，并且固有的 DET 能力可能会激发其他氧化还原酶的界面工程。

articles.title: Ether phospholipids modulate somatosensory responses by tuning multiple receptor functions in <i>Drosophila</i>.
articles.titleZh: 醚磷脂通过调节果蝇中的多种受体功能来调节体感反应。
articles.authors: Suito T, Deng X, Sato S, Nagao K, Ganser C, Uchihashi T, Tsutsumi M, Nemoto T, Hara Y, Tominaga M, Sokabe T.
articles.abstract: PIEZO and TRP channels are receptors for physical stimuli such as mechanical touch and temperature in sensory neurons. As these receptors are localized in the plasma membrane, the modulation of their activities by membrane lipids has recently attracted attention. In this study, we focused on ether phospholipids (ePLs) enriched in neurons and analyzed their role in somatosensation using Drosophila. Reduced mechanosensory behavior was observed with ePL-synthesizing gene knockout or knockdown in PIEZO-expressing neurons. PIEZO activation was significantly augmented in the presence of ePLs. Furthermore, we observed that ePLs modulate the thermosensory behavior and reduce the temperature threshold of TRPA1. Finally, we revealed that ePLs affect membrane tension and lipid order of the plasma membrane in cultured cells. Our study identified ePLs as a modulator of a specific set of receptors for multiple somatosensory modalities, which underscores the significance of functional interaction between membrane lipids and sensory channel proteins.
articles.abstractZh: PIEZO 和 TRP 通道是感觉神经元中机械触摸和温度等物理刺激的受体。由于这些受体位于质膜中，膜脂对其活性的调节最近引起了人们的关注。在这项研究中，我们重点关注神经元中富含的醚磷脂（ePL），并使用果蝇分析了它们在体感中的作用。通过敲除 ePL 合成基因或敲低表达 PIEZO 的神经元，观察到机械感觉行为减少。 ePL 存在时 PIEZO 激活显着增强。此外，我们观察到 ePL 调节热感行为并降低 TRPA1 的温度阈值。最后，我们发现 ePL 会影响培养细胞中质膜的膜张力和脂质顺序。我们的研究确定 ePL 是多种体感模式的一组特定受体的调节剂，这强调了膜脂和感觉通道蛋白之间功能相互作用的重要性。

articles.title: Mitotic microhomology-mediated break-induced replication promotes chromoanasynthesis.
articles.titleZh: 有丝分裂微同源介导的断裂诱导的复制促进染色体合成。
articles.authors: Ngo GHP, Cleal K, Seifan S, Miklos V, Barwacz SA, Ruis BL, Kamranvar SA, Grimstead JW, Liu Y, Hendrickson EA, Baird DM.
articles.abstract: Chromoanasynthesis is a form of complex chromosomal rearrangement (CCR) commonly detected in cancers and congenital disorders, but the mechanism underlying its generation remain elusive. Here we develop a single-molecule long-read DNA sequencing approach to characterise ultra-complex mutational events, consistent with chromoanasynthesis, occurring at shortened telomeres and sub-telomeric DNA double-strand breaks in human cells. Our data reveal that chromoanasynthesis is generated by microhomology-mediated break-induced replication (MM-BIR), occurring specifically in mitosis. Surprisingly, this mitotic pathway involves a collaboration between microhomology-mediated end-joining (MMEJ) and BIR, where MMEJ proteins initiate a Polδ-dependent BIR pathway that is regulated by PIF1, POLD3 and PCNA. This pathway is highly prone to template switching and can generate dramatic amplification of genomic loci in a single event. Our findings help explain the extreme mutagenic nature of chromoanasynthesis and establish mitotic MM-BIR as a key driver of CCRs, with important implications for the origin of cancers and congenital disorders.
articles.abstractZh: 染色体合成是复杂染色体重排 (CCR) 的一种形式，常见于癌症和先天性疾病中，但其产生的机制仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们开发了一种单分子长读长 DNA 测序方法来表征超复杂的突变事件，与染色体分析一致，发生在人类细胞中端粒缩短和亚端粒 DNA 双链断裂处。我们的数据表明，染色合成是由微同源介导的断裂诱导复制（MM-BIR）产生的，特别发生在有丝分裂中。令人惊讶的是，这种有丝分裂途径涉及微同源介导的末端连接（MMEJ）和 BIR 之间的协作，其中 MMEJ 蛋白启动受 PIF1、POLD3 和 PCNA 调节的 Polδ 依赖性 BIR 途径。该途径非常容易发生模板转换，并且可以在单个事件中产生基因组位点的显着扩增。我们的研究结果有助于解释色素分析的极端诱变性质，并将有丝分裂 MM-BIR 确立为 CCR 的关键驱动因素，对癌症和先天性疾病的起源具有重要意义。

articles.title: Plant P-bodies in post-transcriptional control: Composition, dynamics, and context-dependent roles.
articles.titleZh: 转录后控制中的植物 P 体：组成、动力学和上下文相关的作用。
articles.authors: Matinahmadi A, Zayani Z, Majewska K, Smoliński DJ.
articles.abstract: Processing bodies (P-bodies, PBs) are cytoplasmic ribonucleoprotein condensates that concentrate mRNA-decay and translation-repression factors. In plants, PBs share core machinery with other eukaryotes but exhibit unique, context-dependent features that distinguish them from their yeast and mammalian counterparts. These properties are shaped by direct modulation from hormonal signaling (e.g., abscisic acid [ABA]) and stress physiology, underscoring their specialized roles in adaptation. Here we synthesize plant-focused evidence on PB composition, liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS)-driven assembly, and their coupling to decapping-dependent and co-translational decay pathways. We delineate the contexts in which PBs act as decay hotspots versus buffering sites for non-translating mRNAs, and explicitly distinguish plant findings from inferences derived from yeast/animal systems. We also integrate recent advances on post-translational modifications (e.g., mitogen-activated protein kinase-dependent DCP1 phosphorylation) and RNA modifications (m6A/ECT8) in selective mRNA targeting. Finally, we outline open questions regarding the spatial organization of decay, PB-stress granule crosstalk, and hormonal control mechanisms, and highlight methodological avenues to address them. Overall, plant PBs are presented as dynamic regulatory hubs that help tune post-transcriptional control in response to developmental and environmental cues, with their underlying mechanisms increasingly resolved by interdisciplinary strategies combining live-cell imaging, quantitative proteomics, and CRISPR-based genetics.
articles.abstractZh: 加工体（P 体，PB）是细胞质核糖核蛋白凝聚物，集中 mRNA 衰变和翻译抑制因子。在植物中，PB 与其他真核生物共享核心机制，但表现出独特的、依赖于环境的特征，这将它们与酵母和哺乳动物的对应物区分开来。这些特性是通过激素信号（例如脱落酸 [ABA]）和应激生理学的直接调节而形成的，强调了它们在适应中的特殊作用。在这里，我们综合了以植物为中心的 PB 组成、液-液相分离 (LLPS) 驱动的组装以及它们与脱盖依赖性和共翻译衰变途径的耦合的证据。我们描述了 PB 作为衰变热点与非翻译 mRNA 缓冲位点的背景，并明确区分植物发现与源自酵母/动物系统的推论。我们还将翻译后修饰（例如丝裂原激活蛋白激酶依赖性 DCP1 磷酸化）和 RNA 修饰 (m6A/ECT8) 的最新进展整合到选择性 mRNA 靶向中。最后，我们概述了有关衰变空间组织、PB 应力颗粒交叉的开放问题

articles.title: Biosynthesis of benzylisoquinoline alkaloids and its evolution in plants.
articles.titleZh: 苄基异喹啉生物碱的生物合成及其在植物中的进化。
articles.authors: Tian Y, An Z, Li Q, Bai G, Zhang Q, Dong Y, Chen Y, Chen S, Xu Z, Gao R.
articles.abstract: Benzylisoquinoline alkaloids (BIAs) represent a large class of plant specialized metabolites that enhance plant resistance to biotic and abiotic stresses while also exhibiting diverse pharmacological activities, such as the analgesic effects of morphine and the antibacterial properties of berberine. We systematically review the biosynthetic pathways of diverse BIA scaffolds and the key enzymes involved. These enzymes, including methyltransferases, cytochrome P450 monooxygenases, berberine bridge enzymes, demethylases, and acyltransferases, collectively mediate structural diversification of BIAs through reactions such as methylation, oxidation, ring formation, demethylation, and acetylation. Additionally, we discuss how lineage-specific gene duplication events, neofunctionalization, and/or the assembly of biosynthetic gene clusters have driven structural diversification and adaptive evolution across taxa. Despite significant progress, challenges remain in fully characterizing pathway gaps, enzyme promiscuity, and regulatory networks. We recommend that integrating multi-omics data with protein engineering and synthetic biology offers promising avenues for sustainable production of high-value BIAs and the discovery of novel bioactive compounds.
articles.abstractZh: 苄基异喹啉生物碱 (BIA) 代表一大类植物特有代谢物，可增强植物对生物和非生物胁迫的抵抗力，同时还表现出多种药理活性，例如吗啡的镇痛作用和小檗碱的抗菌特性。我们系统地回顾了不同 BIA 支架的生物合成途径以及所涉及的关键酶。这些酶，包括甲基转移酶、细胞色素 P450 单加氧酶、小檗碱桥酶、去甲基化酶和酰基转移酶，通过甲基化、氧化、成环、去甲基化和乙酰化等反应共同介导 BIA 的结构多样化。此外，我们还讨论了谱系特异性基因复制事件、新功能化和/或生物合成基因簇的组装如何驱动跨类群的结构多样化和适应性进化。尽管取得了重大进展，但在充分表征途径差距、酶混杂和监管网络方面仍然存在挑战。我们建议将多组学数据与蛋白质工程和合成生物学相结合，为可持续生产高品质蛋白质提供有希望的途径。

articles.title: Continental-scale drivers of soil microbial extracellular polymeric substances.
articles.titleZh: 土壤微生物细胞外聚合物的大陆尺度驱动因素。
articles.authors: Shi K, Zheng Q, Wang B, Noll L, Zhang S, Hu Y, Ruan H, Wanek W.
articles.abstract: Extracellular polymeric substances (EPS) are key microbial residues that contribute to soil organic carbon (SOC) and promote soil aggregation. Yet, their abundance and large-scale controls have only begun to be investigated. We conduct extensive soil sampling across a European transect spanning diverse climates, bedrocks, and land uses. Average soil EPS content is 956 ± 55 µg g-1 soil (n= 92 sites), with EPS-carbon (EPS-C) contributing 1.6 ± 0.1% to SOC. Bedrock influences EPS content, EPS-C contribution to SOC, and the EPS-C/microbial biomass carbon (MBC) ratio, whereas land use mainly affects the latter two. The EPS-C/MBC ratio is negatively correlated with microbial growth and carbon use efficiency, and increases under water deficit, while EPS increases with MBC, clay content, and exchangeable calcium. Our results demonstrate that EPS represents a functionally important microbial residue, regulated by climatic, edaphic, microbial, and land-use factors, with significant implications for soil carbon cycling and sequestration.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞外聚合物（EPS）是重要的微生物残留物，有助于形成土壤有机碳（SOC）并促进土壤聚集。然而，对它们的丰富性和大规模控制的研究才刚刚开始。我们在欧洲横断面进行了广泛的土壤采样，涵盖不同的气候、基岩和土地利用。土壤 EPS 平均含量为 956 ± 55 µg g-1 土壤（n= 92 个地点），其中 EPS-碳 (EPS-C) 对 SOC 贡献 1.6 ± 0.1%。基岩影响 EPS 含量、EPS-C 对 SOC 的贡献以及 EPS-C/微生物生物量碳 (MBC) 比率，而土地利用主要影响后两者。 EPS-C/MBC比率与微生物生长和碳利用效率呈负相关，并且在缺水时增加，而EPS随着MBC、粘土含量和交换性钙的增加而增加。我们的结果表明，EPS 是一种功能上重要的微生物残留物，受气候、土壤、微生物和土地利用因素的调节，对土壤碳循环和固存具有重大影响。

articles.title: Optimization of sporulation of Trametes sanguinea ZHSJ and untargeted metabolomics of spores, mycelium and fruiting body.
articles.titleZh: 血栓菌 ZHSJ 孢子形成优化及孢子、菌丝体和子实体的非靶向代谢组学。
articles.authors: Li Y, Su Y, Yang P, Peng C, Cheng X, Zhang X, Peng L, Lodi RS, Wang Z.
articles.abstract: Trametes sanguinea belongs to the polyporaceae family and it is a white rot medicinal fungus. In the present study, pure mycelium of Trametes sanguinea ZHSJ (T. sanguinea ZHSJ) was obtained from the fruiting body of wild basidiomycetes by tissue separation method, and its growth conditions were optimized in vitro. The results exhibited the optimal growth of T. sanguinea ZHSJ at pH 5, temperature 30 ℃ with the carbon source maltose 20 g/L and nitrogen source yeast extract 4 g/L. LC-MS based untargeted metabolomic studies revealed there are 6715 metabolites in both positive and negative ion mode detection of spores (SP), mycelium (MY) and fruiting body (MU). However, principal component analysis (PCA) represented PC1 67.10% and PC2 24.60% metabolite variance among SP, MY and MU. Further, metabolite cluster and Variable projection importance (VIP) analysis has represented differential upregulated and down regulated metabolites with p value < 0.05 and VIP ≥ 1 significance. Moreover, KEGG pathway enrichment analysis represented SP vs. MY and SP vs. MY major metabolites 23 and 31 involved in biosynthesis of co-factors and MY vs. MU major metabolites involved in diterpenoid biosynthesis. Hence, current study reveals that the morphological stages of T. sanguinea ZHSJ possess several variations in their metabolites and this is the first study to reveal the optimization of T. sanguinea spores and their metabolites comparison with mycelium and fruiting body through LC-MS based untargeted metabolomics. Further research on the biological activity of these differential metabolites of T. sanguinea spores would way a path in identification of novel medicinally important compounds.
articles.abstractZh: 血栓菌属于多孔菌科，是一种白腐药用真菌。本研究采用组织分离法从野生担子菌子实体中获得了血红栓菌ZHSJ（T. sanguinea ZHSJ）纯菌丝体，并对其体外生长条件进行了优化。结果表明，在碳源麦芽糖20 g/L、氮源酵母抽提物4 g/L、pH 5、温度30 ℃条件下，血红T. sanguinea ZHSJ生长最适。基于LC-MS的非靶向代谢组学研究表明，孢子（SP）、菌丝体（MY）和子实体（MU）的正离子和负离子模式检测中共有6715种代谢物。然而，主成分分析 (PCA) 表明 SP、MY 和 MU 之间的 PC1 67.10% 和 PC2 24.60% 代谢差异。此外，代谢物簇和变量投影重要性 (VIP) 分析代表了差异上调和下调的代谢物，p 值 < 0.05 且 VIP ≥ 1 显着性。此外，KEGG 通路富集分析代表了参与辅因子生物合成的 SP 与 MY 以及 SP 与 MY 主要代谢物 23 和 31 以及参与二萜生物合成的 MY 与 MU 主要代谢物。

articles.title: RNA-specific local translation is patterned by condensates for multinucleate cell growth.
articles.titleZh: RNA 特异性局部翻译由多核细胞生长的凝结物形成。
articles.authors: Geisterfer ZM, Jalihal AP, Cole SJ, Gladfelter AS.
articles.abstract: Coordination between growth and nuclear division is a common cell feature. In some syncytia, nuclei divide asynchronously throughout the cell but growth occurs only at discrete locations, raising the question how the processes are locally regulated and globally coordinated. In the syncytial fungus Ashbya gossypii, both cell cycle progression and hyphal elongation require condensates formed by the protein Whi3 in complex with distinct mRNA species. Here we show that Whi3 condensates are enriched for translation regulators and are associated with local, spatially patterned translation of specific target RNAs near nuclei and growth sites. Whi3-RNA condensates can both promote and repress mRNA translation in an RNA- and condensate size-dependent manner in vitro. Condensate interfaces are sites of translation, tunable by condensate composition, RNA valency and protein charge state in vitro. Together, these data suggest that Whi3 condensates can generate a continuum of translation states that vary depending on the subcellular location and resident RNA sequences.
articles.abstractZh: 生长和核分裂之间的协调是一个常见的细胞特征。在一些合胞体中，细胞核在整个细胞中异步分裂，但生长仅发生在离散位置，这就提出了如何局部调节和全局协调该过程的问题。在合胞体真菌 Ashbya gossypii 中，细胞周期进程和菌丝伸长都需要由蛋白质 Whi3 与不同 mRNA 种类形成复合物形成的缩合物。在这里，我们表明，Whi3 缩合物富含翻译调节因子，并且与细胞核和生长位点附近特定目标 RNA 的局部、空间模式翻译相关。 Whi3-RNA 凝聚体可以在体外以 RNA 和凝聚体大小依赖性方式促进和抑制 mRNA 翻译。凝结界面是翻译位点，可通过体外凝结组成、RNA 价态和蛋白质电荷状态进行调节。总之，这些数据表明 Whi3 缩合物可以产生连续的翻译状态，其变化取决于亚细胞位置和驻留 RNA 序列。

articles.title: Thiolutin extends replicative lifespan by rewiring yeast transcription and metabolism.
articles.titleZh: 硫鲁丁通过重新连接酵母转录和代谢来延长复制寿命。
articles.authors: Mołoń M, Kielar P, Kobylińska Z, Mołoń A, Winiarski J, Kula-Maximenko M, Galiniak S.
articles.abstract: Transcription is a major cellular energy sink tightly coupled to growth, metabolism, and aging. Thiolutin, a widely used RNA polymerase inhibitor in yeast, has unclear long-term effects on aging. We show that thiolutin oppositely affects replicative and chronological aging in Saccharomyces cerevisiae by remodeling transcription, metabolism, and proteostasis. Thiolutin extends replicative lifespan, increasing reproductive potential and prolonging the mitotic phase, despite slower growth and lower ATP. This longevity is linked to global transcriptional repression, including reduced ribosome biogenesis, translation, and mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation, and dampening of TOR1-dependent growth programs. In parallel, thiolutin triggers a selective adaptive response with activation of RPN4-mediated proteasome remodeling and redox-responsive genes, without HOG1 induction. Conversely, thiolutin accelerates early chronological aging: post-mitotic survival drops alongside repression of reserve carbohydrate genes (GPH1, GSY2, TSL1), suggesting impaired adaptation when entering stationary phase. FT-Raman spectroscopy confirms coordinated depletion of RNA, proteins, lipids, and carbohydrates. Thus, thiolutin promotes a low-energy, stress-adaptive state that benefits budding yeast cells but compromises early survival of non-budding populations, underscoring transcription–energy coupling in aging trajectories.
articles.abstractZh: 转录是一个主要的细胞能量库，与生长、新陈代谢和衰老密切相关。硫黄素是一种在酵母中广泛使用的 RNA 聚合酶抑制剂，对衰老的长期影响尚不清楚。我们发现，硫芦丁通过重塑转录、代谢和蛋白质稳态，对酿酒酵母的复制和时间老化产生相反的影响。尽管生长速度较慢且 ATP 较低，但硫黄素可延长复制寿命，提高生殖潜力并延长有丝分裂期。这种长寿与整体转录抑制有关，包括核糖体生物合成、翻译和线粒体氧化磷酸化的减少，以及 TOR1 依赖性生长程序的抑制。同时，硫芦丁通过激活 RPN4 介导的蛋白酶体重塑和氧化还原反应基因来触发选择性适应性反应，而无需 HOG1 诱导。相反，硫芦丁会加速早期衰老：有丝分裂后存活率随着储备碳水化合物基因（GPH1、GSY2、TSL1）的抑制而下降，表明进入稳定期时适应受损。 FT-拉曼光谱证实了 RNA、蛋白质、脂质和碳水化合物的协调消耗

articles.title: Data storage and retrieval with unnatural proteins expressed via E. coli.
articles.titleZh: 使用大肠杆菌表达的非天然蛋白质进行数据存储和检索。
articles.authors: Zhou Y, Ng CCA, Liu C, Tam WM, Lau FCM, Yao ZP.
articles.abstract: Data storage using proteins offers high capacity and stability, enabling utilization of protein techniques for data storage and retrieval. However, expressing unnatural proteins with random sequences for data storage and sequencing them for accurate data retrieval remain challenging. In this study, by encoding digital data into amino acid sequences and incorporating them into collagen-like protein templates, we achieve successful expression of the proteins via E. coli for data storage; the data-bearing proteins containing selective amino acids and arginine intervals can be sequenced through tryptic digestion followed by LC-MS/MS analysis to achieve complete data recovery, even for protein mixtures encoding multiple datasets. We further demonstrate much higher stability of the data-bearing protein than DNA, and random access and cryptographic data protection using affinity-tagged proteins. This work establishes a robust framework for protein-based data storage, opening up avenues for data storage and retrieval, protein engineering and chemistry, synthetic biology, proteomics, and beyond.
articles.abstractZh: 使用蛋白质的数据存储提供高容量和稳定性，使得能够利用蛋白质技术进行数据存储和检索。然而，用随机序列表达非天然蛋白质以进行数据存储并对它们进行测序以实现准确的数据检索仍然具有挑战性。在本研究中，通过将数字数据编码为氨基酸序列并将其整合到类胶原蛋白模板中，我们通过大肠杆菌成功表达了蛋白质以进行数据存储；含有选择性氨基酸和精氨酸区间的数据承载蛋白质可以通过胰蛋白酶消化进行测序，然后进行 LC-MS/MS 分析，以实现完整的数据恢复，甚至对于编码多个数据集的蛋白质混合物也是如此。我们进一步证明了数据承载蛋白的稳定性比 DNA 高得多，并且使用亲和标记蛋白进行随机访问和加密数据保护。这项工作为基于蛋白质的数据存储建立了一个强大的框架，为数据存储和检索、蛋白质工程和化学、合成生物学、蛋白质组学等开辟了途径。

articles.title: Predicting FOX gene candidates for oxic nitrogen fixation using multi-omic machine learning and comparative bioinformatics.
articles.titleZh: 使用多组学机器学习和比较生物信息学预测有氧固氮的 FOX 候选基因。
articles.authors: Young J, Gu L, Zhou R.
articles.abstract: Nitrogen fixation in oxygenic cyanobacteria depends on a system of genes that protect oxygen-sensitive nitrogenase, many of which likely remain uncharacterized. Here we predict FOX (fixation in the presence of oxygen) gene candidates in Anabaena sp. PCC 7120 by integrating nitrogen step-down RNA-seq (0/6/12/21 hours), quantitative proteomics, promoter architecture, genomic context, and reciprocal-best-hit conservation across diazotrophic and non-diazotrophic cyanobacteria. Using 68 literature-validated FOX genes and 835 conserved non-essential genes as a proxy negative class, we trained logistic regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost models and evaluated them using 20 repeated stratified 80/20 train–test splits. The best models achieved ROC–AUC up to 0.80 and average precision up to 0.55 and precision among the top 20 ranked genes reached 0.39 versus a 0.075 prevalence baseline. Model interpretation highlights late step-down induction, diazotroph-biased conservation, and genomic neighborhood signals as leading predictors. We generated genome-wide FOX probability scores used primarily for candidate ranking, nominating conserved genes spanning heterocyst envelope processes as well as broader redox, metabolism, and electron-pool regulation. We release these predictions and a public web-based optimizer that applies comparative-bioinformatics filters and size constraints to propose candidate accessory-gene complements for experimental testing and heterologous reconstitution efforts.
articles.abstractZh: 产氧蓝细菌中的固氮取决于保护氧敏感固氮酶的基因系统，其中许多可能尚未被表征。在这里，我们预测鱼腥藻中的 FOX（有氧固定）基因候选。 PCC 7120 通过整合氮降压 RNA-seq（0/6/12/21 小时）、定量蛋白质组学、启动子结构、基因组背景以及固氮和非固氮蓝藻的相互最佳命中保护。使用 68 个经文献验证的 FOX 基因和 835 个保守的非必需基因作为代理阴性类，我们训练了逻辑回归、随机森林和 XGBoost 模型，并使用 20 次重复分层的 80/20 训练-测试分割对其进行了评估。最好的模型的 ROC-AUC 高达 0.80，平均精度高达 0.55，排名前 20 的基因的精度达到 0.39，而患病率基线为 0.075。模型解释强调晚期降压诱导、固氮菌偏向保守和基因组邻域信号作为主要预测因子。我们生成了全基因组 FOX 概率评分，主要用于候选排序、提名跨越异形囊膜过程的保守基因以及

articles.title: SplitTurboID mapping of dimeric protein phosphatase complex interactomes.
articles.titleZh: 二聚体蛋白磷酸酶复合体相互作用组的 SplitTurboID 作图。
articles.authors: Rajkumar A, Gaudreau-Lapierre A, Anthony CLF, Nguyen V, Ooi S, Campuzano D, Trinkle-Mulcahy L.
articles.abstract: Unlike its counterpart Ser/Thr kinases, the predominant Ser/Thr protein phosphatase 1 (PP1) is a promiscuous enzyme that gains its subcellular localization and substrate specificity from a large panel of regulatory proteins with which it associates. Mapping the interactomes of catalytic and regulatory subunits on their own provides evidence for the targeting of PP1 to a wide range of cellular pathways, but does not provide a conditional analysis of individual holophosphatase complexes. To achieve this, we adapted a splitTurboID fragment complementation approach for the proximal interactome mapping of distinct catalytic-regulatory subunit pairs. We demonstrated the reliability and high spatial resolution of this technique, using an analysis pipeline that highlights unique and enriched near neighbors above shared common contaminants. In addition to confirming that a newly identified regulatory subunit has both PP1- and non-PP1-related associations, we further demonstrate the general applicability of this approach to other types of protein-protein pairs.
articles.abstractZh: 与其对应的 Ser/Thr 激酶不同，主要的 Ser/Thr 蛋白磷酸酶 1 (PP1) 是一种混杂的酶，它从与其结合的大量调节蛋白中获得亚细胞定位和底物特异性。单独绘制催化亚基和调节亚基的相互作用组为 PP1 靶向多种细胞途径提供了证据，但没有提供单个全磷酸酶复合物的条件分析。为了实现这一目标，我们采用 splitTurboID 片段互补方法来绘制不同催化调节亚基对的近端相互作用组图。我们使用分析管道展示了该技术的可靠性和高空间分辨率，该分析管道突出显示了共享常见污染物之上的独特且丰富的近邻。除了确认新鉴定的调节亚基具有 PP1 相关关联和非 PP1 相关关联外，我们还进一步证明了该方法对其他类型的蛋白质-蛋白质对的普遍适用性。

articles.title: Unraveling the complexities: A comprehensive review of severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome and its associated complications.
articles.titleZh: 揭开复杂性：对严重发热伴血小板减少综合征及其相关并发症的全面回顾。
articles.authors: Zhou Y, Wang Y, Wu Y, Zhang Z, Zhang Y, Chen C, Chen Y, Zhang Y, Fang L.
articles.abstract: Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS), caused by Dabie bandavirus (DBV), is an emerging vector-borne infection with significant global health implications, particularly in East Asia. In recent years, its geographic footprint has expanded beyond traditional endemic regions, raising global concern due to high morbidity and variable case-fatality rates of up to 30%. Clinically, SFTS presents with an acute onset of high fever, thrombocytopenia, leukocytopenia, headache, and gastrointestinal disturbances. In severe cases, rapid progression may lead to life-threatening complications, including myocarditis, neurological disorders, invasive pulmonary aspergillosis (IPA), secondary infections, systemic inflammatory response syndrome (SIRS), hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH), and ultimately multi-organ failure (MOF). This review synthesizes recent advances in virology, pathophysiological mechanisms, diagnostic strategies, and therapeutic interventions for DBV infections. Special attention is given to the complications most commonly associated with poor prognoses and fatal outcomes in patients with SFTS, alongside future outlooks for research and public health preparedness to mitigate the growing global burden of this high-priority tick-borne disease.
articles.abstractZh: 由大别班达病毒 (DBV) 引起的严重发热伴血小板减少综合征 (SFTS) 是一种新兴的媒介传播感染，对全球健康产生重大影响，特别是在东亚。近年来，其地理足迹已超出传统流行地区，因其高发病率和高达 30% 的可变病死率而引起全球关注。临床上，SFTS 表现为急性发作的高烧、血小板减少、白细胞减少、头痛和胃肠道紊乱。在严重的情况下，快速进展可能导致危及生命的并发症，包括心肌炎、神经系统疾病、侵袭性肺曲霉病（IPA）、继发感染、全身炎症反应综合征（SIRS）、噬血细胞性淋巴组织细胞增多症（HLH）以及最终的多器官衰竭（MOF）。这篇综述综合了 DBV 感染的病毒学、病理生理学机制、诊断策略和治疗干预方面的最新进展。特别关注与 SFTS 患者预后不良和致命结果最常见相关的并发症，以及研究和公共卫生准备的未来前景

articles.title: Applications of Opuntia ficus-indica (L.) mill seed oil from eastern morocco including chemical profiling, antibacterial activity, and docking.
articles.titleZh: 摩洛哥东部仙人掌磨碎种子油的应用，包括化学分析、抗菌活性和对接。
articles.authors: Kadda S, Khibech O, Loukili EH, Conte R, Azzaoui K, Ouahhoud S, Hammouti B, Serghini HC, Hadda TB, Jodeh S, Belabed A.
articles.abstract: This study reports the chemical profiling and antimicrobial potential of Opuntia ficus-indica seed oil from Eastern Morocco, with emphasis on pharmacologically relevant constituents and valorization of an underexploited by-product. Seed oil was obtained by cold mechanical pressing and characterized using GC–MS (fatty acids and volatile profile), HPLC–DAD (tocopherols), and UHPLC–MS/MS (phenolic constituents). The oil exhibited a PUFA-rich profile dominated by linoleic acid (73.94%), with palmitic and stearic acids as major saturated components, while oleic acid was not detected under our analytical conditions. Tocopherol analysis revealed a high γ-tocopherol level (657.52 mg/kg). UHPLC–MS/MS enabled annotation of multiple phenolic compounds, including arbutin and kaempferol as major constituents. In vitro antibacterial assays showed no inhibition against Staphylococcus aureus and Streptococcus spp. (inhibition zone < 7 mm), whereas moderate-to-high activity was observed against Escherichia coli (11.6 ± 0.64 mm) and Klebsiella spp. (15.6 ± 0.51 mm). In silico POM analysis supported favorable drug-likeness/toxicological profiles for arbutin and kaempferol. Overall, these results support O. ficus-indica seed oil as a chemically rich natural matrix with promising antioxidant and antibacterial potential.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究报告了摩洛哥东部仙人掌种子油的化学分析和抗菌潜力，重点是药理学相关成分和未充分利用的副产品的价值。种子油通过冷机械压榨获得，并使用 GC-MS（脂肪酸和挥发性成分）、HPLC-DAD（生育酚）和 UHPLC-MS/MS（酚类成分）进行表征。该油表现出富含 PUFA 的特征，其中亚油酸 (73.94%) 为主，棕榈酸和硬脂酸为主要饱和成分，而在我们的分析条件下未检测到油酸。生育酚分析显示γ-生育酚水平较高（657.52 毫克/千克）。 UHPLC-MS/MS 能够注释多种酚类化合物，包括作为主要成分的熊果苷和山奈酚。体外抗菌试验显示对金黄色葡萄球菌和链球菌没有抑制作用。 （抑制区 < 7 毫米），而对大肠杆菌 (11.6 ± 0.64 毫米) 和克雷伯菌属具有中到高活性。 （15.6 ± 0.51 毫米）。计算机 POM 分析支持熊果苷和山奈酚具有良好的药物相似性/毒理学特征。总的来说，这些结果支持

articles.title: Citrate clearance is a major function of aconitase 2 in the canonical TCA cycle.
articles.titleZh: 柠檬酸盐清除是典型 TCA 循环中乌头酸酶 2 的主要功能。
articles.authors: Xie A, Brunner JS, Chakraborty S, Montero AM, Bridgeman AE, Paras KI, Cui R, Fagoaga-Eugui M, Komza M, Arnold PK, Jackson BT, Noriega Madrazo S, Atmane MI, Carrasco SE, Finley LWS.
articles.abstract: The tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle couples nutrient oxidation with the generation of reducing equivalents that power oxidative phosphorylation. Nevertheless, the requirement for components of the TCA cycle is context-specific, raising the question of which TCA cycle outputs support cell fitness. Here, we demonstrate that citrate clearance is an essential function of the TCA cycle. As citrate production increases, so do TCA cycle activity and dependence upon aconitase 2 (ACO2), the enzyme that initiates citrate catabolism in the TCA cycle. Disrupting citrate catabolism activates the integrated stress response and impairs cell fitness, and these effects are reversed by preventing citrate production or promoting mitochondrial citrate efflux. In vivo, ACO2 deficiency induces citrate accumulation and triggers tubular degeneration in the kidney, a tissue that physiologically takes up circulating citrate. Thus, intracellular citrate accumulation can be a metabolic liability, and citrate clearance is a major function of ACO2 in the TCA cycle.
articles.abstractZh: 三羧酸 (TCA) 循环将营养物氧化与驱动氧化磷酸化的还原当量的生成结合起来。然而，对 TCA 循环组成部分的要求是根据具体情况而定的，这就提出了哪些 TCA 循环输出支持细胞适应性的问题。在这里，我们证明柠檬酸盐清除是 TCA 循环的一个重要功能。随着柠檬酸盐产量的增加，TCA 循环活性和对乌头酸酶 2 (ACO2) 的依赖性也随之增加，乌头酸酶 2 是在 TCA 循环中启动柠檬酸盐分解代谢的酶。破坏柠檬酸分解代谢会激活综合应激反应并损害细胞健康，而这些影响可以通过阻止柠檬酸产生或促进线粒体柠檬酸流出来逆转。在体内，ACO2 缺乏会诱导柠檬酸盐积累并引发肾脏（生理上吸收循环柠檬酸盐的组织）肾小管变性。因此，细胞内柠檬酸盐积累可能是一种代谢负担，而柠檬酸盐清除是 ACO2 在 TCA 循环中的主要功能。

articles.title: Convergent evolution of hexenal isomerases in Lepidoptera and plants.
articles.titleZh: 鳞翅目和植物中己烯醛异构酶的趋同进化。
articles.authors: Lin YH, Wu BC, Sharaf A, Heijblom SME, Prattis I, Tan CW, Schilder RJ, Ali JG, Allmann S.
articles.abstract: Green leaf volatiles (GLVs) are six-carbon volatile organic compounds that mediate plant responses to environmental stresses. The quantity and composition of emitted GLVs can vary with stress type, allowing plants to fine-tune their volatile blends. In addition, insect herbivores are capable of modulating these emissions. A key mechanism underlying this plasticity is the conversion of Z-3-hexenal to E-2-hexenal by the enzyme (3Z):(2E)-hexenal isomerase (Hi), which reshapes GLV profiles and may influence multitrophic interactions. Here we investigate the evolutionary origin, functional diversification and catalytic mechanisms of lepidopteran Hi homologues, which belong to the glucose-methanol-choline oxidoreductase family. Phylogenetic analysis of 34 lepidopteran species identified a distinct glucose-methanol-choline-β subclade enriched in Hi homologues, largely confined to the Apoditrysia lineage. Functional assays showed species-specific variation in Hi activity, with Manduca sexta Hi-1 displaying the highest activity among tested homologues under identical protein concentrations, both in vitro and in planta. Structural modelling and site-directed mutagenesis revealed that Hi activity requires a flavin adenine dinucleotide cofactor enabling the identification of key residues critical for flavin adenine dinucleotide binding. Comparative phylogenetics further suggests that Hi enzymes in plants and Lepidoptera evolved independently from unrelated enzyme families, representing a case of functional convergence coinciding with the Cretaceous angiosperm radiation.
articles.abstractZh: 绿叶挥发物（GLV）是六碳挥发性有机化合物，可调节植物对环境胁迫的反应。排放的 GLV 的数量和成分可能因胁迫类型而异，从而使植物能够微调其挥发性混合物。此外，食草昆虫能够调节这些排放。这种可塑性背后的一个关键机制是 (3Z):(2E)-己烯醛异构酶 (Hi) 将 Z-3-己烯醛转化为 E-2-己烯醛，这会重塑 GLV 谱并可能影响多营养相互作用。在这里，我们研究属于葡萄糖-甲醇-胆碱氧化还原酶家族的鳞翅目 Hi 同源物的进化起源、功能多样性和催化机制。对 34 个鳞翅目物种的系统发育分析发现了一个富含 Hi 同源物的独特葡萄糖-甲醇-胆碱-β 亚支，主要局限于 Apoditrysia 谱系。功能测定显示 Hi 活性存在物种特异性差异，在体外和植物中，在相同蛋白质浓度下，在测试的同系物中，Manduca sexta Hi-1 显示出最高的活性。结构建模和定点突变揭示了 Hi acti

articles.title: Decoding the molecular logic of rapidly evolving ZAD zinc finger proteins in <i>Drosophila</i>.
articles.titleZh: 解码果蝇中快速进化的 ZAD 锌指蛋白的分子逻辑。
articles.authors: Saito R, Umemura Y, Makino S, Fukaya T.
articles.abstract: The zinc finger-associated domain (ZAD)-containing C2H2 zinc finger proteins (ZAD-ZnFs) represent the most abundant class of transcription factors that emerged during insect evolution, yet their molecular diversity and biological functions remain largely unclear. Here, we established a systematic CRISPR-based protein-tagging approach that enables direct, unambiguous comparison of nuclear localization and genome-wide binding profiles of endogenous ZAD-ZnFs in developing Drosophila embryos. Evidence is provided that a subset of ZAD-ZnFs forms nuclear condensates through the stacking of the N-terminal ZAD dimerization surface. Disruption of condensation activity leads to misregulation of genome-wide binding profiles and lethality, underscoring its functional and physiological significance in development. Integrative chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing and Micro-C analyses reveal that many ZAD-ZnFs colocalize with core insulator proteins such as CCCTC-binding factor and Centrosomal protein 190 kD to control the formation of topological boundaries. We suggest that the diverse molecular functions of ZAD-ZnFs have evolutionarily arisen from their ancestral role as insulator-binding proteins.
articles.abstractZh: 含有锌指相关结构域 (ZAD) 的 C2H2 锌指蛋白 (ZAD-ZnFs) 代表了昆虫进化过程中出现的最丰富的一类转录因子，但其分子多样性和生物学功能仍不清楚。在这里，我们建立了一种基于 CRISPR 的系统性蛋白质标记方法，能够直接、明确地比较发育中的果蝇胚胎中内源 ZAD-ZnF 的核定位和全基因组结合谱。有证据表明，ZAD-ZnF 的一个子集通过 N 端 ZAD 二聚化表面的堆积形成核凝聚物。缩合活性的破坏导致全基因组结合谱和致死率的失调，强调了其在发育中的功能和生理意义。整合染色质免疫沉淀测序和 Micro-C 分析表明，许多 ZAD-ZnF 与 CCCTC 结合因子和中心体蛋白 190 kD 等核心绝缘体蛋白共定位，以控制拓扑边界的形成。我们认为，ZAD-ZnFs 的多种分子功能是从其作为绝缘体结合 p 的祖先角色进化而来的。

articles.title: Dynamics of genetic circuits in Pseudomonas protegens.
articles.titleZh: 保护假单胞菌遗传回路的动力学。
articles.authors: Rico J, Japón P, Rubio LM, Goñi-Moreno Á.
articles.abstract: Genetic circuit engineering enables new cellular functions, yet most circuits are developed in the model host Escherichia coli, limiting their availability and performance in alternative organisms. To expand chassis options, we developed an experimental-theoretical pipeline to evaluate NOT logic circuits, or inverters, in the soil bacterium Pseudomonas protegens Pf-5, a species with valuable environmental traits and a newcomer to bioengineering. We characterized the inverter's input-output behavior and used mathematical modeling to infer key dynamic principles. The model quantified how parameters such as translation efficiency, repressor performance, and promoter activity shape circuit output and influence inter-host portability. Pf-5 displayed distinct properties, including steeper on/off transitions than the synthetic biology workhorse Pseudomonas putida. A model-guided design of two compatible inverters connected in series was validated, producing a YES logic response. This work provides DNA parts, circuits, and models that establish P. protegens Pf-5 as a promising chassis for environmental synthetic biology. A record of this paper's transparent peer review process is included in the supplemental information.
articles.abstractZh: 基因电路工程能够实现新的细胞功能，但大多数电路是在模型宿主大肠杆菌中开发的，限制了它们在替代生物体中的可用性和性能。为了扩展底盘选项，我们开发了一个实验理论管道来评估土壤细菌保护假单胞菌 Pf-5 中的非逻辑电路或反相器，这是一种具有有价值的环境特征的物种，也是生物工程的新来者。我们描述了逆变器的输入输出行为，并使用数学模型来推断关键的动态原理。该模型量化了翻译效率、阻遏蛋白性能和启动子活性等参数如何影响电路输出并影响宿主间的可移植性。 Pf-5 显示出独特的特性，包括比合成生物学主力恶臭假单胞菌更陡峭的开/关转换。两个串联兼容逆变器的模型引导设计经过验证，产生“是”逻辑响应。这项工作提供了 DNA 部分、电路和模型，将 P. protegens Pf-5 确立为环境合成生物学的有前途的基础。包含本文透明同行评审过程的记录

articles.title: Global maps of transcription factor properties reveal threshold-based formation of DNA-bound and mobile clusters.
articles.titleZh: 转录因子特性的全局图揭示了 DNA 结合和移动簇的基于阈值的形成。
articles.authors: Dima SS, Turner MA, Garcia HG, Reeves GT.
articles.abstract: The relationship between bulk transcription factor concentration and DNA binding has been a central question in gene regulation for decades. Recent studies propose that DNA-bound transcription factor hubs, or clusters, aid in fast and precise transcriptional interpretation. Using live imaging techniques, we quantify the concentration, binding, and mobility of the morphogen Dorsal (Dl), both in bulk and in clusters, in Drosophila blastoderm embryo. Our experiments encompass multiple length and timescales, allowing us to obtain a nucleus-wide view of the mechanism connecting hub formation to bulk Dl concentration. Our results show that previously unobserved, slowly moving clusters of Dl are present, in addition to the expected populations of freely mobile and DNA-bound Dl. Furthermore, both mobile clusters and DNA-bound Dl appear only once a threshold concentration in the nucleus is surpassed, a behavior consistent with liquid-liquid phase separation. Thus, our work elucidates how bulk transcription factor concentration dictates the formation and spatiotemporal changes of different populations needed for gene regulation.
articles.abstractZh: 数十年来，大量转录因子浓度与 DNA 结合之间的关系一直是基因调控的核心问题。最近的研究表明，DNA 结合的转录因子中心或簇有助于快速、精确的转录解释。使用实时成像技术，我们量化了果蝇胚盘胚胎中形态发生素 Dorsal (Dl) 的浓度、结合力和迁移率，无论是散装还是成簇。我们的实验涵盖多个长度和时间尺度，使我们能够获得连接枢纽形成与本体 Dl 浓度的机制的全核视图。我们的结果表明，除了预期的自由移动和 DNA 结合的 D1 群体之外，还存在先前未观察到的缓慢移动的 D1 簇。此外，移动簇和DNA结合的D1仅在超过细胞核中的阈值浓度时才出现，这种行为与液-液相分离一致。因此，我们的工作阐明了大量转录因子浓度如何决定基因调控所需的不同群体的形成和时空变化。

articles.title: Industrial perspective validation of a neutralizer-free l-lactic acid production process by engineered acid-tolerant yeast Pichia kudriavzevii.
articles.titleZh: 通过工程耐酸酵母 Pichia kudriavzevii 进行无中和剂 L-乳酸生产工艺的工业透视验证。
articles.authors: Wang Y, Cui J, Liu Z, Zhou Y, Chen W, Gao S, Ruchala J, Yu B, Wang L.
articles.abstract: Large amounts of waste salt formation are a major bottleneck in the industrial production of l-lactic acid (l-LA). In this study, we developed a cost-effective, neutralizer-free process with industrial potential using acid-tolerant yeast Pichia kudriavzevii. Based on the previously engineered P. kudriavzevii Pkz04, we further improved l-LA production by inserting multicopy l-lactate dehydrogenase, performing promoter replacement, and introducing a lactate transporter, resulting in 102.32 g/l l-LA without neutralizers. Subsequently, we performed batch fermentation in a low-cost inorganic salt medium containing only 0.03 g/l yeast extract and achieved 75.09 g/l l-LA, which outperformed most reported strains with respect to a yield of 0.99 g/g glucose. Finally, a detailed technoeconomic analysis was conducted, including an analysis of low concentrations of organic nitrogen sources, pH-adjustment and nonadjustment processes, and carbon losses in different fermentation processes. Our results highlight the potential of low-pH production of l-LA from an industrial perspective, which is both financially viable and environmentally beneficial.
articles.abstractZh: 大量废盐的形成是l-乳酸（l-LA）工业生产的主要瓶颈。在这项研究中，我们使用耐酸酵母库德里亚夫泽维毕赤酵母开发了一种具有工业潜力的经济高效、无中和剂的工艺。基于之前改造的 P. kudriavzevii Pkz04，我们通过插入多拷贝 L-乳酸脱氢酶、进行启动子替换和引入乳酸转运蛋白，进一步提高了 L-LA 产量，在没有中和剂的情况下产生了 102.32 g/l L-LA。随后，我们在仅含有 0.03 g/l 酵母提取物的低成本无机盐培养基中进行分批发酵，并获得了 75.09 g/l l-LA，其葡萄糖产量为 0.99 g/g，优于大多数报道的菌株。最后进行了详细的技术经济分析，包括低浓度有机氮源、pH调节和不调节过程以及不同发酵过程中的碳损失分析。我们的结果凸显了从工业角度低 pH 值生产 l-LA 的潜力，这既具有经济可行性，又对环境有利。

articles.title: Polymorphism and evolutionary origins of accessory chromosomes in the basidiomycete Tremella fuciformis.
articles.titleZh: 担子菌银耳副染色体的多态性和进化起源。
articles.authors: Zhang J, Tong Q, Lin F, An X, Huang H, Chen H, Ye J, Xu H, Lv X, Lv Z, Zeng F, Zhang T, Wu X, Xie B, Ming R, Deng Y.
articles.abstract: Accessory chromosomes are non-essential for growth but poorly characterized in basidiomycetes, unlike in Ascomycota. Here, we report whole-genome sequencing of 16 strains of the basidiomycete Tremella fuciformis (silver ear fungus), generating 27 complete haplotypes (5 monokaryons and 11 dikaryons, each contributing two distinct haplotypes). Genome size varied by over one-third, driven by accessory chromosomes and repetitive sequences in core chromosomes (essential for basic biology). Each strain harbored 8-10 core chromosomes (polymorphic via fusion/fission) and 2-10 accessory chromosomes (total 108), whose distribution reflects phylogeny and symbiotic specificity with the ascomycete Annulohypoxylon stygium. Accessory chromosomes are small, transposon-rich, gene-poor, and exhibit higher sequence similarity but more diverse structural variations than core chromosomes, with few shared genes across phylogenetic branches. Both chromosome types show frequent copy number variation during cell type transformation. Most accessory chromosome genes lack homologs in core chromosomes or existing gene databases. Our study reveals basidiomycete accessory chromosome diversity, suggesting an origin from unexplored species pre-dating T. fuciformis speciation.
articles.abstractZh: 与子囊菌门不同，辅助染色体对于生长不是必需的，但在担子菌中的特征很少。在这里，我们报告了 16 株担子菌银耳菌（银耳）菌株的全基因组测序，产生了 27 个完整的单倍型（5 个单核体和 11 个双核体，每个提供两种不同的单倍型）。基因组大小变化超过三分之一，由辅助染色体和核心染色体中的重复序列（基础生物学所必需）驱动。每个菌株都含有 8-10 条核心染色体（通过融合/裂变形成多态性）和 2-10 条辅助染色体（总共 108 条），其分布反映了系统发育和与子囊菌 Annulohypoxylon stygium 的共生特异性。辅助染色体较小，富含转座子，基因贫乏，与核心染色体相比，具有更高的序列相似性，但结构变异更多样化，跨系统发育分支的共享基因很少。两种染色体类型在细胞类型转化过程中都表现出频繁的拷贝数变异。大多数辅助染色体基因在核心染色体或现有基因数据库中缺乏同源物。我们的研究揭示了担子菌辅助染色体的多样性，表明其起源

articles.title: Quantum-augmented graph differential geometry enhances accuracy in protein-protein interaction prediction.
articles.titleZh: 量子增强图微分几何提高了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用预测的准确性。
articles.authors: Karthick V, Alshammari FS, Jayasimman IP, Besi PR, Akgul A.
articles.abstract: Protein-protein interactions (PPIs) constitute the fundamental building blocks of cellular machinery, orchestrating complex biological processes from signal transduction to metabolic regulation. Despite significant advances in computational biology, existing methods face critical limitations in capturing the quantum mechanical nature of molecular interactions and the intricate dynamics of protein networks. This work introduces a groundbreaking Quantum-based Graph Differential Model (QGDM) that synergistically combines quantum superposition principles with differential geometry to model PPI networks with unprecedented accuracy. Our innovative framework incorporates quantum state representations of protein conformations, quantum entanglement effects in binding sites, and novel differential operators on protein interaction graphs to capture temporal dynamics. Through comprehensive evaluation on five major datasets (STRING, BioGRID, IntAct, HIPPIE, and DIP), QGDM achieves exceptional performance with 96.7% accuracy, 95.8% precision, and 94.3% recall, representing improvements of 15.2%, 13.9%, and 16.1% respectively over state-of-the-art methods. Our model successfully identified 1247 novel PPIs in the human interactome, with experimental validation confirming 91.8% accuracy through yeast two-hybrid screening and co-immunoprecipitation assays. The quantum differential framework provides revolutionary insights into the probabilistic nature of protein interactions and establishes a theoretical foundation for understanding cellular network dynamics through quantum mechanical principles. This work opens new frontiers in computational biology, offering transformative capabilities for drug discovery, disease mechanism elucidation, and personalized medicine applications.
articles.abstractZh: 蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）构成细胞机器的基本构建模块，协调从信号转导到代谢调节的复杂生物过程。尽管计算生物学取得了重大进展，但现有方法在捕获分子相互作用的量子力学性质和蛋白质网络的复杂动力学方面面临着严重的局限性。这项工作引入了一种突破性的基于量子的图微分模型（QGDM），它将量子叠加原理与微分几何协同结合，以前所未有的精度对 PPI 网络进行建模。我们的创新框架结合了蛋白质构象的量子态表示、结合位点的量子纠缠效应以及蛋白质相互作用图上的新颖微分算子来捕获时间动态。通过对五个主要数据集（STRING、BioGRID、IntAct、HIPPIE 和 DIP）的综合评估，QGDM 获得了 96.7% 的准确率、95.8% 的精确度和 94.3% 的召回率，分别比最先进的方法提高了 15.2%、13.9% 和 16.1%。我们的模型成功识别了 1247 n

articles.title: Stress adaptation of mitochondrial protein import by OMA1-mediated degradation of DNAJC15.
articles.titleZh: OMA1 介导的 DNAJC15 降解对线粒体蛋白输入的应激适应。
articles.authors: Kroczek L, Nolte H, Lasarzewski Y, Agrawal I, Molinié T, Curbelo Piñero D, Lemke K, Rugarli E, Langer T.
articles.abstract: Mitochondria dynamically adapt to cellular stress to ensure cell survival. The stress-regulated mitochondrial peptidase OMA1 orchestrates these adaptive responses, which limit mitochondrial fusion and promote mitochondrial stress signaling and metabolic rewiring. Here, we show that cellular stress adaptation involves OMA1-mediated regulation of mitochondrial protein import and OXPHOS biogenesis. OMA1 cleaves the mitochondrial chaperone DNAJC15 and promotes its degradation by the m-AAA protease AFG3L2. Loss of DNAJC15 impairs mitochondrial protein import and restricts OXPHOS biogenesis under conditions of mitochondrial dysfunction. Non-imported mitochondrial preproteins accumulate at the endoplasmic reticulum, inducing an unfolded protein response. Our results demonstrate stress-dependent changes in mitochondrial protein import as part of the OMA1-mediated mitochondrial stress response and highlight the interdependence of proteostasis regulation between different organelles.
articles.abstractZh: 线粒体动态适应细胞应激以确保细胞存活。应激调节线粒体肽酶 OMA1 协调这些适应性反应，限制线粒体融合并促进线粒体应激信号传导和代谢重连。在这里，我们表明细胞应激适应涉及 OMA1 介导的线粒体蛋白输入和 OXPHOS 生物发生的调节。 OMA1 裂解线粒体伴侣 DNAJC15 并促进其被 m-AAA 蛋白酶 AFG3L2 降解。 DNAJC15 的缺失会损害线粒体蛋白的输入，并在线粒体功能障碍的情况下限制 OXPHOS 的生物合成。非输入的线粒体前蛋白在内质网处积累，诱导未折叠的蛋白质反应。我们的结果证明线粒体蛋白输入的应激依赖性变化是 OMA1 介导的线粒体应激反应的一部分，并强调了不同细胞器之间蛋白质稳态调节的相互依赖性。

articles.title: Analysis and control of untemplated DNA polymerase activity for guided synthesis of kilobase-scale DNA sequences.
articles.titleZh: 分析和控制非模板 DNA 聚合酶活性，以引导合成千碱基级 DNA 序列。
articles.authors: Castle SD, Irvine TCT, Woolfson A, Linshiz G, Riley BT, Samuel IDW, Picco L, Holliger P, Oldfield LM, Hessel A, Gorochowski TE.
articles.abstract: DNA polymerases are complex molecular machines capable of replicating genetic material using a template-driven process. While the copying function of these enzymes is well established, their ability to perform untemplated DNA synthesis is less well characterized. Here, we explore the ability of DNA polymerases to synthesize DNA fragments in the absence of a template. We use long-read nanopore sequencing, real-time fluorescence assays, and atomic force microscopy to observe the synthesis and physical structure of pools of DNA products derived from a diverse set of natural and engineered DNA polymerases across varying temperatures and buffer compositions. We detail the features of the DNA fragments generated, enrichment of select sequence motifs, and demonstrate that the sequence composition of the synthesized DNA can be altered by modifying environmental conditions. This work provides extensive data to better discern the process of untemplated DNA polymerase activity and may support its potential repurposing as a technology for the guided synthesis of DNA sequences on the kilobase-scale and beyond.
articles.abstractZh: DNA 聚合酶是复杂的分子机器，能够使用模板驱动的过程复制遗传物质。虽然这些酶的复制功能已得到充分证实，但它们执行非模板 DNA 合成的能力尚不清楚。在这里，我们探索 DNA 聚合酶在没有模板的情况下合成 DNA 片段的能力。我们使用长读长纳米孔测序、实时荧光测定和原子力显微镜来观察在不同温度和缓冲液成分下衍生自多种天然和工程 DNA 聚合酶的 DNA 产物库的合成和物理结构。我们详细描述了生成的 DNA 片段的特征、选择序列基序的富集，并证明合成 DNA 的序列组成可以通过改变环境条件来改变。这项工作提供了广泛的数据，以更好地识别非模板 DNA 聚合酶活性的过程，并可能支持其潜在的重新利用，作为千碱基级及以上 DNA 序列引导合成的技术。

articles.title: Decoding the substrate specificity landscape of a promiscuous enzyme through multi-substrate mutational scanning.
articles.titleZh: 通过多底物突变扫描解码混杂酶的底物特异性景观。
articles.authors: Vanella R, Boult S, Küng C, Nash MA.
articles.abstract: Substrate specificity is a defining feature of enzyme function, but its molecular underpinnings remain difficult to decode and engineer. Here, we leverage enzyme proximity sequencing (EP-Seq) to systematically map how single-point and combinatorial mutations reshape the substrate preferences of D-amino acid oxidase (DAOx) from Rhodotorula gracilis, a model promiscuous enzyme. We generate ~40,000 sequence-phenotype pairs, enabling us to profile the activities of ~6,500 unique DAOx variants against five D-amino acid substrates with distinct physicochemical properties. Our analysis reveals that substrate-specific mutations are distributed throughout the enzyme structure. Mutations near the active site drive strong specificity shifts but also incur catalytic penalties, while distal mutations subtly rewire intramolecular contacts in order to modulate specificity with minimal loss of activity. We identify and validate positional hotspots that act allosterically to influence specificity, and characterize key variants that acquire exclusive substrate specificity or exhibit up to 230-fold changes in substrate preference. Combining mutations with complementary effects further sharpens substrate discrimination, enabling rational design of highly selective biocatalysts. This work establishes a powerful framework for decoding enzyme specificity and provides foundational datasets to advance AI-guided enzyme engineering.
articles.abstractZh: 底物特异性是酶功能的一个决定性特征，但其分子基础仍然难以解码和设计。在这里，我们利用酶邻近测序 (EP-Seq) 系统地绘制单点和组合突变如何重塑来自红酵母（一种混杂酶模型）的 D-氨基酸氧化酶 (DAOx) 的底物偏好。我们生成了约 40,000 个序列-表型对，使我们能够分析约 6,500 个独特的 DAOx 变体针对具有不同理化特性的五种 D-氨基酸底物的活性。我们的分析表明，底物特异性突变分布在整个酶结构中。活性位点附近的突变会驱动强烈的特异性变化，但也会引起催化惩罚，而远端突变巧妙地重新连接分子内接触，以便在活性损失最小的情况下调节特异性。我们识别并验证通过变构作用影响特异性的位置热点，并表征获得独特底物特异性或在底物偏好方面表现出高达 230 倍变化的关键变体。将突变与互补效应相结合进一步增强了子结构

articles.title: Editing and synthetic engineering of chloroplast genomes.
articles.titleZh: 叶绿体基因组的编辑和合成工程。
articles.authors: Fu J, Zhang J.
articles.abstract: Chloroplasts are central to photosynthesis and metabolic biosynthesis in plants and algae, offering immense potential for synthetic biology. This review highlights recent advances in chloroplast genome minimization, high-efficiency genome editing, and metabolic pathway redesign aimed at optimizing chloroplast function. We first summarize strategies for relocating chloroplast-encoded genes to the nuclear genome, thereby facilitating chloroplast genome streamlining while maintaining gene expression. We then discuss cutting-edge tools for precise chloroplast genome editing, including gene knockout, knockin, base substitution, and multiplex modifications. Finally, we explore the dynamic regulation of chloroplast energy metabolism and the redesign of core metabolic pathways to enable de novo biosynthesis of high-value compounds, enhancing production efficiency and enabling crop trait improvement. Together, these integrated approaches pave the way for next-generation chloroplast engineering with broad implications for biotechnology and agriculture.
articles.abstractZh: 叶绿体是植物和藻类光合作用和代谢生物合成的核心，为合成生物学提供了巨大的潜力。这篇综述重点介绍了叶绿体基因组最小化、高效基因组编辑和旨在优化叶绿体功能的代谢途径重新设计的最新进展。我们首先总结了将叶绿体编码基因重新定位到核基因组的策略，从而促进叶绿体基因组精简，同时保持基因表达。然后，我们讨论用于精确叶绿体基因组编辑的尖端工具，包括基因敲除、敲入、碱基替换和多重修饰。最后，我们探索叶绿体能量代谢的动态调控和核心代谢途径的重新设计，以实现高价值化合物的从头生物合成，提高生产效率并改善作物性状。这些综合方法共同为下一代叶绿体工程铺平了道路，对生物技术和农业具有广泛影响。

articles.title: Generation of functionally competent testicular somatic cells from pluripotent stem cells.
articles.titleZh: 从多能干细胞产生有功能的睾丸体细胞。
articles.authors: Sato T, Yoshino T, Ohtsuka M, Suzuki T, Matsumura T, Matsudaira Y, Ishikawa-Yamauchi Y, Maeda S, Yabukami H, Kanai Y, Inoue M, Shima Y, Tachibana M, Matoba S, Inoue K, Ogonuki N, Ogura A, Hayashi K, Ogawa T.
articles.abstract: Cellular interactions between germ cells and gonadal somatic cells are essential for the progression of gametogenesis. Here, we report a culture method for generating fetal testicular somatic cell-like cells (fTeSLCs) from embryonic stem cells. These fTeSLCs exhibit a transcriptomic profile closely resembling that of their in vivo counterparts, including distinct cell populations corresponding to Sertoli cells and interstitial cells. For functional assessment, interstitial cell-like cells (ICLCs) and Sertoli-like cells (SerLCs) were isolated from fTeSLCs. ICLCs differentiated into Leydig cells when cocultured with testes lacking endogenous Leydig cells, thereby restoring androgenic support. SerLCs reconstituted the seminiferous epithelium following selective ablation of endogenous Sertoli cells. Both cell types supported spermatogenesis and generated spermatids reaching the elongating stage. Notably, round spermatids derived from these reconstructed systems produced viable offspring by round spermatid injection. These findings demonstrate that fTeSLCs can generate functional testicular somatic cells, providing a valuable platform for studying testis development and spermatogenesis.
articles.abstractZh: 生殖细胞和性腺体细胞之间的细胞相互作用对于配子发生的进展至关重要。在这里，我们报告了一种从胚胎干细胞生成胎儿睾丸体细胞样细胞（fTeSLC）的培养方法。这些 fTeSLC 表现出的转录组谱与体内对应物非常相似，包括与支持细胞和间质细胞相对应的不同细胞群。为了进行功能评估，从 fTeSLC 中分离出间质细胞样细胞 (ICLC) 和支持细胞样细胞 (SerLC)。当与缺乏内源性间质细胞的睾丸共培养时，ICLC 分化为间质细胞，从而恢复雄激素支持。 SerLCs 在选择性消融内源性支持细胞后重建生精上皮。两种细胞类型都支持精子发生并产生达到伸长阶段的精子细胞。值得注意的是，源自这些重建系统的圆形精子细胞通过圆形精子细胞注射产生了可存活的后代。这些发现表明，fTeSLC 可以产生功能性睾丸体细胞，为研究睾丸发育和精子发生提供了有价值的平台。

articles.title: Phylogenomics-driven metalloantibiotic engineering: Overcoming ciprofloxacin resistance in Pseudomonasaeruginosa with sideromycin-bismuth synergy
articles.titleZh: 系统基因组学驱动的金属抗生素工程：利用铁霉素-铋协同作用克服铜绿假单胞菌对环丙沙星的耐药性

articles.title: Plasmodium ARK1 regulates spindle formation during atypical mitosis and forms a divergent chromosomal passenger complex.
articles.titleZh: 疟原虫 ARK1 在非典型有丝分裂过程中调节纺锤体的形成，并形成不同的染色体乘客复合体。
articles.authors: Nagar A, Yanase R, Zeeshan M, Ferguson DJP, Abel S, Pashley SL, Mishra A, Eze A, Rea E, Brady D, Bottrill AR, Vaughan S, Le Roch KG, Guttery DS, Holder AA, Tromer EC, Sharma P, Tewari R.
articles.abstract: Mitosis in Plasmodium spp., the causative agent of malaria, is fundamentally different from model eukaryotes, proceeding via a bipartite microtubule organising centre (MTOC) and lacking canonical regulators such as Polo kinases. During schizogony, asynchronous nuclear replication produces a multinucleate schizont, while rapid male gametogony generates an octaploid nucleus before gamete formation. Here, we identify Aurora-related kinase 1 (ARK1) as a key component of inner MTOC and spindle formation, controlling kinetochore dynamics and driving mitotic progression. Conditional ARK1 depletion disrupts spindle biogenesis, kinetochore segregation, karyokinesis and cytokinesis in both stages, and affects parasite transmission. Interactome analysis shows that ARK1 forms the catalytic core of a non-canonical chromosomal passenger complex (CPC) containing two highly divergent inner centromere proteins (INCENPs), which we term INCENP-A and INCENP-B, and lacking the canonical chromatin-targeting subunits Survivin and Borealin. Comparative genomics suggests that apicomplexan INCENPs arose through recurrent lineage-specific duplications, reflecting an evolutionary rewiring of CPC architecture in this eukaryotic lineage. Together, these findings reveal key adaptations in Plasmodium mitosis involving ARK1 and its INCENP scaffolds, and identify the ARK1-INCENP interface as a potential multistage target for antimalarial intervention.
articles.abstractZh: 疟疾的病原体疟原虫属的有丝分裂与模型真核生物有根本的不同，它通过二分微管组织中心 (MTOC) 进行，并且缺乏 Polo 激酶等规范调节因子。在裂殖过程中，异步核复制产生多核裂殖体，而快速雄性配子生殖在配子形成之前产生八倍体核。在这里，我们确定 Aurora 相关激酶 1 (ARK1) 是内部 MTOC 和纺锤体形成的关键组成部分，控制动粒动力学并驱动有丝分裂进展。有条件的 ARK1 耗竭会破坏两个阶段的纺锤体生物发生、着丝粒分离、核分裂和胞质分裂，并影响寄生虫传播。相互作用组分析表明，ARK1 形成非经典染色体过客复合体 (CPC) 的催化核心，其中包含两个高度分化的内部着丝粒蛋白 (INCENP)，我们将其称为 INCENP-A 和 INCENP-B，并且缺乏经典染色质靶向亚基 Survivin 和 Borealin。比较基因组学表明，apicomplexan INCENPs是通过反复出现的谱系特异性重复而产生的，反映了CPC结构的进化重新布线

articles.title: The nitrogen starvation-induced inhibitor Rts3 restrains Sit4/PP6 to gate quiescence downstream of TORC1.
articles.titleZh: 氮饥饿诱导的抑制剂 Rts3 抑制 Sit4/PP6 以控制 TORC1 下游的静止。
articles.authors: Dokládal L, Péli-Gulli MP, Alba J, Stumpe M, Jaquenoud M, Klemt I, Jaggi CA, Calviello RL, Hu Z, Siva Sankar D, Peter M, Dengjel J, De Virgilio C.
articles.abstract: Cellular quiescence is a reversible state essential for survival under nutrient-limiting or growth-restrictive conditions, yet the mechanisms fine-tuning its depth and reversibility remain elusive. Here, we identify Saccharomyces cerevisiae Rts3 as a regulator of the quiescence trajectory downstream of TORC1. Using phosphatase inhibitor beads and mass spectrometry, we characterize Rts3 as a phosphatase interactor in rapamycin-treated cells and define it as an inhibitor of the PP6 phosphatase Sit4. Mechanistically, it employs an α-helix to dock directly into the Sit4-Sap185/190 catalytic cleft. Transcriptionally induced by Gln3/Gat1 during nitrogen starvation, Rts3 is rapidly degraded upon nutrient repletion via a TORC1-SCFCdc4-proteasome axis. By selectively constraining Sit4-Sap185/190 activity, this inhibitor modulates nitrogen-responsive transcriptional and translational programs to prevent excessive accumulation of Gln3/Rtg3 targets, establishing a feedback loop gating quiescence depth to support long-term survival. Our findings position Rts3 as a dynamic molecular brake on Sit4, ensuring a protective yet reversible quiescent state.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞静止是一种可逆状态，对于营养限制或生长限制条件下的生存至关重要，但微调其深度和可逆性的机制仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们将酿酒酵母 Rts3 确定为 TORC1 下游静止轨迹的调节因子。使用磷酸酶抑制剂珠和质谱，我们将 Rts3 表征为雷帕霉素处理的细胞中的磷酸酶相互作用物，并将其定义为 PP6 磷酸酶 Sit4 的抑制剂。从机制上讲，它采用 α 螺旋直接对接 Sit4-S​​ap185/190 催化裂隙。 Rts3 在氮饥饿期间由 Gln3/Gat1 诱导转录，在营养补充后通过 TORC1-SCFCdc4-蛋白酶体轴迅速降解。通过选择性限制 Sit4-S​​ap185/190 活性，该抑制剂调节氮响应转录和翻译程序，以防止 Gln3/Rtg3 靶标过度积累，建立门控静止深度的反馈回路以支持长期生存。我们的研究结果将 Rts3 定位为 Sit4 的动态分子制动器，确保保护性但可逆的静态状态。

articles.title: CLCC1 governs ER bilayer equilibration to maintain lipid homeostasis.
articles.titleZh: CLCC1 控制 ER 双层平衡以维持脂质稳态。
articles.authors: Wu L, Wang J, Wang Y, Yang J, Yao Y, Wang Y, Huang D, Hu Y, Xu X, Wang R, Du W, Shi Y, Li Q, Liu L, Zhu Y, Li S, Chen FJ, Zhang X, Wang X, Guo Q, Xu L, Li P, Chen XW.
articles.abstract: Orchestration of lipid production, storage and mobilization is vital for cellular and systemic homeostasis1,2. Dysfunctional plasma lipid control represents the major risk factor for cardiometabolic diseases-the leading cause of human mortality3,4. Within the cellular landscape, the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) is the central hub of lipid synthesis and secretion, particularly in metabolically active hepatocytes in the liver or enterocytes in the gut5,6. Initially assembled in the ER lumen, lipid-ferrying lipoproteins necessitate the cross-membrane transfer of both neutral and phospholipids onto the lumenal apolipoprotein B (APOB), in a poorly defined process7-10. Here we show that the ER protein CLCC1 regulates cellular lipid partition and, consequently, systemic lipid homeostasis by participating in trans-bilayer equilibration of phospholipids. CLCC1 partners with the phospholipid scramblase TMEM41B11,12 to recognize imbalanced bilayers and promote lipid scrambling, thereby supporting lipoprotein biogenesis and the subsequent bulk lipid transport. Loss of CLCC1 or TMEM41B leads to the emergence of giant lumenal lipid droplets enclosed by imbalanced ER bilayers and, consequently, accelerated pathogenesis of metabolic-dysfunction-associated liver steatohepatitis. The results reveal that phospholipid scrambling at the ER is essential for establishing a dynamic equilibrium. Considering the requirement of trans-bilayer phospholipid equilibration in numerous biological processes, ranging from catabolic autophagy to viral infection13-16, we anticipate that future work will elucidate a homeostatic control mechanism intrinsic to ER function in lipid biogenesis and distribution.
articles.abstractZh: 脂质产生、储存和动员的协调对于细胞和全身稳态至关重要1,2。血脂控制功能失调是心脏代谢疾病的主要危险因素，也是人类死亡的主要原因3,4。在细胞景观中，内质网 (ER) 是脂质合成和分泌的中心枢纽，特别是在肝脏中代谢活跃的肝细胞或肠道中的肠细胞中5,6。脂质转运脂蛋白最初在内质网腔内组装，需要将中性脂质和磷脂跨膜转移到腔内载脂蛋白 B (APOB) 上，过程定义不明确7-10。在这里，我们表明 ER 蛋白 CLCC1 通过参与磷脂的跨双层平衡来调节细胞脂质分配，从而调节全身脂质稳态。 CLCC1 与磷脂扰乱酶 TMEM41B11,12 合作识别不平衡的双层并促进脂质扰乱，从而支持脂蛋白生物发生和随后的大量脂质运输。 CLCC1 或 TMEM41B 的缺失会导致由不平衡的 ER 双层包围的巨大腔内脂滴的出现，因此，

articles.title: CLCC1 promotes hepatic neutral lipid flux and nuclear pore complex assembly.
articles.titleZh: CLCC1 促进肝中性脂质流动和核孔复合物组装。
articles.authors: Mathiowetz AJ, Meymand ES, Parlakgül G, van Hilten N, Torres EF, Artico LL, Deol KK, Lange M, Pang SP, Doubravsky CE, Roberts MA, Jorgens DM, Zalpuri R, Kang M, Boone C, Parks BW, Zhang Y, Morgens DW, Newman ET, Zhou Y, Talukdar S, Grabe M, Ku G, Levine TP, Arruda AP, Olzmann JA.
articles.abstract: Imbalances in lipid storage and secretion lead to hepatic steatosis, the accumulation of lipid droplets in hepatocytes1,2.
