articles.abstractZh: 冠状病毒基因组富含次优的 A 和 U 结尾密码子，这些密码子通常与由于同源 tRNA 可用性有限而导致翻译效率降低相关。尽管存在这种限制，冠状病毒如何有效表达其蛋白质仍不清楚。通过分析它们的密码子使用情况，我们确定了四种 tRNA 修饰——肌苷 (I)、queuosine (Q)、5-甲基羧甲基尿苷/5-甲基羧甲基-2-硫尿苷 (mcm5U/mcm5s2U) 和 5-甲基胞苷/5-甲酰胞苷 (m5C/f5C)——对于解码其次优密码子至关重要。值得注意的是，SARS-CoV-2 和 HCoV-OC43 感染分别代表严重和轻度人类感染，重新编程这些修饰以有利于病毒蛋白合成。从机制上讲，这种重编程是由相应 tRNA 修饰酶的表达改变驱动的。由于这两种病毒都会诱导 DNA 损伤和氧化应激（已知会类似地改变 Q、mcm5U/mcm5s2U 和 m5C/f5C 修饰以促进应激反应蛋白的表达），因此我们的研究结果支持冠状病毒基因组已经适应了应激条件下的 tRNA 修饰情况。总体而言，冠状病毒精心策划了密码子特异性重编程

articles.title: Enhancing microbial metabolic capacity through high-energy electron beam-induced intense structural variations.
articles.titleZh: 通过高能电子束引起的强烈结构变化增强微生物代谢能力。
articles.authors: Feng X, Li Z, Zhang Y, Xu J, Xin Z, Yang J, Wu M, Zhang S, Yu Z, Qu D, He T, Wu J, Yu J, Liu W, Seyedsayamdost MR, Wang W, Xu F.
articles.abstract: Small-molecule metabolites are key pharmaceutical resources embedded in complex organismal metabolomes. Scalable microbial production depends on metabolic activation capacity, which in turn requires efficient genetic variation. Structural variants (SVs), key drivers of phenotypic diversity, are pivotal for organism evolution, yet their highly efficient induction remains challenging. While DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs) facilitate SVs formation, existing mutagenesis technologies struggle to balance high DSB efficiency with cellular preservation, particularly in microbial strain improvement for metabolite production. Conventional irradiation methods suffer from low SVs induction rates, making strain enhancement a lengthy and labor-intensive process. Here, we systematically compare six irradiation technologies in Streptomyces lividans 1326 and identify high-energy pulsed electron beams (HEPE) as an approach which effectively induces strong DSBs while preserving cellular integrity. This results in extensive SVs that reshape genome sequences and 3D chromatin structure, leading to activation of secondary metabolite production. By integrating HEPE with high-throughput metabolomics (HEPE-HiTMS), we discover two secondary metabolites with unusual C-N linkage, respectively. Applied across various microorganisms, HEPE enables record-high clavulanic acid and microcin J25 production, and markedly increases lovastatin yields. With its ability to induce SVs with minimal cytotoxicity, HEPE represents a powerful tool for cryptic metabolite discovery and industrial strain development.
articles.abstractZh: 小分子代谢物是复杂生物体代谢组中的关键药物资源。可扩展的微生物生产取决于代谢激活能力，而代谢激活能力又需要有效的遗传变异。结构变异（SV）是表型多样性的关键驱动因素，对于生物体进化至关重要，但其高效诱导仍然具有挑战性。虽然 DNA 双链断裂 (DSB) 有利于 SV 的形成，但现有的诱变技术很难在高 DSB 效率与细胞保存之间取得平衡，特别是在代谢物生产的微生物菌株改良方面。传统的辐照方法存在SV诱导率低的问题，使得应变增强成为一个漫长且劳动密集的过程。在这里，我们系统地比较了浅青紫链霉菌 1326 中的六种辐照技术，并确定高能脉冲电子束 (HEPE) 作为一种有效诱导强 DSB 同时保持细胞完整性的方法。这会产生大量的 SV，重塑基因组序列和 3D 染色质结构，从而激活次级代谢产物的产生。通过将 HEPE 与高通量代谢组学 (HEPE-

articles.title: Molecular insights into fungal inositol phosphorylceramide synthesis and its inhibition by antifungal aureobasidin A.
articles.titleZh: 真菌肌醇磷酸神经酰胺合成及其抗真菌金黄木素 A 抑制作用的分子见解。
articles.authors: Chen J, Ke Y, Zhang M, Lin X, Hua Z, Zhang D, Hu X, Ding X, Li J, Yang P, Yu H.
articles.abstract: Fungal inositol phosphorylceramide (IPC) synthase is an essential enzyme complex that catalyzes a critical step in sphingolipid biosynthesis. It is the molecular target of potent antifungal aureobasidin A (AbA). Despite its therapeutic relevance, the lack of structural and mechanistic insights into IPC synthase function and inhibition has impeded rational antifungal drug development. Here, we present cryo-EM structures of Saccharomyces cerevisiae IPC synthase in two distinct functional states: a ceramide-bound form and an AbA-inhibited complex. Our study reveals a conserved heterodimeric architecture formed by Aur1 and Kei1, stabilized through extensive protein-protein and lipid-mediated interactions. Within catalytic Aur1, we identify a membrane-embedded reaction chamber harboring a conserved H-H-D catalytic triad (H255, H294, and D298) essential for IPC synthesis. Structural comparisons illuminate the mechanism of ceramide recognition and reveal how AbA acts as a competitive inhibitor by occupying the substrate-binding pocket. Further analyses identify key residues involved in AbA binding and explain the molecular basis of drug resistance. Together, these findings advance the mechanistic understanding of fungal IPC biosynthesis and inhibition, and establish a foundation for developing new antifungal drugs targeting IPC synthase.
articles.abstractZh: 真菌肌醇磷酸神经酰胺 (IPC) 合酶是一种必需的酶复合物，可催化鞘脂生物合成的关键步骤。它是强效抗真菌金黄色素 A (AbA) 的分子靶点。尽管具有治疗相关性，但缺乏对 IPC 合酶功能和抑制的结构和机制的了解，阻碍了合理的抗真菌药物开发。在这里，我们展示了两种不同功能状态的酿酒酵母 IPC 合酶的冷冻电镜结构：神经酰胺结合形式和 AbA 抑制复合物。我们的研究揭示了由 Aur1 和 Kei1 形成的保守异二聚体结构，通过广泛的蛋白质-蛋白质和脂质介导的相互作用来稳定。在催化 Aur1 中，我们发现了一个膜嵌入反应室，其中包含 IPC 合成所必需的保守 H-H-D 催化三联体（H255、H294 和 D298）。结构比较阐明了神经酰胺识别的机制，并揭示了 AbA 如何通过占据底物结合袋作为竞争性抑制剂。进一步分析确定了与 AbA 结合相关的关键残基并解释了耐药性的分子基础。这些发现共同推进了机械

articles.title: PAN2 maintains mRNA poly(A) tail homeostasis and regulates translation during spermiogenesis in mice.
articles.titleZh: PAN2 在小鼠精子发生过程中维持 mRNA 多聚腺苷酸尾稳态并调节翻译。
articles.authors: Wu X, Wu YK, Jia MY, Niu Z, Liu J, Wang WJ, Jiang ZY, Lu F, Chen L, Liu L, Fan HY.
articles.abstract: The elongation and shortening of poly(A) tails are the most common types of post-transcriptional mRNA regulation in eukaryotic cells. PAN2-PAN3 and CCR4-NOT complexes are the main cytoplasmic enzymes that trim the poly(A) tails of mRNAs. However, the in vivo function of PAN2-PAN3 in mammals remains unclear. Here, we found that the germline-specific deletion of Pan2 causes male infertility due to a step-8/9 spermatogenic arrest, while meiotic prophase proceeds normally. Using PAIso-seq2 and mass spectrometry analyses, we define stage-specific remodeling of poly(A) tails that is disrupted in Pan2-null round spermatids (RS). Ribo-lite reveals a global reduction in translation efficiency in Pan2-deficient RS, correlating with proteomic changes and impairing pathways for spermatid differentiation. Endogenous IP-MS identifies PAN2 association with PABPC1 and initiation factors (EIF4E, EIF4A1, EIF5A), whose protein levels decline upon Pan2 loss, indicating compromised stability of key translational machinery. Together, these findings highlight the important physiological functions of PAN2 in spermiogenesis and expand our understanding of the post-transcriptional regulation of mRNAs in specific physiological processes.
articles.abstractZh: Poly(A) 尾的延长和缩短是真核细胞中最常见的转录后 mRNA 调节类型。 PAN2-PAN3 和 CCR4-NOT 复合物是修剪 mRNA 聚腺苷酸尾的主要细胞质酶。然而，PAN2-PAN3 在哺乳动物体内的功能仍不清楚。在这里，我们发现 Pan2 的种系特异性缺失会因步骤 8/9 生精停滞而导致男性不育，而减数分裂前期则正常进行。使用 PAIso-seq2 和质谱分析，我们定义了在 Pan2-null 圆形精子细胞 (RS) 中被破坏的 Poly(A) 尾的特定阶段重塑。 Ribo-lite 揭示了 Pan2 缺陷 RS 中翻译效率的整体降低，这与蛋白质组变化和精子细胞分化途径受损相关。内源 IP-MS 识别出 PAN2 与 PABPC1 和起始因子（EIF4E、EIF4A1、EIF5A）的关联，其蛋白质水平在 Pan2 丢失后下降，表明关键翻译机制的稳定性受损。总之，这些发现强调了 PAN2 在精子发生中的重要生理功能，并扩展了我们对精子发生中 mRNA 转录后调控的理解。

articles.title: Termination of the integrated stress response.
articles.titleZh: 综合应激反应的终止。
articles.authors: De Miguel C, Thorkelsson SR, Fatalska A, Hodgson G, Dalglish M, Wang C, Bertolotti A.
articles.abstract: Stress responses enable cells to detect, adapt to, and survive challenges. The benefit of these signaling pathways depends on their reversibility. The integrated stress response (ISR) is elicited by phosphorylation of eukaryotic translation initiation factor eIF2, which traps and inhibits rate-limiting translation factor eIF2B, thereby attenuating translation initiation. Termination of this pathway thus requires relieving eIF2B from P-eIF2 inhibition. Here, we found that eIF2 phosphatase subunits PPP1R15A and PPP1R15B (R15B) bound P-eIF2 in complex with eIF2B. Biochemical investigations guided by cryo-electron microscopy structures of native eIF2-eIF2B and P-eIF2-eIF2B complexes bound to R15B demonstrated that R15B enabled dephosphorylation of otherwise dephosphorylation-incompetent P-eIF2 on eIF2B. This sheds light on ISR termination, revealing that R15B rescues eIF2B from P-eIF2 inhibition, thereby safeguarding translation and cell fitness.
articles.abstractZh: 应激反应使细胞能够检测、适应和生存挑战。这些信号通路的好处取决于它们的可逆性。整合应激反应 (ISR) 是由真核翻译起始因子 eIF2 磷酸化引发的，它捕获并抑制限速翻译因子 eIF2B，从而减弱翻译起始。因此，终止该途径需要解除 eIF2B 对 P-eIF2 的抑制。在这里，我们发现 eIF2 磷酸酶亚基 PPP1R15A 和 PPP1R15B (R15B) 与 P-eIF2 结合，与 eIF2B 形成复合物。由与 R15B 结合的天然 eIF2-eIF2B 和 P-eIF2-eIF2B 复合物的冷冻电子显微镜结构引导的生化研究表明，R15B 能够使 eIF2B 上原本无法去磷酸化的 P-eIF2 去磷酸化。这揭示了 ISR 终止，揭示 R15B 将 eIF2B 从 P-eIF2 抑制中解救出来，从而保护翻译和细胞健康。

articles.title: Whole-cell modeling predicts alternative proteome allocation strategies in the archaeon Methanococcus maripaludis.
articles.titleZh: 全细胞模型预测了古细菌马里帕鲁迪斯甲烷球菌中的替代蛋白质组分配策略。
articles.authors: Kasem GS, Soliman THA, Mousa MAA, Jaheen ZF, Elsemman IE.
articles.abstract: The archaeon Methanococcus maripaludis (M. maripaludis) is a model organism for studying archaeal physiology and energy conservation in the hydrogenotrophic methanogenesis pathway. M. maripaludis has a distinct proteome allocation strategy, in which ribosomal proteome allocations do not change with growth rates. Here, we developed a proteome-constrained metabolic model that can explain this different proteome allocation strategy. First, we used multiple bioinformatics databases to compile information about the translational process and enzymatic complexes. We then extended a genome-scale metabolic model of M. maripaludis with protein synthesis processes, including ribosome assembly, tRNA charging, and enzyme assembly reactions. The proposed model predicts alternative proteome resource allocation strategies and mutant fitness for this archaeon under different conditions. Therefore, our model provides a framework for studying the effects of resource allocation on the hydrogenotrophic methanogenesis pathway.
articles.abstractZh: 古细菌马里帕鲁迪斯甲烷球菌（M. maripaludis）是研究古细菌生理学和氢营养产甲烷途径能量守恒的模式生物。 M. maripaludis 具有独特的蛋白质组分配策略，其中核糖体蛋白质组分配不随生长速度而变化。在这里，我们开发了一种蛋白质组限制的代谢模型，可以解释这种不同的蛋白质组分配策略。首先，我们使用多个生物信息学数据库来编译有关翻译过程和酶复合物的信息。然后，我们利用蛋白质合成过程（包括核糖体组装、tRNA 充电和酶组装反应）扩展了 M. maripaludis 的基因组规模代谢模型。所提出的模型预测了不同条件下该古菌的替代蛋白质组资源分配策略和突变体适应性。因此，我们的模型为研究资源分配对氢营养产甲烷途径的影响提供了一个框架。

articles.title: A bacterial YopJ-family acetyltransferase suppresses host immune response by Nε-acetylation of JAK1.
articles.titleZh: 细菌 YopJ 家族乙酰转移酶通过 JAK1 的 Nε 乙酰化抑制宿主免疫反应。
articles.authors: Chen TT, Zheng SR, Yang B, Lu Q, Liu X, Zhong W, Jiang Z, Li F, Hu G, Feng Y, Hu C, Su J, Ouyang S.
articles.abstract: A common host response to pathogen infection involves the production of robust interferons or proinflammatory cytokines to activate the JAK-STAT pathway, thereby limiting pathogen replication. The bacterial pathogen Legionella pneumophila creates an intracellular niche and evades host immunity utilizing a cohort of effectors by diverse biochemical activities, thereby permissive for its intracellular replication. However, roles of the JAK-STAT pathway during bacterial infection remain elusive. Here, we identify for the first time that L. pneumophila acetyltransferase effector Lem17 acts as a negative regulator of the JAK-STAT signaling. Lem17 directly interacts with JAK1 through a JAK1-binding Box1-like motif, preventing its recruitment by cytokine receptors. As a YopJ-family acetyltransferase, Lem17 catalyzes Nε-lysine acetylation of JAK1 and impairs its kinase activity, thereby disrupting JAK1-mediated signaling transduction. Our findings provide insights into the mechanism by which L. pneumophila subverts host immunity through acetylation and underscore the role of the JAK-STAT pathway against bacterial infection.
articles.abstractZh: 宿主对病原体感染的常见反应涉及产生强效干扰素或促炎细胞因子以激活 JAK-STAT 途径，从而限制病原体复制。细菌病原体嗜肺军团菌创建了一个细胞内生态位，并通过不同的生化活动利用一组效应器逃避宿主免疫，从而允许其在细胞内复制。然而，JAK-STAT 通路在细菌感染过程中的作用仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们首次确定嗜肺军团菌乙酰转移酶效应子 Lem17 充当 JAK-STAT 信号传导的负调节因子。 Lem17 通过 JAK1 结合 Box1 样基序直接与 JAK1 相互作用，防止其被细胞因子受体招募。作为 YopJ 家族乙酰转移酶，Lem17 催化 JAK1 的 Nε-赖氨酸乙酰化并损害其激酶活性，从而破坏 JAK1 介导的信号转导。我们的研究结果提供了对嗜肺军团菌通过乙酰化破坏宿主免疫的机制的见解，并强调了 JAK-STAT 通路对抗细菌感染的作用。

articles.title: Adipocyte NADH dehydrogenase reverses circadian and diet-induced metabolic syndrome.
articles.titleZh: 脂肪细胞 NADH 脱氢酶可逆转昼夜节律和饮食引起的代谢综合征。
articles.authors: Hepler C, Waldeck NJ, Weidemann BJ, Marcheva B, Chen YJ, Hecker J, Zhu Z, Nozawa R, Mastroni JV, Thorne AK, Reczek CR, Cedernaes J, Ramsey KM, Peek CB, Barish GD, Chandel NS, Bass J.
articles.abstract: Circadian clocks are internal timing systems that enable organisms to anticipate and adapt to daily environmental changes. These rhythms arise from a transcription-translation feedback loop in which CLOCK and BMAL1 regulate the expression of thousands of genes, including their repressors PER and CRY. Disruption of circadian rhythms contributes to obesity, metabolic disease and cancer, yet how the clock maintains metabolic homeostasis remains limited. Here we report that the clock regulates oxidative metabolism in adipocytes through diurnal complex I respiration. Disrupting the clock in male mice via adipocyte-specific genetic deletion or high-fat-diet feeding reduces complex I respiration in adipocytes, leading to suppression of the peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor and insulin signalling pathways. In contrast, restoring complex I function by expressing yeast NDI1 in adipocytes protects against diet-induced and circadian-induced metabolic dysfunction independently of weight gain. These findings reveal that adipocyte circadian disruption impairs metabolic health through mitochondrial complex I dysfunction, establishing clock control of complex I as a key regulator of metabolic homeostasis.
articles.abstractZh: 昼夜节律时钟是内部计时系统，使生物体能够预测和适应日常环境变化。这些节律源自转录-翻译反馈环，其中 CLOCK 和 BMAL1 调节数千个基因的表达，包括它们的阻遏物 PER 和 CRY。昼夜节律的破坏会导致肥胖、代谢疾病和癌症，但生物钟如何维持代谢稳态仍然有限。在这里，我们报道时钟通过昼夜复合物 I 呼吸调节脂肪细胞的氧化代谢。通过脂肪细胞特异性基因缺失或高脂肪饮食喂养来扰乱雄性小鼠的时钟，会减少脂肪细胞中的复合物 I 呼吸，从而抑制过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体和胰岛素信号通路。相比之下，通过在脂肪细胞中表达酵母 NDI1 来恢复复合物 I 的功能，可以防止饮食引起的和昼夜节律引起的代谢功能障碍，而与体重增加无关。这些发现表明，脂肪细胞昼夜节律紊乱通过线粒体复合物 I 功能障碍损害代谢健康，从而确立复合物 I 的时钟控制作为代谢的关键调节剂

articles.title: Cold plasma treatment as a way to sanitize bovine milk while maintaining full nutritional value, stability, toxicological and microbiological safety.
articles.titleZh: 冷等离子体处理是一种对牛奶进行消毒的方法，同时保持完整的营养价值、稳定性、毒理学和微生物安全性。
articles.authors: Grządka E, Krajewska M, Budzyńska B, Kurach Ł, Terebun P, Zarzeczny D, Kwiatkowski M, Pawłat J, Gołębiowska K, Starek-Wójcicka A.
articles.abstract: The scope of this work is to compare cow’s milk hygienization methods (pasteurization, sterilization, and cold plasma treatment) in terms of milk’s toxicological safety (using Danio rerio larvae), microbiological safety (counts of mesophilic aerobic bacteria, yeasts, and molds), nutritional properties (polyphenols, vitamins: B1, B2, B3, B5, B6, B9, and B12, minerals: Ca, Zn, Se), physicochemical properties (pH, conductivity, particle size, color), colloidal stability (turbidimetric method), and chemical changes in milk samples at the molecular level (FT-IR). Pasteurization was performed at 65 °C for 30 min, sterilization at 110 °C for 30 min in an autoclave, while cold plasma treatment was carried out in a gliding arc reactor using nitrogen or air as the working gas for 5, 10, or 20 min, ensuring that the milk temperature was kept below 36 °C. The studies showed that milk preserved with plasma is toxicologically safe and microbiologically safer than fresh milk. Plasma-hygienized milk also retains a higher concentration of vitamins and minerals than temperature-hygienized milk samples and has physicochemical properties similar to those of fresh milk. The use of a gliding arc reactor for milk treatment is important for potential industrial implementation.
articles.abstractZh: 这项工作的范围是从牛奶的毒理学安全性（使用斑马鱼幼虫）、微生物安全性（嗜温需氧细菌、酵母菌和霉菌的计数）、营养特性（多酚、维生素：B1、B2、B3、B5、B6、B9 和 B12，矿物质：Ca、锌、硒）、理化性质（pH、电导率、粒径、颜色）、胶体稳定性（比浊法）以及牛奶样品在分子水平上的化学变化（FT-IR）。巴氏灭菌在65℃下进行30分钟，在高压灭菌器中在110℃下灭菌30分钟，同时在滑弧反应器中进行冷等离子体处理，使用氮气或空气作为工作气体5、10或20分钟，确保牛奶温度保持在36℃以下。研究表明，用血浆保存的牛奶比新鲜牛奶在毒理学和微生物学上更安全。与温度卫生的牛奶样品相比，血浆卫生的牛奶还保留了更高浓度的维生素和矿物质，并且具有与鲜牛奶相似的理化特性。滑弧反应器的使用

articles.title: Genome sequencing of Bacillus daqingensis and Alkalicoccus luteus reveals taxonomic insights and adaptive mechanisms.
articles.titleZh: 大庆芽孢杆菌和藤黄碱球菌的基因组测序揭示了分类学见解和适应机制。
articles.authors: Narsing Rao MP, Wang KK, Zhu KY, Wang JL, Quadri SR, Haribabu J, Chandru HK, Wang S.
articles.abstract: This study presents the genome sequencing of Bacillus daqingensis X10-1T and Alkalicoccus luteus KCTC 33100T, and provides a comprehensive assessment of the taxonomic status, metabolic capabilities, and adaptive features of members within the genus Alkalicoccus. Functional genome analysis revealed that Bacillus daqingensis and other Alkalicoccus species possess genes for both ‘salt-in’ and ‘salt-out’ strategies, indicating robust mechanisms for osmotic regulation under saline conditions. Phylogenetic, phylogenomic, 16S rRNA gene sequence, and orthologous gene clustering (using OrthoVenn3) analyses demonstrated a close relationship between Bacillus daqingensis X10-1T and Alkalicoccus luteus KCTC 33100T. Notably, average amino acid identity values between these strains exceed the genus-level cutoff, while the average nucleotide identity value surpasses the accepted threshold for species delineation. Based on these integrative genomic and phylogenetic findings, we propose the reclassification of Bacillus daqingensis Wang et al. 2023 as Alkalicoccus daqingensis comb. nov., and further Bacillus daqingensis Wang et al. 2023 and Alkalicoccus daqingensis should be considered later heterotypic synonyms of Bacillus luteus Subhash et al. in IJSEM 64:1580–1586, 2014 and Alkalicoccus luteus (Subhash et al. 2014 and Alkalicoccus luteus (Subhash et al. 2014) Gupta et al. 2020.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究对大庆芽孢杆菌 X10-1T 和藤黄碱球菌 KCTC 33100T 进行了基因组测序，并对碱球菌属成员的分类状况、代谢能力和适应特征进行了全面评估。功能基因组分析表明，大庆芽孢杆菌和其他碱球菌物种拥有“盐进”和“盐出”策略的基因，表明在盐水条件下具有强大的渗透调节机制。系统发育、系统基因组、16S rRNA基因序列和直系同源基因聚类（使用OrthoVenn3）分析表明大庆芽孢杆菌X10-1T和藤黄碱球菌KCTC 33100T之间存在密切关系。值得注意的是，这些菌株之间的平均氨基酸同一性值超过了属水平的截止值，而平均核苷酸同一性值超过了物种划分所接受的阈值。基于这些综合基因组和系统发育发现，我们建议对大庆芽孢杆菌 Wang 等人进行重新分类。 2023年为大庆碱球菌梳。 nov.，以及进一步的大庆芽孢杆菌 Wang 等人。 2023年和大庆碱球菌应考虑后期异质性

articles.title: RNA N4-acetylcytidine modification in human cancers: from molecular function to oncogenic mechanisms.
articles.titleZh: 人类癌症中的 RNA N4-乙酰胞苷修饰：从分子功能到致癌机制。
articles.authors: Shi Y, Sun J, Chen H, Yu K, Li J, Liu B.
articles.abstract: The RNA epitranscriptome represents a critical layer of gene regulation, with N4-acetylcytidine (ac4C) emerging as a pivotal modification in cancer biology. Catalyzed exclusively by N-acetyltransferase 10 (NAT10), ac4C decorates a broad spectrum of RNAs, profoundly influencing their stability and translation efficiency. This review synthesizes recent advances illuminating how the NAT10-ac4C axis drives oncogenic processes, including sustained proliferation, metabolic reprogramming, invasion and metastasis, immunosuppression, and therapy resistance by selectively stabilizing mRNAs encoding key oncoproteins. We detail the molecular mechanisms underpinning these roles across diverse malignancies, highlighting context-dependent functions and intricate cross-talk with other signal pathways. Furthermore, we explore the translational promise of this pathway, discussing NAT10 inhibitors and rational combination therapies that resensitize tumors to conventional treatments in preclinical models. Unraveling the full regulatory circuitry of ac4C will not only deepen our understanding of cancer pathogenesis but also pave the way for novel diagnostic and therapeutic strategies in precision oncology.
articles.abstractZh: RNA 表观转录组代表了基因调控的关键层，其中 N4-乙酰胞苷 (ac4C) 成为癌症生物学中的关键修饰。 ac4C 仅由 N-乙酰转移酶 10 (NAT10) 催化，修饰多种 RNA，深刻影响其稳定性和翻译效率。这篇综述综合了最新进展，阐明了 NAT10-ac4C 轴如何通过选择性稳定编码关键癌蛋白的 mRNA 来驱动致癌过程，包括持续增殖、代谢重编程、侵袭和转移、免疫抑制和治疗抵抗。我们详细介绍了在不同恶性肿瘤中支撑这些作用的分子机制，强调了上下文相关的功能以及与其他信号通路的复杂串扰。此外，我们探讨了该途径的转化前景，讨论了 NAT10 抑制剂和合理的联合疗法，使肿瘤在临床前模型中对常规治疗重新敏感。解开ac4C的完整调控回路不仅将加深我们对癌症发病机制的理解，而且为精准肿瘤的新诊断和治疗策略铺平道路

articles.title: Structure and mechanism of antiphage retron Eco2.
articles.titleZh: 抗噬菌体逆转录子Eco2的结构和机制。
articles.authors: Jasnauskaitė M, Juozapaitis J, Liegutė T, Grigaitis R, Skorupskaitė A, Steinchen W, Mikšys A, Truncaitė L, Kazlauskaitė K, Torres Jiménez MF, Khochare S, Dudas G, Bange G, Malinauskaitė L, Songailienė I, Pausch P.
articles.abstract: Retrons are prokaryotic reverse transcriptase systems that produce multicopy single-stranded DNA (msDNA), yet the principles by which they mediate antiviral defense remain largely unresolved. Here we investigate the mechanism of Escherichia coli Eco2, a minimal retron composed of a single reverse transcriptase-nuclease fusion protein. Cryogenic electron microscopy and hydrogen/deuterium exchange mass spectrometry reveal the structures and dynamics of a trimeric nucleoprotein complex assembled within a branched msDNA scaffold, which cages the TOPRIM nucleases. We show that the phage-encoded endonuclease DenB initiates msDNA degradation, thereby unblocking the nuclease active sites. Activated Eco2 cuts transfer RNAs, resulting in translational shutdown for antiphage defense. We further identify ribosomal protein S1 as a putative RNA chaperone that associates with the msDNA precursor. These findings provide insights into the molecular mechanisms of minimal retrons and establish a structural basis for engineering of Eco2.
articles.abstractZh: 逆转录子是原核逆转录酶系统，可产生多拷贝单链 DNA (msDNA)，但它们介导抗病毒防御的原理在很大程度上仍未解决。在这里，我们研究了大肠杆菌 Eco2 的机制，这是一种由单一逆转录酶-核酸酶融合蛋白组成的最小逆转录子。低温电子显微镜和氢/氘交换质谱揭示了在分支 msDNA 支架内组装的三聚核蛋白复合物的结构和动力学，该支架笼罩着 TOPRIM 核酸酶。我们发现噬菌体编码的核酸内切酶 DenB 启动 msDNA 降解，从而解锁核酸酶活性位点。激活的 Eco2 会切割转移 RNA，导致抗噬菌体防御的翻译关闭。我们进一步确定核糖体蛋白 S1 是与 msDNA 前体相关的假定 RNA 伴侣。这些发现为最小逆子的分子机制提供了见解，并为 Eco2 的工程化奠定了结构基础。

articles.title: Tuning of the RBR1-E2F/DP transcriptional module by the F-box protein FBL17.
articles.titleZh: 通过 F-box 蛋白 FBL17 调节 RBR1-E2F/DP 转录模块。
articles.authors: Espanet J, He X, Pan T, Gentric N, Potuschak T, Desvoyes B, Hammann P, Chicher J, Brik R, Lechner E, Latrasse D, Pettkó-Szandtner A, Gutierrez C, Raynaud C, Magyar Z, Benhamed M, Yan S, Noir S, Genschik P.
articles.abstract: F-box proteins of SCF E3 ligases have been documented to control the abundance of numerous critical regulatory proteins. In Arabidopsis, one of them, F-BOX-LIKE17 (FBL17), stands out for playing a key role in DNA replication, DNA damage, and, more recently, for the control of cell size. FBL17 null mutants exhibit severe cellular defects leading to lethality. However, the molecular mechanisms by which FBL17 operate remain poorly understood. Here, we show that FBL17 interacts with different components of the RETINOBLASTOMA-RELATED1/E2F module and is involved in the protein turnover of E2Fa and E2Fb. However, mutations in E2Fa or E2Fb do not alleviate the severe fbl17 phenotype but worsen it. By contrast, it is the accumulation of the transcriptional repressor E2Fc that causes fbl17 mutant lethality. Our results highlight a key role for FBL17 in modulating the transcriptional control of E2F target genes ensuring precise control of cell cycle progression and avoiding uncontrolled DNA damage response.
articles.abstractZh: SCF E3 连接酶的 F-box 蛋白已被证明可以控制许多关键调节蛋白的丰度。在拟南芥中，其中之一 F-BOX-LIKE17 (FBL17) 在 DNA 复制、DNA 损伤以及最近的细胞大小控制中发挥着关键作用。 FBL17无效突变体表现出严重的细胞缺陷，导致致命。然而，FBL17 运作的分子机制仍知之甚少。在这里，我们表明 FBL17 与视网膜母细胞瘤相关 1/E2F 模块的不同组件相互作用，并参与 E2Fa 和 E2Fb 的蛋白质周转。然而，E2Fa 或 E2Fb 的突变并不能缓解严重的 fbl17 表型，反而会使其恶化。相比之下，转录抑制因子 E2Fc 的积累导致了 fbl17 突变体的致死。我们的结果强调了 FBL17 在调节 E2F 靶基因转录控制方面的关键作用，确保精确控制细胞周期进程并避免不受控制的 DNA 损伤反应。

articles.title: A new application of bacterial cellulose in textiles and fashion: using Kombucha-derived biofilm to remove dye from polluted water.
articles.titleZh: 细菌纤维素在纺织品和时尚中的新应用：使用康普茶衍生的生物膜去除污染水中的染料。
articles.authors: Wood J, Verran J, Randviir E, Redfern J.
articles.abstract: The fashion and textile industries face mounting pressure to adopt sustainable practices due to their environmental impacts, including waste generation and water pollution from dyeing. Bacterial cellulose, a renewable, biodegradable material produced via microbial fermentation, offers a promising solution. While bacterial cellulose has been explored as a sustainable textile material in fashion apparel, this study introduces its potential for removing synthetic dyes from dyehouse wastewater. Dyeing processes produce wastewater contaminated with synthetic dyes, which are toxic, persistent, and bio accumulative, posing ecological risks. Bacterial cellulose's nanofibrillar structure makes it effective for capturing liquid contaminants through chemical bonding and physical trapping. Using a microbial consortium (Kombucha), bacterial biofilms were developed over 30 days in either black tea and sugar or Hestrin and Schramm medium. They were then immersed in dye-polluted water. Kombucha-derived bacterial cellulose biofilms reduced dye colour intensity by over 79% for acid blue and 63% for reactive navy, with the most effective results from biofilms developed in black tea containing active microbes. Results indicate that the microbial consortium in the Kombucha-derived pellicle may have a role in removing colour pollution from dyestuff wastewater, thereby presenting a sustainable pathway for addressing key environmental challenges in fashion and textile industries.
articles.abstractZh: 由于其对环境的影响，包括废物产生和染色造成的水污染，时尚和纺织行业面临着采用可持续实践的越来越大的压力。细菌纤维素是一种通过微生物发酵生产的可再生、可生物降解的材料，提供了一种有前景的解决方案。虽然细菌纤维素已被探索作为时尚服装中的可持续纺织材料，但这项研究介绍了其从染厂废水中去除合成染料的潜力。染色过程会产生被合成染料污染的废水，这些废水具有毒性、持久性和生物累积性，构成生态风险。细菌纤维素的纳米纤维结构使其能够通过化学键合和物理捕获有效捕获液体污染物。使用微生物群落（康普茶），在红茶和糖或 Hestrin 和 Schramm 培养基中经过 30 天的时间形成细菌生物膜。然后将它们浸入被染料污染的水中。康普茶衍生的细菌纤维素生物膜将酸性蓝的染料颜色强度降低了 79% 以上，将活性海军蓝的染料颜色强度降低了 63%，其中在含有活性物质的红茶中形成的生物膜效果最有效

articles.title: A slight mismatch between a gene's codon usage and the cellular tRNA supply is beneficial.
articles.titleZh: 基因的密码子使用和细胞 tRNA 供应之间的轻微不匹配是有益的。
articles.authors: Chen F, Liu Y, Zhou Z, Liao J, Fan X, Huang Y, Chen Y, Chen J, Yang JR.
articles.abstract: Each amino acid except two is encoded by multiple synonymous codons, but at unequal frequencies. Such codon usage bias (CUB) is observable in almost all species, and commonly assumed as the result of natural selection towards an optimal CUB that matches the cellular tRNA supply. Here we hypothesize instead that the optimal CUB of a gene should slightly mismatch the tRNA supply to avoid excessive translational costs, while ensuring adequate functional payoff. By modifying the CUB of a resistance gene expressed in bacteria under antibiotic selection, we demonstrate that a small mismatch with the tRNA supply confers faster bacterial growth than those with minimized or large CUB-tRNA mismatches. Intriguingly, the optimal degree of CUB-tRNA mismatch increases as the resistance gene becomes less important in media with lower antibiotic concentrations, which is explainable by our model as a shift in the balance between the gene's functional payoff and translational cost. Furthermore, genomic analyses in model organisms suggest that the optimal degree of CUB-tRNA mismatch is larger for endogenous genes with lower functional importance and higher mRNA abundance, respectively supporting the impact of functional payoff and translational cost. Finally, we find that mutations increasing or decreasing the CUB-tRNA mismatch of native genes are both predominantly deleterious, such that the CUB-tRNA mismatch is likely selectively maintained rather than minimized to that achievable in the presence of genetic drift and mutational bias. These results challenge the commonly assumed unidirectional selection on CUB and highlight the CUB-modulated balance between functional payoff and translational cost.
articles.abstractZh: 除两个氨基酸外，每个氨基酸均由多个同义密码子编码，但频率不同。这种密码子使用偏差 (CUB) 在几乎所有物种中都可以观察到，并且通常被认为是自然选择与细胞 tRNA 供应相匹配的最佳 CUB 的结果。在这里，我们假设基因的最佳 CUB 应该与 tRNA 供应稍微不匹配，以避免过多的翻译成本，同时确保足够的功能回报。通过修改在抗生素选择下细菌中表达的抗性基因的 CUB，我们证明与 tRNA 供应的小错配比具有最小或大 CUB-tRNA 错配的细菌生长得更快。有趣的是，随着抗性基因在抗生素浓度较低的培养基中变得不那么重要，CUB-tRNA 错配的最佳程度也会增加，我们的模型可以将其解释为基因功能回报和翻译成本之间平衡的转变。此外，模型生物的基因组分析表明，对于功能重要性较低和 mRNA 丰度较高的内源基因，CUB-tRNA 错配的最佳程度较大，分别支持

articles.title: Ectopic expression of cytosolic DHODH uncouples de novo pyrimidine biosynthesis from mitochondrial electron transport.
articles.titleZh: 胞浆 DHODH 的异位表达使从头嘧啶生物合成与线粒体电子传递脱钩。
articles.authors: Curtabbi A, Jaroszewicz SN, Sanz-Cortés R, Acín-Pérez R, Prymidis D, Cherevatenko M, Martínez-de-Mena R, Esteban-Amo MJ, de la Fuente MA, Frezza C, Enríquez JA.
articles.abstract: Dihydroorotate dehydrogenase is a rate-limiting enzyme of de novo pyrimidine synthesis. In most eukaryotes, this enzyme is bound to the inner mitochondrial membrane, where it couples orotate synthesis to ubiquinone reduction. As ubiquinone must be regenerated by respiratory complex III, pyrimidine biosynthesis and cellular respiration are tightly coupled. Consequently, inhibition of respiration suppresses DNA synthesis and cell proliferation. Here we show that expression of the Saccharomyces cerevisiae URA1 gene (ScURA) in mammalian cells uncouples pyrimidine biosynthesis from mitochondrial electron transport. ScURA forms a homodimer in the cytosol that uses fumarate as an electron acceptor instead of ubiquinone, enabling respiration-independent pyrimidine biosynthesis. Cells expressing ScURA are resistant to drugs that inhibit complex III and the mitochondrial ribosome. Additionally, ScURA enables growth of mitochondrial-DNA-lacking ρ0 cells in uridine-deficient medium and ameliorates the phenotype of cellular models of mitochondrial diseases. Overall, this genetic tool uncovers the contribution of pyrimidine biosynthesis to the phenotypes arising from electron transport chain defects.
articles.abstractZh: 二氢乳清酸脱氢酶是嘧啶从头合成的限速酶。在大多数真核生物中，这种酶与线粒体内膜结合，将乳清酸合成与泛醌还原结合起来。由于泛醌必须由呼吸复合物 III 再生，因此嘧啶生物合成和细胞呼吸紧密耦合。因此，呼吸抑制会抑制 DNA 合成和细胞增殖。在这里，我们证明了哺乳动物细胞中酿酒酵母 URA1 基因 (ScURA) 的表达使嘧啶生物合成与线粒体电子传递脱钩。 ScURA 在细胞质中形成同二聚体，使用富马酸盐而不是泛醌作为电子受体，从而实现不依赖于呼吸的嘧啶生物合成。表达 ScURA 的细胞对抑制复合物 III 和线粒体核糖体的药物具有抗性。此外，ScURA 能够使缺乏线粒体 DNA 的 ρ0 细胞在缺乏尿苷的培养基中生长，并改善线粒体疾病细胞模型的表型。总体而言，该遗传工具揭示了嘧啶生物合成对电子传递链定义所产生的表型的贡献

articles.title: Effect of dual bacterial combinations on in vitro nutrient degradability, gas production, methane emission, ruminal fermentation parameters and predictive values in sheep.
articles.titleZh: 双细菌组合对绵羊体外营养物降解性、产气量、甲烷排放量、瘤胃发酵参数和预测值的影响。
articles.authors: Saleem ASA, Bassiony SM, Abdelnour SA, Abdel-Monem UM, Elaref MY, Al-Marakby KM.
articles.abstract: The aim of the current study was to investigate the effects of incubating the tested feed with three dual combinations of two strains each at two doses: 2 × 109 (low; 2) and 4 × 109 (high; 4) CFU/g feed/combination on nutrient degradability, gas production, methane emission, fermentation parameters, and protozoa count using a sheep model. The three combinations were Lactobacillus acidophilus + Lactobacillus bulgaricus (AB2 and AB4), Lactobacillus casei + Lactobacillus plantarum (CP2 and CP4), and Bacillus licheniformis + Bacillus subtilis (LS2 and LS4). The in vitro evaluation demonstrated a significant increase in gas production (P c exhibited superiority compared to the control group (P 2 group had the highest dry matter content compared to CP4, LS2, LS4, and the control group (P 2, AB4, CP2, and CP4 compared to the other groups (P 2, AB4, CP2, and CP4 groups (P 2 group (P 3-N, pH, and protozoa count, while TVFA concentrations were significantly higher compared to the basal diet without probiotic supplements (P c produced the most favorable results among all the in vitro tested parameters. The findings demonstrate the potential of a dual probiotic strategy to enhance in vitro fermentation efficiency. This approach improves nutrient degradability and associated predictive values, while also reducing methane production. This research provides valuable insights for implementing sustainable and efficient dietary interventions in the sheep industry, particularly in light of the challenges posed by climate change.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究的目的是利用绵羊模型，研究用两种菌株的三种双重组合（每种剂量为两种剂量）孵化测试饲料：2 × 109（低；2）和 4 × 109（高；4）CFU/g 饲料/组合对养分降解性、气体产生、甲烷排放、发酵参数和原生动物计数的影响。这三种组合是嗜酸乳杆菌+保加利亚乳杆菌（AB2和AB4）、干酪乳杆菌+植物乳杆菌（CP2和CP4）以及地衣芽孢杆菌+枯草芽孢杆菌（LS2和LS4）。体外评价显示，产气量显着增加（P c 与对照组相比（P 2 组与 CP4、LS2、LS4 相比，干物质含量最高），对照组（P 2、AB4、CP2 和 CP4 与其他组相比（P 2、AB4、CP2 和 CP4 组（P 2 组（P 3-N、pH 和原虫计数，同时 TVFA 浓度））显着升高与不添加益生菌补充剂的基础饮食相比（P c 在所有体外测试参数中产生了最有利的结果。研究结果表明，双重益生菌策略具有增强体外生育力的潜力

articles.title: Giant DNA viruses encode a hallmark translation initiation complex of eukaryotic life.
articles.titleZh: 巨型DNA病毒编码真核生命的标志性翻译起始复合物。
articles.authors: Fels JM, Hill AB, Han R, Garcia JM, Bisio H, Abergel C, Kranzusch PJ, Lee ASY.
articles.abstract: In contrast to living organisms, viruses were long thought to lack protein synthesis machinery and instead depend on host factors to translate viral transcripts. Here, we discover that giant DNA viruses encode a distinct and functional IF4F translation-initiation complex to drive protein synthesis, thereby blurring the line between cellular and acellular biology. During infection, eukaryotic IF4F on host ribosomes is replaced by an essential viral IF4F that regulates viral translation, virion formation, and replication plasticity during altered host states. Structural dissection of viral IF4F reveals that the mRNA cap-binding subunit mediates exclusive interactions with viral mRNAs, constituting a molecular switch from translating host to viral proteins. Thus, our study establishes that viruses express a eukaryotic translation-initiation complex for protein synthesis, illuminating a series of evolutionary innovations in a core process of life.
articles.abstractZh: 与生物体相比，长期以来人们认为病毒缺乏蛋白质合成机制，而是依赖宿主因素来翻译病毒转录本。在这里，我们发现巨型 DNA 病毒编码一种独特的功能性 IF4F 翻译起始复合物来驱动蛋白质合成，从而模糊了细胞生物学和非细胞生物学之间的界限。在感染过程中，宿主核糖体上的真核 IF4F 被必需的病毒 IF4F 取代，该病毒 IF4F 在宿主状态改变期间调节病毒翻译、病毒颗粒形成和复制可塑性。病毒 IF4F 的结构剖析揭示了 mRNA 帽结合亚基介导与病毒 mRNA 的排他性相互作用，构成从宿主蛋白翻译为病毒蛋白的分子开关。因此，我们的研究确定病毒表达用于蛋白质合成的真核翻译起始复合物，阐明了生命核心过程中的一系列进化创新。

articles.title: KNAT7 transcription factor regulates metabolite and ion profiles to control cell wall biosynthesis in Populus.
articles.titleZh: KNAT7 转录因子调节代谢物和离子谱以控制杨属细胞壁的生物合成。
articles.authors: Sharma D, Lakra N, Ahlawat YK, Biswal AK, Malik A, Rathee V, Muhie SH.
articles.abstract: Poplar (Populus spp.) is widely recognized as a fast-growing woody species with considerable potential for sustainable bioenergy production, largely due to the high cellulose content of its secondary cell walls. Members of the KNOTTED1-like homeobox transcription factor family are known regulators of plant development, and KNAT7 has been closely associated with secondary wall formation and lignification. In the present study, metabolite and ion profiles were examined in transgenic poplar lines with KNAT7 overexpression and antisense suppression to elucidate its role in metabolic regulation during wood formation. Pronounced alterations in primary metabolism were observed in KNAT7-overexpressing lines, including substantial increases in soluble sugars such as glucose, gluconic acid, mannitol, sucrose, xylitol, and cellobiose, indicating enhanced carbon allocation toward cell wall polysaccharide biosynthesis. Amino acid metabolism was also significantly affected, with elevated levels of L-glutamic acid and L-5-oxoproline, as well as increased abundance of phenylalanine and tyrosine, key precursors of the lignin biosynthetic pathway. In addition, several phenolic and defense-related secondary metabolites, including hydroquinone, resveratrol, salicylic acid, and 4-hydroxybenzoic acid, were enriched, suggesting coordinated regulation of structural reinforcement and stress responsiveness. Elemental profiling revealed increased accumulation of Na, Mg, Fe, Mn, Zn, and Cu, with magnesium showing notable enrichment, consistent with its role as a cofactor in enzymes associated with lignin biosynthesis. Overall, the findings indicate that KNAT7 modulates metabolite and ion homeostasis in support of secondary cell wall biosynthesis, underscoring its potential utility for genetic improvement of wood quality and bioenergy-related traits in poplar.
articles.abstractZh: 杨树（Populus spp.）被广泛认为是一种快速生长的木本物种，具有可持续生物能源生产的巨大潜力，这主要是由于其次生细胞壁的纤维素含量高。 KNOTTED1 样同源盒转录因子家族的成员是已知的植物发育调节因子，KNAT7 与次生壁形成和木质化密切相关。在本研究中，对具有 KNAT7 过表达和反义抑制的转基因杨树品系的代谢物和离子谱进行了检查，以阐明其在木材形成过程中代谢调节中的作用。在 KNAT7 过表达株系中观察到初级代谢的显着改变，包括可溶性糖（如葡萄糖、葡萄糖酸、甘露醇、蔗糖、木糖醇和纤维二糖）的大幅增加，表明细胞壁多糖生物合成的碳分配增强。氨基酸代谢也受到显着影响，L-谷氨酸和L-5-氧代脯氨酸水平升高，以及木质素生物合成途径的关键前体苯丙氨酸和酪氨酸丰度增加。此外，一些酚类和防御相关的硒

articles.title: A genetically encoded bifunctional enzyme mitigates redox imbalance and lipotoxicity.
articles.titleZh: 基因编码的双功能酶可减轻氧化还原失衡和脂毒性。
articles.authors: Pan X, Munan S, Zuckerman AL, Pon A, Thompson NB, Perera RM, Shrestha N, Violante S, Cross JR, Goodman RP, Shah H, Cracan V.
articles.abstract: Dihydroxyacetone phosphate (DHAP), glycerol-3-phosphate (Gro3P) and reduced/oxidized nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NADH/NAD⁺) are key metabolites of the Gro3P shuttle, which transfers reducing equivalents between the cytosol and mitochondria. Targeted activation of Gro3P biosynthesis has recently emerged as a promising strategy to alleviate reductive stress. However, because Gro3P constitutes the backbone of triglycerides, its accumulation can promote extensive lipogenesis. Here we show that a genetically encoded tool based on a di-domain glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase from the alga Chlamydomonas reinhardtii (CrGPDH) effectively operates both the alternative Gro3P shunt, which regenerates NAD⁺ while converting DHAP to Gro3P, and the glycerol shunt, which converts Gro3P to glycerol and inorganic phosphate, across transformed and primary mammalian cell cultures as well as mouse liver. CrGPDH expression supported proliferation of cancer cells under respiratory chain inhibition or hypoxia, as well as patient-derived fibroblasts with mitochondrial dysfunction. Moreover, CrGPDH decreased triglyceride levels in kidney cancer cell lines and reversed ethanol-induced triglyceride accumulation in mouse liver. Thus, CrGPDH represents a promising xenotopic tool to alleviate redox imbalance and associated impaired lipogenesis in conditions ranging from primary mitochondrial diseases to steatosis.
articles.abstractZh: 磷酸二羟丙酮 (DHAP)、3-磷酸甘油 (Gro3P) 和还原/氧化烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸 (NADH/NAD⁺) 是 Gro3P 穿梭的关键代谢物，它在细胞质和线粒体之间转移还原当量。 Gro3P 生物合成的靶向激活最近已成为缓解还原应激的一种有前景的策略。然而，由于Gro3P构成甘油三酯的主干，其积累可以促进广泛的脂肪生成。在这里，我们展示了一种基于来自藻类莱茵衣藻 (CrGPDH) 的双结构域甘油-3-磷酸脱氢酶的遗传编码工具，可以在转化和原代哺乳动物细胞培养物以及小鼠肝脏中有效地操作替代性 Gro3P 分流器（在将 DHAP 转化为 Gro3P 的同时再生 NAD⁺）和甘油分流器（将 Gro3P 转化为甘油和无机磷酸盐）。 CrGPDH 表达支持呼吸链抑制或缺氧条件下癌细胞的增殖，以及线粒体功能障碍的患者来源的成纤维细胞的增殖。此外，CrGPDH 降低了肾癌细胞系中的甘油三酯水平，并逆转了乙醇诱导的甘油三酯水平。

articles.title: A novel approach to silver nanoparticle biosynthesis using ursolic acid from Catharanthus roseus for therapeutic effects.
articles.titleZh: 一种利用长春花中的熊果酸生物合成银纳米粒子的新方法，以达到治疗效果。
articles.authors: Raguvaran K, Kamatchi PAC, Handayani M, Kalpana M, Abass KS, Velraj M, Murugesan AM, Rasool A, Maheswaran R, Tarighat MA, Abdi G.
articles.abstract: The present study attentive on the bio synthesis of silver nanoparticles (AgNPs) using ursolic acid (UA-AgNPs) isolated from Catharanthus roseus and investigated their antibacterial, antibiofilm, antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anticancer activities. The biosynthesized UA-AgNPs were characterized using techniques like UV-Vis, XRD, FT-IR, EDX, TEM, zeta potential, and DLS. The UA-AgNPs exhibited stronger antibacterial activity than ursolic acid and AgNO3, producing inhibition zones of 18.00 mm and 16 ± 0.3 mm against B. cereus and P. aeruginosa, respectively, which were comparable to the activity of standard antibiotics and MIC (Minimum inhibitory concentration) values of 6.95 and 12.39 µg/mL, respectively. The anti-biofilm activity inhibited 64.43% and 60.89% of biofilm production. UA-AgNPs also impaired bacterial motility and caused higher protein and (Deoxyribonucleic acid) DNA leakage in membrane integrity assays compared to the control. Antioxidant activity was confirmed by DPPH and FRAP assays, and in vivo experiments in Saccharomyces cerevisiae highlighted significant antioxidant effects. Furthermore, UA-AgNPs exhibited potential anticancer activity against the HeLa cell line (IC50 29.20 µg/mL) with minimal cytotoxicity on Vero cells (IC50 5.59 µg/mL). Moreover, UA-AgNPs reduced LPS-induced Nitric oxide (NO) production in RAW264.7 cells. Through molecular docking studies, they demonstrated interactions with breast cancer proteins BRCA1 and C-erbB2 and bacterial virulence proteins Hbl and aglD. These findings highlight the bio efficacy of UA-AgNPs as a dual-action therapeutic agent with potent antibacterial and anticancer activity, combined with low toxicity toward normal cells, making them promising candidates for biomedical applications.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究关注使用从长春花中分离的熊果酸（UA-AgNPs）生物合成银纳米颗粒（AgNPs），并研究其抗菌、抗生物膜、抗氧化、抗炎和抗癌活性。使用 UV-Vis、XRD、FT-IR、EDX、TEM、zeta 电位和 DLS 等技术对生物合成的 UA-AgNP 进行表征。 UA-AgNPs表现出比熊果酸和AgNO3更强的抗菌活性，对蜡状芽孢杆菌和铜绿假单胞菌的抑制区分别为18.00 mm和16±0.3 mm，与标准抗生素的活性相当，MIC（最低抑菌浓度）值分别为6.95和12.39 µg/mL。抗生物膜活性抑制了64.43%和60.89%的生物膜产生。与对照相比，UA-AgNP 还会损害细菌运动性，并在膜完整性测定中导致更高的蛋白质和（脱氧核糖核酸）DNA 泄漏。 DPPH 和 FRAP 测定证实了抗氧化活性，酿酒酵母体内实验强调了显着的抗氧化作用。此外，UA-AgNPs 对 HeLa 细胞表现出潜在的抗癌活性

articles.title: Adaptor-mediated recruitment of three dyneins to dynactin enhances force generation.
articles.titleZh: 接头介导的三个动力蛋白向动力蛋白的募集增强了力的产生。
articles.authors: Rao L, Liu X, Arnold M, Okada K, McKenney RJ, Stengel K, Sidoli S, Berger F, Gennerich A.
articles.abstract: Cytoplasmic dynein is an essential microtubule motor protein that powers organelle transport and mitotic spindle assembly. Its activity depends on dynein-dynactin-cargo adaptor complexes, such as dynein-dynactin-BicD2, which typically function with two dynein motors. We show that mechanical tension recruits a third dynein motor via an auxiliary BicD2 adaptor binding the light intermediate chain of the third dynein, stabilizing multidynein assemblies and enhancing force generation. Lis1 prevents dynein from transitioning into a force-limiting phi-like conformation, allowing single-dynein dynein-dynactin-BicD2 to sustain forces up to approximately 4.5 pN, whereas force generation often ends at about 2.5 pN without Lis1. Complexes with two or three dyneins generate 7 pN and 9 pN, respectively, consistent with a staggered motor arrangement that enhances collective output. Under load, dynein-dynactin-BicD2 primarily takes 8-nm steps, challenging existing dynein coordination models. These findings reveal adaptive mechanisms that enable robust intracellular transport under varying mechanical demands.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞质动力蛋白是一种重要的微管运动蛋白，为细胞器运输和有丝分裂纺锤体组装提供动力。其活性取决于动力蛋白-动力蛋白-货物接头复合物，例如动力蛋白-动力蛋白-BicD2，其通常与两个动力蛋白马达一起发挥作用。我们表明，机械张力通过结合第三动力蛋白轻中间链的辅助 BicD2 适配器招募第三动力蛋白马达，稳定多动力蛋白组件并增强力的产生。 Lis1 可防止动力蛋白转变为力限制的 phi 样构象，从而允许单动力蛋白 dynein-dynactin-BicD2 维持高达约 4.5 pN 的力，而没有 Lis1 时力的产生通常在约 2.5 pN 时结束。具有两个或三个动力蛋白的复合物分别产生 7 pN 和 9 pN，与增强集体输出的交错运动排列一致。在负载下，dynein-dynactin-BicD2 主要采用 8 nm 步长，挑战现有的动力蛋白协调模型。这些发现揭示了适应性机制，可以在不同的机械需求下实现稳健的细胞内运输。

articles.title: APOL1 plasma membrane pools resist rapid protein degradation.
articles.titleZh: APOL1 质膜池可抵抗蛋白质的快速降解。
articles.authors: Höffken V, Alvermann L, Niggemeier D, Beul K, Nedvetsky P, Ellinger B, Assenmacher D, Granado D, Pavenstädt H, Weide T.
articles.abstract: Homozygosity of two sequence variants within the human APOL1 gene, called APOL1 G1 and G2, in combination with high Apolipoprotein L1 (APOL1) expression levels are linked to a wide spectrum of renal diseases summarized as APOL1-mediated kidney diseases (AMKDs). Previous studies have shown that inflammatory and immunomodulatory triggers are major contributors to elevated APOL1 protein expression. However, little is known about the stability of APOL1 and the role of protein degradation in regulating its intracellular levels. In this study, we systematically investigated these aspects. To investigate degradation dynamics, we used stable HEK293T cell lines with inducible overexpression of GFP-tagged APOL1 vA/G0, its C-terminal risk variants (G1, G2), N-terminal isoforms (vB1, vB3, vC), as well as the deletion mutant (ΔN59), APOL2, and an APOL1–APOL2 chimeric protein (NTvA-APOL2). Degradation and protein biosynthesis were modified using proteasome inhibitors and cycloheximide, respectively. Treated cells were analyzed using Western blotting, immunofluorescence microscopy and flow cytometry analyses. Moreover, in silico analyses were performed to identify motifs within the APOL1 sequence potentially mediating its degradation. This study shows that APOL1 is subject to remarkably rapid proteasomal degradation, observed for both the APOL1 wildtype (G0) and renal risk variants (RRVs) G1 and G2. Moreover, despite distinct topologies at the intracellular membranes of the APOL1 isoforms, all exhibit rapid protein degradation. In contrast, APOL2 – the closest homolog of APOL1 – demonstrated significantly greater resistance to proteasomal degradation. In silico analyses identified two intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) present in APOL1 but absent in APOL2, potentially underlying the increased susceptibility to degradation. Notably, APOL1 surface-localized pools were resistant to rapid proteasomal degradation, with no major differences observed between G0 and RRVs. Together our findings suggest that APOL1 stability is highly compartment-specific, with rapid degradation at intracellular pools and pronounced stability at the cell surface. Targeting the stability of APOL1 at the PM represents a promising avenue for the development of novel therapeutic interventions against AMKD.
articles.abstractZh: 人类 APOL1 基因内两个序列变体（称为 APOL1 G1 和 G2）的纯合性与高载脂蛋白 L1 (APOL1) 表达水平相结合，与多种肾脏疾病相关，这些肾脏疾病概括为 APOL1 介导的肾脏疾病 (AMKD)。先前的研究表明，炎症和免疫调节触发因素是 APOL1 蛋白表达升高的主要原因。然而，人们对 APOL1 的稳定性以及蛋白质降解在调节其细胞内水平中的作用知之甚少。在本研究中，我们系统地研究了这些方面。为了研究降解动力学，我们使用稳定的 HEK293T 细胞系，该细胞系可诱导过度表达 GFP 标记的 APOL1 vA/G0、其 C 端风险变异体 (G1、G2)、N 端亚型 (vB1、vB3、vC) 以及缺失突变体 (ΔN59)、APOL2 和 APOL1-APOL2 嵌合蛋白 (NTvA-APOL2)。分别使用蛋白酶体抑制剂和放线菌酮来修饰降解和蛋白质生物合成。使用蛋白质印迹、免疫荧光显微镜和流式细胞术分析处理的细胞。此外，还进行了计算机分析以鉴定 APOL1 序列内的基序

articles.title: Engineering intrinsically disordered regions for guiding genome navigation.
articles.titleZh: 设计本质上无序的区域来指导基因组导航。
articles.authors: Liu J, Kumar DK, Hurieva B, Jonas F, Barkai N.
articles.abstract: Intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) navigate transcription factors (TFs) to their binding sites in genomes, raising the question of how IDR sequences can encode for specific genome recognition. To define the principles of IDR-directed binding, we designed de novo IDRs and tested their activity in directing selective binding across the budding yeast genome. Our de novo IDRs were designed by dispersing hydrophobic amino acids within hundreds of hydrophilic residues, as we found to be required in native TF-directing IDRs. Although showing no alignment-based similarity to native TFs, the de novo IDRs were active in directing genome binding toward a tunable range of targets, as revealed by systematically varying the hydrophobic spread or disorder scaffold. Overall, the 185 synthetic IDRs tested displayed a continuum of sequence-directed binding preferences across hundreds of promoters. Our results open new doors for understanding and engineering selective binding across genomes.
articles.abstractZh: 本质无序区域 (IDR) 将转录因子 (TF) 引导至基因组中的结合位点，这就提出了 IDR 序列如何编码以实现特定基因组识别的问题。为了定义 IDR 定向结合的原理，我们从头设计了 IDR，并测试了它们在芽殖酵母基因组中定向选择性结合的活性。我们的 de novo IDR 是通过将疏水性氨基酸分散在数百个亲水性残基中而设计的，正如我们发现的天然 TF 导向 IDR 所需要的那样。尽管与天然 TF 没有基于比对的相似性，但从头 IDR 能够积极引导基因组结合到一系列可调节的靶标上，正如通过系统地改变疏水性扩散或无序支架所揭示的那样。总体而言，测试的 185 个合成 IDR 在数百个启动子中显示出连续的序列定向结合偏好。我们的结果为理解和设计跨基因组的选择性结合打开了新的大门。

articles.title: GCN5 drives MASLD progression through LXRα/SREBP1c signaling pathway-mediated de novo lipogenesis.
articles.titleZh: GCN5 通过 LXRα/SREBP1c 信号通路介导的从头脂肪生成驱动 MASLD 进展。
articles.authors: Xiao HT, Song P, Jin J, Wang YD, Xu YY, Wu H, Shao XX, Gan QF, He J, Wen YR, Zhu J, Chen BY, Zhou P, Lai LN, Yang H, Li P, Zheng ZG.
articles.abstract: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is a global health concern that affects nearly one-quarter of the world's population. General control non-repressed protein 5 (GCN5), a histone acetyltransferase (HAT), has been implicated in the progression of several diseases, but its role in MASLD remains unclear. Here, we provide the experimental evidence that progressive human and male murine MASLD is driven by GCN5, but not by p300/CREB binding protein associated factor (PCAF) activation. Hepatocyte-specific GCN5 overexpression accelerates MASLD progression, whereas its ablation alleviates disease severity. Moreover, pharmacological inhibition of GCN5 with CPTH2 protects against MASLD. Metabolomics and RNA-seq analyses demonstrate that GCN5 promotes de novo lipogenesis (DNL) by upregulating SREBP1c-mediated transcription of lipogenic genes. Mechanistically, GCN5 acetylates histone H3 at the SREBP1c promoter, enhancing transcription through its intrinsic acetyltransferase activity. Our findings further identify GCN5 as a key regulator of LXRα-induced SREBP1c expression, suggesting that targeting GCN5 may selectively inhibit SREBP1c-driven DNL without impairing LXRα-mediated reverse cholesterol transport (RCT). Notably, combined treatment with the Liver X Receptor (LXR) agonist T0901317 and CPTH2 synergistically reduced lipid accumulation in vitro and in vivo, highlighting a promising therapeutic strategy for MASLD.
articles.abstractZh: 代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪肝病 (MASLD) 是一个全球性的健康问题，影响着世界近四分之一的人口。一般控制非抑制蛋白 5 (GCN5) 是一种组蛋白乙酰转移酶 (HAT)，与多种疾病的进展有关，但其在 MASLD 中的作用仍不清楚。在这里，我们提供了实验证据，证明进行性人类和雄性小鼠 MASLD 是由 GCN5 驱动的，而不是由 p300/CREB ​​结合蛋白相关因子 (PCAF) 激活驱动的。肝细胞特异性 GCN5 过度表达会加速 MASLD 的进展，而其消融则可减轻疾病的严重程度。此外，用 CPTH2 对 GCN5 进行药理学抑制可预防 MASLD。代谢组学和 RNA-seq 分析表明，GCN5 通过上调 SREBP1c 介导的脂肪生成基因的转录来促进从头脂肪生成 (DNL)。从机制上讲，GCN5 在 SREBP1c 启动子处乙酰化组蛋白 H3，通过其内在的乙酰转移酶活性增强转录。我们的研究结果进一步确定 GCN5 是 LXRα 诱导的 SREBP1c 表达的关键调节因子，表明靶向 GCN5 可以选择性抑制 SREBP1c 驱动的 DNL，而不损害 LX

articles.title: H3K4me1 directs H3K36me2 and H3K36me3 deposition in land plants.
articles.titleZh: H3K4me1 指导 H3K36me2 和 H3K36me3 在陆地植物中的沉积。
articles.authors: Wu J, Wang J, Du K, Li Y, Xie W, He C, Xing Q, Li X, Zhu X, Wu Z, Wu X, Zhang L, Shen WH, Lan F, Gan J, Liu B, Dong A.
articles.abstract: Monomethylation of histone 3 lysine 4 (H3K4me1) marks enhancers in mammals. However, the function of H3K4me1 in plants remains largely unclear. Here, we present the genome-wide distribution of H3K4me1 in diverse species across evolution, revealing a distinctive H3K4me1 distribution pattern in land plants. To explore the function of H3K4me1 in plants, we identified an H3K4me1-specific reader protein, Early heading date 3 (Ehd3), and solved the structure of Ehd3 in complex with the H3K4me1 peptide, revealing a unique binding module differing from the previously reported PHD finger proteins. We further identified an Ehd3-binding protein, SET domain group 724 (SDG724), and the deletion of either Ehd3 or SDG724 caused similar defects in plant phenotype and changes in transcriptome and epigenome profiles. Both Ehd3 and SDG724 are enriched at chromatin regions marked by H3K4me1 but not H3K4me2 or H3K4me3. Ehd3 activates the H3K36 methyltransferase SDG724, and H3K36me2/me3 are colocalized with H3K4me1 in the genomes of the examined land plants. Collectively, our results reveal that H3K4me1 directs the establishment of H3K36me2 and H3K36me3 in land plants.
articles.abstractZh: 组蛋白 3 赖氨酸 4 (H3K4me1) 的单甲基化标志着哺乳动物的增强子。然而，H3K4me1 在植物中的功能仍不清楚。在这里，我们展示了 H3K4me1 在不同物种进化过程中的全基因组分布，揭示了陆地植物中独特的 H3K4me1 分布模式。为了探索 H3K4me1 在植物中的功能，我们鉴定了一种 H3K4me1 特异性读取蛋白，早期抽穗日期 3 (Ehd3)，并解析了 Ehd3 与 H3K4me1 肽复合物的结构，揭示了与之前报道的 PHD 指蛋白不同的独特结合模块。我们进一步鉴定了一种 Ehd3 结合蛋白，SET 结构域组 724 (SDG724)，并且 Ehd3 或 SDG724 的删除会导致植物表型的类似缺陷以及转录组和表观基因组谱的变化。 Ehd3 和 SDG724 在 H3K4me1 标记的染色质区域富集，但在 H3K4me2 或 H3K4me3 标记的染色质区域不富集。 Ehd3 激活 H3K36 甲基转移酶 SDG724，并且 H3K36me2/me3 与 H3K4me1 共定位于所检查的陆地植物的基因组中。总的来说，我们的结果表明 H3K4me1 指导 H3K36me2 和 H3K36me3 在陆地植物中的建立。

articles.title: NUT1-Exo70A1 Regulates Xylem Vessel Development and Influences Water Use Efficiency in Maize.
articles.titleZh: NUT1-Exo70A1 调节玉米木质部导管发育并影响水分利用效率。
articles.authors: Zhu T, Wang Y, Wang Y, Wang C, Liu Y, He J, Zhao B, Liu S, Lian Y, Wu L, Cheng J, Yang Z, Qin F.
articles.abstract: Efficient water uptake and transport through xylem vessels are essential for plant growth and development. The patterned secondary cell wall (SCW) structure of xylem vessels provides robust mechanical support to withstand the strong negative pressure generated by transpiration and facilitates long-distance water transport. However, the key factors governing SCW patterning in xylem vessels and their potential for enhancing water use efficiency (WUE) remain undetermined. Here, we report the identification of a recessive maize (Zea mays) mutant drought-sensitive 1 (ds1), which is highly susceptible to water deficit. ds1 defects in SCW patterning and xylem vessel differentiation, and exhibits significantly reduced hydraulic conductivity. DS1 is the ortholog of Arabidopsis Exo70A1 and is regulated by the NAC transcription factor NECROTIC UPPER TIPS1 (NUT1) in vascular tissues. Overexpressing Exo70A1 enhanced hydraulic conductivity and consequently boosted biomass and grain yield under both well-watered and drought conditions. Thus, the NUT1-Exo70A1 module represents a promising genetic target for improving WUE in crops.
articles.abstractZh: 通过木质部导管的有效水分吸收和运输对于植物生长和发育至关重要。木质部导管的图案化次生细胞壁（SCW）结构提供了强大的机械支撑，以承受蒸腾作用产生的强负压，并促进长距离水分运输。然而，控制木质部导管中 SCW 模式的关键因素及其提高水分利用效率 (WUE) 的潜力仍未确定。在这里，我们报告了隐性玉米（Zea mays）突变体干旱敏感1（ds1）的鉴定，该突变体对水分亏缺高度敏感。 ds1 在 SCW 图案化和木质部导管分化方面存在缺陷，并且表现出显着降低的水力传导率。 DS1 是拟南芥 Exo70A1 的直系同源物，受维管组织中 NAC 转录因子 NECROTIC UPPER TIPS1 (NUT1) 的调节。过度表达 Exo70A1 增强了水力传导性，从而在水分充足和干旱条件下提高了生物量和谷物产量。因此，NUT1-Exo70A1 模块代表了一个有前景的改善作物 WUE 的遗传靶点。

articles.title: Quantitative analysis of small RNA pseudouridylation reveals interplay of PUS enzymes in tRNA anticodon stem-loop.
articles.titleZh: 小 RNA 假尿苷化的定量分析揭示了 tRNA 反密码子茎环中 PUS 酶的相互作用。
articles.authors: Liu W, Ma Y, Wang L, Lu B, Dong Y, Zhuang Y, He B, Zhang M, Yi C.
articles.abstract: Pseudouridine (Ψ) is an abundant modification in small RNA catalyzed by multiple pseudouridine synthases (PUSs). However, the substrate specificity of human PUSs remains elusive. Here, we adopted PRAISE, a quantitative Ψ detection method, to profile pseudouridylation in small RNA, including cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNAs, snRNA, and snoRNA. We found that snoRNA pseudouridylation is mediated not only by RNA-guided DKC1, but also by the stand-alone enzyme PUS7 at a specific site. Interestingly, several PUS enzymes, including PUS1, RPUSD1, and PUS7, which install nearby Ψ sites within tRNA anticodon stem-loop, can influence pseudouridylation catalyzed by other PUSs, revealing an unrecognized interplay during Ψ formation. For the three RluA family enzymes, RPUSD1 catalyzes the canonical Ψ30 in tRNA-Ile and Ψ72 in tRNA-Arg isoacceptors. RPUSD2 pseudouridylates Ψ31 of mt-tRNALeu(CUN), Ψ32 of mt-tRNAPro and mt-tRNACys, whereas RPUSD3 lacks tRNA activity. Together, our quantitative Ψ profiling characterized PUS tRNA substrates and revealed unexpected PUS interplay.
articles.abstractZh: 假尿苷 (Ψ) 是由多种假尿苷合酶 (PUS) 催化的小 RNA 的丰富修饰。然而，人类 PUS 的底物特异性仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们采用 PRAISE（一种定量 Ψ 检测方法）来分析小 RNA 中的假尿苷化，包括胞浆和线粒体 tRNA、snRNA 和 snoRNA。我们发现 snoRNA 假尿苷化不仅由 RNA 引导的 DKC1 介导，而且还由特定位点的独立酶 PUS7 介导。有趣的是，几种 PUS 酶，包括 PUS1、RPUSD1 和 PUS7，它们在 tRNA 反密码子茎环内安装附近的 Ψ 位点，可以影响其他 PUS 催化的假尿苷化，揭示 Ψ 形成过程中未被识别的相互作用。对于三种 RluA 家族酶，RPUSD1 催化 tRNA-Ile 中的典型 Ψ30 和 tRNA-Arg 同工受体中的 Ψ72。 RPUSD2 假尿苷酸化 mt-tRNALeu(CUN) 的 Ψ31、mt-tRNAPro 和 mt-tRNACys 的 Ψ32，而 RPUSD3 缺乏 tRNA 活性。总之，我们的定量 Ψ 分析描述了 PUS tRNA 底物的特征，并揭示了意想不到的 PUS 相互作用。

articles.title: BamA self-insertion drives inner-to-outer membrane remodelling in diderm Firmicutes.
articles.titleZh: BamA 自我插入驱动二层厚壁菌门内膜到外膜的重塑。
articles.authors: Beskrovnaya P, Hashimi A, Sexton DL, Nikas GE, Tocheva EI.
articles.abstract: Exclusive to Firmicutes, endospore formation is a complex process that results in the release of a mature spore after the mother cell lyses. The spore is protected by multiple layers, including inner and outer spore membranes (IsM and OsM), both originating from the mother cell's inner membrane (IM). While well understood in monoderm bacteria like Bacillus subtilis, less is known about diderm sporulators such as Acetonema longum, which retain and remodel their OsM into a functional outer membrane (OM) during germination. Here, we demonstrate that outer membrane proteins (OMPs), including the essential BAM complex component BamA and the LPS translocon protein LptD, are present in vegetative and germinating cells but absent from mature spores, indicating that OM biogenesis occurs without pre-existing OMPs. Growth-stage proteomics and expression profiling identify two previously uncharacterized proteins, SonA and SonB, co-expressed with BamA and in a conserved operon among diderm Firmicutes. SonA is a β-barrel OMP with three POTRA domains, while SonB is a predicted OM lipoprotein. In vitro, BamA and SonA spontaneously fold and insert into liposomes, supporting a model where BamA and/or SonA initiate self-insertion into the OsM, driving its stepwise transformation into a fully functional OM.
articles.abstractZh: 内生孢子的形成是厚壁菌门所独有的，是一个复杂的过程，导致母细胞裂解后释放出成熟的孢子。孢子受到多层保护，包括孢子内膜和外膜（IsM 和 OsM），两者均源自母细胞的内膜 (IM)。虽然人们对枯草芽孢杆菌等单胚层细菌了解甚多，但对长丙酮酸杆菌等二胚层孢子菌却知之甚少，这种孢子在发芽过程中保留并重塑其 OsM 为功能性外膜 (OM)。在这里，我们证明外膜蛋白（OMP），包括必需的 BAM 复合体成分 BamA 和 LPS 易位蛋白 LptD，存在于营养细胞和萌发细胞中，但不存在于成熟孢子中，这表明 OM 生物发生在没有预先存在的 OMP 的情况下发生。生长阶段蛋白质组学和表达谱鉴定了两种以前未表征的蛋白质，SonA 和 SonB，它们与 BamA 共表达，并存在于二真皮厚壁菌门的保守操纵子中。 SonA 是具有三个 POTRA 结构域的 β 桶 OMP，而 SonB 是预测的 OM 脂蛋白。在体外，BamA 和 SonA 自发折叠并插入脂质体中，支持 BamA 和/o 的模型

articles.title: A synthetic cell with integrated DNA self-replication and lipid biosynthesis.
articles.titleZh: 具有集成 DNA 自我复制和脂质生物合成功能的合成细胞。
articles.authors: Restrepo Sierra AM, Ramirez Gomez F, van Tongeren M, Sierra Heras L, Danelon C.
articles.abstract: The emergence, organization, and persistence of cellular life are the result of the functional integration of metabolic and genetic networks. Here, we engineer phospholipid vesicles that can operate three essential functions, namely transcription-translation of a partial genome, self-replication of this DNA program, and membrane synthesis. The synthetic genome encodes six proteins, and its compartmentalized expression produces active liposomes with distinct phenotypes demonstrating successful module integration. Our results reveal that genetic factors exert a stronger control over DNA replication and membrane synthesis than metabolic crosstalk or module co-activity. By showing how genetically encoded functions derived from different species can be integrated in liposome compartments, our work opens avenues for the construction of autonomous and evolving synthetic cells.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞生命的出现、组织和持续是代谢和遗传网络功能整合的结果。在这里，我们设计了能够执行三种基本功能的磷脂囊泡，即部分基因组的转录翻译、DNA 程序的自我复制和膜合成。合成基因组编码六种蛋白质，其区室化表达产生具有不同表型的活性脂质体，证明模块整合成功。我们的结果表明，遗传因素对 DNA 复制和膜合成的控制比代谢串扰或模块协同活性更强。通过展示来自不同物种的基因编码功能如何整合到脂质体隔室中，我们的工作为构建自主和进化的合成细胞开辟了途径。

articles.title: Behavioral and lethal effects of yeast based bioformulations on Bactrocera dorsalis.
articles.titleZh: 基于酵母的生物制剂对橘小实蝇的行为和致死影响。
articles.authors: Ramniwas S, Sharma A, Singh NV, Kumar G.
articles.abstract: The Oriental fruit fly, Bactrocera dorsalis (Diptera: Tephritidae), is a globally significant agricultural pest necessitating novel and sustainable management strategies. This study investigated the efficacy of two stable bio-control agents derived from the naturally associated mycobiome of Zaprionus indianus: the yeast species Debaryomyces hansenii ziha1 and Pichia kudriavzevii zibd3, formulated with Essential Oil of Citral (EOC). Efficacy was evaluated via stability testing across 7 °C, 25 °C and 35 °C, compatibility assessment (T-factor), behavioral preference assays, insecticidal trials against first-instar larvae, and chemical characterization using GC-MS and Y-tube olfactometry. Both EOC-based formulations demonstrated high stability and acceptable compatibility with the fungi (EOC ≤ 1%, T ≈ 55), but exhibited strikingly opposite behavioral effects on adult B. dorsalis. D. hansenii-EOC showed significant attractant activity (- 95 ± 0.5%), which was correlated with VOCs such as Acetophenone and Hexadecenal, while P. kudriavzevii-EOC acted as a potent repellent (100 ± 0.5%), attributed to compounds including p-Mentha1,5-dien-8-ol and Naphthalene. Furthermore, P. kudriavzevii-EOC exhibited a synergistic lethal effect against pre-adult stages, causing over 50% larval mortality. In conclusion, the insect mycobiome serves as a rich and selective source for chemical ecology-based pest management, offering stable, dual-action bio-formulations (Attractant and Repellent/Larvicide) that are ideal for developing targeted "Push-Pull" or "Attract-and-Kill" strategies in B. dorsalis integrated pest management (IPM) programs.
articles.abstractZh: 东方果蝇，橘小实蝇（双翅目：实蝇科）是一种全球重要的农业害虫，需要新颖的可持续管理策略。本研究调查了两种稳定的生物防治剂的功效，这两种生物防治剂源自 Zaprionus indianus 天然相关的真菌生物组：酵母种 Debaryomyces hansenii ziha1 和 Pichia kudriavzevii zibd3，用柠檬醛精油 (EOC) 配制而成。通过 7°C、25°C 和 35°C 的稳定性测试、兼容性评估（T 因子）、行为偏好测定、针对一龄幼虫的杀虫试验以及使用 GC-MS 和 Y 管嗅觉测定法的化学表征来评估功效。两种基于 EOC 的配方都表现出高稳定性和可接受的与真菌的相容性（EOC ≤ 1%，T ≈ 55），但对成年橘小实蝇表现出截然不同的行为影响。 D. hansenii-EOC 显示出显着的引诱活性 (- 95 ± 0.5%)，这与苯乙酮和十六烯醛等 VOC 相关，而 P. kudriavzevii-EOC 则充当有效的驱避剂 (100 ± 0.5%)，归因于包括 p-Mentha1,5-dien-8-ol 和萘在内的化合物。此外，P. kudriavzevii-EO

articles.title: Bifidobacterium breve promotes growth and lipid alteration in Trichomonas vaginalis transiently through transcriptomic reprogramming.
articles.titleZh: 短双歧杆菌通过转录组重编程瞬时促进阴道毛滴虫的生长和脂质改变。
articles.authors: Chen PY, Yeh YM, Chen CH, Li MC, Hsu YT, Huang PJ, Cheng WH.
articles.abstract: Trichomonas vaginalis is recognized as the most prevalent non-viral sexually transmitted parasitic infection, establishing its presence in the vaginal microbiota alongside commensal bacteria, particularly Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium species. Notably, a reduction in the population of Bifidobacterium breve has been documented in women infected with T. vaginalis. However, the dynamics of the interaction between T. vaginalis and these beneficial bacterial species remain inadequately understood, warranting further investigation to elucidate the underlying mechanisms and potential implications for vaginal health. We investigated the effects of B. breve on the growth of T. vaginalis, including its gene expression and interactions with the host. HeLa cells were exposed to T. vaginalis that had been pretreated with or without B. breve. We assessed cytokine responses (specifically IL-6 and IL-8) and evaluated cytopathic effects. The dynamics of the co-culture were monitored microscopically. Additionally, we conducted transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses to characterize the responses of T. vaginalis to B. breve. Co-culture of T. vaginalis with B. breve for 4 h significantly increased protozoan proliferation by 1.2-fold, while bacterial abundance was reduced by 27%. HeLa cells showed no cytopathic effects or changes after treatment with B. breve, whether given before or alongside T. vaginalis. Microscopy showed a direct physical association between the two organisms. Transcriptomic profiling of T. vaginalis co-cultured with B. breve revealed an upregulation of genes related to fatty acid metabolism and DNA replication. Metabolomic analysis confirmed changes in the content of long-chain fatty acids. Additionally, there was an increase in virulence-associated genes, including adhesins. B. breve promotes the growth of T. vaginalis and modulates parasite gene expression and lipid metabolism transiently. However, it does not confer protection on host epithelial cells during infection. These findings suggest that B. breve may contribute to maintaining microbial community balance but does not directly counteract T. vaginalis. Importantly, these insights highlight the potential value of B. breve–associated microbial or metabolic signatures as indicators of ecological shifts that predispose to parasite overgrowth.
articles.abstractZh: 阴道毛滴虫被认为是最常见的非病毒性传播寄生虫感染，它与共生细菌一起存在于阴道微生物群中，特别是乳杆菌和双歧杆菌。值得注意的是，感染阴道毛滴虫的女性中短双歧杆菌数量有所减少。然而，阴道毛滴虫和这些有益细菌物种之间相互作用的动态仍然没有得到充分的了解，需要进一步研究以阐明潜在的机制和对阴道健康的潜在影响。我们研究了短双歧杆菌对阴道毛滴虫生长的影响，包括其基因表达和与宿主的相互作用。将 HeLa 细胞暴露于经过或不经过短双歧杆菌预处理的阴道毛滴虫。我们评估了细胞因子反应（特别是 IL-6 和 IL-8）并评估了细胞病变效应。通过显微镜监测共培养的动态。此外，我们还进行了转录组学和代谢组学分析，以表征阴道毛滴虫对短双歧杆菌的反应。阴道毛滴虫与短双歧杆菌共培养 4 小时显着增加

articles.title: Decode and rewire: programming Komagataella phaffii for bioproduction with synthetic transcriptional tools.
articles.titleZh: 解码和重新接线：使用合成转录工具对 Komagataella phaffii 进行生物生产编程。
articles.authors: Wei X, Cong W, Zhou H, Zhang J, Çalık P.
articles.abstract: The yeast Komagataella phaffii is a leading producer of secreted therapeutic and industrial proteins. Its excellent traits make it a primary host for the production of value-added carbon compounds, including native metabolites, heterologous biomolecules, and synthetic chemicals. Recent breakthrough discoveries in engineering synthetic promoters have set the stage for novel bioprocesses that utilize sustainable carbon sources through directed evolution methods, ushering in a new era in bioindustry. This review discusses how engineering-directed transcriptional machinery element (TME) interaction-driven methodologies can unlock latent potential to rewire expression for the directed evolution of metabolic functions. We highlight discoveries in the design of transcriptional switches and metabolic switches, the reverse-engineering TME interaction via synthetic transcription factors, forcing K. phaffii for directed evolution.
articles.abstractZh: Komagataella phaffii 酵母是分泌性治疗和工业蛋白质的主要生产者。其优异的特性使其成为生产增值碳化合物的主要宿主，包括天然代谢物、异源生物分子和合成化学品。最近在工程合成启动子方面的突破性发现为通过定向进化方法利用可持续碳源的新型生物过程奠定了基础，开创了生物工业的新时代。这篇综述讨论了工程导向的转录机械元件（TME）相互作用驱动的方法如何释放潜在的潜力，重新连接表达以实现代谢功能的定向进化。我们重点介绍转录开关和代谢开关设计中的发现，通过合成转录因子对 TME 相互作用进行逆向工程，迫使 K. phaffii 进行定向进化。

articles.title: Dual recruitment of two CCM2 molecules to KRIT1 suppresses KLF4 expression.
articles.titleZh: 将两个 CCM2 分子双重招募至 KRIT1 可抑制 KLF4 表达。
articles.authors: Huet-Calderwood C, Fisher OS, Das S, Su VL, Boggon TJ, Calderwood DA.
articles.abstract: Regulated expression of Kruppel like factor (KLF) transcription factors is essential for normal maintenance of endothelial cells, but loss of either K-Rev interaction trapped 1 (KRIT1) or cerebral cavernous malformations 2 (CCM2) proteins results in significant over-expression of KLF4 protein, causing the cerebrovascular disorder, cerebral cavernous malformations. Here, combining knockdown and reconstitution in an endothelial cell line, with co-immunoprecipitation, biophysical analysis of purified proteins, and co-crystallography, we find that to restrain KLF4 expression, two CCM2 proteins must cluster on a single KRIT1, with the PTB domain of each CCM2 protein binding either the second or third NPxF motif within KRIT1. This clustering of two PTB domains to a single peptide reveals a previously unobserved mechanism for PTB domain recruitment to partner proteins. Overall, our data support a model where clustering of two CCM2 molecules to one KRIT1 is required for normal regulation of expression of KLF4 transcription factor.
articles.abstractZh: Kruppel样因子（KLF）转录因子的调节表达对于内皮细胞的正常维持至关重要，但是K-Rev相互作用捕获1（KRIT1）或脑海绵状血管畸形2（CCM2）蛋白的缺失会导致KLF4蛋白的显着过度表达，从而引起脑血管疾病、脑海绵状血管瘤。在这里，将内皮细胞系中的敲低和重建与免疫共沉淀、纯化蛋白的生物物理分析和共结晶相结合，我们发现为了抑制 KLF4 表达，两个 CCM2 蛋白必须聚集在单个 KRIT1 上，每个 CCM2 蛋白的 PTB 结构域结合 KRIT1 内的第二个或第三个 NPxF 基序。两个 PTB 结构域聚集到一个肽上揭示了一种以前未观察到的 PTB 结构域招募到伙伴蛋白的机制。总体而言，我们的数据支持一种模型，其中两个 CCM2 分子聚集到一个 KRIT1 是 KLF4 转录因子表达的正常调节所必需的。

articles.title: The overlooked yet critical role of catholyte composition in microbial electrosynthesis.
articles.titleZh: 阴极电解液成分在微生物电合成中被忽视但至关重要的作用。
articles.authors: van der Lee D, Lee M, Gabriëls M, Kleerebezem R, Jourdin L.
articles.abstract: The circular economy should include CO2 valorization, which could be achieved via microbial electrosynthesis (MES). In MES, the catholyte supplies all nutrients, yet its composition has been adopted from other biotechnologies, overlooking specific needs of MES. In this Perspective, we examine how catholyte design impacts MES performance at microbial, electrochemical, and process levels. We highlight mismatches in metal availability, electrode interactions, and medium origins. We propose reframing the catholyte as a key design parameter and introduce a decision-making framework for tailored formulation. This strategy has the potential to improve MES performance and serve as model for optimizing media in broader biotechnological applications.
articles.abstractZh: 循环经济应包括二氧化碳增值，这可以通过微生物电合成（MES）来实现。在MES中，阴极电解液提供所有营养物质，但其成分是从其他生物技术中采用的，忽略了MES的特定需求。在本视角中，我们研究了阴极电解液设计如何影响微生物、电化学和工艺水平的 MES 性能。我们强调金属可用性、电极相互作用和介质来源方面的不匹配。我们建议将阴极电解液重新定义为关键设计参数，并引入定制配方的决策框架。该策略具有提高 MES 性能的潜力，并可作为在更广泛的生物技术应用中优化培养基的模型。

articles.title: Effect of a truncated mutant factor V on hemostatic function and embryonic development in mice.
articles.titleZh: 截短的突变因子 V 对小鼠止血功能和胚胎发育的影响。
articles.authors: Miguel-Batuecas A, De Pablo-Moreno JA, Porras N, Bermejo-Álvarez P, González-Brusi L, Serrano LJ, De Pablo-Moreno JM, Sánchez MJ, García-Arranz M, Rodríguez-Bertos A, Chumappumkal Joseph B, Revuelta L, Liras A.
articles.abstract: Factor V is an essential protein in the blood clotting process and plays a central role in secondary hemostasis. Its deficiency causes a rare inherited disorder characterized by episodes of severe bleeding, some of which can be life-threatening. Although previous studies have established that factor V is essential for normal embryonic development, its specific contribution to vascular maturation remains incompletely understood, factor V is believed to contribute to blood vessel stabilization and regulate angiogenesis through its interaction with thrombin. In a recent study, a CRISPR-engineered mouse model intended to produced a mild factor V deficiency disease, unexpectedly produced a frameshift mutation in the A3 domain, resulting in a truncated protein. Factor V levels in healthy embryonic mouse tissues were assessed to investigate its role at different developmental stages. The mutation markedly impaired viability, as homozygous mice exhibited a lethal phenotype with severe bleeding and perinatal death, along with impaired coagulation function. Histopathological and immunohistochemical analyses indicated a link between factor V deficiency, thrombin and α-smooth muscle actin, potentially affecting proangiogenic signaling and embryonic vascular formation. Factor V gene expression increased during late embryogenesis, underscoring its importance in vascular development and maturation. Overall, these findings are consistent with a role for factor V in stabilizing embryonic blood vessels and modulating thrombin-dependent angiogenesis, and add further detail on the developmental impact of its deficiency and the pathogenesis of congenital bleeding disorders.
articles.abstractZh: V因子是血液凝固过程中必需的蛋白质，在二次止血中发挥核心作用。它的缺乏会导致一种罕见的遗传性疾病，其特征是严重出血，其中一些可能危及生命。尽管之前的研究已确定因子 V 对于正常胚胎发育至关重要，但其对血管成熟的具体贡献仍不完全清楚，但因子 V 被认为有助于血管稳定并通过其与凝血酶的相互作用调节血管生成。在最近的一项研究中，旨在产生轻度 V 因子缺乏症的 CRISPR 工程小鼠模型意外地在 A3 结构域中产生了移码突变，从而产生了截短的蛋白质。评估健康小鼠胚胎组织中的因子 V 水平，以研究其在不同发育阶段的作用。该突变显着损害了生存能力，因为纯合子小鼠表现出严重出血和围产期死亡的致命表型，同时凝血功能受损。组织病理学和免疫组织化学分析表明 V 因子缺乏、凝血酶和 α-平滑肌肌动蛋白、pot 之间存在联系

articles.title: Structural ontogeny of protein-protein interactions.
articles.titleZh: 蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的结构个体发育。
articles.authors: Yang A, Jiang H, Jude KM, Akpinaroglu D, Allenspach S, Li AJ, Bowden J, Perez CP, Liu L, Huang PS, Kortemme T, Listgarten J, Garcia KC.
articles.abstract: Understanding how protein binding sites evolve interactions with other proteins could hold clues to targeting "undruggable" surfaces. We used synthetic coevolution to engineer new interactions between naïve surfaces, simulating the de novo formation of protein complexes. We isolated seven distinct structural families of protein Z-domain complexes and found that synthetic complexes explore multiple shallow energy wells through ratchet-like docking modes, whereas complexes formed by natural binding sites converged in a deep energy well with a relatively fixed geometry. Epistasis analysis of a machine learning-estimated fitness landscape revealed "seed" contacts between binding partners that anchored the earliest stages of encounter complex formation. Our results suggest that "silent" surfaces have a shallower energy landscape than natural binding sites, disfavoring tight binding, likely owing to evolutionary counterselection.
articles.abstractZh: 了解蛋白质结合位点如何进化与其他蛋白质的相互作用可以为靶向“不可成药”表面提供线索。我们使用合成协同进化来设计原始表面之间的新相互作用，模拟蛋白质复合物的从头形成。我们分离了蛋白质Z结构域复合物的七个不同结构家族，发现合成复合物通过棘轮状对接模式探索多个浅能量井，而由天然结合位点形成的复合物聚集在具有相对固定几何形状的深能量井中。对机器学习估计的适应度景观的上位分析揭示了结合伙伴之间的“种子”接触，这些接触锚定了遭遇复合体形成的最早阶段。我们的结果表明，“沉默”表面的能量景观比自然结合位点更浅，不利于紧密结合，这可能是由于进化的反选择。

articles.title: Structure and function of the yeast amino acid-sensing SEAC-EGOC supercomplex.
articles.titleZh: 酵母氨基酸感应 SEAC-EGOC 超复合物的结构和功能。
articles.authors: Tafur L, Bonadei L, Zheng Y, Gabus C, Loewith R.
articles.abstract: The Seh1-associated complex (SEAC; GATOR in mammals) transduces amino acid signals to the Target of Rapamycin Complex 1 (TORC1), a master regulator of cell growth. The SEAC is composed of two subcomplexes, SEACIT (GATOR1), an inhibitor of TORC1 that has GAP activity against Gtr1, and SEACAT (GATOR2), which appears to regulate SEACIT. However, the molecular details of this regulation are unclear. Here we determined the cryo-electron microscopy structure of the SEAC bound to its substrate, the EGOC (Ragulator-Rag), and studied its function in TORC1 amino acid signaling. A single SEAC can interact with two EGOC molecules via SEACIT, binding exclusively to the 'active' version of the EGOC, without involvement of SEACAT. The GAP activity of the SEACIT is essential for the regulation of TORC1 by amino acids and its loss phenocopies the lack of Gtr1-Gtr2, establishing the SEAC-EGOC complex as an amino acid-sensing hub. Compared to other SEACAT subunits, the loss of Sea2, or its N-terminal β-propeller domain, yielded strong defects in amino acid signaling to TORC1. Our results suggest that the Sea2 β-propeller recruits a GAP inhibitor to mediate fast amino acid signaling to TORC1, with additional pathways acting with slower kinetics.
articles.abstractZh: Seh1 相关复合物（SEAC；哺乳动物中的 GATOR）将氨基酸信号转导至雷帕霉素复合物 1 (TORC1) 的靶标，雷帕霉素复合物 1 (TORC1) 是细胞生长的主要调节因子。 SEAC 由两个子复合物组成：SEACIT (GATOR1)（一种 TORC1 抑制剂，对 Gtr1 具有 GAP 活性）和 SEACAT (GATOR2)（似乎调节 SEACIT）。然而，这种调节的分子细节尚不清楚。在这里，我们确定了与其底物 EGOC（Ragulator-Rag）结合的 SEAC 的冷冻电子显微镜结构，并研究了其在 TORC1 氨基酸信号传导中的功能。单个 SEAC 可以通过 SEACIT 与两个 EGOC 分子相互作用，仅与 EGOC 的“活性”版本结合，而无需 SEACAT 的参与。 SEACIT 的 GAP 活性对于氨基酸对 TORC1 的调节至关重要，其丧失表现出 Gtr1-Gtr2 缺乏的表现，从而将 SEAC-EGOC 复合体建立为氨基酸传感中枢。与其他 SEACAT 亚基相比，Sea2 或其 N 端 β-螺旋桨结构域的丢失导致 TORC1 的氨基酸信号传导存在严重缺陷。我们的结果表明 Sea2 β-螺旋桨招募 GAP 抑制剂来介导 TORC1 的快速氨基酸信号传导，并添加

articles.title: Targeted elimination of Staphylococcus aureus mastitis infections with synthetic phage-based CRISPR-Cas delivery systems.
articles.titleZh: 使用基于合成噬菌体的 CRISPR-Cas 递送系统有针对性地消除金黄色葡萄球菌乳腺炎感染。
articles.authors: Garmendia-Antoñana N, Dorado-Morales P, Gil C, García B, Echeverz M, Solano C, Penadés JR, Lasa I.
articles.abstract: Treatment options for Staphylococcus aureus infections are increasingly limited, particularly in livestock, where S. aureus causes mastitis requiring prolonged antibiotic therapy. This study engineered Phage Inducible Chromosomal Islands (ePICIs) to deliver CRISPR-Cas9 modules targeting small RNA genes. ePICIs exhibit bactericidal activity without chromosomal integration, an expanded host range compared to their parental phages, and biofilm-dependent efficacy influenced by the extracellular matrix composition. Biofilms mediated by the Bap protein strongly protect bacteria from ePICIs, whereas PIA/PNAG-based biofilms do not. Despite Bap-mediated protection in vitro, ePICIs achieved bactericidal effects comparable to vancomycin in a mouse mastitis model caused by Bap-producing strains. These findings reveal key factors affecting phage-delivered CRISPR-Cas efficacy and highlight that antibiofilm therapies should not be dismissed based solely on in vitro performance. Non-replicative ePICIs thus represent a promising alternative for treating localized infections such as mastitis.
articles.abstractZh: 金黄色葡萄球菌感染的治疗选择越来越有限，特别是在家畜中，金黄色葡萄球菌会引起乳腺炎，需要长期抗生素治疗。这项研究设计了噬菌体诱导染色体岛 (ePICIs)，以提供针对小 RNA 基因的 CRISPR-Cas9 模块。 ePICIs 表现出无需染色体整合的杀菌活性、与其亲代噬菌体相比扩大的宿主范围以及受细胞外基质成分影响的生物膜依赖性功效。由 Bap 蛋白介导的生物膜可以强有力地保护细菌免受 ePICIs 的侵害，而基于 PIA/PNAG 的生物膜则不能。尽管在体外存在 Bap 介导的保护作用，但 ePICIs 在由 Bap 产生菌株引起的小鼠乳腺炎模型中取得了与万古霉素相当的杀菌效果。这些发现揭示了影响噬菌体传递的 CRISPR-Cas 功效的关键因素，并强调不应仅根据体外表现而放弃抗生物膜疗法。因此，非复制性 ePICIs 代表了治疗乳腺炎等局部感染的一种有前途的替代方案。

articles.title: A dual role of <i>Arabidopsis</i> PAL nuclear localization in fine tuning flavonoid biosynthesis.
articles.titleZh: 拟南芥 PAL 核定位在微调类黄酮生物合成中的双重作用。
articles.authors: Sun L, Yang Z, Shan X, Wang N, Liu Z, Gao X, Gu Y, Zhao Q.
articles.abstract: The phenylpropanoid pathway is essential for plant development and environmental adaptation, producing metabolites such as flavonoids, lignin, and salicylic acid. Phenylalanine ammonia-lyase (PAL) catalyzes the first committed step in this pathway and has long been viewed as a cytoplasmic enzyme. Here, we reveal that PAL responds to elevated flavonoid levels in Arabidopsis by undergoing phosphorylation and relocating to the nucleus. Nuclear sequestration of PAL reduces its cytoplasmic abundance and enzymatic activity, resulting in rapid suppression of phenylpropanoid metabolic flux. In parallel, nuclear-localized PAL interacts with the transcription factor TT8, disrupting MBW complex formation and down-regulating flavonoid biosynthetic genes. This dual mechanism enables PAL to act as a metabolic feedback regulator that dynamically adjusts flavonoid production in response to internal metabolic states. Our findings redefine PAL as both a biosynthetic enzyme and a responsive integrator of cellular metabolic status, establishing a previously unknown paradigm for feedback control in plant specialized metabolism.
articles.abstractZh: 苯丙素途径对于植物发育和环境适应至关重要，可产生类黄酮、木质素和水杨酸等代谢物。苯丙氨酸解氨酶 (PAL) 催化该途径的第一个关键步骤，长期以来一直被视为一种细胞质酶。在这里，我们揭示了 PAL 通过磷酸化并重新定位到细胞核来响应拟南芥中升高的类黄酮水平。 PAL 的核隔离降低了其细胞质丰度和酶活性，导致苯丙素代谢通量的快速抑制。与此同时，核定位的 PAL 与转录因子 TT8 相互作用，破坏 MBW 复合物的形成并下调类黄酮生物合成基因。这种双重机制使 PAL 能够充当代谢反馈调节剂，根据内部代谢状态动态调整类黄酮的产生。我们的研究结果将 PAL 重新定义为生物合成酶和细胞代谢状态的响应整合器，建立了植物专门代谢中以前未知的反馈控制范例。

articles.title: Genome-wide discovery and phenotyping of non-coding transcripts in A. fumigatus reveals lncRNAs with a role in antifungal drug sensitivity.
articles.titleZh: 烟曲霉非编码转录本的全基因组发现和表型分析揭示了 lncRNA 在抗真菌药物敏感性中的作用。
articles.authors: Weaver D, Qi T, Chown H, Fraczek M, Lebedinec R, Dineen L, Valero C, van Rhijn N, Furukawa T, Bromley M, Delneri D, Bowyer P.
articles.abstract: Recent data suggests one fungus, Aspergillus fumigatus, causes more deaths annually than HIV or malaria combined. Coupled with rapid emergence of antifungal drug resistance, the limited range of effective treatments, and mortality rates of >50%, aspergillosis represents a major challenge in infectious diseases. Recent studies have identified long-noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs) involved in drug resistance and virulence in pathogenic yeasts such as Candida spp. However, there is very limited knowledge of lncRNAs in human pathogenic moulds, including A. fumigatus. Here we exploit transcriptomics data of A. fumigatus exposed to different environments to annotate transcripts mapping to 2388 genomic loci. After manual curation we generate a database of over 1000 lncRNAs. We observe that the lncRNAs display orchestrated transcriptional profiles upon drug treatment and many are proximal to genes involved in azole sensitivity.
