Our findings reveal that site-specific phosphorylation of LRP by PRP4KA precludes FLC gene loop formation, constituting a key mechanism for FLC transcriptional repression to ensure timely flowering.
articles.abstractZh: 新出现的证据表明，多种含有 RNA 识别基序 (RRM) 的蛋白质参与转录调控，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们发现先前未表征的晚花 RRM 含有蛋白 (LRP) 通过与其 5' 和 3' 基因组区域直接关联，阻止关键花抑制基因 FLOWERING LOCUS C (FLC) 的 5'-3' 染色质环。 LRP 功能的丧失导致 5'-3' 基因循环增加，FLC 基因座上的 RNA 聚合酶 II (Pol II) 占用减少，从而增加 FLC 转录并延迟拟南芥开花。此外，由激酶 PRP4KA 介导的 LRP 丝氨酸 17 位点特异性磷酸化对于 LRP 蛋白稳定性及其防止 FLC 染色质环化和 Pol II 募集的功能至关重要。我们的研究结果表明，PRP4KA 对 LRP 的位点特异性磷酸化阻止了 FLC 基因环的形成，构成了 FLC 转录抑制以确保及时开花的关键机制。

articles.title: Butyrolactol A enhances caspofungin efficacy via flippase inhibition in drug-resistant fungi.
articles.titleZh: 丁乳醇 A 通过抑制耐药真菌中的翻转酶来增强卡泊芬净的疗效。
articles.authors: Chen X, Duan HD, Hoy MJ, Koteva K, Spitzer M, Guitor AK, Puumala E, Fiebig AA, Hu G, Yiu B, Chou S, Bian Z, Choi Y, Guo ABY, Wang W, Sun S, Robbins N, Averette AF, Cook MA, Truant R, MacNeil LT, Brown ED, Kronstad JW, Coombes BK, Cowen LE, Heitman J, Li H, Wright GD.
articles.abstract: Fungal infections cause millions of deaths annually and are challenging to treat due to limited therapeutic options and rising resistance. Cryptococci are intrinsically resistant to the latest generation of antifungals, echinocandins, while Candida auris, a notorious global threat, is also increasingly resistant. We performed a natural product screen to rescue caspofungin fungicidal activity against Cryptococcus neoformans H99 and identified butyrolactol A, which restores echinocandin efficacy against resistant fungal pathogens, including multidrug-resistant C. auris. Mode-of-action studies reveal that butyrolactol A inhibits the phospholipid flippase Apt1-Cdc50, blocking phospholipid transport. Cryo-electron microscopy analysis of the Apt1-butyrolactol A complex reveals that the flippase is trapped in a dead-end state. Apt1 inhibition disrupts membrane asymmetry, vesicular trafficking, and cytoskeletal organization, thereby enhancing echinocandin uptake and potency. This study identifies lipid flippases as promising antifungal targets and demonstrates the potential of revisiting natural products to expand the antifungal arsenal and combat resistance.
articles.abstractZh: 真菌感染每年导致数百万人死亡，并且由于治疗选择有限和耐药性不断上升，治疗具有挑战性。隐球菌对最新一代抗真菌药物棘白菌素具有内在耐药性，而臭名昭著的全球威胁念珠菌的耐药性也越来越强。我们进行了天然产物筛选，以挽救卡泊芬净对新型隐球菌 H99 的杀菌活性，并鉴定出丁内酯 A，它可以恢复棘白菌素对耐药真菌病原体（包括多重耐药耳念珠菌）的功效。作用模式研究表明丁乳醇 A 抑制磷脂翻转酶 Apt1-Cdc50，从而阻断磷脂转运。 Apt1-丁内酯 A 复合物的冷冻电镜分析表明翻转酶处于死端状态。 Apt1 抑制会破坏膜不对称性、囊泡运输和细胞骨架组织，从而增强棘白菌素的摄取和效力。这项研究将脂质翻转酶确定为有前途的抗真菌靶点，并证明了重新审视天然产物以扩大抗真菌库和对抗耐药性的潜力。

articles.title: HP1β recruits RING1A to ubiquitinate histone H2A for BRCA1-mediated resection of double-stand breaks.
articles.titleZh: HP1β 招募 RING1A 泛素化组蛋白 H2A，以实现 BRCA1 介导的双链断裂切除。
articles.authors: Charaka V, Pandita RK, Tsai CL, Wang X, Chakraborty S, Ramos KS, Nandi S, Leonard F, Singh V, Sarkar PS, Hunt CR, Tainer JA, Das C, Pandita TK.
articles.abstract: Efficient DNA double-strand break (DSB) repair by homologous recombination (HR), as initiated by BRCA1 recruitment orchestrated by histone and non-histone proteins, is critical to genome stability, replication, transcription, and cancer avoidance. Here we reveal Heterochromatin Protein1 beta (HP1β) promotes BRCA1 enrichment at DNA DSB sites in gene-rich regions, and this is impaired by HP1β depletion. We find that HP1β is specifically enriched at DSBs within gene-rich regions via its Chromo Shadow Domain (CSD) that interacts with both Chromatin Assembly Factor 1 and the RING1A ubiquitinase component of Polycomb Repressor Complex 1. The resulting protein complex facilitates BRCA1 recruitment by promoting H2A lysine 119 ubiquitination. Collective findings reveal a novel mechanism whereby HP1β interactions, mediated through its CSD of HP1β interaction with RING1A, promotes H2AK119 ubiquitination to facilitate BRCA1 recruitment and orchestrate efficient HR and CtIP-dependent DNA resection at DSB sites in gene-rich active chromatin.
articles.abstractZh: 由组蛋白和非组蛋白精心策划的 BRCA1 募集启动，通过同源重组 (HR) 进行有效的 DNA 双链断裂 (DSB) 修复，对于基因组稳定性、复制、转录和癌症避免至关重要。在这里，我们揭示了异染色质蛋白 1 beta (HP1β) 促进基因丰富区域中 DNA DSB 位点的 BRCA1 富集，而 HP1β 耗尽会损害这种富集。我们发现 HP1β 通过其染色质阴影结构域 (CSD) 在基因丰富区域内的 DSB 上特异性富集，该结构域与染色质组装因子 1 和 Polycomb 阻遏复合物 1 的 RING1A 泛素酶成分相互作用。由此产生的蛋白质复合物通过促进 H2A 赖氨酸 119 泛素化来促进 BRCA1 募集。集体研究结果揭示了一种新机制，通过 HP1β 与 RING1A 相互作用的 CSD 介导 HP1β 相互作用，促进 H2AK119 泛素化，以促进 BRCA1 招募，并在富含基因的活性染色质的 DSB 位点协调高效的 HR 和 CtIP 依赖​​性 DNA 切除。

articles.title: Mechanical forces regulate the composition and fate of stalled nascent chains.
articles.titleZh: 机械力调节停滞的新生链的组成和命运。
articles.authors: Khan D, Vinayak AA, Sitron CS, Brandman O.
articles.abstract: The ribosome-associated quality control (RQC) pathway resolves stalled ribosomes. As part of RQC, stalled nascent polypeptide chains (NCs) are appended with CArboxy-Terminal amino acid tails (CAT tails) in an mRNA-free, non-canonical elongation process. The relationship between CAT tail composition (alanine [Ala] and threonine [Thr] in yeast) and function has remained unknown. Using biochemical approaches in yeast, we discovered that mechanical forces on the NC regulate CAT tailing. We propose that CAT tailing initially operates in "extrusion mode," which increases NC lysine accessibility for on-ribosome ubiquitylation. Thr in CAT tails prevents the formation of polyalanine, which forms α-helices that lower extrusion efficiency and disrupt termination of CAT tailing. After NC ubiquitylation, pulling forces on the NC switch CAT tailing to an Ala-only "release mode," which facilitates NC release and degradation. Failure to switch from extrusion to release mode leads to the accumulation of NCs on large ribosomal subunits and proteotoxic aggregation of Thr-rich CAT tails.
articles.abstractZh: 核糖体相关质量控制 (RQC) 途径可解决停滞的核糖体问题。作为 RQC 的一部分，停滞的新生多肽链 (NC) 在无 mRNA、非规范的延伸过程中附加 CArboxy 末端氨基酸尾（CAT 尾）。 CAT 尾部组成（酵母中的丙氨酸 [Ala] 和苏氨酸 [Thr]）与功能之间的关系仍然未知。利用酵母中的生化方法，我们发现 NC 上的机械力可调节 CAT 拖尾。我们建议 CAT 加尾最初以“挤出模式”运行，这增加了核糖体上泛素化的 NC 赖氨酸可及性。 CAT 尾部中的苏氨酸可防止聚丙氨酸的形成，而聚丙氨酸会形成 α-螺旋，从而降低挤出效率并破坏 CAT 尾部的终止。 NC 泛素化后，NC 上的拉力将 CAT 转变为仅 Ala 的“释放模式”，这有利于 NC 的释放和降解。未能从挤出模式切换到释放模式会导致 NC 在大核糖体亚基上的积累以及富含苏氨酸的 CAT 尾部的蛋白毒性聚集。

articles.title: Pyramiding elite alleles of the genetically linked OsNRAMP5 and OsHMA3 confers low Cd accumulation in rice grains without compromising stress tolerance.
articles.titleZh: 基因连锁的 OsNRAMP5 和 OsHMA3 的金字塔精英等位基因使水稻籽粒中的镉积累量较低，而不影响胁迫耐受性。
articles.authors: Tang L, Wang J, Ji Z, Li X, Liu X, Lv Q, Wei P, Hu X, Li Y, Mao B, Shao Y, Peng Y, Wei Z, Bai L, Chen C, Zhao B.
articles.abstract: Excessive cadmium (Cd) accumulation in rice grains poses a serious threat to food security. Cd uptake by roots and its subsequent transport to grains are mediated by mineral element transporters in rice. Consequently, efforts to reduce Cd accumulation are often accompanied by unintended decreases in essential mineral elements. Achieving a substantial reduction in grain Cd concentrations while maintaining appropriate levels of mineral elements therefore remains a major bottleneck in low-Cd rice breeding. Here, we report that pyramiding elite alleles of OsNRAMP5 and OsHMA3, two key genes encoding Cd transporters, confers low Cd accumulation in grains without inducing sensitivity to manganese (Mn) deficiency in Layandabu (LAA), a tropical japonica rice cultivar. A serine-to-phenylalanine substitution at position 313 in OsNRAMP5LAA weakens its interaction with OsVAP1-3, a vesicle-associated membrane protein (VAMP)-associated protein that facilitates OsNRAMP5 export from the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) to the plasma membrane. This weakened interaction results in partial retention of OsNRAMP5LAA in the ER, thereby reducing Cd and Mn uptake. Introgression of the linked OsNRAMP5LAA and OsHMA3LAA alleles into the commercial rice cultivar Wushansimiao markedly reduced Cd concentrations in brown rice grown in Cd-contaminated fields without incurring a yield penalty, even under combined heat and low-Mn stress. Thus, our findings provide mechanistic insights into how low-Cd accumulation can be balanced with stress resilience and offer a promising strategy for developing rice cultivars with low-Cd grains and broad environmental adaptability.
articles.abstractZh: 稻米中镉（Cd）的过量积累对粮食安全构成严重威胁。根部对镉的吸收及其随后向谷物的转运是由水稻中的矿物元素转运蛋白介导的。因此，减少镉积累的努力常常伴随着必需矿物元素的意外减少。因此，在保持适当矿质元素水平的同时实现籽粒镉浓度的大幅降低仍然是低镉水稻育种的主要瓶颈。在这里，我们报道了 OsNRAMP5 和 OsHMA3（编码 Cd 转运蛋白的两个关键基因）的金字塔精英等位基因，在热带粳稻品种 Layandabu (LAA) 中赋予了籽粒中较低的 Cd 积累，而不诱导对锰 (Mn) 缺乏的敏感性。 OsNRAMP5LAA 313 位的丝氨酸取代为苯丙氨酸，削弱了其与 OsVAP1-3 的相互作用，OsVAP1-3 是一种囊泡相关膜蛋白 (VAMP) 相关蛋白，可促进 OsNRAMP5 从内质网 (ER) 输出到质膜。这种减弱的相互作用导致 OsNRAMP5LAA 部分保留在 ER 中，从而减少 Cd 和 Mn 的吸收。相连的 OsNRAMP5LAA 和 OsHM 的渗入

articles.title: RNA-coupled CRISPR screens reveal ZNF207 as a regulator of LMNA aberrant splicing in progeria.
articles.titleZh: RNA 偶联 CRISPR 筛选揭示 ZNF207 作为早衰症 LMNA 异常剪接的调节因子。
articles.authors: Behera AK, Kim JJ, Kordale S, Pekovic F, Damodaran AP, Kumari B, Vidak S, Dickson E, Xiao MS, Duncan G, Andresson T, Misteli T, Valkov E, Gonatopoulos-Pournatzis T.
articles.abstract: Despite progress in understanding pre-mRNA splicing, the regulatory mechanisms controlling most alternative splicing events remain unclear. We developed CRASP-seq (CRISPR-based identification of regulators of alternative splicing with phenotypic sequencing), a method that integrates pooled CRISPR-based genetic perturbations with deep sequencing of splicing reporters, to quantitatively assess the impact of all human genes on alternative splicing from a single RNA sample. CRASP-seq identified both known and untested regulators, enriched for proteins involved in RNA splicing and metabolism. As a proof-of-concept, CRASP-seq analysis of the LMNA cryptic splicing event linked to progeria uncovered ZNF207, primarily known for mitotic spindle assembly, as a regulator of progerin splicing. ZNF207 depletion enhances canonical LMNA splicing and decreases progerin protein levels in patient-derived cells. We further show that ZNF207's zinc-finger domain broadly impacts alternative splicing through direct interactions with U1 small nuclear ribonucleoprotein (snRNP) components. These findings position ZNF207 as a U1 snRNP auxiliary factor and demonstrate the power of CRASP-seq to uncover key regulators and domains of alternative splicing.
articles.abstractZh: 尽管在理解前 mRNA 剪接方面取得了进展，但控制大多数选择性剪接事件的调节机制仍不清楚。我们开发了 CRASP-seq（基于 CRISPR 的表型测序选择性剪接调节因子识别），这是一种将基于 CRISPR 的遗传扰动与剪接报告基因深度测序相结合的方法，可定量评估单个 RNA 样本中所有人类基因对选择性剪接的影响。 CRASP-seq 鉴定了已知和未经测试的调节因子，富含参与 RNA 剪接和代谢的蛋白质。作为概念验证，对与早衰相关的 LMNA 神秘剪接事件进行 CRASP-seq 分析，发现 ZNF207（主要以有丝分裂纺锤体组装而闻名）是早衰蛋白剪接的调节因子。 ZNF207 耗竭增强了经典 LMNA 剪接并降低了患者来源细胞中的早老素蛋白水平。我们进一步表明，ZNF207 的锌指结构域通过与 U1 小核核糖核蛋白 (snRNP) 成分的直接相互作用广泛影响选择性剪接。这些发现将 ZNF207 定位为 U1 snRNP 辅助因子，并证明 CRASP-seq 揭示关键调控因子的能力

articles.title: Microbial collagenase activity is linked to oral-gut translocation in advanced chronic liver disease.
articles.titleZh: 微生物胶原酶活性与晚期慢性肝病的口腔肠道易位有关。
articles.authors: Jin S, Cenier A, Wetzel D, Arefaine B, Moreno-Gonzalez M, Stamouli M, Mohamad M, Lupatsii M, Ríos E, Lee S, Zamalloa A, Chokshi S, Mardinoglu A, Shoaie S, Beraza N, Patel VC, Schirmer M.
articles.abstract: Microbiome perturbations are associated with advanced chronic liver disease (ACLD), but how microorganisms contribute to disease mechanisms is unclear. Here we analysed metagenomes of paired saliva and faecal samples from an ACLD cohort of 86 individuals, plus 2 control groups of 52 healthy individuals and 14 patients with sepsis. We identified highly similar oral and gut bacterial strains, including Veillonella and Streptococcus spp., which increased in absolute abundance in the gut of patients with ACLD compared with controls. These microbial translocators uniquely share a prtC gene encoding a collagenase-like proteinase, and its faecal abundance was a robust ACLD biomarker (area under precision-recall curve = 0.91). A mouse model of hepatic fibrosis inoculated with Veillonella and Streptococcus prtC-encoding patient isolates showed exacerbation of gut barrier impairment and hepatic fibrosis. Furthermore, faecal collagenase activity was increased in patients with ACLD and experimentally confirmed for the prtC gene of translocating Veillonella parvula. These findings establish mechanistic links between oral-gut translocation and ACLD pathobiology.
articles.abstractZh: 微生物组扰动与晚期慢性肝病 (ACLD) 相关，但微生物如何影响疾病机制尚不清楚。在这里，我们分析了来自 86 名 ACLD 队列的配对唾液和粪便样本的宏基因组，以及 2 个对照组（52 名健康个体和 14 名脓毒症患者）。我们发现了高度相似的口腔和肠道细菌菌株，包括韦荣球菌属和链球菌属，与对照组相比，ACLD 患者肠道中的绝对丰度增加。这些微生物易位子独特地共享一个编码胶原酶样蛋白酶的 prtC 基因，其粪便丰度是一个强大的 ACLD 生物标志物（精确回忆曲线下面积 = 0.91）。接种编码韦荣球菌和链球菌 prtC 的患者分离株的肝纤维化小鼠模型显示，肠道屏障损伤和肝纤维化加剧。此外，ACLD 患者粪便胶原酶活性增加，实验证实了小韦荣球菌易位的 prtC 基因。这些发现建立了口腔肠道易位与 ACLD 病理学之间的机制联系。

articles.title: CK1δ-dependent SNAPIN dysregulation drives lysosomal failure in HIV-1 Vpr-exposed neurons: A targetable mechanism in HAND.
articles.titleZh: CK1δ 依赖性 SNAPIN 失调导致 HIV-1 Vpr 暴露神经元溶酶体衰竭：HAND 中的一种可靶向机制。
articles.authors: Sawaya BE, Santerre M.
articles.abstract: HIV-associated neurocognitive disorders (HANDs) persist in nearly 40% of virally suppressed individuals despite antiretroviral therapy (ART). Lysosomal dysfunction has emerged as a key contributor to HAND pathogenesis, yet the molecular mechanisms linking chronic HIV exposure to impaired neuronal degradation remain incompletely defined. Here, we identify HIV-1 viral protein R (Vpr) as a driver of lysosomal acidification failure, clustering, and degradative impairment in neurons. We report casein kinase 1 delta (CK1δ) as a central mediator of this dysfunction, acting via phosphorylation of the adapter protein SNAPIN. Vpr-induced CK1δ activation leads to hyperphosphorylation of SNAPIN, disrupting lysosomal positioning and motility. These defects are rescued by selective CK1δ inhibition, which restores lysosomal acidification, positioning, and mitophagy. Our findings define a Vpr-CK1δ-SNAPIN axis that contributes to HANDs and highlight lysosomal transport as a targetable mechanism in neurodegeneration.
articles.abstractZh: 尽管接受了抗逆转录病毒治疗 (ART)，但近 40% 的病毒抑制个体仍然存在与 HIV 相关的神经认知障碍 (HAND)。溶酶体功能障碍已成为 HAND 发病机制的关键因素，但将慢性 HIV 暴露与受损神经元退化联系起来的分子机制仍未完全确定。在这里，我们确定 HIV-1 病毒蛋白 R (Vpr) 是神经元溶酶体酸化失败、聚集和降解损伤的驱动因素。我们报告酪蛋白激酶 1 δ (CK1δ) 作为这种功能障碍的中心介质，通过接头蛋白 SNAPIN 的磷酸化发挥作用。 Vpr 诱导的 CK1δ 激活导致 SNAPIN 过度磷酸化，破坏溶酶体定位和运动。这些缺陷可以通过选择性 CK1δ 抑制来修复，从而恢复溶酶体酸化、定位和线粒体自噬。我们的研究结果定义了一个 Vpr-CK1δ-SNAPIN 轴，该轴有助于 HAND，并强调溶酶体转运作为神经退行性疾病的一种可靶向机制。

articles.title: Directed evolution of a staphylophage under biofilm and planktonic conditions.
articles.titleZh: 生物膜和浮游条件下葡萄球菌的定向进化。
articles.authors: Valdivia C, Domingo-Calap P.
articles.abstract: The rise of multidrug-resistant bacteria, particularly biofilm-forming pathogens such as Staphylococcus epidermidis, highlights the urgent need for alternative antimicrobial strategies. Phage therapy, which uses phages to selectively infect and lyse bacterial cells, offers a promising solution. In this study, we evolved the lytic phage vB_Sep_Steph1 under both biofilm and planktonic conditions, using varying initial phage inoculum titers. Whole-genome sequencing of evolved populations revealed recurrent condition-dependent mutations in holins and structural genes with putative depolymerase activity-critical for host recognition and biofilm degradation. Phenotypic improvements in traits such as antibacterial efficacy and replicative fitness were observed to be highly dependent on both the presence of biofilm and the initial phage titer during evolution. Furthermore, some evolved phage lineages could delay bacterial resistance better than the ancestral strain. These findings support the utility of directed phage evolution to improve therapeutic efficacy and robustness, particularly against biofilm-associated infections.
articles.abstractZh: 多重耐药细菌，特别是表皮葡萄球菌等生物膜形成病原体的兴起，凸显了对替代抗菌策略的迫切需要。噬菌体疗法利用噬菌体选择性感染和裂解细菌细胞，提供了一种有前景的解决方案。在这项研究中，我们使用不同的初始噬菌体接种滴度，在生物膜和浮游条件下进化了裂解噬菌体 vB_Sep_Steph1。进化群体的全基因组测序揭示了穴蛋白和结构基因中反复发生的条件依赖性突变，这些突变具有推定的解聚酶活性，这对于宿主识别和生物膜降解至关重要。据观察，抗菌功效和复制适应性等性状的表型改善高度依赖于生物膜的存在和进化过程中初始噬菌体滴度。此外，一些进化的噬菌体谱系可以比祖先菌株更好地延迟细菌耐药性。这些发现支持定向噬菌体进化在提高治疗功效和稳健性方面的实用性，特别是针对生物膜相关感染。

articles.title: Candida auris skin tropism and antifungal resistance are mediated by carbonic anhydrase Nce103.
articles.titleZh: 耳念珠菌的趋肤性和抗真菌耐药性由碳酸酐酶 Nce103 介导。
articles.authors: Phan-Canh T, Coman C, Lackner M, Troppmair N, Müller C, Cerbu D, Seiser S, Penninger P, Tsymala I, Khunweeraphong N, Bitencourt T, Knarr A, Jenull S, Arzani H, Zenz LM, Ianiri G, Chen W, Chowdhary A, Mobley HLT, Hartl M, Moser D, Ahrends R, Elbe-Bürger A, Kuchler K.
articles.abstract: The pronounced skin tropism and pan-antifungal resistance of Candida auris pose a serious global health threat. A key question in C. auris biology is how clinical isolates acquire amphotericin B resistance. Here we demonstrate that a carbonic sensing pathway (CSP) contributes to amphotericin B resistance by modulating mitochondrial energy functions in clinical C. auris isolates. Integrated transcriptomics and proteomics identify the carbonic anhydrase Nce103 and its transcription factors Rca1 and Efg1 as important regulatory components of the CSP. The conversion of CO2 into bicarbonate sustains energy metabolism required for colonization and fitness on human skin and in nutrient-limited microenvironments. We also show that bacterial skin colonizers engage urease to release CO2 that sustains C. auris fitness and skin colonization. These findings highlight therapeutic options to re-sensitize C. auris to antifungal treatments, as well as to prevent skin colonization by blocking the CSP.
articles.abstractZh: 耳念珠菌明显的皮肤亲和性和泛抗真菌耐药性对全球健康构成严重威胁。耳念珠菌生物学的一个关键问题是临床分离株如何获得两性霉素 B 耐药性。在这里，我们证明了碳传感途径（CSP）通过调节临床耳念珠菌分离株的线粒体能量功能来促进两性霉素 B 耐药性。综合转录组学和蛋白质组学将碳酸酐酶 Nce103 及其转录因子 Rca1 和 Efg1 确定为 CSP 的重要调控组件。二氧化碳转化为碳酸氢盐可维持人体皮肤和营养有限的微环境中定植和健康所需的能量代谢。我们还表明，细菌皮肤定殖者利用脲酶释放二氧化碳，维持耳念珠菌的健康和皮肤定殖。这些发现强调了使耳念珠菌重新对抗真菌治疗敏感以及通过阻断 CSP 来防止皮肤定植的治疗选择。

articles.title: MMonitor for real-time monitoring of microbial communities using long reads.
articles.titleZh: MMonitor 使用长读数实时监测微生物群落。
articles.authors: Lucas TN, Biehain U, Gautam A, Gemeinhardt K, Lass T, Konzalla S, Ley RE, Angenent LT, Huson DH.
articles.abstract: Real-time monitoring of microbial communities offers valuable insights into microbial dynamics across diverse environments. However, many existing metagenome analysis tools require advanced computational expertise and are not designed for monitoring. We present MMonitor, an open-source software platform for real-time analysis and visualization of metagenomic Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) sequencing data. MMonitor includes two components: a desktop application for running bioinformatics pipelines through a graphical user interface (GUI) or command-line interface (CLI) and a web-based dashboard for interactive result inspection. The dashboard provides taxonomic composition over time, quality scores, diversity indices, and taxonomy-metadata correlations. Integrated pipelines enable automated de novo assembly and reconstruction of metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs). To validate MMonitor, we tracked human gut microbial populations in three bioreactors using 16S rRNA gene sequencing and applied it to whole-genome sequencing (WGS) data to generate high-quality annotated MAGs. We compare MMonitor with other real-time metagenomic tools, outlining their strengths and limitations.
articles.abstractZh: 微生物群落的实时监测为了解不同环境中的微生物动态提供了宝贵的见解。然而，许多现有的宏基因组分析工具需要先进的计算专业知识，并且不是为监测而设计的。我们推出了 MMonitor，这是一个开源软件平台，用于宏基因组牛津纳米孔技术 (ONT) 测序数据的实时分析和可视化。 MMonitor 包括两个组件：一个用于通过图形用户界面 (GUI) 或命令行界面 (CLI) 运行生物信息学管道的桌面应用程序，以及一个用于交互式结果检查的基于 Web 的仪表板。该仪表板提供了随时间变化的分类组成、质量得分、多样性指数和分类元数据相关性。集成管道可实现宏基因组组装基因组 (MAG) 的自动化从头组装和重建。为了验证 MMonitor，我们使用 16S rRNA 基因测序追踪了三个生物反应器中的人类肠道微生物种群，并将其应用于全基因组测序 (WGS) 数据，以生成高质量的带注释的 MAG。我们将 MMonitor 与其他实时宏基因组工具进行比较，概述它们的优点和局限性。

articles.title: Otubain deubiquitinases: Multi-layered regulators of cell fate, development, and stress responses across kingdoms.
articles.titleZh: Otubain 去泛素酶：细胞命运、发育和跨界应激反应的多层调节因子。
articles.authors: Yang J, Zhang Y, Wang Q, Liu H.
articles.abstract: Otubain deubiquitinating enzymes are pivotal regulators of cell fate, development, and stress responses across animals, plants, and fungi. This review highlights their conserved and pleiotropic functions in orchestrating proteostasis, organogenesis, immune modulation, metabolic adaptation, and stress tolerance. Mechanistically, Otubains operate in both enzyme-dependent and -independent manner, modulating key processes including ubiquitin-proteasome-mediated degradation, DNA damage repair, autophagy, and cell death. Notably, Otubains are subject to multi-layered regulations, including epigenetic, transcriptional, post-transcriptional, and post-translational modifications, as well as RNA-mediated scaffolding. In plants, Otubain homologs control grain size and organ morphogenesis, while in fungi, they mediate stress responses and sexual development. These findings underscore the cross-kingdom conservation of Otubain function and reveal their potential as universal modulators. Furthermore, Otubains represent promising targets for therapeutic intervention, crop improvement, and pathogen management. This review synthesizes recent advances in Otubain biology, emphasizing integrative regulatory networks and translational potential, while highlighting key unresolved questions about their functional diversity.
articles.abstractZh: Otubain 去泛素化酶是动物、植物和真菌细胞命运、发育和应激反应的关键调节因子。这篇综述强调了它们在协调蛋白质稳态、器官发生、免疫调节、代谢适应和应激耐受方面的保守和多效性功能。从机制上讲，Otubains 以酶依赖性和非酶依赖性方式发挥作用，调节关键过程，包括泛素蛋白酶体介导的降解、DNA 损伤修复、自噬和细胞死亡。值得注意的是，Otubains 受到多层次的调控，包括表观遗传、转录、转录后和翻译后修饰，以及 RNA 介导的支架。在植物中，Otubain 同源物控制颗粒大小和器官形态发生，而在真菌中，它们介导应激反应和性发育。这些发现强调了 Otubain 功能的跨界保守性，并揭示了它们作为通用调节剂的潜力。此外，Otubains 代表了治疗干预、作物改良和病原体管理的有希望的目标。这篇综述综合了 Otubain 生物学的最新进展，强调了综合调节

articles.title: The CCCH-tandem zinc-finger protein OsTZF1 positively regulates basal immunity but suppresses Piz-t-mediated blast resistance in rice.
articles.titleZh: CCCH-串联锌指蛋白 OsTZF1 正向调节水稻的基础免疫，但抑制 Piz-t 介导的稻瘟病抗性。
articles.authors: You X, Long J, Wang R, Hou X, Wang J, Huang X, Wang M, Xu X, He F, Hu H, Hao Z, Tao H, Ning Y.
articles.abstract: Plant nucleotide-binding leucine-rich repeat (NLR) immune receptors play a critical role in plant defense, but the mechanisms regulating their expression remain incompletely understood. Here, we report that the rice CCCH-tandem zinc-finger protein OsTZF1 interacts with both AvrPiz-t interacting protein 10 (APIP10) and the NLR protein Piz-t. OsTZF1 positively regulates rice immunity by increasing the transcript levels of OsSGT1 and OsKS4 through binding to the AAAGC motif. However, in Piz-t-carrying plants, knockout of OsTZF1 results in increased Piz-t transcript and protein levels, thus enhancing resistance to virulent strains of Magnaporthe oryzae without a growth penalty. Furthermore, we demonstrate that OsTZF1 can directly bind to the AAAGC motif of Piz-t, thereby repressing its expression level. Thus, OsTZF1 functions as a dual regulator: it activates general defense genes while suppressing Piz-t-mediated resistance to virulent strains, balancing resistance and growth. These findings reveal a strategy for engineering NLR-mediated resistance in crops by fine-tuning immune regulators to achieve both disease resistance and yield stability.
articles.abstractZh: 植物核苷酸结合富含亮氨酸重复序列（NLR）免疫受体在植物防御中发挥着关键作用，但调节其表达的机制仍不完全清楚。在这里，我们报道水稻 CCCH 串联锌指蛋白 OsTZF1 与 AvrPiz-t 相互作用蛋白 10 (APIP10) 和 NLR 蛋白 Piz-t 相互作用。 OsTZF1 通过与 AAAGC 基序结合增加 OsSGT1 和 OsKS4 的转录水平，从而正向调节水稻免疫。然而，在携带 Piz-t 的植物中，敲除 OsTZF1 会导致 Piz-t 转录物和蛋白质水平增加，从而增强对稻瘟病菌强毒菌株的抗性，而不会影响生长。此外，我们证明OsTZF1可以直接结合Piz-t的AAAGC基序，从而抑制其表达水平。因此，OsTZF1 发挥双重调节作用：它激活一般防御基因，同时抑制 Piz-t 介导的对强毒菌株的抗性，平衡抗性和生长。这些发现揭示了一种通过微调免疫调节剂来设计作物 NLR 介导的抗性的策略，以实现抗病性和产量稳定性。

articles.title: Microbiome dysbiosis and chemotherapy resistance in acute myeloid leukemia (AML).
articles.titleZh: 急性髓系白血病（AML）的微生物群失调和化疗耐药。
articles.authors: Tian M, Soleimani Samarkhazan H, Alemohammad SS, Manesh MF, Tavakoli F, Shams A, Zeynalabadi A.
articles.abstract: AML often relapses due to chemotherapy resistance, increasingly linked to gut microbiome dysbiosis. Microbial drug modification, immune modulation, and metabolite-driven survival/epigenetic changes (e.g., SCFAs, kynurenine) promote resistance. Clinical data associate reduced diversity, loss of Faecalibacterium, and Enterococcus overgrowth with poorer outcomes. Microbiome interventions (FMT, probiotics, diet) show promise; priorities are standardizing methods and defining microbe-metabolite mechanisms to guide trials.
articles.abstractZh: AML 经常因化疗耐药而复发，这与肠道微生物群失调越来越相关。微生物药物修饰、免疫调节和代谢物驱动的生存/表观遗传变化（例如 SCFA、犬尿氨酸）会促进耐药性。临床数据表明，多样性降低、粪杆菌丧失和肠球菌过度生长与较差的结果相关。微生物组干预措施（FMT、益生菌、饮食）显示出希望；优先事项是标准化方法和定义微生物代谢机制以指导试验。

articles.title: Microplastic biofilm as hotspots of antibiotic resistance genes and potential pathogens.
articles.titleZh: 微塑料生物膜作为抗生素抗性基因和潜在病原体的热点。
articles.authors: Zhang X, Dong Z, Zhang S, Ma J, Liu S.
articles.abstract: Microplastic biofilms, known as the "plastisphere", harbor diverse microbial communities and serve as reservoirs for antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs). This review discussed the mechanisms driving bacterial community alteration on microplastics and delineated the pathways through which ARGs transfer within microplastic biofilms. We expected to provide a comprehensive understanding of the ecological and human health impacts associated with microplastic biofilms and ARGs, thereby informing strategies to mitigate plastic pollution and its risks.
articles.abstractZh: 微塑料生物膜，被称为“塑料球”，蕴藏着多种微生物群落，是抗生素抗性基因（ARG）的储存库。这篇综述讨论了微塑料上细菌群落变化的驱动机制，并描述了 ARG 在微塑料生物膜内转移的途径。我们希望全面了解与微塑料生物膜和 ARG 相关的生态和人类健康影响，从而为减轻塑料污染及其风险的策略提供信息。

articles.title: NAC controls nascent chain fate through tunnel sensing and chaperone action.
articles.titleZh: NAC 通过隧道传感和伴侣作用来控制新生链的命运。
articles.authors: Lee JH, Rabl L, Gamerdinger M, Goyal V, Khakzar KM, Barbosa NM, Abramovich J, Morales-Polanco F, Köhler AK, Samatova E, Rodnina MV, Deuerling E, Frydman J.
articles.abstract: The nascent polypeptide-associated complex (NAC) is a conserved ribosome-bound factor with essential yet incompletely understood roles in protein biogenesis1. Here we show that NAC is a multi-faceted regulator that coordinates translation elongation, co-translational folding and organelle targeting through distinct interactions with nascent polypeptides both inside and outside the ribosome exit tunnel. Using NAC-selective ribosome profiling in Caenorhabditis elegans, we identify thousands of sequence-specific NAC binding events across the nascent proteome, revealing broad co-translational engagement with hydrophobic and helical motifs in cytosolic, nuclear, endoplasmic reticulum and mitochondrial proteins. Unexpectedly, we discover an intra-tunnel-sensing mode in which NAC engages ribosomes with extremely short nascent polypeptides inside the exit tunnel in a sequence-specific manner. Moreover, initial NAC interactions induce an early elongation slowdown that tunes ribosome flux and prevent ribosome collisions, linking the chaperone activity of NAC to kinetic control of translation. We propose that NAC action protects aggregation-prone intermediates by shielding amphipathic helices, thus promoting cytonuclear folding. NAC also supports mitochondrial membrane protein biogenesis and endoplasmic reticulum targeting by early recognition of signal sequences and transmembrane domains. Our findings establish NAC as an early-acting, multi-faceted orchestrator of co-translational proteostasis, with distinct mechanisms of action on nascent chains depending on their sequence features and subcellular destinations.
articles.abstractZh: 新生多肽相关复合物 (NAC) 是一种保守的核糖体结合因子，在蛋白质生物发生中具有重要但尚未完全了解的作用。在这里，我们证明 NAC 是一种多面调节剂，通过与核糖体出口通道内外的新生多肽的不同相互作用来协调翻译延伸、共翻译折叠和细胞器靶向。使用秀丽隐杆线虫中的 NAC 选择性核糖体分析，我们在新生蛋白质组中鉴定了数千个序列特异性 NAC 结合事件，揭示了与胞质、核、内质网和线粒体蛋白中疏水和螺旋基序的广泛共翻译参与。出乎意料的是，我们发现了一种隧道内传感模式，其中 NAC 以序列特异性方式在出口隧道内将核糖体与极短的新生多肽结合。此外，最初的 NAC 相互作用会诱导早期延伸减慢，从而调节核糖体通量并防止核糖体碰撞，将 NAC 的伴侣活性与翻译的动力学控制联系起来。我们提出 NAC 作用通过屏蔽两亲性螺旋来保护易于聚集的中间体

articles.title: Protocol for marker-free genome editing in Saccharomyces cerevisiae using universal donor templates and multiplexed CRISPR-Cas9.
articles.titleZh: 使用通用供体模板和多重 CRISPR-Cas9 在酿酒酵母中进行无标记基因组编辑的协议。
articles.authors: Hemani D, Grissom JH, Chi RJ.
articles.abstract: Here, we present a protocol for marker-free genome editing in Saccharomyces cerevisiae by combining PCR-based selectable marker cassettes with CRISPR-Cas9. We describe steps for generating gene deletions using MX6 markers and excising the markers by introducing a reusable guide RNA (gRNA)-Cas9 plasmid and universal repair templates, allowing multiplex removal in a single step. Final verification by PCR yields marker-free strains that can be iteratively edited using the same selectable markers. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to Grissom et al.1.
articles.abstractZh: 在这里，我们提出了一种通过将基于 PCR 的选择性标记盒与 CRISPR-Cas9 相结合，在酿酒酵母中进行无标记基因组编辑的方案。我们描述了使用 MX6 标记生成基因删除的步骤，并通过引入可重复使用的引导 RNA (gRNA)-Cas9 质粒和通用修复模板来切除标记，从而允许在一个步骤中进行多重删除。 PCR 最终验证产生无标记菌株，可以使用相同的选择性标记进行迭代编辑。有关该协议的使用和执行的完整详细信息，请参阅 Grissom 等人 1。

articles.title: Protocol to investigate replication kinetics of Kaposi's sarcoma-associated herpesvirus using single-molecule analysis of replicated DNA.
articles.titleZh: 使用复制 DNA 的单分子分析研究卡波西肉瘤相关疱疹病毒复制动力学的方案。
articles.authors: Singh RK, Bose D, Robertson ES.
articles.abstract: Single-molecule analysis of replicated DNA (SMARD) is a powerful tool to study DNA replication by visualizing de novo-incorporated nucleotide analogs in individual DNA molecules. Here, we present the protocol to investigate replication kinetics of Kaposi's sarcoma-associated herpesvirus using SMARD. We describe steps for seeding cells, nucleotide analog pulsing of cells, preparation and digestion of agarose plugs followed by pulsed-field gel electrophoresis, probe labeling, DNA stretching, and fluorescence imaging to map replication origins and fork progression. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to Verma et al.1 and Singh et al.2.
articles.abstractZh: 复制 DNA 的单分子分析 (SMARD) 是通过可视化单个 DNA 分子中从头掺入的核苷酸类似物来研究 DNA 复制的强大工具。在这里，我们提出了使用 SMARD 研究卡波西肉瘤相关疱疹病毒复制动力学的方案。我们描述了接种细胞、细胞的核苷酸类似物脉冲、琼脂糖塞的制备和消化，然后进行脉冲场凝胶电泳、探针标记、DNA 拉伸和荧光成像以绘制复制起点和分叉进展的步骤。有关该协议的使用和执行的完整详细信息，请参阅 Verma 等人 1 和 Singh 等人 2。

articles.title: Advances in machine learning-enhanced microfluidic cell sorting.
articles.titleZh: 机器学习增强的微流体细胞分选的进展。
articles.authors: Li H, Bai J, Ma X, Li L, Liu Y, Liu X, Shen S, Lim C.
articles.abstract: Cell sorting, essential for diagnostics and early intervention, has evolved from conventional methods to sophisticated microfluidic approaches. These miniaturized systems leverage precise hydrodynamic control, facilitating major advances in tumor cell isolation, single-cell analysis, and biomarker detection. However, the vast imaging data generated by these microfluidic techniques necessitate advanced computational methods. Machine learning, particularly computer vision and deep learning, now offers transformative capabilities for automated feature extraction, pattern recognition, and real-time classification, enhancing sorting accuracy, accelerating diagnostics, and informing clinical decisions. This review synthesizes the convergence of microfluidics and machine intelligence, examining their synergistic roles in flow-field optimization, cellular classification, and error correction. While highlighting breakthroughs in diagnostic sensitivity and analytical throughput, we critically address challenges including model generalizability and hardware-software integration. Last, we provide an outlook on multimodal data fusion and the development of on-chip intelligent systems, proposing a roadmap for advancing precision medicine through embedded, adaptive biosensing platforms.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞分选对于诊断和早期干预至关重要，已经从传统方法发展到复杂的微流体方法。这些小型化系统利用精确的流体动力学控制，促进肿瘤细胞分离、单细胞分析和生物标志物检测方面的重大进展。然而，这些微流体技术产生的大量成像数据需要先进的计算方法。机器学习，特别是计算机视觉和深度学习，现在提供自动特征提取、模式识别和实时分类的变革性功能，提高分类准确性，加速诊断并为临床决策提供信息。这篇综述综合了微流体和机器智能的融合，研究了它们在流场优化、细胞分类和误差校正中的协同作用。在强调诊断灵敏度和分析吞吐量方面的突破的同时，我们批判性地解决包括模型通用性和硬件软件集成在内的挑战。最后，我们对多模态数据融合和片上智能系统的发展进行了展望，提出

articles.title: Cell wall-derived mechanical signals control cell growth and division during root development.
articles.titleZh: 细胞壁衍生的机械信号控制根发育过程中的细胞生长和分裂。
articles.authors: Svolacchia N, Marconi M, Politsch JE, Vinciarelli F, De Nittis M, Salvi E, Sotelo-Silveira M, Terenzi A, Bertolotti G, Testi C, Ruocco G, Dello Ioio R, Di Mambro R, Costantino P, Wabnik K, Sabatini S.
articles.abstract: Organogenesis emerges from the interplay between genetic and physical interactions within a growing cellular system. While numerous studies have explored how genetic and molecular networks regulate cell activity, the impact of physical interactions and the resulting mechanical constraints on organ development remains poorly understood. In this study, we combine extensive genetic analysis, live imaging, and mechanical measurements with spatiotemporal computational modeling to show that, in the Arabidopsis root, changes in the mechanical properties of elongating cell walls influence growth and division rate of neighboring meristematic cells, thereby shaping root development. We propose that the cell wall serves as a crucial source of both autonomous and nonautonomous mechanical signals, providing a compelling example of how mechanical forces contribute to organ growth and development.
articles.abstractZh: 器官发生是由不断生长的细胞系统内遗传和物理相互作用之间的相互作用产生的。尽管大量研究探索了遗传和分子网络如何调节细胞活动，但物理相互作用的影响以及由此产生的对器官发育的机械限制仍然知之甚少。在这项研究中，我们将广泛的遗传分析、实时成像和机械测量与时空计算模型相结合，表明在拟南芥根中，伸长细胞壁的机械特性的变化会影响邻近分生组织细胞的生长和分裂率，从而影响根的发育。我们认为细胞壁是自主和非自主机械信号的重要来源，为机械力如何促进器官生长和发育提供了一个令人信服的例子。

articles.title: Divergent immune responses to commensal bacteria bearing distinct motility signatures.
articles.titleZh: 对具有不同运动特征的共生细菌的不同免疫反应。
articles.authors: Duck LW, Jennings MS, Hsu JS, Adeboboye CF, Morgan EL, Coger KJ, Klocke BJ, Hill DD, Alexander KL, Rosenberg AF, Lee G, Zhao Q, Elson CO, Maynard CL.
articles.abstract: Adaptive immune responses to commensal flagellins are hallmarks of Crohn's disease (CD), but it is unclear whether flagellins themselves promote inflammation or whether flagellated commensals can also be colitogenic. Here, we show that the arrangement of motility loci and the diversity of encoded flagellins can separate flagellated gut-derived Clostridia into at least two functionally distinct groups. In gnotobiotic mice, both groups induce tolerogenic responses, but only one group promoted tissue inflammation after barrier disruption. Specific flagellins expressed by members of this proinflammatory group displayed a heightened capacity for TLR5 activation that could be modulated by modification of a defined region of the flagellin D0 domain. Bacteria belonging to the proinflammatory group were also found to be elevated in CD biopsies. Together, this study identified key features of specific commensal bacteria that have colitogenic potential and revealed one mechanism whereby these organisms can potentially initiate intestinal inflammation.
articles.abstractZh: 对共生鞭毛蛋白的适应性免疫反应是克罗恩病 (CD) 的标志，但目前尚不清楚鞭毛蛋白本身是否会促进炎症，或者鞭毛共生体是否也会引起结肠炎。在这里，我们证明运动位点的排列和编码鞭毛蛋白的多样性可以将有鞭毛的肠道来源的梭状芽胞杆菌分成至少两个功能不同的类群。在无菌小鼠中，两组均诱导耐受反应，但只有一组在屏障破坏后促进组织炎症。该促炎组成员表达的特定鞭毛蛋白表现出增强的 TLR5 激活能力，可以通过修饰鞭毛蛋白 D0 结构域的特定区域来调节这种能力。 CD 活检中属于促炎组的细菌也被发现升高。总之，这项研究确定了具有致结肠炎潜力的特定共生细菌的关键特征，并揭示了这些生物体可能引发肠道炎症的一种机制。

articles.title: Mechanism of cotranslational modification of histones H2A and H4 by MetAP1 and NatD.
articles.titleZh: MetAP1 和 NatD 共翻译修饰组蛋白 H2A 和 H4 的机制。
articles.authors: Yudin D, Jaskolowski M, Fan Z, Burg N, Chandrasekar S, Lentzsch AM, Scaiola A, Bothe A, Deuerling E, Gamerdinger M, Shan SO, Ban N.
articles.abstract: The replication-dependent histones H2A and H4 are among the most highly expressed proteins in eukaryotes during the S phase to ensure packaging of replicated chromosomes. Nearly all newly synthesized H2A and H4 are N-terminally acetylated by N-terminal acetyltransferase D (NatD) following excision of the initiator methionine by methionine aminopeptidases (MetAPs). These modifications influence chromatin function, but how they occur cotranslationally on these exceptionally abundant and small proteins was not understood. Here, we show that the nascent polypeptide-associated complex controls the cotranslational modification of histones H2A and H4 by recruiting NatD and the upstream enzyme MetAP1 to ribosomes. MetAP1 and NatD cooperate on the ribosome to create a confined environment for the efficient sequential modification of the nascent histone chain. Our work provides a mechanistic model for the early steps of histone maturation.
articles.abstractZh: 复制依赖性组蛋白 H2A 和 H4 是真核生物 S 期表达最高的蛋白质之一，以确保复制染色体的包装。几乎所有新合成的 H2A 和 H4 在甲硫氨酸氨基肽酶 (MetAP) 切除起始子甲硫氨酸后，都会被 N 末端乙酰转移酶 D (NatD) 乙酰化。这些修饰影响染色质功能，但它们如何在这些异常丰富的小蛋白质上发生共翻译尚不清楚。在这里，我们证明新生的多肽相关复合物通过将 NatD 和上游酶 MetAP1 招募到核糖体来控制组蛋白 H2A 和 H4 的共翻译修饰。 MetAP1 和 NatD 在核糖体上合作，为新生组蛋白链的有效顺序修饰创造一个有限的环境。我们的工作为组蛋白成熟的早期步骤提供了机制模型。

articles.title: Natural variants of <i>AGL80.5</i> and <i>FPA.3</i> contribute to bud break timing in poplar by controlling auxin biosynthesis.
articles.titleZh: AGL80.5 和 FPA.3 的天然变体通过控制生长素生物合成来促进杨树的发芽时间。
articles.authors: Li L, Huang R, Jin Z, Zhang D, Zhang M, Xiao L, Li P, Zhou J, Tian C, Zhong L, Quan M, Liu L, Yang Q, Zhang D, Du Q.
articles.abstract: The molecular mechanisms governing phenological characteristics and local adaptation in woody perennials remain largely unexplored. Here, we identified that AGAMOUS-LIKE 80 (PtoAGL80.5) and FLOWERING TIME CONTROL PROTEIN FPA (PtoFPA.3) were simultaneously associated with photoperiod factors and bud break (BB) timing in Populus tomentosa. Transgenic experiments in growth chamber and two latitudinal field trials confirmed their positive roles in promoting BB. Both are activated by the canonical phenological regulator SUPPRESSOR OF OVEREXPRESSION OF CO 1, which, in turn, up-regulates the auxin biosynthesis gene TRYPTOPHAN AMINOTRANSFERASE-RELATED (PtoTAR2.1), accelerating BB via auxin pathway. As superior haplotypes, PtoFPA.3HAP1 binds PtoAGL80.5HAP1 messenger RNA to elevate protein, up-regulating PtoTAR2.1 and increasing indole-3-acetic acid accumulation. Under future climate scenarios, frequencies of PtoFPA.3HAP1 and PtoAGL80.5HAP1 are predicted to decline, narrowing BB variance across populations. This genetic regulatory network governing BB timing via the auxin pathway in perennial plants provides insights for molecular design breeding and ecological conservation amid climate change.
articles.abstractZh: 控制木本多年生植物物候特征和局部适应的分子机制在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这里，我们发现毛白杨中的 AGAMOUS-LIKE 80 (PtoAGL80.5) 和开花时间控制蛋白 FPA (PtoFPA.3) 同时与光周期因素和发芽 (BB) 时间相关。生长室转基因实验和两项横向田间试验证实了它们在促进 BB 方面的积极作用。两者均由经典物候调节因子 SUPPRESSOR OF OVEREXPRESSION OF CO 1 激活，进而上调生长素生物合成基因色氨酸氨基转移酶相关基因 (PtoTAR2.1)，通过生长素途径加速 BB。作为高级单倍型，PtoFPA.3HAP1 结合 PtoAGL80.5HAP1 信使 RNA 来提升蛋白质含量，上调 PtoTAR2.1 并增加吲哚-3-乙酸积累。在未来的气候情景下，PtoFPA.3HAP1 和 PtoAGL80.5HAP1 的频率预计会下降，从而缩小不同人群的 BB 方差。这种通过多年生植物生长素途径控制 BB 时间的遗传调控网络为分子设计育种和气候变化中的生态保护提供了见解。

articles.title: Pneumococcal S protein coordinates cell wall modification and repair to resist host antimicrobials.
articles.titleZh: 肺炎球菌 S 蛋白协调细胞壁修饰和修复以抵抗宿主抗菌药物。
articles.authors: Burnier J, Gallay C, Bruce KE, Bjånes E, Martin L, Jim KK, Tsui HT, Cremers AJH, Mignolet J, Vollmer D, Biboy J, Nizet V, Vollmer W, Winkler ME, Veening JW.
articles.abstract: S protein is conserved among streptococci and contributes to group A Streptococcus virulence, but the mechanisms involved are unclear. Here we used genetic, biochemical, single-molecule, in vitro and in vivo analyses to show that S protein is crucial for resistance against host-derived antimicrobials by coordinating cell wall modification and repair. We observed that S protein was localized to the streptococcal septum dependent on its transmembrane domain, while S protein function was dependent on its peptidoglycan (PG)-binding LysM domain. Direct interactions between the pneumococcal S protein and the PG synthase PBP1a as well as the PG deacetylase PgdA were detected. Loss of S protein reduced the proportion of circumferentially moving PBP1a molecules, altered streptococcal morphology and increased susceptibility to cell-wall-targeting antibiotics, suggesting that S protein activates PBP1a. Streptococcus pneumoniae ess mutants lacking the gene encoding S protein were more susceptible to human antimicrobial peptide LL-37 and lysozyme, while their virulence was decreased compared with wild-type bacteria in zebrafish and mice. These data suggest that S protein activates the PG repair and modification complex, providing defence against host-derived and environmental antimicrobials.
articles.abstractZh: S 蛋白在链球菌中是保守的，并有助于 A 组链球菌的毒力，但所涉及的机制尚不清楚。在这里，我们使用遗传、生化、单分子、体外和体内分析来表明，S 蛋白通过协调细胞壁修饰和修复，对于抵抗宿主源性抗菌药物至关重要。我们观察到，S 蛋白依赖于其跨膜结构域定位于链球菌隔膜，而 S 蛋白功能依赖于其肽聚糖（PG）结合 LysM 结构域。检测到肺炎球菌 S 蛋白与 PG 合成酶 PBP1a 以及 PG 脱乙酰酶 PgdA 之间的直接相互作用。 S蛋白的丢失减少了周向移动的PBP1a分子的比例，改变了链球菌的形态并增加了对细胞壁靶向抗生素的敏感性，这表明S蛋白激活了PBP1a。缺乏S蛋白编码基因的肺炎链球菌ess突变体对人抗菌肽LL-37和溶菌酶更敏感，但与斑马鱼和小鼠中的野生型细菌相比，其毒力降低。这些数据表明 S 蛋白激活 PG 修复

articles.title: Structural basis of VLCFA chain-length determination by the KCS6-CER2 complex in plants.
articles.titleZh: 植物中 KCS6-CER2 复合物测定 VLCFA 链长的结构基础。
articles.authors: Wang Y, Guan Z, Wang Q, Wang H, Yin X, Zhu Z, Gong Z, Qin Y, Fernie AR, Deng X, Zhu F, Yin P, Cheng Y.
articles.abstract: Very-long-chain fatty acids (VLCFAs) govern plant adaptation and development in a chain length-dependent manner. The elongation of VLCFAs is mediated by 3-ketoacyl-coenzyme A synthase (KCS) and ECERIFERUM2 (CER2) family protein cofactors, but the structural basis and mechanistic principles underlying chain-length determination remain elusive. Here, we report cryo-electron microscopy structures of citrus KCS6-CER2 and KCS6-CER2-like1 complexes, unveiling a kinked elongation tunnel whose hydrophobicity and volume determine VLCFA chain length. KCS6 functions as a catalytic module elongating VLCFAs up to chain length of 28 carbons (C28). CER2 family proteins further extend the tunnel formed by the KCS6 subunit, thus elongating VLCFAs to chain lengths longer than C28. These findings provide a plant-specific structural framework for VLCFA chain-length modulation and lay a foundation for engineering VLCFA biosynthesis for the improvement of crop resilience and VLCFA industrial value.
articles.abstractZh: 极长链脂肪酸（VLCFA）以链长依赖性方式控制植物的适应和发育。 VLCFA 的延伸是由 3-酮脂酰辅酶 A 合酶 (KCS) 和 ECERIFERUM2 (CER2) 家族蛋白辅因子介导的，但链长测定的结构基础和机制原理仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们报告了柑橘 KCS6-CER2 和 KCS6-CER2-like1 复合物的冷冻电子显微镜结构，揭示了一个扭结的延伸通道，其疏水性和体积决定了 VLCFA 链的长度。 KCS6 充当催化模块，将 VLCFA 延长至 28 个碳 (C28) 的链长。 CER2家族蛋白进一步延伸了KCS6亚基形成的隧道，从而将VLCFA延长至比C28更长的链长。这些发现为VLCFA链长调节提供了植物特异性的结构框架，并为工程化VLCFA生物合成以提高作物恢复力和VLCFA工业价值奠定了基础。

articles.title: The G3BP stress-granule proteins reinforce the integrated stress response translation programme.
articles.titleZh: G3BP 应激颗粒蛋白强化了综合应激反应翻译程序。
articles.authors: Smith J, Bartel DP.
articles.abstract: When mammalian cells are exposed to stress, they co-ordinate the condensation of stress granules (SGs) through the action of proteins G3BP1 and G3BP2 (G3BPs) and, simultaneously, undergo a massive reduction in translation. Although SGs and G3BPs have been linked to this translation response, their overall impact has been unclear. Here we investigate the question of how, and indeed whether, G3BPs and SGs shape the stress translation response. We find that SGs are enriched for mRNAs that are resistant to the stress-induced translation shutdown. Although the accurate recruitment of these stress-resistant mRNAs does require the context of stress, a combination of optogenetic tools and spike-normalized ribosome profiling demonstrates that G3BPs and SGs are necessary and sufficient to both help prioritize the translation of their enriched mRNAs and help suppress cytosolic translation. Together, these results support a model in which G3BPs and SGs reinforce the stress translation programme by prioritizing the translation of their resident mRNAs.
articles.abstractZh: 当哺乳动物细胞受到压力时，它们通过蛋白质 G3BP1 和 G3BP2 (G3BP) 的作用协调应激颗粒 (SG) 的凝结，同时翻译量大幅减少。尽管 SG 和 G3BP 与这种翻译反应有关，但它们的总体影响尚不清楚。在这里，我们研究 G3BP 和 SG 如何以及是否确实塑造压力转换反应的问题。我们发现 SG 富含能够抵抗应激诱导的翻译关闭的 mRNA。尽管这些抗应激 mRNA 的准确募集确实需要应激背景，但光遗传学工具和尖峰标准化核糖体分析的结合表明，G3BP 和 SG 对于帮助优先考虑其富集 mRNA 的翻译并帮助抑制胞质翻译是必要且充分的。总之，这些结果支持了一个模型，其中 G3BP 和 SG 通过优先考虑其驻留 mRNA 的翻译来强化应激翻译程序。

articles.title: Biofilm structure as a key factor in antibiotic tolerance: insights from Bacillus subtilis model systems.
articles.titleZh: 生物膜结构是抗生素耐受性的关键因素：来自枯草芽孢杆菌模型系统的见解。
articles.authors: Blaznik M, Volk M, Kraigher B, Calonge-Sanz A, Barco-García G, Stopar D, Dogsa I.
articles.abstract: Tolerance to antimicrobial agents in mature and structured biofilms presents a significant challenge in clinical and industrial applications. The contribution of biofilm physical structure to antimicrobial tolerance remains particularly poorly understood, primarily due to the lack of biofilm structure quantification and manipulation studies. To fill the gap in our knowledge, we have investigated how mechanical and biochemical disruptions of biofilm integrity affect Bacillus subtilis tolerance to antimicrobial agents. Our findings reveal that biofilm structural integrity is a major determinant of tolerance to membrane disrupting antibiotic daptomycin. Biofilm viscoelastic properties as well as antimicrobial tolerance to daptomycin were directly related to the presence of exopolysaccharide EpsA-O. In the absence of EpsA-O bacteria produced weak biofilms with markedly reduced elastic and viscous moduli that correlated with a 3-log reduction in bacterial survival rate when challenged with daptomycin. These findings underscore the protective role of biofilm structure against antibiotics and suggest that targeting biofilm structural integrity could substantially enhance antimicrobial treatment strategies for biofilm-related infections.
articles.abstractZh: 成熟和结构化生物膜对抗菌剂的耐受性在临床和工业应用中提出了重大挑战。生物膜物理结构对抗菌药物耐受性的贡献仍然知之甚少，这主要是由于缺乏生物膜结构量化和操作研究。为了填补我们的知识空白，我们研究了生物膜完整性的机械和生化破坏如何影响枯草芽孢杆菌对抗菌药物的耐受性。我们的研究结果表明，生物膜结构完整性是对膜破坏性抗生素达托霉素耐受的主要决定因素。生物膜粘弹性特性以及对达托霉素的抗菌耐受性与胞外多糖 EpsA-O 的存在直接相关。在没有 EpsA-O 的情况下，细菌产生的生物膜较弱，弹性模量和粘性模量显着降低，这与达托霉素攻击时细菌存活率降低 3 个对数相关。这些发现强调了生物膜结构对抗生素的保护作用，并表明针对生物膜结构完整性可以显着增强抗菌效果。

articles.title: Oxidized MIF is an Alzheimer's disease drug target relaying external risk factors to tau pathology.
articles.titleZh: 氧化 MIF 是一种阿尔茨海默病药物靶标，可将外部危险因素传递给 tau 病理学。
articles.authors: Müller-Schiffmann A, Torres F, Kitaygorodskyy A, Ramani A, Alatza A, Tschirner SK, Orts J, Haltrich A, Prikulis I, Yu S, Dey D, Mallesh S, Prasad D, Solas D, Bader V, Rozemuller A, Wray S, Gopalakrishnan J, Riek R, Lingappa VR, Korth C.
articles.abstract: During deep co-evolution of viruses and host cells, viruses have selected specific host cellular proteins redirected from physiological functions to viral needs, thereby disturbing cellular proteostasis and increasing the risk of triggering protein misfolding diseases (PMDs). Identifying virus-specific, repurposed host proteins also allows the study of fundamental cellular events in "sporadic" PMDs, independent of the virus. Here, we identify a small molecule with very strong activity against neurotropic herpes simplex virus 1 (HSV-1), modulating an allosteric site of macrophage migration inhibitory factor (MIF). The compound efficiently reduces both HSV-1-mediated and non-mediated tau phosphorylation or aggregation in vitro and in vivo. The lead compound, as well as conformation-sensitive antibodies, specifically interacts with an oxidized conformer of MIF (oxMIF) enriched in postmortem brain homogenates of patients with Alzheimer's disease (AD). OxMIF thus participates in a host-viral interface connecting HSV-1 infection, and possibly other external stressors, with tau cellular pathology characteristic for PMDs, including AD.
articles.abstractZh: 在病毒和宿主细胞的深度共同进化过程中，病毒选择了从生理功能转向病毒需求的特定宿主细胞蛋白，从而扰乱细胞蛋白质稳态并增加引发蛋白质错误折叠疾病（PMD）的风险。识别病毒特异性、重新利用的宿主蛋白还可以研究“散发性”PMD 中的基本细胞事件，而与病毒无关。在这里，我们鉴定了一种小分子，该小分子具有很强的抗嗜神经性单纯疱疹病毒 1 (HSV-1) 活性，可调节巨噬细胞迁移抑制因子 (MIF) 的变构位点。该化合物可在体外和体内有效降低 HSV-1 介导和非介导的 tau 磷酸化或聚集。该先导化合物以及构象敏感抗体与阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 患者死后脑匀浆中富含的 MIF 氧化构象异构体 (oxMIF) 发生特异性相互作用。因此，OxMIF 参与连接 HSV-1 感染和可能的其他外部应激源的宿主-病毒界面，具有 PMD（包括 AD）的 tau 细胞病理学特征。

articles.title: The role of nitric oxide synthase in biofilm formation by Staphylococcus aureus.
articles.titleZh: 一氧化氮合酶在金黄色葡萄球菌生物膜形成中的作用。
articles.authors: Huang Y, Cheng Y, Shi Y, Wang X, Khodi Aghmiuni S, Serwat A, Zhang Z, Shu X, Sun B.
articles.abstract: Staphylococcus aureus is capable of colonizing diverse environments and forming biofilms. In this study, we found that the knockout of NO synthase (NOS) impaired biofilm integrity, resulting in weakened biofilms. We found the deletion of the nos reduced intracellular NO levels, which subsequently altered the S-nitrosylation modification levels of the proteome. This alteration was particularly pronounced in the S-nitrosylation modification of the cysteine residue at position 12 of the MgrA. This modification reduced the binding affinity of MgrA to the promoter of the acetyltransferase gene (icaA), resulting in reduced levels of poly-N-acetyl-β-(1-6)-glucosamine (PIA), a key component of biofilms formed by S. aureus, thereby further weakening biofilm formation. Consequently, we conclude that NOS in S. aureus S-nitrosylates the MgrA through the synthesis of endogenous NO. This process strengthens the interaction between MgrA and the icaA promoter (PicaA), thereby enhancing the synthesis of major polysaccharides in biofilms and promoting biofilm formation.
articles.abstractZh: 金黄色葡萄球菌能够在多种环境中定殖并形成生物膜。在这项研究中，我们发现一氧化氮合酶（NOS）的敲除损害了生物膜的完整性，导致生物膜减弱。我们发现 nos 的缺失降低了细胞内 NO 水平，从而改变了蛋白质组的 S-亚硝基化修饰水平。这种改变在 MgrA 12 位半胱氨酸残基的 S-亚硝基化修饰中尤其明显。这种修饰降低了MgrA与乙酰转移酶基因(icaA)启动子的结合亲和力，导致聚-N-乙酰基-β-(1-6)-葡萄糖胺(PIA)水平降低，PIA是金黄色葡萄球菌形成生物膜的关键成分，从而进一步削弱生物膜形成。因此，我们得出结论，金黄色葡萄球菌中的 NOS 通过合成内源性 NO 来 S-亚硝基化 MgrA。这一过程加强了MgrA与icaA启动子（PicaA）之间的相互作用，从而增强了生物膜中主要多糖的合成，促进了生物膜的形成。

articles.title: You are what your fungus eats: diet shapes the microbial garden of a fungus-growing ant.
articles.titleZh: 真菌吃什么，你就是什么：饮食塑造了真菌生长蚂蚁的微生物花园。
articles.authors: Barcoto MO, de Sousa RL, Soares JGDS, Garcia RHDS, deAzevedo ER, Mendes LW, Bueno OC, Rodrigues A.
articles.abstract: Fungus-growing ants maintain an ectosymbiotic microbial garden, an intertwined mesh of fungal symbiont hyphae and microbiota growing through plant substrates. Here, we investigate how different plant diets influence the garden lignocellulosic profile, and whether the microbiota respond to dietary changes. Colonies of Atta sexdens were provided with four different dietary regimens, varying in fiber composition and nutritional content. Diet changed the garden lignocellulosic profile, also influencing the microbial taxonomic composition. The diet of only leaves enriched the garden in Bacillus and Weissella, while a diet of only fruits/cereals lead to a Carnimonas and Mesoplasma enrichment; diets mixing leaves and fruits/cereals intermittently and alternatively enriched the garden in Bacillus, Mesoplasma, and Weissella. The fungal crop development and the spatial distribution of the microbiota and biofilm also varied according to the diet. Our findings suggest that diet has a pivotal role in determining whether ant colonies function optimally and remain healthy.
articles.abstractZh: 生长真菌的蚂蚁维持着一个外共生微生物花园，这是一个由真菌共生菌丝和通过植物基质生长的微生物群交织而成的网格。在这里，我们研究不同的植物饮食如何影响花园木质纤维素特征，以及微生物群是否对饮食变化做出反应。为 Atta sexdens 的群体提供了四种不同的饮食方案，其纤维成分和营养成分各不相同。饮食改变了花园木质纤维素的特征，也影响了微生物的分类组成。只吃叶子的饮食丰富了花园中的芽孢杆菌和魏斯氏菌，而只吃水果/谷物的饮食则导致肉单胞菌和中原体的丰富；间歇性地混合树叶和水果/谷物的饮食，交替丰富花园中的芽孢杆菌、中原体和魏斯氏菌。真菌作物的发育以及微生物群和生物膜的空间分布也根据饮食而变化。我们的研究结果表明，饮食在决定蚁群是否发挥最佳功能并保持健康方面起着关键作用。

articles.title: A plant NLR receptor activates auxin signaling through Aux/IAAs-ARF19 and YUC8-TIR1/AFBs to promote callose-mediated antiviral defense.
articles.titleZh: 植物 NLR 受体通过 Aux/IAAs-ARF19 和 YUC8-TIR1/AFB 激活生长素信号传导，以促进胼胝质介导的抗病毒防御。
articles.authors: Yang T, Zhao R, Mei R, Cui H, Ding Z, Wen Y, Wu Q, Chen Z, Huang S, Wang C, Hong L, Zuo W, Zhang Z, Zhu M, Yang L, Zhang Z, Dong S, Xu Y, Tao X.
articles.abstract: Phytohormone signaling pathways are crucial for defense against pathogens mediated by pattern recognition receptors and nucleotide-binding leucine-rich repeat (NLR) immune receptors. The induction of auxin signaling by immune receptors for antiviral immunity is poorly understood despite its notable role in plant defense against viral pathogens. Here, we report that plant NLR Sw-5b initiates and amplifies auxin signaling through auxin/indole-3-acetic acid (Aux/IAAs)-ARF19 and YUC8-transport inhibitor response1/auxin-signaling F-box (TIR1/AFB) modules to promote callose-mediated antiviral defense. Upon recognizing viral effector, Sw-5b associates with and relieves repressors Aux/IAAs on transcription factor ARF19. ARF19 then activates callose synthase gene GSL5/8 to deposit callose at plasmodesmata, inhibiting viral cell-to-cell spread. Meanwhile, ARF19 activates auxin biosynthesis gene YUC8 to boost auxin production; this further amplifies callose deposition signaling via TIR1/AFB receptors and Aux/IAAs-ARF19-glucan synthase-like (GSL) module, thereby restricting the virus in localized cell death. Our findings provide valuable insights into the mechanism by which plant immune receptors induce phytohormone signaling pathways to combat pathogens.
articles.abstractZh: 植物激素信号通路对于防御由模式识别受体和核苷酸结合富含亮氨酸重复序列 (NLR) 免疫受体介导的病原体至关重要。尽管生长素信号在植物防御病毒病原体方面发挥着显着作用，但免疫受体诱导抗病毒免疫的生长素信号传导却知之甚少。在此，我们报道植物 NLR Sw-5b 通过生长素/吲哚-3-乙酸 (Aux/IAA)-ARF19 和 YUC8-转运抑制剂应答 1/生长素信号 F-盒 (TIR1/AFB) 模块启动和放大生长素信号传导，以促进胼胝质介导的抗病毒防御。在识别病毒效应子后，Sw-5b 会与转录因子 ARF19 上的 Aux/IAA 阻遏物结合并解除其抑制。然后，ARF19 激活胼胝质合酶基因 GSL5/8，将胼胝质沉积在胞间连丝上，抑制病毒细胞间传播。同时，ARF19激活生长素生物合成基因YUC8以促进生长素的产生；这进一步放大了通过 TIR1/AFB 受体和 Aux/IAAs-ARF19-葡聚糖合酶样 (GSL) 模块的胼胝质沉积信号，从而限制病毒的局部细胞死亡。我们的研究结果为植物免疫受体的机制提供了有价值的见解

articles.title: Design of electroactive consortium synthesizing flora enables synergistic biomass-to-bioenergy conversion.
articles.titleZh: 电活性联合体合成菌群的设计能够实现生物质到生物能源的协同转化。
articles.authors: Wang N, Chu Z, Wu J, Wang R, Luo Y, Wang Y, Zhang K, Yue H.
articles.abstract: Efficient biomass-to-energy conversion is key to sustainable development. We engineered a dual-functional synthetic microbial communities(SMC) (Bacillus subtilis XJU-1, XJU-2, Bacillus cereus XJU-3, and Enterobacter hormaechei XJU-5) to simultaneously degrade marine biomass and generate electricity in microbial fuel cells (MFCs). Using porous nickel-molybdenum foam as the anode, the 2-L MFCs achieved 941.67 mV and 443.67 mW m-3. Multi-omics analyses showed that vitamin B6 and amino acid pathways boosted NADH/FADH2 production, while higher SDH and COX activities enhanced electron transfer. The community converted 77%-90% of seven marine substrates into soluble nutrients, which correlated with increased power output. Four MFCs connected in series delivered 2187.17 mV and 598.13 mW m-3, and a 28-L MFCs generated stably for 30 days. Effluents rich in nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium suggest potential use as diluted liquid fertilizers, supporting integrated bioenergy production and resource recycling.
articles.abstractZh: 高效的生物质能源转化是可持续发展的关键。我们设计了双功能合成微生物群落 (SMC)（枯草芽孢杆菌 XJU-1、XJU-2、蜡样芽孢杆菌 XJU-3 和霍马氏肠杆菌 XJU-5），可同时降解海洋生物质并在微生物燃料电池 (MFC) 中发电。使用多孔镍钼泡沫作为阳极，2L MFC 实现了 941.67 mV 和 443.67 mW m-3。多组学分析表明，维生素 B6 和氨基酸途径可促进 NADH/FADH2 的产生，而较高的 SDH 和 COX 活性则可增强电子转移。该群落将七种海洋底物中的 77%-90% 转化为可溶性营养物质，这与功率输出的增加相关。四个串联的 MFC 提供 2187.17 mV 和 598.13 mW m-3，并且 28-L MFC 稳定发电 30 天。富含氮、磷和钾的废水表明有可能用作稀释液体肥料，支持综合生物能源生产和资源回收。

articles.title: Direct recruitment of TONSOKU by the N-terminal tails of histone variants H2A.X and H2A.W coordinates DNA repair.
articles.titleZh: 组蛋白变体 H2A.X 和 H2A.W 的 N 末端尾部直接招募 TONSOKU 协调 DNA 修复。
articles.authors: Li Q, Zhao C, Guo Y, Bai Y, Liu J, Jin X, Yuan Y, Jacob Y, Dong J, Dong J.
articles.abstract: Histone variants play crucial roles in DNA replication and repair. The plant TONSOKU (TSK) requires histone H3.1 unmethylated at lysine 27 for DNA repair at replication forks, but how TSK is recruited to double-strand break (DSB) sites remains unclear. In this study, we show that the leucine-rich repeat (LRR) domain of TSK recognizes the N-terminal tails of histone variants H2A.X and H2A.W-key for DNA repair in euchromatin and heterochromatin, respectively-but not the H2A.Z variant. A unique motif containing multiple basic and acidic residues (BAR motif) in H2A.Z prevents TSK binding. Moreover, disrupting TSK-H2A.X/W binding impairs TSK-mediated DNA repair. Genetic analyses reveal functional complementation between H2A.X and H2A.W in DNA repair, with the H2A.X N terminus being essential. This study reveals a previously unrecognized, H2A.X/W-dependent mechanism for recruiting the DNA repair protein TSK, highlighting the critical role of their N-terminal tails in plant DNA repair.
articles.abstractZh: 组蛋白变体在 DNA 复制和修复中发挥着至关重要的作用。植物 TONSOKU (TSK) 需要在赖氨酸 27 处未甲基化的组蛋白 H3.1 来修复复制叉处的 DNA，但 TSK 如何被招募到双链断裂 (DSB) 位点仍不清楚。在这项研究中，我们证明 TSK 的富含亮氨酸重复 (LRR) 结构域可识别组蛋白变体 H2A.X 和 H2A.W 的 N 末端尾部，分别是常染色质和异染色质 DNA 修复的关键，但不能识别 H2A.Z 变体。 H2A.Z 中含有多个碱性和酸性残基（BAR 基序）的独特基序可防止 TSK 结合。此外，破坏 TSK-H2A.X/W 结合会损害 TSK 介导的 DNA 修复。遗传分析揭示了 H2A.X 和 H2A.W 在 DNA 修复中的功能互补，其中 H2A.X N 末端至关重要。这项研究揭示了一种先前未被认识的 H2A.X/W 依赖性招募 DNA 修复蛋白 TSK 的机制，强调了其 N 末端尾部在植物 DNA 修复中的关键作用。

articles.title: Palaeometabolomes yield biological and ecological profiles at early human sites.
articles.titleZh: 古代谢组在早期人类遗址产生了生物学和生态学特征。
articles.authors: Bromage TG, Denys C, De Jesus CL, Erdjument-Bromage H, Kullmer O, Sandrock O, Schrenk F, McKee MD, Reznikov N, Ashley GM, Hu B, Poudel SB, Souron A, Buss DJ, Ittah E, Kubat J, Rabieh S, Yakar S, Neubert TA.
articles.abstract: The science of metabolic profiling exploits chemical compound byproducts of metabolism called metabolites1 that explain internal biological functions, physiological health and disease, and provide evidence of external influences specific to an organism's habitat. Here we assess palaeometabolomes from fossilized mammalian hard tissues as a molecular ecological strategy to provide evidence of an ancient organism's relationship with its environment. From eastern, central and southern African Plio-Pleistocene localities of palaeoanthropological significance, we study six fossils from Olduvai Gorge, Tanzania, one from the Chiwondo Beds, Malawi, and one from Makapansgat, South Africa. We perform endogeneity assessments by analysing palaeometabolomes of palaeosols and the effects of owl digestion on rodent bones to enable prudent ecological inferences. Diagenesis is indicated by metabolites of collagenase-producing bacteria2, whereas the preservation of peptides including those of collagen are identified by proteomics. Endogenous metabolites document biological functions and exogenous metabolites render environmental details including soil characteristics and woody cover, and enable annual minimum and maximum rainfall and temperature reconstructions at Olduvai Gorge, supporting the freshwater woodland and grasslands of Olduvai Gorge Bed I3-5, and the dry woodlands and marsh of Olduvai Gorge Upper Bed II6. All sites denote wetter and/or warmer conditions than today. We infer that metabolites preserved in hard tissues derive from an extravasated vasculature serum filtrate that becomes entombed within developing mineralized matrices, and most probably survive palaeontological timeframes in the nanoscopic 'pool' of structural-bound water that occurs in hard tissue niches7.
articles.abstractZh: 代谢分析科学利用称为代谢物的代谢化合物副产品来解释内部生物功能、生理健康和疾病，并提供特定于生物体栖息地的外部影响的证据。在这里，我们评估哺乳动物硬组织化石中的古代谢组，作为一种分子生态策略，为古代生物体与其环境的关系提供证据。我们从具有古人类学意义的非洲东部、中部和南部的上里昂-更新世地区，研究了坦桑尼亚奥杜瓦伊峡谷的六块化石、马拉维奇旺多地层的一块化石和南非马卡潘斯加特的一块化石。我们通过分析古土壤的古代谢组和猫头鹰消化对啮齿动物骨骼的影响来进行内生性评估，以实现谨慎的生态推论。成岩作用是通过产生胶原酶的细菌的代谢物来指示的，而包括胶原蛋白在内的肽的保存是通过蛋白质组学来鉴定的。内源代谢物记录生物功能，外源代谢物呈现环境细节，包括土壤特征和木质覆盖，并使年青

articles.title: Stress granule dynamics govern TOR reactivation and growth recovery during post-heat stress adaptation.
articles.titleZh: 应激颗粒动力学控制热应激适应过程中 TOR 的重新激活和生长恢复。
articles.authors: Zhong Z, Yang S, Liu D, Liu Z, Zhao W, Shen X, Wang F, Liu Y, Xu T, Fang X, Xiong Y.
articles.abstract: The conserved target of rapamycin (TOR) pathway and stress granules (SGs) play crucial roles in stress adaptation and survival. However, their interplay in plants remains largely unknown. Here, we elucidate the complex relationship between TOR signaling and SG dynamics in Arabidopsis. In contrast to the positive regulatory role observed in mammals, we show that TOR signaling is dispensable for heat-induced SG formation in plants. Furthermore, heat stress induces the sequestration of TOR and its core complex components, RAPTOR1B and LST8, into SGs. TOR activity is rapidly suppressed by heat stress, independently of SG formation. In contrast, TOR reactivation following heat stress relief is dependent on the rate of SG disassembly, implicating SG recovery dynamics as a key regulator of TOR reactivation. These findings reveal a layer of TOR regulation and highlight the potential of modulating SG dynamics to orchestrate plant growth and stress adaptation.
articles.abstractZh: 雷帕霉素（TOR）途径的保守靶标和应激颗粒（SG）在应激适应和生存中发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，它们在植物中的相互作用仍然很大程度上未知。在这里，我们阐明了拟南芥中 TOR 信号传导与 SG 动态之间的复杂关系。与在哺乳动物中观察到的正向调节作用相反，我们发现 TOR 信号传导对于植物中热诱导的 SG 形成是可有可无的。此外，热应激还会导致 TOR 及其核心复杂成分 RAPTOR1B 和 LST8 被隔离到 SG 中。热应激会迅速抑制 TOR 活性，与 SG 形成无关。相比之下，热应激缓解后 TOR 重新激活取决于 SG 分解速率，这表明 SG 恢复动态是 TOR 重新激活的关键调节因素。这些发现揭示了 TOR 调节层，并强调了调节 SG 动态来协调植物生长和逆境适应的潜力。

articles.title: The RNA exosome maintains cellular RNA homeostasis by controlling transcript abundance in the brain.
articles.titleZh: RNA 外泌体通过控制大脑中的转录丰度来维持细胞 RNA 稳态。
articles.authors: Higginson LA, Wang X, He K, Torstrick M, Kim M, Wijeratne HRS, Runnebohm AM, Benayoun BA, MacLean A, Chanfreau GF, Morton DJ.
articles.abstract: Intracellular ribonucleases (RNases) are essential for maintaining accurate RNA levels. Inherited mutations in genes encoding ubiquitous RNases are associated with human diseases, primarily affecting the nervous system. Recessive mutations in genes encoding the evolutionarily conserved RNA exosome, an RNase complex, cause syndromic neurodevelopmental disorders, such as pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 1b (PCH1b), characterized by progressive neurodegeneration. Here, we establish a CRISPR-Cas9-engineered Drosophila model of PCH1b to investigate the cell-type-specific post-transcriptional regulatory functions of the RNA exosome complex in vivo. Pathogenic variants in Rrp40, a subunit of the complex, disrupt RNA exosome activity, leading to widespread transcriptomic dysregulation in brain-enriched cell populations, including defective rRNA processing. These molecular defects coincide with progressive neurodegeneration and behavioral impairments that track with allele severity. Our findings provide a cell-type-resolved view of RNA exosome function in a fully developed animal brain and underscore the critical role of RNA surveillance in safeguarding transcriptome homeostasis and neuronal integrity.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞内核糖核酸酶 (RNase) 对于维持准确的 RNA 水平至关重要。编码普遍存在的核糖核酸酶的基因的遗传性突变与人类疾病有关，主要影响神经系统。编码进化上保守的 RNA 外泌体（一种 RNase 复合物）的基因的隐性突变会导致综合征性神经发育障碍，例如 1b 型脑桥小脑发育不全（PCH1b），其特征是进行性神经变性。在这里，我们建立了 PCH1b 的 CRISPR-Cas9 工程果蝇模型，以研究体内 RNA 外泌体复合物的细胞类型特异性转录后调节功能。 Rrp40（该复合物的一个亚基）的致病变异会破坏 RNA 外泌体活性，导致大脑富集细胞群中广泛的转录组失调，包括 rRNA 加工缺陷。这些分子缺陷与进行性神经退行性变和与等位基因严重程度相关的行为障碍相一致。我们的研究结果提供了发育完全的动物大脑中 RNA 外泌体功能的细胞类型解析视图，并强调了 RNA 监测在维护转录组稳态和神经元功能方面的关键作用。

articles.title: Natural variation in OsTPS8 confers differential regulation of chalkiness and seed vigor in indica and japonica rice.
articles.titleZh: OsTPS8 的自然变异赋予籼稻和粳稻的垩白度和种子活力的差异调节。
articles.authors: Chen X, Ren Y, Dong H, Jiang X, Zheng X, Duan E, Teng X, Wang Y, Gu C, Chen R, Wang Q, Wang Y, Zhang Y, Zhang R, Zhang Y, Zhao W, Zhang Y, Yang X, Zhou L, Li C, Shan T, Bao Y, Tian Y, Liu X, Liu S, Guo T, Chen M, Wang H, Wang Y, Wan J.
articles.abstract: Chalkiness and seed vigor are major agronomic traits affecting rice grain quality and productivity, respectively. Little is known about the intrinsic relationship and the regulatory mechanisms of these two traits. Here we identified a chalkiness locus qPGWC-8, which encodes trehalose-6-phosphate synthase 8 (OsTPS8) that suppresses trehalose-6-phosphate (Tre6P) biosynthesis by interacting with and inhibiting OsTPS1. A natural promoter variation in OsTPS8 confers differential transcriptional regulation by OsbHLH001. Elevated expression of OsTPS8 reduces Tre6P levels and activates the expression of OsMYBS1 and α-amylase genes, thus promoting starch degradation, chalkiness formation and seed vigor elevation. Two major haplotypes, OsTPS8ASO and OsTPS8IR24, were defined by this functional promoter variation, with OsTPS8IR24 preferentially selected during the domestication of indica rice. Collectively, our findings establish an OsbHLH001-OsTPS8-Tre6P-α-amylase signaling cascade that has a dual role in regulating grain chalkiness and seed vigor, which reveals a molecular link between the appearance quality and seed vigor of rice.
articles.abstractZh: 垩白度和种子活力分别是影响稻米品质和产量的主要农艺性状。人们对这两种性状的内在关系和调节机制知之甚少。在这里，我们鉴定了一个垩白位点qPGWC-8，它编码海藻糖6-磷酸合酶8（OsTPS8），通过与OsTPS1相互作用并抑制OsTPS1来抑制海藻糖6-磷酸（Tre6P）的生物合成。 OsTPS8 中的天然启动子变异赋予 OsbHLH001 差异转录调节作用。 OsTPS8 的表达升高会降低 Tre6P 水平并激活 OsMYBS1 和 α-淀粉酶基因的表达，从而促进淀粉降解、垩白形成和种子活力提高。这种功能性启动子变异定义了两种主要的单倍型，OsTPS8ASO和OsTPS8IR24，其中OsTPS8IR24在籼稻驯化过程中被优先选择。总的来说，我们的研究结果建立了一个 OsbHLH001-OsTPS8-Tre6P-α-淀粉酶信号级联，它在调节谷物垩白度和种子活力方面具有双重作用，揭示了水稻外观品质和种子活力之间的分子联系。

articles.title: 5' UTR-mediated retention of eIF3 on 80S ribosomes promotes co-translational folding of ER membrane proteins.
articles.titleZh: 5' UTR 介导的 eIF3 在 80S 核糖体上的保留促进 ER 膜蛋白的共翻译折叠。
articles.authors: Han B, Zhang S, Zhang Y, Yu B, Lin W, Cheng Y, Duan H, Wolf DA.
articles.abstract: Co-translational folding of nascent polypeptides is essential for protein function and cellular homeostasis. Ribosome-associated chaperones assist in this process, but coordination between their recruitment and translation initiation remains poorly understood. We report here that specific binding sites for eukaryotic translation initiation factor eIF3 within the 5' UTRs of mRNAs promote its retention on 80S ribosomes during the synthesis of select endoplasmic reticulum (ER) membrane proteins. Disruption of these eIF3 binding sites leads to misfolding and sequestration of newly synthesized membrane proteins into ER whorls. Sequestration into ER whorls is exacerbated by HSP70 inhibition but can be rescued by overexpressing HSPA1 and HSPA8. Cross-linking assays reveal that 5' UTR binding sites stabilize eIF3-80S interactions during early elongation, facilitating recruitment of HSPA1 and HSPA8 to ribosomes. These findings indicate that genetic instructions within 5' UTRs direct eIF3-mediated chaperone recruitment, ensuring proper co-translational folding of ER membrane proteins.
articles.abstractZh: 新生多肽的共翻译折叠对于蛋白质功能和细胞稳态至关重要。核糖体相关的伴侣在此过程中提供帮助，但它们的招募和翻译启动之间的协调仍然知之甚少。我们在此报道，mRNA 5' UTR 内真核翻译起始因子 eIF3 的特异性结合位点在选择性内质网 (ER) 膜蛋白的合成过程中促进其保留在 80S 核糖体上。这些 eIF3 结合位点的破坏会导致新合成的膜蛋白错误折叠并隔离到内质网螺旋中。 HSP70 抑制会加剧内质网螺旋的隔离，但可以通过过表达 HSPA1 和 HSPA8 来挽救。交联测定表明，5' UTR 结合位点在早期延伸过程中稳定了 eIF3-80S 相互作用，促进 HSPA1 和 HSPA8 募集至核糖体。这些发现表明 5' UTR 内的遗传指令指导 eIF3 介导的伴侣招募，确保 ER 膜蛋白正确的共翻译折叠。

articles.title: Azithromycin alters the microbiome composition, function and resistome in women with Chlamydia trachomatis infections.
articles.titleZh: 阿奇霉素可改变沙眼衣原体感染女性的微生物组组成、功能和耐药组。
articles.authors: Bommana S, Olagoke O, Hu YJ, Wang R, Kama M, Dehdashti M, Kodimerla R, Read TD, Dean D.
articles.abstract: Antibiotics disrupt mucosal microbial communities, yet the effects on microbiomes infected with Chlamydia trachomatis (Ct) remain poorly understood. Some data exist on vaginal microbiomes, but none exist for the endocervix or rectum that are primary sites of infection. We applied metagenomic shotgun sequencing to vaginal, endocervical and rectal samples collected longitudinally from women who cleared their infection post-treatment (n = 10), had persistent infection (n = 11), or remained uninfected (n = 18) to evaluate azithromycin-induced changes in microbial composition, function, and the resistome over time. Our results show shifts in composition and function post-treatment that support persistent Ct, nonsynonymous Ct L22 amino acid substitutions that may be linked to azithromycin resistance, and significant endocervical increases in azithromycin resistance genes in Lactobacillus iners and Gardnerella vaginalis strains with moderate/high biofilm formation potential. These findings highlight the unintended ecological consequences of azithromycin treatment, including likely resistance gene propagation, emphasizing the need for novel treatment and microbiome-preserving strategies.
articles.abstractZh: 抗生素会破坏粘膜微生物群落，但其对沙眼衣原体 (Ct) 感染微生物群的影响仍知之甚少。存在一些关于阴道微生物组的数据，但没有关于作为主要感染部位的子宫颈内膜或直肠的数据。我们对从治疗后清除感染 (n = 10)、持续感染 (n = 11) 或保持未感染 (n = 18) 的女性纵向收集的阴道、宫颈内膜和直肠样本应用宏基因组鸟枪测序，以评估阿奇霉素引起的微生物组成、功能和耐药组随时间的变化。我们的结果显示，治疗后成分和功能发生变化，支持可能与阿奇霉素耐药性相关的持续性 Ct、非同义 Ct L22 氨基酸取代，以及具有中/高生物膜形成潜力的惰性乳杆菌和阴道加德纳菌菌株中阿奇霉素耐药基因的显着增加。这些发现强调了阿奇霉素治疗的意外生态后果，包括可能的耐药基因传播，强调需要新的治疗和微生物组保护策略。

articles.title: CRISPR-engineered microbiome: living therapeutics revolutionize blood cancer immunotherapy.
articles.titleZh: CRISPR 工程微生物组：活体疗法彻底改变了血癌免疫疗法。
articles.authors: Cheng F, Soleimani Samarkhazan H, Khazaei Y.
articles.abstract: Blood cancers such as leukemia, lymphoma, and myeloma remain refractory in many patients due to immune escape, antigen heterogeneity, and therapy‑related toxicities. To address these challenges, we review recent strategies that harness CRISPR‑engineered gut commensals as precision "living therapeutics" to modulate host immunity and directly target malignant clones. We frame this review around three principal themes: (1) mechanistic strategies whereby CRISPR-engineered commensals modulate host immunity and directly antagonize malignant clones; (2) the enabling technologies and delivery/containment platforms, CRISPR variants, phage/LNP delivery, genetic circuits and biocontainment, that make living therapeutics feasible; and (3) translational progress, outstanding technical and safety barriers, and ethical/regulatory challenges that must be addressed for clinical deployment. To illustrate these themes, we discuss three concrete therapeutic modalities: engineered microbial secretion of immunomodulators, targeted delivery of tumor-lytic payloads, and engineered production of anticancer metabolites, and how these are enabled by contemporary CRISPR and synthetic-biology toolkits. Selected preclinical models report substantial antitumor effects, often >60% tumor reduction in rodent studies, and restoration of CAR-T cell function in controlled settings; however, effect sizes vary across models, and human translation remains unproven. We also analyze key technical barriers, strain stability, biocontainment, off‑target effects, and propose solutions, including auxotrophic kill-switches and AI‑guided strain optimization. Finally, we outline future directions, from in situ phage delivery to multi‑omics-driven patient stratification. CRISPR‑microbiome editing represents a paradigm shift in hematologic oncology, offering localized, sustained therapy with reduced systemic toxicity.
articles.abstractZh: 由于免疫逃逸、抗原异质性和治疗相关毒性，白血病、淋巴瘤和骨髓瘤等血癌在许多患者中仍然难以治疗。为了应对这些挑战，我们回顾了最近的策略，这些策略利用 CRISPR 工程肠道共生体作为精确的“活疗法”来调节宿主免疫并直接靶向恶性克隆。我们围绕三个主要主题进行本次综述：(1) CRISPR 工程共生体调节宿主免疫并直接拮抗恶性克隆的机制策略； (2) 使活疗法可行的使能技术和递送/遏制平台、CRISPR变体、噬菌体/LNP递送、遗传电路和生物遏制； (3) 临床部署必须解决的转化进展、突出的技术和安全障碍以及伦理/监管挑战。为了说明这些主题，我们讨论了三种具体的治疗方式：免疫调节剂的工程微生物分泌、肿瘤溶解有效负载的靶向递送、抗癌代谢物的工程生产，以及如何通过当代 CRISPR 和合成生物学工具包实现这些。精选

articles.title: Modelling reliable metabolic phenotypes by analysing the context-specific transcriptomics data.
articles.titleZh: 通过分析特定背景的转录组数据来建模可靠的代谢表型。
articles.authors: Kumar S P, Bhatt NP.
articles.abstract: Genome-scale metabolic models (GEMs) are valuable tools for investigating healthy and disease states, but often lack the specificity to capture context-dependent metabolic adaptations. Tailoring GEMs using transcriptomic data is crucial for studying these context-specific variations by accurately identifying active metabolic reactions. This study introduces an algorithm called 'Localgini', which uses the Gini coefficient to quantify gene expression variability across samples, enabling precise identification of active reactions for context-specific models (CSMs). To evaluate Localgini, CSMs were generated using six different model extraction methods (MeMs) for NCI-60 cancer cell lines and human tissue datasets. Localgini-based CSMs better represent housekeeping functionalities and known metabolic pathways. Moreover, Localgini-generated active reaction sets require minimal support from the MeMs to build the CSMs. Localgini minimizes variability across CSMs built with different MeMs and the same gene expression data. Overall, by incorporating gene expression heterogeneity, Localgini provides an accurate method for constructing CSMs.
articles.abstractZh: 基因组规模的代谢模型（GEM）是研究健康和疾病状态的宝贵工具，但通常缺乏捕获环境依赖性代谢适应的特异性。使用转录组数据定制 GEM 对于通过准确识别活跃的代谢反应来研究这些特定背景的变异至关重要。这项研究引入了一种名为“Localgini”的算法，该算法使用基尼系数来量化样本之间的基因表达变异性，从而能够精确识别上下文特定模型（CSM）的活跃反应。为了评估 Localgini，使用六种不同的 NCI-60 癌细胞系和人体组织数据集模型提取方法 (MeM) 生成 CSM。基于 Localgini 的 CSM 更好地代表了管家功能和已知的代谢途径。此外，Localgini 生成的主动反应集需要 MeM 的最少支持来构建 CSM。 Localgini 最大限度地减少了使用不同 MeM 和相同基因表达数据构建的 CSM 之间的变异性。总体而言，通过整合基因表达异质性，Localgini 提供了构建 CSM 的准确方法。

articles.title: Rif-seq reveals Caulobacter crescentus mRNA decay is globally coordinated with transcription and translation.
articles.titleZh: Rif-seq 揭示新月柄杆菌 mRNA 衰减与转录和翻译全局协调。
articles.authors: Dilrangi KH, Aretakis JR, Vaidya K, Al-Husini N, Muthunayake NS, Kim S, Schrader JM.
articles.abstract: While transcription and translation have been shown to be coordinated with mRNA decay across various single-gene studies, their global coordination remains poorly defined. Therefore, we utilize rifampicin sequencing experiments in Caulobacter crescentus to measure genome-wide mRNA lifetimes and analyze the impact of transcription and translation. Based on the RNA polymerase elongation speed, we identify that approximately 20% of the transcriptome is cotranscriptionally degraded. To investigate translation's impact on mRNA decay, we find that translation efficiency measured by ribosome profiling correlates with mRNA lifetime. We compare the 5' P cleavage sites to ribosome occupancy and find that cleavage sites occur preferentially in regions of low ribosome occupancy. Using the translation initiation inhibitor retapamulin, which traps ribosomes at the start codon, and chloramphenicol, which arrests elongating ribosomes, we show that ribosomes directly protect the occupied mRNA regions. Taken altogether, mRNA decay is globally interconnected with transcription and translation.
articles.abstractZh: 虽然在各种单基因研究中，转录和翻译已被证明与 mRNA 衰减相协调，但它们的整体协调仍不清楚。因此，我们利用新月柄杆菌中的利福平测序实验来测量全基因组 mRNA 寿命并分析转录和翻译的影响。根据 RNA 聚合酶延伸速度，我们确定大约 20% 的转录组被共转录降解。为了研究翻译对 mRNA 衰减的影响，我们发现通过核糖体分析测量的翻译效率与 mRNA 寿命相关。我们将 5'P 裂解位点与核糖体占用率进行比较，发现裂解位点优先出现在核糖体占用率低的区域。使用翻译起始抑制剂瑞他莫林（在起始密码子处捕获核糖体）和氯霉素（阻止核糖体延伸），我们证明核糖体直接保护被占据的 mRNA 区域。总而言之，mRNA 的衰变与转录和翻译密切相关。

articles.title: <i>Phytophthora</i> effector exploits WY module truncation to manipulate Nt-acetylation-mediated AtMBP-1 turnover and suppress plant immunity.
articles.titleZh: 疫霉效应子利用 WY 模块截短来操纵 Nt 乙酰化介导的 AtMBP-1 更新并抑制植物免疫。
articles.authors: Tian S, Peng Q, Du X, Shao G, Gao W, Liu Q, Gu B, Liu X.
articles.abstract: Phytophthora pathogens deliver a repertoire of WY(L) modular effectors to disarm plant immunity. Understanding how these conserved modules mediate the interactions between Phytophthora effectors and host targets to manipulate plant immunity is crucial. Here, we identified two WY(L) modular paralogous effectors, PcAvh337a and PcAvh337b, essential for Phytophthora capsici virulence. Transposon insertion induced truncation of WY(L) module, enabling PcAvh337b to target Arabidopsis cMyc binding protein 1 (AtMBP-1). While the existence of AtMBP-1 has been debated, this study demonstrates that alternative transcription initiation and translation can generate AtMBP-1, further revealing that AtMBP-1 compromises plant immune responses as a susceptibility factor. AtMBP-1 homeostasis is antagonistically regulated by N-terminal acetyltransferases A and C (NatA and NatC). By modulating AtMBP-1-Nat complexes, PcAvh337b enhances NatA-mediated acetylation of AtMBP-1 to protect AtMBP-1 from ubiquitin-dependent degradation, thereby promoting P. capsici infection. These findings reveal a pathogenic mechanism through which an effector regulates AtMBP-1-Nat modules to suppress plant defense responses, highlighting virulence mechanisms diversification driven by effector dynamics.
articles.abstractZh: 疫霉病原体传递一系列 WY(L) 模块化效应子来解除植物免疫力。了解这些保守模块如何介导疫霉效应子和宿主靶标之间的相互作用以操纵植物免疫至关重要。在这里，我们鉴定了两个 WY(L) 模块化旁系同源效应子 PcAvh337a 和 PcAvh337b，它们对于辣椒疫霉毒力至关重要。转座子插入诱导 WY(L) 模块截短，使 PcAvh337b 能够靶向拟南芥 cMyc 结合蛋白 1 (AtMBP-1)。虽然 AtMBP-1 的存在存在争议，但这项研究表明，替代转录起始和翻译可以生成 AtMBP-1，进一步揭示 AtMBP-1 作为易感因子会损害植物免疫反应。 AtMBP-1 稳态受到 N 端乙酰转移酶 A 和 C（NatA 和 NatC）的拮抗调节。通过调节 AtMBP-1-Nat 复合物，PcAvh337b 增强 NatA 介导的 AtMBP-1 乙酰化，以保护 AtMBP-1 免受泛素依赖性降解，从而促进辣椒疫霉感染。这些发现揭示了效应器调节 AtMBP-1-Nat 模块以抑制植物防御反应的致病机制，h

articles.title: <i>Wolbachia</i>-derived small non-coding RNAs exhibit cross-kingdom regulatory effects on host reproduction of a polyphagous mite.
articles.titleZh: 沃尔巴克氏体衍生的小非编码 RNA 对多食性螨虫的宿主繁殖表现出跨界调节作用。
articles.authors: Zhang YY, Shen XY, Zhao DS, Hoffmann A, Hong XY.
articles.abstract: Wolbachia is a ubiquitous endosymbiont in arthropods that produces small non-coding RNAs, which function as regulators in both the bacterium and its host. Although recent studies have shown cross-kingdom communication between Wolbachia and its host through Wolbachia-derived small non-coding RNAs (WsnRNAs), the functions of WsnRNAs have not been systematically examined. Here, we identify WsnRNAs in Wolbachia-infected Tetranychus truncatus Ehara via RNA-seq and investigate their impacts on host reproductive fitness. A total of 12 WsnRNAs were identified, along with their predicted precursors and hairpin structures. The predicted target genes of five highly expressed WsnRNAs are involved in reproductive development, as revealed by enrichment analysis. Inhibition of WsnRNA-744 and WsnRNA-3640 reduced fecundity, whereas inhibition of WsnRNA-6108 promoted it, indicating that different WsnRNAs exert opposing effects on host fecundity. These findings suggest that WsnRNAs mediate host-endosymbiont communication across species and could represent promising targets for Wolbachia-based pest control strategies.
articles.abstractZh: 沃尔巴克氏体是节肢动物中普遍存在的内共生体，它产生小的非编码 RNA，这些 RNA 在细菌及其宿主中充当调节剂。尽管最近的研究表明沃尔巴克氏体与其宿主之间通过沃尔巴克氏体衍生的小非编码RNA（WsnRNA）进行跨界通讯，但WsnRNA的功能尚未得到系统研究。在这里，我们通过 RNA-seq 鉴定了感染 Wolbachia 的截尾叶螨 (Tetranychus truncatus Ehara) 中的 WsnRNA，并研究了它们对宿主繁殖适应性的影响。总共鉴定出 12 个 WsnRNA 及其预测的前体和发夹结构。富集分析显示，5 个高表达 WsnRNA 的预测靶基因参与生殖发育。抑制 WsnRNA-744 和 WsnRNA-3640 会降低繁殖力，而抑制 WsnRNA-6108 会促进繁殖力，表明不同的 WsnRNA 对宿主繁殖力产生相反的影响。这些发现表明，WsnRNA 介导跨物种的宿主-内共生体通讯，并且可能代表基于沃尔巴克氏体的害虫控制策略的有希望的目标。

articles.title: bHLH35 mediates specificity in plant responses to multiple stress conditions.
articles.titleZh: bHLH35 介导植物对多种胁迫条件的特异性反应。
articles.authors: Sinha R, Zandalinas SI, Peláez-Vico MÁ, Mohanty D, Ghani A, Khan MA, Induri SP, Bereimipour A, Ghandour T, Ogden A, Huang SC, Azad RK, Mendoza-Cózatl D, Joshi T, Fritschi FB, Mittler R.
articles.abstract: Climate change and enhanced pollution levels are subjecting plants and crops to an increased number of different stressors, simultaneously or sequentially, generating conditions of multifactorial stress combination (MFSC). Although MFSC was shown to severely diminish plant growth, yield, and survival, how plants acclimate to increased levels of stress complexity is largely unknown.
