Here, we reveal that the Arabidopsis thaliana transcriptional regulator basic helix-loop-helix 35 (bHLH35) is required for plant acclimation to a specific set of MFSC conditions that includes a combination of salinity, excess light, and heat, occurring simultaneously (but not to each of these stresses applied individually or in any other combination). Under the three-stress combination, bHLH35 interacts with no apical meristem/transcription activator factor/cup-shaped cotyledon 69 (NAC069), binds the promoter of lateral organ boundaries domain 31 (LBD31), and regulates the expression of transcripts involved in flavonoid metabolism and ethylene signaling. Our findings uncover a high degree of specificity in plant responses to stress combination, suggesting that different conditions of MFSC could require the function of specific genetic programs for acclimation.
articles.abstractZh: 气候变化和污染水平的提高使植物和农作物同时或相继遭受越来越多的不同压力源，从而产生多因素压力组合（MFSC）的条件。尽管 MFSC 被证明会严重降低植物的生长、产量和存活率，但植物如何适应增加的胁迫复杂性水平在很大程度上尚不清楚。在这里，我们揭示了拟南芥转录调节因子基本螺旋-环-螺旋35（bHLH35）是植物适应一组特定的MFSC条件所必需的，这些条件包括同时发生的盐度、过量光和热的组合（但不是单独或以任何其他组合施加的这些胁迫中的每一个）。在三胁迫组合下，bHLH35与无顶端分生组织/转录激活因子/杯状子叶69（NAC069）相互作用，结合侧器官边界域31（LBD31）的启动子，并调节参与类黄酮代谢和乙烯信号传导的转录物的表达。我们的研究结果揭示了植物对胁迫组合的反应具有高度特异性，这表明 MFSC 的不同条件可能需要

articles.title: Cultivation of Methanonezhaarchaeia, the third class of methanogens within the phylum Thermoproteota.
articles.titleZh: Methanonezhaarchaeia 的培养，Thermoproteota 门中的第三类产甲烷菌。
articles.authors: Kohtz AJ, Nupp S, Hatzenpichler R.
articles.abstract: Methane is a potent greenhouse gas, largely produced by methanogenic archaea, contributing to Earth's dynamic climate and biogeochemical cycles. In the past decade, metagenomics revealed that lineages outside of the Euryarchaeota superphylum encode genes for methanogenesis. This was recently confirmed through the cultivation of two classes of methanogenic Thermoproteota. Thus far, all methanogens within the Thermoproteota are predicted or were shown to be methylotrophic. The only exception to this are the Nezhaarchaea, for which metagenomic predictions suggest they are CO2-reducing methanogens. Here, we demonstrate methanogenic activity in a third class of Thermoproteota, the Methanonezhaarchaeia. Contrary to genomic predictions for this class, we cultivated a methylotrophic species, Candidatus Methanonezhaarchaeum fastidiosum YNP3N, highlighting the importance of testing metagenomic hypotheses through experimentation. We investigate the metabolic diversity of Methanonezhaarchaeia, including metabolic modifications accompanying frequent loss of methanogenesis in this class. This highlights gaps in our understanding of the biochemistry, diversity, and evolution of thermoproteotal methanogens and their contributions to carbon cycling.
articles.abstractZh: 甲烷是一种强效温室气体，主要由产甲烷古菌产生，有助于地球的动态气候和生物地球化学循环。在过去的十年中，宏基因组学揭示了广古菌超门之外的谱系编码产甲烷基因。最近通过培养两类产甲烷热蛋白菌证实了这一点。到目前为止，Thermoproteota 内的所有产甲烷菌均被预测或显示为甲基营养型。唯一的例外是 Nezhaarchaea，宏基因组预测表明它们是二氧化碳还原产甲烷菌。在这里，我们展示了第三类Thermoproteota（Methanonezhaarchaeia）的产甲烷活性。与该类别的基因组预测相反，我们培养了一种甲基营养物种 Candidatus Methanonezhaarchaeum fastidiosum YNP3N，强调了通过实验测试宏基因组假设的重要性。我们研究了 Methanonezhaarchaeia 的代谢多样性，包括此类中伴随产甲烷作用频繁丧失的代谢改变。这凸显了我们对热蛋白生物化学、多样性和进化的理解上的差距

articles.title: Interferon-stimulated gene GALNT2 restricts respiratory virus infections.
articles.titleZh: 干扰素刺激的基因 GALNT2 可限制呼吸道病毒感染。
articles.authors: Ran W, Yang J, Yu S, Hu Q, He Y, Wang S, Wei C, Sun J, Zhu A, Li F, Zhang L, Li P, Hu H, Pan R, Yu Y, Yuan Y, Sun L, Wang Y, Zhang Z, Chen Z, Liu D, Yan Q, Wang D, Yu K, Wang Y, Zhuo J, Zhuang Z, Tao H, Zeng Q, Zhou K, Chen F, Tang W, Zhou Y, Bai R, Xu Y, Li N, Dai J, Zhao H, Park JE, Wang T, Ding Q, Perlman S, Zhao J, Mao Y, Wang S, Zhao J.
articles.abstract: The innate immune response involves interferons (IFNs), antiviral cytokines that upregulate numerous IFN-stimulated genes, many of which have uncharacterized functions and mechanisms. Here we performed transcriptomic profiling of lung tissues from wild-type and IFNAR-/- mice infected with SARS-CoV-2 and single-cell RNA sequencing of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid and peripheral blood mononuclear cells from patients with COVID-19. We identified O-GalNAc transferase 2 (GALNT2), an N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase, as an antiviral IFN-stimulated gene restricting the replication of multiple coronaviruses and influenza A viruses in vitro and in vivo, contributing to viral clearance and reducing disease severity. Mechanistically, GALNT2-dependent O-linked glycosylation may regulate viral glycoprotein proteolytic processing and impair viral growth by blocking virus-cell fusion. In addition, we found that serine residues at 810/813 in the viral spike protein undergo O-glycosylation and function as the primary genetic determinants of sensitivity or evasion towards GALNT2. Human genetic data analysis revealed that individuals with GALNT2 variants that lost antiviral function had elevated risk of hospitalization following SARS-CoV-2 infection. This study establishes GALNT2 as an antiviral factor against some respiratory virus infections.
articles.abstractZh: 先天免疫反应涉及干扰素 (IFN)，这是一种抗病毒细胞因子，可上调许多 IFN 刺激的基因，其中许多基因具有未知的功能和机制。在这里，我们对感染 SARS-CoV-2 的野生型和 IFNAR-/- 小鼠的肺组织进行了转录组分析，并对 COVID-19 患者的支气管肺泡灌洗液和外周血单核细胞进行了单细胞 RNA 测序。我们确定了 O-GalNAc 转移酶 2 (GALNT2)（一种 N-乙酰半乳糖胺基转移酶）作为一种抗病毒 IFN 刺激基因，可限制多种冠状病毒和甲型流感病毒在体外和体内的复制，有助于病毒清除并降低疾病严重程度。从机制上讲，GALNT2依赖性O-连接糖基化可能调节病毒糖蛋白的蛋白水解加工，并通过阻断病毒-细胞融合来损害病毒生长。此外，我们发现病毒刺突蛋白中 810/813 的丝氨酸残基经历 O-糖基化，并作为对 GALNT2 敏感或逃避的主要遗传决定因素。人类遗传数据分析显示，具有丧失抗病毒功能的 GALNT2 变异的个体风险较高

articles.title: Three transcription factors, OsNF-YC8, OsNF-YC9, and OsNF-YC10, function redundantly to promote amylopectin synthesis by activating SBE3 expression in rice endosperm.
articles.titleZh: 三种转录因子 OsNF-YC8、OsNF-YC9 和 OsNF-YC10 冗余地发挥作用，通过激活水稻胚乳中的 SBE3 表达来促进支链淀粉的合成。
articles.authors: Chen J, Bian X, Chu R, Wang T, Yang R, Zhang C, Huang L, Fan X, Liu Q.
articles.abstract: Starch branching enzyme (SBE) is a key enzyme in starch biosynthesis that introduces branch points into starch molecules. Among its three isoforms, SBE3 plays a pivotal role, as its loss of function significantly alters starch granule structure and accumulation in rice, leading to chalky grains and reduced grain weight. However, the molecular regulatory network governing SBE3 expression remains largely unknown. In this study, three NF-YC family transcription factors-OsNF-YC8, OsNF-YC9, and OsNF-YC10-were identified as transcriptional activators of SBE3, each directly binding to the AAGAGG motif in the SBE3 promoter. Functional analysis revealed functional redundancy among these NF-YC members, as disruption of one or two genes had little effect on SBE3 expression. In contrast, simultaneous disruption of all three genes in the osnf-yc8/9/10 triple mutant resulted in a pronounced reduction in SBE3 transcription, accompanied by a substantial decrease in short-chain amylopectin with degrees of polymerization ranging from 6 to 24. The endosperm of osnf-yc8/9/10 appeared milky white, and resistant starch content was 3.7-fold higher than that of the wild type, without a significant reduction in grain weight. These results elucidate the regulatory roles of OsNF-YC8, OsNF-YC9, and OsNF-YC10 in SBE3 expression and short-chain amylopectin biosynthesis, highlighting their potential for developing functional rice cultivars.
articles.abstractZh: 淀粉分支酶（SBE）是淀粉生物合成中的关键酶，可将分支点引入淀粉分子中。在其三种亚型中，SBE3 发挥着关键作用，因为它的功能丧失显着改变了水稻中淀粉颗粒的结构和积累，导致稻谷白垩化和粒重降低。然而，控制 SBE3 表达的分子调控网络仍然很大程度上未知。在这项研究中，三个 NF-YC 家族转录因子——OsNF-YC8、OsNF-YC9 和 OsNF-YC10——被鉴定为 SBE3 的转录激活因子，每个因子都直接与 SBE3 启动子中的 AAGAGG 基序结合。功能分析揭示了这些 NF-YC 成员之间的功能冗余，因为一两个基因的破坏对 SBE3 表达几乎没有影响。相比之下，osnf-yc8/9/10三突变体中所有三个基因同时破坏导致SBE3转录显着减少，同时聚合度在6至24之间的短链支链淀粉大幅减少。osnf-yc8/9/10的胚乳呈乳白色，抗性淀粉含量比野生型高3.7倍，但没有明显减少。

articles.title: Commensal human gut microbes produce species specific neuroactive compounds.
articles.titleZh: 共生的人类肠道微生物产生物种特异性的神经活性化合物。
articles.authors: Tingler AM, Packirisamy C, Gutierrez A, Horvath AE, Grozis M, Haidacher SJ, Hoch KM, Haag AM, Oezguen N, Engevik KA, Engevik AC, Horvath TD, Engevik MA.
articles.abstract: The gut microbiota communicates with multiple organs through neuroactive molecules, but the specific compounds produced remain unclear. We investigated eight commensal gut species, Lactococcus lactis, Enterococcus faecalis, Blautia producta, Clostridium symbiosum, Streptococcus thermophilus, Prevotella copri, Bacteroides fragilis, and Escherichia coli Nissle, using targeted and non-targeted LC-MS/MS. These bacteria differentially consumed glutamine, glutamate, and tryptophan, producing distinct neuroactive metabolites. For example, E. coli and B. producta generated high levels of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA), while P. copri was the sole producer of tryptamine. In the tyrosine pathway, E. faecalis synthesized tyramine and dopamine, and L. lactis, B. producta, and E. coli produced L-DOPA. Interestingly, none produced serotonin or its intermediates despite consuming tryptophan. Multiple species also generated short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs). These findings demonstrate that commensal microbes contribute to host neurochemistry by producing diverse neuroactive metabolites and SCFAs, highlighting the therapeutic potential of modulating the gut microbiota to influence human health.
articles.abstractZh: 肠道微生物群通过神经活性分子与多个器官进行交流，但产生的具体化合物仍不清楚。我们使用靶向和非靶向 LC-MS/MS 研究了八种共生肠道菌种：乳酸乳球菌、粪肠球菌、布氏菌、共生梭菌、嗜热链球菌、普氏菌、脆弱拟杆菌和大肠杆菌尼氏菌。这些细菌不同程度地消耗谷氨酰胺、谷氨酸和色氨酸，产生不同的神经活性代谢物。例如，大肠杆菌和 B.producta 产生高水平的γ-氨基丁酸（GABA），而普氏菌是色胺的唯一生产者。在酪氨酸途径中，粪肠球菌合成酪胺和多巴胺，乳酸乳球菌、产芽孢杆菌和大肠杆菌产生L-多巴。有趣的是，尽管消耗了色氨酸，但没有一个产生血清素或其中间体。多个物种也产生短链脂肪酸（SCFA）。这些发现表明，共生微生物通过产生多种神经活性代谢物和 SCFA 来促进宿主神经化学，凸显了调节肠道微生物群影响人类健康的治疗潜力。

articles.title: SUMO-specific proteases SPF1 and SPF2 negatively regulate seed oil synthesis by mediating WRI1 deSUMOylation.
articles.titleZh: SUMO 特异性蛋白酶 SPF1 和 SPF2 通过介导 WRI1 去 SUMO 化来负向调节种子油合成。
articles.authors: Liu X, Liu L, Li S, Zhao J, Chen Y, Ma W, Tang S, Guo L, Guo X, Fan C, Hu Z.
articles.abstract: SUMO PROTEASE RELATED TO FERTILITY 1 (SPF1) and SPF2 are responsible for deSUMOylation of SUMO-conjugated protein substrates and for maintaining protein SUMOylation homeostasis. To date, the role of SUMO proteases in fatty acid biosynthesis and lipid accumulation remains unclear. Here, we demonstrate that the Arabidopsis thaliana mutantsspf1-1, spf2-1, and spf1-1 spf2-1 exhibit increased seed size and elevated seed oil content (SOC). We further show that SPF1 and SPF2 interact with WRINKLED1 (WRI1), a master regulator of the transcriptional control of plant oil synthesis. Genetic analyses indicate that the spf1-1 wri1-3 and spf2-1 wri1-3 double mutants, as well as the spf1-1 spf2-1 wri1-3 triple mutant, phenocopy wri1-3 and display severe seed shriveling, indicating that SPF1 and SPF2 act upstream of WRI1. WRI1 was identified as a SUMO1 substrate with two conserved SUMOylation sites, lysine 257 (K257) and K266, in cruciferous plants, with K257 acting as the dominant site required for seed oil synthesis. SUMOylation enhances WRI1 stability, whereas SPF1- and SPF2-mediated deSUMOylation promotes WRI1 degradation. In spf1-1, spf2-1, and spf1-1 spf2-1 mutants, the abundance of SUMOylated WRI1 increases during seed development and correlates with elevated seed oil accumulation. Together, these results indicate that SPF1 and SPF2 negatively regulate oil synthesis by deSUMOylating WRI1, establishing a dynamic SUMOylation and deSUMOylation switch centered on the SPF1/SPF2-WRI1 module that fine-tunes seed development and oil synthesis.
articles.abstractZh: 与生育力相关的 SUMO 蛋白酶 1 (SPF1) 和 SPF2 负责 SUMO 缀合蛋白质底物的去 SUMO 化并维持蛋白质 SUMO 化稳态。迄今为止，SUMO 蛋白酶在脂肪酸生物合成和脂质积累中的作用仍不清楚。在这里，我们证明拟南芥突变体 spf1-1、spf2-1 和 spf1-1 spf2-1 表现出种子大小增加和种子含油量 (SOC) 增加。我们进一步表明 SPF1 和 SPF2 与 WRINKLED1 (WRI1) 相互作用，WRINKLED1 (WRI1) 是植物油合成转录控制的主要调节因子。遗传分析表明，spf1-1 wri1-3 和 spf2-1 wri1-3 双突变体，以及 spf1-1 spf2-1 wri1-3 三重突变体，表现出 wri1-3 的表型并表现出严重的种子枯萎，表明 SPF1 和 SPF2 作用于 WRI1 的上游。 WRI1 被鉴定为十字花科植物中具有两个保守 SUMO 化位点赖氨酸 257 (K257) 和 K266 的 SUMO1 底物，其中 K257 是种子油合成所需的主要位点。 SUMOylation 增强 WRI1 稳定性，而 SPF1 和 SPF2 介导的去SUMOylation 则促进 WRI1 降解。在 spf1-1、spf2-1 和 spf1-1 spf2-1 突变体中，SUMOylat 的丰度

articles.title: The OsWRKY47-OsMYB30/OsWRKY39 module confers both physical and chemical defenses against Magnaporthe oryzae to enhance rice blast resistance.
articles.titleZh: OsWRKY47-OsMYB30/OsWRKY39 模块可针对稻瘟病菌提供物理和化学防御，以增强稻瘟病抗性。
articles.authors: Liu Y, Xiong J, Wu Q, Wang K, Yin J, Hou Q, He K, Zhou T, Zhang Y, Chen J, Xu L, Zeng J, Ma Y, Yi Q, Zhang W, Chen L, Tang Y, Lu X, Wang L, Zhu X, Su J, Shi H, Song L, Xiong Q, Wang J, He M, Chen X, Li W.
articles.abstract: The infection cycle of Magnaporthe oryzae (M. oryzae) in rice typically involves initial invasion through penetration of the leaf epidermis, followed by expansion into neighboring cells. However, few studies have identified single genes that mediate defense against both invasion and expansion. In this study, we demonstrate that OsWRKY47 positively regulates resistance to both stages of M. oryzae infection. Mechanistic analyses indicate that OsWRKY47 transcriptionally activates OsMYB30 during the early stage, thereby enhancing lignin accumulation and strengthening physical barriers against fungal invasion. At later stages, OsWRKY47 represses OsWRKY39 expression, thereby inhibiting M. oryzae expansion. Knockout of OsWRKY39 leads to increased accumulation of stevioside, a metabolite that activates plant immune responses, representing a chemical defense strategy. Structure-function analyses further reveal that a region comprising amino acids 282-288 of OsWRKY47 is crucial for the positive regulation of OsMYB30, whereas the region comprising amino acids 303-333 is essential for repression of OsWRKY39. Collectively, these findings reveal an OsWRKY47-OsMYB30/OsWRKY39 regulatory module that confers resistance to M. oryzae by coordinating physical and chemical defenses to restrict pathogen invasion and expansion. Such coordinated activation of physical and chemical defenses may represent a widespread strategy in plant pathogen responses.
articles.abstractZh: 稻瘟病菌 (M. oryzae) 在水稻中的感染周期通常涉及通过穿透叶表皮进行初始入侵，然后扩展到邻近细胞。然而，很少有研究鉴定出介导防御入侵和扩张的单个基因。在这项研究中，我们证明 OsWRKY47 正向调节对米霉感染两个阶段的抵抗力。机制分析表明，OsWRKY47 在早期转录激活 OsMYB30，从而增强木质素积累并加强针对真菌入侵的物理屏障。在后期，OsWRKY47 抑制 OsWRKY39 表达，从而抑制米霉的扩增。 OsWRKY39 的敲除会导致甜菊苷的积累增加，甜菊苷是一种激活植物免疫反应的代谢物，代表一种化学防御策略。结构-功能分析进一步揭示，包含OsWRKY47的氨基酸282-288的区域对于OsMYB30的正向调节至关重要，而包含氨基酸303-333的区域对于OsWRKY39的抑制是必需的。总的来说，这些发现揭示了 OsWRKY47-OsMYB30/OsWRKY39 调控模块

articles.title: A direct role for a mitochondrial targeting sequence in signalling stress.
articles.titleZh: 线粒体靶向序列在信号应激中的直接作用。
articles.authors: Yuan Z, Balzarini M, Volpe M, Goldstein M, Peng TS, Hui E, Fang NN, Albihlal WS, Hajimohammadi M, Wei K, Yip CK, van Werven FJ, Mayor T, Weidberg H.
articles.abstract: Mitochondrial protein import is required for maintaining organellar function1. Perturbations in this process are associated with various physiological and disease conditions2. Several stress responses, including the mitochondrial compromised protein import response (mitoCPR), combat damage caused by mitochondrial protein import defects2. However, how this defect is sensed remains largely unknown. Here we reveal that the conserved mitochondrial Hsp70 co-chaperone, Mge1, acts as a stress messenger in budding yeast. During mitochondrial stress, unimported Mge1 entered the nucleus and triggered the transcription of mitoCPR target genes. This was mediated by the interaction of Mge1 with the transcription factor Pdr3 on DNA regulatory elements. The mitochondrial targeting sequence of Mge1 was both sufficient and essential for mitoCPR induction, demonstrating that in addition to their roles in mitochondrial protein import, targeting sequences can also function as signalling molecules. As protein import defects are a common consequence of various types of mitochondrial damage3,4, these findings suggest a novel function for the targeting sequence of Mge1 as an indicator of mitochondrial health.
articles.abstractZh: 维持细胞器功能需要线粒体蛋白输入1。这一过程中的扰动与各种生理和疾病状况有关2。几种应激反应，包括线粒体受损蛋白输入反应（mitoCPR），可以对抗线粒体蛋白输入缺陷引起的损伤2。然而，如何感知这种缺陷仍然很大程度上未知。在这里，我们揭示了保守的线粒体 Hsp70 共伴侣 Mge1 在芽殖酵母中充当应激信使。在线粒体应激期间，未输入的 Mge1 进入细胞核并触发 mitoCPR 靶基因的转录。这是由 Mge1 与 DNA 调控元件上的转录因子 Pdr3 相互作用介导的。 Mge1 的线粒体靶向序列对于 mitoCPR 诱导来说既充分又重要，这表明除了在线粒体蛋白输入中发挥作用外，靶向序列还可以充当信号分子。由于蛋白质输入缺陷是各种类型线粒体损伤的常见后果3,4，这些发现表明 Mge1 的靶向序列作为线粒体健康指标具有新功能。

articles.title: A Mycelium Dataset with Edge-Precise Annotation for Semantic Segmentation.
articles.titleZh: 用于语义分割的具有边缘精确注释的菌丝体数据集。
articles.authors: Yuan Q, Liu W, Liu Y, Li P, Liu Y, Yuan X, Dong N, Xiong S, Fu Y.
articles.abstract: With the increasing application of computer vision in mycology research, precisely segmenting mycelium and its edges in petri dish images remains a critical and underexplored task. This technology, accurately delineating mycelium boundaries, enables quantification of growth patterns, playing a crucial role in exploration of strain-related features, environmental adaptability, and physiological stimuli responses. The field confronts two bottlenecks, restricting real-world computer vision application. First, scarce public datasets impede development of mycelium-specific algorithms. Second, low contrast and high complexity of mycelium edges complicate annotation and segmentation processes. To address these bottlenecks, we established MyceliumSeg, the first large-scale benchmark dataset. MyceliumSeg contains: (i) 20,176 high-quality diverse images covering full growth cycle of four fungal species across multiple culture conditions; (ii) 567 pixel-level labeled samples generated with 37 person-days' manual effort through a mycelium annotation framework, including a multi-blind refined annotation guideline and a novel disagreement solution; (iii) a benchmark evaluating mainstream deep learning models under classic and boundary-aware segmentation metrics. MyceliumSeg serves as valuable resource for research on both mycology and segmentation algorithm.
articles.abstractZh: 随着计算机视觉在真菌学研究中的应用不断增加，在培养皿图像中精确分割菌丝体及其边缘仍然是一项关键且尚未充分探索的任务。这项技术可以准确地描绘菌丝体边界，实现生长模式的量化，在探索菌株相关特征、环境适应性和生理刺激反应方面发挥着至关重要的作用。该领域面临两个瓶颈，限制了计算机视觉的实际应用。首先，稀缺的公共数据集阻碍了菌丝体特定算法的开发。其次，菌丝体边缘的低对比度和高复杂性使注释和分割过程变得复杂。为了解决这些瓶颈，我们建立了第一个大规模基准数据集 MyceliumSeg。 MyceliumSeg 包含：(i) 20,176 张高质量的多样化图像，涵盖四种真菌物种在多种培养条件下的完整生长周期； (ii) 通过菌丝体注释框架，经过 37 人天的人工努力生成了 567 个像素级标记样本，包括多盲精细注释指南和新颖的分歧解决方案； (iii) 评估主流深度学习的基准

articles.title: A reconstruction of the mammalian secretory pathway identifies mechanisms regulating antibody production.
articles.titleZh: 哺乳动物分泌途径的重建确定了调节抗体产生的机制。
articles.authors: Masson H, Tat J, Di Giusto P, Antonakoudis A, Shamie I, Baghdassarian H, Samoudi M, Robinson CM, Kuo CC, Koga N, Singh S, Gezalyan A, Li Z, Movsessian A, Richelle A, Lewis NE.
articles.abstract: The secretory pathway processes >30% of mammalian proteins, orchestrating their synthesis, modification, trafficking, and quality control across multiple organelles via coordinated interactions, making its regulation difficult to decipher. To advance such research, we present secRecon, a reconstruction of the mammalian secretory pathway, comprising 1,127 manually curated genes organized within 77 secretory process terms, annotated with functional roles, subcellular localization, protein interactions, and complexes. Applying secRecon to omics data revealed distinct secretory topologies in antibody-producing plasma cells versus Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cells, with CHO-specific deficiencies in proteostasis, translocation, and N-glycosylation genes, highlighting targets to enhance secretion. Analysis of single-cell SEC-seq data uncovered diversity in IgG-secreting plasma cells that is shaped by the unfolded protein response, endoplasmic reticulum (ER)-associated degradation, and vesicle trafficking and identified distinct secretory machinery genes as markers of plasma cell differentiation. These results show that secRecon enables the discovery of mechanisms controlling protein secretion and supports applications in both biomedical research and biotechnology. A record of this paper's transparent peer review process is included in the supplemental information.
articles.abstractZh: 分泌途径处理超过 30% 的哺乳动物蛋白质，通过协调的相互作用协调多个细胞器的合成、修饰、运输和质量控制，使其调控难以破译。为了推进此类研究，我们提出了 secRecon，它是哺乳动物分泌途径的重建，包含 77 个分泌过程术语中组织的 1,127 个手动基因，并注释了功能作用、亚细胞定位、蛋白质相互作用和复合物。将 secRecon 应用于组学数据，揭示了产生抗体的浆细胞与中国仓鼠卵巢 (CHO) 细胞的不同分泌拓扑，其中 CHO 特异性的蛋白质稳态、易位和 N-糖基化基因缺陷，突出了增强分泌的目标。对单细胞 SEC-seq 数据的分析揭示了分泌 IgG 的浆细胞的多样性，这种多样性是由未折叠蛋白反应、内质网 (ER) 相关降解和囊泡运输形成的，并确定了不同的分泌机制基因作为浆细胞分化的标记。这些结果表明 secRecon 能够发现控制蛋白质分泌的机制

articles.title: Cross-regulation of [2Fe-2S] cluster synthesis by ferredoxin-2 and frataxin.
articles.titleZh: ferredoxin-2 和 frataxin 对 [2Fe-2S] 簇合成的交叉调节。
articles.authors: Want K, Gorny H, Turki E, Noiray M, Monfort B, Mor-Gautier R, Tubiana T, Jullian E, Monnier V, D'Autréaux B.
articles.abstract: Iron-sulfur (Fe-S) clusters are essential metallocofactors that perform a multitude of biological functions1-7. Their synthesis is tightly regulated and defects in this process lead to severe diseases8-10, such as Friedreich's ataxia, which is caused by defective expression of frataxin (FXN)11. However, the underlying mechanisms that regulate this process remain unclear. Here we show that efficient Fe-S cluster assembly requires a fine-tuned balance in the ratio of FXN and ferredoxin-2 (FDX2). Fe-S clusters are assembled on the scaffold protein ISCU2; sulfur is provided as a persulfide by NFS1, and the persulfide is cleaved into sulfide by FDX2 (refs. 12,13). FXN stimulates the whole process by accelerating the transfer of persulfide to ISCU2 (refs. 12,14,15). Using an in-vitro-reconstituted human system, we show that any deviation from a close-to-equal amount of FXN and FDX2 downregulates Fe-S cluster synthesis. Structure-function investigation reveals that this is due to competition between FXN and FDX2 and their similar affinities for the same binding site on the NFS1-ISCU2 complex, with higher levels of FXN impairing the persulfide reductase activity of FDX2 and higher levels of FDX2 slowing the FXN-accelerated transfer of persulfide to ISCU2. We also find that FDX2 directly hinders persulfide generation and transfer to ISCU2 by interacting with the persulfide-carrying mobile loop of NFS1. We further show that knocking down the expression of FDX2 increases fly lifespan in a Drosophila model of Friedreich's ataxia. Together, this work highlights a direct regulation of Fe-S cluster biosynthesis through antagonistic binding of FXN and FDX2, and suggests that decreasing FDX2 in the context of FXN deficiency in Friedreich's ataxia might constitute a novel therapeutic axis.
articles.abstractZh: 铁硫 (Fe-S) 簇是执行多种生物学功能的重要金属辅因子1-7。它们的合成受到严格调控，该过程中的缺陷会导致严重的疾病8-10，例如弗里德赖希共济失调，这是由frataxin (FXN)11表达缺陷引起的。然而，调节这一过程的根本机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明，有效的 Fe-S 簇组装需要 FXN 和铁氧还蛋白-2 (FDX2) 比例的微调平衡。 Fe-S簇组装在支架蛋白ISCU2上； NFS1 提供硫作为过硫化物，FDX2 将过硫化物裂解为硫化物（参考文献 12,13）。 FXN 通过加速过硫化物向 ISCU2 的转移来刺激整个过程（参考文献 12、14、15）。使用体外重建的人体系统，我们发现任何接近等量的 FXN 和 FDX2 的偏差都会下调 Fe-S 簇的合成。结构-功能研究表明，这是由于 FXN 和 FDX2 之间的竞争以及它们对 NFS1-ISCU2 复合物上相同结合位点的相似亲和力所致，较高水平的 FXN 会损害 FDX2 的过硫化物还原酶活性，较高水平的

articles.title: Decreased cytoplasmic crowding via inhibition of ribosome biogenesis can trigger Candida albicans filamentous growth.
articles.titleZh: 通过抑制核糖体生物发生减少细胞质拥挤可以引发白色念珠菌丝状生长。
articles.authors: Serrano A, Puerner C, Chevalier L, Plumb E, Elferich J, Diggs S, Sinn LR, Grigorieff N, Ralser M, Delarue M, Bassilana M, Arkowitz RA.
articles.abstract: The human fungal pathogen Candida albicans undergoes a morphological transition from a budding yeast to a filamentous form, which is associated with pathogenesis. Various cues mediate this transition including intracellular reorganization. The cytoplasm is densely packed with proteins including large macromolecular complexes, such as ribosomes, and hence, molecular crowding can impact a range of cellular processes. However, the relationship between cytoplasmic molecular crowding and morphological growth states is unclear. Using a fluorescent microrheological probe and single particle tracking, we observed a striking decrease in molecular crowding during filamentous growth in C. albicans. On the basis of simulations, proteomics and structural data from in situ cryogenic electron microscopy, we show that the reduction in crowding is due to a decrease in ribosome concentration that results in part from an inhibition of ribosome biogenesis, combined with an increase in cytoplasmic volume, leading to a dilution of ribosomes. Filamentation was enhanced in a mutant defective in ribosome biogenesis, while translation was not affected, suggesting that inhibition of ribosome biogenesis is a trigger for C. albicans morphogenesis. Overall, we show that filamentous growth is associated with reduced cytoplasmic crowding via changes in ribosome concentration, suggesting that combination therapies in which ribosome biogenesis is also targeted may be advantageous.
articles.abstractZh: 人类真菌病原体白色念珠菌经历了从芽殖酵母到丝状形式的形态转变，这与发病机制有关。多种线索介导这种转变，包括细胞内重组。细胞质中充满了蛋白质，包括核糖体等大分子复合物，因此分子拥挤会影响一系列细胞过程。然而，细胞质分子拥挤与形态生长状态之间的关系尚不清楚。使用荧光微流变探针和单粒子追踪，我们观察到白色念珠菌丝状生长期间分子拥挤度显着减少。基于模拟、蛋白质组学和原位低温电子显微镜的结构数据，我们表明拥挤的减少是由于核糖体浓度的降低，部分原因是核糖体生物发生的抑制，加上细胞质体积的增加，导致核糖体的稀释。在核糖体生物发生缺陷的突变体中，丝状结构增强，而翻译不受影响，这表明核糖体生物发生的抑制是

articles.title: Evolutionarily convergent mechanism of formin regulation coordinates actin polymerization in apicomplexan parasites.
articles.titleZh: 福尔明调节的进化收敛机制协调顶复门寄生虫中的肌动蛋白聚合。
articles.authors: Qian P, Fu Y, Zeng J, Naldrett MJ, Zhang R, Sibley LD.
articles.abstract: Apicomplexan parasites rely on actin-based motility for host cell invasion and for their dissemination. Although previous studies implicate formin 1 (FRM1) in governing this process in Toxoplasma, the mechanisms that position it at the cell apex and regulate its activity during the transition from intracellular replication to active motility remain unclear. Here, we demonstrate that FRM1 is complexed with a protein methyl transferase that stabilizes it from degradation and positions it at the cell apex. Moreover, we identify a conserved intramolecular interaction within FRM1 that serves as a critical regulatory switch that is functionally conserved in Plasmodium and other apicomplexan parasites. Using structural modeling combined with biochemical assays, we define two regulatory elements located upstream of the FH2 domain that mediate autoinhibition. Repositioning these elements by activation of an intramolecular switch relieves autoinhibition and activates actin polymerization by the FH2 domain. Collectively, these findings elucidate how precise regulation of FRM1 coordinates actin polymerization, parasite motility and host cell invasion.
articles.abstractZh: 顶复门寄生虫依靠基于肌动蛋白的运动来入侵宿主细胞并传播。尽管之前的研究表明福尔敏1（FRM1）在弓形虫中控制这一过程，但将其定位在细胞顶端并在从细胞内复制到主动运动的转变过程中调节其活性的机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们证明 FRM1 与蛋白质甲基转移酶复合，可稳定其降解并将其定位在细胞顶端。此外，我们还发现了 FRM1 内保守的分子内相互作用，该相互作用作为关键的调节开关，在疟原虫和其他顶复门寄生虫中功能保守。使用结构建模与生化测定相结合，我们定义了位于 FH2 结构域上游介导自抑制的两个调控元件。通过激活分子内开关重新定位这些元件可解除自抑制并通过 FH2 结构域激活肌动蛋白聚合。总的来说，这些发现阐明了 FRM1 的精确调节如何协调肌动蛋白聚合、寄生虫运动和宿主细胞入侵。

articles.title: HYPK promotes N-terminal protein acetylation through rapid ribosome exchange of NatA.
articles.titleZh: HYPK 通过 NatA 的快速核糖体交换促进 N 末端蛋白质乙酰化。
articles.authors: Lentzsch AM, Fan Z, Irshad IU, O'Brien EP, Sharma AK, Green R, Shan SO.
articles.abstract: Numerous protein biogenesis factors cotranslationally facilitate the maturation of nascent proteins. Among them, N-terminal acetyltransferase A (NatA) acetylates the N terminus of ∼40% of the eukaryotic proteome. NatA is bound to Huntingtin-interacting protein K (HYPK), which inhibits NatA activity in vitro but enhances function in vivo. Here, kinetic and in-cell measurements resolve this paradox, showing that HYPK acts as a ribosome exchange factor for NatA. Without HYPK, hyper-tight ribosome binding prevents NatA from accessing additional ribosomes following each round of acetylation. HYPK accelerates NatA dissociation from the ribosome to license multiple turnovers, allowing a sub-stoichiometric level of this enzyme to globally acetylate the nascent proteome. Our results uncover a previously unidentified function of HYPK and demonstrate that a "Goldilocks" zone of ribosome interaction kinetics is required for cotranslational protein biogenesis machineries to act on all translating ribosomes in the cell.
articles.abstractZh: 许多蛋白质生物发生因子共同翻译促进新生蛋白质的成熟。其中，N 端乙酰转移酶 A (NatA) 乙酰化约 40% 的真核蛋白质组的 N 端。 NatA 与亨廷顿蛋白相互作用蛋白 K (HYPK) 结合，在体外抑制 NatA 活性，但在体内增强功能。在这里，动力学和细胞内测量解决了这个悖论，表明 HYPK 充当 NatA 的核糖体交换因子。如果没有 HYPK，超紧密的核糖体结合会阻止 NatA 在每轮乙酰化后访问额外的核糖体。 HYPK 加速 NatA 从核糖体上的解离，以允许多次周转，从而允许该酶在亚化学计量水平下对新生蛋白质组进行全局乙酰化。我们的结果揭示了 HYPK 先前未识别的功能，并证明核糖体相互作用动力学的“金发姑娘”区是共翻译蛋白生物发生机制作用于细胞中所有翻译核糖体所必需的。

articles.title: Mutations in mitochondrial ferredoxin FDX2 suppress frataxin deficiency.
articles.titleZh: 线粒体铁氧还蛋白 FDX2 的突变可抑制 frataxin 缺乏。
articles.authors: Meisel JD, Joshi PR, Spelbring AN, Wang H, Wellner SM, Wiesenthal PP, Miranda M, McCoy JG, Barondeau DP, Ruvkun G, Mootha VK.
articles.abstract: Frataxin is a key component of an ancient, mitochondrial iron-sulfur cluster biosynthetic machinery, serving as an allosteric activator of the cysteine desulfurase NFS1 (refs. 1-5). Loss of frataxin levels underlies Friedreich's ataxia6, the most common inherited ataxia. Yeast, Caenorhabditis elegans and human cells can tolerate loss of frataxin when grown in 'permissive' low oxygen tensions7. Here we conducted an unbiased, genome-scale forward genetic screen in C. elegans leveraging permissive and non-permissive oxygen tensions to discover suppressor mutations that bypass the need for frataxin. All mutations act dominantly and are in the ferredoxin FDX2/fdx-2 or in the cysteine desulfurase NFS1/nfs-1 genes, resulting in amino-acid substitutions at the FDX2-NFS1 binding interface. Our genetic and biochemical analyses show that the suppressor mutations boost iron-sulfur cluster levels in the absence of frataxin. We also demonstrate that an excess of FDX2 inhibits frataxin-stimulated NFS1 activity in vitro and blocks the synthesis of iron-sulfur clusters in mammalian cell culture. These findings are consistent with structural and biochemical evidence that frataxin and FDX2 compete for occupancy at the same site on NFS1 (refs. 8,9). We show that lowering levels of wild-type FDX2 through loss of one gene copy can ameliorate the growth of frataxin mutant C. elegans or the ataxia phenotype of a mouse model of Friedreich's ataxia under normoxic conditions. These genetic and biochemical studies indicate that restoring the stoichiometric balance of frataxin and FDX2 through partial knockdown of FDX2 may be a potential therapy for Friedreich's ataxia.
articles.abstractZh: Frataxin 是一种古老的线粒体铁硫簇生物合成机制的关键组成部分，作为半胱氨酸脱硫酶 NFS1 的变构激活剂（参考文献 1-5）。 frataxin 水平的丧失是弗里德赖希共济失调6（最常见的遗传性共济失调）的基础。当酵母、秀丽隐杆线虫和人类细胞在“允许的”低氧张力下生长时，可以耐受 frataxin 的损失7。在这里，我们利用允许和非允许的氧张力对秀丽隐杆线虫进行了无偏见的、基因组规模的正向遗传筛选，以发现绕过 frataxin 需求的抑制突变。所有突变均在铁氧还蛋白 FDX2/fdx-2 或半胱氨酸脱硫酶 NFS1/nfs-1 基因中起显性作用，导致 FDX2-NFS1 结合界面处的氨基酸取代。我们的遗传和生化分析表明，在没有 frataxin 的情况下，抑制突变会提高铁硫簇水平。我们还证明，过量的 FDX2 会抑制体外 frataxin 刺激的 NFS1 活性，并阻止哺乳动物细胞培养物中铁硫簇的合成。这些发现与 frataxin 和 FDX2 竞争的结构和生化证据一致。

articles.title: The miR164e-NAC32 module orchestrates maize plant height via post-translational regulation of DELLA protein stability.
articles.titleZh: miR164e-NAC32 模块通过 DELLA 蛋白稳定性的翻译后调节来协调玉米株高。
articles.authors: Peng C, Zhao X, Xiao J, Zhong X, Chen L, He Y, Li Z, Zhou Y, Duan L.
articles.abstract: Optimization of plant architecture requires precise regulation of internode elongation; however, the post-translational mechanisms that integrate microRNA and phytohormone signaling remain poorly understood. Here, we describe a hierarchical miR164e-NAC32-DELLA regulatory network that controls stem development in maize. Genetic analyses demonstrate that ZmmiR164e negatively regulates its target gene ZmNAC32, with ZmmiR164e overexpression enhancing internode cell elongation and loss-of-function resulting in dwarfism. Notably, ZmNAC32 physically interacts with and stabilizes the DELLA protein ZmD8, as evidenced by increased ZmD8 protein levels in ZmNAC32-overexpressing plants compared with the wild type. Transcriptome profiling reveals that ZmNAC32-mediated regulation of plant height occurs primarily through post-translational stabilization rather than extensive transcriptional reprogramming, with downstream cell wall biosynthesis genes (EXP, XTH, and LAC) showing GA-responsive suppression. Structural analyses further reveal that ZmNAC32 binding stabilizes ZmD8 by shielding the key interaction residue K399, thereby suppressing its degradation. Together, these results identify a miRNA-NAC-DELLA module that governs post-translational protein stability during stem development and provides strategic targets for precision breeding of plant architecture.
articles.abstractZh: 植物株型的优化需要精确调控节间伸长；然而，整合 microRNA 和植物激素信号传导的翻译后机制仍知之甚少。在这里，我们描述了控制玉米茎发育的分层 miR164e-NAC32-DELLA 调控网络。遗传分析表明，ZmmiR164e 负向调节其靶基因 ZmNAC32，ZmmiR164e 过度表达会增强节间细胞伸长和功能丧失，导致侏儒症。值得注意的是，ZmNAC32 与 DELLA 蛋白 ZmD8 发生物理相互作用并稳定 DELLA 蛋白 ZmD8，与野生型相比，过表达 ZmNAC32 的植物中 ZmD8 蛋白水平增加就证明了这一点。转录组分析表明，ZmNAC32 介导的植物高度调节主要通过翻译后稳定而不是广泛的转录重编程发生，下游细胞壁生物合成基因（EXP、XTH 和 LAC）显示 GA 响应性抑制。结构分析进一步表明，ZmNAC32 结合通过屏蔽关键相互作用残基 K399 来稳定 ZmD8，从而抑制其降解。总之，这些结果确定了 miRNA-

articles.title: The transcription factor ANAC017 links mitochondrial retrograde signaling with the ubiquitin-proteasome system to control mitochondrial function in Arabidopsis.
articles.titleZh: 转录因子 ANAC017 将线粒体逆行信号与泛素蛋白酶体系统连接起来，以控制拟南芥中的线粒体功能。
articles.authors: Zhao Y, Ogden M, Pan R, Hu J, Persson S, Murcha MW, Shou H, Wang Y, Khan GA, Whelan J.
articles.abstract: Mitochondrial biogenesis requires the import of more than a thousand proteins encoded by nuclear DNA. The translocase of the outer mitochondrial membrane (TOM) complex serves as the primary gateway for specific recognition of precursor proteins, which are synthesized in the cytosol. Little is known about the regulation of the abundance of the TOM complex. Using forward genetics, we identified key 26S proteasome subunits, including REGULATORY PARTICLE NON-ATPASE1A (RPN1A), that affect the abundance of TOM-complex subunits through the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway. Loss of proteasome function through rpn1a mutation or MG132 treatment increased the abundance of TOM20 isoforms and induced mitochondrial stress marker genes. By contrast, overexpression of ANAC017, an endoplasmic reticulum-anchored transcription factor that activates mitochondrial retrograde signaling under stress, lowered TOM20 abundance and reduced mitochondrial protein import. The rates of mitochondrial protein import and respiratory activity were also altered. Genetic analyses placed the proteasome downstream of ANAC017, since the reduction in TOM20 required the RPN1a subunit. Transcriptome profiling after antimycin A treatment showed broad ANAC017-dependent reprogramming of ubiquitin-proteasome system genes. A second tier formed by ANAC053- and ANAC078-bound promoters of proteasome subunits, including RPN1a, is required to restrain TOM20 accumulation. These findings establish a two-step transcriptional circuit that engages the ubiquitin-proteasome system to tune TOM abundance and coordinate protein import with organelle function.
articles.abstractZh: 线粒体生物发生需要输入由核 DNA 编码的 1000 多种蛋白质。线粒体外膜 (TOM) 复合物的转位酶是特异性识别在细胞质中合成的前体蛋白的主要网关。关于 TOM 复合物丰度的调节知之甚少。利用正向遗传学，我们确定了关键的 26S 蛋白酶体亚基，包括调节颗粒非ATP酶1A (RPN1A)，它们通过泛素-蛋白酶体途径影响 TOM 复合物亚基的丰度。 rpn1a 突变或 MG132 处理导致蛋白酶体功能丧失，增加了 TOM20 亚型的丰度并诱导线粒体应激标记基因。相比之下，ANAC017（一种内质网锚定转录因子，在应激下激活线粒体逆行信号传导）的过度表达会降低 TOM20 丰度并减少线粒体蛋白输入。线粒体蛋白输入率和呼吸活动也发生了改变。遗传分析将蛋白酶体置于 ANAC017 下游，因为 TOM20 的还原需要 RPN1a 亚基。抗霉素 A 后的转录组分析

articles.title: Microbiome-dependent functional responses to structurally distinct oligosaccharides revealed by metaproteomics.
articles.titleZh: 宏蛋白质组学揭示了对结构不同的寡糖的微生物组依赖性功能反应。
articles.authors: Zhang A, Wu Q, Mayne J, Ning Z, Qin H, Dewar A, Figeys D.
articles.abstract: Dietary oligosaccharides are prebiotics that fuel gut microbes, but individual microbiomes may respond differently depending on oligosaccharide structures as well as microbiome composition and function. The extent to which specific gut microbial communities exhibit personalized functional responses to distinct oligosaccharides remains underexplored. We applied a standardized ex vivo microbiome culture, called RapidAIM, coupled with metaproteomics to examine how six structurally diverse oligosaccharides affect the gut microbiota functional response. Our study shows that while human gut microbiomes share some commonalities in utilizing oligosaccharides (e.g. prioritizing dietary fibers over mucin), the fine-scale metabolic and taxonomic responses are highly individualized. Such findings underscore the importance of considering personal microbiome profiles when predicting the outcome of prebiotic interventions. In a broader context, our metaproteomic approach provides a framework for identifying optimal prebiotic choices tailored to individual microbiomes. Ultimately, understanding these personalized responses could inform precision nutrition strategies.
articles.abstractZh: 膳食寡糖是为肠道微生物提供能量的益生元，但个体微生物组可能会根据寡糖结构以及微生物组的组成和功能做出不同的反应。特定肠道微生物群落对不同寡糖表现出个性化功能反应的程度仍有待探索。我们应用了一种标准化的离体微生物组培养物（称为 RapidAIM），结合宏蛋白质组学来研究六种结构不同的寡糖如何影响肠道微生物群的功能反应。我们的研究表明，虽然人类肠道微生物群在利用寡糖方面有一些共性（例如优先考虑膳食纤维而不是粘蛋白），但精细代谢和分类反应是高度个体化的。这些发现强调了在预测益生元干预结果时考虑个人微生物组概况的重要性。在更广泛的背景下，我们的宏蛋白质组学方法提供了一个框架，用于确定适合个体微生物组的最佳益生元选择。最终，了解这些个性化反应可以为精准营养策略提供信息。

articles.title: Mitochondria as key targets underlying hypomagnetic field-induced biological effects.
articles.titleZh: 线粒体是低磁场引起的生物效应的关键靶标。
articles.authors: Ren J, Wang M, Zhao C, Luo Y, Tian L.
articles.abstract: With the rapid development of human deep space exploration, prolonged exposure to hypomagnetic fields (HMF, <5 μT) - an environmental parameter with significantly reduced intensity compared to Earth's geomagnetic field (GMF) - poses unprecedented health challenges. Accumulating evidence demonstrates that HMF exposure induces negative effects on various system functions in animals, including the central nervous system, the cardiovascular system, and the musculoskeletal systems and so forth. In this review, we systematically summarize the multi-level impacts of HMF on mitochondrial quality control and function, proposing mitochondria as direct and sensitive targets of HMF, with iron-sulfur clusters potentially playing a pivotal role. We also explore possible HMF-regulated signaling pathways. In conclusion, this review provides a valuable foundation for understanding the cellular and molecular mechanisms of HMF's potential risks to astronauts and for developing future coping strategies during spaceflight.
articles.abstractZh: 随着人类深空探索的快速发展，长期暴露于低磁场（HMF，<5 μT）——与地球地磁场（GMF）相比强度显着降低的环境参数——带来了前所未有的健康挑战。越来越多的证据表明，HMF暴露会对动物的各种系统功能产生负面影响，包括中枢神经系统、心血管系统和肌肉骨骼系统等。在这篇综述中，我们系统地总结了 HMF 对线粒体质量控制和功能的多层次影响，提出线粒体作为 HMF 的直接和敏感靶标，其中铁硫簇可能发挥关键作用。我们还探索了可能的 HMF 调节信号通路。总之，这篇综述为了解 HMF 对宇航员潜在风险的细胞和分子机制以及制定未来太空飞行期间的应对策略提供了宝贵的基础。

articles.title: CCL20-CCR6 signaling alters the metabolic reprogramming to promote the pathogenic Th17 cell differentiation.
articles.titleZh: CCL20-CCR6 信号传导改变代谢重编程以促进致病性 Th17 细胞分化。
articles.authors: Meitei HT, Kulkarni N, Shirolkar A, Rapole S, Sharma PK, Mujeeb VR, Srivastava S, Lal G.
articles.abstract: CCR6 is a G-protein-coupled receptor that binds to its ligand CCL20. Th17 and Foxp3+CD4+ T cells express CCR6, enabling their migration to inflamed tissues with unique metabolic environments. The factors that regulate their metabolic adaptation and functional roles in these tissues remain unclear. Using inflammatory bowel disease patient samples and experimental colitis models in mice, we demonstrated that the intrinsic signaling of CCL20-CCR6 in CD4+ T cells promotes the differentiation of inflammatory Th1-like Th17 cells (T-bet+RORγt+) during colitis. This signaling induces the rapamycin-sensitive phosphorylation of PI3K, Akt, mTORC1, and STAT3 in a CCR6-dependent manner. RNA-seq and proteomics analysis revealed that the addition of CCL20 during Th17 differentiation affects several metabolic pathways, including energy metabolism. CCL20 significantly increased glycolysis and inhibited oxidative phosphorylation, thereby driving the differentiation of pathogenic Th17 cells. Our findings suggest that alterations in CCR6-induced changes in Th17 metabolism offer an interesting therapeutic target for gut inflammation and autoimmunity.
articles.abstractZh: CCR6 是一种 G 蛋白偶联受体，与其配体 CCL20 结合。 Th17 和 Foxp3+CD4+ T 细胞表达 CCR6，使其能够迁移到具有独特代谢环境的发炎组织。调节这些组织的代谢适应和功能作用的因素仍不清楚。使用炎症性肠病患者样本和小鼠实验性结肠炎模型，我们证明 CD4+ T 细胞中 CCL20-CCR6 的内在信号传导可促进结肠炎期间炎症性 Th1 样 Th17 细胞 (T-bet+RORγt+) 的分化。该信号传导以 CCR6 依赖性方式诱导 PI3K、Akt、mTORC1 和 STAT3 的雷帕霉素敏感磷酸化。 RNA-seq 和蛋白质组学分析表明，在 Th17 分化过程中添加 CCL20 会影响多种代谢途径，包括能量代谢。 CCL20显着增加糖酵解并抑制氧化磷酸化，从而驱动致病性Th17细胞的分化。我们的研究结果表明，CCR6 诱导的 Th17 代谢变化为肠道炎症和自身免疫提供了一个有趣的治疗靶点。

articles.title: The arginase-polyamine signaling axis in immune cells: Implications for immune modulation and host-pathogen interactions.
articles.titleZh: 免疫细胞中的精氨酸酶-多胺信号轴：对免疫调节和宿主-病原体相互作用的影响。
articles.authors: Aziz S, Ahmed A, Singh P, Mukhopadhyay S.
articles.abstract: The immune system employs complex metabolic pathways to regulate host-pathogen interactions. Among these, the arginase-polyamine axis is a crucial modulator of both innate and adaptive immunity. Despite significant progress, the precise roles and regulatory mechanisms governing the arginase-polyamine axis in immune cell function remain incompletely understood. This review aims to provide a comprehensive analysis of the arginase-polyamine axis, highlighting its role in maintaining immune homeostasis and preserving the functional integrity of various immune cell types. Furthermore, we discuss the strategies used by diverse pathogens to manipulate this pathway, facilitating the creation of immunosuppressive microenvironments that promote their intracellular survival and replication in the host. Finally, we highlight the potential of innovative therapeutic strategies that target arginase-polyamine signaling pathways, which can effectively modulate immune responses in the context of infectious diseases.
articles.abstractZh: 免疫系统采用复杂的代谢途径来调节宿主与病原体的相互作用。其中，精氨酸酶-多胺轴是先天免疫和适应性免疫的重要调节剂。尽管取得了重大进展，但控制精氨酸酶-多胺轴在免疫细胞功能中的精确作用和调节机制仍不完全清楚。本综述旨在对精氨酸酶-多胺轴进行全面分析，强调其在维持免疫稳态和保护各种免疫细胞类型功能完整性方面的作用。此外，我们讨论了不同病原体用于操纵该途径的策略，促进免疫抑制微环境的创建，从而促进其在宿主的细胞内存活和复制。最后，我们强调了针对精氨酸酶-多胺信号通路的创新治疗策略的潜力，该策略可以有效调节传染病背景下的免疫反应。

articles.title: Accurate single-domain scaffolding of three nonoverlapping protein epitopes using deep learning.
articles.titleZh: 使用深度学习对三个不重叠的蛋白质表位进行准确的单域支架。
articles.authors: Castro KM, Watson JL, Wang J, Southern J, Ayardulabi R, Georgeon S, Rosset S, Baker D, Correia BE.
articles.abstract: De novo protein design has seen major success in scaffolding single functional motifs; however, in nature, most proteins present multiple functional sites. Here, we describe an approach to simultaneously scaffold multiple functional sites in a single-domain protein using deep learning. We designed small single-domain immunogens, under 130 residues, that present three distinct and irregular motifs from respiratory syncytial virus. These motifs together comprise nearly half of the designed proteins; hence, the overall folds are quite unusual with little global similarity to proteins in the Protein Data Bank. Despite this, X-ray crystal structures confirmed the accuracy of presentation of each of the motifs and the multiepitope design yields improved cross-reactive titers and neutralizing response compared to a single-epitope immunogen. The successful presentation of three distinct binding surfaces in a small single-domain protein highlights the power of generative deep learning methods to solve complex protein design problems.
articles.abstractZh: 从头蛋白质设计在构建单一功能基序方面取得了巨大成功；然而，在自然界中，大多数蛋白质都具有多个功能位点。在这里，我们描述了一种使用深度学习同时支撑单域蛋白质中多个功能位点的方法。我们设计了小于 130 个残基的小型单域免疫原，呈现来自呼吸道合胞病毒的三个不同且不规则的基序。这些基序共同构成了设计蛋白质的近一半；因此，整体折叠非常不寻常，与蛋白质数据库中的蛋白质几乎没有整体相似性。尽管如此，X射线晶体结构证实了每个基序呈现的准确性，并且与单表位免疫原相比，多表位设计产生了改进的交叉反应滴度和中和反应。在小型单域蛋白质中成功呈现三个不同的结合表面，凸显了生成深度学习方法解决复杂蛋白质设计问题的能力。

articles.title: Arabidopsis microtubule-BRI1-associated proteins negatively regulate hypocotyl elongation by controlling brassinosteroid-dependent cortical microtubule reorientation.
articles.titleZh: 拟南芥微管-BRI1 相关蛋白通过控制油菜素类固醇依赖性皮质微管重新定向来负向调节下胚轴伸长。
articles.authors: Delesalle C, Montiel-Jorda A, Aiba R, Spielmann J, Neveu J, Fujita S, Vert G.
articles.abstract: Brassinosteroids (BRs) are steroid-type phytohormones that are essential for plant growth, development, and adaptation to environmental stresses. BRs are known to control microtubule (MT) orientation, which is pivotal for directional growth, but the underlying molecular mechanisms are still largely unknown. Here, we identified and characterized a new family of BRI1-interacting proteins named MICROTUBULE-BRI1-ASSOCIATED PROTEINS (MBAPs). We confirmed, using several complementary approaches, that MBAPs are genuine BRI1 partners in plant cells. We demonstrated that MBAPs localize to cortical microtubules (CMTs) underlying the plasma membrane using a short conserved helix, where they make contact with BRI1. Combinations of mbap loss-of-function mutants showed hypersensitivity to BRs and established MBAPs as negative regulators of BR responses. mbap mutants showed no changes in typical downstream BR signaling readouts and selected BR-regulated genes, and they displayed only mild changes when global BR genomic responses were probed. Consistent with the localization of MBAPs to CMTs, mbap mutants displayed a disordered CMT network and enhanced CMT reorganization upon BR perception. Together, our results shed light on the role of MBAPs as a bridge between BR perception at the cell surface and CMT organization in the control of hypocotyl elongation.
articles.abstractZh: 油菜素类固醇 (BR) 是类固醇型植物激素，对于植物生长、发育和适应环境胁迫至关重要。众所周知，BR 可以控制微管 (MT) 方向，这对于定向生长至关重要，但其潜在的分子机制仍然很大程度上未知。在这里，我们鉴定并鉴定了一个新的 BRI1 相互作用蛋白家族，名为微管-BRI1 相关蛋白 (MBAP)。我们使用多种互补方法证实 MBAP 是植物细胞中真正的 BRI1 伙伴。我们证明 MBAP 使用短保守螺旋定位于质膜下方的皮质微管 (CMT)，并在其中与 BRI1 接触。 mbap 功能丧失突变体的组合表现出对 BR 的超敏反应，并将 MBAP 确立为 BR 反应的负调节因子。 mbap 突变体在典型的下游 BR 信号读数和选定的 BR 调节基因中没有显示任何变化，并且当探测全局 BR 基因组反应时，它们仅显示出轻微的变化。与 MBAP 对 CMT 的定位一致，mbap 突变体表现出无序的 CMT 网络，并在 BR 感知时增强了 CMT 重组。在一起

articles.title: Compiling an early life human gut microbiome atlas and identification of key microbial drivers.
articles.titleZh: 编制早期人类肠道微生物组图谱并识别关键微生物驱动因素。
articles.authors: Tarracchini C, Longhi G, Gennaioli E, Muscò A, Rizzo SM, Viappiani A, Vitale SG, Mancabelli L, Lugli GA, Angioni S, Turroni F, van Sinderen D, Milani C, Ventura M.
articles.abstract: During the first year after birth, the infant gut microbiome undergoes a rapid and profound compositional and functional transformation, impelled by an intricate network of intrinsic and extrinsic factors. This process results in increased taxonomic and functional diversification, alongside greater interindividual variability. To better understand this early-life ecosystem, this study assessed the interindividual variability of the infant gut microbiome using a comprehensive infant gut microbiome database of 5288 fecal metagenomic data from healthy, full-term infants across various geographical locations. Our study identified six reference microbial communities, termed Early-Life Community State Types (ELi-CSTs), which not only capture specific compositional profiles and heterogeneity of the infant gut microbiome, but also record the extensive transformation experienced by this developing microbial community during the first year of human life. Indicative Species analysis and Random Forest modeling assisted the precise identification of unique, key taxonomic signatures that are critical to the structure of each ELi-CST, highlighting microbial taxa with pivotal roles in shaping the infant gut microbiota. To complement these findings, we established a bacterial biobank through dedicated cultivation efforts of the infant microbiota, comprising 182 genome-sequenced isolates corresponding to key taxa involved in early life gut microbiota assembly. This biobank provided the basis for co-cultivation experiments combined with transcriptome analyses, thereby enabling in vitro investigations into microbial cross-talk among key modulators, and yielding novel insights into the molecular interactions and cooperative dynamics behind early microbiome development.
articles.abstractZh: 在出生后的第一年，婴儿肠道微生物组在复杂的内在和外在因素网络的推动下，经历了快速而深刻的组成和功能转变。这一过程导致分类和功能多样化的增加，以及个体间更大的变异性。为了更好地了解这一生命早期生态系统，本研究使用一个全面的婴儿肠道微生物组数据库评估了婴儿肠道微生物组的个体间变异性，该数据库包含来自不同地理位置的健康足月婴儿的 5288 份粪便宏基因组数据。我们的研究确定了六个参考微生物群落，称为早期生命群落状态类型（ELi-CST），它们不仅捕获了婴儿肠道微生物组的特定组成特征和异质性，而且还记录了这个正在发育的微生物群落在人类生命的第一年所经历的广泛转变。指示性物种分析和随机森林建模有助于精确识别对每个 ELi-CST 结构至关重要的独特关键分类学特征，突出显示微生物类群在塑造

articles.title: Linked-domain inhibitors designed to block UBE2D induce the unfolded protein response.
articles.titleZh: 旨在阻断 UBE2D 的链接结构域抑制剂可诱导未折叠蛋白反应。
articles.authors: Bukhari Z, Gu L, Nederstigt AE, Cope LJ, Bolhuis DL, Harvey K, Allen T, Hill S, Yang Y, Lawson G, Lu C, Tran T, Pineda L, Low L, Chiang A, Song J, Fong MV, Rangel VM, Chan WK, Kleiger G, Goldfarb D, Vierra CA, Brown NG, Harrison JS.
articles.abstract: Ubiquitin (Ub) is a protein post-translational modifier that controls proteostasis through mechanisms spanning transcription, translation, and protein degradation. Ub conjugation occurs through a cascade of three enzyme classes (E1, E2, and E3s) involving >1,000 proteins that regulate the ubiquitination of cellular proteins. The E2 Ub-conjugating enzymes are the midpoint, yet their cellular roles remain under-characterized. Here, we develop highly selective and potent pan-UBE2D/UBCH5 inhibitors by targeting the RING- and backside-binding sites with engineered linked-domain proteins. In HeLa cells, these inhibitors phenocopy the knockdown of UBE2D by enhancing chemosensitivity to cisplatin. Whole-cell proteomics reveals that ∼20% of the identified proteins are more abundant, and most do not have altered mRNA levels, suggesting that their protein turnover is regulated by UBE2D. Enrichment analysis of the altered mRNAs indicates that the linked-domain proteins trigger the unfolded protein response. These precision tools will enable new studies probing UBE2D's cellular roles and help to deconvolute complex Ub regulatory networks.
articles.abstractZh: 泛素 (Ub) 是一种蛋白质翻译后修饰剂，通过转录、翻译和蛋白质降解机制控制蛋白质稳态。 Ub 结合通过三种酶类（E1、E2 和 E3）的级联发生，涉及超过 1,000 个调节细胞蛋白泛素化的蛋白。 E2 Ub 结合酶处于中间位置，但它们的细胞作用仍然没有得到充分表征。在这里，我们通过利用工程化的链接域蛋白靶向 RING 和背面结合位点，开发了高度选择性和有效的泛 UBE2D/UBCH5 抑制剂。在 HeLa 细胞中，这些抑制剂通过增强对顺铂的化学敏感性来表观抑制 UBE2D。全细胞蛋白质组学显示，约 20% 的已鉴定蛋白质更加丰富，并且大多数 mRNA 水平没有改变，这表明它们的蛋白质周转受到 UBE2D 的调节。对改变的 mRNA 的富集分析表明，连接域蛋白触发了未折叠蛋白反应。这些精密工具将使探索 UBE2D 细胞作用的新研究成为可能，并有助于解开复杂的 Ub 调控网络。

articles.title: Protocol for obtaining polyhydroxyalkanoates from microbial cultures: Production, quantification, and analytical assays.
articles.titleZh: 从微生物培养物中获取聚羟基脂肪酸酯的方案：生产、定量和分析测定。
articles.authors: Manoli MT, Hernández-Herreros N, Rivero-Buceta V, Rodríguez A, Prieto MA.
articles.abstract: Polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHAs), a family of natural bacterial biodegradable biopolymers, constitute a promising alternative to conventional plastics. Here, we present a protocol to monitor bacterial growth and biopolymer accumulation in shaken flasks using two model bacteria, Pseudomonas putida KT2440 and Cupriavidus necator H16. We also describe steps to achieve high cell-density cultures in benchtop bioreactors using bioprocess engineering. Typical performance metrics include biomass concentrations of 6.5-7 g cell dry weight (CDW)/L and PHA titers of 4.2-4.5 g/L for P. putida and 3.5 g/L for C. necator. We then detail procedures for downstream processing, assessing monomer composition, and determining its thermal properties.
articles.abstractZh: 聚羟基脂肪酸酯 (PHA) 是一类天然细菌可生物降解的生物聚合物，是传统塑料的一种有前景的替代品。在这里，我们提出了一种使用两种模型细菌（恶臭假单胞菌 KT2440 和 Cupriavidus necator H16）监测摇瓶中细菌生长和生物聚合物积累的方案。我们还描述了使用生物过程工程在台式生物反应器中实现高细胞密度培养的步骤。典型的性能指标包括 6.5-7 克细胞干重 (CDW)/L 的生物量浓度，恶臭假单胞菌 (P. putida) 的 PHA 滴度为 4.2-4.5 克/升 (PHA) 滴度，线虫的PHA 滴度为 3.5 克/升 (C. necator)。然后，我们详细介绍下游加工、评估单体成分并确定其热性能的程序。

articles.title: Symbiosome membrane-localized cationic amino acid transporters support symbiotic nitrogen fixation in Medicago truncatula.
articles.titleZh: 共生体膜定位的阳离子氨基酸转运蛋白支持蒺藜苜蓿中的共生固氮。
articles.authors: Wu J, Zhang X, Fan Z, Huang Y, Cao Y, Ren J, Yang L, Tian J, Yu Y, Kong Z.
articles.abstract: Legumes engage in nitrogen-fixing symbiosis with rhizobia, in which host legumes supply dicarboxylates as a carbon source to rhizobia, while rhizobia reciprocate by providing ammonium to the host plants. Beyond this classical model, accumulating evidence suggests that amino acid exchange is also essential for legume-rhizobium symbiosis. However, it remains unclear whether amino acid transporters are present on the symbiosome membrane (SM) to mediate amino acid exchange during symbiotic nitrogen fixation (SNF). In this study, we identified three amino acid transporters in Medicago truncatula-MtCAT1a, MtCAT1b, and MtCAT1c-which belong to a clade of the plant Cationic Amino acid Transporter (CAT) family known to transport a wide range of amino acids. Notably, MtCAT1b and MtCAT1c are predominantly expressed in infected nodule cells and localize to the SM. Genetic analyses further demonstrate that both MtCAT1b and MtCAT1c are required for amino acid exchange at the SM, with additional evidence indicating that bacteroid metabolism is disturbed in the mutants. Transport assays show that both MtCAT1b and MtCAT1c exhibit broad substrate specificity. Collectively, these findings identify MtCAT1b and MtCAT1c as key mediators of cross-kingdom amino acid exchange, which is essential for maintaining efficient SNF in root nodules.
articles.abstractZh: 豆科植物与根瘤菌进行固氮共生，其中寄主豆科植物向根瘤菌提供二羧酸盐作为碳源，而根瘤菌则通过向寄主植物提供铵来回报。除了这个经典模型之外，越来越多的证据表明氨基酸交换对于豆科植物-根瘤菌共生也至关重要。然而，目前尚不清楚共生体膜（SM）上是否存在氨基酸转运蛋白以介导共生固氮（SNF）过程中的氨基酸交换。在这项研究中，我们在蒺藜苜蓿中鉴定了三种氨基酸转运蛋白——MtCAT1a、MtCAT1b 和 MtCAT1c，它们属于植物阳离子氨基酸转运蛋白 (CAT) 家族的一个分支，已知可转运多种氨基酸。值得注意的是，MtCAT1b 和 MtCAT1c 主要在感染的结节细胞中表达并定位于 SM。遗传分析进一步表明，MtCAT1b 和 MtCAT1c 都是 SM 氨基酸交换所必需的，另外的证据表明突变体中类菌代谢受到干扰。转运分析表明 MtCAT1b 和 MtCAT1c 均表现出广泛的底物特异性。总的来说，这些发现确定了 MtC

articles.title: UBA6 specificity for ubiquitin E2 conjugating enzymes reveals a priority mechanism of BIRC6.
articles.titleZh: UBA6 对泛素 E2 结合酶的特异性揭示了 BIRC6 的优先机制。
articles.authors: Riechmann C, Ellison CJ, Anderson JW, Hofmann K, Sarkies P, Elliott PR.
articles.abstract: In mammals, ubiquitylation is orchestrated by the canonical ubiquitin-activating E1 enzyme UBA1 and the orthogonal E1 UBA6. Growing evidence underscores the essentiality of both E1s, which differentiate between 29 active ubiquitin-conjugating enzymes (E2s). The mechanisms governing this distinction have remained unclear. Here we establish a framework for ubiquitin E1-E2 specificity. Focusing on UBA6-controlled ubiquitylation cascades, we reveal that BIRC6, a UBA6-exclusive E2, gains priority over all other UBA6-competent E2s, underpinning the functional importance of defined UBA6-BIRC6 ubiquitylation events in regulating cell death, embryogenesis and autophagy. By capturing BIRC6 receiving ubiquitin from UBA6 in different states, we observe BIRC6 engaging with the UBA6 ubiquitin fold domain, driving an exceptionally high-affinity interaction that is modulated by the UBA6 Cys-Cap loop. Using this interaction as a template, we demonstrate how to confer activity between E2s and their noncognate E1, providing a tool to delineate E1-E2-dependent pathways. Lastly, we explain how BIRC6 priority does not lead to inhibition of UBA6, through a bespoke thioester switch mechanism that disengages BIRC6 upon receiving ubiquitin. Our findings propose a concept of hierarchy of E2 activity with cognate E1s, which may explain how ubiquitin E1s can each function with over a dozen E2s and orchestrate E2-specific cellular functions.
articles.abstractZh: 在哺乳动物中，泛素化是由经典泛素激活 E1 酶 UBA1 和正交 E1 UBA6 精心策划的。越来越多的证据强调了两种 E1 的重要性，它们区分 29 种活性泛素结合酶 (E2)。控制这种区别的机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们建立了泛素 E1-E2 特异性的框架。着眼于UBA6控制的泛素化级联，我们发现BIRC6是UBA6独有的E2，比所有其他具有UBA6能力的E2具有优先权，支撑了定义的UBA6-BIRC6泛素化事件在调节细胞死亡、胚胎发生和自噬中的功能重要性。通过捕获不同状态下的 BIRC6 从 UBA6 接收泛素，我们观察到 BIRC6 与 UBA6 泛素折叠结构域结合，驱动由 UBA6 Cys-Cap 环调节的异常高亲和力相互作用。使用这种相互作用作为模板，我们演示了如何在 E2 与其非同源 E1 之间赋予活性，从而提供了描述 E1-E2 依赖性途径的工具。最后，我们解释了 BIRC6 优先级如何不会导致 UBA6 的抑制，通过定制的硫酯开关机制来解除

articles.title: A microbiota-derived bile acid modulates biofilm formation by the probiotic strain Escherichia coli Nissle 1917.
articles.titleZh: 微生物群衍生的胆汁酸调节益生菌菌株大肠杆菌 Nissle 1917 的生物膜形成。
articles.authors: Perry EK, Udayasuryan B, Zegeye EK, Rose CM, Reichelt M, Tan MW.
articles.abstract: Bacteria that colonize the human gut must withstand a variety of stressors, including detergent-like compounds known as bile acids. Here, we investigated how bile acids found in the human cecum and colon impact the behavior of the probiotic strain Escherichia coli Nissle 1917 (EcN). We found that lithocholic acid (LCA), which is a microbiota-derived secondary bile acid, promotes the formation of a distinctive surface-coating biofilm by EcN, including on an organoid-derived model of the human colonic epithelium. Mechanistic investigations revealed that LCA upregulates the production of several components of flagella, which are essential for LCA-induced biofilm formation and form part of the biofilm matrix. Furthermore, LCA-induced biofilm formation helps EcN compete against certain pathogenic strains. Taken together, our findings shed light on how an abundant colonic metabolite influences the behavior of a clinically proven probiotic strain, triggering the formation of biofilms that may contribute to pathogen suppression.
articles.abstractZh: 寄居在人类肠道中的细菌必须承受各种压力，包括被称为胆汁酸的类似清洁剂的化合物。在这里，我们研究了人类盲肠和结肠中发现的胆汁酸如何影响益生菌菌株大肠杆菌 Nissle 1917 (EcN) 的行为。我们发现，石胆酸 (LCA) 是一种源自微生物群的次级胆汁酸，可促进 EcN 形成独特的表面涂层生物膜，包括在类器官衍生的人类结肠上皮模型上。机制研究表明，LCA 上调鞭毛中几种成分的产生，这些成分对于 LCA 诱导的生物膜形成至关重要，并构成生物膜基质的一部分。此外，LCA 诱导的生物膜形成有助于 EcN 与某些致病菌株竞争。总而言之，我们的研究结果揭示了丰富的结肠代谢物如何影响经临床证明的益生菌菌株的行为，从而引发可能有助于抑制病原体的生物膜的形成。

articles.title: Cohesin drives chromatin scanning during the RAD51-mediated homology search.
articles.titleZh: 在 RAD51 介导的同源性搜索过程中，粘连蛋白驱动染色质扫描。
articles.authors: Marin-Gonzalez A, Rybczynski AT, Nilavar NM, Nguyen D, Li AG, Karwacki-Neisius V, Zou RS, Avilés-Vázquez FJ, Kanemaki MT, Scully R, Ha T.
articles.abstract: Cohesin folds genomes into chromatin loops, the roles of which are under debate. We found that double-strand breaks (DSBs) induce de novo formation of chromatin loops in human cells, with the loop base positioned at the DSB site. These loops form in the S and G2 phases of the cell cycle during homologous recombination repair, concomitantly with DNA end resection and radiation-sensitive protein 51 (RAD51) recruitment. RAD51 shows a broad (megabase-sized) chromatin domain reflective of the homology search. This domain is regulated by cohesin unloader and overlaps with chromatin regions reeled through the break-anchored loop, suggesting that loop extrusion regulates the homology search. Indeed, depletion of the loop-extruding cohesin subunit NIPBL lowers homologous recombination in mouse embryonic stem cells, and this effect is more pronounced when the homologous recombination donor is hundreds of kilobases from the DSB. Our data indicate that loop-extruding cohesin promotes the mammalian homology search by facilitating break-chromatin interactions.
articles.abstractZh: 粘连蛋白将基因组折叠成染色质环，其作用仍存在争议。我们发现双链断裂 (DSB) 会诱导人类细胞中染色质环从头形成，环碱基位于 DSB 位点。这些环在细胞周期的 S 期和 G2 期同源重组修复过程中形成，同时进行 DNA 末端切除和辐射敏感蛋白 51 (RAD51) 募集。 RAD51 显示了反映同源搜索的广泛（兆碱基大小）染色质结构域。该结构域受粘连蛋白卸载器调节，并与通过断裂锚定环卷绕的染色质区域重叠，表明环挤出调节同源性搜索。事实上，环挤出粘连蛋白亚基 NIPBL 的耗尽会降低小鼠胚胎干细胞中的同源重组，并且当同源重组供体距离 DSB 数百个碱基时，这种效应更加明显。我们的数据表明，环挤出粘连蛋白通过促进断裂染色质相互作用来促进哺乳动物同源性搜索。

articles.title: Gut microbiota and Parkinson's disease: exploring pathogenesis and potential therapeutic strategies from a gut-brain axis perspective.
articles.titleZh: 肠道微生物群和帕金森病：从肠-脑轴的角度探索发病机制和潜在的治疗策略。
articles.authors: Jin X, Wei J, Min X, Fan Y, Yuan Z, Du Z, Su Z, Xun T, Du Q, Liang T, He X, Tang W.
articles.abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a prevalent neurodegenerative disorder with a global prevalence exceeding 1‰, posing a significant public health challenge. Although the pathogenesis of PD is not yet fully elucidated, accumulating evidence suggests that it results from the interplay between genetic and environmental factors, highlighting its multifactorial nature. With advances in translational medicine, the gut has emerged as a critical participant in PD onset and progression. This review systematically summarizes the role of the gut in PD, particularly emphasizing potential mechanisms involving neuroinflammation in the central nervous system (CNS), pathological aggregation of α-synuclein (α-syn), and mitochondrial dysfunction. Furthermore, gut-targeted therapeutic strategies for PD are discussed, including fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT), gut-directed anti-inflammatory therapies, supplementation with gut microbiota-derived metabolites such as short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), and interventions targeting α-syn aggregation. A deeper understanding of these mechanisms not only advances the pathological knowledge of PD but also provides theoretical foundations for the early diagnosis and innovative treatment of the disease.
articles.abstractZh: 帕金森病（PD）是一种常见的神经退行性疾病，全球患病率超过千分之一，对公共卫生构成重大挑战。尽管帕金森病的发病机制尚未完全阐明，但越来越多的证据表明，帕金森病是遗传和环境因素相互作用的结果，凸显了其多因素的性质。随着转化医学的进步，肠道已成为帕金森病发病和进展的关键参与者。这篇综述系统地总结了肠道在 PD 中的作用，特别强调了涉及中枢神经系统 (CNS) 神经炎症、α-突触核蛋白 (α-syn) 病理性聚集和线粒体功能障碍的潜在机制。此外，还讨论了针对 PD 的肠道靶向治疗策略，包括粪便微生物群移植 (FMT)、肠道定向抗炎治疗、补充肠道微生物群衍生的代谢物（如短链脂肪酸 (SCFA)）以及针对 α-syn 聚集的干预措施。对这些机制的深入了解不仅可以提高PD的病理学认识，也可以为PD的早期诊断提供理论基础。

articles.title: Prefoldin 3 promotes the turnover of WRKY70 and FHY3 to modulate UV-B-induced hypocotyl growth inhibition in Arabidopsis thaliana.
articles.titleZh: Prefoldin 3 促进 WRKY70 和 FHY3 的更新，以调节拟南芥中 UV-B 诱导的下胚轴生长抑制。
articles.authors: Song Y, Liu M, Gao XM, Zhao YS, Liu B, Zhang H, Gu SB, Yao YJ, Hou J, Yang K, Tang S, Tan LN, Wu QS, Zhang RJ, Qian YY, He SF, Chang WL, Liu JQ, Liu HH.
articles.abstract: Ultraviolet-B (UV-B) radiation, a pervasive light stimulus, profoundly influences plant hypocotyl growth through intricate signaling pathways. Although the core UV-B signaling components have been identified, the precise regulatory mechanisms remain elusive. Here, we identify prefoldin 3 (PFD3), an α subunit of the PFD complex, as a novel negative regulator of UV-B-induced hypocotyl growth inhibition in Arabidopsis thaliana. Upon UV-B exposure, PFD3 accumulates and promotes the turnover of WRKY DNA-BINDING PROTEIN 70 (WRKY70) and FAR-RED ELONGATED HYPOCOTYL 3 (FHY3), thereby attenuating their transcriptional activities toward ELONGATED HYPOCOTYL 5 (HY5)/PACLOBUTRAZOL RESISTANCE1 (PRE1) and CONSTITUTIVE PHOTOMORPHOGENIC 1 (COP1), respectively. These findings delineate two regulatory modules-PFD3-WRKY70-HY5/PRE1 and PFD3-FHY3-COP1-that fine-tune UV-B-mediated inhibition of hypocotyl elongation in a UV RESISTANCE LOCUS 8-dependent manner. Furthermore, we identify amino acid variations in FHY3 from the high-altitude Tibet-0 ecotype of A. thaliana that confer resistance to PFD3-mediated suppression. This genetic adaptation sustains COP1 activation and results in shortened hypocotyls under UV-B radiation in this alpine ecotype. Collectively, our results suggest that allelic variation within these modules enhances adaptation to high-intense UV-B habitats, highlighting the evolutionary significance of these regulatory networks in plant environmental acclimation.
articles.abstractZh: 紫外线 B (UV-B) 辐射是一种普遍的光刺激，通过复杂的信号通路深刻影响植物下胚轴的生长。尽管核心 UV-B 信号成分已被确定，但精确的调节机制仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们鉴定出前折叠蛋白 3 (PFD3)（PFD 复合物的一个 α 亚基）是拟南芥中 UV-B 诱导的下胚轴生长抑制的新型负调节因子。 UV-B 照射后，PFD3 积累并促进 WRKY DNA 结合蛋白 70 (WRKY70) 和 FAR-RED ELONGATED HYPOCOTYL 3 (FHY3) 的周转，从而减弱它们对 ELONGATED HYPOCOTYL 5 (HY5)/Paclobutrazol RESISTANCE1 (PRE1) 和 CONSTITUTIVE 的转录活性分别为光形态 1 (COP1)。这些发现描绘了两个调节模块——PFD3-WRKY70-HY5/PRE1和PFD3-FHY3-COP1——以UV抵抗位点8依赖的方式微调UV-B介导的下胚轴伸长抑制。此外，我们还鉴定了来自拟南芥高海拔西藏-0生态型的FHY3中的氨基酸变异，这些变异赋予了对PFD3介导的抑制的抗性。这种遗传适应维持了 COP1 的激活并导致下胚轴缩短和

articles.title: The transcription factor OsMADS61 positively regulates root elongation and nitrogen use efficiency in rice.
articles.titleZh: 转录因子 OsMADS61 正向调节水稻的根伸长和氮利用效率。
articles.authors: Wang D, Liang Z, Gu C, Chang Y, Zhang J, Wu Y, Zhang Y.
articles.abstract: Plant roots have evolved adaptive strategies mediated by transcriptional networks to cope with fluctuating nitrogen (N) forms and availability. However, the mechanisms linking root-foraging responses to N use efficiency (NUE) in crops remain poorly understood. Here, we show that rice exhibits enhanced root elongation under nitrate compared with ammonium, particularly under low N supply, suggesting a specific regulatory role for nitrate in root morphogenesis. We identify the transcription factor OsMADS61 as a key regulator of nitrate-dependent root morphological and physiological responses, as well as NUE, especially under N-limited conditions. OsMADS61 acts as a transcriptional activator of nitrate metabolism by directly binding to OsNRT2.1 and OsNR2 promoters. Nitric oxide produced via the nitrate reductase pathway, under the control of nitrate-responsive OsMADS61, precisely triggers cell proliferation in the root meristem. Moreover, single-nucleotide polymorphisms in the OsMADS61 promoter may be associated with differential root-foraging responses to nitrate availability. Therefore, enhancing N-adaptive root responses to optimize N uptake and assimilation represents a promising strategy for breeding crops with high NUE.
articles.abstractZh: 植物根已经进化出由转录网络介导的适应性策略，以应对波动的氮（N）形式和可用性。然而，人们对作物根部觅食反应与氮利用效率（NUE）之间的联系机制仍知之甚少。在这里，我们表明，与铵相比，水稻在硝酸盐下表现出更强的根伸长，特别是在低氮供应下，这表明硝酸盐在根形态发生中具有特定的调节作用。我们确定转录因子 OsMADS61 是硝酸盐依赖性根形态和生理反应以及 NUE 的关键调节因子，特别是在氮限制条件下。 OsMADS61 通过直接结合 OsNRT2.1 和 OsNR2 启动子充当硝酸盐代谢的转录激活剂。在硝酸盐响应性 OsMADS61 的控制下，通过硝酸还原酶途径产生的一氧化氮精确触发根分生组织中的细胞增殖。此外，OsMADS61 启动子中的单核苷酸多态性可能与根部觅食对硝酸盐可用性的不同反应有关。因此，增强氮适应性根系反应以优化氮吸收和同化是一个有前途的方法。

articles.title: Architecture of the neutrophil compartment.
articles.titleZh: 中性粒细胞室的结构。
articles.authors: Cerezo-Wallis D, Rubio-Ponce A, Richter M, Pitino E, Kwok I, Marteletto G, Guanolema-Coba AC, Shih C, Huang RK, Moraga A, Bravo NB, Doré S, Callejas S, Aragonés DG, Jiménez-Carretero D, Martin D, Ovadia S, Vicanolo T, Crainiciuc G, Sicilia J, Deng T, Martin A, Zhang J, Cuartero MI, Giraldo DM, Garcia-Culebras A, Aroca-Crevillen A, Martín-Salamanca S, Torroja C, Ruiz M, Ruano I, Ng MSF, Hou J, Wang Y, Zhang M, Pu J, Herruzo A, van Oordt DC, Chang S, Downie AE, Chen F, Graham AL, Gause WC, Fiset PO, Spicer JD, Heyn H, Zuriaga MA, Bernal JA, Udalova IA, Moro MA, de Bock K, Dopazo A, Fuster JJ, Sánchez-Cabo F, Nieto JC, Calvo GF, Skokowa J, Soehnlein O, Quail DF, Walsh LA, Ng LG, Hidalgo A, Ballesteros I.
articles.abstract: Neutrophils exhibit remarkable phenotypic and functional diversity across tissues and diseases1,2, yet the lack of understanding of how this immune compartment is globally organized challenges translation to the clinic. Here we performed single-cell transcriptional profiling of neutrophils spanning 47 anatomical, physiological and pathological scenarios to generate an integrated map of the global neutrophil compartment in mice, which we refer to as NeuMap. NeuMap integrates and expands existing models3,4 to generate fundamental new insights; it reveals that neutrophils organize in a finite number of functional hubs that distribute sequentially during maturation to then branch out into interferon-responsive and immunosuppressive states, as well as a functionally silent state that dominates in the healthy circulation. Computational modelling and timestamp analyses identify prototypical trajectories that connect these hubs, and reveal that the dynamics and preferred paths vary during health, inflammation and cancer. We show that TGFβ, IFNβ and GM-CSF push neutrophils along the different trajectories, and projection of chromatin accessibility sites onto NeuMap reveals that the transcription factor JUNB controls angiogenic and immunosuppressive states and promotes tissue revascularization. The architecture of NeuMap appears to be conserved across sex, environmental and genetic backgrounds, as well as in humans. Finally, we show that NeuMap enables inference of the pathophysiological state of the host by profiling blood neutrophils. Our study delineates the global architecture of the neutrophil compartment and establishes a framework for exploration and exploitation of neutrophil biology.
articles.abstractZh: 中性粒细胞在组织和疾病中表现出显着的表型和功能多样性1,2，但缺乏对这种免疫区室如何在全球范围内组织的了解，这给临床转化带来了挑战。在这里，我们对中性粒细胞进行了跨越 47 个解剖、生理和病理场景的单细胞转录分析，以生成小鼠整体中性粒细胞区室的集成图，我们将其称为 NeuMap。 NeuMap 集成并扩展了现有模型3、4，以生成基本的新见解；它揭示了中性粒细胞组织成有限数量的功能中枢，这些中枢在成熟过程中依次分布，然后分支进入干扰素反应和免疫抑制状态，以及在健康循环中占主导地位的功能沉默状态。计算模型和时间戳分析确定了连接这些中心的原型轨迹，并揭示了健康、炎症和癌症期间动态和首选路径的变化。我们发现 TGFβ、IFNβ 和 GM-CSF 沿着不同的轨迹推动中性粒细胞，并且将染色质可及性位点投影到 NeuMap 上揭示了转录

articles.title: DROSHA, DICER, and damage-induced long ncRNA control BMI1-dependent transcriptional repression at DNA double-strand break.
articles.titleZh: DROSHA、DICER 和损伤诱导的长 ncRNA 在 DNA 双链断裂时控制 BMI1 依赖性转录抑制。
articles.authors: Esposito F, Capozzo I, Riccardi A, Gioia U, Modafferi S, Manfredi L, Colantoni A, Tavella S, Cabrini M, Iannelli F, di Lillo A, d'Adda di Fagagna F, Francia S.
articles.abstract: The activation of the DNA-damage response (DDR) enforces the transcriptional silencing of genes near DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs), a process called DSB-induced silencing in cis (DISC). DISC involves the kinase ATM and the polycomb repressive complex 1 (PRC1) component BMI1. Conversely, DSBs also trigger transcription of damage-induced long non-coding RNAs (dilncRNAs) in an MRE11-RAD50-NBS1 (MRN)-complex-dependent manner. MRN recruits the ribonuclease DROSHA, which, along with DICER, enhances DDR signaling and repair. We show that dilncRNAs, DROSHA, and DICER regulate DISC. MRN or ATM inhibition disrupts DISC, while enoxacin, a DICER activator, restores it even without ATM activity. Mechanistically, DROSHA and DICER enable BMI1 recruitment and H2A-K119 ubiquitination at DSBs. BMI1 interacts with DROSHA and dilncRNAs in a DICER-dependent manner. Blocking dilncRNAs by antisense oligonucleotide and Cas13 reduces BMI1 recruitment and DISC. We propose that DROSHA, DICER, and dilncRNAs mediate DISC by promoting PRC1 recruitment and chromatin modification at DSBs.
articles.abstractZh: DNA 损伤反应 (DDR) 的激活会强制 DNA 双链断裂 (DSB) 附近基因的转录沉默，这一过程称为 DSB 诱导的顺式沉默 (DISC)。 DISC 涉及激酶 ATM 和多梳抑制复合物 1 (PRC1) 成分 BMI1。相反，DSB 还以 MRE11-RAD50-NBS1 (MRN) 复合物依赖性方式触发损伤诱导的长非编码 RNA (dilncRNA) 的转录。 MRN 招募核糖核酸酶 DROSHA，它与 DICER 一起增强 DDR 信号传导和修复。我们证明 dilncRNA、DROSHA 和 DICER 调节 DISC。 MRN 或 ATM 抑制会破坏 DISC，而 DICER 激活剂依诺沙星即使没有 ATM 活性也能恢复它。从机制上讲，DROSHA 和 DICER 能够在 DSB 上实现 BMI1 招募和 H2A-K119 泛素化。 BMI1 以 DICER 依赖性方式与 DROSHA 和 dilncRNA 相互作用。通过反义寡核苷酸和 Cas13 阻断 dilncRNA 可减少 BMI1 募集和 DISC。我们建议 DROSHA、DICER 和 dilncRNA 通过促进 DSB 处的 PRC1 募集和染色质修饰来介导 DISC。

articles.title: Engineering seed-specific gossypol-free cotton for human-safe consumption by harnessing the dominant-negative effect of the Gl<sub>2</sub><sup>e</sup> mutation.
articles.titleZh: 利用 Gl<sub>2</sub><sup>e</sup> 突变的显性负效应，工程化种子特异性无棉酚棉花，供人类安全食用。
articles.authors: Cheng X, Wang P, Wang X, Zameer R, Liu L, Chen Z, Wang P, Jiang J, Yu C, Tian B, Wang W, Yu S, Pan H, Shi H, Duan CG, Zuo D, Zhao L, Li Z, Song CP, Song G, Zou C.
articles.abstract: The global yield of cottonseed could meet the annual protein requirements of approximately half a billion people if gossypol were absent from the seeds. Here, we characterize the molecular mechanism by which the Gl2e mutation exerts a dominant-negative effect on gland development, providing a mechanistic basis for engineering seed-specific gossypol-free (SSGF) cotton. We show that Gl2/Gl3 form multimers-likely tetramers-that function as master regulators within the transcriptional network controlling gossypol gland development. Further analyses demonstrate that Gl2e, a dominant mutant allele of Gl2, induces a glandless phenotype through its dominant-negative effect. In addition, multimers composed of Gl2e and Gl2/Gl3 retain E-box binding activity but lack transcriptional activation capacity, thereby inhibiting gland organogenesis. Guided by these insights, we engineered SSGF cotton by driving Gl2e expression specifically during seed development, effectively suppressing gossypol gland formation in seeds. Multi-year, multi-location field trials of the SSGF cotton confirmed the stable production of gossypol-free seeds without compromising fiber yield or other key agronomic traits. Notably, completely gossypol-free oil and flour can be produced directly from SSGF seeds without the need for degossypolization. This work establishes a mechanistic foundation for understanding gland development and offers a sustainable path toward enhancing global plant-derived protein and oil resources.
articles.abstractZh: 如果种子中不含棉酚，全球棉籽产量可满足约 5 亿人每年的蛋白质需求。在这里，我们描述了 Gl2e 突变对腺体发育产生显性负效应的分子机制，为工程种子特异性无棉酚 (SSGF) 棉花提供了机制基础。我们表明，Gl2/Gl3 形成多聚体（可能是四聚体），在控制棉酚腺发育的转录网络中充当主调节因子。进一步的分析表明，Gl2e（Gl2 的显性突变等位基因）通过其显性负效应诱导无腺表型。此外，由Gl2e和Gl2/Gl3组成的多聚体保留了E-box结合活性，但缺乏转录激活能力，从而抑制腺体器官发生。在这些见解的指导下，我们通过在种子发育过程中特异性驱动 GL2e 表达来改造 SSGF 棉花，从而有效抑制种子中棉酚腺的形成。 SSGF 棉花的多年、多地点田间试验证实了不含棉酚种子的稳定生产，且不会影响纤维产量或其他关键农艺性状。不是

articles.title: Molecular basis of very-long-chain fatty acid elongation by the CER6-GL2 enzyme complex in plant wax biosynthesis.
articles.titleZh: 植物蜡生物合成中 CER6-GL2 酶复合物延长极长链脂肪酸的分子基础。
articles.authors: Liu Y, Chen Y, Zhang X, Li M, Wang J, Yang Z, Ma M, Zhao Z, Liu H, Yu F, Zhang P.
articles.abstract: Plant cuticular waxes, crucial hydrophobic barriers, are primarily composed of aliphatics derived from very-long-chain fatty acids (VLCFAs; >C28) synthesized by the endoplasmic reticulum fatty acid elongase complex. The core catalytic subunit, CER6 (KCS6), requires interaction with the BAHD protein GL2 to elongate acyl chains beyond C28. We determined the cryo-electron microscopy structure of the maize CER6-GL2 (ZmCER6-ZmGL2) heterotetramer bound to coenzyme A (CoA) and malonyl-CoA, revealing a membrane-anchored ZmCER6 homodimer, with each cytosolic catalytic domain having a substrate tunnel. Structural and biochemical analyses suggest that ZmGL2's amino terminus binds ZmCER6 and remodels its substrate tunnel into a continuous hydrophobic channel at their interface, enabling acyl-chain elongation. CER6 uses a distinct Cys-His-Asn catalytic triad, differing from the histidine-dependent catalysis of mammalian elongases. GL2 acts noncatalytically to modulate CER6 activity. Comparative analyses suggest that species-specific substrate preferences arise from divergent CER2/GL2 interactions. This work elucidates the acyl-chain elongation mechanism of plant VLCFA biosynthesis and provides a foundation for engineering stress-resilient crops via wax modulation.
articles.abstractZh: 植物角质层蜡是重要的疏水屏障，主要由源自内质网脂肪酸延长酶复合物合成的极长链脂肪酸（VLCFA；>C28）的脂肪族化合物组成。核心催化亚基 CER6 (KCS6) 需要与 BAHD 蛋白 GL2 相互作用才能将酰基链延长到 C28 之外。我们确定了与辅酶 A (CoA) 和丙二酰辅酶 A 结合的玉米 CER6-GL2 (ZmCER6-ZmGL2) 异四聚体的冷冻电镜结构，揭示了膜锚定的 ZmCER6 同二聚体，每个胞质催化结构域都有一个底物通道。结构和生化分析表明，ZmGL2 的氨基末端结合 ZmCER6，并将其底物通道重塑为界面处的连续疏水通道，从而实现酰基链伸长。 CER6 使用独特的 Cys-His-Asn 催化三联体，与哺乳动物延伸酶的组氨酸依赖性催化不同。 GL2 以非催化方式调节 CER6 活性。比较分析表明，物种特异性底物偏好源于不同的 CER2/GL2 相互作用。这项工作阐明了植物 VLCFA 生物合成的酰基链延长机制，并提供了

articles.title: NAT10 promotes cancer metastasis by modulating p300/CBP activity through chromatin-associated tRNA.
articles.titleZh: NAT10 通过染色质相关 tRNA 调节 p300/CBP 活性来促进癌症转移。
articles.authors: Amin R, Ha NH, Qiu T, Holewinski R, Lam KC, Daugherty-Lopès A, Liu H, Tran AD, Lee MP, Andresson T, Goldszmid RS, Hunter KW.
articles.abstract: Protein and RNA acetylation are crucial for development and cancer progression. NAT10 is the only known acetyltransferase responsible for N4-acetylcytidine (ac4C) modification of RNA. However, the mechanism by which NAT10 contributes to cancer progression remains unclear. Here, we show that NAT10 interacts with a mechanosensitive, metastasis-susceptibility protein complex at the nuclear pore. Loss of NAT10's acetylation activity significantly reduces lung metastasis in both allograft and genetically engineered mouse models of breast cancer. Unexpectedly, upon NAT10 knockout, loss of ac4C modification in chromatin-associated tRNAs disrupts p300/CBP function, resulting in genome-wide chromatin reorganization and altered expression of genes that recruit metastasis-promoting myeloid cells to the tumor microenvironment. These findings highlight a role for NAT10 in regulating enhancer activity in metastatic tumor cells and reveal its impact on tumor-immune interactions that contribute to metastatic progression.
articles.abstractZh: 蛋白质和 RNA 乙酰化对于发育和癌症进展至关重要。 NAT10 是唯一已知的负责 RNA N4-乙酰胞苷 (ac4C) 修饰的乙酰转移酶。然而，NAT10 促进癌症进展的机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们证明 NAT10 与核孔处的机械敏感、转移易感性蛋白复合物相互作用。在同种异体移植和基因工程小鼠乳腺癌模型中，NAT10 乙酰化活性的丧失显着减少了肺转移。出乎意料的是，在 NAT10 敲除后，染色质相关 tRNA 中 ac4C 修饰的丢失会破坏 p300/CBP 功能，导致全基因组染色质重组和将促进转移的骨髓细胞招募到肿瘤微环境的基因表达改变。这些发现强调了 NAT10 在调节转移性肿瘤细胞增强子活性中的作用，并揭示了其对促进转移进展的肿瘤免疫相互作用的影响。

articles.title: QUIRKY controls seed germination via precision degradation of ABI5.
articles.titleZh: QUIRKY 通过精确降解 ABI5 来控制种子发芽。
articles.authors: Jiang Y, Zhu Y, Shi M, Ge Q, Xuan L, Liu L.
articles.abstract: Seed dormancy and germination are dynamically regulated by abscisic acid (ABA), with transcription factor ABA INSENSITIVE 5 (ABI5) serving as a key repressor of germination under stress. Here, we identify QUIRKY (QKY), a MULTIPLE C2 DOMAIN AND TRANSMEMBRANE REGION PROTEIN (MCTP) in Arabidopsis, as a critical regulator of ABA signaling through posttranslational control of ABI5. QKY interacts with ABI5 and facilitates its cytoplasmic degradation via the E3 ubiquitin ligase KEEP ON GOING (KEG), promoting the recruitment of ABI5 into phase-separated condensates. Loss of QKY function enhances ABA hypersensitivity, reducing seed germination rates and impairing seedling establishment. These findings highlight QKY as a scaffold that integrates phase separation and targeted ubiquitination to fine-tune ABA responses, balancing dormancy and germination. Our study expands the understanding of posttranslational ABI5 regulation and reveals MCTPs as central players in coordinating growth-stress trade-offs during early plant development.
articles.abstractZh: 种子休眠和发芽由脱落酸 (ABA) 动态调节，转录因子 ABA INSENSITIVE 5 (ABI5) 是胁迫下发芽的关键抑制因子。在这里，我们确定了 QUIRKY (QKY)，一种拟南芥中的多 C2 域和跨膜区蛋白 (MCTP)，通过 ABI5 的翻译后控制作为 ABA 信号传导的关键调节因子。 QKY 与 ABI5 相互作用，并通过 E3 泛素连接酶 KEEP ON GOING (KEG) 促进其细胞质降解，从而促进 ABI5 募集到相分离的凝聚物中。 QKY 功能的丧失会增强 ABA 过敏，降低种子发芽率并损害幼苗的生长。这些发现强调了 QKY 作为一个支架，它整合了相分离和靶向泛素化来微调 ABA 反应，平衡休眠和萌发。我们的研究扩展了对翻译后 ABI5 调控的理解，并揭示了 MCTP 在植物早期发育过程中协调生长与应激权衡的核心角色。

articles.title: Selective decoupling of IgG1 binding to viral Fc receptors restores antibody-mediated NK cell activation against HCMV.
articles.titleZh: IgG1 与病毒 Fc 受体结合的选择性解偶联可恢复抗体介导的 NK 细胞针对 HCMV 的激活。
articles.authors: Qerqez AN, Hoffmann K, Lee AG, Pareek S, Hager K, Mishra AK, Delidakis G, Bentley K, Kerr-Jones L, Cabrera M, Nguyen T, Göttler RL, Chowdhury A, Kolb PL, Hengel H, Georgiou G, McLellan JS, Stanton RJ, Nguyen AW, Maynard JA.
articles.abstract: Antibodies binding cell-surface antigens to activate cellular immunity are an important mechanism of anti-viral protection, yet antibodies targeting cells infected by human cytomegalovirus (HCMV) exhibit limited efficacy. This is due to HCMV immune evasion mechanisms, including viral receptors (vFcγRs) that bind human immunoglobulin G Fc domains to inhibit host Fcγ receptor activation and impair Fc-mediated immune functions. Here, we biochemically characterize two conserved vFcγRs, gp34 and gp68, and map their Fc binding sites.
