We then engineer Fc variants to retain binding to host Fc receptors CD16A and FcRn but exhibit markedly reduced gp34/gp68 interactions. Antibodies targeting the gB fusogen with engineered Fc domains are not internalized by infected cells, mediate enhanced immune cell activation, and limit viral spread in HCMV-infected fibroblasts more effectively than antibodies with wild-type Fc. This work demonstrates a strategy to enhance therapeutic antibody control of HCMV infections and other herpesvirus infections with similar immune-evasion mechanisms.
articles.abstractZh: 结合细胞表面抗原以激活细胞免疫的抗体是抗病毒保护的重要机制，但针对被人巨细胞病毒（HCMV）感染的细胞的抗体表现出有限的功效。这是由于 HCMV 免疫逃避机制，包括病毒受体 (vFcγR) 结合人免疫球蛋白 G Fc 结构域，抑制宿主 Fcγ 受体激活并损害 Fc 介导的免疫功能。在这里，我们对两个保守的 vFcγR（gp34 和 gp68）进行了生化表征，并绘制了它们的 Fc 结合位点图谱。然后，我们设计了 Fc 变体以保留与宿主 Fc 受体 CD16A 和 FcRn 的结合，但表现出显着减少的 gp34/gp68 相互作用。与具有野生型 Fc 的抗体相比，具有工程化 Fc 结构域的靶向 gB 融合剂的抗体不会被感染细胞内化，可介导增强的免疫细胞激活，并更有效地限制病毒在 HCMV 感染的成纤维细胞中的传播。这项工作展示了一种增强治疗性抗体对 HCMV 感染和具有类似免疫逃避机制的其他疱疹病毒感染的控制的策略。

articles.title: Structural assembly of maize CRY-GL2 photosignaling complex provides insights into its regulatory role in cuticular wax biosynthesis.
articles.titleZh: 玉米 CRY-GL2 光信号复合物的结构组装提供了对其在角质层蜡生物合成中的调节作用的见解。
articles.authors: Liu Y, Zhao Z, Zhang X, Hao Y, Feng F, Chen Y, Wang J, Ma M, Li J, Yu F, Liu H, Zhang P.
articles.abstract: Plant cryptochromes (CRYs) are blue-light photoreceptors regulating physiological processes via oligomerization-dependent interaction with effectors. However, the structural basis for photoactivated CRY-effector assembly remains elusive. Here, we report the crystal structure of an active maize CRY1c photolyase homology region in complex with GLOSSY2 (ZmGL2), a BAHD acyltransferase family protein that could form an enzyme complex with ECERIFERUM6 (ZmCER6) and direct very-long-chain fatty acid elongation in cuticular wax biosynthesis. Light-activated CRY1c forms a homotetrameric scaffold. Each protomer binds one ZmGL2 molecule via conformational changes, forming a 4:4 hetero-octameric photosignaling complex. Structural alignment shows 78% overlap between the GL2-binding interfaces in the ZmCRY1c-ZmGL2 and ZmCER6-ZmGL2 complexes. Biochemically, CRY1c dose-dependently inhibits ZmCER6-ZmGL2 enzyme activity, unveiling a light-dependent regulatory switch modulating very-long-chain fatty acid elongation efficiency. Our work establishes the atomic model for light-activated CRY-effector assembly and uncovers spatial competition between photoreceptor and metabolic enzyme complexes as a photoregulatory paradigm in wax biosynthesis.
articles.abstractZh: 植物隐花色素（CRY）是蓝光光感受器，通过与效应器的寡聚依赖性相互作用来调节生理过程。然而，光激活 CRY 效应器组装的结构基础仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们报道了与 GLOSSY2 (ZmGL2) 复合的活性玉米 CRY1c 光裂合酶同源区域的晶体结构，GLOSSY2 (ZmGL2) 是一种 BAHD 酰基转移酶家族蛋白，可以与 ECERIFERUM6 (ZmCER6) 形成酶复合物，并在角质层蜡生物合成中直接延长长链脂肪酸。光激活的 CRY1c 形成同源四聚体支架。每个原聚体通过构象变化结合一个 ZmGL2 分子，形成 4:4 异八聚体光信号复合物。结构比对显示 ZmCRY1c-ZmGL2 和 ZmCER6-ZmGL2 复合物中的 GL2 结合界面之间有 78% 的重叠。在生化方面，CRY1c 剂量依赖性地抑制 ZmCER6-ZmGL2 酶活性，揭示了调节超长链脂肪酸延伸效率的光依赖性调节开关。我们的工作建立了光激活 CRY 效应器组装的原子模型，并揭示了光感受器和代谢酶复合物作为光受体之间的空间竞争

articles.title: Targeting multiple genetic defects of mitochondrial diseases with a single bacterial lipoate protein ligase.
articles.titleZh: 使用单一细菌硫辛酸蛋白连接酶针对线粒体疾病的多种遗传缺陷。
articles.authors: Hu Z, Yu J, Liu Z, Jiang M, Zeng AP.
articles.abstract: Metabolic disorders caused by defects in energy metabolism can lead to many life-threatening diseases; their therapy remains elusive in most cases. Conventional gene therapy relies on the "one gene for one genetic defect" strategy. Here, we demonstrate a more efficient strategy to target multiple genetic defects with a single gene intervention. Specifically, we used a bacterial lipoate protein ligase involved in protein lipoylation to rescue mitochondrial dysfunctions in human lipoylation pathway (LIPT2, LIAS, and LIPT1), lipoyl precursor supply (MECR), and sulfur insertion accessary partner (FDX1). The efficacy and safety of Escherichia coli-derived LplA or Bacillus subtilis-derived LplJ were validated in human cells and mouse models. LplA knock-in mice exhibited normal health with enhanced energy expenditure. Overexpressing LplA through a mating strategy rescued embryonic lethality in Lipt1-/- mutants, yielding viable offspring with normal body weight, energy expenditure, tissue morphology, and biochemical profile. Our work highlights how evolutionary differences in biosynthetic pathways between humans and bacteria can be leveraged for cross-species therapeutic innovations.
articles.abstractZh: 能量代谢缺陷引起的代谢紊乱可导致多种危及生命的疾病；在大多数情况下，他们的治疗仍然难以捉摸。传统的基因治疗依赖于“一种基因治疗一种遗传缺陷”的策略。在这里，我们展示了一种更有效的策略，通过单基因干预来针对多种遗传缺陷。具体来说，我们使用参与蛋白质脂酰化的细菌硫辛酸蛋白连接酶来挽救人类脂酰化途径（LIPT2、LIAS和LIPT1）、硫辛酰前体供应（MECR）和硫插入辅助伴侣（FDX1）中的线粒体功能障碍。大肠杆菌衍生的 LplA 或枯草芽孢杆菌衍生的 LplJ 的功效和安全性在人类细胞和小鼠模型中得到了验证。 LplA 敲入小鼠表现出正常的健康状况，并且能量消耗增加。通过交配策略过度表达 LplA 可挽救 Lipt1-/- 突变体的胚胎致死性，产生具有正常体重、能量消耗、组织形态和生化特征的可存活后代。我们的工作强调了如何利用人类和细菌之间生物合成途径的进化差异来进行跨物种治疗创新。

articles.title: Translational activators align mRNAs at the small mitoribosomal subunit for translation initiation.
articles.titleZh: 翻译激活剂将 mRNA 与线粒体小亚基对齐，以启动翻译。
articles.authors: Bridgers JB, Carlström A, Sherpa D, Couvillion MT, Rovšnik U, Gao J, Wan B, Shao S, Ott M, Churchman LS.
articles.abstract: Mitochondrial gene expression is essential for oxidative phosphorylation. Mitochondrial-encoded mRNAs are translated by dedicated mitochondrial ribosomes (mitoribosomes), whose regulation remains elusive. In Saccharomyces cerevisiae, nuclear-encoded mitochondrial translational activators (TAs) facilitate transcript-specific translation by a yet unknown mechanism. Here, we investigated the function of TAs containing RNA-binding pentatricopeptide repeats using selective mitoribosome profiling and cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) structural analysis. These analyses show that TAs exhibit strong selectivity for mitoribosomes initiating on their target transcripts. Moreover, TA-mitoribosome footprints indicate that TAs recruit mitoribosomes proximal to the start codon. Two cryo-EM structures of mRNA-TA complexes bound to mitoribosomes stalled in the post-initiation, pre-elongation state revealed the general mechanism of TA action. Specifically, the TAs bind to structural elements in the 5' untranslated region of the client mRNA and the mRNA channel exit to align the mRNA in the small subunit during initiation. Our findings provide a mechanistic basis for understanding how mitochondria achieve transcript-specific translation initiation without relying on general sequence elements to position mitoribosomes at start codons.
articles.abstractZh: 线粒体基因表达对于氧化磷酸化至关重要。线粒体编码的 mRNA 由专用的线粒体核糖体（mitoribosomes）翻译，其调控仍然难以捉摸。在酿酒酵母中，核编码的线粒体翻译激活剂（TA）通过一种尚不清楚的机制促进转录特异性翻译。在这里，我们使用选择性线粒体核糖体分析和冷冻电子显微镜 (cryo-EM) 结构分析研究了含有 RNA 结合五肽重复序列的 TA 的功能。这些分析表明，TA 对启动其目标转录本的线粒体核糖体表现出很强的选择性。此外，TA-线粒体核糖体足迹表明，TA 募集接近起始密码子的线粒体核糖体。与线粒体核糖体结合的 mRNA-TA 复合物的两种冷冻电镜结构，在起始后、延伸前状态下停滞，揭示了 TA 作用的一般机制。具体而言，TA 与客户端 mRNA 5' 非翻译区的结构元件结合，并且 mRNA 通道在启动过程中退出以对齐小亚基中的 mRNA。我们的研究结果为理解线粒体如何

articles.title: <i>De novo</i> cysteine biosynthesis in <i>Pseudomonas aeruginosa</i>: Characterization of the two main cysteine synthase isoforms.
articles.titleZh: 铜绿假单胞菌中的半胱氨酸从头生物合成：两种主要半胱氨酸合酶亚型的表征。
articles.authors: Martedì R, D'Angelo JML, Sassi G, Marchetti M, Hijazi S, Percudani R, Bettati S, Campanini B, Frangipani E.
articles.abstract: Most bacteria synthesize L-cysteine via the reductive sulfate assimilation pathway, which is absent in humans and thus a promising source of antibiotic targets. Despite its relevance, this pathway remains poorly studied in Pseudomonas aeruginosa, a major antimicrobial resistance (AMR)-associated pathogen. We have identified the two main isoforms of cysteine synthase in P. aeruginosa (PA2709 and PA0932), which are pyridoxal 5'-phosphate-dependent enzymes that enable bacterial growth in minimal medium supplemented with either sulfate or thiosulfate. PA2709 is a classical O-acetylserine (OAS) sulfhydrylase, using bisulfide as a sulfur source. PA0932 also shows an OAS-dependent S-sulfocysteine synthase activity. Deletion of either one of the two genes does not lead to cysteine auxotrophy, which is reached only with the double deletion mutant. Interestingly, in the presence of thiosulfate as the only sulfur source, PA0932 displays a cysteine bradytrophic phenotype, suggesting the activation of an alternative sulfur assimilation pathway under these conditions.
articles.abstractZh: 大多数细菌通过还原性硫酸盐同化途径合成L-半胱氨酸，该途径在人类中不存在，因此是有前景的抗生素靶点来源。尽管具有相关性，但该途径在铜绿假单胞菌（一种主要的抗菌素耐药性（AMR）相关病原体）中的研究仍然很少。我们已经鉴定了铜绿假单胞菌中半胱氨酸合酶的两种主要亚型（PA2709 和 PA0932），它们是吡哆醛 5'-磷酸依赖性酶，使细菌能够在补充有硫酸盐或硫代硫酸盐的基本培养基中生长。 PA2709 是一种经典的 O-乙酰丝氨酸 (OAS) 硫化氢解酶，使用二硫化物作为硫源。 PA0932 还显示出 OAS 依赖性 S-磺基半胱氨酸合酶活性。删除这两个基因中的任何一个都不会导致半胱氨酸营养缺陷型，而只有双删除突变体才能实现半胱氨酸营养缺陷型。有趣的是，在硫代硫酸盐作为唯一硫源的情况下，PA0932 显示出半胱氨酸缓养表型，表明在这些条件下激活了替代硫同化途径。

articles.title: Incomplete lineage sorting of segmental duplications defines the human chromosome 2 fusion site early during African great ape speciation.
articles.titleZh: 片段重复的不完整谱系排序定义了非洲巨猿物种形成早期的人类 2 号染色体融合位点。
articles.authors: Yang Z, Zhang L, Jiang X, Yang X, Ma K, Yoo D, Lu Y, Zhang S, Chen J, Nie Y, Bian X, Han J, Fu L, Zhang J, Ventura M, Zhang G, Sun Q, Eichler EE, Mao Y.
articles.abstract: All great apes differ karyotypically from humans due to the fusion of chromosomes 2a and 2b, resulting in human chromosome 2. Here, we show that the fusion was associated with multiple pericentric inversions, segmental duplications (SDs), and the turnover of subterminal repetitive DNA. We characterized the fusion site at the single-base-pair resolution and identified three distinct SDs that originated more than 5 million years ago. These three distinct SDs were differentially distributed among African great apes as a result of incomplete lineage sorting (ILS) and lineage-specific duplication. One of these SDs shares homology to a hypomethylated SD spacer sequence present in the subterminal heterochromatin of Pan but is completely absent subtelomerically in both humans and orangutans. CRISPR-Cas9-mediated depletion of the fusion site in human neural progenitor cells alters the expression of genes, indicating a potential regulatory consequence to this human-specific karyotypic change. Overall, this study offers insights into how complex regions subject to ILS may contribute to speciation.
articles.abstractZh: 所有类人猿在核型上都与人类不同，这是因为 2a 和 2b 号染色体融合，形成了人类 2 号染色体。在这里，我们证明这种融合与多个中心周倒位、片段重复 (SD) 和亚末端重复 DNA 的周转有关。我们以单碱基对分辨率表征了融合位点，并确定了起源于 500 万年前的三个不同的 SD。由于不完全谱系排序 (ILS) 和谱系特异性重复，这三种不同的 SD 在非洲类人猿中存在差异分布。其中一个 SD 与 Pan 亚末端异染色质中存在的低甲基化 SD 间隔序列具有同源性，但在人类和猩猩的亚端粒中完全不存在。 CRISPR-Cas9 介导的人类神经祖细胞融合位点的缺失改变了基因的表达，表明这种人类特异性核型变化的潜在调节后果。总的来说，这项研究提供了关于受 ILS 影响的复杂区域如何促进物种形成的见解。

articles.title: Mammalian synthetic gene circuits for biopharmaceutical development & manufacture.
articles.titleZh: 用于生物制药开发和制造的哺乳动物合成基因电路。
articles.authors: Lim SLY, Gialamoidou S, Kaur R, Jimenez Del Val I.
articles.abstract: This paper reviews the design and application of mammalian synthetic gene circuits for biopharmaceutical manufacturing. It discusses key design principles and outlines transcription factors, DNA-binding proteins, and RNA as input and regulatory modules, while also presenting computational modelling as a driver for circuit optimisation. The review highlights potential applications towards the production of next-generation biotherapeutics by providing examples on monoclonal antibody glycosylation control, CAR-T cell therapy safety, and gene therapy viral vector yields.
articles.abstractZh: 本文综述了用于生物制药制造的哺乳动物合成基因电路的设计和应用。它讨论了关键的设计原则，并概述了转录因子、DNA 结合蛋白和 RNA 作为输入和调节模块，同时还提出了计算模型作为电路优化的驱动因素。该综述通过提供单克隆抗体糖基化控制、CAR-T 细胞治疗安全性和基因治疗病毒载体产量的实例，强调了下一代生物治疗药物生产的潜在应用。

articles.title: A genome-scale single-cell CRISPRi map of trans gene regulation across human pluripotent stem cell lines.
articles.titleZh: 人类多能干细胞系转基因调控的基因组规模单细胞 CRISPRi 图谱。
articles.authors: Feng C, Peets EM, Zhou Y, Crepaldi L, Usluer S, Dunham A, Braunger JM, Su J, Strauss ME, Muraro D, Xian Cheam KA, Bonder MJ, Nogales EG, Cooper S, Bassett A, Leonard S, Gu Y, Fussing B, Burke D, Parts L, Stegle O, Velten B.
articles.abstract: Population-scale resources of genetic, molecular, and cellular information form the basis for understanding human genomes, charting the heritable basis of disease and tracing the effects of mutations. Pooled perturbation assays, probing the effect of many perturbations coupled with single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) readout, are especially potent references for interpreting disease-linked mutations or gene-expression changes. However, the utility of existing maps has been limited by the comprehensiveness of perturbations conducted and the relevance of their cell-line context. Here, we present a genome-scale CRISPR interference perturbation map with scRNA-seq readout across many genetic backgrounds in human pluripotent cells. We map trans expression changes induced by knockdowns and characterize their variation across donors, with expression quantitative trait loci linked to higher genetic modulation of perturbation effects. This study pioneers population-scale CRISPR perturbations with high-dimensional readouts, which will fuel the future of effective modulation of cellular disease phenotypes.
articles.abstractZh: 人口规模的遗传、分子和细胞信息资源构成了理解人类基因组、绘制疾病遗传基础和追踪突变影响的基础。混合扰动分析可探索许多扰动与单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq) 读数相结合的影响，对于解释与疾病相关的突变或基因表达变化来说是特别有效的参考。然而，现有图谱的实用性受到所进行扰动的全面性及其细胞系背景的相关性的限制。在这里，我们提出了一个基因组规模的 CRISPR 干扰扰动图，其中包含人类多能细胞中许多遗传背景的 scRNA-seq 读数。我们绘制了敲低引起的反式表达变化，并表征了它们在供体之间的变异，表达数量性状位点与扰动效应的更高遗传调节相关。这项研究开创了具有高维读数的群体规模 CRISPR 扰动，这将为有效调节细胞疾病表型的未来提供动力。

articles.title: Building synthetic chromosomes one yeast at a time: insights from Sc2.0.
articles.titleZh: 一次构建一个酵母的合成染色体：来自 Sc2.0 的见解。
articles.authors: Erpf PE, Meier F, Walker RSK, Goold HD, Boeke JD, Paulsen IT, Pretorius IS.

articles.title: Core rumen microbes are functional generalists that sustain host metabolism and gut ecosystem function.
articles.titleZh: 核心瘤胃微生物是维持宿主新陈代谢和肠道生态系统功能的功能多面手。
articles.authors: Tovar-Herrera OE, Grinshpan I, Sorek G, Lybovits I, Levin L, Moraïs S, Mizrahi I.
articles.abstract: Some microbes persist across diverse gut microbiomes, raising the question of what features define these core taxa and allow them to persist across hosts. Using the rumen microbiome as a model system, we show that core microbes exhibit distinct attributes of ecological generalists, including greater strain variability and broader functional capacity, linked to larger genome sizes. By analysing ~3,000 genomes of core and non-core microbes and metabolically measuring their functional attributes with both biochemical assays and untargeted/targeted metabolomics, we find that these traits enable core microbes to be metabolically independent while also supporting non-core microbes and the host. Core taxa produce essential metabolites, such as amino acids and vitamins, and encode fibre-degrading enzymes crucial for host nutrition. Additionally, they engage in cross-feeding, providing non-core microbes with vital nutrients. This independence positions core microbes as foundational pillars of gut ecosystem stability, and influencing these microbes could modulate microbiome functionality and ruminant host metabolism, with possible downstream consequences for food security and environmental sustainability.
articles.abstractZh: 一些微生物在不同的肠道微生物组中持续存在，这就提出了一个问题：哪些特征定义了这些核心分类群并允许它们在宿主之间持续存在。使用瘤胃微生物组作为模型系统，我们表明核心微生物表现出生态通才的独特属性，包括与更大的基因组大小相关的更大的菌株变异性和更广泛的功能能力。通过分析约 3,000 个核心和非核心微生物的基因组，并通过生化测定和非靶向/靶向代谢组学以代谢方式测量其功能属性，我们发现这些特征使核心微生物能够在代谢上独立，同时也支持非核心微生物和宿主。核心类群产生氨基酸和维生素等必需代谢物，并编码对宿主营养至关重要的纤维降解酶。此外，它们还进行交叉喂养，为非核心微生物提供重要的营养物质。这种独立性使核心微生物成为肠道生态系统稳定性的基本支柱，影响这些微生物可以调节微生物组功能和反刍动物宿主代谢，可能对粮食安全和环境产生下游影响

articles.title: Engineering mammalian protein secretion: Toward the convergence of high-throughput biology and computational methods.
articles.titleZh: 工程哺乳动物蛋白质分泌：走向高通量生物学和计算方法的融合。
articles.authors: Gabrielli J, Lewis NE, Kontoravdi C, Ceroni F.
articles.abstract: Protein secretion in mammalian cells is the active transport of proteins from the cytoplasm to the extracellular space. It plays a fundamental role in mammalian physiology and signaling, as well as biotherapeutics production and cell and gene therapies. The efficacy of protein secretion, however, is impacted by features of the secreted protein itself, and the host-cell machinery that supports each step of the secretion process. High-throughput techniques such as microfluidics, cell display, and cell encapsulation assays for the study and engineering of secreted proteins are transforming biomedical knowledge and our ability to modulate protein secretion. In addition, computational advances, including signal peptide modeling, whole-protein machine learning models, and genome-scale simulations, are opening new pathways for rational design of protein secretion. Here, we highlight recent developments in secretion engineering that are leading to the convergence of high-throughput experimentation and machine learning methods and can help address current challenges in bioproduction and support future efforts in cell and gene therapy while enabling new modalities.
articles.abstractZh: 哺乳动物细胞中的蛋白质分泌是蛋白质从细胞质到细胞外空间的主动转运。它在哺乳动物生理学和信号传导以及生物治疗药物生产以及细胞和基因治疗中发挥着重要作用。然而，蛋白质分泌的功效受到分泌蛋白质本身特征以及支持分泌过程每一步的宿主细胞机制的影响。用于研究和工程化分泌蛋白的微流控、细胞展示和细胞封装测定等高通量技术正在改变生物医学知识和我们调节蛋白分泌的能力。此外，包括信号肽建模、全蛋白机器学习模型和基因组规模模拟在内的计算进步正在为蛋白质分泌的合理设计开辟新途径。在这里，我们重点介绍分泌工程的最新进展，这些进展导致高通量实验和机器学习方法的融合，有助于解决当前生物生产中的挑战，并支持细胞和基因治疗的未来努力，同时实现新的模式。

articles.title: Lantibiotic-producing bacteria impact microbiome resilience and colonization resistance.
articles.titleZh: 产生羊毛硫抗生素的细菌会影响微生物组的弹性和定植抵抗力。
articles.authors: Cole CG, Zhang ZJ, Dommaraju SR, Dong Q, Pope RL, Son SS, McSpadden EJ, Woodson CK, Lin H, Dylla NP, Sidebottom AM, Sundararajan A, Mitchell DA, Pamer EG.
articles.abstract: A subset of commensal bacterial strains secretes bacteriocins, such as lantibiotics, to inhibit or kill neighboring bacteria, thereby protecting their niche in the gut. The antimicrobial spectrum of lantibiotics includes pathogens, offering a potential therapeutic approach for antibiotic-resistant infections. However, the impact of lantibiotic-producing bacteria on the microbiome remains poorly defined. We find that bacterial species encoding lanthipeptide genes in hospitalized patients are present in greater abundance than lantibiotic-deficient strains of the same species. Among the lanthipeptide sequences, some overlapped with the lantibiotic genes of Blautia pseudococcoides SCSK (BpSCSK). In mice, BpSCSK administration prevents intestinal recolonization by a wide range of commensal species following antibiotic-induced dysbiosis and markedly reduces fecal concentrations of microbiota-derived metabolites. Lantibiotic-mediated dysbiosis results in sustained loss of colonization resistance against Klebsiella pneumoniae and Clostridioides difficile infection. Our findings reveal the impact of lantibiotic-producing bacterial species on microbiome resilience and susceptibility to infection following antibiotic treatment.
articles.abstractZh: 共生菌株的一个子集会分泌细菌素，例如羊毛硫抗生素，以抑制或杀死邻近的细菌，从而保护它们在肠道中的生态位。羊毛硫抗生素的抗菌谱包括病原体，为抗生素耐药性感染提供了潜在的治疗方法。然而，产生羊毛硫抗生素的细菌对微生物群的影响仍不清楚。我们发现，住院患者中编码羊毛硫肽基因的细菌种类比同一种类的羊毛硫抗生素缺陷菌株的丰度更高。在羊毛硫肽序列中，一些羊毛硫抗生素基因与Blautia pseudococcoides SCSK (BpSCSK)的羊毛硫抗生素基因重叠。在小鼠中，BpSCSK 给药可防止抗生素引起的菌群失调后多种共生菌在肠道重新定植，并显着降低粪便中微生物群衍生代谢物的浓度。羊毛硫抗生素介导的菌群失调导致对肺炎克雷伯菌和艰难梭菌感染的定植抵抗力持续丧失。我们的研究结果揭示了产生羊毛硫抗生素的细菌种类对微生物组恢复力和感染易感性的影响

articles.title: Transitions in lung microbiota landscape associate with distinct patterns of pneumonia progression.
articles.titleZh: 肺部微生物群景观的转变与肺炎进展的不同模式相关。
articles.authors: Sumner JT, Huttelmaier S, Pickens CI, Moghadam AA, Abdala-Valencia H, Shen J, NU SCRIPT Study Investigators, Hauser AR, Seed PC, Wunderink RG, Hartmann EM.
articles.abstract: The precise microbial determinants driving clinical outcomes in severe pneumonia are unknown. Competing ecological forces produce dynamic microbiota states in health and disease, and a more thorough understanding of these states has the potential to improve pneumonia therapy. Here, we leverage a large collection of bronchoscopic samples from patients with suspected pneumonia to determine lung microbial ecosystem dynamics throughout the course of pneumonia. We combine 16S rRNA gene, metagenomic, and metatranscriptomic sequencing with bacterial-load quantification to reveal clinically relevant drivers of pneumonia progression. Microbiota states are predictive of pneumonia subtypes and exhibit differential stability and pneumonia therapy response. Disruptive forces, such as aspiration, are associated with cohesive changes in gene expression and microbial community structure. In summary, we show that host and microbiota landscapes change in unison with clinical phenotypes and that microbiota state dynamics reflect pneumonia progression. We suggest that distinct pathways of lung microbial community succession mediate pneumonia progression.
articles.abstractZh: 驱动严重肺炎临床结果的确切微生物决定因素尚不清楚。相互竞争的生态力量会在健康和疾病中产生动态的微生物群状态，对这些状态的更深入了解有可能改善肺炎治疗。在这里，我们利用大量疑似肺炎患者的支气管镜样本来确定整个肺炎过程中肺部微生物生态系统的动态。我们将 16S rRNA 基因、宏基因组和宏转录组测序与细菌负荷定量相结合，揭示肺炎进展的临床相关驱动因素。微生物群状态可预测肺炎亚型，并表现出不同的稳定性和肺炎治疗反应。破坏性力量，例如渴望，与基因表达和微生物群落结构的内聚变化有关。总之，我们表明宿主和微生物群景观与临床表型一致变化，并且微生物群状态动态反映了肺炎的进展。我们认为，肺部微生物群落演替的不同途径介导肺炎进展。

articles.title: Variant-specific interaction of kinectin 1 with the multi-tRNA synthetase complex regulates ER sheet organization.
articles.titleZh: kinectin 1 与多 tRNA 合成酶复合物的变体特异性相互作用可调节 ER 片层组织。
articles.authors: Hosogane M, Siao SY, Hatano A, Huang X, Shichino Y, Watanabe Y, Iwasaki S, Matsumoto M, Nakayama K.
articles.abstract: Kinectin 1 (KTN1) is an integral endoplasmic reticulum (ER) sheet protein involved in ER organization and translation elongation. Alternative splicing introduces sequence diversity into the cytosolic region of KTN1; however, the functional significance of these variants has remained unclear. Here, we show that the multi-tRNA synthetase complex (MSC), composed of eight aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases and three nonenzymatic proteins, specifically interacts with KTN1 in a manner dependent on the alternative exon V2 and glutamine-tRNA synthetase (QARS). Using V2 exon-specific knockout cells and KTN1 knockout cells with variant-specific rescue, we found that the V2 exon is required for KTN1-mediated recruitment of the MSC to the ER, where it facilitates the formation of rough ER stacks. These findings define a variant-specific role for KTN1 in anchoring the MSC to the ER and suggest that this interaction underlies a noncanonical function of the MSC in regulating ER sheet organization.
articles.abstractZh: Kinectin 1 (KTN1) 是一种完整的内质网 (ER) 片层蛋白，参与 ER 组织和翻译延伸。选择性剪接将序列多样性引入 KTN1 的胞质区域；然而，这些变异的功能意义仍不清楚。在这里，我们展示了由八种氨酰基-tRNA合成酶和三种非酶蛋白组成的多tRNA合成酶复合物（MSC），以依赖于替代外显子V2和谷氨酰胺-tRNA合成酶（QARS）的方式与KTN1特异性相互作用。使用 V2 外显子特异性敲除细胞和具有变体特异性拯救的 KTN1 敲除细胞，我们发现 V2 外显子是 KTN1 介导的 MSC 募集到 ER 所必需的，在那里它促进了粗糙 ER 堆栈的形成。这些发现定义了 KTN1 在将 MSC 锚定到 ER 中的变体特异性作用，并表明这种相互作用是 MSC 在调节 ER 表层组织中的非规范功能的基础。

articles.title: Protocol for systematic screening of histone H3/H4 mutants to identify histone residues critical for BCAA-dependent replicative lifespan.
articles.titleZh: 系统筛选组蛋白 H3/H4 突变体的方案，以确定对 BCAA 依赖性复制寿命至关重要的组蛋白残基。
articles.authors: Park S, Liu Y, Ahn SH.
articles.abstract: Here, we present a protocol for high-throughput replicative lifespan (RLS) screening in Saccharomyces cerevisiae using micromanipulation-based aging assays with growth phenotyping. We describe steps for preparing yeast strains, isolating virgin cells, and monitoring divisions to calculate lifespan changes in histone H3/H4 mutants. We also describe sulfometuron methyl (SM) spotting assay to evaluate growth phenotypes linked to branched-chain amino acid (BCAA) metabolism, enabling identification of residues critical for lifespan regulation. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to Park et al.1.
articles.abstractZh: 在这里，我们提出了一种使用基于显微操作的衰老分析和生长表型分析在酿酒酵母中进行高通量复制寿命（RLS）筛选的方案。我们描述了制备酵母菌株、分离原始细胞和监测分裂以计算组蛋白 H3/H4 突变体的寿命变化的步骤。我们还描述了甲磺隆 (SM) 点样测定，以评估与支链氨基酸 (BCAA) 代谢相关的生长表型，从而能够识别对寿命调节至关重要的残基。有关该协议的使用和执行的完整详细信息，请参阅 Park 等人 1。

articles.title: FeaSion decodes the regulatory landscape and functional diversity of RNA polymerase II CTD phosphorylation.
articles.titleZh: FeaSion 解码 RNA 聚合酶 II CTD 磷酸化的调控格局和功能多样性。
articles.authors: Zhu J, Bao L, Xu S, Ji X.
articles.abstract: RNA polymerase II's (RNAPII) C-terminal domain (CTD) contains five phosphorylation sites (pY1, pS2, pT4, pS5, and pS7). However, their regulatome and immediate functions remain elusive. Using the FeaSion (Feature-Screening-Function) strategy, we mapped RNAPII phosphorylation site-specific interactors and genomic occupancy, revealing links to preferential gene length, exon number, and transcription factor binding. CRISPR-FACS screens identified different candidate regulators modulating individual phosphorylation sites. Rapid replacement showed site-specific mutations influence different transcriptional processes, histone modifications (H3K36me3 and H2A.Zac), and preferentially affect developmental and signaling genes. Moreover, we demonstrate kinases CLK1/4 and YES1 directly regulate RNAPII transcription-via site-specific CTD phosphorylation-to control developmental, metabolic, and signal transduction programs. Our findings reveal an expanded regulatory network involving >100 kinase and phosphatases that potentially orchestrate CTD phosphorylation beyond their canonical functions, establishing a multilayered phospho-regulatory network with broad implications for gene expression control in development and disease.
articles.abstractZh: RNA 聚合酶 II (RNAPII) C 端结构域 (CTD) 包含五个磷酸化位点（pY1、pS2、pT4、pS5 和 pS7）。然而，它们的调节组和直接功能仍然难以捉摸。使用 FeaSion（特征-筛选-功能）策略，我们绘制了 RNAPII 磷酸化位点特异性相互作用子和基因组占用率，揭示了与优先基因长度、外显子数量和转录因子结合的联系。 CRISPR-FACS 筛选鉴定出调节个体磷酸化位点的不同候选调节因子。快速替换显示位点特异性突变会影响不同的转录过程、组蛋白修饰（H3K36me3 和 H2A.Zac），并优先影响发育和信号基因。此外，我们证明激酶 CLK1/4 和 YES1 通过位点特异性 CTD 磷酸化直接调节 RNAPII 转录，以控制发育、代谢和信号转导程序。我们的研究结果揭示了一个涉及超过 100 种激酶和磷酸酶的扩展调控网络，这些激酶和磷酸酶可能会协调 CTD 磷酸化超出其规范功能，从而建立一个对基因表达控制具有广泛影响的多层磷酸化调控网络

articles.title: A mechanism for the disrupted redox regulation of vascular contractility during aging.
articles.titleZh: 衰老过程中血管收缩性氧化还原调节被破坏的机制。
articles.authors: Tanaka LY, Gutierre LF, Massucatto RC, Garcia GS, Portas CM, Debbas V, de Souza JMF, De Bessa TC, Teixeira L, Oliveira PVS, Souza BP, Teixeira SK, Branco PC, Miyakawa AA, Gaspar RS, Kajihara D, Valadão IC, Bhowmik A, Carroll K, Laurindo FRM.
articles.abstract: Vascular dysfunction contributes to aging-related phenotype, but mechanisms remain unclear. We propose that aging promotes a deregulated convergence between cellular redox processes and mechanoregulation. We focus on Protein Disulfide Isomerase-A1 (PDI), an endoplasmic reticulum redox chaperone known to modulate NADPH oxidase complexes and to fine-tune cytoskeletal remodeling. Our hypothesis is that PDI connects oxidant generation to actin cytoskeleton remodeling via the modulation of protein sulfenylation, an oxidative post-translational modification. We first show that protein sulfenylation supports vascular contractility and F-actin assembly during mechanoadaptation or agonist-induced contraction. Meanwhile, PDI supports sulfenylation-dependent actin remodeling. Moreover, aged murine arteries lose the sulfenic acid-related component of contractility, while PDI overexpression over-rides this dysfunction and restores aging-related vascular contractility. We further confirm a direct PDI-actin interaction modulated by sulfenic acid. Overall, signaling connections between PDI and sulfenylated proteins behave as an upstream integrative system regulating F-actin assembly, a mechanism that is impaired during aging-induced vascular dysfunction.
articles.abstractZh: 血管功能障碍导致衰老相关表型，但机制仍不清楚。我们认为衰老促进了细胞氧化还原过程和机械调节之间的失调趋同。我们专注于蛋白质二硫键异构酶-A1 (PDI)，这是一种内质网氧化还原分子伴侣，已知可调节 NADPH 氧化酶复合物并微调细胞骨架重塑。我们的假设是，PDI 通过调节蛋白质磺酰化（一种氧化翻译后修饰）将氧化剂的产生与肌动蛋白细胞骨架重塑联系起来。我们首先证明蛋白质磺酰化在机械适应或激动剂诱导的收缩过程中支持血管收缩性和 F-肌动蛋白组装。同时，PDI 支持磺酰化依赖性肌动蛋白重塑。此外，衰老的小鼠动脉会失去与磺酸相关的收缩性成分，而 PDI 过度表达会克服这种功能障碍并恢复与衰老相关的血管收缩性。我们进一步证实了次磺酸调节的直接 PDI-肌动蛋白相互作用。总体而言，PDI 和磺化蛋白之间的信号连接充当调节 F-肌动蛋白组装的上游整合系统，这是一种调节 F-肌动蛋白组装的机制。

articles.title: An SFN-YOLO-based detection method for the fermentation stage in the anaerobic digestion process.
articles.titleZh: 一种基于SFN-YOLO的厌氧消化过程发酵阶段检测方法。
articles.authors: Liu P, Cao S, Wang G, Fan S, Sun T, Yan A.
articles.abstract: Anaerobic digestion is an effective and low-carbon approach for biomass utilization and energy recovery. To accurately determine fermentation stages and enhance process control, this paper proposes an anaerobic digestion fermentation stage detection method based on SFN-YOLO. This model combines spatial feature interaction fusion pyramid network (SFIFPN), a focused linear attention (FLAtt) mechanism that concentrates on key features, and a normalized Wasserstein distance (NWD) loss for robust bounding box regression to accurately detect and classify anaerobic digestion images at different stages. The model demonstrates good detection ability on the validation dataset (precision reaches 91.9%, recall reaches 77.6%, and mAP@0.5 reaches 81.1%), with the total proportion of correctly detected boxes reaching as high as 84.27%. This work demonstrates the potential of intelligent visual monitoring to improve the accuracy, efficiency, and automation of anaerobic digestion processes, contributing to sustainable bioenergy management.
articles.abstractZh: 厌氧消化是生物质利用和能源回收的一种有效、低碳的方法。为了准确判断发酵阶段，加强过程控制，提出一种基于SFN-YOLO的厌氧消化发酵阶段检测方法。该模型结合了空间特征交互融合金字塔网络（SFIFPN）、专注于关键特征的聚焦线性注意（FLAtt）机制以及用于鲁棒边界框回归的归一化 Wasserstein 距离（NWD）损失，以准确检测和分类不同阶段的厌氧消化图像。该模型在验证数据集上表现出良好的检测能力（精度达到91.9%，召回率达到77.6%，mAP@0.5达到81.1%），正确检测框的总比例高达84.27%。这项工作展示了智能视觉监控在提高厌氧消化过程的准确性、效率和自动化方面的潜力，有助于可持续的生物能源管理。

articles.title: Chromosome-level genome assembly of triploid Cyperus rotundus uncovers allelic expression patterns and herbicide resistance mechanisms.
articles.titleZh: 三倍体莎草的染色体水平基因组组装揭示了等位基因表达模式和除草剂抗性机制。
articles.authors: Wu L, Luo Z, Lu Y, Li J, Liu M, Cai H, Zhao S, Huang J, Yi L, He S, Bai L, Pan L.
articles.abstract: Cyperus rotundus, a globally distributed and highly competitive weed, has evolved herbicide resistance, posing a significant challenge to sustainable agriculture; however, the lack of genomic resources has limited comprehensive investigations into its resistance mechanisms. Here, we report a chromosome-level genome assembly of triploid C. rotundus (875.13 Mb across 165 chromosomes), which exhibits high synteny among haplotypes. Comparative analysis of six populations revealed that only a population from Changde, Hunan, China (designated R-HN) displayed dual resistance to glyphosate and glufosinate. In this population, high expression of the target-site resistance gene glutamine synthetase 2 (GS2) contributes to glufosinate resistance, whereas glyphosate resistance is predominantly mediated by non-target-site resistance (NTSR) mechanisms. By integrating transcriptomic profiling with yeast-based functional validation, we identified two NTSR genes, CrABCG15 and CrCASPL2C2, that confer glyphosate resistance. Collectively, this study provides a high-quality genomic resource for C. rotundus and advances our understanding of its genomic evolution and herbicide resistance mechanisms.
articles.abstractZh: 香附(Cyperus rotundus)是一种全球分布、竞争激烈的杂草，已进化出对除草剂的抗性，对可持续农业构成重大挑战；然而，基因组资源的缺乏限制了对其耐药机制的全面研究。在这里，我们报告了三倍体 C. rotundus 的染色体水平基因组组装（165 条染色体上的 875.13 Mb），其在单倍型之间表现出高度同线性。对6个人群的比较分析表明，只有来自中国湖南常德的一个人群（简称R-HN）对草甘膦和草铵膦表现出双重耐药性。在该群体中，靶位点抗性基因谷氨酰胺合成酶 2 (GS2) 的高表达有助于草铵膦抗性，而草甘膦抗性主要由非靶位点抗性 (NTSR) 机制介导。通过将转录组分析与基于酵母的功能验证相结合，我们鉴定了两个赋予草甘膦抗性的 NTSR 基因 CrABCG15 和 CrCASPL2C2。总的来说，这项研究为 C. rotundus 提供了高质量的基因组资源，并增进了我们对其基因组进化和除草剂抗性机制的理解。

articles.title: Ethylene modulates cell wall mechanics for root responses to compaction.
articles.titleZh: 乙烯调节细胞壁力学以适应根部对压实的反应。
articles.authors: Zhang J, Liu Z, Farrar EJ, Li M, Lu H, Qu Z, Chara O, Mitsuda N, Sakamoto S, Xue F, Shan Q, Yu Y, Li J, Zhu X, Zhu M, Shi J, Ogorek LP, Borges A, Bennett MJ, Liang W, Pandey BK, Zhang D, Persson S.
articles.abstract: Soil stresses affect crop yields and present global agricultural challenges1. Soil compaction triggers reduction in root length and radial expansion driven by the plant hormone ethylene2. Here we report how ethylene controls cell wall biosynthesis to promote root radial expansion. We demonstrate how soil compaction stress, via ethylene, upregulates Auxin Response Factor1 in the root cortex, which represses cellulose synthase (CESA) genes. CESA repression drives radial expansion of root cortical cells by modifying the thickness of their cell walls, which results in a thicker epidermis and thinner cortex. Our research links ethylene signalling with root cell wall remodelling, and reveals how dynamic regulation of cellulose synthesis controls root growth in compacted soil.
articles.abstractZh: 土壤压力影响作物产量并带来全球农业挑战1。土壤压实会导致根部长度缩短，并在植物激素乙烯的驱动下进行径向扩张。在这里，我们报告乙烯如何控制细胞壁生物合成以促进根径向扩张。我们展示了土壤压实应力如何通过乙烯上调根皮层中的生长素响应因子 1，从而抑制纤维素合酶 (CESA) 基因。 CESA 抑制通过改变细胞壁的厚度来驱动根皮质细胞的径向扩张，从而导致表皮更厚、皮质更薄。我们的研究将乙烯信号传导与根细胞壁重塑联系起来，并揭示了纤维素合成的动态调节如何控制压实土壤中的根系生长。

articles.title: Lysosomal control of proteostasis and reproductive capacity by conserved LMD-3 protein in <i>C. elegans</i>.
articles.titleZh: C 中保守的 LMD-3 蛋白对蛋白质稳态和繁殖能力的溶酶体控制。线虫。
articles.authors: Zhai Y, Wang T, Han J, Wu M, Gong M, Li W, Zhang Z.
articles.abstract: Human female fertility declines markedly with age, a pattern mirrored in C. elegans fecundity. This shared vulnerability stems from evolutionarily conserved molecular pathways. A growing body of evidence links impaired proteostasis-the cell's ability to manage its proteins-to this age-related fertility drop in both species, although the underlying mechanisms are not fully understood. Here, we identify that LMD-3, a LysM domain protein, is a critical regulator of proteostasis and reproductive capacity in C. elegans. Deficiency of lmd-3 leads to notable defects in oxidation resistance and constitutively high cellular stress responses. We demonstrate that LMD-3, localized to the lysosome, interacts with vitellogenin and a proton-pumping V-type ATPase via its TLDc domain to regulate lysosomal function and maintain yolk protein homeostasis. We also found that supplementing with vitamin B12 can restore fertility in lmd-3 mutants by reducing oxidative stress and improving lysosomal function. These findings establish a model for studying reproductive health and finding potential therapeutic strategies.
articles.abstractZh: 人类女性的生育能力随着年龄的增长而显着下降，这一模式也反映在秀丽隐杆线虫的生育能力中。这种共同的脆弱性源于进化上保守的分子途径。越来越多的证据表明，这两个物种的蛋白质稳态（细胞管理蛋白质的能力）受损与年龄相关的生育力下降有关，尽管其潜在机制尚不完全清楚。在这里，我们确定 LMD-3（一种 LysM 结构域蛋白）是线虫蛋白质稳态和繁殖能力的关键调节因子。 lmd-3 的缺乏会导致抗氧化性和细胞应激反应的显着缺陷。我们证明，定位于溶酶体的 LMD-3 通过其 TLDc 结构域与卵黄蛋白原和质子泵 V 型 ATP 酶相互作用，调节溶酶体功能并维持卵黄蛋白稳态。我们还发现，补充维生素 B12 可以通过减少氧化应激和改善溶酶体功能来恢复 lmd-3 突变体的生育能力。这些发现为研究生殖健康和寻找潜在的治疗策略建立了模型。

articles.title: NSD2 targeting reverses plasticity and drug resistance in prostate cancer.
articles.titleZh: NSD2 靶向逆转前列腺癌的可塑性和耐药性。
articles.authors: Li JJ, Vasciaveo A, Karagiannis D, Sun Z, Gretarsson KH, Chen X, Ouerfelli O, Socciarelli F, Frankenstein Z, Dong H, Zou M, Yuan W, Yang G, Aizenman GM, Pannellini T, Xu X, Beltran H, Chen Y, Gardner K, Robinson BD, de Bono J, Gozani O, Abate-Shen C, Rubin MA, Loda M, Sawyers CL, Califano A, Lu C, Shen MM.
articles.abstract: Lineage plasticity is a cancer hallmark that drives disease progression and treatment resistance1,2. Plasticity is often mediated by epigenetic mechanisms that may be reversible; however, there are few examples of such reversibility. In castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC), plasticity mediates resistance to androgen receptor (AR) inhibitors and progression from adenocarcinoma to aggressive subtypes, including neuroendocrine prostate cancer (CRPC-NE)3-5. Here we show that plasticity-associated treatment resistance in CRPC can be reversed through the inhibition of NSD2, a histone methyltransferase6. NSD2 upregulation in CRPC-NE correlates with poor survival outcomes, and NSD2-mediated H3K36 dimethylation regulates enhancers of genes associated with neuroendocrine differentiation. In prostate tumour organoids established from genetically engineered mice7 that recapitulate the transdifferentiation to neuroendocrine states, and in human CRPC-NE organoids, CRISPR-mediated targeting of NSD2 reverts CRPC-NE to adenocarcinoma phenotypes. Moreover, a canonical AR program is upregulated and responses to the AR inhibitor enzalutamide are restored. Pharmacological inhibition of NSD2 with a first-in-class small molecule reverses plasticity and synergizes with enzalutamide to suppress growth and promote cell death in human patient-derived organoids of multiple CRPC subtypes in culture and in xenografts. Co-targeting of NSD2 and AR may represent a new therapeutic strategy for lethal forms of CRPC that are currently recalcitrant to treatment.
articles.abstractZh: 谱系可塑性是推动疾病进展和治疗耐药性的癌症标志1,2。可塑性通常是由可逆的表观遗传机制介导的。然而，这种可逆性的例子很少。在去势抵抗性前列腺癌 (CRPC) 中，可塑性介导对雄激素受体 (AR) 抑制剂的耐药性以及从腺癌进展为侵​​袭性亚型，包括神经内分泌前列腺癌 (CRPC-NE)3-5。在这里，我们表明，CRPC 中与可塑性相关的治疗抵抗可以通过抑制 NSD2（一种组蛋白甲基转移酶 6）来逆转。 CRPC-NE 中 NSD2 的上调与不良生存结果相关，并且 NSD2 介导的 H3K36 二甲基化调节与神经内分泌分化相关的基因的增强子。在由基因工程小鼠建立的前列腺肿瘤类器官中，再现了神经内分泌状态的转分化，以及在人类 CRPC-NE 类器官中，CRISPR 介导的 NSD2 靶向将 CRPC-NE 恢复为腺癌表型。此外，规范的 AR 程序被上调，并且对 AR 抑制剂恩杂鲁胺的反应得到恢复。 NSD2 的药理抑制

articles.title: The presence and induction of regioselective dehydroxylases dictate urolithin metabolism by Enterocloster species.
articles.titleZh: 区域选择性脱羟酶的存在和诱导决定了肠梭菌属的尿石素代谢。
articles.authors: Pidgeon R, Giurleo A, Dridi L, Castagner B.
articles.abstract: Urolithins are a class of bioactive metabolites derived from the metabolism of dietary ellagitannins by the human gut microbiota. In the gut, urolithins are dehydroxylated regioselectively based on microbiota composition and activity. A single 9-hydroxy urolithin dehydroxylase (ucd) operon in gut resident Enterocloster species has been described to date; however, most enzymes in the urolithin metabolic pathway remain uncharacterized. Here, we investigate urolithin cross-feeding between members of the gut microbiota and discover a novel urolithin dehydroxylase in a subset of Enterocloster species. We show that urolithin intermediates, released by gut resident Gordonibacter species during ellagic acid metabolism, are dehydroxylated at both the 9- and 10-positions by E. asparagiformis, E. citroniae, and E. pacaense, but not E. bolteae. Using untargeted proteomics, we uncover a 10-hydroxy urolithin dehydroxylase operon, termed uxd, responsible for these species-specific differences in urolithin metabolism. By inducing uxd expression with diverse urolithins, we show that 9-hydroxy urolithins are required for uxd transcription and 10-position dehydroxylation. Collectively, this study reveals some of the genes, proteins, and substrate features underlying differences in urolithin metabolism by the human gut microbiota.
articles.abstractZh: 尿石素是一类生物活性代谢物，源自人类肠道微生物群对膳食鞣花单宁的代谢。在肠道中，尿石素根据微生物群组成和活性进行区域选择性脱羟基。迄今为止，已描述了肠道常驻肠肠菌属中的单个 9-羟基尿石素脱羟酶 (ucd) 操纵子；然而，尿石素代谢途径中的大多数酶仍未被表征。在这里，我们研究了肠道微生物群成员之间的尿石素交叉喂养，并在肠菌属物种的一个子集中发现了一种新型的尿石素脱羟酶。我们发现，肠道常驻戈登杆菌在鞣花酸代谢过程中释放的尿石素中间体在 9 位和 10 位上被天门冬球菌、香茅球菌和太平洋球菌脱羟基，但螺栓球菌则不然。利用非靶向蛋白质组学，我们发现了一个 10-羟基尿石素脱羟酶操纵子，称为 uxd，它负责尿石素代谢的这些物种特异性差异。通过用不同的尿石素诱导 uxd 表达，我们发现 uxd 转录和 10 位脱羟基需要 9-羟基尿石素。总的来说，这项研究

articles.title: Divergent viral phosphodiesterases for immune signaling evasion.
articles.titleZh: 用于逃避免疫信号的不同病毒磷酸二酯酶。
articles.authors: Doherty EE, Nomburg J, Adler BA, Lopez S, Hsieh K, Price N, Blount N, Doudna JA.
articles.abstract: Cyclic dinucleotides (CDNs) and other short oligonucleotides play fundamental roles in immune system activation in organisms ranging from bacteria to humans. In response, viruses use phosphodiesterase (PDE)-mediated oligonucleotide cleavage for immune evasion, a strategy whose diversity has not yet been explored. Here, we use a canonical 2H PDE (2H PDE) structure-based search of prokaryotic and eukaryotic viral sequences to identify an exceptional diversity of 2H PDEs across the virome, including enzymes not detectable with sequence search methods alone. Despite active site conservation, biochemical experiments reveal remarkable substrate specificity of these PDEs that corresponds to variations in the core 2H fold. This nuanced specificity allows 2H PDEs to selectively degrade oligonucleotide messengers to avoid interfering with host nucleotide signaling. Together, these findings nominate viral 2H PDEs as key regulators of CDN signaling across the tree of life.
articles.abstractZh: 环状二核苷酸 (CDN) 和其他短寡核苷酸在从细菌到人类等生物体的免疫系统激活中发挥着重要作用。作为回应，病毒利用磷酸二酯酶（PDE）介导的寡核苷酸裂解来逃避免疫，这种策略的多样性尚未被探索。在这里，我们使用基于规范 2H PDE (2H PDE) 结构的原核和真核病毒序列搜索来识别病毒组中 2H PDE 的异常多样性，包括仅使用序列搜索方法无法检测到的酶。尽管活性位点保守，生化实验揭示了这些 PDE 的显着底物特异性，与核心 2H 折叠的变化相对应。这种微妙的特异性使 2H PDE 能够选择性降解寡核苷酸信使，以避免干扰宿主核苷酸信号传导。总之，这些发现提名病毒 2H PDE 作为整个生命树 CDN 信号传导的关键调节因子。

articles.title: Timing of transcription controls the selective translation of newly synthesized mRNAs during acute environmental stress.
articles.titleZh: 转录时间控制着急性环境应激期间新合成 mRNA 的选择性翻译。
articles.authors: Zedan M, Schürch AP, Heinrich S, Gómez-García PA, Khawaja S, Dörries L, Weis K.
articles.abstract: When cells encounter stress, they rapidly mount an adaptive response by switching from pro-growth to stress-responsive gene expression programs. How cells selectively silence pre-existing, pro-growth transcripts yet efficiently translate transcriptionally induced stress mRNA and whether these transcriptional and post-transcriptional responses are coordinated are poorly understood. Here, we show that following acute glucose withdrawal in S. cerevisiae, pre-existing mRNAs are not first degraded to halt protein synthesis, nor are they sequestered away in P-bodies. Rather, their translation is quickly repressed through a sequence-independent mechanism that differentiates between mRNAs produced before and after stress, followed by their decay. Transcriptional induction of endogenous transcripts and reporter mRNAs during stress is sufficient to escape translational repression, while induction prior to stress leads to repression. Our results reveal a timing-controlled coordination of the transcriptional and translational responses in the nucleus and cytoplasm, ensuring a rapid and wide-scale reprogramming of gene expression following environmental stress.
articles.abstractZh: 当细胞遇到压力时，它们会通过从促生长基因表达程序切换到压力响应性基因表达程序来迅速发起适应性反应。细胞如何选择性地沉默预先存在的促生长转录物，同时有效地翻译转录诱导的应激 mRNA，以及这些转录和转录后反应是否协调，人们知之甚少。在这里，我们发现，在酿酒酵母中急性葡萄糖戒断后，预先存在的 mRNA 不会首先被降解以停止蛋白质合成，也不会被隔离在 P 体中。相反，它们的翻译通过一种与序列无关的机制迅速受到抑制，该机制区分应激前后产生的 mRNA，然后衰变。应激期间内源转录本和报告基因 mRNA 的转录诱导足以逃避翻译抑制，而应激前的诱导则会导致抑制。我们的结果揭示了细胞核和细胞质中转录和翻译反应的时间控制协调，确保了环境应激后基因表达的快速和大规模重编程。

articles.title: Transcriptome-wide mRNP condensation precedes stress granule formation and excludes new mRNAs.
articles.titleZh: 转录组范围内的 mRNA 浓缩先于应激颗粒形成并排除新的 mRNA。
articles.authors: Glauninger H, Bard JAM, Wong Hickernell CJ, Velez KM, Airoldi EM, Li W, Singer RH, Paul S, Fei J, Sosnick TR, Wallace EWJ, Drummond DA.
articles.abstract: Stress-induced messenger ribonucleoprotein (mRNP) condensation is conserved across eukaryotes, resulting in stress granule formation under intense stresses, yet the mRNA composition and function of these condensates remain unclear. Exposure of ribosome-free mRNA following stress is thought to cause condensation and stress granule formation through mRNA-sequence-dependent interactions, leading to disproportionate condensation of long mRNAs. Here, we show that, by contrast, virtually all mRNAs condense in response to multiple stresses in budding yeast with minor length dependence and often without stress granule formation. New transcripts escape mRNP condensation, enabling their selective translation. Inhibiting translation initiation causes formation of mRNP condensates distinct from stress granules and processing bodies (P bodies), and these translation-initiation-inhibited condensates (TIICs) are omnipresent, even in unstressed cells. Stress-induced mRNAs are excluded from TIICs due to the timing of their expression, indicating determinants of escape that are independent of sequence. Together, our results reveal a previously undetected level of translation-linked molecular organization and stress-responsive regulation.
articles.abstractZh: 应激诱导的信使核糖核蛋白（mRNP）缩合在真核生物中是保守的，导致在强烈应激下形成应激颗粒，但这些缩合物的 mRNA 组成和功能仍不清楚。人们认为，应激后暴露的无核糖体 mRNA 会通过 mRNA 序列依赖性相互作用引起凝结和应激颗粒形成，从而导致长 mRNA 不成比例地凝结。在这里，我们发现，相比之下，几乎所有 mRNA 都会在芽殖酵母中响应多种应激而发生凝缩，长度依赖性较小，并且通常不会形成应激颗粒。新的转录本逃脱了 mRNA 凝结，从而实现了选择性翻译。抑制翻译起始会导致形成不同于应激颗粒和加工体（P体）的mRNP缩合物，并且这些翻译起始抑制缩合物（TIIC）无处不在，即使在未应激的细胞中也是如此。应激诱导的 mRNA 由于其表达时间而被排除在 TIIC 之外，这表明逃逸的决定因素与序列无关。总之，我们的结果揭示了以前未检测到的翻译相关分子组织水平

articles.title: Nouveau benzo-mimetics of 17R-Resolvin D2 are potent resolution agonists for inflammation.
articles.titleZh: 17R-Resolvin D2 的新苯并模拟物是有效的炎症消退激动剂。
articles.authors: Serhan CN, Chiang N, Simard M, Nshimiyimana R, Rodriguez AR, Mun SJ, Irimia D, Spur BW.
articles.abstract: The acute inflammatory response is a highly coordinated protective process governed by a superfamily of mediators termed specialized proresolving mediators. This includes the recently uncovered 17R-Resolvin D2 (17R-RvD2). We report 17R-RvD2 is rapidly metabolized and locally inactivated by human macrophages. An analog was prepared in a stereospecific synthesis. This benzo-17R-RvD2 resists rapid enzymatic inactivation and shared 17R-RvD2's pro-resolving actions enhancing human macrophage efferocytosis (pico-nanomolar). In peritonitis, benzo-17R-RvD2 (1 ng/mouse; 2.7 pmol) limited neutrophil infiltration >70%, reduced tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-α), and increased interleukin-1 (IL-1) receptor antagonist. The analog (1 nM) also enhanced >50% Escherichia coli killing by human leukocytes, equi-molar potent to 17R-RvD2. Benzo-17R-RvD2 (5 nM) reduced the area of human neutrophil swarms on zymosan-targeted chips >30%, without reducing potency of neutrophil swarms against live Candida clusters. Benzo-17R-RvD2 activated human-RvD2 receptor, EC50 ∼1.5 nM, comparable to 17R-RvD2. This longer-acting benzo-17R-RvD2 stimulated critical events in resolution of inflammation, providing a manufacturable prototype for potent SPM mimetics.
articles.abstractZh: 急性炎症反应是一个高度协调的保护过程，由称为专门促消退介质的介质超家族控制。这包括最近发现的 17R-Resolvin D2 (17R-RvD2)。我们报告 17R-RvD2 被人类巨噬细胞快速代谢并局部失活。通过立体定向合成制备类似物。这种 Benzo-17R-RvD2 可抵抗快速酶失活，并具有 17R-RvD2 的促分解作用，可增强人巨噬细胞胞吞作用（皮纳摩尔）。在腹膜炎中，Benzo-17R-RvD2（1 ng/小鼠；2.7 pmol）限制中性粒细胞浸润 >70%，减少肿瘤坏死因子 α (TNF-α)，并增加白细胞介素 1 (IL-1) 受体拮抗剂。该类似物 (1 nM) 还增强了人类白细胞对大肠杆菌的杀伤力 >50%，与 17R-RvD2 等摩尔效力。 Benzo-17R-RvD2 (5 nM) 可将酵母聚糖靶向芯片上的人类中性粒细胞群面积减少 >30%，但不会降低中性粒细胞群对抗活念珠菌簇的效力。 Benzo-17R-RvD2 激活人 RvD2 受体，EC50 ∼1.5 nM，与 17R-RvD2 相当。这种长效 Benz-17R-RvD2 刺激了炎症消退的关键事件，提供了一种方法

articles.title: Degradation and ring-opening polymerization of poly(ε-caprolactone) by a novel enzyme from <i>Pseudomonas</i> sp. DS0801.
articles.titleZh: 假单胞菌属新型酶对聚（ε-己内酯）的降解和开环聚合。 DS0801。
articles.authors: Di Y, Luan W, Sun L, Qi J, Xia H, Li F, Zhai N.
articles.abstract: Poly(ε-caprolactone) (PCL) is a widely used synthetic polymer with significant commercial applications, and its degradation and synthesis have become the focus of considerable research. In this study, we purified a PCL-degrading enzyme, PCLase0801, produced by Pseudomonas sp. DS0801. The enzyme was purified to homogeneity and had a molecular weight of 30.4 kDa. It exhibited optimal activity at 40°C and pH 8.0, hydrolyzing PCL into monomers, dimers, and trimers. The enzyme was identified as a lipase and showed good tolerance to organic solvents. Additionally, PCLase0801 catalyzed the ring-opening polymerization of ε-caprolactone, producing PCL with a molecular weight of 6050 g/mol and favorable structural properties. This work provides new insights into the potential applications of PCL-degrading enzymes in PCL treatment and biosynthesis.
articles.abstractZh: 聚(ε-己内酯)(PCL)是一种广泛使用的合成聚合物，具有重要的商业应用，其降解和合成已成为大量研究的焦点。在这项研究中，我们纯化了由假单胞菌产生的 PCL 降解酶 PCLase0801。 DS0801。该酶纯化至均质，分子量为 30.4 kDa。它在 40°C 和 pH 8.0 时表现出最佳活性，将 PCL 水解成单体、二聚体和三聚体。该酶被鉴定为脂肪酶并且对有机溶剂表现出良好的耐受性。此外，PCLase0801催化ε-己内酯的开环聚合，生成分子量为6050 g/mol且具有良好结构性质的PCL。这项工作为 PCL 降解酶在 PCL 处理和生物合成中的潜在应用提供了新的见解。

articles.title: Faecalibacterium prausnitzii alleviates experimental recurrent acute pancreatitis by producing oleic acid to regulate MAPK/NF-κB signaling and Th17/Treg balance.
articles.titleZh: 普拉梭菌通过产生油酸调节 MAPK/NF-κB 信号传导和 Th17/Treg 平衡来缓解实验性复发性急性胰腺炎。
articles.authors: Qin W, Mei Q, Wang G, Wang R, Huang Z, Fu Y, Xu B, Huang C, Ai L, Zeng Y.
articles.abstract: Acute pancreatitis (AP) is a complex gastrointestinal disorder associated with disruptions in the gut microbiome. However, the gut microbial and metabolomic profiles in recurrent acute pancreatitis (RAP), which is a clinically distinct subtype of AP, remain unclear. This study integrated microbiome-metabolome analysis to identify the key gut microbial species and metabolic pathways associated with RAP. The findings reveal that the abundance of Faecalibacterium prausnitzii (Fp) is significantly diminished in RAP patients, exhibiting a strong negative correlation with disease severity. Consistent with this observation, fecal microbiota transplantation enriched with Fp significantly ameliorated pancreatic injury in RAP mice. We further isolated Fp Ai 3-16 strain from the stool of healthy volunteers. Functional validation using experimental AP models demonstrates that Fp Ai 3-16 and its metabolite oleic acid (OA) can effectively attenuate pancreatitis by modulating MAPK/NF-κB signaling pathways and restoring the intestinal Th17/Treg balance. Importantly, these results extend beyond the context of RAP, as they highlight the broader significance of the gut-pancreas axis in the pathogenesis of AP. Thus, the elucidation of the underlying molecular mechanisms offers novel therapeutic avenues for RAP management and provides a foundation for further investigations into the intricate interplay between the gut microbiome and the pancreas.
articles.abstractZh: 急性胰腺炎 (AP) 是一种与肠道微生物群破坏相关的复杂胃肠道疾病。然而，复发性急性胰腺炎 (RAP) 是临床上独特的 AP 亚型，其肠道微生物和代谢组学特征仍不清楚。这项研究整合了微生物组-代谢组分析，以确定与 RAP 相关的关键肠道微生物种类和代谢途径。研究结果表明，RAP 患者中普拉梭菌 (Fp) 的丰度显着减少，与疾病严重程度呈强负相关。与这一观察结果一致，富含 Fp 的粪便微生物群移植显着改善了 RAP 小鼠的胰腺损伤。我们进一步从健康志愿者的粪便中分离出 Fp Ai 3-16 菌株。使用实验 AP 模型进行的功能验证表明，Fp Ai 3-16 及其代谢物油酸 (OA) 可以通过调节 MAPK/NF-κB 信号通路和恢复肠道 Th17/Treg 平衡来有效减轻胰腺炎。重要的是，这些结果超出了 RAP 的范围，因为它们强调了肠-胰腺轴在病原体中的更广泛意义

articles.title: Mitochondrial NAD<sup>+</sup> gradient sustained by membrane potential and transport.
articles.titleZh: 线粒体 NAD<sup>+</sup> 梯度由膜电位和运输维持。
articles.authors: Goyal S, Lyons SN, Cambronne XA.
articles.abstract: SLC25A51 is required for the replenishment of free nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (oxidized form) (NAD+) into mammalian mitochondria. However, it is not known how SLC25A51 imports this anionic molecule to sustain elevated NAD+ concentrations in the matrix. Understanding this would reveal regulatory mechanisms used to maintain critical bioenergetic gradients for cellular respiration, oxidative mitochondrial reactions, and mitochondrial adenosine triphosphate (ATP) production. In this work, mutational analyses and localized NAD+ biosensors revealed that the mitochondrial membrane potential (ΔΨm) works in concert with charged residues in the carrier's inner pore to enable sustained import of NAD+ against its electrochemical gradient into the matrix. Dissipation of the ΔΨm or mutation of select residues in SLC25A51 led to equilibration of NAD+ from the matrix. Corroborating data were obtained with the structurally distinct mitochondrial NAD+ carrier from Saccharomyces cerevisiae (ScNdt1p) and mitochondrial ATP transport suggesting a shared mechanism of charge compensation and electrogenic transport in these mitochondrial carrier family members.
articles.abstractZh: SLC25A51 是向哺乳动物线粒体补充游离烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（氧化形式）(NAD+) 所必需的。然而，尚不清楚 SLC25A51 如何导入这种阴离子分子以维持基质中升高的 NAD+ 浓度。了解这一点将揭示用于维持细胞呼吸、氧化线粒体反应和线粒体三磷酸腺苷 (ATP) 生产的关键生物能梯度的调节机制。在这项工作中，突变分析和局部 NAD+ 生物传感器揭示了线粒体膜电位 (ΔΨm) 与载体内孔中的带电残基协同作用，使得 NAD+ 能够逆其电化学梯度持续导入基质中。 SLC25A51 中 ΔΨm 的耗散或选择残基的突变导致 NAD+ 从基质中平衡。通过来自酿酒酵母的结构不同的线粒体 NAD+ 载体 (ScNdt1p) 和线粒体 ATP 运输获得了证实的数据，表明这些线粒体载体家族成员具有共同的电荷补偿和生电运输机制。

articles.title: Chemical inhibition of MrkH-dependent activation of type 3 fimbriae synthesis and biofilm formation by Klebsiella pneumoniae.
articles.titleZh: 肺炎克雷伯菌对 3 型菌毛合成和生物膜形成的 MrkH 依赖性激活的化学抑制。
articles.authors: Wilksch JJ, Tan JWH, Nero TL, Hocking DM, Bennett-Wood V, Wang N, Zavras SA, Schiesser CH, Tauschek M, Schembri MA, Lithgow T, Hartland EL, Robins-Browne RM, Parker MW, Yang J, Strugnell RA.
articles.abstract: Biofilm formation by Klebsiella pneumoniae is mediated by the type 3 fimbriae Mrk, and regulated by MrkH and 3',5'-cyclic diguanylic acid (c-di-GMP). We sought to identify specific chemical inhibitors of K. pneumoniae biofilm formation that reduced the activity of MrkH. A compound N-(3-cyano-5,6,7,8-tetrahydro-4H-cyclohepta[b]thien-2-yl)-2-methoxybenzamide, JT71, reduced K. pneumoniae mrkA promoter activity and biofilm formation by 50% without affecting cell viability. Western blot analysis, hemagglutination assays, electron microscopy and qPCR showed that JT71 reduced type 3 fimbriae production, and transcription of mrkA and mrkH. JT71 demonstrated activity against other clinical and multi-drug resistant K. pneumoniae isolates, and a type 3 fimbriate-positive Citrobacter koseri strain. In silico molecule docking was used to illustrate that JT71 could bind directly to the MrkH protein and block its activity. JT71 possesses promising drug-likeness properties and is non-toxic to mammalian cells. Chemical inhibition of transcriptional regulators that control fimbriae expression can inhibit bacterial biofilm formation.
articles.abstractZh: 肺炎克雷伯菌的生物膜形成由 3 型菌毛 Mrk 介导，并受 MrkH 和 3',5'-环二鸟苷酸 (c-di-GMP) 调节。我们试图找出能够降低 MrkH 活性的肺炎克雷伯菌生物膜形成的特定化学抑制剂。化合物 N-(3-氰基-5,6,7,8-四氢-4H-环庚[b]噻吩-2-基)-2-甲氧基苯甲酰胺 JT71 可将肺炎克雷伯菌 mrkA 启动子活性和生物膜形成降低 50%，而不影响细胞活力。蛋白质印迹分析、血凝试验、电子显微镜和 qPCR 表明，JT71 减少了 3 型菌毛的产生以及 mrkA 和 mrkH 的转录。 JT71 表现出对其他临床和多重耐药肺炎克雷伯菌分离株以及 3 型流苏阳性柠檬酸杆菌菌株的活性。使用计算机分子对接来说明JT71可以直接结合MrkH蛋白并阻断其活性。 JT71 具有良好的药物样特性，并且对哺乳动物细胞无毒。控制菌毛表达的转录调节因子的化学抑制可以抑制细菌生物膜的形成。

articles.title: Combinatorial screening in tobacco enables engineering of rose-terpenoid-enriched rice endosperm.
articles.titleZh: 烟草中的组合筛选能够对富含玫瑰萜类化合物的水稻胚乳进行工程改造。
articles.authors: Li Y, Miao Y, Sun M, Cheng N, Hu F, Zhu T, Liu X, Luo J.

articles.title: Deubiquitinases cleave ubiquitin-fused ribosomal proteins and physically counteract their targeting to the UFD pathway.
articles.titleZh: 去泛素酶可裂解泛素融合核糖体蛋白，并以物理方式抵消其对 UFD 途径的靶向作用。
articles.authors: Patchett S, Moghadasi SA, Shukla A, El Oualid F, Ueberheide BM, Olsen SK, Huang TT.
articles.abstract: In eukaryotes, each ribosomal subunit includes a ribosomal protein (RP) that is encoded as a fusion protein with ubiquitin (Ub). In yeast, each Ub-RP fusion requires processing by deubiquitylating enzymes (DUBs) to generate ribosome assembly-competent RPs and contribute to the cellular Ub pool. However, how Ub-RP fusions are processed by DUBs in human cells remains unclear. Here, we discovered that Ub-RPs are substrates of the Ub-fusion degradation (UFD) pathway in human cells via lysine 29 and 48 (K29/K48)-specific ubiquitylation and proteasomal degradation. We identified a pool of DUBs that catalytically process Ub-RPs, as well as DUBs that physically occlude Ub-RP interaction with UFD pathway Ub E3 ligases to prevent their degradation in a non-catalytic manner. Our results suggest that DUBs both process and stabilize Ub-RPs, whereas the UFD pathway regulates levels of Ub-RPs that cannot be fully processed by DUBs to fine-tune protein homeostasis.
articles.abstractZh: 在真核生物中，每个核糖体亚基都包含核糖体蛋白 (RP)，其编码为与泛素 (Ub) 的融合蛋白。在酵母中，每个 Ub-RP 融合都需要通过去泛素化酶 (DUB) 进行处理，以生成具有核糖体组装能力的 RP 并为细胞 Ub 库做出贡献。然而，人类细胞中 DUB 如何处理 Ub-RP 融合仍不清楚。在这里，我们发现 Ub-RPs 是人类细胞中 Ub 融合降解 (UFD) 途径的底物，通过赖氨酸 29 和 48 (K29/K48) 特异性泛素化和蛋白酶体降解。我们确定了一组催化处理 Ub-RP 的 DUB，以及物理阻断 Ub-RP 与 UFD 途径 Ub E3 连接酶相互作用的 DUB，以防止其以非催化方式降解。我们的结果表明，DUB 既能处理又稳定 Ub-RP，而 UFD 途径则调节 DUB 无法完全处理的 Ub-RP 水平，以微调蛋白质稳态。

articles.title: Hepatocyte mitochondrial NAD<sup>+</sup> content is limiting for liver regeneration.
articles.titleZh: 肝细胞线粒体 NAD<sup>+</sup> 含量限制肝脏再生。
articles.authors: Mukherjee S, Velázquez Aponte RA, Perry CE, Lee WD, Janssen KA, Niere M, Adzika GK, Lu MJ, Chan HR, Zou X, Chen B, Bye N, Xiao T, Yook JS, Salik O, Frederick DW, Gaspar RB, Doan KV, Davis JG, Rabinowitz JD, Wallace DC, Snyder NW, Kajimura S, Cambronne XA, Ziegler M, Baur JA.
articles.abstract: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) precursor supplementation shows metabolic and functional benefits in rodent models of disease and is being explored as potential therapeutic strategy in humans. However, the wide range of processes that involve NAD+ in every cell and subcellular compartment make it difficult to narrow down the mechanisms of action. Here we show that the rate of liver regeneration is closely associated with the concentration of NAD+ in hepatocyte mitochondria. We find that the mitochondrial NAD+ concentration in hepatocytes of male mice is determined by the expression of the transporter SLC25A51 (MCART1). The heterozygous loss of SLC25A51 modestly decreases mitochondrial NAD+ content in multiple tissues and impairs liver regeneration, whereas the hepatocyte-specific overexpression of SLC25A51 is sufficient to enhance liver regeneration comparably to the effect of systemic NAD+ precursor supplements. This benefit is observed even though NAD+ levels are increased only in mitochondria. Thus, the hepatocyte mitochondrial NAD+ pool is a key determinant of the rate of liver regeneration.
articles.abstractZh: 烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸 (NAD+) 前体补充剂在啮齿动物疾病模型中显示出代谢和功能益处，并且正在探索作为人类的潜在治疗策略。然而，每个细胞和亚细胞区室中涉及 NAD+ 的过程多种多样，因此很难缩小作用机制的范围。在这里，我们发现肝脏再生速度与肝细胞线粒体中 NAD+ 的浓度密切相关。我们发现雄性小鼠肝细胞中线粒体 NAD+ 浓度由转运蛋白 SLC25A51 (MCART1) 的表达决定。 SLC25A51 的杂合缺失会适度降低多个组织中线粒体 NAD+ 的含量，并损害肝再生，而 SLC25A51 的肝细胞特异性过度表达足以增强肝再生，与全身 NAD+ 前体补充剂的效果相当。尽管 NAD+ 水平仅在线粒体中增加，但仍观察到这种益处。因此，肝细胞线粒体 NAD+ 池是肝脏再生速度的关键决定因素。

articles.title: Protocol for the expression, purification, and biochemical characterization of the innate immune sensor MDA5.
articles.titleZh: 先天免疫传感器 MDA5 的表达、纯化和生化表征方案。
articles.authors: Joiner JD, Herrero Del Valle A, Singh R, Modis Y.
articles.abstract: MDA5 is one of the primary eukaryotic innate immune sensors of viruses, recognizing long double-stranded RNA (dsRNA). Here, we present procedures for the recombinant expression and purification of murine MDA5 from E. coli. We describe the steps to purify MDA5 in high yields for downstream experiments and procedures to determine the ATPase activity and RNA-binding properties of purified MDA5. These approaches can be used to produce disease-associated mutants of MDA5, to uncover the biochemical mechanisms underpinning known disease phenotypes. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to Singh et al.1.
articles.abstractZh: MDA5 是病毒的主要真核先天免疫传感器之一，可识别长双链 RNA (dsRNA)。在这里，我们介绍了从大肠杆菌中重组表达和纯化鼠 MDA5 的程序。我们描述了高产率纯化 MDA5 的步骤，用于下游实验和确定纯化 MDA5 的 ATP 酶活性和 RNA 结合特性的程序。这些方法可用于产生与疾病相关的 MDA5 突变体，以揭示支撑已知疾病表型的生化机制。有关该协议的使用和执行的完整详细信息，请参阅 Singh 等人 1。

articles.title: A microbial community that alters mitochondrial morphology and age-related motor function in <i>C. elegans</i>.
articles.titleZh: 改变线粒体形态和年龄相关运动功能的微生物群落。线虫。
articles.authors: Dennis N, Vazquez-Prada M, Freeman LM, Xue F, White LJ, Karamalegos AA, Sullivan WG, Kudzminkaite B, Brown I, Hiscock JR, Ezcurra M.
articles.abstract: Across diverse taxa, the composition of the microbiota is associated with host fitness. A mechanistic understanding of how microbial communities influence host physiology could lead to microbiota-based interventions for lifelong health. Here, we have developed a host-microbiota model system consisting of the model organism C. elegans combined with a defined natural microbiota (DefNatMta) consisting of 11 bacterial strains isolated from wild C. elegans to study natural host-microbiota interactions in the laboratory. We show that DefNatMta persists in the C. elegans gut, forming a stable and distinct gut microbiota. Utilizing this host-microbiota system, we find that DefNatMta affects age-related motility and protects against age-related decline in motor function. DefNatMta acts by altering metabolism and mitochondrial network dynamics in muscle and requires dynamin-related protein 1 (DRP-1), a regulator of mitochondrial fission to protect against age-related motility decline. Our findings are consistent with microbe-mitochondria communication affecting age-related muscle function.
articles.abstractZh: 在不同的分类群中，微生物群的组成与宿主的适应性有关。对微生物群落如何影响宿主生理机能的机械理解可能会导致基于微生物群的终身健康干预措施。在这里，我们开发了一个宿主-微生物群模型系统，该系统由模型生物秀丽隐杆线虫与定义的天然微生物群 (DefNatMta) 组成，该天然微生物群由从野生秀丽隐杆线虫中分离出的 11 种细菌菌株组成，以在实验室中研究自然宿主-微生物群的相互作用。我们发现 DefNatMta 持续存在于秀丽隐杆线虫肠道中，形成稳定且独特的肠道微生物群。利用这种宿主-微生物群系统，我们发现 DefNatMta 会影响与年龄相关的运动能力，并防止与年龄相关的运动功能下降。 DefNatMta 通过改变肌肉中的新陈代谢和线粒体网络动力学发挥作用，并需要动力相关蛋白 1 (DRP-1)，它是线粒体裂变的调节因子，可防止与年龄相关的运动能力下降。我们的研究结果与微生物-线粒体通讯影响与年龄相关的肌肉功能是一致的。

articles.title: Far-red light orchestrates antiviral defense in plants.
articles.titleZh: 远红光协调植物的抗病毒防御。
articles.authors: Gong Q, He L, Huang F, Wang Y, Xie J, Hong Y, Liu Y.
articles.abstract: Light undergoes dramatic spectral shifts at dusk (sunset) and dawn (sunrise), enhancing insect activity and increasing the risk of insect-borne virus transmission. However, how plants respond to these light changes and associated viral threats remains unclear. Here, we show that far-red (FR) light, enriched in skylight during dusk and dawn, activates plant antiviral defense via phytochrome A (phyA). FR light-induced phyA activation promotes degradation of phytochrome interacting factor 1 (PIF1), which triggers the REVEILLE 7 (RVE7)-enhanced disease susceptibility 1 (EDS1) cascade to enhance salicylic acid (SA) signaling. Furthermore, multiple viruses use their RNA-dependent RNA polymerases to disrupt the phyA-far-red elongated hypocotyl 1 (FHY1) interaction to block phyA nuclear transport, impairing FR light-induced plant defense. Our findings uncover the molecular basis of FR light-mediated plant antiviral defense and reveal a previously unidentified viral counter-defense mechanism, highlighting how plants interpret environmental light cues to adapt to insect-borne viral infections.
articles.abstractZh: 光线在黄昏（日落）和黎明（日出）时会经历剧烈的光谱变化，增强昆虫活动并增加昆虫传播病毒传播的风险。然而，植物如何应对这些光线变化和相关的病毒威胁仍不清楚。在这里，我们展示了黄昏和黎明期间天光中丰富的远红 (FR) 光，通过光敏色素 A (phyA) 激活植物的抗病毒防御。 FR 光诱导的 phyA 激活促进光敏色素相互作用因子 1 (PIF1) 的降解，从而触发 REVEILLE 7 (RVE7) 增强疾病易感性 1 (EDS1) 级联，从而增强水杨酸 (SA) 信号传导。此外，多种病毒利用其RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶破坏phyA-远红延长下胚轴1 (FHY1)相互作用，从而阻断phyA核运输，损害FR光诱导的植物防御。我们的研究结果揭示了 FR 光介导的植物抗病毒防御的分子基础，并揭示了以前未识别的病毒反防御机制，强调了植物如何解释环境光线索以适应昆虫传播的病毒感染。

articles.title: Genetic elements promote retention of extrachromosomal DNA in cancer cells.
articles.titleZh: 遗传元件促进癌细胞中染色体外 DNA 的保留。
articles.authors: Sankar V, Hung KL, Gnanasekar A, Wong IT, Shi Q, Kraft K, Jones MG, He BJ, Yan X, Belk JA, Liu KJ, Agarwal S, Wang SK, Henssen AG, Mischel PS, Chang HY.
articles.abstract: Extrachromosomal DNA (ecDNA) is a prevalent and devastating form of oncogene amplification in cancer1,2. Circular megabase-sized ecDNAs lack centromeres, stochastically segregate during cell division3-6 and persist over many generations. It has been more than 40 years since ecDNAs were first observed to hitchhike on mitotic chromosomes into daughter cell nuclei, but the mechanism underlying this process remains unclear3,7. Here we identify a family of human genomic elements, termed retention elements, that tether episomes to mitotic chromosomes to increase ecDNA transmission to daughter cells. Using Retain-seq, a genome-scale assay that we developed, we reveal thousands of human retention elements that confer generational persistence to heterologous episomes. Retention elements comprise a select set of CpG-rich gene promoters and act additively. Live-cell imaging and chromosome conformation capture show that retention elements physically interact with mitotic chromosomes at regions that are mitotically bookmarked by transcription factors and chromatin proteins. This activity intermolecularly recapitulates promoter-enhancer interactions. Multiple retention elements are co-amplified with oncogenes on individual ecDNAs in human cancers and shape their sizes and structures. CpG-rich retention elements are focally hypomethylated. Targeted cytosine methylation abrogates retention activity and leads to ecDNA loss, which suggests that methylation-sensitive interactions modulate episomal DNA retention. These results highlight the DNA elements and regulatory logic of mitotic ecDNA retention. Amplifications of retention elements promote the maintenance of oncogenic ecDNA across generations of cancer cells, and reveal the principles of episome immortality intrinsic to the human genome.
articles.abstractZh: 染色体外 DNA (ecDNA) 是癌症中癌基因扩增的一种普遍且具有破坏性的形式1,2。圆形兆碱基大小的 ecDNA 缺乏着丝粒，在细胞分裂 3-6 过程中随机分离，并持续多个世代。自首次观察到 ecDNA 搭有丝分裂染色体进入子细胞核以来已有 40 多年的历史，但这一过程背后的机制仍不清楚3,7。在这里，我们鉴定了一个人类基因组元件家族，称为保留元件，它将附加体连接到有丝分裂染色体上，以增加 ecDNA 向子细胞的传递。使用我们开发的基因组规模检测 Retain-seq，我们揭示了数千个人类保留元件，这些元件赋予异源附加体代际持久性。保留元件包含一组精选的富含 CpG 的基因启动子，并发挥加性作用。活细胞成像和染色体构象捕获表明，保留元件在由转录因子和染色质蛋白标记有丝分裂的区域与有丝分裂染色体发生物理相互作用。这种活性在分子间概括了启动子-增强子的相互作用。多个保留元件共同扩增

articles.title: HSP90 buffers deleterious genetic variations in BRCA1.
articles.titleZh: HSP90 缓冲 BRCA1 中的有害遗传变异。
articles.authors: Gracia B, Zhang XH, Montes P, Pham TC, Huang M, Chen J, Karras GI.
articles.abstract: Protein-folding chaperone heat shock protein 90 (HSP90) buffers genetic variation in diverse organisms, but the clinical significance of HSP90 buffering in human disease remains unclear. Here, we show that HSP90 buffers mutations in the BRCT domain of BRCA1. HSP90-buffered BRCA1 mutations result in protein variants that retain interactions with partner proteins and strongly rely on HSP90 for protein stability and function in cell survival. Moreover, HSP90-buffered BRCA1 variants confer poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibitor resistance in cancer cells. Low-level HSP90 inhibition overcomes this resistance, revealing a cryptic and mutant-specific HSP90-contingent synthetic lethality. Furthermore, by stabilizing metastable variants across the entirety of the BRCT domain, HSP90 reduces the clinical severity of BRCA1 mutations, allowing them to accumulate in populations. We estimate that HSP90 buffers 18% of known human BRCA1-BRCT missense mutations. Our work extends the clinical significance of HSP90 buffering to a prevalent class of variations in BRCA1, pioneering its importance in therapy resistance and cancer predisposition.
articles.abstractZh: 蛋白质折叠伴侣热休克蛋白 90 (HSP90) 可缓冲多种生物体中的遗传变异，但 HSP90 缓冲在人类疾病中的临床意义仍不清楚。在这里，我们证明 HSP90 缓冲 BRCA1 的 BRCT 结构域中的突变。 HSP90 缓冲的 BRCA1 突变会导致蛋白质变体，这些变体保留了与伴侣蛋白的相互作用，并强烈依赖 HSP90 来实现蛋白质稳定性和细胞存活功能。此外，HSP90 缓冲的 BRCA1 变体赋予癌细胞对聚（ADP-核糖）聚合酶（PARP）抑制剂的耐药性。低水平的 HSP90 抑制克服了这种耐药性，揭示了一种神秘的、突变体特异性的 HSP90 合成致死性。此外，通过稳定整个 BRCT 结构域的亚稳态变异，HSP90 降低了 BRCA1 突变的临床严重程度，使它们能够在群体中积累。我们估计 HSP90 可以缓冲 18% 的已知人类 BRCA1-BRCT 错义突变。我们的工作将 HSP90 缓冲的临床意义扩展到 BRCA1 中常见的一类变异，开创了其在治疗耐药性和癌症易感性方面的重要性。

articles.title: Metabolic silencing induced by the small bacterial membrane protein YohP.
articles.titleZh: 小细菌膜蛋白 YohP 诱导的代谢沉默。
articles.authors: Natriashvili A, Mohammadsadeghi N, Milanov M, Smudde E, Prucker I, Jessen HJ, Carabadjac I, Heerklotz H, Franco PHC, Langer JD, Koch HG.
articles.abstract: Small membrane proteins represent an abundant and ubiquitous class of proteins that are often up-regulated when cells encounter unfavorable conditions, yet their function remains poorly understood. In bacteria, these proteins consist of typically less than 50 amino acids, without detectable catalytic activity. Thus, the benefit of producing these proteins during stress conditions is unknown. In the current study we used a multidisciplinary approach to determine the function of the 27-amino-acid-long protein YohP in Escherichia coli. Proteomics and lipidomics revealed that YohP production triggers the up-regulation of membrane protective proteins, increases the cardiolipin content, and leads to reduced membrane fluidity and a reduced membrane potential. Simultaneously, the stringent response is induced and many key metabolic enzymes are down-regulated. Overall, this multidisciplinary approach indicates that YohP-induced proteome and membrane changes initiate a state of metabolic silencing that protects E. coli against stress conditions and helps to conserve cellular resources.
articles.abstractZh: 小膜蛋白代表了一类丰富且普遍存在的蛋白质，当细胞遇到不利条件时，这些蛋白质通常会上调，但它们的功能仍然知之甚少。在细菌中，这些蛋白质通常由少于 50 个氨基酸组成，没有可检测到的催化活性。因此，在应激条件下产生这些蛋白质的好处尚不清楚。在当前的研究中，我们采用多学科方法来确定 27 个氨基酸长的蛋白质 YohP 在大肠杆菌中的功能。蛋白质组学和脂质组学表明，YohP 的产生会引发膜保护蛋白的上调，增加心磷脂含量，并导致膜流动性降低和膜电位降低。同时，诱导了严格的反应，并且许多关键的代谢酶被下调。总体而言，这种多学科方法表明 YohP 诱导的蛋白质组和膜变化启动代谢沉默状态，保护大肠杆菌免受应激条件的影响并有助于保存细胞资源。

articles.title: Structural basis of regulated N-glycosylation at the secretory translocon.
articles.titleZh: 分泌易位子受调节 N-糖基化的结构基础。
articles.authors: Yamsek M, Ma M, Jha R, Wan Y, Li Q, Zhong F, DeLong K, Ji Z, Rohatgi R, Keenan RJ.
articles.abstract: Most human secretory pathway proteins are N-glycosylated by oligosaccharyltransferase (OST) complexes as they enter the endoplasmic reticulum (ER)1-3. Recent work revealed a substrate-assisted mechanism by which N-glycosylation of the chaperone glucose-regulated protein 94 (GRP94) is regulated to control cell surface receptor signalling4. Here we report the structure of a natively isolated GRP94 folding intermediate tethered to a specialized CCDC134-bound translocon. Together with functional analysis, the data reveal how a conserved N-terminal extension in GRP94 inhibits OST-A and how structural rearrangements within the translocon shield the tethered nascent chain from inappropriate OST-B glycosylation. These interactions depend on a hydrophobic CCDC134 groove, which recognizes a non-native conformation of nascent GRP94. Our results define a mechanism of regulated N-glycosylation and illustrate how the nascent chain remodels the translocon to facilitate its own biogenesis.
articles.abstractZh: 大多数人类分泌途径蛋白在进入内质网 (ER)1-3 时会被寡糖转移酶 (OST) 复合物 N-糖基化。最近的工作揭示了一种底物辅助机制，通过调节分子伴侣葡萄糖调节蛋白 94 (GRP94) 的 N-糖基化来控制细胞表面受体信号传导 4。在这里，我们报告了天然分离的 GRP94 折叠中间体的结构，该中间体与专门的 CCDC134 结合易位子相连。结合功能分析，数据揭示了 GRP94 中保守的 N 端延伸如何抑制 OST-A，以及易位子内的结构重排如何保护束缚的新生链免受不适当的 OST-B 糖基化。这些相互作用依赖于疏水性 CCDC134 凹槽，该凹槽可识别新生 GRP94 的非天然构象。我们的结果定义了一种受调节的 N-糖基化机制，并说明了新生链如何重塑易位子以促进其自身的生物发生。

articles.title: ZAK activation at the collided ribosome.
articles.titleZh: 碰撞核糖体处的 ZAK 激活。
articles.authors: Huso VL, Niu S, Catipovic MA, Saba JA, Denk T, Park E, Cheng J, Berninghausen O, Becker T, Green R, Beckmann R.
articles.abstract: Ribosome collisions activate the ribotoxic stress response mediated by the MAP3K ZAK, which in turn regulates cell-fate consequences through downstream phosphorylation of the MAPKs p38 and JNK1. Despite the critical role of ZAK during cellular stress, a mechanistic and structural understanding of ZAK-ribosome interactions and how these lead to activation remain elusive. Here we combine biochemistry and cryo-electron microscopy to discover distinct ZAK-ribosome interactions required for constitutive recruitment and for activation. We find that upon induction of ribosome collisions, interactions between ZAK and the ribosomal protein RACK1 enable its activation by dimerization of its SAM domains at the collision interface. Furthermore, we discover how this process is negatively regulated by the ribosome-binding protein SERBP1 to prevent constitutive ZAK activation. Characterization of novel SAM variants as well as a known pathogenic variant of the SAM domain of ZAK supports a key role of the SAM domain in regulating kinase activity on and off the ribosome, with some mutants bypassing the ribosome requirement for ZAK activation. Collectively, our data provide a mechanistic blueprint of the kinase activity of ZAK at the collided ribosome interface.
articles.abstractZh: 核糖体碰撞激活由 MAP3K ZAK 介导的核糖应激反应，进而通过 MAPK p38 和 JNK1 的下游磷酸化调节细胞命运。尽管 ZAK 在细胞应激过程中发挥着关键作用，但对 ZAK-核糖体相互作用的机制和结构理解以及它们如何导致激活仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们结合生物化学和冷冻电子显微镜来发现组成型招募和激活所需的不同 ZAK-核糖体相互作用。我们发现，在诱导核糖体碰撞时，ZAK 和核糖体蛋白 RACK1 之间的相互作用通过碰撞界面上 SAM 结构域的二聚化使其激活。此外，我们还发现了核糖体结合蛋白 SERBP1 如何负向调节这一过程，以防止组成型 ZAK 激活。新型 SAM 变体以及 ZAK SAM 结构域的已知致病性变体的表征支持 SAM 结构域在调节核糖体内外激酶活性中的关键作用，其中一些突变体绕过了 ZAK 激活的核糖体要求。总的来说，我们的数据提供了一个机械蓝图

articles.title: Structure of the transcriptional co-activator SAGA complex, including the histone acetyltransferase module.
articles.titleZh: 转录共激活因子 SAGA 复合物的结构，包括组蛋白乙酰转移酶模块。
articles.authors: Mattoo RUH, Chen DH, Bushnell DA, Tamir S, Kornberg RD.
articles.abstract: The Spt-Ada-Gcn5 acetyltransferase (SAGA) complex, a 1.8 MDa multi-subunit assembly comprising 19 subunits, is required for RNA polymerase II transcription in eukaryotes. The complex consists of four modules: transcription-associated protein 1 (Tra1), core, deubiquitination (DUB), and histone acetyltransferase (HAT). Although the structures of the Tra1, core, and DUB modules have been determined, the overall architecture of the HAT module remained elusive due to its inherent flexibility. To address this, we conducted cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) analyses on SAGA purified from the thermophilic fungus Chaetomium thermophilum, yielding structures of Tra1 and core modules at 2.6 Å and three of the four HAT subunits at 3.7 Å. The structure of the HAT module was informative about the aspects of histone acetylation and the interface of HAT-core modules, contradicting earlier AlphaFold predictions. Our structure-guided genetic and biochemical analyses confirmed the roles of Ada1 and Spt7 in anchoring the HAT module within the SAGA complex.
articles.abstractZh: Spt-Ada-Gcn5 乙酰转移酶 (SAGA) 复合体是一种包含 19 个亚基的 1.8 MDa 多亚基组装体，是真核生物中 RNA 聚合酶 II 转录所必需的。该复合物由四个模块组成：转录相关蛋白 1 (Tra1)、核心、去泛素化 (DUB) 和组蛋白乙酰转移酶 (HAT)。尽管Tra1、核心和DUB模块的结构已经确定，但由于其固有的灵活性，HAT模块的整体架构仍然难以捉摸。为了解决这个问题，我们对从嗜热真菌 Chaetomium thermophilum 纯化的 SAGA 进行了冷冻电子显微镜 (cryo-EM) 分析，得到了 Tra1 的结构和 2.6 Å 的核心模块以及 3.7 Å 的四个 HAT 亚基中的三个。 HAT 模块的结构提供了有关组蛋白乙酰化和 HAT 核心模块接口方面的信息，这与早期的 AlphaFold 预测相矛盾。我们的结构引导遗传和生化分析证实了 Ada1 和 Spt7 在将 HAT 模块锚定在 SAGA 复合体中的作用。

articles.title: Advances in fungal vaccine development: Progress in the face of emerging challenges.
articles.titleZh: 真菌疫苗开发的进展：面对新挑战的进展。
articles.authors: Moses M, Huang X, Xue X, Chen C.
articles.abstract: Historically overshadowed by bacterial and viral infections, fungal diseases are resurging globally, fueled by rising antifungal resistance and the increasing vulnerability of immunocompromised populations in healthcare settings. The widespread misuse and overuse of antifungals have accelerated the emergence of resistant fungal pathogens, complicating clinical management. Despite significant progress in vaccine development, with candidates such as NDV-3A and PEV7 advancing to late-stage trials, none have received FDA approval. Consequently, novel, more effective, and tolerable antifungal therapies are urgently needed. This review consolidates data on the progress made in fungal vaccine development, emphasizing key obstacles to clinical realization. It further proposes innovative strategies, such as bioinformatics-driven antigen discovery, nanotechnology-based delivery systems, reverse vaccinology, and the exploration of probiotic-vaccine synergies, which hold exceptional promise in overcoming these challenges and advancing the fight against fungal infections.
articles.abstractZh: 历史上，真菌疾病一直被细菌和病毒感染所掩盖，但由于抗真菌耐药性不断上升以及医疗机构中免疫功能低下人群的脆弱性日益增加，真菌疾病正在全球范围内卷土重来。抗真菌药物的广泛滥用和过度使用加速了耐药真菌病原体的出现，使临床管理变得复杂化。尽管疫苗开发取得了重大进展，NDV-3A 和 PEV7 等候选疫苗已进入后期试验，但尚未获得 FDA 批准。因此，迫切需要新颖、更有效、更耐受的抗真菌疗法。该综述整合了真菌疫苗开发进展的数据，强调了临床实现的主要障碍。它还提出了创新策略，例如生物信息学驱动的抗原发现、基于纳米技术的递送系统、反向疫苗学以及益生菌-疫苗协同作用的探索，这些策略在克服这些挑战和推进抗击真菌感染方面具有特殊的前景。

articles.title: Microbial regulators of physiological and reproductive health in women of reproductive age: their local, proximal and distal regulatory roles.
articles.titleZh: 育龄妇女生理和生殖健康的微生物调节剂：其局部、近端和远端调节作用。
articles.authors: Cheng Q, Lv S, Yin N, Wang J.
articles.abstract: The female microbiome is emerging as a key regulator of gynecological and reproductive health. This review summarizes how local and gut microbes affect gynecological outcomes, fertility, and pregnancy through metabolic, immune, and hormonal pathways. We highlight underlying mechanisms and intervention strategies, emphasizing the restoration of microbial homeostasis as a promising avenue for advancing understanding, prevention, and management of women's physiological and reproductive health conditions.
articles.abstractZh: 女性微生物组正在成为妇科和生殖健康的关键调节因子。这篇综述总结了局部和肠道微生物如何通过代谢、免疫和激素途径影响妇科结果、生育力和妊娠。我们强调潜在的机制和干预策略，强调恢复微生物稳态是增进对妇女生理和生殖健康状况的理解、预防和管理的有前途的途径。

articles.title: Nanomaterial-mediated delivery of tomato miR393 intrinsically targeting a cell wall-related gene of Botrytis cinerea confers efficient control of gray mold disease.
articles.titleZh: 纳米材料介导的番茄 miR393 本质上靶向灰葡萄孢细胞壁相关基因，可有效控制灰霉病。
articles.authors: Yin Y, Wang R, Hou J, Fu Y, Chen Y, Wang L, Sikandar A, Li Y, Liu T.
articles.abstract: Gray mold, caused by the fungal pathogen Botrytis cinerea, is a major threat to global agriculture. Conventional pesticide control exacerbates environmental pollution and increases the risk of resistance. Although RNA interference (RNAi) holds potential for disease management, its application is limited by RNA instability and ambiguous targeting. Here, we demonstrate that tomato microRNA393 (miR393) can move across kingdoms into B. cinerea and reduce its pathogenicity. Using RT-qPCR, GUS staining, and 5' RLM-RACE, we confirmed that miR393 specifically targets nucleotides 1777-1778 of the BcFKS1 gene in B. cinerea, thereby suppressing its expression and disrupting fungal cell wall integrity. To protect miR393 from degradation, we developed a star polycation (SPc)-based nanocarrier delivery system. This nanomaterial can extend the degradation half-life of miR393 six-fold under RNase A and RNase III treatment (up to 2 h) and increase delivery efficiency by 35%-65%. SPc-loaded miR393 enhances tomato immunity by activating the jasmonic acid and salicylic acid pathways, suppressing auxin receptor genes, and inducing PR1 protein accumulation (6.8-fold). Inoculation assays further showed that SPc-loaded double-stranded miR393 can reduce gray mold lesion areas by 67% in tomato, 88% in strawberry, and 41% in grape. This study elucidates the dual mechanism by which miR393 controls gray mold-cross-kingdom regulation of pathogenic fungi and modulation of plant immunity-and provides a promising strategy for sustainable disease prevention and control.
articles.abstractZh: 灰霉病由真菌病原体灰葡萄孢引起，是全球农业的主要威胁。传统的农药防治加剧了环境污染并增加了抗药性风险。尽管 RNA 干扰 (RNAi) 在疾病管理方面具有潜力，但其应用受到 RNA 不稳定和目标不明确的限制。在这里，我们证明番茄 microRNA393 (miR393) 可以跨界进入灰霉病菌并降低其致病性。使用 RT-qPCR、GUS 染色和 5' RLM-RACE，我们证实 miR393 特异性靶向 B. cinerea 中 BcFKS1 基因的核苷酸 1777-1778，从而抑制其表达并破坏真菌细胞壁完整性。为了保护 miR393 免遭降解，我们开发了一种基于星型聚阳离子 (SPc) 的纳米载体递送系统。这种纳米材料可以将 miR393 在 RNase A 和 RNase III 处理下的降解半衰期延长六倍（长达 2 小时），并将递送效率提高 35%-65%。负载 SPc 的 miR393 通过激活茉莉酸和水杨酸途径、抑制生长素受体基因和诱导 PR1 蛋白积累（6.8 倍）来增强番茄免疫力。接种试验进一步表明

articles.title: Recurrent evolution of selfishness from an essential tRNA synthetase in Caenorhabditis tropicalis.
articles.titleZh: 热带秀丽隐杆线虫中必需的 tRNA 合成酶的自私循环进化。
articles.authors: Tikanova P, Ross JJ, Hagmüller A, Pühringer F, Pliota P, Krogull D, Stefania V, Hunold M, Koreshova A, Koller A, Ostapchuk I, Okweri J, Gokcezade J, Duchek P, Dong G, Ben-David E, Burga A.
articles.abstract: No genome on Earth is free of selfish genes. This reflects both their ability to subvert the laws of inheritance and their de novo emergence from host genes. Yet, despite their ubiquity and key role in driving innovation, the mechanisms responsible for their genesis remain largely unexplored. Here we report the discovery of three toxin-antidote elements in the nematode Caenorhabditis tropicalis.
