Early administration increased microbiome diversity and Lactobacillus abundance. These findings suggest that rationally designed microbial consortia targeting neurometabolite production can modulate brain physiology and confer neuroprotection, supporting their potential for microbiome-based interventions in neurodegenerative disease.
articles.abstractZh: 肠脑轴使中枢神经系统和肠道之间能够进行沟通，某些微生物代谢物会影响神经退行性变。利用基因组规模的代谢模型，我们设计并测试了一个合成微生物群落，该群落具有在帕金森病 (PD) 神经变性果蝇模型中产生 GABA 和其他神经代谢物的预测能力。该联盟（短短乳杆菌、副干酪乳杆菌、多形拟杆菌）在生物反应器中生产 GABA。接受联合体的雌性 PD 果蝇在联合体给药后 10 和 25 天时表现出免受运动障碍的保护。头部代谢组学揭示了帕金森病相关的能量平衡、氨基酸和神经递质代谢以及疾病相关生物标志物的部分恢复。早期给药增加了微生物组多样性和乳酸菌丰度。这些发现表明，合理设计的针对神经代谢产物产生的微生物群落可以调节大脑生理学并赋予神经保护作用，支持其基于微生物组干预神经退行性疾病的潜力。

articles.title: Herbal terpenoids activate autophagy and mitophagy through modulation of bioenergetics and protect from metabolic stress, sarcopenia and epigenetic aging.
articles.titleZh: 草药萜类化合物通过调节生物能量激活自噬和线粒体自噬，并防止代谢应激、肌肉减少症和表观遗传衰老。
articles.authors: Civiletto G, Brunetti D, Lizzo G, Muller K, Jacot GE, Daskalaki I, Sizzano F, Huh M, Di Meo I, Colombo MN, Sanchez-Garcia JL, Bétrisey BJ, Zollinger A, Lino P, Neal C, Egesipe AL, Richard J, Chimen M, Hermant A, Brinon B, Texari L, Metairon S, Qureshi MA, Patel DS, Vanapalli SA, Malavolta M, Gao AW, Lalou A, Provinciali M, Orlando F, Tiranti V, Brooke RT, Horvath S, Auwerx J, Feige JN, Gut P.
articles.abstract: Small molecular food components contribute to the health benefits of diets rich in fruits, vegetables, herbs and spices. The cellular mechanisms by which noncaloric bioactives promote healthspan are not well understood, limiting their use in disease prevention. Here, we deploy a whole-organism, high-content screen in zebrafish to profile food-derived compounds for activation of autophagy, a cellular quality control mechanism that promotes healthy aging. We identify thymol and carvacrol as activators of autophagy and mitophagy through a transient dampening of the mitochondrial membrane potential. Chemical stabilization of thymol-induced mitochondrial depolarization blocks mitophagy activation, suggesting a mechanism originating from the mitochondrial membrane. Supplementation with thymol prevents excess liver fat accumulation in a mouse model of diet-induced obesity, improves pink-1-dependent heat stress resilience in Caenorhabditis elegans, and slows the decline of skeletal muscle performance while delaying epigenetic aging in SAMP8 mice. Thus, terpenoids from common herbs promote autophagy during aging and metabolic overload, making them attractive molecules for nutrition-based healthspan promotion.
articles.abstractZh: 小分子食品成分有助于富含水果、蔬菜、香草和香料的饮食对健康的益处。无热量生物活性物质促进健康寿命的细胞机制尚不清楚，限制了它们在疾病预防中的应用。在这里，我们在斑马鱼中部署了全生物体高含量筛选，以分析用于激活自噬的食物衍生化合物，自噬是一种促进健康衰老的细胞质量控制机制。我们通过短暂抑制线粒体膜电位将百里香酚和香芹酚确定为自噬和线粒体自噬的激活剂。百里香酚诱导的线粒体去极化的化学稳定性阻止了线粒体自噬的激活，这表明一种源自线粒体膜的机制。补充百里香酚可防止饮食引起的肥胖小鼠模型中肝脏脂肪堆积过多，改善秀丽隐杆线虫中依赖于 Pink-1 的热应激恢复能力，并减缓骨骼肌性能的下降，同时延缓 SAMP8 小鼠的表观遗传衰老。因此，来自常见草药的萜类化合物在衰老和代谢超负荷期间促进自噬，使它们成为基于营养的健康的有吸引力的分子。

articles.title: Rational design of a hospital-specific phage cocktail to treat Enterobacter cloacae complex infections.
articles.titleZh: 合理设计医院专用噬菌体混合物来治疗阴沟肠杆菌复合感染。
articles.authors: Subedi D, Gordillo Altamirano F, Deehan R, Perera A, Patwa R, Kostoulias X, Korneev D, Blakeway L, Macesic N, Peleg AY, Barr JJ.
articles.abstract: The Alfred Hospital in Melbourne, Australia, has reported an ongoing outbreak of infections caused by multidrug-resistant Enterobacter cloacae complex (ECC). Phage therapy is a promising strategy to treat antimicrobial-resistant infections. Utilizing the hospital's isolate collection, built over the past decade, we established an initial 3-phage cocktail with 54% ECC coverage. We then iteratively improved this product by enhancing phage killing efficiency using phage adaptation and expanded host range through targeted phage isolation against low-coverage ECC isolates. This optimization yielded Entelli-02, containing five well-characterized virulent phages that target clinical ECC isolates via distinct bacterial cell surface receptors. Entelli-02 exhibits 88% host coverage against The Alfred Hospital's ECC isolate collection (n = 206), confirmed by plaque formation and reduced bacterial load in septicaemic mice by >99%. We produced this cocktail as a therapeutic-grade product, ready for clinical use. Entelli-02 represents a hospital-specific phage cocktail with frontline efficacy and on-demand availability.
articles.abstractZh: 澳大利亚墨尔本阿尔弗雷德医院报告了由多重耐药阴沟肠杆菌复合体（ECC）引起的感染持续爆发。噬菌体疗法是​​治疗耐药感染的一种有前途的策略。利用医院过去十年建立的分离菌库，我们建立了初始 3 噬菌体混合物，其 ECC 覆盖率达到 54%。然后，我们通过利用噬菌体适应来提高噬菌体杀伤效率，并通过针对低覆盖率 ECC 分离株的靶向噬菌体分离来扩大宿主范围，从而迭代改进了该产品。这种优化产生了 Entelli-02，它包含 5 个特征明确的剧毒噬菌体，它们通过不同的细菌细胞表面受体靶向临床 ECC 分离株。 Entelli-02 对阿尔弗雷德医院的 ECC 分离菌群 (n = 206) 表现出 88% 的宿主覆盖率，这一点通过斑块形成和败血症小鼠的细菌载量减少 > 99% 得到证实。我们生产这种鸡尾酒作为治疗级产品，可供临床使用。 Entelli-02 代表了一种医院专用的噬菌体鸡尾酒，具有一线功效和按需可用性。

articles.title: Steric repulsion counteracts ER-to-lipid droplet protein movement.
articles.titleZh: 位阻排斥抵消了内质网到脂滴的蛋白质运动。
articles.authors: Damm A, Omrane M, Stojanović O, Esch BM, Zouiouich M, Carpentier M, Klemm R, Fröhlich F, Forêt L, Thiam AR.
articles.abstract: Lipid droplets (LDs) are organelles with a neutral lipid core surrounded by a phospholipid monolayer, which is continuous with the cytoplasmic leaflet of the endoplasmic reticulum (ER). LD function depends on a highly dynamic LD surface proteome. Key proteins continuously exchange between the ER and LDs; however, the mechanisms governing the interorganelle movement and accumulation on the LD surface remain poorly understood. Here, we developed an ex cellulo tool introducing a classification of ER-derived proteins based on their different affinity for LDs. We find that proteins with higher LD affinity can effectively displace those with lower affinity from the LD surface, identifying steric hindrance as a key mechanism in regulating ER-to-LD protein transfer. Consistent with this model, we show that, during adipocyte differentiation Plin1-an adipocyte-specific high-affinity LD protein-reduces the recruitment of ER proteins with lower affinity by displacing them from the LD surface. These findings highlight lateral protein-protein exclusion as a fundamental mechanism in shaping the LD proteome.
articles.abstractZh: 脂滴（LD）是具有被磷脂单层包围的中性脂质核心的细胞器，其与内质网（ER）的细胞质小叶连续。 LD 功能取决于高度动态的 LD 表面蛋白质组。 ER 和 LD 之间的关键蛋白不断交换；然而，控制细胞器间运动和在 LD 表面积累的机制仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们开发了一种细胞外工具，根据 ER 衍生蛋白对 LD 的不同亲和力对它们进行分类。我们发现具有较高 LD 亲和力的蛋白质可以有效地从 LD 表面取代那些具有较低亲和力的蛋白质，从而确定空间位阻是调节 ER 到 LD 蛋白质转移的关键机制。与该模型一致，我们表明，在脂肪细胞分化过程中，Plin1（一种脂肪细胞特异性高亲和力 LD 蛋白）通过将低亲和力 ER 蛋白从 LD 表面置换，减少了它们的募集。这些发现强调了横向蛋白质-蛋白质排斥是形成 LD 蛋白质组的基本机制。

articles.title: Synthesis and antibacterial evaluation of trisindolines against methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus targeting cell membrane.
articles.titleZh: 三吲哚啉的合成及针对细胞膜的耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌的抗菌评价。
articles.authors: Rathore A, Zargar IA, Kumari J, Sarkar B, Manhas R, Firdous S, Pandian R, Mukherjee D, Mahapa A.
articles.abstract: Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) poses a significant global health threat that requires novel antimicrobials to combat this WHO-designated priority pathogen. In this study, we designed, synthesized and evaluated a series of unexplored trisindoline derivatives against MRSA, including multidrug-resistant (MDR) clinical isolates. The Structure Activity Relationship (SAR) analysis of the trisindolines indicated the importance of strategic substitutions in the trisindoline core for their anti-staphylococcal efficacy. Biocompatibility studies revealed a high safety profile for the active compounds across various mammalian cell lines. Furthermore, the derivatives displayed rapid bactericidal action, anti-biofilm efficacy, intracellular MRSA killing and combinatorial effect with vancomycin. Mechanistic studies revealed that these compounds disrupt MRSA cell integrity by influencing several membrane-related pathways. Finally, in vivo assessments of a lead trisindoline in an MRSA-induced systemic infection model demonstrated a significant reduction of bacterial load. Therefore, these trisindoline molecules may offer a promising therapeutic model for combating MRSA infections.
articles.abstractZh: 耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌 (MRSA) 对全球健康构成重大威胁，需要新型抗菌药物来对抗这种世界卫生组织指定的优先病原体。在这项研究中，我们设计、合成并评估了一系列未开发的抗 MRSA 的三吲哚啉衍生物，包括多重耐药 (MDR) 临床分离株。三吲哚啉的结构活性关系 (SAR) 分析表明，三吲哚啉核心中的战略取代对其抗葡萄球菌功效的重要性。生物相容性研究揭示了活性化合物在各种哺乳动物细胞系中的高安全性。此外，这些衍生物还表现出快速杀菌作用、抗生物膜功效、细胞内MRSA杀灭作用以及与万古霉素的联合作用。机理研究表明，这些化合物通过影响多种膜相关途径来破坏 MRSA 细胞的完整性。最后，在 MRSA 诱导的全身感染模型中对先导三吲哚啉进行的体内评估表明，细菌负荷显着减少。因此，这些三吲哚啉分子可能为对抗 MRSA 感染提供有前景的治疗模型

articles.title: A flavin-dependent monooxygenase favors the formation of (6S)-α-bitter acids in hop glandular trichomes.
articles.titleZh: 黄素依赖性单加氧酶有利于啤酒花腺毛中 (6S)-α-苦酸的形成。
articles.authors: Feng C, Liu B, Zhao P, Ma L, Li J, Wang G.

articles.title: Defining the roles of the Integrator, NEXT, and nuclear exosome complexes in Drosophila oogenesis.
articles.titleZh: 定义 Integrator、NEXT 和核外泌体复合物在果蝇卵子发生中的作用。
articles.authors: Lee Y, Biasini A, Tipping C, Hong SH, Zamore PD.
articles.abstract: Nuclear RNA homeostasis depends on the balance of transcription, RNA processing, degradation, and transport between the nucleus and cytoplasm. RNA degradation directed by the Integrator, nuclear exosome targeting (NEXT), and nuclear exosome complexes controls the accumulation of aberrant nuclear RNA. Here, we report that Drosophila oogenesis requires the Integrator, NEXT, and nuclear exosome complexes. Depletion of Integrator, NEXT, or nuclear exosome components in Drosophila female germ cells causes infertility and accumulation of 3' extended small nuclear RNAs, promoter upstream transcripts, and cryptic transcripts. Our data highlight the essential role of nuclear RNA degradation and processing in Drosophila oogenesis and provide a catalog of RNAs whose nuclear levels are regulated by these three complexes. We propose that Integrator, NEXT, and the nuclear exosome support oogenesis by ensuring that inappropriate transcription does not overwhelm the limited supply of proteins that bind, process, and traffic RNA.
articles.abstractZh: 核 RNA 稳态取决于转录、RNA 加工、降解以及细胞核和细胞质之间运输的平衡。 Integrator、核外泌体靶向 (NEXT) 和核外泌体复合物指导的 RNA 降解控制异常核 RNA 的积累。在这里，我们报告果蝇卵子发生需要 Integrator、NEXT 和核外泌体复合物。果蝇雌性生殖细胞中整合子、NEXT 或核外泌体成分的耗尽会导致不育和 3' 延伸小核 RNA、启动子上游转录本和隐秘转录本的积累。我们的数据强调了核 RNA 降解和加工在果蝇卵子发生中的重要作用，并提供了核水平受这三种复合物调节的 RNA 目录。我们建议 Integrator、NEXT 和核外泌体通过确保不适当的转录不会压倒结合、加工和运输 RNA 的蛋白质的有限供应来支持卵子发生。

articles.title: Detection of dedifferentiated stem cells in the <i>Drosophila</i> testis.
articles.titleZh: 检测果蝇睾丸中的去分化干细胞。
articles.authors: Bener MB, DiPippo SM, Slepchenko BM, Inaba M.
articles.abstract: Dedifferentiation is the process by which partially or terminally differentiated cells revert to a stem cell state, a conserved mechanism that supports stem cell maintenance across various systems. In the Drosophila testis, dedifferentiated germline stem cells (GSCs) have been identified using a lineage-tracing method that relies on the lineage-specific promoter of the differentiation factor bam. However, the specificity and sensitivity of this method have never been thoroughly evaluated. Here, we estimate "false-positive" and "false-negative" marking rates of the bam-dependent lineage tracing system by combining live imaging with mathematical modeling. Our study not only provides a refined tool to facilitate the investigation of dedifferentiation in the Drosophila GSC system but also underscores the importance of quantitatively validating genetic marking systems to ensure the accuracy of lineage-tracing experiments.
articles.abstractZh: 去分化是部分或终末分化的细胞恢复到干细胞状态的过程，这是一种支持干细胞在不同系统中维持的保守机制。在果蝇睾丸中，使用依赖于分化因子 bam 的谱系特异性启动子的谱系追踪方法鉴定了去分化的生殖干细胞 (GSC)。然而，该方法的特异性和敏感性从未得到彻底评估。在这里，我们通过将实时成像与数学建模相结合来估计依赖于 bam 的谱系追踪系统的“假阳性”和“假阴性”标记率。我们的研究不仅提供了一个完善的工具来促进果蝇 GSC 系统去分化的研究，而且强调了定量验证遗传标记系统以确保谱系追踪实验准确性的重要性。

articles.title: Nuclear factor-Y transcription factors in crops: Biological roles, regulation, and breeding applications.
articles.titleZh: 作物中的核因子-Y 转录因子：生物学作用、调控和育种应用。
articles.authors: Wu H, Hou X, Zhang C.
articles.abstract: Given global challenges such as climate change and food insecurity, crop species must adopt sophisticated strategies to enhance phenotypic plasticity and stress resilience, thereby ensuring yield stability and environmental adaptability in agricultural systems. Nuclear factor-Y (NF-Y) transcription factors, which exist in multiple paralogs and function as a trimeric complex, enable numerous possible combinations that likely perform key regulatory functions in these processes. Over the past decade, research on NF-Y has notably expanded from the model plant Arabidopsis to various crop species, leading to major advances in genetic and molecular understanding. However, no comprehensive review has focused on crop NF-Y. Here, we present a systematic overview of current knowledge on NF-Y in crops across multiple regulatory layers, emphasizing the mechanisms underlying the assembly and disassembly of the NF-Y complex and its mechanistic roles in the epigenetic regulation of target genes. These mechanistic insights, together with the diverse biological functions of NF-Y, establish a theoretical foundation for exploiting NF-Y in molecular crop breeding. We also discuss practical strategies and potential obstacles in applying NF-Y research to field conditions. Collectively, this review offers valuable insights into the function and regulation of crop NF-Y, providing guidance for future research and the development of innovative strategies in molecular design breeding processes.
articles.abstractZh: 考虑到气候变化和粮食不安全等全球挑战，作物品种必须采取复杂的策略来增强表型可塑性和抗逆能力，从而确保农业系统的产量稳定性和环境适应性。核因子-Y (NF-Y) 转录因子存在于多个旁系同源物中并作为三聚体复合物发挥作用，可实现多种可能的组合，这些组合可能在这些过程中发挥关键的调节功能。在过去的十年中，NF-Y 的研究已从模式植物拟南芥扩展到各种作物物种，从而在遗传和分子理解方面取得了重大进展。然而，还没有针对作物 NF-Y 进行全面的审查。在这里，我们系统地概述了作物中 NF-Y 跨多个调控层的最新知识，强调了 NF-Y 复合物组装和分解的机制及其在靶基因表观遗传调控中的机制作用。这些机制见解以及 NF-Y 的多种生物学功能，为在分子作物育种中利用 NF-Y 奠定了理论基础。我们还讨论了实际策略

articles.title: The marine diatom Phaeodactylum tricornutum as a versatile bioproduction chassis: Current progress, challenges, and perspectives.
articles.titleZh: 海洋硅藻三角褐指藻作为多功能生物生产基础：当前进展、挑战和前景。
articles.authors: Wang S, Hu Z.
articles.abstract: Beyond its importance in diatom studies, the marine model diatom Phaeodactylum tricornutum has emerged as a versatile photosynthetic chassis for sustainable bioproduction, enabling the production of both native bioactive metabolites and engineered heterologous compounds through synthetic biology. Over the past three decades, transformative advances in the development of genetic tools, including transgenic element optimization, CRISPR-Cas genome editing, and high-efficiency transformation systems, have enabled the engineering of strains for increased fucoxanthin, fatty acid, and triacylglycerol yields and the successful synthesis of diverse heterologous products, from terpenoids and therapeutic peptides to sustainable materials. At the same time, advances in molecular toolkits have refined chassis optimization by revealing the fundamental biological mechanisms underlying nutrient uptake, environmental stress adaptation, stimulus perception, and cell development. Despite this progress, critical challenges persist, particularly suboptimal product yields, biomass limitations, and prohibitive production costs, which hinder industrial translation. In this review, we examine emerging strategies, such as chloroplastic gene expression, DNA site-specific integration, and trophic alteration, that show promise for species improvement; we also address other scale-up considerations, including cultivation strategies, techno-economic analysis, and regulatory policies. Integrated efforts could accelerate the transition of P. tricornutum from a model diatom to a scalable, eco-friendly biomanufacturing platform.
articles.abstractZh: 除了在硅藻研究中的重要性之外，海洋模型硅藻三角褐指藻已成为可持续生物生产的多功能光合底盘，能够通过合成生物学生产天然生物活性代谢物和工程异源化合物。在过去的三十年中，遗传工具开发的革命性进展，包括转基因元件优化、CRISPR-Cas基因组编辑和高效转化系统，使得菌株工程能够增加岩藻黄质、脂肪酸和三酰甘油的产量，并成功合成从萜类化合物和治疗性肽到可持续材料的各种异源产品。与此同时，分子工具包的进步通过揭示营养吸收、环境压力适应、刺激感知和细胞发育的基本生物学机制，完善了底盘优化。尽管取得了这些进展，但关键挑战仍然存在，特别是产品产量不理想、生物量限制和生产成本过高，这些都阻碍了工业转化。在这篇评论中，我们研究了新兴的stra

articles.title: Membrane receptors cluster phosphatidylserine to activate LC3-associated phagocytosis.
articles.titleZh: 膜受体聚集磷脂酰丝氨酸以激活 LC3 相关的吞噬作用。
articles.authors: Boada-Romero E, Guy CS, Palacios G, Mari L, Poudel S, Li Z, Sharma P, Green DR.
articles.abstract: LC3-associated phagocytosis (LAP) represents a non-canonical function of autophagy proteins in which ATG8-family proteins (LC3 and GABARAP proteins) are lipidated onto single-membrane phagosomes as particles are engulfed by phagocytic cells. LAP plays roles in innate immunity, inflammation and anticancer responses, and is initiated following phagocytosis of particles that stimulate Toll-like receptors (TLR) and Fc receptors as well as following engulfment of dying cells. However, how this molecular process is initiated remains elusive. Here we report that receptors that engage LAP enrich phosphatidylserine (PS) in the phagosome membrane via membrane-proximal domains that are necessary and sufficient for LAP to proceed. Subsequently, PS recruits the Rubicon-containing PI3-kinase complex to initiate the enzymatic cascade leading to LAP. Manipulation of plasma membrane PS content, PS binding by Rubicon or the PS-clustering domains of receptors prevents LAP and delays phagosome maturation. Therefore, the initiation of LAP represents a novel mechanism of PS-mediated signal transduction following ligation of surface receptors.
articles.abstractZh: LC3 相关吞噬作用 (LAP) 代表自噬蛋白的非典型功能，其中 ATG8 家族蛋白（LC3 和 GABARAP 蛋白）随着颗粒被吞噬细胞吞噬而被脂质化到单膜吞噬体上。 LAP 在先天免疫、炎症和抗癌反应中发挥作用，并在吞噬刺激 Toll 样受体 (TLR) 和 Fc 受体的颗粒以及吞噬垂死细胞后启动。然而，这个分子过程是如何启动的仍然难以捉摸。在此，我们报道了与 LAP 结合的受体通过近膜结构域富集吞噬体膜中的磷脂酰丝氨酸 (PS)，这对于 LAP 的进行是必要且充分的。随后，PS 招募包含 Rubicon 的 PI3 激酶复合物来启动导致 LAP 的酶级联反应。操纵质膜 PS 含量、Rubicon 的 PS 结合或受体的 PS 聚集域可防止 LAP 并延迟吞噬体成熟。因此，LAP 的启动代表了表面受体连接后 PS 介导的信号转导的新机制。

articles.title: Mitochondrial uncoupling, energy substrate utilization, and brown adipose tissue as therapeutic targets in cancer.
articles.titleZh: 线粒体解偶联、能量底物利用和棕色脂肪组织作为癌症的治疗靶点。
articles.authors: Ragni M, Ruocco C, Nisoli E.
articles.abstract: Mitochondria play a central role in regulating cellular energy metabolism, redox homeostasis, and biosynthesis. Mitochondrial uncoupling, through the alteration in the permeability of the inner mitochondrial membrane (IMM) to the leak of protons without adenosine triphosphate (ATP) synthesis, regulates thermogenesis, glucose and lipid metabolism, and reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation. In brown adipose tissue (BAT), proton leak via uncoupling protein 1 (UCP1) is essential for thermogenesis and has been shown to improve systemic glucose homeostasis, and recent studies indicate that BAT activation can also suppress tumor growth by competing with cancer cells for glucose. Several small-molecule mitochondrial uncouplers have demonstrated anticancer effects in preclinical models, although endogenous UCPs-particularly UCP2-are often upregulated in tumors, where they may support tumor growth by buffering ROS and increasing metabolic flexibility. These seemingly contradictory observations highlight the context-dependent effects of mitochondrial uncoupling in cancer. Here, we review current understanding of mitochondrial uncoupling mechanisms, the roles of UCP isoforms, and the metabolic interplay between BAT, cancer cells, and the tumor microenvironment, with a focus on therapeutic implications.
articles.abstractZh: 线粒体在调节细胞能量代谢、氧化还原稳态和生物合成中发挥着核心作用。线粒体解偶联通过改变线粒体内膜 (IMM) 对质子泄漏的通透性而无需合成三磷酸腺苷 (ATP)，从而调节产热、葡萄糖和脂质代谢以及活性氧 (ROS) 的产生。在棕色脂肪组织 (BAT) 中，通过解偶联蛋白 1 (UCP1) 产生的质子泄漏对于产热至关重要，并且已被证明可以改善全身葡萄糖稳态，最近的研究表明，BAT 激活还可以通过与癌细胞竞争葡萄糖来抑制肿瘤生长。几种小分子线粒体解偶联剂已在临床前模型中表现出抗癌作用，尽管内源性 UCP（尤其是 UCP2）在肿瘤中经常上调，它们可能通过缓冲 ROS 和增加代谢灵活性来支持肿瘤生长。这些看似矛盾的观察结果强调了癌症中线粒体解偶联的背景依赖性影响。在这里，我们回顾了目前对线粒体解偶联机制、UCP 亚型的作用以及代谢的理解。

articles.title: Staying productive under pressure: systems evaluations of β-carotene production in Yarrowia lipolytica under continuous fermentation.
articles.titleZh: 在压力下保持生产力：连续发酵下解脂耶氏酵母生产 β-胡萝卜素的系统评估。
articles.authors: Worland AM, Xu VA, Duran MF, Gitman P, Hunter-Cevera K, Klemm C, Sun Y, Sanchis DR, Ledesma-Amaro R, Pomraning KR, Tanjore D, Blenner M, Tang YJ.
articles.abstract: Scaling biomanufacturing from laboratory to industrial scale poses significant challenges, especially for continuous fermentation. This study investigates these challenges using a β-carotene-producing Yarrowia lipolytica strain. Through fermentation experiments and proteomics, we have assessed how fermentation modes, carbon sources, dissolved O2, and media composition influence long-term bioproduction. In shaking flask subcultures, the strain maintained β-carotene production for over ~30 generations. However, in continuous fermentations, subpopulation shifted toward faster-growing low-producers, leading to significant production losses within just ~18 growth generations. This process was accelerated by O2 limitation and high bioreactor dilution rates. Using canola oil as a carbon source increases population heterogeneity but enhances β-carotene biosynthesis and prolongs production compared with glucose-based media. Kinetic modeling suggests that strains optimized for the highest production in laboratory settings may be less robust in industrial environments, where suboptimal yet faster-growing variants gain a competitive edge under prolonged stress and ultimately shape overall continuous fermentation performance.
articles.abstractZh: 将生物制造从实验室规模扩大到工业规模提出了重大挑战，特别是对于连续发酵而言。本研究使用产生 β-胡萝卜素的解脂耶氏酵母菌株来研究这些挑战。通过发酵实验和蛋白质组学，我们评估了发酵模式、碳源、溶解氧和培养基成分如何影响长期生物生产。在摇瓶传代培养中，该菌株保持 β-胡萝卜素生产约 30 代以上。然而，在连续发酵中，亚群转向生长速度更快的低生产者，导致在短短 18 个生长代内出现重大产量损失。 O2 限制和高生物反应器稀释率加速了这一过程。与基于葡萄糖的培养基相比，使用菜籽油作为碳源增加了群体异质性，但增强了β-胡萝卜素生物合成并延长了产量。动力学模型表明，在实验室环境中为最高产量而优化的菌株在工业环境中可能不太稳健，在工业环境中，次优但生长较快的变体在长期压力下获得竞争优势，并最终形成整体控制

articles.title: Rapid remodeling of NTP levels enables immediate translational adaptation to energy stress in yeast.
articles.titleZh: NTP 水平的快速重塑使得酵母能够立即转化适应能量应激。
articles.authors: Bexley K, Ristová M, Sharma S, Spanos C, Chabes A, Tollervey D.
articles.abstract: In Saccharomyces cerevisiae, glucose depletion induces metabolic reprogramming through widespread transcriptional and translational reorganization. We report that initial, very rapid translational silencing is driven by a specialized metabolic mechanism. Following glucose withdrawal, intracellular NTP levels drop drastically over 30 s before stabilizing at a regulated, post-stress set point. Programmed translational control results from the differential NTP affinities of key enzymes; ATP falls below the (high) binding constants for DEAD-box helicase initiation factors, including eIF4A, driving mRNA release and blocking 80S assembly. Contrastingly, guanosine triphosphate (GTP) levels always greatly exceed the (low) binding constants for elongation factors, allowing ribosome run-off and orderly translation shutdown. Translation initiation is immediately lost on all pre-existing mRNAs before being preferentially re-established on newly synthesized, upregulated stress-response transcripts. We conclude that enzymatic constants are tuned for metabolic remodeling. This response counters energy depletion rather than being glucose specific, allowing hierarchical inhibition of energy-consuming processes on very rapid timescales.
articles.abstractZh: 在酿酒酵母中，葡萄糖消耗通过广泛的转录和翻译重组诱导代谢重编程。我们报告说，最初的、非常快速的翻译沉默是由特殊的代谢机制驱动的。葡萄糖戒断后，细胞内 NTP 水平在 30 秒内急剧下降，然后稳定在受调节的应激后设定点。程序化翻译控制源自关键酶的不同 NTP 亲和力； ATP 低于 DEAD-box 解旋酶起始因子（包括 eIF4A）的（高）结合常数，驱动 mRNA 释放并阻断 80S 组装。相比之下，三磷酸鸟苷 (GTP) 水平始终大大超过延伸因子的（低）结合常数，从而允许核糖体流失和有序翻译关闭。所有预先存在的 mRNA 上的翻译起始立即丢失，然后优先在新合成的、上调的应激反应转录本上重新建立。我们得出的结论是，酶常数是针对代谢重塑进行调整的。这种反应可以对抗能量消耗，而不是针对葡萄糖，从而可以分层抑制能量消耗

articles.title: Microbial tools and regulatory innovations for climate-resilient winemaking.
articles.titleZh: 用于气候适应型酿酒的微生物工具和监管创新。
articles.authors: Vicente J, Benito S, Marquina D, Santos A.
articles.abstract: Climate-induced acidity loss threatens wine quality, prompting sustainable microbial acidification strategies using Lachancea thermotolerans. This yeast naturally reduces pH and ethanol, aligns with consumer preferences, and benefits from omics-driven selection and enabling policy frameworks. Adaptation requires coordinated biotechnological innovation, institutional backing, and clear consumer communication to maintain sustainability and competitiveness.
articles.abstractZh: 气候引起的酸度损失威胁着葡萄酒的质量，促使人们使用耐热拉昌氏菌进行可持续的微生物酸化策略。这种酵母自然地降低 pH 值和乙醇，符合消费者的偏好，并受益于组学驱动的选择和有利的政策框架。适应需要协调的生物技术创新、机构支持和清晰的消费者沟通，以保持可持续性和竞争力。

articles.title: Redox-dependent liver gluconeogenesis impacts different intensity exercise in mice.
articles.titleZh: 氧化还原依赖性肝脏糖异生作用影响小鼠不同强度的运动。
articles.authors: Horiuchi T, Kaneko K, Hosaka S, Uno K, Tomiyama S, Takahashi K, Yamato M, Endo A, Sugawara H, Kawana Y, Asai Y, Kodama S, Imai J, Mizuno S, Takahashi S, Takasaki A, Ono H, Yokote K, Maeda R, Sugiura Y, Katagiri H.
articles.abstract: Hepatic gluconeogenesis produces glucose from various substrates to meet energy demands. However, how these substrates are preferentially used under different conditions remains unclear. Here, we show that preferential supplies of lactate and glycerol modulate hepatic gluconeogenesis, thereby impacting high-intensity and low-intensity exercise capacities, respectively. We find that liver-specific knockout of phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase 1 (L-Pck1KO), which blocks gluconeogenesis from lactate, decreases high-intensity exercise capacity but increases low-intensity exercise capacity by enhancing gluconeogenesis from glycerol. Conversely, liver-specific knockout of glycerol kinase (L-GykKO), which inhibits glycerol-derived gluconeogenesis, induces the opposite effects by enhancing gluconeogenesis from lactate. Given that these compensatory steps depend on NAD+-mediated oxidation in the cytosol, we hepatically expressed NADH oxidase from Lactobacillus brevis (LbNOX) to decrease the cytosolic [NADH]/[NAD+] ratio. We find that hepatic LbNOX expression enhances gluconeogenesis from both redox-dependent substrates and increases exercise capacities at both intensities. Importantly, LbNOX-induced enhancement of high-intensity and low-intensity exercise capacities is abolished in L-Pck1KO and L-GykKO mice, respectively. Therefore, supplies of gluconeogenic substrates and cytosolic redox states, rather than altered enzyme expressions, modulate hepatic gluconeogenesis and exercise capacity at different intensities. Globally, this study shows that regulating hepatic gluconeogenesis through cytosolic redox states is a potent strategy for increasing exercise performance.
articles.abstractZh: 肝脏糖异生从各种底物中产生葡萄糖以满足能量需求。然而，这些底物在不同条件下如何优先使用仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明优先供应乳酸和甘油可调节肝脏糖异生，从而分别影响高强度和低强度运动能力。我们发现，肝脏特异性敲除磷酸烯醇丙酮酸羧激酶 1 (L-Pck1KO) 会阻止乳酸的糖异生，从而降低高强度运动能力，但通过增强甘油的糖异生来提高低强度运动能力。相反，肝脏特异性敲除甘油激酶 (L-GykKO) 会抑制甘油来源的糖异生，但会通过增强乳酸的糖异生来诱导相反的作用。鉴于这些补偿步骤依赖于细胞质中 NAD+ 介导的氧化，我们在肝脏中表达短乳杆菌 (LbNOX) 的 NADH 氧化酶，以降低细胞质 [NADH]/[NAD+] 比率。我们发现肝脏 LbNOX 表达增强了两种氧化还原依赖性底物的糖异生，并提高了两种强度的运动能力。重要的是，LbNO

articles.title: A glutamyl-tRNA reductase and its binding protein promote transitory starch biosynthesis and enhance grain quality and yield in rice.
articles.titleZh: 谷氨酰-tRNA 还原酶及其结合蛋白促进瞬时淀粉生物合成并提高水稻的谷物品质和产量。
articles.authors: Duan Y, Li X, Ma L, Jiao G, Cao R, Dong N, Li X, Wang Z, Wang P, Tang S, Wei X, Hu P.
articles.abstract: Transitory starch in rice leaves is critical for temporary carbon storage, plant growth, and subsequent grain filling, yet the regulatory mechanisms underlying its biosynthesis remain poorly understood. Here, we found that Leaf Starch Deficiency 3 (LSD3), a rice glutamyl-tRNA reductase (GluTR), interacts with GluTR-binding protein (GluTRBP), which in turn associates with granule-bound starch synthase II (GBSSII), the key enzyme responsible for amylose synthesis in leaves. The LSD3-GluTRBP module maintains both the protein stability and enzymatic activity of GBSSII. The lsd3 and glutrbp mutants exhibited markedly reduced GBSSII activity, resulting in significant decreases in leaf starch accumulation. Moreover, these mutants displayed severe defects in carbon-source transport from leaves to developing grains, accompanied by strong downregulation of genes associated with carbon-source allocation. Consequently, the lsd3 and glutrbp mutants showed reduced endosperm-storage starch content and severely compromised grain quality and yield. Notably, overexpression of GBSSII partially rescued defective phenotypes in both leaves and grains of the mutants. In summary, our findings establish that the LSD3-GluTRBP module acts upstream of GBSSII and plays a central role in transitory starch biosynthesis as well as in determining grain quality and yield in rice. These findings provide new molecular targets for simultaneously improving both grain yield and quality in rice.
articles.abstractZh: 稻叶中的瞬时淀粉对于临时碳储存、植物生长和随后的籽粒灌浆至关重要，但其生物合成背后的调节机制仍知之甚少。在这里，我们发现叶子淀粉缺乏症 3 (LSD3)，一种水稻谷氨酰-tRNA 还原酶 (GluTR)，与 GluTR 结合蛋白 (GluTRBP) 相互作用，而 GluTRBP 又与颗粒结合淀粉合酶 II (GBSSII) 相关，GBSSII 是叶子中负责直链淀粉合成的关键酶。 LSD3-GluTRBP 模块保持了 GBSSII 的蛋白质稳定性和酶活性。 lsd3 和 glutrbp 突变体表现出 GBSSII 活性显着降低，导致叶淀粉积累显着减少。此外，这些突变体在从叶子到发育中的谷物的碳源运输方面表现出严重缺陷，并伴有与碳源分配相关的基因的强烈下调。因此，lsd3 和 glutrbp 突变体表现出胚乳储存淀粉含量降低，并严重损害谷物质量和产量。值得注意的是，GBSSII 的过度表达部分挽救了突变体叶片和籽粒中的缺陷表型。总之，我们的研究结果表明

articles.title: Ethanol ingestion via frugivory in wild chimpanzees.
articles.titleZh: 野生黑猩猩通过食果摄入乙醇。
articles.authors: Maro A, Sandel AA, Blaiore BZA, Wittig RM, Mitani JC, Dudley R.
articles.abstract: Human attraction to alcohol may derive from an evolutionary association between ethanol and fruits consumed by animals in nature. Fermentative yeasts are widespread in the terrestrial biosphere, and simple carbohydrates underpinning ethanol production are commonplace within fruits. We determined ethanol concentrations within fruits representing a substantial portion of the diet of our closest living relatives, the chimpanzees. Ripe fruit pulp from 20 angiosperm species in Côte d'Ivoire and Uganda contained an average value of 0.31 (± 0.21 SD) and 0.32% (± 0.20) ethanol (weight/weight), respectively, as scaled by annual chimpanzee feeding time per species at each site. Chimpanzees typically eat ~4.5 kilograms of fruit per day, corresponding to an estimated ethanol ingestion of 14 grams (±9), or the equivalent of 1.4 (±0.9) standard drinks by international standards. These findings are consistent with the hypothesis that ethanol is widespread within tropical fruits and that modern predisposition to alcohol consumption derives from ancestral exposure to this psychoactive substance among frugivorous primates.
articles.abstractZh: 人类对酒精的吸引力可能源于乙醇和自然界动物食用的水果之间的进化关联。发酵酵母广泛存在于陆地生物圈中，而支撑乙醇生产的简单碳水化合物在水果中也很常见。我们测定了水果中的乙醇浓度，这些水果代表了我们现存的近亲黑猩猩饮食的很大一部分。科特迪瓦和乌干达 20 种被子植物的成熟果肉中乙醇的平均值分别为 0.31 (± 0.21 SD) 和 0.32% (± 0.20) 乙醇（重量/重量），按每个地点黑猩猩每年进食时间计算。黑猩猩通常每天吃约 4.5 公斤水果，相当于估计摄入 14 克 (±9) 乙醇，或按照国际标准相当于 1.4 (±0.9) 标准饮料。这些发现与乙醇在热带水果中广泛存在的假设相一致，并且现代人的饮酒倾向源于食果灵长类动物祖先对这种精神活性物质的接触。

articles.title: Protocol for triggering plant gene silencing by viral delivery of short RNA.
articles.titleZh: 通过病毒传递短 RNA 触发植物基因沉默的方案。
articles.authors: García A, Aragonés V, Ortiz-García P, Daròs JA, Pasin F.
articles.abstract: Virus-induced gene silencing (VIGS) leverages viral vectors to deliver 200-400-nt inserts targeting specific genes. Here, we present a protocol for triggering gene silencing by virus-delivered short RNA inserts (vsRNAi). We describe steps for designing 32-nt vsRNAi that simultaneously target Nicotiana benthamiana homeologous genes involved in chlorophyll biosynthesis and assembling them into JoinTRV, a vector system based on tobacco rattle virus (TRV). This approach results in robust gene silencing phenotypes, including visible leaf yellowing and reduced chlorophyll levels. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to García et al.1.
articles.abstractZh: 病毒诱导的基因沉默 (VIGS) 利用病毒载体传递针对特定基因的 200-400 nt 插入片段。在这里，我们提出了一种通过病毒传递的短 RNA 插入 (vsRNAi) 触发基因沉默的方案。我们描述了设计 32-nt vsRNAi 的步骤，该 32-nt vsRNAi 同时靶向参与叶绿素生物合成的烟草本塞姆氏同源基因，并将它们组装到基于烟草脆裂病毒 (TRV) 的载体系统 JoinTRV 中。这种方法会产生强大的基因沉默表型，包括可见的叶子变黄和叶绿素水平降低。有关该协议的使用和执行的完整详细信息，请参阅 García 等人 1。

articles.title: Ultrafast and scalable synthesis of enzyme-metal hybrid catalysts in evaporating microdroplets.
articles.titleZh: 在蒸发微滴中超快速且可扩展地合成酶-金属杂化催化剂。
articles.authors: Qiao Y, Xin R, Li X, Ge J.
articles.abstract: One-pot chemoenzymatic cascade reactions integrate the advantages of enzymatic catalysis and chemical catalysis, offering routes to synthesize enantiopure compounds in an efficient and environmentally friendly manner. The rational design of enzyme-metal hybrid catalysts (EMHCs) is an attractive strategy for operating chemoenzymatic cascade reactions efficiently under mild conditions. In this study, we develop a method for the instantaneous and continuous synthesis of EMHCs in evaporating microdroplets. Compared to traditional wet impregnation methods, the reaction time of the microdroplet-assisted method is shortened from days to seconds, achieving a space-time yield increase by two to five orders of magnitude. The as-prepared Pd/lipase cross-linked enzyme aggregates with ultrasmall Pd nanoclusters and well-preserved structure of enzymes exhibit excellent activity in the dynamic kinetic resolution of chiral amines. The mechanism for the process enhancement in the synthesis of EMHCs in evaporating microdroplets is studied by theoretical calculations, indicating that the fast solvent evaporation and high-heat transfer are the major factors for the instantaneous synthesis of EMHCs.
articles.abstractZh: 一锅化学酶级联反应结合了酶催化和化学催化的优点，为高效、环境友好的合成对映体纯化合物提供了途径。酶-金属杂化催化剂（EMHC）的合理设计是在温和条件下有效运行化学酶级联反应的一种有吸引力的策略。在这项研究中，我们开发了一种在蒸发微滴中瞬时连续合成 EMHC 的方法。与传统的湿法浸渍方法相比，微滴辅助方法的反应时间从几天缩短到几秒钟，实现了时空产率提高了两到五个数量级。所制备的 Pd/脂肪酶交联酶具有超小的 Pd 纳米团簇和保存完好的酶结构，在手性胺的动态动力学拆分中表现出优异的活性。通过理论计算研究了蒸发微滴合成EMHCs过程增强的机理，表明溶剂快速蒸发和高传热是EMHCs瞬时合成的主要因素。

articles.title: Impact of mycotoxins and glyphosate residue on the gut microbiome and resistome of European fallow deer.
articles.titleZh: 霉菌毒素和草甘膦残留对欧洲小鹿肠道微生物组和耐药组的影响。
articles.authors: Tóth AG, Nagy SÁ, Lakatos I, Solymosi N, Stágel A, Paholcsek M, Posta K, Gömbös P, Ferenczi S, Szőke Z.
articles.abstract: Some mycotoxins and herbicide residues pose threats to animal health. These toxins might affect the gut microbiome of fallow deer. The analyzation of the intestinal content samples of this valuable game species exposed to varying levels of zearalenone (ZEA) and other toxic compounds such as aflatoxin B1, deoxynivalenol, fumonisin B1, and glyphosate residues was performed. Metagenomic analysis revealed significant alterations in the bacterial community composition. Higher ZEA levels were associated with decreased alpha diversity, whereas higher aflatoxin levels had the opposite effect. Changes in the abundance of antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) were also observed, suggesting a potential link between mycotoxin exposure and antimicrobial resistance. Furthermore, five complete bacterial genomes were assembled from the metagenomic data. These findings highlight the complex interplay between environmental toxins, gut microbiota, and animal health. Understanding these interactions is crucial for developing strategies to mitigate the negative effects of toxin exposure on wildlife populations.
articles.abstractZh: 一些霉菌毒素和除草剂残留对动物健康构成威胁。这些毒素可能会影响小鹿的肠道微生物组。对暴露于不同水平的玉米赤霉烯酮 (ZEA) 和其他有毒化合物（如黄曲霉毒素 B1、脱氧雪腐镰刀菌烯醇、伏马菌素 B1 和草甘膦残留物）的这种有价值的野味物种的肠道内容物样本进行了分析。宏基因组分析揭示了细菌群落组成的显着变化。较高的 ZEA 水平与 α 多样性降低相关，而较高的黄曲霉毒素水平则具有相反的效果。还观察到抗生素抗性基因（ARG）丰度的变化，表明霉菌毒素暴露与抗生素耐药性之间存在潜在联系。此外，根据宏基因组数据组装了五个完整的细菌基因组。这些发现凸显了环境毒素、肠道微生物群和动物健康之间复杂的相互作用。了解这些相互作用对于制定减轻毒素暴露对野生动物种群负面影响的策略至关重要。

articles.title: Two microbiome metabolites compete for tRNA modification to impact mammalian cell proliferation and translation quality control.
articles.titleZh: 两种微生物组代谢物竞争 tRNA 修饰，从而影响哺乳动物细胞增殖和翻译质量控制。
articles.authors: Zhang W, Lahry K, Cipurko D, Huang S, Zbihley O, Sevilleja AM, Rudzka D, Frietze LR, Assari M, Katanski CD, Singh M, Attina A, Guillorit H, Watkins CP, Gourlain D, Varlet D, Falconi J, Djiane A, Hirtz C, Chen H, Macari F, Johnson K, Chevrier N, David A, Pan T.
articles.abstract: The microbiome affects eukaryotic host cells via many metabolites, including the well-studied queuine as substrate for host tRNA queuosine modification. The microbial metabolite pre-queuosine 1 (preQ1) is produced in the bacterial tRNA queuosine biosynthesis pathway, with unknown effects on host cell biology. Here we show that preQ1 strongly represses cell proliferation in both human and mouse cells. Queuine reverses this effect by competing with preQ1 to modify the same tRNA. PreQ1 is detectable in the plasma and tissues of mice, and its injection suppresses tumour growth in a mouse cancer model. Mechanistically, preQ1 reduces cognate tRNA levels specifically, as well as codon-dependent translation of housekeeping genes. We identify the endoplasmic reticulum-localized inositol-requiring enzyme 1 (IRE1) ribonuclease as the enzyme responsible for the selective degradation of preQ1-modified tRNAs on translating ribosomes. Our results identify two microbial metabolites competing for host tRNA modification, which elicits translation quality control and impacts cell proliferation.
articles.abstractZh: 微生物组通过许多代谢物影响真核宿主细胞，包括经过充分研究的队列碱作为宿主 tRNA 队列碱修饰的底物。微生物代谢物前奎奥辛 1 (preQ1) 在细菌 tRNA 奎奥辛生物合成途径中产生，对宿主细胞生物学的影响未知。在这里，我们发现 preQ1 强烈抑制人类和小鼠细胞的细胞增殖。 Queuine 通过与 preQ1 竞争修饰相同的 tRNA 来逆转这种效应。 PreQ1 可在小鼠血浆和组织中检测到，注射它可以抑制小鼠癌症模型中的肿瘤生长。从机制上讲，preQ1 特异性降低同源 tRNA 水平，以及管家基因的密码子依赖性翻译。我们确定内质网定位的肌醇需要酶 1 (IRE1) 核糖核酸酶是负责翻译核糖体上 preQ1 修饰的 tRNA 选择性降解的酶。我们的结果确定了两种微生物代谢物竞争宿主 tRNA 修饰，从而引发翻译质量控制并影响细胞增殖。

articles.title: The generation and consequences of N-terminal proteoform diversity.
articles.titleZh: N 端蛋白质多样性的产生和后果。
articles.authors: Morrison EJ, Rissland OS.
articles.abstract: N-terminal proteoforms are protein variants with altered N termini that arise from RNA-driven processes, such as alternative promoter usage, splicing, and translation initiation site usage, as well as protein alterations, such as N-terminal processing and modifications. While our understanding of these mechanisms has grown substantially over the past decade, the interplay between RNA-driven processes and N-terminal proteoforms has received less attention. Here, we summarize recent advancements in our understanding of N-terminal proteoform creation, function, and usage. We highlight advances in alternative translation initiation site usage as well as newly discovered N-degron pathways, and we explore how differences in N termini via processing and modifications can give rise to different N-degrons: elements at the extreme N terminus of proteins that trigger turnover. Many regulatory pathways converge on the N terminus and corresponding nucleotides, and an integrated, multidisciplinary approach holds the potential to reveal new insights into gene regulation and function.
articles.abstractZh: N 端蛋白质变体是 N 端发生改变的蛋白质变体，由 RNA 驱动的过程产生，例如替代启动子的使用、剪接和翻译起始位点的使用，以及蛋白质改变，例如 N 端加工和修饰。虽然我们对这些机制的理解在过去十年中有了显着的增长，但 RNA 驱动过程和 N 端蛋白质形式之间的相互作用却很少受到关注。在这里，我们总结了我们对 N 端蛋白质形式的创建、功能和用途的理解的最新进展。我们重点介绍了替代翻译起始位点使用方面的进展以及新发现的 N 降解决定子途径，并探讨了 N 末端的差异如何通过加工和修饰产生不同的 N 降解决定子：位于蛋白质极端 N 末端的元素，可触发翻转。许多调控途径汇聚在 N 末端和相应的核苷酸上，综合的、多学科的方法有可能揭示基因调控和功能的新见解。

articles.title: A universal oxygen scavenger for oxidase-based biosensors.
articles.titleZh: 用于基于氧化酶的生物传感器的通用除氧剂。
articles.authors: Zhang H, Saadeldin MG, Buesen D, Elfaitory H, Burger J, Friebe VM, Honacker J, Vöpel T, Oughli AA, Plumeré N.
articles.abstract: Oxidase-based electrochemical biosensors are widely deployed for point-of-use applications, yet oxygen interference remains a major challenge, substantially reducing sensing accuracy. Here, we developed a universal enzymatic O2 scavenger composed of alcohol oxidase, catalase, and paraformaldehyde to eliminate O2 within the sensor by converting it to water. Unlike other oxidases, alcohol oxidase exclusively uses O2 as an electron acceptor, preventing interference with the electron transfer chain involving the sensing oxidase. We demonstrated the compatibility of this O2 scavenger for calibration-free sensing of glucose, lactate, and creatinine in the concentration range relevant to human health. Without the O2 scavenger, sensor readings were less than 50% of those under inert gas conditions. With the O2 scavenger, the accuracy improved to 99%, even at low substrate concentrations. The general compatibility and performances of this alcohol oxidase-based O2 scavenger unlock the full potential of oxidase-based biosensors for reliable point-of-use sensing.
articles.abstractZh: 基于氧化酶的电化学生物传感器广泛应用于使用点应用，但氧气干扰仍然是一个主要挑战，大大降低了传感精度。在这里，我们开发了一种由乙醇氧化酶、过氧化氢酶和多聚甲醛组成的通用酶 O2 清除剂，通过将传感器内的 O2 转化为水来消除 O2。与其他氧化酶不同，醇氧化酶专门使用 O2 作为电子受体，防止干扰涉及传感氧化酶的电子传递链。我们证明了这种氧气清除剂的兼容性，可在与人类健康相关的浓度范围内对葡萄糖、乳酸和肌酐进行免校准传感。没有氧气清除剂时，传感器读数低于惰性气体条件下的 50%。使用 O2 清除剂，即使在底物浓度较低的情况下，准确度也提高到 99%。这种基于酒精氧化酶的氧气清除剂的总体兼容性和性能充分发挥了基于氧化酶的生物传感器的可靠使用点传感的潜力。

articles.title: A Ψ-Ψ codon-anticodon pairing in nonsense suppression and translational recoding.
articles.titleZh: 无义抑制和翻译重新编码中的 Ψ-Ψ 密码子-反密码子配对。
articles.authors: Pan Y, Kierzek E, Kierzek R, Mathews DH, Yu YT.
articles.abstract: Pseudouridine (Ψ) is known for decades but its flexibility in base pairing remains unclear. This study engineers artificial box H/ACA guide RNAs to direct pseudouridylation at the uridine of a premature termination codon (PTC; UAA, UAG or UGA) within an intronless mRNA and U36 of the anticodon of a matching tRNA in yeast and human cells. Targeted pseudouridylation leads to the formation of a Ψ-Ψ codon-anticodon pair, which, together with the other two Watson-Crick base pairs in the codon-anticodon duplex, greatly improves codon-anticodon recognition, robustly promoting PTC readthrough. The intronless mRNA level remains unchanged with or without guide RNAs. Additionally, pseudouridylation does not impact tRNA stability or charging. Our results show that nonsense suppression is promoted by the high affinity of the Ψ-Ψ pair, which is verified by melting curve analysis. This work identifies an unusual Ψ-Ψ base pair, which contributes greatly to codon-anticodon recognition and translational recoding.
articles.abstractZh: 伪尿苷 (Ψ) 已为人所知数十年，但其碱基配对的灵活性仍不清楚。这项研究设计了人工盒 H/ACA 引导 RNA，以指导酵母和人类细胞中无内含子 mRNA 内过早终止密码子（PTC；UAA、UAG 或 UGA）的尿苷以及匹配 tRNA 反密码子 U36 的假尿苷化。靶向假尿苷化导致形成 Ψ-Ψ 密码子-反密码子对，它与密码子-反密码子双链体中的其他两个 Watson-Crick 碱基对一起，极大地提高了密码子-反密码子识别，有力地促进了 PTC 通读。无论有或没有指导 RNA，无内含子 mRNA 水平均保持不变。此外，假尿苷化不会影响 tRNA 稳定性或充电。我们的结果表明，Ψ-Ψ 对的高亲和力促进了无义抑制，这一点通过熔解曲线分析得到了验证。这项工作鉴定了一个不寻常的 Ψ-Ψ 碱基对，这对密码子-反密码子识别和翻译重新编码有很大贡献。

articles.title: Computational design of sequence-specific DNA-binding proteins.
articles.titleZh: 序列特异性 DNA 结合蛋白的计算设计。
articles.authors: Glasscock CJ, Pecoraro RJ, McHugh R, Doyle LA, Chen W, Boivin O, Lonnquist B, Na E, Politanska Y, Haddox HK, Cox D, Norn C, Coventry B, Goreshnik I, Vafeados D, Lee GR, Gordân R, Stoddard BL, DiMaio F, Baker D.
articles.abstract: Sequence-specific DNA-binding proteins (DBPs) have critical roles in biology and biotechnology and there has been considerable interest in the engineering of DBPs with new or altered specificities for genome editing and other applications. While there has been some success in reprogramming naturally occurring DBPs using selection methods, the computational design of new DBPs that recognize arbitrary target sites remains an outstanding challenge. We describe a computational method for the design of small DBPs that recognize short specific target sequences through interactions with bases in the major groove and use this method to generate binders for five distinct DNA targets with mid-nanomolar to high-nanomolar affinities. The individual binding modules have specificity closely matching the computational models at as many as six base-pair positions and higher-order specificity can be achieved by rigidly positioning the binders along the DNA double helix using RFdiffusion. The crystal structure of a designed DBP-target site complex is in close agreement with the design model and the designed DBPs function in both Escherichia coli and mammalian cells to repress and activate transcription of neighboring genes. Our method provides a route to small and, hence, readily deliverable sequence-specific DBPs for gene regulation and editing.
articles.abstractZh: 序列特异性 DNA 结合蛋白 (DBP) 在生物学和生物技术中发挥着至关重要的作用，并且人们对具有新的或改变的特异性的 DBP 工程用于基因组编辑和其他应用产生了很大的兴趣。虽然使用选择方法对自然发生的 DBP 进行重编程已取得一些成功，但识别任意目标位点的新 DBP 的计算设计仍然是一个突出的挑战。我们描述了一种设计小 DBP 的计算方法，该方法通过与大沟中的碱基相互作用来识别短的特定靶序列，并使用该方法为五个具有中纳摩尔至高纳摩尔亲和力的不同 DNA 靶标生成结合物。各个结合模块在多达六个碱基对位置处具有与计算模型紧密匹配的特异性，并且可以通过使用 RF 扩散沿 DNA 双螺旋严格定位结合物来实现更高阶的特异性。设计的 DBP-靶位点复合物的晶体结构与设计模型非常一致，并且设计的 DBP 在大肠杆菌和哺乳动物细胞中都具有抑制和激活转录的功能

articles.title: A plant-specific cytochrome <i>b<sub>5</sub></i>-like protein is essential for phytosterol biosynthesis.
articles.titleZh: 植物特异性细胞色素 b5 样蛋白对于植物甾醇生物合成至关重要。
articles.authors: Zhao X, Qiao L, Wang ZY, Xu SL, Shanklin J, Liu CJ.
articles.abstract: Sterols are essential isoprenoid derivatives that contribute to membrane structure and function. In plants, they also serve as precursors to phytohormones and specialized metabolites important for development, defense, and health. Although the sterol biosynthetic pathway is considered well-characterized, we report the discovery of a plant-specific cytochrome b5-like protein, CB5LP, as a critical component of phytosterol biosynthesis. Loss of CB5LP in Arabidopsis causes embryonic defects, seedling lethality, and accumulation of 14α-methyl-sterols, with reduced levels of sitosterol and stigmasterol-indicating a defect in sterol 14α-demethylation. TurboID-based proximity labeling and in vitro assays show that CB5LP physically and functionally interacts with CYP51, a cytochrome P450 enzyme catalyzing this demethylation step. Unlike canonical cytochrome b5 proteins, CB5LP has a reversed topology and is exclusive to plants, acting as an evolutionarily distinct electron donor. This discovery reveals an uncharacterized redox partnership essential for sterol biosynthesis and highlights a promising target for the development of selective herbicide.
articles.abstractZh: 甾醇是重要的类异戊二烯衍生物，有助于膜结构和功能。在植物中，它们还作为植物激素和对发育、防御和健康很重要的特殊代谢物的前体。尽管甾醇生物合成途径被认为已被充分表征，但我们报告发现了植物特异性细胞色素 b5 样蛋白 CB5LP，它是植物甾醇生物合成的关键组成部分。拟南芥中 CB5LP 的缺失会导致胚胎缺陷、幼苗死亡和 14α-甲基甾醇的积累，其中谷甾醇和豆甾醇水平降低，表明甾醇 14α-去甲基化存在缺陷。基于 TurboID 的邻近标记和体外测定表明，CB5LP 在物理和功能上与 CYP51（一种催化此去甲基化步骤的细胞色素 P450 酶）相互作用。与典型的细胞色素 b5 蛋白不同，CB5LP 具有相反的拓扑结构，并且是植物独有的，充当进化上独特的电子供体。这一发现揭示了甾醇生物合成所必需的一种未表征的氧化还原伙伴关系，并强调了选择性除草剂开发的一个有希望的目标。

articles.title: ABCA7 variants impact phosphatidylcholine and mitochondria in neurons.
articles.titleZh: ABCA7 变异影响神经元中的磷脂酰胆碱和线粒体。
articles.authors: von Maydell D, Wright SE, Pao PC, Staab C, King O, Spitaleri A, Bonner JM, Liu L, Yu CJ, Chiu CC, Leible D, Ni Scannail A, Li M, Boix CA, Mathys H, Leclerc G, Menchaca GS, Welch G, Graziosi A, Leary N, Samaan G, Kellis M, Tsai LH.
articles.abstract: Loss-of-function variants in the lipid transporter ABCA7 substantially increase the risk of Alzheimer's disease1,2, yet how they impact cellular states to drive disease remains unclear. Here, using single-nucleus RNA-sequencing analysis of human brain samples, we identified widespread gene expression changes across multiple neural cell types associated with rare ABCA7 loss-of-function variants. Excitatory neurons, which expressed the highest levels of ABCA7, showed disrupted lipid metabolism, mitochondrial function, DNA repair and synaptic signalling pathways. Similar transcriptional disruptions occurred in neurons carrying the common Alzheimer's-associated variant ABCA7 p.Ala1527Gly3, predicted by molecular dynamics simulations to alter the ABCA7 structure. Induced pluripotent stem (iPS)-cell-derived neurons with ABCA7 loss-of-function variants recapitulated these transcriptional changes, displaying impaired mitochondrial function, increased oxidative stress and disrupted phosphatidylcholine metabolism. Supplementation with CDP-choline increased phosphatidylcholine synthesis, reversed these abnormalities and normalized amyloid-β secretion and neuronal hyperexcitability-key Alzheimer's features that are exacerbated by ABCA7 dysfunction. Our results implicate disrupted phosphatidylcholine metabolism in ABCA7-related Alzheimer's risk and highlight a possible therapeutic approach.
articles.abstractZh: 脂质转运蛋白 ABCA7 中的功能丧失变异会显着增加阿尔茨海默病的风险1,2，但它们如何影响细胞状态从而导致疾病仍不清楚。在这里，通过对人脑样本进行单核 RNA 测序分析，我们发现了多种神经细胞类型中广泛的基因表达变化，这些变化与罕见的 ABCA7 功能丧失变异相关。表达最高水平 ABCA7 的兴奋性神经元显示出脂质代谢、线粒体功能、DNA 修复和突触信号传导通路被破坏。类似的转录破坏发生在携带常见阿尔茨海默病相关变体 ABCA7 p.Ala1527Gly3 的神经元中，分子动力学模拟预测该突变会改变 ABCA7 结构。具有 ABCA7 功能丧失变异的诱导多能干 (iPS) 细胞衍生的神经元重现了这些转录变化，显示线粒体功能受损、氧化应激增加和磷脂酰胆碱代谢紊乱。补充 CDP-胆碱可增加磷脂酰胆碱合成，逆转这些异常并使淀粉样蛋白-β 分泌和神经元过度兴奋性正常化 - 关键阿尔茨海姆病

articles.title: Giant KASH proteins and ribosomes establish distinct cytoplasmic biophysical properties in vivo.
articles.titleZh: 巨大的 KASH 蛋白和核糖体在体内建立了独特的细胞质生物物理特性。
articles.authors: Ding X, Hao H, Elnatan D, Alinaya PN, Kalra S, Kaur A, Kumari S, Holt LJ, Luxton GWG, Starr DA.
articles.abstract: Understanding how cells control their biophysical properties during development remains a fundamental challenge. While macromolecular crowding affects multiple cellular processes in single cells, its regulation in living animals remains poorly understood. Using genetically encoded multimeric nanoparticles for in vivo rheology, we found that Caenorhabditis elegans tissues maintain mesoscale properties that differ from those observed across diverse systems, including bacteria, yeast species, and cultured mammalian cells. We identified two conserved mechanisms controlling particle mobility: Ribosome concentration, a known regulator of cytoplasmic crowding, works in concert with a previously unknown function for the giant KASH (Klarsicht/ANC-1/SYNE homology) protein ANC-1 in providing structural constraints through associating with the endoplasmic reticulum. These findings reveal mechanisms by which tissues establish and maintain distinct mesoscale properties, with implications for understanding cellular organization across species.
articles.abstractZh: 了解细胞在发育过程中如何控制其生物物理特性仍然是一个基本挑战。虽然大分子拥挤会影响单细胞中的多个细胞过程，但其在活体动物中的调节仍知之甚少。使用基因编码的多聚纳米颗粒进行体内流变学，我们发现秀丽隐杆线虫组织保持的介观特性与在不同系统（包括细菌、酵母物种和培养的哺乳动物细胞）中观察到的特性不同。我们确定了控制颗粒移动性的两种保守机制：核糖体浓度，一种已知的细胞质拥挤调节剂，与巨型 KASH（Klarsicht/ANC-1/SYNE 同源性）蛋白 ANC-1 的先前未知功能协同工作，通过与内质网结合提供结构约束。这些发现揭示了组织建立和维持独特的介观特性的机制，对于理解跨物种的细胞组织具有重要意义。

articles.title: Locusts adopt IP<sub>3</sub> as a second messenger for olfactory signal transduction.
articles.titleZh: 蝗虫采用IP<sub>3</sub>作为嗅觉信号转导的第二信使。
articles.authors: Yang J, He H, Dong S, Lv J, Cheng L, Yu Q, Kang L, Guo X.
articles.abstract: Insects, unlike vertebrates, use heteromeric complexes of odorant receptors and co-receptors for olfactory signal transduction. However, the secondary messengers involved in this process are largely unknown. Here, we use the olfactory signal transduction of the aggregation pheromone 4-vinylanisole (4VA) as a model to address this question. When locusts detect 4VA, the pheromone is transported by OBP10 and OBP13 to the OR35-Orco receptor complex, thereby activating downstream pathways in the antenna. A pivotal downstream molecule, the lipid-binding protein Clvs2, facilitates phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate transportation across the cytolemma, providing more substrates for inositol trisphosphate (IP3) production. PLCe1, a biosynthetic enzyme, boosts IP3 levels in the antennal lobe of the brain. IP3 is responsible for converting chemical signals from the antenna into neural signals, confirming IP3 as a secondary messenger in olfaction perception instead of GPCR in locusts. These findings elucidate the universal function of IP3 in olfactory signal perception, shedding light on the key nodes of insect olfactory signal transduction.
articles.abstractZh: 与脊椎动物不同，昆虫使用气味受体和辅助受体的异聚复合物进行嗅觉信号转导。然而，参与这一过程的次要信使在很大程度上是未知的。在这里，我们使用聚集信息素 4-乙烯基苯甲醚 (4VA) 的嗅觉信号转导作为模型来解决这个问题。当蝗虫检测到 4VA 时，信息素通过 OBP10 和 OBP13 转运至 OR35-Orco 受体复合物，从而激活天线中的下游通路。关键的下游分子脂质结合蛋白 Clvs2 可促进磷脂酰肌醇 4,5-二磷酸跨细胞膜的运输，为三磷酸肌醇 (IP3) 的生产提供更多底物。 PLCe1 是一种生物合成酶，可提高大脑触角叶中的 IP3 水平。 IP3 负责将来自触角的化学信号转换为神经信号，证实 IP3 是嗅觉感知中的第二信使，而不是蝗虫中的 GPCR。这些发现阐明了IP3在嗅觉信号感知中的普遍功能，揭示了昆虫嗅觉信号转导的关键节点。

articles.title: Protocol for screening inhibitors of the fungal sphingolipid-metabolizing enzyme ceramide synthase.
articles.titleZh: 筛选真菌鞘脂代谢酶神经酰胺合酶抑制剂的方案。
articles.authors: Zhong A, Dasilva D, Pereira de Sa N, You JK, Del Poeta M.
articles.abstract: Fungal sphingolipids have emerged as potent antifungal targets based on cumulative evidence demonstrating that fungal sphingolipid metabolism is essential to the virulence of pathogenic fungi. Here, we present a protocol to screen for inhibitors of the sphingolipid-metabolizing enzyme ceramide synthase. We describe steps for harvesting microsomes from Saccharomyces cerevisiae, performing in vitro reactions, and performing lipid extractions. We then detail the use of a high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC)-based fluorometric assay to screen large chemical libraries for ceramide synthase inhibitors. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to Dasilva et al.1.
articles.abstractZh: 累积的证据表明真菌鞘脂代谢对于病原真菌的毒力至关重要，真菌鞘脂已成为有效的抗真菌靶点。在这里，我们提出了一个筛选鞘脂代谢酶神经酰胺合酶抑制剂的方案。我们描述了从酿酒酵母中收获微粒体、进行体外反应和进行脂质提取的步骤。然后，我们详细介绍了如何使用基于高效液相色谱 (HPLC) 的荧光测定来筛选大型化学库中的神经酰胺合酶抑制剂。有关该协议的使用和执行的完整详细信息，请参阅 Dasilva 等人 1。

articles.title: Structure and mechanism of the mitochondrial calcium transporter NCLX.
articles.titleZh: 线粒体钙转运蛋白NCLX的结构和机制。
articles.authors: Fan M, Tsai CW, Zhang J, Zhang J, Krishnan AR, Liu TY, Huang YL, Aydin D, Du S, Sobecks BL, Rodriguez MX, Reiter AH, Bertozzi CR, Dror RO, Tsai MF, Feng L.
articles.abstract: As a key mitochondrial Ca2+ transporter, NCLX regulates intracellular Ca2+ signalling and vital mitochondrial processes1-3. The importance of NCLX in cardiac and nervous-system physiology is reflected by acute heart failure and neurodegenerative disorders caused by its malfunction4-9. Despite substantial advances in the field, the transport mechanisms of NCLX remain unclear. Here we report the cryo-electron microscopy structures of NCLX, revealing its architecture, assembly, major conformational states and a previously undescribed mechanism for alternating access. Functional analyses further reveal an unexpected transport function of NCLX as a H+/Ca2+ exchanger, rather than as a Na+/Ca2+ exchanger as widely believed1. These findings provide critical insights into mitochondrial Ca2+ homeostasis and signalling, offering clues for developing therapies to treat diseases related to abnormal mitochondrial Ca2+.
articles.abstractZh: 作为关键的线粒体 Ca2+ 转运蛋白，NCLX 调节细胞内 Ca2+ 信号传导和重要的线粒体过程1-3。 NCLX 在心脏和神经系统生理学中的重要性反映在其功能障碍引起的急性心力衰竭和神经退行性疾病4-9。尽管该领域取得了重大进展，但 NCLX 的转运机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们报告了 NCLX 的冷冻电子显微镜结构，揭示了它的结构、组装、主要构象状态以及以前未描述的交替访问机制。功能分析进一步揭示了 NCLX 作为 H+/Ca2+ 交换器的意外转运功能，而不是广泛认为的 Na+/Ca2+ 交换器 1。这些发现为线粒体 Ca2+ 稳态和信号传导提供了重要见解，为开发治疗线粒体 Ca2+ 异常相关疾病的疗法提供了线索。

articles.title: The OsbZIP35-COR1-OsTCP19 module modulates cell proliferation to regulate grain length and weight in rice.
articles.titleZh: OsbZIP35-COR1-OsTCP19 模块可调节细胞增殖，从而调节水稻的籽粒长度和重量。
articles.authors: Xu P, Khan NU, Wang H, Zhao Y, Xu B, Hu Q, Pan Y, Li D, Li J, Sun X, Li J, Zhang H, Li Z, Zhang Z.
articles.abstract: Grain size substantially influences rice quality and yield. In this study, we identified CONTROL OF SLENDER RICE 1 (COR1), a quantitative trait locus encoding an F-box protein that enhances grain length by promoting cell proliferation. The transcription factor OsbZIP35 represses COR1 expression, while COR1 interacts with OsTCP19, leading to its degradation. Knockout of either OsbZIP35 or OsTCP19 results in increased grain length, confirming their regulatory roles in grain development. The OsbZIP35-COR1-OsTCP19 module controls the expression of the cell cycle gene OsCycB1;4, thereby modulating cell proliferation and ultimately determining grain size. Five haplotypes of COR1 were identified, with COR1-Hap1 and COR1-Hap3 being elite alleles associated with longer grains. Field plot trials demonstrated that the near-isogenic line NIL-COR1SLG increased yield by ~6.6% compared to NIL-COR1Nip. These findings elucidate the genetic mechanisms underlying grain size regulation and offer promising strategies for improving rice yield.
articles.abstractZh: 颗粒大小极大地影响稻米的品质和产量。在这项研究中，我们鉴定了 CONTROL OF SLENDER RICE 1 (COR1)，这是一个编码 F-box 蛋白的数量性状基因座，可通过促进细胞增殖来增加籽粒长度。转录因子 OsbZIP35 抑制 COR1 表达，而 COR1 与 OsTCP19 相互作用，导致其降解。 OsbZIP35 或 OsTCP19 的敲除都会导致籽粒长度增加，证实了它们在籽粒发育中的调节作用。 OsbZIP35-COR1-OsTCP19 模块控制细胞周期基因 OsCycB1;4 的表达，从而调节细胞增殖并最终决定颗粒大小。鉴定了 COR1 的五种单倍型，其中 COR1-Hap1 和 COR1-Hap3 是与较长谷物相关的精英等位基因。田间小区试验表明，与 NIL-COR1Nip 相比，近等基因系 NIL-COR1SLG 的产量增加了约 6.6%。这些发现阐明了籽粒大小调控的遗传机制，并为提高水稻产量提供了有前景的策略。

articles.title: Cellular pan-chain acyl-CoA profiling reveals SLC25A42/SLC25A16 in mitochondrial CoA import and metabolism.
articles.titleZh: 细胞泛链酰基 CoA 分析揭示了 SLC25A42/SLC25A16 在线粒体 CoA 输入和代谢中的作用。
articles.authors: Liu R, Zhang Z, Kyaw AK, Grabińska KA, Shah H, Shen H.
articles.abstract: The essential cofactor coenzyme A (CoASH) and its thioester derivatives (acyl-CoAs) have pivotal roles in cellular metabolism. However, the mechanism by which different acyl-CoAs are accurately partitioned into different subcellular compartments to support site-specific reactions, and the physiological impact of such compartmentalization, remain poorly understood. Here, we report an optimized liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry-based pan-chain acyl-CoA extraction and profiling method that enables a robust detection of 33 cellular and 23 mitochondrial acyl-CoAs from cultured human cells. We reveal that SLC25A16 and SLC25A42 are critical for mitochondrial import of free CoASH. This CoASH import process supports an enriched mitochondrial CoA pool and CoA-dependent pathways in the matrix, including the high-flux TCA cycle and fatty acid oxidation. Despite a small fraction of the mitochondria-localized CoA synthase COASY, de novo CoA biosynthesis is primarily cytosolic and supports cytosolic lipid anabolism. This mitochondrial acyl-CoA compartmentalization enables a spatial regulation of anabolic and energy-related catabolic processes, which promises to shed light on pathophysiology in the inborn errors of CoA metabolism.
articles.abstractZh: 必需的辅因子辅酶 A (CoASH) 及其硫酯衍生物（酰基 CoAs）在细胞代谢中发挥着关键作用。然而，不同的酰基辅酶A被准确地分配到不同的亚细胞区室以支持位点特异性反应的机制，以及这种区室化的生理影响，仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们报告了一种优化的基于液相色谱-质谱法的泛链酰基辅酶A提取和分析方法，该方法能够从培养的人类细胞中可靠地检测33种细胞和23种线粒体酰基辅酶A。我们发现 SLC25A16 和 SLC25A42 对于游离 CoASH 的线粒体输入至关重要。该 CoASH 导入过程支持基质中丰富的线粒体 CoA 池和 CoA 依赖性途径，包括高通量 TCA 循环和脂肪酸氧化。尽管线粒体定位的 CoA 合酶 COASY 只占一小部分，但从头 CoA 生物合成主要是在细胞质中进行的，并支持细胞质脂质合成代谢。这种线粒体酰基辅酶A区室化能够对合成代谢和能量相关的分解代谢过程进行空间调节，这有望为病理生理学提供线索

articles.title: SlBES1-mediated brassinosteroid signaling suppresses flavonoid biosynthesis in tomato fruit.
articles.titleZh: SlBES1 介导的油菜素类固醇信号传导抑制番茄果实中的类黄酮生物合成。
articles.authors: Jian Y, Li Y, Liu H, Hu S, Jia C, Yu S, Shao Z, Ou X, Yang J, Meng F, Liu L, Wang Q.
articles.abstract: With rising living standards, consumers' demand for color diversity and nutritional quality in tomato products has increased. Flavonoids are a key determinant of peel color and nutritional value in tomato fruit, where their biosynthesis is controlled by various phytohormones, including brassinosteroids (BRs). However, the underlying mechanism by which BR regulates flavonoid biosynthesis remains unclear. Here, we show that exogenous BRs suppress flavonoid accumulation, whereas reduced endogenous BR levels in RNAi lines of SlCYP90B3, a rate-limiting BR biosynthetic gene, result in increased flavonoid content in the fruit peel. We further demonstrate that BRI1-EMS-suppressor1 (SlBES1), a basic helix-loop-helix transcription factor essential for BR signaling, not only regulates fruit firmness but also represses flavonoid accumulation by directly binding to the promoters of the flavonoid biosynthetic genes SlCHS1, SlCHS2, and SlF3'H. Additionally, SlBES1 modulates a hierarchical transcriptional cascade by repressing the expression of SlMYB12, further suppressing flavonoid biosynthesis. Moreover, the homologous transcription factor brassinazole-resistant1 (SlBZR1) enhances SlBES1-mediated repression of flavonoid accumulation. Specifically, SlBES1 predominantly inhibits flavonoid biosynthesis, whereas SlBZR1 primarily enhances carotenoid pathway activity. Notably, variation in SlBES1 is correlated with flavonoid content during tomato domestication. Collectively, these results highlight a novel role for SlBES1 as a negative regulator of flavonoid biosynthesis, offering potential strategies for flavonoid biofortification in tomato.
articles.abstractZh: 随着生活水平的提高，消费者对番茄产品的颜色多样性和营养品质的需求不断增加。类黄酮是番茄果实果皮颜色和营养价值的关键决定因素，其生物合成受各种植物激素控制，包括油菜素类固醇 (BR)。然而，BR 调节类黄酮生物合成的潜在机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们发现外源 BR 抑制类黄酮积累，而限速 BR 生物合成基因 SlCYP90B3 的 RNAi 系中内源 BR 水平降低，导致果皮中类黄酮含量增加。我们进一步证明，BRI1-EMS-suppressor1 (SlBES1) 是 BR 信号传导所必需的基本螺旋-环-螺旋转录因子，不仅可以调节果实硬度，还可以通过直接与类黄酮生物合成基因 SlCHS1、SlCHS2 和 SlF3'H 的启动子结合来抑制类黄酮积累。此外，SlBES1 通过抑制 SlMYB12 的表达来调节分层转录级联，进一步抑制类黄酮生物合成。此外，同源转录因子brassinodium-resistive1 (SlBZR1) 增强SlBES1 介导

articles.title: The multi-kingdom cancer microbiome.
articles.titleZh: 多界癌症微生物组。
articles.authors: Dohlman AB, Pan X, Zitvogel L, Iliev ID.
articles.abstract: Microbial influence on cancer development and therapeutic response is a growing area of cancer research. Although it is known that microorganisms can colonize certain tissues and contribute to tumour initiation, the use of deep sequencing technologies and computational pipelines has led to reports of multi-kingdom microbial communities in a growing list of cancer types. This has prompted discussions on the role and scope of microbial presence in cancer, while raising the possibility of microbiome-based diagnostic, prognostic and therapeutic tools. However, additional investigation and thorough validation of cancer microbiome findings are required before this translational potential can be realized. Here we provide historical context and a conceptual framework for the so-called cancer microbiome and summarize experimental studies into tumour-associated bacteria, fungi and other microorganisms. We also discuss the current evidence for microbial colonization of tumours and their varied influence on the disease, including recent debates. Finally, we consider outstanding questions and discuss our outlook for the field.
articles.abstractZh: 微生物对癌症发展和治疗反应的影响是癌症研究的一个不断发展的领域。尽管众所周知微生物可以在某些组织中定植并促进肿瘤的发生，但深度测序技术和计算流程的使用导致了越来越多的癌症类型中存在多界微生物群落的报道。这引发了关于微生物在癌症中的作用和范围的讨论，同时提高了基于微生物组的诊断、预后和治疗工具的可能性。然而，在实现这种转化潜力之前，还需要对癌症微生物组的发现进行额外的调查和彻底的验证。在这里，我们提供了所谓的癌症微生物组的历史背景和概念框架，并总结了与肿瘤相关的细菌、真菌和其他微生物的实验研究。我们还讨论了肿瘤微生物定植的当前证据及其对疾病的不同影响，包括最近的争论。最后，我们考虑悬而未决的问题并讨论我们对该领域的展望。

articles.title: Hydroxylation of HPPD facilitates its PUB11-mediated ubiquitination and degradation in response to oxidative stress in Arabidopsis.
articles.titleZh: HPPD 的羟基化促进其 PUB11 介导的泛素化和降解，以响应拟南芥中的氧化应激。
articles.authors: Yu XH, Wen X, Dong J, Hu YF, Wang XL, Zhu DY, Ling Q, Lin HY, Yang GF.
articles.abstract: 4-Hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase (HPPD) is critical for plant photosynthesis and essential for enhancing tolerance to oxidative stress. However, the precise mechanisms by which plants regulate HPPD in response to oxidative stress remain largely unknown. Here, we show that Arabidopsis thaliana HPPD (AtHPPD) undergoes a previously uncharacterized post-translational modification-phenylalanine hydroxylation-in response to excessive hydroxyl radicals (·OH), thereby mediating oxidative stress tolerance. Biochemical analyses revealed that this hydroxylation impairs the normal function of AtHPPD, accelerating its degradation. We further identified PUB11 as a key interactor of AtHPPD. Both in vitro and in vivo assays demonstrated that this interaction is enhanced under oxidative stress, promoting ubiquitination and facilitating rapid AtHPPD degradation via the 26S proteasome to maintain reactive oxygen species homeostasis. Overall, this work uncovers a novel mechanism by which plants balance photosynthetic efficiency with the repair of oxidative damage, identifies key processes in oxidative stress regulation, and provides a foundation for breeding crops with improved resilience to abiotic stress.
articles.abstractZh: 4-羟基苯基丙酮酸双加氧酶 (HPPD) 对于植物光合作用至关重要，对于增强氧化应激耐受性至关重要。然而，植物调节 HPPD 响应氧化应激的确切机制仍然很大程度上未知。在这里，我们发现拟南芥 HPPD (AtHPPD) 会经历先前未表征的翻译后修饰 - 苯丙氨酸羟基化 - 响应过量的羟基自由基 (·OH)，从而介导氧化应激耐受性。生化分析表明，这种羟基化会损害 AtHPPD 的正常功能，加速其降解。我们进一步确定 PUB11 是 AtHPPD 的关键相互作用子。体外和体内测定均表明，这种相互作用在氧化应激下增强，促进泛素化并通过 26S 蛋白酶体促进 AtHPPD 快速降解，以维持活性氧稳态。总体而言，这项工作揭示了植物平衡光合效率与氧化损伤修复的新机制，确定了氧化应激调节的关键过程，并为培育具有更高抗逆性的作物奠定了基础。

articles.title: Sensitive and specific affinity purification-mass spectrometry assisted by PafA-mediated proximity labeling.
articles.titleZh: PafA 介导的邻近标记辅助的灵敏且特异的亲和纯化质谱法。
articles.authors: Luo S, Xie L, Yang L, Hu Z, Wang L, Wang Y, Li Q, Guo S, Tao S, Jiang H.
articles.abstract: While affinity purification-mass spectrometry (AP-MS) has significantly advanced protein-protein interaction (PPI) studies, its limitations in detecting weak, transient, and membrane-associated interactions remain. To address these challenges, we introduced a proteomic method termed affinity purification coupled proximity labeling-mass spectrometry (APPLE-MS), which combines the high specificity of Twin-Strep tag enrichment with PafA-mediated proximity labeling. This method achieves improved sensitivity while maintaining high specificity (4.07-fold over AP-MS). APPLE-MS also revealed the dynamic mitochondrial interactome of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) ORF9B during antiviral responses, while endogenous PIN1 profiling uncovered novel roles in DNA replication. Notably, APPLE-MS enabled in situ mapping of GLP-1 receptor complexes, demonstrating its unique capabilities for membrane PPI studies. This versatile method advances interactome research by providing comprehensive, physiologically relevant PPI networks, opening new opportunities for mechanistic discovery and therapeutic targeting.
articles.abstractZh: 虽然亲和纯化质谱 (AP-MS) 显着推进了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用 (PPI) 研究，但其在检测弱、瞬时和膜相关相互作用方面的局限性仍然存在。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了一种称为亲和纯化偶联邻近标记质谱 (APPLE-MS) 的蛋白质组学方法，该方法将 Twin-Strep 标签富集的高特异性与 PafA 介导的邻近标记相结合。该方法提高了灵敏度，同时保持了高特异性（是 AP-MS 的 4.07 倍）。 APPLE-MS 还揭示了抗病毒反应期间严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒 2 (SARS-CoV-2) ORF9B 的动态线粒体相互作用组，而内源 PIN1 分析揭示了 DNA 复制中的新作用。值得注意的是，APPLE-MS 能够对 GLP-1 受体复合物进行原位作图，展示了其在膜 PPI 研究中的独特功能。这种多功能方法通过提供全面的、生理相关的 PPI 网络推进了相互作用组研究，为机制发现和治疗靶向开辟了新的机会。

articles.title: The KASH protein UNC-83 differentially regulates kinesin-1 activity to control developmental stage-specific nuclear migration.
articles.titleZh: KASH 蛋白 UNC-83 差异性调节驱动蛋白-1 活性，以控制发育阶段特异性核迁移。
articles.authors: Gümüşderelioğlu S, Sahabandu N, Elnatan D, Gregory EF, Chiba K, Niwa S, Luxton GWG, McKenney RJ, Starr DA.
articles.abstract: Nuclear migration plays a fundamental role in development, requiring precise spatiotemporal control of bidirectional movement through dynein and kinesin motors. Here, we uncover a differential isoform-dependent mechanism for developmental regulation of nuclear migration directionality. The nuclear envelope Klarsicht/ANC-1/Syne homology (KASH) protein UNC-83 in Caenorhabditis elegans exists in multiple isoforms that differentially control motor activity to achieve tissue-specific nuclear positioning. The shorter UNC-83c isoform promotes kinesin-1-dependent nuclear movement in embryonic hyp7 precursors, while longer UNC-83a/b isoforms facilitate dynein-mediated nuclear migration in larval P cells. We demonstrate that the UNC-83a-specific N-terminal domain functions as a kinesin-1 inhibitory module by directly binding the kinesin heavy chain (UNC-116). This interaction prevents kinesin-1 activation and reduces the protein's affinity for kinesin light chain (KLC-2), allowing for dynein-mediated transport. By contrast, UNC-83c exhibits high-affinity binding to KLC-2, promoting kinesin-1 activation for plus-end-directed movement. AlphaFold structural predictions reveal that UNC-83 contains five spectrin-like repeats, with two located within the inhibitory N-terminal domain. Genetic analysis demonstrates that these spectrin-like repeats are essential for dynein-dependent P cell nuclear migration but dispensable for kinesin-1-dependent hyp7 migration. This isoform-specific inhibition, combined with differential affinity for KLC-2, establishes a mechanism for achieving directional control of nuclear positioning during development. Together, these interdisciplinary studies reveal how alternative isoforms of cargo adaptors can generate developmental stage-specific regulation of motor activity.
articles.abstractZh: 核迁移在发育中发挥着重要作用，需要通过动力蛋白和驱动蛋白马达对双向运动进行精确的时空控制。在这里，我们发现了核迁移方向性发育调控的差异亚型依赖性机制。秀丽隐杆线虫中的核膜 Klarsicht/ANC-1/Syne 同源 (KASH) 蛋白 UNC-83 存在于多种同种型中，这些同种型可差异控制运动活动以实现组织特异性核定位。较短的UNC-83c亚型促进胚胎hyp7前体中驱动蛋白1依赖性核运动，而较长的UNC-83a/b亚型促进幼虫P细胞中动力蛋白介导的核迁移。我们证明了 UNC-83a 特异性 N 末端结构域通过直接结合驱动蛋白重链 (UNC-116) 作为驱动蛋白-1 抑制模块。这种相互作用可防止驱动蛋白-1 激活并降低该蛋白对驱动蛋白轻链 (KLC-2) 的亲和力，从而允许动力蛋白介导的运输。相比之下，UNC-83c 表现出与 KLC-2 的高亲和力结合，促进驱动蛋白-1 激活，以实现正端定向运动。 AlphaFold 结构预测表明 UNC-83 包含

articles.title: Gene delivery in mosquitos with a vesicular stomatitis virus vector.
articles.titleZh: 使用水泡性口炎病毒载体向蚊子传递基因。
articles.authors: Zhang Y, Wang X, Qi H, Yuan F, Li H, Hu Q, Zou Z, Zheng A.
articles.abstract: Gain- and loss-of-function techniques are essential for comprehensive investigation of gene function. In mosquitoes, effective loss-of-function (LOF) methods such as RNA interference and gene knockout are available. However, convenient and practical methodologies for gain-of-function (GOF) are currently lacking. Here, we developed the vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV) vector as a GOF delivery system, which efficiently delivers target genes in mosquito Aedes aegypti without affect their fitness. Importantly, by tactically altering the insertion site of target genes within the VSV vector, we can control the relative levels of transcription. This VSV-mediated method resulted in the corresponding phenotypic changes in mosquitoes overexpressing target genes compared to controls. Additionally, we discovered that VSV could infect various orders of insects, including fruit flies (Diptera), fall armyworms (Lepidoptera), and beetles (Coleoptera), highlighting its potential as a versatile gene delivery platform across insect species.
articles.abstractZh: 功能获得和丧失技术对于基因功能的全面研究至关重要。在蚊子中，可以使用有效的功能丧失（LOF）方法，例如RNA干扰和基因敲除。然而，目前缺乏方便实用的功能增益（GOF）方法。在这里，我们开发了水泡性口炎病毒（VSV）载体作为GOF传递系统，该系统可以有效地将目标基因传递到埃及伊蚊中，而不影响其适应性。重要的是，通过策略性地改变 VSV 载体内靶基因的插入位点，我们可以控制转录的相对水平。与对照相比，这种 VSV 介导的方法导致过度表达靶基因的蚊子发生相应的表型变化。此外，我们发现 VSV 可以感染多种昆虫，包括果蝇（双翅目）、秋粘虫（鳞翅目）和甲虫（鞘翅目），凸显了其作为跨昆虫物种的多功能基因传递平台的潜力。

articles.title: Cracking the mysteries of resistance to sheath blight disease: SBRR1 plays a pivotal role.
articles.titleZh: 破解纹枯病抗性之谜：SBRR1 发挥着关键作用。
articles.authors: Zhang Y, Wang D, Fu ZQ, Que Y.

articles.title: ADSL deficiency is a secondary mitochondrial disease affecting organelle homeostasis and ERK2/AKT signaling in a linear genotype-phenotype relation.
articles.titleZh: ADSL 缺陷是一种继发性线粒体疾病，影响细胞器稳态和线性基因型-表型关系中的 ERK2/AKT 信号传导。
articles.authors: Bordi M, Testa B, Compagnucci C, Colasuonno F, Cipressa F, Betterini E, Mancini A, Carsetti C, Salvatori I, Ferraina C, Yang M, De Cegli R, Del Prete E, Veroni C, Rizza S, Mauri S, Ziviani E, Macchiaiolo M, Vecchio D, Panfili FM, Rizza T, Weber G, Carrozzo R, Ferri A, Campello S, Ballabio A, Frezza C, Cestra G, Tartaglia M, Bartuli A, Cecconi F.
articles.abstract: Adenylosuccinate lyase deficiency (ADSLd) is a rare autosomal recessive purine metabolism disorder with several clinical manifestations. While toxic substrate accumulation is a known hallmark, no additional molecular mechanisms have been established. Here, we show that ADSLd is associated with mitochondrial dysfunction, including increased fragmentation, impaired respiration, and reduced ATP production. The severity of mitochondrial impairment correlates with ADSLd pathology, especially in mitochondria-dependent tissues. We also identify defects in mitochondrial dynamics and transport linked to ERK2 and AKT suppression. Notably, overexpressing constitutively active ERK2 or supplementing purine intermediates partially rescues the mitochondrial phenotype. These findings suggest an alternative disease mechanism and highlight mitochondrial metabolism as a potential therapeutic target in ADSLd.
articles.abstractZh: 腺苷琥珀酸裂解酶缺乏症（ADSLd）是一种罕见的常染色体隐性遗传性嘌呤代谢紊乱，具有多种临床表现。虽然有毒底物积累是一个已知的标志，但尚未建立其他分子机制。在这里，我们发现 ADSLd 与线粒体功能障碍有关，包括碎片增加、呼吸受损和 ATP 产生减少。线粒体损伤的严重程度与 ADSLd 病理相关，尤其是在线粒体依赖性组织中。我们还发现了与 ERK2 和 AKT 抑制相关的线粒体动力学和运输缺陷。值得注意的是，过表达组成型活性 ERK2 或补充嘌呤中间体可以部分挽救线粒体表型。这些发现提出了另一种疾病机制，并强调线粒体代谢是 ADSLd 的潜在治疗靶点。

articles.title: Computational design of potent and selective binders of BAK and BAX.
articles.titleZh: BAK 和 BAX 的有效和选择性结合剂的计算设计。
articles.authors: Berger S, Lee EF, Harris TJ, Tran S, Bera AK, Arguinchona L, Kang A, Sankaran B, Kasapgil S, Miller MS, Smyth S, Lutfi M, Uren RT, Kluck RM, Colman PM, Fairlie WD, Czabotar PE, Baker D, Birkinshaw RW.
articles.abstract: Potent and selective binders of the key proapoptotic proteins BAK and BAX have not been described. We use computational protein design to generate high affinity binders of BAK and BAX with greater than 100-fold specificity for their target. Both binders activate their targets when at low concentration, driving pore formation, but inhibit membrane permeabilization when in excess. Crystallography shows that the BAK binder induces BAK unfolding, exposing the α6 helix and BH3 domain. Together, these data suggest that upon binding, BAK or BAX unfold; at high binder concentrations, self-association of the partially folded BAK or BAX proteins is blocked and the membrane remains intact, whereas at low concentrations, dimers form, and the membrane ruptures. Our designed binders modulate apoptosis via direct, specific interactions with BAK and BAX and reveal that for therapeutic strategies targeting BAK and BAX, inhibition requires saturating binder concentrations at the site of action.
articles.abstractZh: 关键促凋亡蛋白 BAK 和 BAX 的有效和选择性结合剂尚未被描述。我们使用计算蛋白质设计来生成 BAK 和 BAX 的高亲和力结合物，其靶点特异性超过 100 倍。两种结合剂在低浓度时都会激活其靶标，促进孔的形​​成，但在浓度过高时会抑制膜透化。晶体学显示 BAK 结合剂诱导 BAK 解折叠，暴露 α6 螺旋和 BH3 结构域。总之，这些数据表明，结合后，BAK 或 BAX 展开；在高结合剂浓度下，部分折叠的 BAK 或 BAX 蛋白的自缔合被阻断，膜保持完整，而在低浓度下，形成二聚体，膜破裂。我们设计的结合剂通过与 BAK 和 BAX 的直接、特异性相互作用来调节细胞凋亡，并表明对于针对 BAK 和 BAX 的治疗策略，抑制需要作用位点的结合剂浓度达到饱和。

articles.title: SIFamide-dependent synaptic plasticity in male-specific GABAergic neurons underlies experience-modulated mating behaviors.
articles.titleZh: 雄性特异性 GABA 能神经元中的 SIFamide 依赖性突触可塑性是经验调节交配行为的基础。
articles.authors: Zhang T, Miao H, Song Y, Wu Z, Kim WJ.
articles.abstract: Drosophila melanogaster relies on complex brain circuits and neuromodulation for experience-dependent sexual behavior, yet the role of neuropeptide signaling in behavioral refinement remains unclear. We investigate SIFamide (SIFa) and its receptor (SIFaR) in regulating male Drosophila sexual behavior. SIFaR is essential for these behaviors, particularly interval timing. Knockdown in fru-positive neurons impairs courtship index (CI) and mating duration (MD) but not copulation latency (CL). Critically, SIFaR in GABAergic mAL neurons (fru+, dsx-) specifically controls MD and CI, not CL. Additionally, SIFa signaling in mAL neurons of experienced males increases presynaptic terminals, indicating context-dependent synaptic plasticity. These results reveal a complex SIFa/SIFaR interaction with specific neurons in modulating male behavior. The distinct roles of SIFaR in fru-positive versus other neurons, alongside its plasticity function, provide new insights into neural mechanisms of context-dependent behavioral adaptation.
articles.abstractZh: 果蝇依赖于复杂的大脑回路和神经调节来实现依赖于经验的性行为，但神经肽信号传导在行为细化中的作用仍不清楚。我们研究西福酰胺（SIFa）及其受体（SIFaR）在调节雄性果蝇性行为中的作用。 SIFaR 对于这些行为至关重要，尤其是间隔计时。 fru 阳性神经元的敲低会损害求偶指数 (CI) 和交配持续时间 (MD)，但不会损害交配潜伏期 (CL)。重要的是，GABA能mAL神经元（fru+、dsx-）中的SIFaR特异性控制MD和CI，而不是CL。此外，经验丰富的男性 mAL 神经元中的 SIFa 信号传导会增加突触前末梢，表明突触可塑性与环境相关。这些结果揭示了 SIFa/SIFaR 与特定神经元在调节男性行为方面的复杂相互作用。 SIFaR 在 fru 阳性神经元与其他神经元中的独特作用及其可塑性功能，为背景依赖性行为适应的神经机制提供了新的见解。

articles.title: TaGW2-TaVOZ1 module regulates wheat salt tolerance via both E3 ligase-dependent and -independent pathways.
articles.titleZh: TaGW2-TaVOZ1 模块通过 E3 连接酶依赖性和非依赖性途径调节小麦耐盐性。
articles.authors: Li S, Zhang P, Wang X, Feng W, Zhu H, Qin Z, Chen B, Wang C, Nie X, Kang Z, Mao H.
articles.abstract: Wheat production is limited by the rapid expansion of salinized arable land worldwide. Identification of the molecular mechanisms that underlie the salt stress response is of great importance. Here, we uncovered the NAC-type transcription factor, TaVOZ1, as a positive regulator of wheat salt tolerance. Its overexpression could enhance yield and biomass production under salt stress, while TaVOZ1 knockdown attenuates salt tolerance. TaVOZ1 transcriptionally activates stress-responsive genes, especially HKT1-family transporters, decreasing shoot Na+ accumulation. However, the RING-type E3 ligase, TaGW2, directly interacts with and ubiquitinates TaVOZ1, promoting its ubiquitin/26S proteasomal degradation. TaGW2 overexpression reduces salt tolerance, while its knockdown or knockout enhances wheat response to salt stress. Moreover, we found a moonlight function of TaGW2 wherein it binds the same DNA motifs as TaVOZ1 to block its up-regulation of HKT1-family genes while coordinately governing both the salt tolerance and grain yield. This study highlights the functional versatility of TaGW2 and defines an antagonistic TaGW2-TaVOZ1 regulatory module in wheat salt tolerance.
articles.abstractZh: 小麦产量因全球盐碱化耕地的迅速扩张而受到限制。识别盐胁迫反应的分子机制非常重要。在这里，我们发现了 NAC 型转录因子 TaVOZ1，作为小麦耐盐性的正调节因子。它的过度表达可以提高盐胁迫下的产量和生物量，而 TaVOZ1 敲低会减弱耐盐性。 TaVOZ1 转录激活应激反应基因，尤其是 HKT1 家族转运蛋白，减少芽 Na+ 积累。然而，RING 型 E3 连接酶 TaGW2 直接与 TaVOZ1 相互作用并泛素化，促进其泛素/26S 蛋白酶体降解。 TaGW2 过表达会降低耐盐性，而其敲低或敲除则会增强小麦对盐胁迫的反应。此外，我们发现TaGW2的月光功能，其中它结合与TaVOZ1相同的DNA基序，阻断其HKT1家族基因的上调，同时协调控制耐盐性和谷物产量。这项研究强调了 TaGW2 的功能多功能性，并定义了小麦耐盐性中的拮抗 TaGW2-TaVOZ1 调节模块。

articles.title: Phytochrome B stabilizes the KNOX transcription factor BP/KNAT1 to promote light-initiated seed germination in Arabidopsis thaliana.
articles.titleZh: 光敏色素 B 稳定 KNOX 转录因子 BP/KNAT1，促进拟南芥种子萌发。
articles.authors: Gu D, Wang Y, Zhao M, Chen H, Wu S, Jin X, Deng L, Ji R, Xu J, Zheng F, Liu X.
articles.abstract: Seed germination represents a critical step in the life cycle of plants. The far-red/red light photoreceptor phytochrome B (phyB) plays a dominant role in promoting germination by modulating gibberellin (GA) and abscisic acid (ABA) metabolism, although the underlying mechanism remains poorly understood. In this study, we identified BREVIPEDICELLUS (BP)/KNAT1, a KNOX transcription factor that acts downstream of phyB and activates light-initiated seed germination in Arabidopsis thaliana. BP undergoes ubiquitination and is degraded through the 26S proteasome pathway. phyB directly interacts with BP and stabilizes BP protein by decreasing its ubiquitination in imbibed seeds. A genome-wide transcriptomic analysis revealed that BP and phyB co-regulate the expression of genes associated with ABA biosynthesis, signal transduction, seed dormancy, and cell wall organization. BP suppresses the expression of two key ABA biosynthetic genes, NCED6 and NCED9, thus lowering ABA levels in imbibed seeds under phyB-activated conditions. BP directly binds to NCED6 and NCED9 and represses their expression by increasing the levels of H3K27me3, a repressive histone modification marker. Genetic analysis demonstrated that NCED6/NCED9 acts epistatic to BP in phyB-dependent germination. Overall, this study reveals a transcriptional module consisting of phyB-BP-NCED6/9, which transfers light signals that inhibit ABA biosynthesis, thereby promoting light-induced germination.
