articles.abstractZh: 种子发芽代表植物生命周期的关键步骤。远红/红光感受器光敏色素 B (phyB) 通过调节赤霉素 (GA) 和脱落酸 (ABA) 代谢在促进发芽中发挥主导作用，但其潜在机制仍知之甚少。在这项研究中，我们鉴定了 BREVIPEDICELLUS (BP)/KNAT1，这是一种 KNOX 转录因子，作用于 phyB 下游并激活拟南芥中光引发的种子萌发。 BP 经历泛素化并通过 26S 蛋白酶体途径降解。 phyB 直接与 BP 相互作用，并通过减少吸液种子中 BP 蛋白的泛素化来稳定 BP 蛋白。全基因组转录组分析表明，BP 和 phyB 共同调节与 ABA 生物合成、信号转导、种子休眠和细胞壁组织相关的基因的表达。 BP 抑制两个关键的 ABA 生物合成基因 NCED6 和 NCED9 的表达，从而降低在 phyB 激活条件下吸收种子中的 ABA 水平。 BP 直接结合 NCED6 和 NCED9，并通过增加 H3K27me3（一种抑制性组蛋白修饰标记）的水平来抑制它们的表达。遗传分析d

articles.title: Commensal yeast promotes Salmonella Typhimurium virulence.
articles.titleZh: 共生酵母可促进鼠伤寒沙门氏菌的毒力。
articles.authors: Jaswal K, Todd OA, Flores Audelo RC, Santus W, Paul S, Duffy CM, Eshoo ET, Singh M, Miao J, Underhill DM, Peters BM, Behnsen J.
articles.abstract: Enteric pathogens engage in complex interactions with the host and the resident microbiota to establish gut colonization1-3. Although mechanistic interactions between enteric pathogens and bacterial commensals have been extensively studied, whether and how commensal fungi affect enteric infections remain largely unknown1. Here we show that colonization with the common human gut commensal fungus Candida albicans worsened infections with the enteric pathogen Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serovar Typhimurium. The presence of C. albicans in the mouse gut increased Salmonella caecal colonization and systemic dissemination. We investigated the underlying mechanism and found that Salmonella binds to C. albicans via type 1 fimbriae and uses its type 3 secretion system to deliver effector proteins into C. albicans. A specific effector, SopB, was sufficient to manipulate C. albicans metabolism and trigger the release of millimolar amounts of arginine into the extracellular environment. The released arginine, in turn, induced expression of the type 3 secretion system in Salmonella, increasing its invasion of epithelial cells. C. albicans deficient in arginine production was unable to increase Salmonella virulence. Arginine-producing C. albicans also dampened the inflammatory response during Salmonella infection. Arginine supplementation in the absence of C. albicans increased the systemic spread of Salmonella and decreased the inflammatory response, phenocopying the presence of C. albicans. In summary, we identified C. albicans colonization as a susceptibility factor for disseminated Salmonella infection and arginine as a central metabolite in the cross-kingdom interaction between fungi, bacteria and host.
articles.abstractZh: 肠道病原体与宿主和常驻微生物群发生复杂的相互作用，以建立肠道定植1-3。尽管肠道病原体和细菌共生体之间的机制相互作用已被广泛研究，但共生真菌是否以及如何影响肠道感染仍然很大程度上未知。在这里，我们表明，常见的人类肠道共生真菌白色念珠菌的定植加重了肠道病原体沙门氏菌肠道亚种的感染。鼠伤寒肠血清型。小鼠肠道中白色念珠菌的存在增加了沙门氏菌盲肠定植和全身传播。我们研究了潜在的机制，发现沙门氏菌通过 1 型菌毛与白色念珠菌结合，并利用其 3 型分泌系统将效应蛋白传递到白色念珠菌中。一种特定的效应子 SopB 足以操纵白色念珠菌的新陈代谢并触发毫摩尔量的精氨酸释放到细胞外环境中。释放的精氨酸反过来诱导沙门氏菌3型分泌系统的表达，增加其对上皮细胞的侵袭。缺乏精氨酸生产的白色念珠菌无法进入

articles.title: Cross-feeding percolation phase transitions of intercellular metabolic networks.
articles.titleZh: 细胞间代谢网络的交叉喂养渗滤相变。
articles.authors: Latoski LCF, De Martino A, De Martino D.
articles.abstract: Intercellular cross-talk is essential for the adaptation capabilities of populations of cells. While direct diffusion-driven cell-to-cell exchanges are difficult to map, current nanotechnology enables one to probe single-cell exchanges with the medium. We introduce a mathematical method to reconstruct the dynamic unfolding of intercellular exchange networks from these data, applying it to an experimental coculture system. The exchange network, initially dense, progressively fragments into small disconnected clusters. To explain these dynamics, we develop a maximum-entropy multicellular metabolic model with diffusion-driven exchanges. The model predicts a transition from a dense network to a sparse one as nutrient consumption shifts. We characterize this crossover both numerically, revealing a power-law decay in the cluster-size distribution, and analytically, by connecting to percolation theory. Comparison with data suggests that populations evolve toward the sparse phase by remaining near the crossover. These findings offer insights into the collective organization driving the adaptive dynamics of cell populations.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞间串扰对于细胞群的适应能力至关重要。虽然直接扩散驱动的细胞间交换很难绘制，但当前的纳米技术使人们能够探测单细胞与介质的交换。我们引入了一种数学方法，可以根据这些数据重建细胞间交换网络的动态展开，并将其应用于实验共培养系统。最初密集的交换网络逐渐分裂成互不相连的小集群。为了解释这些动力学，我们开发了具有扩散驱动交换的最大熵多细胞代谢模型。该模型预测，随着营养消耗的变化，网络会从密集网络转变为稀疏网络。我们通过数字方式描述了这种交叉，揭示了簇大小分布的幂律衰减，并通过连接渗流理论进行分析。与数据的比较表明，种群通过保持在交叉附近而向稀疏阶段进化。这些发现提供了对驱动细胞群适应性动态的集体组织的见解。

articles.title: DNA2 enables growth by restricting recombination-restarted replication.
articles.titleZh: DNA2 通过限制重组重新启动的复制来促进生长。
articles.authors: Hudson JJR, Appanah R, Jones D, Davidson K, Budden AM, Vaitsiankova A, Chan KL, Caldecott KW, Carr AM, Rass U.
articles.abstract: Nuclease-helicase DNA2 is a multifunctional genome caretaker that is essential for cell proliferation in a range of organisms, from yeast to human1-4. Bi-allelic DNA2 mutations that reduce DNA2 concentrations cause a spectrum of primordial dwarfism disorders, including Seckel and Rothmund-Thomson-related syndromes5-7. By contrast, cancer cells frequently express high concentrations of DNA2 (refs. 8-11). The mechanism that precludes cell proliferation in the absence of DNA2 and the molecular aetiology of DNA2-linked diseases remain elusive. Here we used yeast and human cells to demonstrate that DNA2 suppresses homologous recombination-restarted replication and checkpoint activation at stalled DNA replication forks. Loss of this control mechanism upon degradation of DNA2 in human cells causes recombination-dependent DNA synthesis and build-up of RPA-bound single-stranded DNA in the G2 phase of the cell cycle. Consequently, DNA2 deprivation triggers the DNA damage checkpoint and invariably leads to ATR-p21-dependent cell-cycle exit before mitosis. These findings explain why DNA2 is essential for cell proliferation and reveal that replication fork processing to restrict recombination is indispensable for avoiding cellular senescence. Stochastic entry into senescence stifles the proliferative potential of cells following the expression of a Seckel syndrome patient-derived DNA2 hypomorph or partial degradation of DNA2, providing a conceptual framework to explain global growth failure in DNA2-linked primordial dwarfism disorders.
articles.abstractZh: 核酸酶-解旋酶 DNA2 是一种多功能基因组守护者，对于从酵母到人类等一系列生物体的细胞增殖至关重要1-4。降低 DNA2 浓度的双等位基因 DNA2 突变会导致一系列原始侏儒症，包括 Seckel 和 Rothmund-Thomson 相关综合征 5-7。相比之下，癌细胞经常表达高浓度的 DNA2（参考文献 8-11）。在缺乏 DNA2 的情况下阻止细胞增殖的机制以及 DNA2 相关疾病的分子病因学仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们使用酵母和人类细胞来证明 DNA2 抑制同源重组重启复制和停滞的 DNA 复制叉处的检查点激活。人类细胞中 DNA2 降解后失去这种控制机制会导致重组依赖性 DNA 合成，并在细胞周期的 G2 期形成 RPA 结合的单链 DNA。因此，DNA2 剥夺会触发 DNA 损伤检查点，并总是导致 ATR-p21 依赖性细胞周期在有丝分裂前退出。这些发现解释了为什么 DNA2 对于细胞增殖至关重要，并揭示了限制重组的复制叉处理

articles.title: Heightened innate immunity may trigger chronic inflammation, fatigue and post-exertional malaise in ME/CFS.
articles.titleZh: 先天免疫力的增强可能会引发 ME/CFS 的慢性炎症、疲劳和劳累后不适。
articles.authors: Che X, Ranjan A, Guo C, Zhang K, Goldsmith R, Levine S, Moneghetti KJ, Zhai Y, Ge L, Mishra N, Hornig M, Bateman L, Klimas NG, Montoya JG, Peterson DL, Klein SL, Fiehn O, Komaroff AL, Lipkin WI.
articles.abstract: Myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome (ME/CFS) is characterized by unexplained fatigue, post-exertional malaise (PEM), and cognitive dysfunction. ME/CFS patients often report a prodrome consistent with infection. We present a multi-omics analysis based on plasma metabolomic and proteomic profiling, and immune responses to microbial stimulation, before and after exercise. We report evidence of an exaggerated innate immune response after exposure to microbial antigens; impaired energy production involving the citric acid cycle, beta-oxidation of fatty acids, and urea cycle energy production from amino acids; systemic inflammation linked to lipid abnormalities; disrupted extracellular matrix homeostasis with release of endogenous ligands that promote inflammation; reduced cell-cell adhesion and associated gut dysbiosis; complement activation; redox imbalance reflected by disturbances in copper-dependent antioxidant pathways; and dysregulation of tryptophan-serotonin-kynurenine pathways. Many abnormalities were worse following exercise and correlated with the intensity of symptoms. Our findings may inform development of targeted therapeutic interventions for ME/CFS and PEM.
articles.abstractZh: 肌痛性脑脊髓炎/慢性疲劳综合征（ME/CFS）的特点是不明原因的疲劳、劳力后不适（PEM）和认知功能障碍。 ME/CFS 患者经常报告与感染一致的前驱症状。我们提出了基于血浆代谢组学和蛋白质组学分析以及运动前后对微生物刺激的免疫反应的多组学分析。我们报告了暴露于微生物抗原后夸大的先天免疫反应的证据；涉及柠檬酸循环、脂肪酸β-氧化和氨基酸尿素循环能量产生的能量产生受损；与脂质异常相关的全身炎症；破坏细胞外基质稳态，释放内源性配体，促进炎症；细胞间粘附力降低和相关肠道菌群失调；补体激活；铜依赖性抗氧化途径的紊乱反映了氧化还原失衡；以及色氨酸-血清素-犬尿氨酸途径的失调。许多异常现象在运动后会变得更严重，并且与症状的强度相关。我们的研究结果可能为 ME/CFS 和 PEM 的靶向治疗干预措施的开发提供信息

articles.title: Multiple overlapping binding sites determine transcription factor occupancy.
articles.titleZh: 多个重叠的结合位点决定转录因子的占据。
articles.authors: Khetan S, Carroll BS, Bulyk ML.
articles.abstract: Transcription factors (TFs) regulate gene expression by interacting with DNA in a sequence-specific manner. High-throughput in vitro technologies, such as protein-binding microarrays1-6 and HT-SELEX (high-throughput systematic evolution of ligands by exponential enrichment)7,8, have revealed the DNA-binding specificities of hundreds of TFs. However, they have limited ability to reliably identify lower-affinity DNA binding sites, which are increasingly recognized as important for precise spatiotemporal control of gene expression9-19. Here, to address this limitation, we developed protein affinity to DNA by in vitro transcription and RNA sequencing (PADIT-seq), with which we comprehensively assayed the binding preferences of six TFs to all possible ten-base-pair DNA sequences, detecting hundreds of novel, lower-affinity binding sites. The expanded repertoire of lower-affinity binding sites revealed that nucleotides flanking high-affinity DNA binding sites create overlapping lower-affinity sites that together modulate TF genomic occupancy in vivo. We propose a model in which TF binding is not determined by individual binding sites, but rather by the sum of multiple, overlapping binding sites. The overlapping binding model explains how competition between paralogous TFs for shared high-affinity binding sites is determined by flanking nucleotides that create differential numbers of overlapping, lower-affinity binding sites. Critically, the model transforms our understanding of noncoding-variant effects, revealing how single nucleotide changes simultaneously alter multiple overlapping sites to additively influence gene expression and human traits, including diseases.
articles.abstractZh: 转录因子 (TF) 通过以序列特异性方式与 DNA 相互作用来调节基因表达。高通量体外技术，例如蛋白质结合微阵列1-6和HT-SELEX（通过指数富集进行配体的高通量系统进化）7,8，已经揭示了数百个TF的DNA结合特异性。然而，它们可靠地识别低亲和力 DNA 结合位点的能力有限，而人们越来越认识到这些位点对于基因表达的精确时空控制非常重要9-19。为了解决这一限制，我们通过体外转录和 RNA 测序 (PADIT-seq) 开发了蛋白质对 DNA 的亲和力，通过这种方法，我们全面分析了 6 个 TF 与所有可能的 10 碱基对 DNA 序列的结合偏好，检测了数百个新颖的低亲和力结合位点。低亲和力结合位点的扩展表明，高亲和力 DNA 结合位点侧翼的核苷酸会产生重叠的低亲和力位点，这些位点共同调节体内 TF 基因组的占据。我们提出了一个模型，其中 TF 结合不是由单个结合位点决定的，而是由多个重叠结合位点的总和决定的

articles.title: Natural variation in the GhTTL promoter modulates cotton fiber elongation through the GhTALE-GhTTL-GhBIN2 module.
articles.titleZh: GhTTL 启动子的自然变异通过 GhTALE-GhTTL-GhBIN2 模块调节棉纤维伸长。
articles.authors: Liu L, Liu Z, Fan L, Yu M, Qanmber G, Wang L, Li Y, Li F, Jin S, Yang Z.
articles.abstract: In cotton, fiber length is a key determinant of industrial utility and is one of the most important agricultural traits shaped during domestication. However, the genetic determinants and molecular mechanisms underlying natural variation in fiber length remain poorly characterized. In this study, we identified GhTTL as a critical positive regulator of fiber elongation through genome-wide association study (GWAS). Natural polymorphisms in the cis-regulatory element of the GhTTL promoter region were found to significantly affect its binding affinity for the transcription factor GhTALE, thereby modulating GhTTL expression across diverse cotton populations. Mechanistic investigations revealed that GhTTL interacts with GhBIN2, a central negative regulator of the brassinosteroid (BR) signaling pathway, and anchors it to the cell membrane. This reduces cytoplasmic GhBIN2 levels, preventing it from associating with GhBES1, a master transcription factor of BR signaling. As a result, GhBES1 localizes to the nucleus, where it promotes fiber cell elongation. These findings elucidate the molecular basis of natural variation in cotton fiber length and provide deeper insights into the regulation of fiber elongation. In addition, this study identifies potential targets for genetic improvement to enhance cotton fiber quality and yield.
articles.abstractZh: 在棉花中，纤维长度是工业效用的关键决定因素，也是驯化过程中形成的最重要的农业性状之一。然而，纤维长度自然变化的遗传决定因素和分子机制仍然知之甚少。在这项研究中，我们通过全基因组关联研究 (GWAS) 确定 GhTTL 是纤维伸长的关键正调节因子。研究发现 GhTTL 启动子区域顺式调控元件的天然多态性显着影响其与转录因子 GhTALE 的结合亲和力，从而调节不同棉花群体中的 GhTTL 表达。机制研究表明，GhTTL 与油菜素类固醇 (BR) 信号通路的中央负调节因子 GhBIN2 相互作用，并将其锚定在细胞膜上。这会降低细胞质 GhBIN2 水平，阻止其与 BR 信号转导的主要转录因子 GhBES1 结合。结果，GhBES1 定位于细胞核，促进纤维细胞伸长。这些发现阐明了棉纤维长度自然变化的分子基础，并为棉纤维长度的调节提供了更深入的见解。

articles.title: Organ-level gene-regulatory networks inferred from transcriptomic data reveal context-specific regulation and highlight novel regulators of ripening and ABA-mediated responses in tomato.
articles.titleZh: 从转录组数据推断的器官水平基因调控网络揭示了特定环境的调控，并突出了番茄成熟和 ABA 介导反应的新调控因子。
articles.authors: Fernández JD, Navarro-Payá D, Santiago A, Cerda A, Canan J, Contreras-Riquelme S, Moyano TC, Landaeta-Sepúlveda D, Melet L, Canales J, Johnson NR, Álvarez JM, Matus JT, Vidal EA.
articles.abstract: Tomato (Solanum lycopersicum) is a globally important crop, yet the gene-regulatory networks (GRNs) that control its gene expression remain poorly understood. In this study, we constructed GRNs for roots, leaves, flowers, fruits, and seeds by inferring transcription factor (TF)-target interactions from over 10 000 RNA-sequencing libraries using the GENIE3 algorithm. We refined these networks using gene co-expression data and computational predictions of TF binding sites. Our networks confirmed key regulators in important processes, including TOMATO AGAMOUS LIKE 1 and RIPENING INHIBITOR in fruit ripening, and SlABF2, SlABF3, and SlABF5 in abscisic acid (ABA) response in leaves. In addition, we identified novel candidate regulators, including AUXIN RESPONSE FACTOR 2A and ETHYLENE RESPONSE FACTOR E2 in fruit ripening and G-BOX BINDING FACTOR 3 (SlGBF3) in ABA-related and drought pathways. To further validate the GRNs, we performed DNA affinity purification sequencing for SlGBF3 and confirmed the accuracy of our GRN predictions. This study provides a valuable resource for dissecting transcriptional regulation in tomato, with potential applications in crop improvement. The GRNs are publicly accessible through a user-friendly web platform at https://plantaeviz.tomsbiolab.com/tomviz.
articles.abstractZh: 番茄（Solanum lycopersicum）是一种全球重要的作物，但控制其基因表达的基因调控网络（GRN）仍然知之甚少。在这项研究中，我们使用 GENIE3 算法从 10000 多个 RNA 测序文库中推断转录因子 (TF)-靶标相互作用，构建了根、叶、花、果实和种子的 GRN。我们使用基因共表达数据和 TF 结合位点的计算预测来完善这些网络。我们的网络确认了重要过程中的关键调节因子，包括果实成熟中的 TOMATO AGAMOUS LIKE 1 和 RIPENING IHIBITOR，以及叶片脱落酸 (ABA) 反应中的 SlABF2、SlABF3 和 SlABF5。此外，我们还确定了新的候选调节因子，包括果实成熟中的生长素响应因子 2A 和乙烯响应因子 E2，以及 ABA 相关和干旱途径中的 G-BOX 结合因子 3 (SlGBF3)。为了进一步验证 GRN，我们对 SlGBF3 进行了 DNA 亲和纯化测序，并证实了我们 GRN 预测的准确性。这项研究为剖析番茄转录调控提供了宝贵的资源，并在作物改良方面具有潜在的应用。 GRN 已公开

articles.title: The discovery of a <i>Legionella</i> phage explains a key determinant of human disease.
articles.titleZh: 军团菌噬菌体的发现解释了人类疾病的关键决定因素。
articles.authors: Nicholson B, Santé JF, Chaney EH, Deme JC, Deecker SR, Sztanko K, Davidson AR, Lea SM, Ensminger AW.
articles.abstract: Host cells provide intracellular bacteria with protection from harsh environmental conditions and immune responses, but for many intracellular pathogens, this protection does not appear to be absolute as once thought. Bacteriophages that can kill bacteria inside host cells have been identified for pathogens including Salmonella, Mycobacterium, and Chlamydia species. Even in pathogens for which no stable phages have been isolated, such as Legionella pneumophila, the presence of phage defense systems suggests phage susceptibility. Here, we report the stable isolation of Legionella bacteriophage LME-1 (Legionella mobile element-1) and its impact on bacterial virulence in humans. Cryo-electron microscopy of the capsid (2.1 angstroms) and portal-tail complex (1.9 angstroms) reveals an unambiguous phage particle with T7-like morphology. Characterizing the host range of this phage, we make a serendipitous finding that links the acquisition of a phage defense mechanism to the formation of a virulent clade of L. pneumophila responsible for 80% of all Legionnaires' disease.
articles.abstractZh: 宿主细胞为细胞内细菌提供免受恶劣环境条件和免疫反应的保护，但对于许多细胞内病原体来说，这种保护似乎并不像人们曾经认为的那样是绝对的。已经鉴定出可以杀死宿主细胞内细菌的噬菌体，可杀死包括沙门氏菌、分枝杆菌和衣原体在内的病原体。即使在尚未分离出稳定噬菌体的病原体（例如嗜肺军团菌）中，噬菌体防御系统的存在也表明噬菌体具有敏感性。在这里，我们报告了军团菌噬菌体 LME-1（军团菌移动元件-1）的稳定分离及其对人类细菌毒力的影响。衣壳（2.1埃）和门尾复合物（1.9埃）的冷冻电子显微镜揭示了具有T7样形态的明确噬菌体颗粒。在表征该噬菌体的宿主范围时，我们偶然发现了噬菌体防御机制的获得与嗜肺军团菌剧毒分支的形成有关，该分支负责 80% 的军团病。

articles.title: The TaCEP15 peptide signaling cascade modulates primary root length and drought tolerance in wheat.
articles.titleZh: TaCEP15 肽信号级联调节小麦的初生根长度和耐旱性。
articles.authors: Yang W, Li R, Feng M, Qin Z, Zhang Y, Peng H, Yao Y, Hu Z, Ni Z, Song W, Qin F, Takahashi F, Sun Q, Xin M.
articles.abstract: Drought stress poses an environmental challenge affecting crop yield. Small signaling peptides play crucial roles in the regulation of stress responses in plants. Here, we unveil that the TaCEP15 peptide interacts with the leucine-rich repeat receptor-like kinase TaCEPRL. Knockout of TaCEP15 or TaCEPRL increases primary root length and enhances drought tolerance in wheat. TaCEPRL interacts with and phosphorylates TaSnRK1α, leading to the degradation of TaSnRK1α. The presence of TaCEP15 intensifies the phosphorylation and degradation of TaSnRK1α. Consistently, overexpressing TaSnRK1α boosts primary root elongation and augments drought tolerance. In addition, we identify the transcription factor TabZIP9, which binds to the TaCEP15 promoter and suppresses its transcription. A-to-T substitution in the TaCEP15 promoter decreases the binding affinity of TabZIP9. As expected, transgenic plants with TabZIP9 knockout or overexpression exhibit noteworthy changes in primary root length and drought tolerance. Our findings shed light on the importance of the peptide signaling pathway in regulating primary root length and responding to drought stress in wheat.
articles.abstractZh: 干旱胁迫带来了影响作物产量的环境挑战。小信号肽在植物应激反应的调节中发挥着至关重要的作用。在这里，我们揭示了 TaCEP15 肽与富含亮氨酸的重复受体样激酶 TaCEPRL 相互作用。 TaCEP15 或 TaCEPRL 的敲除增加了小麦的初生根长度并增强了耐旱性。 TaCEPRL 与 TaSnRK1α 相互作用并磷酸化 TaSnRK1α，导致 TaSnRK1α 降解。 TaCEP15 的存在增强了 TaSnRK1α 的磷酸化和降解。一致地，过度表达 TaSnRK1α 会促进初生根伸长并增强耐旱性。此外，我们还鉴定了转录因子 TabZIP9，它与 TaCEP15 启动子结合并抑制其转录。 TaCEP15 启动子中的 A 到 T 替换会降低 TabZIP9 的结合亲和力。正如预期的那样，TabZIP9 敲除或过表达的转基因植物在初生根长度和耐旱性方面表现出显着的变化。我们的研究结果揭示了肽信号通路在调节小麦初生根长度和应对干旱胁迫方面的重要性。

articles.title: MAPK and mTORC1 signaling converge to drive cyclin D1 protein production to enable cell cycle reentry in melanoma persister cells.
articles.titleZh: MAPK 和 mTORC1 信号传导共同驱动细胞周期蛋白 D1 蛋白的产生，从而使黑色素瘤持续细胞能够重新进入细胞周期。
articles.authors: Nangia V, Ashraf H, Marikar N, Passanisi VJ, Ill CR, Spencer SL.
articles.abstract: In BRAF-mutant melanoma cells treated with inhibitors of the kinases BRAF and MEK, a subset of cells rapidly and nongenetically adapts to escape drug-induced quiescence and reenters the cell cycle. Here, we investigated the mechanisms enabling this drug escape by computationally reconstructing single-cell lineages from time-lapse imaging data, linking dynamic signaling pathways to distinct cell-cycle fate outcomes. We found that reactivation of the MEK substrate ERK was necessary but not sufficient to drive escape; rather, the activity of the protein complex mTORC1 was also required to promote cell growth and protein synthesis in drug-treated cells destined for cell-cycle reentry. ERK and mTORC1 signaling converged to increase the abundance of cyclin D1 protein, a critical bottleneck for cell-cycle commitment under drug pressure. In cells in which endogenous cyclin D1 was fluorescently tagged using CRISPR, the subset that escaped drug treatment exhibited marked accumulation of cyclin D1 at least 15 hours before cell-cycle reentry, enabling early prediction of future drug escape. Cyclin D1 thus represents both an early biomarker and potential therapeutic target for suppressing drug escape in melanoma. We observed a similar mTORC1-driven mechanism underlying escape in lung cancer cells, but not colon cancer cells, highlighting partial generalizability across cancer types.
articles.abstractZh: 在用 BRAF 和 MEK 激酶抑制剂处理的 BRAF 突变黑色素瘤细胞中，一部分细胞快速且非遗传性地适应逃避药物诱导的静止并重新进入细胞周期。在这里，我们通过根据延时成像数据计算重建单细胞谱系，将动态信号通路与不同的细胞周期命运结果联系起来，研究了这种药物逃逸的机制。我们发现 MEK 底物 ERK 的重新激活是必要的，但不足以驱动逃逸；相反，蛋白质复合物 mTORC1 的活性也需要促进经过药物处理的细胞的细胞生长和蛋白质合成，这些细胞将重新进入细胞周期。 ERK 和 mTORC1 信号传导聚合以增加细胞周期蛋白 D1 蛋白的丰度，这是药物压力下细胞周期承诺的关键瓶颈。在使用 CRISPR 荧光标记内源性细胞周期蛋白 D1 的细胞中，逃脱药物治疗的细胞亚群在细胞周期重新进入前至少 15 小时表现出明显的细胞周期蛋白 D1 积累，从而能够及早预测未来的药物逃逸。因此，Cyclin D1 既代表了抑制药物的早期生物标志物，又代表了潜在的治疗靶点。

articles.title: Polyserine-mediated targeting of FAF2/UBXD8 ameliorates tau aggregation.
articles.titleZh: 多丝氨酸介导的 FAF2/UBXD8 靶向可改善 tau 蛋白聚集。
articles.authors: Van Alstyne M, Brown G, Nguyen VL, Ramaswami M, Hoeffer CA, Parker R.
articles.abstract: Tau aggregation is a hallmark of several neurodegenerative disorders, and the gain of toxic function of misfolded tau species is linked to pathobiology. Herein, we identified proteins that limit tau aggregation when targeted to tau aggregates by polyserine domains. Polyserine targeting was most effective at mitigating tau aggregation when fused to the vasolin-containing protein (VCP) adaptor protein fas-associated factor family member 2/UBX domain-containing protein 8 (FAF2/UBXD8). Surprisingly, FAF2/UBXD8 suppresses tau aggregation independent of VCP but does require ubiquitination, membrane localization, and a ubiquitin regulator X (UBX) domain. Validation in animal models demonstrated that polyserine-targeted FAF2/UBXD8 rescues tau-induced neurodegeneration in Drosophila. Further, delivery of targeted FAF2/UBXD8 reduced gliosis, seeding capacity, and insoluble tau levels in PS19 tau transgenic mice while improving contextual fear conditioning. Collectively, our findings highlight polyserine as a tau-targeting strategy and identify targeted FAF2/UBXD8 as a potent suppressor of tau pathology.
articles.abstractZh: Tau 蛋白聚集是多种神经退行性疾病的标志，错误折叠的 tau 蛋白种类的毒性功能的获得与病理生物学有关。在此，我们鉴定了当通过多丝氨酸结构域靶向 tau 聚集体时限制 tau 聚集的蛋白质。当与含血管素蛋白 (VCP) 接头蛋白 fas 相关因子家族成员 2/含 UBX 结构域的蛋白 8 (FAF2/UBXD8) 融合时，聚丝氨酸靶向在减轻 tau 聚集方面最为有效。令人惊讶的是，FAF2/UBXD8 独立于 VCP 抑制 tau 聚集，但确实需要泛素化、膜定位和泛素调节因子 X (UBX) 结构域。动物模型验证表明，多聚丝氨酸靶向 FAF2/UBXD8 可挽救果蝇中 tau 诱导的神经变性。此外，靶向 FAF2/UBXD8 的递送减少了 PS19 tau 转基因小鼠的神经胶质增生、播种能力和不溶性 tau 水平，同时改善了情境恐惧调节。总的来说，我们的研究结果强调了聚丝氨酸作为 tau 靶向策略，并确定靶向 FAF2/UBXD8 是 tau 病理学的有效抑制剂。

articles.title: Systematically investigating and identifying bacteriocins in the human gut microbiome.
articles.titleZh: 系统研究和鉴定人类肠道微生物组中的细菌素。
articles.authors: Zhang D, Zou Y, Shi Y, Zhang J, Liu J, Wu G, Zhang J, Gao Y, Chen M, Li YX.
articles.abstract: Human gut microbiota produces unmodified bacteriocins, natural antimicrobial peptides that protect against pathogens and regulate host physiology. However, current bioinformatic tools limit the comprehensive investigation of bacteriocins' biosynthesis, obstructing research into their biological functions. Here, we introduce IIBacFinder, a superior analysis pipeline for identifying unmodified class II bacteriocins. Through large-scale bioinformatic analysis and experimental validation, we demonstrate their widespread distribution across the bacterial kingdom, with most being habitat specific. Analyzing over 280,000 bacterial genomes, we reveal the diverse potential of human gut bacteria to produce these bacteriocins. Guided by meta-omics analysis, we synthesized 26 hypothetical bacteriocins from gut commensal species, with 16 showing antibacterial activities. Further ex vivo tests show minimal impact of narrow-spectrum bacteriocins on human fecal microbiota. Our study highlights the huge biosynthetic potential of unmodified bacteriocins in the human gut, paving the way for understanding their biological functions and health implications.
articles.abstractZh: 人类肠道微生物群产生未经修饰的细菌素、天然抗菌肽，可以抵御病原体并调节宿主生理机能。然而，现有的生物信息学工具限制了细菌素生物合成的全面研究，阻碍了对其生物学功能的研究。在这里，我们介绍 IIBacFinder，这是一种用于识别未修饰的 II 类细菌素的卓越分析管道。通过大规模生物信息分析和实验验证，我们证明了它们在整个细菌界的广泛分布，其中大多数是特定栖息地的。通过分析超过 280,000 个细菌基因组，我们揭示了人类肠道细菌产生这些细菌素的多种潜力。在元组学分析的指导下，我们从肠道共生物种中合成了 26 种假设的细菌素，其中 16 种显示出抗菌活性。进一步的离体测试表明，窄谱细菌素对人类粪便微生物群的影响极小。我们的研究强调了未经修饰的细菌素在人体肠道中的巨大生物合成潜力，为了解其生物学功能和健康影响铺平了道路。

articles.title: Epigenome editing based treatment: Progresses and challenges.
articles.titleZh: 基于表观基因组编辑的治疗：进展与挑战。
articles.authors: Yuan L, Xiong Y, Zhang Y, Gu S, Lei Y.
articles.abstract: Epigenome editing is emerging as a transformative approach in clinical treatment, enabling precise modifications to gene expression without altering the underlying DNA sequence. The ongoing transition of epigenome editing techniques from foundational research to clinical applications highlights several key strategies. These include targeted DNA methylation/demethylation, histone modification, and transcriptional regulation. These approaches offer the potential for durable and reversible gene expression modulation, paving the way for precisely tailored therapies for genetic and complex diseases. Here, we review pioneering research, technological advancements, granted patents, and clinical trials that have been reported during the past decade. By synthesizing current research and development efforts, this review aims to provide insights into the promising landscape of epigenome editing and its potential to promote therapeutic interventions.
articles.abstractZh: 表观基因组编辑正在成为临床治疗中的一种变革性方法，能够在不改变潜在 DNA 序列的情况下精确修改基因表达。表观基因组编辑技术从基础研究到临床应用的持续转变凸显了几个关键策略。其中包括靶向 DNA 甲基化/去甲基化、组蛋白修饰和转录调控。这些方法提供了持久且可逆的基因表达调节的潜力，为针对遗传和复杂疾病的精确定制疗法铺平了道路。在这里，我们回顾了过去十年中报道的开创性研究、技术进步、授予的专利和临床试验。通过综合当前的研究和开发工作，本综述旨在深入了解表观基因组编辑的前景及其促进治疗干预的潜力。

articles.title: Hidden route to salicylic acid has finally been uncovered.
articles.titleZh: 水杨酸的隐藏途径终于被发现。
articles.authors: Tian L, Feussner I.

articles.title: Inactivation of β-1,3-glucan synthase-like 5 confers broad-spectrum resistance to Plasmodiophora brassicae pathotypes in cruciferous plants.
articles.titleZh: β-1,3-葡聚糖合酶样 5 的失活赋予十字花科植物对十字花科根霉病型的广谱抗性。
articles.authors: Wu Y, Zhao C, Zhang Y, Shen C, Zhang Y, Zhang X, Gao L, Zeng L, Ke Q, Qin L, Liu F, Huang J, Ren L, Liu Y, Cheng H, Tong C, Hu Q, Cheng X, Wei Y, Liu S, Liu L.
articles.abstract: Clubroot disease, caused by the obligate intracellular rhizarian protist Plasmodiophora brassicae, is devastating to cruciferous crops worldwide. Widespread field P. brassicae pathotypes frequently overcome the pathotype-specific resistance of modern varieties, posing a challenge for durable control of this disease. Here a genome-wide association study of 3 years of data comprising field clubroot phenotyping of 244 genome-resequenced Brassica napus accessions identified a strong association of β-1,3-glucan synthase-like 5 (GSL5) with clubroot susceptibility. GSL5 was evolutionarily conserved, and inactivation of GSL5 by genome editing in Arabidopsis, B. napus, Brassica rapa and Brassica oleracea conferred broad-spectrum, high-level resistance to P. brassicae pathotypes without yield penalties in B. napus. GSL5 inactivation derepressed the jasmonic acid-mediated immunity during P. brassicae secondary infection, and this immune repression was possibly reinforced through stabilization of GSL5 by a P. brassicae effector, facilitating clubroot susceptibility. Our study provides durable resistance resources for cruciferous clubroot disease control and insights into plant resistance against intracellular eukaryotic phytopathogens.
articles.abstractZh: 根肿病是由专性细胞内根茎原生生物甘蓝根肿菌引起的，对全世界的十字花科作物具有毁灭性的影响。广泛存在的田间甘蓝假单胞菌致病型经常克服现代品种的致病型特异性抗性，对这种疾病的持久控制提出了挑战。在此，一项对 3 年数据进行的全基因组关联研究，包括 244 个基因组测序的甘蓝型油菜种质的田间根肿病表型分析，确定了 β-1,3-葡聚糖合酶样 5 (GSL5) 与根肿病易感性之间的强相关性。 GSL5 在进化上是保守的，通过拟南芥、甘蓝型油菜、白菜和甘蓝中的基因组编辑使 GSL5 失活，可赋予甘蓝型油菜广谱、高水平的抗性，而不会影响甘蓝型油菜的产量。 GSL5失活在甘蓝假单胞菌继发感染过程中抑制了茉莉酸介导的免疫，并且这种免疫抑制可能通过甘蓝假单胞菌效应子稳定GSL5而得到加强，从而促进根肿病的易感性。我们的研究为十字花科根肿病的控制提供了持久的抗性资源，并再次深入了解植物抗性

articles.title: RAD23B acquires a copper metalloadaptor function in amphibian-to-reptile evolution to increase metabolism and regulate genomic integrity.
articles.titleZh: RAD23B 在两栖动物到爬行动物的进化过程中获得了铜金属负载适配器功能，以增加新陈代谢并调节基因组完整性。
articles.authors: Xiao T, He D, Liu D, Jia S, Chen Q, Silverman D, Maitra N, Huang AY, Pezacki A, Nguyen TT, Rao G, Tillage R, Deng K, Weinshenker D, Britt RD, Kelly MJS, Dan Y, Chang CJ.
articles.abstract: Increasing brain complexity is a major step in the evolution of species. Here, we show that, in the transition from amphibians to reptiles, the DNA repair protein RAD23B acquires a metalloadaptor function that allows it to serve as a central hub for both metabolism and protection of genomic integrity. More specifically, RAD23B gains an allosteric H274/H323 copper-binding site to enable the transfer of copper from the universal copper transporter 1 (CTR1) uptake protein to all known copper metallochaperone pathways, while simultaneously making its canonical functions in DNA repair copper dependent. This layer of nutrient regulation allows organisms to withstand elevated levels of potentially toxic copper while augmenting metabolism in cells with high energetic needs across both physiology and disease, including neurons in the locus coeruleus, a key brain structure that regulates sleep, and cancer cells.
articles.abstractZh: 大脑复杂性的增加是物种进化的重要一步。在这里，我们表明，在从两栖动物到爬行动物的转变过程中，DNA 修复蛋白 RAD23B 获得了金属负载适配器功能，使其能够充当新陈代谢和基因组完整性保护的中枢。更具体地说，RAD23B 获得了一个变构 H274/H323 铜结合位点，使铜能够从通用铜转运蛋白 1 (CTR1) 摄取蛋白转移到所有已知的铜金属伴侣途径，同时使其在 DNA 修复中的规范功能依赖于铜。这一层营养调节使生物体能够承受潜在有毒铜水平的升高，同时增强生理学和疾病中具有高能量需求的细胞的新陈代谢，包括蓝斑神经元（调节睡眠的关键大脑结构）和癌细胞。

articles.title: Requirements for establishment and epigenetic stability of mammalian heterochromatin.
articles.titleZh: 哺乳动物异染色质的建立和表观遗传稳定性的要求。
articles.authors: Tatarakis A, Saini H, Yu J, Feng W, Pinzon-Arteaga CA, Moazed D.
articles.abstract: Heterochromatic domains of DNA account for a large fraction of mammalian genomes and play critical roles in silencing transposons and genes, but the mechanisms that establish and maintain these domains are not fully understood. Here, we use a CRISPR-based genetic screen to investigate the requirements for establishment and maintenance of histone H3 lysine 9 trimethylation (H3K9me3) heterochromatin. In mouse embryonic stem cells (mESCs), we show that transiently induced H3K9me3 heterochromatin is inherited for a limited number of cell divisions, independently of sequence-dependent recruitment, but becomes stable upon differentiation, concomitant with downregulation of enzymes erasing H3K9me and DNA methylation. In addition, ordered and non-redundant activities of multiple H3K9 and DNA methyltransferases, together with histone deacetylases, chromatin remodeling complexes, and RNA processing factors, are required for heterochromatin maintenance. Our findings suggest that a newly acquired H3K9me3 domain can be maintained like an imprint but requires reinforcement by DNA methylation and other pathways.
articles.abstractZh: DNA 异染色质结构域占哺乳动物基因组的很大一部分，在转座子和基因沉默中发挥着关键作用，但建立和维持这些结构域的机制尚不完全清楚。在这里，我们使用基于 CRISPR 的遗传筛选来研究组蛋白 H3 赖氨酸 9 三甲基化 (H3K9me3) 异染色质的建立和维持的要求。在小鼠胚胎干细胞（mESC）中，我们发现瞬时诱导的 H3K9me3 异染色质在有限次数的细胞分裂中遗传，与序列依赖性募集无关，但在分化时变得稳定，同时伴随着消除 H3K9me 和 DNA 甲基化的酶的下调。此外，多种 H3K9 和 DNA 甲基转移酶以及组蛋白脱乙酰酶、染色质重塑复合物和 RNA 加工因子的有序和非冗余活性是异染色质维持所必需的。我们的研究结果表明，新获得的 H3K9me3 结构域可以像印记一样维持，但需要通过 DNA 甲基化和其他途径进行强化。

articles.title: Multi-omic assessment of mRNA translation dynamics in liver cancer cell lines.
articles.titleZh: 肝癌细胞系中 mRNA 翻译动力学的多组学评估。
articles.authors: González A, Pandey M, Schlusser N, Rahaman S, Ataman M, Mittal N, Schmidt A, Becskei A, Zavolan M.
articles.abstract: The limited correlation between mRNA and protein levels within cells highlighted the need to study mechanisms of translational control. To decipher the factors that determine the rates of individual steps in mRNA translation, machine learning approaches are currently applied to large libraries of synthetic constructs, whose properties are generally different from those of endogenous mRNAs. To fill this gap and thus enable the discovery of elements driving the translation of individual endogenous mRNAs, we here report steady-state and dynamic multi-omics data from human liver cancer cell lines, specifically (i) ribosome profiling data from unperturbed cells as well as following the block of translation initiation (ribosome run-off, to trace translation elongation), (ii) protein synthesis rates estimated by pulsed stable isotope labeled amino acids in cell culture (pSILAC), and (iii) mean ribosome load on individual mRNAs determined by mRNA sequencing of polysome fractions (polysome profiling). These data will enable improved predictions of mRNA sequence-dependent protein output, which is crucial for engineering protein expression and for the design of mRNA vaccines.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞内 mRNA 和蛋白质水平之间的有限相关性凸显了研究翻译控制机制的必要性。为了破译决定 mRNA 翻译中各个步骤速率的因素，机器学习方法目前应用于大型合成构建体库，其特性通常与内源 mRNA 的特性不同。为了填补这一空白，从而能够发现驱动单个内源 mRNA 翻译的元素，我们在此报告了来自人类肝癌细胞系的稳态和动态多组学数据，特别是 (i) 来自未受干扰细胞的核糖体分析数据以及翻译起始块（核糖体流失，以追踪翻译延伸），(ii) 通过细胞培养物中的脉冲稳定同位素标记的氨基酸 (pSILAC) 估计的蛋白质合成率，以及 (iii) 平均值通过多核糖体片段的 mRNA 测序（多核糖体分析）确定单个 mRNA 上的核糖体负载。这些数据将能够改进对 mRNA 序列依赖性蛋白质输出的预测，这对于工程蛋白质表达和 mRNA 疫苗的设计至关重要。

articles.title: Pathogenic variants in MAEA disrupt DNA replication fork stability and are associated with developmental abnormalities in humans.
articles.titleZh: MAEA 的致病变异会破坏 DNA 复制叉的稳定性，并与人类发育异常相关。
articles.authors: Zeinali E, Mashayekhi F, Farraj RA, Hasanni T, Caron MC, Coulombe Y, Fitieh A, Glover JNM, Masson JY, Ismail IH.
articles.abstract: Replication stress (RS) poses a threat to genome stability and drives genomic rearrangements. The homologous recombination (HR) pathway repairs stalled replication forks (RFs) and prevents such instability. Through an E3 ubiquitin ligase screen aimed at identifying regulators of RAD51, we identified macrophage erythroblast attacher (MAEA), a core component of C-terminal to Lish (CTLH) E3 ubiquitin ligase complex, as a regulator of the HR pathway. Loss of MAEA impairs RAD51 recruitment at stalled RFs, leading to increased sensitivity to RS-inducing agents and excessive degradation of nascent DNA strands. Mechanistically, MAEA associates with and mediates the ubiquitylation of Ku80, enabling its removal from RF ends and facilitating the loading of RAD51. Notably, MAEA deficiency is associated with a developmental disorder involving microcephaly, craniofacial abnormalities, ocular defects, and heart malformations. Functional assays show that disease-linked MAEA variants (R34C, E349G, Y394D, and M396R) are defective in RS response. These findings establish MAEA as an essential factor in RF protection and genome integrity.
articles.abstractZh: 复制压力（RS）对基因组稳定性构成威胁并驱动基因组重排。同源重组 (HR) 途径可修复停滞的复制叉 (RF) 并防止这种不稳定性。通过旨在鉴定 RAD51 调节因子的 E3 泛素连接酶筛选，我们鉴定了巨噬细胞成红细胞附着物 (MAEA)，即 Lish (CTLH) E3 泛素连接酶复合物 C 端的核心成分，作为 HR 通路的调节因子。 MAEA 的缺失会损害 RAD51 在停滞 RF 处的募集，导致对 RS 诱导剂的敏感性增加以及新生 DNA 链的过度降解。从机制上讲，MAEA 关联并介导 Ku80 的泛素化，使其能够从 RF 末端去除并促进 RAD51 的加载。值得注意的是，MAEA 缺乏与发育障碍有关，包括小头畸形、颅面畸形、眼部缺陷和心脏畸形。功能分析表明，与疾病相关的 MAEA 变异（R34C、E349G、Y394D 和 M396R）在 RS 反应中存在缺陷。这些发现表明 MAEA 是射频保护和基因组完整性的重要因素。

articles.title: Intracellular lactate dynamics in <i>Drosophila</i> neurons.
articles.titleZh: 果蝇神经元的细胞内乳酸动态。
articles.authors: Price MS, Rastegari E, Gupta R, Vo K, Moore TI, Venkatachalam K.
articles.abstract: Rates of lactate production and consumption reflect the metabolic state of many cell types, including neurons. Here, we investigated the effects of nutrient deprivation on lactate dynamics in Drosophila neurons by leveraging the limiting effects of the unstirred layer, a diffusion barrier that forms around cells in culture. We found that neurons constitutively consume lactate when the availability of trehalose, a glucose disaccharide preferred by insects, is limited by the unstirred layer. Acute mechanical disruption of the unstirred layer reduced this reliance on lactate. Through kinetic modeling and experimental validation, we demonstrate that neuronal lactate consumption rates under unstirred layer conditions correlate inversely with the cells' mitochondrial density. Furthermore, neuronal lactate levels exhibited temporal correlations that allowed postperturbation lactate dynamics to be predicted by preperturbation values. Collectively, our findings reveal the influence of naturally forming diffusion barriers on neuronal metabolic preferences and demonstrate the existence of temporal correlations between lactate dynamics under conditions of nutrient deprivation and those evoked by the subsequent restoration of nutrient availability.
articles.abstractZh: 乳酸的产生和消耗率反映了包括神经元在内的许多细胞类型的代谢状态。在这里，我们利用未搅拌层（培养细胞周围形成的扩散屏障）的限制作用，研究了营养剥夺对果蝇神经元乳酸动态的影响。我们发现，当海藻糖（昆虫首选的葡萄糖二糖）的可用性受到未搅拌层的限制时，神经元会持续消耗乳酸。对未搅拌层的急剧机械破坏减少了对乳酸的依赖。通过动力学建模和实验验证，我们证明在未搅拌层条件下神经元乳酸消耗率与细胞线粒体密度成反比。此外，神经元乳酸水平表现出时间相关性，使得可以通过扰动前值来预测扰动后乳酸动态。总的来说，我们的研究结果揭示了自然形成的扩散障碍对神经元代谢偏好的影响，并证明了营养剥夺条件下的乳酸动态与诱发条件下的乳酸动态之间存在时间相关性。

articles.title: A chaperone-proteasome-based fragmentation machinery is essential for aggrephagy.
articles.titleZh: 基于伴侣蛋白酶体的碎片机制对于聚合吞噬至关重要。
articles.authors: Mauthe M, van de Beek N, Mari M, Korsten G, Nobari P, Castelino KB, de Mattos EP, Ouhida I, Dijkstra JL, Schipper-Krom S, de la Ballina LR, Mueller MR, Simonsen A, Hipp MS, Kapitein LC, Kampinga HH, Reggiori F.
articles.abstract: Perturbations in protein quality control lead to the accumulation of misfolded proteins and protein aggregates, which can compromise health and lifespan. One key mechanism eliminating protein aggregates is aggrephagy, a selective type of autophagy. Here we reveal that fragmentation is required before autophagic clearance of various types of amorphous aggregates. This fragmentation requires both the 19S proteasomal regulatory particle and the DNAJB6-HSP70-HSP110 chaperone module. These two players are also essential for aggregate compaction that leads to the clustering of the selective autophagy receptors, which initiates the autophagic removal of the aggregates. We also found that the same players delay the formation of disease-associated huntingtin inclusions. This study assigns a novel function to the 19S regulatory particle and the DNAJB6-HSP70-HSP110 module, and uncovers that aggrephagy entails a piecemeal process, with relevance for proteinopathies.
articles.abstractZh: 蛋白质质量控​​制的干扰会导致错误折叠的蛋白质和蛋白质聚集体的积累，从而损害健康和寿命。消除蛋白质聚集体的一个关键机制是聚合自噬，它是一种选择性类型的自噬。在这里，我们揭示了在自噬清除各种类型的无定形聚集体之前需要裂解。这种碎片化需要 19S 蛋白酶体调节颗粒和 DNAJB6-HSP70-HSP110 分子伴侣模块。这两个参与者对于聚集体压缩也至关重要，聚集体压缩会导致选择性自噬受体聚集，从而启动聚集体的自噬清除。我们还发现，相同的参与者延迟了与疾病相关的亨廷顿蛋白内含物的形成。这项研究为 19S 调节颗粒和 DNAJB6-HSP70-HSP110 模块赋予了一种新功能，并揭示了聚集吞噬需要一个渐进的过程，与蛋白质病相关。

articles.title: A nut-and-bolt assembly of the bimodular large progenitor botulinum neurotoxin complex.
articles.titleZh: 双模块大祖肉毒杆菌神经毒素复合物的具体组装。
articles.authors: Lam KH, Gao L, Przykopanski A, Chen B, Huang T, Krüger M, Bartels AM, Dorner MB, Perry K, Dorner BG, Rummel A, Jin R.
articles.abstract: Botulinum neurotoxin serotype A (BoNT/A) is naturally produced by bacteria along with four nontoxic neurotoxin-associated proteins (NTNH, HA70, HA33, and HA17), forming a bimodular large progenitor toxin complex (L-PTC). The BoNT/A-NTNH complex protects the toxin from adverse environment, while the complex consisting of HA proteins facilitates toxin absorption during oral intoxication. How these two independent modules assemble into the L-PTC remains unclear. Here, we report the crystal structure of the BoNT/A-NTNH-HA70 complex at ~2.9-Å resolution. The structure reveals that the BoNT/A-NTNH complex is anchored into a concentric double β-barrel channel of trimeric HA70 through a short β-hairpin of NTNH (termed nLoop), resembling a nut-and-bolt attachment. We find that the nLoop of NTNH is strictly conserved across HA-containing BoNT complexes and that NTNH-HA70 binding is interchangeable among them. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the nLoop functions as a minimal motif enabling attachment of a protein-of-interest to the HA complex, with potential applications in oral biologics delivery.
articles.abstractZh: A 型肉毒杆菌神经毒素 (BoNT/A) 由细菌与四种无毒神经毒素相关蛋白（NTNH、HA70、HA33 和 HA17）自然产生，形成双模块大祖毒素复合物 (L-PTC)。 BoNT/A-NTNH复合物可保护毒素免受不利环境的影响，而由HA蛋白组成的复合物可促进口服中毒期间毒素的吸收。这两个独立的模块如何组装成 L-PTC 仍不清楚。在这里，我们报告了 BoNT/A-NTNH-HA70 复合物的晶体结构，分辨率约为 2.9-Å。该结构表明，BoNT/A-NTNH 复合物通过 NTNH 的短 β-发夹（称为 nLoop）锚定到三聚体 HA70 的同心双 β-桶通道中，类似于螺母和螺栓连接。我们发现 NTNH 的 nLoop 在含有 HA 的 BoNT 复合物中是严格保守的，并且 NTNH-HA70 结合在它们之间是可以互换的。此外，我们证明 nLoop 作为最小基序发挥作用，能够将感兴趣的蛋白质附着到 HA 复合物上，在口服生物制剂输送中具有潜在的应用。

articles.title: BioFuse: A programmable timer switch of gene expression.
articles.titleZh: BioFuse：基因表达的可编程定时器开关。
articles.authors: Huang C, Zhao J, Tan Z, Dai S, Wang B, Xie Z, Zhang F, Zhou Y, Yu N, Cai C, Yao Y, Wang B, Tian B.
articles.abstract: Current gene circuits designed to time gene expression depend on the intricate interactions among various regulators and their targets, which confines them to a limited range of temporal tunability. Here, we report a programmable timer switch of gene expression termed BioFuse, which allows the reaction time ranging from hours to days. BioFuse comprises a series of fuse-like tandem DNA cassettes that can be sequentially edited by the adenine base editors (ABEs), resulting in either the activation or deactivation of a downstream gene once the editing is complete. Adjusting the number of DNA cassettes incorporated allows precise programming of BioFuse's reaction time. Applying BioFuse to control carotenoid biosynthesis genes decouples lycopene production from growth in E. coli and increases lycopene yield without external inducers. Using BioFuse in a bacterial autolysis system enables timely and efficient protein release. BioFuse offers a versatile tool for precise, wide-range timing of gene expression and metabolic activities in bacteria, with potential applications in industry and biomedicine.
articles.abstractZh: 目前设计用于调节基因表达时间的基因电路取决于各种调节因子及其靶标之间复杂的相互作用，这将它们限制在有限的时间可调范围内。在这里，我们报告了一种称为 BioFuse 的基因表达可编程定时器开关，它允许反应时间从几小时到几天不等。 BioFuse 包含一系列类似保险丝的串联 DNA 盒，可以由腺嘌呤碱基编辑器 (ABE) 顺序编辑，一旦编辑完成，就会激活或失活下游基因。调整 DNA 盒的数量可以精确编程 BioFuse 的反应时间。应用 BioFuse 控制类胡萝卜素生物合成基因，使番茄红素的产生与大肠杆菌的生长脱钩，并在无需外部诱导剂的情况下提高番茄红素产量。在细菌自溶系统中使用 BioFuse 可以实现及时有效的蛋白质释放。 BioFuse 提供了一种多功能工具，可对细菌中的基因表达和代谢活动进行精确、广泛的计时，在工业和生物医学方面具有潜在的应用。

articles.title: Cryptosporidium parvum multidrug resistance protein confers resistance to toxic gut microbial metabolite.
articles.titleZh: 小隐孢子虫多药耐药蛋白赋予对有毒肠道微生物代谢物的抵抗力。
articles.authors: Huang W, Xu R, Kimball A, Witola WH, Baldridge MT, Feng Y, Xiao L, Sibley LD.
articles.abstract: Cryptosporidium parvum subtypes differ in pathogenicity, but the underlying factors are largely unknown. We show that two genetically similar C. parvum isolates grow equally well in vitro but differ in pathogenicity in immunocompromised mice. Reduced oocyst shedding of the avirulent strain was restored by antibiotic treatment, suggesting susceptibility to colonization resistance imparted by the microbiota. This resistance was associated with a gene encoding a parasite ABC transporter and enhanced infectivity. Molecular analyses indicate that the ABC transporter belongs to a multidrug resistance protein (MRP) family. CpMRP1 binds bacterial metabolites, notably deoxycholic acid (DCA) that inhibits C. parvum growth. CpMRP1 is exported from small granules to the parasite-host interface, potentially mediating the export of xenobiotics. Loss of CpMRP1 reduces infectivity and DCA resistance in mice, and CpMRP1 polymorphisms across isolates determine susceptibility to DCA. These results define CpMRP1 as a determinant of C. parvum sensitivity to microbiome-mediated inhibition, thereby influencing infectivity.
articles.abstractZh: 小隐孢子虫亚型的致病性不同，但其潜在因素很大程度上未知。我们发现，两种遗传相似的微小隐球菌分离株在体外生长同样良好，但在免疫功能低下的小鼠中的致病性不同。通过抗生素治疗可以恢复无毒菌株卵囊脱落的减少，这表明对微生物群赋予的定植抗性敏感。这种抗性与编码寄生虫 ABC 转运蛋白的基因和增强的感染性有关。分子分析表明 ABC 转运蛋白属于多药耐药蛋白 (MRP) 家族。 CpMRP1 结合细菌代谢物，尤其是抑制微小念珠菌生长的脱氧胆酸 (DCA)。 CpMRP1从小颗粒输出到寄生虫-宿主界面，可能介导外源物质的输出。 CpMRP1 的缺失会降低小鼠的感染性和 DCA 耐药性，并且分离株之间的 CpMRP1 多态性决定对 DCA 的易感性。这些结果将 CpMRP1 定义为微小念珠菌对微生物介导的抑制敏感性的决定因素，从而影响感染性。

articles.title: Proximity-specific ribosome profiling reveals the logic of localized mitochondrial translation.
articles.titleZh: 邻近特异性核糖体分析揭示了局部线粒体翻译的逻辑。
articles.authors: Luo J, Khandwala S, Hu J, Lee SY, Hickey KL, Levine ZG, Harper JW, Ting AY, Weissman JS.
articles.abstract: Localized translation broadly enables spatiotemporal control of gene expression. Here, we present LOV-domain-controlled ligase for translation localization (LOCL-TL), an optogenetic approach for monitoring translation with codon resolution at any defined subcellular location under physiological conditions. Application of LOCL-TL to mitochondrially localized translation revealed that ∼20% of human nuclear-encoded mitochondrial genes are translated on the outer mitochondrial membrane (OMM). Mitochondrially translated messages form two classes distinguished by encoded protein length, recruitment mechanism, and cellular function. An evolutionarily ancient mechanism allows nascent chains to drive cotranslational recruitment of long proteins via an unanticipated bipartite targeting signal. Conversely, mRNAs of short proteins, especially eukaryotic-origin electron transport chain (ETC) components, are specifically recruited by the OMM protein A-kinase anchoring protein 1 (AKAP1) in a translation-independent manner that depends on mRNA splicing. AKAP1 loss lowers ETC levels. LOCL-TL thus reveals a hierarchical strategy that enables preferential translation of a subset of proteins on the OMM.
articles.abstractZh: 局部翻译广泛地实现了基因表达的时空控制。在这里，我们提出了用于翻译定位的 LOV 域控制连接酶（LOCL-TL），这是一种光遗传学方法，用于在生理条件下任何定义的亚细胞位置以密码子分辨率监测翻译。 LOCL-TL 在线粒体定位翻译中的应用表明，约 20% 的人类核编码线粒体基因在线粒体外膜 (OMM) 上翻译。线粒体翻译的信息分为两类，根据编码的蛋白质长度、募集机制和细胞功能进行区分。一种进化上古老的机制允许新生链通过意想不到的二分靶向信号驱动长蛋白的共翻译招募。相反，短蛋白的 mRNA，尤其是真核起源的电子传递链 (ETC) 成分，由 OMM 蛋白 A 激酶锚定蛋白 1 (AKAP1) 以依赖于 mRNA 剪接的翻译独立方式特异性招募。 AKAP1 损失会降低 ETC 水平。因此，LOCL-TL 揭示了一种分层策略，可以优先翻译 OM 上的蛋白质子集

articles.title: Structural basis for lipid transport at membrane contact sites by the IST2-OSH6 complex.
articles.titleZh: IST2-OSH6 复合物在膜接触位点转运脂质的结构基础。
articles.authors: Arndt M, Schweri A, Dutzler R.
articles.abstract: Membrane contact sites are hubs for interorganellar lipid transport within eukaryotic cells. As a principal tether bridging the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) and the plasma membrane in Saccharomyces cerevisiae, the protein IST2 has a major role during lipid transport between both compartments. Here, we show a comprehensive investigation elucidating the structural and mechanistic properties of IST2 and its interaction with the soluble lipid transfer protein OSH6. The ER-embedded transmembrane domain of IST2 is homologous to the TMEM16 family and acts as a constitutively active lipid scramblase. The extended C terminus binds to the plasma membrane and the phosphatidylserine-phosphatidylinositol 4-phosphate exchanger OSH6. Through cellular growth assays and biochemical and structural studies, we characterized the interaction between both proteins and show that OSH6 remains associated with IST2 during lipid shuttling between membranes. These results highlight the role of the IST2-OSH6 complex in lipid trafficking and offer initial insights into the relevance of scramblases for carrier-like lipid transport mechanisms.
articles.abstractZh: 膜接触位点是真核细胞内细胞器间脂质运输的枢纽。作为酿酒酵母中连接内质网 (ER) 和质膜的主要系链，蛋白质 IST2 在两个区室之间的脂质转运过程中发挥着重要作用。在这里，我们进行了一项全面的研究，阐明了 IST2 的结构和机制特性及其与可溶性脂质转运蛋白 OSH6 的相互作用。 IST2 的 ER 嵌入跨膜结构域与 TMEM16 家族同源，并充当组成型活性脂质扰乱酶。延伸的 C 末端与质膜和磷脂酰丝氨酸-磷脂酰肌醇 4-磷酸交换剂 OSH6 结合。通过细胞生长测定以及生化和结构研究，我们表征了两种蛋白质之间的相互作用，并表明在膜之间的脂质穿梭过程中，OSH6 仍然与 IST2 相关。这些结果强调了 IST2-OSH6 复合物在脂质运输中的作用，并为扰乱酶与载体样脂质运输机制的相关性提供了初步见解。

articles.title: Candida albicans colonization in the human colon correlates with a reduction in acetate- and butyrate-producing bacteria, as simulated using the M-SHIME® model.
articles.titleZh: 正如使用 M-SHIME® 模型模拟的那样，白色念珠菌在人类结肠中的定殖与产生乙酸盐和丁酸盐的细菌的减少相关。
articles.authors: Marsaux B, d'Hoker W, Moens F, Van Elst D, Minnebo Y, Marzorati M, Van de Wiele T.
articles.abstract: Candida albicans is a common gut commensal, typically restricted by the resident microbiota. However, microbiome disruption can enable its outgrowth, increasing the risk of life-threatening candidiasis. Restoring key protective microbes offer a therapeutic strategy, though their identification remains challenging. Using the M-SHIME® model simulating the human proximal colon, we investigated C. albicans-bacteriome interactions under eubiotic and dysbiotic conditions. We assessed how clindamycin, ciprofloxacin, and metronidazole modulate C. albicans colonization and evaluated associated microbial and metabolic shifts. The effects were antibiotic- and donor-specific: clindamycin facilitated colonization, ciprofloxacin had no impact, and metronidazole showed variable outcomes. Engraftment did not correlate with total bacterial concentration or α-diversity, but with the loss of specific taxa, notably Lachnospiraceae and Bifidobacterium. These correlations were supported functionally by reductions in acetate and butyrate, suggesting a metabolic mechanism of fungal suppression. This study highlights the role of dysbiosis in C. albicans outgrowth and supports targeted microbiome restoration strategies.
articles.abstractZh: 白色念珠菌是一种常见的肠道共生菌，通常受到常驻微生物群的限制。然而，微生物组的破坏可能导致其生长，增加危及生命的念珠菌病的风险。恢复关键的保护性微生物提供了一种治疗策略，尽管它们的识别仍然具有挑战性。使用模拟人类近端结肠的 M-SHIME® 模型，我们研究了益生和生态失调条件下白色念珠菌与细菌组的相互作用。我们评估了克林霉素、环丙沙星和甲硝唑如何调节白色念珠菌定植，并评估了相关的微生物和代谢变化。效果是抗生素和供体特异性的：克林霉素促进定植，环丙沙星没有影响，甲硝唑显示出不同的结果。植入与总细菌浓度或α-多样性无关，但与特定类群的损失相关，特别是毛螺菌科和双歧杆菌。这些相关性在功能上得到了乙酸盐和丁酸盐减少的支持，表明了真菌抑制的代谢机制。这项研究强调了生态失调在白色念珠菌生长中的作用，并支持有针对性的微生物组恢复

articles.title: Mitochondrial activity tunes nociceptor resilience to excitotoxicity.
articles.titleZh: 线粒体活性调节伤害感受器对兴奋性毒性的恢复能力。
articles.authors: Yuan L, Chandel NS, Julius D.
articles.abstract: The capsaicin receptor, TRPV1, mediates the detection of noxious chemical and thermal stimuli by nociceptors, primary sensory neurons of the pain pathway. Overactivation of TRPV1 leads to cellular damage or death through calcium entry and excitotoxicity. We have exploited this phenomenon to conduct a systematic analysis of excitotoxicity through a genome-wide CRISPRi screen, thereby revealing a comprehensive network of regulatory pathways. We show that decreased expression of mitochondrial electron transport chain (ETC) components protects against capsaicin-induced toxicity and other challenges by mitigating both calcium imbalance and the generation of mitochondrial reactive oxygen species via distinct pathways. Moreover, we confirm the regulatory roles of the ETC in sensory neurons through gain-of-function and loss-of-function experiments. Interestingly, TRPV1+ sensory neurons maintain lower expression of ETC components and can better tolerate excitotoxicity and oxidative stress compared with other sensory neuron subtypes, implicating ETC tuning as an intrinsic cellular strategy that protects nociceptors against excitotoxicity.
articles.abstractZh: 辣椒素受体 TRPV1 介导伤害感受器（疼痛通路的初级感觉神经元）对有毒化学物质和热刺激的检测。 TRPV1 过度激活会通过钙进入和兴奋性毒性导致细胞损伤或死亡。我们利用这一现象，通过全基因组 CRISPRi 筛选对兴奋毒性进行了系统分析，从而揭示了一个全面的调控途径网络。我们发现，线粒体电子传递链（ETC）成分的表达减少可以通过不同的途径减轻钙失衡和线粒体活性氧的产生，从而防止辣椒素引起的毒性和其他挑战。此外，我们通过功能获得和功能丧失实验证实了 ETC 在感觉神经元中的调节作用。有趣的是，与其他感觉神经元亚型相比，TRPV1+感觉神经元维持较低的ETC成分表达，并且可以更好地耐受兴奋性毒性和氧化应激，这表明ETC调节是保护伤害感受器免受兴奋性毒性的内在细胞策略。

articles.title: A population model reveals a surprising role of stochastic cell division in epigenetic memory systems.
articles.titleZh: 群体模型揭示了随机细胞分裂在表观遗传记忆系统中的惊人作用。
articles.authors: Klingel V, Graf D, Weirich S, Jeltsch A, Radde NE.
articles.abstract: Epigenetic memory systems store transient environmental signals in bacteria in specific DNA methylation patterns. Synthetic zinc finger protein (ZnF4) binds to the DNA in a methylation-dependent manner and represses the expression of the DNA methyltransferase CcrM. The mechanisms ensuring long-term ON-state stability remain unclear. Measurements showed a gradual shift of cell populations from ON to OFF starting after four days of cultivation. We use a hybrid modeling approach integrating flow cytometry data and bulk DNA methylation measurements to test the hypothesis that stochastic cell division is a key factor in this transition. Interestingly, model parameters cluster into two groups with opposite effects of cell division rates on ON-state stability. Experiments show that faster cell division increases memory stability-an initially unexpected result. Model simulations provide a potential explanation for this observation and deepen our understanding of the mechanisms and timing of the ON/OFF switch in individual cells.
articles.abstractZh: 表观遗传记忆系统以特定的 DNA 甲基化模式存储细菌中的瞬时环境信号。合成锌指蛋白 (ZnF4) 以甲基化依赖性方式与 DNA 结合，并抑制 DNA 甲基转移酶 CcrM 的表达。确保长期导通状态稳定性的机制仍不清楚。测量结果显示，培养四天后，细胞群逐渐从开启状态转变为关闭状态。我们使用整合流式细胞术数据和大量 DNA 甲基化测量的混合建模方法来检验随机细胞分裂是这一转变的关键因素的假设。有趣的是，模型参数分为两组，细胞分裂率对 ON 状态稳定性的影响相反。实验表明，更快的细胞分裂可以提高记忆稳定性——这是一个最初意想不到的结果。模型模拟为这一观察结果提供了潜在的解释，并加深了我们对单个细胞中开关的机制和时间的理解。

articles.title: Directed evolution-based discovery of ligands for in vivo restimulation of chimeric antigen receptor T cells.
articles.titleZh: 基于定向进化的配体发现，用于嵌合抗原受体 T 细胞的体内再刺激。
articles.authors: Grzywa TM, Neeser A, Ramasubramanian R, Romanov A, Tannir R, Mehta NK, Cossette B, Morgan DM, Goncalves B, Sukaj I, Bergaggio E, Kadauke S, Myers RM, Paruzzo L, Ghilardi G, Cozzone A, Schuster SJ, Frey N, Zhang L, Yousefpour P, Abraham W, Suh H, Ruella M, Grupp SA, Chiarle R, Wittrup KD, Ma L, Irvine DJ.
articles.abstract: Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell therapy targeting CD19 elicits remarkable clinical efficacy in B cell malignancies, but many patients relapse owing to failed expansion and/or progressive loss of CAR-T cells. We recently reported a strategy to potently restimulate CAR-T cells in vivo, enhancing their functionality by administration of a vaccine-like stimulus comprised of surrogate peptide ligands for a CAR linked to a lymph node-targeting amphiphilic PEG-lipid (amph-vax). Here we demonstrate a general strategy to discover and optimize peptide mimotopes enabling amph-vax generation for any CAR. We use yeast surface display to identify peptide binders to FMC63 (the scFv used in clinical CD19 CARs), which are then subsequently affinity matured by directed evolution. CAR-T vaccines using these optimized mimotopes triggered marked expansion and memory development of CD19 CAR-T cells in both syngeneic and humanized mouse models of B-acute lymphoblastic leukaemia/lymphoma, and enhanced control of disease progression compared with CD19 CAR-T-only-treated mice. This approach enables amph-vax boosting to be applied to any clinically relevant CAR-T cell product.
articles.abstractZh: 靶向 CD19 的嵌合抗原受体 (CAR) T 细胞疗法在 B 细胞恶性肿瘤中产生了显着的临床疗效，但许多患者由于 CAR-T 细胞扩增失败和/或逐渐丢失而复发。我们最近报道了一种在体内有效重新刺激 CAR-T 细胞的策略，通过施用类似疫苗的刺激物来增强其功能，该刺激物由与淋巴结靶向的两亲性 PEG-脂质 (amph-vax) 连接的 CAR 的替代肽配体组成。在这里，我们展示了发现和优化肽模拟表位的一般策略，使任何 CAR 能够生成 amph-vax。我们使用酵母表面展示来识别 FMC63（临床 CD19 CAR 中使用的 scFv）的肽结合物，然后通过定向进化使其亲和力成熟。使用这些优化模拟表位的 CAR-T 疫苗在 B 急性淋巴细胞白血病/淋巴瘤的同基因和人源化小鼠模型中引发了 CD19 CAR-T 细胞的显着扩增和记忆发育，并且与仅接受 CD19 CAR-T 治疗的小鼠相比，增强了对疾病进展的控制。这种方法使得 amph-vax 加强能够应用于任何临床相关的 CAR-T 细胞产品。

articles.title: Harnessing dual-channel probiotics to synergistically correct intestinal and vaginal dysbiosis after antibiotic disruption.
articles.titleZh: 利用双通道益生菌协同纠正抗生素破坏后的肠道和阴道菌群失调。
articles.authors: Zhao X, Huang Q, Liu Y, He X, Chen W, Liu Y, Gan L, Wei J, Zhang H, Chen T.
articles.abstract: Antibiotics are widely used to treat infectious diseases, yet antibiotic therapy has been shown to disrupt symbiotic microbiota. Notably, the dosage and duration of antibiotic use for specific infections may exert detrimental effects on microbiota in non-infected sites. Here, we propose a dual-channel probiotic delivery strategy to address gut and vaginal dysbiosis caused by antibiotic therapies. In a Helicobacter pylori infection model, oral administration of Limosilactobacillus reuteri NCU-15 alleviated gastritis and protected the intestinal barrier and microbiota. In a vaginal dysbiosis model, intravaginal delivery of Lactobacillus crispatus NCU-23 reduced local inflammation and apoptosis, restoring vaginal microbial homeostasis. In the entero-vaginal disordered mice, dual-channel probiotic therapy produced synergistic effects by reducing inflammation, inhibiting apoptosis, and reestablishing microbial balance. These findings demonstrate the potential of dual-channel probiotic intervention to modulate gut-vaginal microbiota interactions and offer a scientific basis for developing strategies to prevent or treat antibiotic-induced dysbiosis.
articles.abstractZh: 抗生素广泛用于治疗传染病，但抗生素治疗已被证明会破坏共生微生物群。值得注意的是，针对特定感染的抗生素使用剂量和持续时间可能会对非感染部位的微生物群产生有害影响。在这里，我们提出了一种双通道益生菌递送策略，以解决抗生素治疗引起的肠道和阴道菌群失调问题。在幽门螺杆菌感染模型中，口服罗伊氏柠檬酸杆菌 NCU-15 可缓解胃炎并保护肠道屏障和微生物群。在阴道生态失调模型中，阴道内输送卷曲乳杆菌 NCU-23 可减少局部炎症和细胞凋亡，恢复阴道微生物稳态。在肠阴道疾病小鼠中，双通道益生菌疗法通过减少炎症、抑制细胞凋亡和重建微生物平衡产生协同效应。这些发现证明了双通道益生菌干预调节肠道-阴道微生物群相互作用的潜力，并为制定预防或治疗抗生素引起的菌群失调的策略提供了科学依据。

articles.title: VEL-dependent polymerization maintains the chromatin association of Polycomb proteins for the switch to epigenetic silencing.
articles.titleZh: VEL 依赖性聚合维持 Polycomb 蛋白的染色质关联，以便切换到表观遗传沉默。
articles.authors: Schulten A, Jang GJ, Payne-Dwyer A, Fiedler M, Nielsen ML, Mateo-Bonmatí E, Bienz M, Leake MC, Dean C.
articles.abstract: Multivalent protein-chromatin interactions facilitated by higher-order protein assemblies are emerging as a crucial theme in eukaryotic gene regulation. However, understanding the underlying mechanisms in their functional context remains challenging. Arabidopsis VEL proteins assemble biomolecular condensates by head-to-tail polymerization. Here, we dissect the role of VEL polymerization domains in conferring the epigenetic switch to Polycomb repressive complex 2 (PRC2) silencing at Arabidopsis FLOWERING LOCUS C (FLC). We show that VIN3 VEL polymerization produces higher-order nuclear VIN3 assemblies in vivo, which promote multivalent chromatin association and efficient H3K27me3 nucleation. VRN5 VEL polymerization, however, is not required unless a third homolog VEL1 is absent. The VRN5 VEL domain has different polymerization properties and is functionally unable to replace VIN3 VEL, but it is required to physically connect VIN3 with PRC2. This work reveals the combinatorial roles of VEL polymerization domains in maintaining the chromatin association of Polycomb proteins for the switch to epigenetic silencing.
articles.abstractZh: 由高阶蛋白质组装促进的多价蛋白质-染色质相互作用正在成为真核基因调控的一个关键主题。然而，理解其功能背景下的潜在机制仍然具有挑战性。拟南芥 VEL 蛋白通过头尾聚合组装生物分子缩合物。在这里，我们剖析了 VEL 聚合结构域在拟南芥开花基因座 C (FLC) 赋予表观遗传开关 Polycomb 抑制复合物 2 (PRC2) 沉默中的作用。我们发现，VIN3 VEL 聚合在体内产生更高阶的核 VIN3 组装体，从而促进多价染色质缔合和有效的 H3K27me3 成核。然而，VRN5 VEL 聚合不是必需的，除非第三个同系物 VEL1 不存在。 VRN5 VEL 域具有不同的聚合属性，在功能上无法替代 VIN3 VEL，但需要将 VIN3 与 PRC2 进行物理连接。这项工作揭示了 VEL 聚合结构域在维持 Polycomb 蛋白染色质关联以转向表观遗传沉默中的组合作用。

articles.title: Ablation of histone H1.4 reveals the focal regulation of AP-1 directed enhancers.
articles.titleZh: 组蛋白 H1.4 的消融揭示了 AP-1 定向增强子的局灶性调节。
articles.authors: Gokey NG, Ward JM, Milliman EJ, Deterding LJ, Trotter KW, Archer TK.
articles.abstract: Nucleosomes are flanked by histone H1's, which bind linker DNA and aid chromatin compaction. The specific role of linker histone Has remained elusive due to complex compensatory mechanisms among H1 variants. H1.4 ablation resulted in robust changes in nascent transcription and gene expression, with critical pathways upregulated (RAR, TNF-α/NF-κB) and extracellular matrix and collagen genes repressed. Alternations to chromatin accessibility intersected extragenic and intronic regions, overlapped sites of known enhancer chromatin, and were of enhancer size. These sites exhibited concomitant and concordant changes to epigenetic marks (H3K27ac/H3K4me1). Sites, which gained accessibility contained binding motifs for basal factors (TBP, SRF), localized to polycomb, heterochromatin, and quiescent/low chromatin, and gained active RNA transcription in ΔH1.4 cells. However, the AP-1 motif was enriched at sites that lost accessibility, consistent with the gene expression changes. This places histone H1.4 as a hitherto underappreciated regulator of transcriptional response patterns and a dynamic member of regulatory chromatin.
articles.abstractZh: 核小体两侧是组蛋白 H1，它结合接头 DNA 并帮助染色质压缩。由于 H1 变体之间复杂的补偿机制，接头组蛋白的具体作用仍然难以捉摸。 H1.4 消融导致新生转录和基因表达发生剧烈变化，关键通路上调（RAR、TNF-α/NF-κB），细胞外基质和胶原蛋白基因受到抑制。染色质可及性的改变与基因外和内含子区域相交，已知增强子染色质的重叠位点，并且具有增强子大小。这些位点表现出表观遗传标记 (H3K27ac/H3K4me1) 的伴随且一致的变化。获得可及性的位点包含基础因子（TBP、SRF）的结合基序，定位于多梳、异染色质和静止/低染色质，并在 ΔH1.4 细胞中获得活性 RNA 转录。然而，AP-1 基序在失去可及性的位点处富集，与基因表达变化一致。这使得组蛋白 H1.4 成为迄今为止未被充分认识的转录反应模式调节因子和调节染色质的动态成员。

articles.title: Mechanisms and genomic implications of break-induced replication.
articles.titleZh: 断裂诱导复制的机制和基因组影响。
articles.authors: Atari A, Jiang H, Greenberg RA.
articles.abstract: DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs) are a severe threat to genome stability, as DSB-repair mechanisms with low fidelity contribute to loss of genome integrity. Break-induced replication (BIR) is a crucial DSB-repair pathway when classical homologous recombination mechanisms fail. BIR is often triggered by stalled or collapsed replication forks, following extensive end resection that generates a single-stranded DNA substrate, which can engage either canonical homology-driven BIR, or microhomology-mediated BIR (mmBIR), which requires shorter sequence homologies than does canonical BIR. BIR is a double-edged sword: it is necessary for DSB repair, but is also culpable for introducing mutations and structural variations that are linked to cancer and genetic disorders. In this Review, we discuss BIR regulation in mammalian cells, and the role of BIR in telomere maintenance and in human disease, as well as in genome engineering. We highlight emerging findings in these areas and advances in technologies that have enabled their discovery and reshape our understanding of this enigmatic repair mechanism.
articles.abstractZh: DNA 双链断裂 (DSB) 对基因组稳定性构成严重威胁，因为保真度低的 DSB 修复机制会导致基因组完整性丧失。当经典同源重组机制失败时，断裂诱导复制 (BIR) 是至关重要的 DSB 修复途径。 BIR 通常由停滞或崩溃的复制叉触发，在广泛的末端切除后生成单链 DNA 底物，该底物可以接合规范同源驱动的 BIR 或微同源介导的 BIR (mmBIR)，后者需要比规范 BIR 更短的序列同源性。 BIR 是一把双刃剑：它对于 DSB 修复是必要的，但也可能导致与癌症和遗传性疾病相关的突变和结构变异。在这篇综述中，我们讨论了哺乳动物细胞中的 BIR 调节，以及 BIR 在端粒维持、人类疾病以及基因组工程中的作用。我们重点介绍这些领域的新发现以及使它们得以发现并重塑我们对这种神秘修复机制的理解的技术进步。

articles.title: RETICULATA1 is a plastid-localized basic amino acid transporter.
articles.titleZh: RETICULATA1 是一种质体定位的碱性氨基酸转运蛋白。
articles.authors: Kuhnert F, Westhoff P, Valencia V, Krüger S, Vogel K, Lundquist PK, Rosar C, Goss T, Weber APM.
articles.abstract: Plants have a crucial role in providing essential amino acids for human nutrition. Nine of the 20 proteinogenic amino acids are exclusively synthesized de novo in plastids, yet transporters mediating their exchange across the plastid inner envelope remain unknown. Here we identify RETICULATA1 (RE1) as a plastid-localized transporter for basic amino acids-including Arg, Citr, Orn and Lys-in Arabidopsis thaliana. Loss-of-function mutants display a reticulate leaf phenotype, contain lower amounts of basic amino acids and are impaired in amino acid homeostasis. RE1 belongs to a novel class of membrane transport proteins that contain a domain of unknown function 3411 and are found exclusively in plastid-containing organisms. Our results indicate functional overlap with its closest homologue RER1, as the double mutant is lethal. Isotope labelling reveals that loss of RE1 reduces basic amino acid biosynthesis and affects the equilibration of plastidic and cytosolic amino acid pools. These findings uncover a critical role for plastidial amino acid transporters in coordinating primary metabolism, development and nutrient allocation in plants.
articles.abstractZh: 植物在为人类营养提供必需氨基酸方面发挥着至关重要的作用。 20 种蛋白氨基酸中的 9 种完全在质体中从头合成，但介导其跨质体内膜交换的转运蛋白仍然未知。在这里，我们将 RETICULATA1 (RE1) 鉴定为拟南芥中碱性氨基酸（包括 Arg、Citr、Orn 和 Lys）的质体定位转运蛋白。功能丧失突变体表现出网状叶表型，含有较低量的碱性氨基酸并且氨基酸稳态受损。 RE1 属于一类新型膜转运蛋白，含有未知功能 3411 的结构域，仅在含质体的生物体中发现。我们的结果表明与其最接近的同源物 RER1 功能重叠，因为双突变体是致命的。同位素标记表明，RE1 的缺失会减少碱性氨基酸的生物合成，并影响质体和胞质氨基酸池的平衡。这些发现揭示了质体氨基酸转运蛋白在协调植物初级代谢、发育和养分分配中的关键作用。

articles.title: LYVAC/PDZD8 is a lysosomal vacuolator.
articles.titleZh: LYVAC/PDZD8 是一种溶酶体空泡剂。
articles.authors: Yang H, Xun J, Li Y, Mondal A, Lv B, Watkins SC, Shi L, Tan JX.
articles.abstract: Lysosomal vacuolation is commonly found in many pathophysiological conditions, but its molecular mechanisms and functions remain largely unknown. Here, we show that the endoplasmic reticulum (ER)-anchored lipid transfer protein PDZ domain-containing 8 (PDZD8), which we propose to be renamed as lysosomal vacuolator (LYVAC), is a general mediator of lysosomal vacuolation. Using human cell lines, we found that diverse lysosomal vacuolation inducers converged on lysosomal osmotic stress, triggering LYVAC recruitment through multivalent interactions. Stress-induced lysosomal lipid signaling contributed to both the recruitment and activation of LYVAC. By directly sensing lysosomal phosphatidylserine and cholesterol, the lipid transfer domain of LYVAC mediated directional ER-to-lysosome lipid movement, leading to osmotic membrane expansion of lysosomes. These findings uncover an essential mechanism for lysosomal vacuolation with broad implications in pathophysiology.
articles.abstractZh: 溶酶体空泡形成常见于许多病理生理状况，但其分子机制和功能仍然很大程度上未知。在这里，我们发现内质网（ER）锚定的脂质转移蛋白含有PDZ结构域8（PDZD8），我们建议将其重命名为溶酶体空泡（LYVAC），是溶酶体空泡形成的一般介质。使用人类细胞系，我们发现多种溶酶体空泡化诱导剂聚集在溶酶体渗透压上，通过多价相互作用触发 LYVAC 募集。应激诱导的溶酶体脂质信号传导有助于 LYVAC 的募集和激活。通过直接感应溶酶体磷脂酰丝氨酸和胆固醇，LYVAC 的脂质转移结构域介导内质网到溶酶体的定向脂质运动，导致溶酶体的渗透膜扩张。这些发现揭示了溶酶体空泡形成的基本机制，在病理生理学中具有广泛的意义。

articles.title: Ume6 protein complexes connect morphogenesis, adherence and hypoxic genes to shape Candida albicans biofilm architecture.
articles.titleZh: Ume6 蛋白复合物连接形态发生、粘附和缺氧基因以塑造白色念珠菌生物膜结构。
articles.authors: Do E, McManus CJ, Zarnowski R, Huang MY, Goerlich K, Andes DR, Mitchell AP.
articles.abstract: Biofilms of the fungal pathogen Candida albicans can form on implanted medical devices and contribute to fungal virulence and are recalcitrant to antifungal therapy. The transcription factor Ume6 directs hyphal cell elongation and thus promotes biofilm formation in C. albicans. However, how exactly this key biofilm and virulence regulator functions has remained unclear. Here RNA sequencing and chromatin immunoprecipitation with sequencing data show that Ume6 binds to and activates multiple biofilm-relevant genes. Ume6-associated sequence motifs correspond to binding sites for biofilm master regulators Efg1 and Ndt80, and hypoxic response regulator Upc2. Co-immunoprecipitation assays show the existence of Ume6-Efg1, Ume6-Ndt80 and Ume6-Upc2 protein complexes. Promoter binding of Ume6 is partially dependent upon Efg1, Ndt80 or Upc2, as is Ume6 target gene activation, thus indicating that the protein complexes function to drive Ume6-target gene interaction. Ume6 therefore acts as a bridge that connects the hyphal morphogenesis and adherence genes that shape biofilm architecture and the hypoxic response genes required for growth in the low-oxygen biofilm environment. These findings are vital for our understanding of the pathobiology of C. albicans and could open the way to new treatment options.
articles.abstractZh: 真菌病原体白色念珠菌的生物膜可以在植入的医疗设备上形成，并导致真菌毒力并且难以抗真菌治疗。转录因子 Ume6 指导菌丝细胞伸长，从而促进白色念珠菌生物膜的形成。然而，这种关键的生物膜和毒力调节剂究竟如何发挥作用仍不清楚。此处，RNA 测序和染色质免疫沉淀与测序数据显示 Ume6 结合并激活多个生物膜相关基因。 Ume6 相关序列基序对应于生物膜主调节因子 Efg1 和 Ndt80 以及缺氧反应调节因子 Upc2 的结合位点。免疫共沉淀分析显示 Ume6-Efg1、Ume6-Ndt80 和 Ume6-Upc2 蛋白复合物的存在。 Ume6 的启动子结合部分依赖于 Efg1、Ndt80 或 Upc2，Ume6 靶基因激活也是如此，因此表明蛋白质复合物的功能是驱动 Ume6-靶基因相互作用。因此，Ume6 充当桥梁，连接塑造生物膜结构的菌丝形态发生和粘附基因以及在低氧生物膜环境中生长所需的缺氧反应基因。这些发现是

articles.title: Diverse oncogenes use common mechanisms to drive growth of major forms of human cancer.
articles.titleZh: 不同的癌基因使用共同的机制来驱动主要人类癌症的生长。
articles.authors: Kauko O, Turunen M, Pihlajamaa P, Häkkinen A, Queiroz RML, Pääkkönen M, Ventelä S, Gaetani M, Lundström SL, Murgia A, Sahu B, Routila J, Wei GH, Irjala H, Griffin JL, Lilley KS, Kivioja T, Hautaniemi S, Taipale J.
articles.abstract: Mutations in numerous genes contribute to human cancer, with different oncogenic lesions prevalent in different cancer types. However, the malignant phenotype is simple, characterized by unrestricted cell growth, invasion, and often metastasis. One possible hypothesis explaining this dichotomy is that cancer genes regulate common targets, which then function as master regulators of essential cancer phenotypes. To identify mechanisms that drive the most fundamental feature shared by all tumors-unrestricted cell proliferation-we used a multiomic approach, which identified translation and ribosome biogenesis as common targets of major oncogenic pathways across cancer types. Proteomic analysis of tumors and functional studies of cell cultures established nucleolar and coiled-body phosphoprotein 1 as a key node, whose convergent regulation, both transcriptionally and posttranslationally, is critical for tumor cell proliferation. Our results indicate that lineage-specific oncogenic pathways regulate the same set of targets for growth control, revealing key downstream nodes that could be targeted for therapy or chemoprevention.
articles.abstractZh: 许多基因的突变导致人类癌症，不同的癌症类型中普遍存在不同的致癌病变。然而，恶性表型很简单，其特点是细胞生长、侵袭和经常转移不受限制。解释这种二分法的一个可能的假设是，癌症基因调节共同的靶标，然后这些靶标充当基本癌症表型的主要调节因子。为了确定驱动所有肿瘤共有的最基本特征（不受限制的细胞增殖）的机制，我们使用了多组学方法，该方法将翻译和核糖体生物合成确定为跨癌症类型的主要致癌途径的共同目标。肿瘤的蛋白质组学分析和细胞培养物的功能研究将核仁和卷曲体磷蛋白 1 确定为关键节点，其转录和翻译后的聚合调节对于肿瘤细胞增殖至关重要。我们的结果表明，谱系特异性致癌途径调节同一组生长控制目标，揭示了可作为治疗或化学预防目标的关键下游节点。

articles.title: Engineered yeast provides rare but essential pollen sterols for honeybees.
articles.titleZh: 工程酵母为蜜蜂提供稀有但必需的花粉甾醇。
articles.authors: Moore E, de Sousa RT, Felsinger S, Arnesen JA, Dyekjær JD, Farman DI, Gonçalves RFS, Stevenson PC, Borodina I, Wright GA.
articles.abstract: Honeybees are important crop pollinators, but they increasingly face pollen starvation as a result of agricultural intensification and climate change1. Frequent flowering dearth periods and high-density rearing conditions weaken colonies, which often leads to their demise2. Beekeepers provide colonies with pollen substitutes, but these feeds do not sustain brood production because they lack essential sterols found in pollen3,4. Here we describe a technological advance in honeybee nutrition with wide-reaching impacts on global food security. We first measured the quantity and proportion of sterols present in honeybee tissues. Using this information, we genetically engineered a strain of the oleaginous yeast Yarrowia lipolytica to produce a mixture of essential sterols for bees and incorporated this yeast strain into an otherwise nutritionally complete diet. Colonies exclusively fed with this diet reared brood for significantly longer than those fed diets without suitable sterols. The use of this method to incorporate sterol supplements into pollen substitutes will enable honeybee colonies to produce brood in the absence of floral pollen. Optimized diets created using this yeast strain could also reduce competition between bee species for access to natural floral resources and stem the decline in wild bee populations.
articles.abstractZh: 蜜蜂是重要的农作物授粉媒介，但由于农业集约化和气候变化，它们日益面临花粉饥饿的问题1。频繁的开花缺乏期和高密度饲养条件会削弱蜂群，这通常会导致它们的死亡2。养蜂人为蜂群提供花粉替代品，但这些饲料不能维持育雏生产，因为它们缺乏花粉中的必需甾醇3,4。在这里，我们描述了蜜蜂营养方面的技术进步，对全球粮食安全产生了广泛影响。我们首先测量了蜜蜂组织中甾醇的数量和比例。利用这些信息，我们对产油酵母解脂耶氏酵母菌株进行了基因改造，以生产蜜蜂必需的甾醇混合物，并将这种酵母菌株纳入营养全面的饮食中。专门用这种饮食喂养的蜂群比那些没有合适的甾醇饮食的蜂群饲养育雏的时间要长得多。使用这种方法将甾醇补充剂纳入花粉替代品中将使蜂群能够在没有花粉的情况下产卵。使用该酵母菌创建的优化饮食

articles.title: Histone demethylase LSD1 regulates lipid homeostasis during <i>Cryptococcus neoformans</i> infection.
articles.titleZh: 组蛋白去甲基化酶 LSD1 在新型隐球菌感染期间调节脂质稳态。
articles.authors: Lohia GK, Shah A, Balaji KN.
articles.abstract: An opportunistic fungal pathogen, Cryptococcus neoformans, causes cryptococcal meningitis and is frequently associated with high mortality in immunocompromised individuals. The formation of metabolically altered lipid-rich foamy macrophages is a successful strategy used by various intracellular pathogens to secure a nutrient source and niche within the host. Herein, we elucidate the involvement of macroautophagy, specifically lipophagy, in lipid dysregulation during C. neoformans infection. C. neoformans driven activation of WNT-signaling leads to an aberrant lipid accumulation in host macrophages under the regulatory role of a histone modifier, Lysine Specific Demethylase 1 (LSD1). In a murine model of pulmonary infection, targeting host LSD1 led to a significant reduction in lung fungal burden, accompanied by improved lung pathology and reduced lipid content in the lungs. The study highlights the significance of host epigenetic regulation in modulating foamy macrophage formation through the regulation of lipophagy during C. neoformans pathogenesis.
articles.abstractZh: 新型隐球菌是一种机会性真菌病原体，可引起隐球菌性脑膜炎，并且通常与免疫功能低下个体的高死亡率相关。代谢改变的富含脂质的泡沫状巨噬细胞的形成是各种细胞内病原体用来确保宿主内营养源和生态位的成功策略。在此，我们阐明了巨自噬，特别是脂肪自噬，在新型隐球菌感染期间的脂质失调中的作用。在组蛋白修饰剂赖氨酸特异性脱甲基酶 1 (LSD1) 的调节作用下，新型隐球菌驱动的 WNT 信号激活导致宿主巨噬细胞中异常脂质积累。在小鼠肺部感染模型中，靶向宿主LSD1可显着减少肺部真菌负荷，同时改善肺部病理学并降低肺部脂质含量。该研究强调了宿主表观遗传调控在新型隐球菌发病过程中通过调节脂肪吞噬来调节泡沫巨噬细胞形成的重要性。

articles.title: Moderate heating renders 7.8-million-year-old sedimentary organic matter bioavailable.
articles.titleZh: 适度的加热使 780 万年前的沉积有机质具有生物可利用性。
articles.authors: Gan S, Heuer VB, Schmidt F, Wörmer L, Wang F, Adhikari RR, Hatcher P, Pearson A, Hinrichs KU.
articles.abstract: Marine sediments are a large reservoir of recalcitrant organic matter and host microbes at subsurface depths exceeding 2.4 kilometers and temperatures up to 120°C, yet the mechanisms supplying bioavailable substrates remain unclear. Here, we investigated 7.8-million-year-old sediment from IODP Site C0012 off the Nankai Trough, Japan, through incubations at 20°, 35°, 55°, and 85°C to simulate burial temperatures. Using 3D fluorescence spectroscopy and ultrahigh-resolution mass spectrometry, we tracked changes in dissolved organic matter (DOM). At 35°C, humic-like DOM was released alongside metal ions, exhibiting low bioavailability. At 55°C, abiotic decomposition of humic compounds generated smaller, more bioavailable DOM, promoting fermentation. At 85°C, large nitrogen-containing humic compounds decomposed, producing labile H2 and acetate mainly through abiotic processes, bypassing fermentation. Our findings show how abiotic thermal processes activate the refractory organic matter pool, advancing our understanding of long-term carbon sequestration in marine sediments and its implications for global carbon cycling.
articles.abstractZh: 海洋沉积物是一个巨大的顽固性有机物库，在地下超过 2.4 公里的深度和高达 120°C 的温度下寄生着微生物，但提供生物可利用底物的机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们通过在 20°C、35°C、55°C 和 85°C 下培养来模拟埋藏温度，对日本南海海槽附近 IODP Site C0012 的 780 万年前的沉积物进行了调查。使用 3D 荧光光谱和超高分辨率质谱，我们追踪了溶解有机物 (DOM) 的变化。在 35°C 时，类腐殖酸 DOM 与金属离子一起释放，表现出较低的生物利用度。在 55°C 时，腐殖质化合物的非生物分解产生更小、更具生物利用度的 DOM，从而促进发酵。在 85°C 时，大量含氮腐殖质化合物分解，主要通过非生物过程产生不稳定的氢气和乙酸，绕过发酵。我们的研究结果表明非生物热过程如何激活难熔有机物质库，增进我们对海洋沉积物中长期碳封存及其对全球碳循环影响的理解。

articles.title: Plant negative-strand RNA virus phosphoprotein condensates exploit host trafficking and lipid synthesis for viral factory assembly.
articles.titleZh: 植物负链 RNA 病毒磷蛋白缩合物利用宿主运输和脂质合成进行病毒工厂组装。
articles.authors: Wang Z, Zhang J, Huang J, Sha G, Song X, Cao X, Yan Z, Liu C, Chen S, Li Z, Huang X, Xie Q, Yang X, Zhou G, Zhang T.
articles.abstract: RNA viruses often remodel host intracellular membranes to establish specialized replication compartments through viral protein-induced phase separation. However, the mechanisms underlying membrane remodeling and the characteristics that render these sites conducive to replication remain poorly understood, particularly in plant negative-strand RNA viruses. Here, we demonstrate that the phosphoprotein (P) of rice stripe mosaic virus (RSMV) forms biomolecular condensates via liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) to recruit essential components for viral replication factories (VFs). We identify a direct interaction between RSMV P and adenosine diphosphate (ADP) ribosylation factor 1 (OsARF1C), a crucial regulator of the coatomer protein I (COP I) vesicle transport pathway that is vital for viral replication. This interaction indirectly recruits OsARF1C's partner, phosphatidylinositol 4-kinase beta (OsPI4KB), which drives localized phosphatidylinositol-4 phosphate (PI4P) synthesis. Concurrently, the P protein modulates its aggregates and LLPS droplets through PI4P, thereby expanding the replication site and enhancing viral replication.
articles.abstractZh: RNA病毒经常重塑宿主细胞内膜，通过病毒蛋白诱导的相分离建立专门的复制区室。然而，膜重塑的机制以及使这些位点有利于复制的特征仍然知之甚少，特别是在植物负链 RNA 病毒中。在这里，我们证明了水稻条纹花叶病毒（RSMV）的磷蛋白（P）通过液-液相分离（LLPS）形成生物分子缩合物，以招募病毒复制工厂（VF）的必需成分。我们确定了 RSMV P 与二磷酸腺苷 (ADP) 核糖基化因子 1 (OsARF1C) 之间的直接相互作用，OsARF1C 是对病毒复制至关重要的外壳蛋白 I (COP I) 囊泡运输途径的关键调节因子。这种相互作用间接招募 OsARF1C 的伴侣磷脂酰肌醇 4 激酶 β (OsPI4KB)，后者驱动局部磷脂酰肌醇 4 磷酸 (PI4P) 合成。同时，P蛋白通过PI4P调节其聚集体和LLPS液滴，从而扩大复制位点并增强病毒复制。

articles.title: SLC45A4 is a pain gene encoding a neuronal polyamine transporter.
articles.titleZh: SLC45A4 是编码神经元多胺转运蛋白的疼痛基因。
articles.authors: Middleton SJ, Markússon S, Åkerlund M, Deme JC, Tseng M, Li W, Zuberi SR, Kuteyi G, Sarkies P, Baskozos G, Perez-Sanchez J, Farah A, Hébert HL, Toikumo S, Yu Z, Maxwell S, Dong YY, Kessler BM, Kranzler HR, Linley JE, Smith BH, Lea SM, Parker JL, Lyssenko V, Newstead S, Bennett DL.
articles.abstract: Polyamines are regulatory metabolites with key roles in transcription, translation, cell signalling and autophagy1. They are implicated in multiple neurological disorders, including stroke, epilepsy and neurodegeneration, and can regulate neuronal excitability through interactions with ion channels2. Polyamines have been linked to pain, showing altered levels in human persistent pain states and modulation of pain behaviour in animal models3. However, the systems governing polyamine transport within the nervous system remain unclear. Here, undertaking a genome-wide association study (GWAS) of chronic pain intensity in the UK Biobank (UKB), we found a significant association between pain intensity and variants mapping to the SLC45A4 gene locus. In the mouse nervous system, Slc45a4 expression is enriched in all sensory neuron subtypes within the dorsal root ganglion, including nociceptors. Cell-based assays show that SLC45A4 is a selective plasma membrane polyamine transporter, and the cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) structure reveals a regulatory domain and basis for polyamine recognition. Mice lacking SLC45A4 show normal mechanosensitivity but reduced sensitivity to noxious heat- and algogen-induced tonic pain that is associated with reduced excitability of C-polymodal nociceptors. Our findings therefore establish a role for neuronal polyamine transport in pain perception and identify a target for therapeutic intervention in pain treatment.
articles.abstractZh: 多胺是调节代谢物，在转录、翻译、细胞信号传导和自噬中发挥关键作用1。它们与多种神经系统疾病有关，包括中风、癫痫和神经变性，并且可以通过与离子通道的相互作用来调节神经元兴奋性2。多胺与疼痛有关，显示人类持续性疼痛状态的水平发生改变，并在动物模型中调节疼痛行为3。然而，神经系统内控制多胺转运的系统仍不清楚。在这里，我们在英国生物银行 (UKB) 进行了慢性疼痛强度的全基因组关联研究 (GWAS)，发现疼痛强度与映射到 SLC45A4 基因位点的变异之间存在显着关联。在小鼠神经系统中，Slc45a4 表达在背根神经节内的所有感觉神经元亚型中丰富，包括伤害感受器。基于细胞的检测表明，SLC45A4 是一种选择性质膜多胺转运蛋白，冷冻电子显微镜 (cryo-EM) 结构揭示了多胺识别的调节域和基础。缺乏SLC45A4的小鼠表现出正常的机械敏感性，但对有害热的敏感性降低

articles.title: Tandem repeat-induced sexual silencing: A Rid-dependent RNAi mechanism for fungal genome defense via translational repression.
articles.titleZh: 串联重复诱导的有性沉默：通过翻译抑制实现真菌基因组防御的 Rid 依赖性 RNAi 机制。
