articles.abstractZh: 吞噬白细胞利用活性氧来防御病原微生物。细菌病原体金黄色葡萄球菌通过产生抗氧化酶和小分子来适应氧化应激，以保护蛋白质、核酸和其他重要的细胞成分。在这里，我们发现硫辛酸载体蛋白 GcvH-L 促进金黄色葡萄球菌对氧化应激的抵抗力。编码 GcvH-L 的基因位于多种病原微生物的保守操纵子内。该操纵子还编码 LplA2（一种氧化还原响应性硫辛酰连接酶）和 SirTM（一种 ADP-核糖基转移酶）。我们证明硫辛酰-GcvH-L 的 ADP-核糖基化可以保护硫辛酸免于氧化，并调节其从 GcvH-L 转移到中央代谢所需的酶复合物。 ΔgcvH-L 突变体在感染过程中减弱，并且对吞噬细胞呼吸爆发更敏感，这种表型在 NADPH 氧化酶缺陷小鼠中被消除。因此，ADP-核糖基化和脂酰化在GcvH-L上汇聚，促进金黄色葡萄球菌对氧化应激的抵抗。

articles.title: (p)ppGpp imposes graded transcriptional changes to impair motility and promote antibiotic tolerance in biofilms.
articles.titleZh: (p)ppGpp 施加分级转录变化以损害生物膜的运动性并促进抗生素耐受性。
articles.authors: Engelhardt F, Turnbull K, Gür M, Müsken M, Preusse M, Häussler S, Roghanian M.
articles.abstract: (p)ppGpp is the master regulator of bacterial stress responses, orchestrating cellular physiology via the stringent response to promote survival and adaptation. In response to nutritional challenges and stress, (p)ppGpp extensively rewires the transcriptome. Here, we demonstrate that (p)ppGpp production in Pseudomonas aeruginosa is gradual and relative to stress severity, rather than binary (on/off). Transcriptomic analysis reveals that (p)ppGpp ensures proportionate cellular responses to stress by imposing a layer-by-layer regulation of gene expression. These effects intensify as (p)ppGpp levels rise, with up to a quarter of the genome differentially regulated at maximal levels. Initial increases in (p)ppGpp reduce growth and metabolism while suppressing motility and pyocyanin production. At higher levels, biofilm-related genes are upregulated at the expense of virulence genes, promoting the formation of condensed biofilms. Finally, (p)ppGpp-driven reprogramming induces antimicrobial tolerance, particularly under biofilm conditions, independently of its effects on growth.
articles.abstractZh: (p)ppGpp 是细菌应激反应的主要调节因子，通过严格的反应来协调细胞生理学，以促进生存和适应。为了应对营养挑战和压力，(p)ppGpp 广泛地重新连接转录组。在这里，我们证明铜绿假单胞菌中 (p)ppGpp 的产生是渐进的，并且与应激严重程度相关，而不是二元的（开/关）。转录组分析表明，(p)ppGpp 通过对基因表达进行逐层调控，确保细胞对压力做出适当的反应。随着 (p)ppGpp 水平的升高，这些影响会加剧，多达四分之一的基因组在最大水平上受到差异调节。 (p)ppGpp 的初始增加会降低生长和代谢，同时抑制运动和绿脓蛋白的产生。在较高水平上，生物膜相关基因以毒力基因为代价上调，促进浓缩生物膜的形成。最后，(p)ppGpp 驱动的重编程会诱导抗菌素耐受性，特别是在生物膜条件下，与其对生长的影响无关。

articles.title: 2-hydroxyglutarate mediates whitening of brown adipocytes coupled to nuclear softening upon mitochondrial dysfunction.
articles.titleZh: 2-羟基戊二酸介导棕色脂肪细胞的增白以及线粒体功能障碍时的核软化。
articles.authors: Kaul H, Isermann L, Senft K, Popovic M, Georgomanolis T, Baumann L, Sivanesan P, Pouikli A, Nolte H, Lucic B, Hildebrandt X, Seidel K, Gnad T, Gaedke F, Göbel U, Peters F, Cherevatenko M, Park JH, Schauss A, Peltzer N, Brüning JC, Kornfeld JW, Pfeifer A, Langer T, Lusic M, Wickström SA, Frezza C, Trifunovic A.
articles.abstract: Mitochondria have a crucial role in regulating cellular homeostasis in response to intrinsic and extrinsic cues by changing cellular metabolism to meet these challenges. However, the molecular underpinnings of this regulation and the complete spectrum of these physiological outcomes remain largely unexplored. In this study, we elucidate the mechanisms driving the whitening phenotype in brown adipose tissue (BAT) deficient in the mitochondrial matrix protease CLPP. Here we show that CLPP-deficient BAT shows aberrant accumulation of lipid droplets, which occurs independently of defects in oxygen consumption and fatty acid oxidation. Our results indicate that mitochondrial dysfunction due to CLPP deficiency leads to the build-up of the oncometabolite D-2-hydroxyglutarate (D-2HG), which in turn promotes lipid droplet enlargement. We further demonstrate that D-2HG influences gene expression and decreases nuclear stiffness by modifying epigenetic signatures. We propose that lipid accumulation and altered nuclear stiffness regulated through 2HG are stress responses to mitochondrial dysfunction in BAT.
articles.abstractZh: 线粒体通过改变细胞代谢来应对这些挑战，在响应内在和外在信号而调节细胞稳态方面发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，这种调节的分子基础和这些生理结果的完整范围在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这项研究中，我们阐明了在线粒体基质蛋白酶 CLPP 缺陷的棕色脂肪组织 (BAT) 中驱动美白表型的机制。在这里，我们发现 CLPP 缺陷的 BAT 表现出脂滴的异常积累，这种积累与氧消耗和脂肪酸氧化的缺陷无关。我们的结果表明，由于 CLPP 缺乏而导致的线粒体功能障碍会导致致癌代谢物 D-2-羟基戊二酸 (D-2HG) 的积累，进而促进脂滴增大。我们进一步证明 D-2HG 通过修改表观遗传特征影响基因表达并降低核硬度。我们认为，通过 2HG 调节的脂质积累和核硬度改变是 BAT 中线粒体功能障碍的应激反应。

articles.title: Biomolecular condensates in plant immunity.
articles.titleZh: 植物免疫中的生物分子凝聚体。
articles.authors: Huang S, Dong X.
articles.abstract: Plant defense against microbial pathogens relies on coordinated regulation of diverse molecular processes. Although much has been learned about these processes through traditional and modern approaches, recent findings indicate that they are orchestrated through membraneless biomolecular condensates formed via liquid-liquid phase separation and related phase transitions. The principle of subcellular compartmentalization is especially important for plants, as they lack specialized immune cells, requiring them to coordinate defense responses with other physiological functions. As a result, the dynamic spatiotemporal organization of immune-related molecules becomes a critical layer of regulation that has only recently become a research frontier. Here, we discuss the emerging roles of biomolecular condensates in plant immunity, identify critical questions for future research, and propose a framework for moving forward. By incorporating condensate biology into the study of plant defense, we suggest novel strategies for enhancing crop resilience and advancing sustainable agriculture.
articles.abstractZh: 植物对微生物病原体的防御依赖于不同分子过程的协调调节。尽管通过传统和现代方法已经对这些过程有了很多了解，但最近的研究结果表明，它们是通过液-液相分离和相关相变形成的无膜生物分子缩合物精心策划的。亚细胞区室化的原理对植物尤其重要，因为它们缺乏专门的免疫细胞，需要它们协调防御反应与其他生理功能。因此，免疫相关分子的动态时空组织成为关键的调控层，直到最近才成为研究前沿。在这里，我们讨论了生物分子缩合物在植物免疫中的新兴作用，确定了未来研究的关键问题，并提出了一个前进的框架。通过将凝结水生物学纳入植物防御研究，我们提出了增强作物恢复力和推进可持续农业的新策略。

articles.title: Directed evolution of LaccID for cell surface proximity labeling and electron microscopy.
articles.titleZh: 用于细胞表面邻近标记和电子显微镜的 LaccID 的定向进化。
articles.authors: Lee SY, Roh H, Gonzalez-Perez D, Mackey MR, Hoces D, McLaughlin CN, Lin C, Adams SR, Nguyen K, Kim KY, Luginbuhl DJ, Luo L, Udeshi ND, Carr SA, Hernández-López RA, Ellisman MH, Alcalde M, Ting AY.
articles.abstract: Enzymes that oxidize aromatic substrates have been harnessed for cell-based technologies including proximity labeling and electron microscopy; however, they are associated with drawbacks such as the need for toxic H2O2. Here, we explore multicopper oxidases (laccases) as a new enzyme class for proximity labeling and electron microscopy in mammalian cells. LaccID was generated through 11 rounds of directed evolution from an ancestral fungal laccase and catalyzes one-electron oxidation of diverse aromatic substrates using O2 instead of toxic H2O2. Surprisingly, we found that LaccID is selectively active at the surface plasma membrane of both living and fixed cells. We use LaccID proximity labeling and mass spectrometry to map the changing surface proteome of T cells that engage with tumor cells through antigen-specific T cell receptors. In addition, we use LaccID as a genetically encodable tag for EM visualization of cell surface features in mammalian cell culture and in the fly brain. Our study paves the way for future cell-based applications of LaccID.
articles.abstractZh: 氧化芳香族底物的酶已被用于基于细胞的技术，包括邻近标记和电子显微镜；然而，它们也有一些缺点，例如需要有毒的 H2O2。在这里，我们探索多铜氧化酶（漆酶）作为哺乳动物细胞中邻近标记和电子显微镜的新酶类。 LaccID 是通过祖先真菌漆酶经过 11 轮定向进化而产生的，并使用 O2 而不是有毒的 H2O2 催化多种芳香族底物的单电子氧化。令人惊讶的是，我们发现 LaccID 在活细胞和固定细胞的表面质膜上具有选择性活性。我们使用 LaccID 邻近标记和质谱分析来绘制 T 细胞表面蛋白质组的变化，这些 T 细胞通过抗原特异性 T 细胞受体与肿瘤细胞结合。此外，我们使用 LaccID 作为基因可编码标签，用于哺乳动物细胞培养物和果蝇大脑中细胞表面特征的电镜可视化。我们的研究为 LaccID 未来基于细胞的应用铺平了道路。

articles.title: eIF2A regulates cell migration in a translation-independent manner.
articles.titleZh: eIF2A 以不依赖翻译的方式调节细胞迁移。
articles.authors: Jungfleisch J, Mestre-Farràs N, Gómez-Riera R, Pourcelot O, Bertrand E, Halidi N, Gebauer F.
articles.abstract: The RNA-binding protein eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2A (eIF2A) is an alternative translation initiation factor shown to drive tumor formation by facilitating translation from near-cognate initiation codons. Here, we uncover a function for eIF2A in regulating cell migration in a manner independent of overt control of translation. Using a melanoma cell model consisting of nontumoral melanocytic Mel-ST cells and their metastatic counterpart obtained by H-Ras transformation, we unexpectedly find minimal effects of eIF2A depletion on translation. Interactome studies identified centrosomal proteins as major binding partners of eIF2A. We found that eIF2A colocalizes with the centrosome, enhances centrosome composition, and promotes centrosome orientation during cell migration. Migration requires the C-terminal disordered region of eIF2A, involved in mRNA binding. Interaction with mRNA, however, does not require ongoing translation. These findings reveal a role for eIF2A in centrosome dynamics beyond its traditional function in translation.
articles.abstractZh: RNA 结合蛋白真核翻译起始因子 2A (eIF2A) 是另一种翻译起始因子，显示可通过促进近同源起始密码子的翻译来驱动肿瘤形成。在这里，我们发现了 eIF2A 以独立于翻译的明显控制的方式调节细胞迁移的功能。使用由非肿瘤黑素细胞 Mel-ST 细胞及其通过 H-Ras 转化获得的转移性对应细胞组成的黑色素瘤细胞模型，我们意外地发现 eIF2A 耗竭对翻译的影响极小。相互作用组研究确定中心体蛋白是 eIF2A 的主要结合伙伴。我们发现 eIF2A 与中心体共定位，增强中心体组成，并在细胞迁移过程中促进中心体定向。迁移需要 eIF2A C 端无序区域，参与 mRNA 结合。然而，与 mRNA 的相互作用不需要持续的翻译。这些发现揭示了 eIF2A 在中心体动力学中的作用超出了其传统的翻译功能。

articles.title: Engineering affinity-matured variants of an anti-polysialic acid monoclonal antibody with superior cytotoxicity-mediating potency.
articles.titleZh: 工程化亲和力成熟的抗聚唾液酸单克隆抗体变体，具有优异的细胞毒性介导效力。
articles.authors: Wang W, Bunyatov M, Moffat D, Lopez-Barbosa N, DeLisa MP.
articles.abstract: Monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) that specifically recognize cell surface glycans associated with cancer and infectious disease hold tremendous value for basic research and clinical applications. However, high-quality anti-glycan mAbs with sufficiently high affinity and specificity remain scarce, highlighting the need for strategies that enable optimization of antigen-binding properties. To this end, we engineered the affinity of a polysialic acid (polySia)-specific antibody called mAb735, which possesses only modest affinity. Using a combination of rational design and directed evolution, we isolated several affinity-matured IgG variants with ∼5- to 7-fold stronger affinity for polySia relative to mAb735. The higher affinity IgG variants opsonized polySia-positive cancer cells more avidly and triggered greater antibody-dependent cell-mediated cytotoxicity (ADCC) and complement-dependent cytotoxicity (CDC). Collectively, these results demonstrate the effective application of molecular evolution techniques to an important anti-glycan antibody, providing insights into its carbohydrate recognition and uncovering variants with greater therapeutic promise due to their enhanced affinity and potency.
articles.abstractZh: 特异性识别与癌症和传染病相关的细胞表面聚糖的单克隆抗体 (mAb) 对于基础研究和临床应用具有巨大价值。然而，具有足够高亲和力和特异性的高质量抗聚糖单克隆抗体仍然稀缺，这突出表明需要能够优化抗原结合特性的策略。为此，我们设计了一种名为 mAb735 的聚唾液酸 (polySia) 特异性抗体的亲和力，该抗体仅具有适度的亲和力。通过合理设计和定向进化的结合，我们分离出了几种亲和力成熟的 IgG 变体，其对 PolySia 的亲和力比 mAb735 强 5 至 7 倍。亲和力较高的 IgG 变体更积极地调理 PolySia 阳性癌细胞，并引发更大的抗体依赖性细胞介导的细胞毒性 (ADCC) 和补体依赖性细胞毒性 (CDC)。总的来说，这些结果证明了分子进化技术在重要的抗聚糖抗体上的有效应用，提供了对其碳水化合物识别的深入了解，并发现了由于其增强的亲和力和p而具有更大治疗前景的变体。

articles.title: Pseudomonads coordinate innate defense against viruses and bacteria with a single regulatory system.
articles.titleZh: 假单胞菌通过单一的调节系统协调针对病毒和细菌的先天防御。
articles.authors: Brinkley DM, Bertolli SK, Gallagher LA, Tan Y, Motha de Silva M, Brockman A, Zhang D, Peterson SB, Mougous JD.
articles.abstract: Bacterial cells live under constant existential threats imposed by other bacteria and viruses. Mechanisms for contending with these threats are well documented; however, the regulation of these diverse defense elements remains poorly understood. Here, we describe a genome-wide, coordinated, and highly effective immune response, termed Gac/Rsm-regulated unified antagonism response and defense (GUARD), that protects against bacterial and viral threats using a single regulatory pathway. Bioinformatic analyses reveal a Pseudomonas-wide form of the Gac/Rsm regulatory pathway (GRP), an established danger-sensing system in P. aeruginosa. Proteomic studies of diverse Pseudomonas species show that the pathway regulates a large and variable suite of factors implicated in defense against both bacterial and phage threats. Focusing on P. protegens, we identify profound phenotypic consequences of these factors against multiple forms of bacterial antagonism and several phages. Together, our results reveal that bacteria, like multicellular eukaryotes, couple danger sensing to the activation of an immune response with antibacterial and antiviral arms.
articles.abstractZh: 细菌细胞生活在其他细菌和病毒持续存在的威胁之下。应对这些威胁的机制已有详细记录；然而，人们对这些不同防御要素的调节仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们描述了一种全基因组、协调且高效的免疫反应，称为 Gac/Rsm 调节的统一拮抗反应和防御 (GUARD)，它使用单一调节途径防御细菌和病毒威胁。生物信息学分析揭示了假单胞菌范围内的 Gac/Rsm 调节途径 (GRP)，这是铜绿假单胞菌中已建立的危险感知系统。对不同假单胞菌属物种的蛋白质组学研究表明，该途径调节大量且可变的因素，这些因素涉及防御细菌和噬菌体的威胁。重点关注 P. protegens，我们确定了这些因素对多种形式的细菌拮抗作用和几种噬菌体的深刻表型影响。总之，我们的结果表明，细菌，如多细胞真核生物，将危险感知与抗菌和抗病毒臂的免疫反应的激活结合起来。

articles.title: Structural basis of pseudoGTPase-mediated protein-protein interactions.
articles.titleZh: 假 GTP 酶介导的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的结构基础。
articles.authors: Wang B, Yang R, Wan C, Tian Y, Wu J, Adewole TS, Roy S, Li S, Shen J, Yin Q.
articles.abstract: GTPases regulate cellular processes through conformational changes triggered by guanine nucleotide binding. Recently, pseudoGTPases, the catalytically inactive counterparts of GTPases, have been identified across species from bacteria to human, although their functions and mechanisms remain unexplored. Here, we demonstrate that the N-terminal region of the assembly chaperone AAGAB is a class I pseudoGTPase using biochemistry and X-ray crystallography. Furthermore, we discovered that the AAGAB pseudoGTPase domain (psGD) interacts with the σ subunits of AP1 and AP2 adaptor complexes, which are heterotetrameric complexes involved in clathrin-mediated membrane trafficking. AAGAB psGD engages the σ subunits via a unique interface distinct from the conventional GTPase interacting regions. Further biochemical and cell-based assays confirmed the crucial role of the newly identified interface in binding and membrane trafficking. Collectively, our results establish AAGAB pseudoGTPase domain as a critical protein-protein interaction module. These findings offer new insight into the structural basis and molecular mechanisms of pseudoGTPases.
articles.abstractZh: GTPases 通过鸟嘌呤核苷酸结合引发的构象变化来调节细胞过程。最近，假 GTP 酶（GTP 酶的无催化活性对应物）已在从细菌到人类的各个物种中得到鉴定，尽管其功能和机制仍未得到探索。在这里，我们使用生物化学和 X 射线晶体学证明了组装伴侣 AAGAB 的 N 端区域是 I 类假 GTP 酶。此外，我们发现 AAGAB 假 GTP 酶结构域 (psGD) 与 AP1 和 AP2 接头复合物的 σ 亚基相互作用，AP1 和 AP2 接头复合物是参与网格蛋白介导的膜运输的异四聚体复合物。 AAGAB psGD 通过不同于传统 GTPase 相互作用区域的独特界面与 σ 亚基结合。进一步的生化和细胞测定证实了新发现的界面在结合和膜运输中的关键作用。总的来说，我们的结果将 AAGAB 伪 GTPase 结构域确立为关键的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用模块。这些发现为假GTP酶的结构基础和分子机制提供了新的见解。

articles.title: Protocol for development and use of spike-in control for chromatin immunoprecipitation of chromatin-binding proteins in Schizosaccharomyces pombe.
articles.titleZh: 裂殖酵母染色质结合蛋白染色质免疫沉淀的掺入控制的开发和使用方案。
articles.authors: Khanduja JS, Motamedi M.
articles.abstract: Chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP) assays provide quantitative information about the genomic localization of chromatin-binding proteins; however, their sensitivity is limited by several technical variables. Here, we present a protocol for developing and using Saccharomyces cerevisiae chromatin as an exogenous spike-in control for ChIP of chromatin-binding proteins in Schizosaccharomyces pombe. We describe steps for preparing and validating the spike-in control. We then detail the procedure for adding spike-in control to S. pombe chromatin in ChIP assay and its use in data normalization. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to Khanduja et al.1.
articles.abstractZh: 染色质免疫沉淀 (ChIP) 检测提供有关染色质结合蛋白基因组定位的定量信息；然而，它们的敏感性受到几个技术变量的限制。在这里，我们提出了一种开发和使用酿酒酵母染色质作为裂殖酵母染色质结合蛋白 ChIP 的外源掺入对照的方案。我们描述了准备和验证掺入控制的步骤。然后，我们详细介绍了在 ChIP 测定中向粟酒裂殖酵母染色质添加掺入对照的程序及其在数据标准化中的用途。有关该协议的使用和执行的完整详细信息，请参阅 Khanduja 等人 1。

articles.title: Silencing mitochondrial gene expression in living cells.
articles.titleZh: 沉默活细胞中的线粒体基因表达。
articles.authors: Cruz-Zaragoza LD, Dahal D, Koschel M, Boshnakovska A, Zheenbekova A, Yilmaz M, Morgenstern M, Dohrke JN, Bender J, Valpadashi A, Henningfeld KA, Oeljeklaus S, Kremer LS, Breuer M, Urbach O, Dennerlein S, Lidschreiber M, Jakobs S, Warscheid B, Rehling P.
articles.abstract: Mitochondria fulfill central functions in metabolism and energy supply. They express their own genome, which encodes key subunits of the oxidative phosphorylation system. However, the central mechanisms underlying mitochondrial gene expression remain enigmatic, and a lack of suitable technologies to target mitochondrial protein synthesis in cells has limited experimental access. We silenced the translation of specific mitochondrial mRNAs in living human cells by delivering synthetic peptide-morpholino chimeras. This approach allowed us to perform a comprehensive temporal monitoring of cellular responses. Our study provides insights into mitochondrial translation, its integration into cellular physiology, and provides a strategy to address mitochondrial gene expression in living cells. The approach can potentially be used to analyze mechanisms and pathophysiology of mitochondrial gene expression in a range of cellular model systems.
articles.abstractZh: 线粒体履行新陈代谢和能量供应的核心功能。它们表达自己的基因组，编码氧化磷酸化系统的关键亚基。然而，线粒体基因表达的核心机制仍然是个谜，并且缺乏针对细胞中线粒体蛋白质合成的合适技术限制了实验机会。我们通过提供合成肽-吗啉代嵌合体来沉默人类活细胞中特定线粒体 mRNA 的翻译。这种方法使我们能够对细胞反应进行全面的时间监测。我们的研究提供了对线粒体翻译及其与细胞生理学的整合的见解，并提供了解决活细胞中线粒体基因表达的策略。该方法可用于分析一系列细胞模型系统中线粒体基因表达的机制和病理生理学。

articles.title: A trehalase-derived MAMP triggers LecRK-V-mediated immune responses in <i>Arabidopsis</i>.
articles.titleZh: 海藻糖酶衍生的 MAMP 在拟南芥中触发 LecRK-V 介导的免疫反应。
articles.authors: Iino E, Kadota Y, Maki N, Sato K, Ono E, Ishihama N, Rugen-Hankey M, Wei S, Ngou BPM, Kumakura N, Schmid MW, den Akker SE, Suzuki T, Uehara T, Shirasu K.
articles.abstract: Plant-parasitic nematodes (PPNs) cause major agricultural losses worldwide, yet the molecular basis of plant immunity against these pathogens remains poorly understood. To investigate how plants recognize PPNs, we aimed to identify microbe-associated molecular patterns (MAMPs) from nematodes and the corresponding plant immune components. Because of the limited availability of material from obligate PPNs, we used Caenorhabditis elegans, a free-living nematode, as a MAMP source. C. elegans extract activated MAMP-triggered immune responses in Arabidopsis Col-0. Through chromatography-based purification, we identified a secreted trehalase and pinpointed a conserved peptide region essential for its MAMP activity. A corresponding peptide from root-knot nematode trehalase enabled the identification of lectin receptor kinases LecRK-V.5 and LecRK-V.6 as key components in immune induction. Notably, this peptide region is conserved across some phytophagous insects and fungal pathogens, with LecRK-Vs required for immune responses to these peptides, highlighting the role of LecRK-V-mediated mechanism for broad-spectrum pathogen detection via trehalase-derived peptides.
articles.abstractZh: 植物寄生线虫（PPN）在世界范围内造成重大农业损失，但植物针对这些病原体的免疫的分子基础仍然知之甚少。为了研究植物如何识别 PPN，我们的目的是从线虫和相应的植物免疫成分中识别微生物相关分子模式 (MAMP)。由于来自专性 PPN 的材料有限，我们使用秀丽隐杆线虫（一种自由生活的线虫）作为 MAMP 来源。线虫提取物激活拟南芥 Col-0 中 MAMP 触发的免疫反应。通过基于色谱的纯化，我们鉴定了一种分泌性海藻糖酶，并查明了对其 MAMP 活性至关重要的保守肽区域。来自根结线虫海藻糖酶的相应肽能够鉴定出凝集素受体激酶 LecRK-V.5 和 LecRK-V.6 作为免疫诱导的关键成分。值得注意的是，该肽区域在一些植食性昆虫和真菌病原体中是保守的，LecRK-V 是对这些肽的免疫反应所必需的，这凸显了 LecRK-V 介导的机制在通过海藻糖酶衍生肽进行广谱病原体检测中的作用。

articles.title: Diffusing protein binders to intrinsically disordered proteins.
articles.titleZh: 将蛋白质结合剂扩散至本质上无序的蛋白质。
articles.authors: Liu C, Wu K, Choi H, Han HL, Zhang X, Watson JL, Ahn G, Zhang JZ, Shijo S, Good LL, Fischer CM, Bera AK, Kang A, Brackenbrough E, Coventry B, Hick DR, Qamar S, Li X, Decarreau J, Gerben SR, Yang W, Goreshnik I, Vafeados D, Wang X, Lamb M, Murray A, Kenny S, Bauer MS, Hoofnagle AN, Zhu P, Knowles TPJ, Baker D.
articles.abstract: Proteins that bind to intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) and intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) with high affinity and specificity could be useful for therapeutic and diagnostic applications1-4. However, a general methodology for targeting IDPs or IDRs has yet to be developed. Here we show that starting only from the target sequence of the input, and freely sampling both target and binding protein conformations, RFdiffusion5 can generate binders to IDPs and IDRs in a wide range of conformations. We used this approach to generate binders to the IDPs amylin, C-peptide, VP48 and BRCA1_ARATH in diverse conformations with a dissociation constant (Kd) ranging from 3 to 100 nM. For the IDRs G3BP1, common cytokine receptor γ-chain (IL-2RG) and prion protein, we diffused binders to β-strand conformations of the targets, obtaining Kd between 10 and 100 nM. Fluorescence imaging experiments show that the binders bind to their respective targets in cells. The G3BP1 binder disrupts stress granule formation in cells, and the amylin binder inhibits amyloid fibril formation and dissociates existing fibres, enables targeting of both monomeric and fibrillar amylin to lysosomes, and increases the sensitivity of mass spectrometry-based amylin detection. Our approach should be useful for creating binders to flexible IDPs or IDRs spanning a wide range of intrinsic conformational preferences.
articles.abstractZh: 以高亲和力和特异性与本质无序蛋白 (IDP) 和本质无序区域 (IDR) 结合的蛋白质可用于治疗和诊断应用1-4。然而，针对 IDP 或 IDR 的通用方法尚未制定。在这里，我们表明，仅从输入的目标序列开始，并自由采样目标和结合蛋白构象，RFdiffusion5 可以生成多种构象的 IDP 和 IDR 结合物。我们使用这种方法生成不同构象的 IDP 胰淀素、C 肽、VP48 和 BRCA1_ARATH 的结合物，解离常数 (Kd) 范围为 3 至 100 nM。对于 IDR G3BP1、常见细胞因子受体 γ 链 (IL-2RG) 和朊病毒蛋白，我们将结合剂扩散至靶标的 β 链构象，获得 10 至 100 nM 之间的 Kd。荧光成像实验表明结合物与细胞中各自的靶标结合。 G3BP1 结合剂破坏细胞中应激颗粒的形成，胰岛淀粉样多肽结合剂抑制淀粉样原纤维形成并解离现有纤维，使单体和原纤维胰岛淀粉样多肽能够靶向溶酶体，并增加

articles.title: Natural variation in SBRR1 shows high potential for sheath blight resistance breeding in rice.
articles.titleZh: SBRR1 的自然变异显示出水稻抗纹枯病育种的巨大潜力。
articles.authors: Feng Z, Gao P, Wang G, Kang H, Zhao J, Xie W, Chen R, Ju R, Wang X, Wei Z, Zhang H, Zhang J, Zhang Y, Hu K, Sun Q, Zhu Y, Xiong Y, Liu X, Chen X, Chen Z, Yang C, Liu J, Wang GL, Zhang SW, Yang Z, Zuo S.
articles.abstract: Sheath blight (ShB), caused by necrotrophic fungus Rhizoctonia solani, is one of the most serious rice diseases worldwide. To the best of our knowledge, no genes with high potential for rice ShB resistance breeding have been previously characterized. Here we identify a ShB resistance receptor-like kinase 1 (SBRR1) gene via a genome-wide association study. The SBRR1-R elite allele, containing a 256-bp insertion in its promoter, is preferentially present in indica varieties in geographical regions with highly favorable conditions for ShB development. Introduction of SBRR1-R into a commercial japonica rice variety significantly reduces yield loss under severe ShB disease pressure. Transcription factor bHLH57 specifically binds to the 256-bp sequence and accounts for highly induced expression and stronger resistance of SBRR1-R. Localization of SBRR1 on plasma membrane, aided by SBRR1-interaction-protein 1, and phosphorylation of SBRR1 are required for SBRR1 to rapidly upregulate downstream chitinase genes for resistance. These findings offer mechanistical insights into ShB resistance hidden in natural rice varieties.
articles.abstractZh: 纹枯病（ShB）由坏死性真菌立枯丝核菌引起，是世界范围内最严重的水稻病害之一。据我们所知，之前尚未鉴定过具有水稻 ShB 抗性育种潜力的基因。在这里，我们通过全基因组关联研究鉴定了 ShB 耐药受体样激酶 1 (SBRR1) 基因。 SBRR1-R 精英等位基因在其启动子中包含 256 bp 的插入，优先存在于对 ShB 发育非常有利的地理区域的籼稻品种中。将 SBRR1-R 引入商业粳稻品种可显着减少严重 ShB 病害压力下的产量损失。转录因子 bHLH57 特异性结合 256 bp 序列，导致 SBRR1-R 的高度诱导表达和更强的抗性。 SBRR1 在 SBRR1 相互作用蛋白 1 的帮助下定位在质膜上，并且 SBRR1 磷酸化是 SBRR1 快速上调下游几丁质酶基因产生耐药性所必需的。这些发现为天然水稻品种中隐藏的 ShB 抗性提供了机制见解。

articles.title: PEX39 facilitates the peroxisomal import of PTS2-containing proteins.
articles.titleZh: PEX39 促进含有 PTS2 的蛋白质的过氧化物酶体输入。
articles.authors: Chen WW, Rodrigues TA, Wendscheck D, Pedrosa AG, Yang C, Francisco T, Möcklinghoff T, Zografakis A, Nunes-Silva B, Avraham RE, Silva AR, Ferreira MJ, Das H, Koster J, Neuwirth S, Bender J, Oeljeklaus S, Sondhi V, Gatsogiannis C, Schuldiner M, Zalckvar E, Hofmann K, Waterham HR, DeBerardinis RJ, Azevedo JE, Warscheid B.
articles.abstract: Peroxisomes are metabolic organelles essential for human health. Defects in peroxisomal biogenesis proteins (also known as peroxins (PEXs)) cause devastating disease. PEX7 binds proteins containing a type 2 peroxisomal targeting signal (PTS2) to enable their import from the cytosol into peroxisomes, although many aspects of this process remain enigmatic. Utilizing in vitro assays, yeast and human cells, we show that PEX39, a previously uncharacterized protein, is a cytosolic peroxin that facilitates the import of PTS2-containing proteins by binding PEX7 and stabilizing its interaction with cargo proteins containing a PTS2. PEX39 and PEX13, a peroxisomal membrane translocon protein, both possess an (R/K)PWE motif necessary for PEX7 binding. Handover of PEX7 from PEX39 to PEX13 via these motifs provides a new paradigm for peroxisomal protein import and biogenesis. Collectively, this work reveals how PEX39 and (R/K)PWE motifs facilitate the import of PTS2-containing proteins and advances our understanding of peroxisomal disease.
articles.abstractZh: 过氧化物酶体是对人类健康至关重要的代谢细胞器。过氧化物酶体生物合成蛋白（也称为过氧化物酶 (PEX)）的缺陷会导致毁灭性的疾病。 PEX7 结合含有 2 型过氧化物酶体靶向信号 (PTS2) 的蛋白质，使其能够从胞质溶胶导入过氧化物酶体，尽管这一过程的许多方面仍然是个谜。利用体外检测、酵母和人类细胞，我们发现 PEX39（一种以前未表征的蛋白质）是一种胞质过氧化物酶，通过结合 PEX7 并稳定其与含有 PTS2 的货物蛋白的相互作用，促进含有 PTS2 的蛋白质的输入。 PEX39 和 PEX13（一种过氧化物酶体膜易位蛋白）均具有 PE​​X7 结合所需的 (R/K)PWE 基序。通过这些基序将 PEX7 从 PEX39 转移到 PEX13 为过氧化物酶体蛋白输入和生物合成提供了新的范例。总的来说，这项工作揭示了 PEX39 和 (R/K)PWE 基序如何促进含有 PTS2 的蛋白质的输入，并增进我们对过氧化物酶体疾病的理解。

articles.title: Quantifying the varying harvest of fermentation products from the human gut microbiota.
articles.titleZh: 量化人类肠道微生物群发酵产物的不同收获。
articles.authors: Arnoldini M, Sharma R, Moresi C, Chure G, Chabbey J, Slack E, Cremer J.
articles.abstract: Fermentation products released by the gut microbiota provide energy and regulatory functions to the host. Yet, little is known about the magnitude of this metabolic flux and its quantitative dependence on diet and microbiome composition. Here, we establish orthogonal approaches to consistently quantify this flux, integrating data on bacterial metabolism, digestive physiology, and metagenomics. From the nutrients fueling microbiota growth, most carbon ends up in fermentation products and is absorbed by the host. This harvest varies strongly with the amount of complex dietary carbohydrates and is largely independent of bacterial mucin and protein utilization. It covers 2%-5% of human energy demand for Western diets and up to 10% for non-Western diets. Microbiota composition has little impact on the total harvest but determines the amount of specific fermentation products. This consistent quantification of metabolic fluxes by our analysis framework is crucial to elucidate the gut microbiota's mechanistic functions in health and disease.
articles.abstractZh: 肠道微生物群释放的发酵产物为宿主提供能量和调节功能。然而，人们对这种代谢通量的大小及其对饮食和微生物组组成的定量依赖性知之甚少。在这里，我们建立了正交方法来持续量化这种通量，整合细菌代谢、消化生理学和宏基因组学的数据。从促进微生物群生长的营养物质中，大多数碳最终形成发酵产物并被宿主吸收。这种收获随复杂膳食碳水化合物的量变化很大，并且在很大程度上与细菌粘蛋白和蛋白质的利用无关。它满足西方饮食中人体能量需求的 2%-5%，以及非西方饮食中高达 10% 的能量需求。微生物群组成对总收获影响不大，但决定特定发酵产物的量。我们的分析框架对代谢通量的一致量化对于阐明肠道微生物群在健康和疾病中的机制功能至关重要。

articles.title: Role of gut microbiota and derived metabolites in cardiovascular diseases.
articles.titleZh: 肠道微生物群和衍生代谢物在心血管疾病中的作用。
articles.authors: Yu J, Yang YN, Chen W, Hu J, Jin Z, Wu C, Li Y.
articles.abstract: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) remain one of the leading causes of death worldwide, imposing a significant societal burden and highlighting the urgent need for effective disease management strategies to reduce mortality and prevent disability. Recently, gut microbiota and its metabolites have been considered as an essential part of human physiology, emphasizing their contributions in CVD development and management. An increasing number of studies have shown that gut microbiota affects the process of CVDs either directly through changes in its composition and function or indirectly through its metabolites, and plays an important role in host physiology and disease development. This review provides a comprehensive overview of how gut microbes and their specific metabolites interact and contribute to the generation and development of CVDs. In addition, the therapeutic potential to treat CVDs by targeting the gut microbiota is also discussed, which may provide promising possibilities for the clinical treatment of CVDs in the future.
articles.abstractZh: 心血管疾病（CVD）仍然是全世界死亡的主要原因之一，造成了巨大的社会负担，并凸显了迫切需要有效的疾病管理策略来降低死亡率和预防残疾。最近，肠道微生物群及其代谢物被认为是人类生理学的重要组成部分，强调了它们在心血管疾病发展和管理中的贡献。越来越多的研究表明，肠道菌群通过其组成和功能的变化直接或通过其代谢产物间接影响CVD的进程，并在宿主生理和疾病发展中发挥重要作用。这篇综述全面概述了肠道微生物及其特定代谢物如何相互作用以及如何促进心血管疾病的产生和发展。此外，还讨论了通过靶向肠道微生物群治疗心血管疾病的治疗潜力，这可能为未来心血管疾病的临床治疗提供有希望的可能性。

articles.title: The DNA replication checkpoint targets the kinetochore to reposition DNA structure-induced replication damage to the nuclear periphery.
articles.titleZh: DNA 复制检查点以动粒为目标，重新定位 DNA 结构诱导的核外围复制损伤。
articles.authors: Maclay TM, Whalen JM, Johnson MJ, Freudenreich CH.
articles.abstract: Hairpin-forming CAG/CTG repeats pose significant challenges to DNA replication. In S. cerevisiae, long CAG/CTG repeat tracts reposition from the interior of the nucleus to the nuclear pore complex (NPC) to maintain their integrity. We show that relocation of a (CAG/CTG)130 tract to the NPC is dependent on phosphorylation of Mrc1 (hClaspin) of the fork protection complex and activation of the Mrc1/Rad53 replication checkpoint, implicating an uncoupled fork as the initial damage signal. Dun1-mediated phosphorylation of the kinetochore protein Cep3 is required for repositioning, a constraint that can be overcome by centromere inactivation, connecting detachment of the kinetochore from microtubule ends to NPC association. Activation of this pathway leads to the formation of DNA damage-induced microtubules, which associate with the repeat and are necessary for locus repositioning. These data implicate the replication checkpoint in facilitating the movement of DNA structure-associated damage to the nuclear periphery by centromere release and microtubule-directed motion.
articles.abstractZh: 形成发夹的 CAG/CTG 重复对 DNA 复制提出了重大挑战。在酿酒酵母中，长 CAG/CTG 重复束从细胞核内部重新定位到核孔复合体 (NPC)，以保持其完整性。我们发现 (CAG/CTG)130 束向 NPC 的重新定位取决于叉保护复合物的 Mrc1 (hClaspin) 的磷酸化和 Mrc1/Rad53 复制检查点的激活，这表明未偶联的叉作为初始损伤信号。重新定位需要 Dun1 介导的着丝粒蛋白 Cep3 磷酸化，这一限制可以通过着丝粒失活来克服，将着丝粒与微管末端的分离与 NPC 关联联系起来。该通路的激活会导致 DNA 损伤诱导的微管的形成，微管与重复序列相关，并且是基因座重新定位所必需的。这些数据表明复制检查点通过着丝粒释放和微管定向运动促进与 DNA 结构相关的损伤向核外围的移动。

articles.title: Three PP2C phosphatases modulate FERONIA receptor kinase activity to regulate pollen-stigma interaction in Arabidopsis.
articles.titleZh: 三种 PP2C 磷酸酶调节 FERONIA 受体激酶活性，从而调节拟南芥花粉-柱头相互作用。
articles.authors: Cheng L, Liu Z, Lu B, Gao S, Zhao J, Li C.
articles.abstract: Pollen hydration represents the initial and critical step in pollen-stigma interactions and is necessary for successful plant fertilization. The FERONIA (FER) receptor kinase regulates pollen hydration by modulating stigmatic reactive oxygen species (ROS) accumulation through rapid alkalinization factor 23/33 (RALF23/33) and pollen coat protein B-class peptide (PCP-B) signaling. However, the function and regulatory mechanism of FER's receptor kinase activity in pollen hydration remain poorly understood. In this study, we found that the kinase-dead form of FERK565R fails to restore stigmatic ROS accumulation and pollen hydration in the fer-4 mutant. By integrating RNA sequencing database analyses with yeast two-hybrid assays, we identified three type 2C phosphatases (PP2Cs)-protein phosphatase 2C clade H 1 (PP2CH1) and clade-E Growth-Regulating 1 and 2 (EGR1 and EGR2)-that interact with FER at the plasma membrane. These PP2Cs dephosphorylate FER at Ser695 and Thr696 within the activation segment, thereby inhibiting its kinase activity. Mutations at these two residues reduced ROS levels in the stigma and increased pollen hydration rates. Altogether, this study reveals a crucial regulatory mechanism of FER signaling, demonstrating that PP2CH1, EGR1, and EGR2 act as negative regulators of FER kinase activity to modulate stigmatic ROS accumulation and promote pollen hydration.
articles.abstractZh: 花粉水合作用是花粉-柱头相互作用的初始和关键步骤，对于植物成功受精是必要的。 FERONIA (FER) 受体激酶通过快速碱化因子 23/33 (RALF23/33) 和花粉外壳蛋白 B 类肽 (PCP-B) 信号传导调节柱头活性氧 (ROS) 积累，从而调节花粉水合。然而，FER 受体激酶活性在花粉水合中的功能和调节机制仍知之甚少。在这项研究中，我们发现 FERK565R 的激酶死亡形式无法恢复 fer-4 突变体中柱头 ROS 积累和花粉水合。通过将 RNA 测序数据库分析与酵母双杂交测定相结合，我们鉴定了三种 2C 型磷酸酶 (PP2C)——蛋白磷酸酶 2C 分支 H 1 (PP2CH1) 和分支 E 生长调节 1 和 2（EGR1 和 EGR2）——它们与质膜上的 FER 相互作用。这些 PP2C 在激活片段内的 Ser695 和 Thr696 处使 FER 去磷酸化，从而抑制其激酶活性。这两个残基的突变降低了柱头中的ROS水平并增加了花粉水合率。总而言之，这项研究揭示了一个重要的规律

articles.title: Metagenomic selections reveal diverse antiphage defenses in human and environmental microbiomes.
articles.titleZh: 宏基因组选择揭示了人类和环境微生物组中不同的抗噬菌体防御。
articles.authors: Rodriguez-Rodriguez L, Pfister J, Schuck L, Martin AE, Mercado-Santiago LM, Tagliabracci VS, Forsberg KJ.
articles.abstract: To prevent phage infection, bacteria have developed an arsenal of antiphage defenses. Evidence suggests that many examples in nature have not been described. Using plasmid libraries expressing small DNA inserts and functional selections for antiphage defense in Escherichia coli, we identified over 200 putative defenses from 14 bacterial phyla in 9 human and soil microbiomes. Many defenses were unrecognizable based on sequence or predicted structure and thus could only be identified via functional assays. In mechanistic studies, we show that some defenses encode nucleases that distinguish phage DNA via diverse chemical modifications. We also identify outer membrane proteins that prevent phage adsorption and a set of unknown defenses with diverse antiphage profiles and modalities. Most defenses acted against at least two phages, indicating that broadly acting systems are widely distributed. Collectively, these findings highlight the diversity and interoperability of antiphage defense systems.
articles.abstractZh: 为了防止噬菌体感染，细菌开发了一系列抗噬菌体防御系统。有证据表明，自然界中的许多例子尚未被描述。利用表达小 DNA 插入片段的质粒文库和大肠杆菌中抗噬菌体防御的功能选择，我们从 9 个人类和土壤微生物组的 14 个细菌门中鉴定出了 200 多种假定的防御。许多防御机制无法根据序列或预测结构进行识别，因此只能通过功能分析来识别。在机制研究中，我们发现一些防御机制编码核酸酶，通过不同的化学修饰来区分噬菌体 DNA。我们还鉴定了防止噬菌体吸附的外膜蛋白和一组具有不同抗噬菌体特征和模式的未知防御。大多数防御作用至少针对两种噬菌体，表明作用广泛的系统分布广泛。总的来说，这些发现凸显了反噬菌体防御系统的多样性和互操作性。

articles.title: Mitochondrial hyper-acetylation induced by an engineered acetyltransferase promotes cellular senescence.
articles.titleZh: 工程乙酰转移酶诱导的线粒体过度乙酰化可促进细胞衰老。
articles.authors: Shimazu T, Kataoka A, Suzuki T, Dohmae N, Shinkai Y.
articles.abstract: Protein acetylation plays crucial roles in diverse biological functions, including mitochondrial metabolism. Although SIRT3 catalyzes the removal of acetyl groups in mitochondria, the addition of the acetyl groups is thought to be primarily controlled in an enzyme-independent manner due to the absence of potent acetyltransferases. In this study, we developed an engineered mitochondria-localized acetyltransferase, named engineered mitochondrial acetyltransferase (eMAT). eMAT localized in the mitochondrial matrix and introduced robust global protein lysine acetylation, including 413 proteins with 1,119 target lysine residues. Notably, 74% of the acetylated proteins overlapped with previously known acetylated proteins, indicating that the eMAT-mediated acetylation system is physiologically relevant. Functionally, eMAT negatively regulated mitochondrial energy metabolism, inhibited cell growth, and promoted cellular senescence, suggesting that mitochondrial hyper-acetylation drives metabolic inhibition and cellular senescence. SIRT3 counteracted eMAT-induced acetylation and metabolic inhibition, restored cell growth, and protected cells from senescence, highlighting the contribution of SIRT3 in maintaining energy metabolism and preventing cellular senescence.
articles.abstractZh: 蛋白质乙酰化在多种生物功能中发挥着至关重要的作用，包括线粒体代谢。尽管 SIRT3 催化线粒体中乙酰基的去除，但由于缺乏有效的乙酰转移酶，乙酰基的添加被认为主要以不依赖于酶的方式控制。在这项研究中，我们开发了一种工程化的线粒体定位乙酰转移酶，称为工程化线粒体乙酰转移酶（eMAT）。 eMAT 定位于线粒体基质，并引入了强大的全局蛋白质赖氨酸乙酰化，包括具有 1,119 个目标赖氨酸残基的 413 个蛋白质。值得注意的是，74% 的乙酰化蛋白与先前已知的乙酰化蛋白重叠，表明 eMAT 介导的乙酰化系统具有生理相关性。从功能上讲，eMAT 负向调节线粒体能量代谢，抑制细胞生长，促进细胞衰老，表明线粒体过度乙酰化驱动代谢抑制和细胞衰老。 SIRT3 抵消了 eMAT 诱导的乙酰化和代谢抑制，恢复细胞生长，并保护细胞免于衰老，强调了

articles.title: PFKFB3 activates CAD to enhance de novo pyrimidine synthesis for cell growth.
articles.titleZh: PFKFB3 激活 CAD 以增强细胞生长所需的嘧啶从头合成。
articles.authors: Da Q, Cai Y, Ma Q, Yang Q, Cao Y, Zhou Y, Zhao D, Liu Z, Xu J, Quan J, Zhang L, Wang R, Jiang X, Liu X, Ouyang K, Han Z, Liu J, Wang T, Zhang C, Weintraub NL, Fulton DJR, Zhao J, Hong M, Li Z, Huo Y.
articles.abstract: Aerobic glycolysis, termed the Warburg effect, is one of the aberrant metabolic pathways in highly proliferating cells. Glycolysis provides glycolytic metabolites to support the generation of biomass, such as nucleotides, amino acids, and lipids. Research on the direct interactions between glycolysis and other metabolic pathways is an emerging field that has garnered significant interest. Phosphofructokinase-2/fructose-2,6-bisphosphatase 3 (PFKFB3) activates glycolysis by synthesizing fructose-2,6-bisphosphate (F2,6BP), which allosterically activates the rate-limiting enzyme 6-phosphofructo-1-kinase (PFK-1). In this study, we found that PFKFB3 directly interacts with and regulates the phosphorylation of carbamoyl-phosphate synthetase 2, aspartate transcarbamylase, and dihydroorotase (CAD), the enzyme catalyzing the first three steps of de novo pyrimidine synthesis. PFKFB3 inactivation reduced de novo pyrimidine synthesis, RNA and DNA production, and cell proliferation. Thus, the glycolytic activator PFKFB3 bridges glycolysis with pyrimidine synthesis, unites both glucose metabolism and nucleic acid metabolism, and contributes to cell proliferation under pathological conditions.
articles.abstractZh: 有氧糖酵解，称为瓦伯格效应，是高度增殖细胞中的异常代谢途径之一。糖酵解提供糖酵解代谢物以支持生物质的产生，例如核苷酸、氨基酸和脂质。关于糖酵解和其他代谢途径之间直接相互作用的研究是一个引起人们极大兴趣的新兴领域。磷酸果糖激酶-2/果糖-2,6-二磷酸酶 3 (PFKFB3) 通过合成果糖-2,6-二磷酸 (F2,6BP) 激活糖酵解，从而变构激活限速酶 6-磷酸果糖-1-激酶 (PFK-1)。在这项研究中，我们发现 PFKFB3 直接与氨基甲酰磷酸合成酶 2、天冬氨酸转氨甲酰酶和二氢乳清酶 (CAD) 相互作用并调节其磷酸化，这些酶催化嘧啶从头合成的前三个步骤。 PFKFB3 失活会减少嘧啶的从头合成、RNA 和 DNA 的产生以及细胞增殖。因此，糖酵解激活剂PFKFB3将糖酵解与嘧啶合成联系起来，将葡萄糖代谢和核酸代谢结合起来，并有助于病理条件下的细胞增殖。

articles.title: Serum-free cultured meat production by using <i>Pichia pastoris</i>-derived recombinant albumin.
articles.titleZh: 使用毕赤酵母衍生的重组白蛋白生产无血清培养肉。
articles.authors: Kim YR, Hwang D, Jang SW, Han JH, Na GR, Park JH, Tae G, Park SM, Choi HW.
articles.abstract: Cultured meat production involves the growth, differentiation, and food processing of muscle satellite cells. However, its heavy reliance on fetal bovine serum (FBS) significantly increases production costs, which has prompted interest in developing alternative serum substitutes. In this study, we aimed to enhance the economic viability and scalability of cultured meat production by cultivating and differentiating bovine muscle satellite cells (bMuSCs) in media supplemented with Pichia pastoris (P. pastoris)-derived bovine recombinant albumin (Br-A) or porcine recombinant albumin (Pr-A). As a result, P. pastoris-derived recombinant albumin (rAlbumin) effectively supported the proliferation of bMuSCs while maintaining their differentiation potential. In addition, the expression of the satellite cell marker Paired-box7 (Pax7) was upregulated. Moreover, P. pastoris-derived rAlbumin effectively induced myotube formation in the differentiation process. These results highlight the potential of P. pastoris-derived rAlbumin as a cost-effective and scalable alternative to serum components, providing a promising solution for serum-free media in the cultured meat industry.
articles.abstractZh: 培养肉生产涉及肌肉卫星细胞的生长、分化和食品加工。然而，其对胎牛血清（FBS）的严重依赖显着增加了生产成本，这促使人们对开发替代血清替代品产生兴趣。在这项研究中，我们旨在通过在补充有巴斯德毕赤酵母（P. Pastoris）衍生的牛重组白蛋白（Br-A）或猪重组白蛋白（Pr-A）的培养基中培养和分化牛肌肉卫星细胞（bMuSC）来提高培养肉生产的经济可行性和可扩展性。因此，巴斯德毕赤酵母来源的重组白蛋白（rAlbumin）有效支持 bMuSC 的增殖，同时保持其分化潜力。此外，卫星细胞标记物配对盒7（Pax7）的表达上调。此外，巴斯德毕赤酵母来源的rAlbumin在分化过程中有效诱导肌管形成。这些结果凸显了巴斯德毕赤酵母衍生的r白蛋白作为血清成分的经济有效且可扩展的替代品的潜力，为培养肉行业的无血清培养基提供了一种有前景的解决方案。

articles.title: Two deeply conserved non-coding sequences control PLETHORA1/2 expression and coordinate embryo and root development.
articles.titleZh: 两个高度保守的非编码序列控制 PLETHORA1/2 的表达并协调胚胎和根的发育。
articles.authors: Kerstens M, Boele Y, Morales-Cruz A, Roelofsen C, Wang P, Baumgart LA, O'Malley R, Sanchez-Perez G, Scheres B, Willemsen V.
articles.abstract: Conserved non-coding sequences (CNSs) are integral elements of transcriptional regulation. Transcriptional tuning of PLETHORA (PLT) genes that encode master regulators of plant development is vital for embryogenesis and meristematic function. However, how the expression of PLT genes is modulated through CNSs remains unclear. Through motif-based mining of upstream sequences in 120 angiosperm genomes, we identified 21 conserved and lineage-specific CNSs, two of which are unusually long, similar, and colinear within eudicots. Using Arabidopsis thaliana, we demonstrate that these two deeply conserved elements, which we named BOX1 and BOX2, control PLT1 and PLT2 expression. CRISPR mutants within these elements specifically reduced PLT expression levels, and reporter lines revealed that deletion of either or both BOXes altered and/or abrogated the PLT2 expression pattern in the root tip, affecting the ability to rescue the plt1 plt2 double mutant. We further show that the influence of these elements on expression patterns is already exerted during embryogenesis and functional in the context of the early embryo. Finally, we reveal the existence of a BOX-mediated autoregulatory feedback loop that, in large part, explains CNS influence on expression patterns. We thus uncover a transcriptional mechanism by which genes encoding master regulators of embryo and root meristem development are regulated.
articles.abstractZh: 保守的非编码序列（CNS）是转录调控的组成部分。编码植物发育主调控因子的 PLETHORA (PLT) 基因的转录调节对于胚胎发生和分生组织功能至关重要。然而，PLT基因的表达如何通过CNS调节仍不清楚。通过对 120 个被子植物基因组中的上游序列进行基于基序的挖掘，我们鉴定了 21 个保守且谱系特异性的 CNS，其中两个在双子叶植物中异常长、相似且共线。利用拟南芥，我们证明了这两个高度保守的元件（我们将其命名为 BOX1 和 BOX2）控制 PLT1 和 PLT2 的表达。这些元件中的 CRISPR 突变体特异性地降低了 PLT 表达水平，报告系显示，删除一个或两个 BOX 会改变和/或消除根尖中的 PLT2 表达模式，从而影响拯救 plt1 plt2 双突变体的能力。我们进一步表明，这些元件对表达模式的影响已经在胚胎发生过程中发挥作用，并在早期胚胎的背景下发挥作用。最后，我们揭示了 BOX 介导的自动调节反馈的存在

articles.title: Cohesin-mediated stabilization of the CCAN complex at kinetochores in mitosis.
articles.titleZh: 有丝分裂中着丝粒处的粘连蛋白介导的 CCAN 复合体的稳定性。
articles.authors: Haase J, Aktar K, Bonner MK, Colin L, Gupta H, Marinoni BE, Morgan DO, Kelly AE.
articles.abstract: The constitutive centromere-associated network (CCAN) of the inner kinetochore links CENP-A-containing nucleosomes of the centromere to the outer kinetochore, ensuring accurate chromosome segregation during mitosis. CCAN binding at the centromere is stabilized upon mitotic entry, but the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Here, we demonstrate that cohesin is essential for CCAN stability. The chromosomal passenger complex (CPC), independently of its kinase subunit Aurora B, regulates cohesin-mediated CCAN stability via heterochromatin protein-1 (HP1), Haspin kinase, and phosphorylation of the cohesin-release factor WAPL, which weakens WAPL's affinity for PDS5B. While cohesin depletion disrupts CCAN stability, neither separase-mediated cohesin cleavage nor depletion of the cohesion-essential Esco2 acetyltransferase affects CCAN stability, indicating that cohesin stabilizes the CCAN independently of sister chromatid cohesion. Furthermore, we show that WAPL phosphorylation maintains a centromere-proximal pool of cohesin and promotes the formation of the primary constriction. These findings establish a non-cohesive function of cohesin in stabilizing the CCAN during mitosis and suggest that cohesin-mediated organization of centromeric chromatin strengthens kinetochore engagement to ensure faithful chromosome segregation.
articles.abstractZh: 内着丝粒的组成性着丝粒相关网络 (CCAN) 将着丝粒中含有 CENP-A 的核小体连接到外着丝粒，确保有丝分裂期间染色体的准确分离。 CCAN 在着丝粒上的结合在有丝分裂进入时稳定，但潜在的机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们证明粘连蛋白对于 CCAN 稳定性至关重要。染色体过客复合体 (CPC) 独立于其激酶亚基 Aurora B，通过异染色质蛋白 1 (HP1)、Haspin 激酶和粘连蛋白释放因子 WAPL 的磷酸化（削弱 WAPL 对 PDS5B 的亲和力）调节粘连蛋白介导的 CCAN 稳定性。虽然粘连蛋白消耗会破坏 CCAN 稳定性，但分离酶介导的粘连蛋白裂解和粘连必需 Esco2 乙酰转移酶的消耗都不会影响 CCAN 稳定性，表明粘连蛋白独立于姐妹染色单体粘连稳定 CCAN。此外，我们发现 WAPL 磷酸化维持了近端着丝粒的粘连蛋白库并促进初级缢缩的形成。这些发现证实了粘连蛋白在有丝分裂过程中稳定 CCAN 的非粘性功能，并表明

articles.title: eIF1 and eIF5 dynamically control translation start site fidelity.
articles.titleZh: eIF1 和 eIF5 动态控制翻译起始位点保真度。
articles.authors: Grosely R, Alvarado C, Ivanov IP, Nicholson OB, Puglisi JD, Dever TE, Lapointe CP.
articles.abstract: Human translation initiation requires accurate recognition of translation start sites. While AUG codons are canonical start sites, non-AUG codons are also used, typically with lower efficiency. The initiator tRNA and initiation factors eIF1 and eIF5 control recognition. How they distinguish different start sites yet allow flexible recognition remains unclear. Here we used real-time single-molecule assays and an in vitro reconstituted human system to reveal how eIF1 and eIF5 direct start site selection. eIF1 binds initiation complexes in two modes: stable binding during scanning, followed by transient, concentration-dependent rebinding after start site recognition. Termination of eIF1 rebinding requires transient and concentration-dependent binding by eIF5, which allows the formation of translation competent ribosomes. Non-AUG start sites differentially stabilize eIF1 and destabilize eIF5 binding, blocking initiation at multiple points. We confirmed these opposing effects in human cells. Collectively, our findings uncover that eIF1 and eIF5 directly compete to bind initiation complexes and illuminate how their dynamic interplay tunes the fidelity of start site recognition, which has broad connections to health and disease.
articles.abstractZh: 人工翻译启动需要准确识别翻译起始位点。虽然 AUG 密码子是规范的起始位点，但也使用非 AUG 密码子，通常效率较低。起始子 tRNA 和起始因子 eIF1 和 eIF5 控制识别。它们如何区分不同的起始位点并允许灵活识别仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用实时单分子测定和体外重建人体系统来揭示 eIF1 和 eIF5 如何直接选择起始位点。 eIF1 以两种模式结合起始复合物：扫描期间稳定结合，然后在起始位点识别后短暂、浓度依赖性重新结合。 eIF1 重新结合的终止需要 eIF5 短暂且浓度依赖性的结合，从而形成具有翻译能力的核糖体。非 AUG 起始位点差异性地稳定 eIF1 并不稳定 eIF5 结合，从而在多个点阻断起始。我们在人体细胞中证实了这些相反的作用。总的来说，我们的研究结果揭示了 eIF1 和 eIF5 直接竞争结合起始复合物，并阐明了它们的动态相互作用如何调整起始位点识别的保真度，这已经

articles.title: Current applications and future perspectives on rare-earth-based materials in stomatology.
articles.titleZh: 稀土基材料在口腔医学中的当前应用和未来前景。
articles.authors: Dong Z, Lu X, Zhang W, Tang S, Liu H, Zhang R, Liang Y, Liu X, Zhang Y.
articles.abstract: A confluence of factors, including the incompatibility of conventional materials with the oral environment, inadequate dynamic response, and insufficient multi-objective synergy, hinders precise diagnosis and efficient treatment in contemporary stomatology. Due to their unique electronic configuration and multivalent properties, rare earth elements (REEs) have shown excellent optical response, enzyme simulation activity, antibacterial efficacy, and biological regulation potential. These attributes offer a promising path for developing a new generation of oral functional materials. To align the unique properties of REEs and the clinical demands, this article summarizes the current knowledge of physicochemical properties and biological functions of REEs, and provides a comprehensive overview of the cutting-edge applications of rare-earth-based materials in oral medicine. We anticipate that this review will enhance the understanding of the interdisciplinary value of rare-earth-based materials in stomatology, thereby contributing to the improvement of future oral healthcare.
articles.abstractZh: 传统材料与口腔环境不相容、动态响应不足、多目标协同作用不足等因素综合阻碍了当代口腔医学的精准诊断和高效治疗。由于其独特的电子构型和多价特性，稀土元素（REE）表现出优异的光学响应、酶模拟活性、抗菌功效和生物调节潜力。这些特性为开发新一代口腔功能材料提供了一条有前途的道路。本文结合稀土的独特性质和临床需求，总结了目前稀土理化性质和生物学功能的认识，全面概述了稀土基材料在口腔医学中的前沿应用。我们预计本次综述将增进对口腔医学中稀土材料跨学科价值的理解，从而有助于改善未来的口腔保健。

articles.title: Imeglimin suppresses glucagon secretion and induces a loss of α cell identity.
articles.titleZh: Imeglimin 抑制胰高血糖素分泌并诱导 α 细胞身份丧失。
articles.authors: Tsuno T, Li J, Nishiyama K, Kawasawa YI, Inoue R, Ong Yajima E, Nishiyama A, Yabe SG, Kin T, Okochi H, Tamura T, Shapiro AMJ, Oyadomari S, Kitamura T, Terauchi Y, Shirakawa J.
articles.abstract: Dysregulated α cell function contributes to the development of diabetes. In this study, we find that treatment with imeglimin, an antidiabetic drug, prevents glucagon release and induces a loss of α cell identity through direct action on α cells. Mechanistically, imeglimin reduces Gsα expression to inhibit the exchange protein directly activated by cyclic adenosine monophosphate 2 (EPAC2)-mediated secretion of glucagon induced by low glucose, gastric inhibitory polypeptide (GIP), or adrenaline in an insulin-independent manner. Imeglimin also attenuates α cell Ca2+ oscillations. MafB expression is downregulated by imeglimin to induce α cell dedifferentiation. In addition, imeglimin upregulates C/EBP homologous protein (CHOP) expression, which partly contributes to the reduction in Gsα and MafB expression to reduce glucagon secretion and induce α cell reprogramming without altering protein translation. These pleiotropic effects of imeglimin on glucagon secretion and α cell identity can be recapitulated in mouse models of diabetes in vivo. These data suggest that the imeglimin-mediated regulation of α cell plasticity, particularly via glucagon suppression, may contribute to glucose homeostasis.
articles.abstractZh: α细胞功能失调会导致糖尿病的发生。在这项研究中，我们发现用抗糖尿病药物 imeglimin 治疗可防止胰高血糖素释放，并通过直接作用于 α 细胞而诱导 α 细胞身份的丧失。从机制上讲，imeglimin 降低 Gsα 表达，以抑制由环单磷酸腺苷 2 (EPAC2) 直接激活的交换蛋白，介导的胰高血糖素分泌由低血糖、胃抑制多肽 (GIP) 或肾上腺素以不依赖胰岛素​​的方式诱导。 Imeglimin 还可以减弱 α 细胞 Ca2+ 振荡。 imeglimin 下调 MafB 表达，诱导 α 细胞去分化。此外，imeglimin 上调 C/EBP 同源蛋白 (CHOP) 表达，这在一定程度上有助于减少 Gsα 和 MafB 表达，从而减少胰高血糖素分泌并诱导 α 细胞重编程，而不改变蛋白翻译。伊格列明对胰高血糖素分泌和 α 细胞特性的这些多效性作用可以在体内糖尿病小鼠模型中重现。这些数据表明，伊格列明介导的α细胞可塑性调节，特别是通过胰高血糖素抑制，可能有助于葡萄糖的升高。

articles.title: Immune dysfunction during S. aureus biofilm-associated implant infections: opportunities for novel therapeutic strategies.
articles.titleZh: 金黄色葡萄球菌生物膜相关植入物感染期间的免疫功能障碍：新治疗策略的机会。
articles.authors: Brandquist ND, Kielian T.
articles.abstract: Staphylococcus aureus is a common cause of biofilm infections, particularly on implanted medical devices. Biofilms are heterogeneous bacterial communities contained in a self-produced matrix that are poorly cleared by the immune system. This review discusses mechanisms employed by the biofilm, such as alterations in bacterial metabolism and toxin production, to induce immune dysfunction by highlighting recent bacterial single-cell sequencing studies. Additionally, the role of immune recognition and metabolism in biofilm containment is examined with an emphasis on the role of granulocytic myeloid-derived suppressor cells and how responses are tailored to distinct tissue niches. We also address emerging evidence revealing the importance of the infection microenvironment, host genetic variability, and bacterial heterogeneity in shaping immune responses during S. aureus biofilm infections.
articles.abstractZh: 金黄色葡萄球菌是生物膜感染的常见原因，特别是在植入式医疗设备上。生物膜是包含在自身产生的基质中的异质细菌群落，免疫系统很难清除它们。这篇综述通过强调最近的细菌单细胞测序研究，讨论了生物膜所采用的机制，例如细菌代谢和毒素产生的改变，以诱导免疫功能障碍。此外，还研究了免疫识别和代谢在生物膜遏制中的作用，重点是粒细胞骨髓源性抑制细胞的作用以及如何针对不同的组织生态位定制反应。我们还讨论了新出现的证据，这些证据揭示了感染微环境、宿主遗传变异性和细菌异质性在金黄色葡萄球菌生物膜感染期间形成免疫反应的重要性。

articles.title: Reconstitution of BNIP3/NIX-mitophagy initiation reveals hierarchical flexibility of the autophagy machinery.
articles.titleZh: BNIP3/NIX-线粒体自噬起始的重建揭示了自噬机制的层次灵活性。
articles.authors: Adriaenssens E, Schaar S, Cook ASI, Stuke JFM, Sawa-Makarska J, Nguyen TN, Ren X, Schuschnig M, Romanov J, Khuu G, Uoselis L, Lazarou M, Hummer G, Hurley JH, Martens S.
articles.abstract: Selective autophagy is a lysosomal degradation pathway that is critical for maintaining cellular homeostasis by disposing of harmful cellular material. Although the mechanisms by which soluble cargo receptors recruit the autophagy machinery are becoming increasingly clear, the principles governing how organelle-localized transmembrane cargo receptors initiate selective autophagy remain poorly understood. Here we demonstrate that the human transmembrane cargo receptors can initiate autophagosome biogenesis not only by recruiting the upstream FIP200/ULK1 complex but also via a WIPI-ATG13 complex. This latter pathway is employed by the BNIP3/NIX receptors to trigger mitophagy. Additionally, other transmembrane mitophagy receptors, including FUNDC1 and BCL2L13, exclusively use the FIP200/ULK1 complex, whereas FKBP8 and the ER-phagy receptor TEX264 are capable of utilizing both pathways to initiate autophagy. Our study defines the molecular rules for initiation by transmembrane cargo receptors, revealing remarkable flexibility in the assembly and activation of the autophagy machinery, with important implications for therapeutic interventions.
articles.abstractZh: 选择性自噬是一种溶酶体降解途径，对于通过处理有害细胞物质维持细胞稳态至关重要。尽管可溶性货物受体招募自噬机制的机制越来越清楚，但细胞器定位的跨膜货物受体如何启动选择性自噬的原理仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们证明人类跨膜货物受体不仅可以通过招募上游 FIP200/ULK1 复合物，还可以通过 WIPI-ATG13 复合物来启动自噬体生物发生。 BNIP3/NIX 受体利用后一种途径来触发线粒体自噬。此外，其他跨膜线粒体自噬受体，包括 FUNDC1 和 BCL2L13，专门使用 FIP200/ULK1 复合物，而 FKBP8 和 ER 吞噬受体 TEX264 能够利用这两种途径来启动自噬。我们的研究定义了跨膜货物受体启动的分子规则，揭示了自噬机制组装和激活的显着灵活性，对治疗干预具有重要意义。

articles.title: Translation efficiency covariation identifies conserved coordination patterns across cell types.
articles.titleZh: 翻译效率共变可识别跨细胞类型的保守协调模式。
articles.authors: Liu Y, Rao S, Hoskins I, Geng M, Zhao Q, Chacko J, Ghatpande V, Qi K, Persyn L, Wang J, Zheng D, Zhong Y, Park D, Sarinay Cenik E, Agarwal V, Ozadam H, Cenik C.
articles.abstract: Characterizing shared patterns of RNA expression between genes across conditions has led to the discovery of regulatory networks and biological functions. However, it is unclear if such coordination extends to translation. In this study, we uniformly analyze 3,819 ribosome profiling datasets from 117 human and 94 mouse tissues and cell lines. We introduce the concept of translation efficiency covariation (TEC), identifying coordinated translation patterns across cell types. We nominate candidate mechanisms driving shared patterns of translation regulation. TEC is conserved across human and mouse cells and uncovers gene functions that are not evident from RNA or protein co-expression. Moreover, our observations indicate that proteins that physically interact are highly enriched for positive covariation at both translational and transcriptional levels. Our findings establish TEC as a conserved organizing principle of mammalian transcriptomes. TEC has potential as a predictive marker for gene function and may offer a framework for designing gene expression systems in synthetic biology and biotechnological applications.
articles.abstractZh: 表征不同条件下基因之间共享的 RNA 表达模式已经导致调控网络和生物功能的发现。然而，尚不清楚这种协调是否延伸到翻译领域。在这项研究中，我们统一分析了来自 117 个人类和 94 个小鼠组织和细胞系的 3,819 个核糖体分析数据集。我们引入了翻译效率共变（TEC）的概念，识别跨细胞类型的协调翻译模式。我们提名推动翻译监管共享模式的候选机制。 TEC 在人类和小鼠细胞中是保守的，可以揭示 RNA 或蛋白质共表达中不明显的基因功能。此外，我们的观察表明，物理相互作用的蛋白质在翻译和转录水平上高度富集正共变。我们的研究结果确立了 TEC 作为哺乳动物转录组的保守组织原则。 TEC 有潜力作为基因功能的预测标记，并可能为合成生物学和生物技术应用中的基因表达系统设计提供框架。

articles.title: De novo design and structure of a peptide-centric TCR mimic binding module.
articles.titleZh: 以肽为中心的 TCR 模拟结合模块的从头设计和结构。
articles.authors: Householder KD, Xiang X, Jude KM, Deng A, Obenaus M, Zhao Y, Wilson SC, Chen X, Wang N, Garcia KC.
articles.abstract: T cell receptor (TCR) mimics offer a promising platform for tumor-specific targeting of peptide-major histocompatibility complex (pMHC) in cancer immunotherapy. In this study, we designed a de novo α-helical TCR mimic (TCRm) specific for the NY-ESO-1 peptide presented by human leukocyte antigen (HLA)-A*02, achieving high on-target specificity with nanomolar affinity (dissociation constant Kd = 9.5 nM). The structure of the TCRm-pMHC complex at 2.05-Å resolution revealed a rigid TCR-like docking mode with an unusual degree of focus on the up-facing NY-ESO-1 side chains, suggesting the potential for reduced off-target reactivity. Indeed, a structure-informed in silico screen of 14,363 HLA-A*02 peptides correctly predicted two off-target peptides, yet our TCRm maintained peptide selectivity and cytotoxicity as a T cell engager. These results represent a path for precision targeting of tumor antigens with peptide-focused α-helical TCR mimics.
articles.abstractZh: T 细胞受体 (TCR) 模拟物为癌症免疫治疗中肽主要组织相容性复合物 (pMHC) 的肿瘤特异性靶向提供了一个有前途的平台。在本研究中，我们设计了一种对人类白细胞抗原 (HLA)-A*02 呈递的 NY-ESO-1 肽具有特异性的从头 α-螺旋 TCR 模拟物 (TCRm)，以纳摩尔亲和力（解离常数 Kd = 9.5 nM）实现了高靶向特异性。分辨率为 2.05-Å 的 TCRm-pMHC 复合物结构揭示了一种类似于 TCR 的刚性对接模式，该模式异常集中于朝上的 NY-ESO-1 侧链，这表明有可能减少脱靶反应性。事实上，14,363 个 HLA-A*02 肽的结构信息计算机筛选正确预测了两个脱靶肽，而我们的 TCRm 保持了作为 T 细胞接合者的肽选择性和细胞毒性。这些结果代表了利用以肽为中心的 α-螺旋 TCR 模拟物精确靶向肿瘤抗原的途径。

articles.title: Design of high-specificity binders for peptide-MHC-I complexes.
articles.titleZh: 肽-MHC-I 复合物的高特异性结合物的设计。
articles.authors: Liu B, Greenwood NF, Bonzanini JE, Motmaen A, Meyerberg J, Dao T, Xiang X, Ault R, Sharp J, Wang C, Visani GM, Vafeados DK, Roullier N, Nourmohammad A, Scheinberg DA, Garcia KC, Baker D.
articles.abstract: Class I major histocompatibility complex (MHC-I) molecules present peptides derived from intracellular antigens on the cell surface for immune surveillance. Proteins that recognize peptide-MHC-I (pMHCI) complexes with specificity for diseased cells could have considerable therapeutic utility. Specificity requires recognition of outward-facing amino acid residues within the disease-associated peptide as well as avoidance of extensive contacts with ubiquitously expressed MHC. We used RFdiffusion to design pMHCI-binding proteins that make extensive contacts with the peptide and identified specific binders for 11 target pMHCs starting from either experimental or predicted pMHCI structures. Upon incorporation into chimeric antigen receptors, designs for eight targets conferred peptide-specific T cell activation. Our approach should have broad utility for both protein- and cell-based pMHCI targeting.
articles.abstractZh: I 类主要组织相容性复合体 (MHC-I) 分子在细胞表面呈递源自细胞内抗原的肽，用于免疫监视。识别肽-MHC-I (pMHCI) 复合物并对患病细胞具有特异性的蛋白质可能具有相当大的治疗效用。特异性需要识别疾病相关肽内面向外的氨基酸残基，并避免与普遍表达的 MHC 广泛接触。我们使用 RFdiffusion 设计了 ​​pMHCI 结合蛋白，该蛋白与肽广泛接触，并从实验或预测的 pMHCI 结构出发，鉴定了 11 个目标 pMHC 的特异性结合物。在掺入嵌合抗原受体后，八个靶标的设计赋予了肽特异性 T 细胞激活。我们的方法应该对基于蛋白质和基于细胞的 pMHCI 靶向具有广泛的实用性。

articles.title: Nighttime caffeine intake increases motor impulsivity.
articles.titleZh: 夜间摄入咖啡因会增加运动冲动。
articles.authors: Saldes EB, Sabandal PR, Han KA.
articles.abstract: Caffeine is commonly consumed at night by shift workers and military personnel to promote alertness, yet its adverse effects remain underexplored. Here, we show that nighttime caffeine intake impairs inhibitory control in Drosophila melanogaster, resulting in impulsive motor behavior, with females more sensitive than males. This effect is independent of hyperactivity or sleep loss, as walking speed was unchanged and artificial sleep deprivation via light or mechanical stimulation did not elicit similar deficits. Notably, daytime caffeine intake did not impair inhibitory control, highlighting a circadian gating of caffeine's impact. Mechanistically, we show that dopamine signaling mediates this effect. Reduced dopamine synthesis, silencing of protocerebral anterior medial (PAM) dopaminergic neurons, or altered dopamine transporter activity attenuated or exacerbated impulsivity. Targeted manipulations identified the dopamine D1 receptor (dDA1/Dop1R1) in the mushroom body (MB) α/β and γ lobes as essential for this effect, with γ-lobe neurons exhibiting heightened sensitivity. These findings uncover a circadian- and dopamine-dependent mechanism.
articles.abstractZh: 轮班工人和军事人员通常在夜间摄入咖啡因以提高警觉性，但其不利影响仍未得到充分研究。在这里，我们发现夜间摄入咖啡因会损害黑腹果蝇的抑制控制，导致冲动运动行为，雌性比雄性更敏感。这种效应与多动或睡眠不足无关，因为步行速度没有改变，并且通过光或机械刺激人工剥夺睡眠不会引起类似的缺陷。值得注意的是，白天摄入咖啡因并不会损害抑制控制，凸显了咖啡因影响的昼夜节律控制。从机制上讲，我们表明多巴胺信号传导介导这种效应。多巴胺合成减少、原大脑前内侧 (PAM) 多巴胺能神经元沉默或多巴胺转运蛋白活性改变会减弱或加剧冲动性。有针对性的操作发现蘑菇体 (MB) α/β 和 γ 叶中的多巴胺 D1 受体 (dDA1/Dop1R1) 对于这种效应至关重要，其中 γ 叶神经元表现出更高的敏感性。这些发现揭示了昼夜节律和多巴胺依赖性机制。

articles.title: Complete biosynthesis of salicylic acid from phenylalanine in plants.
articles.titleZh: 在植物中从苯丙氨酸完成水杨酸的生物合成。
articles.authors: Zhu B, Zhang Y, Gao R, Wu Z, Zhang W, Zhang C, Zhang P, Ye C, Yao L, Jin Y, Mao H, Tou P, Huang P, Zhao J, Zhao Q, Liu CJ, Zhang K.
articles.abstract: Salicylic acid (SA) is a pivotal phytohormone for plant responses to biotic and abiotic stresses. Plants have evolved two pathways to produce SA: the isochorismate synthase and phenylalanine ammonia lyase (PAL) pathways1. Whereas the isochorismate synthase pathway has been fully identified2-4, the PAL pathway remains incomplete. Here we report the full characterization of the PAL pathway for SA biosynthesis via functional analysis of rice (Oryza sativa) SA-DEFICIENT GENE 1 (OSD1) to OSD4. The cinnamoyl-coenzyme A (CoA) ligase OSD1 catalyses the conversion of trans-cinnamic acid to cinnamoyl-CoA, which is subsequently transformed to benzoyl-CoA via the β-oxidative pathway in peroxisomes. The resulting benzoyl-CoA is further converted to benzyl benzoate by the peroxisomal benzoyltransferase OSD2. Benzyl benzoate is subsequently hydroxylated to benzyl salicylate by the endoplasmic reticulum membrane-resident cytochrome P450 OSD3, which is ultimately hydrolysed to salicylic acid by the cytoplasmic carboxylesterase OSD4. Evolutionary analyses reveal that the PAL pathway was first assembled before the divergence of gymnosperms and has been conserved in most seed plants. Activation of the PAL pathway in rice significantly enhances salicylic acid levels and plant immunity. Completion of the PAL pathway provides critical insights into the primary salicylic acid biosynthetic pathway across plant species and offers a precise target for modulating crop immunity.
articles.abstractZh: 水杨酸（SA）是植物应对生物和非生物胁迫的关键植物激素。植物进化出了两条产生SA的途径：异分支酸合酶和苯丙氨酸解氨酶(PAL)途径1。尽管异分支酸合酶途径已被完全鉴定2-4，但 PAL 途径仍然不完整。在此，我们通过对水稻 (Oryza sativa) SA 缺陷基因 1 (OSD1) 至 OSD4 的功能分析，报告了 SA 生物合成 PAL 途径的完整特征。肉桂酰辅酶 A (CoA) 连接酶 OSD1 催化反式肉桂酸转化为肉桂酰辅酶 A，随后通过过氧化物酶体中的 β-氧化途径转化为苯甲酰辅酶 A。生成的苯甲酰辅酶 A 通过过氧化物酶体苯甲酰转移酶 OSD2 进一步转化为苯甲酸苄酯。苯甲酸苄酯随后被内质网膜驻留的细胞色素 P450 OSD3 羟基化为水杨酸苄酯，最终被细胞质羧酸酯酶 OSD4 水解为水杨酸。进化分析表明，PAL 途径在裸子植物分化之前首次组装，并且在大多数种子植物中得到保守。激活

articles.title: Deciphering phenylalanine-derived salicylic acid biosynthesis in plants.
articles.titleZh: 破译植物中苯丙氨酸衍生的水杨酸生物合成。
articles.authors: Wang Y, Song S, Zhang W, Deng Q, Feng Y, Tao M, Kang M, Zhang Q, Yang L, Wang X, Zhu C, Wang X, Zhu W, Zhu Y, Cao P, Chen J, Pan J, Feng S, Chen X, Dai H, Song S, Yang J, Zhao T, Cao F, Tao Z, Shen X, Last RL, Hu J, Yu J, Fan P, Pan R.
articles.abstract: Salicylic acid (SA) is a ubiquitous plant hormone with a long history in human civilization1,2. Because of the central role of SA in orchestrating plant pathogen defence, understanding SA biosynthesis is fundamental to plant immunity research and crop improvement. Isochorismate-derived SA biosynthesis has been well defined in Arabidopsis. However, increasing evidence suggests a crucial function for phenylalanine-derived SA biosynthesis in many other plant species1. Here we reveal the phenylalanine-derived SA biosynthetic pathway in rice by identifying three dedicated enzymes - peroxisomal benzoyl-CoA:benzyl alcohol benzoyltransferase (BEBT), the endoplasmic reticulum-associated cytochrome P450 enzyme benzylbenzoate hydroxylase (BBH), and cytosolic benzylsalicylate esterase (BSE) that sequentially convert benzoyl-CoA to benzylbenzoate, benzylsalicylate and SA. The pathogen-induced gene expression pattern and SA biosynthetic functions of this triple-enzyme module are conserved in diverse plants. This work fills a major knowledge gap in the biosynthesis of a key plant defence hormone, establishing a foundation for new strategies to create disease-resistant crops.
articles.abstractZh: 水杨酸（SA）是一种普遍存在的植物激素，在人类文明中有着悠久的历史1,2。由于 SA 在协调植物病原体防御方面发挥着核心作用，因此了解 SA 生物合成对于植物免疫研究和作物改良至关重要。拟南芥中异分支酸衍生的 SA 生物合成已被明确定义。然而，越来越多的证据表明，苯丙氨酸衍生的 SA 生物合成在许多其他植物物种中具有至关重要的功能。在这里，我们通过鉴定三种专用酶揭示了水稻中苯丙氨酸衍生的SA生物合成途径：过氧化物酶体苯甲酰辅酶A：苯甲醇苯甲酰转移酶（BEBT）、内质网相关细胞色素P450酶苯甲酸苄酯羟化酶（BBH）和胞质水杨酸苯甲酯酯酶（BSE），它们依次将苯甲酰辅酶A转化为苯甲酸苄酯，水杨酸苄酯和SA。该三酶模块的病原体诱导基因表达模式和SA生物合成功能在不同植物中是保守的。这项工作填补了关键植物防御激素生物合成方面的重大知识空白，为创造抗病作物的新策略奠定了基础。

articles.title: Driving a protective allele of the mosquito FREP1 gene to combat malaria.
articles.titleZh: 驱动蚊子 FREP1 基因的保护性等位基因来对抗疟疾。
articles.authors: Li Z, Dong Y, You L, Corder RM, Arzobal J, Yeun A, Yang L, Marshall JM, Dimopoulos G, Bier E.
articles.abstract: Malaria remains a substantial global health challenge, causing approximately half a million deaths each year1. The mosquito fibrinogen-related protein 1 (FREP1) is required for malaria parasites to infect the midgut epithelium2. The naturally occurring FREP1Q allele has been reported to prevent parasite infection, while supporting essential physiological functions in the mosquito3. Here we generate congenic strains of Anopheles stephensi, edited to carry either the parasite-susceptible FREP1L224 or the putative-refractory FREP1Q224 alleles. The FREP1Q224 allele confers robust resistance to infection by both human and rodent malaria parasites, with negligible fitness costs. The protective FREP1Q224 allele can be efficiently driven into FREP1L224 mosquito populations using a novel linked allelic-drive system that selectively replaces the L224 codon with the parasite-refractory Q224 allele, thereby rendering populations refractory to parasite infection. This antimalaria drive system provides a novel genetic approach to aid in malaria elimination efforts.
articles.abstractZh: 疟疾仍然是一项重大的全球健康挑战，每年导致约 50 万人死亡1。疟疾寄生虫感染中肠上皮需要蚊子纤维蛋白原相关蛋白 1 (FREP1)2。据报道，天然存在的 FREP1Q 等位基因可以预防寄生虫感染，同时支持蚊子的基本生理功能3。在这里，我们生成了史氏按蚊的同源品系，经过编辑以携带对寄生虫敏感的 FREP1L224 或假定的难治性 FREP1Q224 等位基因。 FREP1Q224 等位基因对人类和啮齿动物疟疾寄生虫的感染具有强大的抵抗力，而健康成本可以忽略不计。使用新型连锁等位基因驱动系统，可以将保护性 FREP1Q224 等位基因有效地驱动到 FREP1L224 蚊子种群中，该系统选择性地用抗寄生虫的 Q224 等位基因替换 L224 密码子，从而使种群对寄生虫感染具有抵抗力。这种抗疟疾驱动系统提供了一种新颖的遗传方法来帮助消除疟疾。

articles.title: Selective inhibition of ERO1α with M6766, a novel small-molecule inhibitor, prevents arterial thrombosis and ischemic stroke in mice.
articles.titleZh: 使用新型小分子抑制剂 M6766 选择性抑制 ERO1α 可预防小鼠动脉血栓形成和缺血性中风。
articles.authors: Wang J, Kim JS, Jha V, Brown G, Lee J, Bokorova R, Jin BR, Ahmed M, Castelblanco E, Johnson D, Prinsen M, Ilagan MXG, Remedi MS, Razani B, Dolle RE, Cho J.
articles.abstract: Using endoplasmic reticulum oxidoreductase 1α (ERO1α) conditional knockout (CKO) mice, a recent study underscores the crucial role of ERO1α in platelet activation under thrombotic conditions. Through a high-throughput screen of 39,901 compounds, we identify M6766 as a selective inhibitor of ERO1α with an IC50 of 1.4 μM and a KD of 1.1 μM. A docking model and biochemical studies reveal that M6766 binds to the flavin adenine dinucleotide-binding pocket in ERO1α and exhibits >70-fold selectivity over other tested enzymes, except ERO1β, which it inhibits with an IC50 of 7.2 μM. M6766 concentration-dependently inhibits granule secretion, αIIbβ3 integrin activation, Ca2+ mobilization, and platelet aggregation induced by various agonists, but it does not affect agonist-induced production of reactive oxygen species. Pretreatment of ERO1α with M6766 reduces its binding to the Ca2+ sensor stromal interaction molecule 1. To validate whether these inhibitory effects result from the inhibition of ERO1α and ERO1β, we generate megakaryocyte-specific Ero1β or Ero1α/β CKO mice. Deletion of platelet Ero1α/β impairs platelet activation and aggregation, whereas deletion of Ero1β has no effect. While EN460 markedly inhibits the function of Ero1α/β-null platelets, M6766 does not, highlighting its specificity. M6766 treatment diminishes platelet accumulation on collagen-coated surfaces under arterial shear conditions. Moreover, intravenous injection of M6766 into mice decreases arterial thrombosis and infarct volume during ischemic stroke without prolonging tail bleeding times. Although eptifibatide, an αIIbβ3 antagonist, effectively blocks arterial thrombosis, it prolongs bleeding times at therapeutic doses. Our findings suggest that ERO1α inhibition is a promising anti-thrombotic strategy with potential advantages over current therapies.
articles.abstractZh: 最近的一项研究使用内质网氧化还原酶 1α (ERO1α) 条件敲除 (CKO) 小鼠，强调了 ERO1α 在血栓条件下血小板激活中的关键作用。通过对 39,901 种化合物的高通量筛选，我们确定 M6766 是 ERO1α 的选择性抑制剂，IC50 为 1.4 μM，KD 为 1.1 μM。对接模型和生化研究表明，M6766 与 ERO1α 中的黄素腺嘌呤二核苷酸结合袋结合，并表现出比其他测试酶高 70 倍的选择性，但 ERO1β 除外，它抑制 ERO1β 的 IC50 为 7.2 μM。 M6766 浓度依赖性地抑制各种激动剂诱导的颗粒分泌、αIIbβ3 整合素激活、Ca2+ 动员和血小板聚集，但不影响激动剂诱导的活性氧的产生。用 M6766 预处理 ERO1α 会减少其与 Ca2+ 传感器基质相互作用分子的结合 1。为了验证这些抑制作用是否是由 ERO1α 和 ERO1β 的抑制引起的，我们生成了巨核细胞特异性 Ero1β 或 Ero1α/β CKO 小鼠。血小板 Ero1α/β 的缺失会损害血小板的活化和聚集，而 Ero1β 的缺失则没有影响。而E

articles.title: Unveiling molecular mechanisms of strobilurin resistance in the cacao pathogen <i>Moniliophthora perniciosa</i>.
articles.titleZh: 揭示可可病原体 Moniliophthora perniciosa 抗甲氧基丙烯酸酯的分子机制。
articles.authors: Prado PFV, Mendes CVC, Pires BA, Fiorin GL, Mieczkowski P, Pereira GAG, Teixeira PJPL, Thomazella DPT.
articles.abstract: Strobilurin fungicides inhibit mitochondrial respiration, leading to ATP depletion and oxidative stress. Although widely used in agriculture, these chemicals are ineffective against the cacao pathogen Moniliophthora perniciosa. Here, we show that M. perniciosa tolerates high concentrations of the commercial strobilurin azoxystrobin in vitro. Transcriptomic analysis revealed that short-term exposure triggers upregulation of genes related to catabolic pathways, including the glyoxylate cycle and fatty acid degradation, alongside repression of genes involved in anabolic processes, such as cell division and ribosome biogenesis. Simultaneously, genes associated with cellular detoxification and oxidative stress responses were strongly induced. These alterations suggest that M. perniciosa remodels its metabolism to counteract fungicide toxicity. Remarkably, long-term exposure to azoxystrobin led to the emergence of a resistant mutant harboring mutations in two putative growth and transcriptional regulators. This work provides new insights into the molecular basis of strobilurin resistance and informs strategies for more effective fungicide deployment in agriculture.
articles.abstractZh: 甲氧基丙烯酸酯类杀菌剂抑制线粒体呼吸，导致 ATP 耗竭和氧化应激。尽管这些化学物质广泛用于农业，但对可可病原体 Perniciosa 念珠菌无效。在这里，我们表明 M. perniciosa 在体外耐受高浓度的商业甲氧基丙烯酸酯嘧菌酯。转录组分析显示，短期暴露会引发与分解代谢途径相关的基因上调，包括乙醛酸循环和脂肪酸降解，同时抑制参与合成代谢过程的基因，例如细胞分裂和核糖体生物发生。同时，与细胞解毒和氧化应激反应相关的基因被强烈诱导。这些改变表明，M. perniciosa 重塑了其代谢以抵消杀菌剂的毒性。值得注意的是，长期接触嘧菌酯导致出现了一种耐药突变体，该突变体在两个假定的生长和转录调节因子中含有突变。这项工作为嗜球果伞素抗性的分子基础提供了新的见解，并为在农业中更有效地部署杀菌剂提供了策略。

articles.title: Protocol for assessment of CRISPR base editors and their components in Escherichia coli.
articles.titleZh: 用于评估大肠杆菌中 CRISPR 碱基编辑器及其组件的方案。
articles.authors: Shelake RM, Kim JY.
articles.abstract: Base editing (BE) is a CRISPR technique that allows precise nucleobase conversions. However, high expression of BE components is often toxic in Escherichia coli. Here, we present a protocol for analyzing BE at single or multiple target sites using promoter-terminators for single guide RNA (sgRNA) and BE component expression. We describe steps for designing and cloning sgRNA, synthetic target, and BE biomodules. We then detail procedures for BE module assemblage, E. coli transformation, and testing base editors and components. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to Shelake and Kim,1 Shelake et al.,2 and Shelake et al.3.
articles.abstractZh: 碱基编辑 (BE) 是一种 CRISPR 技术，可实现精确的核碱基转换。然而，BE成分的高表达在大肠杆菌中通常是有毒的。在这里，我们提出了一种使用启动子终止子来分析单个或多个靶位点的 BE 的方案，用于单向导 RNA (sgRNA) 和 BE 组件表达。我们描述了设计和克隆 sgRNA、合成靶标和 BE 生物模块的步骤。然后，我们详细介绍了 BE 模块组装、大肠杆菌转化以及测试碱基编辑器和组件的程序。有关该协议的使用和执行的完整详细信息，请参阅 Shelake 和 Kim,1 Shelake 等人,2 和 Shelake 等人3。

articles.title: SPIDR enables multiplexed mapping of RNA-protein interactions and uncovers a mechanism for selective translational suppression upon cell stress.
articles.titleZh: SPIDR 能够实现 RNA-蛋白质相互作用的多重映射，并揭示细胞应激时选择性翻译抑制的机制。
articles.authors: Wolin E, Guo JK, Blanco MR, Goronzy IN, Gorhe D, Dong W, Perez AA, Keskin A, Valenzuela E, Abdou AA, Urbinati CR, Kaufhold R, Rube HT, Brito Querido J, Guttman M, Jovanovic M.
articles.abstract: RNA-binding proteins (RBPs) regulate all stages of the mRNA life cycle, yet current methods generally map RNA targets of RBPs one protein at a time. To overcome this limitation, we developed SPIDR (split-and-pool identification of RBP targets), a highly multiplexed split-pool method that profiles the binding sites of dozens of RBPs simultaneously. SPIDR identifies precise, single-nucleotide binding sites for diverse classes of RBPs. Using SPIDR, we uncovered an interaction between LARP1 and the 18S rRNA and resolved this interaction to the mRNA entry channel of the 40S ribosome using cryoelectron microscopy (cryo-EM), providing a potential mechanistic explanation for LARP1's role in translational suppression. We explored changes in RBP binding upon mTOR inhibition and identified that 4EBP1 preferentially associates with translationally repressed mRNAs upon mTOR inhibition. SPIDR has the potential to significantly advance our understanding of RNA biology by enabling rapid, de novo discovery of RNA-protein interactions at an unprecedented scale.
articles.abstractZh: RNA 结合蛋白 (RBP) 调节 mRNA 生命周期的所有阶段，但目前的方法通常一次绘制一种蛋白质的 RBP 的 RNA 靶标。为了克服这一限制，我们开发了 SPIDR（RBP 靶标的分割池识别），这是一种高度多重的分割池方法，可同时分析数十个 RBP 的结合位点。 SPIDR 识别不同类别 RBP 的精确单核苷酸结合位点。使用 SPIDR，我们发现了 LARP1 和 18S rRNA 之间的相互作用，并使用冷冻电子显微镜 (cryo-EM) 解析了这种与 40S 核糖体 mRNA 进入通道的相互作用，为 LARP1 在翻译抑制中的作用提供了潜在的机制解释。我们探索了 mTOR 抑制后 RBP 结合的变化，并发现 4EBP1 在 mTOR 抑制后优先与翻译抑制的 mRNA 结合。 SPIDR 有潜力以前所未有的规模快速、从头发现 RNA-蛋白质相互作用，从而显着增进我们对 RNA 生物学的理解。

articles.title: Systematic, high-throughput characterization of bacteriophage gene essentiality on diverse hosts.
articles.titleZh: 不同宿主上噬菌体基因必要性的系统、高通量表征。
articles.authors: Chen J, Nilsen ED, Chitboonthavisuk C, Corban JE, Yang M, Mo CY, Raman S.
articles.abstract: Understanding core and conditional gene essentiality is crucial for decoding genotype-phenotype relationships in organisms. We present phage high-throughput approach for gene essentiality mapping and profiling (PhageMaP), a high-throughput method to create genome-scale loss-of-function libraries for systematically assessing gene essentiality in bacteriophages. Using PhageMaP across diverse hosts, we generate gene essentiality maps for all or most genes in the model phages T7 and T4, as well as the non-model phage Bas63. These maps provide fundamental insights into genome organization, gene function, and host-specific conditional essentiality. By applying PhageMaP to a collection of anti-phage defense systems, we uncover phage genes that either inhibit or activate six defenses and offer mechanistic hypotheses. Furthermore, we engineer synthetic phages with enhanced infectivity by modular transfer of a PhageMaP-discovered defense inhibitor from Bas63 to T7. PhageMaP advances bacteriophage functional genomics and accelerates rational phage design for therapy.
articles.abstractZh: 了解核心和条件基因的重要性对于解码生物体中的基因型-表型关系至关重要。我们提出了用于基因必要性作图和分析的噬菌体高通量方法（PhageMaP），这是一种创建基因组规模功能丧失文库的高通量方法，用于系统地评估噬菌体中的基因必要性。使用跨不同宿主的 PhageMaP，我们为模型噬菌体 T7 和 T4 以及非模型噬菌体 Bas63 中的所有或大多数基因生成基因必要性图谱。这些图谱提供了对基因组组织、基因功能和宿主特异性条件重要性的基本见解。通过将 PhageMaP 应用于一系列抗噬菌体防御系统，我们发现了抑制或激活六种防御的噬菌体基因，并提供了机制假设。此外，我们通过将 PhageMaP 发现的防御抑制剂从 Bas63 模块化转移到 T7，设计了具有增强感染性的合成噬菌体。 PhageMaP 推进了噬菌体功能基因组学并加速了合理的噬菌体治疗设计。

articles.title: Targeted disruption of the <i>cls</i> gene in <i>Buchnera aphidicola</i> impairs membrane integrity and host symbiont dynamics.
articles.titleZh: 定向破坏 Buchnera aphidicola 中的 cls 基因会损害膜完整性和宿主共生体动力学。
articles.authors: Xin Yee Tan K, Shigenobu S.
articles.abstract: The obligate symbiosis between pea aphids (Acyrthosiphon pisum) and Buchnera aphidicola represents metabolic interdependence between the host insect and its bacterial symbiont. Buchnera has a highly reduced genome that has lost nearly all phospholipid synthesis genes except cls, encoding a cardiolipin synthase homologue. We employed in vivo antisense, cell-penetrating peptide (CPP)-conjugated synthetic peptide nucleic acids (PNAs) to knock down cls in Buchnera. This intervention resulted in significant downregulation of cls expression, lowered Buchnera titers, pronounced morphological distortions, and reduced aphid reproduction. Notably, Buchnera cells were often detected in the aphid gut following anti-cls PNAs treatment, deviating from their typical intracellular niche within bacteriocytes. Collectively, the cls gene is critical for maintaining Buchnera integrity, proper cellular localization, and symbiont-host interactions. Given that the retention of cls is a common feature among many obligate endosymbionts despite massive gene loss, our findings offer key insights into the evolutionary principles shaping symbiotic relationships involving membrane biology.
articles.abstractZh: 豌豆蚜 (Acyrthosiphon pisum) 和 Buchnera aphidicola 之间的专性共生代表了宿主昆虫与其细菌共生体之间代谢的相互依赖。 Buchnera 的基因组高度减少，几乎丢失了除编码心磷脂合酶同源物的 cls 之外的所有磷脂合成基因。我们采用体内反义、细胞穿透肽 (CPP) 缀合的合成肽核酸 (PNA) 来敲低 Buchnera 中的 cls。这种干预导致 cls 表达显着下调，Buchnera 滴度降低，形态明显扭曲，并减少蚜虫繁殖。值得注意的是，在抗 cls PNA 处理后，经常在蚜虫肠道中检测到 Buchnera 细胞，这偏离了细菌细胞内典型的细胞内生态位。总的来说，cls 基因对于维持 Buchnera 完整性、正确的细胞定位和共生体与宿主的相互作用至关重要。尽管基因大量丢失，但 cls 的保留是许多专性内共生体的一个共同特征，我们的研究结果为塑造涉及膜生物学的共生关系的进化原理提供了重要的见解。

articles.title: The nuclear periphery confers repression on H3K9me2-marked genes and transposons to shape cell fate.
articles.titleZh: 核外围对 H3K9me2 标记基因和转座子进行抑制，从而影响细胞命运。
articles.authors: Marin HC, Allen C, Simental E, Martin EW, Panning B, Al-Sady B, Buchwalter A.
articles.abstract: Heterochromatic loci marked by histone H3 lysine 9 dimethylation (H3K9me2) are enriched at the nuclear periphery in metazoans, but the effect of spatial position on heterochromatin function has not been defined. Here we remove three nuclear lamins and the lamin B receptor (LBR) in mouse embryonic stem cells and show that heterochromatin detaches from the nuclear periphery. Mutant mouse embryonic stem cells sustain naive pluripotency and maintain H3K9me2 across the genome but cannot repress H3K9me2-marked genes or transposons. Further, mutant cells fail to differentiate into epiblast-like cells, a transition that requires the expansion of H3K9me2 across the genome. Mutant epiblast-like cells can silence naive pluripotency genes and activate epiblast-stage genes. However, H3K9me2 cannot repress markers of alternative fates, including primitive endoderm. We conclude that the lamins and LBR control the spatial position, dynamic remodelling and repressive capacity of H3K9me2-marked heterochromatin to shape cell fate decisions.
articles.abstractZh: 组蛋白 H3 赖氨酸 9 二甲基化 (H3K9me2) 标记的异染色质位点在后生动物的核周边富集，但空间位置对异染色质功能的影响尚未确定。在这里，我们去除了小鼠胚胎干细胞中的三个核纤层蛋白和核纤层蛋白 B 受体 (LBR)，并显示异染色质从核外围分离。突变小鼠胚胎干细胞维持幼稚多能性并在整个基因组中维持 H3K9me2，但不能抑制 H3K9me2 标记的基因或转座子。此外，突变细胞无法分化为外胚层样细胞，这一转变需要 H3K9me2 在整个基因组中的扩展。突变的外胚层样细胞可以沉默幼稚多能性基因并激活外胚层阶段基因。然而，H3K9me2 不能抑制其他命运的标记，包括原始内胚层。我们得出的结论是，核纤层蛋白和 LBR 控制 H3K9me2 标记的异染色质的空间位置、动态重塑和抑制能力，从而塑造细胞命运决定。

articles.title: Protocol for Agrobacterium-mediated transformation of tomato and flow cytometry-based ploidy confirmation.
articles.titleZh: 农杆菌介导的番茄转化和基于流式细胞术的倍性确认的方案。
articles.authors: Wang Y, Feng Y, Wang T, Liu L.
articles.abstract: Here, we present an Agrobacterium-mediated transformation protocol for tomato, Solanum lycopersicum cv. Micro-Tom, which incorporates flow cytometric ploidy analysis, a critical yet often overlooked step. We detail steps for cotyledon explants, inoculating with Agrobacterium, and co-cultivating cotyledons. We then describe procedures for regenerating shoots/roots, identifying diploid transgenic plants, and screening transgenic plants.
