Though ignored when compared with mitochondrial oxidation, the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) generates reactive oxygen species requiring antioxidant quality control. Using multi-organismal profiling featuring Drosophila, zebrafish, and mammalian hepatocytes, here we characterize the paraoxonase-like C20orf3/adipocyte plasma-membrane-associated protein (APMAP) as an ER-localized antioxidant that suppresses ER lipid oxidation to safeguard ER function. APMAP-depleted cells exhibit defective ER morphology, ER stress, and lipid peroxidation dependent on ER-oxidoreductase 1α (ERO1A), as well as sensitivity to ferroptosis and defects in ApoB-lipoprotein homeostasis. Similarly, organismal APMAP depletion in Drosophila and zebrafish perturbs ApoB-lipoprotein homeostasis. Strikingly, APMAP loss is rescued with chemical antioxidant N-acetyl-cysteine (NAC). Lipidomics identifies that APMAP loss elevates phospholipid peroxidation and boosts ceramides-signatures of lipid stress. Collectively, we propose that APMAP is an ER-localized antioxidant that promotes lipid and lipoprotein homeostasis in the ER network.
articles.abstractZh: 氧化应激扰乱脂质稳态并导致代谢疾病。尽管与线粒体氧化相比被忽略，但内质网 (ER) 会产生需要抗氧化剂质量控制的活性氧。通过对果蝇、斑马鱼和哺乳动物肝细胞的多生物体分析，我们将类对氧磷酶 C20orf3/脂肪细胞质膜相关蛋白 (APMAP) 描述为一种内质网局部抗氧化剂，可抑制内质网脂质氧化以保护内质网功能。 APMAP 耗尽的细胞表现出有缺陷的 ER 形态、ER 应激和依赖于 ER 氧化还原酶 1α (ERO1A) 的脂质过氧化，以及对铁死亡和 ApoB 脂蛋白稳态缺陷的敏感性。同样，果蝇和斑马鱼体内 APMAP 的消耗会扰乱 ApoB 脂蛋白稳态。引人注目的是，化学抗氧化剂 N-乙酰半胱氨酸 (NAC) 可以挽救 APMAP 损失。脂质组学发现 APMAP 损失会加剧磷脂过氧化并增强脂质应激的神经酰胺特征。总的来说，我们认为 APMAP 是一种内质网局部抗氧化剂，可促进内质网网络中的脂质和脂蛋白稳态。

articles.title: Phosphorylation of CPR5 by the receptor-like kinase FLR2 promotes mRNA poly(A) tail processing and immunity to Magnaporthe oryzae in rice.
articles.titleZh: 受体样激酶 FLR2 对 CPR5 的磷酸化可促进 mRNA 聚 (A) 尾部加工和水稻对稻瘟病菌的免疫力。
articles.authors: Luo X, Xing J, Peng Z, Zhang M, Wei Z, Xu J, Yu F, Deng H.
articles.abstract: Regulation of RNA metabolism is crucial for the modulation of gene expression in plants exposed to external stresses. However, the mechanism by which plant membrane receptors transmit external signals to regulate RNA metabolism has not been determined. In this study, we show that FERONIA-like receptor 2 (FLR2) modulates innate immunity in rice by inducing the translation of the immune regulator OsEIL1, thereby promoting resistance to Magnaporthe oryzae. FLR2 interacts with and phosphorylates the mRNA processing factor CONSTITUTIVE EXPRESSER OF PATHOGENESIS-RELATED GENES 5 (CPR5), leading to modulation of OsEIL1 poly(A) tail length and translation in response to M. oryzae infection. Like the flr2 loss-of-function mutant, the cpr5 mutant exhibited increased resistance to M. oryzae, induced reactive oxygen species generation, and activated the MAPK cascade. Furthermore, the phospho-dead cpr5 mutant (cpr5mut5A), in which the FLR2 phosphorylation sites are altered, could not rescue the cpr5 phenotype and resulted in longer OsEIL1 poly(A) tails than in the wild type. Conversely, the phospho-mimic cpr5mut5D restored both the wild-type phenotype and OsEIL1 poly(A) tail length in the cpr5 mutant background. These findings suggest that FLR2 perceives external stressors and regulates RNA metabolism via CPR5, revealing a novel posttranscriptional regulatory pathway in rice.
articles.abstractZh: RNA 代谢的调节对于暴露于外部胁迫的植物中基因表达的调节至关重要。然而，植物膜受体传递外部信号调节RNA代谢的机制尚未确定。在这项研究中，我们发现 FERONIA 样受体 2 (FLR2) 通过诱导免疫调节剂 OsEIL1 的翻译来调节水稻的先天免疫，从而促进对稻瘟病的抗性。 FLR2 与 mRNA 加工因子致病相关基因组成型表达蛋白 5 (CPR5) 相互作用并使其磷酸化，从而响应米霉感染而调节 OsEIL1 聚 (A) 尾长和翻译。与 flr2 功能丧失突变体一样，cpr5 突变体表现出对米霉的抗性增强，诱导活性氧的产生，并激活 MAPK 级联。此外，磷酸化死亡的 cpr5 突变体 (cpr5mut5A)（其中 FLR2 磷酸化位点发生改变）无法挽救 cpr5 表型，并导致 OsEIL1 poly(A) 尾比野生型更长。相反，磷酸化模拟的 cpr5mut5D 恢复了 cpr5 m 中的野生型表型和 OsEIL1 poly(A) 尾长。

articles.title: Protocol for probing candidate effector activity using the Prf-based plant cell death phenotype.
articles.titleZh: 使用基于 Prf 的植物细胞死亡表型探测候选效应子活性的方案。
articles.authors: Liu J, Irigoyen S, Mandadi KK.
articles.abstract: Identification and functional characterization of candidate effector proteins of pathogens are essential for understanding plant-microbe interactions. Here, we present a protocol for probing candidate effector activity using the Prf-based plant cell death phenotype. We describe steps for co-infiltrating plant leaves with a Prf protein and the effector and visually assess the cell death phenotype as a readout for detecting effector activity. The protocol enables the screening of candidate effectors that suppress programmed cell death by interfering with plant immune responses. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to Wang et al.1.
articles.abstractZh: 病原体候选效应蛋白的鉴定和功能表征对于理解植物-微生物相互作用至关重要。在这里，我们提出了一个使用基于 Prf 的植物细胞死亡表型探测候选效应子活性的方案。我们描述了用 Prf 蛋白和效应子共同渗透植物叶子的步骤，并目视评估细胞死亡表型作为检测效应子活性的读数。该方案能够筛选通过干扰植物免疫反应来抑制程序性细胞死亡的候选效应器。有关该协议的使用和执行的完整详细信息，请参阅 Wang 等人 1。

articles.title: Activation of bacterial programmed cell death by phage inhibitors of host immunity.
articles.titleZh: 宿主免疫的噬菌体抑制剂激活细菌程序性细胞死亡。
articles.authors: Silas S, Carion H, Makarova KS, Laderman ES, Todeschini T, Kumar P, Johnson M, Bocek M, Nobrega FL, Koonin EV, Bondy-Denomy J.
articles.abstract: Bacterial and archaeal viruses are replete with diverse uncharacterized accessory genes (AGs), which likely interface with host processes. However, large-scale discovery of virus AG functions remains challenging. Here, we developed an integrated computational and experimental discovery platform to identify viral AGs and assign functions. We show that multiple AGs activate unexpected programmed cell death (PCD) activity of distinct restriction-modification (R-M) systems. We describe an exapted type I R-M decoy that kills the host upon sensing several different anti-defense AGs and a self-guarded type III R-M system that restricts phages but also induces PCD when bound by anti-R-M proteins. Other phage counter-defense genes additionally activate non-R-M-based abortive infection systems encoded by prophages. This defense strategy creates a conundrum: lose AGs and be exposed to immunity or keep AGs and trigger PCD. Strategies employed by viruses to avoid this double bind could be an important factor in virus evolution that remains to be explored.
articles.abstractZh: 细菌和古细菌病毒充满了多种未表征的辅助基因（AG），这些基因可能与宿主过程相互作用。然而，大规模发现病毒AG功能仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们开发了一个集成的计算和实验发现平台来识别病毒 AG 并分配功能。我们发现多个 AG 会激活不同限制性修饰 (R-M) 系统的意外程序性细胞死亡 (PCD) 活性。我们描述了一种外适应的 I 型 R-M 诱饵，它在感测到几种不同的抗防御 AG 后杀死宿主，以及一种自我保护的 III 型 R-M 系统，该系统限制噬菌体，但在与抗 R-M 蛋白结合时也会诱导 PCD。其他噬菌体反防御基因还可以激活由原噬菌体编码的非基于 R-M 的流产感染系统。这种防御策略产生了一个难题：失去 AG 并受到免疫，或者保留 AG 并触发 PCD。病毒避免这种双重束缚所采用的策略可能是病毒进化的一个重要因素，仍有待探索。

articles.title: An engineered gut bacterium protects against dietary methylmercury exposure in pregnant mice.
articles.titleZh: 一种经过改造的肠道细菌可以保护怀孕小鼠免受饮食中的甲基汞暴露。
articles.authors: Yu KB, Chandra F, Coley-O'Rourke EJ, Paulson ET, Novoselov A, Zhang D, Finnigan D, Paramo J, Lopez-Romero A, Dong TS, Schartup AT, Hsiao EY.
articles.abstract: Despite efforts to decrease mercury emissions, chronic exposure to the neurotoxicant methylmercury (MeHg) continues to be a global problem that contributes to disparities in risk for neurological and metabolic diseases. Herein we engineer a human commensal gut bacterium, Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron (Bt), to detoxify MeHg by heterologous expression of organomercury lyase (MerB) and mercuric reductase (MerA) genes derived from a resistant bacterium isolated from Hg-polluted mines. We demonstrate that BtmerA/B demethylates MeHg both in vitro and within the intestines of mice orally exposed to MeHg or diets containing MeHg-rich fish. In pregnant mice exposed to dietary MeHg, BtmerA/B decreases MeHg accumulation in the maternal liver, brain, placenta, and fetal brain, and attenuates the expression of cellular stress genes in the fetal brain. Overall, this work provides foundational proof-of-principle supporting the ability of an engineered gut bacterium to limit MeHg bioaccumulation and reduce adverse effects of chronic MeHg exposure.
articles.abstractZh: 尽管努力减少汞排放，但长期接触神经毒剂甲基汞 (MeHg) 仍然是一个全球性问题，导致神经系统和代谢疾病的风险存在差异。在此，我们设计了一种人类共生肠道细菌，Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron (Bt)，通过有机汞裂解酶 (MerB) 和汞还原酶 (MerA) 基因的异源表达来解毒汞，这些基因源自从汞污染矿井中分离出的抗性细菌。我们证明，BtmerA/B 在体外和口服暴露于 MeHg 或含有富含 MeHg 的鱼的饮食的小鼠肠道内都能使 MeHg 去甲基化。在暴露于膳食甲基汞的怀孕小鼠中，BtmerA/B 会减少母体肝脏、大脑、胎盘和胎儿大脑中甲基汞的积累，并减弱胎儿大脑中细胞应激基因的表达。总体而言，这项工作提供了基础原理验证，支持工程肠道细菌限制甲基汞生物蓄积并减少慢性甲基汞暴露的不利影响的能力。

articles.title: Editing proteins inside a cell.
articles.titleZh: 编辑细胞内的蛋白质。
articles.authors: Hampton JT, Liu WR.
articles.abstract: Pairs of split protein segments can modify a variety of target proteins in a living cell.
articles.abstractZh: 成对的分裂蛋白片段可以修饰活细胞中的多种靶蛋白。

articles.title: Elucidation and de novo reconstitution of glyceollin biosynthesis
articles.titleZh: 甘油蛋白生物合成的阐明和从头重建
articles.authors: Sun Y, Chen C, Lin C, Zhang H, Lian J, Hong B.
articles.abstract: Glyceollins are phytoalexins, soybean-produced compounds that respond to pathogen invasion, injury, and environmental challenges. While these compounds have diverse bioactivities, their limited accessibility hinders further physiological and biochemical studies. Additionally, the incomplete understanding of glyceollin biosynthesis, particularly cyclization steps, remains a major barrier to sustainable production through synthetic biology. In this study, we uncover the complete biosynthetic pathway of glyceollins through a combinatorial approach involving transient expression in Nicotiana benthamiana, in vitro enzyme characterization, and yeast feeding studies. We identified previously uncharacterized genes encoding reductases for 7,2′,4′-trihydroxyisoflavanol biosynthesis and five P450 enzymes that mediate the final oxidative cyclization to produce glyceollins I, II, and III. By de novo reconstruction of the pathway through synthetic biology and metabolic engineering, we successfully produced glyceollins from simple carbon sources in baker’s yeast. This work advances the understanding of glyceollin biosynthesis in soybeans, enables sustainable production in microbial hosts, and offers new opportunities for their application in agriculture and biology.
articles.abstractZh: 甘油酚是植物抗毒素，是大豆产生的化合物，可对病原体入侵、损伤和环境挑战做出反应。虽然这些化合物具有不同的生物活性，但其有限的可及性阻碍了进一步的生理和生化研究。此外，对甘油蛋白生物合成（特别是环化步骤）的不完全了解仍然是合成生物学可持续生产的主要障碍。在这项研究中，我们通过涉及烟草瞬时表达、体外酶表征和酵母喂养研究的组合方法揭示了甘油蛋白的完整生物合成途径。我们鉴定了以前未表征的基因，它们编码用于 7,2',4'-三羟基异黄烷醇生物合成的还原酶，以及介导最终氧化环化以产生甘油蛋白 I、II 和 III 的五种 P450 酶。通过合成生物学和代谢工程从头重建途径，我们成功地从面包酵母中的简单碳源生产了甘油。这项工作增进了对大豆中甘油生物合成的理解，实现了微生物宿主的可持续生产，并

articles.title: Ribosomes modulate transcriptome abundance via generalized frameshift and out-of-frame mRNA decay.
articles.titleZh: 核糖体通过广义移码和框外 mRNA 衰减来调节转录组丰度。
articles.authors: Zhang Y, Nersisyan L, Fürst E, Alexopoulos I, Santolaria C, Huch S, Bassot C, Garre E, Sunnerhagen P, Piazza I, Pelechano V.
articles.abstract: Cells need to adapt their transcriptome to quickly match cellular needs in changing environments. mRNA abundance can be controlled by altering both its synthesis and decay. Here, we show how, in response to poor nutritional conditions, the bulk of the S. cerevisiae transcriptome undergoes -1 ribosome frameshifts and experiences an accelerated out-of-frame co-translational mRNA decay. Using RNA metabolic labeling, we demonstrate that in poor nutritional conditions, nonsense-mediated mRNA decay (NMD)-dependent degradation represents at least one-third of the total mRNA decay. We further characterize this mechanism and identify low codon optimality as a key factor for ribosomes to induce out-of-frame mRNA decay. Finally, we show that this phenomenon is conserved from bacteria to humans. Our work provides evidence for a direct regulatory feedback mechanism coupling protein demand with the control of mRNA abundance to limit cellular growth and broadens the functional landscape of mRNA quality control.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞需要调整其转录组，以快速满足不断变化的环境中的细胞需求。 mRNA 丰度可以通过改变其合成和衰变来控制。在这里，我们展示了，为了应对不良的营养条件，大部分酿酒酵母转录组如何经历-1核糖体移码，并经历加速的框外共翻译 mRNA 衰减。使用RNA代谢标记，我们证明在营养不良的条件下，无义介导的mRNA衰减（NMD）依赖性降解至少占总mRNA衰减的三分之一。我们进一步表征了这种机制，并确定低密码子最优性是核糖体诱导框外 mRNA 衰变的关键因素。最后，我们证明这种现象从细菌到人类都是保守的。我们的工作为将蛋白质需求与 mRNA 丰度控制相结合的直接调节反馈机制提供了证据，以限制细胞生长并拓宽 mRNA 质量控制的功能范围。

articles.title: Sumoylated Etv1 establishes mouse mammary cancer stem cells that support tumorigenesis by non-stem cancer cells.
articles.titleZh: Sumoylated Etv1 建立了小鼠乳腺癌干细胞，支持非干癌细胞的肿瘤发生。
articles.authors: Li Z, Koch KE, Thompson DT, Van der Heide DM, Chang J, Franke CM, Suraju MO, Beck AC, Lorenzen AW, White JR, Bartschat NI, Kulak MV, Meyerholz DK, Kenny C, Weigel RJ.
articles.abstract: The small ubiquitin-like modifier (SUMO) pathway is required for maintenance of cancer stem cells/tumor-initiating cells (CSCs/TICs), which drive tumorigenesis when transplanted into immunocompromised mice. We found that inhibition of the SUMO pathway blocked Neu-mediated mammary oncogenesis and inhibited the function of CSCs/TICs without effects on normal mammary stem cells. Transcriptomic analysis implicated SUMO-conjugated Etv1 as being critical for oncogenesis. After SUMO pathway inhibition, a SUMO-mimetic Etv1 protein, created by a fusion with SUMO1 or SUMO2, established a stem-like cell capable of tumorigenesis, whereas a SUMO-resistant Etv1 protein established a proliferative, non-tumorigenic cell. In mixing experiments, stem-like cells induced tumorigenesis by non-stem cells. We conclude that SUMO-conjugated Etv1 is necessary to maintain the CSC/TIC phenotype and that crosstalk between stem and non-stem cells is crucial for tumorigenesis. The findings demonstrate dynamic interactions between heterogeneous cell types to drive tumorigenesis, which has implications for future cancer therapeutic development.
articles.abstractZh: 小泛素样修饰剂 (SUMO) 途径是维持癌症干细胞/肿瘤起始细胞 (CSC/TIC) 所必需的，当移植到免疫功能低下的小鼠体内时，这些细胞会驱动肿瘤发生。我们发现，抑制 SUMO 通路可阻断 Neu 介导的乳腺肿瘤发生并抑制 CSC/TIC 的功能，而不影响正常乳腺干细胞。转录组分析表明 SUMO 结合的 Etv1 对于肿瘤发生至关重要。 SUMO 通路抑制后，通过与 SUMO1 或 SUMO2 融合产生的 SUMO 模拟 Etv1 蛋白建立了能够肿瘤发生的干细胞样细胞，而 SUMO 抗性 Etv1 蛋白则建立了增殖性非致瘤细胞。在混合实验中，干细胞样细胞诱导非干细胞发生肿瘤。我们得出结论，SUMO 缀合的 Etv1 对于维持 CSC/TIC 表型是必要的，并且干细胞和非干细胞之间的串扰对于肿瘤发生至关重要。研究结果表明异质细胞类型之间的动态相互作用可驱动肿瘤发生，这对未来癌症治疗的发展具有重要意义。

articles.title: TIGR-Tas: A family of modular RNA-guided DNA-targeting systems in prokaryotes and their viruses.
articles.titleZh: TIGR-Tas：原核生物及其病毒中的一系列模块化 RNA 引导的 DNA 靶向系统。
articles.authors: Faure G, Saito M, Wilkinson ME, Quinones-Olvera N, Xu P, Flam-Shepherd D, Kim S, Reddy N, Zhu S, Evgeniou L, Koonin EV, Macrae RK, Zhang F.
articles.abstract: RNA-guided systems provide remarkable versatility, enabling diverse biological functions. Through iterative structural and sequence homology-based mining starting with a guide RNA-interaction domain of Cas9, we identified a family of RNA-guided DNA-targeting proteins in phage and parasitic bacteria. Each system consists of a tandem interspaced guide RNA (TIGR) array and a TIGR-associated (Tas) protein containing a nucleolar protein (Nop) domain, sometimes fused to HNH (TasH)- or RuvC (TasR)-nuclease domains. We show that TIGR arrays are processed into 36-nucleotide RNAs (tigRNAs) that direct sequence-specific DNA binding through a tandem-spacer targeting mechanism. TasR can be reprogrammed for precise DNA cleavage, including in human cells. The structure of TasR reveals striking similarities to box C/D small nucleolar ribonucleoproteins and IS110 RNA-guided transposases, providing insights into the evolution of diverse RNA-guided systems.
articles.abstractZh: RNA 引导系统具有卓越的多功能性，可实现多种生物功能。通过从 Cas9 的引导 RNA 相互作用域开始，基于迭代结构和序列同源性的挖掘，我们在噬菌体和寄生细菌中鉴定了一系列 RNA 引导的 DNA 靶向蛋白。每个系统均由串联间隔引导 RNA (TIGR) 阵列和包含核仁蛋白 (Nop) 结构域的 TIGR 相关 (Tas) 蛋白组成，有时与 HNH (TasH) 或 RuvC (TasR) 核酸酶结构域融合。我们证明 TIGR 阵列被加工成 36 核苷酸 RNA (tigRNA)，通过串联间隔区靶向机制指导序列特异性 DNA 结合。 TasR 可以重新编程以实现精确的 DNA 切割，包括在人类细胞中。 TasR 的结构揭示了与盒 C/D 小核仁核糖核蛋白和 IS110 RNA 引导转座酶的惊人相似性，为不同 RNA 引导系统的进化提供了见解。

articles.title: U1 snRNP regulates alternative promoter activity by inhibiting premature polyadenylation.
articles.titleZh: U1 snRNP 通过抑制过早多聚腺苷酸化来调节替代启动子活性。
articles.authors: Kim G, Carroll CL, Wakefield ZP, Tuncay M, Fiszbein A.
articles.abstract: Emerging evidence indicates that splicing factors mediate the close link between transcription and splicing. However, the mechanisms underlying this coupling remain unclear. U1 small nuclear ribonucleoprotein particle (U1 snRNP) not only initiates splicing but also plays a crucial role in preventing premature cleavage and polyadenylation, facilitating long-distance transcriptional elongation. Here, we show that U1 snRNP regulates alternative promoter activity in human cells by inhibiting premature polyadenylation. In genes carrying premature polyadenylation sites between two promoters, U1 snRNP inhibition with antisense oligonucleotides leads to a significant decrease in downstream promoter activity. Conversely, restoring U1 snRNP activity or inhibiting premature polyadenylation rescues downstream promoter activity. Mechanistically, U1 snRNP inhibition correlates with reduced chromatin accessibility, decreased RNA polymerase II serine 5 phosphorylation, and increased promoter-proximal pause at downstream promoters. Our findings support a model in which U1 snRNP favors productive elongation from upstream promoters, triggering downstream promoter activation by destabilizing nucleosomes and promoting promoter escape.
articles.abstractZh: 新的证据表明剪接因子介导转录和剪接之间的密切联系。然而，这种耦合背后的机制仍不清楚。 U1小核核糖核蛋白颗粒（U1 snRNP）不仅启动剪接，而且在防止过早裂解和多聚腺苷酸化、促进长距离转录延伸方面发挥着至关重要的作用。在这里，我们证明 U1 snRNP 通过抑制过早的聚腺苷酸化来调节人类细胞中的替代启动子活性。在两个启动子之间携带过早聚腺苷酸化位点的基因中，用反义寡核苷酸抑制 U1 snRNP 会导致下游启动子活性显着降低。相反，恢复 U1 snRNP 活性或抑制过早的聚腺苷酸化可挽救下游启动子活性。从机制上讲，U1 snRNP 抑制与染色质可及性降低、RNA 聚合酶 II 丝氨酸 5 磷酸化降低以及下游启动子处的启动子近端暂停增加相关。我们的研究结果支持一个模型，其中 U1 snRNP 有利于上游启动子的生产性延伸，通过破坏核小体的稳定性来触发下游启动子激活

articles.title: A live bacteria enzyme assay for identification of human disease mutations and drug screening.
articles.titleZh: 用于鉴定人类疾病突变和药物筛选的活细菌酶测定。
articles.authors: Choe D, Palsson BO.
articles.abstract: Advances in high-throughput sequencing have enabled the identification of genetic variations associated with human disease. However, deciphering the functional significance of these variations remains challenging. Here we propose an alternative approach that uses humanized Escherichia coli to study human genetic enzymopathies and to screen candidate drug effects on metabolic targets. By replacing selected E. coli metabolic enzymes with their human orthologues and their sequence variants, we demonstrate that the growth rate of E. coli reflects the in vivo activity of heterologously expressed human enzymes. This approach accurately reflected enzyme activities of known sequence variants, enabling rapid screening of causal sequence variations associated with human diseases. This approach bridges the gap between in vitro assays and cell-based assays. Our findings suggest that the proposed approach using a humanized E. coli strain holds promise for drug discovery, offering a high-throughput and cost-effective platform for identifying new compounds targeting human enzymes. Continued research and innovation in this field have the potential to impact the development and practice of precision medicine.
articles.abstractZh: 高通量测序的进步使得能够识别与人类疾病相关的遗传变异。然而，破译这些变异的功能意义仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出了一种替代方法，使用人源化大肠杆菌来研究人类遗传酶病并筛选候选药物对代谢靶点的作用。通过用人类直系同源物及其序列变体替换选定的大肠杆菌代谢酶，我们证明大肠杆菌的生长速率反映了异源表达的人类酶的体内活性。这种方法准确地反映了已知序列变异的酶活性，从而能够快速筛选与人类疾病相关的因果序列变异。这种方法弥补了体外测定和基于细胞的测定之间的差距。我们的研究结果表明，所提出的使用人源化大肠杆菌菌株的方法有望用于药物发现，为识别针对人类酶的新化合物提供高通量且具有成本效益的平台。该领域的持续研究和创新有可能影响精密工业的发展和实践

articles.title: Bacterial pathogens hijack host cell peroxisomes for replication vacuole expansion and integrity.
articles.titleZh: 细菌病原体劫持宿主细胞过氧化物酶体以实现复制液泡扩张和完整性。
articles.authors: Hossain MJ, Romanov KA, Jian J, Swaby LC, Bandyopadhyay S, Guan I, Thomas SM, Olive AJ, O'Connor TJ.
articles.abstract: Pathogens manipulate host cell organelles to establish infection. There is extensive evidence of pathogen modulation of the endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus, mitochondria, endosomes, lysosomes, and nucleus. However, one organelle that has been largely overlooked in connection with bacterial pathogenesis is peroxisomes. Here, we demonstrate that Legionella actively recruits peroxisomes to its replication vacuole using a secreted bacterial effector protein. Defects in peroxisome metabolic function restrict expansion of the Legionella vacuole membrane and cause rupture of this compartment, inhibiting bacterial replication and leading to bacterial degradation. Similarly, peroxisome dysfunction causes Salmonella replication vacuole destabilization and reduced bacterial burden within host cells. Thus, these two intracellular bacterial pathogens exploit host cell peroxisomes to maintain their replication compartments, establishing a critical role for this organelle in disease.
articles.abstractZh: 病原体操纵宿主细胞器来建立感染。有大量证据表明病原体对内质网、高尔基体、线粒体、内体、溶酶体和细胞核进行调节。然而，与细菌发病机制有关的一种在很大程度上被忽视的细胞器是过氧化物酶体。在这里，我们证明军团菌使用分泌的细菌效应蛋白主动将过氧化物酶体招募到其复制液泡中。过氧化物酶体代谢功能的缺陷限制了军团菌液泡膜的扩张并导致该室破裂，抑制细菌复制并导致细菌降解。同样，过氧化物酶体功能障碍会导致沙门氏菌复制液泡不稳定并减少宿主细胞内的细菌负担。因此，这两种细胞内细菌病原体利用宿主细胞过氧化物酶体来维持其复制区室，从而确立了这种细胞器在疾病中的关键作用。

articles.title: tRNA modifications tune m<sup>6</sup>A-dependent mRNA decay.
articles.titleZh: tRNA 修饰可调节 m<sup>6</sup>A 依赖性 mRNA 衰减。
articles.authors: Linder B, Sharma P, Wu J, Birbaumer T, Eggers C, Murakami S, Ott RE, Fenzl K, Vorgerd H, Erhard F, Jaffrey SR, Leidel SA, Steinmetz LM.
articles.abstract: Chemically modified nucleotides in mRNA are critical regulators of gene expression, primarily through interactions with reader proteins that bind to these modifications. Here, we present a mechanism by which the epitranscriptomic mark N6-methyladenosine (m6A) is read by tRNAs during translation. Codons that are modified with m6A are decoded inefficiently by the ribosome, rendering them "non-optimal" and inducing ribosome collisions on cellular transcripts. This couples mRNA translation to decay. 5-Methoxycarbonylmethyl-2-thiouridine (mcm5s2U) in the tRNA anticodon loop counteracts this effect. This unanticipated link between the mRNA and tRNA epitranscriptomes enables the coordinated decay of mRNA regulons, including those encoding oncogenic signaling pathways. In cancer, dysregulation of the m6A and mcm5s2U biogenesis pathways-marked by a shift toward more mcm5s2U-is associated with more aggressive tumors and poor prognosis. Overall, this pan-epitranscriptomic interaction represents a novel mechanism of post-transcriptional gene regulation with implications for human health.
articles.abstractZh: mRNA 中经过化学修饰的核苷酸是基因表达的关键调节因子，主要是通过与结合这些修饰的读取蛋白相互作用。在这里，我们提出了一种在翻译过程中 tRNA 读取表观转录组标记 N6-甲基腺苷 (m6A) 的机制。用 m6A 修饰的密码子被核糖体解码效率低下，使其“非最佳”并诱导细胞转录物上的核糖体碰撞。这将 mRNA 翻译与衰变耦合起来。 tRNA 反密码子环中的 5-甲氧基羰基甲基-2-硫尿苷 (mcm5s2U) 可抵消这种效应。 mRNA 和 tRNA 表观转录组之间这种意想不到的联系使得 mRNA 调节子（包括那些编码致癌信号通路的调节子）协调衰减。在癌症中，m6A 和 mcm5s2U 生物发生途径的失调（以向更多 mcm5s2U 的转变为标志）与更具侵袭性的肿瘤和不良预后相关。总体而言，这种泛表转录组相互作用代表了一种转录后基因调控的新机制，对人类健康具有影响。

articles.title: Facile generation of drug-like conformational antibodies specific for amyloid fibrils.
articles.titleZh: 轻松生成淀粉样原纤维特异性的药物样构象抗体。
articles.authors: Desai AA, Zupancic JM, Trzeciakiewicz H, Gerson JE, DuBois KN, Skinner ME, Sharkey LM, McArthur N, Ferris SP, Bhatt NN, Makowski EK, Smith MD, Chen H, Huang J, Jerez C, Kuo YH, Kane RS, Kanaan NM, Paulson HL, Tessier PM.
articles.abstract: Antibodies that recognize insoluble antigens, such as amyloid fibrils associated with neurodegenerative disorders, are important for research, diagnostic and therapeutic applications. However, these types of antibodies are difficult to generate, typically require animal immunization and also commonly require humanization in the case of therapeutic applications. Here we report a methodology for generating high-quality, fully human, conformation-specific antibodies against amyloid fibrils using a published human nonimmune library, yeast-surface display and quantitative fluorescence-activated cell sorting. Notably, this approach enables the isolation of conformation-specific antibodies against tau fibrils (Alzheimer's disease) and α-synuclein fibrils (Parkinson's disease) with combinations of high affinity, high conformational specificity and, in some cases, low off-target binding that rival or exceed those of clinical-stage antibodies specific for tau (zagotenemab) and α-synuclein (cinpanemab). This approach is expected to simplify the generation of conformation-specific antibodies against diverse protein aggregates and other insoluble antigens.
articles.abstractZh: 识别不溶性抗原（例如与神经退行性疾病相关的淀粉样原纤维）的抗体对于研究、诊断和治疗应用非常重要。然而，这些类型的抗体很难产生，通常需要动物免疫，并且在治疗应用中通常还需要人源化。在这里，我们报告了一种使用已发表的人类非免疫文库、酵母表面展示和定量荧光激活细胞分选来生成针对淀粉样原纤维的高质量、全人源、构象特异性抗体的方法。值得注意的是，这种方法能够分离针对 tau 原纤维（阿尔茨海默病）和 α-突触核蛋白原纤维（帕金森病）的构象特异性抗体，其具有高亲和力、高构象特异性，并且在某些情况下还具有低脱靶结合，可与 tau (zagotenemab) 和 α-突触核蛋白 (cinpanemab) 特异性的临床阶段抗体相媲美或超过。这种方法有望简化针对不同蛋白质聚集体和其他不溶性抗原的构象特异性抗体的生成。

articles.title: Palmitic acid and palmitoylation in cancer: Understanding, insights, and challenges.
articles.titleZh: 癌症中的棕榈酸和棕榈酰化：理解、见解和挑战。
articles.authors: Song P, Jiang Q, Wu X, Bu L, Xie W, Wei W, Xing X, Guo J.
articles.abstract: Nutrients from dietary foods not only provide energy and building blocks, but also play critical roles in modulating diverse pathophysiological functions. They achieve these, in part, by accelerating cell signaling transduction processes via modulating various types of protein post-translational modifications (PTMs). Notably, accumulating evidence has identified palmitic acid (PA), a major component of high-fat diets, as a significant contributor to various human disorders, including diabetes and cancer. Hence, further understanding the roles of PA and its involvement in protein palmitoylation, a key PTM, is crucial for uncovering the mechanisms underlying these diseases and exploring potential clinical applications in cancer therapy. This review comprehensively summarizes recent advances in the understanding of PA homeostasis and palmitoylation in tumorigenesis. Specifically, it highlights the connections between palmitoylation and key processes such as oncogenic signaling pathways, cell death mechanisms, innate immune responses, and the tumor microenvironment. The review also emphasizes potential therapeutic strategies, including targeting PA homeostasis, palmitoylation-associated processes, or specific palmitoylated proteins for cancer treatment. Finally, the challenges in the field, such as the regulation of PA homeostasis and the dynamic detection or targeting of palmitoylation, are discussed, underscoring the need for further research to address these critical issues.
articles.abstractZh: 膳食食品中的营养素不仅提供能量和组成部分，而且在调节多种病理生理功能中发挥着关键作用。他们在一定程度上通过调节各种类型的蛋白质翻译后修饰（PTM）来加速细胞信号转导过程来实现这些目标。值得注意的是，越来越多的证据表明，高脂肪饮食的主要成分棕榈酸 (PA) 是导致糖尿病和癌症等多种人类疾病的重要因素。因此，进一步了解 PA 的作用及其在蛋白质棕榈酰化（关键 PTM）中的参与对于揭示这些疾病的潜在机制和探索癌症治疗的潜在临床应用至关重要。本综述全面总结了肿瘤发生中 PA 稳态和棕榈酰化的最新进展。具体来说，它强调了棕榈酰化与致癌信号通路、细胞死亡机制、先天免疫反应和肿瘤微环境等关键过程之间的联系。该综述还强调了潜在的治疗策略，包括针对 PA 稳态、棕榈酰化相关药物

articles.title: Cryptosporidium modifies intestinal microvilli through an exported virulence factor.
articles.titleZh: 隐孢子虫通过输出的毒力因子改变肠道微绒毛。
articles.authors: Rodrigues E, Pallett MA, Straker LC, Mkandawire TT, Sala K, Collinson L, Sateriale A.
articles.abstract: Cryptosporidium is a common intestinal infection of vertebrates and a significant threat to public health. Within the epithelial layer of the intestine, the parasite invades and replicates. Infected cells are readily detected under a microscope by the presence of elongated microvilli, particularly around the vacuole where the parasite resides. Here, we identify a family of Cryptosporidium virulence factors that are exported into the host cell during infection and localize to the microvilli. We examine the trafficking and function of the most highly expressed family member, Microvilli protein 1 (MVP1), which appears to control the elongation of microvilli through engagement of host EBP50 and CDC42. Remarkably, this mechanism closely mirrors that of an enteropathogenic Escherichia coli virulence factor, MAP, which is also known to drive host microvilli elongation during infection. This highlights a unique instance where eukaryotic and prokaryotic virulence factors have convergently evolved to modulate host actin structures through a similar mechanism.
articles.abstractZh: 隐孢子虫是脊椎动物常见的肠道感染，对公众健康构成重大威胁。在肠道上皮层内，寄生虫侵入并复制。通过存在细长的微绒毛，特别是在寄生虫所在的液泡周围，可以在显微镜下轻松检测到受感染的细胞。在这里，我们鉴定了一系列隐孢子虫毒力因子，这些因子在感染过程中输出到宿主细胞中并定位于微绒毛。我们检查了表达最高的家族成员微绒毛蛋白 1 (MVP1) 的运输和功能，该蛋白似乎通过宿主 EBP50 和 CDC42 的结合来控制微绒毛的伸长。值得注意的是，这种机制与肠病性大肠杆菌毒力因子 MAP 密切相关，众所周知，MAP 也会在感染过程中驱动宿主微绒毛伸长。这突出了一个独特的例子，即真核和原核毒力因子已经聚合进化，通过类似的机制调节宿主肌动蛋白结构。

articles.title: Harnessing the analog computing power of regulatory networks with the Regulatory Network Machine.
articles.titleZh: 通过监管网络机利用监管网络的模拟计算能力。
articles.authors: Pietak A, Levin M.
articles.abstract: Gene regulatory networks (GRNs) are critically important for efforts in biomedicine and biotechnology. Here, we introduce the Regulatory Network Machine (RNM) framework, demonstrating how GRNs behave as analog computers capable of sophisticated information processing. Our RNM framework encapsulates: (1) a dissipative dynamic system with a focus on GRNs, (2) a set of inputs to the system, (3) system output states with identifiable relevance to biotechnological or biomedical objectives, and (4) Network Finite State Machines (NFSMs), which are maps detailing how the system changes equilibrium state in response to patterns of applied inputs. As an extension to attractor landscape analysis, the NFSMs map the sequential logic inherent in the GRN and, therefore, embody the "software-like" nature of the system, providing easy identification of specific applied interventions necessary to achieve desired, stable biological outcomes. We illustrate the use of our RNM framework in important biological examples, including in cancer renormalization.
articles.abstractZh: 基因调控网络（GRN）对于生物医学和生物技术领域的工作至关重要。在这里，我们介绍监管网络机 (RNM) 框架，演示 GRN 如何充当能够进行复杂信息处理的模拟计算机。我们的 RNM 框架封装了：(1) 一个以 GRN 为重点的耗散动态系统，(2) 系统的一组输入，(3) 与生物技术或生物医学目标具有可识别相关性的系统输出状态，以及 (4) 网络有限状态机 (NFSM)，它们是详细说明系统如何响应应用输入模式而改变平衡状态的映射。作为吸引子景观分析的扩展，NFSM 映射了 GRN 中固有的顺序逻辑，因此体现了系统的“类似软件”性质，可以轻松识别实现所需的稳定生物学结果所需的特定应用干预措施。我们说明了 RNM 框架在重要的生物学示例中的使用，包括在癌症重正常化中。

articles.title: Pangenome analysis reveals structural variation associated with seed size and weight traits in peanut.
articles.titleZh: 全基因组分析揭示了与花生种子大小和重量性状相关的结构变异。
articles.authors: Zhao K, Xue H, Li G, Chitikineni A, Fan Y, Cao Z, Dong X, Lu H, Zhao K, Zhang L, Qiu D, Ren R, Gong F, Li Z, Ma X, Wan S, Varshney RK, Wei C, Yin D.
articles.abstract: Peanut (Arachis hypogaea L.) is an important oilseed and food legume crop, with seed size and weight being critical traits for domestication and breeding. However, genomic rearrangements like structural variations (SVs) underlying seed size and weight remain unclear. Here we present a comprehensive pangenome analysis utilizing eight high-quality genomes (two diploid wild, two tetraploid wild and four tetraploid cultivated peanuts) and resequencing data of 269 accessions with diverse seed sizes. We identified 22,222 core or soft-core, 22,232 distributed and 5,643 private gene families. The frequency of SVs in subgenome A is higher than in subgenome B. We identified 1,335 domestication-related SVs and 190 SVs associated with seed size or weight. Notably, a 275-bp deletion in gene AhARF2-2 results in loss of interaction with AhIAA13 and TOPLESS, reducing the inhibitory effect on AhGRF5 and promoting seed expansion. This high-quality pangenome serves as a fundamental resource for the genetic enhancement of peanuts and other legume crops.
articles.abstractZh: 花生 (Arachishypogaea L.) 是一种重要的油籽和食用豆类作物，种子大小和重量是驯化和育种的关键性状。然而，种子大小和重量背后的结构变异（SV）等基因组重排仍不清楚。在这里，我们利用八个高质量基因组（两个二倍体野生、两个四倍体野生和四个四倍体栽培花生）和 269 个不同种子大小的材料的重测序数据，提出了全面的全基因组分析。我们确定了 22,222 个核心或软核心、22,232 个分布式基因家族和 5,643 个私有基因家族。亚基因组 A 中 SV 的频率高于亚基因组 B 中的频率。我们鉴定了 1,335 个与驯化相关的 SV 和 190 个与种子大小或重量相关的 SV。值得注意的是，AhARF2-2 基因中 275 bp 的缺失导致与 AhIAA13 和 TOPLESS 的相互作用丧失，从而降低了对 AhGRF5 的抑制作用并促进种子扩张。这种高质量的全基因组是花生和其他豆科作物遗传增强的基本资源。

articles.title: STT3A-mediated mega protein complex assembly during dengue and Zika virus infection.
articles.titleZh: 登革热和寨卡病毒感染期间 STT3A 介导的巨蛋白复合物组装。
articles.authors: Liu T, Hanners NW, Tao H, Szabo C, Xu D, Lin W, Schoggins JW, Yan N, Wu J.
articles.abstract: Flavivirus replication in mammalian cells requires host oligosaccharyltransferase (OST) complex, which is classically known to catalyze protein N-glycosylation. However, enzymatic activity of OST is not required for flavivirus infection, leaving the underlying mechanism puzzling. We show the STT3A sub-complex of OST, including STT3A and DC2, to be critically required for dengue virus (DENV) and Zika virus (ZIKV) infection. We find that STT3A nucleates a mega protein complex assembly during DENV infection as a scaffold through its interaction with other OST subunits, translocon proteins, and viral nonstructural proteins. The integrity of this mega protein complex is important for supporting flavivirus infection. We also identified a small-molecule compound NSC-323241 that disrupts STT3A-mediated mega protein complex assembly and potently blocks DENV and ZIKV infection. Together, our study reveals a scaffolding function of STT3A in flavivirus infection through comprehensive molecular dissection of the multi-subunit OST complex and associated host and viral proteins.
articles.abstractZh: 黄病毒在哺乳动物细胞中的复制需要宿主寡糖转移酶 (OST) 复合物，传统上已知该复合物可催化蛋白质 N-糖基化。然而，黄病毒感染不需要 OST 的酶活性，这使得其潜在机制令人费解。我们证明了 OST 的 STT3A 子复合体，包括 STT3A 和 DC2，是登革热病毒 (DENV) 和寨卡病毒 (ZIKV) 感染所必需的。我们发现，STT3A 在 DENV 感染过程中通过与其他 OST 亚基、易位子蛋白和病毒非结构蛋白的相互作用，使巨型蛋白复合物组装成核，作为支架。这种巨型蛋白质复合物的完整性对于支持黄病毒感染非常重要。我们还鉴定了一种小分子化合物 NSC-323241，它可以破坏 STT3A 介导的巨蛋白复合物组装，并有效阻止 DENV 和 ZIKV 感染。总之，我们的研究通过对多亚基 OST 复合物以及相关宿主和病毒蛋白的全面分子解剖，揭示了 STT3A 在黄病毒感染中的支架功能。

articles.title: MAX inactivation deregulates the MYC network and induces neuroendocrine neoplasia in multiple tissues.
articles.titleZh: MAX 失活会解除 MYC 网络的调节，并在多个组织中诱导神经内分泌肿瘤。
articles.authors: Freie B, Ibrahim AH, Carroll PA, Bronson RT, Augert A, MacPherson D, Eisenman RN.
articles.abstract: The MYC transcription factor requires MAX for DNA binding and widespread activation of gene expression in both normal and neoplastic cells. Inactivating mutations in MAX are associated with a subset of neuroendocrine cancers including pheochromocytoma, pituitary adenoma, and small cell lung cancer. Neither the extent nor the mechanisms of MAX tumor suppression are well understood. Deleting Max across multiple mouse neuroendocrine tissues, we find that Max inactivation alone produces pituitary adenomas, while Max inactivation cooperates with Rb1/Trp53 loss to accelerate medullary thyroid C cell and pituitary adenoma development. In the thyroid tumor cell lines, MAX loss triggers a marked shift in genomic occupancy by other members of the MYC network (MNT, MLX, MondoA) supporting metabolism, survival, and proliferation of neoplastic neuroendocrine cells. Our work reveals MAX as a broad suppressor of neuroendocrine tumorigenesis through its ability to maintain a balance of genomic occupancies among the diverse transcription factors in the MYC network.
articles.abstractZh: MYC 转录因子需要 MAX 来结合 DNA 并广泛激活正常细胞和肿瘤细胞中的基因表达。 MAX 失活突变与一部分神经内分泌癌相关，包括嗜铬细胞瘤、垂体腺瘤和小细胞肺癌。 MAX 肿瘤抑制的程度和机制尚不清楚。通过删除多个小鼠神经内分泌组织中的 Max，我们发现 Max 失活单独会产生垂体腺瘤，而 Max 失活与 Rb1/Trp53 损失配合加速甲状腺髓样 C 细胞和垂体腺瘤的发展。在甲状腺肿瘤细胞系中，MAX 缺失会引发 MYC 网络其他成员（MNT、MLX、MondoA）基因组占据的显着变化，支持肿瘤神经内分泌细胞的代谢、存活和增殖。我们的工作揭示了 MAX 通过其维持 MYC 网络中不同转录因子之间基因组占据平衡的能力，成为神经内分泌肿瘤发生的广泛抑制剂。

articles.title: Regulation of translation elongation and integrated stress response in heat-shocked neurons.
articles.titleZh: 热休克神经元翻译伸长和综合应激反应的调节。
articles.authors: Seluzicki CM, Razavi-Mohseni M, Türker F, Patel P, Hua B, Beer MA, Goff L, Margolis SS.
articles.abstract: Neurons deviate from a canonical heat shock response (HSR). Here, we revealed that neuronal adaptation to heat shock accompanies a brake on mRNA translation, slowed elongating ribosomes, phosphorylation of eukaryotic elongation factor-2 (p-eEF2), and suppressed the integrated stress response (ISR). Returning neurons to control temperature within 1 h of starting heat shock was necessary for survival and allowed for restored translation following dephosphorylation of eEF2. Subsequent to recovery, neurons briefly activated the ISR and were sensitive to the ISR inhibitor ISRIB, which enhanced protein synthesis and survival. Ribosome profiling and RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) identified newly synthesized and existing transcripts associated with ribosomes during heat shock. Preservation of these transcripts for translation during recovery was in part mediated by p-eEF2 and slowed ribosomes. Our work supports a neuronal heat shock model of a partially suspended state of translation poised for rapid reversal if recovery becomes an option and provides insight into regulation between the HSR and the ISR.
articles.abstractZh: 神经元偏离典型的热休克反应（HSR）。在这里，我们揭示了神经元对热休克的适应伴随着 mRNA 翻译的抑制、减缓核糖体的延伸、真核延伸因子 2 (p-eEF2) 的磷酸化，并抑制综合应激反应 (ISR)。在开始热休克后 1 小时内使神经元恢复到控制温度对于生存是必要的，并且允许在 eEF2 去磷酸化后恢复翻译。恢复后，神经元短暂激活 ISR，并对 ISR 抑制剂 ISRIB 敏感，从而增强蛋白质合成和存活。核糖体分析和 RNA 测序 (RNA-seq) 鉴定了热休克过程中与核糖体相关的新合成的和现有的转录本。这些转录本在恢复过程中的翻译保存部分是由 p-eEF2 和减慢核糖体介导的。我们的工作支持部分暂停翻译状态的神经元热休克模型，如果恢复成为一种选择，则可以快速逆转，并提供对 HSR 和 ISR 之间调节的深入了解。

articles.title: Conserved sites on the influenza H1 and H3 hemagglutinin recognized by human antibodies.
articles.titleZh: 人类抗体识别的 H1 和 H3 流感血凝素上的保守位点。
articles.authors: Maurer DP, Vu M, Ferreira Ramos AS, Dugan HL, Khalife P, Geoghegan JC, Walker LM, Bajic G, Schmidt AG.
articles.abstract: Monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) targeting the influenza hemagglutinin (HA) can be used as prophylactics or templates for next-generation vaccines. Here, we isolated broad, subtype-neutralizing mAbs from human B cells recognizing the H1 or H3 HA "head" and a mAb engaging the conserved stem. The H1 mAbs bind the lateral patch epitope on HAs from 1933 to 2021 and a prepandemic swine H1N1 virus. We improved neutralization potency using directed evolution toward a contemporary H1 HA. Deep mutational scanning of four antigenically distinct H1N1 viruses identified potential viral escape pathways. For the H3 mAbs, we used cryo-electron microscopy to define their epitopes: One mAb binds the side of the HA head, accommodating the N133 glycan and a pocket underneath the receptor binding site; the other mAb recognizes an HA stem epitope that partially overlaps with previously characterized mAbs but with distinct antibody variable genes. Collectively, these mAbs identify conserved sites recognized by broadly-reactive mAbs that may be elicited by next-generation vaccines.
articles.abstractZh: 针对流感血凝素 (HA) 的单克隆抗体 (mAb) 可用作下一代疫苗的预防剂或模板。在这里，我们从识别 H1 或 H3 HA“头”的人类 B 细胞中分离出广泛的亚型中和 mAb，以及与保守茎结合的 mAb。 H1 mAb 结合 1933 年至 2021 年 HA 和大流行前猪 H1N1 病毒上的侧斑表位。我们使用当代 H1 HA 的定向进化来提高中和效力。对四种抗原性不同的 H1N1 病毒进行深度突变扫描，确定了潜在的病毒逃逸途径。对于 H3 mAb，我们使用冷冻电子显微镜来定义其表位：一种 mAb 结合 HA 头的一侧，容纳 N133 聚糖和受体结合位点下方的口袋；另一种 mAb 识别 HA 茎表位，该表位与之前表征的 mAb 部分重叠，但具有不同的抗体可变基因。总的来说，这些单克隆抗体识别出被广泛反应的单克隆抗体识别的保守位点，这些位点可能由下一代疫苗引发。

articles.title: Genomic and genetic insights into Mendel's pea genes.
articles.titleZh: 对孟德尔豌豆基因的基因组和遗传学见解。
articles.authors: Feng C, Chen B, Hofer J, Shi Y, Jiang M, Song B, Cheng H, Lu L, Wang L, Howard A, Bendahmane A, Fouchal A, Moreau C, Sawada C, LeSignor C, Zhang C, Vikeli E, Tsanakas G, Zhao H, Cheema J, Barclay JE, Hou J, Sayers L, Wingen L, Vigouroux M, Vickers M, Ambrose M, Dalmais M, Higuera-Poveda P, Li P, Yuan Q, Spanner R, Horler R, Wouters R, Chundakkad S, Wu T, Zhao X, Li X, Sun Y, Huang Z, Wu Z, Deng XW, Steuernagel B, Domoney C, Ellis N, Chayut N, Cheng S.
articles.abstract: Mendel1 studied in detail seven pairs of contrasting traits in pea (Pisum sativum), establishing the foundational principles of genetic inheritance. Here we investigate the genetic architecture that underlies these traits and uncover previously undescribed alleles for the four characterized Mendelian genes2-7, including a rare revertant of Mendel's white-flowered a allele. Primarily, we focus on the three remaining uncharacterized traits and find that (1) an approximately 100-kb genomic deletion upstream of the Chlorophyll synthase (ChlG) gene disrupts chlorophyll biosynthesis through the generation of intergenic transcriptional fusion products, conferring the yellow pod phenotype of gp mutants; (2) a MYB gene with an upstream Ogre element insertion and a CLE peptide-encoding gene with an in-frame premature stop codon explain the v and p alleles, which disrupt secondary cell wall thickening and lignification, resulting in the parchmentless, edible-pod phenotype; and (3) a 5-bp exonic deletion in a CIK-like co-receptor kinase gene, in combination with a genetic modifier locus, is associated with the fasciated stem (fa) phenotype. Furthermore, we characterize genes and alleles associated with diverse agronomic traits, such as axil ring anthocyanin pigmentation, seed size and the 'semi-leafless' form. This study establishes a foundation for fundamental research, education in biology and genetics, and pea breeding practices.
articles.abstractZh: 孟德尔详细研究了豌豆（Pisum sativum）的七对对比性状，建立了遗传的基本原理。在这里，我们研究了这些性状背后的遗传结构，并发现了四个孟德尔基因2-7的先前未描述的等位基因，包括孟德尔白花a等位基因的罕见回复体。首先，我们关注剩下的三个未表征的性状，发现（1）叶绿素合酶（ChlG）基因上游约100 kb的基因组缺失通过产生基因间转录融合产物破坏叶绿素生物合成，赋予gp突变体黄色豆荚表型； (2) 具有上游 Ogre 元件插入的 MYB 基因和具有框内提前终止密码子的 CLE 肽编码基因解释了 v 和 p 等位基因，这些等位基因破坏次生细胞壁增厚和木质化，导致无羊皮纸、可食用豆荚表型； (3) CIK 样共受体激酶基因中的 5 bp 外显子缺失与遗传修饰位点相结合，与成束茎 (fa) 表型相关。此外，我们还描述了基因和等位基因相关性

articles.title: LncRNA SLNCR phenocopies the E2F1 DNA binding site to promote melanoma progression.
articles.titleZh: LncRNA SLNCR 表型复制 E2F1 DNA 结合位点以促进黑色素瘤进展。
articles.authors: Shah K, Anastasakou E, Sejour L, Wang Y, Wert-Lamas L, Rauchet C, Studer S, Goller S, Distel RJ, Marasco W, Perera L, Vlachos IS, Novina CD.
articles.abstract: The long non-coding RNA SLNCR and the transcription factor E2F1 are known melanoma oncogenes. We show that SLNCR binds to E2F1 to promote the proliferation, invasion, and migration of melanoma cells from the bloodstream into the lungs. Blocking SLNCR-E2F1 complex formation without reducing the levels of either SLNCR or E2F1 prevents lung extravasation in mice. A 60-nt fragment of SLNCR contains two RNA analogs of the E2F1 DNA binding site (BS) in opposite orientations and can form a hairpin RNA that phenocopies the E2F1 DNA BS. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and biochemical experiments indicate that this fragment of SLNCR binds to the E2F1 DNA-binding domain more effectively than the E2F1 DNA BS. MD simulations predict higher affinity for DNA-E2F1 complex formation but faster kinetics and a greater number of RNA-amino acid contacts for the RNA-E2F1 complex, suggesting that RNA binding to E2F1 is more kinetically favorable.
articles.abstractZh: 长非编码RNA SLNCR和转录因子E2F1是已知的黑色素瘤癌基因。我们发现 SLNCR 与 E2F1 结合可促进黑色素瘤细胞从血流到肺部的增殖、侵袭和迁移。在不降低 SLNCR 或 E2F1 水平的情况下阻断 SLNCR-E2F1 复合物形成可防止小鼠肺外渗。 SLNCR 的 60 nt 片段包含 E2F1 DNA 结合位点 (BS) 的两个方向相反的 RNA 类似物，并且可以形成表型复制 E2F1 DNA BS 的发夹 RNA。分子动力学 (MD) 模拟和生化实验表明，SLNCR 的该片段比 E2F1 DNA BS 更有效地与 E2F1 DNA 结合域结合。 MD模拟预测DNA-E2F1复合物形成的亲和力更高，但RNA-E2F1复合物的动力学更快，并且RNA-氨基酸接触的数量更多，这表明RNA与E2F1的结合在动力学上更有利。

articles.title: Loss of intracellular ATP affects axoplasmic viscosity and pathological protein aggregation in mammalian neurons.
articles.titleZh: 细胞内 ATP 的损失会影响哺乳动物神经元的轴浆粘度和病理性蛋白质聚集。
articles.authors: Guillaud L, Garanzini A, Zakhia S, De la Fuente S, Dimitrov D, Boerner S, Terenzio M.
articles.abstract: Neurodegenerative diseases display synaptic deficits, mitochondrial defects, and protein aggregation. We show that intracellular adenosine triphosphate (ATP) regulates axoplasmic viscosity and protein aggregation in mammalian neurons. Decreased intracellular ATP upon mitochondrial inhibition leads to axoterminal cytosol, synaptic vesicles, and active zone component condensation, modulating the functional organization of mouse glutamatergic synapses. Proteins involved in the pathogenesis of Parkinson's disease (PD), Alzheimer's disease (AD), and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) condensed and underwent ATP-dependent liquid phase separation in vitro. Human inducible pluripotent stem cell-derived neurons from patients with PD and ALS displayed reduced axoplasmic fluidity and decreased intracellular ATP. Last, nicotinamide mononucleotide treatment successfully rescued intracellular ATP levels and axoplasmic viscosity in neurons from patients with PD and ALS and reduced TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) aggregation in human motor neurons derived from a patient with ALS. Thus, our data suggest that the hydrotropic activity of ATP contributes to the regulation of neuronal homeostasis under both physiological and pathological conditions.
articles.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病表现出突触缺陷、线粒体缺陷和蛋白质聚集。我们发现细胞内三磷酸腺苷（ATP）调节哺乳动物神经元的轴浆粘度和蛋白质聚集。线粒体抑制导致细胞内 ATP 减少，导致轴端胞质、突触小泡和活性区成分浓缩，从而调节小鼠谷氨酸能突触的功能组织。参与帕金森病 (PD)、阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 和肌萎缩侧索硬化症 (ALS) 发病机制的蛋白质在体外浓缩并进行 ATP 依赖性液相分离。来自 PD 和 ALS 患者的人诱导多能干细胞衍生的神经元表现出轴浆流动性降低和细胞内 ATP 减少。最后，烟酰胺单核苷酸治疗成功地挽救了 PD 和 ALS 患者神经元的细胞内 ATP 水平和轴浆粘度，并减少了 ALS 患者的人类运动神经元中 TAR DNA 结合蛋白 43 (TDP-43) 的聚集。因此，我们的数据表明 ATP 的亲水活性有助于神经元稳态的调节

articles.title: Pooled tagging and hydrophobic targeting of endogenous proteins for unbiased mapping of unfolded protein responses.
articles.titleZh: 内源蛋白的汇集标签和疏水靶向，用于未折叠蛋白反应的无偏映射。
articles.authors: Sansbury SE, Serebrenik YV, Lapidot T, Smith DG, Burslem GM, Shalem O.
articles.abstract: To achieve system-level insights into proteome organization, regulation, and function, we developed an approach to generate complex cell pools with endogenously tagged proteins amenable to high-throughput visualization and perturbation. Pooled imaging coupled to in situ barcode sequencing identified the subcellular localization of each HaloTag-tagged protein, and subsequent ligand-induced misfolding of the library followed by single-cell RNA sequencing revealed responses to spatially restricted protein misfolding. These datasets characterized protein quality control responses in previously uninterrogated cellular compartments, and cross-compartment analyses revealed mutually exclusive rather than collaborative responses, whereby the heat shock response (HSR) is induced in some compartments and repressed in others where autophagy genes are induced. We further assign protein quality control functions to previously uncharacterized genes based on shared transcriptional responses to protein misfolding across cellular compartments. Altogether, we present an efficient method for large-scale studies of proteome dynamics, function, and homeostasis.
articles.abstractZh: 为了获得对蛋白质组组织、调控和功能的系统级洞察，我们开发了一种方法来生成复杂的细胞池，其中内源标记的蛋白质适合高通量可视化和扰动。合并成像与原位条形码测序相结合，确定了每个 HaloTag 标记蛋白的亚细胞定位，随后配体诱导的文库错误折叠，随后进行单细胞 RNA 测序，揭示了对空间限制蛋白错误折叠的反应。这些数据集表征了先前未经询问的细胞区室中的蛋白质质量控​​制反应，跨区室分析揭示了相互排斥的而不是协作的反应，其中热休克反应（HSR）在一些区室中被诱导，而在其他区室中诱导自噬基因的区域中被抑制。我们根据对跨细胞区室蛋白质错误折叠的共享转录反应，进一步将蛋白质质量控​​制功能分配给以前未表征的基因。总而言之，我们提出了一种用于大规模研究蛋白质组动力学、功能和稳态的有效方法。

articles.title: Starting a synthetic biological intelligence lab from scratch.
articles.titleZh: 从头开始建立一个合成生物智能实验室。
articles.authors: Tanveer MS, Patel D, Schweiger HE, Abu-Bonsrah KD, Watmuff B, Azadi A, Pryshchep S, Narayanan K, Puleo C, Natarajan K, Mostajo-Radji MA, Kagan BJ, Wang G.
articles.abstract: Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have led to the development and deployment of gigantic models trained on billions of samples. While training these models consumes enormous energy, the human brain produces similar outputs with dramatically lower data and energy requirements. This has increased interest in synthetic biological intelligence (SBI), which involves training in vitro neurons for goal-directed tasks. This multidisciplinary field requires knowledge of tissue engineering, biomaterials, signal processing, computer programming, neuroscience, and AI. As a result, starting SBI research is highly nontrivial and time-consuming, as most labs specialize in either the biological aspects or the computational ones. Here, we propose how a computational lab can become familiar with the biological aspects of SBI and also discuss computational aspects for biological labs that are interested in SBI. We describe general strategies as well as step-by-step processes, risks, and precautions to mitigate delays and minimize costs.
articles.abstractZh: 人工智能 (AI) 的最新进展促进了基于数十亿样本训练的巨型模型的开发和部署。虽然训练这些模型会消耗大量能量，但人脑会产生类似的输出，而数据和能量需求却大大降低。这增加了人们对合成生物智能（SBI）的兴趣，它涉及训练体外神经元以执行目标导向的任务。这个多学科领域需要组织工程、生物材料、信号处理、计算机编程、神经科学和人工智能的知识。因此，启动 SBI 研究非常重要且耗时，因为大多数实验室要么专注于生物学方面，要么专注于计算方面。在这里，我们提出计算实验室如何熟悉 SBI 的生物学方面，并讨论对 SBI 感兴趣的生物实验室的计算方面。我们描述了一般策略以及分步流程、风险和预防措施，以减少延误并最大限度地降低成本。

articles.title: Structural dissection of ergosterol metabolism reveals a pathway optimized for membrane phase separation.
articles.titleZh: 麦角甾醇代谢的结构剖析揭示了膜相分离优化的途径。
articles.authors: Juarez-Contreras I, Lopes LJS, Holt J, Yu-Liao L, O'Shea K, Ruiz-Ruiz J, Sodt A, Budin I.
articles.abstract: Sterols are among the most abundant lipids in eukaryotic cells yet are synthesized through notoriously long metabolic pathways. It has been proposed that the molecular evolution of such pathways must have required each step to increase the capacity of its product to condense and order phospholipids. Here, we carry out a systematic analysis of the ergosterol pathway that leverages the yeast vacuole's capacity to phase separate into ordered membrane domains. In the post-synthetic steps specific to ergosterol biosynthesis, we find that successive modifications act to oscillate ordering capacity, settling on a level that supports phase separation while retaining fluidity of the resulting domains. Simulations carried out with each intermediate showed how conformers in the sterol's alkyl tail are capable of modulating long-range ordering of phospholipids, which could underlie changes in phase behavior. Our results indicate that the complexity of sterol metabolism could have resulted from the need to balance lipid interactions required for membrane organization.
articles.abstractZh: 甾醇是真核细胞中最丰富的脂质之一，但却是通过众所周知的长代谢途径合成的。有人提出，此类途径的分子进化必定需要每一步来提高其产物凝结和排序磷脂的能力。在这里，我们对麦角甾醇途径进行了系统分析，该途径利用酵母液泡相分离成有序膜域的能力。在麦角甾醇生物合成特有的合成后步骤中，我们发现连续的修饰会振荡排序能力，稳定在支持相分离的水平，同时保留所得结构域的流动性。对每种中间体进行的模拟表明，甾醇烷基尾部的构象异构体如何能够调节磷脂的长程排序，这可能是相行为变化的基础。我们的结果表明，甾醇代谢的复杂性可能是由于需要平衡膜组织所需的脂质相互作用造成的。

articles.title: The dynamics of microbiome and virome in migratory birds of southwest China.
articles.titleZh: 中国西南地区候鸟微生物组和病毒组动态.
articles.authors: Luo Q, Gao H, Xiang Y, Li J, Dong L, Wang X, Liu F, Guo Y, Shen C, Ding Q, Qin C, Liang G, Wen L.
articles.abstract: Migratory birds carry pathogens, posing a significant threat to environmental and human health. We documented the metatranscriptome and RNA virome of 896 stool samples from migratory birds and environmental samples over four consecutive years in southwest China. Our analysis identified Catellicoccus marimammalium as the predominant bacterium in the gut of black-headed gulls, with an average relative abundance of 79.3%. Strain-level analysis of C. marimammalium revealed a dominant population with some longitudinal diversity over the four years. Additionally, the gut of black-headed gulls was found to harbor numerous viruses, including a novel hepatovirus. Lysates of cells of C. marimammalium but not other bacteria derived from black-headed gulls could inhibit the replication of human hepatovirus, suggesting a potential regulatory role for gut commensal bacteria in modulating viral carriage. These findings enhance our understanding of the microbiome and RNA virome diversity in migratory birds and provide insights into the modulation of asymptomatic infections.
articles.abstractZh: 候鸟携带病原体，对环境和人类健康构成重大威胁。我们连续四年记录了中国西南地区 896 份候鸟粪便样本和环境样本的宏转录组和 RNA 病毒组。我们的分析发现，马氏乳球菌是黑头鸥肠道中的主要细菌，平均相对丰度为 79.3%。对 C. marimammalium 的菌株水平分析揭示了四年来具有一定纵向多样性的优势种群。此外，人们还发现黑头鸥的肠道内含有多种病毒，其中包括一种新型肝病毒。马哺乳动物细胞的裂解物（而非黑头鸥衍生的其他细菌）可以抑制人肝病毒的复制，这表明肠道共生细菌在调节病毒携带方面具有潜在的调节作用。这些发现增强了我们对候鸟微生物组和 RNA 病毒组多样性的理解，并为无症状感染的调节提供了见解。

articles.title: The peptidoglycan of <i>Borrelia burgdorferi</i> can persist in discrete tissues and cause systemic responses consistent with chronic illness.
articles.titleZh: 伯氏疏螺旋体的肽聚糖可以持续存在于离散组织中，并引起与慢性疾病一致的全身反应。
articles.authors: McClune ME, Ebohon O, Dressler JM, Davis MM, Tupik JD, Lochhead RB, Booth CJ, Steere AC, Jutras BL.
articles.abstract: Persistent symptoms after an acute infection is an emerging public health concern, but the pathobiology of such conditions is not well understood. One possible scenario involves the persistence of lingering antigen. We have previously reported that patients with postinfectious Lyme arthritis often harbor the peptidoglycan (PG) cell wall of Borrelia burgdorferi, the Lyme disease agent, in the synovial fluid of their inflamed joints after treatment. However, it is not yet known how B. burgdorferi PG persists, in what form, or if it may play a role in other postinfectious complications after Lyme disease. Using a murine model, we developed a real-time in vivo system to track B. burgdorferi PG as a function of cell wall chemistry and validated our findings using both molecular and cellular approaches. Unlike typical bacterial PG, the unique chemical properties of polymeric B. burgdorferi PG drive murine liver accumulation, where the cell wall material persists for weeks. Kupffer cells and hepatocytes phagocytose and retain B. burgdorferi PG and, although liver occupancy coincides with minimal pathology, both organ-specific and secreted protein profiles produced under these conditions bear some similarities to reported proteins enriched in patients with chronic illness after acute infection. Moreover, transcriptomic profiling indicated that B. burgdorferi PG affects energy metabolism in peripheral blood mononuclear cells. Our findings provide mechanistic insights into how a pathogenic molecule can persist after agent clearance, potentially contributing to illness after infection.
articles.abstractZh: 急性感染后持续出现的症状是一个新出现的公共卫生问题，但这种情况的病理学尚不清楚。一种可能的情况涉及残留抗原的持续存在。我们之前曾报道过，感染后莱姆关节炎患者在治疗后发炎关节的滑液中经常含有伯氏疏螺旋体（莱姆病病原体）的肽聚糖（PG）细胞壁。然而，目前尚不清楚伯氏疏螺旋体 PG 如何持续存在、以什么形式存在，或者它是否可能在莱姆病后的其他感染后并发症中发挥作用。使用小鼠模型，我们开发了一个实时体内系统来跟踪伯氏疏螺旋体 PG 作为细胞壁化学功能的函数，并使用分子和细胞方法验证了我们的发现。与典型的细菌 PG 不同，聚合伯氏疏螺旋体 PG 的独特化学性质可促进小鼠肝脏的积累，使细胞壁物质在其中持续数周。库普弗细胞和肝细胞吞噬并保留伯氏疏螺旋体 PG，尽管肝脏占据与最小的病理学相符，但在这些条件下产生的器官特异性和分泌蛋白谱都

articles.title: Unlocking the synergistic potential of green metallic nanoparticles and antibiotics for antibacterial and wound healing activities.
articles.titleZh: 释放绿色金属纳米颗粒和抗生素在抗菌和伤口愈合活性方面的协同潜力。
articles.authors: Pammi SVN, Alipour AM, Matangi R, Gurugubelli TR, Perumalveeramalai C, Ruddaraju LK.
articles.abstract: The discovery of antibiotics in the 20th century has played a crucial role in contemporary medicine for treating bacterial infections; however, the rise of antimicrobial resistance poses a significant threat to their efficacy, creating a global health crisis. On the other hand, the lack of discovery of new antibiotics for overcoming resistance has stagnated. In this context, metallic nanoparticles (MNPs) prepared with green approaches (P-MNPs) have emerged as viable options for combating multidrug-resistant bacteria and inhibiting biofilm formation. Additionally, when combined with commercial antibiotics, P-MNPs enhance drug delivery, improve circulation, and effectively target bacteria, reducing the required dosage and expanding antibacterial activity while maintaining biocompatibility. In this review, synergistic antibacterial mechanisms of P-MNPs and antibiotics (nAbts), their wound healing and cytotoxicity studies are underscored, which paves a road map for the researchers and medical practitioners to use nAbts in clinical translations.
articles.abstractZh: 20世纪抗生素的发现在当代治疗细菌感染的医学中发挥了至关重要的作用；然而，抗菌素耐药性的上升对其功效构成了重大威胁，造成了全球健康危机。另一方面，用于克服耐药性的新抗生素的发现却停滞不前。在这种背景下，用绿色方法制备的金属纳米颗粒（MNP）（P-MNP）已成为对抗多重耐药细菌和抑制生物膜形成的可行选择。此外，当与商业抗生素结合使用时，P-MNP 可增强药物输送、改善循环并有效靶向细菌，从而减少所需剂量并扩大抗菌活性，同时保持生物相容性。在这篇综述中，重点介绍了 P-MNP 和抗生素 (nAbts) 的协同抗菌机制、其伤口愈合和细胞毒性研究，这为研究人员和医疗从业者在临床转化中使用 nAbts 铺平了路线图。

articles.title: Micronutrients: Minor yet crucial for symbiotic nitrogen fixation.
articles.titleZh: 微量营养素：对于共生固氮来说虽然次要但至关重要。
articles.authors: Gao JP, Chiu CH.
articles.abstract: Nodulation represents a crucial but energy-intensive strategy for legumes to survive in nutrient-poor soils. A recent study by Ren et al. (2025) highlights the significance of micronutrients, particularly iron (Fe), in regulating symbiotic nitrogen fixation, which ensures that nodulation occurs only under favorable environmental conditions.
articles.abstractZh: 结瘤是豆科植物在营养贫乏的土壤中生存的关键但能源密集型策略。 Ren 等人最近的一项研究。 (2025) 强调了微量营养素，特别是铁 (Fe) 在调节共生固氮方面的重要性，这确保了结瘤仅在有利的环境条件下发生。

articles.title: Peptide surfactants with post-translational C-methylations that promote bacterial development.
articles.titleZh: 具有翻译后 C-甲基化作用的肽表面活性剂，可促进细菌发育。
articles.authors: Zhang C, Li Y, Overton EN, Seyedsayamdost MR.
articles.abstract: Bacteria produce a variety of peptides to mediate nutrient acquisition, microbial interactions and other physiological processes. Of special interest are surface-active peptides that aid in growth and development. Herein we report the structure and characterization of clavusporins, unusual and hydrophobic ribosomal peptides with multiple C-methylations at unactivated carbon centers, which help drastically reduce the surface tension of water and thereby aid in Streptomyces development. The peptides are synthesized by a previously uncharacterized protein superfamily, termed DUF5825, in conjunction with a vitamin B12-dependent radical S-adenosylmethionine metalloenzyme. The operon encoding clavusporins is widespread among actinomycete bacteria, suggesting a prevalent role for clavusporins as morphogens in erecting aerial hyphae and thereby advancing sporulation and proliferation.
articles.abstractZh: 细菌产生多种肽来介导营养获取、微生物相互作用和其他生理过程。特别令人感兴趣的是有助于生长和发育的表面活性肽。在此，我们报告了棒孢菌素的结构和表征，棒孢菌素是一种不寻常的疏水性核糖体肽，在未活性碳中心具有多个 C-甲基化，这有助于大大降低水的表面张力，从而有助于链霉菌的发育。这些肽是由以前未表征的蛋白质超家族（称为 DUF5825）与维生素 B12 依赖性自由基 S-腺苷甲硫氨酸金属酶结合合成的。编码棒孢菌素的操纵子在放线菌中广泛存在，这表明棒孢菌素在竖立气生菌丝并从而促进孢子形成和增殖方面作为形态发生素的普遍作用。

articles.title: Protocol to quantitatively assess glycolysis and related carbon metabolic fluxes using stable isotope tracing in Crabtree-positive yeasts.
articles.titleZh: 使用稳定同位素示踪克拉布特里阳性酵母定量评估糖酵解和相关碳代谢通量的方案。
articles.authors: Niphadkar S, Sreedharan S, Vengayil V, Laxman S.
articles.abstract: Crabtree-positive yeasts rapidly consume glucose via glycolysis, making it difficult to experimentally estimate their actual glycolytic rate or flux. We present a stable isotope labeling and liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS)-based protocol to quantitatively estimate glycolytic and related carbon metabolic fluxes using Saccharomyces cerevisiae. This approach defines time windows to capture glucose metabolic intermediate production before label saturation, enabling a comparison of glycolytic flux changes across different cells. This protocol provides a reliable, quantitative approach to study dynamic metabolic fluxes in these cells. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to Vengayil et al., 2024.1.
articles.abstractZh: 克拉布特里阳性酵母通过糖酵解快速消耗葡萄糖，因此很难通过实验估计其实际的糖酵解速率或通量。我们提出了一种基于稳定同位素标记和液相色谱-串联质谱 (LC-MS/MS) 的方案，以使用酿酒酵母定量估计糖酵解和相关的碳代谢通量。这种方法定义了在标签饱和之前捕获葡萄糖代谢中间产物的时间窗口，从而能够比较不同细胞之间的糖酵解通量变化。该协议提供了一种可靠的定量方法来研究这些细胞中的动态代谢通量。有关该协议的使用和执行的完整详细信息，请参阅 Vengayil 等人，2024.1。

articles.title: Re-epithelialization of cancer cells increases autophagy and DNA damage: Implications for breast cancer dormancy and relapse.
articles.titleZh: 癌细胞的上皮再形成增加了自噬和 DNA 损伤：对乳腺癌休眠和复发的影响。
articles.authors: Drago-Garcia D, Giri S, Chatterjee R, Simoni-Nieves A, Abedrabbo M, Genna A, Rios MLU, Lindzen M, Sekar A, Gupta N, Aharoni N, Bhandari T, Mayalagu A, Schwarzmüller L, Tarade N, Zhu R, Mohan-Raju HR, Karatekin F, Roncato F, Eyal-Lubling Y, Keidar T, Nof Y, Belugali Nataraj N, Bernshtein KS, Wagner B, Nair NU, Sanghvi N, Alon R, Seger R, Pikarsky E, Donzelli S, Blandino G, Wiemann S, Lev S, Prywes R, Barkan D, Rueda OM, Caldas C, Ruppin E, Shiloh Y, Dahlhoff M, Yarden Y.
articles.abstract: Cellular plasticity mediates tissue development as well as cancer growth and progression. In breast cancer, a shift to a more epithelial phenotype (epithelialization) underlies a state of reversible cell growth arrest called tumor dormancy, which enables drug resistance, tumor recurrence, and metastasis. Here, we explored the mechanisms driving epithelialization and dormancy in aggressive mesenchymal-like breast cancer cells in three-dimensional cultures. Overexpressing either of the epithelial lineage-associated transcription factors OVOL1 or OVOL2 suppressed cell proliferation and migration and promoted transition to an epithelial morphology. The expression of OVOL1 (and of OVOL2 to a lesser extent) was regulated by steroid hormones and growth factors and was more abundant in tumors than in normal mammary cells. An uncharacterized and indirect target of OVOL1/2, C1ORF116, exhibited genetic and epigenetic aberrations in breast tumors, and its expression correlated with poor prognosis in patients. We further found that C1ORF116 was an autophagy receptor that directed the degradation of antioxidant proteins, including thioredoxin. Through C1ORF116 and unidentified mediators, OVOL1 expression dysregulated both redox homeostasis (in association with increased ROS, decreased glutathione, and redistribution of the transcription factor NRF2) and DNA damage and repair (in association with increased DNA oxidation and double-strand breaks and an altered interplay among the kinases p38-MAPK, ATM, and others). Because these effects, as they accumulate in cells, can promote metastasis and dormancy escape, the findings suggest that OVOLs not only promote dormancy entry and maintenance in breast cancer but also may ultimately drive dormancy exit and tumor recurrence.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞可塑性介导组织发育以及癌症生长和进展。在乳腺癌中，向更多上皮表型（上皮化）的转变是一种可逆的细胞生长停滞状态（称为肿瘤休眠）的基础，这种状态导致耐药性、肿瘤复发和转移。在这里，我们探索了三维培养物中侵袭性间充质样乳腺癌细胞驱动上皮化和休眠的机制。过度表达上皮谱系相关转录因子 OVOL1 或 OVOL2 会抑制细胞增殖和迁移，并促进向上皮形态的转变。 OVOL1（以及较小程度的 OVOL2）的表达受到类固醇激素和生长因子的调节，并且在肿瘤中比在正常乳腺细胞中更丰富。 OVOL1/2 的一个未表征的间接靶标 C1ORF116 在乳腺肿瘤中表现出遗传和表观遗传畸变，其表达与患者不良预后相关。我们进一步发现 C1ORF116 是一种自噬受体，可引导抗氧化蛋白（包括硫氧还蛋白）的降解。通过 C1ORF116 和身份不明的介体，OVOL1 e

articles.title: The retrotransposon-derived capsid genes PNMA1 and PNMA4 maintain reproductive capacity.
articles.titleZh: 逆转录转座子衍生的衣壳基因 PNMA1 和 PNMA4 维持生殖能力。
articles.authors: Wood TWP, Henriques WS, Cullen HB, Romero M, Blengini CS, Sarathy S, Sorkin J, Bekele H, Jin C, Kim S, Wang X, Laureau R, Chemiakine A, Khondker RC, Isola JVV, Stout MB, Gennarino VA, Mogessie B, Jain D, Schindler K, Suh Y, Wiedenheft B, Berchowitz LE.
articles.abstract: Almost half of the human genome consists of retrotransposons-'parasitic' sequences that insert themselves into the host genome via an RNA intermediate. Although most of these sequences are silenced or mutationally deactivated, they can present opportunities for evolutionary innovation: mutation of a deteriorating retrotransposon can result in a gene that provides a selective advantage to the host in a process termed 'domestication'1-3. The PNMA family of gag-like capsid genes was domesticated from an ancient vertebrate retrotransposon of the Metaviridae clade at least 100 million years ago4,5. PNMA1 and PNMA4 are positively regulated by the master germ cell transcription factors MYBL1 and STRA8, and their transcripts are bound by the translational regulator DAZL during gametogenesis6. This developmental regulation of PNMA1 and PNMA4 expression in gonadal tissue suggested to us that they might serve a reproductive function. Through the analysis of donated human ovaries, genome-wide association studies (GWASs) and mouse models, we found that PNMA1 and PNMA4 are necessary for the maintenance of a normal reproductive lifespan. These proteins self-assemble into capsid-like structures that exit human cells, and we observed large PNMA4 particles in mouse male gonadal tissue that contain RNA and are consistent with capsid formation.
articles.abstractZh: 几乎一半的人类基因组由反转录转座子组成——“寄生”序列，它们通过 RNA 中间体将自身插入宿主基因组中。尽管这些序列中的大多数被沉默或突变失活，但它们可以提供进化创新的机会：恶化的逆转录转座子的突变可以产生一种基因，该基因在称为“驯化”的过程中为宿主提供选择优势1-3。 PNMA 类 gag 衣壳基因家族是至少 1 亿年前从 Metaviridae 进化枝的古代脊椎动物逆转录转座子中驯化的 4,5。 PNMA1 和 PNMA4 受到主生殖细胞转录因子 MYBL1 和 STRA8 的正向调节，并且它们的转录物在配子发生过程中受到翻译调节因子 DAZL 的结合。性腺组织中 PNMA1 和 PNMA4 表达的发育调节向我们表明它们可能具有生殖功能。通过对捐赠的人类卵巢、全基因组关联研究（GWAS）和小鼠模型的分析，我们发现PNMA1和PNMA4对于维持正常的生殖寿命是必需的。这些蛋白质自组装成衣壳样结构

articles.title: An expanded metabolic pathway for androgen production by commensal bacteria.
articles.titleZh: 共生细菌产生雄激素的扩展代谢途径。
articles.authors: Wang T, Ahmad S, Cruz-Lebrón A, Ernst SE, Olivos Caicedo KY, Jeong Y, Binion B, Mbuvi P, Dutta D, Fernandez-Materan FV, Breister AM, Tang E, Lee JW, Kang JD, Harris SC, Ikegawa S, Gaskins HR, Erdman JW, Yang G, Cann I, Daniel SL, Hylemon PB, Anantharaman K, Bernardi RC, Alves JMP, Sfanos KS, Irudayaraj J, Ridlon JM.
articles.abstract: Commensal bacteria have been implicated in the modulation of steroid hormones, including circulating androgen levels in the host. However, the microbial genetic pathways involved in androgen production have not been fully characterized. Here we identify a microbial gene encoding an enzyme that catalyses the conversion of androstenedione to epitestosterone in the gut microbiome member Clostridium scindens and named this gene desF. We demonstrate that epitestosterone impacts androgen receptor-dependent prostate cancer cell proliferation in vitro. We also demonstrate that stool desF levels are elevated in patients with prostate cancer who are unresponsive to abiraterone/prednisone therapy. Bacterial isolates from urine or prostatectomy tissue produced androgens, and 17β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase activity encoded by the desG gene was detected in strains of the urinary tract bacterium Propionimicrobium lymphophilum. Furthermore, we demonstrate that urinary androgen-producing bacterial strains can promote prostate cancer cell growth through metabolism of cortisol and prednisone. Abiraterone, which targets host desmolase (CYP17A1), a rate-limiting enzyme in adrenal steroidogenesis, does not inhibit bacterial desmolase (DesAB), whereas the conversion of prednisone to androgens by DesAB, DesF and DesG drives androgen-receptor-dependent prostate cancer cell line proliferation in vitro. Our results are a significant advance in steroid microbiology and highlight a potentially important role for gut and urinary tract bacteria in host endocrine function and drug metabolism.
articles.abstractZh: 共生细菌与类固醇激素的调节有关，包括宿主体内循环雄激素水平。然而，参与雄激素产生的微生物遗传途径尚未得到充分表征。在这里，我们鉴定了一种微生物基因，该基因编码一种酶，该酶可催化肠道微生物组成员梭状芽孢杆菌中雄烯二酮转化为表睾酮，并将该基因命名为 desF。我们证明表睾酮在体外影响雄激素受体依赖性前列腺癌细胞的增殖。我们还证明，对阿比特龙/泼尼松治疗无反应的前列腺癌患者粪便 desF 水平升高。从尿液或前列腺切除组织中分离的细菌产生雄激素，并且在尿路细菌嗜淋巴丙酸微生物菌株中检测到由 desG 基因编码的 17β-羟基类固醇脱氢酶活性。此外，我们证明尿中产生雄激素的细菌菌株可以通过皮质醇和泼尼松的代谢促进前列腺癌细胞的生长。阿比特龙，靶向宿主去氨酶 (CYP17A1)，这是肾上腺类固醇生成的限速酶，美国能源部

articles.title: Mitochondrial NADPH fuels mitochondrial fatty acid synthesis and lipoylation to power oxidative metabolism.
articles.titleZh: 线粒体 NADPH 促进线粒体脂肪酸合成和脂酰化，从而促进氧化代谢。
articles.authors: Kim D, Kesavan R, Ryu K, Dey T, Marckx A, Menezes C, Praharaj PP, Morley S, Ko B, Soflaee MH, Tom HJ, Brown H, Vu HS, Tso SC, Brautigam CA, Lemoff A, Mettlen M, Mishra P, Cai F, Allen DK, Hoxhaj G.
articles.abstract: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate (NADPH) is a vital electron donor essential for macromolecular biosynthesis and protection against oxidative stress. Although NADPH is compartmentalized within the cytosol and mitochondria, the specific functions of mitochondrial NADPH remain largely unexplored. Here we demonstrate that NAD+ kinase 2 (NADK2), the principal enzyme responsible for mitochondrial NADPH production, is critical for maintaining protein lipoylation, a conserved lipid modification necessary for the optimal activity of multiple mitochondrial enzyme complexes, including the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex. The mitochondrial fatty acid synthesis (mtFAS) pathway utilizes NADPH for generating protein-bound acyl groups, including lipoic acid. By developing a mass-spectrometry-based method to assess mammalian mtFAS, we reveal that NADK2 is crucial for mtFAS activity. NADK2 deficiency impairs mtFAS-associated processes, leading to reduced cellular respiration and mitochondrial translation. Our findings support a model in which mitochondrial NADPH fuels the mtFAS pathway, thereby sustaining protein lipoylation and mitochondrial oxidative metabolism.
articles.abstractZh: 烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸磷酸 (NADPH) 是大分子生物合成和防止氧化应激所必需的重要电子供体。尽管 NADPH 被划分在细胞质和线粒体内，但线粒体 NADPH 的具体功能在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这里，我们证明 NAD+ 激酶 2 (NADK2) 是负责线粒体 NADPH 产生的主要酶，对于维持蛋白质脂酰化至关重要，脂酰化是一种保守的脂质修饰，对于多种线粒体酶复合物（包括丙酮酸脱氢酶复合物）的最佳活性至关重要。线粒体脂肪酸合成 (mtFAS) 途径利用 NADPH 生成蛋白质结合的酰基，包括硫辛酸。通过开发一种基于质谱的方法来评估哺乳动物 mtFAS，我们发现 NADK2 对于 mtFAS 活性至关重要。 NADK2 缺乏会损害 mtFAS 相关过程，导致细胞呼吸和线粒体翻译减少。我们的研究结果支持线粒体 NADPH 为 mtFAS 途径提供燃料，从而维持蛋白质脂酰化和线粒体氧化代谢的模型。

articles.title: Consecutive low-frequency shifts in A/T content denote nucleosome positions across microeukaryotes.
articles.titleZh: A/T 含量的连续低频变化表示微真核生物中核小体的位置。
articles.authors: Mondo SJ, He G, Sharma A, Ciobanu D, Riley R, Andreopoulos WB, Lipzen A, Kuo A, LaButti K, Pangilinan J, Salamov A, Salamon H, Shu L, Gladden J, Magnuson J, Aime MC, O'Malley R, Grigoriev IV.
articles.abstract: Nucleosomes are the basic repeating unit, each spanning ≈150bp, that structures DNA in the nucleus and their positions have major consequences on gene activity. Here, through analyzing DNA signatures across 1117 microeukaryote genomes, we discovered ≈150bp shifts in A/T content associated with nucleosome organization. Often consecutively arrayed across the genome, A/T peaks were enriched surrounding transcriptional start sites in specific clades. Most nucleosomes (both in vitro and in vivo) across eukaryotes aligned with A/T peaks, even in the presence of DNA modifications. Using artificial intelligence-based approaches, we describe DNA features associated with nucleosomes and construct a deep learning (DL) model for improved nucleosome occupancy prediction. Using this model, we found that ≈70% of "random" transfer DNA inserts from an in vivo fungal RB-TDNAseq library avoided DL predicted nucleosome-bound regions. This study reveals a eukaryote-wide strategy for generating cassettes of nucleosome-favorable DNAs that has a profound impact on nucleosome organization.
articles.abstractZh: 核小体是基本的重复单元，每个跨越约 150bp，在细胞核中构建 DNA，它们的位置对基因活性有重大影响。在这里，通过分析 1117 个微真核生物基因组的 DNA 特征，我们发现与核小体组织相关的 A/T 内容有约 150bp 的变化。 A/T 峰通常在基因组中连续排列，在特定进化枝的转录起始位点周围富集。即使存在 DNA 修饰，真核生物中的大多数核小体（体外和体内）也与 A/T 峰对齐。使用基于人工智能的方法，我们描述了与核小体相关的 DNA 特征，并构建了深度学习 (DL) 模型以改进核小体占用预测。使用该模型，我们发现来自体内真菌 RB-TDNAseq 文库的约 70% 的“随机”转移 DNA 插入片段避开了 DL 预测的核小体结合区域。这项研究揭示了一种真核生物范围内的策略，用于生成对核小体有利的 DNA 盒，这对核小体组织具有深远的影响。

articles.title: Engineering bacteriophages through deep mining of metagenomic motifs.
articles.titleZh: 通过深入挖掘宏基因组图案来工程噬菌体。
articles.authors: Huss P, Kieft K, Meger A, Nishikawa K, Anantharaman K, Raman S.
articles.abstract: Bacteriophages can adapt to new hosts by altering sequence motifs through recombination or convergent evolution. Where these motifs exist and what fitness advantage they confer remains largely unknown. We report a new method, Metagenomic Sequence Informed Functional Scoring (Meta-SIFT), to find sequence motifs in metagenomic datasets to engineer phage activity. Meta-SIFT uses experimental deep mutational scanning data to create sequence profiles to mine metagenomes for functional motifs invisible to other searches. We experimentally tested ~17,000 Meta-SIFT-derived sequence motifs in the receptor binding protein of the T7 phage. The screen revealed thousands of T7 variants with novel host specificity with motifs sourced from distant families. Position, substitution, and location preferences dictated specificity across a panel of 20 hosts and conditions. To demonstrate therapeutic utility, we engineered active T7 variants against foodborne pathogen Escherichia coli O121. Meta-SIFT is a powerful tool to unlock the potential encoded in phage metagenomes to engineer bacteriophages.
articles.abstractZh: 噬菌体可以通过重组或趋同进化改变序列基序来适应新的宿主。这些图案存在于何处以及它们赋予什么健身优势仍然很大程度上未知。我们报告了一种新方法，宏基因组序列知情功能评分（Meta-SIFT），用于在宏基因组数据集中查找序列基序来设计噬菌体活性。 Meta-SIFT 使用实验性深度突变扫描数据来创建序列图谱，以挖掘宏基因组中其他搜索不可见的功能基序。我们通过实验测试了 T7 噬菌体受体结合蛋白中大约 17,000 个 Meta-SIFT 衍生的序列基序。屏幕显示了数千个具有新颖宿主特异性的 T7 变体，其图案来自遥远的家庭。位置、替补和位置偏好决定了 20 个宿主和条件小组的特异性。为了证明治疗效用，我们设计了针对食源性病原体大肠杆菌 O121 的活性 T7 变体。 Meta-SIFT 是一个强大的工具，可以释放噬菌体宏基因组中编码的潜力，从而设计噬菌体。

articles.title: Metabolic rewiring caused by mitochondrial dysfunction promotes mTORC1-dependent skeletal aging.
articles.titleZh: 线粒体功能障碍引起的代谢重新布线会促进 mTORC1 依赖性骨骼衰老。
articles.authors: Bubb K, Etich J, Probst K, Parashar T, Schuetter M, Dethloff F, Reincke S, Nolte JL, Krüger M, Schlötzer-Schrehard U, Nüchel J, Demetriades C, Giavalisco P, Riemer J, Brachvogel B.
articles.abstract: Decline of mitochondrial respiratory chain (mtRC) capacity is a hallmark of mitochondrial diseases. Patients with mtRC dysfunction often present reduced skeletal growth as a sign of premature cartilage degeneration and aging, but how metabolic adaptations contribute to this phenotype is poorly understood. Here we show that, in mice with impaired mtRC in cartilage, reductive/reverse TCA cycle segments are activated to produce metabolite-derived amino acids and stimulate biosynthesis processes by mechanistic target of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1) activation during a period of massive skeletal growth and biomass production. However, chronic hyperactivation of mTORC1 suppresses autophagy-mediated organelle recycling and disturbs extracellular matrix secretion to trigger chondrocytes death, which is ameliorated by targeting the reductive metabolism. These findings explain how a primarily beneficial metabolic adaptation response required to counterbalance the loss of mtRC function, eventually translates into profound cell death and cartilage tissue degeneration. The knowledge of these dysregulated key nutrient signaling pathways can be used to target skeletal aging in mitochondrial disease.
articles.abstractZh: 线粒体呼吸链（mtRC）能力下降是线粒体疾病的标志。 mtRC 功能障碍的患者通常会出现骨骼生长减慢，这是软骨过早退化和衰老的迹象，但代谢适应如何导致这种表型却知之甚少。在这里，我们发现，在软骨中 mtRC 受损的小鼠中，还原/反向 TCA 循环片段被激活，产生代谢物衍生的氨基酸，并在大量骨骼生长和生物量产生期间通过雷帕霉素复合物 1 (mTORC1) 激活的机械目标刺激生物合成过程。然而，mTORC1 的慢性过度激活会抑制自噬介导的细胞器回收，并干扰细胞外基质分泌，从而引发软骨细胞死亡，而通过靶向还原代谢可以改善这种情况。这些发现解释了平衡 mtRC 功能丧失所需的主要有益的代谢适应反应如何最终转化为严重的细胞死亡和软骨组织退化。这些失调的关键营养信号通路的知识可用于针对线粒体疾病中的骨骼衰老

articles.title: Spatial analysis of mitochondrial gene expression reveals dynamic translation hubs and remodeling in stress.
articles.titleZh: 线粒体基因表达的空间分析揭示了应激中的动态翻译中心和重塑。
articles.authors: Begeman A, Smolka JA, Shami A, Waingankar TP, Lewis SC.
articles.abstract: Protein- and RNA-rich bodies contribute to the spatial organization of gene expression in the cell and are also sites of quality control critical to cell fitness. In most eukaryotes, mitochondria harbor their own genome, and all steps of mitochondrial gene expression co-occur within a single compartment-the matrix. Here, we report that processed mitochondrial RNAs are consolidated into micrometer-scale translation hubs distal to mitochondrial DNA transcription and RNA processing sites in human cells. We find that, during stress, mitochondrial messenger and ribosomal RNA are sequestered in mesoscale bodies containing mitoribosome components, concurrent with suppression of active translation. Stress bodies are triggered by proteotoxic stress downstream of double-stranded RNA accumulation in cells lacking unwinding activity of the highly conserved helicase SUPV3L1/SUV3. We propose that the spatial organization of nascent polypeptide synthesis into discrete domains serves to throttle the flow of genetic information to support recovery of mitochondrial quality control.
articles.abstractZh: 富含蛋白质和 RNA 的小体有助于细胞内基因表达的空间组织，也是对细胞健康至关重要的质量控制位点。在大多数真核生物中，线粒体拥有自己的基因组，并且线粒体基因表达的所有步骤同时发生在单个区室（基质）内。在这里，我们报告说，加工后的线粒体 RNA 被整合到人类细胞中线粒体 DNA 转录和 RNA 加工位点远端的微米级翻译中心中。我们发现，在应激过程中，线粒体信使和核糖体 RNA 被隔离在含有线粒体成分的中尺度体中，同时抑制主动翻译。应激体是由缺乏高度保守的解旋酶 SUPV3L1/SUV3 解旋活性的细胞中双链 RNA 积累下游的蛋白毒性应激触发的。我们提出，将新生多肽合成的空间组织形成离散域可以抑制遗传信息的流动，以支持线粒体质量控制的恢复。

articles.title: Chromosome-segment scanning for gain- or loss-of-function screening (CHASING).
articles.titleZh: 用于功能获得或丧失筛查的染色体片段扫描 (CHASING)。
articles.authors: Xia Y, Sun L, Liang Z, Han Z, Li J, Dong P, Huo YX, Guo S.
articles.abstract: Identifying beneficial or functional mutations for a specific species is a task always relies on the labor-intensive construction of a library containing thousands of single-gene knockout or interference strains. Here, we systematically demonstrated that the task could be done by constructing a genome-scale library, designed by AutoGSL, containing a limited number of large fragment deletion strains. The loss-of- and gain-of-function phenotypes could be efficiently screened out by our chromosome-segment scanning, and the specific gene corresponding to an observed phenotype could be quickly identified and visualized by our computer-aided gene-annotation web tool. Additionally, a Clusters of Orthologous Gene Transformer learned representations were transferred to predict growth phenotypes of the genome-scale library under varying conditions. We further utilized our chromosome segment scanning for gain- or loss-of-function screening (CHASING) strategy to obtain acetoin- and lycopene-overproducing hosts. Our work highlighted the significance of CHASING in functional genomics investigation, robust chassis engineering, and chemical overproduction.
articles.abstractZh: 识别特定物种的有益或功能突变是一项始终依赖于劳动密集型构建包含数千个单基因敲除或干扰菌株的文库的任务。在这里，我们系统地证明了可以通过构建由 AutoGSL 设计的基因组规模文库来完成该任务，该文库包含有限数量的大片段缺失菌株。我们的染色体片段扫描可以有效筛选出功能丧失和功能获得的表型，并且可以通过我们的计算机辅助基因注释网络工具快速识别和可视化与观察到的表型相对应的特定基因。此外，直系同源基因转化器学习的表征被转移以预测不同条件下基因组规模文库的生长表型。我们进一步利用染色体片段扫描进行功能获得或丧失筛选（CHASING）策略来获得乙偶姻和番茄红素过量生产的宿主。我们的工作强调了 CHASING 在功能基因组学研究、强大的底盘工程和化学过量生产中的重要性。

articles.title: Histone acetyltransferase HAF2 associates with pyruvate dehydrogenase complex to control H3K14ac and H3K23ac in ethylene response.
articles.titleZh: 组蛋白乙酰转移酶 HAF2 与丙酮酸脱氢酶复合物结合，控制乙烯反应中的 H3K14ac 和 H3K23ac。
articles.authors: Chen CY, Shao Z, Wang G, Zhao B, Hardtke HA, Leong J, Zhou T, Zhang YJ, Qiao H.
articles.abstract: Ethylene plays essential roles in plant development, growth, and defense responses by controlling transcriptional reprogramming, in which ETHYLENE INSENSITIVE 2-C-terminal end (EIN2-C)-directed regulation of histone acetylation is the first key step for chromatin to perceive ethylene signaling. However, the histone acetyltransferase (HAT) in this process remains unknown. Here, we identify HAF2 as the missing HAT, as HAF2 mutations confer ethylene hyposensitivity. HAF2 interacts with EIN2-C in response to ethylene, and its bromodomain preferentially binds H3K14ac, while its HAT domain acetylates H3K14 and H3K23, favoring H3K14. Chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing confirms HAF2's role in regulating H3K14ac and H3K23ac. Additionally, HAF2 cooperates with the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex (PDC) to modulate histone acetylation in an EIN2-dependent manner. Our findings establish HAF2 as the key HAT that, together with EIN2-C and PDC, orchestrates H3K14ac and H3K23ac deposition, preferentially targeting H3K14, in response to ethylene.
articles.abstractZh: 乙烯通过控制转录重编程在植物发育、生长和防御反应中发挥重要作用，其中乙烯不敏感 2-C 末端 (EIN2-C) 定向调控组蛋白乙酰化是染色质感知乙烯信号传导的第一个关键步骤。然而，这个过程中的组蛋白乙酰转移酶（HAT）仍然未知。在这里，我们将 HAF2 确定为缺失的 HAT，因为 HAF2 突变会导致乙烯敏感性降低。 HAF2 响应乙烯而与 EIN2-C 相互作用，其溴结构域优先结合 H3K14ac，而其 HAT 结构域乙酰化 H3K14 和 H3K23，有利于 H3K14。染色质免疫沉淀测序证实了 HAF2 在调节 H3K14ac 和 H3K23ac 中的作用。此外，HAF2 与丙酮酸脱氢酶复合物 (PDC) 合作，以 EIN2 依赖性方式调节组蛋白乙酰化。我们的研究结果表明，HAF2 是关键的 HAT，它与 EIN2-C 和 PDC 一起协调 H3K14ac 和 H3K23ac 沉积，优先针对 H3K14，响应乙烯。

articles.title: Induced proximity to PML protects TDP-43 from aggregation via SUMO-ubiquitin networks.
articles.titleZh: 诱导接近 PML 可保护 TDP-43 免于通过 SUMO 泛素网络聚集。
