articles.title: Camel milk and D-allulose synergistically improved camel dairy flavor and alleviated insulin resistance of human HepG2 cells.
articles.titleZh: 骆驼奶和D-阿洛酮糖协同改善骆驼乳风味并减轻人HepG2细胞的胰岛素抵抗。
articles.authors: Aili T, Xu Z, Liu C, Yang J, Yue H.
articles.abstract: Camel milk is a dairy product widely consumed in desert and semi-arid areas, with high nutritional value and potential for auxiliary medical treatment. It has unique efficacy and a gamey taste, and exploring its functional factors and making camel milk more easily accepted by the public has become a research hotspot. This study mainly investigated the protein components in camel milk that may play a role in alleviating insulin resistance by observing the cell activity, glucose consumption, and morphological changes of the treatment group. Further research was conducted on the potential synergistic hypoglycemic effect of camel milk and D-allulose, and a formula was ultimately determined to enhance the flavor of camel milk through a series of sensory evaluation experiments. The optimal concentration for the treatment of insulin resistance (IR) was identified as 4 mg/mL of CWP4 combined with 1 mg/mL of D-allulose for a period of 12 h. The addition of D-allulose at a ratio of 1:36 in camel milk has been observed reduce the odoriferous properties of the camel milk, while simultaneously retaining the majority of other desirable flavors. This research helps to concentrate the functional protein factors in camel milk, promote the intensive processing of camel milk, and develop new camel milk health products. These products may help patients with diabetes stabilize their blood sugar levels in daily life, thus enriching their diet, and may expand the market of camel milk.
articles.abstractZh: 骆驼奶是沙漠和半干旱地区广泛消费的乳制品，营养价值高，具有辅助医疗的潜力。其功效独特，口味浓郁，探索其功能因素，使骆驼奶更容易被大众接受已成为研究热点。本研究主要通过观察治疗组的细胞活性、葡萄糖消耗和形态变化来研究骆驼奶中可能发挥缓解胰岛素抵抗作用的蛋白质成分。对骆驼奶与D-阿洛酮糖潜在的协同降糖作用进行了进一步研究，并通过一系列感官评价实验，最终确定了增强骆驼奶风味的配方。治疗胰岛素抵抗（IR）的最佳浓度被确定为 4 mg/mL 的 CWP4 与 1 mg/mL 的 D-阿洛酮糖组合，持续 12 小时。据观察，在骆驼奶中以 1:36 的比例添加 D-阿洛酮糖可降低骆驼奶的气味特性，同时保留大部分其他所需风味。这项研究有助于集中功能p

articles.title: Comparative potential of biogas production from the distillery, fruit and vegetable waste and their mixtures (digestion).
articles.titleZh: 从酿酒厂、水果和蔬菜废物及其混合物（消化）生产沼气的比较潜力。
articles.authors: Gebresilasie GG, Gebreslassie MG, Gebresemati M.
articles.abstract: Biogas is becoming increasingly important as a renewable energy source in the face of global warming and declining fossil fuel reserves. Biogas is produced by anaerobic digestion of organic materials which can be available from various wastes such as agro-industrial, human, fruit waste, distillery, animal waste and aquatic plants. This study deals particularly with the comparative potential of biogas production from distillery, fruit and vegetable waste and their mixtures (digestion). The materials used as feed in this research were distillery waste which is dark-colored liquid waste from Desta Alcohol and Liquor Factory Private Limited Company. Fruit and vegetable waste such as banana peels, papaya, mango, tomato, avocado, cabbage leaves, watermelon skin, and orange skin were collected from juice houses and fruit and vegetable wholesale markets in Mekelle City, and Cow manure used as a buffer solution, collected from Desta Alcohol and Liquor Factory PLC. Waste samples were characterized for total solids, volatile solids, pH, biochemical oxygen demand, and chemical oxygen demand according to established standards. Biogas was analyzed using a biogas analyzer, an ORSAT apparatus for CO2, and a TUTWILER apparatus for H2S. Finally, the %CH4 was calculated from 100 % by ignoring other gases. The maximum biogas production from all wastes was observed at 37 °C. Mixture (co-digestion) produced high biogas in litter (L): 6.95, 9.47 and 9.54 at 20 °C, 37 °C and 50 °C respectively. The maximum methane composition was observed from the co-digestion (M) in (%) 67, 70 and 70.3 at 20 °C, 37 °C and 50 °C respectively. Methane yield was calculated at both temperature and substrates (waste). Comparatively, maximum methane yield was observed at 37 °C for distillery waste, fruit vegetable waste and mixture(digestion); 0.032, 0.061 and 0.079 L per gram volatile solids digestion (LCH4/gVS) respectively.
articles.abstractZh: 面对全球变暖和化石燃料储量下降，沼气作为可再生能源变得越来越重要。沼气是通过有机材料的厌氧消化产生的，这些有机材料可以从各种废物中获得，例如农工业、人类、水果废物、酿酒厂、动物废物和水生植物。这项研究特别涉及从酿酒厂、水果和蔬菜废物及其混合物（消化）生产沼气的比较潜力。本研究中用作饲料的材料是酿酒厂废物，是来自德斯塔酒精和酒厂私人有限公司的深色液体废物。香蕉皮、木瓜、芒果、番茄、鳄梨、卷心菜叶、西瓜皮和橙子皮等果蔬废物收集自默克莱市的果汁店和果蔬批发市场，用作缓冲溶液的牛粪则收集自德斯塔酒精和酒厂PLC。根据既定标准，对废物样品的总固体含量、挥发性固体含量、pH 值、生化需氧量和化学需氧量进行表征。使用沼气分析仪（ORSAT 装置）对沼气进行分析

articles.title: Electrochemical CO<sub>2</sub> reduction to liquid fuels: Mechanistic pathways and surface/interface engineering of catalysts and electrolytes.
articles.titleZh: 电化学 CO<sub>2</sub> 还原为液体燃料：催化剂和电解质的机械途径和表面/界面工程。
articles.authors: Li X, Kang W, Fan X, Tan X, Masa J, Robertson AW, Jung Y, Han B, Texter J, Cheng Y, Dai B, Sun Z.
articles.abstract: The high energy density of green synthetic liquid chemicals and fuels makes them ideal for sustainable energy storage and transportation applications. Electroreduction of carbon dioxide (CO2) directly into such high value-added chemicals can help us achieve a renewable C cycle. Such electrochemical reduction typically suffers from low faradaic efficiencies (FEs) and generates a mixture of products due to the complexity of controlling the reaction selectivity. This perspective summarizes recent advances in the mechanistic understanding of CO2 reduction reaction pathways toward liquid products and the state-of-the-art catalytic materials for conversion of CO2 to liquid C1 (e.g., formic acid, methanol) and C2+ products (e.g., acetic acid, ethanol, n-propanol). Many liquid fuels are being produced with FEs between 80% and 100%. We discuss the use of structure-binding energy relationships, computational screening, and machine learning to identify promising candidates for experimental validation. Finally, we classify strategies for controlling catalyst selectivity and summarize breakthroughs, prospects, and challenges in electrocatalytic CO2 reduction to guide future developments.
articles.abstractZh: 绿色合成液体化学品和燃料的高能量密度使其成为可持续能源储存和运输应用的理想选择。将二氧化碳（CO2）直接电还原成此类高附加值化学品可以帮助我们实现可再生的碳循环。由于控制反应选择性的复杂性，这种电化学还原通常法拉第效率（FE）较低，并且会产生产物混合物。该观点总结了 CO2 还原反应生成液体产物的机理以及将 CO2 转化为液体 C1（例如甲酸、甲醇）和 C2+ 产物（例如乙酸、乙醇、正丙醇）的最先进催化材料的最新进展。许多液体燃料的 FE 含量在 80% 到 100% 之间。我们讨论了使用结构结合能量关系、计算筛选和机器学习来识别有希望的候选者进行实验验证。最后，我们对控制催化剂选择性的策略进行了分类，并总结了电催化二氧化碳还原的突破、前景和挑战，以指导未来的发展。

articles.title: Emerging paradigms for target discovery of traditional medicines: A genome-wide pan-GPCR perspective.
articles.titleZh: 传统药物靶标发现的新兴范例：全基因组泛 GPCR 视角。
articles.authors: Bi Z, Li H, Liang Y, Sun D, Liu S, Chen W, Leng L, Song C, Zhang S, Cong Z, Chen S.
articles.abstract: Traditional medicines serve not only as an integral part of medical treatments prescribed by healthcare providers but also as a fundamental reservoir for novel molecular scaffolds. However, gaps remain in our understanding of the mechanisms underlying their activity. A superfamily of membrane proteins, G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs), have been demonstrated to be potential targets for several compounds isolated from traditional medicines. Given that GPCRs serve as targets for approximately one-third of all marketed drugs, they may be compelling targets for repurposing traditional medicines. Despite this potential, research investigating their activity or potential ligands across GPCRome, the library of human GPCRs, is scarce. Drawing on the functional and structural knowledge presently available, this review contemplates prospective trends in GPCR drug discovery, proposes innovative strategies for investigating traditional medicines, and highlights ligand screening approaches for identifying novel drug-like molecules. To discover bioactive molecules from traditional medicines that either directly bind to GPCRs or indirectly modify their function, a genome-wide pan-GPCR drug discovery platform was designed for the identification of bioactive components and targets, and the evaluation of their pharmacological profiles. This platform aims to aid the exploration of all-sided relations between traditional medicines and GPCRome using advanced high-throughput screening techniques. We present various approaches used by many, including ourselves, to illuminate the previously unexplored aspects of traditional medicines and GPCRs.
articles.abstractZh: 传统药物不仅是医疗保健提供者处方医疗的一个组成部分，而且还是新型分子支架的基本储存库。然而，我们对其活动背后机制的理解仍然存在差距。膜蛋白超家族 G 蛋白偶联受体 (GPCR) 已被证明是从传统药物中分离出的几种化合物的潜在靶标。鉴于 GPCR 是大约三分之一的上市药物的靶点，它们可能是重新利用传统药物的引人注目的靶点。尽管有这种潜力，但研究它们在人类 GPCRome（人类 GPCR 库）中的活性或潜在配体的研究却很少。本综述利用现有的功能和结构知识，思考了 GPCR 药物发现的未来趋势，提出了研究传统药物的创新策略，并重点介绍了用于识别新型药物样分子的配体筛选方法。为了从传统药物中发现直接结合 GPCR 或间接修饰其功能的生物活性分子，一种全基因组泛 GPCR 药物

articles.title: A biophysical basis for the spreading behavior and limited diffusion of Xist.
articles.titleZh: Xist 传播行为和有限扩散的生物物理学基础。
articles.authors: Ding M, Wang D, Chen H, Kesner B, Grimm NB, Weissbein U, Lappala A, Jiang J, Rivera C, Lou J, Li P, Lee JT.
articles.abstract: Xist RNA initiates X inactivation as it spreads in cis across the chromosome. Here, we reveal a biophysical basis for its cis-limited diffusion. Xist RNA and HNRNPK together drive a liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) that encapsulates the chromosome. HNRNPK droplets pull on Xist and internalize the RNA. Once internalized, Xist induces a further phase transition and "softens" the HNRNPK droplet. Xist alters the condensate's deformability, adhesiveness, and wetting properties in vitro. Other Xist-interacting proteins are internalized and entrapped within the droplet, resulting in a concentration of Xist and protein partners within the condensate. We attribute LLPS to HNRNPK's RGG and Xist's repeat B (RepB) motifs. Mutating these motifs causes Xist diffusion, disrupts polycomb recruitment, and precludes the required mixing of chromosomal compartments for Xist's migration. Thus, we hypothesize that phase transitions in HNRNPK condensates allow Xist to locally concentrate silencing factors and to spread through internal channels of the HNRNPK-encapsulated chromosome.
articles.abstractZh: Xist RNA 在沿染色体顺式传播时启动 X 失活。在这里，我们揭示了其顺式限制扩散的生物物理基础。 Xist RNA 和 HNRNPK 共同驱动封装染色体的液-液相分离 (LLPS)。 HNRNPK 液滴吸引 Xist 并使 RNA 内化。一旦内化，Xist 会引发进一步的相变并“软化”HNRNPK 液滴。 Xist 改变了冷凝物的可变形性、粘附性和体外润湿特性。其他 Xist 相互作用的蛋白质被内化并捕获在液滴内，导致 Xist 和蛋白质伴侣在冷凝液中浓缩。我们将 LLPS 归因于 HNRNPK 的 RGG 和 Xist 的重复 B (RepB) 基序。这些基序突变会导致 Xist 扩散，破坏多梳募集，并阻止 Xist 迁移所需的染色体区室混合。因此，我们假设 HNRNPK 凝聚物中的相变使 Xist 能够局部集中沉默因子并通过 HNRNPK 封装的染色体的内部通道扩散。

articles.title: Metabolism-driven chromatin dynamics: Molecular principles and technological advances.
articles.titleZh: 代谢驱动的染色质动力学：分子原理和技术进步。
articles.authors: Sahu V, Lu C.
articles.abstract: Cells integrate metabolic information into core molecular processes such as transcription to adapt to environmental changes. Chromatin, the physiological template of the eukaryotic genome, has emerged as a sensor and rheostat for fluctuating intracellular metabolites. In this review, we highlight the growing list of chromatin-associated metabolites that are derived from diverse sources. We discuss recent advances in our understanding of the mechanisms by which metabolic enzyme activities shape the chromatin structure and modifications, how specificity may emerge from their seemingly broad effects, and technologies that facilitate the study of epigenome-metabolome interplay. The recognition that metabolites are immanent components of the chromatin regulatory network has significant implications for the evolution, function, and therapeutic targeting of the epigenome.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞将代谢信息整合到转录等核心分子过程中，以适应环境变化。染色质是真核基因组的生理模板，已成为细胞内代谢物波动的传感器和变阻器。在这篇综述中，我们重点介绍了来自不同来源的越来越多的染色质相关代谢物。我们讨论了我们对代谢酶活动塑造染色质结构和修饰的机制的理解的最新进展，特异性如何从其看似广泛的影响中显现出来，以及促进表观基因组-代谢组相互作用研究的技术。代谢物是染色质调控网络的内在组成部分这一认识对于表观基因组的进化、功能和治疗靶向具有重要意义。

articles.title: Mouse ZGRF1 helicase facilitates DNA repair and maintains efficient fertility.
articles.titleZh: 小鼠 ZGRF1 解旋酶促进 DNA 修复并保持高效的生育力。
articles.authors: Lim EWK, Kompocholi S, Brannvoll A, Bagge KSV, Gruhn JR, Martin-Gonzalez J, Albers E, Hickson ID, López-Contreras A, Lisby M.
articles.abstract: The recently characterised human ZGRF1 helicase promotes genomic stability by facilitating DNA interstrand crosslink repair. In its absence, human cells exhibit greater sensitivity towards anti-cancer drugs such as mitomycin C and camptothecin. Moreover, the downregulation of ZGRF1 expression is associated with increased survival in cancer patients. These attributes point to ZGRF1 as a potential anti-cancer drug target. Here, we investigated the role of ZGRF1 in tumorigenesis using the mouse model. We generated a ZGRF1 mutant mouse and find that it is viable and displays normal development. However, at a cellular level, mouse embryonic fibroblasts exhibit sensitivity to ICLs and show elevated levels of the DNA damage marker γH2AX. In the absence of ZGRF1, the rates of tumorigenesis and tumour-free survival in Eμ-Myc and Trp53 knockout mice remained largely unaffected. These findings suggest a potential role for ZGRF1 in the proliferation of specific cancer types, highlighting avenues for further research in other cancer models. Additionally, beyond its known function in DNA repair, our study also reveals that ZGRF1 promotes meiotic recombination and that its loss results in reduced fertility in mice manifested as a 30 % reduction in meiotic crossovers and a 15 % reduction in litter size.
articles.abstractZh: 最近鉴定的人类 ZGRF1 解旋酶通过促进 DNA 链间交联修复来促进基因组稳定性。如果没有它，人类细胞对丝裂霉素 C 和喜树碱等抗癌药物表现出更高的敏感性。此外，ZGRF1表达的下调与癌症患者的生存率增加有关。这些属性表明 ZGRF1 作为潜在的抗癌药物靶点。在这里，我们使用小鼠模型研究了 ZGRF1 在肿瘤发生中的作用。我们培育了一只 ZGRF1 突变小鼠，发现它具有活力并表现出正常发育。然而，在细胞水平上，小鼠胚胎成纤维细胞表现出对 ICL 的敏感性，并且 DNA 损伤标记 γH2AX 水平升高。在缺乏 ZGRF1 的情况下，Eμ-Myc 和 Trp53 敲除小鼠的肿瘤发生率和无瘤生存率基本不受影响。这些发现表明 ZGRF1 在特定癌症类型增殖中的潜在作用，突出了其他癌症模型进一步研究的途径。此外，除了已知的 DNA 修复功能外，我们的研究还表明 ZGRF1 促进减数分裂重组，并且其丢失导致减数分裂重组减少。

articles.title: A widespread and ancient bacterial machinery assembles cytochrome OmcS nanowires essential for extracellular electron transfer.
articles.titleZh: 一种广泛而古老的细菌机器组装细胞色素 OmcS 纳米线，这对细胞外电子转移至关重要。
articles.authors: Shen C, Salazar-Morales AI, Jung W, Erwin J, Gu Y, Coelho A, Gupta K, Yalcin SE, Samatey FA, Malvankar NS.
articles.abstract: Microbial extracellular electron transfer (EET) drives various globally important environmental phenomena and has biotechnology applications. Diverse prokaryotes have been proposed to perform EET via surface-displayed "nanowires" composed of multi-heme cytochromes. However, the mechanism that enables only a few cytochromes to polymerize into nanowires is unclear. Here, we identify a highly conserved omcS-companion (osc) cluster that drives the formation of cytochrome OmcS nanowires in Geobacter sulfurreducens. Through a combination of genetic, biochemical, and biophysical methods, we establish that prolyl isomerase-containing chaperon OscH, channel-like OscEFG, and β-propeller-like OscD are involved in the folding, secretion, and morphology maintenance of OmcS nanowires, respectively. OscH and OscG can interact with OmcS. Furthermore, overexpression of oscG accelerates EET by overproducing nanowires in an ATP-dependent manner. Heme loading splits OscD; ΔoscD accelerates cell growth, bundles nanowires into cables. Our findings establish the mechanism and prevalence of a specialized and modular assembly system for nanowires across phylogenetically diverse species and environments.
articles.abstractZh: 微生物细胞外电子转移（EET）驱动各种全球重要的环境现象并具有生物技术应用。多种原核生物已被提议通过表面展示的由多血红素细胞色素组成的“纳米线”进行 EET。然而，仅使少数细胞色素聚合成纳米线的机制尚不清楚。在这里，我们鉴定了一个高度保守的 omcS-companion (osc) 簇，它驱动硫还原地杆菌中细胞色素 OmcS 纳米线的形成。通过结合遗传、生物化学和生物物理方法，我们确定含有脯氨酰异构酶的伴侣OscH、通道状OscEFG和β-螺旋桨状OscD分别参与OmcS纳米线的折叠、分泌和形态维持。 OscH 和OscG 可以与OmcS 交互。此外，oscG 的过度表达通过以 ATP 依赖性方式过量产生纳米线来加速 EET。血红素加载分裂 OscD； ΔoscD 加速细胞生长，将纳米线捆绑成电缆。我们的研究结果建立了跨系统发育不同物种和环境的纳米线专用模块化组装系统的机制和普遍性。

articles.title: Autoactive CNGC15 enhances root endosymbiosis in legume and wheat.
articles.titleZh: 自活性 CNGC15 增强豆科植物和小麦的根内共生。
articles.authors: Cook NM, Gobbato G, Jacott CN, Marchal C, Hsieh CY, Lam AHC, Simmonds J, Del Cerro P, Gomez PN, Rodney C, Cruz-Mireles N, Uauy C, Haerty W, Lawson DM, Charpentier M.
articles.abstract: Nutrient acquisition is crucial for sustaining life. Plants develop beneficial intracellular partnerships with arbuscular mycorrhiza (AM) and nitrogen-fixing bacteria to surmount the scarcity of soil nutrients and tap into atmospheric dinitrogen, respectively1,2. Initiation of these root endosymbioses requires symbiont-induced oscillations in nuclear calcium (Ca2+) concentrations in root cells3. How the nuclear-localized ion channels, cyclic nucleotide-gated channel (CNGC) 15 and DOESN'T MAKE INFECTIONS1 (DMI1)4 are coordinated to specify symbiotic-induced nuclear Ca2+ oscillations remains unknown. Here we discovered an autoactive CNGC15 mutant that generates spontaneous low-frequency Ca2+ oscillations. While CNGC15 produces nuclear Ca2+ oscillations via a gating mechanism involving its helix 1, DMI1 acts as a pacemaker to specify the frequency of the oscillations. We demonstrate that the specificity of symbiotic-induced nuclear Ca2+ oscillations is encoded in its frequency. A high frequency activates endosymbiosis programmes, whereas a low frequency modulates phenylpropanoid pathways. Consequently, the autoactive cngc15 mutant, which is capable of generating both frequencies, has increased flavonoids that enhance AM, root nodule symbiosis and nutrient acquisition. We transferred this trait to wheat, resulting in field-grown wheat with increased AM colonization and nutrient acquisition. Our findings reveal a new strategy to boost endosymbiosis in the field and reduce inorganic fertilizer use while sustaining plant growth.
articles.abstractZh: 获取营养对于维持生命至关重要。植物与丛枝菌根 (AM) 和固氮细菌形成有益的细胞内伙伴关系，以克服土壤养分的缺乏并分别利用大气中的二氮1,2。这些根内共生的启动需要共生体诱导根细胞中核钙 (Ca2+) 浓度的振荡3。核定位离子通道、环核苷酸门控通道 (CNGC) 15 和 DOESN'T MAKE INFECTIONS1 (DMI1)4 如何协调以指定共生诱导的核 Ca2+ 振荡仍然未知。在这里，我们发现了一种自动激活的 CNGC15 突变体，它能产生自发的低频 Ca2+ 振荡。 CNGC15 通过涉及其螺旋 1 的门控机制产生核 Ca2+ 振荡，而 DMI1 则充当起搏器来指定振荡频率。我们证明共生诱导的核 Ca2+ 振荡的特异性是由其频率编码的。高频激活内共生程序，而低频则调节苯丙素途径。因此，能够产生两种频率的自动活性 cngc15 突变体

articles.title: Comprehensive genome-scale CRISPR knockout screening of CHO cells.
articles.titleZh: CHO 细胞的全面基因组规模 CRISPR 敲除筛选。
articles.authors: Shin SW, Kim SH, Gasselin A, Lee GM, Lee JS.
articles.abstract: Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cells play a pivotal role in the production of recombinant therapeutics. In the present study, we conducted a genome-scale pooled CRISPR knockout (KO) screening using a virus-free, recombinase-mediated cassette exchange-based platform in CHO-K1 host and CHO-K1 derived recombinant cells. Genome-wide guide RNA (gRNA) amplicon sequencing data were generated from cell libraries, as well as short- and long-term KO libraries, and validated through phenotypic assessment and gRNA read count distribution. Additionally, we obtained gRNA amplicon sequencing data from the highly productive recombinant cell populations. By analyzing these datasets, essential genes involved in cell fitness as well as functional target genes associated with therapeutic protein production can be identified. Collectively, our next-generation sequencing datasets, derived from a robust and reliable CRISPR screening method, provide valuable insights into CHO genomic functions, advancing the development of next-generation CHO factories.
articles.abstractZh: 中国仓鼠卵巢 (CHO) 细胞在重组治疗药物的生产中发挥着关键作用。在本研究中，我们使用无病毒、重组酶介导的基于盒交换的平台在 CHO-K1 宿主和 CHO-K1 衍生的重组细胞中进行了基因组规模的汇集 CRISPR 敲除 (KO) 筛选。全基因组指导 RNA (gRNA) 扩增子测序数据是从细胞文库以及短期和长期 KO 文库生成的，并通过表型评估和 gRNA 读取计数分布进行验证。此外，我们还从高产重组细胞群中获得了 gRNA 扩增子测序数据。通过分析这些数据集，可以识别参与细胞适应性的必需基因以及与治疗性蛋白质生产相关的功能性靶基因。总的来说，我们的下一代测序数据集源自强大而可靠的 CRISPR 筛选方法，为 CHO 基因组功能提供了宝贵的见解，推动了下一代 CHO 工厂的发展。

articles.title: De novo designed proteins neutralize lethal snake venom toxins.
articles.titleZh: 从头设计的蛋白质可以中和致命的蛇毒毒素。
articles.authors: Vázquez Torres S, Benard Valle M, Mackessy SP, Menzies SK, Casewell NR, Ahmadi S, Burlet NJ, Muratspahić E, Sappington I, Overath MD, Rivera-de-Torre E, Ledergerber J, Laustsen AH, Boddum K, Bera AK, Kang A, Brackenbrough E, Cardoso IA, Crittenden EP, Edge RJ, Decarreau J, Ragotte RJ, Pillai AS, Abedi M, Han HL, Gerben SR, Murray A, Skotheim R, Stuart L, Stewart L, Fryer TJA, Jenkins TP, Baker D.
articles.abstract: Snakebite envenoming remains a devastating and neglected tropical disease, claiming over 100,000 lives annually and causing severe complications and long-lasting disabilities for many more1,2. Three-finger toxins (3FTx) are highly toxic components of elapid snake venoms that can cause diverse pathologies, including severe tissue damage3 and inhibition of nicotinic acetylcholine receptors, resulting in life-threatening neurotoxicity4. At present, the only available treatments for snakebites consist of polyclonal antibodies derived from the plasma of immunized animals, which have high cost and limited efficacy against 3FTxs5-7. Here we used deep learning methods to de novo design proteins to bind short-chain and long-chain α-neurotoxins and cytotoxins from the 3FTx family. With limited experimental screening, we obtained protein designs with remarkable thermal stability, high binding affinity and near-atomic-level agreement with the computational models. The designed proteins effectively neutralized all three 3FTx subfamilies in vitro and protected mice from a lethal neurotoxin challenge. Such potent, stable and readily manufacturable toxin-neutralizing proteins could provide the basis for safer, cost-effective and widely accessible next-generation antivenom therapeutics. Beyond snakebite, our results highlight how computational design could help democratize therapeutic discovery, particularly in resource-limited settings, by substantially reducing costs and resource requirements for the development of therapies for neglected tropical diseases.
articles.abstractZh: 蛇咬伤仍然是一种毁灭性且被忽视的热带疾病，每年夺走超过 10 万人的生命，并导致更多人出现严重并发症和长期残疾1,2。三指毒素 (3FTx) 是蛇毒的剧毒成分，可引起多种病理，包括严重的组织损伤3和烟碱乙酰胆碱受体的抑制，从而导致危及生命的神经毒性4。目前，唯一可用的蛇咬伤治疗方法是从免疫动物血浆中提取的多克隆抗体，其成本高，且针对 3FTxs5-7 的疗效有限。在这里，我们使用深度学习方法从头设计蛋白质以结合 3FTx 家族的短链和长链 α-神经毒素和细胞毒素。通过有限的实验筛选，我们获得了具有显着热稳定性、高结合亲和力以及与计算模型接近原子水平一致性的蛋白质设计。设计的蛋白质在体外有效地中和了所有三个 3FTx 亚家族，并保护小鼠免受致命的神经毒素的攻击。这种有效、稳定且易于制造的毒素中和蛋白可以提供基础

articles.title: SARS-CoV-2 drug resistance and therapeutic approaches.
articles.titleZh: SARS-CoV-2 耐药性和治疗方法。
articles.authors: Batool S, Chokkakula S, Jeong JH, Baek YH, Song MS.
articles.abstract: In light of the transition of COVID-19 from a pandemic to an endemic phase, there is still a dire need to address challenges associated with drug resistance, particularly among immunocompromised and high-risk populations. This review explores the current state of research on SARS-CoV-2 drug resistance and underscores the ongoing need for effective therapeutic strategies. It critically evaluates existing knowledge on resistance mechanisms and therapeutic options, aiming to consolidate information and highlight areas for future research. By examining the complex interactions between the virus and its host, the review advocates for a multifaceted approach, including combination therapies, targeted drug development, and continuous surveillance of viral mutations. It also emphasizes the impact of evolving viral variants on antiviral efficacy and suggests adaptive treatment protocols. This review aims to enhance our understanding of SARS-CoV-2 drug resistance and contribute to more effective management of COVID-19 through a discussion of promising strategies such as drug repurposing and combination therapies.
articles.abstractZh: 鉴于 COVID-19 从大流行阶段转变为地方病阶段，仍然迫切需要解决与耐药性相关的挑战，特别是在免疫功能低下和高危人群中。本综述探讨了 SARS-CoV-2 耐药性的研究现状，并强调了对有效治疗策略的持续需求。它批判性地评估有关耐药机制和治疗方案的现有知识，旨在巩固信息并突出未来研究的领域。通过检查病毒与其宿主之间复杂的相互作用，该审查提倡采取多方面的方法，包括联合疗法、靶向药物开发和病毒突变的持续监测。它还强调了不断进化的病毒变异对抗病毒功效的影响，并提出了适应性治疗方案。本综述旨在通过讨论药物再利用和联合疗法等有前景的策略，增强我们对 SARS-CoV-2 耐药性的理解，并有助于更有效地管理 COVID-19。

articles.title: Structure of E6AP in complex with HPV16-E6 and p53 reveals a novel ordered domain important for E3 ligase activation.
articles.titleZh: E6AP 与 HPV16-E6 和 p53 复合物的结构揭示了一个对于 E3 连接酶激活很重要的新型有序结构域。
articles.authors: Kenny S, Iyer S, Gabel CA, Tegenfeldt N, DeMarco AG, Hall MC, Chang L, Davisson VJ, Pol SV, Das C.
articles.abstract: High-risk human papillomavirus E6 oncoprotein is a model system for the recognition and degradation of cellular p53 tumor suppressor protein. There remains a gap in the understanding of the ubiquitin transfer reaction, including placement of the E6AP catalytic HECT domain of the ligase concerning the p53 substrate and how E6 itself is protected from ubiquitination. We determined the cryoelectron microscopy (cryo-EM) structure of the E6AP/E6/p53 complex, related the structure to in vivo modeling of the tri-molecular complex, and identified structural interactions associated with activation of the ubiquitin ligase function. The structure reveals that the N-terminal ordered domain (NOD) in E6AP has a terminal alpha helix that mediates the interaction of the NOD with the HECT domain of E6AP and protects the HPV-E6 protein from ubiquitination. In addition, this NOD helix is required for E6AP ligase function by contributing to the affinity of the E6-E6AP association, modulating E6 substrate recognition, while displacing UbcH7.
articles.abstractZh: 高危人乳头瘤病毒 E6 癌蛋白是识别和降解细胞 p53 肿瘤抑制蛋白的模型系统。对泛素转移反应的理解仍然存在差距，包括连接酶的 E6AP 催化 HECT 结构域与 p53 底物的位置以及如何保护 E6 本身免受泛素化。我们确定了 E6AP/E6/p53 复合物的冷冻电子显微镜 (cryo-EM) 结构，将该结构与三分子复合物的体内建模相关联，并确定了与泛素连接酶功能激活相关的结构相互作用。该结构表明，E6AP 中的 N 端有序结构域 (NOD) 具有末端 α 螺旋，可介导 NOD 与 E6AP 的 HECT 结构域的相互作用，并保护 HPV-E6 蛋白免于泛素化。此外，该 NOD 螺旋是 E6AP 连接酶功能所必需的，它有助于 E6-E6AP 缔合的亲和力，调节 E6 底物识别，同时取代 UbcH7。

articles.title: Targeting protein-ligand neosurfaces with a generalizable deep learning tool.
articles.titleZh: 使用可推广的深度学习工具瞄准蛋白质配体新表面。
articles.authors: Marchand A, Buckley S, Schneuing A, Pacesa M, Elia M, Gainza P, Elizarova E, Neeser RM, Lee PW, Reymond L, Miao Y, Scheller L, Georgeon S, Schmidt J, Schwaller P, Maerkl SJ, Bronstein M, Correia BE.
articles.abstract: Molecular recognition events between proteins drive biological processes in living systems1. However, higher levels of mechanistic regulation have emerged, in which protein-protein interactions are conditioned to small molecules2-5. Despite recent advances, computational tools for the design of new chemically induced protein interactions have remained a challenging task for the field6,7. Here we present a computational strategy for the design of proteins that target neosurfaces, that is, surfaces arising from protein-ligand complexes. To develop this strategy, we leveraged a geometric deep learning approach based on learned molecular surface representations8,9 and experimentally validated binders against three drug-bound protein complexes: Bcl2-venetoclax, DB3-progesterone and PDF1-actinonin. All binders demonstrated high affinities and accurate specificities, as assessed by mutational and structural characterization. Remarkably, surface fingerprints previously trained only on proteins could be applied to neosurfaces induced by interactions with small molecules, providing a powerful demonstration of generalizability that is uncommon in other deep learning approaches. We anticipate that such designed chemically induced protein interactions will have the potential to expand the sensing repertoire and the assembly of new synthetic pathways in engineered cells for innovative drug-controlled cell-based therapies10.
articles.abstractZh: 蛋白质之间的分子识别事件驱动生命系统中的生物过程1。然而，更高水平的机械调节已经出现，其中蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用以小分子为条件2-5。尽管最近取得了进展，但用于设计新的化学诱导蛋白质相互作用的计算工具仍然是该领域的一项具有挑战性的任务6,7。在这里，我们提出了一种针对新表面（即由蛋白质-配体复合物产生的表面）的蛋白质设计的计算策略。为了开发这一策略，我们利用了基于学习的分子表面表示8,9的几何深度学习方法，并针对三种药物结合蛋白复合物进行了实验验证的结合剂：Bcl2-venetoclax、DB3-黄体酮和PDF1-肌动素。通过突变和结构表征评估，所有结合物均表现出高亲和力和准确的特异性。值得注意的是，以前仅在蛋白质上训练的表面指纹可以应用于由与小分子相互作用诱导的新表面，这提供了在其他深度学习方法中不常见的普遍性的有力证明。我们预计

articles.title: The regulatory landscape of 5' UTRs in translational control during zebrafish embryogenesis.
articles.titleZh: 斑马鱼胚胎发生过程中翻译控制中 5'UTR 的调控景观。
articles.authors: Reimão-Pinto MM, Castillo-Hair SM, Seelig G, Schier AF.
articles.abstract: The 5' UTRs of mRNAs are critical for translation regulation during development, but their in vivo regulatory features are poorly characterized. Here, we report the regulatory landscape of 5' UTRs during early zebrafish embryogenesis using a massively parallel reporter assay of 18,154 sequences coupled to polysome profiling. We found that the 5' UTR suffices to confer temporal dynamics to translation initiation and identified 86 motifs enriched in 5' UTRs with distinct ribosome recruitment capabilities. A quantitative deep learning model, Danio Optimus 5-Prime (DaniO5P), identified a combined role for 5' UTR length, translation initiation site context, upstream AUGs, and sequence motifs on ribosome recruitment. DaniO5P predicts the activities of maternal and zygotic 5' UTR isoforms and indicates that modulating 5' UTR length and motif grammar contributes to translation initiation dynamics. This study provides a first quantitative model of 5' UTR-based translation regulation in development and lays the foundation for identifying the underlying molecular effectors.
articles.abstractZh: mRNA 的 5' UTR 对于发育过程中的翻译调控至关重要，但其体内调控特征尚不清楚。在这里，我们使用与多核糖体分析相结合的 18,154 个序列的大规模并行报告分析来报告早期斑马鱼胚胎发生过程中 5' UTR 的调控景观。我们发现 5' UTR 足以赋予翻译起始时间动态，并鉴定出 86 个富含 5' UTR 的基序，具有独特的核糖体招募能力。定量深度学习模型 Danio Optimus 5-Prime (DaniO5P) 确定了 5' UTR 长度、翻译起始位点背景、上游 AUG 和序列基序对核糖体募集的综合作用。 DaniO5P 预测母体和合子 5' UTR 亚型的活性，并表明调节 5' UTR 长度和基序语法有助于翻译起始动力学。这项研究提供了第一个基于 5'UTR 的翻译调控定量模型，并为识别潜在的分子效应奠定了基础。

articles.title: Addressing genome scale design tradeoffs in Pseudomonas putida for bioconversion of an aromatic carbon source.
articles.titleZh: 解决恶臭假单胞菌中芳香族碳源生物转化的基因组规模设计权衡。
articles.authors: Banerjee D, Menasalvas J, Chen Y, Gin JW, Baidoo EEK, Petzold CJ, Eng T, Mukhopadhyay A.
articles.abstract: Genome-scale metabolic models (GSMM) are commonly used to identify gene deletion sets that result in growth coupling and pairing product formation with substrate utilization and can improve strain performance beyond levels typically accessible using traditional strain engineering approaches. However, sustainable feedstocks pose a challenge due to incomplete high-resolution metabolic data for non-canonical carbon sources required to curate GSMM and identify implementable designs. Here we address a four-gene deletion design in the Pseudomonas putida KT2440 strain for the lignin-derived non-sugar carbon source, p-coumarate (p-CA), that proved challenging to implement. We examine the performance of the fully implemented design for p-coumarate to glutamine, a useful biomanufacturing intermediate. In this study glutamine is then converted to indigoidine, an alternative sustainable pigment and a model heterologous product that is commonly used to colorimetrically quantify glutamine concentration. Through proteomics, promoter-variation, and growth characterization of a fully implemented gene deletion design, we provide evidence that aromatic catabolism in the completed design is rate-limited by fumarase hydratase (FUM) enzyme activity in the citrate cycle and requires careful optimization of another fumarate hydratase protein (PP_0897) expression to achieve growth and production. A double sensitivity analysis also confirmed a strict requirement for fumarate hydratase activity in the strain where all genes in the growth coupling design have been implemented. Metabolic cross-feeding experiments were used to examine the impact of complete removal of the fumarase hydratase reaction and revealed an unanticipated nutrient requirement, suggesting additional functions for this enzyme. While a complete implementation of the design was achieved, this study highlights the challenge of completely inactivating metabolic reactions encoded by under-characterized proteins, especially in the context of multi-gene edits.
articles.abstractZh: 基因组规模代谢模型 (GSMM) 通常用于识别基因缺失组，这些基因缺失组会导致生长耦合以及产物形成与底物利用配对，并且可以将菌株性能提高到超出使用传统菌株工程方法通常可达到的水平。然而，由于策划 GSMM 和确定可实施的设计所需的非规范碳源的高分辨率代谢数据不完整，可持续原料提出了挑战。在这里，我们在恶臭假单胞菌 KT2440 菌株中针对木质素衍生的非糖碳源对香豆酸 (p-CA) 进行了四基因删除设计，事实证明该设计实施起来具有挑战性。我们检查了对香豆酸到谷氨酰胺（一种有用的生物制造中间体）的完全实施设计的性能。在这项研究中，谷氨酰胺随后转化为靛蓝，一种替代的可持续色素和一种模型异源产品，通常用于比色定量谷氨酰胺浓度。通过完全实施的基因删除设计的蛋白质组学、启动子变异和生长表征，我们提供了证据，表明完成的设计中的芳香族分解代谢是速率限制的

articles.title: Intracellular protein-lipid interactions drive presynaptic assembly prior to neurexin recruitment.
articles.titleZh: 细胞内蛋白质-脂质相互作用在神经素招募之前驱动突触前组装。
articles.authors: Frankel EB, Tiroumalechetty A, Su Z, Henry PS, Mueller BD, Jorgensen EM, Wu Y, Kurshan PT.
articles.abstract: Neurexin cell-adhesion molecules regulate synapse development and function by recruiting synaptic components. Here, we uncover a mechanism for presynaptic assembly that precedes neurexin recruitment, mediated by interactions between cytosolic proteins and membrane phospholipids. Developmental imaging in C. elegans reveals that the intracellular active zone protein SYD-1 accumulates at nascent presynapses prior to its binding partner neurexin. Combining molecular dynamics simulations to model intrinsic interactions between SYD-1 and lipid bilayers with biochemical and in vivo validation of these predictions, we find that PIP2-interacting residues in the SYD-1 C2 domain are required for active zone assembly. Genetic perturbation of a PIP2-generating enzyme disrupts synaptic SYD-1 accumulation, while the PIP2-interacting domain of mammalian RIM1 can compensate for the SYD-1 C2 domain, suggesting functional homology between these proteins. Finally, we propose that the evolutionarily conserved γ-neurexin isoform represents a minimal neurexin sequence that stabilizes nascent presynaptic assemblies, potentially a core function of this isoform.
articles.abstractZh: 神经毒素细胞粘附分子通过募集突触成分来调节突触发育和功能。在这里，我们发现了一种在神经素招募之前的突触前组装机制，由胞质蛋白和膜磷脂之间的相互作用介导。秀丽隐杆线虫的发育成像显示，细胞内活性区蛋白 SYD-1 在其结合伙伴神经毒素之前在新生突触前积累。结合分子动力学模拟来模拟 SYD-1 和脂质双层之间的内在相互作用以及这些预测的生化和体内验证，我们发现 SYD-1 C2 结构域中的 PIP2 相互作用残基是活性区组装所必需的。 PIP2 生成酶的遗传扰动会破坏突触 SYD-1 的积累，而哺乳动物 RIM1 的 PIP2 相互作用结构域可以补偿 SYD-1 C2 结构域，表明这些蛋白质之间存在功能同源性。最后，我们提出进化上保守的 γ-神经毒素亚型代表了稳定新生突触前组件的最小神经毒素序列，这可能是该亚型的核心功能。

articles.title: Life stage impact on the human skin ecosystem: lipids and the microbial community.
articles.titleZh: 生命阶段对人类皮肤生态系统的影响：脂质和微生物群落。
articles.authors: Pagac MP, Davient B, Plado LA, Lam HYI, Lee SM, Ravikrishnan A, Chua WLE, Muralidharan S, Sridharan A, Irudayaswamy AS, Srinivas R, Wearne S, Mohamed Naim AN, Ho EXP, Ng HQA, Kwah JS, Png E, Bendt AK, Wenk MR, Torta F, Nagarajan N, Common J, Chong YS, Tham EH, Shek LP, Loo EXL, Chambers J, Yew YW, Loh M, Dawson TL.
articles.abstract: Sebaceous free fatty acids are metabolized by multiple skin microbes into bioactive lipid mediators termed oxylipins. This study investigated correlations between skin oxylipins and microbes on the superficial skin of pre-pubescent children (N = 36) and adults (N = 100), including pre- (N = 25) and post-menopausal females (N = 25). Lipidomics and metagenomics revealed that Malassezia restricta positively correlated with the oxylipin 9,10-DiHOME on adult skin and negatively correlated with its precursor, 9,10-EpOME, on pre-pubescent skin. Co-culturing Malassezia with keratinocytes demonstrated a link between 9,10-DiHOME and pro-inflammatory cytokines IL-1β and IL-6 production. We also observed strong correlations between other skin oxylipins and microbial taxa, highlighting life stage differences in sebum production and microbial community composition. Our findings imply a complex host-microbe communication system mediated by lipid metabolism occurring on human skin, warranting further research into its role in skin health and disease and paving the way towards novel therapeutic targets and treatments.
articles.abstractZh: 皮脂游离脂肪酸被多种皮肤微生物代谢成称为氧脂质的生物活性脂质介质。本研究调查了青春期前儿童 (N = 36) 和成人 (N = 100)，包括绝经前女性 (N = 25) 和绝经后女性 (N = 25) 的浅表皮肤上的皮肤氧脂素和微生物之间的相关性。脂质组学和宏基因组学显示，马拉色菌与成人皮肤上的氧脂素 9,10-DiHOME 呈正相关，与青春期前皮肤上的其前体 9,10-EpOME 呈负相关。马拉色菌与角质形成细胞共培养证明了 9,10-DiHOME 与促炎细胞因子 IL-1β 和 IL-6 产生之间的联系。我们还观察到其他皮肤氧脂素和微生物类群之间存在很强的相关性，突出了皮脂产生和微生物群落组成的生命阶段差异。我们的研究结果表明，人体皮肤上存在由脂质代谢介导的复杂宿主-微生物通讯系统，需要进一步研究其在皮肤健康和疾病中的作用，并为新的治疗靶点和治疗方法铺平道路。

articles.title: Rapid discovery of cyclic peptide protein aggregation inhibitors by continuous selection.
articles.titleZh: 通过持续筛选快速发现环肽蛋白聚集抑制剂。
articles.authors: Yang L, Zhang J, Andon JS, Li L, Wang T.
articles.abstract: Protein aggregates are associated with numerous diseases. Here we report a platform for the rapid phenotypic selection of protein aggregation inhibitors from genetically encoded cyclic peptide libraries in Escherichia coli based on phage-assisted continuous evolution (PACE). We developed a new PACE-compatible selection for protein aggregation inhibition and used it to identify cyclic peptides that suppress amyloid-β42 and human islet amyloid polypeptide aggregation. Additionally, we integrated a negative selection that removes false positives and off-target hits, greatly improving cyclic peptide selectivity. We show that selected inhibitors are active when chemically resynthesized in in vitro assays. Our platform provides a powerful approach for the rapid discovery of cyclic peptide inhibitors of protein aggregation and may serve as the basis for the future evolution of cyclic peptides with a broad spectrum of inhibitory activities.
articles.abstractZh: 蛋白质聚集体与许多疾病有关。在这里，我们报告了一个基于噬菌体辅助连续进化（PACE）从大肠杆菌基因编码环肽库中快速表型选择蛋白质聚集抑制剂的平台。我们开发了一种新的 PACE 兼容选择，用于抑制蛋白质聚集，并用它来鉴定抑制淀粉样蛋白-β42 和人胰岛淀粉样多肽聚集的环肽。此外，我们还集成了阴性选择，可以消除假阳性和脱靶命中，从而大大提高环肽的选择性。我们表明，在体外试验中进行化学再合成时，选定的抑制剂具有活性。我们的平台为快速发现蛋白质聚集的环肽抑制剂提供了一种强大的方法，并且可以作为具有广谱抑制活性的环肽未来进化的基础。

articles.title: Ribosomal A-site interactions with near-cognate tRNAs drive stop codon readthrough.
articles.titleZh: 核糖体 A 位点与近同源 tRNA 的相互作用驱动终止密码子通读。
articles.authors: Čapková Pavlíková Z, Miletínová P, Roithová A, Pospíšilová K, Záhonová K, Kachale A, Becker T, Durante IM, Lukeš J, Paris Z, Beznosková P, Valášek LS.
articles.abstract: Transfer RNAs (tRNAs) serve as a dictionary for the ribosome translating the genetic message from mRNA into a polypeptide chain. In addition to this canonical role, tRNAs are involved in other processes such as programmed stop codon readthrough (SC-RT). There, tRNAs with near-cognate anticodons to stop codons must outcompete release factors and incorporate into the ribosomal decoding center to prevent termination and allow translation to continue. However, not all near-cognate tRNAs promote efficient SC-RT. Here, with the help of Saccharomyces cerevisiae and Trypanosoma brucei, we demonstrate that those tRNAs that promote efficient SC-RT establish critical contacts between their anticodon stem (AS) and ribosomal proteins Rps30/eS30 and Rps25/eS25 forming the decoding site. Unexpectedly, the length and well-defined nature of the AS determine the strength of these contacts, which is reflected in organisms with reassigned stop codons. These findings open an unexplored direction in tRNA biology that should facilitate the design of artificial tRNAs with specifically altered decoding abilities.
articles.abstractZh: 转移 RNA (tRNA) 充当核糖体的字典，将遗传信息从 mRNA 翻译成多肽链。除了这一典型作用之外，tRNA 还参与其他过程，例如程序化终止密码子通读 (SC-RT)。在那里，具有近同源反密码子的终止密码子的 tRNA 必须战胜释放因子并整合到核糖体解码中心以防止终止并允许翻译继续。然而，并非所有近同源 tRNA 都能促进有效的 SC-RT。在这里，在酿酒酵母和布氏锥虫的帮助下，我们证明那些促进高效 SC-RT 的 tRNA 在其反密码子干 (AS) 和形成解码位点的核糖体蛋白 Rps30/eS30 和 Rps25/eS25 之间建立了关键的接触。出乎意料的是，AS 的长度和明确的性质决定了这些接触的强度，这反映在具有重新分配的终止密码子的生物体中。这些发现为 tRNA 生物学开辟了一个尚未探索的方向，这将有助于设计具有特定改变的解码能力的人工 tRNA。

articles.title: Biodesulfurization enhancement via targeted re-insertion of the flavin reductase dszD in the genome of the model strain Rhodococcus qingshengii IGTS8.
articles.titleZh: 通过在模型菌株青生红球菌 IGTS8 的基因组中定向重新插入黄素还原酶 dszD 来增强生物脱硫。
articles.authors: Martzoukou O, Klenias F, Kopsini E, Hatzinikolaou DG.
articles.abstract: Biodesulfurization (BDS) has emerged as an alternative to the excessively costly hydrodesulfurization of recalcitrant heterocyclic sulfur compounds, such as dibenzothiophene (DBT) and its derivatives. The model desulfurizing strain Rhodococcus qingshengii IGTS8 is responsible for the removal of sulfur through the 4S metabolic pathway, operating through a plasmid-borne dszABC operon, as well as the chromosomal gene for the flavin reductase, d szD. However, naturally occurring biocatalysts do not exhibit the required BDS activity to be useful for industrial applications and for this reason, genetic modifications are currently being explored. Here, we constructed a genetically modified R. qingshengii IGTS8 strain, which carries an additional copy of the flavin reductase gene dszD under the control of the rhodococcal promoter P kap1 , inserted in the neutral chromosomal genetic locus crtI. We conducted a comparative study of the growth and biodesulfurization capabilities of P kap1 -dszD, wild-type and crtIΔ strains, grown on different types and concentrations of carbon and sulfur sources. A significant enhancement of biodesulfurization activity, maximum calculated biomass, and dszD transcript levels in the presence of DBT as the sole sulfur source was achieved for the P kap1 -dszD strain paving the way for further studies that could lead to a more viable commercial biodesulfurization process.
articles.abstractZh: 生物脱硫（BDS）已成为对顽固杂环硫化合物（例如二苯并噻吩（DBT）及其衍生物）进行成本过高的加氢脱硫的替代方案。模型脱硫菌株青生红球菌 IGTS8 负责通过 4S 代谢途径去除硫，通过质粒携带的 dszABC 操纵子以及黄素还原酶 d szD 的染色体基因进行操作。然而，天然存在的生物催化剂并不表现出可用于工业应用所需的 BDS 活性，因此，目前正在探索基因修饰。在这里，我们构建了一个转基因R. qingshengii IGTS8菌株，该菌株在红球菌启动子P kap1的控制下携带黄素还原酶基因dszD的额外拷贝，插入中性染色体遗传位点crtI中。我们对在不同类型和浓度的碳源和硫源上生长的 P kap1 -dszD、野生型和 crtIΔ 菌株的生长和生物脱硫能力进行了比较研究。生物脱硫活性、最大计算生物量和 dszD tra 显着增强

articles.title: Isolation and optimization of Bacillus thuringiensis BRB-3 isolated from germinated black upland rice seeds for GABA production.
articles.titleZh: 从发芽黑旱稻种子中分离和优化用于 GABA 生产的苏云金芽孢杆菌 BRB-3。
articles.authors: Wannasutta R, Boonlue S, Riddech N, Mongkolthanaruk W.
articles.abstract: Gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) is a non-coded amino acid that recently gained increased attention within the functional food industry. This study aimed to isolate endophytic bacteria from sterilized surfaces of germinated black upland rice seeds for GABA production and optimization. A total of 38 isolates were screened for glutamic acid decarboxylase (GAD) activity using a colorimetric method. Among these, thirteen isolates exhibited positive GAD activity. The BRB-3 strain emerged as the most promising, producing the highest GABA levels (4.54 g/L) at an optimal pH of 6.5. However, the BRB-3 strain was sensitive to pH lower than 5.5; so the pH was adjusted to 6.5 through all experiments. Further identification of the BRB-3 strain was performed using 16S rRNA gene sequence, which placed it in Bacillus cereus group. Subsequent rpoB gene sequence analysis confirmed that the BRB-3 strain was Bacillus thuringiensis BRB-3. GABA production was optimized in MRS broth by investigating carbon, nitrogen, monosodium glutamate (MSG), pH and temperature. Interestingly, the concentration of MSG did not impact GABA production of B. thuringiensis BRB-3. Under optimal conditions of 3 % soy protein as the nitrogen source, 2 % sucrose, no added MSG at 30 °C, pH 6.5 for 12 days, B. thuringiensis BRB-3 achieved a high GABA yield of 25.06 g/L (242.9 mM). Therefore, B. thuringiensis BRB-3 demonstrated significant potential for GABA production and could be utilized in various functional food products, including germinated rice seeds.
articles.abstractZh: γ-氨基丁酸 (GABA) 是一种非编码氨基酸，最近在功能性食品行业中受到越来越多的关注。本研究旨在从发芽黑旱稻种子的灭菌表面分离内生细菌，用于 GABA 生产和优化。使用比色法筛选了总共 38 个分离株的谷氨酸脱羧酶 (GAD) 活性。其中，13 个分离株表现出阳性 GAD 活性。 BRB-3 菌株成为最有前途的菌株，在最佳 pH 值 6.5 下产生最高的 GABA 水平 (4.54 g/L)。然而，BRB-3菌株对pH低于5.5敏感；因此通过所有实验将pH调节至6.5。利用16S rRNA基因序列对BRB-3菌株进行进一步鉴定，将其归入蜡样芽孢杆菌组。随后的rpoB基因序列分析证实BRB-3菌株为苏云金芽孢杆菌BRB-3。通过研究碳、氮、味精 (MSG)、pH 和温度，优化了 MRS 肉汤中的 GABA 生产。有趣的是，味精的浓度并不影响苏云金芽孢杆菌 BRB-3 的 GABA 产量。在3%大豆蛋白的最佳条件下

articles.title: Classification of polyphenol oxidases shows ancient gene duplication leading to two distinct enzyme types.
articles.titleZh: 多酚氧化酶的分类显示古老的基因复制导致了两种不同的酶类型。
articles.authors: Meitil IKS, de O G Silva C, Pedersen AG, Agger JW.
articles.abstract: Polyphenol oxidases (PPOs) are coupled binuclear copper proteins that catalyze the oxidation of phenols. New functions of PPOs are continuously being discovered, latest with several fungal o-methoxy phenolases, which are active on lignin-derived compounds. Here, we perform a comprehensive phylogenetic analysis of PPOs from a wide taxonomic origin and define 12 PPO groups. We find that a deep gene duplication has led to two distinct PPO types. Type 1 includes PPOs from chordates and molluscs, as well as the fungal o-methoxy phenolases. Type 2 includes plant PPOs, molluscan hemocyanins, and fungal tyrosinases. Most of the type 2 proteins have a C-terminal shielding domain and a thioether bond in the copper-binding site. We also find that most ascomycetes contain high numbers of the PPO type 1 that includes the o-methoxy phenolases, which may indicate a role in the lignin conversion strategy of these fungi.
articles.abstractZh: 多酚氧化酶 (PPO) 是偶联的双核铜蛋白，可催化酚类氧化。 PPO 的新功能不断被发现，最新发现的是几种真菌邻甲氧基酚酶，它们对木质素衍生的化合物具有活性。在这里，我们对广泛的分类学起源的 PPO 进行了全面的系统发育分析，并定义了 12 个 PPO 类群。我们发现深度基因重复导致了两种不同的 PPO 类型。 1 型包括来自脊索动物和软体动物的 PPO，以及真菌邻甲氧基酚酶。 2 型包括植物 PPO、软体动物血蓝蛋白和真菌酪氨酸酶。大多数 2 型蛋白在铜结合位点具有 C 端屏蔽结构域和硫醚键。我们还发现大多数子囊菌含有大量的 1 型 PPO，其中包括邻甲氧基酚酶，这可能表明在这些真菌的木质素转化策略中发挥作用。

articles.title: Comprehensive analysis of poly(A) tails in mouse testes and ovaries using Nanopore Direct RNA Sequencing.
articles.titleZh: 使用 Nanopore 直接 RNA 测序对小鼠睾丸和卵巢中的 Poly(A) 尾进行综合分析。
articles.authors: Czarnocka-Cieciura A, Brouze M, Gumińska N, Mroczek S, Gewartowska O, Krawczyk PS, Dziembowski A.
articles.abstract: Gametogenesis is a process in which dysfunctions lead to infertility, a growing health and social problem worldwide. In both spermatogenesis and oogenesis, post-transcriptional gene expression regulation is crucial. Essentially, all mRNAs possess non-templated poly(A) tails, whose composition and dynamics (elongation, shortening, and modifications) determine the fate of mRNA. Moreover, gametogenesis, especially oogenesis, represents a unique instance of the complexity of poly(A) tails metabolism, with oocyte-specific waves of cytoplasmic polyadenylation. In this context, we provide a comprehensive transcriptomic dataset focusing on mRNA poly(A) tail composition and dynamics in murine testes and ovaries. It consists of RNA samples isolated from wild-type and transgenic mice lacking TENT5 polymerases, which can extend poly(A) tails in the cytoplasm. TENT5 deficiencies have serious consequences. For instance, the defect of TENT5D causes infertility in humans. The data described here are generated mainly using the Oxford Nanopore Direct RNA Sequencing (DRS) method, which provides ground-truth information about mRNA molecules, including poly(A) tail length and nucleotide content. For instance, we show the prevalence of uridilated tails in testicular mRNAs.
articles.abstractZh: 配子发生是一个功能障碍导致不孕的过程，这是世界范围内日益严重的健康和社会问题。在精子发生和卵子发生中，转录后基因表达调控至关重要。本质上，所有 mRNA 都具有非模板化聚腺苷酸尾，其组成和动态（延伸、缩短和修饰）决定了 mRNA 的命运。此外，配子发生，尤其是卵子发生，代表了聚腺苷酸尾代谢复杂性的一个独特实例，具有卵母细胞特异性的细胞质聚腺苷酸化波。在这种情况下，我们提供了一个全面的转录组数据集，重点关注小鼠睾丸和卵巢中 mRNA Poly(A) 尾部的组成和动态。它由从缺乏 TENT5 聚合酶的野生型和转基因小鼠中分离出来的 RNA 样本组成，TENT5 聚合酶可以在细胞质中延伸聚 (A) 尾。 TENT5 缺陷会产生严重后果。例如，TENT5D的缺陷会导致人类不育。这里描述的数据主要使用牛津纳米孔直接RNA测序（DRS）方法生成，该方法提供有关mRNA分子的真实信息，包括poly(A)尾长度和核苷酸含量。对于在

articles.title: Genome-wide transcriptomics revealed carbon source-mediated gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) production in a probiotic, Lactiplantibacillus pentosus 9D3.
articles.titleZh: 全基因组转录组学揭示了益生菌戊糖乳杆菌 9D3 中碳源介导的 γ-氨基丁酸 (GABA) 产生。
articles.authors: Raethong N, Chamtim P, Thananusak R, Whanmek K, Santivarangkna C.
articles.abstract: GABA-producing probiotics present promising opportunities for developing functional foods. Carbon sources have been identified as a critical influence on GABA production. Therefore, this study investigated the holistic metabolic responses and GABA biosynthesis to various carbon sources of Lactiplantibacillus pentosus 9D3, a proficient GABA producer, using a genome-wide transcriptomic approach. The analysis revealed 414 genes with differential expression responses to altering carbon sources, i.e., glucose, sucrose, and lactose, notably sugar phosphotransferase systems (PTS) (11 genes), indicating carbon source-mediated transcriptional change patterns in L. pentosus 9D3. The integration of transcriptome data with a genome-scale metabolic network (GSMN) revealed that L. pentosus 9D3 displays adaptability by synthesizing GABA as an alternative acid-tolerant mechanism when lactose is used as a carbon source rather than depending on the fatty acid synthesis and the arginine catabolic pathway. The findings of this study offer valuable insights into optimal carbon source utilization and gene expression co-regulation, thereby enhancing the GABA-producing capability of a probiotic and broadening its potential applications in the functional food industry.
articles.abstractZh: 产生 GABA 的益生菌为开发功能性食品提供了广阔的机遇。碳源已被确定为对 GABA 生产的关键影响。因此，本研究采用全基因组转录组学方法，研究了 GABA 高效生产者戊糖乳杆菌 9D3 对各种碳源的整体代谢反应和 GABA 生物合成。分析揭示了 414 个基因对改变碳源（即葡萄糖、蔗糖和乳糖）有差异表达反应，特别是糖磷酸转移酶系统 (PTS)（11 个基因），表明戊糖乳杆菌 9D3 中碳源介导的转录变化模式。转录组数据与基因组规模代谢网络（GSMN）的整合表明，当乳糖用作碳源时，戊糖乳杆菌9D3通过合成GABA作为替代耐酸机制而不是依赖于脂肪酸合成和精氨酸分解代谢途径，表现出适应性。这项研究的结果为最佳碳源利用和基因表达共同调节提供了宝贵的见解，从而增强了益生菌和广泛的益生菌的 GABA 生产能力。

articles.title: Mycoparasitic transcription factor 1 (BcMTF1) participates in the Botrytis cinerea response against Trichoderma atroviride.
articles.titleZh: 真菌寄生转录因子 1 (BcMTF1) 参与灰葡萄孢 (Botrytis cinerea) 针对深绿色木霉 (Trichoderma atroviride) 的反应。
articles.authors: Olivares-Yañez C, Arias-Inostroza N, Polanco R, Canessa P.
articles.abstract: Botrytis cinerea is a phytopathogenic fungus. Traditional control using fungicides has faced challenges, prompting the exploration of sustainable alternatives such as biocontrol. Trichoderma atroviride, a promising biocontroller, is well-known for its mycoparasitism. However, the molecular processes involved in this fungal-fungal interaction, particularly regarding the defense mechanisms of the pathogen, have yet to be deeply studied. Here, we investigated the transcriptional defense responses of B. cinerea to T. atroviride. We focused on four B. cinerea transcription factors (TFs) differentially expressed during interaction with the biocontroller. Mutants lacking these TFs exhibit increased sensitivity to T. atroviride, with the Bcin07g06800 (BcMTF1) loss-of-function mutant being most susceptible. Genes predicted to be regulated by mycoparasitic transcription factor 1 were differentially expressed during this interaction. BcMTF1 influences B. cinerea's resistance to mycoparasitism by regulating the expression of genes potentially involved in fungal defense against Trichoderma. The findings provide insights into the transcriptional processes underlying fungal-fungal interactions.
articles.abstractZh: 灰葡萄孢 (Botrytis cinerea) 是一种植物病原真菌。使用杀菌剂的传统控制面临挑战，促使人们探索生物防治等可持续替代方案。深绿木霉是一种很有前途的生物防治剂，因其真菌寄生而闻名。然而，这种真菌与真菌相互作用所涉及的分子过程，特别是病原体的防御机制，尚未得到深入研究。在这里，我们研究了 B. cinerea 对 T. atroviride 的转录防御反应。我们重点关注在与生物控制剂相互作用过程中差异表达的四种灰霉病转录因子 (TF)。缺乏这些 TF 的突变体表现出对深绿木霉的敏感性增加，其中 Bcin07g06800 (BcMTF1) 功能丧失突变体最敏感。预计受真菌寄生转录因子 1 调节的基因在这种相互作用过程中存在差异表达。 BcMTF1 通过调节可能参与针对木霉菌的真菌防御的基因的表达来影响灰霉病菌对真菌寄生的抵抗力。这些发现提供了对真菌-真菌相互作用背后的转录过程的见解。

articles.title: RBBP6 anchors pre-mRNA 3' end processing to nuclear speckles for efficient gene expression.
articles.titleZh: RBBP6 将前 mRNA 3' 末端加工锚定到核斑点上，以实现有效的基因表达。
articles.authors: Yoon Y, Bournique E, Soles LV, Yin H, Chu HF, Yin C, Zhuang Y, Liu X, Liu L, Jeong J, Yu C, Valdez M, Tian L, Huang L, Shi X, Seelig G, Ding F, Tong L, Buisson R, Shi Y.
articles.abstract: Pre-mRNA 3' processing is an integral step in mRNA biogenesis. However, where this process occurs in the nucleus remains unknown. Here, we demonstrate that nuclear speckles (NSs), membraneless organelles enriched with splicing factors, are major sites for pre-mRNA 3' processing in human cells. We show that the essential pre-mRNA 3' processing factor retinoblastoma-binding protein 6 (RBBP6) associates strongly with NSs via its C-terminal intrinsically disordered region (IDR). Importantly, although the conserved N-terminal domain (NTD) of RBBP6 is sufficient for pre-mRNA 3' processing in vitro, its IDR-mediated association with NSs is required for efficient pre-mRNA 3' processing in cells. Through proximity labeling analyses, we provide evidence that pre-mRNA 3' processing for over 50% of genes occurs near NSs. We propose that NSs serve as hubs for RNA polymerase II transcription, pre-mRNA splicing, and 3' processing, thereby enhancing the efficiency and coordination of different gene expression steps.
articles.abstractZh: 前 mRNA 3' 加工是 mRNA 生物发生中不可或缺的步骤。然而，这个过程在细胞核中发生的位置仍然未知。在这里，我们证明核斑点（NS），富含剪接因子的无膜细胞器，是人类细胞中前 mRNA 3' 加工的主要位点。我们发现必需的前 mRNA 3' 加工因子视网膜母细胞瘤结合蛋白 6 (RBBP6) 通过其 C 端固有无序区域 (IDR) 与 NS 密切相关。重要的是，尽管 RBBP6 的保守 N 端结构域 (NTD) 足以在体外进行前 mRNA 3' 加工，但其 IDR 介导的与 NS 的关联是细胞中有效的前 mRNA 3' 加工所必需的。通过邻近标记分析，我们提供的证据表明，超过 50% 的基因的前 mRNA 3' 处理发生在 NS 附近。我们建议 NS 作为 RNA 聚合酶 II 转录、前 mRNA 剪接和 3' 加工的枢纽，从而提高不同基因表达步骤的效率和协调。

articles.title: Structure and catalytic mechanism of exogenous fatty acid recycling by AasS, a versatile acyl-ACP synthetase.
articles.titleZh: AasS（一种多功能酰基-ACP 合成酶）回收外源脂肪酸的结构和催化机制。
articles.authors: Huang H, Wang C, Chang S, Cui T, Xu Y, Huang M, Zhang H, Zhou C, Zhang X, Feng Y.
articles.abstract: Fatty acids (FAs) are essential building blocks for all the domains of life, of which bacterial de novo synthesis, called type II FA synthesis (FAS II), is energetically expensive. The recycling of exogenous FAs (eFAs) partially relieves the FAS II demand and, therefore, compromises the efficacy of FAS II-directed antimicrobials. The versatile acyl-acyl carrier protein (ACP) synthetase, AasS, enables bacterial channeling of diverse eFA nutrients through holo-ACP, an activated form of ACP. However, the molecular mechanism for AasS catalysis is not fully understood. Here we report a series of cryo-electron microscopy structures of AasS from the bioluminescent bacterium Vibrio harveyi to provide insights into the catalytic cycle. AasS forms a ring-shaped hexamer, with each protomer folding into two distinct domains. Biochemical and structural analysis suggests that AasS accommodates distinct eFA substrates and the conserved W230 residue has a gating role. Adenosine triphosphate and Mg2+ binding converts the AasS hexamer to a tetramer, which is likely needed for the acyl adenylate intermediate formation. Afterward, AasS reverts to the hexamer conformation in adaption to acyl-ACP production. The complete landscape for eFA scavenging lays a foundation for exploiting the versatility of AasS in biopharmaceuticals.
articles.abstractZh: 脂肪酸 (FA) 是所有生命领域的重要组成部分，其中细菌从头合成，称为 II 型 FA 合成 (FAS II)，其能量消耗非常昂贵。外源 FA (eFA) 的回收部分缓解了 FAS II 的需求，因此损害了 FAS II 定向抗菌药物的功效。多功能酰基-酰基载体蛋白 (ACP) 合成酶 AasS 使细菌能够通过 Holo-ACP（ACP 的一种激活形式）输送多种 eFA 营养物质。然而，AasS 催化的分子机制尚不完全清楚。在这里，我们报告了一系列来自生物发光细菌哈维弧菌的 AasS 的冷冻电子显微镜结构，以提供对催化循环的见解。 AasS 形成环形六聚体，每个原聚体折叠成两个不同的域。生化和结构分析表明，AasS 可容纳不同的 eFA 底物，而保守的 W230 残基具有门控作用。三磷酸腺苷和 Mg2+ 结合将 AasS 六聚体转化为四聚体，这可能是酰基腺苷酸中间体形成所必需的。之后，AasS 恢复为六聚体构象以适应酰基-ACP 产物

articles.title: Tat-fimbriae ("tafi"): An unusual type of haloarchaeal surface structure depending on the twin-arginine translocation pathway.
articles.titleZh: Tat-fimbriae（“tafi”）：一种不寻常的盐古菌表面结构，取决于双精氨酸易位途径。
articles.authors: Galeva AV, Zhao D, Syutkin AS, Topilina MY, Shchyogolev SY, Pavlova EY, Selivanova OM, Kireev II, Surin AK, Burygin GL, Liu J, Xiang H, Pyatibratov MG.
articles.abstract: The surface structures of archaeal cells, many of which exist at high temperatures, high salinity, and non-physiological pH, are key factors for their adaptation to extreme living conditions. In the haloarchaeon Haloarcula hispanica, we have discovered a thin filamentous surface appendage called tat-fimbriae ("tafi"), which were identified to be composed of three protein subunits, TafA, TafC, and TafE, among which TafA is the major fimbrial subunit. Molecular genetic evidence demonstrates TafA was transported through the twin-arginine translocation pathway (Tat-pathway). Based on protein structure prediction (including AlphaFold 3), tafi exhibits a linear structure: TafC at the tip, TafE acting as an adapter, TafA forming the core filament, and they link the fourth subunit TafF, anchoring tafi to the cell wall. To our knowledge, this is the first case that the Tat-pathway has been linked to the secretion of protein subunits forming prokaryotic filamentous structures.
articles.abstractZh: 古细菌细胞的表面结构，其中许多存在于高温、高盐度和非生理pH值下，是其适应极端生活条件的关键因素。在haloarchaeon Haloarcula hispanica中，我们发现了一种细丝状表面附属物，称为tat-fimbriae（“tafi”），其被鉴定由TafA、TafC和TafE三个蛋白质亚基组成，其中TafA是主要的菌毛亚基。分子遗传学证据表明 TafA 通过双精氨酸易位途径（Tat 途径）转运。根据蛋白质结构预测（包括AlphaFold 3），tafi呈现出线性结构：TafC位于尖端，TafE充当适配器，TafA形成核心丝，它们连接第四个亚基TafF，将tafi锚定在细胞壁上。据我们所知，这是Tat途径与形成原核丝状结构的蛋白质亚基的分泌相关的第一个案例。

articles.title: ERK activation dynamics in maturing oocyte controls embryonic nuclear divisions in Caenorhabditis elegans.
articles.titleZh: 成熟卵母细胞中的 ERK 激活动态控制着秀丽隐杆线虫的胚胎核分裂。
articles.authors: Baek HB, Das D, Chen SY, Li H, Arur S.
articles.abstract: ERK activity oscillates between sustained activation during oocyte formation and transient inactivation during oocyte maturation, fertilization, and early embryogenesis. Consequences of ectopic ERK activity upon oocyte maturation and in early embryogenesis are unknown. We show, in Caenorhabditis elegans, that ectopic ERK activity upon oocyte maturation (metaphase I oocytes) results in embryos with abnormalities in nuclear divisions leading to embryonic death. We uncover that ERK directly phosphorylates Polo-like kinase I (PLK-1), on Serine 404, to inhibit nuclear envelope breakdown (NEBD) in early embryogenesis. The RAS/ERK/PLK-1 pathway poisons zygotic NEBD and inhibits the merging of parental genomes, underlining the importance of turning off ERK prior to embryogenesis. Given the conserved nature of both ERK signaling to oocyte development and PLK1 to embryonic divisions, this work has implications for women undergoing in vitro fertilization (IVF) where ectopic ERK activation during superovulation through hormonal stimulation may diminish oocyte quality and influence zygotic development.
articles.abstractZh: ERK 活性在卵母细胞形成期间的持续激活和卵母细胞成熟、受精和早期胚胎发生期间的短暂失活之间振荡。异位 ERK 活性对卵母细胞成熟和早期胚胎发生的影响尚不清楚。我们发现，在秀丽隐杆线虫中，卵母细胞成熟（中期 I 卵母细胞）时的异位 ERK 活性会导致胚胎核分裂异常，从而导致胚胎死亡。我们发现 ERK 直接磷酸化丝氨酸 404 上的 Polo 样激酶 I (PLK-1)，以抑制早期胚胎发生中的核膜破裂 (NEBD)。 RAS/ERK/PLK-1 途径毒害合子 NEBD 并抑制亲本基因组的合并，强调了在胚胎发生前关闭 ERK 的重要性。鉴于卵母细胞发育的 ERK 信号传导和胚胎分裂的 PLK1 信号传导的保守性，这项工作对接受体外受精 (IVF) 的女性具有重要意义，因为在超排卵过程中通过激素刺激异位 ERK 激活可能会降低卵母细胞质量并影响合子发育。

articles.title: Exploring phytochemicals and their pharmacological applications from ethnomedicinal plants: A focus on Lycium barbarum, Solanacea.
articles.titleZh: 探索民族药用植物的植物化学物质及其药理应用：重点关注枸杞、茄科植物。
articles.authors: Baimakhanova B, Sadanov A, Bogoyavlenskiy A, Berezin V, Trenozhnikova L, Baimakhanova G, Ibraimov A, Serikbayeva E, Arystanov Z, Arystanova T, Nazakat R, Khammetova A, Seitimova G, Turgumbayeva A.
articles.abstract: Lycium barbarum is a species commonly utilized in dietary supplements and natural healthcare products. Lycium barbarum also referred to as wolfberry or goji berry, are predominantly found in China, Japan, Korea, and North America. Lycium barbarum has a lengthy history as a medicinal and functional food. Recent studies showcasing their exceptional bioac-tive properties have led to an increase in their cultivation and popularity worldwide. Lycium barbarum have been recognized as a valuable source of functional ingredients with promising applications in the food and medical sectors. Lycium barbarum are rich in phytochemical compounds such as polysaccharides, carotenoids, organic acids, carbohydrates (fructose and glucose), phenolic compounds (such as phenolic acids and flavonoids), and vitamins (ascorbic acid). Various biological activities, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, prebiotic, neuroprotective, antidiabetic, and gastroprotective effects, have linked to their consumption. The purpose of this review is to provide a comprehensive overview of the phytochemical components as well as the biological active properties of Lycium barbarum.
articles.abstractZh: 枸杞是一种常用于膳食补充剂和天然保健产品的物种。枸杞也称为枸杞或枸杞，主要产于中国、日本、韩国和北美。枸杞作为药用和功能食品有着悠久的历史。最近的研究显示了其卓越的生物活性，导致其在全球范围内的种植和普及有所增加。枸杞已被认为是功能性成分的宝贵来源，在食品和医疗领域具有广阔的应用前景。枸杞富含植物化学成分，如多糖、类胡萝卜素、有机酸、碳水化合物（果糖和葡萄糖）、酚类化合物（如酚酸和类黄酮）和维生素（抗坏血酸）。各种生物活性，包括抗菌、抗炎、益生元、神经保护、抗糖尿病和胃保护作用，都与它们的食用有关。本综述的目的是全面概述枸杞的植物化学成分以及生物活性特性。

articles.title: IL-21 shapes the B cell response in a context-dependent manner.
articles.titleZh: IL-21 以环境依赖性方式影响 B 细胞反应。
articles.authors: Kim Y, Manara F, Grassmann S, Belcheva KT, Reyes K, Kim H, Downs-Canner S, Yewdell WT, Sun JC, Chaudhuri J.
articles.abstract: The T-cell-derived cytokine IL-21 is crucial for germinal center (GC) responses, but its precise role in B cell function has remained elusive. Using IL-21 receptor (Il21r) conditional knockout mice and ex vivo culture systems, we demonstrate that IL-21 has dual effects on B cells. While IL-21 induced apoptosis in a STAT3-dependent manner in naive B cells, it promoted the robust proliferation of pre-activated B cells, particularly IgG1+ B cells. In vivo, B-cell-specific Il21r deletion impaired IgG1 responses post-immunization and disrupted progression from pre-GC to GC states. Although Il21r deficiency did not affect the proportion of IgG1+ cells among GC B cells, it greatly diminished the proportion of IgG1+ cells among the plasmablast/plasma cell population. Collectively, our findings suggest that IL-21 serves as a critical regulator of B cell fates, influencing B cell apoptosis and proliferation in a context-dependent manner.
articles.abstractZh: T 细胞衍生的细胞因子 IL-21 对于生发中心 (GC) 反应至关重要，但其在 B 细胞功能中的确切作用仍然难以捉摸。使用 IL-21 受体 (Il21r) 条件敲除小鼠和离体培养系统，我们证明 IL-21 对 B 细胞具有双重作用。虽然 IL-21 以 STAT3 依赖性方式诱导初始 B 细胞凋亡，但它促进了预激活 B 细胞（尤其是 IgG1+ B 细胞）的强劲增殖。在体内，B 细胞特异性 Il21r 缺失会损害免疫后的 IgG1 反应，并破坏从 GC 前状态到 GC 状态的进展。尽管Il21r缺陷并不影响GC B细胞中IgG1+细胞的比例，但它大大减少了浆母细胞/浆细胞群中IgG1+细胞的比例。总的来说，我们的研究结果表明 IL-21 是 B 细胞命运的关键调节因子，以环境依赖性方式影响 B 细胞凋亡和增殖。

articles.title: Quantitative RNA pseudouridine maps reveal multilayered translation control through plant rRNA, tRNA and mRNA pseudouridylation.
articles.titleZh: 定量 RNA 假尿苷图谱揭示了通过植物 rRNA、tRNA 和 mRNA 假尿苷化的多层翻译控制。
articles.authors: Li H, Wang G, Ye C, Zou Z, Jiang B, Yang F, He K, Ju C, Zhang L, Gao B, Liu S, Chen Y, Zhang J, He C.
articles.abstract: Pseudouridine (Ψ) is the most abundant RNA modification, yet studies of Ψ have been hindered by a lack of robust methods to profile comprehensive Ψ maps. Here we utilize bisulfite-induced deletion sequencing to generate transcriptome-wide Ψ maps at single-base resolution across various plant species. Integrating ribosomal RNA, transfer RNA and messenger RNA Ψ stoichiometry with mRNA abundance and polysome profiling data, we uncover a multilayered regulation of translation efficiency through Ψ modifications. rRNA pseudouridylation could globally control translation, although the effects vary at different rRNA Ψ sites. Ψ in the tRNA T-arm loop shows strong positive correlations between Ψ stoichiometry and the translation efficiency of their respective codons. We observed a general inverse correlation between Ψ level and mRNA stability, but a positive correlation with translation efficiency in Arabidopsis seedlings. In conclusion, our study provides critical resources for Ψ research in plants and proposes prevalent translation regulation through rRNA, tRNA and mRNA pseudouridylation.
articles.abstractZh: 假尿苷 (Ψ) 是最丰富的 RNA 修饰，但由于缺乏稳健的方法来分析全面的 Ψ 图谱，对 Ψ 的研究受到了阻碍。在这里，我们利用亚硫酸氢盐诱导的缺失测序来生成跨不同植物物种的单碱基分辨率的全转录组 Ψ 图谱。将核糖体 RNA、转移 RNA 和信使 RNA Ψ 化学计量与 mRNA 丰度和多核糖体分析数据相结合，我们发现了通过 Ψ 修饰对翻译效率的多层调控。 rRNA 假尿苷化可以全局控制翻译，尽管不同 rRNA Ψ 位点的效果有所不同。 tRNA T 臂环中的 Ψ 显示 Ψ 化学计量与其各自密码子的翻译效率之间呈强正相关。我们观察到拟南芥幼苗中 Ψ 水平与 mRNA 稳定性之间一般呈负相关，但与翻译效率呈正相关。总之，我们的研究为植物 Ψ 研究提供了关键资源，并提出了通过 rRNA、tRNA 和 mRNA 假尿苷化进行普遍的翻译调控。

articles.title: TDP43 autoregulation gives rise to dominant negative isoforms that are tightly controlled by transcriptional and post-translational mechanisms.
articles.titleZh: TDP43 的自动调节会产生受转录和翻译后机制严格控制的显性负亚型。
articles.authors: Dykstra MM, Weskamp K, Gómez NB, Waksmacki J, Tank E, Glineburg MR, Snyder A, Pinarbasi E, Bekier M, Li X, Miller MR, Bai J, Shahzad S, Nedumaran N, Wieland C, Stewart C, Willey S, Grotewold N, McBride J, Moran JJ, Suryakumar AV, Lucas M, Tessier PM, Ward M, Todd PK, Barmada SJ.
articles.abstract: The nuclear RNA-binding protein TDP43 is integrally involved in the pathogenesis of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD). Previous studies uncovered N-terminal TDP43 isoforms that are predominantly cytosolic in localization, prone to aggregation, and enriched in susceptible spinal motor neurons. In healthy cells, however, these shortened (s)TDP43 isoforms are difficult to detect in comparison to full-length (fl)TDP43, raising questions regarding their origin and selective regulation. Here, we show that sTDP43 is created as a by-product of TDP43 autoregulation and cleared by nonsense-mediated RNA decay (NMD). sTDP43-encoding transcripts that escape NMD are rapidly degraded post-translationally via the proteasome and macroautophagy. Circumventing these regulatory mechanisms by overexpressing sTDP43 results in neurodegeneration via N-terminal oligomerization and impairment of flTDP43 splicing activity, in addition to RNA-binding-dependent gain-of-function toxicity. Collectively, these studies highlight endogenous mechanisms that tightly regulate sTDP43 expression and underscore the consequences of aberrant sTDP43 accumulation in disease.
articles.abstractZh: 核RNA结合蛋白TDP43整体参与肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）和额颞叶变性（FTLD）的发病机制。先前的研究发现，N 端 TDP43 亚型主要定位于胞质中，易于聚集，并在易受影响的脊髓运动神经元中富集。然而，在健康细胞中，与全长 (fl)TDP43 相比，这些缩短的 (s)TDP43 亚型很难检测到，这引发了有关其起源和选择性调控的问题。在这里，我们证明 sTDP43 是作为 TDP43 自动调节的副产品产生的，并通过无义介导的 RNA 衰变 (NMD) 清除。逃避 NMD 的 sTDP43 编码转录物在翻译后通过蛋白酶体和巨自噬快速降解。通过过度表达 sTDP43 来规避这些调节机制，除了 RNA 结合依赖性功能获得毒性之外，还会通过 N 端寡聚化和 flTDP43 剪接活性受损导致神经变性。总的来说，这些研究强调了严格调节 sTDP43 表达的内源性机制，并强调了疾病中异常 sTDP43 积累的后果。

articles.title: Transcription factor networks in cellular quiescence.
articles.titleZh: 细胞静止中的转录因子网络。
articles.authors: Mitra M, Batista SL, Coller HA.
articles.abstract: Many of the cells in mammalian tissues are in a reversible quiescent state; they are not dividing, but retain the ability to proliferate in response to extracellular signals. Quiescence relies on the activities of transcription factors (TFs) that orchestrate the repression of genes that promote proliferation and establish a quiescence-specific gene expression program. Here we discuss how the coordinated activities of TFs in different quiescent stem cells and differentiated cells maintain reversible cell cycle arrest and establish cell-protective signalling pathways. We further cover the emerging mechanisms governing the dysregulation of quiescence TF networks with age. We explore how recent developments in single-cell technologies have enhanced our understanding of quiescence heterogeneity and gene regulatory networks. We further discuss how TFs and their activities are themselves regulated at the RNA, protein and chromatin levels. Finally, we summarize the challenges associated with defining TF networks in quiescent cells.
articles.abstractZh: 哺乳动物组织中的许多细胞都处于可逆的静止状态。它们不分裂，但保留响应细胞外信号而增殖的能力。静止依赖于转录因子（TF）的活动，转录因子协调抑制促进增殖的基因并建立静止特异性基因表达程序。在这里，我们讨论不同静止干细胞和分化细胞中转录因子的协调活动如何维持可逆的细胞周期停滞并建立细胞保护信号通路。我们进一步讨论了随着年龄的增长，控制静止转录因子网络失调的新兴机制。我们探讨单细胞技术的最新发展如何增强我们对静止异质性和基因调控网络的理解。我们进一步讨论转录因子及其活性本身如何在 RNA、蛋白质和染色质水平上受到调节。最后，我们总结了与在静态细胞中定义 TF 网络相关的挑战。

articles.title: A mechanistic overview on green assisted formulation of nanocomposites and their multifunctional role in biomedical applications.
articles.titleZh: 纳米复合材料绿色辅助配方及其在生物医学应用中的多功能作用的机理概述。
articles.authors: Mahnoor, Malik K, Kazmi A, Sultana T, Raja NI, Bibi Y, Abbas M, Badruddin IA, Ali MM, Bashir MN.
articles.abstract: The importance of nanocomposites constantly attains attention because of their unique properties all across the fields especially in medical perspectives. The study of green-synthesized nanocomposites has grown to be extremely fascinating in the field of research. Nanocomposites are more promising than mono-metallic nanoparticles because they exhibit synergistic effects. This review encapsulates the current development in the formulation of plant-mediated nanocomposites by using several plant species and the impact of secondary metabolites on their biocompatible functioning. Phyto-synthesis produces diverse nanomaterials with biocompatibility, environment-friendliness, and in vivo actions, characterized by varying sizes, shapes, and biochemical nature. This process is advantageous to conventional physical and chemical procedures. New studies have been conducted to determine the biomedical efficacy of nanocomposites against various diseases. Unfortunately, there has been inadequate investigation into green-assisted nanocomposites. Incorporating phytosynthesized nanocomposites in therapeutic interventions not only enhances healing processes but also augments the host's immune defenses against infections. This review highlights the phytosynthesis of nanocomposites and their various biomedical applications, including antibacterial, antidiabetic, antiviral, antioxidant, antifungal, anti-cancer, and other applications, as well as their toxicity. This review also explores the mechanistic action of nanocomposites to achieve their designated tasks. Biogenic nanocomposites for multimodal imaging have the potential to exchange the conventional methods and materials in biomedical research. Well-designed nanocomposites have the potential to be utilized in various biomedical fields as innovative theranostic agents with the subsequent objective of efficiently diagnosing and treating a variety of human disorders.
articles.abstractZh: 纳米复合材料的重要性因其独特的性能而不断受到关注，尤其是在医学领域。绿色合成纳米复合材料的研究在研究领域已经变得非常令人着迷。纳米复合材料比单金属纳米粒子更有前景，因为它们表现出协同效应。这篇综述概括了目前通过使用几种植物物种来配制植物介导的纳米复合材料的进展，以及次生代谢产物对其生物相容性功能的影响。植物合成可产生具有生物相容性、环境友好性和体内作用的多种纳米材料，其特征在于不同的尺寸、形状和生化性质。该方法优于传统的物理和化学方法。已经进行了新的研究来确定纳米复合材料针对各种疾病的生物医学功效。不幸的是，对绿色辅助纳米复合材料的研究还不够。将植物合成的纳米复合材料纳入治疗干预措施不仅可以增强愈合过程，还可以增强宿主的免疫防御

articles.title: Cellular and organismal function of choline metabolism.
articles.titleZh: 胆碱代谢的细胞和有机体功能。
articles.authors: Kenny TC, Scharenberg S, Abu-Remaileh M, Birsoy K.
articles.abstract: Choline is an essential micronutrient critical for cellular and organismal homeostasis. As a core component of phospholipids and sphingolipids, it is indispensable for membrane architecture and function. Additionally, choline is a precursor for acetylcholine, a key neurotransmitter, and betaine, a methyl donor important for epigenetic regulation. Consistent with its pleiotropic role in cellular physiology, choline metabolism contributes to numerous developmental and physiological processes in the brain, liver, kidney, lung and immune system, and both choline deficiency and excess are implicated in human disease. Mutations in the genes encoding choline metabolism proteins lead to inborn errors of metabolism, which manifest in diverse clinical pathologies. While the identities of many enzymes involved in choline metabolism were identified decades ago, only recently has the field begun to understand the diverse mechanisms by which choline availability is regulated and fuelled via metabolite transport/recycling and nutrient acquisition. This review provides a comprehensive overview of choline metabolism, emphasizing emerging concepts and their implications for human health and disease.
articles.abstractZh: 胆碱是一种对细胞和机体稳态至关重要的必需微量营养素。作为磷脂和鞘脂的核心成分，它对于膜的结构和功能是不可或缺的。此外，胆碱是乙酰胆碱（一种关键的神经递质）和甜菜碱（对表观遗传调节很重要的甲基供体）的前体。与其在细胞生理学中的多效作用相一致，胆碱代谢有助于脑、肝、肾、肺和免疫系统中的许多发育和生理过程，胆碱缺乏和过量都与人类疾病有关。编码胆碱代谢蛋白的基因突变会导致先天性代谢错误，表现为多种临床病理。虽然数十年前就已经确定了参与胆碱代谢的许多酶的特性，但直到最近，该领域才开始了解通过代谢物运输/回收和营养获取来调节和促进胆碱可用性的多种机制。本综述对胆碱代谢进行了全面概述，强调了新兴概念及其对人类健康和疾病的影响。

articles.title: Human TRMT1 and TRMT1L paralogs ensure the proper modification state, stability, and function of tRNAs.
articles.titleZh: 人类 TRMT1 和 TRMT1L 旁系同源物确保 tRNA 的正确修饰状态、稳定性和功能。
articles.authors: Zhang K, Manning AC, Lentini JM, Howard J, Dalwigk F, Maroofian R, Efthymiou S, Chan P, Eliseev SI, Yang Z, Chang H, Karimiani EG, Bakhshoodeh B, Houlden H, Kaiser SM, Lowe TM, Fu D.
articles.abstract: The tRNA methyltransferase 1 (TRMT1) enzyme catalyzes the N2,N2-dimethylguanosine (m2,2G) modification in tRNAs. Intriguingly, vertebrates encode an additional tRNA methyltransferase 1-like (TRMT1L) paralog. Here, we use a comprehensive tRNA sequencing approach to decipher targets of human TRMT1 and TRMT1L. We find that TRMT1 methylates all known tRNAs containing guanosine at position 26, while TRMT1L represents the elusive enzyme catalyzing m2,2G at position 27 in tyrosine tRNAs. Surprisingly, TRMT1L is also necessary for maintaining 3-(3-amino-3-carboxypropyl)uridine (acp3U) modifications in a subset of tRNAs through a process that can be uncoupled from methyltransferase activity. We also demonstrate that tyrosine and serine tRNAs are dependent upon m2,2G modifications for their stability and function in translation. Notably, human patient cells with disease-associated TRMT1 variants exhibit reduced levels of tyrosine and serine tRNAs. These findings uncover unexpected roles for TRMT1 paralogs, decipher functions for m2,2G modifications, and pinpoint tRNAs dysregulated in human disorders caused by tRNA modification deficiency.
articles.abstractZh: tRNA 甲基转移酶 1 (TRMT1) 催化 tRNA 中的 N2,N2-二甲基鸟苷 (m2,2G) 修饰。有趣的是，脊椎动物编码一个额外的 tRNA 甲基转移酶 1 样 (TRMT1L) 旁系同源物。在这里，我们使用全面的 tRNA 测序方法来破译人类 TRMT1 和 TRMT1L 的靶标。我们发现 TRMT1 甲基化所有已知的 26 位含有鸟苷的 tRNA，而 TRMT1L 代表酪氨酸 tRNA 中 27 位催化 m2,2G 的难以捉摸的酶。令人惊讶的是，TRMT1L 对于通过与甲基转移酶活性脱钩的过程维持 tRNA 子集中的 3-(3-氨基-3-羧丙基)尿苷 (acp3U) 修饰也是必需的。我们还证明酪氨酸和丝氨酸 tRNA 的稳定性和翻译功能依赖于 m2,2G 修饰。值得注意的是，具有与疾病相关的 TRMT1 变异的人类患者细胞表现出酪氨酸和丝氨酸 tRNA 水平降低。这些发现揭示了 TRMT1 旁系同源物的意想不到的作用，破译了 m2、2G 修饰的功能，并查明了 tRNA 在由 tRNA 修饰缺陷引起的人类疾病中失调。

articles.title: Impact of trace metal supplementation on anaerobic biological methanation under hydrogen and carbon dioxide starvation.
articles.titleZh: 微量金属补充对氢气和二氧化碳饥饿下厌氧生物甲烷化的影响。
articles.authors: Ghiotto G, De Bernardini N, Orellana E, Fiorito G, Cenci L, Kougias PG, Campanaro S, Treu L.
articles.abstract: Biomethanation is a crucial process occurring in natural and engineered systems which can reduce carbon dioxide to methane impacting the global carbon cycle. However, little is known about the effect of on-and-off gaseous provision and micronutrients on bioconversion. Here, anaerobic microbiomes underwent intermittent feeding with incremental starvations and selective metal supplementation to assess the impact of hydrogen and carbon dioxide availability on microbial physiology. Resilience was tested under differential cultivations in basal medium supplemented with either nickel or cobalt. Nickel-augmented cultures exhibited faster recovery upon starvation, suggesting a beneficial effect. Dominant Methanothermobacter thermautotrophicus demonstrated robust growth, genetic stability and transcriptional downregulation when starved. Conversely, bacteria were plastic and prone to genetic fluctuations, accumulating mutations on genes encoding for ABC-transporters and C-metabolism enzymes. This study pioneers cellular resilience and response to micronutrient supplementation in anaerobic carbon dioxide-fixating microbiomes, offering valuable insights into microbial activity recovery after carbon and electron donor deprivation.
articles.abstractZh: 生物甲烷化是自然和工程系统中发生的一个关键过程，可以将二氧化碳还原为甲烷，从而影响全球碳循环。然而，人们对断断续续的气体供应和微量营养素对生物转化的影响知之甚少。在这里，厌氧微生物群经历了间歇性喂养，并逐渐增加饥饿和选择性金属补充，以评估氢气和二氧化碳的可用性对微生物生理学的影响。在补充有镍或钴的基础培养基中的差异培养下测试了弹性。镍增强的培养物在饥饿时表现出更快的恢复，表明其具有有益的作用。显性的嗜热甲烷嗜热杆菌在饥饿时表现出强劲的生长、遗传稳定性和转录下调。相反，细菌具有可塑性，容易发生遗传波动，编码 ABC 转运蛋白和 C 代谢酶的基因突变不断累积。这项研究开创了厌氧二氧化碳固定微生物组中细胞的弹性和对微量营养素补充的反应，为微生物活动恢复提供了宝贵的见解。

articles.title: Ribosome customization and functional diversification among P-stalk proteins regulate late poxvirus protein synthesis.
articles.titleZh: P-茎蛋白的核糖体定制和功能多样化调节晚期痘病毒蛋白合成。
articles.authors: Khalatyan N, Cornish D, Ferrell AJ, Savas JN, Shen PS, Hultquist JF, Walsh D.
articles.abstract: Growing evidence suggests that ribosomes selectively regulate translation of specific mRNA subsets. Here, quantitative proteomics and cryoelectron microscopy demonstrate that poxvirus infection does not alter ribosomal subunit protein (RP) composition but skews 40S rotation states and displaces the 40S head domain. Genetic knockout screens employing metabolic assays and a dual-reporter virus further identified two RPs that selectively regulate non-canonical translation of late poxvirus mRNAs, which contain unusual 5' poly(A) leaders: receptor of activated C kinase 1 (RACK1) and RPLP2. RACK1 is a component of the altered 40S head domain, while RPLP2 is a subunit of the P-stalk, wherein RPLP0 anchors two heterodimers of RPLP1 and RPLP2 to the large 60S subunit. RPLP0 was required for global translation, yet RPLP1 was dispensable, while RPLP2 was specifically required for non-canonical poxvirus protein synthesis. From these combined results, we demonstrate that poxviruses structurally customize ribosomes and become reliant upon traditionally non-essential RPs from both ribosomal subunits for efficient initiation on their late mRNAs.
articles.abstractZh: 越来越多的证据表明核糖体选择性地调节特定 mRNA 子集的翻译。在这里，定量蛋白质组学和冷冻电子显微镜证明，痘病毒感染不会改变核糖体亚基蛋白 (RP) 的组成，但会扭曲 40S 旋转状态并置换 40S 头结构域。采用代谢测定和双报告病毒的基因敲除筛选进一步鉴定了两种选择性调节晚期痘病毒 mRNA 的非规范翻译的 RP，其中包含不寻常的 5' Poly(A) 前导序列：活化 C 激酶 1 (RACK1) 的受体和 RPLP2。 RACK1是改变的40S头结构域的组成部分，而RPLP2是P-茎的亚基，其中RPLP0将RPLP1和RPLP2的两个异二聚体锚定至大60S亚基。 RPLP0是全局翻译所必需的，而RPLP1是可有可无的，而RPLP2是非典型痘病毒蛋白合成所特别需要的。从这些综合结果中，我们证明痘病毒在结构上定制核糖体，并依赖于来自两个核糖体亚基的传统非必需 RP 来有效启动其晚期 mRNA。

articles.title: Streptomyces secretes a siderophore that sensitizes competitor bacteria to phage infection.
articles.titleZh: 链霉菌分泌一种铁载体，使竞争细菌对噬菌体感染敏感。
articles.authors: Zang Z, Zhang C, Park KJ, Schwartz DA, Podicheti R, Lennon JT, Gerdt JP.
articles.abstract: To overtake competitors, microbes produce and secrete secondary metabolites that kill neighbouring cells and sequester nutrients. This metabolite-mediated competition probably evolved in complex microbial communities in the presence of viral pathogens. We therefore hypothesized that microbes secrete natural products that make competitors sensitive to phage infection. We used a binary-interaction screen and chemical characterization to identify a secondary metabolite (coelichelin) produced by Streptomyces sp. that sensitizes its soil competitor Bacillus subtilis to phage infection in vitro. The siderophore coelichelin sensitized B. subtilis to a panel of lytic phages (SPO1, SP10, SP50, Goe2) via iron sequestration, which prevented the activation of B. subtilis Spo0A, the master regulator of the stationary phase and sporulation. Metabolomics analysis revealed that other bacterial natural products may also provide phage-mediated competitive advantages to their producers. Overall, this work reveals that synergy between natural products and phages can shape the outcomes of competition between microbes.
articles.abstractZh: 为了超越竞争对手，微生物会产生并分泌次级代谢产物，杀死邻近的细胞并隔离营养。这种代谢物介导的竞争可能是在存在病毒病原体的复杂微生物群落中进化的。因此，我们假设微生物分泌天然产物，使竞争对手对噬菌体感染敏感。我们使用二元相互作用筛选和化学表征来鉴定链霉菌产生的次级代谢产物（coelichelin）。使其土壤竞争对手枯草芽孢杆菌在体外对噬菌体感染敏感。铁载体天蓝藻素通过铁螯合使枯草芽孢杆菌对一组裂解噬菌体（SPO1、SP10、SP50、Goe2）敏感，从而阻止枯草芽孢杆菌 Spo0A（稳定期和孢子形成的主要调节剂）的激活。代谢组学分析表明，其他细菌天然产物也可能为其生产者提供噬菌体介导的竞争优势。总的来说，这项工作揭示了天然产物和噬菌体之间的协同作用可以塑造微生物之间的竞争结果。

articles.title: Triacylglycerol mobilization underpins mitochondrial stress recovery.
articles.titleZh: 三酰甘油动员支持线粒体应激恢复。
