articles.abstractZh: 单克隆抗体 (Abs) 以类似于 T 细胞受体 (TCR) 的方式识别主要组织相容性复合物 (MHC) 呈递的肿瘤抗原，具有作为癌症免疫治疗的巨大潜力。然而，“TCR 模拟”(TCRm) Ab 的分离非常费力，因为 Ab 尚未进化出 αβ-TCR 的结构细微的肽-MHC 限制。在这里，我们提出了一种快速分离高度肽特异性和“MHC 限制性”抗体的策略，通过重新设计预选的抗体，以与传统 αβ-TCR 结构相似的方式与肽-MHC 结合。我们创建了基于结构的文库，重点关注 TCRm Ab 互补决定区 (CDR) 环的肽相互作用残基，并快速生成针对小鼠和人类肿瘤抗原的 MHC 限制性抗体，这些抗体在格式化为 IgG、双特异性 T 细胞接合器 (BiTE) 和嵌合抗原受体 T (CAR-T) 时特异性杀死靶细胞。对一种选定的 pMHC 限制性抗体的晶体分析揭示了高度肽特异性识别，验证了工程策略。这种方法可以在几周内产生肿瘤抗原特异性抗体，从而有可能实现快速临床转化。

articles.title: HOP co-chaperones contribute to GA signaling by promoting the accumulation of the F-box protein SNE in Arabidopsis.
articles.titleZh: HOP 共伴侣通过促进拟南芥中 F-box 蛋白 SNE 的积累来促进 GA 信号传导。
articles.authors: Mangano S, Muñoz A, Fernández-Calvino L, Castellano MM.
articles.abstract: Gibberellins (GAs) play important roles in multiple developmental processes and in plant response to the environment. Within the GA pathway, a central regulatory step relies on GA-dependent degradation of the DELLA transcriptional regulators. Nevertheless, the relevance of the stability of other key proteins in this pathway, such as SLY1 and SNE (the F-box proteins involved in DELLA degradation), remains unknown. Here, we take advantage of mutants in the HSP70-HSP90 organizing protein (HOP) co-chaperones and reveal that these proteins contribute to the accumulation of SNE in Arabidopsis. Indeed, HOP proteins, along with HSP90 and HSP70, interact in vivo with SNE, and SNE accumulation is significantly reduced in the hop mutants. Concomitantly, greater accumulation of the DELLA protein RGA is observed in these plants. In agreement with these molecular phenotypes, hop mutants show a hypersensitive response to the GA inhibitor paclobutrazol and display a partial response to the ectopic addition of GA when GA-regulated processes are assayed. These mutants also display different phenotypes associated with alterations in the GA pathway, such as reduced germination rate, delayed bolting, and reduced hypocotyl elongation in response to warm temperatures. Remarkably, ectopic overexpression of SNE reverts the delay in germination and the thermally dependent hypocotyl elongation defect of the hop1 hop2 hop3 mutant, revealing that SNE accumulation is the key aspect of the hop mutant phenotypes. Together, these data reveal a pivotal role for HOP in SNE accumulation and GA signaling.
articles.abstractZh: 赤霉素 (GA) 在多种发育过程和植物对环境的反应中发挥着重要作用。在 GA 途径中，一个核心调控步骤依赖于 DELLA 转录调控因子的 GA 依赖性降解。然而，该途径中其他关键蛋白（例如 SLY1 和 SNE（参与 DELLA 降解的 F-box 蛋白））稳定性的相关性仍然未知。在这里，我们利用 HSP70-HSP90 组织蛋白 (HOP) 共伴侣中的突变体，揭示这些蛋白有助于拟南芥中 SNE 的积累。事实上，HOP 蛋白以及 HSP90 和 HSP70 在体内与 SNE 相互作用，并且啤酒花突变体中 SNE 的积累显着减少。与此同时，在这些植物中观察到 DELLA 蛋白 RGA 的积累量更大。与这些分子表型一致，啤酒花突变体对 GA 抑制剂多效唑表现出超敏反应，并且在分析 GA 调节过程时对 GA 的异位添加表现出部分反应。这些突变体还表现出与 GA 途径改变相关的不同表型，例如发芽率降低、抽苔延迟、

articles.title: Recording of cellular physiological histories along optically readable self-assembling protein chains.
articles.titleZh: 沿着光学可读的自组装蛋白质链记录细胞生理历史。
articles.authors: Linghu C, An B, Shpokayte M, Celiker OT, Shmoel N, Zhang R, Zhang C, Park D, Park WM, Ramirez S, Boyden ES.
articles.abstract: Observing cellular physiological histories is key to understanding normal and disease-related processes. Here we describe expression recording islands-a fully genetically encoded approach that enables both continual digital recording of biological information within cells and subsequent high-throughput readout in fixed cells. The information is stored in growing intracellular protein chains made of self-assembling subunits, human-designed filament-forming proteins bearing different epitope tags that each correspond to a different cellular state or function (for example, gene expression downstream of neural activity or pharmacological exposure), allowing the physiological history to be read out along the ordered subunits of protein chains with conventional optical microscopy. We use expression recording islands to record gene expression timecourse downstream of specific pharmacological and physiological stimuli in cultured neurons and in living mouse brain, with a time resolution of a fraction of a day, over periods of days to weeks.
articles.abstractZh: 观察细胞生理历史是了解正常和疾病相关过程的关键。在这里，我们描述了表达记录岛——一种完全基因编码的方法，可以连续数字记录细胞内的生物信息，并随后在固定细胞中进行高通量读出。这些信息存储在由自组装亚基组成的不断生长的细胞内蛋白链中，人类设计的丝状形成蛋白带有不同的表位标签，每个表位标签对应于不同的细胞状态或功能（例如，神经活动或药理暴露下游的基因表达），允许使用传统光学显微镜沿着蛋白链的有序亚基读出生理历史。我们使用表达记录岛来记录培养神经元和活体小鼠大脑中特定药理和生理刺激下游的基因表达时间进程，时间分辨率为一天的一小部分，持续数天到数周的时间。

articles.title: PGC-1α senses the CBC of pre-mRNA to dictate the fate of promoter-proximally paused RNAPII.
articles.titleZh: PGC-1α 感知前 mRNA 的 CBC，以决定启动子近端暂停的 RNAPII 的命运。
articles.authors: Rambout X, Cho H, Blanc R, Lyu Q, Miano JM, Chakkalakal JV, Nelson GM, Yalamanchili HK, Adelman K, Maquat LE.
articles.abstract: PGC-1α is well established as a metazoan transcriptional coactivator of cellular adaptation in response to stress. However, the mechanisms by which PGC-1α activates gene transcription are incompletely understood. Here, we report that PGC-1α serves as a scaffold protein that physically and functionally connects the DNA-binding protein estrogen-related receptor α (ERRα), cap-binding protein 80 (CBP80), and Mediator to overcome promoter-proximal pausing of RNAPII and transcriptionally activate stress-response genes. We show that PGC-1α promotes pausing release in a two-arm mechanism (1) by recruiting the positive transcription elongation factor b (P-TEFb) and (2) by outcompeting the premature transcription termination complex Integrator. Using mice homozygous for five amino acid changes in the CBP80-binding motif (CBM) of PGC-1α that destroy CBM function, we show that efficient differentiation of primary myoblasts to myofibers and timely skeletal muscle regeneration after injury require PGC-1α binding to CBP80. Our findings reveal how PGC-1α activates stress-response gene transcription in a previously unanticipated pre-mRNA quality-control pathway.
articles.abstractZh: PGC-1α 被认为是细胞应激反应的后生动物转录共激活因子。然而，PGC-1α 激活基因转录的机制尚不完全清楚。在此，我们报道 PGC-1α 作为支架蛋白，在物理和功能上连接 DNA 结合蛋白雌激素相关受体 α (ERRα)、帽结合蛋白 80 (CBP80) 和介体，以克服 RNAPII 的启动子近端暂停并转录激活应激反应基因。我们表明，PGC-1α 在双臂机制中促进暂停释放：(1) 通过招募正转录延伸因子 b (P-TEFb) 和 (2) 通过竞争过早的转录终止复合物整合子。使用 PGC-1α 的 CBP80 结合基序 (CBM) 中五个氨基酸发生改变的纯合小鼠，破坏 CBM 功能，我们发现初级成肌细胞有效分化为肌纤维以及损伤后及时的骨骼肌再生需要 PGC-1α 与 CBP80 结合。我们的研究结果揭示了 PGC-1α 如何在先前未预料到的前 mRNA 质量控制途径中激活应激反应基因转录。

articles.title: Phage therapy: From biological mechanisms to future directions.
articles.titleZh: 噬菌体疗法：从生物学机制到未来方向。
articles.authors: Strathdee SA, Hatfull GF, Mutalik VK, Schooley RT.
articles.abstract: Increasing antimicrobial resistance rates have revitalized bacteriophage (phage) research, the natural predators of bacteria discovered over 100 years ago. In order to use phages therapeutically, they should (1) preferably be lytic, (2) kill the bacterial host efficiently, and (3) be fully characterized to exclude side effects. Developing therapeutic phages takes a coordinated effort of multiple stakeholders. Herein, we review the state of the art in phage therapy, covering biological mechanisms, clinical applications, remaining challenges, and future directions involving naturally occurring and genetically modified or synthetic phages.
articles.abstractZh: 不断增加的抗菌药物耐药率让噬菌体（噬菌体）研究重新焕发活力，噬菌体是 100 多年前发现的细菌的天敌。为了在治疗上使用噬菌体，它们应该（1）最好是裂解性的，（2）有效杀死细菌宿主，以及（3）经过充分表征以排除副作用。开发治疗性噬菌体需要多个利益相关者的协调努力。在此，我们回顾了噬菌体治疗的最新技术，涵盖生物机制、临床应用、剩余挑战以及涉及天然噬菌体和转基因或合成噬菌体的未来方向。

articles.title: Cryo-EM structure of the respiratory I + III2 supercomplex from Arabidopsis thaliana at 2 Å resolution.
articles.titleZh: 拟南芥呼吸 I + III2 超复合体的冷冻电镜结构，分辨率为 2 Å。
articles.authors: Klusch N, Dreimann M, Senkler J, Rugen N, Kühlbrandt W, Braun HP.
articles.abstract: Protein complexes of the mitochondrial respiratory chain assemble into respiratory supercomplexes. Here we present the high-resolution electron cryo-microscopy structure of the Arabidopsis respiratory supercomplex consisting of complex I and a complex III dimer, with a total of 68 protein subunits and numerous bound cofactors. A complex I-ferredoxin, subunit B14.7 and P9, a newly defined subunit of plant complex I, mediate supercomplex formation. The component complexes stabilize one another, enabling new detailed insights into their structure. We describe (1) an interrupted aqueous passage for proton translocation in the membrane arm of complex I; (2) a new coenzyme A within the carbonic anhydrase module of plant complex I defining a second catalytic centre; and (3) the water structure at the proton exit pathway of complex III2 with a co-purified ubiquinone in the QO site. We propose that the main role of the plant supercomplex is to stabilize its components in the membrane.
articles.abstractZh: 线粒体呼吸链的蛋白质复合物组装成呼吸超复合物。在这里，我们展示了拟南芥呼吸超复合物的高分辨率电子冷冻显微镜结构，由复合物 I 和复合物 III 二聚体组成，总共有 68 个蛋白质亚基和大量结合的辅助因子。复合物 I-铁氧还蛋白、亚基 B14.7 和 P9（植物复合物 I 的新定义亚基）介导超复合物形成。这些成分复合物彼此稳定，从而能够对其结构进行新的详细了解。我们描述了（1）复合物 I 膜臂中质子易位的中断水通道； (2) 植物复合物 I 的碳酸酐酶模块中的新辅酶 A 定义了第二个催化中心； (3) 配合物 III2 与 QO 位点共纯化泛醌的质子出口路径处的水结构。我们认为植物超级复合物的主要作用是稳定其在膜中的成分。

articles.title: Potent ClpP agonists with anticancer properties bind with improved structural complementarity and alter the mitochondrial N-terminome.
articles.titleZh: 具有抗癌特性的强效 ClpP 激动剂与改善的结构互补性结合并改变线粒体 N 末端。
articles.authors: Mabanglo MF, Wong KS, Barghash MM, Leung E, Chuang SHW, Ardalan A, Majaesic EM, Wong CJ, Zhang S, Lang H, Karanewsky DS, Iwanowicz AA, Graves LM, Iwanowicz EJ, Gingras AC, Houry WA.
articles.abstract: The mitochondrial ClpP protease is responsible for mitochondrial protein quality control through specific degradation of proteins involved in several metabolic processes. ClpP overexpression is also required in many cancer cells to eliminate reactive oxygen species (ROS)-damaged proteins and to sustain oncogenesis. Targeting ClpP to dysregulate its function using small-molecule agonists is a recent strategy in cancer therapy. Here, we synthesized imipridone-derived compounds and related chemicals, which we characterized using biochemical, biophysical, and cellular studies. Using X-ray crystallography, we found that these compounds have enhanced binding affinities due to their greater shape and charge complementarity with the surface hydrophobic pockets of ClpP. N-terminome profiling of cancer cells upon treatment with one of these compounds revealed the global proteomic changes that arise and identified the structural motifs preferred for protein cleavage by compound-activated ClpP. Together, our studies provide the structural and molecular basis by which dysregulated ClpP affects cancer cell viability and proliferation.
articles.abstractZh: 线粒体 ClpP 蛋白酶通过特定降解参与多种代谢过程的蛋白质来负责线粒体蛋白质质量控​​制。许多癌细胞也需要 ClpP 过度表达，以消除活性氧 (ROS) 损伤的蛋白质并维持肿瘤发生。使用小分子激动剂靶向 ClpP 使其功能失调是癌症治疗的最新策略。在这里，我们合成了亚咪啶酮衍生的化合物和相关化学品，并通过生物化学、生物物理和细胞研究对其进行了表征。使用 X 射线晶体学，我们发现这些化合物由于其与 ClpP 表面疏水口袋更大的形状和电荷互补性而具有增强的结合亲和力。用其中一种化合物处理后，癌细胞的 N 端组分析揭示了所产生的整体蛋白质组变化，并鉴定了化合物激活的 ClpP 进行蛋白质切割时首选的结构基序。总之，我们的研究提供了 ClpP 失调影响癌细胞活力和增殖的结构和分子基础。

articles.title: MEP pathway products allosterically promote monomerization of deoxy-D-xylulose-5-phosphate synthase to feedback-regulate their supply.
articles.titleZh: MEP 途径产品变构促进脱氧-D-木酮糖-5-磷酸合酶的单体化，以反馈调节其供应。
articles.authors: Di X, Ortega-Alarcon D, Kakumanu R, Iglesias-Fernandez J, Diaz L, Baidoo EEK, Velazquez-Campoy A, Rodríguez-Concepción M, Perez-Gil J.
articles.abstract: Isoprenoids are a very large and diverse family of metabolites required by all living organisms. All isoprenoids derive from the double-bond isomers isopentenyl diphosphate (IPP) and dimethylallyl diphosphate (DMAPP), which are produced by the methylerythritol 4-phosphate (MEP) pathway in bacteria and plant plastids. It has been reported that IPP and DMAPP feedback-regulate the activity of deoxyxylulose 5-phosphate synthase (DXS), a dimeric enzyme that catalyzes the main flux-controlling step of the MEP pathway. Here we provide experimental insights into the underlying mechanism. Isothermal titration calorimetry and dynamic light scattering approaches showed that IPP and DMAPP can allosterically bind to DXS in vitro, causing a size shift. In silico ligand binding site analysis and docking calculations identified a potential allosteric site in the contact region between the two monomers of the active DXS dimer. Modulation of IPP and DMAPP contents in vivo followed by immunoblot analyses confirmed that high IPP/DMAPP levels resulted in monomerization and eventual aggregation of the enzyme in bacterial and plant cells. Loss of the enzymatically active dimeric conformation allows a fast and reversible reduction of DXS activity in response to a sudden increase or decrease in IPP/DMAPP supply, whereas aggregation and subsequent removal of monomers that would otherwise be available for dimerization appears to be a more drastic response in the case of persistent IPP/DMAPP overabundance (e.g., by a blockage in their conversion to downstream isoprenoids). Our results represent an important step toward understanding the regulation of the MEP pathway and rational design of biotechnological endeavors aimed at increasing isoprenoid contents in microbial and plant systems.
articles.abstractZh: 类异戊二烯是所有生物体所需的一个非常大且多样化的代谢物家族。所有类异戊二烯均源自双键异构体异戊烯基二磷酸 (IPP) 和二甲基烯丙基二磷酸 (DMAPP)，它们是由细菌和植物质体中的甲基赤藓糖醇 4-磷酸 (MEP) 途径产生的。据报道，IPP 和 DMAPP 反馈调节脱氧木酮糖 5-磷酸合酶 (DXS) 的活性，DXS 是一种二聚酶，催化 MEP 途径的主要通量控制步骤。在这里，我们提供了对潜在机制的实验见解。等温滴定量热法和动态光散射方法表明，IPP 和 DMAPP 可以在体外以变构方式与 DXS 结合，导致尺寸变化。计算机配体结合位点分析和对接计算确定了活性 DXS 二聚体的两个单体之间的接触区域中的潜在变构位点。体内 IPP 和 DMAPP 含量的调节以及随后的免疫印迹分析证实，高 IPP/DMAPP 水平导致细菌和植物细胞中酶的单体化和最终聚集。酶活性二聚体构象的丧失使得 fas

articles.title: Retrograde signaling in plants: A critical review focusing on the GUN pathway and beyond.
articles.titleZh: 植物中的逆行信号：针对 GUN 途径及其他途径的批判性评论。
articles.authors: Richter AS, Nägele T, Grimm B, Kaufmann K, Schroda M, Leister D, Kleine T.
articles.abstract: Plastids communicate their developmental and physiological status to the nucleus via retrograde signaling, allowing nuclear gene expression to be adjusted appropriately. Signaling during plastid biogenesis and responses of mature chloroplasts to environmental changes are designated "biogenic" and "operational" controls, respectively. A prominent example of the investigation of biogenic signaling is the screen for gun (genomes uncoupled) mutants. Although the first five gun mutants were identified 30 years ago, the functions of GUN proteins in retrograde signaling remain controversial, and that of GUN1 is hotly disputed. Here, we provide background information and critically discuss recently proposed concepts that address GUN-related signaling and some novel gun mutants. Moreover, considering heme as a candidate in retrograde signaling, we revisit the spatial organization of heme biosynthesis and export from plastids. Although this review focuses on GUN pathways, we also highlight recent progress in the identification and elucidation of chloroplast-derived signals that regulate the acclimation response in green algae and plants. Here, stress-induced accumulation of unfolded/misassembled chloroplast proteins evokes a chloroplast-specific unfolded protein response, which leads to changes in the expression levels of nucleus-encoded chaperones and proteases to restore plastid protein homeostasis. We also address the importance of chloroplast-derived signals for activation of flavonoid biosynthesis leading to production of anthocyanins during stress acclimation through sucrose non-fermenting 1-related protein kinase 1. Finally, a framework for identification and quantification of intercompartmental signaling cascades at the proteomic and metabolomic levels is provided, and we discuss future directions of dissection of organelle-nucleus communication.
articles.abstractZh: 质体通过逆行信号将其发育和生理状态传达给细胞核，从而使核基因表达得到适当调整。质体生物发生期间的信号传导和成熟叶绿体对环境变化的反应分别被指定为“生物发生”和“操作”对照。生物信号研究的一个突出例子是枪（基因组解偶联）突变体的筛选。尽管前五个枪突变体在 30 年前就已被发现，但 GUN 蛋白在逆行信号传导中的功能仍然存在争议，其中 GUN1 的功能也存在激烈争议。在这里，我们提供背景信息并批判性地讨论最近提出的解决枪支相关信号传导和一些新型枪支突变体的概念。此外，考虑到血红素作为逆行信号传导的候选者，我们重新审视了血红素生物合成和质体输出的空间组织。虽然这篇综述的重点是 GUN 途径，但我们也强调了在识别和阐明调节绿藻和植物适应反应的叶绿体衍生信号方面的最新进展。在这里，压力引起的未折叠/错误组装的积累

articles.title: Executing cell-specific cross-linking immunoprecipitation and sequencing (seCLIP) in C. elegans.
articles.titleZh: 在秀丽隐杆线虫中执行细胞特异性交联免疫沉淀和测序 (seCLIP)。
articles.authors: Blazie SM, Jin Y.
articles.abstract: The single-end enhanced cross-linking immunoprecipitation (seCLIP) method is well suited for efficient and unbiased transcriptome-wide interrogation of RNA-binding protein (RBP) interaction sites. Here, we provide a protocol for executing cell-specific seCLIP for any desired RBP in Caenorhabditis elegans. We begin with steps and recommendations for transgene construction and Cas9-mediated chromosomal integration. We provide detailed procedures for isolation of RBP-associated RNA fragments, subsequent library preparation, and sequencing. We further discuss best practices for data analysis, interpretation of results, and troubleshooting. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to Blazie et al. (2021).1.
articles.abstractZh: 单端增强交联免疫沉淀 (seCLIP) 方法非常适合对 RNA 结合蛋白 (RBP) 相互作用位点进行高效且公正的转录组范围内的询问。在这里，我们提供了一个用于在秀丽隐杆线虫中执行任何所需 RBP 的细胞特异性 seCLIP 的协议。我们首先介绍转基因构建和 Cas9 介导的染色体整合的步骤和建议。我们提供分离 RBP 相关 RNA 片段、后续文库制备和测序的详细程序。我们进一步讨论数据分析、结果解释和故障排除的最佳实践。有关该协议的使用和执行的完整详细信息，请参阅 Blazie 等人。 (2021).1。

articles.title: Gut microbiota as an antioxidant system in centenarians associated with high antioxidant activities of gut-resident Lactobacillus.
articles.titleZh: 肠道微生物群作为百岁老人的抗氧化系统，与肠道驻留乳酸菌的高抗氧化活性有关。
articles.authors: Wu L, Xie X, Li Y, Liang T, Zhong H, Yang L, Xi Y, Zhang J, Ding Y, Wu Q.
articles.abstract: The gut microbiota plays an important role in human health and longevity, and the gut microbiota of centenarians shows unique characteristics. Nowadays, most microbial research on longevity is usually limited to the bioinformatics level, lacking validating information on culturing functional microorganisms. Here, we combined metagenomic sequencing and large-scale in vitro culture to reveal the unique gut microbial structure of the world's longevity town-Jiaoling, China, centenarians and people of different ages. Functional strains were isolated and screened in vitro, and the possible relationship between gut microbes and longevity was explored and validated in vivo. 247 healthy Cantonese natives of different ages participated in the study, including 18 centenarians. Compared with young adults, the gut microbiota of centenarians exhibits higher microbial diversity, xenobiotics biodegradation and metabolism, oxidoreductases, and multiple species (the potential probiotics Lactobacillus, Akkermansia, the methanogenic Methanobrevibacter, gut butyrate-producing members Roseburia, and SCFA-producing species uncl Clostridiales, uncl Ruminococcaceae) known to be beneficial to host metabolism. These species are constantly changing with age. We also isolated 2055 strains from these samples by large-scale in vitro culture, most of which were detected by metagenomics, with clear complementarity between the two approaches. We also screened an age-related gut-resident Lactobacillus with independent intellectual property rights, and its metabolite (L-ascorbic acid) and itself have good antioxidant effects. Our findings underscore the existence of age-related trajectories in the human gut microbiota, and that distinct gut microbiota and gut-resident as antioxidant systems may contribute to health and longevity.
articles.abstractZh: 肠道菌群对人类健康和长寿起着重要作用，百岁老人的肠道菌群表现出独特的特征。目前，大多数关于长寿的微生物研究通常仅限于生物信息学水平，缺乏培养功能微生物的验证信息。在这里，我们结合宏基因组测序和大规模体外培养，揭示了世界长寿之乡——中国蕉岭、百岁老人和不同年龄段人群独特的肠道微生物结构。在体外分离和筛选功能菌株，并在体内探索和验证肠道微生物与长寿之间的可能关系。 247名不同年龄段的健康广东人参与了这项研究，其中包括18名百岁老人。与年轻人相比，百岁老人的肠道菌群表现出更高的微生物多样性、异生物质生物降解和代谢、氧化还原酶以及多种已知有益于宿主代谢的物种（潜在益生菌乳杆菌、阿克曼氏菌、产甲烷短杆菌、肠道产丁酸成员罗斯伯利亚和产短链脂肪酸的物种（uncl Clostridiales、uncl Ruminococcaceae））

articles.title: The eINTACT system dissects bacterial exploitation of plant osmosignalling to enhance virulence.
articles.titleZh: eINTACT 系统剖析细菌利用植物渗透信号传导来增强毒力。
articles.authors: You Y, Koczyk G, Nuc M, Morbitzer R, Holmes DR, von Roepenack-Lahaye E, Hou S, Giudicatti A, Gris C, Manavella PA, Noël LD, Krajewski P, Lahaye T.
articles.abstract: Bacteria inject effector proteins into host cells to manipulate cellular processes that promote disease. Since bacteria deliver minuscule amounts of effectors only into targeted host cells, it is technically challenging to capture effector-dependent cellular changes from bulk-infected host tissues. Here, we report a new technique called effector-inducible isolation of nuclei tagged in specific cell types (eINTACT), which facilitates affinity-based purification of nuclei from Arabidopsis plant cells that have received Xanthomonas bacterial effectors. Analysis of purified nuclei reveals that the Xanthomonas effector XopD manipulates the expression of Arabidopsis abscisic acid signalling-related genes and activates OSCA1.1, a gene encoding a calcium-permeable channel required for stomatal closure in response to osmotic stress. The loss of OSCA1.1 causes leaf wilting and reduced bacterial growth in infected leaves, suggesting that OSCA1.1 promotes host susceptibility. eINTACT allows us to uncover that XopD exploits host OSCA1.1/abscisic acid osmosignalling-mediated stomatal closure to create a humid habitat that favours bacterial growth and opens up a new avenue for accurately elucidating functions of effectors from numerous gram-negative plant bacteria in native infection contexts.
articles.abstractZh: 细菌将效应蛋白注入宿主细胞以操纵促进疾病的细胞过程。由于细菌仅将微量的效应子传递到目标宿主细胞中，因此从大量感染的宿主组织中捕获效应子依赖性细胞变化在技术上具有挑战性。在这里，我们报告了一种称为效应子诱导的特定细胞类型细胞核分离（eINTACT）的新技术，该技术有助于基于亲和力从接受黄单胞菌细菌效应子的拟南芥植物细胞中纯化细胞核。对纯化细胞核的分析表明，黄单胞菌效应子 XopD 操纵拟南芥脱落酸信号相关基因的表达，并激活 OSCA1.1，这是一种编码钙渗透通道的基因，是响应渗透胁迫而关闭气孔所需的。 OSCA1.1 的缺失会导致叶片枯萎并减少受感染叶片中的细菌生长，表明 OSCA1.1 会促进宿主的易感性。 eINTACT 使我们发现 XopD 利用宿主 OSCA1.1/脱落酸渗透信号介导的气孔关闭来创建有利于细菌生长的潮湿栖息地，并为准确阐明细菌开辟了新途径

articles.title: The thylakoid membrane protein NTA1 is an assembly factor of the cytochrome b6f complex essential for chloroplast development in Arabidopsis.
articles.titleZh: 类囊体膜蛋白 NTA1 是拟南芥叶绿体发育所必需的细胞色素 b6f 复合物的组装因子。
articles.authors: Li N, Wong WS, Feng L, Wang C, Wong KS, Zhang N, Yang W, Jiang Y, Jiang L, He JX.
articles.abstract: The cytochrome b6f (Cyt b6f) complex is a multisubunit protein complex in chloroplast thylakoid membranes required for photosynthetic electron transport. Here we report the isolation and characterization of the new tiny albino 1 (nta1) mutant in Arabidopsis, which has severe defects in Cyt b6f accumulation and chloroplast development. Gene cloning revealed that the nta1 phenotype was caused by disruption of a single nuclear gene, NTA1, which encodes an integral thylakoid membrane protein conserved across green algae and plants. Overexpression of NTA1 completely rescued the nta1 phenotype, and knockout of NTA1 in wild-type plants recapitulated the mutant phenotype. Loss of NTA1 function severely impaired the accumulation of multiprotein complexes related to photosynthesis in thylakoid membranes, particularly the components of Cyt b6f. NTA1 was shown to directly interact with four subunits (Cyt b6/PetB, PetD, PetG, and PetN) of Cyt b6f through the DUF1279 domain and C-terminal sequence to mediate their assembly. Taken together, our results identify NTA1 as a new and key regulator of chloroplast development that plays essential roles in assembly of the Cyt b6f complex by interacting with multiple Cyt b6f subunits.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞色素 b6f (Cyt b6f) 复合物是叶绿体类囊体膜中光合电子传递所需的多亚基蛋白质复合物。在这里，我们报告了拟南芥中新的微小白化1（nta1）突变体的分离和表征，该突变体在细胞色素b6f积累和叶绿体发育方面存在严重缺陷。基因克隆显示，nta1 表型是由单个核基因 NTA1 破坏引起的，NTA1 编码在绿藻和植物中保守的完整类囊体膜蛋白。 NTA1的过表达完全挽救了nta1表型，而在野生型植物中敲除NTA1则重现了突变表型。 NTA1功能的丧失严重损害了类囊体膜中与光合作用相关的多蛋白复合物的积累，特别是Cyt b6f的成分。 NTA1 通过 DUF1279 结构域和 C 端序列直接与 Cyt b6f 的四个亚基（Cyt b6/PetB、PetD、PetG 和 PetN）相互作用，介导其组装。总而言之，我们的结果确定 NTA1 是叶绿体发育的新的关键调节因子，通过与 w 相互作用，在 Cyt b6f 复合物的组装中发挥重要作用。

articles.title: Virus-assisted directed evolution of enhanced suppressor tRNAs in mammalian cells.
articles.titleZh: 哺乳动物细胞中增强型抑制 tRNA 的病毒辅助定向进化。
articles.authors: Jewel D, Kelemen RE, Huang RL, Zhu Z, Sundaresh B, Cao X, Malley K, Huang Z, Pasha M, Anthony J, van Opijnen T, Chatterjee A.
articles.abstract: Site-specific incorporation of unnatural amino acids (Uaas) in living cells relies on engineered aminoacyl-transfer RNA synthetase-tRNA pairs borrowed from a distant domain of life. Such heterologous suppressor tRNAs often have poor intrinsic activity, presumably due to suboptimal interaction with a non-native translation system. This limitation can be addressed in Escherichia coli using directed evolution. However, no suitable selection system is currently available to do the same in mammalian cells. Here we report virus-assisted directed evolution of tRNAs (VADER) in mammalian cells, which uses a double-sieve selection scheme to facilitate single-step enrichment of active yet orthogonal tRNA mutants from naive libraries. Using VADER we developed improved mutants of Methanosarcina mazei pyrrolysyl-tRNA, as well as a bacterial tyrosyl-tRNA. We also show that the higher activity of the most efficient mutant pyrrolysyl-tRNA is specific for mammalian cells, alluding to an improved interaction with the unique mammalian translation apparatus.
articles.abstractZh: 非天然氨基酸 (Uaas) 在活细胞中的位点特异性掺入依赖于从遥远的生命领域借来的工程化氨酰基转移 RNA 合成酶-tRNA 对。这种异源抑制 tRNA 通常具有较差的内在活性，可能是由于与非天然翻译系统的相互作用不理想。在大肠杆菌中可以使用定向进化来解决这一限制。然而，目前还没有合适的选择系统可以在哺乳动物细胞中进行同样的操作。在这里，我们报告了哺乳动物细胞中病毒辅助的 tRNA 定向进化（VADER），它使用双筛选择方案来促进从初始文库中单步富集活性但正交的 tRNA 突变体。使用 VADER，我们开发了马氏甲烷八叠球菌吡咯赖氨酰-tRNA 以及细菌酪氨酰-tRNA 的改良突变体。我们还表明，最有效的突变体吡咯赖氨酰-tRNA 的较高活性是哺乳动物细胞特有的，这暗示着与独特的哺乳动物翻译装置的相互作用得到了改善。

articles.title: A single 2'-O-methylation of ribosomal RNA gates assembly of a functional ribosome.
articles.titleZh: 核糖体 RNA 的单个 2'-O-甲基化可控制功能性核糖体的组装。
articles.authors: Yelland JN, Bravo JPK, Black JJ, Taylor DW, Johnson AW.
articles.abstract: RNA modifications are widespread in biology and abundant in ribosomal RNA. However, the importance of these modifications is not well understood. We show that methylation of a single nucleotide, in the catalytic center of the large subunit, gates ribosome assembly. Massively parallel mutational scanning of the essential nuclear GTPase Nog2 identified important interactions with rRNA, particularly with the 2'-O-methylated A-site base Gm2922. We found that methylation of G2922 is needed for assembly and efficient nuclear export of the large subunit. Critically, we identified single amino acid changes in Nog2 that completely bypass dependence on G2922 methylation and used cryoelectron microscopy to directly visualize how methylation flips Gm2922 into the active site channel of Nog2. This work demonstrates that a single RNA modification is a critical checkpoint in ribosome biogenesis, suggesting that such modifications can play an important role in regulation and assembly of macromolecular machines.
articles.abstractZh: RNA 修饰在生物学中广泛存在，并且在核糖体 RNA 中含量丰富。然而，这些修改的重要性尚未得到充分理解。我们表明，大亚基催化中心的单个核苷酸的甲基化可控制核糖体组装。对必需核 GTPase Nog2 的大规模并行突变扫描发现了与 rRNA 的重要相互作用，特别是与 2'-O-甲基化 A 位点碱基 Gm2922 的相互作用。我们发现 G2922 的甲基化是大亚基组装和有效核输出所必需的。至关重要的是，我们鉴定了 Nog2 中的单个氨基酸变化，这些变化完全绕过了对 G2922 甲基化的依赖，并使用冷冻电子显微镜直接可视化甲基化如何将 Gm2922 翻转到 Nog2 的活性位点通道中。这项工作表明，单个 RNA 修饰是核糖体生物合成中的关键检查点，表明此类修饰可以在大分子机器的调节和组装中发挥重要作用。

articles.title: mTORC1 regulates a lysosome-dependent adaptive shift in intracellular lipid species.
articles.titleZh: mTORC1 调节细胞内脂质种类的溶酶体依赖性适应性转变。
articles.authors: Hosios AM, Wilkinson ME, McNamara MC, Kalafut KC, Torrence ME, Asara JM, Manning BD.
articles.abstract: The mechanistic target of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1) senses and relays environmental signals from growth factors and nutrients to metabolic networks and adaptive cellular systems to control the synthesis and breakdown of macromolecules; however, beyond inducing de novo lipid synthesis, the role of mTORC1 in controlling cellular lipid content remains poorly understood. Here we show that inhibition of mTORC1 via small molecule inhibitors or nutrient deprivation leads to the accumulation of intracellular triglycerides in both cultured cells and a mouse tumor model. The elevated triglyceride pool following mTORC1 inhibition stems from the lysosome-dependent, but autophagy-independent, hydrolysis of phospholipid fatty acids. The liberated fatty acids are available for either triglyceride synthesis or β-oxidation. Distinct from the established role of mTORC1 activation in promoting de novo lipid synthesis, our data indicate that mTORC1 inhibition triggers membrane phospholipid trafficking to the lysosome for catabolism and an adaptive shift in the use of constituent fatty acids for storage or energy production.
articles.abstractZh: 雷帕霉素复合物 1 (mTORC1) 的机制靶点感知生长因子和营养物质的环境信号并将其传递到代谢网络和适应性细胞系统，以控制大分子的合成和分解；然而，除了诱导脂质从头合成之外，mTORC1 在控制细胞脂质含量方面的作用仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们发现通过小分子抑制剂或营养剥夺抑制 mTORC1 会导致培养细胞和小鼠肿瘤模型中细胞内甘油三酯的积累。 mTORC1 抑制后甘油三酯池升高源于溶酶体依赖性但不依赖自噬的磷脂脂肪酸水解。释放的脂肪酸可用于甘油三酯合成或β-氧化。与 mTORC1 激活在促进从头脂质合成中的既定作用不同，我们的数据表明，mTORC1 抑制会触发膜磷脂运输到溶酶体进行分解代谢，以及使用组成脂肪酸进行储存或能量生产的适应性转变。

articles.title: Polλ promotes microhomology-mediated end-joining.
articles.titleZh: Polλ 促进微同源介导的末端连接。
articles.authors: Chandramouly G, Jamsen J, Borisonnik N, Tyagi M, Calbert ML, Tredinnick T, Ozdemir AY, Kent T, Demidova EV, Arora S, Wilson SH, Pomerantz RT.
articles.abstract: The double-strand break (DSB) repair pathway called microhomology-mediated end-joining (MMEJ) is thought to be dependent on DNA polymerase theta (Polθ) and occur independently of nonhomologous end-joining (NHEJ) factors. An unresolved question is whether MMEJ is facilitated by a single Polθ-mediated end-joining pathway or consists of additional undiscovered pathways. We find that human X-family Polλ, which functions in NHEJ, additionally exhibits robust MMEJ activity like Polθ. Polλ promotes MMEJ in mammalian cells independently of essential NHEJ factors LIG4/XRCC4 and Polθ, which reveals a distinct Polλ-dependent MMEJ mechanism. X-ray crystallography employing in situ photo-induced DSB formation captured Polλ in the act of stabilizing a microhomology-mediated DNA synapse with incoming nucleotide at 2.0 Å resolution and reveals how Polλ performs replication across a DNA synapse joined by minimal base-pairing. Last, we find that Polλ is semisynthetic lethal with BRCA1 and BRCA2. Together, these studies indicate Polλ MMEJ as a distinct DSB repair mechanism.
articles.abstractZh: 双链断裂 (DSB) 修复途径称为微同源介导的末端连接 (MMEJ)，被认为依赖于 DNA 聚合酶 theta (Polθ)，并且独立于非同源末端连接 (NHEJ) 因素而发生。一个未解决的问题是 MMEJ 是否是由单个 Polθ 介导的末端连接途径促进的，还是由其他未发现的途径组成。我们发现，在 NHEJ 中发挥作用的人类 X 家族 Polλ 还表现出与 Polθ 一样强大的 MMEJ 活性。 Polλ 在哺乳动物细胞中独立于必需的 NHEJ 因子 LIG4/XRCC4 和 Polθ 促进 MMEJ，这揭示了独特的 Polλ 依赖性 MMEJ 机制。 X 射线晶体学采用原位光诱导 DSB 形成，以 2.0 Å 的分辨率捕获了 Polλ 稳定微同源介导的 DNA 突触的过程，并揭示了 Polλ 如何在通过最小碱基配对连接的 DNA 突触中进行复制。最后，我们发现 Polλ 对 BRCA1 和 BRCA2 具有半合成致死作用。总之，这些研究表明 Polλ MMEJ 是一种独特的 DSB 修复机制。

articles.title: Density and temperature controlled fluid extraction in a bacterial biofilm is determined by poly-γ-glutamic acid production.
articles.titleZh: 细菌生物膜中的密度和温度控制的流体提取由聚-γ-谷氨酸的产生决定。
articles.authors: Morris RJ, Stevenson D, Sukhodub T, Stanley-Wall NR, MacPhee CE.
articles.abstract: A hallmark of microbial biofilms is the self-production of an extracellular molecular matrix that encases the resident cells. The matrix provides protection from the environment, while spatial heterogeneity of gene expression influences the structural morphology and colony spreading dynamics. Bacillus subtilis is a model bacterial system used to uncover the regulatory pathways and key building blocks required for biofilm growth and development. In this work, we report on the emergence of a highly active population of bacteria during the early stages of biofilm formation, facilitated by the extraction of fluid from the underlying agar substrate. We trace the origin of this fluid extraction to the production of poly-γ-glutamic acid (PGA). The flagella-dependent activity develops behind a moving front of fluid that propagates from the boundary of the biofilm towards the interior. The extent of fluid proliferation is controlled by the presence of extracellular polysaccharides (EPS). We also find that PGA production is positively correlated with higher temperatures, resulting in high-temperature mature biofilm morphologies that are distinct from the rugose colony biofilm architecture typically associated with B. subtilis. Although previous reports have suggested that PGA production does not play a major role in biofilm morphology in the undomesticated isolate NCIB 3610, our results suggest that this strain produces distinct biofilm matrices in response to environmental conditions.
articles.abstractZh: 微生物生物膜的一个标志是自我产生包裹常驻细胞的细胞外分子基质。基质提供了免受环境影响的保护，而基因表达的空间异质性影响结构形态和菌落扩散动力学。枯草芽孢杆菌是一种模型细菌系统，用于揭示生物膜生长和发育所需的调节途径和关键构建模块。在这项工作中，我们报告了在生物膜形成的早期阶段出现的高度活跃的细菌群体，这是通过从下面的琼脂基质中提取液体来促进的。我们将这种流体提取的起源追溯到聚-γ-谷氨酸 (PGA) 的生产。鞭毛依赖性活动在从生物膜边界向内部传播的流体移动前沿后面发展。液体增殖的程度由细胞外多糖（EPS）的存在控制。我们还发现 PGA 的产生与较高的温度呈正相关，从而导致高温成熟的生物膜形态，与皱纹菌落生物膜结构不同。

articles.title: Prediction and verification of glycosyltransferase activity by bioinformatics analysis and protein engineering.
articles.titleZh: 通过生物信息学分析和蛋白质工程预测和验证糖基转移酶活性。
articles.authors: Gerloff DL, Ilina EI, Cialini C, Mata Salcedo U, Mittelbronn M, Müller T.
articles.abstract: A significant number of proteins are annotated as functionally uncharacterized proteins. Within this protocol, we describe how to use protein family multiple sequence alignments and structural bioinformatics resources to design loss-of-function mutations of previously uncharacterized proteins within the glycosyltransferase family. We detail approaches to determine target protein active sites using three-dimensional modeling. We generate active site mutants and quantify any changes in enzymatic function by a glycosyltransferase assay. With modifications, this protocol could be applied to other metal-dependent enzymes. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to Ilina et al. (2022).1.
articles.abstractZh: 大量蛋白质被注释为功能未表征的蛋白质。在此协议中，我们描述了如何使用蛋白质家族多序列比对和结构生物信息学资源来设计糖基转移酶家族中先前未表征的蛋白质的功能丧失突变。我们详细介绍了使用三维建模确定靶蛋白活性位点的方法。我们生成活性位点突变体，并通过糖基转移酶测定来量化酶功能的任何变化。经过修改，该协议可以应用于其他金属依赖性酶。有关该协议的使用和执行的完整详细信息，请参阅 Ilina 等人。 (2022).1。

articles.title: Structurally distinct PARP7 inhibitors provide new insights into the function of PARP7 in regulating nucleic acid-sensing and IFN-β signaling.
articles.titleZh: 结构不同的 PARP7 抑制剂为 PARP7 在调节核酸传感和 IFN-β 信号传导中的功能提供了新的见解。
articles.authors: Sanderson DJ, Rodriguez KM, Bejan DS, Olafsen NE, Bohn ID, Kojic A, Sundalam S, Siordia IR, Duell AK, Deng N, Schultz C, Grant DM, Matthews J, Cohen MS.
articles.abstract: The mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase PARP7 has emerged as a key negative regulator of cytosolic NA-sensors of the innate immune system. We apply a rational design strategy for converting a pan-PARP inhibitor into a potent selective PARP7 inhibitor (KMR-206). Consistent with studies using the structurally distinct PARP7 inhibitor RBN-2397, co-treatment of mouse embryonic fibroblasts with KMR-206 and NA-sensor ligands synergistically induced the expression of the type I interferon, IFN-β. In mouse colon carcinoma (CT-26) cells, KMR-206 alone induced IFN-β. Both KMR-206 and RBN-2397 increased PARP7 protein levels in CT-26 cells, demonstrating that PARP7's catalytic activity regulates its own protein levels. Curiously, treatment with saturating doses of KMR-206 and RBN-2397 achieved different levels of PARP7 protein, which correlated with the magnitude of type I interferon gene expression. These latter results have important implications for the mechanism of action of PARP7 inhibitors and highlights the usefulness of having structurally distinct chemical probes for the same target.
articles.abstractZh: 单 ADP 核糖基转移酶 PARP7 已成为先天免疫系统胞质 NA 传感器的关键负调节因子。我们采用合理的设计策略将泛 PARP 抑制剂转化为有效的选择性 PARP7 抑制剂 (KMR-206)。与使用结构不同的 PARP7 抑制剂 RBN-2397 的研究一致，用 KMR-206 和 NA 传感器配体共同处理小鼠胚胎成纤维细胞可协同诱导 I 型干扰素 IFN-β 的表达。在小鼠结肠癌 (CT-26) 细胞中，KMR-206 单独诱导 IFN-β。 KMR-206 和 RBN-2397 均增加 CT-26 细胞中的 PARP7 蛋白水平，表明 PARP7 的催化活性可调节其自身的蛋白水平。奇怪的是，用饱和剂量的 KMR-206 和 RBN-2397 治疗可实现不同水平的 PARP7 蛋白，这与 I 型干扰素基因表达的强度相关。后面的这些结果对 PARP7 抑制剂的作用机制具有重要意义，并强调了针对同一靶标具有结构不同的化学探针的有用性。

articles.title: Adeno-associated viral delivery of engineered tRNA-enzyme pairs into nonsense mutation mouse models.
articles.titleZh: 腺相关病毒将工程化的 tRNA-酶对递送至无义突变小鼠模型中。
articles.authors: Zheng Z, Shi N, Xia Q.
articles.abstract: In this protocol, we describe how to utilize the unnatural amino acid (UAA) incorporation system to read through endogenous premature termination codons in a Duchenne muscular dystrophy mouse model. We detail how to screen and optimize tRNA-enzyme pairs for efficient UAA incorporation, deliver the system intraperitoneally or intramuscularly in pathogenic mice by an adeno-associated viral (AAV) vector, and evaluate the restoration of endogenous dystrophin and increase in muscle strength after AAV injection. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to Shi et al. (2021).1.
articles.abstractZh: 在本协议中，我们描述了如何利用非天然氨基酸（UAA）掺入系统来读取杜氏肌营养不良症小鼠模型中的内源性过早终止密码子。我们详细介绍了如何筛选和优化 tRNA-酶对以实现有效的 UAA 掺入，通过腺相关病毒 (AAV) 载体在致病小鼠中腹膜内或肌内输送该系统，并评估 AAV 注射后内源性肌营养不良蛋白的恢复和肌肉力量的增加。有关该协议的使用和执行的完整详细信息，请参阅 Shi 等人。 (2021).1。

articles.title: Engineering yeast for industrial-level production of the antimalarial drug artemisinin.
articles.titleZh: 用于工业级生产抗疟药物青蒿素的工程酵母。
articles.authors: Smith AB, Chekan JR.
articles.abstract: Artemisinin-based combination therapies are the gold standard treatment for uncomplicated malaria. A seminal study by Paddon et al. detailed an efficient approach for producing artemisinic acid from engineered yeast and its conversion to artemisinin, and demonstrated how to use metabolic engineering and synthetic biology for the production of bioactive compounds.
articles.abstractZh: 基于青蒿素的联合疗法是治疗单纯性疟疾的黄金标准。 Paddon 等人的一项开创性研究。详细介绍了一种从工程酵母中生产青蒿酸及其转化为青蒿素的有效方法，并演示了如何利用代谢工程和合成生物学来生产生物活性化合物。

articles.title: Ring domains are essential for GATOR2-dependent mTORC1 activation.
articles.titleZh: 环结构域对于 GATOR2 依赖性 mTORC1 激活至关重要。
articles.authors: Jiang C, Dai X, He S, Zhou H, Fang L, Guo J, Liu S, Zhang T, Pan W, Yu H, Fu T, Li D, Inuzuka H, Wang P, Xiao J, Wei W.
articles.abstract: The GATOR2-GATOR1 signaling axis is essential for amino-acid-dependent mTORC1 activation. However, the molecular function of the GATOR2 complex remains unknown. Here, we report that disruption of the Ring domains of Mios, WDR24, or WDR59 completely impedes amino-acid-mediated mTORC1 activation. Mechanistically, via interacting with Ring domains of WDR59 and WDR24, the Ring domain of Mios acts as a hub to maintain GATOR2 integrity, disruption of which leads to self-ubiquitination of WDR24. Physiologically, leucine stimulation dissociates Sestrin2 from the Ring domain of WDR24 and confers its availability to UBE2D3 and subsequent ubiquitination of NPRL2, contributing to GATOR2-mediated GATOR1 inactivation. As such, WDR24 ablation or Ring deletion prevents mTORC1 activation, leading to severe growth defects and embryonic lethality at E10.5 in mice. Hence, our findings demonstrate that Ring domains are essential for GATOR2 to transmit amino acid availability to mTORC1 and further reveal the essentiality of nutrient sensing during embryonic development.
articles.abstractZh: GATOR2-GATOR1 信号轴对于氨基酸依赖性 mTORC1 激活至关重要。然而，GATOR2 复合物的分子功能仍然未知。在这里，我们报告 Mios、WDR24 或 WDR59 环结构域的破坏完全阻碍氨基酸介导的 mTORC1 激活。从机制上讲，通过与 WDR59 和 WDR24 的环结构域相互作用，Mios 的环结构域充当维持 GATOR2 完整性的枢纽，其破坏会导致 WDR24 的自我泛素化。生理学上，亮氨酸刺激使 Sestrin2 从 WDR24 的环结构域解离，并赋予 UBE2D3 可用性和随后的 NPRL2 泛素化，从而导致 GATOR2 介导的 GATOR1 失活。因此，WDR24 消融或 Ring 缺失会阻止 mTORC1 激活，导致小鼠 E10.5 时严重生长缺陷和胚胎致死。因此，我们的研究结果表明，Ring 结构域对于 GATOR2 将氨基酸可用性传递给 mTORC1 至关重要，并进一步揭示了胚胎发育过程中营养感应的重要性。

articles.title: The Wsp chemosensory system modulates c-di-GMP-dependent biofilm formation by integrating DSF quorum sensing through the WspR-RpfG complex in Lysobacter.
articles.titleZh: Wsp 化学感应系统通过溶杆菌中的 WspR-RpfG 复合物整合 DSF 群体感应来调节 c-di-GMP 依赖性生物膜形成。
articles.authors: Xu K, Wang L, Xiong D, Chen H, Tong X, Shao X, Li T, Qian G.
articles.abstract: The ubiquitous Wsp (wrinkly spreader phenotype) chemosensory system and DSF (diffusible signal factor) quorum sensing are two important chemically associated signaling systems that mediate bacterial communications between the host and environment. Although these two systems individually control biofilm formation in pathogenic bacteria via the ubiquitous second messenger c-di-GMP, their crosstalk mechanisms remain elusive. Here we present a scenario from the plant-beneficial and antifungal bacterium Lysobacter enzymogenes OH11, where biofilm formation favors the colonization of this bacterium in fungal hyphae. We found that the Wsp system regulated biofilm formation via WspR-mediated c-di-GMP signaling, whereas DSF system did not depend on the enzymatic activity of RpfG to regulate biofilm formation. We further found that WspR, a diguanylate cyclase (DGC) responsible for c-di-GMP synthesis, could directly bind to one of the DSF signaling components, RpfG, an active phosphodiesterase (PDE) responsible for c-di-GMP degradation. Thus, the WspR-RpfG complex represents a previously undiscovered molecular linker connecting the Wsp and DSF systems. Mechanistically, RpfG could function as an adaptor protein to bind and inhibit the DGC activity of unphosphorylated WspR independent of its PDE activity. Phosphorylation of WspR impaired its binding affinity to RpfG and also blocked the ability of RpfG to act as an adaptor protein, which enabled the Wsp system to regulate biofilm formation in a c-di-GMP-dependent manner by dynamically integrating the DSF system. Our findings demonstrated a previously uncharacterized mechanism of crosstalk between Wsp and DSF systems in plant-beneficial and antifungal bacteria.
articles.abstractZh: 无处不在的 Wsp（皱纹传播表型）化学感应系统和 DSF（扩散信号因子）群体感应是两个重要的化学相关信号系统，介导宿主与环境之间的细菌通讯。尽管这两个系统通过普遍存在的第二信使 c-di-GMP 分别控制病原菌中生物膜的形成，但它们的串扰机制仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们展示了一种对植物有益的抗真菌细菌溶酶杆菌 OH11 的场景，其中生物膜的形成有利于这种细菌在真菌菌丝中的定殖。我们发现Wsp系统通过WspR介导的c-di-GMP信号调节生物膜形成，而DSF系统不依赖于RpfG的酶活性来调节生物膜形成。我们进一步发现，WspR（一种负责 c-di-GMP 合成的二鸟苷酸环化酶（DGC））可以直接与 DSF 信号成分之一 RpfG（负责 c-di-GMP 降解的活性磷酸二酯酶（PDE））结合。因此，WspR-RpfG 复合物代表了之前未发现的连接 Wsp 和 DSF 系统的分子接头。从机制上讲，RpfG 可以充当

articles.title: Dynamic chromatin accessibility deploys heterotypic cis/trans-acting factors driving stomatal cell-fate commitment.
articles.titleZh: 动态染色质可及性部署了驱动气孔细胞命运承诺的异型顺式/反式作用因子。
articles.authors: Kim ED, Dorrity MW, Fitzgerald BA, Seo H, Sepuru KM, Queitsch C, Mitsuda N, Han SK, Torii KU.
articles.abstract: Chromatin architecture and transcription factor (TF) binding underpin cell-fate specification during development, but their mutual regulatory relationships remain unclear. Here we report an atlas of dynamic chromatin landscapes during stomatal cell-lineage progression, in which sequential cell-state transitions are governed by lineage-specific bHLH TFs. Major reprogramming of chromatin accessibility occurs at the proliferation-to-differentiation transition. We discover novel co-cis regulatory elements (CREs) signifying the early precursor stage, BBR/BPC (GAGA) and bHLH (E-box) motifs, where master-regulatory bHLH TFs, SPEECHLESS and MUTE, consecutively bind to initiate and terminate the proliferative state, respectively. BPC TFs complex with MUTE to repress SPEECHLESS expression through a local deposition of repressive histone marks. We elucidate the mechanism by which cell-state-specific heterotypic TF complexes facilitate cell-fate commitment by recruiting chromatin modifiers via key co-CREs.
articles.abstractZh: 染色质结构和转录因子 (TF) 结合是发育过程中细胞命运规范的基础，但它们的相互调节关系仍不清楚。在这里，我们报告了气孔细胞谱系进展过程中动态染色质景观的图谱，其中连续的细胞状态转变由谱系特异性的 bHLH TF 控制。染色质可及性的主要重编程发生在增殖到分化的过渡阶段。我们发现了标志着早期前体阶段的新型顺式调控元件（CRE）、BBR/BPC（GAGA）和bHLH（E-box）基序，其中主调控bHLH TF、SPEECHLESS和MUTE连续结合，分别启动和终止增殖状态。 BPC TF 与 MUTE 复合，通过局部沉积抑制性组蛋白标记来抑制 SPEECHLESS 表达。我们阐明了细胞状态特异性异型 TF 复合物通过关键的共 CRE 招募染色质修饰剂来促进细胞命运决定的机制。

articles.title: Substrate-binding guides individual melibiose permeases MelB to structurally soften and to destabilize cytoplasmic middle-loop C3.
articles.titleZh: 底物结合引导个体蜜二糖渗透酶 MelB 软化结构并破坏细胞质中环 C3 的稳定性。
articles.authors: Blaimschein N, Hariharan P, Manioglu S, Guan L, Müller DJ.
articles.abstract: The melibiose permease MelB is a well-studied Na+-coupled transporter of the major facilitator superfamily. However, the symport mechanism of galactosides and cations is still not fully understood, especially at structural levels. Here, we use single-molecule force spectroscopy to investigate substrate-induced structural changes of MelB from Salmonella typhimurium. In the absence of substrate, MelB equally populates two different states, from which one shows higher mechanical structural stability with additional stabilization of the cytoplasmic middle-loop C3. In the presence of either melibiose or a coupling Na+-cation, however, MelB increasingly populates the mechanically less stable state, which shows a destabilized middle-loop C3. In the presence of both substrate and co-substrate, this mechanically less stable state of MelB is predominant. Our findings describe how both substrates guide MelB transporters to populate two different mechanically stabilized states, and contribute mechanistic insights to the alternating-access action for the galactoside/cation symport catalyzed by MelB.
articles.abstractZh: 蜜二糖渗透酶 MelB 是主要促进子超家族中经过充分研究的 Na+ 偶联转运蛋白。然而，半乳糖苷和阳离子的共转运机制仍不完全清楚，特别是在结构水平上。在这里，我们使用单分子力谱研究底物诱导的鼠伤寒沙门氏菌 MelB 的结构变化。在没有底物的情况下，MelB 同等地填充两种不同的状态，其中一种状态显示出更高的机械结构稳定性，并且细胞质中环 C3 具有额外的稳定性。然而，在存在蜜二糖或偶联 Na+-阳离子的情况下，MelB 逐渐占据机械稳定性较差的状态，这显示出不稳定的中环 C3。在底物和共底物同时存在的情况下，MelB 的机械稳定性较差的状态占主导地位。我们的研究结果描述了两种底物如何引导 MelB 转运蛋白填充两种不同的机械稳定状态，并为 MelB 催化的半乳糖苷/阳离子同向转运的交替访问作用提供了机制见解。

articles.title: Engineered cell entry links receptor biology with single-cell genomics.
articles.titleZh: 工程细胞进入将受体生物学与单细胞基因组学联系起来。
articles.authors: Yu B, Shi Q, Belk JA, Yost KE, Parker KR, Li R, Liu BB, Huang H, Lingwood D, Greenleaf WJ, Davis MM, Satpathy AT, Chang HY.
articles.abstract: Cells communicate with each other via receptor-ligand interactions. Here, we describe lentiviral-mediated cell entry by engineered receptor-ligand interaction (ENTER) to display ligand proteins, deliver payloads, and record receptor specificity. We optimize ENTER to decode interactions between T cell receptor (TCR)-MHC peptides, antibody-antigen, and other receptor-ligand pairs. A viral presentation strategy allows ENTER to capture interactions between B cell receptor and any antigen. We engineer ENTER to deliver genetic payloads to antigen-specific T or B cells to selectively modulate cellular behavior in mixed populations. Single-cell readout of ENTER by RNA sequencing (ENTER-seq) enables multiplexed enumeration of antigen specificities, TCR clonality, cell type, and states of individual T cells. ENTER-seq of CMV-seropositive patient blood samples reveals the viral epitopes that drive effector memory T cell differentiation and inter-clonal vs. intra-clonal phenotypic diversity targeting the same epitope. ENTER technology enables systematic discovery of receptor specificity, linkage to cell fates, and antigen-specific cargo delivery.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞通过受体-配体相互作用相互通讯。在这里，我们描述了慢病毒介导的细胞进入，通过工程化的受体-配体相互作用（ENTER）来展示配体蛋白、传递有效负载并记录受体特异性。我们优化 ENTER 来解码 T 细胞受体 (TCR)-MHC 肽、抗体-抗原和其他受体-配体对之间的相互作用。病毒呈递策略允许 ENTER 捕获 B 细胞受体与任何抗原之间的相互作用。我们设计了 ENTER，将遗传有效负载传递给抗原特异性 T 或 B 细胞，从而选择性地调节混合群体中的细胞行为。通过 RNA 测序 (ENTER-seq) 读取 ENTER 的单细胞读数可以对抗原特异性、TCR 克隆性、细胞类型和单个 T 细胞的状态进行多重计数。 CMV 血清阳性患者血液样本的 ENTER-seq 揭示了驱动效应记忆 T 细胞分化的病毒表位以及针对相同表位的克隆间与克隆内表型多样性。 ENTER 技术能够系统地发现受体特异性、与细胞命运的联系以及抗原特异性货物递送。

articles.title: EstG is a novel esterase required for cell envelope integrity in Caulobacter.
articles.titleZh: EstG 是柄杆菌细胞包膜完整性所需的新型酯酶。
articles.authors: Daitch AK, Orsburn BC, Chen Z, Alvarez L, Eberhard CD, Sundararajan K, Zeinert R, Kreitler DF, Jakoncic J, Chien P, Cava F, Gabelli SB, Goley ED.
articles.abstract: Proper regulation of the bacterial cell envelope is critical for cell survival. Identification and characterization of enzymes that maintain cell envelope homeostasis is crucial, as they can be targets for effective antibiotics. In this study, we have identified a novel enzyme, called EstG, whose activity protects cells from a variety of lethal assaults in the ⍺-proteobacterium Caulobacter crescentus. Despite homology to transpeptidase family cell wall enzymes and an ability to protect against cell-wall-targeting antibiotics, EstG does not demonstrate biochemical activity toward cell wall substrates. Instead, EstG is genetically connected to the periplasmic enzymes OpgH and BglX, responsible for synthesis and hydrolysis of osmoregulated periplasmic glucans (OPGs), respectively. The crystal structure of EstG revealed similarities to esterases and transesterases, and we demonstrated esterase activity of EstG in vitro. Using biochemical fractionation, we identified a cyclic hexamer of glucose as a likely substrate of EstG. This molecule is the first OPG described in Caulobacter and establishes a novel class of OPGs, the regulation and modification of which are important for stress survival and adaptation to fluctuating environments. Our data indicate that EstG, BglX, and OpgH comprise a previously unknown OPG pathway in Caulobacter. Ultimately, we propose that EstG is a novel enzyme that instead of acting on the cell wall, acts on cyclic OPGs to provide resistance to a variety of cellular stresses.
articles.abstractZh: 细菌细胞包膜的适当调节对于细胞存活至关重要。维持细胞包膜稳态的酶的鉴定和表征至关重要，因为它们可以成为有效抗生素的靶标。在这项研究中，我们发现了一种名为 EstG 的新型酶，其活性可以保护细胞免受新月柄变形杆菌的各种致命攻击。尽管与转肽酶家族细胞壁酶具有同源性，并且能够抵御细胞壁靶向抗生素，但 EstG 并未表现出针对细胞壁底物的生化活性。相反，EstG 在基因上与周质酶 OpgH 和 BglX 相关，分别负责渗透调节周质葡聚糖 (OPG) 的合成和水解。 EstG 的晶体结构揭示了与酯酶和酯交换酶的相似性，并且我们在体外证明了 EstG 的酯酶活性。通过生化分级分离，我们确定了葡萄糖的环状六聚体可能是 EstG 的底物。该分子是在 Caulobacter 中描述的第一个 OPG，并建立了一类新型 OPG，其调节和修饰对于应激耐受非常重要。

articles.title: Interspecies competition in oral biofilms mediated by Streptococcus gordonii extracellular deoxyribonuclease SsnA.
articles.titleZh: 戈登链球菌胞外脱氧核糖核酸酶 SsnA 介导的口腔生物膜的种间竞争。
articles.authors: Rostami N, Shields RC, Serrage HJ, Lawler C, Brittan JL, Yassin S, Ahmed H, Treumann A, Thompson P, Waldron KJ, Nobbs AH, Jakubovics NS.
articles.abstract: Extracellular DNA (eDNA) is a key component of many microbial biofilms including dental plaque. However, the roles of extracellular deoxyribonuclease (DNase) enzymes within biofilms are poorly understood. Streptococcus gordonii is a pioneer colonizer of dental plaque. Here, we identified and characterised SsnA, a cell wall-associated protein responsible for extracellular DNase activity of S. gordonii. The SsnA-mediated extracellular DNase activity of S. gordonii was suppressed following growth in sugars. SsnA was purified as a recombinant protein and shown to be inactive below pH 6.5. SsnA inhibited biofilm formation by Streptococcus mutans in a pH-dependent manner. Further, SsnA inhibited the growth of oral microcosm biofilms in human saliva. However, inhibition was ameliorated by the addition of sucrose. Together, these data indicate that S. gordonii SsnA plays a key role in interspecies competition within oral biofilms. Acidification of the medium through sugar catabolism could be a strategy for cariogenic species such as S. mutans to prevent SsnA-mediated exclusion from biofilms.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞外 DNA (eDNA) 是包括牙菌斑在内的许多微生物生物膜的关键成分。然而，人们对细胞外脱氧核糖核酸酶 (DNase) 在生物膜中的作用知之甚少。戈登链球菌是牙菌斑的先驱定植者。在这里，我们鉴定并表征了 SsnA，一种负责 S. gordonii 细胞外 DNase 活性的细胞壁相关蛋白。 S. gordonii 的 SsnA 介导的细胞外 DNase 活性在糖中生长后受到抑制。 SsnA 被纯化为重组蛋白，并显示在 pH 6.5 以下没有活性。 SsnA 以 pH 依赖性方式抑制变形链球菌生物膜的形成。此外，SsnA 抑制人唾液中口腔微观生物膜的生长。然而，通过添加蔗糖改善了抑制作用。总之，这些数据表明 S. gordonii SsnA 在口腔生物膜内的种间竞争中发挥着关键作用。通过糖分解代谢酸化培养基可能是变形链球菌等致龋菌种防止 SsnA 介导的生物膜排斥的策略。

articles.title: Optimization of the proliferation and persistency of CAR T cells derived from human induced pluripotent stem cells.
articles.titleZh: 源自人类诱导多能干细胞的 CAR T 细胞增殖和持久性的优化。
articles.authors: Ueda T, Shiina S, Iriguchi S, Terakura S, Kawai Y, Kabai R, Sakamoto S, Watanabe A, Ohara K, Wang B, Xu H, Minagawa A, Hotta A, Woltjen K, Uemura Y, Kodama Y, Seno H, Nakatsura T, Tamada K, Kaneko S.
articles.abstract: The effectiveness of chimaeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell immunotherapies against solid tumours relies on the accumulation, proliferation and persistency of T cells at the tumour site. Here we show that the proliferation of CD8αβ cytotoxic CAR T cells in solid tumours can be enhanced by deriving and expanding them from a single human induced-pluripotent-stem-cell clone bearing a CAR selected for efficient differentiation. We also show that the proliferation and persistency of the effector cells in the tumours can be further enhanced by genetically knocking out diacylglycerol kinase, which inhibits antigen-receptor signalling, and by transducing the cells with genes encoding for membrane-bound interleukin-15 (IL-15) and its receptor subunit IL-15Rα. In multiple tumour-bearing animal models, the engineered hiPSC-derived CAR T cells led to therapeutic outcomes similar to those of primary CD8 T cells bearing the same CAR. The optimization of effector CAR T cells derived from pluripotent stem cells may aid the development of long-lasting antigen-specific T-cell immunotherapies for the treatment of solid tumours.
articles.abstractZh: 嵌合抗原受体 (CAR) T 细胞免疫疗法针对实体瘤的有效性依赖于 T 细胞在肿瘤部位的积累、增殖和持久性。在这里，我们表明，实体瘤中 CD8αβ 细胞毒性 CAR T 细胞的增殖可以通过从带有选择用于有效分化的 CAR 的单个人诱导多能干细胞克隆衍生和扩展来增强。我们还表明，通过基因敲除抑制抗原受体信号传导的二酰甘油激酶，并用编码膜结合白细胞介素 15 (IL-15) 及其受体亚基 IL-15Rα 的基因转导细胞，可以进一步增强肿瘤中效应细胞的增殖和持久性。在多种携带肿瘤的动物模型中，工程化的 hiPSC 衍生的 CAR T 细胞产生的治疗结果与携带相同 CAR 的原代 CD8 T 细胞相似。源自多能干细胞的效应 CAR T 细胞的优化可能有助于开发用于治疗实体瘤的持久抗原特异性 T 细胞免疫疗法。

articles.title: Protocol for host volatile collection and mosquito behavior assays.
articles.titleZh: 宿主挥发物收集和蚊子行为测定的方案。
articles.authors: Zhang H, Zhu Y, Yu X, Cheng G.
articles.abstract: The volatile collection step is important for insect behavior assays and in-depth component analysis. Here, we describe how to collect volatiles from animals, humans, and skin microbiota. Furthermore, we detail steps to improve behavioral devices adapted to the different collection techniques. This protocol provides a high-throughput and widely applicable approach to study the attracting or repelling effect of volatiles on mosquitoes. The volatile collection step is easily adaptable and time efficient. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to Zhang et al.1.
articles.abstractZh: 挥发物收集步骤对于昆虫行为测定和深入成分分析非常重要。在这里，我们描述了如何从动物、人类和皮肤微生物群中收集挥发物。此外，我们还详细介绍了改进适应不同收集技术的行为设备的步骤。该协议提供了一种高通量且广泛适用的方法来研究挥发物对蚊子的吸引或驱避作用。易失性收集步骤易于调整且省时。有关该协议的使用和执行的完整详细信息，请参阅Zhang et al.1。

articles.title: Two isoleucyl tRNAs that decode synonymous codons divergently regulate breast cancer metastatic growth by controlling translation of proliferation-regulating genes.
articles.titleZh: 两种解码同义密码子的异亮氨酰 tRNA 通过控制增殖调节基因的翻译来不同地调节乳腺癌转移生长。
articles.authors: Earnest-Noble LB, Hsu D, Chen S, Asgharian H, Nandan M, Passarelli MC, Goodarzi H, Tavazoie SF.
articles.abstract: The human genome contains 61 codons encoding 20 amino acids. Synonymous codons representing a given amino acid are decoded by a set of transfer RNAs (tRNAs) called isoacceptors. We report the surprising observation that two isoacceptor tRNAs that decode synonymous codons become modulated in opposing directions during breast cancer progression. Specifically, tRNAIleUAU became upregulated, whereas tRNAIleGAU became repressed as breast cancer cells attained enhanced metastatic capacity. Functionally, tRNAIleUAU promoted and tRNAIleGAU suppressed metastatic colonization in mouse xenograft models. These tRNAs mediated opposing effects on codon-dependent translation of growth-promoting genes, consistent with genomic enrichment or depletion of their cognate codons in mitotic genes. Our findings uncover a specific isoacceptor tRNA pair that act in opposition, divergently impacting growth-regulating genes and a disease phenotype. Degeneracy of the genetic code can thus be biologically exploited by human cancer cells via tRNA isoacceptor shifts that causally facilitate the transition toward a growth-promoting state.
articles.abstractZh: 人类基因组包含编码20个氨基酸的61个密码子。代表给定氨基酸的同义密码子由一组称为 isoacceptor 的转移 RNA (tRNA) 解码。我们报告了一个令人惊讶的观察结果，即在乳腺癌进展过程中，两个解码同义密码子的同受体 tRNA 在相反的方向上受到调节。具体来说，当乳腺癌细胞获得增强的转移能力时，tRNAIleUAU 上调，而 tRNAIleGAU 则受到抑制。在功能上，tRNAIleUAU 促进小鼠异种移植模型中的转移定植，tRNAIleGAU 抑制转移定植。这些 tRNA 对生长促进基因的密码子依赖性翻译产生相反的作用，这与有丝分裂基因中同源密码子的基因组富集或耗尽一致。我们的研究结果揭示了一个特定的同受体 tRNA 对，其作用相反，对生长调节基因和疾病表型产生不同的影响。因此，人类癌细胞可以通过 tRNA 同工受体转变来生物利用遗传密码的简并性，从而促进向生长促进状态的转变。

articles.title: High-quality and robust protein quantification in large clinical/pharmaceutical cohorts with IonStar proteomics investigation.
articles.titleZh: 通过 IonStar 蛋白质组学研究，对大型临床/药物队列进行高质量、稳健的蛋白质定量。
articles.authors: Shen S, Wang X, Zhu X, Rasam S, Ma M, Huo S, Qian S, Zhang M, Qu M, Hu C, Jin L, Tian Y, Sethi S, Poulsen D, Wang J, Tu C, Qu J.
articles.abstract: Robust, reliable quantification of large sample cohorts is often essential for meaningful clinical or pharmaceutical proteomics investigations, but it is technically challenging. When analyzing very large numbers of samples, isotope labeling approaches may suffer from substantial batch effects, and even with label-free methods, it becomes evident that low-abundance proteins are not reliably measured owing to unsufficient reproducibility for quantification. The MS1-based quantitative proteomics pipeline IonStar was designed to address these challenges. IonStar is a label-free approach that takes advantage of the high sensitivity/selectivity attainable by ultrahigh-resolution (UHR)-MS1 acquisition (e.g., 120-240k full width at half maximum at m/z = 200) which is now widely available on ultrahigh-field Orbitrap instruments. By selectively and accurately procuring quantitative features of peptides within precisely defined, very narrow m/z windows corresponding to the UHR-MS1 resolution, the method minimizes co-eluted interferences and substantially enhances signal-to-noise ratio of low-abundance species by decreasing noise level. This feature results in high sensitivity, selectivity, accuracy and precision for quantification of low-abundance proteins, as well as fewer missing data and fewer false positives. This protocol also emphasizes the importance of well-controlled, robust experimental procedures to achieve high-quality quantification across a large cohort. It includes a surfactant cocktail-aided sample preparation procedure that achieves high/reproducible protein/peptide recoveries among many samples, and a trapping nano-liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry strategy for sensitive and reproducible acquisition of UHR-MS1 peptide signal robustly across a large cohort. Data processing and quality evaluation are illustrated using an example dataset ( http://proteomecentral.proteomexchange.org ), and example results from pharmaceutical project and one clinical project (patients with acute respiratory distress syndrome) are shown. The complete IonStar pipeline takes ~1-2 weeks for a sample cohort containing ~50-100 samples.
articles.abstractZh: 对大样本群体进行稳健、可靠的定量通常对于有意义的临床或药物蛋白质组学研究至关重要，但这在技术上具有挑战性。当分析大量样品时，同位素标记方法可能会受到显着的批次效应的影响，即使使用无标记方法，由于定量重现性不足，低丰度蛋白质也无法可靠地测量。基于 MS1 的定量蛋白质组学流程 IonStar 旨在应对这些挑战。 IonStar 是一种无标记方法，利用超高分辨率 (UHR)-MS1 采集（例如，m/z = 200 时半峰全宽 120-240k）可实现的高灵敏度/选择性，目前在超高场 Orbitrap 仪器上广泛使用。通过在与 UHR-MS1 分辨率相对应的精确定义、非常窄的 m/z 窗口内选择性、准确地获取肽的定量特征，该方法最大限度地减少了共洗脱干扰，并通过降低噪声水平显着提高了低丰度物种的信噪比。该特性导致高灵敏度、选择性、

articles.title: A cohesin traffic pattern genetically linked to gene regulation.
articles.titleZh: 与基因调控遗传相关的粘连蛋白运输模式。
articles.authors: Valton AL, Venev SV, Mair B, Khokhar ES, Tong AHY, Usaj M, Chan K, Pai AA, Moffat J, Dekker J.
articles.abstract: Cohesin-mediated loop extrusion has been shown to be blocked at specific cis-elements, including CTCF sites, producing patterns of loops and domain boundaries along chromosomes. Here we explore such cis-elements, and their role in gene regulation. We find that transcription termination sites of active genes form cohesin- and RNA polymerase II-dependent domain boundaries that do not accumulate cohesin. At these sites, cohesin is first stalled and then rapidly unloaded. Start sites of transcriptionally active genes form cohesin-bound boundaries, as shown before, but are cohesin-independent. Together with cohesin loading, possibly at enhancers, these sites create a pattern of cohesin traffic that guides enhancer-promoter interactions. Disrupting this traffic pattern, by removing CTCF, renders cells sensitive to knockout of genes involved in transcription initiation, such as the SAGA complexes, and RNA processing such DEAD/H-Box RNA helicases. Without CTCF, these factors are less efficiently recruited to active promoters.
articles.abstractZh: 粘连蛋白介导的环挤出已被证明在特定的顺式元件（包括 CTCF 位点）处被阻断，从而沿着染色体产生环模式和结构域边界。在这里，我们探讨了这些顺式元件及其在基因调控中的作用。我们发现活性基因的转录终止位点形成粘连蛋白和 RNA 聚合酶 II 依赖性结构域边界，但不积累粘连蛋白。在这些位点，粘连蛋白首先被停滞，然后迅速卸载。转录活性基因的起始位点形成粘连蛋白结合边界，如前所示，但不依赖于粘连蛋白。与可能在增强子上的粘连蛋白加载一起，这些位点创建了一种粘连蛋白流量模式，指导增强子-启动子相互作用。通过去除 CTCF 来破坏这种交通模式，使细胞对敲除参与转录起始（例如 SAGA 复合物）和 RNA 加工（例如 DEAD/H-Box RNA 解旋酶）的基因敏感。如果没有 CTCF，这些因子就无法有效地招募到活性启动子中。

articles.title: A critical period of translational control during brain development at codon resolution.
articles.titleZh: 大脑发育过程中密码子解析过程中翻译控制的关键时期。
articles.authors: Harnett D, Ambrozkiewicz MC, Zinnall U, Rusanova A, Borisova E, Drescher AN, Couce-Iglesias M, Villamil G, Dannenberg R, Imami K, Münster-Wandowski A, Fauler B, Mielke T, Selbach M, Landthaler M, Spahn CMT, Tarabykin V, Ohler U, Kraushar ML.
articles.abstract: Translation modulates the timing and amplification of gene expression after transcription. Brain development requires uniquely complex gene expression patterns, but large-scale measurements of translation directly in the prenatal brain are lacking. We measure the reactants, synthesis and products of mRNA translation spanning mouse neocortex neurogenesis, and discover a transient window of dynamic regulation at mid-gestation. Timed translation upregulation of chromatin-binding proteins like Satb2, which is essential for neuronal subtype differentiation, restricts protein expression in neuronal lineages despite broad transcriptional priming in progenitors. In contrast, translation downregulation of ribosomal proteins sharply decreases ribosome biogenesis, coinciding with a major shift in protein synthesis dynamics at mid-gestation. Changing activity of eIF4EBP1, a direct inhibitor of ribosome biogenesis, is concurrent with ribosome downregulation and affects neurogenesis of the Satb2 lineage. Thus, the molecular logic of brain development includes the refinement of transcriptional programs by translation. Modeling of the developmental neocortex translatome is provided as an open-source searchable resource at https://shiny.mdc-berlin.de/cortexomics .
articles.abstractZh: 翻译调节转录后基因表达的时间和扩增。大脑发育需要独特的复杂基因表达模式，但缺乏直接在产前大脑中进行大规模翻译测量。我们测量了小鼠新皮质神经发生过程中 mRNA 翻译的反应物、合成和产物，并发现了妊娠中期动态调节的瞬时窗口。 Satb2等染色质结合蛋白的定时翻译上调对神经元亚型分化至关重要，尽管祖细胞中存在广泛的转录启动，但它限制了神经元谱系中的蛋白质表达。相反，核糖体蛋白翻译下调急剧降低核糖体生物发生，与妊娠中期蛋白质合成动力学的重大转变相一致。 eIF4EBP1 是核糖体生物发生的直接抑制剂，其活性变化与核糖体下调同时发生，并影响 Satb2 谱系的神经发生。因此，大脑发育的分子逻辑包括通过翻译对转录程序进行细化。发育性新皮质翻译组的建模以开源形式提供

articles.title: A general method for chemogenetic control of peptide function.
articles.titleZh: 肽功能化学遗传学控制的通用方法。
articles.authors: Shen J, Geng L, Li X, Emery C, Kroning K, Shingles G, Lee K, Heyden M, Li P, Wang W.
articles.abstract: Natural or engineered peptides serve important biological functions. A general approach to achieve chemical-dependent activation of short peptides will be valuable for spatial and temporal control of cellular processes. Here we present a pair of chemically activated protein domains (CAPs) for controlling the accessibility of both the N- and C-terminal portion of a peptide. CAPs were developed through directed evolution of an FK506-binding protein. By fusing a peptide to one or both CAPs, the function of the peptide is blocked until a small molecule displaces them from the FK506-binding protein ligand-binding site. We demonstrate that CAPs are generally applicable to a range of short peptides, including a protease cleavage site, a dimerization-inducing heptapeptide, a nuclear localization signal peptide, and an opioid peptide, with a chemical dependence up to 156-fold. We show that the CAPs system can be utilized in cell cultures and multiple organs in living animals.
articles.abstractZh: 天然或工程肽具有重要的生物学功能。实现短肽的化学依赖性激活的通用方法对于细胞过程的空间和时间控制将是有价值的。在这里，我们提出了一对化学激活蛋白结构域 (CAP)，用于控制肽 N 端和 C 端部分的可及性。 CAP 是通过 FK506 结合蛋白的定向进化而开发的。通过将肽与一个或两个 CAP 融合，肽的功能被阻断，直到小分子将它们从 FK506 结合蛋白配体结合位点取代。我们证明，CAP 通常适用于一系列短肽，包括蛋白酶切割位点、二聚诱导七肽、核定位信号肽和阿片肽，化学依赖性高达 156 倍。我们证明 CAP 系统可用于细胞培养和活体动物的多个器官。

articles.title: Global profiling identifies a stress-responsive tyrosine site on EDC3 regulating biomolecular condensate formation.
articles.titleZh: 全局分析确定了 EDC3 上调节生物分子凝聚体形成的应激反应性酪氨酸位点。
articles.authors: Ciancone AM, Hosseinibarkooie S, Bai DL, Borne AL, Ferris HA, Hsu KL.
articles.abstract: RNA granules are cytoplasmic condensates that organize biochemical and signaling complexes in response to cellular stress. Functional proteomic investigations under RNA-granule-inducing conditions are needed to identify protein sites involved in coupling stress response with ribonucleoprotein regulation. Here, we apply chemical proteomics using sulfonyl-triazole (SuTEx) probes to capture cellular responses to oxidative and nutrient stress. The stress-responsive tyrosine and lysine sites detected mapped to known proteins involved in processing body (PB) and stress granule (SG) pathways, including LSM14A, FUS, and Enhancer of mRNA-decapping protein 3 (EDC3). Notably, disruption of EDC3 tyrosine 475 (Y475) resulted in hypo-phosphorylation at S161 and S131 and altered protein-protein interactions (PPIs) with decapping complex components (DDX6, DCP1A/B) and 14-3-3 proteins. This resulting mutant form of EDC3 was capable of rescuing the PB-deficient phenotype of EDC3 knockout cells. Taken together, our findings identify Y475 as an arsenic-responsive site that regulates RNA granule formation by coupling EDC3 post-translational modification and PPI states.
articles.abstractZh: RNA 颗粒是细胞质凝聚物，可组织生化和信号复合物以响应细胞应激。需要在 RNA 颗粒诱导条件下进行功能蛋白质组学研究，以确定参与应激反应与核糖核蛋白调节耦合的蛋白质位点。在这里，我们使用磺酰三唑 (SuTEx) 探针应用化学蛋白质组学来捕获细胞对氧化和营养应激的反应。检测到的应激反应酪氨酸和赖氨酸位点映射到参与加工体 (PB) 和应激颗粒 (SG) 途径的已知蛋白质，包括 LSM14A、FUS 和 mRNA 脱帽蛋白 3 增强子 (EDC3)。值得注意的是，EDC3 酪氨酸 475 (Y475) 的破坏导致 S161 和 S131 的低磷酸化，并改变与脱帽复合物成分 (DDX6、DCP1A/B) 和 14-3-3 蛋白的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用 (PPI)。由此产生的 EDC3 突变体形式能够挽救 EDC3 敲除细胞的 PB 缺陷表型。综上所述，我们的研究结果确定 Y475 是一个砷响应位点，通过耦合 EDC3 翻译后修饰和 PPI 状态来调节 RNA 颗粒的形成。

articles.title: Protein fluorescent labeling in live yeast cells using scFv-based probes.
articles.titleZh: 使用基于 scFv 的探针对活酵母细胞进行蛋白质荧光标记。
articles.authors: Tsirkas I, Zur T, Dovrat D, Cohen A, Ravkaie L, Aharoni A.
articles.abstract: The fusion of fluorescent proteins (FPs) to endogenous proteins is a widespread approach for microscopic examination of protein function, expression, and localization in the cell. However, proteins that are sensitive to FP fusion or expressed at low levels are difficult to monitor using this approach. Here, we develop a single-chain fragment variable (scFv)-FP approach to efficiently label Saccharomyces cerevisiae proteins that are tagged with repeats of hemagglutinin (HA)-tag sequences. We demonstrate the successful labeling of DNA-binding proteins and proteins localized to different cellular organelles including the nuclear membrane, peroxisome, Golgi apparatus, and mitochondria. This approach can lead to a significant increase in fluorescence intensity of the labeled protein, allows C'-terminal labeling of difficult-to-tag proteins and increased detection sensitivity of DNA-damage foci. Overall, the development of a scFv-FP labeling approach in yeast provides a general and simple tool for the function and localization analysis of the yeast proteome.
articles.abstractZh: 荧光蛋白 (FP) 与内源蛋白的融合是显微镜检查细胞中蛋白质功能、表达和定位的一种广泛使用的方法。然而，使用这种方法很难监测对 FP 融合敏感或低水平表达的蛋白质。在这里，我们开发了一种单链片段可变（scFv）-FP方法来有效标记带有血凝素（HA）标签序列重复标记的酿酒酵母蛋白质。我们证明了 DNA 结合蛋白和定位于不同细胞器（包括核膜、过氧化物酶体、高尔基体和线粒体）的蛋白质的成功标记。这种方法可以显着增加标记蛋白质的荧光强度，允许对难以标记的蛋白质进行 C' 末端标记，并提高 DNA 损伤灶的检测灵敏度。总体而言，酵母 scFv-FP 标记方法的开发为酵母蛋白质组的功能和定位分析提供了通用且简单的工具。

articles.title: Mucosal-associated invariant T cells for cancer immunotherapy.
articles.titleZh: 用于癌症免疫治疗的粘膜相关不变 T 细胞。
articles.authors: Li YR, Zhou K, Wilson M, Wilson M, Kramer A, Zhu Y, Dawson N, Yang L.
articles.abstract: Human mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells are characterized by their expression of an invariant TCR α chain Vα7.2-Jα33/Jα20/Jα12 paired with a restricted TCR β chain. MAIT cells recognize microbial peptides presented by the highly conserved MHC class I-like molecule MR1 and bridge the innate and acquired immune systems to mediate augmented immune responses. Upon activation, MAIT cells rapidly proliferate, produce a variety of cytokines and cytotoxic molecules, and trigger efficient antitumor immunity. Administration of a representative MAIT cell ligand 5-OP-RU effectively activates MAIT cells and enhances their antitumor capacity. In this review, we introduce MAIT cell biology and their importance in antitumor immunity, summarize the current development of peripheral blood mononuclear cell-derived and stem cell-derived MAIT cell products for cancer treatment, and discuss the potential of genetic engineering of MAIT cells for off-the-shelf cancer immunotherapy.
articles.abstractZh: 人粘膜相关恒定 T (MAIT) 细胞的特点是表达恒定 TCR α 链 Vα7.2-Jα33/Jα20/Jα12 与限制性 TCR β 链配对。 MAIT 细胞识别由高度保守的 MHC I 类分子 MR1 呈递的微生物肽，并连接先天性和后天性免疫系统以介导增强的免疫反应。 MAIT细胞被激活后，迅速增殖，产生多种细胞因子和细胞毒性分子，并引发高效的抗肿瘤免疫。施用代表性MAIT细胞配体5-OP-RU可有效激活MAIT细胞并增强其抗肿瘤能力。在这篇综述中，我们介绍了MAIT细胞生物学及其在抗肿瘤免疫中的重要性，总结了外周血单核细胞衍生和干细胞衍生的MAIT细胞产品用于癌症治疗的当前发展，并讨论了MAIT细胞基因工程用于现成癌症免疫治疗的潜力。

articles.title: Polarity of the CRISPR roadblock to transcription.
articles.titleZh: CRISPR 转录障碍的极性。
articles.authors: Hall PM, Inman JT, Fulbright RM, Le TT, Brewer JJ, Lambert G, Darst SA, Wang MD.
articles.abstract: CRISPR (clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats) utility relies on a stable Cas effector complex binding to its target site. However, a Cas complex bound to DNA may be removed by motor proteins carrying out host processes and the mechanism governing this removal remains unclear. Intriguingly, during CRISPR interference, RNA polymerase (RNAP) progression is only fully blocked by a bound endonuclease-deficient Cas (dCas) from the protospacer adjacent motif (PAM)-proximal side. By mapping dCas-DNA interactions at high resolution, we discovered that the collapse of the dCas R-loop allows Escherichia coli RNAP read-through from the PAM-distal side for both Sp-dCas9 and As-dCas12a. This finding is not unique to RNAP and holds for the Mfd translocase. This mechanistic understanding allowed us to modulate the dCas R-loop stability by modifying the guide RNAs. This work highlights the importance of the R-loop in dCas-binding stability and provides valuable mechanistic insights for broad applications of CRISPR technology.
articles.abstractZh: CRISPR（成簇规则间隔短回文重复序列）的实用性依赖于稳定的 Cas 效应复合物与其靶位点的结合。然而，与 DNA 结合的 Cas 复合物可能会被执行宿主过程的运动蛋白去除，并且控制这种去除的机制仍不清楚。有趣的是，在 CRISPR 干扰过程中，RNA 聚合酶 (RNAP) 的进展仅被来自原型间隔子相邻基序 (PAM) 近端的结合的核酸内切酶缺陷型 Cas (dCas) 完全阻断。通过以高分辨率绘制 dCas-DNA 相互作用图谱，我们发现 dCas R 环的崩溃允许大肠杆菌从 PAM 远端读取 Sp-dCas9 和 As-dCas12a 的 RNAP。这一发现并非 RNAP 所独有，也适用于 Mfd 转位酶。这种机制上的理解使我们能够通过修改引导 RNA 来调节 dCas R 环的稳定性。这项工作强调了 R 环在 dCas 结合稳定性中的重要性，并为 CRISPR 技术的广泛应用提供了有价值的机制见解。

articles.title: Specific and efficient gene knockout and overexpression in mouse interscapular brown adipocytes in vivo.
articles.titleZh: 小鼠肩胛间棕色脂肪细胞体内特异性、高效的基因敲除和过表达。
articles.authors: Xue K, Wu D, Qiu Y.
articles.abstract: The classical Cre-LoxP system is time consuming. Here we detail a protocol that leverages Rosa26-LSL-Cas9;Adiponectin-Cre mice to restrict Cas9 expression in adipocytes. This enables specific deletion of target genes in brown adipocytes within 6 weeks by local injection of AAV-sgRNA into interscapular brown adipose tissue. We also describe an adiponectin-promoter-driven AAV vector to express sgRNA-resistant cDNA-encoded protein for subsequent rescue. This protocol thus provides an efficient means to specifically knockout and overexpress genes in brown adipocytes in vivo. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to Xue et al. (2022).1.
articles.abstractZh: 经典的 Cre-LoxP 系统非常耗时。在这里，我们详细介绍了利用 Rosa26-LSL-Cas9;Adiponectin-Cre 小鼠限制脂肪细胞中 Cas9 表达的方案。通过将 AAV-sgRNA 局部注射到肩胛间棕色脂肪组织中，可以在 6 周内特异性删除棕色脂肪细胞中的靶基因。我们还描述了一种脂联素启动子驱动的 AAV 载体，用于表达 sgRNA 抗性 cDNA 编码蛋白，用于后续救援。因此，该方案提供了一种有效的方法来特异性敲除和过度表达体内棕色脂肪细胞中的基因。有关该协议的使用和执行的完整详细信息，请参阅Xue等人。 (2022).1。

articles.title: A circadian clock translational control mechanism targets specific mRNAs to cytoplasmic messenger ribonucleoprotein granules.
articles.titleZh: 生物钟翻译控制机制将特定的 mRNA 靶向细胞质信使核糖核蛋白颗粒。
articles.authors: Castillo KD, Wu C, Ding Z, Lopez-Garcia OK, Rowlinson E, Sachs MS, Bell-Pedersen D.
articles.abstract: Phosphorylation of Neurospora crassa eukaryotic initiation factor 2 α (eIF2α), a conserved translation initiation factor, is clock controlled. To determine the impact of rhythmic eIF2α phosphorylation on translation, we performed temporal ribosome profiling and RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) in wild-type (WT), clock mutant Δfrq, eIF2α kinase mutant Δcpc-3, and constitutively active cpc-3c cells. About 14% of mRNAs are rhythmically translated in WT cells, and translation rhythms for ∼30% of these mRNAs, which we named circadian translation-initiation-controlled genes (cTICs), are dependent on the clock and CPC-3. Most cTICs are expressed from arrhythmic mRNAs and contain a P-body (PB) localization motif in their 5' leader sequence. Deletion of SNR-1, a component of cytoplasmic messenger ribonucleoprotein granules (cmRNPgs) that include PBs and stress granules (SGs), and the PB motif on one of the cTIC mRNAs, zip-1, significantly alters zip-1 rhythmic translation. These results reveal that the clock regulates rhythmic translation of specific mRNAs through rhythmic eIF2α activity and cmRNPg metabolism.
articles.abstractZh: 粗糙脉孢菌真核起始因子 2 α (eIF2α)（一种保守的翻译起始因子）的磷酸化是受时钟控制的。为了确定节律性 eIF2α 磷酸化对翻译的影响，我们对野生型 (WT)、时钟突变体 Δfrq、eIF2α 激酶突变体 Δcpc-3 和组成型活性 cpc-3c 细胞进行了时间核糖体分析和 RNA 测序 (RNA-seq)。大约 14% 的 mRNA 在 WT 细胞中有节奏地翻译，其中约 30% 的 mRNA 的翻译节律（我们将其命名为昼夜节律翻译起始控制基因 (cTIC)）取决于时钟和 CPC-3。大多数 cTIC 由心律失常 mRNA 表达，并在其 5' 前导序列中包含 P 体 (PB) 定位基序。 SNR-1 是细胞质信使核糖核蛋白颗粒 (cmRNPgs) 的一个组成部分，其中包括 PB 和应激颗粒 (SG)，以及 cTIC mRNA 之一 zip-1 上的 PB 基序的删除会显着改变 zip-1 节律翻译。这些结果表明，时钟通过有节奏的 eIF2α 活性和 cmRNPg 代谢来调节特定 mRNA 的有节奏翻译。

articles.title: Biopharmaceutical benchmarks 2022.
articles.titleZh: 2022 年生物制药基准。
articles.authors: Walsh G, Walsh E.

articles.title: De novo birth of functional microproteins in the human lineage.
articles.titleZh: 人类谱系中功能性微生物蛋白的从头诞生。
articles.authors: Vakirlis N, Vance Z, Duggan KM, McLysaght A.
articles.abstract: Small open reading frames (sORFs) can encode functional "microproteins" that perform crucial biological tasks. However, their size makes them less amenable to genomic analysis, and their origins and conservation are poorly understood. Given their short length, it is plausible that some of these functional microproteins have recently originated entirely de novo from noncoding sequences. Here we sought to identify such cases in the human lineage by reconstructing the evolutionary origins of human microproteins previously found to have measurable, statistically significant fitness effects. By tracing the formation of each ORF and its transcriptional activation, we show that novel microproteins with significant phenotypic effects have emerged de novo throughout animal evolution, including two after the human-chimpanzee split. Notably, traditional methods for assessing coding potential would miss most of these cases. This evidence demonstrates that the functional potential intrinsic to sORFs can be relatively rapidly and frequently realized through de novo gene emergence.
articles.abstractZh: 小型开放阅读框（sORF）可以编码执行关键生物学任务的功能性“微生物蛋白”。然而，它们的大小使得它们不太适合基因组分析，而且它们的起源和保护也知之甚少。鉴于其长度较短，这些功能性微生物蛋白中的一些最近可能完全由非编码序列从头产生。在这里，我们试图通过重建人类微生物蛋白质的进化起源来识别人类谱系中的此类情况，这些蛋白质先前被发现具有可测量的、统计上显着的适应性效应。通过追踪每个 ORF 的形成及其转录激活，我们发现具有显着表型效应的新型微生物蛋白在整个动物进化过程中从头出现，其中包括人类与黑猩猩分裂后的两种微生物蛋白。值得注意的是，评估编码潜力的传统方法会错过大多数情况。这一证据表明，sORF 固有的功能潜力可以通过基因从头出现相对快速且频繁地实现。

articles.title: Developmental phenomics suggests that H3K4 monomethylation confers multi-level phenotypic robustness.
articles.titleZh: 发育表型组学表明 H3K4 单甲基化赋予多级表型稳健性。
articles.authors: Gandara L, Tsai A, Ekelöf M, Galupa R, Preger-Ben Noon E, Alexandrov T, Crocker J.
articles.abstract: How histone modifications affect animal development remains difficult to ascertain. Despite the prevalence of histone 3 lysine 4 monomethylation (H3K4me1) on enhancers, hypomethylation appears to have minor effects on phenotype and viability. Here, we genetically reduce H3K4me1 deposition in Drosophila melanogaster and find that hypomethylation reduces transcription factor enrichment in nuclear microenvironments, disrupts gene expression, and reduces phenotypic robustness. Using a developmental phenomics approach, we find changes in morphology, metabolism, behavior, and offspring production. However, many phenotypic changes are only detected when hypomethylated flies develop outside of standard laboratory environments or with specific genetic backgrounds. Therefore, quantitative phenomics measurements can unravel how pleiotropic modulators of gene expression affect developmental robustness under conditions resembling the natural environments of a species.
articles.abstractZh: 组蛋白修饰如何影响动物发育仍然很难确定。尽管增强子上普遍存在组蛋白 3 赖氨酸 4 单甲基化 (H3K4me1)，但低甲基化似乎对表型和活力影响较小。在这里，我们从基因角度减少了果蝇中 H3K4me1 的沉积，发现低甲基化会降低核微环境中转录因子的富集，破坏基因表达，并降低表型稳健性。使用发育表型组学方法，我们发现形态、新陈代谢、行为和后代产生的变化。然而，只有当低甲基化果蝇在标准实验室环境之外或具有特定遗传背景的情况下发育时，才能检测到许多表型变化。因此，定量表型组学测量可以揭示基因表达的多效性调节剂如何在类似于物种自然环境的条件下影响发育稳健性。

articles.title: Interspecies recombination, not de novo mutation, maintains virulence after β-lactam resistance acquisition in Streptococcus pneumoniae.
articles.titleZh: 肺炎链球菌获得β-内酰胺耐药性后，通过种间重组（而非从头​​突变）维持毒力。
articles.authors: Nishimoto AT, Dao TH, Jia Q, Ortiz-Marquez JC, Echlin H, Vogel P, van Opijnen T, Rosch JW.
articles.abstract: As opposed to de novo mutation, β-lactam resistance in S. pneumoniae is often conferred via homologous recombination during horizontal gene transfer. We hypothesize that β-lactam resistance in pathogenic streptococci is restricted to naturally competent species via intra-/interspecies recombination due to in vivo fitness trade-offs of de novo penicillin-binding protein (PBP) mutations. We show that de novo mutant populations have abrogated invasive disease capacity and are difficult to evolve in vivo. Conversely, serially transformed recombinant strains efficiently integrate resistant oral streptococcal DNA, gain penicillin resistance and tolerance, and retain virulence in mice. Large-scale changes in pbp2X, pbp2B, and non-PBP-related genes occur in recombinant isolates. Our results indicate that horizontal transfer of β-lactam resistance engenders initially favorable or minimal cost changes in vivo compared with de novo mutation(s), underscoring the importance of recombination in the emergence of β-lactam resistance and suggesting why some pathogenic streptococci lacking innate competence remain universally susceptible.
articles.abstractZh: 与从头突变相反，肺炎链球菌的β-内酰胺抗性通常是通过水平基因转移过程中的同源重组而赋予的。我们假设，由于青霉素结合蛋白（PBP）从头突变的体内适应性权衡，致病性链球菌中的β-内酰胺耐药性仅限于通过种内/种间重组的天然物种。我们表明，从头突变群体已经消除了侵袭性疾病的能力，并且难以在体内进化。相反，连续转化的重组菌株可有效整合耐药口腔链球菌 DNA，获得青霉素耐药性和耐受性，并在小鼠中保留毒力。重组分离株中 pbp2X、pbp2B 和非 PBP 相关基因发生大规模变化。我们的结果表明，与从头突变相比，β-内酰胺抗性的水平转移最初在体内产生有利或最小的成本变化，强调了重组在β-内酰胺抗性出现中的重要性，并表明为什么一些缺乏先天能力的致病性链球菌仍然普遍易感。

articles.title: Nuclear-cytoplasmic compartmentalization of cyclin B1-Cdk1 promotes robust timing of mitotic events.
articles.titleZh: 细胞周期蛋白 B1-Cdk1 的核-细胞质区室化促进有丝分裂事件的稳健计时。
