We also show that C15orf57 encodes a protein that binds the AP2 complex, localizes to clathrin-coated pits and enables efficient transferrin uptake. Finally, we provide an interactive webtool for the community to explore our results, which establish co-essentiality profiling as a powerful resource for biological pathway identification and discovery of new gene functions.
articles.abstractZh: 后基因组时代的一个中心问题是基因如何相互作用形成生物途径。对数百个细胞系的基因依赖性的测量已被用来将基因聚类到“共必需”途径中，但这种方法受到普遍存在的假阳性的限制。在本研究中，我们开发了一种统计方法，能够可靠地识别基因共必需性，并产生一组全基因组的功能模块。该图谱概括了不同的通路和蛋白质复合物，并预测了 108 个未表征基因的功能。验证最高预测，我们表明 TMEM189 编码缩醛磷脂合成的关键酶——缩醛磷脂去饱和酶。我们还表明，C15orf57 编码一种与 AP2 复合物结合的蛋白质，定位于网格蛋白包被的凹坑并能够有效摄取转铁蛋白。最后，我们为社区提供了一个交互式网络工具来探索我们的结果，将共本质分析建立为生物途径识别和新基因功能发现的强大资源。

articles.title: Generation of recombinant hyperimmune globulins from diverse B-cell repertoires.
articles.titleZh: 从不同的 B 细胞库中生成重组超免疫球蛋白。
articles.authors: Keating SM, Mizrahi RA, Adams MS, Asensio MA, Benzie E, Carter KP, Chiang Y, Edgar RC, Gautam BK, Gras A, Leong J, Leong R, Lim YW, Manickam VA, Medina-Cucurella AV, Niedecken AR, Saini J, Simons JF, Spindler MJ, Stadtmiller K, Tinsley B, Wagner EK, Wayham N, Tracy L, Lundberg CV, Büscher D, Terencio JV, Roalfe L, Pearce E, Richardson H, Goldblatt D, Ramjag AT, Carrington CVF, Simmons G, Muench MO, Chamow SM, Monroe B, Olson C, Oguin TH, Lynch H, Jeanfreau R, Mosher RA, Walch MJ, Bartley CR, Ross CA, Meyer EH, Adler AS, Johnson DS.
articles.abstract: Plasma-derived polyclonal antibody therapeutics, such as intravenous immunoglobulin, have multiple drawbacks, including low potency, impurities, insufficient supply and batch-to-batch variation. Here we describe a microfluidics and molecular genomics strategy for capturing diverse mammalian antibody repertoires to create recombinant multivalent hyperimmune globulins. Our method generates of diverse mixtures of thousands of recombinant antibodies, enriched for specificity and activity against therapeutic targets. Each hyperimmune globulin product comprised thousands to tens of thousands of antibodies derived from convalescent or vaccinated human donors or from immunized mice. Using this approach, we generated hyperimmune globulins with potent neutralizing activity against severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus-2 (SARS-CoV-2) in under 3 months, Fc-engineered hyperimmune globulins specific for Zika virus that lacked antibody-dependent enhancement of disease, and hyperimmune globulins specific for lung pathogens present in patients with primary immune deficiency. To address the limitations of rabbit-derived anti-thymocyte globulin, we generated a recombinant human version and demonstrated its efficacy in mice against graft-versus-host disease.
articles.abstractZh: 血浆衍生的多克隆抗体疗法，例如静脉注射免疫球蛋白，具有多种缺点，包括效力低、杂质、供应不足和批次间差异。在这里，我们描述了一种微流体和分子基因组学策略，用于捕获不同的哺乳动物抗体库以创建重组多价超免疫球蛋白。我们的方法产生了数千种重组抗体的不同混合物，这些抗体针对治疗靶点的特异性和活性得到了丰富。每种超免疫球蛋白产品包含数千至数万种源自恢复期或已接种疫苗的人类供体或免疫小鼠的抗体。利用这种方法，我们在不到 3 个月的时间内生成了对严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒 2 (SARS-CoV-2) 具有有效中和活性的超免疫球蛋白、针对寨卡病毒的 Fc 工程超免疫球蛋白（缺乏抗体依赖性疾病增强作用）以及针对原发性免疫缺陷患者中存在的肺部病原体的超免疫球蛋白。为了解决兔源抗胸腺细胞球蛋白的局限性，我们生成了重组人版本并 de

articles.title: Experimental systems biology approaches reveal interaction mechanisms in model multispecies communities.
articles.titleZh: 实验系统生物学方法揭示了模型多物种群落中的相互作用机制。
articles.authors: Khare A.
articles.abstract: Interactions between microorganisms in multispecies communities are thought to have substantial consequences for the community. Identifying the molecules and genetic pathways that contribute to such interplay is thus crucial to understand as well as modulate community dynamics. Here I focus on recent studies that utilize experimental systems biology techniques to study these phenomena in simplified model microbial communities. These unbiased biochemical and genomic approaches have identified novel interactions and described the underlying genetic and molecular mechanisms. I discuss the insights provided by these studies, describe innovative strategies used to investigate less tractable organisms and environments, and highlight the utility of integrating these and more targeted methods to comprehensively characterize interactions between species in microbial communities.
articles.abstractZh: 多物种群落中微生物之间的相互作用被认为会对群落产生重大影响。因此，识别有助于这种相互作用的分子和遗传途径对于理解和调节群落动态至关重要。在这里，我重点关注利用实验系统生物学技术在简化模型微生物群落中研究这些现象的最新研究。这些公正的生化和基因组方法已经确定了新的相互作用，并描述了潜在的遗传和分子机制。我讨论了这些研究提供的见解，描述了用于研究不易处理的生物体和环境的创新策略，并强调了整合这些方法和更有针对性的方法来全面表征微生物群落中物种之间相互作用的效用。

articles.title: Selective immunocapture and light-controlled traceless release of transiently caged proteins.
articles.titleZh: 选择性免疫捕获和光控无痕释放瞬时笼蛋白。
articles.authors: Rakauskaitė R, Urbanavičiūtė G, Simanavičius M, Žvirblienė A, Klimašauskas S.
articles.abstract: The 4,5-dimethoxy-2-nitrobenzyl (DMNB) photocaging group introduced into small biomolecules, peptides, oligonucleotides, and proteins is commonly used for spatiotemporal control of chemical and biological processes. Here, we describe the use of a DMNB-selective monoclonal antibody for non-covalent capture of chemically or biosynthetically produced proteins containing surface-exposed DMNB caging groups followed by light-controlled traceless decaging and release of the bound proteins into solution for a variety of downstream applications. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to Rakauskaitė et al. (2020).
articles.abstractZh: 引入小生物分子、肽、寡核苷酸和蛋白质中的 4,5-二甲氧基-2-硝基苄基 (DMNB) 光锁定基团通常用于化学和生物过程的时空控制。在这里，我们描述了使用 DMNB 选择性单克隆抗体来非共价捕获化学或生物合成产生的含有表面暴露的 DMNB 笼蔽基团的蛋白质，然后进行光控无痕脱笼并将结合的蛋白质释放到溶液中，以用于各种下游应用。有关该协议的使用和执行的完整详细信息，请参阅 Rakauskaitė 等人。 （2020）。

articles.title: A methionine-Mettl3-N6-methyladenosine axis promotes polycystic kidney disease.
articles.titleZh: 甲硫氨酸-Mettl3-N6-甲基腺苷轴可促进多囊肾病。
articles.authors: Ramalingam H, Kashyap S, Cobo-Stark P, Flaten A, Chang CM, Hajarnis S, Hein KZ, Lika J, Warner GM, Espindola-Netto JM, Kumar A, Kanchwala M, Xing C, Chini EN, Patel V.
articles.abstract: Autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD) is a common monogenic disorder marked by numerous progressively enlarging kidney cysts. Mettl3, a methyltransferase that catalyzes the abundant N6-methyladenosine (m6A) RNA modification, is implicated in development, but its role in most diseases is unknown. Here, we show that Mettl3 and m6A levels are increased in mouse and human ADPKD samples and that kidney-specific transgenic Mettl3 expression produces tubular cysts. Conversely, Mettl3 deletion in three orthologous ADPKD mouse models slows cyst growth. Interestingly, methionine and S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) levels are also elevated in ADPKD models. Moreover, methionine and SAM induce Mettl3 expression and aggravate ex vivo cyst growth, whereas dietary methionine restriction attenuates mouse ADPKD. Finally, Mettl3 activates the cyst-promoting c-Myc and cAMP pathways through enhanced c-Myc and Avpr2 mRNA m6A modification and translation. Thus, Mettl3 promotes ADPKD and links methionine utilization to epitranscriptomic activation of proliferation and cyst growth.
articles.abstractZh: 常染色体显性多囊肾病 (ADPKD) 是一种常见的单基因疾病，其特征是大量逐渐增大的肾囊肿。 Mettl3 是一种甲基转移酶，可催化丰富的 N6-甲基腺苷 (m6A) RNA 修饰，与发育有关，但其在大多数疾病中的作用尚不清楚。在这里，我们表明小鼠和人类 ADPKD 样本中 Mettl3 和 m6A 水平增加，并且肾脏特异性转基因 Mettl3 表达产生管状囊肿。相反，在三种直系同源 ADPKD 小鼠模型中，Mettl3 缺失会减缓囊肿的生长。有趣的是，ADPKD 模型中的蛋氨酸和 S-腺苷蛋氨酸 (SAM) 水平也升高。此外，蛋氨酸和 SAM 诱导 Mettl3 表达并加剧离体囊肿生长，而饮食蛋氨酸限制可减轻小鼠 ADPKD。最后，Mettl3 通过增强 c-Myc 和 Avpr2 mRNA m6A 修饰和翻译来激活囊肿促进 c-Myc 和 cAMP 通路。因此，Mettl3 促进 ADPKD 并将蛋氨酸利用与增殖和囊肿生长的表观转录激活联系起来。

articles.title: Lifestyle-specific S-nitrosylation of protein cysteine thiols regulates Escherichia coli biofilm formation and resistance to oxidative stress.
articles.titleZh: 蛋白质半胱氨酸硫醇的生活方式特异性 S-亚硝基化可调节大肠杆菌生物膜的形成和对氧化应激的抵抗力。
articles.authors: Barraud N, Létoffé S, Beloin C, Vinh J, Chiappetta G, Ghigo JM.
articles.abstract: Communities of bacteria called biofilms are characterized by reduced diffusion, steep oxygen, and redox gradients and specific properties compared to individualized planktonic bacteria. In this study, we investigated whether signaling via nitrosylation of protein cysteine thiols (S-nitrosylation), regulating a wide range of functions in eukaryotes, could also specifically occur in biofilms and contribute to bacterial adaptation to this widespread lifestyle. We used a redox proteomic approach to compare cysteine S-nitrosylation in aerobic and anaerobic biofilm and planktonic Escherichia coli cultures and we identified proteins with biofilm-specific S-nitrosylation status. Using bacterial genetics and various phenotypic screens, we showed that impairing S-nitrosylation in proteins involved in redox homeostasis and amino acid synthesis such as OxyR, KatG, and GltD altered important biofilm properties, including motility, biofilm maturation, or resistance to oxidative stress. Our study therefore revealed that S-nitrosylation constitutes a physiological basis underlying functions critical for E. coli adaptation to the biofilm environment.
articles.abstractZh: 与个体化的浮游细菌相比，被称为生物膜的细菌群落的特征是扩散减少、氧气和氧化还原梯度陡峭以及特定的性质。在这项研究中，我们研究了通过蛋白质半胱氨酸硫醇的亚硝基化（S-亚硝基化）发出的信号，调节真核生物的多种功能，是否也可以特异性地发生在生物膜中，并有助于细菌适应这种广泛的生活方式。我们使用氧化还原蛋白质组学方法来比较需氧和厌氧生物膜以及浮游大肠杆菌培养物中的半胱氨酸 S-亚硝基化，并鉴定了具有生物膜特异性 S-亚硝基化状态的蛋白质。利用细菌遗传学和各种表型筛选，我们发现，损害参与氧化还原稳态和氨基酸合成的蛋白质（例如 OxyR、KatG 和 GltD）中的 S-亚硝基化会改变重要的生物膜特性，包括运动性、生物膜成熟或对氧化应激的抵抗力。因此，我们的研究表明，S-亚硝基化构成了大肠杆菌适应生物膜环境的关键功能的生理基础。

articles.title: Programmable protein circuit design.
articles.titleZh: 可编程蛋白质电路设计。
articles.authors: Chen Z, Elowitz MB.
articles.abstract: A fundamental challenge in synthetic biology is to create molecular circuits that can program complex cellular functions. Because proteins can bind, cleave, and chemically modify one another and interface directly and rapidly with endogenous pathways, they could extend the capabilities of synthetic circuits beyond what is possible with gene regulation alone. However, the very diversity that makes proteins so powerful also complicates efforts to harness them as well-controlled synthetic circuit components. Recent work has begun to address this challenge, focusing on principles such as orthogonality and composability that permit construction of diverse circuit-level functions from a limited set of engineered protein components. These approaches are now enabling the engineering of circuits that can sense, transmit, and process information; dynamically control cellular behaviors; and enable new therapeutic strategies, establishing a powerful paradigm for programming biology.
articles.abstractZh: 合成生物学的一个基本挑战是创建可以编程复杂细胞功能的分子电路。由于蛋白质可以相互结合、裂解和化学修饰，并与内源途径直接、快速地相互作用，因此它们可以扩展合成电路的功能，超出仅靠基因调控所能实现的范围。然而，使蛋白质如此强大的多样性也使利用它们作为良好控制的合成电路组件的努力变得复杂。最近的工作已经开始应对这一挑战，重点关注正交性和可组合性等原则，这些原则允许从一组有限的工程蛋白质组件构建不同的电路级功能。这些方法现在使得能够感知、传输和处理信息的电路工程成为可能。动态控制细胞行为；并实现新的治疗策略，为编程生物学建立强大的范例。

articles.title: Tau aggregates are RNA-protein assemblies that mislocalize multiple nuclear speckle components.
articles.titleZh: Tau 蛋白聚集体是 RNA-蛋白质组装体，可错误定位多个核斑点成分。
articles.authors: Lester E, Ooi FK, Bakkar N, Ayers J, Woerman AL, Wheeler J, Bowser R, Carlson GA, Prusiner SB, Parker R.
articles.abstract: Tau aggregates contribute to neurodegenerative diseases, including frontotemporal dementia and Alzheimer's disease (AD). Although RNA promotes tau aggregation in vitro, whether tau aggregates in cells contain RNA is unknown. We demonstrate, in cell culture and mouse brains, that cytosolic and nuclear tau aggregates contain RNA with enrichment for small nuclear RNAs (snRNAs) and small nucleolar RNAs (snoRNAs). Nuclear tau aggregates colocalize with and alter the composition, dynamics, and organization of nuclear speckles, membraneless organelles involved in pre-mRNA splicing. Moreover, several nuclear speckle components, including SRRM2, mislocalize to cytosolic tau aggregates in cells, mouse brains, and brains of individuals with AD, frontotemporal dementia (FTD), and corticobasal degeneration (CBD). Consistent with these alterations, we observe that the presence of tau aggregates is sufficient to alter pre-mRNA splicing. This work identifies tau alteration of nuclear speckles as a feature of tau aggregation that may contribute to the pathology of tau aggregates.
articles.abstractZh: Tau 蛋白聚集会导致神经退行性疾病，包括额颞叶痴呆和阿尔茨海默病 (AD)。尽管RNA在体外促进tau聚集，但细胞中的tau聚集是否含有RNA尚不清楚。我们在细胞培养物和小鼠大脑中证明，胞质和核 tau 聚集体含有富集小核 RNA (snRNA) 和小核仁 RNA (snoRNA) 的 RNA。核tau蛋白聚集体与核斑点、参与前mRNA剪接的无膜细胞器共定位并改变其组成、动态和组织。此外，包括 SRRM2 在内的几种核斑点成分错误定位到细胞、小鼠大脑以及 AD、额颞叶痴呆 (FTD) 和皮质基底节变性 (CBD) 患者的大脑中的胞质 tau 聚集体。与这些改变一致，我们观察到 tau 聚集体的存在足以改变前 mRNA 剪接。这项工作将核斑点的 tau 改变确定为 tau 聚集的一个特征，可能有助于 tau 聚集的病理学。

articles.title: Protocol for measuring sphingolipid metabolism in budding yeast.
articles.authors: Ikeda A, Hanaoka K, Funato K.
articles.abstract: Sphingolipid biosynthesis occurs in both the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) and the Golgi apparatus. Ceramide synthesized in the ER is transported to the Golgi and incorporated into complex sphingolipids. Here, we present a step-by-step protocol to analyze sphingolipid metabolism in budding yeast. Ceramide and inositolphosphorylceramide (IPC) are classes of sphingolipids present in yeast and are metabolically labeled with radioactive precursors. This protocol for metabolic labeling can be used to investigate ceramide transport in an in vivo environment. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to Ikeda et al. (2020).

articles.title: A review of dynamical systems approaches for the detection of chaotic attractors in cancer networks.
articles.titleZh: 用于检测癌症网络中混沌吸引子的动力系统方法的综述。
articles.authors: Uthamacumaran A.
articles.abstract: Cancers are complex dynamical systems. They remain the leading cause of disease-related pediatric mortality in North America. To overcome this burden, we must decipher the state-space attractor dynamics of gene expression patterns and protein oscillations orchestrated by cancer stemness networks. The review provides an overview of dynamical systems theory to steer cancer research in pattern science. While most of our current tools in network medicine rely on statistical correlation methods, causality inference remains primitively developed. As such, a survey of attractor reconstruction methods and machine algorithms for the detection of causal structures applicable in experimentally derived time series cancer datasets is presented. A toolbox of complex systems approaches are discussed for reconstructing the signaling state space of cancer networks, interpreting causal relationships in their time series gene expression patterns, and assisting clinical decision making in computational oncology. As a proof of concept, the applicability of some algorithms are demonstrated on pediatric brain cancer datasets and the requirement of their time series analysis is highlighted.
articles.abstractZh: 癌症是复杂的动力系统。它们仍然是北美疾病相关儿科死亡的主要原因。为了克服这一负担，我们必须破译由癌症干性网络精心策划的基因表达模式和蛋白质振荡的状态空间吸引子动力学。该综述概述了动力系统理论，以指导模式科学中的癌症研究。虽然我们目前网络医学中的大多数工具都依赖于统计相关方法，但因果推断仍然处于初级发展阶段。因此，提出了对吸引子重建方法和机器算法的调查，用于检测适用于实验得出的时间序列癌症数据集的因果结构。讨论了复杂系统方法的工具箱，用于重建癌症网络的信号状态空间，解释其时间序列基因表达模式中的因果关系，并协助计算肿瘤学中的临床决策。作为概念证明，一些算法的适用性在儿科脑癌数据集上得到了证明，并强调了其时间序列分析的要求。

articles.title: Mitochondrial NADP+ is essential for proline biosynthesis during cell growth.
articles.titleZh: 线粒体 NADP+ 对于细胞生长过程中脯氨酸生物合成至关重要。
articles.authors: Tran DH, Kesavan R, Rion H, Soflaee MH, Solmonson A, Bezwada D, Vu HS, Cai F, Phillips JA, DeBerardinis RJ, Hoxhaj G.
articles.abstract: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate (NADP+) is vital to produce NADPH, a principal supplier of reducing power for biosynthesis of macromolecules and protection against oxidative stress. NADPH exists in separate pools, in both the cytosol and mitochondria; however, the cellular functions of mitochondrial NADPH are incompletely described. Here, we find that decreasing mitochondrial NADP(H) levels through depletion of NAD kinase 2 (NADK2), an enzyme responsible for production of mitochondrial NADP+, renders cells uniquely proline auxotrophic. Cells with NADK2 deletion fail to synthesize proline, due to mitochondrial NADPH deficiency. We uncover the requirement of mitochondrial NADPH and NADK2 activity for the generation of the pyrroline-5-carboxylate metabolite intermediate as the bottleneck step in the proline biosynthesis pathway. Notably, after NADK2 deletion, proline is required to support nucleotide and protein synthesis, making proline essential for the growth and proliferation of NADK2-deficient cells. Thus, we highlight proline auxotrophy in mammalian cells and discover that mitochondrial NADPH is essential to enable proline biosynthesis.
articles.abstractZh: 烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸磷酸 (NADP+) 对于产生 NADPH 至关重要，NADPH 是大分子生物合成和防止氧化应激的还原能力的主要供应者。 NADPH 存在于细胞质和线粒体中的不同池中；然而，线粒体 NADPH 的细胞功能尚未完全描述。在这里，我们发现通过消耗 NAD 激酶 2 (NADK2)（一种负责产生线粒体 NADP+ 的酶）来降低线粒体 NADP(H) 水平，使细胞呈现独特的脯氨酸营养缺陷型。由于线粒体 NADPH 缺乏，NADK2 缺失的细胞无法合成脯氨酸。我们发现线粒体 NADPH 和 NADK2 活性对于生成吡咯啉-5-羧酸盐代谢中间体是脯氨酸生物合成途径中的瓶颈步骤。值得注意的是，NADK2 缺失后，需要脯氨酸来支持核苷酸和蛋白质合成，这使得脯氨酸对于 NADK2 缺陷细胞的生长和增殖至关重要。因此，我们强调哺乳动物细胞中的脯氨酸营养缺陷型，并发现线粒体 NADPH 对于脯氨酸生物合成至关重要。

articles.title: Decoding the messaging of the ubiquitin system using chemical and protein probes.
articles.titleZh: 使用化学和蛋白质探针解码泛素系统的消息传递。
articles.authors: Henneberg LT, Schulman BA.
articles.abstract: Post-translational modification of proteins by ubiquitin is required for nearly all aspects of eukaryotic cell function. The numerous targets of ubiquitylation, and variety of ubiquitin modifications, are often likened to a code, where the ultimate messages are diverse responses to target ubiquitylation. E1, E2, and E3 multiprotein enzymatic assemblies modify specific targets and thus function as messengers. Recent advances in chemical and protein tools have revolutionized our ability to explore the ubiquitin system, through enabling new high-throughput screening methods, matching ubiquitylation enzymes with their cellular targets, revealing intricate allosteric mechanisms regulating ubiquitylating enzymes, facilitating structural revelation of transient assemblies determined by multivalent interactions, and providing new paradigms for inhibiting and redirecting ubiquitylation in vivo as new therapeutics. Here we discuss the development of methods that control, disrupt, and extract the flow of information across the ubiquitin system and have enabled elucidation of the underlying molecular and cellular biology.
articles.abstractZh: 真核细胞功能的几乎所有方面都需要泛素对蛋白质进行翻译后修饰。 The numerous targets of ubiquitylation, and variety of ubiquitin modifications, are often likened to a code, where the ultimate messages are diverse responses to target ubiquitylation. E1、E2 和 E3 多蛋白酶组装体修饰特定靶标，从而发挥信使的作用。化学和蛋白质工具的最新进展彻底改变了我们探索泛素系统的能力，通过启用新的高通量筛选方法，将泛素化酶与其细胞靶标相匹配，揭示调节泛素化酶的复杂变构机制，促进多价相互作用确定的瞬时组装的结构揭示，并为体内抑制和重定向泛素化作为新的治疗方法提供新的范例。 Here we discuss the development of methods that control, disrupt, and extract the flow of information across the ubiquitin system and have enabled elucidation of the underlying molecular and cellular biology.

articles.title: Directed evolution in mammalian cells.
articles.titleZh: 哺乳动物细胞的定向进化。
articles.authors: Hendel SJ, Shoulders MD.
articles.abstract: Directed evolution experiments are typically carried out using in vitro systems, bacteria, or yeast-even when the goal is to probe or modulate mammalian biology. Performing directed evolution in systems that do not match the intended mammalian environment severely constrains the scope and functionality of the targets that can be evolved. We review new platforms that are now making it possible to use the mammalian cell itself as the setting for directed evolution and present an overview of frontier challenges and high-impact targets for this approach.
articles.abstractZh: 定向进化实验通常使用体外系统、细菌或酵母进行，即使目标是探测或调节哺乳动物生物学。在与预期哺乳动物环境不匹配的系统中进行定向进化严重限制了可进化目标的范围和功能。我们回顾了现在可以使用哺乳动物细胞本身作为定向进化环境的新平台，并概述了这种方法的前沿挑战和高影响目标。

articles.title: Liquid-like protein interactions catalyse assembly of endocytic vesicles.
articles.titleZh: 液体状蛋白质相互作用催化内吞囊泡的组装。
articles.authors: Day KJ, Kago G, Wang L, Richter JB, Hayden CC, Lafer EM, Stachowiak JC.
articles.abstract: During clathrin-mediated endocytosis, dozens of proteins assemble into an interconnected network at the plasma membrane. As initiators of endocytosis, Eps15 and Fcho1/2 concentrate downstream components, while permitting dynamic rearrangement within the budding vesicle. How do initiator proteins meet these competing demands? Here we show that Eps15 and Fcho1/2 rely on weak, liquid-like interactions to catalyse endocytosis. In vitro, these weak interactions promote the assembly of protein droplets with liquid-like properties. To probe the physiological role of these liquid-like networks, we tuned the strength of initiator protein assembly in real time using light-inducible oligomerization of Eps15. Low light levels drove liquid-like assemblies, restoring normal rates of endocytosis in mammalian Eps15-knockout cells. By contrast, initiator proteins formed solid-like assemblies upon exposure to higher light levels, which stalled vesicle budding, probably owing to insufficient molecular rearrangement. These findings suggest that liquid-like assembly of initiator proteins provides an optimal catalytic platform for endocytosis.
articles.abstractZh: 在网格蛋白介导的内吞作用过程中，数十种蛋白质在质膜上组装成互连的网络。作为内吞作用的引发剂，Eps15 和 Fcho1/2 集中下游成分，同时允许出芽囊泡内的动态重排。起始蛋白如何满足这些相互竞争的需求？在这里，我们表明 Eps15 和 Fcho1/2 依赖于微弱的、类似液体的相互作用来催化内吞作用。在体外，这些弱相互作用促进具有液体性质的蛋白质液滴的组装。为了探究这些液体状网络的生理作用，我们使用 Eps15 的光诱导寡聚化实时调整起始蛋白组装的强度。低光水平驱动液体状组装，恢复哺乳动物 Eps15 敲除细胞的正常内吞速率。相比之下，引发蛋白在暴露于较高光照水平时形成固体状组装体，这可能是由于分子重排不足而导致囊泡出芽停滞。这些发现表明，起始蛋白的液体状组装为内吞作用提供了最佳的催化平台。

articles.title: Small molecule targeting of biologically relevant RNA tertiary and quaternary structures.
articles.titleZh: 生物相关 RNA 三级和四级结构的小分子靶向。
articles.authors: Zafferani M, Hargrove AE.
articles.abstract: Initial successes in developing small molecule ligands for non-coding RNAs have underscored their potential as therapeutic targets. More recently, these successes have been aided by advances in biophysical and structural techniques for identification and characterization of more complex RNA structures; these higher-level folds present protein-like binding pockets that offer opportunities to design small molecules that could achieve a degree of selectivity often hard to obtain at the primary and secondary structure level. More specifically, identification and small molecule targeting of RNA tertiary and quaternary structures have allowed researchers to probe several human diseases and have resulted in promising clinical candidates. In this review we highlight a selection of diverse and exciting successes and the experimental approaches that led to their discovery. These studies include examples of recent developments in RNA-centric assays and ligands that provide insight into the features responsible for the affinity and biological outcome of RNA-targeted chemical probes. This report highlights the potential and emerging opportunities to selectively target RNA tertiary and quaternary structures as a route to better understand and, ultimately, treat many diseases.
articles.abstractZh: 开发非编码 RNA 小分子配体的初步成功强调了它们作为治疗靶点的潜力。最近，这些成功得益于生物物理和结构技术的进步，用于识别和表征更复杂的 RNA 结构。这些更高水平的折叠呈现出类似蛋白质的结合袋，为设计小分子提供了机会，这些小分子可以实现在一级和二级结构水平上通常难以获得的一定程度的选择性。更具体地说，RNA 三级和四级结构的识别和小分子靶向使研究人员能够探索多种人类疾病，并产生了有希望的临床候选药物。在这篇综述中，我们重点介绍了一系列令人兴奋的成功案例以及导致其发现的实验方法。这些研究包括以 RNA 为中心的测定和配体的最新进展的例子，它们提供了对 RNA 靶向化学探针的亲和力和生物学结果的相关特征的深入了解。本报告强调了选择性靶向 RNA 三级和四级的潜力和新兴机会

articles.title: High-throughput 5'P sequencing enables the study of degradation-associated ribosome stalls.
articles.titleZh: 高通量 5'P 测序能够研究与降解相关的核糖体失速。
articles.authors: Zhang Y, Pelechano V.
articles.abstract: RNA degradation is critical for gene expression and mRNA quality control. mRNA degradation is connected to the translation process up to the degree that 5'-3' mRNA degradation follows the last translating ribosome. Here, we present an improved high-throughput 5'P degradome RNA-sequencing method (HT-5Pseq). HT-5Pseq is easy, scalable, and uses affordable duplex-specific nuclease-based rRNA depletion. We investigate in vivo ribosome stalls focusing on translation termination. By comparing ribosome stalls identified by ribosome profiling, disome-seq and HT-5Pseq, we find that degradation-associated ribosome stalls are often enriched in Arg preceding the stop codon. On the contrary, mRNAs depleted for those stalls use more frequently a TAA stop codon preceded by hydrophobic amino acids. Finally, we show that termination stalls found by HT-5Pseq, and not by other approaches, are associated with decreased mRNA stability. Our work suggests that ribosome stalls associated with mRNA decay can be easily captured by investigating the 5'P degradome.
articles.abstractZh: RNA 降解对于基因表达和 mRNA 质量控制至关重要。 mRNA 降解与翻译过程的关联程度达到了 5'-3' mRNA 降解遵循最后一个翻译核糖体的程度。在这里，我们提出了一种改进的高通量 5'P 降解组 RNA 测序方法 (HT-5Pseq)。 HT-5Pseq 简单、可扩展，并使用经济实惠的基于双链体特异性核酸酶的 rRNA 去除。我们研究体内核糖体失速，重点关注翻译终止。通过比较核糖体分析、二体测序和 HT-5Pseq 鉴定的核糖体停顿，我们发现与降解相关的核糖体停顿通常在终止密码子之前的 Arg 中富集。相反，那些因停顿而耗尽的 mRNA 更频繁地使用前面带有疏水性氨基酸的 TAA 终止密码子。最后，我们证明 HT-5Pseq 而非其他方法发现的终止停滞与 mRNA 稳定性下降相关。我们的工作表明，通过研究 5'P 降解组可以轻松捕获与 mRNA 降解相关的核糖体停滞。

articles.title: The SMC5/6 complex compacts and silences unintegrated HIV-1 DNA and is antagonized by Vpr.
articles.titleZh: SMC5/6 复合物压缩并沉默未整合的 HIV-1 DNA，并被 Vpr 拮抗。
articles.authors: Dupont L, Bloor S, Williamson JC, Cuesta SM, Shah R, Teixeira-Silva A, Naamati A, Greenwood EJD, Sarafianos SG, Matheson NJ, Lehner PJ.
articles.abstract: Silencing of nuclear DNA is an essential feature of innate immune responses to invading pathogens. Early in infection, unintegrated lentiviral cDNA accumulates in the nucleus yet remains poorly expressed. In HIV-1-like lentiviruses, the Vpr accessory protein enhances unintegrated viral DNA expression, suggesting Vpr antagonizes cellular restriction. We previously showed how Vpr remodels the host proteome, identifying multiple cellular targets. We now screen these using a targeted CRISPR-Cas9 library and identify SMC5-SMC6 complex localization factor 2 (SLF2) as the Vpr target responsible for silencing unintegrated HIV-1. SLF2 recruits the SMC5/6 complex to unintegrated lentiviruses, and depletion of SLF2, or the SMC5/6 complex, increases viral expression. ATAC-seq demonstrates that Vpr-mediated SLF2 depletion increases chromatin accessibility of unintegrated virus, suggesting that the SMC5/6 complex compacts viral chromatin to silence gene expression. This work implicates the SMC5/6 complex in nuclear immunosurveillance of extrachromosomal DNA and defines its targeting by Vpr as an evolutionarily conserved antagonism.
articles.abstractZh: 核 DNA 沉默是针对入侵病原体的先天免疫反应的一个基本特征。在感染早期，未整合的慢病毒 cDNA 在细胞核中积累，但仍表达不佳。在 HIV-1 样慢病毒中，Vpr 辅助蛋白增强未整合的病毒 DNA 表达，表明 Vpr 拮抗细胞限制。我们之前展示了 Vpr 如何重塑宿主蛋白质组，识别多个细胞靶标。我们现在使用靶向 CRISPR-Cas9 文库筛选这些病毒，并确定 SMC5-SMC6 复合物定位因子 2 (SLF2) 作为负责沉默未整合的 HIV-1 的 Vpr 靶点。 SLF2 将 SMC5/6 复合物招募到未整合的慢病毒中，而 SLF2 或 SMC5/6 复合物的耗尽会增加病毒表达。 ATAC-seq 证明 Vpr 介导的 SLF2 耗竭增加了未整合病毒的染色质可及性，表明 SMC5/6 复合物压缩病毒染色质以沉默基因表达。这项工作表明 SMC5/6 复合物参与染色体外 DNA 的核免疫监视，并将 Vpr 的靶向定义为进化上保守的拮抗作用。

articles.title: Single-cell resolution of lineage trajectories in the Arabidopsis stomatal lineage and developing leaf.
articles.titleZh: 拟南芥气孔谱系和发育中的叶子的谱系轨迹的单细胞分辨率。
articles.authors: Lopez-Anido CB, Vatén A, Smoot NK, Sharma N, Guo V, Gong Y, Anleu Gil MX, Weimer AK, Bergmann DC.
articles.abstract: Dynamic cell identities underlie flexible developmental programs. The stomatal lineage in the Arabidopsis leaf epidermis features asynchronous and indeterminate divisions that can be modulated by environmental cues. The products of the lineage, stomatal guard cells and pavement cells, regulate plant-atmosphere exchanges, and the epidermis as a whole influences overall leaf growth. How flexibility is encoded in development of the stomatal lineage and how cell fates are coordinated in the leaf are open questions. Here, by leveraging single-cell transcriptomics and molecular genetics, we uncovered models of cell differentiation within Arabidopsis leaf tissue. Profiles across leaf tissues identified points of regulatory congruence. In the stomatal lineage, single-cell resolution resolved underlying cell heterogeneity within early stages and provided a fine-grained profile of guard cell differentiation. Through integration of genome-scale datasets and spatiotemporally precise functional manipulations, we also identified an extended role for the transcriptional regulator SPEECHLESS in reinforcing cell fate commitment.
articles.abstractZh: 动态的细胞身份是灵活的发育计划的基础。拟南芥叶表皮中的气孔谱系具有异步和不确定的分裂，可以通过环境因素进行调节。谱系的产物、气孔保卫细胞和路面细胞调节植物与大气的交换，而表皮作为一个整体影响整体叶子的生长。气孔谱系的发育如何编码灵活性以及叶子中的细胞命运如何协调都是悬而未决的问题。在这里，通过利用单细胞转录组学和分子遗传学，我们发现了拟南芥叶组织内的细胞分化模型。叶组织的概况确定了监管一致性点。在气孔谱系中，单细胞分辨率解决了早期阶段潜在的细胞异质性，并提供了保卫细胞分化的细粒度特征。通过整合基因组规模的数据集和时空精确的功能操作，我们还确定了转录调节因子 SPEECHLESS 在增强细胞命运承诺方面的扩展作用。

articles.title: The frontier of live tissue imaging across space and time.
articles.titleZh: 跨越空间和时间的活体组织成像的前沿。
articles.authors: Huang Q, Garrett A, Bose S, Blocker S, Rios AC, Clevers H, Shen X.
articles.abstract: What you see is what you get-imaging techniques have long been essential for visualization and understanding of tissue development, homeostasis, and regeneration, which are driven by stem cell self-renewal and differentiation. Advances in molecular and tissue modeling techniques in the last decade are providing new imaging modalities to explore tissue heterogeneity and plasticity. Here we describe current state-of-the-art imaging modalities for tissue research at multiple scales, with a focus on explaining key tradeoffs such as spatial resolution, penetration depth, capture time/frequency, and moieties. We explore emerging tissue modeling and molecular tools that improve resolution, specificity, and throughput.
articles.abstractZh: 所见即所得——成像技术长期以来对于组织发育、稳态和再生的可视化和理解至关重要，这些都是由干细胞自我更新和分化驱动的。过去十年分子和组织建模技术的进步为探索组织异质性和可塑性提供了新的成像方式。在这里，我们描述了当前最先进的多尺度组织研究成像模式，重点是解释关键的权衡，例如空间分辨率、穿透深度、捕获时间/频率和部分。我们探索新兴的组织建模和分子工具，以提高分辨率、特异性和通量。

articles.title: The tissue protective functions of interleukin-22 can be decoupled from pro-inflammatory actions through structure-based design.
articles.titleZh: 通过基于结构的设计，可以将 IL-22 的组织保护功能与促炎作用分离。
articles.authors: Saxton RA, Henneberg LT, Calafiore M, Su L, Jude KM, Hanash AM, Garcia KC.
articles.abstract: Interleukin-22 (IL-22) acts on epithelial cells to promote tissue protection and regeneration, but can also elicit pro-inflammatory effects, contributing to disease pathology. Here, we engineered a high-affinity IL-22 super-agonist that enabled the structure determination of the IL-22-IL-22Rα-IL-10Rβ ternary complex to a resolution of 2.6 Å. Using structure-based design, we systematically destabilized the IL-22-IL-10Rβ binding interface to create partial agonist analogs that decoupled downstream STAT1 and STAT3 signaling. The extent of STAT bias elicited by a single ligand varied across tissues, ranging from full STAT3-biased agonism to STAT1/3 antagonism, correlating with IL-10Rβ expression levels. In vivo, this tissue-selective signaling drove tissue protection in the pancreas and gastrointestinal tract without inducing local or systemic inflammation, thereby uncoupling these opposing effects of IL-22 signaling. Our findings provide insight into the mechanisms underlying the cytokine pleiotropy and illustrate how differential receptor expression levels and STAT response thresholds can be synthetically exploited to endow pleiotropic cytokines with enhanced functional specificity.
articles.abstractZh: 白细胞介素 22 (IL-22) 作用于上皮细胞，促进组织保护和再生，但也可引发促炎作用，促进疾病病理。在这里，我们设计了一种高亲和力的 IL-22 超级激动剂，能够以 2.6 Å 的分辨率确定 IL-22-IL-22Rα-IL-10Rβ 三元复合物的结构。使用基于结构的设计，我们系统地破坏了 IL-22-IL-10Rβ 结合界面的稳定性，以创建部分激动剂类似物，可解耦下游 STAT1 和 STAT3 信号传导。单个配体引起的 STAT 偏向程度在不同组织中有所不同，范围从完全 STAT3 偏向激动到 STAT1/3 拮抗，与 IL-10Rβ 表达水平相关。在体内，这种组织选择性信号传导驱动胰腺和胃肠道的组织保护，而不诱导局部或全身炎症，从而消除了 IL-22 信号传导的这些相反作用。我们的研究结果提供了对细胞因子多效性潜在机制的深入了解，并说明了如何综合利用差异受体表达水平和 STAT 反应阈值来赋予多效性细胞因子增强的功能特异性。

articles.title: Antibody evasion by the P.1 strain of SARS-CoV-2.
articles.titleZh: SARS-CoV-2 P.1 株的抗体逃避。
articles.authors: Dejnirattisai W, Zhou D, Supasa P, Liu C, Mentzer AJ, Ginn HM, Zhao Y, Duyvesteyn HME, Tuekprakhon A, Nutalai R, Wang B, López-Camacho C, Slon-Campos J, Walter TS, Skelly D, Costa Clemens SA, Naveca FG, Nascimento V, Nascimento F, Fernandes da Costa C, Resende PC, Pauvolid-Correa A, Siqueira MM, Dold C, Levin R, Dong T, Pollard AJ, Knight JC, Knight JC, Crook D, Lambe T, Clutterbuck E, Bibi S, Flaxman A, Bittaye M, Belij-Rammerstorfer S, Gilbert SC, Carroll MW, Klenerman P, Barnes E, Dunachie SJ, Paterson NG, Williams MA, Williams MA, Hall DR, Hulswit RJG, Bowden TA, Fry EE, Mongkolsapaya J, Ren J, Stuart DI, Screaton GR.
articles.abstract: Terminating the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic relies upon pan-global vaccination. Current vaccines elicit neutralizing antibody responses to the virus spike derived from early isolates. However, new strains have emerged with multiple mutations, including P.1 from Brazil, B.1.351 from South Africa, and B.1.1.7 from the UK (12, 10, and 9 changes in the spike, respectively). All have mutations in the ACE2 binding site, with P.1 and B.1.351 having a virtually identical triplet (E484K, K417N/T, and N501Y), which we show confer similar increased affinity for ACE2. We show that, surprisingly, P.1 is significantly less resistant to naturally acquired or vaccine-induced antibody responses than B.1.351, suggesting that changes outside the receptor-binding domain (RBD) impact neutralization. Monoclonal antibody (mAb) 222 neutralizes all three variants despite interacting with two of the ACE2-binding site mutations. We explain this through structural analysis and use the 222 light chain to largely restore neutralization potency to a major class of public antibodies.
articles.abstractZh: 终止 SARS-CoV-2 大流行有赖于全球疫苗接种。目前的疫苗会引发对早期分离株病毒尖峰的中和抗体反应。然而，出现了具有多种突变的新菌株，包括来自巴西的 P.1、来自南非的 B.1.351 和来自英国的 B.1.1.7（尖峰分别有 12、10 和 9 个变化）。所有的 ACE2 结合位点都有突变，其中 P.1 和 B.1.351 具有几乎相同的三联体（E484K、K417N/T 和 N501Y），我们证明它们对 ACE2 具有相似的亲和力增加。令人惊讶的是，我们发现 P.1 对自然获得的或疫苗诱导的抗体反应的抵抗力明显低于 B.1.351，这表明受体结合结构域 (RBD) 外部的变化会影响中和。尽管与两个 ACE2 结合位点突变相互作用，单克隆抗体 (mAb) 222 仍可中和所有三种变体。我们通过结构分析解释了这一点，并使用 222 轻链在很大程度上恢复了主要一类公共抗体的中和效力。

articles.title: Gain-of-function variants in SYK cause immune dysregulation and systemic inflammation in humans and mice.
articles.titleZh: SYK 的功能获得性变异会导致人类和小鼠的免疫失调和全身炎症。
articles.authors: Wang L, Aschenbrenner D, Zeng Z, Cao X, Mayr D, Mehta M, Capitani M, Warner N, Pan J, Wang L, Li Q, Zuo T, Cohen-Kedar S, Lu J, Ardy RC, Mulder DJ, Dissanayake D, Peng K, Huang Z, Li X, Wang Y, Wang X, Li S, Bullers S, Gammage AN, Warnatz K, Schiefer AI, Krivan G, Goda V, Kahr WHA, Lemaire M, Genomics England Research Consortium, Lu CY, Siddiqui I, Surette MG, Kotlarz D, Engelhardt KR, Griffin HR, Rottapel R, Decaluwe H, Laxer RM, Proietti M, Hambleton S, Elcombe S, Guo CH, Grimbacher B, Dotan I, Ng SC, Freeman SA, Snapper SB, Klein C, Boztug K, Huang Y, Li D, Uhlig HH, Muise AM.
articles.abstract: Spleen tyrosine kinase (SYK) is a critical immune signaling molecule and therapeutic target. We identified damaging monoallelic SYK variants in six patients with immune deficiency, multi-organ inflammatory disease such as colitis, arthritis and dermatitis, and diffuse large B cell lymphomas. The SYK variants increased phosphorylation and enhanced downstream signaling, indicating gain of function. A knock-in (SYK-Ser544Tyr) mouse model of a patient variant (p.Ser550Tyr) recapitulated aspects of the human disease that could be partially treated with a SYK inhibitor or transplantation of bone marrow from wild-type mice. Our studies demonstrate that SYK gain-of-function variants result in a potentially treatable form of inflammatory disease.
articles.abstractZh: 脾酪氨酸激酶（SYK）是一种重要的免疫信号分子和治疗靶点。我们在六名患有免疫缺陷、结肠炎、关节炎和皮炎等多器官炎症性疾病以及弥漫性大 B 细胞淋巴瘤的患者中发现了破坏性的单等位基因 SYK 变异。 SYK 变体增加了磷酸化并增强了下游信号传导，表明功能获得了增强。患者变体 (p.Ser550Tyr) 的敲入 (SYK-Ser544Tyr) 小鼠模型概括了人类疾病的各个方面，可以使用 SYK 抑制剂或移植野生型小鼠的骨髓进行部分治疗。我们的研究表明，SYK 功能获得性变异会导致一种潜在可治疗的炎症性疾病。

articles.title: Ultraconserved enhancer function does not require perfect sequence conservation.
articles.titleZh: 超保守的增强子功能不需要完美的序列保守。
articles.authors: Snetkova V, Ypsilanti AR, Akiyama JA, Mannion BJ, Plajzer-Frick I, Novak CS, Harrington AN, Pham QT, Kato M, Zhu Y, Godoy J, Meky E, Hunter RD, Shi M, Kvon EZ, Afzal V, Tran S, Rubenstein JLR, Visel A, Pennacchio LA, Dickel DE.
articles.abstract: Ultraconserved enhancer sequences show perfect conservation between human and rodent genomes, suggesting that their functions are highly sensitive to mutation. However, current models of enhancer function do not sufficiently explain this extreme evolutionary constraint. We subjected 23 ultraconserved enhancers to different levels of mutagenesis, collectively introducing 1,547 mutations, and examined their activities in transgenic mouse reporter assays. Overall, we find that the regulatory properties of ultraconserved enhancers are robust to mutation. Upon mutagenesis, nearly all (19/23, 83%) still functioned as enhancers at one developmental stage, as did most of those tested again later in development (5/9, 56%). Replacement of endogenous enhancers with mutated alleles in mice corroborated results of transgenic assays, including the functional resilience of ultraconserved enhancers to mutation. Our findings show that the currently known activities of ultraconserved enhancers do not necessarily require the perfect conservation observed in evolution and suggest that additional regulatory or other functions contribute to their sequence constraint.
articles.abstractZh: 超级保守的增强子序列在人类和啮齿动物基因组之间显示出完美的保守性，表明它们的功能对突变高度敏感。然而，当前的增强子功能模型并不能充分解释这种极端的进化限制。我们对 23 个超保守增强子进行了不同水平的诱变，总共引入了 1,547 个突变，并在转基因小鼠报告基因测定中检查了它们的活性。总的来说，我们发现超保守增强子的调控特性对突变具有鲁棒性。诱变后，几乎所有（19/23，83%）在一个发育阶段仍然充当增强子，大多数在发育后期再次测试的那些（5/9，56%）也是如此。在小鼠中用突变等位基因替换内源增强子证实了转基因测定的结果，包括超保守增强子对突变的功能恢复力。我们的研究结果表明，目前已知的超保守增强子的活性不一定需要在进化中观察到的完美保守性，并且表明额外的调节或其他功能有助于其序列限制。

articles.title: Molecular basis of C-S bond cleavage in the glycyl radical enzyme isethionate sulfite-lyase.
articles.titleZh: 甘氨酰自由基酶羟乙磺酸亚硫酸盐裂解酶中 C-S 键裂解的分子基础。
articles.authors: Dawson CD, Irwin SM, Backman LRF, Le C, Wang JX, Vennelakanti V, Yang Z, Kulik HJ, Drennan CL, Balskus EP.
articles.abstract: Desulfonation of isethionate by the bacterial glycyl radical enzyme (GRE) isethionate sulfite-lyase (IslA) generates sulfite, a substrate for respiration that in turn produces the disease-associated metabolite hydrogen sulfide. Here, we present a 2.7 Å resolution X-ray structure of wild-type IslA from Bilophila wadsworthia with isethionate bound. In comparison with other GREs, alternate positioning of the active site β strands allows for distinct residue positions to contribute to substrate binding. These structural differences, combined with sequence variations, create a highly tailored active site for the binding of the negatively charged isethionate substrate. Through the kinetic analysis of 14 IslA variants and computational analyses, we probe the mechanism by which radical chemistry is used for C-S bond cleavage. This work further elucidates the structural basis of chemistry within the GRE superfamily and will inform structure-based inhibitor design of IsIA and thus of microbial hydrogen sulfide production.
articles.abstractZh: 细菌甘氨酰自由基酶 (GRE) 羟乙基磺酸盐亚硫酸裂解酶 (IslA) 对羟乙基磺酸盐进行脱磺化，生成亚硫酸盐，亚硫酸盐是呼吸作用的底物，进而产生与疾病相关的代谢物硫化氢。在这里，我们展示了来自 Bilophila wadsworthia 的野生型 IslA 与羟乙磺酸盐结合的 2.7 Å 分辨率 X 射线结构。与其他 GRE 相比，活性位点 β 链的交替定位允许不同的残基位置有助于底物结合。这些结构差异与序列变化相结合，为带负电荷的羟乙基磺酸盐底物的结合创建了高度定制的活性位点。通过对 14 个 IslA 变体的动力学分析和计算分析，我们探讨了自由基化学用于 C-S 键断裂的机制。这项工作进一步阐明了 GRE 超家族内化学的结构基础，并将为基于结构的 IsIA 抑制剂设计以及微生物硫化氢生产提供信息。

articles.title: NaV1.2 EFL domain allosterically enhances Ca2+ binding to sites I and II of WT and pathogenic calmodulin mutants bound to the channel CTD.
articles.titleZh: NaV1.2 EFL 结构域变构增强 Ca2+ 与 WT 的位点 I 和 II 的结合以及与通道 CTD 结合的致病性钙调蛋白突变体。
articles.authors: Mahling R, Hovey L, Isbell HM, Marx DC, Miller MS, Kilpatrick AM, Weaver LD, Yoder JB, Kim EH, Andresen CNJ, Li S, Shea MA.
articles.abstract: Neuronal voltage-gated sodium channel NaV1.2 C-terminal domain (CTD) binds calmodulin (CaM) constitutively at its IQ motif. A solution structure (6BUT) and other NMR evidence showed that the CaM N domain (CaMN) is structurally independent of the C-domain (CaMC) whether CaM is bound to the NaV1.2IQp (1,901-1,927) or NaV1.2CTD (1,777-1,937) with or without calcium. However, in the CaM + NaV1.2CTD complex, the Ca2+ affinity of CaMN was more favorable than in free CaM, while Ca2+ affinity for CaMC was weaker than in the CaM + NaV1.2IQp complex. The CTD EF-like (EFL) domain allosterically widened the energetic gap between CaM domains. Cardiomyopathy-associated CaM mutants (N53I(N54I), D95V(D96V), A102V(A103V), E104A(E105A), D129G(D130G), and F141L(F142L)) all bound the NaV1.2 IQ motif favorably under resting (apo) conditions and bound calcium normally at CaMN sites. However, only N53I and A102V bound calcium at CaMC sites at [Ca2+] 2+ spikes in excitable cells.
articles.abstractZh: 神经元电压门控钠通道 NaV1.2 C 末端结构域 (CTD) 在其 IQ 基序上组成型结合钙调蛋白 (CaM)。溶液结构 (6BUT) 和其他 NMR 证据表明，CaM N 结构域 (CaMN) 在结构上独立于 C 结构域 (CaMC)，无论 CaM 是否与 NaV1.2IQp (1,901-1,927) 或 NaV1.2CTD (1,777-1,937) 结合，有或没有钙。然而，在CaM + NaV1.2CTD复合物中，CaMN的Ca2+亲和力比游离CaM更有利，而Ca2+对CaMC的亲和力比CaM + NaV1.2IQp复合物弱。 CTD EF 样 (EFL) 结构域变构地扩大了 CaM 结构域之间的能量差距。心肌病相关的 CaM 突变体（N53I（N54I）、D95V（D96V）、A102V（A103V）、E104A（E105A）、D129G（D130G）和 F141L（F142L））在静息（apo）条件下均有利地结合 NaV1.2 IQ 基序，并通常在 CaMN 位点结合钙。然而，只有 N53I 和 A102V 在可兴奋细胞中 [Ca2+] 2+ 尖峰处的 CaMC 位点处结合钙。

articles.title: Ultra-fast proteomics with Scanning SWATH.
articles.titleZh: 使用 Scanning SWATH 进行超快速蛋白质组学。
articles.authors: Messner CB, Demichev V, Bloomfield N, Yu JSL, White M, Kreidl M, Egger AS, Freiwald A, Ivosev G, Wasim F, Zelezniak A, Jürgens L, Suttorp N, Sander LE, Kurth F, Lilley KS, Mülleder M, Tate S, Ralser M.
articles.abstract: Accurate quantification of the proteome remains challenging for large sample series and longitudinal experiments. We report a data-independent acquisition method, Scanning SWATH, that accelerates mass spectrometric (MS) duty cycles, yielding quantitative proteomes in combination with short gradients and high-flow (800 µl min-1) chromatography. Exploiting a continuous movement of the precursor isolation window to assign precursor masses to tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) fragment traces, Scanning SWATH increases precursor identifications by ~70% compared to conventional data-independent acquisition (DIA) methods on 0.5-5-min chromatographic gradients. We demonstrate the application of ultra-fast proteomics in drug mode-of-action screening and plasma proteomics. Scanning SWATH proteomes capture the mode of action of fungistatic azoles and statins. Moreover, we confirm 43 and identify 11 new plasma proteome biomarkers of COVID-19 severity, advancing patient classification and biomarker discovery. Thus, our results demonstrate a substantial acceleration and increased depth in fast proteomic experiments that facilitate proteomic drug screens and clinical studies.
articles.abstractZh: 对于大样本系列和纵向实验来说，蛋白质组的准确定量仍然具有挑战性。我们报告了一种独立于数据的采集方法 Scanning SWATH，该方法可加速质谱 (MS) 工作周期，结合短梯度和高流量 (800 µl min-1) 色谱法产生定量蛋白质组。扫描 SWATH 利用前体分离窗口的连续移动将前体质量分配给串联质谱 (MS/MS) 碎片迹线，与传统的数据独立采集 (DIA) 方法相比，在 0.5-5 分钟色谱梯度上，前体识别率提高了约 70%。我们展示了超快速蛋白质组学在药物作用模式筛选和血浆蛋白质组学中的应用。扫描 SWATH 蛋白质组可捕获抑菌唑类药物和他汀类药物的作用模式。此外，我们确认了 43 种并确定了 11 种新的 COVID-19 严重程度的血浆蛋白质组生物标志物，从而推进了患者分类和生物标志物的发现。因此，我们的结果表明快速蛋白质组实验的显着加速和深度增加，有利于蛋白质组药物筛选和临床研究。

articles.title: SH3BP4 promotes neuropilin-1 and α5-integrin endocytosis and is inhibited by Akt.
articles.titleZh: SH3BP4 促进神经毡蛋白-1 和 α5-整合素内吞作用，并被 Akt 抑制。
articles.authors: Burckhardt CJ, Minna JD, Danuser G.
articles.abstract: Cells probe their surrounding matrix for attachment sites via integrins that are internalized by endocytosis. We find that SH3BP4 regulates integrin surface expression in a signaling-dependent manner via clathrin-coated pits (CCPs). Dephosphorylated SH3BP4 at S246 is efficiently recruited to CCPs, while upon Akt phosphorylation, SH3BP4 is sequestered by 14-3-3 adaptors and excluded from CCPs. In the absence of Akt activity, SH3BP4 binds GIPC1 and targets neuropilin-1 and α5/β1-integrin for endocytosis, leading to inhibition of cell spreading. Similarly, chemorepellent semaphorin-3a binds neuropilin-1 to activate PTEN, which antagonizes Akt and thus recruits SH3BP4 to CCPs to internalize both receptors and induce cell contraction. In PTEN mutant non-small cell lung cancer cells with high Akt activity, expression of non-phosphorylatable active SH3BP4-S246A restores semaphorin-3a induced cell contraction. Thus, SH3BP4 links Akt signaling to endocytosis of NRP1 and α5/β1-integrins to modulate cell-matrix interactions in response to intrinsic and extrinsic cues.
articles.abstractZh: 细胞通过内吞作用内化的整合素探测其周围基质的附着位点。我们发现 SH3BP4 通过网格蛋白包被的凹坑 (CCP) 以信号依赖方式调节整合素表面表达。 S246 处去磷酸化的 SH3BP4 被有效招募至 CCP，而 Akt 磷酸化后，SH3BP4 被 14-3-3 接头隔离并从 CCP 中排除。在缺乏 Akt 活性的情况下，SH3BP4 结合 GIPC1 并靶向 Neuropilin-1 和 α5/β1-整合素进行内吞作用，从而抑制细胞扩散。同样，化学排斥性 semaphorin-3a 与神经毡蛋白-1 结合以激活 PTEN，后者拮抗 Akt，从而将 SH3BP4 募集到 CCP 内化这两种受体并诱导细胞收缩。在具有高 Akt 活性的 PTEN 突变非小细胞肺癌细胞中，非磷酸化活性 SH3BP4-S246A 的表达可恢复 semaphorin-3a 诱导的细胞收缩。因此，SH3BP4 将 Akt 信号传导与 NRP1 和 α5/β1-整合素的内吞作用联系起来，以响应内在和外在线索来调节细胞-基质相互作用。

articles.title: Lineage tracing and analog recording in mammalian cells by single-site DNA writing.
articles.titleZh: 通过单位点 DNA 写入在哺乳动物细胞中进行谱系追踪和模拟记录。
articles.authors: Loveless TB, Grotts JH, Schechter MW, Forouzmand E, Carlson CK, Agahi BS, Liang G, Ficht M, Liu B, Xie X, Liu CC.
articles.abstract: Studying cellular and developmental processes in complex multicellular organisms can require the non-destructive observation of thousands to billions of cells deep within an animal. DNA recorders address the staggering difficulty of this task by converting transient cellular experiences into mutations at defined genomic sites that can be sequenced later in high throughput. However, existing recorders act primarily by erasing DNA. This is problematic because, in the limit of progressive erasure, no record remains. We present a DNA recorder called CHYRON (Cell History Recording by Ordered Insertion) that acts primarily by writing new DNA through the repeated insertion of random nucleotides at a single locus in temporal order. To achieve in vivo DNA writing, CHYRON combines Cas9, a homing guide RNA and the template-independent DNA polymerase terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase. We successfully applied CHYRON as an evolving lineage tracer and as a recorder of user-selected cellular stimuli.
articles.abstractZh: 研究复杂多细胞生物体的细胞和发育过程可能需要对动物体内数千至数十亿个细胞进行无损观察。 DNA记录仪通过将短暂的细胞经历转化为特定基因组位点的突变来解决这项任务的巨大困难，这些突变可以在以后以高通量进行测序。然而，现有的记录器主要通过擦除 DNA 来起作用。这是有问题的，因为在渐进擦除的限制下，不会保留任何记录。我们提出了一种名为 CHYRON（按顺序插入进行细胞历史记录）的 DNA 记录仪，其主要作用是通过按时间顺序在单个基因座上重复插入随机核苷酸来写入新 DNA。为了实现体内 DNA 写入，CHYRON 结合了 Cas9、归巢引导 RNA 和不依赖模板的 DNA 聚合酶末端脱氧核苷酸转移酶。我们成功地将 CHYRON 用作进化谱系示踪剂和用户选择的细胞刺激的记录器。

articles.title: CRISPR-Cas9 strategies to insert MS2 stem-loops into endogenous loci in Drosophila embryos.
articles.titleZh: CRISPR-Cas9 策略将 MS2 茎环插入果蝇胚胎的内源基因座。
articles.authors: Hoppe C, Ashe HL.
articles.abstract: CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing has transformed biology by enabling site-specific genome modifications to be simply engineered. Here, we describe two CRISPR-Cas9 approaches to introduce MS2 stem-loop sequences into endogenous gene loci in Drosophila. This can facilitate live imaging of nascent transcription in Drosophila. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to Hoppe et al. (2020).
articles.abstractZh: CRISPR-Cas9 基因组编辑通过简单地设计位点特异性基因组修饰而改变了生物学。在这里，我们描述了两种 CRISPR-Cas9 方法，将 MS2 茎环序列引入果蝇的内源基因位点。这可以促进果蝇新生转录的实时成像。有关该协议的使用和执行的完整详细信息，请参阅 Hoppe 等人。 （2020）。

articles.title: Meiotic DNA break repair can utilize homolog-independent chromatid templates in C. elegans.
articles.titleZh: 减数分裂 DNA 断裂修复可以利用秀丽隐杆线虫中的同源独立染色单体模板。
articles.authors: Toraason E, Horacek A, Clark C, Glover ML, Adler VL, Premkumar T, Salagean A, Cole F, Libuda DE.
articles.abstract: During meiosis, the maintenance of genome integrity is critical for generating viable haploid gametes.1 In meiotic prophase I, double-strand DNA breaks (DSBs) are induced and a subset of these DSBs are repaired as interhomolog crossovers to ensure proper chromosome segregation. DSBs not resolved as crossovers with the homolog must be repaired by other pathways to ensure genome integrity.2 To determine if alternative repair templates can be engaged for meiotic DSB repair during oogenesis, we developed an assay to detect sister and/or intra-chromatid repair events at a defined DSB site during Caenorhabditis elegans meiosis. Using this assay, we directly demonstrate that the sister chromatid or the same DNA molecule can be engaged as a meiotic repair template for both crossover and noncrossover recombination, with noncrossover events being the predominant recombination outcome. We additionally find that the sister or intra-chromatid substrate is available as a recombination partner for DSBs induced throughout meiotic prophase I, including late prophase when the homolog is unavailable. Analysis of noncrossover conversion tract sequences reveals that DSBs are processed similarly throughout prophase I. We further present data indicating that the XPF-1 nuclease functions in late prophase to promote sister or intra-chromatid repair at steps of recombination following joint molecule processing. Despite its function in sister or intra-chromatid repair, we find that xpf-1 mutants do not exhibit severe defects in progeny viability following exposure to ionizing radiation. Overall, we propose that C. elegans XPF-1 may assist as an intersister or intrachromatid resolvase only in late prophase I.
articles.abstractZh: 在减数分裂过程中，维持基因组完整性对于产生可行的单倍体配子至关重要。1 在减数分裂前期 I，会诱导双链 DNA 断裂 (DSB)，并且这些 DSB 的子集作为同源物间交叉进行修复，以确保正确的染色体分离。由于与同源物交叉而未解析的 DSB 必须通过其他途径进行修复，以确保基因组完整性。 2 为了确定替代修复模板是否可以用于卵子发生过程中的减数分裂 DSB 修复，我们开发了一种检测方法，用于检测秀丽隐杆线虫减数分裂过程中指定 DSB 位点的姐妹和/或染色单体内修复事件。使用该测定，我们直接证明姐妹染色单体或相同的DNA分子可以作为交叉和非交叉重组的减数分裂修复模板，其中非交叉事件是主要的重组结果。我们还发现，姐妹底物或染色单体内底物可作为整个减数分裂前期 I 诱导的 DSB 的重组伴侣，包括同系物不可用时的前期晚期。对非交叉转化区序列的分析表明，DSB 的处理方式类似：

articles.title: Meiotic sister chromatid exchanges are rare in C. elegans.
articles.titleZh: 减数分裂姐妹染色单体交换在秀丽隐杆线虫中很少见。
articles.authors: Almanzar DE, Gordon SG, Rog O.
articles.abstract: Sexual reproduction shuffles the parental genomes to generate new genetic combinations. To achieve that, the genome is subjected to numerous double-strand breaks, the repair of which involves two crucial decisions: repair pathway and repair template.1 Use of crossover pathways with the homologous chromosome as template exchanges genetic information and directs chromosome segregation. Crossover repair, however, can compromise the integrity of the repair template and is therefore tightly regulated. The extent to which crossover pathways are used during sister-directed repair is unclear because the identical sister chromatids are difficult to distinguish. Nonetheless, indirect assays have led to the suggestion that inter-sister crossovers, or sister chromatid exchanges (SCEs), are quite common.2-11 Here we devised a technique to directly score physiological SCEs in the C. elegans germline using selective sister chromatid labeling with the thymidine analog 5-ethynyl-2'-deoxyuridine (EdU). Surprisingly, we find SCEs to be rare in meiosis, accounting for HIM-6. Second, the synaptonemal complex-a conserved interface that promotes crossover repair12,13-promotes SCEs when localized between the sisters. Our data suggest that crossover pathways in C. elegans are only used to generate the single necessary link between the homologous chromosomes. Noncrossover pathways repair almost all other breaks, regardless of the repair template.
articles.abstractZh: 有性生殖会对亲本基因组进行重组，以产生新的遗传组合。为了实现这一目标，基因组会遭受多次双链断裂，其修复涉及两个关键决定：修复途径和修复模板。1 使用以同源染色体为模板的交叉途径交换遗传信息并指导染色体分离。然而，交叉修复可能会损害修复模板的完整性，因此受到严格监管。在姐妹定向修复过程中交叉途径的使用程度尚不清楚，因为相同的姐妹染色单体很难区分。尽管如此，间接分析表明姐妹间交叉或姐妹染色单体交换 (SCE) 相当常见。2-11 在这里，我们设计了一种技术，使用胸苷类似物 5-乙炔基-2'-脱氧尿苷 (EdU) 进行选择性姐妹染色单体标记，直接对秀丽隐杆线虫种系中的生理 SCE 进行评分。令人惊讶的是，我们发现 SCE 在减数分裂中很少见，例如 HIM-6。其次，联会复合体（一种促进交叉修复的保守界面12,13）当位于

articles.title: Simultaneous binding of Guidance Cues NET1 and RGM blocks extracellular NEO1 signaling.
articles.titleZh: Guidance Cues NET1 和 RGM 的同时结合会阻断细胞外 NEO1 信号传导。
articles.authors: Robinson RA, Griffiths SC, van de Haar LL, Malinauskas T, van Battum EY, Zelina P, Schwab RA, Karia D, Malinauskaite L, Brignani S, van den Munkhof MH, Düdükcü Ö, De Ruiter AA, Van den Heuvel DMA, Bishop B, Elegheert J, Aricescu AR, Pasterkamp RJ, Siebold C.
articles.abstract: During cell migration or differentiation, cell surface receptors are simultaneously exposed to different ligands. However, it is often unclear how these extracellular signals are integrated. Neogenin (NEO1) acts as an attractive guidance receptor when the Netrin-1 (NET1) ligand binds, but it mediates repulsion via repulsive guidance molecule (RGM) ligands. Here, we show that signal integration occurs through the formation of a ternary NEO1-NET1-RGM complex, which triggers reciprocal silencing of downstream signaling. Our NEO1-NET1-RGM structures reveal a "trimer-of-trimers" super-assembly, which exists in the cell membrane. Super-assembly formation results in inhibition of RGMA-NEO1-mediated growth cone collapse and RGMA- or NET1-NEO1-mediated neuron migration, by preventing formation of signaling-compatible RGM-NEO1 complexes and NET1-induced NEO1 ectodomain clustering. These results illustrate how simultaneous binding of ligands with opposing functions, to a single receptor, does not lead to competition for binding, but to formation of a super-complex that diminishes their functional outputs.
articles.abstractZh: 在细胞迁移或分化过程中，细胞表面受体同时暴露于不同的配体。然而，通常不清楚这些细胞外信号是如何整合的。当 Netrin-1 (NET1) 配体结合时，Neogenin (NEO1) 充当有吸引力的引导受体，但它通过排斥引导分子 (RGM) 配体介导排斥。在这里，我们表明信号整合是通过形成三元 NEO1-NET1-RGM 复合物而发生的，这会触发下游信号的相互沉默。我们的 NEO1-NET1-RGM 结构揭示了细胞膜中存在的“三聚体的三聚体”超级组装体。超组装形成通过阻止信号兼容的 RGM-NEO1 复合物和 NET1 诱导的 NEO1 胞外域聚类的形成，从而抑制 RGMA-NEO1 介导的生长锥塌陷和 RGMA 或 NET1-NEO1 介导的神经元迁移。这些结果说明具有相反功能的配体与单个受体的同时结合不会导致结合竞争，而是导致形成超级复合物，从而减少其功能输出。

articles.title: How the O<sub>2</sub>-dependent Mg-protoporphyrin monomethyl ester cyclase forms the fifth ring of chlorophylls.
articles.titleZh: O<sub>2</sub>依赖性镁原卟啉单甲酯环化酶如何形成叶绿素的第五环。
articles.authors: Chen GE, Adams NBP, Jackson PJ, Dickman MJ, Hunter CN.
articles.abstract: Mg-protoporphyrin IX monomethyl ester (MgPME) cyclase catalyses the formation of the isocyclic ring, producing protochlorophyllide a and contributing substantially to the absorption properties of chlorophylls and bacteriochlorophylls. The O2-dependent cyclase is found in both oxygenic phototrophs and some purple bacteria. We overproduced the simplest form of the cyclase, AcsF, from Rubrivivax gelatinosus, in Escherichia coli. In biochemical assays the di-iron cluster within AcsF is reduced by ferredoxin furnished by NADPH and ferredoxin:NADP+ reductase, or by direct coupling to Photosystem I photochemistry, linking cyclase to the photosynthetic electron transport chain. Kinetic analyses yielded a turnover number of 0.9 min-1, a Michaelis-Menten constant of 7.0 µM for MgPME and a dissociation constant for MgPME of 0.16 µM. Mass spectrometry identified 131-hydroxy-MgPME and 131-keto-MgPME as cyclase reaction intermediates, revealing the steps that form the isocyclic ring and completing the work originated by Sam Granick in 1950.
articles.abstractZh: 镁原卟啉 IX 单甲酯 (MgPME) 环化酶催化等环的形成，产生原叶绿素 a，并对叶绿素和细菌叶绿素的吸收特性做出重大贡献。 O2依赖性环化酶存在于产氧光养生物和一些紫色细菌中。我们在大肠杆菌中过量生产了最简单形式的环化酶 AcsF，该酶来自 Rubrivivax gelatinosus。在生化测定中，AcsF 内的二铁簇被 NADPH 和铁氧还蛋白：NADP+ 还原酶提供的铁氧还蛋白还原，或通过直接耦合到光系统 I 光化学，将环化酶连接到光合电子传递链。动力学分析得出 MgPME 的周转数为 0.9 min-1，米氏常数为 7.0 µM，MgPME 的解离常数为 0.16 µM。质谱鉴定出 131-羟基-MgPME 和 131-酮基-MgPME 为环化酶反应中间体，揭示了形成等环的步骤，完成了 Sam Granick 于 1950 年原创的工作。

articles.title: HectD1 controls hematopoietic stem cell regeneration by coordinating ribosome assembly and protein synthesis.
articles.titleZh: HectD1 通过协调核糖体组装和蛋白质合成来控制造血干细胞再生。
articles.authors: Lv K, Gong C, Antony C, Han X, Ren JG, Donaghy R, Cheng Y, Pellegrino S, Warren AJ, Paralkar VR, Tong W.
articles.abstract: Impaired ribosome function is the underlying etiology in a group of bone marrow failure syndromes called ribosomopathies. However, how ribosomes are regulated remains poorly understood, as are approaches to restore hematopoietic stem cell (HSC) function loss because of defective ribosome biogenesis. Here we reveal a role of the E3 ubiquitin ligase HectD1 in regulating HSC function via ribosome assembly and protein translation. Hectd1-deficient HSCs exhibit a striking defect in transplantation ability and ex vivo maintenance concomitant with reduced protein synthesis and growth rate under stress conditions. Mechanistically, HectD1 ubiquitinates and degrades ZNF622, an assembly factor for the ribosomal 60S subunit. Hectd1 loss leads to accumulation of ZNF622 and the anti-association factor eIF6 on 60S, resulting in 60S/40S joining defects. Importantly, Znf622 depletion in Hectd1-deficient HSCs restored ribosomal subunit joining, protein synthesis, and HSC reconstitution capacity. These findings highlight the importance of ubiquitin-coordinated ribosome assembly in HSC regeneration.
articles.abstractZh: 核糖体功能受损是一组称为核糖体病的骨髓衰竭综合征的根本病因。然而，人们对核糖体的调控方式仍然知之甚少，恢复由于核糖体生物发生缺陷而导致的造血干细胞（HSC）功能丧失的方法也是如此。在这里，我们揭示了 E3 泛素连接酶 HectD1 通过核糖体组装和蛋白质翻译调节 HSC 功能的作用。 Hectd1缺陷的HSC在移植能力和离体维持方面表现出显着的缺陷，同时在应激条件下蛋白质合成和生长速率降低。从机制上讲，HectD1 泛素化并降解 ZNF622（核糖体 60S 亚基的组装因子）。 Hectd1 丢失导致 ZNF622 和抗关联因子 eIF6 在 60S 上积累，导致 60S/40S 连接缺陷。重要的是，Hectd1 缺陷型 HSC 中 Znf622 的消耗恢复了核糖体亚基连接、蛋白质合成和 HSC 重建能力。这些发现强调了泛素协调的核糖体组装在 HSC 再生中的重要性。

articles.title: Molecular organization of the E. coli cellulose synthase macrocomplex.
articles.titleZh: 大肠杆菌纤维素合酶大复合物的分子组织。
articles.authors: Acheson JF, Ho R, Goularte NF, Cegelski L, Zimmer J.
articles.abstract: Cellulose is frequently found in communities of sessile bacteria called biofilms. Escherichia coli and other enterobacteriaceae modify cellulose with phosphoethanolamine (pEtN) to promote host tissue adhesion. The E. coli pEtN cellulose biosynthesis machinery contains the catalytic BcsA-B complex that synthesizes and secretes cellulose, in addition to five other subunits. The membrane-anchored periplasmic BcsG subunit catalyzes pEtN modification. Here we present the structure of the roughly 1 MDa E. coli Bcs complex, consisting of one BcsA enzyme associated with six copies of BcsB, determined by single-particle cryo-electron microscopy. BcsB homo-oligomerizes primarily through interactions between its carbohydrate-binding domains as well as intermolecular beta-sheet formation. The BcsB hexamer creates a half spiral whose open side accommodates two BcsG subunits, directly adjacent to BcsA's periplasmic channel exit. The cytosolic BcsE and BcsQ subunits associate with BcsA's regulatory PilZ domain. The macrocomplex is a fascinating example of cellulose synthase specification.
articles.abstractZh: 纤维素经常存在于称为生物膜的固着细菌群落中。大肠杆菌和其他肠杆菌科用磷酸乙醇胺 (pEtN) 修饰纤维素以促进宿主组织粘附。大肠杆菌 pEtN 纤维素生物合成机制包含合成和分泌纤维素的催化 BcsA-B 复合物以及其他五个亚基。膜锚定的周质 BcsG 亚基催化 pEtN 修饰。在这里，我们展示了通过单颗粒冷冻电子显微镜测定的大约 1 MDa 大肠杆菌 Bcs 复合物的结构，该复合物由一种 BcsA 酶与 6 个 BcsB 拷贝相关联组成。 BcsB 主要通过其碳水化合物结合域之间的相互作用以及分子间 β-折叠层的形成来同源寡聚化。 BcsB 六聚体形成一个半螺旋，其开放侧容纳两个 BcsG 亚基，直接邻近 BcsA 的周质通道出口。胞质 BcsE 和 BcsQ 亚基与 BcsA 的 PilZ 调节域相关。大复合物是纤维素合酶规范的一个有趣的例子。

articles.title: Biomaterial-based immunoengineering to fight COVID-19 and infectious diseases.
articles.titleZh: 基于生物材料的免疫工程对抗 COVID-19 和传染病。
articles.authors: Zarubova J, Zhang X, Hoffman T, Hasani-Sadrabadi MM, Li S.
articles.abstract: Infection by SARS-CoV-2 virus often induces the dysregulation of immune responses, tissue damage, and blood clotting. Engineered biomaterials from the nano- to the macroscale can provide targeted drug delivery, controlled drug release, local immunomodulation, enhanced immunity, and other desirable functions to coordinate appropriate immune responses and to repair tissues. Based on the understanding of COVID-19 disease progression and immune responses to SARS-CoV-2, we discuss possible immunotherapeutic strategies and highlight biomaterial approaches from the perspectives of preventive immunization, therapeutic immunomodulation, and tissue healing and regeneration. Successful development of biomaterial platforms for immunization and immunomodulation will not only benefit COVID-19 patients, but also have broad applications for a variety of infectious diseases.
articles.abstractZh: SARS-CoV-2 病毒感染通常会引起免疫反应失调、组织损伤和凝血。从纳米到宏观的工程生物材料可以提供靶向药物输送、控制药物释放、局部免疫调节、增强免疫力以及协调适当的免疫反应和修复组织的其他所需功能。基于对 COVID-19 疾病进展和对 SARS-CoV-2 免疫反应的了解，我们讨论了可能的免疫治疗策略，并从预防性免疫、治疗性免疫调节以及组织愈合和再生的角度重点介绍了生物材料方法。成功开发用于免疫和免疫调节的生物材料平台不仅将使COVID-19患者受益，而且对多种传染病也有广泛的应用。

articles.title: Transcriptional Silencers: Driving Gene Expression with the Brakes On.
articles.titleZh: 转录沉默剂：踩刹车驱动基因表达。
articles.authors: Segert JA, Gisselbrecht SS, Bulyk ML.
articles.abstract: Silencers are regulatory DNA elements that reduce transcription from their target promoters; they are the repressive counterparts of enhancers. Although discovered decades ago, and despite evidence of their importance in development and disease, silencers have been much less studied than enhancers. Recently, however, a series of papers have reported systematic studies of silencers in various model systems. Silencers are often bifunctional regulatory elements that can also act as enhancers, depending on cellular context, and are enriched for expression quantitative trait loci (eQTLs) and disease-associated variants. There is not yet evidence of a 'silencer chromatin signature', in the distribution of histone modifications or associated proteins, that is common to all silencers; instead, silencers may fall into various subclasses, acting by distinct (and possibly overlapping) mechanisms.
articles.abstractZh: 沉默子是 DNA 调控元件，可减少目标启动子的转录；它们是增强子的压制性对应物。尽管消音器在几十年前就被发现了，并且有证据表明它们在发育和疾病中的重要性，但对消音器的研究比增强剂要少得多。然而，最近一系列论文报道了各种模型系统中消声器的系统研究。沉默子通常是双功能调节元件，根据细胞环境也可以充当增强子，并且富含表达数量性状基因座（eQTL）和疾病相关变异。目前还没有证据表明在组蛋白修饰或相关蛋白的分布中存在所有沉默子所共有的“沉默子染色质特征”；相反，消音器可能分为不同的子类，通过不同的（并且可能重叠的）机制起作用。

articles.title: Coupled oscillators coordinate collective germline growth.
articles.titleZh: 耦合振荡器协调集体种系生长。
articles.authors: Doherty CA, Diegmiller R, Kapasiawala M, Gavis ER, Shvartsman SY.
articles.abstract: Developing oocytes need large supplies of macromolecules and organelles. A conserved strategy for accumulating these products is to pool resources of oocyte-associated germline nurse cells. In Drosophila, these cells grow more than 100-fold to boost their biosynthetic capacity. No previously known mechanism explains how nurse cells coordinate growth collectively. Here, we report a cell cycle-regulating mechanism that depends on bidirectional communication between the oocyte and nurse cells, revealing the oocyte as a critical regulator of germline cyst growth. Transcripts encoding the cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor, Dacapo, are synthesized by the nurse cells and actively localized to the oocyte. Retrograde movement of the oocyte-synthesized Dacapo protein to the nurse cells generates a network of coupled oscillators that controls the cell cycle of the nurse cells to regulate cyst growth. We propose that bidirectional nurse cell-oocyte communication establishes a growth-sensing feedback mechanism that regulates the quantity of maternal resources loaded into the oocyte.
articles.abstractZh: 发育中的卵母细胞需要大量的大分子和细胞器。积累这些产品的保守策略是汇集卵母细胞相关生殖细胞的资源。在果蝇中，这些细胞生长超过 100 倍以增强其生物合成能力。之前没有已知的机制可以解释护理细胞如何集体协调生长。在这里，我们报告了一种依赖于卵母细胞和护理细胞之间双向通讯的细胞周期调节机制，揭示了卵母细胞是种系囊肿生长的关键调节剂。编码细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶抑制剂 Dacapo 的转录本由护士细胞合成并主动定位于卵母细胞。卵母细胞合成的 Dacapo 蛋白逆向运动至护士细胞，产生耦合振荡器网络，控制护士细胞的细胞周期，从而调节囊肿生长。我们提出，双向的护士细胞-卵母细胞通讯建立了一种生长感知反馈机制，可以调节加载到卵母细胞中的母体资源的数量。

articles.title: Understanding and treating the inflammatory adverse events of cancer immunotherapy.
articles.titleZh: 了解和治疗癌症免疫疗法的炎症不良事件。
articles.authors: Dougan M, Luoma AM, Dougan SK, Wucherpfennig KW.
articles.abstract: During the past decade, immunotherapies have made a major impact on the treatment of diverse types of cancer. Inflammatory toxicities are not only a major concern for Food and Drug Administration (FDA)-approved checkpoint blockade and chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell therapies, but also limit the development and use of combination therapies. Fundamentally, these adverse events highlight the intricate balance of pro- and anti-inflammatory pathways that regulate protective immune responses. Here, we discuss the cellular and molecular mechanisms of inflammatory adverse events, current approaches to treatment, as well as opportunities for the design of immunotherapies that limit such inflammatory toxicities while preserving anti-tumor efficacy.
articles.abstractZh: 在过去的十年中，免疫疗法对多种癌症的治疗产生了重大影响。炎症毒性不仅是美国食品药品监督管理局 (FDA) 批准的检查点阻断和嵌合抗原受体 (CAR) T 细胞疗法的主要关注点，而且还限制了联合疗法的开发和使用。从根本上讲，这些不良事件凸显了调节保护性免疫反应的促炎和抗炎途径之间的复杂平衡。在这里，我们讨论炎症不良事件的细胞和分子机制、当前的治疗方法，以及设计限制此类炎症毒性同时保持抗肿瘤功效的免疫疗法的机会。

articles.title: Regulation of the endocytosis and prion-chaperoning machineries by yeast E3 ubiquitin ligase Rsp5 as revealed by orthogonal ubiquitin transfer.
articles.titleZh: 正交泛素转移揭示了酵母 E3 泛素连接酶 Rsp5 对内吞作用和朊病毒伴侣机制的调节。
articles.authors: Wang Y, Wang Y, Fang S, Chen G, Ganti R, Chernova TA, Zhou L, Duong D, Kiyokawa H, Li M, Zhao B, Shcherbik N, Chernoff YO, Yin J.
articles.abstract: Attachment of the ubiquitin (UB) peptide to proteins via the E1-E2-E3 enzymatic machinery regulates diverse biological pathways, yet identification of the substrates of E3 UB ligases remains a challenge. We overcame this challenge by constructing an "orthogonal UB transfer" (OUT) cascade with yeast E3 Rsp5 to enable the exclusive delivery of an engineered UB (xUB) to Rsp5 and its substrate proteins. The OUT screen uncovered new Rsp5 substrates in yeast, such as Pal1 and Pal2, which are partners of endocytic protein Ede1, and chaperones Hsp70-Ssb, Hsp82, and Hsp104 that counteract protein misfolding and control self-perpetuating amyloid aggregates (prions), resembling those involved in human amyloid diseases. We showed that prion formation and effect of Hsp104 on prion propagation are modulated by Rsp5. Overall, our work demonstrates the capacity of OUT to deconvolute the complex E3-substrate relationships in crucial biological processes such as endocytosis and protein assembly disorders through protein ubiquitination.
articles.abstractZh: 泛素 (UB) 肽通过 E1-E2-E3 酶促机制与蛋白质结合，调节多种生物途径，但 E3 UB 连接酶底物的鉴定仍然是一个挑战。我们通过与酵母 E3 Rsp5 构建“正交 UB 转移”(OUT) 级联克服了这一挑战，从而能够将工程化 UB (xUB) 独家递送至 Rsp5 及其底物蛋白。 OUT筛选发现了酵母中新的Rsp5底物，例如Pal1和Pal2，它们是内吞蛋白Ede1的伴侣，以及伴侣Hsp70-Ssb、Hsp82和Hsp104，它们可以抵消蛋白质错误折叠并控制自我永存的淀粉样蛋白聚集体（朊病毒），类似于人类淀粉样蛋白疾病中涉及的那些。我们发现朊病毒的形成和 Hsp104 对朊病毒传播的影响受到 Rsp5 的调节。总体而言，我们的工作证明了 OUT 通过蛋白质泛素化解构关键生物过程（例如内吞作用和蛋白质组装紊乱）中复杂的 E3-底物关系的能力。

articles.title: Maintaining the structural and functional homeostasis of the plant endoplasmic reticulum.
articles.titleZh: 维持植物内质网的结构和功能稳态。
articles.authors: Brandizzi F.
articles.abstract: The endoplasmic reticulum (ER) is a ubiquitous organelle that is vital to the life of eukaryotic cells. It synthesizes essential lipids and proteins and initiates the glycosylation of intracellular and surface proteins. As such, the ER is necessary for cell growth and communication with the external environment. The ER is also a highly dynamic organelle, whose structure is continuously remodeled through an interaction with the cytoskeleton and the action of specialized ER shapers. Recent and significant advances in ER studies have brought to light conserved and unique features underlying the structure and function of this organelle in plant cells. In this review, exciting developments in the understanding of the mechanisms for plant ER structural and functional homeostasis, particularly those that underpin ER network architecture and ER degradation, are presented and discussed.
articles.abstractZh: 内质网（ER）是一种普遍存在的细胞器，对真核细胞的生命至关重要。它合成必需的脂质和蛋白质，并启动细胞内和表面蛋白质的糖基化。因此，内质网对于细胞生长和与外部环境的沟通是必需的。内质网也是一个高度动态的细胞器，其结构通过与细胞骨架的相互作用以及专门的内质网塑造者的作用而不断重塑。 ER 研究的最新重大进展揭示了植物细胞中这种细胞器的结构和功能的保守且独特的特征。在这篇综述中，介绍并讨论了植物 ER 结构和功能稳态机制的令人兴奋的进展，特别是那些支持 ER 网络结构和 ER 降解的机制。

articles.title: Mechanism for food texture preference based on grittiness.
articles.titleZh: 基于砂砾度的食物质地偏好机制。
articles.authors: Li Q, Montell C.
articles.abstract: An animal's decision to accept or reject a prospective food is based only, in part, on its chemical composition. Palatability is also greatly influenced by textural features including smoothness versus grittiness, which is influenced by particle sizes. Here, we demonstrate that Drosophila melanogaster is endowed with the ability to discriminate particle sizes in food and uses this information to decide whether a food is appealing. The decision depends on a mechanically activated channel, OSCA/TMEM63, which is conserved from plants to humans. We found that tmem63 is expressed in a multidendritic neuron (md-L) in the fly tongue. Loss of tmem63 impairs the activation of md-L by mechanical stimuli and the ability to choose food based on particle size. These findings reveal the first role for this evolutionarily conserved, mechanically activated TMEM63 channel in an animal and provide an explanation of how flies can sense and behaviorally respond to the texture of food provided by particles.
articles.abstractZh: 动物接受或拒绝某种食物的决定仅部分取决于其化学成分。适口性也很大程度上受到质地特征的影响，包括光滑度与砂质性，而砂质性又受颗粒尺寸的影响。在这里，我们证明果蝇具有辨别食物颗粒大小的能力，并利用这些信息来决定食物是否有吸引力。该决定取决于机械激活通道 OSCA/TMEM63，该通道从植物到人类都是保守的。我们发现 tmem63 在果蝇舌头的多树突神经元 (md-L) 中表达。 tmem63 的缺失会损害机械刺激对 md-L 的激活以及根据颗粒大小选择食物的能力。这些发现揭示了这种进化上保守的、机械激活的 TMEM63 通道在动物中的第一个作用，并解释了果蝇如何感知颗粒提供的食物质地并做出行为反应。

articles.title: <i>APOE4</i> disrupts intracellular lipid homeostasis in human iPSC-derived glia.
articles.titleZh: APOE4 破坏人 iPSC 来源的神经胶质细胞内的脂质稳态。
articles.authors: Sienski G, Narayan P, Bonner JM, Kory N, Boland S, Arczewska AA, Ralvenius WT, Akay L, Lockshin E, He L, Milo B, Graziosi A, Baru V, Lewis CA, Kellis M, Sabatini DM, Tsai LH, Lindquist S.
articles.abstract: The E4 allele of the apolipoprotein E gene (APOE) has been established as a genetic risk factor for many diseases including cardiovascular diseases and Alzheimer's disease (AD), yet its mechanism of action remains poorly understood. APOE is a lipid transport protein, and the dysregulation of lipids has recently emerged as a key feature of several neurodegenerative diseases including AD. However, it is unclear how APOE4 perturbs the intracellular lipid state. Here, we report that APOE4, but not APOE3, disrupted the cellular lipidomes of human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived astrocytes generated from fibroblasts of APOE4 or APOE3 carriers, and of yeast expressing human APOE isoforms. We combined lipidomics and unbiased genome-wide screens in yeast with functional and genetic characterization to demonstrate that human APOE4 induced altered lipid homeostasis. These changes resulted in increased unsaturation of fatty acids and accumulation of intracellular lipid droplets both in yeast and in APOE4-expressing human iPSC-derived astrocytes. We then identified genetic and chemical modulators of this lipid disruption. We showed that supplementation of the culture medium with choline (a soluble phospholipid precursor) restored the cellular lipidome to its basal state in APOE4-expressing human iPSC-derived astrocytes and in yeast expressing human APOE4 Our study illuminates key molecular disruptions in lipid metabolism that may contribute to the disease risk linked to the APOE4 genotype. Our study suggests that manipulating lipid metabolism could be a therapeutic approach to help alleviate the consequences of carrying the APOE4 allele.
articles.abstractZh: 载脂蛋白E基因（APOE）的E4等位基因已被确定为包括心血管疾病和阿尔茨海默病（AD）在内的许多疾病的遗传危险因素，但其作用机制仍知之甚少。 APOE 是一种脂质转运蛋白，脂质失调最近已成为包括 AD 在内的多种神经退行性疾病的关键特征。然而，目前尚不清楚 APOE4 如何扰乱细胞内脂质状态。在此，我们报告 APOE4（而非 APOE3）破坏了由 APOE4 或 APOE3 载体的成纤维细胞产生的人诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）衍生的星形胶质细胞以及表达人 APOE 亚型的酵母的细胞脂质组。我们将酵母中的脂质组学和无偏全基因组筛选与功能和遗传特征相结合，以证明人类 APOE4 诱导改变的脂质稳态。这些变化导致酵母和表达 APOE4 的人 iPSC 衍生星形胶质细胞中脂肪酸不饱和度增加和细胞内脂滴积累。然后我们确定了这种脂质破坏的遗传和化学调节剂。我们证明了在培养基中添加ch

articles.title: An expanded universe of cancer targets.
articles.titleZh: 扩大了癌症靶点范围。
articles.authors: Hahn WC, Bader JS, Braun TP, Califano A, Clemons PA, Druker BJ, Ewald AJ, Fu H, Jagu S, Kemp CJ, Kim W, Kuo CJ, McManus M, B Mills G, Mo X, Sahni N, Schreiber SL, Talamas JA, Tamayo P, Tyner JW, Wagner BK, Weiss WA, Gerhard DS, Cancer Target Discovery and Development Network.
articles.abstract: The characterization of cancer genomes has provided insight into somatically altered genes across tumors, transformed our understanding of cancer biology, and enabled tailoring of therapeutic strategies. However, the function of most cancer alleles remains mysterious, and many cancer features transcend their genomes. Consequently, tumor genomic characterization does not influence therapy for most patients. Approaches to understand the function and circuitry of cancer genes provide complementary approaches to elucidate both oncogene and non-oncogene dependencies. Emerging work indicates that the diversity of therapeutic targets engendered by non-oncogene dependencies is much larger than the list of recurrently mutated genes. Here we describe a framework for this expanded list of cancer targets, providing novel opportunities for clinical translation.
articles.abstractZh: 癌症基因组的表征提供了对肿瘤中体细胞改变基因的深入了解，改变了我们对癌症生物学的理解，并使得治疗策略的定制成为可能。然而，大多数癌症等位基因的功能仍然神秘，许多癌症特征超越了它们的基因组。因此，肿瘤基因组特征不会影响大多数患者的治疗。了解癌症基因的功能和电路的方法为阐明癌基因和非癌基因依赖性提供了补充方法。新兴工作表明，非癌基因依赖性产生的治疗靶点的多样性远远大于经常突变的基因列表。在这里，我们描述了这个扩展的癌症靶点列表的框架，为临床转化提供了新的机会。

articles.title: Lysosomal Regulation of Metabolism in Quiescent Hematopoietic Stem Cells: More than Just Autophagy.
articles.titleZh: 静态造血干细胞代谢的溶酶体调节：不仅仅是自噬。
articles.authors: Ghaffari S.
articles.abstract: The depth of quiescence in hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) dictates their potency and is sensitive to metabolic perturbations. Recent evidence suggests that lysosomal functions distinct from autophagic processes are pivotal in regulating quiescence versus activation by potential control of the access to a nutrient reservoir required for HSC activation.
articles.abstractZh: 造血干细胞 (HSC) 的静止深度决定了它们的效力，并且对代谢扰动敏感。最近的证据表明，与自噬过程不同的溶酶体功能在通过潜在控制 HSC 激活所需的营养储存库的通路来调节静止与激活方面至关重要。

articles.title: Orphan receptor GPR37L1 remains unliganded.
articles.titleZh: 孤儿受体 GPR37L1 仍未配体。
articles.authors: Ngo T, Wilkins BP, So SS, Keov P, Chahal KK, Finch AM, Coleman JLJ, Kufareva I, Smith NJ.

articles.title: Structure-based decoupling of the pro- and anti-inflammatory functions of interleukin-10.
articles.titleZh: IL-10 促炎和抗炎功能的基于结构的解耦。
articles.authors: Saxton RA, Saxton RA, Tsutsumi N, Su LL, Abhiraman GC, Mohan K, Henneberg LT, Aduri NG, Gati C, Garcia KC.
articles.abstract: Interleukin-10 (IL-10) is an immunoregulatory cytokine with both anti-inflammatory and immunostimulatory properties and is frequently dysregulated in disease. We used a structure-based approach to deconvolute IL-10 pleiotropy by determining the structure of the IL-10 receptor (IL-10R) complex by cryo-electron microscopy at a resolution of 3.5 angstroms. The hexameric structure shows how IL-10 and IL-10Rα form a composite surface to engage the shared signaling receptor IL-10Rβ, enabling the design of partial agonists. IL-10 variants with a range of IL-10Rβ binding strengths uncovered substantial differences in response thresholds across immune cell populations, providing a means of manipulating IL-10 cell type selectivity. Some variants displayed myeloid-biased activity by suppressing macrophage activation without stimulating inflammatory CD8+ T cells, thereby uncoupling the major opposing functions of IL-10. These results provide a mechanistic blueprint for tuning the pleiotropic actions of IL-10.
articles.abstractZh: 白细胞介素-10 (IL-10) 是一种免疫调节细胞因子，具有抗炎和免疫刺激特性，在疾病中经常失调。我们使用基于结构的方法通过冷冻电子显微镜以 3.5 埃的分辨率确定 IL-10 受体 (IL-10R) 复合物的结构来解卷积 IL-10 多效性。六聚体结构显示了 IL-10 和 IL-10Rα 如何形成复合表面以接合共享信号受体 IL-10Rβ，从而能够设计部分激动剂。具有一系列 IL-10Rβ 结合强度的 IL-10 变体揭示了免疫细胞群反应阈值的显着差异，从而提供了操纵 IL-10 细胞类型选择性的方法。一些变体通过抑制巨噬细胞活化而不刺激炎症性 CD8+ T 细胞来表现出骨髓偏向的活性，从而解开 IL-10 的主要相反功能。这些结果为调节 IL-10 的多效性作用提供了机制蓝图。

articles.title: Targeting acute myeloid leukemia dependency on VCP-mediated DNA repair through a selective second-generation small-molecule inhibitor.
articles.titleZh: 通过选择性第二代小分子抑制剂，针对急性髓系白血病对 VCP 介导的 DNA 修复的依赖。
articles.authors: Roux B, Vaganay C, Vargas JD, Alexe G, Benaksas C, Pardieu B, Fenouille N, Ellegast JM, Malolepsza E, Ling F, Sodaro G, Ross L, Pikman Y, Conway AS, Tang Y, Wu T, Anderson DJ, Le Moigne R, Zhou HJ, Luciano F, Hartigan CR, Galinsky I, DeAngelo DJ, Stone RM, Auberger P, Schenone M, Carr SA, Guirouilh-Barbat J, Lopez B, Khaled M, Lage K, Hermine O, Hemann MT, Puissant A, Stegmaier K, Benajiba L.
articles.abstract: The development and survival of cancer cells require adaptive mechanisms to stress. Such adaptations can confer intrinsic vulnerabilities, enabling the selective targeting of cancer cells. Through a pooled in vivo short hairpin RNA (shRNA) screen, we identified the adenosine triphosphatase associated with diverse cellular activities (AAA-ATPase) valosin-containing protein (VCP) as a top stress-related vulnerability in acute myeloid leukemia (AML). We established that AML was the most responsive disease to chemical inhibition of VCP across a panel of 16 cancer types. The sensitivity to VCP inhibition of human AML cell lines, primary patient samples, and syngeneic and xenograft mouse models of AML was validated using VCP-directed shRNAs, overexpression of a dominant-negative VCP mutant, and chemical inhibition. By combining mass spectrometry-based analysis of the VCP interactome and phospho-signaling studies, we determined that VCP is important for ataxia telangiectasia mutated (ATM) kinase activation and subsequent DNA repair through homologous recombination in AML. A second-generation VCP inhibitor, CB-5339, was then developed and characterized. Efficacy and safety of CB-5339 were validated in multiple AML models, including syngeneic and patient-derived xenograft murine models. We further demonstrated that combining DNA-damaging agents, such as anthracyclines, with CB-5339 treatment synergizes to impair leukemic growth in an MLL-AF9-driven AML murine model. These studies support the clinical testing of CB-5339 as a single agent or in combination with standard-of-care DNA-damaging chemotherapy for the treatment of AML.
articles.abstractZh: 癌细胞的发育和生存需要适应压力的机制。这种适应可以赋予内在的脆弱性，从而能够选择性地靶向癌细胞。通过体内短发夹 RNA (shRNA) 筛选，我们发现与多种细胞活性相关的腺苷三磷酸酶 (AAA-ATPase) 含缬洛菌素蛋白 (VCP) 是急性髓系白血病 (AML) 中与应激相关的首要脆弱性。我们确定 AML 是 16 种癌症类型中对 VCP 化学抑制反应最敏感的疾病。使用VCP定向shRNA、显性失活VCP突变体的过度表达和化学抑制来验证人类AML细胞系、原代患者样本以及AML同基因和异种移植小鼠模型对VCP抑制的敏感性。通过结合基于质谱的 VCP 相互作用组分析和磷酸信号研究，我们确定 VCP 对于 AML 中共济失调毛细血管扩张突变 (ATM) 激酶激活和随后通过同源重组进行的 DNA 修复非常重要。随后开发并表征了第二代 VCP 抑制剂 CB-5339。 CB-5339 的功效和安全性

articles.title: Co-crystallization with diabodies: A case study for the introduction of synthetic symmetry.
articles.titleZh: 与双抗体共结晶：引入合成对称性的案例研究。
articles.authors: Chesterman C, Arnold E.
articles.abstract: This work presents a method for introducing synthetic symmetry into protein crystallization samples using an antibody fragment termed a diabody (Dab). These Dabs contain two target binding sites, and engineered disulfide bonds have been included to modulate Dab flexibility. The impacts of Dab engineering have been observed through assessment of thermal stability, small-angle X-ray scattering, and high-resolution crystal structures. Complexes between the engineered Dabs and HIV-1 reverse transcriptase (RT) bound to a high-affinity DNA aptamer were also generated to explore the capacity of engineered Dabs to enable the crystallization of bound target proteins. This strategy increased the crystallization hit frequency obtained for RT-aptamer, and the structure of a Dab-RT-aptamer complex was determined to 3.0-Å resolution.
